english_verse: But if the priest finds that the hair in the infected area hasn't turned white and that the sore is only skin deep and it is healing, he will tell you to stay away from everyone else for seven days.
translation_verse: Ama usaraaŋal yaa ká yii tikupin kaa bí ndulim poon ní kaa ŋmɔ́ ki kɔ́ tiwunnan poon, kaa tí pīiǹ fàaayee, usaraaŋal ń dū-u kí pìin̄ kudii u-baba iwiin iluli.

english_verse: On the seventh day the priest will examine you again, and if the infection is spreading, he will say, “This is leprosy—you are unclean.”
translation_verse: Iwiin iluli dal, usaraaŋal yaa fātìi kpēē-u ki ká yii an wāaǹee, usaraaŋal ń sòoǹ báà ŋma ń gbìl̄ yii udaan kɔ́ tijɔkɔndi. An sá dinyaŋgbandi buuŋŋu.

english_verse: However, if the infection hasn't spread and has begun to heal, and if only a scar remains, he will say, “Only a scar remains from the burn, and you are clean.”
translation_verse: Ama ndulimee yaa kaa wāaǹ ki gbíntì dibɔɔbaantiil ní kaa pīiǹ fàaayee, an sá ndulim fám ní. Usaraaŋal ń sòoǹ báà ŋma ń gbìl̄ yii udaan kaa kɔ́ tijɔkɔndi, an sá ŋŋmi buŋweeku.

english_verse: If you have a sore on your head or chin,
translation_verse: «Ŋween ŋubɔ yaa tɔ́ uninja àá unimpu ubɔ yil àá u-nyɔɔkpaalee,

english_verse: it must be examined by a priest. If the infection seems more than skin deep, and the hair in it has thinned out and lost its color, he will say, “This is leprosy—you are unclean.”
translation_verse: usaraaŋal ń kpèè ŋween gbanti. U yaa ká yii ŋweenee ŋmɔ́ ki kɔ́ tiwunnan poon ní tikuti bí ki sá kpalku kaa múkúee, usaraaŋal ń sòoǹ báà ŋma ń gbìl̄ yii udaan kɔ́ tijɔkɔndi. An sá kideeŋŋi kin sá dinyaŋgbandi ki tòó diyil àá dinyɔɔkpaalee.

english_verse: On the other hand, if he discovers that the itchy spot is only skin deep, but that the hair still isn't healthy, he will order you to stay away from everyone else for seven days.
translation_verse: Ama usaraaŋal yaa ká yii ŋweenee kaa ŋmɔ́ ki kɔ́ tiwunnan poon, ní tikuti tin bɔ̀ǹee kaa bí ki-poonee, ú dū-u kí pìin̄ kudii u-baba iwiin iluli.

english_verse: By that time, if the itch hasn't spread, if the hair seems healthy, and if the itch is only skin deep,
translation_verse: Iwiin iluli dalee, usaraaŋal ń fàtīí kpèè ŋweenee. U yaa ká yii ŋuaa wāaǹ, ní tikuti tin sá kpalkuee kaa bí ŋu-poon ní kaa ŋmɔ́ ki kɔ́ tiwunnan poonee,

english_verse: you must shave off the hair around the infection, but not those on it. Then the priest will tell you to stay away from everyone else for another seven days.
translation_verse: udaan ń kòol̀ u-yil kí gɔ́ntí laakin ŋween bée. Míǹ boonee usaraaŋal ń fàtīí dū-u kí pìin̄ kudii u-baba nliliitiim iwiin iluli.

english_verse: By that time, if the itch hasn't spread and seems no more than skin deep, he will say, “You are clean; now you must wash your clothes.”
translation_verse: Iwiin iluli dalee, usaraaŋal ń fàtīí kpèè ŋween gbanti. An yaa kaa wāaǹ, kaa ŋmɔ́ ki kɔ́ tiwunnan poonee, usaraaŋal ń sòoǹ báà ŋma ń gbìl̄ yii waa kɔ́ tijɔkɔndi. Ú pée fíntí u-wampeeŋkaati ní kí nyā tijɔkɔndin.

english_verse: Later, if the itch starts spreading, even though the hair is still healthy, the priest will say, “You are unclean.”
translation_verse: usaraaŋal ń tí fàtīí kpèè-u. U yaa ká yii kideeŋŋee wāaǹee, an kaa ti bàlifī ú nyàab̀ kí kpèè yii tikuti tin sá kpalkuee báaa an kpá, udaan kɔ́ tijɔkɔndi.

english_verse: If white spots break out on your skin,
translation_verse: «Uninja àá unimpu ubɔ wunti yaa lēē ki ŋá aliki aliki ki pīiǹee,

english_verse: but the priest discovers that it is only a rash, he will say, “You are clean.”
translation_verse: usaraaŋal ń kpèè-u. Alikee yaa pīiǹ fàaayee, mimmee an sá ncabiyaamu. Udaan kaa kɔ́ tijɔkɔndi.

english_verse: If you become bald on any part of your head, you are still clean.
translation_verse: U-yigbeel yaa kaa cáá tiyikpiti ní ki jɔ̀m̀ee, mimmee un yigbeel ŋātèe dee, waa kɔ́ tijɔkɔndi.

english_verse: But if a priest discovers that a reddish-white sore has broken out on the bald spot and looks like leprosy, he will say,
translation_verse: Usaraaŋal ń kpèè-u. U yaa ká yii mbuun ŋun tɔ́ u-yil kansikin àá u-yigbeel laakin ŋātèe pīiǹ fàaa ki náań nì dinyaŋgbandee,

english_verse: If you ever have leprosy, you must tear your clothes, leave your hair uncombed, cover the lower part of your face, and go around shouting, “I'm unclean! I'm unclean!”
translation_verse: «Un būǹ dinyaŋgbandee máaǹ kí pèen̄ tiwan tin cátèe, kí taa ti càatī u-yil, kí bìin̄ u-nyɔɔkuti pu, ní kí nīn kūuntí ki lì yii: <M kɔ́ tijɔkɔndeeee! M kɔ́ tijɔkɔndi!>

english_verse: As long as you have the disease, you are unclean and must live alone outside the camp.
translation_verse: Udaan làá nīn bí tijɔkɔndin míǹ kí nīn cí ŋyunti ŋun dinyaŋgbandi buuŋyi làá dóóyee. U làá nīn kóò u-baba, dinaapaal kpaanceetiŋu. Dinyaŋgbandi din tòó tiwampeeŋkaal puee marab

english_verse: he will tell you to wash the clothing or leather and put it aside for another seven days,
translation_verse: ú yàntī bí fíntí tiwan tin pu kudaaŋŋuee kēe, ní ú cáá síiń dibalin nliliitiim iwiin iluli.

english_verse: after which he will examine it again. If the spot hasn't spread, but is still greenish or reddish, the clothing or leather is unclean and must be burned.
translation_verse: Bi nín fíntì míǹ ki dóòyee ní usaraaŋal ń fàtīí kpèè. U yaa ká yii kudaaŋŋuee pée gbíntìi bí kii ku nín nìn bí puee, báà ku yaa kaa lālim̀aaa, tiwanee kɔ́ tijɔkɔndi. Bí cáá-tì kí wà ŋŋmi, di sá yii tiwanee poon àá ti-boon bíil̀.

english_verse: Later, if the spot reappears elsewhere on the clothing or the leather, you must burn it.
translation_verse: Ama boonee, kudaaŋŋuee yaa fātìi nyáń ki kā tiwampeeŋkaalee pu, àá satee pu, àá tiŋgiliisee pu, àá ŋgban wantee puee, an sá bí wà-tì ŋŋmi ní, kun puee dinyaŋgbandi di bíi tòó-tì.

english_verse: Even if the spot completely disappears after being washed, it must be washed again before it is clean.
translation_verse: «Ama an yaa sá tiwampeeŋkaal, àá sata, àá tiŋgiliisi, àá ŋgban wanti tin bi fíntì ní kudaaŋŋuee wáŋkèe, bí fàtīí fíntí-tì nliliitiim ní tí nyā tijɔkɔndin.»

english_verse: These are the rules for deciding if clothing is clean or unclean after a spot appears on it.
translation_verse: Mara un bi nìn síiǹ kí ŋmā kí béé yii tiwampeeŋkaal, àá sata, àá tiŋgiliisi, àá ŋgban wanti tin pu kudaaŋŋu bée kɔ́ tijɔkɔndaaa, taa kɔ́ee dee.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses to say to the people:
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan sòon̄ nì Mooyiisi ki bí yii:

english_verse: kilograms of your finest flour mixed with oil.
translation_verse: ní úǹ ń nyā dinaapaal kpaanceetiŋu kí kpèè-u. Unyaŋgbantee yaa lafun pɔ́ɔkèe,

english_verse: he will order someone to bring out two live birds that are acceptable for sacrifice, together with a stick of cedar wood, a piece of red yarn, and a branch from a hyssop plant.
translation_verse: ní usaraaŋal ń yàntī bí cáań ubunlee yil pu nnɔmbiyaamu mun ŋān̄ bí dūú ŋá saraayee muli nì mu-nimbiliŋ nì busubu bun bi yíì yii seediree dɔŋu nì gulfaman nì kifaapibiki kin bi yíì isɔpee.

english_verse: The priest will order someone to kill one of the birds over a clay pot of spring water.
translation_verse: Usaraaŋal ń yàntī bí làntì nnɔmbiyaamuee kiba kí dū ki-fatikuu kí ŋá ditansambil din poon nnyimbul nnyim kēe.

english_verse: Then he will dip the other bird, the cedar, the red yarn, and the hyssop in the blood of the dead bird.
translation_verse: Ní ú yòon̄ kinɔmbiki kin kíǹee nì seedir dɔŋuee nì gulfamanee nì isɔpi faapibikee kí dūú bɔ̄ kinɔmbiki kin bi lāntèe fatikuun.

english_verse: Next, he will sprinkle you seven times with the blood and say, “You are now clean.” Finally, he will release the bird and let it fly away.
translation_verse: Niinee ní ú dū fatikuee kí yàaǹ un bi bíi ŋáań saraa kí fíntí u-jɔkɔntee pu ŋfunyɔm miluli. Míǹ boonee ní ú sòoǹ báà ŋma ń gbìl̄ yii udaan nyáń tijɔkɔndin ní kí gíiǹ kinɔmbiki kin baa kūūyee kí líí tisati watil pú.

english_verse: After this you must wash your clothes, shave your entire body, and take a bath before you are completely clean. You may move back into camp, but you must not enter your tent for seven days.
translation_verse: Un bi ŋá saraa ki fíntì u-jɔkɔntee máaǹ kí fíntí u-wampeeŋkaati, kí kòol̀ u-wunti kɔkɔ pu kuti, kí fàl̀ ní kí nín nyā tijɔkɔndin. Míǹ boonee, u ŋūǹ kí gítí dinaapaal pu, ama waa nín máaǹ kí kɔ́ u-tantiu poon kí cáá sāā iwiin iluli ní.

english_verse: Then you must once again shave your head, face, and eyebrows, as well as the hair on the rest of your body. Finally, wash your clothes and take a bath, and you will be completely clean.
translation_verse: Iwiin iluli dalee ní ú kòol̀ u-wunti kɔkɔ pu kuti, an dàkà yii u-yikpiti nì u-nyimpul nì u-niŋgbuŋkooŋyi nì tikuti tin pée bí u-wunti puee, ní kí fíntí u-wampeeŋkaati, kí fàl̀ ní kí nín nyā tijɔkɔndin.

english_verse: On the eighth day you must bring to the priest two rams and a year-old female lamb that have nothing wrong with them; also bring
translation_verse: «Iwiin inii dalee, ú cáań apibil ŋin laaba kaa wɔ̀b̄ee ali nì dibindi diba pisaliu un laaba kaa wɔ̀b̄ee, nì ŋyim min bi dū ŋkpam ki búuńee kiiloobi biwa nì ŋkpam liitiri dijandi.

english_verse: Then the priest will present you and your offerings to me at the entrance to my sacred tent.
translation_verse: Usaraaŋal un bíi ŋáań saraa gbantee ń dū un jɔkɔnti bi bíi fíntée nì saraabi bin u cáańee kɔkɔ kí síiń circir kɔŋkooŋŋu punyɔkɔki nyɔkɔpu.

english_verse: There he will offer one of the rams, together with the oil, as a sacrifice to make things right. He will also lift them up to show that they are dedicated to me.
translation_verse: Ú yòon̄ apibilee kansikin din bi làá dūú ŋá dibɔkpil saraauee nì ŋkpam liitiri dijandee yilpu kí fíiǹ fíiǹ ti-Dindaan nimbiin.

english_verse: This sacrifice is very holy. It belongs to the priest and must be killed in the same place where animals are killed as sacrifices for sins and as sacrifices to please me.

english_verse: Then the community of Israel will bring you a ram and two goats, both of them males. The goats are to be used as sacrifices for sin, and the ram is to be used as a sacrifice to please me.
translation_verse: Míǹ boonee ní Isirayeel yab ń tīī-u iŋɔjaa ili ú dūú ŋá ikpiti pɔ̄tam saraau ní kí tīī-u upìja ubɔ ú dūú ŋá saraawɔkaa.

english_verse: Aaron, you must offer the bull as a sacrifice of forgiveness for your own sins and for the sins of your family.
translation_verse: «Aarɔn ń dū dinabil din u làá dūú ŋá úǹ u-ba kpitii pɔ̄tam saraauee kí ŋá saraa ní kí ŋá dikoobil nín bālifì puee kí fíntí u-kpitii nì u-dicaŋku yai.

english_verse: Then you will lead the two goats into my presence at the front of the sacred tent,
translation_verse: U yaa ŋá míǹ ki dóòyee ní ú cáań iŋɔjaa ilee ti-Dindaan nimbiin circir kɔŋkooŋŋu punyɔkɔki nyɔkɔpu.

english_verse: where I will show you which goat will be sacrificed to me and which one will be sent into the desert to the demon Azazel.
translation_verse: Ú tɔ̄ kasi iŋoobuee liitil pu kí béé un làá nīn sá ti-Dindaan yɔuee nì un làá nīn sá Asaseel yɔuee.

english_verse: After you offer the first goat as a sacrifice for sin,
translation_verse: Ní Aarɔn ń dū uŋoobu un bi tɔ́ kasi ki lēē yii u sá ti-Dindaan yɔuee kí ŋá ikpiti pɔ̄tam saraau.

english_verse: the other one must be presented to me alive, before you send it into the desert to take away the sins of the people.
translation_verse: Ama Asaseel ŋoobuuee, úǹ ń nīn wāĺ ní bí cáań-u ti-Dindaan nimbiin kí ŋá dikoobil nín bālifì puee kí fíntí samaa kpitii, ní kí jà-u kí tɔ̄ kuteeun kí tīī Asaseel.

english_verse: You must offer the bull as a sacrifice to ask forgiveness for your own sins and for the sins of your family.
translation_verse: «Niinee ní Aarɔn ń yòon̄ dinabil din u làá dūú ŋá u-kpitii pɔ̄tam saraauee, ní kí ŋá dikoobil nín bālifì puee kí fíntí u-kpitii nì u-dicaŋku yai. Ú làntì dinabilee kí ŋá úǹ u-ba kpitii pɔ̄tam saraau.

english_verse: Then you will take a fire pan of live coals from the bronze altar, together with two handfuls of finely ground incense, into the most holy place.
translation_verse: Ú mɔ́fí amɔsiŋkoon ŋin bí nsaraafan pu circir kɔŋkooŋŋunee kí ŋá kisambiki kin poon bi tùutī talaaluee. Ú yáfí talaalu yim aŋaŋkul ali ní kí cáá kɔkɔ kí kɔ́ǹ circir páaa laŋki, ŋŋaapìtikaa boon.

english_verse: There you will present them to me by placing the incense on the coals, so that the place of mercy will be covered with a cloud of smoke. Do this, or you will die right there!
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan nimbiin niinee ní Aarɔn ń dū talaaluee kí páká amɔsiŋkoonee pu ní talaaluee nyiim ń yīkì kí bìin̄ dipoondi taŋkpapilinti dakaau nì u-bìil pu, án nín làá ŋá pu ú taa kpúee.

english_verse: Next, use a finger to sprinkle some of the blood on the place of mercy, which is on the lid of the sacred chest; then sprinkle blood seven times in front of the chest.
translation_verse: U yaa ŋá míǹ ki dóòyee ní ú dū u-ŋambiki kí sēē dinabilee fatikuu kí dūú yàaǹ Dipoondi dakaau bìil pu, ŋwìiń nyalaŋki pú, ŋfunyɔm miluli, ní kí yàaǹ dakaayee nyɔkɔpu ŋfunyɔm miluli.

english_verse: Aaron, you must next sacrifice the goat for the sins of the people, and you must sprinkle its blood inside the most holy place, just as you did with the blood of the bull.
translation_verse: Míǹ boonee ní ú làntì uŋɔja un u làá dūú ŋá samaa kɔkɔ kpitii pɔ̄tam saraauee. Ú yòon̄ u-fatikuu kí cáá kɔ́ǹ circir páaa laŋki, ŋŋaapìtikaa boon. Ú dū fatiku gbanti kí ŋá kii u nín bàà pée dū dinabilee fatikuu ki ŋá pu ki dūu yāaǹ Dipoondi dakaau bìil pu nì dakaayee nyɔkɔpu puee.

english_verse: By doing this, you will take away the sins that make both the most holy place and the people of Israel unclean. Do the same for the sacred tent, which is here among the people.
translation_verse: Aarɔn nín máaǹ kí ŋá pu kí fíntí circir páaa laŋki kí nyāntí Isirayeel yab yìntitam nì bi-kpitii nín kɔ́ǹ circir páaa laŋki gbanti tijɔkɔndi tin poonee dee. Ú ŋá dikpafindi tantiu un bí bi-cee bi-jɔkɔnti kansikinee míǹ mbaantiim.

english_verse: After leaving the tent, you will purify the bronze altar by smearing each of its four corners with some of the blood from the bull and from the goat.
translation_verse: Míǹ boonee ní ú nyānní circir kɔŋkooŋŋun kí dāan̄ nsaraafan ŋun bí circir kɔŋkooŋŋu nyɔkɔpuee cee, ní kí ŋá dikoobil nín bālifì puee kí nyāntí-ŋu tijɔkɔndin, ní kí jōō dinabilee fatikuu nì uŋɔjee fatikuu kí dūú ŋmìtī nsaraafan yiŋyi kɔkɔ pu kí màntīí tū.

english_verse: Use a finger to sprinkle the altar seven times with the blood, and it will be completely clean from the sins of the people.
translation_verse: U yaa ŋá míǹ ki dóòyee ní ú dū u-ŋambiki kí sēē fatikuee kí yàaǹ nsaraafan pu ŋfunyɔm miluli, kí fíntí-ŋu kí nyāntí Isirayeel yab jɔkɔntin, kí ŋá-ŋu circir.

english_verse: After you have purified the most holy place, the sacred tent, and the bronze altar, you must bring the live goat to the front of the tent.
translation_verse: «Aarɔn yaa ŋá saraabi ki nyántì circir páaa laŋki nì dikpafindi tantiu jaŋŋi ŋin kíǹee nì nsaraafan kɔkɔ tijɔkɔndin ki dóòyee ní ú dàtī Asaseel ŋɔjauee nì u-nimbiliŋ kí cáań ti-Dindaan nimbiin.

english_verse: There you will lay your hands on its head, while confessing every sin the people have committed, and you will appoint someone to lead the goat into the desert, so that it can take away their sins.
translation_verse: Niinee ní Aarɔn ń dū u-ŋalii liitil kí páań uŋɔjee yil pu ní kí bìitī Isirayeel yab tuŋkpitiŋ nì bi-yìntitam nì bi-kpitii pu kí dūú túń uŋɔjee pu, ní kí lēē unil ubɔ ń péetí-u kí tɔ̄ kupɔɔun.

english_verse: Finally, this goat that carries the heavy burden of Israel's sins must be released deep in the desert.
translation_verse: Mimmee, uŋɔjee kpáaǹ bi-kpitii kɔkɔ ki cáa búntì laakin ubɔ kaa kóòyee dee. «Bi nín péetì uŋɔjee ki tɔ́ kupɔɔun míǹ ki dóòyee,

english_verse: Aaron, after this you must go inside the sacred tent, take a bath, put on your regular priestly clothes, and leave there the clothes you put on before entering the most holy place. Then you will come out and offer sacrifices to please me and sacrifices for your sins and for the sins of the people.
translation_verse: Ú yūĺ mpaan ŋun bí circiree pu kí fàl̀ ní kí fàtīí gíiǹ u-wampeeŋkaati kí pèen̄. Míǹ boonee ní ú nyānní kí ŋá u-saraawɔkaau nì samaa kɔkɔ yɔu, ní kí ŋá dikoobil nín bālifì puee kí fíntí úǹ u-ba kpitii nì samaa kpitii.

english_verse: The fat from these sacrifices for sin must be sent up in smoke on the bronze altar.
translation_verse: Míǹ boonee ní ú dū tiwaŋkuti tin bi dūu ŋá ikpiti pɔ̄tam saraauee kpam kí wà ŋŋmi nsaraafan pu.

english_verse: The one who led the goat into the desert and sent it off to the demon Azazel must take a bath and wash his clothes before coming back into camp.
translation_verse: «Unil un péetì Asaseel ŋɔjau ki tɔ́ kupɔɔunee máaǹ kí fíntí u-wampeeŋkaati, kí fàl̀, ní kí nín kɔ́ dinaapaalin.

english_verse: The remains of the bull and the goat whose blood was taken into the most holy place must be taken outside the camp and burned.
translation_verse: Unaja nì uŋɔja in bi dūu ŋá ikpiti pɔ̄tam saraau, ki dū i-fatikuu ki kɔ́ǹ circir páaa laŋki ki fíntì tijɔkɔndee, bí cáá i-gbaŋyi nì i-nanti nì i-nai kí nyāntí dinaapaal kpaanceetiŋu kí wà ŋŋmi.

english_verse: And whoever does this must take a bath and change clothes before coming back into camp. The Lord told Moses to say to the people:
translation_verse: Unil un dū an wantee ki wùn̄ ŋŋmee ń fíntí u-wampeeŋkaati, kí fàl̀, ní kí nín kɔ́ dinaapaalin.

english_verse: On the tenth day of the seventh month of each year, you must go without eating to show sorrow for your sins, and no one, including foreigners who live among you, is allowed to work.
translation_verse: «Tin bí nee ń nīn sá-ni dibɔkpaal din làá nīn bí ki cá jaanjaanee: uŋmaluluúti, iwiin saalaa dalee, an yaa sá kitindambikeeee, unicaan un dɔ́miń ki kóò ni-pueeyeeee, ni-kɔkɔ ń bóob́ kinyɔkɔ kí taa tɔ̄ ditundi báà diba.

english_verse: This is the day on which the sacrifice for the forgiveness of your sins will be made in my presence,
translation_verse: Di sá yii ŋwiin gbanti ní bi ŋáań saraabi kí fíntí-ni kí nyāntí ni-jɔkɔntin ní kpántí circirdambi ti-Dindaan nimbiin.

english_verse: and from now on, it must be celebrated each year. Go without eating and make this a day of complete rest just like the Sabbath.
translation_verse: Ní dū ŋwiin gbanti kí ŋá diŋuŋfil nì dinyɔɔboobil wiiŋŋu. Án nīn sá dibɔkpaal din làá nīn bí ki cá jaanjaanee.

english_verse: The high priest must offer the sacrifices for cleansing from sin, while wearing the sacred linen clothes.
translation_verse: «Usaraaŋal un bi bātì ŋkpam ki sītì u-yil pu ki dū-u ki sú ti-Dindaan u fōō u-baa yil ki kpántì usaraaŋakpilee di dāa ŋáań ikpiti pɔ̄tam saraau nee. U dāa pèentí ŋŋaapiin saraaŋabɔkutiŋ

english_verse: He will offer these sacrifices for the most holy place, the sacred tent, the bronze altar, all the priests, and for the whole community.
translation_verse: ní kí ŋá saraabi kí fíntí circir páaa laŋki nì dikpafindi tantiu jaŋŋi ŋin kíǹee nì nsaraafan nì bisaraaŋaliibi nì samaa kɔkɔ kí nyāntí tijɔkɔndin.

english_verse: You must celebrate this day each year—it is the Great Day of Forgiveness for all the sins of the people of Israel. Moses did exactly as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: «Án nīn sá-ni dibɔkpaal din làá nīn bí ki cá jaanjaanee. Ní nīn ŋáań saraabi dibindi poonee diba ki fíntí Isirayeel yab kpitii kɔkɔ.» Ní Aarɔn ŋá kii ti-Dindaan nín tīī Mooyiisi mara puee.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan bí Mooyiisi yii:

english_verse: to tell Aaron, his sons, and everyone else in Israel:
translation_verse: «Tùkù Aarɔn nì u-jipɔmbi nì Isirayeel yab kɔkɔ yii marab bin man ni-Dindaan yóoǹee sèé:

english_verse: Whenever you kill any of your cattle, sheep, or goats as sacrifices to me, you must do it at the entrance to the sacred tent. If you don't, you will be guilty of pouring out blood, and you will no longer belong to the community of Israel.
translation_verse: ní kaa cáań-u circir kɔŋkooŋŋu punyɔkɔki nyɔkɔpu kí ŋá saraa kí tīī u-Dindaanee, bi làá dāá bàlifì udaan fatiku gbanti pɔndi. Kii u nín kūū tiwan tin cáá kufoou ki nyántì fatiku ki fée puee, bí nyāntí-u Isirayeel nibul kansikin.

english_verse: but in front of the sacred tent. Then a priest can splatter its blood against the bronze altar and send its fat up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Niinee ní usaraaŋal ń dū fatikuee kí yàaǹ nsaraafan ŋun bí circir kɔŋkooŋŋu nyɔkɔpuee pu, ní kí dū saraayee kpam kí wà ŋŋmi nsaraafanee pu, ní u-sɔnsɔfiŋu ń sɔ̀ŋkì ti-Dindaan pɔbil.

english_verse: Remember! No one in Israel, including foreigners, is to offer a sacrifice anywhere
translation_verse: «Á gíti tùkù-bi yii: Isirayeel yab ubɔ àá binicambi bin kóò bi-kansikinee ubɔ yaa là kí ŋá saraawɔkaa àá saraa un ní an yaa pée sée,

english_verse: except at the entrance to the sacred tent. If you do, you will no longer belong to my people. Do Not Eat Blood The Lord said:
translation_verse: ní kaa cáań dikpafindi tantiu punyɔkɔki nyɔkɔpu kí ŋá saraa kí tīī ti-Dindaanee, bí nyāntí udaan Isirayeel nibul kansikin.»

english_verse: I will turn against any of my people who eat blood. This also includes any foreigners living among you.
translation_verse: «Isirayeel yab ubɔ àá binicambi bin kóò bi-kansikinee ubɔ yaa ŋmɔ́ fatikuee, m làá fàtī m-boon kí tīī udaan ní kí nyāntí-u Isirayeel nibul kansikin.

english_verse: Life is in the blood, and I have given you the blood of animals to sacrifice in place of your own.
translation_verse: Di sá yii kun kamaa cáá kufoouee maŋfal kā fatikun ní, ní man dūu tīī án fíntí ni-kpitii nsaraafan pu. Tiŋman puee fatiku yàntī ní ká ni-kpitii pɔ̄tam, kun puee u-ni ní dimaŋfal bí.

english_verse: Even if you should hunt and kill a bird or an animal, you must drain out the blood and cover it with soil.
translation_verse: «Isirayeel yab kansikin ubɔ àá binicambi bin kóò bi-kansikinee ubɔ yaa cūtì kukpɔŋu ní ki kūū upeel un baa kòóyee àá kinɔmbiki kin baa kòóyee, ú yàntī upeelee àá kinɔmbikee fatikuu ń nyā kí fá kitiŋ ní ú dū ntam kí bìin̄ fatikuee pu.

english_verse: The life of every living creature is in its blood. That's why I have forbidden you to eat blood and why I have warned you that anyone who does will no longer belong to my people.
translation_verse: Di sá yii kun pée cáá kufoouee maŋfal kā ku-fatikuun ní. An pu ní m bí nimbi Isirayeel yab yii: <Ní taa ŋmɔ́ báà kuwaŋkuluu kubɔ fatikuu, di sá yii ku-fatikuu di sá ku-maŋfal.> Un yaa ŋmɔ́ fatikuee, bí nyāntí-u Isirayeel nibul kansikin.

english_verse: If you happen to find a dead animal and eat it, you must take a bath and wash your clothes, but you are still unclean until evening.
translation_verse: «Kitindambiki àá unicaan yaa ŋmɔ́ dipeekpil àá upeel un an cúúyee, u máaǹ kí fíntí u-wampeeŋkaati, kí fàl̀, ní ki làá nīn bí tijɔkɔndin kí cáá sāā kujoou. Míǹ boonee ní ú nín nyā tijɔkɔndin.

english_verse: If you don't take a bath, you will suffer for what you did wrong.
translation_verse: Ama udaan yaa kaa fíntì u-wampeeŋkaati, kaa fùl̄ muee, udaan ŋá ikpiti ki fōō dibɔkpil.»

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan bí Mooyiisi yii:

english_verse: to tell the people of Israel: I am the Lord your God!
translation_verse: «Tùkù Isirayeel yab yii man di sá ni-Dindaan, ni-Nimbɔtiu.

english_verse: So don't follow the customs of Egypt where you used to live or those of Canaan where I am bringing you.
translation_verse: Naa máaǹ kí nīn ŋáań kii Eejipiti tiŋki kin poon ni nìn kóòyee yab nín nìn ŋáań puee, kaa tí máaǹ kí nīn ŋáań kii Kanaan tiŋki kin poon m cáǹ-ni nee yab nín ŋáań puee. Naa máaǹ kí fōō bi-bimbim.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and you must obey my teachings.
translation_verse: Nín̄ tɔ́maan m-koobiliŋ kí nīn ŋúb́ m-bɔkpaaŋi. Man di sá ni-Dindaan, ni-Nimbɔtiu.

english_verse: Obey them and you will live. I am the Lord.
translation_verse: «Nín̄ ŋúb́maan m-bɔkpaaŋi nì m-koobiliŋ. Un yaa ŋáań min marab gbanti lēe di ŋmátí. Man di sá ni-Dindaan.

english_verse: Don't have sex with any of your close relatives,
translation_verse: «Ni-kansikin ubɔ ń taa dòon̄ nì unimpu u nì un pēē mmaalee. Man di sá ni-Dindaan.

english_verse: And don't disgrace him by having sex with any of his other wives.
translation_verse: «Aa máaǹ kí dòon̄ nì a-baa nimpoobi kansikin báà ubɔ. A yaa ŋá mimmee a kɔ́ǹ a-baa icoo dee.

english_verse: or a sister of your father or mother.
translation_verse: «Aa máaǹ kí dòon̄ nì a-na naal àá u-maan, kun puee u nì a-na pēē ní.

english_verse: Don't disgrace your uncle by having sex with his wife.
translation_verse: «Aa máaǹ kí kɔ́ǹ a-baa naal àá u-maan icoo kí dòon̄ nì u-nimpuu, kun puee a-na dee.

english_verse: And don't have sex with the daughter or granddaughter of any woman that you have earlier had sex with. You will be having sex with her closest relatives, and that would make you unclean.
translation_verse: «Aa máaǹ kí dòon̄ nì unimpu nì u-bisal àá u-jipɔɔn bisal àá u-bisal bisal, kun puee an sá u-maaliŋu poon biyaamu ní ki sá ajɔkɔntuun.

english_verse: As long as your wife is alive, don't cause trouble for her by taking one of her sisters as a second wife.
translation_verse: «Aa máaǹ kí cáá a-nimpuu maan àá u-naal kí kūtì u-pu ŋyunti ŋun ní u dáá bí dimaŋfalinee. A yaa ŋá mimmee, a náań ipoompoon ki bíl̀ bi-kansikin dee.

english_verse: When a woman is having her monthly period, she is unclean, so don't have sex with her.
translation_verse: «Aa máaǹ kí dòon̄ nì unimpu ŋyunti ŋun ní u ká u-ba ki bí tijɔkɔndinee.

english_verse: Don't have sex with another man's wife—that would make you unclean.
translation_verse: «Aa máaǹ kí dòon̄ nì a-juti nimpuu, di sá yii án làá kɔ́ǹ-si tijɔkɔndi.

english_verse: Don't sacrifice your children on the altar fires to the god Molech. I am the Lord your God, and that would disgrace me.
translation_verse: «Aa máaǹ kí dū a-biyaamu kansikin kiba kí wà ŋŋmi kí ŋá saraa kí tīī diwaal Mooleeki kí kpèè man ni-Nimbɔtiu yindi fám. Man di sá ni-Dindaan.

english_verse: It is disgusting for a man to have sex with another man.
translation_verse: «Aa máaǹ kí dòon̄ nì a-ninjajuti kii bi nín dɔ̀ nì unimpu puee. An sá ntimbiil ní.

english_verse: Don't make yourselves unclean by any of these disgusting practices of those nations that I am forcing out of the land for you. They made themselves
translation_verse: «Ní taa yàntī atuŋkpiti nee kansikin báà diba ń kɔ́ǹ-ni tijɔkɔndi. Di sá yii atuŋkpiti gbanti di kɔ́ǹ atimbun ŋin nib m làá jà ni-nyɔkɔpu kí fōō bi-timmu kí tīī-ni nee tijɔkɔndi.

english_verse: and the land so unclean, that I punished the land because of their sins, and I made it vomit them up.
translation_verse: Kitiŋ kɔkɔ kɔ́ tijɔkɔndi ní m làá dáaĺ ki-tafal binib bin kóò ki-puee kpitii pu, ní kitiŋee ń wùliŋkì ki-nib kí fá.

english_verse: Now don't do these sickening things that make the land filthy. Instead, obey my laws and teachings.
translation_verse: Di sá yii ntimbiil tuuŋŋi gbanti ní binib bin péé péé ki kāl̀ kitiŋ gbantin ní nimbi dāa nín bāańee ŋá ní ki yāntì kì kɔ́ tijɔkɔndi.

english_verse: Then the land won't become sick of you and vomit you up, just as it did them.
translation_verse: Ní taa ti kɔ́ǹ-kì tijɔkɔndi, án nín làá ŋá pu kí taa wùliŋkì-ni kí fá kii kì nín nìn wūliŋkì bin līntiǹ-nee ki fá puee.

english_verse: If any of you do these vulgar, disgusting things, you will be unclean and no longer belong to my people. I am the Lord your God, and I forbid you to follow their sickening way of life.
translation_verse: «Nín̄ ŋúb́maan tibɔti tin m kpáafì-ni nee kí taa ŋá ntimbiil tuuŋŋi ŋin bi nìn ŋáań ki wāatì ní nimbi nín bāańee, kí taa yàntī an tuuŋŋee ń kɔ́ǹ-ni tijɔkɔndi. Man di sá ni-Dindaan, ni-Nimbɔtiu.»

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan bí Mooyiisi

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: I am the Lord your God. I am holy, and you must be holy too!
translation_verse: ń tùkù Isirayeel yab kɔkɔ yii: «Nín̄ bímaan circir, kun puee man, ni-Dindaan, ni-Nimbɔtiu bí circir ní!

english_verse: Respect your father and your mother, honor the Sabbath, and don't make idols or images. I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: «Ní taa tòotī awaa, kí taa dū tikúti kí dùntī kí mɔ́ɔ́ awaa. Man di sá ni-Dindaan, ni-Nimbɔtiu.

english_verse: When you offer a sacrifice to ask my blessing, be sure to follow my instructions.
translation_verse: «Ni yaa bíi ŋáań mpèé saraau kí tīī-mee, nóómaan mara nín sá puee ní ḿ fōō.

english_verse: You may eat the meat either on the day of the sacrifice or on the next day, but you must burn anything left over on the third day.
translation_verse: Ní ŋmɔ́ saraa gbanti nanti yaadal wiiŋŋu nì kutaa yaa wúntèe. Ama tinan gbanti yaa kíǹ winta dalee, bí cáá wà ŋŋmi.

english_verse: If you eat any of it on the third day, the sacrifice will be disgusting to me, and I will reject it.
translation_verse: Ubɔ yaa ŋmɔ́ saraa gbanti nanti winta dalee, an kɔ́ tijɔkɔndi. Maa làá fōō saraa gbanti.

english_verse: In fact, you will be punished for not respecting what I say is holy, and you will no longer belong to the community of Israel.
translation_verse: Un di yaa ŋmɔ́ tinan gbanti winta dalee, udaan ŋá ikpiti ki fōō dibɔkpil, kun puee u kpēē kun bi dūu sú-mee fám. Bí nyāntí udaan Isirayeel nibul kansikin.

english_verse: When you harvest your grain, always leave some of it standing along the edges of your fields and don't pick up what falls on the ground.
translation_verse: «Ni yaa láa bíi cēē ni-kpaajintee, ní taa láa cā kí tin bà ŋkpaabuku, kí taa fàtīí lūlifì ifin in pu ni súntèe.

english_verse: Don't strip your grapevines clean or gather the grapes that fall off the vines. Leave them for the poor and for those foreigners who live among you. I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Ní taa fàtīí gítí ni-boon kí kìtī fiinyi subiliŋ ŋin pu ni jítèe, kí taa tòò ŋin gbátì ki dɔ̄ kitiŋee. Ní yàntī ŋíǹ bifalaadambi nì binicambi ń lūlifì. Man di sá ni-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu.

english_verse: Do not steal or tell lies or cheat others.
translation_verse: «Ní taa yɔ̀, kí taa mɔ̄ntì, kí taa mùul̀ ni-juti.

english_verse: Do not misuse my name by making promises you don't intend to keep. I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Ní taa pùtī m-yindi kí bìin̄ ni-nyimɔŋyi pu. Ni yaa ŋá mimmee, ni kpēē man ni-Nimbɔtiu yindi fám dee. Man di sá ni-Dindaan.

english_verse: Do not steal anything or cheat anyone, and don't fail to pay your workers at the end of each day.
translation_verse: «Ní taa mùul̀ ni-juti, kí taa yɔ̀-u. Ní taa yàntī upaadaan nimbiliŋ ń dòon̄ ni-cee kutaa ń wúntí naa pàn̄-u.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and I command you not to make fun of the deaf or to cause a blind person to stumble.
translation_verse: Ní taa sìì utafakpaafu, kí taa dū tiba kí làkan̄ ujɔfu saŋŋu pu, ama ní fàŋkì man ni-Nimbɔtiu. Man di sá ni-Dindaan.

english_verse: Don't be a gossip, but never hesitate to speak up in court, especially if your testimony can save someone's life.
translation_verse: Ní taa cáá ni-nabiyaamu disambiil. Ní taa lēē nnyimɔn seerau ni-nabiki pu bí kpɔ̀-u. Man di sá ni-Dindaan.

english_verse: Don't hold grudges. On the other hand, it's wrong not to correct someone who needs correcting.
translation_verse: «Ní taa nín̄ ná ni-nabiyaamu ni-pɔbilin. Ama ní sòoǹ ibaamɔn kí tùkù ni-nabiki kin yaa yīntiǹ-nee, án nín làá ŋá pu u-puee ní taa ŋá ikpitee.

english_verse: Don't be angry or try to take revenge. I am the Lord, and I command you to love others as much as you love yourself.
translation_verse: Ní taa tɔ̀ ipɔntoon, kí taa dū ni-nabiyaamu kí ŋá ni-poon. Ní nīn néeḿmaan ni-jutiibi kii nimbi ni-bee. Man di sá ni-Dindaan.

english_verse: Breed your livestock animals only with animals of the same kind, and don't plant two kinds of seed in the same field or wear clothes made of different kinds of material.
translation_verse: «Nín̄ ŋúb́maan m-bɔkpaaŋi nee. Ní taa dū tiwaŋkuti tin buluku kaa pēēyee uja nì usal kí kpāfì tí jɔ̄m̀ tɔb, kí taa bɔ̄l̀ ni-kpaabun iwambool ili in kaa pēēyee, kí taa pèen̄ sata un bi dū gulfab bin bí bi-ba bi-ba ki lùn̄ee.

english_verse: If a man has sex with a slave woman who is promised in marriage to someone else, he must pay a fine, but they are not to be put to death. After all, she was still a slave at the time.
translation_verse: «Usapɔɔn yaa sá uyumbu ní ki cáá bɔɔn ní baa láá fātìi dá-u ki líì àá ki nyántì-u kuyuŋun ní uninja ubɔ dōoǹ nì uee, bí gíí udaan dipɔndi ú pà. Ama bí taa kpɔ̀-bi, di sá yii usapɔɔnee dáá gbíntìi sá uyumbu.

english_verse: The man must bring a ram to the entrance of the sacred tent and give it to a priest, who will then offer it as a sacrifice to me, so the man's sins will be forgiven.
translation_verse: Usaraaŋal ń dū upìjee kí ŋá dikoobil nín bālifì puee dibɔkpil daan pu m-nimbiin, ikpiti in ní u ŋée pu ní ú ká u-kpitii pɔ̄tam.

english_verse: After you enter the land, you will plant fruit trees, but you are not to eat any fruit from them for the first three years.
translation_verse: «Ni yaa láa kɔ́ Kanaan tiŋkin ní ki yaa cóoǹ isufi in lòoǹ abil ŋin bi ŋmóòyee kɔkɔ nì i-bulukuee, asubil gbanti ń nīn sá ni-cee kii ŋin kɔ́ tijɔkɔndee abin ata, ní taa ŋmɔ́-ŋi.

english_verse: In the fourth year the fruit must be set apart, as an expression of thanks
translation_verse: Dibinnanaatiil poonee, ní dū isufee biliŋ kí sú man ni-Dindaan nì ifaal poon.

english_verse: to me, the Lord God. Do this, and in the fifth year, those trees will produce an abundant harvest of fruit for you to eat.
translation_verse: Dibiŋŋmooŋmootiil poonee, ni dāa ŋūǹ kí ŋmɔ́ isufee biliŋ. Ni yaa ŋá mimmee, ni-sufii gbanti làá dāá nīn lòoǹ ní ki kútí. Man di sá ni-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu.

english_verse: Don't eat the blood of any animal. Don't practice any kind of witchcraft.
translation_verse: «Ní taa ŋmɔ́ kuwaŋkuluu kubɔ nanti laakin bi lāntì-kùee. Ní taa bàlifì dibalifil kí taa bɔ̄ tibɔɔl mun.

english_verse: I forbid you to shave any part of your head or beard or to cut and tattoo yourself as a way of worshiping the dead.
translation_verse: Ní taa cāfì ni-wunti kí dàkà yii ni ká dikpool, kí taa ŋmà tiba naŋku ni-wunti pu. Man di sá ni-Dindaan.

english_verse: Don't let your daughters serve as temple prostitutes—this would bring disgrace both to them and the land.
translation_verse: «Ní taa yàntī ni-bisalib ń kpántí iwaatooti laakpaamu kí fá bi-jilimau. An yaa ŋá mimmee, kitiŋ nee kɔkɔ nib làá dū bi-ba kí líí nì tilaakpaal ní tijɔkɔndi ń kɔ́-kì.

english_verse: I command you to respect the Sabbath and the place where I am worshiped.
translation_verse: Ní nīn tɔ́ ŋwiŋŋuŋfikaa, kí nīn tɔ́ m-circir kɔŋkooŋŋu. Man di sá ni-Dindaan.

english_verse: Don't make yourselves disgusting to me by going to people who claim they can talk to the dead.
translation_verse: «Ní taa cù bibɔɔbi cee, kí taa cù bin sòoǹ nì bitaŋkpiibee cee. Ní taa cù bi-cee, kun puee bi làá kɔ́ǹ-ni tijɔkɔndi. Man di sá ni-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu.

english_verse: I command you to show respect for older people and to obey me with fear and trembling.
translation_verse: «Yīkì kí tīī utikpil disíndi kí nīn tɔ́ un yikpiti pīiǹee. Ni yaa ŋá mimmee, ni lafun fàŋkí man ni-Nimbɔtiu dee. Man di sá ni-Dindaan.

english_verse: Don't mistreat any foreigners who live in your land.
translation_verse: «Unicaan yaa dɔ́miń ki kɔ́-nee, ní taa mùul̀-u.

english_verse: Instead, treat them as well as you treat your own people and love them as much as you love yourself. Remember, you were once foreigners in the land of Egypt. I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Ní ŋúb́ unicaan un kɔ́-nee kii kitindambikee, kí nīn néeń-u kii nimbi ni-bee. Kun puee ni-mun kāl̀ kunicaŋu Eejipiti tiŋkin. Man di sá ni-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu.

english_verse: Use honest scales and don't cheat when you weigh or measure anything. I am the Lord your God. I rescued you from Egypt,
translation_verse: Ni-saniyab nì ni-waŋŋmantikaati, an dàkà yii tiwan tin bi cáa ŋmàntī nnyiŋfee nì tin bi cáa ŋmàntī nnyimee nì ni-sambiŋmantikaaŋi kɔkɔ ń nīn sá deedee wanti. Man di sá ni-Dindaan, ni-Nimbɔtiu un di nyántìń-ni Eejipiti tiŋkinee.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan bí Mooyiisi

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: Death by stoning is the penalty for any citizens or foreigners in the country who sacrifice their children to the god Molech.
translation_verse: ń tùkù Isirayeel yab yii: «Isirayeel yab kansikin ubɔ àá binicambi bin kóò Isirayeel tiŋkinee ubɔ di yaa dū u-biki ki ŋá saraa ki tīī diwaal Mooleekee, bí kpɔ̀-u. Samaa ń yāŋkì-u ataŋkpee kí kpɔ̀.

english_verse: They have disgraced both the place where I am worshiped and my holy name, and so I will turn against them and no longer let them belong to my people.
translation_verse: Mama m-ba làá fàtī m-boon kí tīī udaan ní kí nyāntí-u Isirayeel nibul kansikin u nín dū u-biki ki ŋá saraa ki tīī diwaal Mooleeki, ki kɔ́ǹ m-circir kɔŋkooŋŋu tijɔkɔndi ki kpēē m-circir yindi fámee pu.

english_verse: Some of you may let them get away with human sacrifice,
translation_verse: Ama samaa yaa ŋá kii waa ká udaan nín dū u-biki ki ŋá saraa ki tīī Mooleekee, ní kaa kūū-uee,

english_verse: but not me. If any of you worship Molech, I will turn against you and your entire family, and I will no longer let you belong to my people.
translation_verse: man m-ba di làá fàtī m-boon kí tīī udaan nì u-dicaŋku. M làá nyāntí-bi Isirayeel nibul kansikin, kí kpáaǹ bin kɔkɔ pée kútì u-pu ki ŋá saraa ki tīī diwaal Mooleekee.

english_verse: I will be your enemy if you go to someone who claims to speak with the dead, and I will destroy you from among my people.
translation_verse: «Ubɔ yaa tí cūtì ubɔɔ cee ki búń tibɔɔl ki yíiń bitaŋkpiibi àá ki bālifì ki kpēē tin bí ki dòońee puee, m làá fàtī m-boon kí tīī udaan ní kí nyāntí-u Isirayeel nibul kansikin.

english_verse: Dedicate yourselves to me and be holy because I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: «Nyāmaan tijɔkɔndin kí nīn bí circir, man di sá ni-Dindaan, ni-Nimbɔtiu. Uninja nì unimpu kpāfitam min kòóyee tafadaaldi

english_verse: I have chosen you as my people, and I expect you to obey my laws.
translation_verse: «Nín̄ ŋúb́maan m-bɔkpaaŋi, kí ŋá ŋi nín lī puee. Man di sá ni-Dindaan un gāntì-ni ní nīn sá man yabee.

english_verse: If you curse your father or mother, you will be put to death, and it will be your own fault.
translation_verse: «Un di yaa sīī u-baa àá u-nee, bí kpɔ̀-u. Udaan nín sīī u-baa àá u-nee puee, u-kúm kpuulool ń gítí u-pu.

english_verse: If any of you men have sex with another man's wife, both you and the woman will be put to death.
translation_verse: «Ubɔ yaa dōoǹ nì u-juti nimpuuee, bí kpɔ̀ udaan nì unimpuee.

english_verse: Having sex with one of your father's wives disgraces him. So both you and the woman will be put to death, just as you deserve.
translation_verse: «Ubɔ yaa dōoǹ nì u-baa nimpuuee, udaan kpēē u-baa fám dee. Bí kpɔ̀ udaan nì unimpu gbanti, bi-kúm kpuulool ń fàtīí gítí bi-pu.

english_verse: It isn't natural to have sex with your daughter-in-law, and both of you will be put to death, just as you deserve.
translation_verse: «Ubɔ yaa dōoǹ nì u-jipɔɔn nimpuuee, bí kpɔ̀ udaan nì unimpuee, kun puee tin bi ŋée sá ntimbiil bɔti, ní bi-kúm kpuulool ń fàtīí gítí bi-pu.

english_verse: It's disgusting for men to have sex with one another, and those who do will be put to death, just as they deserve.
translation_verse: «Uninja yaa dōoǹ nì u-ninjajuti kii bi nín dɔ̀ nì unimpu puee, bi-liitil ŋá ntimbiil bɔti, bí kpɔ̀ bi-liitil ní bi-kúm kpuulool ń fàtīí gítí bi-pu.

english_verse: It isn't natural for a man to marry both a woman and her daughter, and so all three of them will be burned to death.
translation_verse: «Ubɔ yaa cáá unimpu nì u-nee, an sá tijɔkɔndi ní. Bí wà bi-taatil ŋŋmi bí kpú kí nyāntí tijɔkɔndi gbanti ni-kansikin.

english_verse: If any of you have sex with an animal, both you and the animal will be put to death, just as you deserve.
translation_verse: «Unimpu yaa yāntì kuwaŋkuluu jɔ́m̀-uee, bí kpɔ̀-u kí kpɔ̀ kuwaŋkuluuee. Bí kpɔ̀ bi-liitil ní bi-kúm kpuulool ń fàtīí gítí bi-pu.

english_verse: If you marry one of your sisters, you will be punished, and the two of you will be disgraced by being openly forced out of the community.
translation_verse: «Ubɔ yaa cáá u-niisal pēē baa kaa pēē na, àá pēē na kaa pēē baa ní ki dōoǹ nì uee, bi ŋá icoo bɔti. Bí dáaĺ bi-tafal bi-nabiyaamu nimbiin. Udaan làá túń u-kpitii gìńdi u nín dōoǹ nì u-niisalee pu.

english_verse: If you have sex with a woman during her monthly period, both you and the woman will be cut off from the people of Israel.
translation_verse: «Ubɔ yaa dōoǹ nì unimpu un bíi fùul̀ ŋkpinee, bí nyāntí bi-liitil Isirayeel nibul kansikin, kun puee bi kpáfì kinyɔkɔ ki ká tinimpool.

english_verse: The sisters of your father and mother are your own relatives, and you will be punished for having sex with any of them.
translation_verse: «Aa máaǹ kí dòon̄ nì a-na naal àá u-maan àá a-baa niisal. Ubɔ yaa dōoǹ nì unimpu u nì un pēē nnyeenee, bi-liitil làá túń bi-kpitii gìńdi.

english_verse: If you have sex with your uncle's wife, neither you nor she will ever have any children.
translation_verse: «Ubɔ yaa dōoǹ nì u-baawaai nimpuuee, u kpēē u-baawaai gbanti fám dee. Bi-liitil làá túń bi-kpitii gìńdi. Bi kpá kí ká mmaal ní kí dāá kpáàa kpú.

english_verse: Obey my laws and teachings. Or else the land I am giving you will become sick of you and throw you out.
translation_verse: «Nín̄ ŋúb́maan m-bɔkpaaŋi nì m-koobiliŋ kɔkɔ kí ŋá ŋi nín lī puee, án nín làá ŋá pu kitiŋ kin poon m cáǹ-ni nee ń taa dū-ni kí fée.

english_verse: The nations I am chasing out did these disgusting things, and I hated them for it, so don't follow their example.
translation_verse: Ní taa fōō atimbun ŋin poon nib m làá jà ni-nyɔkɔpu nee koobiliŋ kí nīn ŋáań míǹ, kun puee bi-tuuŋŋi gbanti pu ní maa ti là kí wāl̀-bi.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and I have promised you their land that is rich with milk and honey. I have chosen you to be different from other people.
translation_verse: M tùkū-ni ki síiǹ yii: <Nimbi di làá fōō bi-tiŋki, man di dū-kì ki tīī-ni. An sá kitiŋ kin poon nnaabiim nì tisiil còol̀ee ní!> Man di sá ni-Dindaan, ni-Nimbɔtiu un di gāntì nimbi inibool kɔkɔ kansikinee.

english_verse: That's why you must make a difference between animals and birds that I have said are clean and unclean—this will keep you from becoming disgusting to me.
translation_verse: An pu ní ni máaǹ kí béé kí gàntì tiwaŋkuti tin ni kòóyee nì tin naa kòóyee, nì nnɔmbiyaamu mun ni kòóyee nì mun naa kòóyee, án nín làá ŋá pu ní taa yàntī tiwaŋkuti nì nnɔmbiyaamu nì tin pée kpátì ki gbí kitiŋ pu, m gāntì yii ní nīn kòóyee ń kɔ́ǹ-ni tijɔkɔndee.

english_verse: I am the Lord, the holy God. You have been chosen to be my people, and so you must be holy too.
translation_verse: «Nín̄ bímaan circir kí nīn sá man yab, kun puee man ni-Dindaan bí circir ní, ní m gāntì-ni anibul kɔkɔ kansikin ní nīn sá man yab.

english_verse: If you claim to receive messages from the dead, you will be put to death by stoning, just as you deserve.
translation_verse: «Uninja àá unimpu yaa bí ni-kansikin ki būū tibɔɔl ki yíì bitaŋkpiibi àá ki sòoǹ tin bí ki dòońee puee, bí kpɔ̀ udaan. Bí yāŋkì udaan ataŋkpee kí kpɔ̀ ní u-kúm kpuulool ń gítí u-pu.»

english_verse: The Lord gave Moses these instructions for Aaron's sons, the priests: Touching a dead body will make you unclean. So don't go near a dead relative,
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan bí Mooyiisi ń tùkù bisaraaŋaliibi, Aarɔn jipɔmbi yii: «Unil ubɔ yaa kpíì bisaraaŋaliibi naakookunee, usaraaŋal ń taa gbēē-u kí kɔ́ǹ u-ba tijɔkɔndi.

english_verse: or an unmarried sister, who has no husband to take care of her.
translation_verse: àá u-niisal un kaa láá mɔ́ǹee, kun puee u-niisal gbanti dáá gbíntìi bí u-dicaŋkun kaa mɔ́ǹ.

english_verse: Don't make yourself unclean by attending the funeral of someone related to you by marriage.
translation_verse: Usaraaŋal sá uyidaan ní u-nibul kansikin, an puee waa máaǹ kí kɔ́ǹ u-ba tijɔkɔndi kí fá u-nyooti.

english_verse: Don't shave any part of your head or trim your beard or cut yourself to show that you are mourning.
translation_verse: «Bisaraaŋaliibi yaa ká dikpoolee, bí taa kòol̀ kí cùkū bi-yiliŋ àá kí kòol̀ bi-nyimpuliŋ kpaanceetii ŋmaniŋma àá kí cāfì bi-wunti nì njimu.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and I have chosen you alone to offer sacrifices of food to me on the altar. That's why you must keep yourselves holy.
translation_verse: Bi máaǹ kí dū bi-ba kɔkɔ kí sú man bi-Nimbɔtiu, kí nīn nyí kí taa bīil̀ m-yindi. Di sá yii bíǹ di tìì man bi-Dindaan bi-Nimbɔtiu saraabi bin bi cáa wù ŋŋmee. An puee ní bi máaǹ kí nīn bí circir.

english_verse: Don't marry a divorced woman or a woman who has served as a temple prostitute. You are holy,
translation_verse: «Usaraaŋal ń taa cáá unimpu un ŋá dilaakpaatundi ki kée, àá unimpu un uninja ubɔ ŋmātiǹ-u ki dōoǹ nì uee, àá unimpu un cal jìn̄-uee, kun puee bi dū usaraaŋal ki sú man u-Nimbɔtiu ní.

english_verse: If any of you priests has a daughter who disgraces you by serving as a temple prostitute, she must be burned to death.
translation_verse: «Usaraaŋal bisal yaa bíi ŋáań dilaakpaatundi ki bíil̀ u-bee, u-baa ní u bíi bíiĺ. Bí wà u-bisal gbanti ŋŋmi.

english_verse: If you are the high priest, you must not mess up your hair or tear your clothes in order to mourn for the dead.
translation_verse: «Usaraaŋakpil di sá un yil pu bi bātì ŋkpam ki sītì u pèentí asaraaŋabɔkutee. An puee ú taa yàntī u-yikpiti ń nīn bí fikil fikil, kí taa cátí u-wampeeŋkaati kí dàkà yii u bí kunimbaaun.

english_verse: Don't make yourself unclean by going near a dead body, not even that of your own father or mother.
translation_verse: Ú taa sútí kí pìl̄ utaŋkpiil. Báà u-na àá u-baa di yaa kpíì, ú taa kɔ́ǹ u-ba tijɔkɔndi.

english_verse: If you leave the sacred place to attend a funeral, both you and the sacred place become unclean, because you are the high priest.
translation_verse: Ú taa nyā ti-Dindaan circir kɔŋkooŋŋun kí bīil̀-ŋu. Di sá yii bi bātì man u-Nimbɔtiu kpam ki sītì u-yil pu ki dū-u ki sú-mi. Man di sá ni-Dindaan.

english_verse: If you are the high priest, you must marry only a virgin
translation_verse: «U yaa làá cáá unimpuee, ú cáá usapɔɔn un kaa nyí uninja ki kée.

english_verse: from your own tribe. Don't marry a divorced woman or any other woman who has already had sex, including a temple prostitute.
translation_verse: Ú taa cáá ukpiipu, kí taa cáá unimpu un cal jìn̄-uee àá un ŋá dilaakpaatundi ki bíil̀ u-bee. Ama ú kpèè u-nibul kansikin usapɔɔn un kaa nyí uninja ki kée kí cáá,

english_verse: In this way, your descendants will be qualified to serve me. Remember—I am the Lord, and I have chosen you.
translation_verse: án nín làá ŋá pu ú taa cáań mmaanyeen ŋun bíil̀ee u-maaliŋu poonee. Man di sá ni-Dindaan un gāntì-u ú nīn bí m-tundinee.» b. Kun ŋūǹ kí pìin̄ unil nsan ú taa kpántí usaraaŋalee

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan bí Mooyiisi yii:

english_verse: to say to Aaron and his sons: I am the Lord God, and I demand that you honor my holy name by showing proper respect for the offerings brought to me by the people of Israel.
translation_verse: «Tùkù Aarɔn nì u-jipɔmbi yii, kí taa kpèè m-circir yindi fámee, bí nīn tɔ́ circir saraabi bin Isirayeel yab cāabìń ki tìì-mee. Man di sá ni-Dindaan.

english_verse: If any of you are unclean when you accept an offering for me, I will no longer let you serve as a priest.
translation_verse: Tùkù-bi yii: «Ni-maaliŋu poon kí nīn cée, unil ubɔ yaa bí tijɔkɔndin ní ki sútì ki pìl̄ m-circir saraabi bin Isirayeel yab cāabìń ki tìì man ni-Dindaanee, bí nyāntí-u m-tundin. Man di sá ni-Dindaan.

english_verse: None of you may take part in the sacred meals while you have a skin disease or an infected penis, or after you have been near a dead body or have had a flow of semen,
translation_verse: Aarɔn maaliŋu poon un di yaa būǹ dinyaŋgbandi àá batikuee kaa máaǹ kí jī circir saraabi jinti kí cáá sāā ŋwiin ŋun u làá pɔ̄ɔkèe. Míǹ mbaantiim un di yaa gbēē unil un gbēē dinikpil ki kɔ́ tijɔkɔndi, àá unil un nyéem̀ tijatee,

english_verse: Once you are unclean, you must take a bath, but you still cannot eat any of the sacred food until evening.
translation_verse: Ŋwìiń yaa jéetèe, u nyáń tijɔkɔndin. Míǹ boonee, u ŋūǹ kí nīn kíǹ ki jīǹ circir saraabi jinti, kun puee u-jinti dee.

english_verse: I command you not to eat anything that is killed by a wild animal or dies a natural death. This would make you unclean.
translation_verse: Usaraaŋal kaa máaǹ kí ŋmɔ́ kuwaŋkuluu kun kpíìyee, àá kun an cúúyee nanti án kɔ́ǹ-u tijɔkɔndi. Man di sá ni-Dindaan.

english_verse: Obey me, or you will die on duty for disgracing the place of worship. Remember—I am the Lord, the one who makes a priest holy.
translation_verse: «Bisaraaŋaliibi ń nīn ŋúb́ tin ní m kpáafì-bee, án nín làá ŋá pu saraabi jinti puee, bí taa yòon̄ ikpiti iba kí túńee. Bi yaa kpēē saraabi jinti fámee, asee bí kpú. Man di sá ni-Dindaan un gāntì bisaraaŋaliibi bí nīn bí m-tundinee.

english_verse: Only you priests and your families may eat the food offerings; these are too sacred for any of your servants.
translation_verse: «Unil un kaa sá usaraaŋal dicaŋkunee kaa máaǹ kí jī circir saraabi jinti. Unicaan un dɔ́miń ki kɔ́ usaraaŋal puee nì usaraaŋal paadaaŋwu kaa máaǹ kí jī circir saraabi gbanti jinti.

english_verse: However, any slave that you own, including those born into your household, may eat this food.
translation_verse: Ama usaraaŋal yumbuu un u dū u-nimbiliŋ ki dée, nì un bi màl̄ u-dicaŋkunee ŋūǹ kí jī tijin tin usaraaŋal jīǹee.

english_verse: If your daughter marries someone who isn't a priest, she can no longer have any of this food.
translation_verse: Usaraaŋal bisal yaa kaa mɔ́ǹ bisaraaŋaliibi naakookunee, waa cáá nsan kí jī tijin tin ní bi lēē circir saraabi poonee.

english_verse: But if she returns to your home, either widowed or divorced, and has no children, she may join in the meal. Only members of a priestly family can eat this food,
translation_verse: Ama usaraaŋal bisal yaa kpántì ukpiipu, àá u nì u-cal yākatì tɔbin waa cáá kibiki, ní ki fātìi gítì u-baa dicaŋkun ki kā kii u nín nìn pée kā u-sapɔntin puee, u ŋūǹ kí jī tijin tin u-baa jīǹee. Un kaa sá bisaraaŋaliibi naakookunee kaa cáá nsan kí jī tijin gbanti.

english_verse: must have nothing wrong with them, or else I won't accept them. Bulls or rams or goats are the animals to be used for these sacrifices.
translation_verse: Ní taa dū kuwaŋkuluu kun laaba wɔ̀b̄ee kí ŋá saraa kí tīī-mi, di sá yii maa làá fōō an saraau.

english_verse: I warn you not to treat lightly the offerings that are brought by the people of Israel.
translation_verse: «Bisaraaŋaliibi ń taa kpèè Isirayeel yab nín lèekī dijandi din bi-saraabi poon ki tìì man bi-Dindaanee fám.

english_verse: Don't let them become guilty of eating this sacred food. Remember—I am the Lord, the one who makes these offerings holy. Acceptable Sacrifices
translation_verse: Bi yaa kaa máaǹ kí jī tijin gbanti ní ki jíń-tèe, bi kɔ́ tibɔtin ní an bàlifī yii bí ŋāŋkì. Man di sá ni-Dindaan un gāntì bisaraaŋaliibi bí nīn bí m-tundinee.» Tiwaŋkuti tin ní bi máaǹ kí dūú ŋá saraabee

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan bí Mooyiisi

english_verse: to tell Aaron and his sons and everyone else the rules for offering sacrifices. He said: The animals that are to be completely burned on the altar
translation_verse: ń tùkù Aarɔn nì u-jipɔmbi nì Isirayeel yab kɔkɔ yii: «Isirayeel yab ubɔ àá binicambi bin kóò Isirayeel tiŋkinee ubɔ yaa là kí ŋá saraawɔkaa kí tīī man ni-Dindaanee, an yaa sá kí pà ipooneeee, an yaa tí sá kí ŋá nlammɔntiim saraaueeee,

english_verse: When you offer a sacrifice to ask my blessing, there must be nothing wrong with the animal. This is true, whether the sacrifice is part of a promise or something you do voluntarily.
translation_verse: Ubɔ yaa là kí ŋá mpèé saraauee, an yaa sá kí pà ipooneeee, an yaa sá nlammɔntiim saraaueeee, án nīn sá unaa àá upii àá uŋoobu un laaba kaa wɔ̀b̄ee ní ḿ nín fōō saraa gbanti.

english_verse: If one of your cattle or lambs has a leg that is longer or shorter than the others, you may offer it voluntarily, but not as part of a promise.
translation_verse: Ni ŋūǹ kí dū unaa àá upii un taal diba fɔ̀kɔǹ ŋin kíǹee, àá un taal diba kaa fɔ̀kɔ̀ ki bàn̄ ŋin kíǹee kí ŋá nlammɔntiim saraau kí tīī man ni-Dindaan, ama naa ŋūǹ kí dū-u kí ŋá saraa kí pà ipoon ḿ fōō.

english_verse: As long as you live in this land, don't offer an animal with injured testicles.
translation_verse: Ní taa dū kuwaŋkuluu kun kuntancakabiliŋ wīī àá ki mátì àá bi gíí ki lēēyee kí ŋá saraa kí tīī man ni-Dindaan. Naa máaǹ kí ŋá míǹ gba ni-tiŋkin.

english_verse: And don't bring me animals you bought from a foreigner. I won't accept them, because they are no better than one that has something wrong with it.
translation_verse: Ní taa dā unicaan ubɔ cee tiwaŋkuti tin bi fāatì mimmee kí ŋá saraa kí tīī man ni-Dindaan. Bi nín fāatì-tì mimmee, ti wɔ̀b̄ dee. Ni yaa dū-tì ki ŋá saraayee, maa làá fōō-tì.»

english_verse: The Lord told Moses to say:
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan bí Mooyiisi yii:

english_verse: Newborn cattle, sheep, or goats must remain with their mothers for seven days, but on the eighth day, you may send them up in smoke to me, and I will accept the offering.
translation_verse: «Bi yaa màl̄ kinabiki àá kipibiki àá kiŋɔbikee, kí nīn bí ki-na cee kí cáá sāā iwiin iluli. Kí yòon̄ iwiin inii dal kí nīn cée, bi yaa dū-kì ki ŋá saraa ki wùn̄ ŋŋmi kí tīī-mee, m làá fōō.

english_verse: Don't sacrifice a newborn animal and its mother on the same day.
translation_verse: Ama ní taa kpɔ̀ unaaŋkpil àá upiŋkpil àá uŋɔŋkpil nì u-biki ŋwimbaanti.

english_verse: When you offer a sacrifice to give thanks to me, you must do it in a way that is acceptable.
translation_verse: «Ni yaa bíi ŋáań ijaam saraauee, nóómaan mara nín sá puee ní ḿ fōō.

english_verse: Eat all of the meat that same day and don't save any for the next day. I am the Lord your God!
translation_verse: Ní ŋmɔ́ tinan kɔkɔ ŋwiin gbanti kí taa yàntī tiba ń kíń kí wúntí kutaa. Man di sá ni-Dindaan.

english_verse: Obey my laws and teachings—I am the Lord.
translation_verse: «Nín̄ ŋúb́maan m-marab kí ŋá bi nín lī puee. Man di sá ni-Dindaan.

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: I have chosen certain times for you to come together and worship me.
translation_verse: ń tùkù Isirayeel yab yii: «Ni yaa kóoǹ ki kpáfì kí jāam̀ man ni-Dindaanee, jiŋaakpaambi bin ni làá nīn jīǹee sɔ̀. Ŋwiŋŋuŋfikaa bɔti

english_verse: You have six days when you can do your work, but the seventh day of each week is holy because it belongs to me. No matter where you live, you must rest on the Sabbath and come together for worship. This law will never change. Passover and the Festival of Thin Bread (Numbers
translation_verse: «Kinyɔŋ poonee, ni cáá iwiin iluu kí tɔ̄ ni-tundi. Ama ŋwinluluúti dal sá ŋwiŋŋuŋfikaa ní, diŋuŋfil wiiŋŋu ŋun ni làá kóoǹ kí kpāfì kí jāam̀-mee. Laakin kamaa ni yaa bàn̄ ki kóòyee, ní taa tɔ̄ ditundi ŋwiŋŋuŋfikaa dal, ama ní dū-ŋu kí sú-mi.»

english_verse: No one is to work on that day—it is the Great Day of Forgiveness, when sacrifices will be offered to me, so that I will forgive your sins.
translation_verse: Ní taa láa tɔ̄ ditundi báà diba ŋwiin gbanti, kun puee an sá ikpiti pɔ̄tam wiŋkpaaŋŋu ŋun bi ŋáań ni-pu akoobil ki fíntí ni-kpitii kɔkɔ man ni-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu nimbiinee ní.

english_verse: Passover is another time when you must come together to worship me, and it must be celebrated on the evening of the fourteenth day of the first month of each year.
translation_verse: Dilákatil jiŋaaliu un bi jīǹ ki tìì ti-Dindaan tinyoolee kífí uŋmapeepeekaa, ŋwiin ŋubɔ kpá saalku dal kujoopɔŋ ní.

english_verse: Each day of this festival you must offer sacrifices. Then on the final day you must once again rest from your work and come together for worship. Offering the First Part of the Harvest
translation_verse: Iwiin iluli gbanti kɔkɔ poonee, ní ŋá saraabi kí dūú wà ŋŋmi kí tīī man ni-Dindaan. Ŋwinluluúti dalee, ní kóoǹ kí kpāfì kí jāam̀-mi. Ní taa tɔ̄ ditundi báà diba.» Dijimbɔ́ndi dipeepeekaal jiŋaaliu

translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan bí Mooyiisi

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: After you enter the land I am giving you, the first bundle of wheat from each crop must be given to me. So bring it to a priest
translation_verse: ń tùkù Isirayeel yab yii: «Ni yaa láa kɔ́ kitiŋ kin m làá tīī-nee poon, ní ki yaa láa bíi cēē ni-kpaajintee, dibɔ́ndi din ni làá péé péé kí cēē, ní cáań kí tīī usaraaŋal.

english_verse: and two kilograms of your finest flour mixed with olive oil. Then he will place these on the bronze altar and send them up in smoke with a smell that pleases me. Together with these, you must bring a liter of wine as a drink offering.
translation_verse: Ní dū ŋyim min bi dū ŋkpam ki búuńee kiiloobi biluu kí ŋá saraa. An sá saraa un bi dùú wà ŋŋmi u-sɔnsɔfiŋu sɔ̀ŋkī m-pɔbilee. Ní dāá dū ndamam liitiri ubɔ nì dijandi mun kí fá-mi.

english_verse: I am your God, and I forbid you to eat any new grain or anything made from it until you have brought these offerings. This law will never change. The Harvest Festival (Numbers
translation_verse: Naa máaǹ kí ŋmɔ́ tijimpɔn gbanti kpɔnɔu àá ti-fiŋyi in bi púĺee, àá ti-biliŋ ŋin sá apɔɔnee kí dāá sāā ŋwiin ŋun ní ni làá cáań saraa kí tīī man ni-Nimbɔtiuee. Laakin kamaa ni yaa bàn̄ ki kóòyee, ní nīn ŋúb́ dibɔkpaal nee kí nīn cáa cá jaanjaan.» Kudiceeu jiŋaaliu

english_verse: The Lord God said to Moses:
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan bí Mooyiisi yii:

english_verse: None of my people are ever to do any work on that day—not now or in the future. And I will wipe out those who do!
translation_verse: Ní taa pée tɔ̄ ditundi ní. Laakin kamaa ni yaa bàn̄ ki kóòyee, ní nīn ŋúb́ dibɔkpaal nee kí nīn cáa cá jaanjaan.

english_verse: Seven weeks after you offer this bundle of grain, each family must bring another offering of new grain.
translation_verse: «Ŋwiŋŋuŋfikaa ŋun ni cáań tijincɔ̀fikaalee, ku yaa wúntèe ní kíĺ kí kàaǹ nnyɔmu mululi.

english_verse: Bring two loaves of bread to be lifted up in dedication to me. Each loaf is to be made with yeast and with two kilograms of the finest flour from the first part of your harvest.
translation_verse: Laakin kamaa ní ni yaa kóòyee, ní cáań kpɔnɔb bin ni dū ŋyim kiiloobi biluu nì ŋkpɔnɔnyɔkɔ ki ŋée bili kí fíiǹ fíiǹ kí tīī man ni-Dindaan. An di sá tijincɔ̀fikaal saraau un ni cáań ki tīī man ni-Dindaanee.

english_verse: At this same time, the entire community of Israel must bring seven lambs that are a year old, a young bull, and two rams. These animals must have nothing wrong with them, and they must be offered as a sacrifice to please me. You must also offer the proper grain and wine sacrifices with each animal.
translation_verse: Ní cáań apibil aluli ŋin cáá dibindi diba ŋi-laaba kaa wɔ̀b̄ee, nì unaja nì ipijaa ili kí kūtì kpɔnɔbee pu. Ní dū an waŋkutee kí ŋá saraawɔkaa, kí kpáaǹ tijin saraau nì ndaam min bi cáa kútí saraabi gbanti puee. An di sá saraa un bi dùú wà ŋŋmi u-sɔnsɔfiŋu sɔ̀ŋkī man ni-Dindaan pɔbilee.

english_verse: Offer a goat as a sacrifice for sin, and two rams a year old as a sacrifice to ask my blessing.
translation_verse: Míǹ boonee ní ní dū uŋɔja mun kí ŋá ikpiti pɔ̄tam saraau, ní kí dū apibil ŋin cáá dibindi dibee ali kí ŋá mpèé saraau.

english_verse: The priest will lift up the rams together with the bread in dedication to me. These offerings are holy and are my gift to the priest.
translation_verse: Niinee ní usaraaŋal ń yòon̄ apibil alee nì tijincɔ̀fikaal kpɔnɔbee yilpu kí fíiǹ fíiǹ man ni-Dindaan nimbiin. Saraabi gbantee, bi dū-bi ki sú man dee, usaraaŋal di yì.

english_verse: This is a day of celebration and worship, a time of rest from your work. You and your descendants must obey this law.
translation_verse: Yaadal wiiŋŋuee, ní kóoǹ samaa kɔkɔ kí kpāfì kí jāam̀-mi. Ní taa tɔ̄ ditundi báà diba. Laakin kamaa ni yaa bàn̄ ki kóòyee, ní nīn ŋúb́ dibɔkpaal nee kí nīn cáa cá jaanjaan.

english_verse: When you harvest your grain, always leave some of it standing around the edges of your fields and don't pick up what falls on the ground. Leave it for the poor and for those foreigners who live among you. I am the Lord your God! The Festival of Trumpets (Numbers
translation_verse: «Ni yaa láa bíi cēē ni-kpaajintee, ní taa cā kí bà ŋkpaabuku, kí taa gítí ni-boon mun kí lūlifì. Dūú tīīmaan bifalaadambi nì binicambi. Man di sá ni-Dindaan, ni-Nimbɔtiu.» Diteetil nì ifaal wiiŋŋu

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan gíti bí Mooyiisi

english_verse: The tenth day of the seventh month is the Great Day of Forgiveness. It is a solemn day of worship; everyone must go without eating to show sorrow for their sins, and sacrifices must be burned.
translation_verse: «Uŋmaluluúti poon iwiin saalaa dal sá ikpiti pɔ̄tam wiŋkpaaŋŋu ní. Ní dāá kóoǹ kí kpāfì kí bóob́ kinyɔkɔ kí ŋá saraabi kí dūú wà ŋŋmi kí tīī man ni-Dindaan.

english_verse: This is a time of complete rest just like the Sabbath, and everyone must go without eating from the evening of the ninth to the evening of the tenth. The Festival of Shelters (Numbers
translation_verse: An sá diŋuŋfil wiiŋŋu kii ni nín ŋáań pu ŋwiŋŋuŋfikaa dalee ní. Ní dāá bóob́ kinyɔkɔ. Uŋmal gbanti poon iwiin iwa dal kujoou kí cáá sāā ku yaa wúntèe kujoou ní ŋwiŋŋuŋfikaa gbanti sá.» Tantib jiŋaaliu

english_verse: Pick the best fruit from your trees and cut leafy branches to use during the time of this joyous celebration in my honor.
translation_verse: Ŋwimpeepeekaa dalee, ní nyàab̀ asubimɔnti nì tikpakpati nì isufi in cáá tifaal sùuuyee paŋŋi nì ŋkpinni sufii faati, ní kí fàal̀ man ni-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu nimbiin iwiin iluli.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan bí Mooyiisi

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: Beginning on the fifteenth day of the seventh month, and continuing for seven days, everyone must celebrate the Festival of Shelters in honor of me.
translation_verse: ń tùkù Isirayeel yab yii: «Uŋmaluluúti gbanti poon iwiin saalku dalee, ní jī tantib jiŋaaliu kí tīī man ni-Dindaan yindi tinyool. Ní dāá jī jiŋaal gbanti iwiin iluli.

english_verse: No one is to do any work on the first day of the festival—it is a time when everyone must come together for worship.
translation_verse: Ŋwimpeepeekaa dalee, ní kóoǹ kí kpāfì kí jāam̀-mi. Ní taa tɔ̄ ditundi báà diba.

english_verse: For seven days, sacrifices must be offered on the altar. The eighth day is also to be a day of complete rest, as well as a time of offering sacrifices on the altar and of coming together for worship.
translation_verse: Iwiin iluli gbanti kɔkɔ poonee, ní ŋá saraabi kí dùú wà ŋŋmi kí tīī man ni-Dindaan. Ŋwinniniiti dalee, ní kóoǹ kí kpáfì kí jāam̀-mi ní kí ŋá saraa kí dūú wà ŋŋmi kí tīī-mi. Yaadal ní jiŋaal gbanti kúntí. Ní taa láa tɔ̄ ditundi báà diba.

english_verse: I have chosen these festivals as times when my people must come together for worship and when animals, grain, and wine are to be offered on the proper days.
translation_verse: «Jiŋaalib bin ni máaǹ kí nīn jīǹ ki tìì man ni-Dindaan tinyoolee dee. Ni yaa bíi jīǹ jiŋaalib gbantee, ní kóoǹ kí kpāfì kí jāam̀ man ni-Dindaan, kí nīn ŋáań saraawɔkaa nì tijin saraabi nì mpèé saraabi nì ndaam saraabi kii jiŋaal kamaa wiiŋŋu koobiliŋ nín sá puee.

english_verse: These festivals must be celebrated in addition to the Sabbaths and the times when you offer special gifts or sacrifices to keep a promise or as a voluntary offering.
translation_verse: Saraabi gbanti sá kí dūú kūtì bin ni ŋáań ŋwiŋŋuŋfikaa kamaa dalee pu ní, ní kí kūtì dipɔl saraau nì saraabi bin bi ŋáań kí pà ipoon pɔndee nì nlammɔntiim saraabi bin ni pée ŋáań ki tìì man ni-Dindaanee.

english_verse: Remember to begin the Festival of Shelters on the fifteenth day of the seventh month after you have harvested your crops. Celebrate this festival for seven days in honor of me and don't do any work on the first day or on the day following the festival.
translation_verse: «Ni yaa cáń ni-kpaajinti uŋmaluluúti iwiin saalku dalee, ní jī iwiin iluli jiŋaaliu kí tīī man ni-Dindaan yindi tinyool. Ŋwimpeepeekaa dal nì ŋwinniniiti dal sá diŋuŋfil wiiŋyi ní.

english_verse: I command you and all of your descendants to celebrate this festival during the seventh month of each year.
translation_verse: Dibindi kamaayee, ní dū iwiin iluli kí jī jiŋaal nee kí tīī man ni-Dindaan tinyool. Ní nīn ŋúb́ dibɔkpaal nee kí nīn cáa cá jaanjaan. Uŋmaluluúti poonee, ní jī jiŋaal gbanti.

english_verse: For seven days every Israelite must live in a shelter,
translation_verse: Iwiin iluli gbantee, nimbi Isirayeel yab kɔkɔ ń nīn kóò tantib poon.

english_verse: so future generations will know that I made their ancestors live in shelters when I brought them out of Egypt. I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Mimmee ni-biyaamu kɔkɔ làá béé yii m nín nìn nyántìń-ni Eejipiti tiŋkinee, tantib poon ní m nìn yāntì ni kóò. Man di sá ni-Dindaan, ni-Nimbɔtiu.»

english_verse: This is how Moses instructed the people of Israel to celebrate the Lord's festivals.
translation_verse: Míǹ ní Mooyiisi cántì ki tùkū Isirayeel yab bi nín máaǹ kí nīn jīǹ ti-Dindaan jiŋaalib ki tìì-u tinyool puee.

english_verse: It's possible to pay the owner for an animal that has been killed, but death is the penalty for murder.
translation_verse: «Un yaa kūū kuwaŋkuluuee, ú nyàab̀ kubɔ kí téeǹ. Ama un yaa kūū unilee, bí kpɔ̀ u mun.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan bí Mooyiisi yii:

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: You must supply the purest olive oil for the lamps in the sacred tent, so they will keep burning.
translation_verse: «Yàntī Isirayeel yab ń cáań-si ɔliifi kpam min ŋān̄ ki wāĺ kílkilee á dūú ŋá fitilab poon, án nín làá ŋá pu fitilab ń nīn pée fòol̄ ŋyunti kamaayee.

english_verse: Aaron will set up the gold lampstand in the holy place of the sacred tent. Then he will light the seven lamps that must be kept burning there in my presence, every night from now on. This law will never change. The Sacred Bread The Lord said:
translation_verse: Aarɔn máaǹ kí nīn kpèé fitilab bin tɔ́kɔ́ fitilab tɔ́kɔŋkaati tin bi dū sindaariya ki nyūntèe pu, ní bí nīn fòol̄ ŋyunti kamaa ti-Dindaan nimbiin.» Kpɔnɔb bin bi dūu ŋá Unimbɔti saraayee

english_verse: Use your finest flour to bake twelve loaves of bread about two kilograms each,
translation_verse: «Á dū ŋyim kí ŋá kpɔnɔb saalaa nì bili, kpɔnɔ kamaa nyiŋfiŋu ń nīn sá kiiloobi biluu.

english_verse: then take them into the sacred tent and lay them on the gold table in two rows of six loaves.
translation_verse: Á dū-bi kí páań teebil un sí m-nimbiin bi dū sindaariya ki nyūntèe pu. Á páań-bi ipɔ̀n ili pu, mpɔ̀n kamaa ń nīn cáá kpɔnɔb biluu.

english_verse: Alongside each row put some pure incense that will be sent up by fire in place of the bread as an offering to me.
translation_verse: Mpɔ̀n kamaa puee, á dū talaalu un sá umɔntee kí páań án nīn sá kudaaŋŋu man Unimbɔti nimbiin yii saraa gbanti sá ki tīī-mi, ní bí dāá dū talaaluee kí wà ŋŋmi kpɔnɔbee yil pu kí tīī man ni-Dindaan.»

english_verse: Aaron must lay fresh loaves on the table each Sabbath, and priests in all generations must continue this practice as part of Israel's agreement with me.
translation_verse: «Ŋwiŋŋuŋfikaa kamaa kí yòon̄ kí nīn cá jaanjaanee, ní nīn pāantí kpɔnɔb gbanti man ni-Dindaan nimbiin. Án nīn sá tin Isirayeel yab máaǹ kí nīn ŋáań ki cá jaanjaanee.

english_verse: This bread will always belong to Aaron and his family; it is very holy because it was offered to me, and it must be eaten in a holy place. Punishment for Cursing the Lord
translation_verse: Aarɔn nì u-jipɔmbi di yì kpɔnɔb gbanti. Bi yaa làá ŋmɔ́-bee, bí ŋmɔ́-bi mpaan ŋun bí circiree pu. Di sá yii saraabi gbanti sá circir páaa wanti tin bi lēē circir saraabi bin bi dù kí wà ŋŋmi kí tīī man ni-Dindaanee poon ní. Bíǹ di yì-tì kí nīn cá jaanjaan.» Bin sòoǹ ki bíiĺ Unimbɔtee tafadaaldi

english_verse: Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri from the tribe of Dan, had married an Egyptian, and they had a son. One day their son got into a fight with an Israelite man in camp and cursed the name of the Lord. So the young man was dragged off to Moses,
translation_verse: Niinee, unaacimpɔɔn un na sá Isirayeelee kíĺ ki bíi sòoǹ ki bíiĺ Unimbɔti yindi ki sìí-u. Ní bi cáań-u Mooyiisi cee. U-na Dibrii bisal Seeloomiiti nìn sá Daani naakookun ní.

english_verse: who had him guarded while everyone waited for the Lord to tell them what to do.
translation_verse: Ní bi dū-u ki pīiǹ kudii kí cīití ti-Dindaan u-ba ń sòoǹ u-bɔti.

english_verse: Finally, the Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Niinee ní ti-Dindaan bí Mooyiisi yii:

english_verse: This man has cursed me! Take him outside the camp and tell the witnesses to lay their hands on his head. Then command the whole community of Israel to stone him to death.
translation_verse: «Nyāntí kijapaayee dinaapaal kpaanceetiŋu ní bin kɔkɔ gbìl̄ u nín sòon̄ puee ń dū bi-ŋalii kí páań u-yil pu, ní samaa kɔkɔ ń yāŋkì-u ataŋkpee kí kpɔ̀.

english_verse: And warn the others that everyone else who curses me will die in the same way, whether they are Israelites by birth or foreigners living among you.
translation_verse: Un yaa sòon̄ ki bíil̀ man ni-Dindaan yindee, see bí kpɔ̀-u. Samaa kɔkɔ ń yāŋkì-u ataŋkpee. Udaan yaa sá unicaanaaa, kitindambikaaa, u nín pée ŋá pu ní ki sòon̄ ki bíil̀ Unimbɔti yindee, see ú kpú.

english_verse: Death is also the penalty for murder,
translation_verse: «Unil un yaa lēē u-juti maŋfalee, bí lēē u mun yal.

english_verse: but the killing of an animal that belongs to someone else requires only that the animal be replaced.
translation_verse: U yaa tí kūū ubɔ waŋkulukuee, ú nyàab̄ kí téeǹ-u.

english_verse: Personal injuries to others must be dealt with in keeping with the crime—
translation_verse: «Ubɔ yaa ŋá u-juti tiweendee, bí ŋá u mun tiweendi.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and I demand equal justice both for you Israelites and for those foreigners who live among you.
translation_verse: «Ni nín sòoǹ unicaan bɔti puee, míǹ mbaantiim ní ni máaǹ kí sòoǹ kitindambiki mun bɔti, di sá yii man di sá ni-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu.»

english_verse: When Moses finished speaking, the people did what the Lord had told Moses, and they stoned to death the man who had cursed the Lord.
translation_verse: Míǹ ní Mooyiisi nìn sòon̄ nì Isirayeel yab. Bi nìn nyántì un sòon̄ ki bíil̀ Unimbɔti yindee dinaapaal kpaanceetiŋu ní ki yáŋkì-u ataŋkpee ki kūū. Ti-Dindaan nín nìn tùkū Mooyiisi yii bí ŋá puee, míǹ deedee ní bi nìn ŋá.

english_verse: So when you buy or sell farmland, the price is to be determined by the number of crops it can produce before the next Year of Celebration. Don't try to cheat.
translation_verse: Tikpaatanee daaku ń nóó nì abin ŋin páaǹ dibatɔl bindi din jítèe puee, ní kí kpèè ŋin kíǹ bí kpɔ̀ tikpaatanee pu ní dibatɔl bindi dipɔndi ń nín bàńee.

english_verse: When Moses was on Mount Sinai, the Lord told him
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan sòon̄ nì Mooyiisi Siinaayi jool pu ki bí

english_verse: This is a year of complete celebration, so don't plant any seed or harvest what your fields or vineyards produce.
translation_verse: Abin ili nì disaalaatiil sá dibatɔl bindi ní ki tīī-ni. Ní taa kpɔ̀ kí bɔ̄l̀ tiba, kí taa cā dibindi din jítèe jinti tin sá aleenee àá kí kìtī ni-fiinyi sufii paŋŋi ŋin naa ŋáŋkèe pu abil.

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: After you enter the land that I am giving you, it must be allowed to rest one year out of every seven.
translation_verse: ú tùkù Isirayeel yab yii: «Ni yaa láa kɔ́ kitiŋ kin m làá dūú tīī-nee poonee, dibinluluútiil kamaayee, ní dāá yàntī kí taa kpɔ̀ ni-kpaatanti kí tīī man ni-Dindaan tinyool.

english_verse: but the seventh year you must let your fields and vineyards rest in honor of me, your Lord.
translation_verse: Ama dibinluluútiilee, ní dāá yàntī ni-kpaatanti ń dòon̄ kí ŋùŋfì. Ní dāá dū dibindi gbanti kí sú man ni-Dindaan. Ní taa láa kpɔ̀ kí bɔ̄l̀ ni-sati, kí taa ŋāŋkì ni-fiinyi sufii paŋŋi.

english_verse: This is to be a time of complete rest for your fields and vineyards, so don't harvest anything they produce.
translation_verse: Ní taa láa cā dibindi din jítèe jinti tin sá aleenee àá kí kìtī ni-fiinyi sufii paŋŋi ŋin naa ŋáŋkèe pu abil, kun puee an dāa sá dibindi din tikpaatan máaǹ kí dòon̄ kí ŋùŋfèe ní.

english_verse: However, you and your slaves and your hired workers, as well as any domestic or wild animals, may eat whatever grows on its own. The Year of Celebration The Lord said to his people:
translation_verse: Míǹ mbaantiim ní ni-waŋkuti nì ipeel in bí ni-tiŋkinee mun dāa ŋūǹ kí jī tin ni-tiŋki làá dāá lòoǹee.» Dibatɔl bindi

english_verse: or uncle or cousin, or some other family member. In fact, if you ever get enough money, you may buy your own freedom
translation_verse: U yaa kaa cáá u nì un pēē kiŋkiŋee, u-baawaai àá u-baawaai jipɔɔn àá u nì un pēē mmaalee ubɔ ŋūǹ kí dā-u kí líí. Úǹ u-ba yaa tí ká ŋŋmam, u ŋūǹ kí dā u-ba kí líí.

english_verse: on the tenth day of the seventh month, which is also the Great Day of Forgiveness, trumpets are to be blown everywhere in the land.
translation_verse: Uŋmaluluúti, iwiin saalaa dal, an dàkà yii ikpiti pɔ̄tam wiŋkpaaŋŋu dalee, ní búń ŋyin kí fáá iwiliili kitiŋ kɔkɔ poon.

english_verse: This fiftieth year is sacred—it is a time of freedom and of celebration when everyone will receive back their original property, and slaves will return home to their families.
translation_verse: Ni yaa ŋá mimmee, ni dū dibindi ili nì disaalaatiilee ki sú Unimbɔti dee, ní kí bāakì kitiŋ kɔkɔ poon yii báà ŋma ń fōō u-ba. Dibindi gbanti ní bi yíì yii dibatɔl bindi. Báà ŋma ń dāá fàtīí fōō u-kpaatanti tin u nìn dūu nyáfèe, ní bin nìn dū bi-ba ki nyáfèe ń fàtīí kpì bi-dumpui.

english_verse: In this time of sacred celebration you may eat only what grows on its own.
translation_verse: Di sá yii an sá dibatɔl bindi ní bi dūu sú ti-Dindaan. Ni ŋūǹ kí jī tin kitiŋ làá dāá lòoǹee.

english_verse: During this year, all property must go back to its original owner.
translation_verse: «Dibatɔl bindi gbanti poonee, báà ŋma ń fàtīí fōō u-kpaatanti tin u nìn dūu nyáfèe.

english_verse: If it is a long time before the next Year of Celebration, the price will be higher, because what is really being sold are the crops that the land can produce.
translation_verse: Abin yaa kíǹ ki náaǹee, kudaau mun máaǹ kí nīn pɔ̄ɔ̄ ní, ní abin ŋin kíǹee yaa kaa ti náaǹee, kudaau ń nīn pɔ̀fì, kun puee abin ŋin kíǹ ní kpɔ̀ tikpaatanee puee ní ni máaǹ kí kpèè ní kí nyāfiǹ-u.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, so obey me and don't cheat anyone.
translation_verse: Ni-kansikin ubɔ ń taa mùul̀ u-nabiki, ama ní fàŋkì man ni-Nimbɔtiu, kun puee man di sá ni-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu.

english_verse: If you obey my laws and teachings, you will live safely in the land and enjoy its abundant crops.
translation_verse: Kitiŋ làá dāá lòoǹ mmɔntiim ní ká kí jī kí díkí, ní kí dāá kàl̄ ki-poon nì ŋgbansɔŋfi.

english_verse: Don't ever worry about what you will eat during the seventh year when you are forbidden to plant or harvest.
translation_verse: «An yaa yíì ni ŋūǹ kí bàlifì ni-ba yii: <Ti nín kaa cáá nsan kí kpɔ̀ kí bɔ̄l̀ ti-sati, kaa tí cáá nsan kí cā dibinluluútiil kamaa nee, kin ba ní ti làá nīn jīǹ dee?>

english_verse: I will see to it that you harvest enough in the sixth year to last for three years.
translation_verse: Tiŋman, m làá dāá bìin̄ ni-boon ní dibinluluutiil ń lòoǹ abin ata jinti.

english_verse: In the eighth year you will live on what you harvested in the sixth year, but in the ninth year you will eat what you plant and harvest in the eighth year.
translation_verse: Ni dāa bí ki būul̀ dibinniniitiil poon ní ki jīǹ tijiŋkpikil kí cáá sāā dibiŋwawatiil poon, ŋyunti ŋun ni làá dāá cā tijimpɔnee.» Unil cáá nsan kí fàtīí dā u-tiŋki

english_verse: No land may be permanently bought or sold. It all belongs to me—it isn't your land, and you only live there for a little while.
translation_verse: Ní taa nyāfì kitiŋ katanjoolii, di sá yii man di yì kitiŋ. Nimbi kóò man pu kii binikɔkaabi àá binicambee ní.

english_verse: When property is being sold, the original owner must be given the first chance to buy it.
translation_verse: An puee kitiŋ kin m làá dūú tīī-nee kɔkɔ poonee, ní dāá pɔ̄ un dū u-tiŋki ki nyáfèe nsan ú dāá fàtīí dā-kì.

english_verse: If any of you Israelites become so poor that you are forced to sell your property, your closest relative must buy it back,
translation_verse: Disool yaa cúú ni-nabiyaamu kansikin kiba ní kì gíí ki-kpaatanti dijandi ki nyáfèe, udaan nabiki u nì un pēē udaan cáá nsan kí fàtīí dā tikpaatan gbantee ń dā-tì.

english_verse: if that relative has the money. Later, if you can afford to buy it,
translation_verse: Udaan yaa kaa cáá u nì un pēēyee ń fàtīí dā kitiŋee, ama ní úǹ u-ba ká ŋŋmam kí fàtīí dēe,

english_verse: you must pay enough to make up for what the present owner will lose on it before the next Year of Celebration, when the property would become yours again.
translation_verse: ú cɔ́tí u nín nyáfì kitiŋee abin nín nyáń puee, kí pà abin ŋin kíǹ dibatɔl bindi ń nín bàńee nimbiliŋ kí tīī un u nìn dū u-tiŋki ki nyáfiǹee, ní kí fàtīí fōō u-tiŋki.

english_verse: But if you don't have the money to pay the present owner a fair price, you will have to wait until the Year of Celebration, when the property will once again become yours.
translation_verse: Ama úǹ u-ba yaa kaa ká ŋŋmam kí pà kí fàtīí fōō u-tiŋkee, kí gbíntí un di dá-kèe ŋaan kí cáá sāā dibatɔl bindi. Dibatɔl bindi gbanti poonee, ú fàtīí fōō u-tiŋki.

english_verse: If you sell a house in a walled city, you have only one year in which to buy it back.
translation_verse: Kudii yaa bí kitiŋ kin bi máń digundi ki māntìi túee poon ní ubɔ dū-ku ki nyáfèe, udaan cáá dibimmɔndi kí fàtīí dā-ku. An kaa máaǹ kí jītí dibindi pu, kí kíĺ ŋwiin ŋun u dū-ku ki nyáfèe.

english_verse: If you don't buy it back before that year is up, it becomes the permanent property of the one who bought it, and it will not be returned to you in the Year of Celebration.
translation_verse: Dibimmɔndi yaa jítì ní un nyáfì kudiiyee kaa ŋúń ki fātìi dá-kuee, un di dá kudiiyee nì u-naantiibi di kíǹ ki yì-ku kí nīn cá talku. An kaa ti bàlifī yii ú gíiǹ kudiiyee kí tīī un cee u nìn dée dibatɔl bindin.

english_verse: But a house out in a village may be bought back at any time just like a field. And it must be returned to its original owner in the Year of Celebration.
translation_verse: Ama adiin ŋin bí ntimbilimu mun baa máń digundi ki māntìi túee poonee ŋman bí kii tikpaatanee dee. Bi cáá nsan kí fàtīí dā-ŋi, ní dibatɔl bindi poonee, bí fàtīí fōō-ŋi.

english_verse: If any Levites own houses inside a walled city, they will always have the right to buy them back.
translation_verse: Leefii yab bíǹ cáá nsan ŋyunti ŋun ní bi yaa lèe kí fàtīí dā bi-diiŋŋi ŋin yú bi-timmu poon bi dūu nyáfèe.

english_verse: And any houses that they do not buy back will be returned to them in the Year of Celebration, because these homes are their permanent property among the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Báà gba Leefii yab ubɔ di yaa fātìi dá u-juti uleefiija cee kudii ní dibatɔl bindi yaa bāańee, an sá ú nyā ní kí gíiǹ kudiiyee kí tīī ku-dindaan. Di sá yii Leefii yab diiŋŋi sá bi-fakal ní Isirayeel yab kansikin.

english_verse: No pastureland owned by the Levi tribe can ever be sold; it is their permanent possession. Help for the Poor The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ama tikpaatan tin māntìi tú ntimu mun poon bi kóòyee, baa máaǹ kí dūú nyāfì. Di sá yii an sá bi-wanti ní kí nīn cá talku. An nín máaǹ bí pìnnì usoodaan tiwan puee

english_verse: If any of your people become poor and unable to support themselves, you must help them, just as you are supposed to help foreigners who live among you.
