english_verse: But do not kill the young women who have never had sex. You may keep them for yourselves.”
translation_verse: Ama ní taa kpɔ̀ nsapɔmbiyaamu mun kaa láá béè bininjabee, ní yàntī bíǹ ń nīn bí kí tīī-ni.

english_verse: Then Moses said to the soldiers, “If you killed anyone or touched a dead body, you are unclean and have to stay outside the camp for seven days. On the third and seventh days, you must go through a ceremony to make yourselves and your captives clean.
translation_verse: Ni-kansikin bin kɔkɔ kūū unil kujaaun àá ki gbēē utaŋkpiilee ń nyā kí nīn bí dinaapaal boon iwiin iluli, kí ŋá akoobil winta dal nì winluli dal ní kí fàtīí kpántí circir. Mara gbanti sá ki tīī nimbi nì bin kɔkɔ ni cúuń kuyuŋuee ní.

english_verse: Then wash your clothes and anything made from animal skin, goat's hair, or wood.”
translation_verse: Ní ŋá abɔkuti nì igban nì tiŋɔkuti wanti nì idɔ wanti kɔkɔ circir.»

english_verse: Eleazar then explained, “If you need to purify something that won't burn, such as gold, silver, bronze, iron, tin, or lead, you must first place it in a hot fire. After you take it out, sprinkle it with the water that purifies. Everything else should only be sprinkled with the water. Do all of this, just as the Lord commanded Moses.
translation_verse: tiwan tin kɔkɔ kaa wù ŋŋmee, ní dū ŋŋmi kí fùuǹ-tì ní tí kpántí circir, kí dū nnyim min lèekī ikpitee kí dūú cántí-tì. Ama tin ŋŋmi wùee, ní dū tíǹ ki ŋá nnyim gbantin kí fíntí ní tí kpántí circir wanti.

english_verse: Wash your clothes on the seventh day, and after that, you will be clean and may return to the camp.” Everything Taken from the Midianites Is Divided
translation_verse: Ni yaa fíntì ni-bɔkutiŋ iwiin iluli dalee, ni kíǹ ki bí circir dee, mimmee ni ŋūǹ kí fàtīí gítí dinaapaal pu.» Bi nín jáń ki fōoń tiwan tiŋyee yàkatitam

english_verse: The Lord told Moses:
translation_verse: Ní ti-Dindaan bí Mooyiisi yii:

english_verse: Make a list of everything taken from the Midianites, including the captives and the animals. Then divide them between the soldiers and the rest of the people. Eleazar the priest and the family leaders will help you.
translation_verse: Ní cúú binibee nì tiwaŋkutee kí yàkatī mili pu, kí dū dijandi diba kí tīī bijanjaliibi bin cūtì kujaauee, ní kí dū dijandi din kíǹee kí tīī samaa kɔkɔ.

english_verse: From the half that belongs to the soldiers, set aside for the Lord one out of every
translation_verse: Bi yaa lēē bi-jandi poon tin sá man yatee ki tīī-mee, á dūú tīī usaraaŋakpil Eeleeyasaar.

english_verse: So we want to give the Lord all the gold jewelry we took from the Midianites. It's our gift to him for watching over us and our troops.”
translation_verse: An pu ní ti cáań tiwampɔkaal kí ŋá ti-Dindaan saraa ú fíntí-ti kí nyāntí ti-jɔkɔntin. Ti cáań sindaariya wanti, an dàkà yii abɔmbil nì mbɔmbiyaamu nì falfatib nì tiléeŋkaal tin báà ŋma kánní kujaaunee.»

english_verse: Moses and Eleazar followed the Lord's instructions
translation_verse: Ní Mooyiisi nì usaraaŋakpil Eeleeyasaar ŋá kii ti-Dindaan nín bí yii bí ŋá puee.

english_verse: women and gave them to Eleazar to be dedicated to the Lord. Then from the half that belonged to the people, Moses set aside one out of every
translation_verse: Bi nín nìn cúú tin kujaaunee, tin kíǹ bi cáańee nyɔkɔm sɔ̀. Ipii nì iŋoobu nìn sá kutukub alaataa aluu nì kutukub biŋmoo kpá imuŋku inaa.

english_verse: and listed everything that had been taken from the Midianites. The list included
translation_verse: Bisapɔmbi bin kaa nyí bininjabee nìn sá kutukub mmuŋku nì saalaa nì bili.

english_verse: and said, “Sir, we have counted our troops, and not one soldier is missing.
translation_verse: ní ki bí-u yii: «Ti nín kàan̄ ti-janjaliibi bin ti kpōotì kujaaunee, ti ká yii bi-kansikin báà ubɔ kaa fɔ́tì.

english_verse: Moses and Eleazar accepted the jewelry from the commanders,
translation_verse: Ní Mooyiisi nì usaraaŋakpil Eeleeyasaar fōō sindaariya wantee bi-ŋaan.

english_verse: This did not include the things that the soldiers had kept for themselves.
translation_verse: Bijanjaliibi ŋwaamuee kaa nìn cáań tin bi kánní kujaaunee ki tīī, bi nìn dūu kpáafì bi-ba ní.

english_verse: So Moses and Eleazar placed the gold in the Lord's sacred tent to remind Israel of what had happened.
translation_verse: Ní Mooyiisi nì usaraaŋakpil Eeleeyasaar fōō bijanjakpilibee cee sindaariya wanti, ní ki cáa kɔ́ǹ circir kɔŋkooŋŋu poon ti-Dindaan nimbiin, án nín làá ŋá pu ú taa súntí Isirayeel yab puee.

english_verse: then after the Lord helps Israel capture the land, you can return to your own land. You will no longer have to stay with the others.
translation_verse: ní kitiŋee nib kɔkɔ ń sìntī bi-ba ki tīī ti-Dindaanee. Boonee ni ŋūǹ kí nīn gítí ni-cee. Ŋyunti gbantee ni nyáń ti-Dindaan bɔtin, ki nyáń ni-nabiyaamu Isirayeel yab mun bɔtin, ní kitiŋ laakin ni bí nee ń kpántí ni-yaka ti-Dindaan nimbiin.

english_verse: The tribes of Reuben and Gad owned a lot of cattle and sheep, and they saw that the regions of Jazer and Gilead had good pastureland.
translation_verse: Rubeen nì Gaadi naakɔti yab nìn cáá tiwaŋkuti tikpil, ní bi nìn dáań ki ká yii Yaseer tiŋki nì Galaadi tiŋki ŋān̄ diwaŋkpàal.

english_verse: So they went to Moses, Eleazar, and the other leaders of Israel and said,
translation_verse: An pu ní bi cūtìi ká Mooyiisi nì usaraaŋakpil Eeleeyasaar nì Isirayeel yab kpilib ki bí-bi yii:

english_verse: “The Lord has helped us capture the land around the towns of Ataroth, Dibon, Jazer, Nimrah, Heshbon, Elealeh, Sebam, Nebo, and Beon. That's good pastureland, and since we own cattle and sheep,
translation_verse: nìn sá ntimu mun ti-Dindaan nìn jáń ki fōō ki tīī Isirayeel yabee ní. Ntimuee ŋān̄ diwaŋkpàal, ní timbi a-tɔntɔnliibi mun cáá tiwaŋkuti.

english_verse: would you let us stay here east of the Jordan River and have this land as our own?”
translation_verse: A yaa bàà kíikí kí dū ntimu gbanti kí tīī-ti, timbi ń taa dùtī Jɔɔdan buŋgbandi lapu pu.»

english_verse: Moses answered: You mean you'd stay here while the rest of the Israelites go into battle?
translation_verse: Ní Mooyiisi kíí Gaadi nì Rubeen naakɔti yab yii: «Ba pu ní ni-nabiyaamu ń búntí kujaau ní nimbi ń gbíntí ki kā doo?

english_verse: If you did that, it would discourage the others from crossing over into the land the Lord promised them.
translation_verse: Ba pu ní ni bí ki yɔ̀tī ni-nabiyaamu Isirayeel yab wunti bí taa cùú fōō kitiŋ kin ti-Dindaan dūu tīī-bee?

english_verse: This is exactly what happened when I sent your ancestors from Kadesh-Barnea to explore the land.
translation_verse: Míǹ ní ni-baabi mun nìn tí ŋá ŋyunti ŋun ti nìn bí Kadeesi-Baarneeya m nìn tú-bi bí cùú cɔ̄ŋkì Kanaan tiŋkee.

english_verse: They went as far as Eshcol Valley, then returned and told the people that we should not enter it.
translation_verse: Bi nìn jɔ́m̀ áli ki bàn̄ Eeskool tantakalin ki kpēē kitiŋ, ní boonee bi yɔ̄tì Isirayeel yab wunti bí taa kɔ́ kitiŋ kin ti-Dindaan tīī-bee poon.

english_verse: Moses said: You promised that you would be ready to fight for the Lord.
translation_verse: Ní Mooyiisi bí-bi yii: «Ni nín lī puee, ní ŋámaan míǹ. Ní bɔ́ntí kí cù kujaau, kii ti-Dindaan nín tīī mara puee.

english_verse: but he was so angry with the others that he forced them to wander around in the desert for
translation_verse: An pu ní ti-Dindaan nìn fōō Isirayeel yab pu diŋuul ki yāntì bi tú ki yìiǹ kuteeun abin imuŋku ili, ní bin kɔkɔ nìn yīntiǹ-uee kpíì.

english_verse: So Moses gave the Machirites the region of Gilead, and they settled there.
translation_verse: Ní Mooyiisi dū kitiŋ gbanti ki tīī-bi bí nīn kíǹ ki kóò.

english_verse: Now you people of Reuben and Gad are doing the same thing and making the Lord even angrier.
translation_verse: Nimbi binikpitib nee làá nóó ni-baabi tabɔbiliŋ kí gbítí ti-Dindaan ŋuul Isirayeel yab puɔɔɔ?

english_verse: If you reject the Lord, he will once again abandon his people and leave them here in the desert. And you will be to blame!
translation_verse: Míǹ puee nimbi di yaa fātì ni-boon ki tīī ti-Dindaanee, u làá gíti yàntī Isirayeel yab ń yúntí kuteeun, ní nimbi di làá dāá túń samaa gbanti kpuulool.»

english_verse: The men from Reuben and Gad replied: Let us build places to keep our sheep and goats, and towns for our wives and children,
translation_verse: Bi gbìl̄ mimmee ní ki sútìi pìl̄ Mooyiisi, ní ki bí-u yii: «Ti làá mā doo nee tikpuŋkpun ti-piii nì ti-ŋoobui ń nīn kóò, ní kí mā ti-biyaamu adiin.

english_verse: We will stay with them until they have settled in their own tribal lands.
translation_verse: See ti-nabiyaamu Isirayeel yab yaa bàn̄ báà ŋma fōō u-tinjandee ní timbi ń nīn gítiń ti-cee.

english_verse: The land on this side of the Jordan River will be ours, so we won't expect to receive any on the other side.
translation_verse: Ama timbi kaa dāa gíti cáá kí fōō tiba kitiŋ kin a làá dāá tīī bíǹ lapu pu buŋgbandee poon, di sá timbi gíti dáá fōō ti-fakal doo pú buŋgbandi.»

english_verse: You also agreed to cross the Jordan and stay with the rest of the Israelites, until the Lord forces our enemies out of the land. If you do these things,
translation_verse: Bin kɔkɔ sá bininjab ki bàl̄ tijanjawanee ń dùtī Jɔɔdan buŋŋu, kii ti-Dindaan nín tīī mara puee. Bí nīn bí niin kí tin sāā ŋyunti ŋun ti-Dindaan làá jà u-nannanliibi kɔkɔ,

english_verse: But if you don't keep your promise, you will sin against the Lord and be punished.
translation_verse: Ama ni yaa kaa ŋá mimmee, ni ŋá ti-Dindaan ikpiti, ní ni-kpitii gbanti làá nīn pée dī-ni.

english_verse: Go ahead and build towns for your wives and children, and places for your sheep and goats. Just be sure to do what you have promised.
translation_verse: An puee ní māmaan ni-biyaamu adiin kí mā ni-piii nì ni-ŋoobui tikpuŋkpun. Ama ní ŋá tin ni pōoǹ yii ni làá ŋée mun.»

english_verse: The men from Reuben and Gad answered: Sir, we will do just what you have said.
translation_verse: Ní Gaadi nì Rubeen naakɔti yab bí Mooyiisi yii: «Timbi a-tɔntɔnliibi làá ŋá kii sii ti-dindaan nín bí yii tí ŋá puee.

english_verse: Our wives and children and sheep and cattle will stay here in the towns in Gilead.
translation_verse: Ti-nimpoobi nì ti-biyaamu nì ti-picaŋkpunti nì ti-ŋɔcaŋkpunti nì ti-naai kɔkɔ làá gbíntí Galaadi tiŋkin doo ní.

english_verse: But those of us who are prepared for battle will cross the Jordan and fight for the Lord.
translation_verse: Ní timbi a-tɔntɔnliibi ń yòon̄ ti-janjawanti kí cùú já ki nóó nì ti-Dindaan nín tīī mara puee, kii a nín lī puee.»

english_verse: Then Moses said to Eleazar, Joshua, and the family leaders,
translation_verse: Ní Mooyiisi tīī mara nee usaraaŋakpil Eeleeyasaar nì Nuuni jipɔɔn Joosuwa nì Isirayeel yab naakɔti kɔkɔ kpilib bi-pu.

english_verse: “Make sure that the tribes of Gad and Reuben prepare for battle and cross the Jordan River with you. If they do, then after the land is in your control, give them the region of Gilead as their tribal land.
translation_verse: U nìn bí-bi yii: «Gaadi nì Rubeen naakɔti yab bin kɔkɔ sá bijanjaliibee yaa bāań, ní ni-kɔkɔ dūtì Jɔɔdan buŋŋu ki cūtìi jáń kii ti-Dindaan nín tīī mara puee ki fōō kitiŋee, ní dāá dū Galaadi tiŋki kí tīī-bi.

english_verse: But if they break their promise, they will receive land on the other side of the Jordan, like the rest of the tribes.”
translation_verse: Ama bi yaa kaa dɔ́miń ki kútì ni-pu ni jáńee, Kanaan tiŋkin ní bi làá tin yàkatī ni nì bi kɔkɔ atinjan.»

english_verse: The tribes of Gad and Reuben replied, “We are your servants and will do whatever the Lord has commanded.
translation_verse: Ní Gaadi nì Rubeen yab tí kíí yii: «Ti-Dindaan nín pée bí tí ŋá puee, míǹ ní ti làá ŋá.

english_verse: We will cross the Jordan River, ready to fight for the Lord in Canaan. But the land we will inherit as our own will be on this side of the river.”
translation_verse: Timbi ti-ba làá yòon̄ tijanjawan kí cù Kanaan tiŋkin kí já kii ti-Dindaan nín tīī-ti mara puee. Ama timbi tinjandi din bi làá tīī-tee di sá Jɔɔdan buŋgbandi doo pú yal ní.»

english_verse: So Moses gave the tribes of Gad, Reuben, and half of Manasseh the territory and towns that King Sihon the Amorite had ruled, as well as the territory and towns that King Og of Bashan had ruled.
translation_verse: Ní Mooyiisi dū Amɔɔr yab bɔtiu Siiwɔn, nì Baasan yab bɔtiu Ɔɔgi timmu, nì ntimu mun gíti bí mu-kpaanceetii ki māntìi tú-muee ki tīī Gaadi nì Rubeen naakɔtin yab, nì Jooseefi jipɔɔn Manasee naakooku dijandi yab.

english_verse: The tribe of Gad rebuilt the towns of Dibon, Ataroth, Aroer,
translation_verse: Gaadi naakookun yab nìn fātìi máń Diibɔn nì Atarooti nì Arooweer timmu,

english_verse: Atroth-Shophan, Jazer, Jogbehah,
translation_verse: nì Atarooti-Soofan nì Yaseer nì Yoogeebeeya

english_verse: Beth-Nimrah, and Beth-Haran. They built walls around them and also built places to keep their sheep and goats.
translation_verse: nì Beeti-Niimra nì Beeti-Yaran timmu. Bi nìn fātìi máń ntimu gbanti kɔkɔ ní ki máń agun ki māntìi tú-mu, ní ki máń bi-piii nì bi-ŋoobui tikpuŋkpun.

english_verse: The tribe of Reuben rebuilt Heshbon, Elealeh, Kiriathaim,
translation_verse: Ní Rubeen naakookun yab fātìi máń Yeeseebɔn nì Eelalee nì Kiiriyatayiim

english_verse: Sibmah, as well as the towns that used to be known as Nebo and Baal-Meon. They renamed all those places.
translation_verse: nì Neeboo nì Baal-Meeyɔn nì Siibima timmu. Boonee bi dāa kpántì ntimu gbanti yiŋŋi ki pú-mu ayimpɔɔn.

english_verse: The clan of Machir from the tribe of East Manasseh went to the region of Gilead, captured its towns, and forced out the Amorites.
translation_verse: Ní Manasee jipɔɔn Makiir yab jáń nì Galaadi yab ki fōō bi-tiŋki, ní ki jìn̄ Amɔɔr yab bin nìn kóò ki-puee.

english_verse: Jair from the Manasseh tribe captured villages and renamed them “Villages of Jair.”
translation_verse: Manasee jipɔɔn Yayiir yab nìn cūtìi jáń nì Amɔɔr timbilimmu kí fōō-mu, ní ki pú-mu diyindi yii Yayiir timbilimmu.

english_verse: Nobah captured the town of Kenath with its villages and renamed it Nobah.
translation_verse: Ní Noobiya cūtìi jáń ki fōō Keenaati tiŋki nì ki-timbilimmu, ní ki dū úǹ u-ba yindi ki pú kitiŋee yii Noobiya.

english_verse: As Israel traveled from Egypt under the command of Moses and Aaron,
translation_verse: Isirayeel yab nín nyáń Eejipiti tiŋkin, Mooyiisi nì Aarɔn kpòotī-bi bi nóó tɔb akiti akiti pu ki kàal̀ ki yíkí puee sɔ̀.

english_verse: Moses kept a list of the places they camped, just as the Lord had instructed. Here is the record of their journey:
translation_verse: Bi-saŋkindi poonee, ti-Dindaan yaa nìn dàkā-bi yii bí kàl̄ laakin kí ŋùŋfì kí nín nìkēe, Mooyiisi nìn ŋmà niin yindi ní. Bi nín nìn kāl̀ kāl̀ laakiŋyee yiŋŋi sèé.

english_verse: After the Israelites left Rameses, they camped at Succoth,
translation_verse: Isirayeel yab yíkì Ramseesee, ní ki cūtìi kāl̀ Sukooti.

english_verse: and from there, they moved their camp to Etham on the edge of the desert.
translation_verse: Bi yíkì Sukootee, ní ki cūtìi kāl̀ Eetaam, kuteeu kpaanyɔkɔ.

english_verse: Then they turned back toward Pi-Hahiroth, east of Baal-Zephon, and camped near Migdol.
translation_verse: Bi yíkì Eetaamee ní ki túlifì bi-boon ki dī Pii-Ayirooti, kitiŋ kin nì Baal-Seefɔn túĺ tɔbee, ní ki cūtìi kāl̀ Miigidool nyɔkɔpu.

english_verse: They left Pi-Hahiroth, crossed the Red Sea, then walked three days into the Etham Desert and camped at Marah.
translation_verse: Bi yíkì Pii-Ayirooti ní ki dūtì dimɔɔl, ki cōom̀ iwiin ita Eetaam teekun ní ki dūu nyáń Maara tiŋki pu ní ki kāl̀ niin.

english_verse: They left Elim and camped near the Red Sea,
translation_verse: Bi yíkì Eeliimee ní ki cūtìi kāl̀ ki pìlīǹ Tikati mɔɔl.

english_verse: then turned east and camped along the western edge of the Sinai Desert.
translation_verse: Bi yíkì Tikati mɔɔl ceeyee ní ki cūtìi kāl̀ Siini teekun.

english_verse: From there they went to Dophkah, Alush, and Rephidim, where they had no water.
translation_verse: Bi yíkì Aluusee ní ki cūtìi kāl̀ Reefiidiim tiŋkin, laakin Isirayeel yab nìn bàn̄ nnyim kpá bí nyɔ̀ee.

english_verse: They left Rephidim and finally reached the Sinai Desert.
translation_verse: Bi yíkì Reefiidiimee ní ki cūtìi kāl̀ Siinaayi teekun.

english_verse: When they left Kadesh, they came to Mount Hor, on the border of Edom.
translation_verse: Bi yíkì Kadeesee ní ki cūtìi kāl̀ Yɔɔr jool pu, ki pìlīǹ Eedoom tiŋki kpaanyɔkɔ.

english_verse: That's where the Lord commanded Aaron the priest to go to the top of the mountain. Aaron died there on the first day of the fifth month,
translation_verse: Niinee ní usaraaŋakpil Aarɔn jɔ́m̀ Yɔɔr jool pu kii ti-Dindaan nín nìn tùkū-u puee, ní ki kpíì niin. Isirayeel yab nín nyáń kuyuŋu Eejipiti tiŋkinee, abin imuŋku ili, uŋmaŋmooŋmooti wimpeepeekaaŋu dal ní u kpíì.

english_verse: It was then that the Canaanite king of Arad, who lived in the Southern Desert of Canaan, heard that Israel was headed that way.
translation_verse: Niinee ní ukanaanja, Araadi yab bɔtiu un nìn kóò Neegeeb, Kanaan tiŋkinee, gbìl̄ yii Isirayeel yab tóobiń-u.

english_verse: and finally in the lowlands of Moab across the Jordan River from Jericho.
translation_verse: Bi yíkì Abariim jooŋŋi puee ní ki cūtìi kāl̀ Moowaab tantakalin, an pìlīǹ Jɔɔdan buŋŋu ki túĺ Jeeriikoo tiŋki.

english_verse: Their camp stretched from Beth-Jeshimoth to Acacia. The Lord's Command To Conquer Canaan
translation_verse: Ní bi kāl̀ Jɔɔdan buŋgbandi ki yōoǹ Beeti-Yeesimooti ki tin cáa sāā Afeel-Siitiim, Moowaab tantakalin. Ti-Dindaan tīī mara bí já kí fōō Kanaan tiŋki

english_verse: While Israel was camped in the lowlands of Moab across the Jordan River from Jericho, the Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan sòon̄ nì Mooyiisi, Moowaab tantakal din túĺ Jeeriikooyee yii

english_verse: to give the people of Israel this message: When you cross the Jordan River and enter Canaan,
translation_verse: ú tùkù Isirayeel yab yii: «Ni yaa dūtì Jɔɔdan buŋŋu ki kɔ́ Kanaan tiŋkinee,

english_verse: Then settle in the land—I have given it to you as your own.
translation_verse: Ní fōō kitiŋ gbanti kí nīn kíǹ ki kóò, di sá nimbi ní m dū kitiŋ gbanti ki tīī ní nīn kíǹ ki yì.

english_verse: I will show you how to divide the land among the tribes, according to the number of clans in each one, so that the larger tribes will have more land than the smaller ones.
translation_verse: Ní dāá tɔ̄ kasi ní an lēē kunaakoou kamaa nín máaǹ dijandi diŋyee. Kunaakoou kun nib yaa wīikée, ní tīī-bi kitiŋ ń nīn wīikí, kun nib yaa kaa náaǹee, ní tīī-bi án taa nín̄ náaǹ. Ní kunaakoou kamaa ń nīn yì dijandi din bi tɔ́ kasi ku jíńee. Ní yàkatīmaan kí nóó nì ni-baabi naakɔti nín sá puee.

english_verse: If you don't force out all the people there, they will be like splinters in your eyes and thorns in your back. They will always be trouble for you,
translation_verse: Ama ni yaa kaa jìn̄ binib bin kóò kitiŋ gbantinee ki cūnnì ndan kí wàatī ni-bee, bin ni kíǹee di dāa kpántí ikuŋkum ki sàatī ni-nimbiliŋ, ní ki dāa sá akuŋkunjal ki sàatī ni-takakalii. Bi làá dāá nīn páb̀-ni kitiŋ kin ni làá cùú kàl̄ nee poon.

english_verse: and I will treat you as severely as I planned on treating them.
translation_verse: Ní man nín bàà yóoǹ kí dáaĺ bi-tafal miŋyee, ḿ dāá dūú dáaĺ nimbi tafal.»

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan bí Mooyiisi

english_verse: to tell the people of Israel that their land in Canaan would have the following borders:
translation_verse: ń tīī Isirayeel yab mara nee yii: «Ni yaa láa kɔ́ Kanaan tiŋkinee, kitiŋ kin m yóoǹ kí tīī-ni ní nīn kíǹ ki yèe kpaanyɔmmu sɔ̀.

english_verse: The southern border will be the Zin Desert and the northwest part of Edom. This border will begin at the south end of the Dead Sea.
translation_verse: Ni-tiŋki kpaanyɔkɔ kífí Siini teekun ŋgiil pú kí tin cáá gbèen̄ Eedoom tiŋki, ní kí fàtīí yòon̄ ŋwìiń nyalaŋki pú kí cáá sāā Ŋyaam mɔɔl ŋgiil pú.

english_verse: It will go west from there, but will turn southward to include Scorpion Pass, the village of Zin, and the town of Kadesh-Barnea. From there, the border will continue to Hazar-Addar and on to Azmon.
translation_verse: Ni-kpaanyɔkɔ làá fàtīí fíiǹ kí dī ŋgiil pú kí nīn jɔ́ḿ Akrabiim gbantaŋki watil, kí dūú dī Siini teeku kí cáá sāā Kadeesi Barneeya tiŋki ŋgiil pú, ní kí dūú dī Asaar-Adaar tiŋki watil, kí tin jītí Asimɔn tiŋkin,

english_verse: It will run along the Egyptian Gorge and end at the Mediterranean Sea.
translation_verse: ní kí yòon̄ Asimɔn tiŋki kikpaanyɔkɔ kí fàtīí dūú dī Eejipiti kpiŋŋu kí tin cáá sāā Meediiteeranee tiŋkuu.

english_verse: The western border will be the Mediterranean Sea.
translation_verse: Ŋwìiń jeetilaŋki púee, ni-tiŋki kpaanyɔkɔ di sá Meediiteeranee tiŋkuu.

english_verse: The northern border will begin at the Mediterranean, then continue eastward to Mount Hor.
translation_verse: Ŋgan púee, ni-tiŋki kpaanyɔkɔ ń kíĺ Meediiteeranee tiŋkuu kí nīn pée nóó míǹ kí nīn cáa cá áli Ɔɔr jool.

english_verse: After that, it will run to Lebo-Hamath and across to Zedad, which is the northern edge of your land.
translation_verse: Kí yòon̄ní Ɔɔr jool pú kí dūú dīń Yamati ní kikpaanyɔkɔ ń tin sāā Seedaad.

english_verse: From Zedad, the border will continue east to Ziphron and end at Hazar-Enan.
translation_verse: Ni-tiŋki kpaanyɔkɔ làá nìkī kí yòon̄ Siifirɔn tiŋki kí tin cáá sāā Yatisaar-Eenan. Ni-tiŋki kpaanyɔkɔ nín sá pu ŋgan púee dee.

english_verse: The eastern border will begin at Hazar-Enan in the north, then run south to Shepham,
translation_verse: Ŋwìiń nyalaŋki púee, ni-tiŋki kpaanyɔkɔ ń kíĺ Yatisaar-Eenan kí tin cáá sāā Seefam tiŋki,

english_verse: and on down to Riblah on the east side of Ain. From there, it will go south to the eastern hills of Lake Galilee,
translation_verse: ní kí yòon̄ Seefam tiŋki kí nīn sìntī Riibila watil, Aayin tiŋki ŋwìiń nyalaŋki pú, ní kí yòon̄ niin kí nīn sìntī kí tin cáá sāā Geeneesareeti mɔɔgbandi ŋwìiń nyalaŋki pú,

english_verse: then follow the Jordan River down to the north end of the Dead Sea. The land within those four borders will belong to you.
translation_verse: ní kí yòon̄ niin kí nīn sìntī Jɔɔdan buŋŋu kí tin cáá sāā Ŋyaam mɔɔl. Ni-tiŋki nín làá nīn cáá ŋkpaanyɔmu nì ntimu mun māntìi tú-nee puee dee.»

english_verse: Then Moses told the people, “You will receive the land inside these borders. It will be yours, but the Lord has commanded you to divide it among the nine and a half tribes.
translation_verse: Ní Mooyiisi dū maree ki nāatì Isirayeel yab yii: «Kitiŋ nee ní ni làá tɔ̄ kasi ní án lēē báà ŋma tinjandi kí tīī-u. Ti-Dindaan di lēē ki síiǹ yii u làá dū-kì ki tīī tinaakɔti tiwa nì dijandee.

english_verse: The tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh have already been given their land
translation_verse: Di sá Rubeen naakooku dicaŋŋi yab, nì Gaadi naakooku dicaŋŋi yab, nì Manasee naakooku dijandi dicaŋŋi yab fōō bi-tinjaŋŋi.

english_verse: across from Jericho, east of the Jordan River.” The Leaders Who Will Divide the Land
translation_verse: Tinaakɔti tili nì dijandee yab fōō bi-fakal Jɔɔdan buŋgbandi lapu pu ki túĺ Jeeriikoo tiŋki ŋwìiń nyalaŋki pú.» Bikpilib bin làá yàkatī kitiŋee yiŋŋi

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses,
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan sòon̄ nì Mooyiisi ki bí-u yii:

english_verse: “Eleazar the priest and Joshua son of Nun will divide the land for the Israelites.
translation_verse: «Usaraaŋakpil Eeleeyasaar nì Nuuni jipɔɔn Joosuwa di làá yàkatī kitiŋ kí tīī-ni.

english_verse: One leader from each tribe will help them,
translation_verse: Ní lēē kunaakoou kamaa poon ukpil ubɔ kí kūtì bi-pu bí yàkatī kitiŋ.

english_verse: These are the men the Lord commanded to help Eleazar and Joshua divide the land for the Israelites.
translation_verse: Binib bin ti-Dindaan nìn lēē bí yàkatī Kanaan tiŋki kí tīī Isirayeel yabee dee.

english_verse: to say to them: When you receive your tribal lands, you must give towns and pastures to the Levi tribe.
translation_verse: «Tùkù Isirayeel yab yii bí lēē bi-tinjaŋŋi poon ntimu kí tīī Leefii yab bí nīn kóò. Bí dū ntimuee kpaanceetii mun kí tīī-bi.

english_verse: That way, the Levites will have towns to live in and pastures for their animals.
translation_verse: Bí nīn cáá ntimu ki kóò, ní ntimu gbanti kpaanceetii ń nīn sá ki tīī bi-naai nì bi-wanti nì bi-waŋkuti tin kíǹee kɔkɔ.

english_verse: The pasture around each of these towns must be in the shape of a square, with the town itself in the center. The pasture is to measure
translation_verse: Ní ŋmàntī kitiŋ boon ŋwìiń nyalaŋki pú meetab kutuku, ŋgiil pú meetab kutuku, ŋgan pú meetab kutuku ní ŋwìiń jeetilaŋki pú meetab kutuku, ní kitiŋ ń nīn bí kansikin. Ikpaanceeti nín máaǹ kí nīn bí pu kí màntīí tū kitiŋee dee.

english_verse: Six of the towns you give them will be Safe Towns where a person who has accidentally killed someone can run for protection. But you will also give the Levites
translation_verse: Ni yaa láa tīī Leefii yab ntimuee, ní dāá lēē ntimu muluu kí kūtì, mú nīn sá laakin ní ubɔ yaa kaa nyí ki kūū unil, ú sāǹ kí kɔ́ kí ŋmátée. Ní dāá kūtì-bi ntimu imuŋku ili nì muli.

english_verse: Since the towns for the Levites must come from Israel's own tribal lands, the larger tribes will give more towns than the smaller ones. The Safe Towns (Deuteronomy
translation_verse: Ni yaa làá lēē Isirayeel tinjaŋŋi poon ntimu kí tīī Leefii yabee, ní lēē bin timmu wīikée cee tikpil, ní kí lēē bin yɔmu kaa wīikée cee fiii. Kunaakoou kamaa ń lēē ku-timmu kí nóó nì ku-tinjandi din ku fōōyee nín sá puee kí tīī Leefii yab.» Kitiŋ kin poon unikpɔl sáń kí kɔ́ee

english_verse: by one of the victim's relatives. He will take revengefor his relative's death as soon as he finds you.
translation_verse: Unil un bi kūūyee nabiki kin máaǹ kí tɔ̀ ipɔntoonee di máaǹ kí kpɔ̀ unikpɔlee kí tɔ̀ ipɔntoon. Laakin ní u yaa pée ká-uee, u ŋūǹ kí kpɔ̀-u.

english_verse: There are to be six of these Safe Towns,
translation_verse: Ní dāá lēē ntimu muluu mun poon ní binib làá nīn sáń ki kóòyee.

english_verse: The Lord then told Moses
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan sòon̄ nì Mooyiisi

english_verse: to tell the people of Israel: After you have crossed the Jordan River and are settled in Canaan,
translation_verse: ú tùkù Isirayeel yab yii: «Ni yaa láa dūtì Jɔɔdan buŋŋu ki bàn̄ ki kɔ́ Kanaan tiŋkinee,

english_verse: choose Safe Towns, where a person who has accidentally killed someone can run for protection.
translation_verse: ní dāá lēē ntimu mubɔ, ubɔ yaa kaa nyí ki kūū unilee, ú sāǹ kí kɔ́.

english_verse: If the victim's relatives think it was murder, they might try to take revenge. Anyone accused of murder can run to one of these Safe Towns for protection and not be killed before a trial is held.
translation_verse: Ntimuee di dāa sá un kūū unilee balilaŋki ní un nabiki bi kūūyee ń taa ŋmā kí kpɔ̀-u kí tɔ̀ ipɔntoon samaa kaa láá sòon̄ u-bɔti.

english_verse: They will be places of protection for anyone who lives in Israel and accidentally kills someone. Laws about Murder and Accidental Killing The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ntimu muluuyee làá nīn sá kibalilaŋ ki tīī Isirayeel yab nì binicambi bin kóò bi-ceeyee nì bisaŋkinliibi bin túutì bi-puee. Bi-kansikinee un kaa nyí ki kūū unilee ń sāǹ kí kɔ́ niin.

english_verse: Suppose you hit someone with a piece of iron or a large stone or a dangerous wooden tool. If that person dies, then you are a murderer and must be put to death
translation_verse: U yaa tí dū ndɔ ŋun ŋūǹ kí kpɔ̀ unilee ki tɔ́ u-juti ní u kpíìyee, udaan sá unikpɔl, bí kpɔ̀ u mun.

english_verse: Or suppose you get angry and kill someone by pushing or hitting or by throwing something. You are a murderer and must be put to death by one of the victim's relatives.
translation_verse: án yaa ti sá nì kudɔ̀ŋu ní u fáá-u ní u kpíìyee, un kūū u-jutee máaǹ ŋkúm, u sá unikpɔl ní. Un u kūūyee nabiki kin máaǹ kí tɔ̀ ipɔntoonee yaa pée ká-u laakiŋyee, ú kpɔ̀-u kí tɔ̀ ipɔntoon.

english_verse: But if you are not angry and accidentally kill someone in any of these ways, the townspeople must hold a trial and decide if you are guilty.
translation_verse: samaa ń kpāfì kí dī mara nee pu kí sòoǹ kí ŋāŋkì un kūū unil kaa nyée nì un làá tɔ̀ ipɔntoonee kansikin.

english_verse: If they decide that you are innocent, you will be protected from the victim's relative and sent to stay in one of the Safe Towns until the high priest dies.
translation_verse: Samaa ń fīī un kɔ́ tibɔtinee un làá tɔ̀ ipɔntoonee ŋaan, ní kí gíiǹ-u kitiŋ kin poon bin kūū binibee sáń ki kóòyee. «Ú nīn bí niin kí nīn cí usaraaŋakpil un bi lēē ki dū ŋkpam ki sītì u-puee yaa láa kpíìyee.

english_verse: But if you ever leave the Safe Town
translation_verse: Ama unikpɔlee yaa nyáń kitiŋ kin bi lēē bí nīn sáń ki kóòyee poon,

english_verse: and are killed by the victim's relative, he cannot be punished for killing you.
translation_verse: ní un làá tɔ̀ ipɔntoonee ká-u laaba, kaa sá kitiŋ kin bi sáń ki kóòyee poon ní ki kūū-uee, waa ŋá ikpiti.

english_verse: You must stay inside the town until the high priest dies; only then can you go back home.
translation_verse: An sá unikpɔlee ń gbíntí kí nīn kā kitiŋ kin poon u sáǹ ki kɔ́ee kí nīn cí usaraaŋakpil kúm. Úǹ kúm boonee, u ŋūǹ kí gítiń u-tiŋkin.

english_verse: Death is the penalty for murder. But no one accused of murder can be put to death unless there are at least two witnesses to the crime.
translation_verse: «Báà nnikpaakoon yaa pée yāntì ki sá ŋuŋyee, ní ká biseeradambi ń nīn wīikí kí wàatī kí nín kpɔ̀ unikpɔl. Ní taa kpɔ̀ ubɔ unibaanti seerau pu.

english_verse: You cannot give someone money to escape the death penalty; you must pay with your own life!
translation_verse: Ní taa fōō kunimbiŋmiiu kubɔ un kūū unil ki máaǹ ŋkúmee cee kí gíiǹ-u kí líí, ní kpɔ̀-u.

english_verse: And if you have been proven innocent of murder and are living in a Safe Town, you cannot pay to go back home; you must stay there until the high priest dies.
translation_verse: Ní taa tí fōō u-cee animbil kí dàkà-u nsan ú sāǹ kí cùú kɔ́ kitiŋ kin poon binikpɔliibi sáń ki kóòyee, àá kí yàntī ú gítiń kí nīn kóò u-tiŋkin ŋyunti ŋun ní usaraaŋakpil kaa láá kpíìyee.

english_verse: I, the Lord, live among you people of Israel, so your land must be kept pure. But when a murder takes place, blood pollutes the land, and it becomes unclean. If that happens, the murderer must be put to death, so the land will be clean again. Keep murder out of Israel!
translation_verse: Ní taa láa kɔ́ǹ kitiŋ kin poon ni làá dāá nīn kóòyee tijɔkɔndi, kun puee m kóò ki-poon ní. Di sá yii man di sá ni-Dindaan, ní ki kóò Isirayeel yab kansikin.»

english_verse: One day the family leaders from the Gilead clan of the Manasseh tribe went to Moses and the other family leaders of Israel
translation_verse: Jooseefi naantiibi nìn dɔ́miń ki ká Mooyiisi nì Isirayeel yab tindaŋkpilib nì tinaakɔti kpilib. Bíǹ di nìn sá Manasee naantiiu Galaadi, Makiir jipɔɔn maaliŋun dicaŋŋi kpilib.

english_verse: and said, “Sir, the Lord has said that he will show what land each tribe will receive as their own. And the Lord has commanded you to give the daughters of our relative Zelophehad the land that he would have received.
translation_verse: Bi nìn bí yii: «Ti-Dindaan di tīī sii ti-kpiliu mara yii Isirayeel yab ń tɔ̄ kasi ní báà ŋma ń jī ditinjandi din làá nīn sá u-fakalee. Ti-Dindaan di tí tīī-si mara yii á dū ti-nabiki Seeloofaadi tinjandi kí tīī u-bisalib difakal.

english_verse: But if they marry men from other tribes of Israel, the land they receive will become part of that tribe's inheritance and will no longer belong to us.
translation_verse: Bi yaa mɔ́ǹ Isirayeel yab naakooku kubɔ poon niliuee, timbi naakooku tinjandi yíkì ti-cee dee ki cūtìi kútì kunaakoou kun poon bi mɔ́ǹee tinjandi pu. Mimmee ditinjandi din bi tīī timbi difakalee bātì dee.

english_verse: Even when land is returned to its original owner in the Year of Celebration, we will not get back Zelophehad's land—it will belong to the tribe into which his daughters married.”
translation_verse: Dibatɔl bindi yaa bāańee, bíǹ tinjandi làá cùú dūú kūtì kunaakoou kun poon bi mɔ́ǹee, ní timbi baabi tinjandi ń bàtī ti-naakookun.»

english_verse: So Moses told the people that the Lord had said: These men from the Manasseh tribe are right.
translation_verse: Ní ti-Dindaan bí Mooyiisi ń tùkù Isirayeel yab tibɔti nee yii: «Jooseefi naantiibi naakookun yab cáá ibaamɔn.

english_verse: I will allow Zelophehad's daughters to marry anyone, as long as those men belong to one of the clans of the Manasseh tribe.
translation_verse: Mara un man ni-Dindaan tīī Seeloofaadi bisalibee sèé. Bi ŋūǹ kí mɔ̄ǹ un ní bi yaa lèe, ama án nīn sá bi-baa naakookun bi nín pēē pēē mmaal puee niliu ubɔ.

english_verse: Tribal land must not be given to another tribe—it will remain the property of the tribe that received it.
translation_verse: Bi yaa mɔ́ǹ mimmee, kunaakoou kubɔ tinjandi kaa ti yíkí kí cùú kūtì kubɔ pu, ama Isirayeel yab báà ŋma ń nīn ŋúb́ u-baa naakooku tinjandi.

english_verse: In the future, any daughter who inherits land must marry someone from her own tribe. Israel's tribal land is never to be passed from one tribe to another.
translation_verse: Kunaakoou kubɔ tinjandi ń taa yīkìí póotí kubɔ poon, ama Isirayeel yab báà ŋma ń nīn pée ŋúb́ u-baa naakooku tinjandi nín sá puee.»

english_verse: Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Noah the daughters of Zelophehad obeyed the Lord and married their uncles' sons
translation_verse: Niinee Maala nì Tiirsa nì Ɔgila nì Miilka nì Nɔɔwa mɔ́ǹ bi-baa nabiyaamu jipɔmbi.

english_verse: and remained part of the Manasseh tribe. So their land stayed in their father's clan.
translation_verse: Bi nìn mɔ́ǹ Jooseefi jipɔɔn Manasee naakookun yab, ní bi-tinjandi din bi fōō difakalee gbíntì bi-baa maaliŋun.

english_verse: These are the laws that the Lord gave to Moses and the Israelites while they were camped in the lowlands of Moab across the Jordan River from Jericho.
translation_verse: Abɔkpaa nì marab bin ti-Dindaan nìn dī Mooyiisi pu ki tīī Isirayeel yab Moowaab tantakalin, Jɔɔdan buŋgbandi ki túĺ Jeeriikoo tiŋkee dee.

english_verse: Now, turn around and go back into the desert by way of Red Sea Road.
translation_verse: Nimbee, fàtīmaan ni-boon kí cùú dī Tikati mɔɔl saŋŋu kí nīn gítí kuteeu watil pú.»

english_verse: People of Israel, when we were in our camp at Mount Sinai, the Lord our God told us: You have stayed here long enough.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan ti-Nimbɔtiu nìn sòon̄ nì ti Ooreeb jool pu. U nìn lī yii: «Ni kāl̀ dijool nee pu ki yúntì.

english_verse: Leave this place and go into the land that belongs to the Amorites and their neighbors the Canaanites. This land includes the Jordan River valley, the hill country, the western foothills, the Southern Desert, the Mediterranean seacoast, the Lebanon Mountains, and all the territory as far as the Euphrates River.
translation_verse: Yīkìmaan kí nīn cá Amɔɔr yab nín kóò ajoon tiŋki kinee. Nín̄ cámaan ntimu mun māntìi tú-ŋee poon, Arabaa teekun nì ajoon ŋin mun dī-kuee ni. Ní càatīmaan kí cù Seefeelaa paal pu nì Neegeeb teekun, nì kitiŋ kin dɔ̄ dimɔɔgbandee, kí bà Kanaan yab nì Leebanɔn timmun, kí cáá sāā Eefiraati buŋkpaaŋŋu.

english_verse: I give you this land, just as I promised your ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. Now you must go and take the land. Leaders Were Appointed (Exodus
translation_verse: Kpèèmaan, m dū kitiŋ nee ki tīī-ni. Nín̄ cámaan kí fōō kitiŋ kin ní man ni-Dindaan nìn pōoǹ kí tīī ni-naanjab Abraam nì Isaaki nì Jaakɔb nì bi-naantiibi bin làá dāá páanní boonee.» Mooyiisi kāaǹ bibɔsoonliibi

english_verse: After I gave these instructions to the judges, I taught you the Lord's commands. Men Were Sent To Explore the Hill Country (Numbers
translation_verse: Míǹ ní m nìn kpáafì-ni, ŋwiin gbanti tin kɔkɔ ni máaǹ kí ŋée. Isirayeel yab yīntiǹ Unimbɔti

english_verse: You stayed in your tents and grumbled, “The Lord must hate us—he brought us out of Egypt, just so he could hand us over to the Amorites and get rid of us.
translation_verse: Ni kíĺ ki bíi gbùkum̄ ni-tantib poon ki lì yii: «Kináŋ ní ti-Dindaan ná-ti ní ki nyántìń-ti Eejipiti tiŋkin kí dū-ti kí ŋá Amɔɔr yab ŋaan bí kpɔ̀ kí céetí-ti!

english_verse: Right after the Lord commanded us to leave Mount Sinai, I told you: Israel, being your leader is too big a job for one person.
translation_verse: Niinee ní Mooyiisi nìkī ki lī yii: «M nìn tùkū-ni ŋwiin gbanti yii ni sá diwaŋgul din nyìm̀ tikpilee ki tīī-mi ḿ ŋmā kí túń m-baba.

english_verse: God has even promised to bless us a thousand times more, and I pray that he will.
translation_verse: M mèé yii ti-Dindaan ni-naanjab Nimbɔtiu ń yàntī ní mɔ̀tīí bùtī míǹ ŋfunyɔm kutuku pu, ní kí bìin̄ ni-boon kii u nín nìn pōoǹ-ni puee.

english_verse: But I cannot take care of all your problems and settle all your arguments alone.
translation_verse: Ama mana ní m làá ŋmā kí túń ni-gìŋ́ŋi nì ni-bɔlii kí nīn sòoǹ ni-bɔti m-baba?

english_verse: Then I took these men, who were already wise and respected leaders, and I appointed them as your official leaders. Some of them became military officers in charge of groups of
translation_verse: Míǹ ní m dū ni-naakɔtin yidambi, binib bin cáá dinyil bi nyí bi-puee, ki kpántì ni-kpootiliibi. Biba sá binib kutuku ubɔ kpootiliibi, biba sá binib dilaataal kpootiliibi, biba sá binib imuŋku ili nì saalaa kpootiliibi, biba sá binib saalaa kpootiliibi. M nìn lēē biba mun bí nīn kpèé ni-naakɔti poon bɔti.

english_verse: and others became judges. I gave these judges the following instructions: When you settle legal cases, your decisions must be fair. It doesn't matter if the case is between two Israelites, or between an Israelite and a foreigner living in your community.
translation_verse: Niinee ní m kpáafì ni-bɔsoonliibi ŋyunti gbanti yii: «Ni-nabiyaamu yaa cáań-ni tibɔti ní sòoǹee, ní pīlifìmaan-bi. Isirayeel yab kansikin ubɔ nì u-nabiki àá unicaan un kóò ni-puee kansikin ní tibɔti yaa bí ní bi cáań-tì ní sòoǹee, ní sòoǹ-tì nì ibaamɔn.

english_verse: And it doesn't matter if one is helpless and the other is powerful. Don't be afraid of anyone! No matter who shows up in your court, God will help you make a fair decision. If any case is too hard for you, bring the people to me, and I will make the decision.
translation_verse: Taa nín̄ cáámaan digàntil ibɔsoon poon. An yaa sá kibikaaa, unikpaanaaa, ní pīlifiǹ bi-kɔkɔ mbaantiim. Taa fàŋkìmaan báà ubɔ, kun puee Unimbɔti di yì ibɔsoon ki làá sòoǹ kí tīī-ni. Tibɔti tin yaa pɔ̄ɔ̄ ki tīī-nee, ní cáań-tì m-cee ḿ kpèè-tì.»

english_verse: even though he had always been with us in the desert. During the daytime, the Lord was in the cloud, leading us in the right direction and showing us where to camp. And at night, he was there in the fire.
translation_verse: Too, ni-Nimbɔtiu gbanti mun di nìn līī ni-nyɔkɔpu, ní ki nìn nyàab̀-ni mpaan ni kàal̀ ki ŋùŋfī. Úǹ ubaantee di nìn tí cáá ŋŋmi ki ŋmíntí-ni nsan ŋun ni dēe kunyeeu, ní ki cáá ditagbandi ki dàkà-ni nsan ŋwiimpu.

english_verse: The Lord had commanded us to leave Mount Sinai and go to the hill country that belonged to the Amorites, so we started out into the huge desert. You remember how frightening it was, but soon we were at Kadesh-Barnea,
translation_verse: Míǹ boonee ní ti yíkì Ooreeb jool taapu ki kíĺ Amɔɔr yab jool saŋŋu kii ti-Dindaan ti-Nimbɔtiu nín nìn tīī-ti mara puee. Kii ni nín nyí puee, ti nìn dūu dī kuteeu kun nimbi ni-ba ká ku sá kukpaaŋŋu ki nyāŋkèe pu ní ki tin nyáń Kadeesi Barneeya tiŋki.

english_verse: and I told you, “We have reached the hill country. It belongs to the Amorites now, but the Lord our God is giving it to us. He is the same God our ancestors worshiped, and he has told us to go in and take this land, so don't hesitate and be afraid.”
translation_verse: Kpèèmaan, ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu dū kitiŋ nee ki tīī-ni. Míǹ puee, cùú fōōmaan-kì kí nīn kíǹ ki yì kii ti-Dindaan, ni-baabi Nimbɔtiu nín nìn tùkū-ni puee. Ní taa pée fàŋkìmaan, kí taa yàntī ni-wunti ń yɔ̀tī!»

english_verse: Then all of you came to me and said, “Before we go into the land, let's send some men to explore it. When they come back, they can tell us about the towns we will find and what roads we should take to get there.”
translation_verse: Niinee ní ni-kɔkɔ sútìń ki pìl̄-mi ki lī yii: «Tí tɔ̄maan binib ti-nyɔkɔpu bí cù kí kpèè kitiŋ gbanti nín bí puee. Bi yaa cūtì ki fātìi gítìń ti-ceeyee, bí tùkù-ti nsan ŋun ti máaǹ kí dēe nì ntimu mun poon ti cée nín bí puee.»

english_verse: It seemed like a good idea, so I chose twelve men, one from each tribe.
translation_verse: Ni lī mimmee ní m ká yii míǹ kítì ní m lēē ni-kansikin binib saalaa nì bili, kunaakoou kamaa poon unil ubɔ ubɔ.

english_verse: They explored the hill country as far as Bunch Valley
translation_verse: Niinee ní bi kíĺ dijool saŋŋu ki tin nyáń Eeskool tantakal pu, ki kpēē kitiŋee nín bí puee kɔkɔ.

english_verse: and even brought back some of the fruit. They said, “The Lord our God is giving us good land.” Israel Refused To Obey the Lord (Numbers
translation_verse: Bi kpēē kitiŋee míǹ ki dóòyee ní ki kītì kitiŋ gbanti sufii biliŋ ki cáań ti-cee. Bi nín fātìi gítìń ti-ceeyee ní bi lī yii: «Kitiŋ kin ti-Dindaan ti-Nimbɔtiu dūu tīī-tee baasii ŋān̄ ní!»

english_verse: Then you came back to the place of worship at Kadesh-Barnea and wept, but the Lord would not listen to your prayers. Israel Spent Years in the Desert Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Ni fātìi bāańee ní ki súń ki yáliŋkì ti-Dindaan nimbiin, ama ti-Dindaan kaa fātìi kpēē-ni gba ní kaa nín gbìl̄ tin ni sòon̄ee.

english_verse: You did not want to go into the land, and you refused to obey the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Nì míǹ kɔkɔee, ni yíì kaa cūtì ní ki ŋá mpɔɔgbifin kaa ŋá ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu nín bí yii ní ŋá puee.

english_verse: We are afraid, because the men who explored the land told us that the cities are large, with walls that reach to the sky. The people who live there are taller and stronger than we are, and some of them are Anakim. We have nowhere to go.”
translation_verse: Ba pu ní tí cù niin ní? Ti-nabiyaamu mun nyánní niinee mun bíil̀ ti-pɔbiliŋ ki lī yii: <Binib bin kóò kitiŋ gbantinee pɔ̄ɔ̄ ní ki sá tinikpaandi ki jítiǹ timbi, ní bi-timmu sá ntiŋkpaamu, ní agun ŋin bi máń ki māntìi tú-muee fɔ̀kɔ̀ ki tin sāā kutagbɔŋu.> Ní bi gíti lī yii: <Áli gba ti ká Anaaki yab tinikpaandi niin!>»

english_verse: The Lord our God will lead the way. He will fight on our side, just as he did when we saw him do all those things to the Egyptians.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu un līī ni-nyɔkɔpuee di yì dikɔ̀ndi ki làá já kí tīī-ni kii u nín nìn ŋá pu ki tīī-ni ŋyunti ŋun ni nìn dáá bí Eejipiti tiŋkinee, nimbi ni-ba nimbil ká míǹ,

english_verse: And you know that the Lord has taken care of us the whole time we've been in the desert, just as you might carry one of your children.”
translation_verse: ní kuteeunee ni gíti ká míǹ. Kí yòon̄ ŋwiin ŋun ni yíkìń Eejipiti tiŋkin ki dāa bāań mpaan ŋun pu ni bí díǹ neeyee, ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu di wúń ni-pu kii unil nín wúǹ u-biki pu miŋyee.»

english_verse: But you still would not trust the Lord,
translation_verse: Nì míǹ kɔkɔee, naa dū ni-mákal ki páaǹ ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu pu.

english_verse: You had made the Lord angry, and he said:
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan nìn gbìl̄ tin ni nìn sòon̄ee ní ki gíí diŋuul ki pūtì ki lī yii:

english_verse: You people of this generation are evil, and I refuse to let you go into the good land that I promised your ancestors.
translation_verse: «Binikpitib nee kansikin ubɔ kpá kí wāl̀ kitimmɔntii kin m nìn pōoǹ kí tīī bi-naanjabee,

english_verse: Caleb son of Jephunneh is the only one of your generation that I will allow to go in. He obeyed me completely, so I will give him and his descendants the land he explored.
translation_verse: asee Yeefunee jipɔɔn Kaaleeb baba di làá wāl̀-kì. Úǹ nì u-biyaamu ní m làá dū kitiŋ kin pu u cōom̀ee kí tīī, kun puee u ŋá min ní m lèe kɔkɔ.»

english_verse: The Lord was even angry with me because of you people, and he said, “Moses, I won't let you go into the land either.
translation_verse: An ŋá mimmee ní ti-Dindaan gíí ma mun pu diŋuul ni-pu ní ki lī yii: «Si mun, a kpá kí kɔ́ kitiŋee poon.

english_verse: Instead, I will let Joshua your assistant lead Israel to conquer the land. So encourage him.”
translation_verse: Ama Nuuni jipɔɔn Joosuwa un tútúǹ-see di làá cù niin. Míǹ puee á tīī-u kunyannyaau, kun puee úǹ di làá cáá Isirayeel yab kí kɔ́ǹ kitiŋ gbantin.

english_verse: Then the Lord spoke to you again: People of Israel, you said that your innocent young children would be taken prisoner in the battle for the land. But someday I will let them go into the land, and with my help they will conquer it and live there.
translation_verse: Ni-biyaamu mun ni cáá yii mu làá kpántí iyumbu kí tīī ni-nannanliibee, ni-biyaamu mun kaa nyí díǹ pu kí gàntī tiŋan nì tikpitilee, múǹ gba di làá cù kitiŋ gbantin. Múǹ ní m làá dū kitiŋ gbanti kí tīī mú nīn kíǹ ki yì.

english_verse: Then you told me, “We disobeyed the Lord our God, but now we want to obey him. We will go into the hill country and fight, just as he told us to do.” So you picked up your weapons, thinking it would be easy to take over the hill country.
translation_verse: Niinee ní ni kíí-mi yii: «Ti yīntiǹ ti-Dindaan. Kɔŋkɔnnee ti làá cù dikɔ̀ndi kii ti-Dindaan ti-Nimbɔtiu nín bí yii tí ŋá puee.» Ni lī mimmee ní báà ŋma yōoǹ u-janjawanti ki bàà dākafì yii an làá nīn sá sɔkɔmii ní ŋmā kí já kí fōō ajoon pu tiŋki.

english_verse: But the Lord said, “Moses, warn them not to go into the hill country. I won't help them fight, and their enemies will defeat them.”
translation_verse: Ama ní ti-Dindaan bí-mi yii: «Tùkù-bi bí taa cù ní kaa nín jáń, di sá yii maa làá nīn bí bi-kansikin. Bí taa yàntī bi-nannanliibi ń já kí pɔ̄ɔkiǹ-bi.»

english_verse: I told you what the Lord had said, but you paid no attention. You disobeyed him and went into the hill country anyway. You thought you were so great!
translation_verse: Ní m dū tibɔtee ki tùkū-ni, ama ní naa pílifiǹ-mi. Nì min kɔkɔ ti-Dindaan kpáafì-nee, naa pée fātìi tɔ́-u ní ki ŋá dilambil ki nín jɔ́ḿ ajoon tiŋkin.

english_verse: But when the Amorites in the hill country attacked from their towns, you ran from them as you would run from a swarm of bees. The Amorites chased your troops into Seir as far as Hormah, killing them as they went.
translation_verse: Ŋyunti ŋun Amɔɔr yab bin kóò ajoon pu niinee ká-nee ní bi nyánní, ki kītì ki bīiǹ ni-boon kii dinaŋgbansikpuuloolee, ki jáń ki pɔ́ɔkiǹ-ni sɔ́kɔ sɔkɔ ki kíĺ Seeyiir tiŋki ki tin nyáń Ɔrima tiŋki.

english_verse: until the Lord said: Moses,
translation_verse: Dalbee, ní ti-Dindaan bí-mi yii:

english_verse: Israel has wandered in these hills long enough. Turn and go north.
translation_verse: «Ni cōom̀ ki gɔ́ń dijool nee an yúntì. Kɔŋkɔnnee fàtī kí túĺmaan ŋgan pú.»

english_verse: And give the people these orders: “Be very careful, because you will soon go through the land that belongs to your relatives, the descendants of Esau. They are afraid of you,
translation_verse: Ní ti-Dindaan gíti tí bí-mi yii ḿ kpāafì-ni yii, ni làá jītí ni-nabiyaamu Eesayuu naantiibi tiŋki Seeyiir. Bi yaa ká-nee, bi làá fàŋkì, ama nimbee, ní cúúmaan ni-ba.

english_verse: but don't start a war with them. I have given them the hill country of Seir, so I won't give any of it to you, not even enough to set a foot on.
translation_verse: Ní taa táká-bi tibɔti ní kaa nín jáń nì bi, kun puee maa làá dū bi-tiŋki dijandi fiiiyee gba kí tīī-ni. Báà laakin ni làá dū ni-taaŋi kí síińee gba, maa làá tīī-ni. Di sá yii Seeyiir jooŋŋi tiŋkee, Eesayuu naantiibi ní m dūu tīī.

english_verse: And as you go through their land, you will have to buy food and water from them.”
translation_verse: Nì ni-nimbiliŋ ní ni làá dā tijin bi-cee kí jī. Ki kpáaǹ nnyim min ni làá nyɔ̀ee, ni làá dā-mì ní kí nín ká kí nyɔ̀.

english_verse: We went past the territory that belonged to our relatives, the descendants of Esau. We followed Arabah Road that starts in the south at Elath and Ezion-Geber, then we turned onto the desert road that leads to Moab.
translation_verse: Ti jítì Seeyiir tiŋkin laakin ti-nabiyaamu Eesayuu naantiibi kóòyee, ní ti nóó Arabaa teeku saŋŋu ŋun cá Eelaati nì Eesiyɔn Gabeer timmunee, ní ki fātìi dūu dī Moowaab teeku saŋŋu.

english_verse: The Lord told me, “Don't try to start a war with Moab. Leave them alone, because I gave the land of Ar to them, and I will not let you have any of it.” Tribes That Lived near Canaan
translation_verse: Ní ti-Dindaan bí-mi yii: «Ní taa táká Moowaab yab tibɔti ní kaa nín jáń nì bi, di sá yii maa làá tīī-ni bi-tiŋki dijandi báà fiiiyee gba. Kun puee m dū Aari tiŋki ki tīī Looti naantiibi ní bí nīn kíǹ ki yì.»

english_verse: Before the Lord gave the Moabites their land, a large and powerful tribe lived there. They were the Emim, and they were as tall as the Anakim.
translation_verse: (Dooooyee, Eem yab di nìn kóò niin. Eem yab gbanti nìn sá tinikpaandi, ki nìn wīikí ní ki nìn sá tinifɔkɔl kii Anaaki yabee.

english_verse: The Moabites called them Emim, though others sometimes used the name Rephaim for both the Anakim and the Emim.
translation_verse: Binib biba nìn cáá-bi ki tìì Reefa yab ní kii Anaaki yabee, ama Moowaab yab nìn yíì-bi Eem yab ní.

english_verse: The Horites used to live in Seir, but the Edomites took over that region. They killed many of the Horites and forced the rest of them to leave, just as Israel did to the people in the land that the Lord gave them. Israel Crossed the Zered Gorge Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Dooooyee Koor yab di nìn kóò Seeyiir tiŋkin, ama ní Eesayuu naantiibi kūū ki céetì-bi, ní ki fōō bi-tiŋki ki kíǹ ki kóò niin, kii Isirayeel yab nín nìn ŋá pu ki fōō kitiŋ kin ti-Dindaan dūu tīī-bi bí nīn kíǹ ki yèe puee.)

english_verse: When we came to the Zered Gorge along the southern border of Moab, the Lord told us to cross the gorge into Moab, and we did.
translation_verse: Ní ti-Dindaan tí bí yii: «Kɔŋkɔnnee, yīkìmaan kí dùtī Seereedi bùmbiki.» Niinee ní ti yíkì ki dūtì Seereedi bùmbiki.

english_verse: The Lord kept getting rid of them until finally none of them were left.
translation_verse: Ŋyunti ŋun ní bininjab bin nìn bàn̄ kí cù kujaau ti-Dindaan nibooliŋu kansikinee kɔkɔ kpíìyee,

english_verse: Then the Lord told me,
translation_verse: ní ti-Dindaan bí-mi yii:

english_verse: “Moses, now go past the town of Ar and cross Moab's northern border
translation_verse: «Díǹ nee, ni làá dī Aari tiŋki saŋŋu kí jītí Moowaab tiŋki pu,

english_verse: into Ammon. But don't start a war with the Ammonites. I gave them their land, and I won't give any of it to Israel.” More Nations That Lived near Canaan
translation_verse: ní kí tin nyā Amɔn yab pu. Ní taa táká-bi tibɔti ní kaa nín jáń nì bi. Kun puee maa làá tīī-ni Amɔn yab tiŋki báà dijandi fiii gba, di sá yii Looti naantiibi ní m dū kitiŋ gbanti ki tīī bí nīn yì.»

english_verse: Before the Ammonites conquered the land that the Lord had given them, some of the Rephaim used to live there, although the Ammonites called them Zamzummim.
translation_verse: (Binib biba nìn dàkafī yii, dooooyee Reefa yab di nìn yì kitiŋ gbanti ki kóò. Amɔn yab nìn yíì-bi yii Samsuum yab ní.

english_verse: The Lord helped them as he had helped the Edomites, who killed many of the Horites in Seir and forced the rest to leave before settling there themselves.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan nìn pée tí ŋá míǹ mbaantiim ní ki tīī Eesayuu naantiibi Eedoom yab bin kóò Seeyiir tiŋkinee. U nìn kūū ki céetì Ooni yab ki fōō bi-tiŋki ki tīī-bi, ní bíǹ jíń-kì ki kíǹ ki kóò niin ki dāa sāā díǹ.

english_verse: A group called the Avvim used to live in villages as far south as Gaza, but the Philistines killed them and settled on their land. Israel Crossed the Arnon Gorge Moses said:
translation_verse: Míǹ mbaantiim ní binib biba nyánní Kafitoor tiŋkin ki kūū ki céetì Aafi yab bin nìn kóò ntimbilimu mun nìn bí Gaasaa tiŋkinee, ní ki fōō bi-tiŋki ki kíǹ ki kóò.)

english_verse: After we went through Ammon, the Lord told us: Israel, pack up your possessions, take down your tents, and cross the Arnon River gorge. The territory of the Amorite King Sihon of Heshbon lies on the other side of the river, but I now give you his land. So attack and take it!
translation_verse: Ní ti-Dindaan lī yii: «Yīkìmaan kí kíĺ nsan kí dùtī Arinɔn bùmbiki. Kpèèmaan, m dū Eesbɔn bɔtiu Siiwɔn uamɔɔrja nì u-tiŋki ki ŋá ni-ŋaan. Bóob́maan dikɔ̀ndi kí jáǹ-u kí fōō u-tiŋki.

english_verse: Today I will start making all other nations afraid of you. They will tremble with fear when anyone mentions you, and they will be terrified when you show up. The Defeat of King Sihon of Heshbon (Numbers
translation_verse: Kí yòon̄ díǹ kí nīn cée, m làá yàntī anibul ŋin kɔkɔ bí kitiŋ puee ń fàŋkì-ni. Bi yaa láa pée gbìl̄ ni-puee, dinyoondi dāa cútí-bi ní bi-wunti jìkì ki gbáà kpàkpakpa.» Isirayeel yab jáń ki fōō ubɔti Siiwɔn tiŋki

english_verse: After we had crossed the Arnon and had set up camp in the Kedemoth Desert, I sent messengers to King Sihon of Heshbon, telling him that his nation and ours could be at peace. I said:
translation_verse: Niinee ní m dū binib ki tú doooo Kideemooti teeku bí cù kí sòoǹ nì Siiwɔn, Eesbɔn bɔtiu nì ŋgbansɔŋfi poon kí tùkù-u yii:

english_verse: Please let Israel go across your country. We will walk straight through, without turning off the road.
translation_verse: «Pɔ̄-ti nsan tí jītí a-tiŋki pu. Ti làá nīn pée tàkā didandi ní cáaa kí jītí. Taa làá pàatī ŋgan púɔɔɔ, kaa làá kpòotī kí cù ŋgiil pú.

english_verse: You can even sell us food and water, and we will pay with silver. We need to reach the Jordan River and cross it, because the Lord our God is giving us the land on the west side. The Edomites and Moabites have already let us cross their land. Please let us cross your land as well.
translation_verse: Kpèè, Eesayuu yab bin kóò Seeyiir tiŋkinee nì Moowaab yab bin mun kóò Aari tiŋkinee pú-ti nsan ti jítì bi-timmu pu. An puee ti pée là yii á yàntī tí jītí a-tiŋki pu kí tin dùtī Jɔɔdan buŋŋu kí kɔ́ kitiŋ kin ní ti-Dindaan ti-Nimbɔtiu làá dūú tīī-tee poon ní.»

english_verse: But Sihon refused to let us go across his country, because the Lord made him stubborn and eager to fight us. The Lord told me, “I am going to help you defeat Sihon and take his land, so attack him!”
translation_verse: Niinee ní ti-Dindaan bí-mi yii: «Kpèè, kɔŋkɔnnee m dū Siiwɔn nì u-tiŋki ki ŋá ni-ŋaan. Kíĺ kí jámaan kí fōō u-tiŋki kí nīn kíǹ ki yì.»

english_verse: We met Sihon and his army in battle at Jahaz,
translation_verse: Niinee ní Siiwɔn nì u-janjakitil kɔkɔ nyánní kí já nì ti Yaasa tiŋkin.

english_verse: and the Lord our God helped us defeat them. We killed Sihon, his sons, and everyone else in his army.
translation_verse: Ama ti-Dindaan ti-Nimbɔtiu nìn dū-u ki ŋá ti-ŋaan ní ti jáń ki pɔ́ɔkiǹ u nì u-jipɔmbi nì u-samaau kɔkɔ.

english_verse: Then we captured and destroyed every town in Sihon's kingdom, killing everyone,
translation_verse: Niinee ní ti fōō u-timmu kɔkɔ ní ki kūū ki céetì mu-nib kɔkɔ. Uninjeeee, unimpueeee, kibikeeee, báà unil kaa nìn kíǹ.

english_verse: The Lord helped us capture every town from the Arnon River gorge north to the boundary of Gilead, including the town of Aroer on the edge of the gorge and the town in the middle of the gorge.
translation_verse: Kí yòon̄ Arooweer tiŋki kin bí Arinɔn buŋgbandee nì kitiŋ kin mun bí Arinɔn tantakalin kí cáá sāā Galaadee, kitiŋ kiba kaa nìn kíǹ taa ŋúń ki jáń ki fōō-kì, di sá yii ti-Dindaan ti-Nimbɔtiu nìn dū mu-kɔkɔ ki ŋá ti-ŋaan ní.

english_verse: However, we stayed away from all the Ammonite towns, both in the hill country and near the Jabbok River, just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Asee Amɔn yab tiŋki nì ntimu mun nìn bí Yaabɔki buŋgbaŋŋee nì ntimu mun bí ajoonnee nì laakin ti-Dindaan ti-Nimbɔtiu nìn kpáafì-ti yii tí taa gbēēyee baba ní taa nìn fōō.

english_verse: But the Lord told me, “Moses, don't be afraid of King Og. I am going to help you defeat him and his army and take over his land. Destroy him and his people, just as you did with the Amorite King Sihon of Heshbon.”
translation_verse: Niinee ní ti-Dindaan bí-mi yii: «Taa fàŋkì-u, kun puee m dū-u ki ŋá a-ŋaan ki kpáaǹ u-samaau kɔkɔ nì u-tiŋki. Kii a nín ŋá Amɔɔr yab bɔtiu Siiwɔn un nìn kóò Eesbɔn tiŋkin puee, míǹ ní á ŋá u mun.»

english_verse: The Lord our God helped us destroy Og and his army and conquer his entire kingdom of Bashan, including the Argob region. His kingdom had lots of villages and
translation_verse: Ti nìn nāaǹ ntimu gbanti kɔkɔ ní ki kūū ki céetì mu-nib kɔkɔ, bininjab nì binimpoobi nì mbiyaamu, kii ti nín nìn ŋá Eesbɔn bɔtiu Siiwɔn puee.

english_verse: Sihon and Og had ruled Amorite kingdoms east of the Jordan River. Their land stretched from the Arnon River gorge in the south to Mount Hermon in the north, and we captured it all.
translation_verse: Ti nìn jáń nì Amɔɔr yab bɔtiibi bilee ní ki fōō bi-timmu. Ntimu gbanti nìn bí Jɔɔdan, ŋwìiń nyalaŋki pú ní, kí yòon̄ Arinɔn buŋŋu kí cáá sāā Eermɔn jool.

english_verse: Mount Hermon is called Mount Sirion by the people of Sidon, and it is called Mount Senir by the Amorites.
translation_verse: - Siidɔn yab yíì Eermɔn jool yii Siiriyɔn, ní Amɔn yab yíì-dì yii Seeniir. -

english_verse: We captured all the towns in the highlands, all of Gilead, and all of Bashan as far as Salecah and Edrei, two of the towns that Og had ruled. Og's Coffin

english_verse: After this we stayed in the valley at Beth-Peor.
translation_verse: Niinee ní ti gbíntì ditantakalin ki pìlīǹ Beeti-Peewɔɔr tiŋki.

english_verse: Israel, listen to these laws and teachings! If you obey them, you will live, and you will go in and take the land that the Lord is giving you. He is the God your ancestors worshiped,
translation_verse: Kɔŋkɔnnee Isirayeel yab, pīlifìmaan abɔkpaa nì akoobil ŋin mama m-ba bíi cáa dàkà-ni nee kí ŋá ŋi nín bí yii ní ŋá puee. Ni yaa ŋá mimmee, ni làá nīn bí dimaŋfalin ní kí kɔ́ kí fōō kitiŋ kin ní ti-Dindaan, ni-baabi Nimbɔtiu làá dūú tīī-ni nee.

english_verse: and now he is your God. I am telling you everything he has commanded, so don't add anything or take anything away.
translation_verse: Ní taa gbéeǹ tiba nì tiba tibɔti tin man cáa kpáafí-ni nee pu, kí taa tí bàtī tiba mun ti-pu kí fá. Ní nīn ŋúb́ ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu marab bin m cáa bíi kpáafí-ni nee.

english_verse: You must be very careful not to forget the things you have seen God do for you. Keep reminding yourselves, and tell your children and grandchildren as well.
translation_verse: Ama ní cúúmaan ni-ba, ní nīn nyíǹ ni-ba tiŋan kí taa súntí tin tin ni-nimbil kée. Ní yàntī tin ni kée ń nīn kā ni-pɔbilin ní nīn cáá-tì ki dàkà ni-biyaamu nì ni-naantiibi, ni-maŋfal wiiŋyi kɔkɔ poon.

english_verse: Do you remember the day you stood in the Lord's presence at Mount Sinai? The Lord said, “Moses, bring the people of Israel here. I want to speak to them so they will obey me as long as they live, and so they will teach their children to obey me too.”
translation_verse: Ní téetí ŋwiin ŋun ni nìn síl̀ ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu nimbiin Ooreeb jool caŋinee. Ti-Dindaan nìn tùkū-mi yii: «Kóoǹ samaa nee kɔkɔ kí kpāfì m-cee. M làá yàntī bí gbìl̄ m-nyɔɔbuŋŋi án nín làá ŋá pu bi-wiiŋyi in kɔkɔ bi cáá kí kàl̄ kitiŋ nee puee, bí bīfì kí nīn kíǹ ki fàŋkí-mi ní kí nīn cáa dàkà bi-biyaamuee.»

english_verse: and the Lord spoke to you from the fire. You could hear him and understand what he was saying, but you couldn't see him.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan nìn sòon̄ nì ni ŋŋmee poon. Nneen ŋubɔ nìn sòoǹ ní ni gbìl̀ nneenee pu, ama ní kaa wāĺ ubɔ. Kun kun ni nìn pée gbìl̀ee di sá nneen gbanti.

english_verse: The Lord said he was making an agreement with you, and he told you that your part of the agreement is to obey the Ten Commandments. Then the Lord wrote these Commandments on two flat stones.
translation_verse: U nìn cántì u-poondi din u pōoǹ-nee taapu ki tùkū-ni, ní ki bí yii ní ŋúb́ marab saalaa bin u síiǹ-nee. U nìn ŋmàn̄ marab gbanti titaŋkpapilindi tili pu.

english_verse: That's when the Lord commanded me to give you the laws and teachings you must obey in the land that you will conquer west of the Jordan River. Don't Worship Idols Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Ŋyunti gbanti mbaanti poon ní ti-Dindaan tīī-mi mara yii ḿ dàkà-ni abɔkpaa nì akoobil ŋin ni làá nīn ŋúb́ ni yaa bàn̄ kitiŋ kin ni làá dùtī kí fōō kí nīn kíǹ ki yì nee poonee. Ní nīn nyíǹ ni-ba nì iwaatooti

english_verse: When God spoke to you from the fire, he was invisible. So be careful
translation_verse: Ní nīn nyíǹ ni-ba, di sá yii ŋwiin ŋun ti-Dindaan nìn sòon̄ nì ni ŋŋmi poon Ooreeb jool puee, naa nìn wál̀ báà kujiliŋu kubɔ.

english_verse: not to commit the sin of worshiping idols. Don't make idols to be worshiped, whether they are shaped like men, women,
translation_verse: Ní taa kɔ́ǹ ni-ba tijɔkɔndi kí cùú nīn māā àá ki kpítí awaa aba kí nántíǹ uninja àá unimpu.

english_verse: And when you see the sun or moon or stars, don't be tempted to bow down and worship them. The Lord put them there for all the other nations to worship.
translation_verse: Míǹ mbaantiim ní ní taa wáaǹ kutaa kí kpèè ŋwìiń nì uŋmal nì iŋmalbijaa, an dàkà yii tin kɔkɔ pée bí kutaa puee, kí yàntī tí lábití ni-landɔkɔŋu ní nīn kíǹ ki gbàantí ti-taapu ki jáaḿ-tì. Ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu dū atuun gbanti ki tīī anibul ŋin kɔkɔ kíǹ ki bí kitiŋ puee ní.

english_verse: The Lord was angry with me because of what you said, and he told me that he would not let me cross the Jordan River into the good land that he is giving you.
translation_verse: Ni-puee, ti-Dindaan gíí m-pu diŋuul ní ki pūtì yii m kpá kí dùtī Jɔɔdan buŋŋu kí kɔ́ kitimmɔntii kin ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu làá dūú tīī-ni án kpántí ni-yakee poon.

english_verse: So I must stay here and die on this side of the Jordan, but you will cross the river and take the land.
translation_verse: Di sá yii m làá kpú kitiŋ kin bí nee poon ní, maa làá ŋmā kí dùtī Jɔɔdan buŋŋu. Ama nimbee, ni làá dùtī-dì kí fōō kitiŋee kí nīn kíǹ ki yì.

english_verse: Always remember the agreement that the Lord your God made with you, and don't make an idol in any shape or form.
translation_verse: Míǹ puee ní nīn nyíǹ ni-ba kí taa súntí dipoondi din ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu pōoǹ-nee. Ní taa tin nín̄ nāantí awaa ki nántíǹ tiba kii ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu nín bí yii ní taa ŋá puee.

english_verse: The Lord will be angry if you worship other gods, and he can be like a fire destroying everything in its path.
translation_verse: Kun puee ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu sá ŋŋmi ŋun wù ki céetée ní. U sá Unimbɔti un cáá ipoompoonee ní.

english_verse: Soon you will cross the Jordan River and settle down in the land. Then in the years to come, you will have children, and they will give you grandchildren. After many years, you might lose your sense of right and wrong and make idols, even though the Lord your God hates them. So I am giving you fair warning today, and I call the earth and the sky as witnesses. If you ever make idols, the Lord will be angry, and you won't have long to live, because the Lord will let you be wiped out.
translation_verse: Ama ni yaa ŋá mimmee, ibaamɔn ní m bíi tùkù-ni, kutagbɔŋu nì kitiŋ sá m-seeradambi díǹ yii naa làá pée sūŋkì ní kí kpú kí céetí kitiŋ kin ni làá dùtī Jɔɔdan buŋŋu kí tin kɔ́ nee poon. Naa làá kàl̄ ki-poon kí yúntí báà fiii, di sá yii ni làá kpú ní kí céetí malaa.

english_verse: Only a few of you will survive, and the Lord will force you to leave the land and will scatter you among the nations.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan làá dāá yàntī ní yàl̄ kí tin nín̄ bí atimbun aban. Ni-wíiŋŋu làá dāá bàtī ní ní kíń fiii atimbun ŋin poon ti-Dindaan làá dāá jà-ni kí cùnnèe.

english_verse: There you will have to worship gods made of wood and stone, and these are nothing but idols that can't see or hear or eat or smell.
translation_verse: Atimbun gbantinee, ni làá dāá nīn tòotī awaa ŋin ní unil dū u-ŋalii ki máńee, awaa ŋin sá idɔ nì ataŋkpee kaa wāĺaaa, kaa gbìl̀aaa, kaa jīǹ tijinaaa, kaa tíkì nnumee.

english_verse: In all of your troubles, you may finally decide that you want to worship only the Lord. And if you turn back to him and obey him completely, he will again be your God.
translation_verse: Ni-nimbinaamandi poonee, tin kɔkɔ m sòon̄ nee làá dāá bàń-ni, ní ní dāá fàtīí gítiń ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu cee, ní kí nīn kíǹ ki tɔ́-u.

english_verse: The Lord your God will have mercy—he won't destroy you or desert you. The Lord will remember his promise, and he will keep the agreement he made with your ancestors.

english_verse: The Lord wants you to know he is the only true God, and he wants you to obey him. That's why he let you see his mighty miracles and his fierce fire on earth, and why you heard his voice from that fire and from the sky.

english_verse: The Lord loved your ancestors and decided that you would be his people. So the Lord used his great power to bring you out of Egypt.
translation_verse: Di sá yii u nìn néeń ni-naanjab, ní ki lēē nimbi bin sá bi-naantiibee, ki dū u-pɔŋkpaaŋŋu ki nyántìń-ni Eejipiti tiŋkin.

english_verse: Now you face other nations more powerful than you are, but the Lord has already started forcing them out of their land and giving it to you.
translation_verse: U làá jà anibul ŋin sá akpaan ki pɔ̄ɔ̄ ki jítiǹ-nee, kí cáá-ni kí kɔ́ǹ bi-timmu poon, ní kí dū ntimuee kí tīī-ni mú kpántí ni-yamu.

english_verse: So remember that the Lord is the only true God, whether in the sky above or on the earth below.
translation_verse: Ní dàkafì tiŋan kí béé díǹ nee yii yilpu yilpu fɔ́ŋŋŋ nì kitiŋ taapuee, ti-Dindaan di sá Unimbɔti, Unimbɔti ubɔ kaa ti bí laaba.

english_verse: Today I am explaining his laws and teachings. And if you always obey them, you and your descendants will live long and be successful in the land the Lord is giving you. Safe Towns
translation_verse: Nín̄ ŋúb́maan u-bɔkpaaŋi nì u-marab bin m tīī-ni díǹ pu neeyee. Ni yaa ŋúb́-bee, án làá bútí ni nì ni-biyaamu mun làá dāá páań ni-boonee. Míǹ ní ni làá kàl̄ kí yúntí kitiŋ kin ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu làá dūú tīī-ni jaanjaanee poon.

translation_verse: Ntimuee sɔ̀. Bi nìn lēē Beeseer tiŋki kin bí kuteeu gbantaŋki puee ki tīī Rubeen yab, ní ki lēē Raamooti tiŋki kin bí Galaadee ki tīī Gaadi yab, ní ki lēē Goolan tiŋki kin bí Baasanee ki tīī Manasee yab. MOOYIISI SÒON̄ NLILIITIIM UNIMBƆTI MARAB PU (

translation_verse: Ŋyunti gbantee, baa nìn dá láá dūtì Jɔɔdan buŋŋu. Bi nìn dá láá bí Beeti-Peewɔɔr tantakal caŋin ní. Dijandi gbanti nìn bí Siiwɔn, Amɔɔr yab bɔtiu un nìn kóò Eesbɔnee tiŋki pu ní. Ubɔti gbanti ní Mooyiisi nì Isirayeel yab nìn jáń ki jíń ŋyunti ŋun bi nyáń Eejipiti tiŋkinee.

english_verse: and King Og of Bashan, and took their lands. These two Amorite kings had ruled the territory east of the Jordan River
translation_verse: Bi nìn jáń ki fōō u-tiŋki ki kpáaǹ Baasan yab bɔtiu Ɔɔgi tiŋki. Bibɔtiibee liitil nìn sá Amɔɔr yab bin nìn bí Jɔɔdan buŋgbandi, ŋwìiń nyalaŋki púee ní.

english_verse: from the town of Aroer on the edge of the Arnon River gorge, north to Mount Hermon.
translation_verse: Kitiŋ kin Isirayeel yab nìn fōōyee nìn dɔ̄ kí yòon̄ Arooweer tiŋki kin bí Arinɔn buŋgbandee kí cáá sāā Siiwɔn jool, an dàkà yii Eermɔn jool.

translation_verse: An nìn kpáaǹ Arabaa tiŋki kin kɔkɔ bí Jɔɔdan jandi ŋwìiń nyalaŋki pú púee, kí cáá sāā Arabaa mɔɔl din dɔ̄ Piisga jool taapuee.

english_verse: Moses called together the people of Israel and said: Today I am telling you the laws and teachings that you must follow, so listen carefully.
translation_verse: Mooyiisi yíiń Isirayeel yab kɔkɔ ki kpáfì ní ki bí-bi yii: «Pīlifìmaan Isirayeel yab, pīlifìmaan abɔkpaa nì akoobil ŋin m làá dūú sòoǹ kí ŋá ni-tafalin díǹ nee, kí bīfì-ŋi, kí nīn ŋúb́-ŋi, kí nīn ŋáań kii ŋi nín bí yii ní ŋá puee.

english_verse: Do not murder.

english_verse: The Lord our God made an agreement with our nation at Mount Sinai.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan ti-Nimbɔtiu pūtì ki pōoǹ-ti dipoondi Ooreeb jool pu.

english_verse: The Lord himself spoke to you out of the fire,
translation_verse: Ni-nimbiin niin, dijool pu ní ti-Dindaan sòon̄ nì ni ŋŋmi poon.

english_verse: but you were afraid of the fire and refused to go up the mountain. So I spoke with the Lord for you, then I told you that he had said:
translation_verse: Ŋyunti gbantee, man nìn sí ni nì ti-Dindaan kansikin ní ki cáá ti-Dindaan nyɔɔbundi ki nàatī-ni, kun puee ni nìn fàŋkí ŋŋmi gbanti kaa nìn kíí kí dàb̄ dijool. Ti-Dindaan nìn lī yii:

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, the one who brought you out of Egypt where you were slaves.
translation_verse: «Man di sá a-Dindaan a-Nimbɔtiu un di nyántìń-si kuyuŋun Eejipiti tiŋkinee.

english_verse: Do not worship any god except me.
translation_verse: «Á taa jāam̀ unimbɔti ubɔ kí kūtì man pu.

english_verse: Do not make idols that look like anything in the sky or on earth or in the ocean under the earth.
translation_verse: «Á taa mɔ́ɔ́ diwaal diba kí nántíǹ tiba tin bí yilpuee àá tin bí kitiŋ pu taapu dooyee àá tin bí nnyimin kitiŋ taapuee.

english_verse: Don't bow down and worship idols. I am the Lord your God, and I demand all your love. If you reject me and worship idols, I will punish your families for three or four generations.
translation_verse: Á taa gbàan̄ awaa gbanti nimbiin ní kaa nín jáam̀-ŋi, kun puee mama a-Dindaan a-Nimbɔtiuee, m sá Unimbɔti un cáá ipoompoonee ní. Ubɔ yaa ná-mee, m dátí udaan tafal ní kí dāá dáaĺ u-biyaamu mun tafal kí cáá sāā anaantitɔntɔkɔ ata kii anaa pu.

english_verse: But if you love me and obey my laws, I will be kind to your families for thousands of generations.
translation_verse: Ama bin néeń-mi ki ŋúb́ m-marabee, m ŋáań-bi tiŋan ní kí cáá sāā anaantitɔntɔkɔ kutuku pu.

english_verse: Do not misuse my name. I am the Lord your God, and I will punish anyone who misuses my name.
translation_verse: «Á taa nín̄ yíì man a-Dindaan a-Nimbɔtiu yindi fám fám, kun puee man a-Dindaan kaa làá dūú pɔ̄ un ŋáań mimmee.

english_verse: You have six days when you can do your work,
translation_verse: A cáá iwiin iluu kí tɔ̄ ditundi, kí ŋá tin kɔkɔ a cáá kí ŋée.

english_verse: but the seventh day of the week belongs to me, your God. No one is to work on that day—not you, your children, your oxen or donkeys or any other animal, not even those foreigners who live in your towns. And don't make your slaves do any work.
translation_verse: Ama ŋwinluluúti dal sá ŋwiŋŋuŋfikaa ní, ŋwiin ŋun a dūu sú man a-Dindaan a-Nimbɔtiuee. Á taa tɔ̄ báà ditundi diba ŋwiin gbanti. Sii a-baaa, a-jipɔmbaaa, a-bisalibaaa, a-tɔntɔnliibi bininjab nì binimpoobaaa, a-naayaaa, a-mammuɔɔɔ, a-waŋkutaaa, binicambi bin kóò a-pueeyaaa, ubɔ ń taa tɔ̄ ditundi. A-tɔntɔnliibi bininjab nì binimpoobi máaǹ kí tɔ̄ bi-ba kí ŋùŋfì kii siiyee ŋwiin gbanti.

english_verse: This special day of rest will remind you that I reached out my mighty arm and rescued you from slavery in Egypt.
translation_verse: Á téetí yii a nìn kāl̀ kuyuŋu Eejipiti tiŋkin ní man a-Dindaan a-Nimbɔtiu dū m-pɔŋkpaaŋŋu ki nyántìń-si kitiŋ gbantin. An pu ní man a-Dindaan a-Nimbɔtiu tīī-si mara yii á nīn tɔ́ ŋwiŋŋuŋfikaa.

english_verse: Respect your father and mother, and you will live a long and successful life in the land I am giving you.
translation_verse: «Á nīn tɔ́ a-baa nì a-na kii man a-Dindaan a-Nimbɔtiu nín síiǹ-si mara yii á ŋá puee. A yaa ŋá mimmee, a làá kàl̄ kitiŋ pu kí yúntí ní an bútí-si kitiŋ kin man a-Dindaan a-Nimbɔtiu làá dūú tīī-see poon.

english_verse: Do not steal.
translation_verse: «Á taa yɔ̀.

english_verse: When we were gathered at the mountain, the Lord spoke to us in a loud voice from the dark fiery cloud. The Lord gave us these commands, and only these. Then he wrote them on two flat stones and gave them to me. The People Were Afraid (Exodus
translation_verse: An nìn sá ŋŋmi nì ditagbandi nì dibɔmbɔŋkpaandi poon ní ti-Dindaan nìn sòon̄ nì ni-kɔkɔ mpɔn dijool pu ní ki tīī-ni marab nee. Waa nìn gíti kútì tiba an pu. Míǹ boonee ní u ŋmàn̄ marabee titaŋkpapilindi tili pu ní ki dūu tīī-mi. Mooyiisi, Unimbɔti bɔnaatiliu

english_verse: When fire blazed from the mountain, and you heard the voice coming from the darkness, your tribal leaders came to me
translation_verse: Ŋyunti ŋun ni gbìl̄ nneen sòoǹ dibɔmbɔndi poon dijool mun fōō ŋŋmee ní ni-naakɔti kpilib kɔkɔ nì ni-kpootiliibi sútì ki pìlīń-mi,

english_verse: and said: Today the Lord our God has shown us how powerful and glorious he is. He spoke to us from the fire, and we learned that people can live, even though God speaks to them.
translation_verse: ní ki lī yii: «Kpèè, ti-Dindaan ti-Nimbɔtiu yāntì ti ká u-nyooti nì u nín sá ukpaan miŋyee, ní ki yāntì ti gbìl̄ u-neen mun pu ŋŋmi poon. Díǹ ní ti nín ká yii Unimbɔti ŋūǹ kí sòoǹ nì unil, ní unil gbantee ń taa kpú kí nīn gbíntìi bí dimaŋfalin!

english_verse: But we don't want to take a chance on being killed by that terrible fire, and if we keep on hearing the Lord's voice, we will die.
translation_verse: Kɔŋkɔnnee, ba pu ní tí dū ti-ba kí tīī ŋŋmikpaan nee ń wà-ti tí kpú ní? Ti yaa gbíntìi bíi pílifí ti-Dindaan ti-Nimbɔtiu nín sòoǹ pu ŋŋmikpaan nee poonee, see tí kpú.

english_verse: Has anyone else ever heard the only true God speaking from fire, as we have? And even if they have, would they live to tell about it?
translation_verse: Di sá yii nisaal ulɔu di pée gbìl̄ dimaŋfal Nimbɔtiu neen pu, u sòon̄ ŋŋmi poon kii timbi nín bíi gbìl̀ pu nee ki ŋmátì?

english_verse: Moses, go up close and listen to the Lord. Then come back and tell us, and we will do everything he says.
translation_verse: Míǹ puee, sii sútí kí pìl̄ ti-Dindaan ti-Nimbɔtiu kí pīlifì tin u làá sòoǹee. Míǹ boonee á gítiń kí tùkù-ti tin kɔkɔ ti-Dindaan ti-Nimbɔtiu tùkū-see. Timbi làá pīlifì tin a làá sòoǹee kí ŋá míǹ.»

english_verse: The Lord heard you and said: Moses, I heard what the people said to you, and I approve.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan nìn gbìl̄ tibɔti tin ni nìn sòon̄ m-ceeyee ní ki bí-mi yii: «M gbìl̄ tin kɔkɔ binib nee tùkū-see. Tin kɔkɔ bi lēe, an kítì míǹ.

english_verse: I wish they would always worship me with fear and trembling and be this willing to obey me! Then they and their children would always enjoy a successful life.
translation_verse: Bi-pɔbiliŋ yaa bàà bɔ́ntì kí nīn fàŋkí-mi kí ŋúb́ m-marab kɔkɔ baabadal, án bàà làá nīn ŋān̄ ki tīī bi nì bi-biyaamu kí nīn cáa cá jaanjaan!

english_verse: Now, tell them to return to their tents,
translation_verse: Cùú tùkù-bi yii báà ŋma ń nīn gítí u-tantiun.

english_verse: but you come back here to me. After I tell you my laws and teachings, you will repeat them to the people, so they can obey these laws in the land I am giving them. Moses said:
translation_verse: Ama siiyee, gbíntí m-cee doo ḿ dū m-marab nì m-bɔkpaaŋi nì m-koobiliŋ kí tīī-si á cáá dàkà-bi, bi yaa bàn̄ kitiŋ kin m làá dūú tīī-bi bí nīn kíǹ ki yèe poonee, bí nīn ŋúb́-bee.»

english_verse: Follow them, because they make a path that will lead to a long successful life in the land the Lord your God is giving you.
translation_verse: Ní nīn dī nsan ŋun ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu cátì ki bíl̀ ni-nimbiinee, án nín làá ŋá pu ní nīn bí dimaŋfalin kí jī nnaam kí kàl̄ kitiŋ kin ni làá fōō kí nīn kíǹ ki yèe poon kí yúntée.

english_verse: The Lord told me to give you these laws and teachings, so you can obey them in the land he is giving you. Soon you will cross the Jordan River and take that land.
translation_verse: Marab nì abɔkpaa nì akoobil ŋin ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu tīī-mi ḿ dūú dàkà-ni ni yaa láa dūtì Jɔɔdan buŋŋu ki fōō kitiŋ ki kíǹ ki yèe, ní nīn ŋúb́ ki ŋáań kii bi nín bí yii ní ŋá puee dee.

english_verse: And if you and your descendants want to live a long time, you must always worship the Lord and obey his laws.
translation_verse: Án nín làá ŋá pu ní nimbi nì ni-jipɔmbi nì ni-naantiibi ń dāá fàŋkì ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu kí nīn tɔ́ u-bɔkpaaŋi kɔkɔ nì u-marab bin m tīī-ni nee iwiin in kɔkɔ ni cáá kí kàl̄ kitiŋ puee. Míǹ ní ni-maŋfal wiiŋyi làá fɔ̀kɔn̄.

english_verse: Pay attention, Israel! Our ancestors worshiped the Lord, and he promised to give us this land that is rich with milk and honey. Be careful to obey him, and you will become a successful and powerful nation.
translation_verse: An puee, Isirayeel yab, pīlifìmaan marab gbanti kí nīn tɔ́-bi, kí ŋá bi nín bí yii ní ŋá puee. Ni yaa ŋá mimmee, án làá bútí-ni, ní ní bùtī tikpil kitiŋ kin poon nnaabiim nì tisiil còol̄ee, kii ti-Dindaan ni-baabi Nimbɔtiu nín pōoǹ-ni puee.

english_verse: Listen, Israel! The Lord our God is the only true God!
translation_verse: Pīlifìmaan Isirayeel yab, ti-Dindaan di sá ti-Nimbɔtiu, ti-Dindaan sá ubaanti ní.

english_verse: So love the Lord your God with all your heart, soul, and strength.
translation_verse: Á nīn néeń ti-Dindaan a-Nimbɔtiu nì a-pɔbil kɔkɔ nì a-naŋki kɔkɔ nì a-pɔŋŋu kɔkɔ.

english_verse: and tell them to your children over and over again. Talk about them all the time, whether you're at home or walking along the road or going to bed at night, or getting up in the morning.
translation_verse: Á dū-bi kí cóoĺ a-biyaamu. A yaa kā a-dumpuɔɔɔ, a yaa tàkā nsan pu ki còom̄ ki cáaa, a yaa tí dɔ̄ɔɔ, a yaa tí yúɔɔɔ, bí nīn kā a-nyɔkɔn.

english_verse: Write down copies and tie them to your wrists and foreheads to help you obey them.
translation_verse: Á ŋmà-bi kí dūú fìn̄ a-ŋal nì a-yigbeel án nīn sá-si kudaaŋŋu.

english_verse: Write these laws on the door frames of your homes and on your town gates. Worship Only the Lord Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Á ŋmà-bi kí nákań a-punyɔmmu pu nì a-tiŋki punuubi pu. Isirayeel ń taa súntí u-Nimbɔtiu pu

english_verse: The Lord promised your ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob that he would give you this land. Now he will take you there and give you large towns, with good buildings that you didn't build,
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu làá dāá cáá-ni kí kɔ́ǹ kitiŋ kin ní u nìn pūtì ki pōoǹ ni-naanjab Abraam nì Isaaki nì Jaakɔb yii u làá dūú tīī-nee poon. Kitiŋ gbanti cáá ntimu mun sá ŋkpaamu ki ŋān̄ naa máńee.

english_verse: and houses full of good things that you didn't put there. The Lord will give you wells that you didn't have to dig, and vineyards and olive orchards that you didn't have to plant. But when you have eaten so much that you can't eat any more,
translation_verse: Kitiŋ gbanti gíti cáá adiin ŋin poon naa síiǹ tiba ama ní tigaajawan kɔkɔ nì ti-bulifi gbée, lɔkɔb bin naa gbìn̄ee, fiinyi nì ɔliifi sufii in naa cóoǹee kɔkɔ bí niin. Ni làá dāá jī ní kí díkí.

english_verse: don't forget it was the Lord who set you free from slavery and brought you out of Egypt.
translation_verse: Ama ní nīn nyíǹ ni-ba kí taa súntí ti-Dindaan un nyántìń-ni Eejipiti tiŋki kin poon ni nìn sá iyumbuee pu.

english_verse: Worship and obey the Lord your God with fear and trembling, and promise that you will be loyal to him.
translation_verse: Nín̄ fàŋkímaan ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu. Úǹ baba ní ni máaǹ kí jāam̀, ní úǹ baba yindi mun ní ni máaǹ kí pùtī.

english_verse: Don't have anything to do with gods that are worshiped by the nations around you.
translation_verse: Ní taa tòotī awaa ŋin anibul ŋin māntìi tú-nee tòotēe.

english_verse: If you worship other gods, the Lord will be furious and wipe you off the face of the earth. The Lord your God is with you,
translation_verse: Kun puee ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu un bí ni-kansikinee sá ipoompoon Nimbɔtiu ní. Ni yaa ŋá mimmee, see ú gíí ni-pu diŋuul kí kpɔ̀ kí céetí-ni kitiŋ pu.

english_verse: so don't try to make him prove that he can help you, as you did at Massah.
translation_verse: Ní taa cɔ̄ŋkì ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu kii ni nín nìn cɔ́ŋkì-u Maasa puee.

english_verse: Always obey the laws that the Lord has given you
translation_verse: Nín̄ ŋúb́maan ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu marab nì u-bɔkpaaŋi nì u-koobiliŋ ŋin u tīī-nee tiŋan.

english_verse: Someday your children will ask, “Why did the Lord give us these laws and teachings?”
translation_verse: Fool boon, ni-biyaamu yaa láa bālifì-ni yii: «Ba pu ní ti-Dindaan ti-Nimbɔtiu tīī-ni abɔkpaa nì akoobil nì marab nee dee?»
