english_verse: Then you will answer: We were slaves of the king of Egypt, but the Lord used his great power and set us free.
translation_verse: Ní dāá kíí-bi yii: «Ti nìn sá iyumbu ní Faaroo ŋaan Eejipiti tiŋkin, ní ti-Dindaan dū mpɔŋkpaan ki nyántìń-ti niin.

english_verse: We saw him perform miracles and make horrible things happen to the king, his officials, and everyone else.
translation_verse: Ti-nimbiin niin ní ti-Dindaan dàkā Faaroo nì u-dicaŋku nì u-nib kɔkɔ u-daanti nì u-tuŋkpaaŋŋi, ní ki kɔ́ǹ-bi digìŋ́kpaandin.

english_verse: The Lord rescued us from Egypt, so he could bring us into this land, as he had promised our ancestors.
translation_verse: Ama ní timbee, u nyántìń-ti niin ki cáań-ti doo ki dū kitiŋ kin u nìn pōoǹ kí tīī ti-naanjabee ki tīī-ti.

english_verse: That's why the Lord our God demands that we obey his laws and worship him with fear and trembling. And if we do, he will protect us and help us be successful.
translation_verse: Tin ti máaǹ kí ŋá ní kí nīn kítì ti-Dindaan ti-Nimbɔtiu nimbiinee di sá tí nīn ŋúb́ marab nee kɔkɔ, kí ŋá kii bi nín bí yii tí ŋá puee.»

english_verse: So be sure to obey his laws and teachings I am giving you today. The Lord Will Bless You if You Obey (Deuteronomy
translation_verse: Míǹ puee nín̄ tɔ́maan marab nì abɔkpaa nì akoobil ŋin m tīī-ni díǹ nee kí ŋá ŋi nín bí yii ní ŋá puee.

english_verse: When the Lord helps you defeat your enemies, you must destroy them without pity! And don't get trapped into worshiping their gods.
translation_verse: Anibul ŋin kɔkɔ nib ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu làá dūú ŋá ni-ŋaanee, ní kpɔ̀ kí céetí-bi. Ní taa sɔ̄ bi-saai kí taa tòotī bi-waaŋi mun. Di sá yii an dāa sá kutaliŋŋu ní ki tīī-ni.

english_verse: the Lord will force them out of the land. Then you must destroy them without mercy. Don't make any peace treaties with them,
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu làá dū-bi kí ŋá ni-ŋaan, ní ní já kí pɔ̄ɔkiǹ-bi. Ama ni yaa jáń ki pɔ́ɔkiǹ-bee, ní kpɔ̀ kí céetí-bi. Ni nì bi ń taa ŋá mpèé, ní taa sɔ̄ bi-saai mun.

english_verse: If you do, those people will lead your descendants to worship other gods and to turn their backs on the Lord. That will make him very angry, and he will quickly destroy Israel.
translation_verse: An yaa kaa sá míǹ, bi làá yàntī ni-biyaamu ń dū ti-Dindaan kí fá kí nīn kíǹ ki tòotī awaa, ní ti-Dindaan ń tí gíí ni-pu diŋuul ní kí kpɔ̀ kí céetí-ni malaa.

english_verse: So when you conquer these nations, tear down the altars where they worship their gods. Break up their sacred stones, cut down the poles that they use in worshiping the goddess Asherah, and throw their idols in the fire. The Lord's Chosen People Moses said:
translation_verse: Ni nín máaǹ kí ŋá-bi puee sɔ̀. Ní gbá kí wìil̀ bi-saraafaŋyi nì ataŋkpee ŋin bi dūu cóoǹ ki tòotēe, kí gàatì bi-windɔi ní kí wà bi-waakpitikaaŋi ŋŋmi.

english_verse: Israel, you are the chosen people of the Lord your God. There are many nations on this earth, but he chose only Israel to be his very own.
translation_verse: Di sá yii ni sá dinibul din ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu u-ba yèe ní. Ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu di lēē-ni ki nyántì anibul ŋin kɔkɔ bí kitiŋ puee kansikin ki dū-ni ki ŋá u-nibul, u-gaajawammɔntiiti. Ti-Dindaan ŋúb̀ u-poondi ní

english_verse: but the Lord chose you because he loves you and because he had made a promise to your ancestors. Then with his mighty arm, he rescued you from the king of Egypt, who had made you his slaves.
translation_verse: Ama, ti-Dindaan yaa dū u-pɔŋkpaaŋŋu ki nyántìń-ni Eejipiti yab bɔtiu Faaroo ŋaan, ní ki dá-ni ki nyántì kuyuŋunee, an sá yii u néeń-ni, ní ki ŋúb́ dipoondi din u nìn pōoǹ ni-naanjabee.

english_verse: You know that the Lord your God is the only true God. So love him and obey his commands, and he will faithfully keep his agreement with you and your descendants for a thousand generations.
translation_verse: Míǹ puee, ní béé yii ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu baba di sá Unimbɔti, ibaamɔndaan. Bin tɔ́ u-marabee, u ŋúb̀ u-poondi din u pōoǹ-bee kí cáá sāā anaantitɔntɔkɔ kutuku. U néeń bin néeń-uee ní.

english_verse: But if you turn against the Lord, he will quickly destroy you.
translation_verse: Ama bin ná-uee, u pée pà bi-paati ní dicilpu dicilpu niin, ní kí nàan̄-bi. Waa pée tàantí kí pà bin ná-uee bi-paati.

english_verse: God will bless you more than any other nation—your families will grow and your livestock increase.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan làá dāá bìin̄ ni-pu kí jītíǹ anibul ŋin kɔkɔ kíǹee. Ni-ninjab àá ni-nimpoobi báà ubɔ dāa kpá kí nīn sá uŋmaŋŋmanti, ki kpáaǹ ni-waŋkuti.

english_verse: The Lord will love you and bless you by giving you many children and plenty of food, wine, and olive oil. Your herds of cattle will have many calves, and your flocks of sheep will have many lambs.
translation_verse: Ni yaa láa kɔ́ kitiŋ kin u nìn pōoǹ ni-naanjab kí tīī-nee poonee, u làá dāá nīn néeń-ni kí bìin̄ ni-boon kí yàntī ní màal̀ kí bùtī, ní kí bìin̄ ni-kpaajinti kɔkɔ pu, an dàkà yii ni-bileeu nì ni-damam nì ni-kpam sufii, ní kí bìin̄ ni-naai nì ni-piii nì ni-ŋoobui pu.

english_verse: If you completely obey these laws, the Lord your God will be loyal and keep the agreement he made with you, just as he promised our ancestors.
translation_verse: Ni yaa pílifì akoobil gbanti ní ki yaa ŋá ŋi nín bí yii ní ŋá pueeyee, ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu mun làá ŋá-ni tiŋan kí ŋúb́ dipoondi din u pōoǹ ni-naanjabee deedee.

english_verse: You will no longer suffer with the same horrible diseases that you sometimes had in Egypt. You will be healthy, but the Lord will make your enemies suffer from those diseases. Destroy the Nations and Their Gods Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan làá kàkatī iween kɔkɔ kí wàatī-ni, ní kí kàkatī tiweeŋkpiil tin nìn jéetì Eejipiti tiŋki pu nimbi ni-ba nimbil kée kí wàatī-ni. Naa làá pée ká-i ni-cee, ama u làá cáá-i kí tɔ̄ bin kɔkɔ ná-nee pu ní.

english_verse: You may be thinking, “How can we destroy these nations? They are more powerful than we are.”
translation_verse: An yaa yíì ni làá dàkafì yii: «Too anibul nee pɔ̄ɔ̄ ki jítiǹ-ti. Kin mana ní ti làá ŋmā kí já nì bi kí fōō bi-tiŋki kí ŋá ti-yaka ní?»

english_verse: But stop worrying! Just remember what the Lord your God did to Egypt and its king.
translation_verse: Ní taa fàŋkìmaan-bi, ama ní téetí ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu nín ŋá Faaroo nì Eejipiti nib kɔkɔ puee.

english_verse: You saw how the Lord used his tremendous power to work great miracles and bring you out of Egypt. And he will again work miracles for you when you face these enemies you fear so much.
translation_verse: Nimbi ni-ba ká nì ni-nimbiliŋ agìŋ́kpaan ŋin poon u kɔ́ǹ-bee. Ni ká atuŋkpaan nì mpɔŋkpaan tuuŋŋi ŋin ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu ŋá ki nyántìń-ni kitiŋ gbanti poonee. Too, míǹ mbaantiim ní ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu làá ŋá anibul ŋin ni fàŋkí nee kɔkɔ.

english_verse: Some of them may try to survive by hiding from you, but the Lord will make them panic, and soon they will be dead.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu làá dāá dū inaŋgbansii ní kí tɔ̄ bi-pu, áli gba bin nìn ŋmátì ki nyàab̀ kí sāǹ kí báĺ ní taa ká-bee kɔkɔ ń kpú múb.

english_verse: So don't be frightened when you meet them in battle. The Lord your God is great and fearsome, and he will fight at your side.
translation_verse: Taa pée fàŋkìmaan-bi báà fiii pu, di sá yii ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu un bí ni-ceeyee sá Unimbɔtikpaan nì Kunimbɔtiwambiiu ní.

english_verse: As you attack these nations, the Lord will force them out little by little. He won't let you get rid of them all at once—if he did, there wouldn't be enough people living in the land to keep down the number of wild animals.
translation_verse: Fiii fiii ní ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu làá nīn jì anibul gbanti ki tìì-ni. Naa làá ŋmā kí kpɔ̀ kí céetí-bi dicilpu dicilpu niin, an yaa kaa sá míǹ ipeel làá bùtī ní kí nīn páb́-ni.

english_verse: But when you attack your enemies, the Lord will make them panic, and you will easily destroy them. You will defeat their kings one after another until they are gone, and no one will remember they ever lived.
translation_verse: U làá dū bi-bɔtiibi ki ŋá ni-ŋaan ní ní kpɔ̀-bi kí kpìtī bi-yiŋŋi kitiŋ pu. Bi-kansikin báà ubɔ kaa dāa ŋūǹ kí sīĺ ni-nimbiin. Ni làá dāá kpɔ̀ kí céetí-bi ní.

english_verse: After you conquer a nation, burn their idols. Don't get trapped into wanting the silver or gold on an idol. Even the metal on an idol is disgusting to the Lord,
translation_verse: Ní dāá dū bi-waakpitikaaŋi kí wà ŋŋmi. Ní taa yàntī animbil kúti nì sindaariyab bin bí ŋi-puee ń cúú-ni nnimbitaataam. Ní taa pée yòon̄-ŋi, an yaa kaa sá míǹ, an làá kpántí kutaliŋŋu kí tīī-ni. Di sá yii ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu ná tiwan gbanti ní.

english_verse: Israel, do you want to go into the land the Lord promised your ancestors? Do you want to capture it, live there, and become a powerful nation? Then be sure to obey every command I am giving you.
translation_verse: Ni máaǹ kí nīn ŋúb́ marab bin m tīī-ni díǹ nee ní kí ŋá bi nín bí yii ní ŋá puee. Ni yaa ŋá mimmee, ni làá nīn bí dimaŋfalin ní kí bùtī, ní kí kɔ́ kí fōō kitiŋ kin ti-Dindaan nìn pōoǹ kí tīī ni-naanjabee.

english_verse: so he made you go hungry. Then he gave you manna, a kind of food that you and your ancestors had never even heard about. The Lord was teaching you that people need more than food to live—they need every word that the Lord has spoken.
translation_verse: Agìń gbanti boonee, u yāntì ŋkùm cúú-ni, ní ki dū maana un nimbi nì ni-naanjab kaa nìn nyée ki kpíiǹ-ni. U nìn ŋá míǹ kí dàkà-ni yii an kaa sá tijin dijil ŋmaniŋma di yì unil maŋfal, ama anyɔɔbun ŋin kɔkɔ nyēeń ti-Dindaan nyɔkɔnee di yì unil maŋfal.

english_verse: So keep in mind that the Lord has been correcting you, just as parents correct their children.
translation_verse: Míǹ puee, ni máaǹ kí béé tiŋan yii, kii unil nín dàkà u-biki puee, míǹ mbaantiim ní ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu mun dàkà-ni.

english_verse: Obey the commands the Lord your God has given you and worship him with fear and trembling.
translation_verse: Nín̄ ŋúb́maan ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu marab, kí nīn ŋáań u nín là puee ní kí nīn fàŋkí-u.

english_verse: The Lord your God is bringing you into a good land with streams that flow from springs in the valleys and hills.
translation_verse: Kun puee ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu làá dū-ni kí kɔ́ǹ kitimmɔntii poon ní. Kitiŋ gbanti cáá ibun nì inyimbul nì nnyim min dɔ̄ kitiŋ taapu ki púǹ ditantakalin nì dijool pu ki pùub̀ee.

english_verse: After you eat and are full, give praise to the Lord your God for the good land he gave you.
translation_verse: Ni yaa láa jíń ki díkée, ní dāá jāam̀ ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu, kitimmɔntii kin u tīī-nee pu.

english_verse: Make sure that you never forget the Lord or disobey his laws and teachings that I am giving you today. If you always obey them,
translation_verse: Ama ní nīn nyíǹ ni-ba kí taa súntí ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu pu kí dū u-marab nì u-bɔkpaaŋi nì u-koobiliŋ ŋin m tīī-ni díǹ nee kí fá.

english_verse: you will have plenty to eat, and you will build good houses to live in.
translation_verse: Ni làá dāá jī kí díkí, ní kí dāá mā adimɔnti kí nīn kóò.

english_verse: But when all this happens, don't be proud! Don't forget that you were once slaves in Egypt and that it was the Lord who set you free.
translation_verse: Ama ní nīn nyí kí taa kpántí bilambidambi kí súntí ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu un nyántìń-ni Eejipiti tiŋki kin poon ni nìn sá iyumbuee pu.

english_verse: Remember how he led you in that huge and frightening desert where poisonous snakes and scorpions live. There was no water, but the Lord split open a rock, and water poured out so you could drink.
translation_verse: Úǹ di nìn līī ni-nyɔkɔpu ní ki cáá-ni ki jítì kuteeu kun wāā bàaa ki cáá tifaandi, ki sá ikoobu in cáá tiloolee nì inoom ŋmee pu. Kitiŋkuliŋŋi laakin nnyim kpée, u yāntì nnyim nyáń ditaŋkpal din pɔ̄ɔ̄yee poon ki tīī-ni.

english_verse: He also gave you manna, a kind of food your ancestors had never even heard about. The Lord was testing you to make you trust him, so that later on he could be good to you.
translation_verse: Kuteeu gbanti poonee u kpíiǹ-ni, ki tīī-ni maana un ni-naanjab kaa nìn pée nyí ki kée. U yāntì ni ká agìń kí cɔ̄ŋkì-ni, ní boonee kí dāá ŋá-ni tiŋan ní.

english_verse: When you become successful, don't say, “I'm rich, and I've earned it all myself.”
translation_verse: Naa máaǹ kí lì yii: «An sá nì ti-pɔŋŋu nì ti-pɔɔndi pu ní ti ká tigaajawan nee kɔkɔ.»

english_verse: Instead, remember that the Lord your God gives you the strength to make a living. That's how he keeps the promise he made to your ancestors.
translation_verse: Ama ní téetí ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu pu. Di sá yii úǹ di tīī-ni mpɔn ní ni ŋúń ki túń ditundi ki ká tigaajati gbanti kɔkɔ. U ŋá míǹ kí dàkà yii u nín nìn pōoǹ ni-naanjab dipoondi diŋyee, u bíi ŋáań míǹ kii an nín bíi jītí pu díǹ nan ní.

english_verse: But I'm warning you—if you forget the Lord your God and worship other gods, the Lord will destroy you, just as he destroyed the nations you fought.
translation_verse: Ni yaa kaa tɔ́ ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiuee, kii ti-Dindaan nín bíi kù ki céetí anibul ŋin bí ni-nyɔkɔpu nee, míǹ mbaantiim ní u làá kpɔ̀ kí céetí ni-mun.

english_verse: Israel, listen to me! You will soon cross the Jordan River and go into the land to force out the nations that live there. They are more powerful than you are, and the walls around their cities reach to the sky.
translation_verse: Isirayeel yab, Pīlifìmaan! Ni làá dùtī Jɔɔdan buŋŋu dee. Ni làá cù kí já nì anibul ŋin sá akpaan ki jítiǹ-ni ki pɔ̄ɔǹ-nee nib ní kí fōō bi-timmu mun sá ŋkpaamu bi máń agun ki māntìi tú an fɔ̀kɔ̀ ki tin tūū kutaayee.

english_verse: Some of these nations are descendants of the Anakim. You know how tall and strong they are, and you've heard that no one can defeat them in battle.
translation_verse: Ni làá jà Anaaki yab tinikpaandi nì tinifɔkɔl bin kóò niinee. Nimbi ni-ba nyí-bi ní ki gbìl̄ bi sòon̄ bi-pu yii: «Ŋma di ŋūǹ kí sīĺ Anaaki yab nimbiin dee?»

english_verse: But the Lord your God has promised to go ahead of you, like a raging fire burning everything in its path. So when you attack your enemies, it will be easy for you to destroy them and take their land.
translation_verse: Ama béémaan díǹ yii ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu u-ba di līī ni-nyɔkɔpu kii ŋŋmi ŋun wù ki céetí tikɔkɔee. Úǹ di làá nàan̄-bi ní kí dū-bi kí ŋá ni-ŋaan ní ní jà-bi kí nyāntí bi-tiŋki pu, ní kí kpɔ̀ kí céetí-bi malaa kii ti-Dindaan nín nìn pōoǹ-ni puee.

english_verse: After the Lord helps you wipe out these nations and conquer their land, don't think he did it because you are such good people. You aren't good—you are stubborn! No, the Lord is going to help you, because the nations that live there are evil, and because he wants to keep the promise he made to your ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. When Israel Made an Idol (Exodus
translation_verse: Míǹ puee, ní béémaan yii an kaa sá ni nín bí deedee fiii gba puee pu ní ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu làá fōō kitimmɔntii nee kí tīī-ni ní nīn yì. Ibaamɔn poonee, ni sá dinibul din pɔbil tīlifèe ní. Sindaariya nabil

english_verse: Don't ever forget how you kept rebelling and making the Lord angry the whole time you were in the desert. You rebelled from the day you left Egypt until the day you arrived here.
translation_verse: Ní téetímaan tibɔti nee kí taa súntí-tì dalba dalba ni nín kɔ́ǹ ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu diŋuul kuteeun puee. Kí yòon̄ ŋwiin ŋun ní ni nyáń Eejipitee kí cáá sāā ŋyunti ŋun ni bāań laakin ni bí neeyee, ni pée bí ní ki jáà nì Unimbɔti kaa gbèentí.

english_verse: At Mount Sinai you made the Lord so angry that he was going to destroy you.
translation_verse: Ooreeb jool puee, ni nìn tí gbítì ti-Dindaan ŋuul ní ki yāntì u gíí diŋuul tikpil áli u bàà nìn là kí kpɔ̀ kí céetí-ni.

english_verse: he said: Moses, hurry down the mountain to those people you led out of Egypt. They have already disobeyed me and committed the terrible sin of making an idol.
translation_verse: Míǹ boonee ní ti-Dindaan bí-mi yii: «Yīkì m-cee doo kí kpákatí malaa, kun puee dinibul din a nyántìń Eejipiti tiŋkinee kɔ́ tijɔkɔndin. Binibee kaa tāaǹ kí fàtī bi-boon kí tīī m-marab bin m tīī-bee. Bi dūntì tikúti ki dūu mɔ́ɔ́ diwaal.»

english_verse: I've been watching the Israelites, and I've seen how stubborn and rebellious they are.
translation_verse: Niinee ní ti-Dindaan gíti bí-mi yii: «M nín kpēē dinibul neeyee, m ká yii di-pɔbil lafun gbìfì.

english_verse: So don't try to stop me! I am going to wipe them out, and no one on earth will remember they ever lived. Then I will let your descendants become an even bigger and more powerful nation than Israel. Moses said:
translation_verse: Pée yàntī-mi ḿ kpɔ̀ kí céetí-bi bí taa ti pée gbìl̄ bi-pu kitiŋ pu. Ama siiyee, m làá dī sii pu kí náań ditimbundi din cáá mpɔn ki wīikí ki jítiǹ-bee ní.»

english_verse: Fire was raging on the mountaintop as I went back down, carrying the two stones with the commandments on them.
translation_verse: Niinee ní m kíĺ nsan ki nín kpákatiń dijool pu. Ŋŋmi nìn dá láá bí dijool gbanti pu. M nìn ŋúb́ dipoondi taŋkpapilinti tilee m-ŋaan.

english_verse: I saw how quickly you had sinned and disobeyed the Lord your God. There you were, worshiping the metal idol you had made in the shape of a calf.
translation_verse: M kpēēyee ki lafun ká yii ni yīntiǹ ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu. Ni nìn dūntì tikúti ki dūu mɔ́ɔ́ diwaal ki nántiǹ dinabil. Naa nìn pée tāaǹ ki fātì ni-boon ki tīī ti-Dindaan marab bin u tīī-nee.

english_verse: So I threw down the two stones and smashed them before your very eyes.
translation_verse: An pu ní m nìn dū titaŋkpapilindi tili tin m nìn ŋúb́ee ki yá kitiŋ ní ki gbáń ki wīī-ŋi ni-nimbiin niin. Mooyiisi gbāam̀ Unimbɔti Isirayeel yab pu

english_verse: I bowed down at the place of worship and prayed to the Lord, without eating or drinking for
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan nìn gíí Aarɔn mun pu diŋuul ki nìn là kí kpɔ̀-u. Niinee ní m mēē Aarɔn mun pu.

english_verse: It was a sin for you to make that idol, so I threw it into the fire to melt it down. Then I took the lump of gold, ground it into powder, and threw the powder into the stream flowing down the mountain.
translation_verse: M nìn yōoǹ ikpiti in ni ŋée tundi, an dàkà yii dinabilee, ki tɔ́ ŋŋmin, ní ki gbáń ki mátì-dì ki nàn̄-dì dúsi dusi kii ntamee, ní ki dū ntamee ki sītì mbun ŋun nyēeń dijool pu ki pùub̀ ki sìntēe poon.

english_verse: You also made the Lord angry when you were staying at Taberah, at Massah, and at Kibroth-Hattaavah.
translation_verse: Ni nìn tí yāntì ti-Dindaan gíí diŋuul Tabeera nì Maasa nì Kiibirooti-Taafa timmun mun.

english_verse: Then at Kadesh-Barnea the Lord said, “I am giving you the land, so go ahead and take it!” But since you didn't trust the Lord, you rebelled and disobeyed his command.
translation_verse: Míǹ mbaantiim ní Kadeesi-Baarneeya, ŋyunti ŋun ti-Dindaan nìn tú-ni ki lī yii: «Cùmaan kí fōō kitiŋ kin ní m dūu tīī-nee», ni nìn ŋá ntafapɔn kaa nìn fātìi tɔ́ ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu nyɔɔbundi. Naa nìn cáá u-pu dimákal ní kaa nìn dū tin u sòon̄ee ki túń ditundi.

english_verse: In fact, you've rebelled against the Lord for as long as he has known you.
translation_verse: Doooo ŋwiin ŋun m béè-nee, ni pée sá bin jáà nì ti-Dindaanee ní.

english_verse: After you had made the idol in the shape of a calf, the Lord said he was going to destroy you. So I lay face down in front of the Lord for
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan nìn bíikì ki lī yii u làá kpɔ̀ kí céetí-ni. An di yì-tì ní m nìn tātìi dōoǹ dicincibil ti-Dindaan nimbiin ki ŋá iwiin imuŋku ili ŋwiimpu nì kunyeeu.

english_verse: and prayed: Our Lord, please don't wipe out your people. You used your great power to rescue them from Egypt and to make them your very own.
translation_verse: M nìn mēē ti-Dindaan yii: «M-Dindaan Unimbɔti, taa kpɔ̀ kí céetí a-nibul nee. Sii di yì-bi ní ki dū a-pɔŋkpaaŋŋu nì a-ŋal pɔfiŋu ki fīī-bi ki nyántìń Eejipiti tiŋkin.

english_verse: Israel's ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob obeyed you faithfully. Think about them, and not about Israel's stubbornness, evil, and sin.
translation_verse: Téetí a-tɔntɔnliibi Abraam nì Isaaki nì Jaakɔb pu. Taa kpèè binib nee pɔɔpɔŋŋu nì bi-toonam nì bi-kpitii pu kí lì yii a làá ŋá-bi tiba.

english_verse: If you destroy your people, the Egyptians will say, “The Lord promised to give Israel land, but he wasn't powerful enough to keep his promise. In fact, he hated them so much that he took them into the desert and killed them.”
translation_verse: Á taa yàntī kitiŋ kin poon a nyántìń-tee nib ń lì yii: <Bi-Dindaan kaa nìn pée ŋūǹ kí cáá-bi kí kɔ́ǹ kitiŋ kin u nìn pōoǹ kí tīī-bee ni,> àá kí gíti lì yii: <Waa nìn pée néeń-bee pu ní u nyántì-bi Eejipiti tiŋkin kí cáá-bi kí kpɔ̀ kuteeu pu.>

english_verse: But you, our Lord, chose the people of Israel to be your own, and with your mighty power you rescued them from Egypt.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, bi sá a-nib ní. Sii di yì-bi ní ki dū a-pɔŋkpaaŋŋu nì a-ŋal pɔfiŋu ki nyántìń-bi Eejipiti tiŋkin!»

english_verse: The Lord told me to chisel out two flat stones, just like the ones he had given me earlier. He also commanded me to make a wooden chest, then come up the mountain and meet with him.
translation_verse: Niinee ní ti-Dindaan bí-mi yii: «Kpítí titaŋkpapilindi tili kii tipeepeekaalee. Míǹ boonee á kpáá ndɔ dakaau. A yaa ŋá míǹ ki dóòyee, á jɔ̄mìń m-cee dijool pu doo.

english_verse: He told me that he would write on the new stones the same words he had written on the ones I broke, and that I could put these stones in this sacred chest.
translation_verse: M làá ŋmà tipilindi gbanti pu anyɔɔbun ŋin nìn kā tipilimpeepeekaal pu a dūu lúkú ki wīīyee kí tīī-si á dūú ŋá dakaayee poon.»

english_verse: So I made a chest out of acacia wood, and I chiseled two flat stones like the ones I broke. Then I carried the stones up the mountain,
translation_verse: Niinee ní m dū busubu bun bi yíì akasiyayee dɔŋu ki kpáá dakaa ní ki kpítì titaŋkpapilindi tili ní ki ŋúb́-tì m-ŋaan, ki cáa jɔ́m̀ dijool pu.

english_verse: where the Lord wrote the Ten Commandments on them, just as he had done the first time. The commandments were exactly what he had announced from the fire, when you were gathered at the mountain. After the Lord returned the stones to me,
translation_verse: Kii ti-Dindaan nín nìn ŋmàn̄ pu mpeepeekaaminee, míǹ ní u tí fātìi ŋmàn̄ tipilindee pu marab saalaa bin pu u nìn sòon̄ dijool pu ŋŋmi poon ŋwiin ŋun ni nìn kóoǹ ki kpáfì dijool taapuee. U ŋmàn̄ míǹ ki dóòyee ní ki dū tipilindee ki tīī-mi.

english_verse: I took them down the mountainside and put them in the chest, just as he had commanded. And they are still there. Aaron Died (Numbers
translation_verse: M fōō tipilindee ní ki kpákatìń dijool pu ní ki dū-tì ki ŋá dakaa un m nìn kpááyee poon. Niin ní tipilindee gbíntìi kā kii ti-Dindaan nín nìn kpáafì-mi puee.

english_verse: Respect the Lord your God, be faithful, and serve only him, making promises in his name.
translation_verse: Fàŋkìmaan ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu kí nīn jáaḿ-u. Dūmaan ni-ba kɔkɔ kí tīī-u. Úǹ baba yindi pu ní ni máaǹ kí nīn pùtī.

english_verse: Later we set up camp at the wells belonging to the descendants of Jaakan. Then we moved on and camped at Moserah, where Aaron died and was buried, and his son Eleazar became the priest.
translation_verse: Míǹ boonee ní Isirayeel yab yíkì Beenee-Yaakan lɔkɔb cee ki cūtì Mooseela. Niin ní Aarɔn kpíì ní bi síb́-u ní u-jipɔɔn Eeleeyasaar fōō u-yil ki kpántì usaraaŋakpil.

english_verse: Next, we camped at Gudgodah and then at Jotbathah, where there are flowing streams. The Levites Were Appointed To Carry the Chest Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Bi nyáń niinee, ní ki cūtì Guudigoodaa, ní ki nyáń Guudigoodaa ki nín cá Yootibata, kitiŋ kin cáá ibun tikpilee.

english_verse: After I put the two stones in the sacred chest, the Lord chose the tribe of Levi, not only to carry the chest, but also to serve as his priests at the place of worship and to bless the other tribes in his name. And they still do these things.
translation_verse: Ŋyunti gbanti ní ti-Dindaan lēē Leefii naakookun yab bí nīn tūntí ti-Dindaan poondi dakaau, kí nīn bí u-nimbiin ki tūǹ u-tundi ní kí nīn bìintí binib pu ti-Dindaan yindi pu. Ditundi din bi gbíntìi tūǹ ki dāa sāā díǹee dee.

english_verse: Instead, he told me, “Moses, get ready to lead the people into the land that I promised their ancestors.” What the Lord Wants Moses said:
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan nìn bí-mi yii: «Yīkìm̄! Lìntī binib nee nyɔkɔpu bí cùú já kí fōō kitiŋ kin ní m nìn pōoǹ bi-naanjab yii m làá tīī-bee!» Nín̄ néeń ti-Dindaan kí nīn tɔ́-u

english_verse: People of Israel, what does the Lord your God want from you? The Lord wants you to respect and follow him, to love and serve him with all your heart and soul,
translation_verse: Kɔŋkɔnnee Isirayeel yab, ba ní ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu baasii là yii ní ŋá ní? U là yii ní fàŋkì-u, kí nīn ŋáań u nín là puee, kí nīn néeń-u ní kí nīn tūǹ u-tundi nì ni-pɔbil kɔkɔ nì ni-fam kɔkɔ.

english_verse: and to obey his laws and teachings that I am giving you today. Do this, and all will go well for you.
translation_verse: U là yii ní nīn ŋúb́ u-marab nì u-bɔkpaaŋi ŋin m bíi cáa tìì-ni díǹ nee, án nín làá ŋá pu án nīn ŋān̄ ki tīī-nee!

english_verse: Everything belongs to the Lord your God, not only the earth and everything on it, but also the sky and the highest heavens.
translation_verse: Kpèè ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu di yì yilpu fɔ́ŋŋŋ ki yì kitiŋ nì tin kɔkɔ bí ki-puee.

english_verse: Yet the Lord loved your ancestors and wanted them to belong to him. So he chose them and their descendants rather than any other nation, and today you are still his people.
translation_verse: Ama, ti-Dindaan nìn dū u-ba ki nákáǹ ni-naanjab ŋmaniŋma ní, bíǹ ní u néeń. Kɔŋkɔnnee, nimbi bi-naantiibi ní u lēē anibul kɔkɔ kansikin, kii an nín bí pu díǹ nee.

english_verse: Remember your agreement with the Lord and stop being so stubborn.
translation_verse: Míǹ puee ní kpántímaan ni-pɔbiliŋ kí dū ni-ba kɔkɔ kí sú ti-Dindaan, kí gbèen̄ kí taa ti jáǹ-u.

english_verse: The Lord your God is more powerful than all other gods and lords, and his tremendous power is to be feared. His decisions are always fair, and you cannot bribe him to change his mind.
translation_verse: Di sá yii úǹ di sá inimbɔti kɔkɔ Nimbɔtiu, ní ki sá bidindambi kɔkɔ Dindaan. U sá Unimbɔtikpaan, ki sá Mpɔŋkɔdaan ní ki sá Unimbɔti un cáá tifaandee. Waa pɔ̀ gandi, kaa fòol̄ ubɔ mun cee tiba kí pɔ̀-u.

english_verse: The Lord defends the rights of orphans and widows. He cares for foreigners and gives them food and clothing.
translation_verse: U mɔ́tí ataŋkpiibil nì bikpiipoobi pu, ní ki néeń unicaan un kóò ni-puee ki tìì-u u jīǹ, ki pèentí-u.

english_verse: And you should also care for them, because you were foreigners in Egypt.
translation_verse: Míǹ puee ni máaǹ kí nīn néeń binicambi bin kóò ni-puee, di sá yii nimbi ni-ba nìn sá binicambi ní Eejipiti tiŋkin.

english_verse: Offer your praises to him, because you have seen him work such terrifying miracles for you.
translation_verse: Úǹ ní ni máaǹ kí nyɔ̄ŋkì. Úǹ baba di sá ni-Nimbɔtiu. Úǹ di ŋá atuŋkpaan nì maamaaci tuuŋŋi ki tīī-ni. Nimbi ni-ba ká míǹ.

english_verse: The Lord is your God, so you must always love him and obey his laws and teachings.
translation_verse: Nín̄ néeḿmaan ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu kí nīn ŋáań u nín bí yii ní ŋá puee, kí nīn ŋúb́ u-bɔkpaaŋi nì u-koobiliŋ nì u-marab baabadal.

english_verse: Remember, he corrected you and not your children. You are the ones who saw the Lord use his great power
translation_verse: Nimbi bin sí díǹ nee, ní béé yii an kaa sá ni-biyaamu mun kaa nyí kaa ká ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu dàkatam nì u-pɔŋŋu nì u-tuŋkpaaŋŋee ní m bíi sòoǹ.

english_verse: when he worked miracles in Egypt, making terrible things happen to the king and all his people.
translation_verse: Múǹ di kaa nìn ká maamaacib nì atuun ŋin ní u nìn ŋá Eejipiti tiŋkin ki dàkā Eejipiti bɔtiu Faaroo nì u-tiŋki nib kɔkɔee.

english_verse: And when the Egyptian army chased you in their chariots, you saw the Lord drown them and their horses in the Red Sea. Egypt still suffers from that defeat!
translation_verse: Muaa nìn tí ká ti-Dindaan nín nìn yāntì Tikati mɔɔl nyim gbí ki léeǹ Eejipiti yab janjaliibi nì bi-taamui nì bi-janjatɔrɔkub pu, ki kūū ki céetì-bi kɔkɔ múb ŋyunti ŋun bi nìn bíi jìń ni-boonee

english_verse: You saw what the Lord did for you while you were in the desert, right up to the time you arrived here.
translation_verse: An kaa nìn tí sá ni-biyaamu di nìn ká tin kɔkɔ u ŋá ki tīī-ni kuteeun, ki yāntì ni bāań laakin ni bí nee.

english_verse: And you saw how the Lord made the ground open up in the middle of our camp underneath the tents of Dathan and Abiram, who were swallowed up along with their families, their animals, and their tents.
translation_verse: Múǹ di kaa nìn tí ká u nín nìn ŋá Eeliyaab jipɔmbi Datan nì Abiiram bin nìn sá Rubeen naakookunee puee. U nìn yāntì kitiŋ cúu cōotì laakin bi nìn sée, ní bíǹ nì bi-dicaŋŋi nì bi-tantib nì bin kɔkɔ nìn yú bi-boonee jéetì poon ní kitiŋ fātìi dūu ŋéeb́ bi-pu Isirayeel yab kɔkɔ nimbiin.

english_verse: With your own eyes, you saw the Lord's mighty power do all these things.
translation_verse: Ni-nimbilaaliyin ní ti-Dindaan túń atuŋkpaan gbanti kɔkɔ.

english_verse: Soon you will cross the Jordan River, and if you obey the laws and teachings I'm giving you today, you will be strong enough to conquer the land
translation_verse: Míǹ puee nín̄ ŋúb́maan marab bin kɔkɔ m tīī-ni díǹ nee. Ni yaa ŋá mimmee, ni làá ŋmā kí ká mpɔn kí kɔ́ kitiŋ kin ni bíi dùtī Jɔɔdan buŋŋu kí tin fōō kí nīn kíǹ ki yì nee poon,

english_verse: that the Lord promised your ancestors and their descendants. It's rich with milk and honey, and you will live there and enjoy it for a long time.
translation_verse: ní kí ŋmā kí kàl̄ kitiŋ kin ti-Dindaan nìn pōoǹ kí tīī ni-naanjab nì bi-naantiibee poon kí yúntí. Kitiŋ gbanti poonee, tisiil nì nnaabiim còol̀ ní. Kitiŋ kin ti-Dindaan kpèé tiŋanee

english_verse: But the hills and valleys in the promised land are watered by rain from heaven,
translation_verse: Ama kitiŋ kin ni làá dùtī Jɔɔdan buŋŋu kí tin fōō nee sá ajoon nì atantaka tiŋki ní, ní utaa nì ki-pu.

english_verse: because the Lord your God keeps his eye on this land and takes care of it all year long.
translation_verse: Kì sá kitiŋ kin pu ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu wúńee ní. Ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu nimbil pée cɔ́ ki-pu ní baabadal, kí yòon̄ dibindi kíltam kí cáá sāā di-kúntitam.

english_verse: The Lord your God commands you to love him and to serve him with all your heart and soul. If you obey him,
translation_verse: Míǹ puee ni yaa tɔ́ marab bin m tīī-ni díǹ nee, ki néeń ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu, ki nóó-u nì ni-pɔbil kɔkɔ nì ni-naŋki kɔkɔee,

english_verse: he will send rain at the right seasons, so you will have more than enough food, wine, and olive oil, and there will be plenty of grass for your cattle.
translation_verse: U làá yàntī ni-naakpaapɔɔku ń nīn cáá timɔsɔn kí tīī ni-waŋkuti, ní nimbi ni-ba ń jī kí díkí.

english_verse: But watch out! You will be tempted to turn your backs on the Lord. And if you worship other gods,
translation_verse: Ama ní nīn nyíǹ ni-ba an taa ŋmàtiǹ-ni ní fàtī ni-boon kí tīī-u, kí cùú nīn gbàantí awaa taapu ki jáaḿ-ŋi.

english_verse: the Lord will become angry and keep the rain from falling. Nothing will grow in your fields, and you will die and disappear from the good land that the Lord is giving you.
translation_verse: Ni yaa ŋá míǹ, ti-Dindaan làá gíí ni-pu diŋuul ní kí dū kutaa kí pìin̄ ní utaa ń taa ti nì. Ni-tiŋki kaa ti làá ŋmā kí lòoǹ tikpaajin. An yaa ŋá mimmee naa làá sūŋkì ní kí kpú kí céetí kitimmɔntii kin ti-Dindaan tīī-nee poon.

english_verse: Memorize these laws and think about them. Write down copies and tie them to your wrists and your foreheads to help you obey them.
translation_verse: Dūmaan marab bin m tīī-ni díǹ nee kí ŋá ni-pɔbiliŋin nì ni-nammun. Dūmaan-bi kí fìn̄ ni-ŋalii nì ni-yigbeeŋi pu án nín làá ŋá pu ní taa súntí bi-puee.

english_verse: Teach them to your children. Talk about them all the time—whether you're at home or walking along the road or going to bed at night, or getting up in the morning.
translation_verse: Dūmaan-bi kí dàkà ni-biyaamu. Báà ni yaa bí ni-diikunaaa, ni tàkā nsanni ki còom̄ ki cáaa, ni dɔ̄ɔɔ, ni yúɔɔɔ, bí nīn kā ni-nyɔkɔn.

english_verse: Write them on the door frames of your homes and on your town gates.
translation_verse: Ŋmàmaan-bi kí nákań ni-diiŋŋi punyɔmmu pu nì ni-timmu punuubi pu.

english_verse: Then you and your descendants will live a long time in the land that the Lord promised your ancestors. Your families will live there as long as the sky is above the earth.
translation_verse: Ni yaa ŋá mimmee, ni nì ni-biyaamu làá kàl̄ kitiŋ kin ti-Dindaan pōoǹ kí tīī ni-naanjabee pu kí yúntí kii kutaa kun dàn̄ kitiŋ pu nee nín làá yúntí puee.

english_verse: Love the Lord your God faithfully and obey all the laws and teachings I'm giving you today. If you live the way the Lord wants,
translation_verse: Tiŋman, ni yaa lafun ŋúb́ marab bin m tīī-ni díǹ nee kɔkɔ ki néeń ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu ki ŋáań u nín là puee, ki dū ni-ba ki nákáǹ-uee,

english_verse: he will help you take the land. And even though the nations there are more powerful than you, the Lord will force them to leave when you attack.
translation_verse: ti-Dindaan làá jà anibul nee kɔkɔ kí tīī-ni ní ní fōō anibul ŋin sá akpaan ki pɔ̄ɔ̄ ki jítiǹ-ni nee timmu kí nīn yì.

english_verse: You will capture the land everywhere you go, from the Southern Desert to the Lebanon Mountains, and from the Euphrates River west to the Mediterranean Sea.
translation_verse: Laakin kamaa ní ni-taal yaa tāāyee làá kpántí ni-wanti ní. Ni-tiŋki làá dāá nīn wāā kí yòon̄ kuteeu kí cáá sāā Leebanɔn, ní kí yòon̄ Eefiraati mɔɔl kí cáá sāā Meediiteeranee tiŋkuu ŋwìiń jeetilaŋki pú.

english_verse: No one will be able to stand up to you. The Lord will make everyone terrified of you, just as he promised.
translation_verse: Báà ubɔ kaa dāa ŋūǹ kí sīĺ ni-nimbiin kí jáǹ-ni. Laakin kamaa ní ni yaa pée cūtèe, ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu làá yàntī niin nib kɔkɔ ń fàŋkì-ni ní bi-wunti ń kpú kii u nín pōoǹ-ni puee.

english_verse: Today I am giving you his laws, and if you obey him, he will bless you.
translation_verse: Ni yaa tɔ́ ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu marab bin m tīī-ni díǹ neeyee, dibiindi dee.

english_verse: But if you disobey him and worship those gods that have never done anything for you, the Lord will put a curse on you.
translation_verse: Ama ni yaa kaa tɔ́ ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu marab, ní ki yaa fātì ni-boon ki tīī tin kɔkɔ m kpáafì-ni díǹ nee ki cūtìi nóó awaa ŋin naa nyée, mbusu dee.

english_verse: After the Lord your God helps you take the land, you must have a ceremony where you announce his blessings from Mount Gerizim and his curses from Mount Ebal.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu yaa láa cáá-ni ki kɔ́ǹ kitiŋ kin ni bíi bɔ́ntí kí cù kí fōō nee poonee, ní tɔ́kɔń Geerisiim jool yilpu kí tīī dibiindi, ní kí tɔ́kɔń Eebaal jool yilpu kí tɔ̄ mbusu.

english_verse: You know that these two mountains are west of the Jordan River in land now controlled by the Canaanites living in the Jordan River valley. The mountains are west of the road near the sacred trees of Moreh on the other side of Gilgal.
translation_verse: Kii ni nín nyí puee, ajoon gbanti bí ni yaa dūtì Jɔɔdan buŋŋu ki yōoǹ didandi din dɔ̄ ŋwìiń nyalaŋki púee, ní ki bí Kanaan yab bin kóò Arabaa tiŋki poonee, Giilgaal caŋin. An kaa dátiǹ Mooree sukpaaŋyi.

english_verse: Soon you will cross the Jordan River to conquer the land that the Lord your God is giving you. And when you have settled there,
translation_verse: Ni làá dùtī Jɔɔdan buŋŋu kí cù kí fōō kitiŋ kin ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu tīī-nee dee. Ní fōō kitiŋ gbanti kí nīn kíǹ ki kóò ki-ni.

english_verse: be careful to obey his laws and teachings that I am giving you today.
translation_verse: Ní pɔ́ɔm̀maan ni-ba kí nīn tɔ́ abɔkpaa nì akoobil ŋin kɔkɔ m tīī-ni díǹ nee.

english_verse: Now I'll tell you the laws and teachings that you have to obey as long as you live. Your ancestors worshiped the Lord, and he is giving you this land.
translation_verse: Iwiin in kɔkɔ ni cáá kí kàl̄ kitiŋ kin ti-Dindaan ni-baabi Nimbɔtiu làá tīī-ni ní nīn yèe poonee, abɔkpaa nì marab bin ni máaǹ kí nīn ŋúb́ kí ŋá kii bi nín bí yii ní ŋá puee sɔ̀. Mpaambaanti ŋun pu bi làá nīn jáaḿ Unimbɔtee

english_verse: But the nations that live there worship other gods. So after you capture the land, you must completely destroy their places of worship—on mountains and hills or in the shade of large trees.
translation_verse: Ní kpēelikì iwaatootipaan in kɔkɔ bí ajoon nì ŋgbantamu puee nì isuboon taapu laakin anibul ŋin ni làá jà nee tòotī bi-waaŋee kí fá, bí taa ti ká ipaan gbanti.

english_verse: Wherever these nations worship their gods, you must tear down their altars, break their sacred stones, burn the sacred poles used in worshiping the goddess Asherah, and smash their idols to pieces. Destroy these places of worship so completely that no one will remember they were ever there.
translation_verse: Ní kpēelikì bi-saraafaŋyi, kí gbá kí wìil̀ ataŋkpee ŋin bi dūu cóoǹ ki tòotēe, ní kí wà bi-windɔi ŋŋmi. Gbámaan kí wìil̀ bi-waaŋi ŋin bi máńee binib ń taa ti béé yii tiba nìn bí ipaan gbanti pu.

english_verse: Don't worship the Lord your God in the way those nations worship their gods.
translation_verse: Naa máaǹ kí jāam̀ ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu kii bíǹ nín jáaḿ bi-waaŋi puee.

english_verse: The Lord has promised that later on he will give Israel more land, and some of you may not be able to travel all the way from your homes to the place of worship each time you are hungry for meat. But the Lord will give you cattle, sheep, and goats, and you can butcher any of those animals at home and eat as much as you want.
translation_verse: Mpaan ŋun ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu lēē ní nīn jáaḿ-uee yaa dátiǹ-nee, ní dāá lēē ni-naai àá ni-piii àá ni-ŋoobui in ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu tīī-nee kansikin tin ni lèe kí kpɔ̀ nimbi ni-ba timmu poon kí pée ŋmɔ́ ni nín là puee, kí nóó nì m nín kpáafì-ni puee.

english_verse: It is the same as eating the meat from a deer or a gazelle that you kill when you go hunting. And in this way, anyone who is unclean and unfit for worship can have some of the meat.
translation_verse: Niinee ni pée ŋmóò-tì kii bi nín kù ucaŋkpalim àá ukpiil pu kí ŋmɔ́-uee ní. Un bí circiree nì un kaa bí circiree kɔkɔ ŋūǹ kí ŋmɔ́ tinan gbanti.

english_verse: But don't eat the blood. It is the life of the animal, so let it drain out on the ground before you eat the meat.
translation_verse: Naa máaǹ kí ŋmɔ́ fatiku. Ní kpáatí-u kí fá kitiŋ kii bi nín kpáatí nnyim kí fá puee.

english_verse: Do you want the Lord to make you successful? Do you want your children to be successful even after you are gone? Then do what pleases the Lord and don't eat blood.
translation_verse: Ní taa pée ŋmɔ́ fatiku, án nín làá ŋá pu án nīn ŋān̄ kí tīī ni nì ni-biyaamuee. Di sá yii ŋyunti gbantee, ni bíi ŋáań min kítì ti-Dindaan nimbiinee dee.

english_verse: All sacrifices and offerings to the Lord must be taken to the place where he chooses to be worshiped. If you offer a sacrifice to please the Lord, all of its meat must be burned on the altar. You can eat the meat from certain kinds of sacrifices, but you must always pour out the animal's blood on the altar.
translation_verse: An yaa sá saraawɔkaayee, ní yòon̄ tinan kɔkɔ nì fatiku kí cáá ŋá saraa ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu saraafaŋŋu pu. Ama an yaa sá saraabi bin kíǹeeyee, ní kpáatí bi-fatikuu kí pɔ̀l̄ ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu saraafaŋŋu pu, ní kí ŋmɔ́ tinan.

english_verse: If you obey these laws, you will be doing what the Lord your God says is right and good. Then he will help you and your descendants be successful. Worship the Lord in the Right Way Moses said:
translation_verse: Ní pīlifì tiŋan kí nīn ŋúb́ abɔkpaa ŋin m tīī-ni nee, ní án bútí ni nì ni-biyaamu mun làá páanní ni-boonee kí nīn cáa cá jaanjaan. Kun puee ni yaa ŋá mimmee, ni ŋá min kítì ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu nimbiinee dee. Ní nīn nyíǹ ni-ba nì Kanaan yab waaŋi

english_verse: Israel, as you go into the land and attack the nations that are there, the Lord will get rid of them, and you can have their land.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu làá nàan̄ anibul ŋin kóò kitiŋ kin poon ni cá kí kɔ́ nee. Ni làá dāá jà-bi ní kí fōō bi-tiŋki kí nīn kíǹ ki kóò niin.

english_verse: But that's when you must be especially careful not to ask, “How did those nations worship their gods? Shouldn't we worship the Lord in the same way?”
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan yaa láa nāaǹ-bi míǹ ki dóòyee, ní dāá nīn nyí nì ni-ba kí taa píĺ ni-ba kutaliŋŋu kí bàlifì bi-waaŋi pu, kí lì yii: «Mana ní anibul nee nib nìn tòotī bi-waaŋi ní? Ti-mun bàà là kí ŋá míǹ mbaantiim deeyaa!»

english_verse: No, you should not! The Lord hates the disgusting way those nations worship their gods, because they even burn their sons and daughters as sacrifices.
translation_verse: Ní taa pée jāam̀ ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu kii bíǹ nín tòotī bi-waaŋi ki ŋáań puee. Bíǹ yaa bíi jáaḿ bi-waaŋee, bi ŋáań atuun ŋin ti-Dindaan kaa néeńee nì ti-bulifi ní. Bi ŋūǹ gba kí dū bi-jipɔmbi nì bi-bisalib kí wà ŋŋmi kí ŋá saraa kí tīī bi-waaŋi.

english_verse: Someday a prophet may come along who is able to perform miracles or tell what will happen in the future. Then the prophet may say, “Let's start worshiping some new gods—some gods that we know nothing about.”
translation_verse: Tí lì yii ubɔ yaa láa yíkì ni-kansikin dalba ní ki bí yii u sá ubɔnaatil àá ubɔɔ ní ki tùkū-ni yii kudaaŋŋu àá maamaacikpaan ubɔ làá nyā.

english_verse: If the prophet says this, don't listen! The Lord your God will be watching to find out whether or not you love him with all your heart and soul.
translation_verse: U nín lī puee yaa lafun ŋá míǹ, ní míǹ boonee u yaa tùkū-ni yii: «Dāam̄maan tí cù kí nóó awaa ŋin naa nyée kí tòotī-ŋee»,

english_verse: You must be completely faithful to the Lord. Worship and obey only the Lord and do this with fear and trembling,
translation_verse: ní taa pīlifiǹ ubɔnaatil àá ubɔɔ gbanti. Di sá yii ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu di bíi cɔ́ŋkí-ni kí kpèè yii ni lafun néeń-u nì ni-pɔbiliŋ kɔkɔ nì ni-naŋki kɔkɔɔɔ, naa néeń-u.

english_verse: because he rescued you from slavery in Egypt. If a prophet tells you to disobey the Lord your God and to stop worshiping him, then that prophet is evil and must be put to death.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu baba ní ni máaǹ kí nīn nóó, ní kí nīn fàŋkí úǹ baba, kí nīn ŋúb́ u-marab, kí nīn tɔ́-u, kí nīn jáaḿ-u ní kí dū ni-ba kí nákáǹ-u.

english_verse: And when the rest of Israel hears about it, they will be afraid, and no one else will ever do such an evil thing again.
translation_verse: Yāŋkìmaan-u ataŋkpee kí kpɔ̀, di sá yii u bàà mākaǹ kí yàntī ní fá ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu un nyántìń-ni kuyuŋun Eejipiti tiŋkinee ní.

english_verse: After the Lord your God gives you towns to live in, you may hear a rumor about one of the towns.
translation_verse: Niinee, Isirayeel yab kɔkɔ làá gbìl̄ tin jítèe ní kí fàŋkì, ní ni-kansikin báà unil kaa dāa gíti ŋáań ikpiti gbanti juti.

english_verse: You may hear that some worthless people have talked everyone there into worshiping other gods, even though these gods had never done anything for them.
translation_verse: Ni yaa tí gbìl̄ dalba yii ntimu mun ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu tīī-ni ní nīn kóòyee kiba poon,

english_verse: You must carefully find out if the rumor is true. Then if the people of that town have actually done such a disgusting thing in your own country,
translation_verse: binib bin kaa pée bí tibanee sāal̀ kitiŋ gbantin nib ki yāntì bi cūtìi tōotì awaa ŋin naa pée nyí ki kée,

english_verse: Gather all the possessions of the people who lived there, and pile them up in the marketplace, without keeping anything for yourself. Set the pile and the whole town on fire, and don't ever rebuild the town. The whole town will be a sacrifice to the Lord your God. Then he won't be angry anymore, and he will have mercy on you and make your nation stronger, just as he promised your ancestors.
translation_verse: Ní dāá kóoǹ ki-gaajawanti kɔkɔ kí bíĺ kitiŋ kansikin kí sēē ŋŋmi, ní kí wà kitiŋee kɔkɔ. Án dāa sá kii saraawɔkaa ní ni ŋá ki tīī ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiuee. Kitiŋ gbanti digbuŋkatiŋ làá nīn bí míǹ ní ki cá jaanjaan, di sá yii ubɔ gíti kpá kí mā niin.

english_verse: That's why you must do what the Lord your God says is right. I am giving you his laws and teachings today, and you must obey them.
translation_verse: Ní taa pée yòon̄ tin sá bí cáá wà ŋŋmee poon tiba, án nín làá ŋá pu ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu ŋuul ń sɔ̀ŋkèe. U làá sɔ̄ ni-saai kí ŋá-ni tiŋan ní kí yàntī ní bùtī kii u nín nìn pōoǹ ni-naanjab puee.

english_verse: Out of all the nations on this earth, the Lord your God chose you to be his own. You belong to the Lord, so don't behave like those who worship other gods. Animals That Can Be Eaten (Leviticus
translation_verse: Di sá yii ni sá circir nibul ní ki tīī ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu. Ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu lēē-ni ki nyántì anibul ŋin kɔkɔ bí kitiŋ puee kansikin ní nīn sá u-gaajawammɔntiiti ní. Tijin tin bi kòóyee nì tin baa kòóyee

english_verse: You can eat any clean bird.
translation_verse: Naa kòó inoon in bí circiree.

english_verse: Don't eat any disgusting animals.
translation_verse: Ní taa jī tin kaa bí circiree.

english_verse: You may eat the meat of cattle, sheep, and goats; wild sheep and goats; and gazelles, antelopes, and all kinds of deer.
translation_verse: nì ukpiil nì ucaŋkpalim nì ubulum nì kijooŋɔjakai nì upeeman nì kipeewuŋ nì ukɔnii.

english_verse: It is all right to eat meat from any animals that have divided hoofs and also chew the cud.
translation_verse: Naa kòó tiwaŋkuti tin tafuŋfukuti látì ní ti yaa ŋmɔ́ timool tì kpìkitī ki fàtīi ŋmóòyee.

english_verse: And don't eat pork, since pigs have divided hoofs, but they do not chew their cud. Don't even touch a dead pig!
translation_verse: Naa jīǹ ugbeeti mun, di sá yii u-tafuŋfukuti látì ama waa kpìkitī ki fàtīi ŋmóò. Ní taa ŋmɔ́ tiwaŋkuti gbanti nanti. Tì yaa kpíì, ní taa gbēē-tì.

english_verse: You can eat any fish that has fins and scales. But there are other creatures that live in the water,
translation_verse: Tiwaŋkuti tin kɔkɔ bí nnyiminee kansikinee, naa kòó tin cáá ijɔŋfeen nì ipɔkɔee.

english_verse: and if they do not have fins and scales, you must not eat them. Treat them as unclean.
translation_verse: Ama ni kòó tin kɔkɔ kaa pée cáá ijɔŋfeen nì ipɔkɔee. Tíǹ kaa ŋān̄ ní jī.

english_verse: Swarming insects are unclean, so don't eat them.
translation_verse: Ni kòó inaaki in cáá ifeenee, iaa bí circir.

english_verse: However, you are allowed to eat certain kinds of winged insects.
translation_verse: Ama naa kòó in bí circiree.

english_verse: You belong to the Lord your God, so if you happen to find a dead animal, don't eat its meat. You may give it to foreigners who live in your town or sell it to foreigners who are visiting your town. Don't boil a young goat in its mother's milk. Give the Lord Ten Percent of Your Harvest Moses said:
translation_verse: Ni kòó diwaŋkpil. Ni ŋūǹ kí dūú tīī binicambi bin kóò ni-puee bí ŋmɔ́. Ni tí ŋūǹ kí dūú nyāfiǹ-bi. Di sá yii nimbee, ni sá circir nibul ní ki tīī ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu. Ní taa dū uŋoobu biim kí ŋàan̄ u-biki nanti. Dibintil kamaa saalaatiiti marab

english_verse: People of Israel, every year you must set aside ten percent of your grain harvest.
translation_verse: Ní nīn lèekī ni-kpaajinti pu tisaalaatiil dibindi kamaa.

english_verse: Also set aside ten percent of your wine and olive oil, and the first-born of every cow, sheep, and goat. Take these to the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped, and eat them there. This will teach you to always respect the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu nimbiin, laakin u làá dāá lēē ní nīn jáaḿ-uee ní ni làá nīn jīǹ ni-kpaajinti nì ni-dapɔm nì ni-kpam saalaatiiti. Ki kpáaǹ ni-naai nì ni-piii nì ni-ŋoobui biseemaliŋ, án nín làá ŋá pu ní bīfì kí nīn fàŋkí ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu kí nīn cáa cá jaanjaanee.

english_verse: But suppose you can't carry that ten percent of your harvest to the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped. If you live too far away, or if the Lord gives you a big harvest,
translation_verse: Ama, ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu yaa láa bīiǹ ni-boon ni-kpaajinti lòon̄ tikpil ní ni yaa láa dáań ki ká yii ti-Dindaan nín lēē mpaan ŋun pu ní nīn jáaḿ-uee dátì, naa làá ŋmā kí túń ni-saalaatiiti kí cùnnì niinee,

english_verse: When you and your family arrive, spend the money on food for a big celebration. Buy cattle, sheep, goats, wine, beer, and if there are any other kinds of food that you want, buy those too.
translation_verse: Niinee ní ní dāá dū animbilee kí dā kun ní ni yaa pée lèe. Ni dāa ŋūǹ kí dūú dā unaa àá upii àá uŋoobu àá ndamam àá ndaam min pɔ̄ɔ̄yee àá tin ní ni yaa láa pée lèe. Ní ni nì ni-dicaŋŋi kɔkɔ ń jī bɔ̀b ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu nimbiin kí fàal̀.

english_verse: And since people of the Levi tribe won't own any land for growing crops, remember to ask the Levites to celebrate with you.
translation_verse: Ama ní nīn nyí kí taa súntí Leefii yab bin kóò ni-timmunee pu, di sá yii bíǹ kaa fōō difakal kii nimbi nín fōō tikpaatan puee.

english_verse: The Levites have no land of their own, so you must give them food from the storehouse. You must also give food to the poor who live in your town, including orphans, widows, and foreigners. If they have enough to eat, then the Lord your God will be pleased and make you successful in everything you do.
translation_verse: Niinee Leefii yab bin kaa cáá tikpaatan bi-ba puee nì binicambi bin kóò ni-puee nì ataŋkpiibil nì bi-kpiipoobi bin kóò ni-timmu poonee ń dāan̄ kí yòon̄ ní kí ká kí jī kí díkí. Ni yaa ŋá mimmee, ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu làá bìin̄ ni-tuuŋŋi kɔkɔ pu.

english_verse: After the Lord your God gives land to each of you, there may be poor Israelites in the town where you live. If there are, then don't be mean and selfish with your money.
translation_verse: Ama an yaa láa ŋá yii ni-nabiki kiba kpántì usoodaan ntimu mun ti-Dindaan làá tīī-nee kiba poonee, ní taa ŋá inimbinaakulim ni-nabiki usoodaan pu kí tīī-kì kun kì nyàab̀ee.

english_verse: Every seven years you must announce, “The Lord says loans do not need to be paid back.” Then if you have loaned money to another Israelite, you can no longer ask for payment.
translation_verse: Ni nín máaǹ kí nīn ŋáań puee sɔ̀. Dibindi din ti-Dindaan síiǹ yii báà ŋma ń dū u-nabiki nín cáá-u dipɔndi diŋyee kí pɔ̄-uee yaa bāańee, bin kɔkɔ nìn pīnnì bi-jutiibi animbilee ń taa páb́ bidambi yii bí téeǹ-bi, bí dūú pɔ̄-bi.

english_verse: This law applies only to loans you have made to other Israelites. Foreigners will still have to pay back what you have loaned them.
translation_verse: Ni ŋūǹ kí bàlifì binicambi bin kóò ni-pu ki cáá-ni dipɔndee bí téeǹ-ni. Ama an yaa sá ni-nabiyaamu pɔɔŋŋee, ní dūú pɔ̄-bi.

english_verse: No one in Israel should ever be poor. The Lord your God is giving you this land, and he has promised to make you very successful, if you obey his laws and teachings that I'm giving you today. You will lend money to many nations, but you won't have to borrow. You will rule many nations, but they won't rule you.
translation_verse: Di sá ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu làá dāá bìin̄ ni-boon kii u nín pōoǹ-ni puee. Atimbun tikpil nib làá dāá dāan̄ ní pìnnì-bi animbil, ama nimbi dāa kpá kí cù báà diba nib cee bí pìnnì-ni animbil. Atimbun tikpil làá dāá nīn bí ni-taapu, ama nimbi dāa kpá kí nīn bí diba taapu.

english_verse: Instead, be kind and lend them what they need.
translation_verse: Ni máaǹ kí dàkà udaan tiniti kí pìnnì-u tin kamaa u nyàab̀ee.

english_verse: Be careful! Don't say to yourself, “Soon it will be the seventh year, and then I won't be able to get my money back.” It would be horrible for you to think that way and to be so selfish that you refuse to help the poor. They are your relatives, and if you don't help them, they may ask the Lord to decide whether you have done wrong. And he will say that you are guilty.
translation_verse: Ama ní nīn nyíǹ ni-ba kí taa yàntī kulandɔkɔkpiiu nee ń jī ni-pɔbiliŋin mpaan ní lì yii: «Dibinluluútiil din poon ti cáá apɔɔn ki pūǹee tóobiń,» ní kí dàkafì mimmee kí ŋá ni-nabiki usoodaan pu inimbinaakulim kí taa tīī-u kun ní u nyàab̀ee. Ni yaa ŋá mimmee, u làá tīminsì kí yíiń ti-Dindaan, ní kí sòoǹ kí tɔ̄ ni-pu, ní an kpántí ikpiti kí tīī-ni.

english_verse: You should be happy to give the poor what they need, because then the Lord will make you successful in everything you do.
translation_verse: Tīīmaan-u kun ní u nyàab̀ee nì dipɔbil diba kí taa nín̄ gbùkum̄. Ŋámaan míǹ, ní ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu ń bìin̄ ni-boon, ní kí bìin̄ ni-tuuŋŋi kɔkɔ pu.

english_verse: But if the animal is lame or blind or has something else wrong with it, you must not sacrifice it to the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Ama tiwaŋkuti gbanti kansikin kubɔ yaa wɔ̀b̄, ku-taal diba wù àá ku jɔ̀b̄ àá ku pée wɔ̀b̄ mbaminee, ní taa dū-ku kí ŋá saraa kí tīī ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu.

english_verse: And don't just tell them they are free to leave—
translation_verse: Ni yaa làá tīī-u dibatɔlee, ní taa yàntī ú búntí iŋaŋkulim.

english_verse: give them sheep and goats and a good supply of grain and wine. The more the Lord has given you, the more you should give them.
translation_verse: Ní dāá lēē ni-piii nì ni-ŋoobui nì ni-kpaajinti nì ni-daam kí pɔ̄-u nì tiniti poon. Ní dāá lēē ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu nín bīiǹ ni-boon ni ká tiŋyee poon kí tīī-u.

english_verse: But one of your slaves may say, “I love you and your family, and I would be better off staying with you, so please don't make me leave.”
translation_verse: Ama ubɔ yumbuu yaa bí-u yii: «Maa là kí nyā a-cee», di sá yii u néeń u-dindaan nì u-dicaŋku ní an mɔ̄ǹ-u ú gbíntí kí nīn bí u-ceeyee,

english_verse: Take the slave to the door of your house and push a sharp metal rod through one earlobe and into the door. Such slaves will belong to you for life, whether they are men or women.
translation_verse: udaan ń yòon̄ mpiin ní kí dū uyumbuee tafal kí nákań ni-punyɔkɔki kí sāā kí cíĺ, ní ú kpántí u-yumbuu kí nīn cáa cá jaanjaan. Báà an yaa sá unimpu, ní ŋá-u míǹ mbaantiim.

english_verse: If the first-born animal of a cow or sheep or goat is a male, it must be given to the Lord. Don't put first-born cattle to work or cut wool from first-born sheep.
translation_verse: Ní dū ni-naai nì ni-piii nì ni-ŋoobui biseemaliŋ kí sú ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu. Ní taa dū ni-naai in sá abiseemalee kí kpàl̄ í kpɔ̀ tikpaal, kí taa tí cā ni-piii in sá abiseemalee kuti.

english_verse: Instead, each year you must take the first-born of these animals to the place where the Lord your God chooses to be worshiped. You and your family will sacrifice them to the Lord and then eat them as part of a sacred meal.
translation_verse: Dibindi sá kamaayee, nimbi nì ni-dicaŋŋi ń cù ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu nimbiin laakin u lēē kí nīn bí ní nīn jáaḿ-uee kí kpɔ̀ tiwaŋkuti gbanti niin kí ŋmɔ́.

english_verse: You can butcher it where you live, and eat it just like the meat of a deer or gazelle that you kill while hunting. Even those people who are unclean and unfit for worship can have some.
translation_verse: Kpɔ̀maan-ku laakin ni kóòyee kí ŋmɔ́. Ni-kansikin bin bí circiree nì bin kaa bí circiree kɔkɔ ŋūǹ kí ŋmɔ́ kii bi nín pée ŋmóò upeeman àá ucaŋkpalim puee.

english_verse: But you must never eat the blood of an animal—let it drain out on the ground.
translation_verse: Ama naa nín máaǹ kí ŋmɔ́ fatiku ní. Ní kpáatí-u kí fá kitiŋ kii nnyimee.

english_verse: People of Israel, you must celebrate Passover in the month of Abib, because one night in that month years ago, the Lord your God rescued you from Egypt.
translation_verse: Ní nīn nyí kí jī Abiibi ŋmaliu poon, Dilákatil jiŋaaliu kí tīī ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu tinyool. Di sá yii uŋmal gbanti poon nyeeku kubɔ ní u nìn nyántìń-ni Eejipiti tiŋkin.

english_verse: People of Israel, if you want to enjoy a long and successful life, make sure that everyone is treated with justice in the land the Lord is giving you. Don't Set Up Sacred Poles or Stones Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Ní nīn sòoǹ tibɔti tí nīn tɔ́kɔ́ ibaamɔn pu, án nín làá ŋá pu ní nīn bí dimaŋfalin, kí ŋmā kí kɔ́ kitiŋ kin ní ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu làá tīī-ni ní nīn kíǹ ki yèe poonee. Ti-Dindaan ná iwaatooti

english_verse: Eat thin bread for the next six days. Then on the seventh day, don't do any work. Instead, come together and worship the Lord. The Harvest Festival (Exodus
translation_verse: Ní dāá dū iwiin iluu kí ŋmɔ́ kpɔnɔb bin kaa cáá ŋkpɔnɔnyɔkɔee, ní ŋwinluluútee ní kpāfì kí jāam̀ ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu kí púntí jiŋaal. Ŋwiin gbantee, naa dāa máaǹ kí tɔ̄ báà diba. Pantikooti jiŋaaliu

english_verse: The Passover sacrifice must be a cow, a sheep, or a goat, and you must offer it at the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped.
translation_verse: Ní dāá lēē ni-piii àá ni-ŋoobui àá ni-naai poon tiwaŋkuti tiba kí kpɔ̀ kí ŋá Dilákatil jiŋaaliu saraau kí tīī ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu. Ní dāá ŋá saraa gbanti mpaan ŋun pu ti-Dindaan làá dāá lēē kí nīn bí ní nīn cá ki jáaḿ-uee.

english_verse: Don't offer the Passover sacrifice in just any town where you happen to live.
translation_verse: Naa dāa máaǹ kí ŋá Dilákatil jiŋaaliu saraau ntimu mun ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu làá tīī-nee kansikin kiban kii ni nín là puee.

english_verse: It must be offered at the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped. Kill the sacrifice at sunset, the time of day when you left Egypt.
translation_verse: Asee mpaan ŋun ti-Dindaan làá dāá lēē kí nīn bí ní nīn jáaḿ-uee baba pu ní ni dāa máaǹ kí ŋá saraa gbanti. Ní dāá ŋá saraayee kujoopɔŋ kii ŋyunti ŋun ni nìn nyáń Eejipiti tiŋkinee.

english_verse: Then cook it and eat it there at the place of worship, returning to your tents the next morning.
translation_verse: Ní dāá tɔ́kɔń tinan gbanti kí ŋmɔ́-tì mpaan ŋun pu ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu làá dāá lēēyee. Kutaa yaa láa wúntì kutaafaauee, ni dāa ŋūǹ kí fàtīí gítí ni-tantibin.

english_verse: And don't set up a sacred stone! The Lord hates these things.
translation_verse: Ní taa tí cóoń diwaataŋkpal niin, di sá yii ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu ná tiwan gbanti.

english_verse: After you have finished the grain harvest and the grape harvest, take your sons and daughters and all your servants to the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped. Celebrate the Festival of Shelters for seven days. Also invite the poor, including Levites, foreigners, orphans, and widows. The Lord will give you big harvests and make you successful in everything you do. You will be completely happy, so celebrate this festival in honor of the Lord your God. Three Festivals at the Place of Worship (Exodus
translation_verse: Ní dāá dū iwiin iluli kí jī jiŋaal kí tīī ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu tinyool laakin u làá dāá lēēyee. Di sá yii ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu làá dāá bìin̄ ni-boon ni-kpaajinti ń lòoǹ ní kí dāá bìin̄ ni-tuuŋŋi kɔkɔ pu. An puee ní dāá nīn bí mmɔŋkpaanni.

english_verse: When you build the altar for offering sacrifices to the Lord your God, don't set up a sacred pole for the worship of the goddess Asherah.
translation_verse: Ní taa cóoń ŋwindɔ ŋubɔ kí kɔ́ĺ nsaraafan ŋun ní ni làá mā kí tīī ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiuee.

english_verse: Seven weeks after you start your grain harvest,
translation_verse: Ni yaa láa kíĺ ki bíi cēē ni-kpaajintee, ní dāá kàaǹ nnyɔmu mululi,

english_verse: go to the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped and celebrate the Harvest Festival in honor of the Lord your God. Bring him an offering as large as you can afford, depending on how big a harvest he has given you. Be sure to take along your sons and daughters and all your servants. Also invite the poor, including Levites, foreigners, orphans, and widows.
translation_verse: Ní dāá cù ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu nimbiin laakin u làá dāá lēē kí nīn bí ní nīn jáaḿ-uee, nimbi nì ni-jipɔmbi nì ni-bisalib nì ni-tɔntɔnliibi nì Leefii yab bin kóò ni-timmunee nì binicambi bin kóò ni-puee nì ataŋkpiibil nì bikpiipoobi bin mun kóò ni-timmunee, ní ni-kɔkɔ ń fàal̀.

english_verse: The bigger the harvest the Lord gives you, the bigger your gift should be. Treat Everyone with Justice Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Ama báà ŋma ń dāá kpèè ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu nín bīiǹ u-boon miŋyee ní kí bɔ́ntí saraabi míǹ kí cáá cùnnì. Bibɔsoonliibi marab

english_verse: Each year there are three festivals when all Israelite men must go to the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped. These are the Festival of Thin Bread, the Harvest Festival, and the Festival of Shelters. And don't forget to take along a gift for the Lord.
translation_verse: Ŋfunyɔm mita dibindi kamaa poonee, ni-kansikin bin sá bininjabee kɔkɔ máaǹ kí dāá cù ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu nimbiin laakin ní u làá dāá lēēyee kí jī jiŋaal un bi ŋmóò kpɔnɔ un kaa cáá ŋkpɔnɔnyɔkɔee nì Pantikooti jiŋaaliu nì tantib jiŋaaliu. Ní taa láa cù ti-Dindaan nimbiin iŋaŋkulim.

english_verse: After you are settled in the towns that you will receive from the Lord your God, the people in each town must appoint judges and other officers. Those of you that become judges must be completely fair when you make legal decisions, even if someone important is involved. Don't take bribes to give unfair decisions. Bribes keep people who are wise from seeing the truth and turn honest people into liars.
translation_verse: Ní nīn kpèé nsan nín dɔ̄ puee ki sòoǹ tibɔti kí taa nín̄ cáá digàntil ni-bɔsooŋyi poon. Ní taa yàntī ubɔ ń pɔ̄-ni tiba kí ŋéeb́ ni-nyɔkɔ, di sá yii tiwampɔkaal yàntī biciŋfitiibi kpántí bijɔfub ní ki kù deedeedambi bɔti.

english_verse: If an ox or a sheep has something wrong with it, don't offer it as a sacrifice to the Lord your God—he will be disgusted! Put To Death People Who Worship Idols Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Ní taa dū unaa àá upii un laaba wɔ̀b̄ee àá un pu tiba pée bí kaa ŋān̄ee kí ŋá saraa kí tīī ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu, di sá yii an sá ntimbiil ní ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu nimbiin.

english_verse: The Lord your God is giving you towns to live in. But later, a man or a woman in your town may start worshiping other gods, or even the sun, moon, or stars. I have warned you not to worship other gods, because whoever worships them is disobeying the Lord and breaking the agreement he made with you.
translation_verse: Tí lì yii udaan cūtìi bíi tòotī awaa ki gbàantí ŋi-taapu àá ki gbàantí ŋwìiń àá uŋmal àá iŋmalbijaa in bí kutaa puee taapu. Man ni-Dindaan mun kpáafì-ni yii ní taa ŋá míǹ jaanjaan.

english_verse: So when you hear that someone in your town is committing this disgusting sin, you must carefully find out if that person really is guilty.
translation_verse: Ni yaa gbìl̄ bi máafì-ni tiba mimmee, ní mɔ̀tīí cɔ̄ŋkì tiŋan kí kpèè yii an sá ibaamɔnaaa, an kaa sá. An yaa lafun sá ibaamɔn yii ubɔ ŋá ntimbiil tuuŋŋi gbanti Isirayeel tiŋki puee,

english_verse: When other Israelites hear about it, they will be afraid and obey the decisions of the court. The King Moses said:
translation_verse: Samaa kɔkɔ làá dāá gbìl̄, ní kí fàŋkì kí taa ti ŋá dilambil míǹ dalba dalba. Dibeel bɔti

english_verse: People of Israel, after you capture the land the Lord your God is giving you, and after you settle on it, you will say, “We want a king, just like the nations around us.”
translation_verse: Ni yaa láa kɔ́ kitiŋ kin ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu làá dūú tīī-nee poon ní ki ká ŋkakaa ki kāl̀ ní ki yaa láa lī dalba yii: «Yàntīmaan tí kàan̄ ubɔti ú nīn kpòotī-ti kii anibul ŋin māntìi tú-tee nín cáá pueeyee»,

english_verse: Go ahead and appoint a king, but make sure that he is an Israelite and that he is the one the Lord has chosen.
translation_verse: ní dāá dū unil un ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu u-ba làá lēēyee kí kàan̄ dibeel. Udaan dāa máaǹ kí nīn sá ni-nabiyaamu Isirayeel nib kansikin ubɔ ní. Ní taa dū unicaan un kaa sá Isirayeel niliuee kí kàan̄ dibeel.

english_verse: The king should not have many horses, especially those from Egypt. The Lord has said never to go back there again.
translation_verse: Ama udaan kaa dāa máaǹ kí nīn cáá itaamu tikpil, àá kí tɔ̄ binib bí cù Eejipiti tiŋkin kí dāń-i, di sá yii ti-Dindaan nìn tùkū-ni yii: «Ní taa pée fàtīí gítí niin».

english_verse: And the king must not have a lot of wives—they might tempt him to be unfaithful to the Lord. Finally, the king must not try to get huge amounts of silver and gold.
translation_verse: Waa dāa máaǹ kí nīn cáá kunimpupaau, án làá dāá yàntī ú fá Unimbɔti. Waa dāa tí máaǹ kí nīn cáá animbil nì sindaariya tikpil.

english_verse: The official copy of God's laws will be kept by the priests of the Levi tribe. So, as soon as anyone becomes king, he must go to the priests and write out a copy of these laws while they watch.
translation_verse: Bi yaa láa kāaǹ-u dibeelee, ú dāá ŋmà marab bin Leefii yab bin sá bisaraaŋaliibee kpáafèe kí ŋá kugbɔŋun kí tīī u-ba.

english_verse: Each day the king must read and obey these laws, so that he will learn to worship the Lord with fear and trembling
translation_verse: Marab gbanti ń nīn bí ki kɔ́ĺ-u ú nīn kàaǹ-bi baabadal kí cáá sāā u-kúm dal. Mimmee u làá bīfì kí nīn fàŋkí ti-Dindaan u-Nimbɔtiu, ní kí nīn ŋúb́ abɔkpaa nì akoobil ŋin kɔkɔ kā marab gbɔŋku gbanti poonee.

english_verse: and not think that he's better than everyone else. If the king completely obeys the Lord's commands, he and his descendants will rule Israel for many years.
translation_verse: U yaa kàaǹ marab gbanti mimmee, án làá yàntī ú taa nín̄ yòontí u-ba yilpu kí dàkà yii u jítiǹ u-nabiyaamu mun kíǹee, ní kí taa kpèè marab biba fám kí taa nín̄ tɔ́-bi. U yaa ŋá míǹ, u nì u-naantiibi làá jī dibeel Isirayeel tiŋki pu kí yúntí.

english_verse: So when I want to speak to them, I will choose one of them to be a prophet like you. I will give my message to that prophet, who will tell the people exactly what I have said.
translation_verse: M làá lēē bi-nabiyaamu kansikin ubɔnaatil un bí kii siiyee kí tīī-bi. M làá dāá dū m-nyɔɔbuŋŋi kí ŋá u-nyɔkɔn ní ú dāá tùkù-bi tin kɔkɔ m kpáafì-uee.

english_verse: Some Levites may have money from selling family possessions, and others may not. But all Levites serving at the place of worship will receive the same amount of food from the sacrifices and gifts brought by the people. Don't Do Disgusting Things Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Báà u yaa nyáfì u-baa fakal ki cáá animbil, bi nín tìì u-nabiyaamu mun bí niinee pu bi jīǹee, míǹ mbaantiim ní bi máaǹ kí tīī udaan mun. Inyimɔn bɔnaatiliibi nì ibaamɔn bɔnaatiliibi

english_verse: The people of the Levi tribe, including the priests, will not receive any land. Instead, they will receive part of the sacrifices that are offered to the Lord,
translation_verse: Bi yaa láa bíi yàkatī tikpaatan ki tìì Isirayeel yabee, bí taa kpáaǹ Leefii yab bisaraaŋaliibi nì bin kɔkɔ pée sá Leefii naakookunee. Saraabi bin bi ŋáań ki tìì ti-Dindaanee di dāa sá bi-jinti nì bi-fakal.

english_verse: When you sacrifice a bull or sheep, the priests will be given the shoulder, the jaws, and the stomach.
translation_verse: Samaa yaa cáań unaa àá upii ki ŋá saraayee, bisaraaŋaliibi jandi di sá kuboou nì nnyɔɔkpaween nì dipool.

english_verse: In addition, they will receive the first part of your grain harvest and part of your first batches of wine and olive oil. You must also give them the first wool that is cut from your sheep each year.
translation_verse: Ní dāá dū tijimpeepeekaal tin ni lēēyee, an dàkà yii ni-bileeu nì ni-damam nì ni-kpam ki kpáaǹ ni-pikuti tin ni péé ki cáńee kí tīī-bi.

english_verse: Give these gifts to the priests, because the Lord has chosen them and their descendants out of all the tribes of Israel to be his special servants at the place of worship.
translation_verse: Di sá yii ni-naakɔti kɔkɔ poonee, Leefii yab ní ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu lēē yii bí nīn bí u-tundin kí nīn cáa cá jaanjaan.

english_verse: Any Levite can leave his hometown, and go to the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped,
translation_verse: Leefii yab ubɔ yaa nìn kóò Isirayeel timmu kiban, ní ki yaa là kí dāan̄ mpaan ŋun ti-Dindaan lēēyee puee,

english_verse: and then be a special servant of the Lord there, just like all the other Levites.
translation_verse: u cáá nsan kí tɔ̄ ditundi kí tīī ti-Dindaan u-Nimbɔtiu kii u-nabiyaamu, Leefii yab bin kíǹee nín bí niin ki tūǹ ti-Dindaan tundi puee.

english_verse: Soon you will go into the land that the Lord your God is giving you. The nations that live there do things that are disgusting to the Lord, and you must not follow their example.
translation_verse: Ni yaa láa kɔ́ kitiŋ kin ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu làá dūú tīī-nee poonee, ní taa bīfì kí nīn ŋáań ntimbiil tuuŋŋi ŋin anibul ŋin bí niin díǹ pu nee ŋáańee.

english_verse: Don't sacrifice your son or daughter. And don't try to use any kind of magic or witchcraft to tell fortunes or to cast spells or to talk with spirits of the dead.
translation_verse: àá ki tòó binib inyɔkɔfi, àá ki kàal̀ abɔɔjal, àá ki sòoǹ tin dòońee, àá ki yíì bitaŋkpiibi ki sòoǹ nì bi.

english_verse: The Lord is disgusted with anyone who does these things, and that's why he will help you destroy the nations that are in the land.
translation_verse: Unil un yaa ŋáań atuun gbantee sá utiŋwiil ní ti-Dindaan nimbiin. Ntimbiil tuuŋŋi gbanti pu ní ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu làá jà anibul nee kɔkɔ kí fōō bi-tiŋki kí tīī-ni.

english_verse: You will go in and take the land from nations that practice magic and witchcraft. But the Lord your God won't allow you to do those things.
translation_verse: Di sá yii anibul ŋin timmu ni làá fōō nee sá binib bin cá biwaadambi nì bibɔɔbi ceeyee ní. Ama nimbee, ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu kaa pú-ni nsan ní ŋá míǹ.

english_verse: Instead, he will choose one of your own people to be a prophet just like me, and you must do what that prophet says.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu làá dāá lēē ni-nabiyaamu kansikin ubɔ ú nīn sá Unimbɔti bɔnaatiliu kii mamee, ní dāá pīlifiǹ-u.

english_verse: You were asking for a prophet the day you were gathered at Mount Sinai and said to the Lord, “Please don't let us hear your voice or see this terrible fire again—if we do, we will die!”
translation_verse: Di sá yii tin ni nìn bālifì ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu ŋwiin ŋun ni nìn kóoǹ ki kpáfì ki sí Ooreeb jool taapuee dee. Ni nìn lī yii: «Taa ti là kí gbìl̄ ti-Dindaan ti-Nimbɔtiu neen pu, kaa ti là kí wāl̀ u-ŋmikpaaŋŋu nee mun. Di sá yii taa là kí kpú.»

english_verse: Then the Lord told me: Moses, they have said the right thing.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan nìn tùkū-mi yii: «Tiŋman bi cáá mbaamɔn kí sòoǹ míǹ.

english_verse: Since the message comes from me, anyone who doesn't obey the message will have to answer to me.
translation_verse: Un sá kamaa yaa kaa dāa pílifiǹ m-nyɔɔbuŋŋi ŋin ubɔnaatilee làá dāá sòoǹ m-yindi puee, mama m-ba di làá dāá dáaĺ u-tafal.

english_verse: But if I haven't spoken, and a prophet claims to have a message from me, you must kill that prophet, and you must also kill any prophet who claims to have a message from another god. Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Ama m yaa kaa tùkū ubɔnaatil ubɔ tiba yii ú lì ní udaan yaa gāā u-bindi ki yíkìi sòon̄ tiba m-yindi pu, àá ki sòon̄ tiba awaa aba puee, an sá ní kpɔ̀-u ní.»

english_verse: You may be asking yourselves, “How can we tell if a prophet's message really comes from the Lord?”
translation_verse: An yaa yíì ni làá bàlifì ni-ba yii: «Kin mana ní ti làá ŋmā kí béé yii tin u sòon̄ee kaa nyánní ti-Dindaan cee?»

english_verse: You will know, because if the Lord says something will happen, it will happen. And if it doesn't, you will know that the prophet was falsely claiming to speak for the Lord. Don't be afraid of any prophet whose message doesn't come from the Lord.
translation_verse: Tiŋman, ubɔnaatilee yaa yíkìi sòon̄ tiba ti-Dindaan yindi pu ní an kaa ŋá kii u nín lī pueeyee, ní béé yii tin u sòon̄ee kaa sá ti-Dindaan nyɔɔbundi. Ubɔnaatil gbanti gāā u-bindi ní ki sòon̄. Ní taa fàŋkì-u.

english_verse: Israel, the Lord your God has promised that if you obey his laws and teachings I'm giving you, and if you always love him, then he will give you the land he promised your ancestors. When that happens, you must name three more Safe Towns in the new territory.
translation_verse: ní dāá lēē ntimu muta mubɔ mun kí kūtì. Di sá yii u làá dāá wàan̄ ni-tiŋki míǹ kí tīī-ni. Ama see ní nīn ŋúb́ marab bin kɔkɔ m tīī-ni díǹ nee, kí nīn néeń ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu, kí nīn ŋáań baabadal kii u nín bí yii ní nīn ŋáań puee. Ŋyunti gbanti baba ní u làá ŋá míǹ kí tīī-ni.

english_verse: Soon you will go into the land and attack the nations. The Lord your God will destroy them and give you their lands, towns, and homes. Then after you are settled,
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu làá dāá kpɔ̀ kí céetí anibul ŋin tiŋki u làá dūú tīī-ni nee, ní ní jà-bi kí nyāntí ní kí fōō bi-timmu kí nīn kíǹ ki yì, kí jī bi-diiŋŋi kí nīn kóò.

english_verse: For example, suppose you and a friend go into the forest to cut wood. You are chopping down a tree with an ax, when the ax head slips off the handle, hits your friend, and kills him. You can run to one of the Safe Towns and save your life.
translation_verse: Tí dūú ŋmàntī kii unil ubɔ nì u-bɔɔ cūtì kubambaŋŋun kí gāā idɔ ní ŋyunti ŋun u dúkutì ceeku kí bàà gāā busubuee, nceekubiim cúu fúkutì ki nyáń ki yá u-bɔɔyee ki kūū-u. An niliuee ŋūǹ kí sāǹ kí kɔ́ ntimu gbanti kiba poon kí fīī u-ba.

english_verse: You don't deserve to die, since you did not mean to harm your friend. But he did get killed, and his relatives might be very angry. They might even choose one of the men from their family to track you down and kill you. If it is too far to one of the Safe Towns, the victim's relative might be able to catch you and kill you.
translation_verse: Nsan ń taa nín̄ dátì, an yaa kaa sá míǹ, un un bi kūūyee nabiki làá jà unikpɔlee diŋuul poon kí cúú-u kí kpɔ̀-u kí téeǹ. U mun kaa bàà máaǹ ŋkúm, di sá yii waa ná-u ní ki kūū-u.

english_verse: That's why I said there must be three Safe Towns.
translation_verse: An pu ní m bíi kpáafí-ni yii ní dāá lēē ntimu muta kí cīití ni-ba.

english_verse: You will need them, so innocent people won't be killed on your land while they are trying to reach a Safe Town that is too far away. You will be guilty of murder, if innocent people lose their lives because you didn't name enough Safe Towns in the land the Lord your God will give you.
translation_verse: Ní dāá ŋámaan míǹ án nín làá ŋá pu kitiŋ kin ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu làá dūú tīī-nee poonee, bí taa kpɔ̀ unil un kaa bàà máaǹ ŋkúmee fám, ní naa nín túǹ ubɔ kúm kpuulool.

english_verse: But what if you really do commit murder? Suppose one of you hates a neighbor. So you wait in a deserted place, kill the neighbor, and run to a Safe Town.
translation_verse: Ama tí lì yii ubɔ ná u-juti, ní ki píĺ ki cí-u ní ki yíkìi cìb̄ ki cúú-u ki gbáń ki kūū-u ní ki sáǹ ki tin kɔ́ ntimu gbanti kiba poon.

english_verse: If that happens, the leaders of your town must send messengers to bring you back from the Safe Town. They will hand you over to one of the victim's relatives, who will put you to death.
translation_verse: Unikpɔlee dumpu tindaŋkpilib ń dāá tɔ̄ binib bí cù kí gíiǹní-u u-tiŋkin ní kí dū-u kí ŋá un u kūūyee nabiki ŋaan, ní úǹ ń kpɔ̀-u kí tɔ̀ ipɔntoon.

english_verse: Israel, for the good of the whole country, you must kill anyone who murders an innocent person. Never show mercy to a murderer! Property Lines Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Taa sɔ̄maan unikpɔl gbanti saai. Ní ŋá míǹ ní kí nyāntí maanyiiba nikpaakooŋŋu kpitii Isirayeel tiŋkin ní án nīn ŋān̄ ki tīī-ni.

english_verse: In the land the Lord is giving you, there are already stones set up to mark the property lines between fields. So don't move those stones. Witnesses Must Tell the Truth Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Ni yaa láa bàn̄ kitiŋ kin ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu làá yàkatī kí tīī-nee poon ki kāl̀ee, ní taa láa cóotí ni-timmu kpaanyɔmmu taŋkpeeŋi kí nìkī. Ní yàntī án nīn pée bí kii bin péeǹ-ni ki bàn̄ee nín ŋmāntì pu ki cóoǹee. Biseeradambi tundi

english_verse: Before you are convicted of a crime, at least two witnesses must be able to testify that you did it.
translation_verse: Unibambaanti seerau kaa ŋūǹ kí yàntī bí kpɔ̀ ubɔ bɔti yii u kūū unil àá u ŋá ikpiti iba. Asee binib bili àá bita di yaa lēē udaan pu seera ní bi ŋūǹ kí kpɔ̀ u-bɔti.

english_verse: If you accuse someone of a crime, but seem to be lying,
translation_verse: Ama ubɔ yaa yíkì ki bíi tūntí u-juti pu ikpiti ibee,

english_verse: then both you and the accused must be taken to the court at the place where the Lord is worshiped. There the priests and judges will find out if you are lying or telling the truth. If you are lying and the accused is innocent,
translation_verse: Bibɔsoonliibee ń fíkití tibɔtee tiŋan kí kpèè. Bi yaa dáań ki ká yii useeradaanee sá unyimɔndaan ní ki bíi lèekī u-juti pu nnyimɔn seerauee,

english_verse: then you will be punished without mercy. You will receive the same punishment the accused would have received if found guilty, whether it means losing an eye, a tooth, a hand, a foot, or even your life. Israel, the crime of telling lies in court must be punished. And when people hear what happens to witnesses that lie, everyone else who testifies in court will tell the truth.
translation_verse: Ní taa sɔ̄ dibɔkpil daan saai. Un yaa kūū unilee, bí kpɔ̀ u mun. Un yaa lēē u-juti nimbilee, bí lēē u mun yal. Un yaa lēē u-juti nyindee, bí lēē u mun nyindi. Un yaa gūutì u-juti ŋalee, bí gùutī u mun ŋal. Un yaa gūutì u-juti taalee, bí gùutī u mun taal.

english_verse: If you have to go to war, you may find yourselves facing an enemy army that is bigger than yours and that has horses and chariots. But don't be afraid! The Lord your God rescued you from Egypt, and he will help you fight.
translation_verse: Ni yaa nyáń kí jáǹ ni-nannanliibi ní ki yaa ká yii bi-taamui nì bi-tɔrɔkub nì bi-janjakitil wīikí ki jítiǹ ni-yabee, ní taa fàŋkì. Di sá yii ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu un nyántìń-ni Eejipiti tiŋkinee bí ni-cee.

english_verse: Before you march into battle, a priest will go to the front of the army
translation_verse: Ni yaa láa bɔ́ntì kí nīn cée, usaraaŋakpil ń nyā kí sīĺ samaa nimbiin kí sòoǹ nì samaa kɔkɔ.

english_verse: and say, “Soldiers of Israel, listen to me! Today when you go into battle, don't be afraid of the enemy, and when you see them, don't panic.
translation_verse: Ú dāá sòoǹ nì bi yii: «Isirayeel yab, pīlifìmaan. Díǹ nee, ni làá nyā kí jáǹ ni-nannanliibi. Ni-wunti ń taa yɔ̀tī. Ní taa fàŋkì-bi kí taa nyɔ̀ ŋkpatim bi-nimbiin.

english_verse: The Lord your God will fight alongside you and help you win the battle.”
translation_verse: Di sá yii ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu di bí ni-cee ní ki làá jáǹ ni-nannanliibi, kí tīī-ni dijajil.»

english_verse: Then the tribal officials will say to the troops: If any of you have built a new house, but haven't yet moved in, you may go home. It isn't right for you to die in battle and for somebody else to live in your new house.
translation_verse: Míǹ boonee ní bigbaŋŋmaliibi ń sòoǹ nì samaa kɔkɔ ní kí bàlifì yii: «Ubɔ bí ni-kansikin ki máń kudipɔŋ kaa láá kɔ́-kuɔɔɔ? Ubɔ yaa bée, udaan ń nīn gítí u-diikun. An yaa kaa sá míǹ, u ŋūǹ kí tin kpúń dikɔ̀ndin ní ubɔ fám ń dāá pɔ̀ntī u-diiku gbanti.

english_verse: If any of you have planted a vineyard but haven't had your first grape harvest, you may go home. It isn't right for you to die in battle and for somebody else to enjoy your grapes.
translation_verse: Ni-kansikin ubɔ kùn̄ fiinyi kpaabu kaa láá kītì bu-biliŋaaa? Ubɔ yaa bée, ú nīn gítí u-diikun. An yaa kaa sá míǹ, u ŋūǹ kí tin kpúń dikɔ̀ndin ní ubɔ fám ń dāá jī u-fiinyi kpaabu gbanti.
