translation_verse: Yoob jipɔmbi kansikin ubɔ nìn ŋáań tijin u-dumpu ní u nì bin kɔkɔ kíǹee ń kpāfì kí jī. Bi nìn ŋáań míǹ ní ki kpántí ní ki nìn yíì bi-niisalib bitee, ní bí kpāfì kí jī kí nyɔ̀.

english_verse: After each feast, Job would send for his children and perform a ceremony, as a way of asking God to forgive them of any wrongs they may have done. He would get up early the next morning and offer a sacrifice for each of them, just in case they had sinned or silently cursed God. Angels, the Lord, and Satan
translation_verse: Bi yaa nìn jíń jíń míǹ ki dóòyee ní Yoob ń yíiń-bi ní kí ŋá-bi circir. U nìn yíkí kutaafaau pɔ̀lpɔl ní kí ŋá saraawɔkaa u-biyaamu kɔkɔ yil pu, di sá yii u nìn lì yii: «An yaa yíì m-jipɔmbi ŋá ikpiti ki tɔ́ Unimbɔti mbusu bi-pɔbiliŋin.» Míǹ ní Yoob nìn pée ŋáań ŋyunti kamaa.

english_verse: One day, when the angels had gathered around the Lord, and Satan was there with them,
translation_verse: Dalba, Unimbɔti tuuŋyi dɔ́miń ti-Dindaan kpafil. Sitaan, ukuŋfil mun nìn bí bi-kansikin.

english_verse: Then the Lord asked, “What do you think of my servant Job? No one on earth is like him—he is a truly good person, who respects me and refuses to do evil.”
translation_verse: Niinee ní ti-Dindaan bí Sitaan yii: «A ká m-tɔntɔnliu Yoobaa! Waa cáá juti kitiŋ pu. Baa kāntí u-pu tikpitil tiba ní u-pɔbil bí diba nì mi. U fàŋkí man Unimbɔti ní ki fàtī u-boon ki tìì ikpiti.»

english_verse: “Why shouldn't he respect you?” Satan remarked.
translation_verse: Ama ní ukuŋfil kíí-u yii: «A nyí yii an sá fám ní Yoob fàŋkí-saaa?

english_verse: “You are like a wall protecting not only him, but his entire family and all his property. You make him successful in whatever he does, and his flocks and herds are everywhere.
translation_verse: Sii di kaa dū a-wundi ki bàkā u nì u-dicaŋku nì u-gaajati kɔkɔ pu kii digundeeee? A bīiǹ u-tuuŋŋi kɔkɔ pu ní ki yāntì u-waŋkuti būtì ki gbí kitiŋ kɔkɔ.

english_verse: Try taking away everything he owns, and he will curse you to your face.”
translation_verse: Ama a yaa là, á tàntī a-ŋal kí fōō tin kɔkɔ u cááyee kí kpèè u yaa kaa sòon̄ ki bíil̀-si!»

english_verse: The Lord replied, “All right, Satan, do what you want with anything that belongs to him, but don't harm Job.” Then Satan left. Job Loses Everything
translation_verse: Niinee ní ti-Dindaan bí ukuŋfil yii: «Too, tin kɔkɔ u cááyee bí a-ŋaan. Ama á nīn nyíǹ a-ba kí taa gbēē úǹ u-ba.» Niinee ní ukuŋfil nyáń ti-Dindaan nimbiin ki nín cá.

english_verse: Job's sons and daughters were having a feast in the home of his oldest son,
translation_verse: Dalba Yoob bisalib nì u-jipɔmbi kpáfì bi-maan ukpil cee ki bíi jīǹ ki nyù,

english_verse: when someone rushed up to Job and said, “While your servants were plowing with your oxen, and your donkeys were nearby eating grass,
translation_verse: ní ntuun dūu bāań Yoob cee ki bí-u yii: «Inaa bàà bíi kù tikpaal ní mmansalimu bí ki kɔ́ĺ-i ki ŋmóò timool,

english_verse: a gang of Sabeans attacked and stole the oxen and donkeys! Your other servants were killed, and I am the only one who escaped to tell you.”
translation_verse: ní Seeba yab péetì-i ní ki kūū a-tɔntɔnliibi. Man baba di pée ŋmátì ní ki dɔ́miń kí tùkù-si.»

english_verse: That servant was still speaking, when a second one came running and said, “God sent down a fire that killed your sheep and your servants. I am the only one who escaped to tell you.”
translation_verse: Yoob tɔntɔnliuee nìn dáá bíi sòoǹ u-nyɔkɔ kaa láá ŋmíl̀ ní ubɔ mun dūu bāań ki bí-u yii: «Unimbɔti ŋmiŋu ŋubɔ nyánní yilpu ki wùn̄ ipii nì a-tɔntɔnliibi kɔkɔ. Man baba di pée ŋmátì ní ki dɔ́miń kí tùkù-si.»

english_verse: Before that servant finished speaking, a third one raced up and said, “Three gangs of Chaldeans attacked and stole your camels! All of your other servants were killed, and I am the only one who escaped to tell you.”
translation_verse: U nìn dáá bíi sòoǹ kaa láá ŋmíl̀ ní ubɔ mun tí bāań ki bí yii: «Kaaldee yab ŋá akiti ata ki dɔ́miń ki jéetì a-gutaamui pu ki péetì-i ní ki dū ntàataajimu ki kūū a-tɔntɔnliibi kɔkɔ. Man baba di pée ŋmátì ní m dɔ́miń kí tùkù-si.»

english_verse: That servant was still speaking, when a fourth one dashed up and said, “Your children were having a feast and drinking wine at the home of your oldest son,
translation_verse: U nìn dáá bíi sòoǹ kaa láá ŋmíl̀ ní ubɔ mun tí bāań ki bí yii: «A-bisalib nì a-jipɔmbi bàà bí bi-maan ukpil cee ki bíi jīǹ ki nyù

english_verse: when suddenly a windstorm from the desert blew the house down, crushing all of your children. I am the only one who escaped to tell you.”
translation_verse: ní kubuŋkpaaŋŋu kubɔ nyánní kuteeu pú ki yá kudii jannaatiliŋ. Kudiiyee lítì ki tàb̄ binipɔmbee ki kūū-bi. Man baba di pée ŋmátì ní m dɔ́miń kí tùkù-si.»

english_verse: When Job heard this, he tore his clothes and shaved his head because of his great sorrow. He knelt on the ground, then worshiped God
translation_verse: Niinee Yoob nyīī yíkì ki cúú u-bɔkutikpaandi ki dáaĺ ki cátì ní ki kōol̀ u-yil diyibaakpandi ní ki tātìi gbāaǹ u-yigbeel tūū kitiŋ

english_verse: and said: “We bring nothing at birth; we take nothing with us at death. The Lord alone gives and takes. Praise the name of the Lord!”
translation_verse: ki lī yii: «M nyáń m-na poon dicancaŋgbeel ní, dicancaŋgbeel ní m làá tí fàtīí gítí. Ti-Dindaan di tīī, ti-Dindaan di cúú ki fōō. Ti-Dindaan yindi ń ká tinyool!»

english_verse: In spite of everything, Job did not sin or accuse God of doing wrong.
translation_verse: Agìń gbanti kɔkɔ poonee, Yoob kaa nìn ŋá ikpiti. Waa nìn sòon̄ ki bíil̀ Unimbɔti.

english_verse: When the angels gathered around the Lord again, Satan was there with them,
translation_verse: Dalba muee, Unimbɔti tuuŋyi tí dɔ́miń ti-Dindaan kpafil. Sitaan, ukuŋfil mun nìn tí bí bi-kansikin kí dū u-ba kí dàkà.

english_verse: and the Lord asked, “Satan, where have you been?” Satan replied, “I have been going all over the earth.”
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan nìn bālifì-u yii: «La ní a nyánní ní?» Ní Sitaan kíí ti-Dindaan yii: «M cūtìi yìin̄ yìin̄ ki māntì kitiŋ pu ní.»

english_verse: Then the Lord asked, “What do you think of my servant Job? No one on earth is like him—he is a truly good person, who respects me and refuses to do evil. And he hasn't changed, even though you persuaded me to destroy him for no reason.”
translation_verse: Niinee ní ti-Dindaan bí Sitaan yii: «A ká m-tɔntɔnliu Yoobaa! Waa cáá juti kitiŋ pu. Baa kāntí u-pu tikpitil tiba ní u-pɔbil bí diba nì mi. U fàŋkí man Unimbɔti ní ki fàtī u-boon ki tìì ikpiti. U gbíntìi yú nì mi nì dipɔbil diba, min kamaa a yāntì m nāaǹ-u fámee.»

english_verse: Try striking Job's own body with pain, and he will curse you to your face.”
translation_verse: Míǹ puee dū igbaŋween kí tɔ̄ u-pu kí kpèè u yaa kaa sòon̄ ki bíil̀-si!»

english_verse: “All right!” the Lord replied. “Make Job suffer as much as you want, but just don't kill him.”
translation_verse: Niinee ní ti-Dindaan bí ukuŋfilee yii: «Too, u bí a-ŋaan, ama á taa nín gbēē u-maŋfal ní.»

english_verse: Satan left and caused painful sores to break out all over Job's body—from head to toe.
translation_verse: Sitaan nyáń ti-Dindaan nimbiinee ní ki nín cá, ní ki cūtìi dū ibunsoon ki tɔ́ Yoob pu kí kíĺ u-taaŋi taapu kí cáá sāā u-yil kansikin.

english_verse: Then Job sat on the ash-heap to show his sorrow. And while he was scraping his sores with a broken piece of pottery,
translation_verse: Niinee ní Yoob tātìi kāl̀ ŋfantamin ní ki nyàab̄ abɔkati ki kɔ́tí u-ba.

english_verse: his wife asked, “Why do you still trust God? Why don't you curse him and die?”
translation_verse: Ní u-nimpuu bí-u yii: «A gbíntìi dáá máká Unimbɔti puɔɔɔ? Pùtì sòoǹ kí bīil̀ Unimbɔti kí kpú!»

english_verse: Job replied, “Don't talk like a fool! If we accept blessings from God, we must accept trouble as well.” In all that happened, Job never once said anything against God. Job's Three Friends
translation_verse: Ama ní Yoob kíí-u yii: «A sòoǹ kii unimpu un yil kaa bí kudiinee. Ti fòol̄ nnaam min Unimbɔti tìì-tee, kin ba pu ní tí yíí kí taa fōō nnaabu ŋun u tīī-ti nee?» Tin bí nee kɔkɔ poonee, Yoob kaa nìn wāaǹ u-nyɔkɔ ki sòon̄ ki yīntiǹ Unimbɔti. Yoob bɔɔbi bita dɔ́miń ki māntì u-pu

english_verse: Eliphaz from Teman, Bildad from Shuah, and Zophar from Naamah were three of Job's friends, and they heard about his troubles. So they agreed to visit Job and comfort him.
translation_verse: Yoob bɔɔbi bita gbìl̄ agìń ŋin jéetì u-puee ní báà ŋma yíkìń u-tiŋkin ki ŋá kinyɔɔbaantii kí cùú sɔ̄ kí tūtuǹ Yoob kí ŋméeǹ-u. Bíǹ di sá uteemanja Eeliifaasi nì usuwaja Biilidaadi nì unaamaja Soofaar.

english_verse: When they came near enough to see Job, they could hardly recognize him. And in their great sorrow, they tore their clothes, then sprinkled dust on their heads and cried bitterly.
translation_verse: Bi nín wálìń-u ndanee, baa ti béè-u. Niinee ní bi kíĺ ki bíi sūǹ mpɔn. Bi nìn cúú tiwan tin bi pēēyee ki cátì ní ki nìn dū ŋfantam ki pùkū bi-yiliŋ kí dàkà bi-nimbaaku.

english_verse: For seven days and nights, they sat silently on the ground beside him, because they realized what terrible pain he was in.
translation_verse: Bi ŋá míǹ ki dóòyee ní ki dɔ́miń ki kāl̀ kitiŋ ki kɔ́ĺ Yoob ki ŋá iwiin iluli ŋwiimpu nì kunyeeu. Báà ubɔ kaa nìn wāaǹ kinyɔkɔ ki sòon̄ nì u, di sá yii bi nìn ká yii u bíi jīǹ falaa tikpil.

english_verse: Finally, Job cursed the day of his birth
translation_verse: Míǹ boonee ní Yoob dāa wāaǹ kinyɔkɔ ki tɔ́ ŋwiin ŋun bi màl̄-uee mbusu.

english_verse: by saying to God:
translation_verse: U nín nìn sòon̄ puee sɔ̀.

english_verse: Blot out the day of my birth and the night when my parents created a son.
translation_verse: M bàà là yii Unimbɔti ń kúntí ŋwiin ŋun ní bi màl̄-mee, kí kúntí kunyeeu kun ní m-na cáá m-poolee.

english_verse: and send thick, gloomy shadows to fill it with dread.
translation_verse: Dibɔmbɔndi nì ŋkúm booŋŋu ń nīn bàlifī ŋu-pu, atagban ń nīn pée bīī ŋu-pu, uŋmal ń cúú ŋwìiń ŋwiin gbanti.

english_verse: Don't let children be created or joyful shouts be heard ever again in that night.
translation_verse: Unimpu ubɔ ń taa ti cáá dipool kunyeeu kun ní m-na nìn cáá m-poolee, bí taa ti gbìl̄ ifaal kuŋkuuntii pu kunyeeu gbanti!

english_verse: Let those with magic powers place a curse on that day.
translation_verse: Bin tòó iwiin mbusu, ki nyí bi nín fìntī kupeebiliŋŋu Draagɔn puee ń tɔ̄ kunyeeu gbanti mbusu.

english_verse: Darken its morning stars and remove all hope of light,
translation_verse: Ku-taafaaŋmalbijaai ń kpántí dibɔmbɔndi! Kú cīití kutaa wúntitam kí gīī kí taa wāl̀ ntaafaawìiń!

english_verse: because it let me be born into a world of trouble. Why Didn't I Die at Birth?
translation_verse: Di sá yii kuaa ŋá tiba ki pīiǹ m-na maaliŋu ki yāntì u màl̄-mi m dāa kɔ́ nnaabu ŋun poon m kɔ́ nee. *

english_verse: Why was I accepted and allowed to nurse at my mother's breast?
translation_verse: Ba pu ní m ká ataa ali ŋin làl̄-mee ní? Ba pu ní m ká abii ali ki ŋáam̀ ní?

english_verse: Now I would be at peace in the silent world below
translation_verse: Kɔnampu nee m bàà bí ŋgbansɔŋfin dikaakulin. M bàà dɔ̄ ki gèeǹ ki ŋùŋfī

english_verse: with kings and their advisors whose palaces lie in ruins,
translation_verse: nì bibɔtiibi nì kitiŋ pu yidambi bin nìn fātìi máń tibɔtinaakɔti tin nìn lítèe,

english_verse: and with rulers once rich with silver and gold.
translation_verse: nì abɔtibil ŋin cáá sindaariya ní animbil gbí bi-diiŋŋinee.

english_verse: I wish I had been born dead and then buried, never to see the light of day.
translation_verse: Àá ba pu ní baa dū-mi ki bál̀ kitiŋin kii kibiki kin bi lēē ki fée, a lì kii kibiki kin bi màl̄ kaa yōoǹee.

english_verse: In the world of the dead, the wicked and the weary rest without a worry. *
translation_verse: Dikaakulinee, binikpitib kàal̀ soooo, ní binib bin túń ditundi ki gīīyee kāntí diŋuŋfil.

english_verse: where captives and slaves are free at last. Why Does God Let Me Live?
translation_verse: Ŋwaamu nì bikpaambi kɔkɔ bí niin ní, uyumbu kpiliu kaa ti cáá u-pu mpɔn. *

english_verse: Why does God let me live when life is miserable and so bitter?
translation_verse: Ba pu ní Unimbɔti yàntī bin jīǹ falaayee gbíntì bí dimaŋfalin ní? Ba pu ní bin poon kaam cɔ́tèe gbíntìi fòotī ní?

english_verse: I keep longing for death more than I would seek a valuable treasure.
translation_verse: Bi kā ki cí ŋkúm, ama ŋkúm kaa dòoń, bi fíkití an kɔkɔ pu ki nyàab̀-mì kii tigaajawammɔntiilee.

english_verse: Nothing could make me happier than to be in the grave.
translation_verse: Bi yaa bàà ká dikaakul diba poon kí dòon̄, bi bàà làá nīn bí dipɔɔpindin ki fàal̀ ní!

english_verse: Why do I go on living when God has me surrounded, and I can't see the road?
translation_verse: Ba pu ní Unimbɔti tìì unil un kaa nyí laakin u cée dimaŋfal ní? An niliu ní Unimbɔti dù kunaabakau kí bàkā u-pu!

english_verse: Moaning and groaning are my food and drink,
translation_verse: Diniindi di kpántì m-jinti, ní m dùǹ kii nnyim nín pùub̀ puee.

english_verse: and my worst fears have all come true.
translation_verse: Kun fàantí-mee di bàń-mi, kun m fàŋkée ní m kāntí.

english_verse: I have no peace or rest— only troubles and worries.
translation_verse: Maa cáá ŋgbansɔŋfi, kaa cáá dibatɔl, kaa cáá diŋuŋfil, ama iyaliŋki di māntìi tú-mi.

english_verse: Please be patient and listen to what I have to say. *
translation_verse: An nín píĺ-si puee, taa bàà là kí sòoǹ. Ama taa ŋūǹ kí nīn ŋmí míǹ ki cá.

english_verse: have guided and encouraged many in need.
translation_verse: A-nyɔɔbuŋŋi nìn tīkintí bin cá kí lítée. A nìn tìì bin gīīyee mpɔn.

english_verse: But now you feel discouraged when struck by trouble.
translation_verse: Kɔŋkɔnnee, sii ní agìń bāań a-wunti yɔ̄tèe. An bāań-si dee, ní tifaandi cúú-si!

english_verse: You respect God and live right, so don't lose hope!
translation_verse: A nín fàŋkí Unimbɔti puee kaa sá a-mákalaaa? Bi nín kaa kāntí tikpitil tiba a-puee kaa tìì-si dimákalaaa?

english_verse: In my experience, only those who plant seeds of evil harvest trouble,
translation_verse: M dáań ki ká tin bí nee yii: Unil yaa kùn̄ tikpitil ki búĺ agìńee, u dāa cēē tikpitil nì agìń mun ní.

english_verse: and then they are swept away by the angry breath of God.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti yaa fōotèe, bi kúù ní, u-ŋuul fooku di wù-bi kii ŋŋmee.

english_verse: They may roar and growl like powerful lions. But when God breaks their teeth,
translation_verse: U yàntī gbikinti kaa ti mùuǹ ní upeecuncuti kaa ti sūǹ ní agbikintipɔmbil nyiŋŋi kɔ́fí.

english_verse: they starve, and their children are scattered. A Secret Was Told to Me
translation_verse: Ugbikintija kúù, kun puee waa ká tiba kí cúú kí ŋmɔ́, ugbikintinaati biyaamu sáǹ ki yàl̄. *

english_verse: A secret was told to me in a faint whisper—
translation_verse: M fōō tibɔti tiba dibalin, bi lɔ́kɔfì tibɔti tiba m-tafalin,

english_verse: I was overcome by sleep, but disturbed by dreams;
translation_verse: ŋyunti ŋun binib dámintí kunyeeu bi-landɔkɔi kóò fikil fikil poonee, ŋyunti ŋun binib dɔ̄ ki gèeǹ fɔ̀rtititee.

english_verse: and my hair stood on end, as a wind blew past my face.
translation_verse: Kubuŋu kubɔ nìn bíi fátí m-nimbiin ní m-wunti sáǹ yàrrr.

english_verse: It stopped and stood still. Then a form appeared— a shapeless form. And from the silence, I heard a voice say,
translation_verse: Ubɔ nìn yú niin maa béè-u tiŋan, kujiliŋu kubɔ nìn bí m-nimbiin. An nìn dáá ŋmí, ní boonee m dāa gbìl̄ m-neen ŋubɔ pu yii:

english_verse: “No humans are innocent in the eyes of God their Creator.
translation_verse: «Nisaal ŋūǹ kí nīn bí deedee Unimbɔti nimbiinaaa? Unil ŋūǹ kí nīn bí circir un náań-uee nimbiinaaa?

english_verse: He finds fault with his servants and even with his angels.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti kaa máká u-tuuŋyi pu, u kāntí úǹ u-ba tɔntɔnliibi pu tikpitil ki sòoǹ.

english_verse: Humans are formed from clay and are fragile as moths, so what chance do you have?
translation_verse: Kin ataa aŋa pu ní u làá nīn máká nisaalib pu? Di sá yii kuyɔkɔu ní bi dūu máń-bi ní bi-wunti sá ntam. Baa pée pɔ̄ɔ̄ dimatil kii kugbuluŋgbuŋŋuee ní!

english_verse: Your tent pegs are pulled up, and you leave this life, having gained no wisdom.”
translation_verse: Ŋŋmii ŋun ŋúb́ bi-maŋfalee cúu tīl̀, ní bí kpú kaa kpáàa ká iciin.»

english_verse: Job, call out for help and see if an angel comes!
translation_verse: Fáá mbiil kí kpèè ubɔ yaa kíí-si. U-tuuŋyi ŋulɔŋu ní a ŋūǹ kí sòoǹ nì ní?

english_verse: Envy and jealousy will kill a stupid fool.
translation_verse: Ugbaan ŋuul di kù-u, kinaatuui poompooŋyi di yàntī u kúù.

english_verse: I have seen fools take root. But God sends a curse, suddenly uprooting them
translation_verse: Tiŋman, m lafun ká an bútì ugbaan, ama maa tāaǹ ní ki tɔ́ u-kɔŋkooŋŋu mbusu yii:

english_verse: Our suffering isn't caused by the failure of crops;
translation_verse: Di sá yii nnaabu kaa nyēeń kitiŋ, míǹ ní falaa mun kaa ti cɔ́tiń kitiŋ.

english_verse: it's all part of life, like sparks shooting skyward.
translation_verse: Ama bi màl̄ unil digìńdi pu ní, a lì kii iŋmiyatiyaal nín yíkí ki ŋàaǹ puee. *

english_verse: Job, if I were you, I would ask God for help.
translation_verse: Man di yaa bàà sá siiyee, m bàà làá nyàab̀ Unimbɔti ní, úǹ ŋaan ní m bàà làá dū m-bɔti kí ŋá.

english_verse: His miracles are marvelous, more than we can count.
translation_verse: U tūǹ atuŋkpaan ŋin nyóò unil kaa ŋūǹ kí gbìl̄ ŋi-taapuee ní. U-maamaaci tuuŋŋi kaa cáá ŋkaan.

english_verse: God sends showers on earth and waters the fields.
translation_verse: Úǹ di yàntī utaa nì kitiŋ pu, ki yàntī nnyim nyēeń yilpu ki sɔ̀ŋkī tisati.

english_verse: He protects the sorrowful and lifts up those who have been disgraced. *
translation_verse: Úǹ di yòontí bin dɔ̄ kitiŋ ki fìlim̀ee yilpu, ní ki yàntī bin kā dikpoolee kāntí mmɔn.

english_verse: in their own evil schemes, and their wisdom fails.
translation_verse: Úǹ di gīintí biciŋfitiibi ciiŋyi ki fàtīi cáa cútí-bi, ní ki bíiĺ milimilidambi nín bɔ́ntì puee.

english_verse: Darkness is their only companion, hiding their path at noon.
translation_verse: Bi gbéetí dibɔmbɔndi ŋwiimpu, ní ki táfí kuwiŋkaŋu pu kii kunyeeuee.

english_verse: God rescues the needy from the words of the wicked and the fist of the mighty.
translation_verse: Ama Unimbɔti fìil̄ unandaan ki nyāntí bi-nyɔmmun, u fìil̄ ufalaadaan ki nyāntí ubaatandaan ŋaan.

english_verse: The poor are filled with hope, and injustice is silenced. Consider Yourself Fortunate
translation_verse: Uwɔfi kíǹ ki cáá dimákal, ama Unimbɔti pīiǹ binikpitib nyɔmmu.

english_verse: Consider yourself fortunate if God All-Powerful chooses to correct you.
translation_verse: Kpèè, unil un tafal Unimbɔti dátée bí mmɔnneeee! Míǹ puee Yoob, taa kpèè Unimbɔti Mpɔŋkɔdaan tafadaaldi fám. *

english_verse: He may cause injury and pain, but he will bandage and heal your cuts and bruises.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti di tìì unil tiweendi, úǹ di tí nyìitī u-buuŋŋu, úǹ di kù unil ní kí tí cáaǹ-u mun.

english_verse: God will protect you from harm, no matter how often trouble may strike.
translation_verse: U làá nyāntí-si agìń poon ŋfunyɔm miluu pu, ní nluluútiimee, tikpitil tiba kaa làá ŋá-si.

english_verse: In times of war and famine, God will keep you safe.
translation_verse: Ŋkùm yuntiŋuee, u làá fīī-si kí nyāntí ŋkúm ŋaan, ní kí fīī-si kí nyāntí kitàataajiki ŋaan kujaau yuntiŋu.

english_verse: You will be sheltered, without fear of hurtful words or any other weapon.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti làá wúń a-pu bikuŋfiliibi ń taa ŋá-si tiba, nnaabu yuntiŋuee, aa làá fàŋkì tiba.

english_verse: You will laugh at the threat of destruction and famine. And you won't be afraid of wild animals—
translation_verse: Nnaabu nì ŋkùm yuntiŋuee, a làá nīn bí ní ki lāā, ní kaa làá fàŋkì ipeel mun.

english_verse: they will no longer be fierce, and your rocky fields will become friendly.
translation_verse: Ataŋkpee kaa làá páb́-si a-saakun, ní ipeel ń kpántí a-bɔɔbi.

english_verse: Your home will be secure, and your sheep will be safe.
translation_verse: Ŋgbansɔŋfi làá nīn bí a-dicaŋkun. A làá dāá kpèè a-waŋkuti ní kí ká yii kubɔ kaa wáŋkì.

english_verse: You will have more descendants than there are blades of grass on the face of the earth.
translation_verse: A làá dāá ká yii a-maaliŋu būtì. A-naantiibi làá dāá nīn bí kii timool nín nyēē kitiŋ pu puee ní.

english_verse: You will live a very long life, and your body will be strong until the day you die.
translation_verse: A làá dāá púĺ kí bà a-wiiŋyi ní kí nín kpú, kii kudiceeu yuntiŋu bi nín cēē idi kí páań kukaatuŋu pu puee.

english_verse: Our experience has proven these things to be true, so listen and learn.
translation_verse: Kpèè, ti nín nyàab̄ ki dāa ká kuŋyee dee, ní an lafun sá ibaamɔn. Pīlifì tiŋan kí dūú kpāafì kí tīī a-ba.

english_verse: They outweigh the sand along the beach, and that's why I have spoken without thinking first.
translation_verse: Ama m-nimbinaamandi nyìm̀ ki jítiǹ tiŋku bul. An pu ní m bíi sòoǹ fám fám.

english_verse: The fearsome arrows of God All-Powerful have filled my soul with their poison.
translation_verse: Tiŋman, Unimbɔti Mpɔŋkɔdaan dū u-piiŋyi ki yá-mi, ní m kíǹ ki bíi nyù i-looti. Unimbɔti nyoondi bíi jáà nì mi.

english_verse: Do oxen and wild donkeys cry out in distress unless they are hungry?
translation_verse: Kumooun maŋki sūǹ ŋyunti ŋun ní timɔsɔn dɔ̄ ki-nimbiin kí ŋmɔ́ee? Àá unaa gíti sūǹ ŋyunti ŋun ní bi tīī-u timool ú ŋmɔ́ee?

english_verse: What is food without salt? What is more tasteless than the white of an egg?
translation_verse: A ŋūǹ kí jī tijin kaa ŋá ŋyaam an nīn mɔ̄ɔɔ? Àá mmɔn ŋulɔŋu ní dijindi laakin pīiǹee cáá?

english_verse: That's how my food tastes, and my appetite is gone. *
translation_verse: M yíì kí gbēē tijin tin bí mimmee. M-falaau sá tijin tin di núutì-mee ní. *

english_verse: How I wish that God would answer my prayer
translation_verse: M bàà là yii ubɔ ń ŋá tin m mēēyee kí tīī-mi, Unimbɔti ń tīī-mi kun m lèe.

english_verse: Then I would be comforted, knowing that in all of my pain I have never disobeyed God.
translation_verse: M bàà làá yùkū nì dipɔɔpindi digìńdi din poon m bí an kaa kúntí nee, ní kí bàà ká diŋmeendi. Maa bàà làá nyā Unimbɔti circirdaan nyɔɔbuŋŋi boon.

english_verse: I am not strong as stone or bronze,
translation_verse: M-pɔŋŋu kaa sá ditaŋkpal pɔŋŋu, ní m-wunti mun kaa tí pɔ̄ɔ̄ kii tasa kútee.

english_verse: and I have finally reached the end of my rope. My Friends, I Am Desperate
translation_verse: Maa tí cáá mpɔn ŋubɔ m-ni kí ŋmā kí fīī m-ba, ní ubɔ mun kaa ti bí laaba kí tíkiń-mi. *

english_verse: My friends, I am desperate, and you should help me, even if I no longer respect God All-Powerful. *
translation_verse: Unil un wunti yɔ̄tèe cáá nsan u-juti ń sɔ̄ u-saai, yaa sá fám, u dù Unimbɔti Mpɔŋkɔdaan faaŋku kí fá ní.

english_verse: like streams that swell with melting snow,
translation_verse: Anyintaŋkpee nì ntaayim yaa dūntèe ní dinyiŋgbagbal ń gbí ibun gbanti.

english_verse: then suddenly disappear in the summer heat.
translation_verse: Ama ní dipeel puee, ní í fóotí, kutuntuŋu yuntiŋuee ní í kpā dicilpu dicilpu.

english_verse: I am like a caravan, lost in the desert while searching for water.
translation_verse: Kpaŋgulib kaa ti pàatī ibun gbanti cee, bi dūú bɔ̄ kuteeun ní kí tin wāŋkì.

english_verse: just as I am with you. Only one look at my suffering, and you run away scared. What Have I Done Wrong?
translation_verse: Ni sá kii ibun gbantee ní ki tīī man ni-bɔɔ! Ni nín ká m-naabuŋuee ní an cúú-ni tifaandi.

english_verse: Have I ever asked any of you to give me a gift
translation_verse: M bālifì-ni yii ní tīī-mi tibaaa, àá ní lēē ni-gaajawanti poon tiba kí pɔ̄-maaa?

english_verse: or to purchase my freedom from brutal enemies?
translation_verse: M bālifì-ni yii ní fīī-mi kí nyāntí m-nannanliu, àá upɔɔl ubɔ ŋaanaaa?

english_verse: What have I done wrong? Show me, and I will keep quiet.
translation_verse: Dàkàmaan-mi, m làá ŋmīĺ, dàkàmaan-mi tin poon m yīntèe.

english_verse: The truth is always painful, but your arguments prove nothing.
translation_verse: Tibulcin nyɔɔbuŋŋi kaa tìì unil tiweendi. Ama ní tùkù-mi kun pu ni wòoǹ-mee.

english_verse: Here I am desperate, and you consider my words as worthless as wind.
translation_verse: Ni là kí wòoǹ m-nyɔɔbuŋŋi fám níii? Ama an sá anyɔɔbun fám ní, unil un kaa ti cáá dimákalee nín sòon̄ ki tɔ́ kutaa puee.

english_verse: Why, you would sell an orphan or your own neighbor!
translation_verse: Ni yaa ká kí tɔ̄ ditaŋkpiibil pu kasi, kí dū nimbi ni-ba bɔɔ kí nyāfì, ni là!

english_verse: Look me straight in the eye; I won't lie to you.
translation_verse: Too, m gbàam̄-ni, kpèèmaan-mi, kí tùkù-mi m yaa bíi mɔ́ntí-ni.

english_verse: Stop accusing me falsely; my reputation is at stake.
translation_verse: Ní fàtīí gítímaan ni-boon, nín̄ sámaan deedeedambi. Fàtīí gítímaan! Ní béémaan yii maa ŋá tikpitil tiba.

english_verse: I know right from wrong, and I am not telling lies.
translation_verse: Mili mili bɔti nyēē m-nyɔkɔnaaa? Ni dàkafī yii m-limbil kaa gbìl̀ falaa níii?

english_verse: Why is life so hard? Why do we suffer?
translation_verse: Unil bítam kitiŋ nee pu bí kii sooja tundee ní, a lì kii upaadaan maŋfal wiiŋyee.

english_verse: We are slaves in search of shade; we are laborers longing for our wages.
translation_verse: Kii uyumbu nín fèefī ki nyàab̀ mboon puee, kii upaadaan nín cí kí fōō u-paati puee,

english_verse: God has made my days drag on and my nights miserable.
translation_verse: míǹ ní an bí-mi. Iŋmal iŋmal sɔ̀ m-maŋfal kaa ti bí tiban. M-paatii di sá iyaliŋki nyati.

english_verse: My parched skin is covered with worms, dirt, and sores,
translation_verse: Ijiliŋkpaam nì ipɔkɔ gbí m-wunti kɔkɔ pu, m-wuŋgbaŋŋu lɔ̄tì lɔ̄tì ki kíǹ ki nyēē nnyim.

english_verse: and my days are running out quicker than the thread of a fast-moving needle. Don't Forget!
translation_verse: M-maŋfal wiiŋyi bíi sáń malaa malaa ki jítiǹ usatalul gulfajantiliikee. M-maŋfal wiiŋyi bíi kúntí dee, dimákal kaa ti bí. *

english_verse: I beg you, God, don't forget! My life is just a breath, and trouble lies ahead.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti, téetí yii m-maŋfal sá kufoou ní, m-nimbibul pée gíti kpá kí ká nnaam.

english_verse: I will vanish from sight, and no one, including you, will ever see me again.
translation_verse: Sii un di nìn kpèé-mee, aa ti làá wāl̀-mi. A làá dāá nyàab̀-mi, ama m dāa gíti kpá.

english_verse: I will disappear in the grave or vanish from sight like a passing cloud.
translation_verse: Kii ditagbandi nín búntí pu kí wāŋkèe, míǹ ní unil un nín sìntī ditaŋkpiilinee kaa ti gítiń.

english_verse: Never will I return home; soon I will be forgotten.
translation_verse: Udaan yaa búntèe, waa ti gítiń u-dumpu, ní laakin u nìn kóòyee, bi kpáàa pée súntì u-pu kpalaa.

english_verse: Am I the sea or a sea monster? Is that why you imprison me?
translation_verse: M sá tiŋku àá kupeebiliŋŋu kun bí nnyimineeee? Kin ba pu ní a cí-mi míǹ?

english_verse: but you torture me with terrible dreams. *
translation_verse: ní a cáá tidamintiil ki fàantí-mi. Kun kun a lèekī ki dàkà-mee kɔ̄ntí-mi dinyoondi.

english_verse: Leave me alone and let me die; my life has no meaning.
translation_verse: M gīiǹ m-ba, maa làá nīn bí ki cá jaanjaan. Maa ti bí tiban, yàntī-mi soooo. *

english_verse: Why do you test us from sunrise to sunset?
translation_verse: A-nimbikpeeŋu pée cɔ́ u-pu ní kutaafaau kamaa, ní ki cɔ́ŋkí-u ŋyunti kamaa.

english_verse: Won't you look away just long enough for me to swallow?
translation_verse: Ŋyunti ŋulɔŋu ní a làá gbèen̄ kí taa ti kpèè-mi ní? A làá pée yàntī kubuŋu ń fáá m-pu dalbaaa?

english_verse: Why do you watch us so closely? What's it to you, if I sin? Why am I your target and such a heavy burden?
translation_verse: Báà m yaa yīntì, ba ní an ŋáań-si ní, sii un cɔ́ŋkí inifunaanee? Ba pu ní a màkantí-mi kii ukpan nín màkà upeel puee ní? M kalin kpántì diwaŋgul ki tīī-si níii?

english_verse: Does God All-Powerful stand in the way of justice?
translation_verse: Unimbɔti pɔ̀ gandaaa? Unimbɔti Mpɔŋkɔdaan kaa sòoǹ tibɔti ti-púɔɔ?

english_verse: He made your children pay for their sins.
translation_verse: A-jipɔmbi máaǹ ki tin ŋá ikpiti, an pu ní u dáaĺ bi-tafal bi-kpitii pu.

english_verse: So why don't you turn to him
translation_verse: Ama sii, a yaa nyàab̄ Unimbɔti, ki yaa gbāam̀ Unimbɔti Mpɔŋkɔdaan,

english_verse: and start living right? Then he will decide to rescue and restore you to your place of honor.
translation_verse: a yaa kaa ŋá tiba ní a-pɔbil bí dibee, u làá wúń a-pu ní kí fàtīí tīī-si mpaan ŋun máaǹ-see.

english_verse: Your future will be brighter by far than your past. Our Ancestors Were Wise
translation_verse: A nín nìn bí min njaminee kaa làá nīn téé a nín làá dāá nīn sá kun foolee. *

english_verse: Our ancestors were wise, so learn from them.
translation_verse: Bàlifì bin līntiǹ-tee, ní kí dàkafì bi-naanjab nín nìn kántì kántì tiŋyee pu.

english_verse: Our own time has been short, like a fading shadow, and we know very little.
translation_verse: Bi màl̄-ti nee, taa yúntì ní kaa nyí tiba mun. Ti-maŋfal wiiŋyi kitiŋ nee pu jītí malaa kii mboonee ní.

english_verse: and if the water dries up, they die sooner than grass.
translation_verse: Nnyim yaa kpée, ku péetíǹ timool tin kíǹee kí kpā, ŋyunti ŋun ku dáá púkuḿ baa láá gāā-kuee!» *

english_verse: Such is the hopeless future of all who turn from God
translation_verse: Bin súntí Unimbɔti puee nín kúntíǹ puee dee. Binikpitib mákal nín kúntí puee dee.

english_verse: and trust in something as frail as a spider's web—
translation_verse: Kun pu bi mákée cúu tīl̀, di sá yii bi-mákal gbanti bí kii tinaŋgbantalindee ní.

english_verse: Sinful people are like plants with spreading roots and plenty of sun and water.
translation_verse: Bi bí kii busubu bun cáá ŋkpiim tikpil ki wīintí ŋwìiń puee ní, bu tòó bu-paŋŋi bukpaa bun poon bu cɔ́ee.

english_verse: They wrap their roots tightly around rocks.
translation_verse: Bu tòó bu-nyaaŋyi ataŋkpee kansikin, ní ki nyàab̀ nsan ki kóò ataŋkpee poon.

english_verse: But once they are pulled up, they have no more place;
translation_verse: Ama bi yaa kpīkitì-bu mpaan ŋun pu bu nìn yúee, mpaan gbanti làá lì yii màa pée ká-bu jaanjaan.

english_verse: their life slips away, and other plants grow there.
translation_verse: Bin súntí Unimbɔti puee naam nín kúntí laakiŋyee dee! Biba di làá nyā kí fōō bu-paaŋŋu.

english_verse: We know God doesn't reject an innocent person or help a sinner.
translation_verse: Unil un baa kāntí u-pu tibee, Unimbɔti kaa féeń-u, ní kaa tútúǹ un ŋáań ikpitee.

english_verse: And so, he will make you happy and give you something to smile about.
translation_verse: U làá yàntī á fàtīí ká tilaal, ní kí yàntī á nīn bí dipɔɔpindin ki fàal̀.

english_verse: But your evil enemies will be put to shame and disappear forever.
translation_verse: Icoo làá cúú a-nannanliibi, binikpitib làá wāŋkì.

english_verse: What you say is true. No human is innocent in the sight of God.
translation_verse: Tiŋman, m nyí yii an lafun sá míǹ. Di sá yii mana ní unil ŋūǹ kí nīn bí deedee Unimbɔti nimbiin?

english_verse: Not once in a thousand times could we win our case if we took him to court.
translation_verse: Unil nì Unimbɔti yaa làá kpáká, Unimbɔti kaa làá kíí anyɔɔbun kutuku poonee dibaba gba.

english_verse: God is wise and powerful— who could possibly oppose him and win?
translation_verse: U-ciiŋyi nyóò ní u-pɔŋŋu sá ŋkpaan, ŋma di ŋūǹ kí yūĺ u-nimbiin kaa ká ditafadaaldi?

english_verse: When God becomes angry, he can move mountains before they even know it.
translation_verse: Úǹ di kpìkitī ajoon dicilpu dicilpu ní ki lábití-ŋi ki cìb̀ u-ŋuul poon.

english_verse: God can shake the earth loose from its foundations
translation_verse: U yàntī kitiŋ nyeel cìŋkī, u yàntī ki-jaantalkub kpìntī.

english_verse: or command the sun and stars to hold back their light.
translation_verse: Úǹ di tìì ŋwìiń mara ní ŋú taa nyā, ní kí dū iŋmalbijaa kí pìin̄ kudii í taa ŋmíntí.

english_verse: God alone stretched out the sky, stepped on the sea,
translation_verse: Úǹ baba di kpátì kutagbɔŋu, ní ki dū u-taaŋi ki tɔ́kɔǹ tiŋkub nyiŋgbanti pu ki cōom̀.

english_verse: and set the stars in place— the Big Dipper and Orion, the Pleiades and the stars in the southern sky.
translation_verse: Úǹ di náań iŋmalbi kitiŋi nín bí pu aba abee: dikitil din bí ŋgan púee nì din bí ti-yil kansikinee nì din bí ŋgiil púee.

english_verse: Of all the miracles God works, we cannot understand a one.
translation_verse: U tūǹ atuŋkpaan ŋin ubɔ kaa ŋūǹ kí gbìl̄ ŋi-taapuee, ní ki ŋáań maamaaci tuuŋŋi ŋin kaa cáá ŋkaanee.

english_verse: And if he grabs something, who can stop him or raise a question?
translation_verse: U yaa fìkī tiba, ŋma di ŋūǹ kí yàntī ú fàtīí gíiǹní-tì? Ŋma di ŋūǹ kí bàlifì-u yii: «Ba ní a ŋáańee?»

english_verse: When God showed his anger, the servants of the sea monster fell at his feet.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti yaa gíí diŋuulee, waa gítí u-boon. Tipeebilindi tin bí tiŋkunee dòoń ki gbàantí u-taaŋi taapu, an dàkà yii Raab nì u-naacimbi. *

english_verse: How, then, could I possibly argue my case with God? Though I Am Innocent
translation_verse: Kin mana ní man un bí nee, m làá ŋmā kí kíí-u? La ní m làá ká anyɔɔbun kí dūú kíí-u?

english_verse: And if God came into court when I called him, he would not hear my case.
translation_verse: Báà m yaa yíiń-u ní u kíí-mi, maa máká yii u làá pīlifiǹ m-nyɔkɔ.

english_verse: He would strike me with a storm and increase my injuries for no reason at all.
translation_verse: U yāntì u-buŋkpaaŋku fáá-mi ki lúkú, u bíi tìì-mi tiweendi fám.

english_verse: Before I could get my breath, my miseries would multiply.
translation_verse: Waa yàntī ḿ fòotī báà fiii, ama ní ki yāntì m-nyɔkɔ túŋkì.

english_verse: God is much stronger than I am, and who would call me into court to give me justice?
translation_verse: Mimmee man nì Unimbɔti ń mɔ̀ɔɔ? Báà an yaa sá dimool, u pɔ̄ɔǹ-mi sɔ́kɔ sɔkɔ! Ḿ cùnnì-u ibɔsoonaaa? Báà an yaa sá ibɔsoonaaa, ŋma di làá yíiń-u tibuul ní?

english_verse: I am not guilty, but I no longer care what happens to me.
translation_verse: Maa kalin ŋá tibaaa? Maa ti kpáàa nyí gba. M gīiǹ nì m-ba ní.

english_verse: What difference does it make? God destroys the innocent along with the guilty.
translation_verse: Man ceeyee, a ŋá tibaaa, aa ŋá tibaaa, an sá ubaanti ní. An pu ní m lì yii: Unimbɔti yàntī maanyiiba nì dibɔkpil daan kúù.

english_verse: When a good person dies a sudden death, God sits back and laughs.
translation_verse: Nnaabukpaan ŋubɔ yaa jéetì kitiŋ pu ki kūū binibee, Unimbɔti bí ní ki lāā maanyiibab bi-nimbinaamandi poon!

english_verse: And who else but God blindfolds the judges, then lets the wicked take over the earth? My Life Is Speeding By
translation_verse: Unimbɔti yaa dū duulinya ki líiǹ binikpitibee, ní ú bìin̄ bibɔsoonliibi nimbiin! An yaa kaa sá úǹ di ŋáań míǹ, ŋma di gíti ŋūǹ kí ŋá míǹ? *

english_verse: My life is speeding by, without a hope of happiness.
translation_verse: M-maŋfal wiiŋyi sáń malaa malaa ki jítiǹ utaatanli, i sáǹ kaa kpáàa ká nnaam ki dáká.

english_verse: Each day passes swifter than a sailing ship or an eagle swooping down.
translation_verse: M-maŋfal wiiŋyi sáń malaa malaa kii meelabee, a lì kii ukaabu nín tòó pu yilpu kí cúú u-jintee.

english_verse: Sometimes I try to be cheerful and to stop complaining,
translation_verse: M yaa bàà bí yii m làá súntí m-yaliŋkii pu, kí bútí m-nimbiin kí lēe,

english_verse: but my sufferings frighten me, because I know that God still considers me guilty.
translation_verse: ní falaa un poon m bée fàantí-mi. Di sá yii m nyí sii Unimbɔti nín kaa làá sòoǹ kí pɔ̀-mee.

english_verse: So what's the use of trying to prove my innocence?
translation_verse: Kii a nín sòon̄ ki kūū m-bɔtee, ba pu ní ḿ gíti tīī m-ba digìńdi fám?

english_verse: Even if I washed myself with the strongest soap,
translation_verse: Báà m yaa dū fɔfɔ ki fùl̄ ki dū njeem ki fíntì m-ŋalii,

english_verse: God would throw me into a pit of stinking slime, leaving me disgusting to my clothes.
translation_verse: a làá fàtīí gíiǹ-mi kí tɔ̄ tikpatin, ní m-wampeeŋkaati gba kaa dāa gíti là-mi.

english_verse: God isn't a mere human like me. I can't put him on trial.
translation_verse: Di sá yii Unimbɔti kaa sá unil kii mamee ḿ ŋmā kí kíí-u, àá ḿ ŋmā man nì u ń cù ibɔsoon.

english_verse: Who could possibly judge between the two of us?
translation_verse: Upàtil ubɔ mun kpá kí ŋmā kí dū u-ŋal kí páań ti-liitil pu kí pàtī-ti.

english_verse: Can someone snatch away the stick God carries to frighten me?
translation_verse: Udaan bàà fòol̄ mbambaan ŋun Unimbɔti cáa gbáà-mi nee, ní kí yàntī ú taa ti fàaǹ-mi.

english_verse: Then I could speak up without fear of him, but for now, I cannot speak.
translation_verse: M bàà làá ŋmā kí sòoǹ nì u kí taa fàŋkì. Ama míǹ ní an kaa sá, maa ti yì m-ba.

english_verse: I am sick of life! And from my deep despair, I complain to you, my God.
translation_verse: M gīī nì m-ba, an puee maa làá ŋmā kí cúú m-ba kí taa yāliŋkì. M-poon kaam cɔ́tì ní m làá sòoǹ kí tùkù-u.

english_verse: Don't just condemn me! Point out my sin.
translation_verse: M làá tùkù Unimbɔti yii: taa kpɔ̀ m-bɔti, tùkù-mi kun ní m ŋá ní a wòoǹ-mee.

english_verse: Why do you take such delight in destroying those you created and in smiling on sinners?
translation_verse: An mɔ̄ǹ-si á nīn sàantí-mi, kí fàtī a-boon kí tīī a-wannaaŋkaati, ama ní kí yàntī án bútí binikpitibaaa?

english_verse: Do you look at things the way we humans do?
translation_verse: Nisaal nimbiliŋ ní a cáaa? Unil nín kpèé ki wāĺ tiwan puee, míǹ ní si mun kpèé ki wāĺ-tàaa?

english_verse: Is that why you are so quick to find fault with me?
translation_verse: Ba pu ní a nyàab̀ kí béé m-yìntitam ní? Ba pu ní a fíkití ki nyàab̀ kí ká m-kpitii ní?

english_verse: You know I am innocent, but who can defend me against you?
translation_verse: Sii a-ba pée nyí yii maa ŋá tiba ní kaa tí ŋūǹ kí ŋmátí kí nyā a-ŋaan.

english_verse: Remember that you molded me like a piece of clay. So don't turn me back into dust once again.
translation_verse: Téetí yii sii di máń-mi kii bi nín māā ditansambil puee, ama ní a là kí nà-mi dúsi dusi ḿ kpántí ntam.

english_verse: As cheese is made from milk, you created my body from a tiny drop.
translation_verse: Sii di náań-mi ki tākaǹ m-na poon kii bi nín bàtī nnaabiim kí ŋá disambilin mí kìl̄ puee.

english_verse: Then you tied my bones together with muscles and covered them with flesh and skin.
translation_verse: A dū anancal nì ŋwuŋgban ki bīiǹ-mi, ní ki ŋá-mi akpab nì igiin ki túkuǹ tɔb pu.

english_verse: You, the source of my life, showered me with kindness and watched over me. You Have Not Explained
translation_verse: Míǹ boonee ní a ŋá-mi tiŋan ki tīī-mi dimaŋfal, ní ki wúń m-pu tiŋan. *

english_verse: You have not explained all of your mysteries,
translation_verse: A dū abɔɔn bɔti tiba ki bál̀ a-pɔbilin. M nyí kun ní a dàkafēe:

english_verse: but you catch and punish me each time I sin.
translation_verse: A là kí ká-mi m bíi ŋáań ikpiti ní, ní kaa là kí dū m-yìntitam kí pɔ̄-mi.

english_verse: No matter how hard I try, you keep hunting me down like a powerful lion.
translation_verse: M yaa gántì m-yilee, a jì-mi kii gbikintee ní, a ŋáań maamaacib kí gbéeǹ m-weeŋyi pu.

english_verse: You never stop accusing me; you become furious and attack over and over again.
translation_verse: A jáà nì mi kaa gbèentí, diŋuul din a gíí m-puee mɔ̀tīí gbēentí, ní a-janjaliibi dòoń akiti akiti kí jáǹ-mi.

english_verse: Why did you let me be born? I would rather have died before birth
translation_verse: Ba pu ní a nyántìń-mi m-na poon ní? Bi yaa bàà màl̄-mi kaa yōoǹee, ubɔ kaa bàà kāntí-mi.

english_verse: I have only a few days left. Why don't you leave me alone? Let me find some relief, *
translation_verse: M-wiiŋyi kaa ti kíǹ ki náaǹ. Gbèen̄ kí taa ti jáǹ-mi, kí yàntī-mi soooo ḿ pée ká dipɔɔpindi fiii iwiin in kíǹ-mi ḿ dūú kàl̄ nee poon,

english_verse: of darkness and despair, the place of no return.
translation_verse: Niinee, dibɔmbɔŋkpaandi nì fikil fikil di bí, ní ŋwalifi bí niin kii dibɔmbɔndee.

english_verse: Your words have silenced others and made them ashamed; now it is only right for you to be put to shame.
translation_verse: A nín cáá kinyɔkɔee di làá yàntī binib ń kpántí bimuumbaaa? A làá bèel̀ binib ubɔ ń taa wòoǹ-saaa?

english_verse: You claim to be innocent and argue that your beliefs are acceptable to God.
translation_verse: A lī gba yii: «Tin m sòoǹee sá ibaamɔn, Unimbɔti kaa làá ká m-pu tiba kí sòoǹ.»

english_verse: and let you know that wisdom has many different sides. You would then discover that God has punished you less than you deserve.
translation_verse: U bàà làá lēē dinyil bɔɔŋŋi kí dàkà-si. Abɔɔn gbanti jítiǹ unil ciiŋyi ń ŋmā kí gbìl̄ taapu. A bàà làá gbìl̄ niin yii Unimbɔti súntì a-kpitii dijandi pu. *

english_verse: They are higher than the heavens and deeper than the grave. So what can you do when you know so little,
translation_verse: Unimbɔti ciiŋyi nyóò kii yilpu nín dátiǹ kitiŋ puee ní, ba ní a ŋūǹ kí ŋá? I nyóò ki jítiǹ ditaŋkpiilin. Tilati ní a ŋūǹ kí béé?

english_verse: and these mysteries outreach the earth and the ocean?
translation_verse: I wāā ki jítiǹ kitiŋ, ki wāā ki jítiǹ tiŋku.

english_verse: If God puts you in prison or drags you to court, what can you do?
translation_verse: Unimbɔti yaa cúú dibɔkpil daan ki pīiǹ kudii, ní ki yaa yíiń udaan ibeeyiinee, ŋma di ŋūǹ kí pìin̄ nsan?

english_verse: God has the wisdom to know when someone is worthless and sinful,
translation_verse: Di sá yii Unimbɔti nyí binib bin kaa bí tibanee. An kaa bàlifī ú kpèè címmm ní kí nín ká laakin ikpiti bée.

english_verse: but it's easier to tame a wild donkey than to make a fool wise. Surrender Your Heart to God
translation_verse: Ama ugbaan kaa ŋūǹ kí kpántí uciŋfiti dalba dalba, a lì kii kumooun maŋki di kaa ŋūǹ kí kpántí kimɔŋkimaŋ puee ní. *

english_verse: Surrender your heart to God, turn to him in prayer,
translation_verse: Yoob, dū a-pɔbil kí tīī Unimbɔti, ní kí yòon̄ a-ŋalii kí túĺ-u kí mèè-u.

english_verse: and give up your sins— even those you do in secret.
translation_verse: Ikpiti yaa táká a-ŋaliiyee, á pítí-i kí fá, kí taa yàntī tin kaa bí deedeeyee ń ká mpaan a-dumpu.

english_verse: Then you won't be ashamed; you will be confident and fearless.
translation_verse: Niinee a làá gántí a-yil kí nyā icoon, tiba kpá kí cìŋkì-si, ní aa làá fàŋkì tiba mun.

english_verse: Your troubles will go away like water beneath a bridge,
translation_verse: Di sá yii a làá súntí a-nimbinaamandi pu, a làá dāá súntí kii nnyim min pùub̄ ki búntèe ní.

english_verse: and your darkest night will be brighter than noon.
translation_verse: A-maŋfal wiiŋyi làá wāl̀ bɔ́iii kí jītíǹ kuwiŋkaŋu pu, ní dibɔmbɔndi ń kpántí kii kutaafaauee.

english_verse: You will rest safe and secure, filled with hope and emptied of worry.
translation_verse: A làá dāá nīn cáá dimákal ní kaa làá fàŋkì tiba. Báà icoo boonee, a làá dāá gèeǹ nì ŋgbansɔŋfi.

english_verse: You will sleep without fear and be greatly respected.
translation_verse: A yaa láa bíi ŋùŋfēe, ubɔ kaa làá dāá pìkil̀-si. Binib tikpil gba làá dāá nyàab̀ kí pàkà-si.

english_verse: But those who are evil will go blind and lose their way. Their only escape is death!
translation_verse: Ama binikpitib làá dāá nyàab̀ dijòońdi áli bi-nimbiliŋ ń lóoĺ. Baa làá dāá ká kibalilaŋ. Bi-mákal kɔkɔ di dāa sá ŋkúm.

english_verse: Job said to his friends:
translation_verse: Niinee ní Yoob kíí yii:

english_verse: You think you are so great, with all the answers.
translation_verse: Tiŋman, ni lafun nyí tikɔkɔ! Ni nì iciin di làá kpāfì kí kpú.

english_verse: But I know as much as you do, and so does everyone else.
translation_verse: Ama ma mun cáá dinyil kii nimbee ní, naa jítiǹ-mi. Tin ni sòon̄ee, báà ŋma pée nyí-tì ní.

english_verse: I have always lived right, and God answered my prayers; now friends make fun of me.
translation_verse: M kūuntí ki yíì Unimbɔti ki máká yii u làá kíí-mi, ama ní m-bɔɔbi ŋúb́-mi ki bèel̄. Man un máká Unimbɔti pu, baa kāntí m-pu tibee, bi ŋúb́-mi ki bèel̄.

english_verse: It's easy to condemn those who are suffering, when you have no troubles.
translation_verse: Binib bin bí mmɔnnee dàkafī yii: «Tí kpèè bin bí agìńnee fám.» Bi sòoǹ nì bin cá kí lítée tibɔbaantiil.

english_verse: Robbers and other godless people live safely at home and say, “God is in our hands!” If You Want To Learn
translation_verse: Tiba kaa páb̀ digaŋgam dambi bi-dumpui, bin tákà Unimbɔtee bí ŋgbansɔŋfin ní. Bi-pɔŋŋu di sá bi-nimbɔtiu. *

english_verse: If you want to learn, then go and ask the wild animals and the birds,
translation_verse: Bàlifì tiwaŋkuti, tì làá dàkà-si, bàlifì inoon in ŋàaǹee, i làá tùkù-si.

english_verse: Any of them can tell you what the Lord has done.
translation_verse: Tiwaŋkuti nee kɔkɔ kansikinee, kulɔkɔ di kaa nyí yii ti-Dindaan di ŋá tin bí nee kɔkɔ?

english_verse: Every living creature is in the hands of God.
translation_verse: Tin kɔkɔ cáá kufoouee maŋfal nì unil kamaa fooku kā u-ŋaan ní.

english_verse: and gain some wisdom from those who have lived a long time.
translation_verse: Binicikitikaabi cee ní a kāntí iciin, ní utikpil di cáá dinyil.»

english_verse: But God is the real source of wisdom and strength.
translation_verse: Ama Unimbɔti di yì iciin nì mpɔn, úǹ di tí yì isaŋki nì dinyil. *

english_verse: No one can rebuild what he destroys, or release those he has imprisoned.
translation_verse: Kun Unimbɔti yaa gbáń ki wīīyee, ubɔ kaa ŋūǹ kí fàtīí mā, un u yaa cúú ki tɔ́ sarkee, ubɔ kaa ŋūǹ kí nyāntí-u.

english_verse: God can hold back the rain or send a flood,
translation_verse: U yaa cúú utaayee, ŋweel nyáń dee. U yaa tí cúú utaa ki pīitèe, kitiŋ mun bíil̀ dee.

english_verse: just as he rules over liars and those they lie to.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti cáá mpɔn nì iciin. Úǹ di yì un kíiĺ u-ba nì un kíiĺ bin kíǹee.

english_verse: God shames counselors, turns judges into fools,
translation_verse: U yàntī kitiŋ pu yidambi còom̄ atakulim, u kɔ̄ntí bibɔsoonliibi inaatuu.

english_verse: God removes priests and others who have great power—
translation_verse: U yàntī bisaraaŋaliibi còom̄ atakulim, ní ki lábití abee dambi ki cìb̀.

english_verse: puts mighty kings to shame, and takes away their power.
translation_verse: U kɔ̄ntí duulinya nikpaambi icoo, ní ki gbákaĺ bipɔndambi bi-pɔŋŋu.

english_verse: God strikes their rulers senseless, then leaves them to roam through barren deserts,
translation_verse: U yàntī kitiŋ pu kpootiliibi yiliŋ lábití, ní ki yàntī bi tú ki yìiǹ kuteeu kun poon nsan kpée.

english_verse: lost in the dark, staggering like someone drunk.
translation_verse: Bi táfí dibɔmbɔndin laakin ŋwalifi kpée, ní ki còom̄ ki kpìntī kii bi gbí ndaamee.

english_verse: I know and understand every bit of this.
translation_verse: Tiŋman, m-nimbigbɔŋu ká tíǹ gbanti kɔkɔ, m-tafal gbìl̄ ní ki gbìl̄ taapu.

english_verse: None of you are smarter than I am; there's nothing you know that I don't.
translation_verse: Tin kɔkɔ ni nyée, ma mun nyí-tì, naa jítiǹ-mi!

english_verse: But I prefer to argue my case with God All-Powerful—
translation_verse: Ama Unimbɔti Mpɔŋkɔdaan ní m là kí sòoǹ nì, úǹ cee ní m làá mɔ̄tì m-ba pu.

english_verse: you are merely useless doctors, who treat me with lies.
translation_verse: Nimbee, ni cáá inyimɔn ki bìintí ibaamɔn pu, ni-kɔkɔ sá inyimɔn nyɔkɔdambi ní.

english_verse: The wisest thing you can do is to keep quiet
translation_verse: Ni yaa bàà ŋūǹ kí nīn ŋmí! Bi bàà yíì-ni biciŋfitiibi ní.

english_verse: and not telling the whole truth when you argue his case?
translation_verse: Ni là kí lì yii ni bí Unimbɔti jandi pú deeyaa! Ni ŋūǹ kí mɔ̄tì Unimbɔti puɔɔɔ?

english_verse: If he took you to court, could you fool him, just as you fool others?
translation_verse: Unimbɔti yaa cɔ́ŋkì-ni, ni làá nyāaa? Àá ni là kí mɔ̄ntì-u kii bi nín mɔ́ntí unil puee ní?

english_verse: If you were secretly unfair, he would correct you,
translation_verse: Ni yaa lēē kí taa nīn bí deedee dibalinee, see ú dāá pée wòoǹ-ni.

english_verse: Your wisdom and arguments will blow away like dust. Be Quiet While I Speak
translation_verse: Ni-dàkatam kaa cáá kunyampoou kii ŋfantamee ní, anyɔɔbun ŋin ni cáa mɔ́tí ni-ba puee pɔ̀fì kii kuyɔkɔuee ní.

english_verse: Be quiet while I speak, and we'll see what happens.
translation_verse: Ŋmīĺmaan kí yàntī ḿ sòoǹ, ní tin làá bàń m-puee ń bàń!

english_verse: I will be responsible for what happens to me.
translation_verse: M bɔ́ntì ki cí tin kɔkɔ làá bàń m-puee, báà an yaa sá ŋkúm.

english_verse: God may kill me, but still I will trust him and offer my defense.
translation_verse: Báà Unimbɔti yaa là ú kpɔ̀-mi, maa ti pée cáá dimákal diba dee. Ama m làá mɔ̄tì m-saŋkindi pu u-nimbiin.

english_verse: This may be what saves me, because no guilty person would come to his court.
translation_verse: M yaa ŋúń ki ŋá mimmee, m làá ká difiil, di sá yii unikpiti ubɔ kaa ŋūǹ kí yūĺ Unimbɔti nimbiin.

english_verse: I have prepared my case well, and I am certain to win.
translation_verse: M bíi bɔ́ntí kí yíiń ibeeyiin, ní m nyí tiŋan pu yii man ní bi làá pɔ̀.

english_verse: If you can prove me guilty, I will give up and die. Job Prays I Ask Only Two Things
translation_verse: Ŋma bí ki làá kɔ̄kɔl̀-mi? M-bɔti yaa tí kpíìyaaa, m kíí kí ŋmīĺ kí kpú. *

english_verse: I ask only two things of you, my God, and I will no longer hide from you—
translation_verse: M-Nimbɔtiu, kàkatī tiwan tili kí wàatī-mi, niinee maa ti làá dū m-ba kí báĺ-si.

english_verse: Then speak, and I will reply; or else let me speak, and you reply.
translation_verse: Míǹ boonee, a yaa yíiń-mi m làá kíí-si, àá m làá sòoǹ ní á kíí-mi.

english_verse: Please point out my sins, so I will know them.
translation_verse: M ŋá-si ikpiti ki yīntiǹ-si ŋfunyɔm miŋa pu ní? Yàntī ḿ béé m-kpitii nì m-yìntitam.

english_verse: Why have you turned your back and count me your enemy?
translation_verse: Ba pu ní a fàtī a-boon ki tìì-mi ní? Ba pu ní a ŋáań-mi kii m sá a-nannanliuee ní?

english_verse: Do you really enjoy frightening a fallen leaf?
translation_verse: Ba ní a fàantí ní? Kufaau kun kubuŋu yòontée? Ba ní a jì ní? Kumɔkuliŋuaaa?

english_verse: Why do you accuse me of horrible crimes and make me pay for sins I did in my youth?
translation_verse: A sòon̄ m-bɔti min pɔ̄ɔ̄yee ki ŋmàn̄ ki ŋá kugbɔŋun, a bíi pà-mi m-naacimpɔntin kpitii paati.

english_verse: You have tied my feet down and keep me surrounded;
translation_verse: A bá-mi abaa, ní a-nimbikpeeŋu pée cɔ́ tin kɔkɔ m ŋáańee pu, áli gba a fíkití ki kpèé m-tabɔbiliŋ kɔkɔ!

english_verse: I am rotting away like cloth eaten by worms.
translation_verse: M-wunti bíi sù kii ndɔ nín sù puee, a lì kii akoosibil nín ŋmóò tiwampeeŋkaal puee.

english_verse: Life is short and sorrowful for every living soul.
translation_verse: Unimpu saaleen di màl̄ unil. U-maŋfal wiiŋyi kaa pée fɔ̀kɔ̀ ní ki cáá agìń.

english_verse: And so, I ask you, God, why pick on me?
translation_verse: Mimmee Unimbɔti, an niliu gbanti ní a kpèéee? Man ní a cáǹ ibɔsoonaaa?

english_verse: There's no way a human can be completely pure.
translation_verse: Ŋma di ŋūǹ kí lēē circir wanti tin kaa bí circiree poon? Báà ubɔ kpá!

english_verse: Our time on earth is brief; the number of our days is already decided by you.
translation_verse: Di sá yii sii di kàan̄ unil maŋfal wiiŋyi ki tīī-u, sii di síiǹ iŋmal in nyɔkɔm u máaǹ kí ŋée, sii di síiǹ u-maŋfal gbeennyɔkɔ kin waa ŋūǹ kí jītée.

english_verse: Why don't you leave us alone and let us find some happiness while we toil and labor? When a Tree Is Chopped Down
translation_verse: Páatí a-nimbikpeeŋu u-pu kí yàntī-u soooo, ú ŋmā kí kúntí u-maŋfal wiiŋyi ŋgbansɔŋfin, kii upaadaan nín kúntí u-tundi ŋwiin puee. *

english_verse: When a tree is chopped down, there is always the hope that it will sprout again.
translation_verse: Busubu búǹ cáá dimákal: bi yaa gāā-bu, bu ŋūǹ kí fàtīí túkú, bu làá nīn pée cɔ́tí ní kaa gbèentí.

english_verse: but at the touch of water, it sprouts once again.
translation_verse: bu yaa gbìl̄ nnyim puee, see bú fàtīí fìkitī ní kí tɔ̄ mpamu kii kisubikee.

english_verse: Humans are different— we die, and that's the end.
translation_verse: Ama unil úǹ yaa kpíìyee, waa ti cáá mpɔn. Unil fooku yaa nyáń u-nee, u gíti bí tilatin?

english_verse: We are like streams and lakes after the water has gone;
translation_verse: Dimɔɔl ŋūǹ kí fóotí, ibun ń kpā,

english_verse: we fall into the sleep of death, never to rise again, until the sky disappears.
translation_verse: ama unil un dōoǹ u-ŋaliŋu puee kaa ti yíkí. Kí cáá sāā ŋyunti ŋun kutagbɔŋu dáá bí nee, waa làá fìntī, u pée kpá kí yīkì u-geemin. *

english_verse: Please hide me, God, deep in the ground— and when you are angry no more, remember to rescue me. Will We Humans Live Again?
translation_verse: A yaa bàà dū-mi ki bál̀ ditaŋkpiilin, kí bàkā m-pu niin kí cáá sāā ŋyunti ŋun ní a-ŋuul làá sɔ̀ŋkèe, ní kí síiń-mi iwiin in nyɔkɔm m làá ŋá niin ní á nín téetí m-puee.

english_verse: Will we humans live again? I would gladly suffer and wait for my time.
translation_verse: Ama unil un kpíìyee gíti ŋūǹ kí gítiń dimaŋfalinaaa? M bàà làá jī kimɔtii m-tumpɔɔl nee yuntiŋu poon, kí nīn cí ŋyunti ŋun ní ubɔ làá dāá fōō-mee.

english_verse: My Creator, you would want me; you would call out, and I would answer.
translation_verse: Niinee a yaa yíiń-mee ní ḿ kíí-si, a bàà làá nyàab̀ kí ká man a-wannaaŋkaati.

english_verse: You would take care of me, but not count my sins—
translation_verse: Aa bàà làá gíti dū m-yìntitam kí yíiń tiba. Too, kɔŋkɔnnee, sii di bí ki kàaǹ m nín dàatī m-taaŋi puee.

english_verse: you would put them in a bag, tie it tight, and toss them away.
translation_verse: A bàà làá dū m-yìntitam kí báĺ kilɔbikin, ní kí bìin̄ m-kpitii pu kii bi nín ŋàl̀ kudii puee. *

english_verse: But in the real world, mountains tumble, and rocks crumble;
translation_verse: Ama dijool cìŋkī ní kí yàaǹ, ní ditaŋkpal ń nìkī mpaan ŋun pu di nìn bée.

english_verse: streams wear away stones and wash away soil. And you destroy our hopes!
translation_verse: Nnyim ŋūǹ kí líntí kí dóó ataŋkpee. Utaa nì kí ŋmɔ́ kí càkatī kitiŋ. Míǹ mbaantiim ní a nàantí unil mákal.

english_verse: You change the way we look, then send us away, wiped out forever.
translation_verse: A dù-u kí yā kitiŋ ní ú búntí kaa ti gítiń. A bíiĺ u-nimbiin ní kí jà-u.

english_verse: We never live to know if our children are praised or disgraced.
translation_verse: Bi yaa bíi tìì u-jipɔmbi jilmaaa, úǹ kaa ti pée nyí tiba, bi yaa tí sīntì-bi taapuɔɔɔ, waa tí nyí.

english_verse: We feel no pain but our own, and when we mourn, it's only for ourselves.
translation_verse: Waa ti nyí tiba ki kútì u-wuŋgbaŋŋu nín bíi jīǹ falaa uŋyee pu, u-naabuŋu baba pu ní u ŋūǹ kí yāliŋkì.

english_verse: Eliphaz from Teman said: *
translation_verse: Niinee ní Eeliifaasi fōō dinyɔɔbundi ki lī yii:

english_verse: Your words are enough to make others turn from God and lead them to doubt.
translation_verse: Áli gba a bíi bíiĺ dinimbɔtinool, a bíi nàantí ŋwimmeem Unimbɔti nimbiin dee.

english_verse: And your sinful, scheming mind is the source of all you say.
translation_verse: A bíi sòoǹ míǹ kun puee a sá unikpiti, ní ki sòoǹ kii mili mili dambee.

english_verse: I am not here as your judge; your own words are witnesses against you.
translation_verse: A-nyɔkɔ poon nyɔɔbuŋŋi di bíi kù a-bɔti, an kaa sá man. Tin kɔkɔ a sòon̄ee fātìi bíi kɔ́kɔĺ-si. *

english_verse: Were you the first human? Are you older than the hills?
translation_verse: A dàkafī yii sii di sá unipeepeekaa un bi màl̄ kitiŋ pueeee? Mimmee bi màl̄-si ki wāatì ní ki nín náań ŋgbantamuɔɔɔ?

english_verse: Have you ever been present when God's council meets? Do you alone have wisdom?
translation_verse: A nyí Unimbɔti nín nìn bɔ́ntì tin dibalin kí ŋéeee? Sii baba di cáá iciinaaa?

english_verse: We have the benefit of wisdom older than your father.
translation_verse: Kpèè utikpil un yúntèe bí ti-kansikin, unil un kpíǹ a-baayee!

english_verse: And you have been offered comforting words from God. Isn't this enough?
translation_verse: A dàkafī yii aa nyàab̀ Unimbɔti ŋmeendi din u dī ti-nyɔɔbummɔɔŋŋi pu ki tìì-si nee níii? *

english_verse: Your emotions are out of control, making you look fierce;
translation_verse: Ba pu ní an yòontí-si míǹ? Ba pu ní a dàab̀-ti míǹ?

english_verse: that's why you attack God with everything you say.
translation_verse: Ba pu ní a díkí Unimbɔti pu míǹ? Ba pu ní a yāntì anyɔɔbun nee juti nyáń a-nyɔkɔn?

english_verse: and neither are angels— not in the sight of God. If God doesn't trust his angels,
translation_verse: Unimbɔti yaa kaa máká úǹ u-ba tuuŋyi pu, ní kutagbɔŋu yaa kaa bí circir u-ceeyee,

english_verse: what chance do humans have? We are so terribly evil that we thirst for sin. Just Listen to What I Know
translation_verse: kin ataa aŋa pu ní unil un cáá titantan kaa bí tiban, unil un ŋáań ikpiti kii bi nín nyù nnyim pu nee pu ní u làá nīn máká? *

english_verse: Just listen to what I know, and you will learn
translation_verse: Pīlifì, m làá dàkà-si tiba, m làá māafì-si tin m kée.

english_verse: wisdom known by others since ancient times.
translation_verse: M làá māafì-si biciŋfitiibi dàkal, didàkal din ní bi fōō bi-naanjab ceeyee.

english_verse: Those who gained such insights also gained the land, and they were not influenced by foreign teachings.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti nìn dū kitiŋ ki tīī bíǹ baba ní, báà unicaan kaa nìn kɔ́ bi-pu.

english_verse: But suffering is in store each day for those who sin.
translation_verse: «Unikpiti jīǹ falaa ní u-maŋfal wiiŋyi kɔkɔ poon, ní uwɔ́bil maŋfal wiiŋyi kaa náaǹ.

english_verse: Even in times of success, they constantly hear the threat of doom.
translation_verse: Ineen in fàantée lɔ́kɔfí u-tafaliŋin. Ŋgbansɔŋfi yuntiŋu ní digaŋgam dambi lítí u-pu.

english_verse: They scrounge around for food, all the while dreading the approaching darkness.
translation_verse: Kaasaabi di làá jī-u. U nyí tiŋan yii dibɔmbɔndi wiiŋŋu kaa ti dátiǹ-u.

english_verse: They are overcome with despair, like frightened soldiers facing a fearsome king in battle.
translation_verse: Dibɔmbɔndi wiiŋŋu ŋun dòoń gbantee kɔ̄ntí-u dinyoondi, dinimbinaamandi nì ilandɔkɔ làá jēetí u-pu, kii ubɔti janjakitil nín bɔ́ntì kí kíĺ dikɔ̀ndi puee ní.»

english_verse: This is because they rebelled against God All-Powerful
translation_verse: Di sá yii u tāntì u-ŋal kí fáá Unimbɔti, u yíkì kí jáǹ Unimbɔti Mpɔŋkɔdaan. *

english_verse: and have attacked him with their weapons.
translation_verse: U sáń ki cá u-yil tīī kí jáǹ Unimbɔti, digbampɔɔl din gbìfèe wúń u-pu.

english_verse: They may be rich and fat,
translation_verse: U gbīfiǹ ŋkpam dūu bīiǹ u-nimbiin ní u-wunti bí gbàlgbal.

english_verse: They won't escape the darkness, and the blazing breath of God will set their future aflame. *
translation_verse: Waa làá ŋmā kí ŋmátí kí nyā dibɔmbɔndin. U làá nīn bí kii busubu bun ŋŋmi wùn̄ee ní, ní Unimbɔti fooku ń yòon̄-u kí tɔ̄ kí fá ndan. *

english_verse: They have put their trust in something worthless; now they will become worthless
translation_verse: Dimuuldi pu ní u máká. Ama dimuuldi kaa sá nsammɔnti, di sá yii dimuuldi ní bi làá gíiǹ kí pà-u.

english_verse: Or like vineyards or orchards whose blossoms and unripe fruit drop to the ground.
translation_verse: U làá nīn bí kii bufiinyisubu biliŋ yaa kaa láá bīń an nín gbátí puee ní, àá kii ɔliifi supumpukum nín gbátí puee.

english_verse: Yes, the godless and the greedy will have nothing but flames feasting on their homes,
translation_verse: Unikpiti dicaŋkun yab làá kpántí biŋmaŋŋmantiibi ní. Ŋŋmi di làá wà u nín fìkī binib wanti ki máń kudii kuŋyee.

english_verse: because they are the parents of trouble and vicious lies.
translation_verse: Unil un yaa cáá ikpiti poolee màal̀ nnaabu ní. Kun ní u bɔ́ntì u-pɔbilinee làá ŋmàtiǹ úǹ u-ba ní.

english_verse: I have often heard this, and it offers no comfort.
translation_verse: Tin a sòon̄ee, m gbìl̄ míǹ ŋfunyɔm dilaataal pu. Ni sá biŋmeenliibi bin kaa pée bí tibanee ní.

english_verse: If I speak, or if I don't, I hurt all the same. My torment continues.
translation_verse: Ama m yaa bíi sòoǹee, m-weeŋyi kaa sɔ̀ŋkī, m yaa tí ŋmíl̀aaa, an kaa tí sɔ̀ŋkī.

english_verse: God has worn me down and destroyed my family;
translation_verse: Ibaamɔn poonee, Unimbɔti yāntì m gīī, u kúntì bin kɔkɔ nìn māntìi tú-mee.

english_verse: my shriveled up skin proves that I am his prisoner.
translation_verse: M-wunti nín dáaĺ pu ŋmìiiyee sá m-seeradaaŋwu, m nín dúntì puee kɔ́kɔĺ-mi ní ki kù m-bɔti.

english_verse: God is my hateful enemy, glaring at me and attacking with his sharp teeth.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti tɔ̄ntì-mi u-ŋuul poon, u kùl̄ ki kāl̀ m-pu u-nyiŋŋi gà kàkaka. U sá m-nannanliu ní ki kpèé-mi címmm.

english_verse: Everyone is against me; they sneer and slap my face.
translation_verse: Binib wàatī bi-nyɔmmu bàaa m-pu, bi fátí-mi itampa ki sìí-mi, bi kpáfí kinyɔkɔ kí jáǹ-mi.

english_verse: And God is the one who handed me over to this merciless mob. Everything Was Going Well
translation_verse: Unimbɔti dū-mi ki líiǹ campɔntib bin kaa bí tibanee, u dū-mi ki ŋá binikpitib ŋaan.

english_verse: Everything was going well, until God grabbed my neck and shook me to pieces. God set me up as the target
translation_verse: M nìn bí ŋgbansɔŋfin ní Unimbɔti dɔ́miń ki cīŋkì-mi. U tɔ́ ki kíĺ m-sil ki dū-mi ki lúkú kitiŋ, ní ki màkā-mi kii ukpanee.

english_verse: for his arrows, and without showing mercy, he slashed my stomach open, spilling out my insides.
translation_verse: U-piiŋyi ŋàaǹ an kɔkɔ pu fìrrr fìrrr. U yá-mi an kɔ́ ki sāā m-ceebiliŋ an kaa cúú-u isaa, u yāntì m-kaami cɔ́tì ki dɔ̄ ki pùub̀ kitiŋ.

english_verse: and so, in my sorrow I dress in sackcloth and sit in the dust.
translation_verse: Kpɔsata ŋma ní m kíǹ ki pèentí, ní m dū m-nimbiin ki múĺ ntamin.

english_verse: My face is red with tears, and dark shadows circle my eyes,
translation_verse: M súń áli m-nimbiliŋ mántì cínciŋ, ní m-niŋgbunti dūu nyīŋfì maa ti kpáàa wāĺ tiŋan.

english_verse: though I am not violent, and my prayers are sincere.
translation_verse: Ama ma mun kaa ŋá tipɔmbɔti jaanjaan. M pée mèé Unimbɔti nì dipɔbil diba ní.

english_verse: If I should die, I beg the earth not to cover my cry for justice.
translation_verse: Kitiŋ, taa bìin̄ m-fatikuu pu, yàntī bí nīn pée gbìl̀ m-kuŋkuuntii pu.

english_verse: Even now, God in heaven is both my witness and my protector.
translation_verse: Di sá yii m cáá kɔŋkɔnnee seeradaan ubɔ yilpu, tiŋman, m cáá ubɔ yilpu niin u mɔ́tí m-pu.

english_verse: My friends have rejected me, but God is the one I beg
translation_verse: M-bɔɔbi bíi bèel̄-mi, ama Unimbɔti ní m sūǹ ki kpèé.

english_verse: to show that I am right, just as a friend should.
translation_verse: M-seeradaaŋwu ń nīn sá un làá pàtī man nì Unimbɔtee, kii unil nín mɔ́tí u-juti pu puee.

english_verse: Because in only a few years, I will be dead and gone.
translation_verse: M-maŋfal wiiŋyi kaa ti kíǹ ki náaǹ, m tākaǹ nsan ŋun pu unil yaa nóó waa ti gítińee.

english_verse: My hopes have died, my time is up, and the grave is ready.
translation_verse: Maa ti cáá ŋfam, ní m-maŋfal wiiŋyi kaa ti náaǹ. Ntaŋkpiifal di kíǹ ki dɔ̄ ki cí-mi.

english_verse: All I can see are angry crowds, making fun of me.
translation_verse: Bibeeliliibi māntìi tú-mi, bi nín jáà nì mi puee yāntì maa ti ŋūǹ kí gèeǹ.

english_verse: If you, Lord, don't help, who will pay the price for my release?
translation_verse: Unimbɔti, pà m-pɔndi kí fīī-mi kí líí, di sá yii ŋma di gíti bí ki làá ŋá míǹ kí tīī-mi?

english_verse: My friends won't really listen, all because of you, and so you must be the one to prove them wrong.
translation_verse: Ibaamɔn puee, a pīiǹ m-bɔɔbi ciiŋyi pu, taa yàntī bí jī m-pu dinyandi.

english_verse: They have condemned me, just to benefit themselves; now blind their children.
translation_verse: Bi náań nì un yíiń u-bɔɔbi bí jī tijin, ní u-biyaamu dɔ̄ ŋkùmee ní. *

english_verse: You, God, are the reason I am insulted and spit on.
translation_verse: M kpántì nlan ní binib cáa gà ki lāā. M sá unil un nimbiin bi tíiĺ ki làbitēe ní.

english_verse: I am almost blind with grief; my body is a mere shadow.
translation_verse: Kunimbaau yāntì maa ti wāĺ tiŋan, m-ŋalii nì m-taaŋi kpántì kii kujiliŋuee ní.

english_verse: People who are truly good would feel so alarmed, that they would become angry with my worthless friends.
translation_verse: Bibulcinnib yaa ká-mee, bi bàkatī ní. Maanyiibab fòol̄ bikpitib pu mbum ní.

english_verse: They would do the right thing and because they did, they would grow stronger.
translation_verse: Bi lì yii: «Deedeedaan ń nīn pɔ̄ɔntí, bin ŋalii bí circiree ń mɔ̀tīí ká mpɔn!»

english_verse: But none of my friends show any sense.
translation_verse: Nimbi m-bɔɔbee, dāam̄maan, ni-kɔkɔ ń gítiń! Ama maa ká uciŋfiti báà ubɔ ni-kansikin! *

english_verse: My life is drawing to an end; hope has disappeared.
translation_verse: M-maŋfal wiiŋyi dóò, tin m bɔ́ntèe kɔkɔ nì m-mákal kɔkɔ tɔ́ nnyimin.

english_verse: I could tell the world below to prepare me a bed.
translation_verse: M gíti máká ba pu? An yaa kaa sá ŋkɔŋkoon pu ditaŋkpiilin, an yaa kaa sá ḿ bíĺ m-kampeeku dibɔmbɔndin!

english_verse: Then I could greet the grave as my father and say to the worms, “Hello, mother and sisters!”
translation_verse: M tùkū m-kaakul yii: «Sii di sá m-baa», ní ki tùkū dikɔtuul yii: «Sii di sá m-na nì m-niisal!»

english_verse: But what kind of hope is that?
translation_verse: M-mákal gíti bí la? Ubɔ ká m-naam laŋkaaa?

english_verse: Will it keep me company in the world of the dead?
translation_verse: M-mákal nì m-naam ń táá-mi tí nīn sìntī ditaŋkpiilin, ti-liitil lítì ntamin.

english_verse: Bildad from Shuah said:
translation_verse: Usuwaja Biilidaadi fōō dinyɔɔbundi ní ki lī yii:

english_verse: How long will you talk? Be sensible! Let us speak.
translation_verse: «Kí cáá sāā ŋyunti ŋulɔŋu ní a làá ŋmīĺ ní? Dàkafì kí wàatī ní tí nín sòoǹ nì si.

english_verse: Or do you think that we are dumb animals?
translation_verse: Ba pu ní a cáá-ti ki yíì tiwaŋkuti ní? Mimmee a dàkafī yii ti sá bigbaambi deeyaa!

english_verse: You cut yourself in anger. Will that shake the earth or even move the rocks? *
translation_verse: «Diŋuul din a gííyee di bíi tìì-si tiweendi. Mimmee a dàkafī yii sii puee, kitiŋ ń kpántí kuteeu, àá ditaŋkpal ń kpántí di-paaŋŋu ní? *

english_verse: The lamps of sinful people soon are snuffed out,
translation_verse: Ukpiti walifiŋu di kúù, ní u-faŋŋu poon ŋmiŋu ń gbèen̄ kaa ti fòol̄.

english_verse: Their powerful legs become weak, and they stumble on schemes of their own doing. *
translation_verse: «Dooooyee u nìn còom̄ ní kìbkib, kɔŋkɔnnee u kíǹ ki còom̄ ní yóooo, ní tin u bɔ́ntì kí ŋée làá yàntī ú lítí.

english_verse: they are trapped in a net,
translation_verse: Kutaliŋŋu làá sàl̄ u-tagbindi, bi píĺ u-saŋŋu pu ŋŋmii án sàl̄-u.

english_verse: Terror strikes and pursues from every side.
translation_verse: Ijaan kɔkɔ puee, dinyoondi jì ki bīī u-boon ki tà ki kíbití-u. *

english_verse: Starving, they run, only to meet disaster,
translation_verse: Úǹ un nìn pɔ̄ɔ̄yee, ŋkùm cúú-u kɔŋkɔnnee, falaa dɔ̄ ki kɔ́ĺ-u.

english_verse: then afterwards to be eaten alive by death itself.
translation_verse: Falaa gbanti bíi ŋmóò u-wuŋgbaŋŋu, ní ŋkúm làá ŋmɔ́ kí bīil̀ u-taaŋi nì u-ŋalii kɔkɔ.

english_verse: Those sinners are dragged from the safety of their tents to die a gruesome death.
translation_verse: «Bi làá dāá nyāntí-u u-kɔŋkooŋŋu kansikin laakin u bí ŋgbansɔŋfinee, kí dàtī-u kí cùnnì ditaŋkpiil bɔtiu cee.

english_verse: and they are left like trees, dried up from the roots.
translation_verse: U làá nīn bí kii busubu bun kpíìyee ní, bu-nyaaŋyi kūń taapu ní bu-faati fáaḿ yilpu. *

english_verse: thrown far from the light into a world of darkness,
translation_verse: Bi làá nyāntí-u ŋwalifin kí cáá tɔ̄ dibɔmbɔndin, ní kí jà-u kitiŋ pu laakin binib kóòyee.

english_verse: without any children to carry on their name.
translation_verse: U-nibul kansikinee, waa cáá kibiki kaa cáá naantiiu, ubɔ kaa bí u-dicaŋkun ki ŋmátì.

english_verse: Everyone, from east to west, is overwhelmed with horror.
translation_verse: Tin làá bàń-uee làá kɔ́ǹ ŋwìiń jeetilaŋki pú yab tiwool, án làá kɔ́ǹ ŋwìiń nyalaŋki pú yab tifaandi.

english_verse: Such is the fate of sinners and their families who don't know God.
translation_verse: Kun di bàń unikpiti nì u-dicaŋku puee dee. Doo di nìn sá mpaan ŋun pu baa nìn nyí Unimbɔtee.»

english_verse: Isn't ten times enough for you to accuse me? Aren't you ashamed?
translation_verse: Ŋfunyɔm saalaa sɔ̀ ni nín bí ki sìí-mee. Ni nín bí ki sàantí-mi pu nee kaa cáá-ni icoooo?

english_verse: Even if I have sinned, you haven't been harmed.
translation_verse: «Báà an yaa sá ibaamɔn yii m yīntì, man nì m-bɔti deeyaa!

english_verse: You boast of your goodness, claiming I am suffering because I am guilty.
translation_verse: Báà ni yaa dàkafī yii ni jítiǹ-mi, ní m-falaau dàkà yii m sá unikpitaaa,

english_verse: But God is the one at fault for finding fault with me.
translation_verse: ní béémaan yii Unimbɔti di yì m-bɔti ní ki yāntì m jéetì u-laaŋkun. *

english_verse: Though I pray to be rescued from this torment, no whisper of justice answers me.
translation_verse: Báà m yaa bíi gbáà ibiil yii bí fīī-maaa, ubɔ kaa làá kíí-mi, m yaa fáá ibiil yii bí jòoń-maaa, ubɔ kaa làá dāan̄ kí pɔ̀-mi.

english_verse: God has me trapped with a wall of darkness
translation_verse: Unimbɔti bàkā m-saŋŋu pu ḿ taa ŋmā kí jītí, u dū dibɔmbɔndi ki tɔ́ m-saŋŋu pu.

english_verse: and attacks with fierce anger, as though I were his enemy.
translation_verse: U-ŋuul fòol̄ m-pu ní lìblib, m kpántì u-nannanliu ní.

english_verse: His entire army advances, then surrounds my tent. I Am Forgotten *
translation_verse: U-janjakitil kpáfì dicilpu ki dòoń ki náaǹ, bi nyàab̄ nsan ki bāań-mi ki māntìi tú m-diiku kí jáǹ-mi. *

english_verse: God has turned relatives and friends against me,
translation_verse: Unimbɔti kākatì m-nabiyaamu ki wāatì-mi. Bin nìn nyí-mee kíǹ ki sáń-mi ní.

english_verse: and I am forgotten.
translation_verse: M-nabiyaamu kiŋkiŋ wáŋkì, m-bɔɔbi súntì m-pu.

english_verse: and when I call my servants, they pay no attention.
translation_verse: M yaa yíiń m-tɔntɔnliu, waa kíikí, báà m yaa gbāam̀-u.

english_verse: My breath disgusts my wife; everyone in my family turns away.
translation_verse: «M-fooku nín núù puee, m kíǹ ki cáá m-nimpuu titantan, m-nabiyaamu mun m nì bi pēē nee núutì-mi.

english_verse: Young children can't stand me, and when I come near, they make fun.
translation_verse: Ki kpáaǹ gba campɔntib kpèé-mi fám. M yaa kíĺ ki bíi sòoǹee, ní bi bèel̄-mi.

english_verse: My best friends and loved ones have turned from me.
translation_verse: M-bɔɔbi bimɔntiibi nimbil kaa ti là kí wāl̀-mi, ní bin m nìn néeńee fātì bi-boon ki tīī-mi.

english_verse: I am skin and bones— just barely alive.
translation_verse: M-gbaŋŋu di pée kíǹ ki bīī m-kpabiŋ pu, m ŋman pée kpíì ní. *

english_verse: My friends, I beg you for pity! God has made me his target.
translation_verse: Nimbi m-bɔɔbi, sɔ̄maan m-saai, sɔ̄maan m-saai, di sá yii Unimbɔti ŋal di fáá-mi!

english_verse: Hasn't he already done enough? Why do you join the attack?
translation_verse: Ba pu ní ni mun bíi sàantí-mi kii Unimbɔtee ní? Naa sāaǹ-mi ki gīīii?

english_verse: I wish that my words could be written down
translation_verse: «M bàà là yii bí ŋmà m-nyɔɔbuŋŋi nee kí síiń, bí ŋmà-ŋi kí ŋá kugbɔŋun.

english_verse: I know that my Protector lives, and at the end he will stand on this earth.
translation_verse: Mamee, m nyí m-mɔtiliu nín bí dimaŋfalinee, úǹ di làá sòoǹ kí pɔ̀-mi kitiŋ nee pu.

english_verse: My flesh may be destroyed, yet from this body I will see God.
translation_verse: Bi yaa láa bíil̀ m-wuŋgbaŋŋu nee ki dóòyee, mama m-ba làá dāá wāl̀ Unimbɔti.

english_verse: My friends, you think up ways to blame and torment me, saying I brought it on myself.
translation_verse: «Ni yaa bālifì ni-ba yii: <Mana ní ti làá ŋmā kí sàaǹ-u ní kí ká nnaakpal kí yíiń-u tibuul?>

english_verse: But watch out for the judgment, when God will punish you!
translation_verse: Ní fàŋkìmaan kitàataajiki ni-ba pu, di sá yii ni nín kā m-pu puee máaǹ ŋkúm ní. Ní béémaan yii ibɔsoon bí.»

english_verse: Your words are disturbing; now I must speak.
translation_verse: M-landɔkɔi bíi téekí-mi ḿ kíí-si, di sá yii an bíi lùkutī m-ni.

english_verse: You have accused and insulted me, and reason requires a reply.
translation_verse: Tin a sòon̄ee sá disiibil ní ki tīī-mi, ama m-nyil bíi lɔ́kɔfí-mi tin m làá dūú kíí-see.

english_verse: that sinful people are happy for only a while.
translation_verse: binikpitib nyandi kaa cá ndan, ní bi-pɔɔpindi mun kaa súŋkáaa? *

english_verse: Though their pride and power may reach to the sky,
translation_verse: Báà udaan yaa fɔ̀kɔ̀ ki tūū kutaa, báà u-yil yaa tùutī atagban,

english_verse: they will disappear like dust, and those who knew them will wonder what happened.
translation_verse: u làá dāá kúntí kii úǹ u-ba bintee ní. Bi nìn nyí-uee làá dāá bàlifì yii: «U bí la?»

english_verse: Their children will have to repay what the parents took from the poor.
translation_verse: U-biyaamu làá gíiǹ tin u nìn fìkī biwɔfib ceeyee kí tīī-bi, úǹ u-ba di làá gíiǹ u-gaajati kí tīī.

english_verse: Indeed, the wicked will die and go to their graves in the prime of life. Sinners Love the Taste of Sin
translation_verse: U nìn cáá mpɔn kii unaacimpɔɔnee ní, ama u nì u-pɔŋŋu gbanti di làá kpāfì kí dòon̄ ntamin. *

english_verse: Sinners love the taste of sin; they relish every bite
translation_verse: Ikpiti mɔ̄ u-nyɔkɔn ní cɔ́ncɔŋ, u cáá u-limbil ní ki bìintí i-pu.

english_verse: But their food will turn sour and poison their stomachs.
translation_verse: Ama tijin tin u jíńee làá sūū u-poon ní kí kpántí ukoobu looti niin.

english_verse: Then God will make them lose the wealth they gobbled up.
translation_verse: Tigaajati tin u nìn dūu náĺee, u làá wùliŋkì-tì, Unimbɔti làá yàntī ú nyāntí tin nìn kā u-poonee.

english_verse: They will die from the fangs of poisonous snakes
translation_verse: Tin u nìn móotée nìn sá ukoobu looti ní, u làá kpú kii ukoowaati di jú-uee. *

english_verse: and never enjoy rivers flowing with milk and honey.
translation_verse: Waa ti làá ká mbùmbiyaamu mun poon ŋkpam pùub̀ee, ibun in poon tisiil nì nnaabiim kpam pùub̀ee.

english_verse: Greedy people want everything and are never satisfied.
translation_verse: U-pɔbil nín kaa sɔ̀m̀ tin u cááyee pu puee, waa làá ŋmā kí kpāafì u-gaajati.

english_verse: But when nothing remains for them to grab, they will be nothing.
translation_verse: U sá upoofu ní ubɔ kaa ŋūǹ kí ŋmátí kí nyā u-ŋaan, an pu ní u-naam mun kaa làá yúntí. *

english_verse: Once they have everything, distress and despair will strike them down,
translation_verse: U làá nīn bí digbilin ní dinimbinaamandi ń jēetí u-pu, bifalaadambi kɔkɔ ŋalii làá nyīī-u kí múĺ.

english_verse: While running from iron spears, they will be killed by arrows of bronze,
translation_verse: Báà u yaa sáǹ ki ŋmátì tikúti kpaŋki kaa cúú-uaaa, tasa kúti piiŋŋu làá cúú-u.

english_verse: whose shining tips go straight through their bodies. They will be trapped by terror,
translation_verse: U làá dáaĺ kí fɔ́fí mpiin kí nyāntí u-wuntin, ní kí nyāntí mpiin ŋun nyɔkɔ cɔ́m̀ee u-pɔɔlin. Ama dinyoondi làá nīn dī-u. *

english_verse: and what they treasure most will be lost in the dark. God will send flames to destroy them in their tents with all their property.
translation_verse: Dibɔmbɔŋkpaandi di dɔ̄ ki cí-u dibalin, ŋŋmi ŋun ubɔ kaa tūūyee làá wà kí céetí-u, ní kí wà tin kíǹ u-diikunee nyíki nyiki.

english_verse: The heavens and the earth will testify against them,
translation_verse: Yilpu làá bìitī atuŋkpiti ŋin u túńee kɔkɔ pu, ní kitiŋ ń lēē u-pu seera kí jáǹ-u.

english_verse: and all their possessions will be dragged off when God becomes angry.
translation_verse: Nnyiŋgbeen làá yòon̄ u-gaajawanti ŋwiin ŋun Unimbɔti ŋuul làá dāá pōōyee.

english_verse: This is what God has decided for those who are evil.
translation_verse: Kun dɔ̄ ki cí ukpitee dee, Unimbɔti nín bɔ́ntì tin ki cíitì-uee dee.

english_verse: If you want to offer comfort, then listen to me.
translation_verse: Ní pīlifìmaan tin m làá sòoǹee tiŋan, míǹ ní ni làá ŋmā kí ŋméeǹ-mi.

english_verse: And when I have finished, you can start your insults all over again.
translation_verse: Ní pɔ̄maan-mi diyimɔɔl ḿ sòoǹ. M yaa sòon̄ ki dóòyee, ni ŋūǹ kí bèel̀-mi.

english_verse: My complaint is against God; that's why I am impatient.
translation_verse: Mimmee unil pu ní m bíi yáliŋkáaa? Aayee! Kin ba pu ní ḿ taa ŋmèè kí gīī?

english_verse: Just looking at me is enough to make you sick,
translation_verse: Kpèèmaan-mi tiŋan, án làá bàkatīǹ-ni ní, ni làá dū ni-ŋalii kí bìin̄ ni-nyɔmmu pu ní kí taa ti sòoǹ.

english_verse: and the very thought of myself fills me with disgust.
translation_verse: Mama m-ba yaa bíi dàkafī tin bāań-mi nee puee, an cútí-mi kufaaŋŋu ní ki ŋáań-mi nyàaa. *

english_verse: Why do evil people live so long and gain such power?
translation_verse: Ba pu ní binikpitib gbíntìi bí dimaŋfalin ní? Ba pu ní bíǹ yaa púĺee, bi gbíntìi pɔ̄ɔ̄ ní?

english_verse: Why are they allowed to see their children grow up?
translation_verse: Bi bí dimaŋfalin ní kí ká bi-biyaamu ń wíiǹ kí ká mpɔn, bi bí gba kí ká bi-naantiibi.

english_verse: They have no worries at home, and God never punishes them.
translation_verse: Bi-dumpuyee, bi bí ŋgbansɔŋfin ní kaa nyí kufaaŋŋu. Unimbɔti bambaaŋŋu kaa fátí-bi jaanjaan.

english_verse: Their cattle have lots of calves without ever losing one;
translation_verse: Bi-najaai yaa jɔ́m̀ isalee, i cāab̀ apoo ní, i màal̀ i-biyaamu kaa làtī jaanjaan.

english_verse: their children play and dance safely by themselves.
translation_verse: Bi-biyaamu sáń ki gbíiĺ kii kupicaŋkpuŋuee, ní bi-naantiibi tɔ́ bi-ba ki ŋōō.

english_verse: These people sing and celebrate to the sound of tambourines, small harps, and flutes,
translation_verse: Bi bɔ̀ɔ́ agaŋgan nì tibati ní ki gà ilan. Bi búǹ kiwulii ní ki gbíiĺ.

english_verse: and they are successful, without a worry, until the day they die. Leave Us Alone!
translation_verse: Nnaam poon ní bi bí ní kí kpú nì ŋgbansɔŋfi. *

english_verse: Those who are evil say to God All-Powerful, “Leave us alone! Don't bother us with your teachings.
translation_verse: Ama bi nìn tùkù Unimbɔti yii: «Yàntī-ti soooo, taa là kí béé a nín là tí nīn bí puee.

english_verse: We succeeded all on our own.” And so, I keep away from them and their evil schemes.
translation_verse: Binikpitib gbanti dàkafī yii bi-pɔŋŋu pu ní an bútì-bi, ama maa là kí nīn bí kii bi nín bí puee.

english_verse: How often does God become angry and send disaster and darkness to punish sinners?
translation_verse: Ni kāntí binikpitib kúù ŋkúntuntukumaaa? Ni pée ká nnaabu jéetì bi-pu, àá Unimbɔti dáaĺ bi-tafal u-ŋuul poon ki káaa?

english_verse: How often does he strike them like a windstorm that scatters straw?
translation_verse: Baa bí kii kumoou kun kubuŋu yòontée, kaa tí bí kii kukpɔŋkpɔŋu kun kunaakpaabuŋŋu yòontée! *

english_verse: You say, “God will punish those sinners' children in place of those sinners.” But I say, “Let him punish those sinners themselves until they really feel it.
translation_verse: Ni lì yii Unimbɔti bɔ́ntì binikpitib gbanti tafadaaldi ki cíitì bi-biyaamu ní. Ama u yaa bàà dáaĺ bíǹ bi-ba tafal, an bàà cíikíǹ-bi!

english_verse: Let God All-Powerful force them to drink their own destruction from the cup of his anger.
translation_verse: An máaǹ yii binikpitib bi-ba ń ká bi-naabuŋu ní kí dáká Unimbɔti Mpɔŋkɔdaan ŋuul kí kpèè.

english_verse: Because after they are dead, they won't care what happens to their children.” Who Can Tell God What To Do?
translation_verse: Di sá yii unil maŋfal wiiŋyi yaa kúntèe, u-biyaamu bɔti kaa ti ká-u.
