english_verse: Who can tell God what to do? He judges powerful rulers. *
translation_verse: Ŋma di ŋūǹ kí dàkà Unimbɔti tin u máaǹ kí ŋée? Unimbɔti u-ba kaa sòoǹ ituun bɔtaaa? *

english_verse: But we all end up dead, beneath a blanket of worms.
translation_verse: Ama bi-kɔkɔ kpíì ní bi síb́-bi, ní akoosibil kpátìi bīiǹ bi-kɔkɔ pu.

english_verse: My friends, I know that you are plotting against me.
translation_verse: M nyí tin ni dàkafēe tiŋan nì ni nín cáá m-pu ilandɔkɔkpiti iŋyee.

english_verse: You ask, “Where is the home of that important person who does so much evil?”
translation_verse: Di sá yii ni lì yii: «Biwɔ́biliibi diiku bí la? Bitɔŋfitiibi kɔŋkooŋŋu bí la? *

english_verse: that those who do wrong never suffer disaster, when God becomes angry.
translation_verse: Nnaabu wiiŋŋuee, tiba kaa ŋáań unikpiti, Unimbɔti ŋuul pée yàntī-u ní soooo.

english_verse: No one points out their sin or punishes them.
translation_verse: Ubɔ kaa bí kí kɔ̄kɔl̀-u, ubɔ kpá kí pà-u u-tuuŋŋi paati.

english_verse: Then at their funerals, they are highly praised;
translation_verse: U yaa kpíìyee, bi cáǹ-u kuceeun ní, ní binib cí u-kaakul.

english_verse: Eliphaz from Teman said:
translation_verse: Niinee uteemanja Eeliifaasi kíí Yoob yii:

english_verse: What use are we humans to God, even the wisest of us?
translation_verse: «Unil mun ŋūǹ kí kèetī Unimbɔtaaa? Báà unil yaa cáá iciin, an sá kí kèetī úǹ u-ba ní.

english_verse: If you were completely sinless, that would still mean nothing to God All-Powerful.
translation_verse: A nín bí deedeeyee làá yàntī Unimbɔti Mpɔŋkɔdaan ń páatí ba? Bi nín kaa kāntí a-pu tikpitil tibee làá kūtì-u ba?

english_verse: No! It's because of your terrible and endless sins.
translation_verse: An kaa sá yii a-yìntitam nín wīikí tikpilee pu, àá a-kpitii nín kaa cáá ŋkaanee puɔɔɔ? *

english_verse: To guarantee payment of a debt, you have taken clothes from innocent people.
translation_verse: Kpèè, a nìn fōō a-juti cee toolima an kaa cáá taapu, a nìn fōō u-wampeeŋkaati ní u kíǹ ki còom̄ ki gàaǹ.

english_verse: And you refused bread and water to the hungry and thirsty,
translation_verse: Aa nìn tīī un nnyinnyoo cááyee nnyim u nyùn̄, kaa tí tīī un ŋkùm nìn cááyee tijin u jíń.

english_verse: although you were rich, respected, and powerful.
translation_verse: Ama a nìn yāntì bipɔɔbi jíń kitiŋ ní ki yāntì binigaakaabi kāl̀ ki-pu.

english_verse: You have turned away widows and have broken the arms of orphans.
translation_verse: A jìn̄ bikpiipoobi iŋaŋkulim, ní ki nāaǹ ditaŋkpiibil pɔŋŋu.

english_verse: That's why you were suddenly trapped by terror,
translation_verse: «An pu ní titalindi māntìi tú-si an kɔkɔ pu, ní dinyoondi jéetì a-pu dicilpu dicilpu.

english_verse: blinded by darkness, and drowned in a flood. God Lives in the Heavens
translation_verse: Kunyeeu mɔ́ ki bīiǹ a-pu ní aa ti wāĺ tiba, ní nnyiŋkpaam gbí ki léeǹ a-pu. *

english_verse: God lives in the heavens above the highest stars, where he sees everything.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti kaa bí yilpu atagbannaaa? Kpèè kutagbɔŋu kun pu iŋmalbijaa kēe nín bí yilpu puee!»

english_verse: Do you think the deep darkness hides you from God?
translation_verse: Niinee ní a lī yii: «Tilati ní Unimbɔti ŋūǹ kí béé? Atagban bīī u-pu, waa làá ŋmā kí sòoǹ ti-bɔti.

english_verse: Do thick clouds cover his eyes, as he walks around heaven's dome high above the earth?
translation_verse: Atagban sá kii ŋŋaabiiŋkaa ŋun gbìfèe ní. Unimbɔti yaa còom̄ kí màntīí tū kutagbɔŋuee, waa wāĺ báà tiba.»

english_verse: Give up those ancient ideas believed by sinners,
translation_verse: «A làá nīn gbíntìi còom̄ isaŋkpiki puɔɔɔ, isan in ní binikpitib nìn cōom̀ee pu ní?

english_verse: They rejected God All-Powerful, feeling he was helpless,
translation_verse: Bi nìn tùkù Unimbɔti yii: «Yàntī-ti soooo! Ba ní Unimbɔti Mpɔŋkɔdaan ŋūǹ kí ŋá-ti ní.»

english_verse: although he had been kind to their families. The beliefs of these sinners are truly disgusting.
translation_verse: Úǹ mun di nìn gbéeǹ bi-diiŋŋi tiwammɔntiil. Maa ŋūǹ kí gbìl̄ binikpitib bimbim taapu. *

english_verse: When God's people see the godless swept away, they celebrate,
translation_verse: Deedeedambi làá ká bi-naabuŋu ní kí nīn fàal̀, maanyiibab làá nīn bèel̄-bi ki lì yii:

english_verse: Surrender to God All-Powerful! You will find peace and prosperity.
translation_verse: Si nì Unimbɔti ń mɔ̄ɔkì ní kpántí bibɔɔtiibi, a yaa ŋá míǹ, án làá fàtīí bútí-si.

english_verse: Listen to his teachings and take them to heart.
translation_verse: U nín dàkà-si puee, fōō míǹ ní kí dū u-nyɔɔbuŋŋi kí ŋá a-pɔbilin.

english_verse: If you return to God and turn from sin, all will go well for you.
translation_verse: «A yaa fātìi gítìń Unimbɔti Mpɔŋkɔdaan cee, u làá fōō-si kí fàtīí gíiǹ-si kí kàan̄ mpaan ŋun pu a nìn bí dooooyee. Nyāntí tin kamaa kaa bí deedeeyee a-kɔŋkooŋŋun.

english_verse: So get rid of your finest gold, as though it were sand.
translation_verse: Dū a-sindaariyau kí lúkú kitiŋ, àá á dū-u kí bíĺ mbun taŋkpeeŋi kansikin.

english_verse: Let God All-Powerful be your silver and gold,
translation_verse: Unimbɔti Mpɔŋkɔdaan làá kpántí a-sindaariyau nì a-nimbiliŋ dikpúkul. *

english_verse: God will answer your prayers, and you will keep the promises you made to him.
translation_verse: A yaa mēē-u, u làá pīlifiǹ-si, ní á dāá ŋá kii a nín pōoǹ yii a làá ŋá puee.

english_verse: He will do whatever you ask, and life will be bright.
translation_verse: Án làá bútí-si tin kamaa a yaa lēē kí ŋée poon, ní ŋwalifi ń nīn ŋmíntí a-saŋŋu pu.

english_verse: When others are disgraced, God will clear their names in answer to your prayers.
translation_verse: «Di sá yii Unimbɔti nàantí bilambidambi tuuŋŋi, ama u fìil̄ unil un di sīntì u-ba taapuee ní.

english_verse: Even those who are guilty will be forgiven, because you obey God.
translation_verse: Kii Unimbɔti nín fìil̄ maanyiibab puee, míǹ ní u làá fīī-si a nín ŋá tin kítèe pu.»

english_verse: Today I complain bitterly, because God has been cruel and made me suffer.
translation_verse: M gbíntìi bíi jáà nì Unimbɔti ki yáliŋkí díǹ, m-yaliŋkii dáá gbíntìi pɔ̄ɔ̄.

english_verse: If I knew where to find God, I would go there
translation_verse: M yaa bàà ŋūǹ kí béé laakin Unimbɔti bée, m bàà làá tin gbàtī u-beejal nimbiin ní!

english_verse: Then I would discover what he wanted to say.
translation_verse: M bàà làá béé u nín làá kíí-mi puee, ní kí gbìl̄ tin u cáá kí tùkù-mee taapu.

english_verse: Would he overwhelm me with his greatness? No! He would listen
translation_verse: Unimbɔti kalin làá dū u-pɔŋŋu kɔkɔ kí jáǹ-mi níii? Aayee! Úǹ làá pīlifiǹ-mi.

english_verse: because I am innocent, and he would say, “I now set you free!”
translation_verse: Ubulcinnil ŋūǹ kí sòoǹ nì u u-bɔti niin, ní Unimbɔti un sá m-bɔsoonliuee ń pɔ̀-mi kí nīn cáa cá talku. *

english_verse: I cannot find God anywhere— in front or back of me,
translation_verse: Ama m yaa nín cá ŋwìiń nyalaŋki púɔɔɔ, Unimbɔti kaa bí niin. M yaa tí nín cá ŋwìiń jeetilaŋki púɔɔɔ, maa kāntí-u.

english_verse: to my left or my right. God is always at work, though I never see him.
translation_verse: U kalin bíi tūǹ ditundi ŋgan pú níii? Aayee, maa wāĺ-u. U kalin bál̀ ŋgiil pú níii? Maa wāĺ tiba.

english_verse: But he knows what I am doing, and when he tests me, I will be pure as gold. *
translation_verse: Ama u nyí nsan ŋun poon m còom̄ee, u yaa cɔ́ŋkì-mi, m làá nyā dándan kii sindaariyee ní.

english_verse: I have never refused to follow any of his commands,
translation_verse: M-taaŋi pée tàkā u-tabɔbiliŋin ní, m pée ŋúb́ u-saŋŋu ní kaa kpēeǹ ki cūtì laaba.

english_verse: and I have always treasured his teachings.
translation_verse: Maa fātì m-boon ki tīī u-marab, m kpáafì u-bɔkpaaŋi kɔkɔ m-pɔbilin.

english_verse: But he alone is God, and who can oppose him? God does as he pleases,
translation_verse: Ama úǹ di lèekī tin u làá ŋée. Ŋma di ŋūǹ kí yàntī ú kpántí nlandɔkɔ? Kun mɔ̄ǹ-uee ní u ŋáań.

english_verse: and he will do exactly what he intends with me. *
translation_verse: Tin u bɔ́ntì kí tīī-mee ní u làá ŋá, ní u bɔ́ntì tiwan tikpil kí tīī-mi.

english_verse: makes me tremble with fear.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti bíil̀ m-pɔbil, Unimbɔti Mpɔŋkɔdaan fāaǹ-mi.

english_verse: God has covered me with darkness, but I refuse to be silent.
translation_verse: Min kamaa dibɔmbɔndi bée, min kamaa kunyeeu mɔ́ m-puee, maa ŋmíl̀.

english_verse: Why doesn't God set a time for court? Why don't his people know where he can be found?
translation_verse: Ba pu ní Unimbɔti Mpɔŋkɔdaan kaa síiǹ ŋwiin ŋubɔ kí sòoǹ binib bɔti ní, ŋwiin ŋun ní deedeedambi làá kée ní?

english_verse: Sinners remove boundary markers and take care of sheep they have stolen.
translation_verse: Binib bí ki cóotí bi-kpaanyɔmmu taŋkpeeŋi ki nìkì, ní ki ŋúb́ ipii in bi yùn̄ee ki kpàá.

english_verse: They cheat orphans and widows by taking their donkeys and oxen.
translation_verse: Bi fòol̄ ditaŋkpiibil maŋki ní ki yòontí ukpiipu naau toolima.

english_verse: The poor are trampled and forced to hide
translation_verse: Bi kàkatī binandambi ki wàatī nsan, ní ki páb̀ bifalaadambi bi sáń ki bāal̀.

english_verse: in the desert, where they and their children must live like wild donkeys and search for food.
translation_verse: Bifalaadambi bí kii kumooun mammu mun di cá kuteeun kí nyàab̀ mu-jintee ní. Nsan ŋun baba pu bi ŋūǹ kí ká tijin kí tīī bi-biyaamuee dee. *

english_verse: If they want grain or grapes, they must go to the property of these sinners.
translation_verse: Biba saakun ní bi cá ki cēē timool ní ki lúlifí utɔŋfiti fiinyi kpaabun.

english_verse: They sleep naked in the cold, because they have no cover,
translation_verse: Ama baa cáá sata kí bìin̄ kunyeeu, tiwool yaa bée, baa cáá satabiiŋkaa.

english_verse: and during a storm their only shelters are caves among the rocky cliffs.
translation_verse: Utaa un nyánní dijool pu ki sɔ̀m̀ee di gbáà-bi. Bi nākantí ataŋkpee pu, di sá yii baa cáá ŋkɔŋkoon.

english_verse: Children whose fathers have died are taken from their mothers as payment for a debt.
translation_verse: Binikpitib bàbitī ditaŋkpiibil di-na biil pu. Bi yòontí usoodaan bipɔŋki toolima kí pà dipɔndi.

english_verse: Then they are forced to work naked in the grain fields because they have no clothes, and they go hungry.
translation_verse: Baa cáá tiwan kí pèen̄ ní bi yàntī bi còom̄ ki gàaǹ, bi yàntī bi tūntí bilee abɔn abɔn, kaa jíń tiba.

english_verse: They crush olives to make oil and grapes to make wine— but still they go thirsty.
translation_verse: Bi yàntī bi ŋmāam̀ ɔliifi biliŋ ki nyāntí ŋkpam, ki yàntī bi ŋmāam̀ fiinyi biliŋ ki nyāntí ndaam, ama ní nnyinnyoo làá kpɔ̀-bi. *

english_verse: And along the city streets, the wounded and dying cry out, yet God does nothing. Some Reject the Light
translation_verse: Binib bí ki yáliŋkí kitiŋin, bin fōō tiweendee bíi gbáà ibiil ki yíì Unimbɔti ń jòoń-bi, ama atuŋkpiti gbanti kaa sòoǹ Unimbɔti tiba!

english_verse: Some rebel and refuse to follow the light.
translation_verse: Bin tūǹ atuŋkpiti gbantee kaa là ŋwalifi bɔti. Baa nyí ŋwalifi saŋyi, kaa tí dì ŋu-sàmbiyaamu.

english_verse: Soon after sunset they murder the poor and the needy, and at night they steal.
translation_verse: Unikpɔl yíkí ntaafaabɔmbɔm ní ki kù usoodaan nì unandaan, ní kunyeeu yaa mɔ̄ee ní ú kpántí unaayuu.

english_verse: Others wait for the dark, thinking they won't be seen if they sleep with the wife or husband of someone else.
translation_verse: Uninja un nyēē u-nimpuu boonee cí kunyeeu yaa bíi móotée ní ú lì yii: «Ubɔ kaa làá wāl̀-mi». U lī mimmee ní kí nyàab̀ tiba kí bìin̄ u-nimbiin.

english_verse: Robbers hide during the day, then break in after dark because they reject the light.
translation_verse: Kunyeeu ní unaayuu cífí adiin, ama kutaa yaa wúntèe ní ú dūú pìin̄ u-ba pu u-diikun. Ŋwalifi sá tiwancan ní ki tīī-u.

english_verse: They prefer night to day, since the terrors of the night are their friends. Sinners Are Filthy Foam
translation_verse: Bíǹ gbanti kɔkɔee, kutaafaau sá kii ŋkúm bɔmbɔndee ní, di sá bi mántì nì kunyeeu tumbilinti ní. *

english_verse: Those sinners are filthy foam on the surface of the water. And so, their fields and vineyards will fall under a curse and won't produce.
translation_verse: Ni lì yii: «Binikpitib bí kii tiwan tin dēē nnyim pu mì cáa féeńee ní. Unimbɔti tɔ́ bi-kpaatanti mbusu, baa ti cá bi-fiinyi kpaaŋŋin ki tūǹ ditundi.

english_verse: Just as the heat of summer swallows the snow, the world of the dead swallows those who sin.
translation_verse: Kii ŋwìiń nín gbáà ntaayim pu mí dùntī kí wāŋkì puee, míǹ ní binikpitib wáŋkí kí cù ditaŋkpiilin.

english_verse: Forgotten here on earth, and with their power broken, they taste sweet to worms.
translation_verse: Unimpu un màl̄-bee kaa ti téetí bi-pu, bi kpántí diina jinti ní kí tīī akoosibil, baa ti pée sòoǹ bi-pu. Bi nàn̄ ikpiti dúsi dusi kii ndɔee ní.

english_verse: Sinners take advantage of widows and other helpless women.
translation_verse: Binib gbantee nìn sāaǹ unimpuŋmaŋŋmanti un kaa nìn ŋúń ki màl̄ee, ní kaa dàkā bikpiipoobi kulaŋŋaŋfitiiu.

english_verse: But God's mighty strength destroys those in power. Even if they seem successful, they are doomed to fail.
translation_verse: Ama Unimbɔti cáá mpɔn kí nyāntí bipɔndambi. U yaa yíkì bi-puee, baa ti làá nīn máká kí nīn bí dimaŋfalin.

english_verse: God may let them feel secure, but they are never out of his sight.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti pée yàntī bí nīn bí ŋgbansɔŋfin ní, ama ní u-nimbikpeeŋu pée cɔ́ bi-saŋkindi pu.

english_verse: Great for a while; gone forever! Sinners are mowed down like weeds, then they wither and die.
translation_verse: Binib gbanti pée yíkí ŋyunti ŋubɔ fiii ní, ama boonee an dóò bi-pu dee. Bi làá tìntī bi-yil kii nsupumpukum min bíi kúùyee ní, bi làá cā-bi kii bi nín cēē idifin puee ní.»

english_verse: If I haven't spoken the truth, then prove me wrong.
translation_verse: M yaa mɔ́ntì, ubɔ ń dàkà-mi yii m mɔ́ntì, udaan ń dàkà yii tin m sòon̄ee kaa sá míǹ.

english_verse: Bildad from Shuah said:
translation_verse: Niinee ní usuwaja Biilidaadi bí Yoob yii:

english_verse: God is the one to fear, because God is in control and rules the heavens.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti sá Mpɔŋkɔdaan ní ki cáá tifaandi, úǹ di yàntī ŋgbansɔŋfi bí áli yilpu.

english_verse: Who can count his army of stars? Isn't God the source of light?
translation_verse: Ŋma di ŋūǹ kí kàaǹ ajanjakiti ŋin u cááyee? Ŋma pu ní u-walifiŋu kaa ŋmíntí ní?

english_verse: How can anyone be innocent in the sight of God?
translation_verse: Mana ní unil ŋūǹ kí nīn bí deedee Unimbɔti nimbiin? Mana ní nisaal ŋūǹ kí nīn bí circir?

english_verse: To him, not even the light of the moon and stars can ever be pure.
translation_verse: Uŋmal nín ŋmíntí puee kaa wāĺ Unimbɔti nimbiin, ní iŋmalbijaa kaa bí circir u-nimbiin.

english_verse: So how can we humans, when we are merely worms?
translation_verse: Kin ti làá sòoǹ unil un bí kii ujiliŋkpaam nee pu yii ba, nisaal un sá kii kinaŋgbammaŋ nee!

english_verse: You have really been helpful to someone weak and weary.
translation_verse: A nyí bi nín tútúǹ un kaa ti cáá mpɔnee pueeyeeee! A nyí bi nín jòoń uwɔfi puee páaa!

english_verse: You have given great advice and wonderful wisdom to someone truly in need.
translation_verse: A nyí bi nín tìì un lóò iciinee isaŋki pueeyeeee! A nyí bi nín dàkà dinyil puee an kaa cáá bí lì!

english_verse: Remember the terrible trembling of those in the world of the dead below the mighty ocean.
translation_verse: Ditaŋkpiilin Inyiŋfi taapu nì bin kóò niinee, bin kpíìyee fam bíi jìkì.

english_verse: Nothing in that land of death and destruction is hidden from God,
translation_verse: Ditaŋkpiilin dɔ̄ mpaampiin pu ní Unimbɔti nimbiin, tiba kaa ŋūǹ kí lìkin̄-u ú taa wāl̀ tin bí niinee.

english_verse: who hung the northern sky and suspended the earth on empty space.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti di kpátì kutagbɔŋu ki dāntì ŋgan pú tiba kaa ŋúb́ ní ki dū kitiŋ ki dāntì laakin tiba kaa bí ki tíkée.

english_verse: God stores water in clouds, but they don't burst,
translation_verse: U dū ntaanyim ki póob́ atagbanni, ní nnyimee nyiŋfiŋu kaa yàntī atagbanee ń pōō.

english_verse: and he wraps them around the face of the moon.
translation_verse: U kpátí atagban ki bìintí u-beejal pu.

english_verse: On the surface of the ocean, God has drawn a boundary line between light and darkness.
translation_verse: U lūtì kulaguŋu ki tú inyiŋfi, laakin ní ŋwalifi kúntí dibɔmbɔndee.

english_verse: And columns supporting the sky tremble at his command.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti yaa tāā ki bíikèe, kutagbɔŋu jaantalkub fàŋkí ní ki cìŋkī.

english_verse: By his power and wisdom, God conquered the force of the mighty ocean.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti dū u-pɔŋŋu ní ki jáń ki fōō tiŋku, ní ki dū u-nyil ki jáń ki pɔ́ɔkiǹ kupeebiliŋŋu kun bí nnyimin bi yíì Raabee.

english_verse: The heavens became bright when he breathed, and the escaping sea monster died at his hands.
translation_verse: U-fooku ŋātì kutagbɔŋu, u dū u-ŋal ki sāā ki pūntì kukoowambiiu kun kóò nnyiminee.

english_verse: These things are merely a whisper of God's power at work. How little we would understand if this whisper ever turned into thunder!
translation_verse: Tin kɔkɔ m sòon̄ní nee sá u-tuuŋŋi kijaŋ kiba ní, tin u ŋá ti nyée sá kii bi nín lɔ́kɔfí unil tafal poon puee ní, ŋma di ŋūǹ kí béé kí cíĺ Unimbɔti nín baasii sá ukpaan miŋyee?

english_verse: I am desperate because God All-Powerful refuses to do what is right. As surely as God lives,
translation_verse: Nì Unimbɔti un bí dimaŋfalin kaa là kí pɔ̀-mi nee yindi puee, nì Unimbɔti Mpɔŋkɔdaan un cɔ́tì m-poon kaam nee yindi puee,

english_verse: I will tell only the truth.
translation_verse: m-nyɔkɔ kpá kí sòoǹ tibɔkpitil, m-limbil kpá kí sòoǹ tinyimɔmbɔti!

english_verse: Until the day I die, I will refuse to do wrong by saying you are right,
translation_verse: M kpá kí tīī-ni ibaamɔn. M kpá kí lì yii m fōō dibɔkpil kí cáá sāā ŋkúm dal.

english_verse: because each day my conscience agrees that I am innocent.
translation_verse: M gbíntìi ŋúb́ yii m bí deedee, ní m kpá kí kɔ́ntí m-nyɔkɔ, m-landɔkɔjaatiŋu kaa làá kɔ̄kɔl̀-mi dalba dalba. *

english_verse: I pray that my enemies will suffer no less than the wicked.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti ń dáaĺ m-nannanliibi tafal kii binikpitibee. Ú dáaĺ bin jáà nì mee tafal kii digaŋgam dambee!

english_verse: Such people are hopeless, and God All-Powerful will cut them down,
translation_verse: Unikpiti gíti máká ba pu ŋyunti ŋun ní Unimbɔti lēē u-maŋfalee?

english_verse: without listening when they beg for mercy.
translation_verse: Dinimbinaamandi yaa jéetì u-puee, Unimbɔti gíti pílifí u-biiliiyaaa?

english_verse: And that is what God should do, because they don't like him or ever pray.
translation_verse: U kāntí u-mɔŋŋu Unimbɔti Mpɔŋkɔdaannaaa? U nìn mèé Unimbɔti ŋyunti kamaaa?

english_verse: Now I will explain in detail what God All-Powerful does.
translation_verse: M làá dàkà-ni Unimbɔti pɔŋkpaaŋŋu, maa làá báĺ-ni Unimbɔti Mpɔŋkɔdaan landɔkɔi.

english_verse: All of you have seen these things for yourselves. So you have no excuse. How God Treats the Wicked
translation_verse: Ni-kɔkɔ dáań ki ká míǹ ni-ba. Kin ba pu ní tin ni sòoǹee kaa cáá taapu míǹ? Kun Unimbɔti bɔ́ntì ki cíitì unikpitee

english_verse: Here is how God All-Powerful treats those who are wicked and brutal.
translation_verse: Kpèèmaan kun Unimbɔti bɔ́ntì ki cíitì unikpitee, kun ní Unimbɔti Mpɔŋkɔdaan bɔ́ntì ki cíitì bipɔndambee:

english_verse: They may have many children, but most of them will go hungry or suffer a violent death.
translation_verse: Báà u-jipɔmbi yaa būtì, dikɔ̀ndin ní bi làá kpɔ̀-bi, ní u-naantiibi ń dāá lóó tijin.

english_verse: Others will die of disease, and their widows won't be able to weep.
translation_verse: Bìlbil kúm di làá dāá kpɔ̀ bin kíǹ kaa kpíìyee, bi-kpiipoobi kaa làá dāá ŋmā kí kàl̄ bi-kpool kí sɔ̄.

english_verse: The wicked may collect riches and clothes in abundance as easily as clay.
translation_verse: Báà unikpiti yaa kōontí animbil ki kpūkuntí kii ŋkpɔŋkpɔmee, àá ki kpūkuntí tiwampeeŋkaal kii kuyɔkɔuee,

english_verse: But God's people will wear clothes taken from them and divide up their riches.
translation_verse: ú nīn gbíntìi nìkì ki kpūkuntí! Deedeedaan ubɔ di làá dāá pèen̄-tì, ubulcinnil di làá dāá jī u-nimbiliŋ. *

english_verse: No homes built by the wicked will outlast a cocoon or a shack.
translation_verse: Kudii kun unikpiti māāyee náań nì kii tinaŋgbantalindee ní, a lì kii kibiŋ kin un cí bukpaayee gāāyee.

english_verse: Those sinners may go to bed rich, but they will wake up poor.
translation_verse: U kóò kí dòon̄ ki sá ugaaja, ama ní an sá u-luŋkikaam, u dāa yíkí kí ŋúbití u-nimbiliŋee, báà tiba kaa ti bí.

english_verse: Terror will strike at night like a flood or a storm.
translation_verse: Dinyoondi làá jēetí u-pu kii nnyiŋgbeen nín lēentí unil pu waa nyí puee ní. Kunaakpaabuŋŋu làá yòon̄-u kunyeeu.

english_verse: without showing mercy, as they try to escape.
translation_verse: Ku làá nīn fátí-u kaa làá sɔ̄ u-saai, see ú dāá pɔ́ɔǹ kí sāǹ-ku kí ŋmátí.

english_verse: At last, the wind will celebrate because they are gone.
translation_verse: Bi làá dāá kpāafì iŋal kí bèel̀-u, laakin u kóòyee, bi làá dāá nīn búǹ ifoon ki lāā-u.

english_verse: the same is done with iron and copper.
translation_verse: Bi gbì kitiŋ ní kí nyāntí tikúti, ní kí dùntī ditaŋkpal kí nyāntí tasa.

english_verse: Miners carry lanterns deep into the darkness to search for these metals.
translation_verse: Binib yòontí ŋwalifi ní kí kɔ́ kitiŋ taapu. Bi gbì ní kí kɔ́ kitiŋ taapu taapu ki nyàab̀ ataŋkpee dibɔmbɔndin.

english_verse: They dig tunnels in distant, unknown places, where they dangle by ropes.
translation_verse: Laakin binib kaa kóòyee, bi gbìn̄ ifal kii tumbuŋku faliiyee, laakin unil taal kaa pée tāā ki kée, binib lúń iŋmii pu ki fīintí.

english_verse: Far beneath the grain fields, fires are built to break loose those rocks
translation_verse: Kitiŋ yilpu lòon̄ tikpaajin, ama ní kitiŋ taapuee, a lì kii ŋŋmi lábitì tikɔkɔ ki cìb̄ee.

english_verse: Miners go to places unseen by the eyes of hawks;
translation_verse: Ikaabu kaa nyí kitiŋ taapu saŋyi gbanti, ikaalun nimbil kaa wál̀-i.

english_verse: they walk on soil unknown to the proudest lions.
translation_verse: Ipeecuncuti taal kaa tāā isan gbanti pu ki ká, míǹ ní gbikinti mun kaa nóó-i ki ká.

english_verse: With their own hands they remove sharp rocks and uproot mountains.
translation_verse: Ama unil gbì ditaŋkpal din pɔ̄ɔ̄yee, u gbì ajoon kí tin bà ŋi-taapu.

english_verse: They dig through the rocks in search of jewels and precious metals.
translation_verse: U gbáń ki wīī ditaŋkpal ki gbìn̄ ifal, tin kɔkɔ sá tigaajawanee, u-nimbil wāĺ tikɔkɔ.

english_verse: They also uncover the sources of rivers and discover secret places. Where Is Wisdom Found?
translation_verse: Bi gbíŋkí ibun nyimbulnimbiliŋ ní kí nyāntí tin nìn bí dibalinee kí páań mpaampiin pu. *

english_verse: Nor can it be discovered in the deepest sea. *
translation_verse: Tiŋkukpaan bí yii: «Iaa bí doo», ní dimɔɔl mun bí yii: «Iaa bí m-cee.»

english_verse: It is worth much more than silver or pure gold
translation_verse: Baa ŋūǹ kí dū disindaariyakúndi kí kpántí-i, baa tí ŋūǹ kí ŋmàntī animbil kí dūú dā-i.

english_verse: Nothing is its equal— not gold or costly glass.
translation_verse: I cáá kunyampoou ki jítiǹ digitil nì sindaariya, baa ŋūǹ kí dū sindaariyamɔnti disambil kí dā-i.

english_verse: Wisdom is worth much more than coral, jasper, or rubies.
translation_verse: Baa tí sòoǹ atakpamɔnti ŋin bi yíì kooraal nì kriistaalee pu. Unil ń nyàab̀ iciinee sɔ́ǹ ú nyàab̀ abeedimbil.

english_verse: All the topaz of Ethiopia and the finest gold cannot compare with it.
translation_verse: Eetiiyoopii tiŋkin taŋkpamɔntiil din bi yíì toopaasee kaa cá i-cee. Taa ŋūǹ kí dū sindaariyamɔmmɔnti kí ŋmàntīǹ-i. *

english_verse: It is hidden from human eyes and even from birds.
translation_verse: Bi dū-i ki bál̀ binifoobi kɔkɔ, ki dū-i ki bál̀ unoon un ŋàaǹ kutaa puee.

english_verse: Death and destruction have merely heard rumors about where it is found.
translation_verse: Ŋkúm nì ditaŋkpiilin bíi lì yii: «Ti gbìl̄ bi sòon̄ i-pu.»

english_verse: God is the only one who knows the way to wisdom;
translation_verse: Ama Unimbɔti nyí nsan ŋun pu bi dì kí ká-iee, úǹ baba di nyí laakin bi ŋūǹ kí ká iciinee.

english_verse: When God divided out the wind and the water,
translation_verse: Ŋyunti ŋun u tīī kubuŋu ku-nyiŋfiŋu ki ŋmāntì inyiŋfee,

english_verse: God told us, “Wisdom means that you respect me, the Lord, and turn from sin.”
translation_verse: Niinee ní u bí binib yii: «Á fàŋkì ti-Dindaanee di sá iciin! Á fàtī a-boon kí tīī tikpitilee di sá dinyil!»

english_verse: I long for the past, when God took care of me,
translation_verse: M yaa bàà ŋūǹ kí fàtīí gítí kii m nín nìn bí puee, ŋyunti ŋun m nìn bí Unimbɔti cí-mee,

english_verse: and the light from his lamp showed me the way through the dark.
translation_verse: ŋyunti ŋun ní u-walifiŋu nìn ŋmíntí m-yil yilpuee! U-walifiŋu nìn tútúǹ-mi ḿ còom̀ kí jītí dibɔmbɔndin.

english_verse: I was in the prime of life, God All-Powerful was my closest friend,
translation_verse: Ŋyunti gbantee, m nìn dáá cáá mpɔn, Unimbɔti nìn píí-mi kubɔɔtiiu ní ki nìn wúń m-dicaŋku pu.

english_verse: and all of my children were nearby.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti Mpɔŋkɔdaan nìn dáá bí m-cee, ní m-jipɔmbi nìn sí ki māntìi tú-mi.

english_verse: My herds gave enough milk to bathe my feet, and from my olive harvest flowed rivers of oil. *
translation_verse: Ŋyunti gbantee, m nìn dēē digbilin ní, ŋkpam nìn còol̀ ditaŋkpal din pu bi ŋmāam̀ ŋkpamee. *

english_verse: When I sat down at the meeting of the city council,
translation_verse: M yaa nìn nyáń kitiŋ punyɔkɔpu ki cūtìi kāl̀ kí sòoǹ tibɔti,

english_verse: and remained silent. Everyone Was Pleased
translation_verse: Bikpilib nìn ŋmīlifí ní bi-nyɔmmu ń kpú. *

english_verse: Everyone was pleased with what I said and did.
translation_verse: Un yaa nìn gbìl̄ m sòon̄ee pàkà-mi ní. Un yaa nìn ká-mee nìn lèekī m-pu seera ní.

english_verse: When poor people or orphans cried out for help, I came to their rescue.
translation_verse: Usoodaan yaa nìn fáá mbiilee, m nìn jòó-u ní, ní ki nìn jòó ditaŋkpiibil din kaa nìn cáá ubɔ ń tūtuǹ-uee.

english_verse: And I was highly praised for my generosity to widows and others in poverty.
translation_verse: Un nìn kúùyee nìn mèé ki bìintí m-pu ní. M nìn tìì bikpiipoobi dipɔɔpindi.

english_verse: I was helpful to the blind and to the lame.
translation_verse: M nìn sá animbil ní ki tīī ujɔfu, ní ki sá ataa ki tīī ufaliŋfaan.

english_verse: I was a father to the needy, and I defended them in court, even if they were strangers.
translation_verse: M nìn sá ubaati ní ki tīī unandaan, ní ki nìn mɔ́tí unicaan pu ibɔsoon poon.

english_verse: When criminals attacked, I broke their teeth and set their victims free.
translation_verse: M nìn gbáà ki wìil̄ bikpitiŋaliibi nyɔɔkpaweeŋyi, ní kí fōō un u cúú ki làá tɔ̀ntēe kí nyāntí u-nyiŋŋin. *

english_verse: I felt certain that I would live a long and happy life, then die in my own bed.
translation_verse: M nìn lī yii: «M làá kàl̄ kitiŋ pu kí yúntí, ní kí kpú man m-ba diikun.

english_verse: In those days I was strong like a tree with deep roots and with plenty of water,
translation_verse: M bí kii busubu bun nyaaŋyi dēē nnyiminee ní, kunyeeu malindi sɔ̀ŋkī m-supampɔmbiliŋ.

english_verse: and when I finished speaking, nothing needed to be said.
translation_verse: M yaa nìn sòon̄ ki dóòyee, ubɔ kaa nìn kpākantí, m-nyɔɔbuŋŋi nìn mɔ̄ bi-cee kii ntaanyim nín jòotī puee ní.

english_verse: My words were eagerly accepted like the showers of spring,
translation_verse: Binib nìn cīití-mi kii bi nín cīití utaa puee ní, a lì kii bi nín cīití umɔfiintaa puee.

english_verse: My advice was followed as though I were a king leading my troops, or someone comforting those in sorrow.
translation_verse: Man di nìn sá bi-kpootiliu ní ki dàkà-bi nsan, m nìn bí bi-kansikin kii ubɔti un u-janjaliibi māntìi túee ní, m nìn ŋmēentí-bi kii bi nín ŋmēentí bin kā dikpoolee puee ní.

english_verse: Young people now insult me, although their fathers would have been a disgrace to my sheep dogs.
translation_verse: Ama díǹ nee, man ní binib bèel̄, binib bin man kpíǹee, binib bin baabi kaa nìn sàafì kí nīn bí m-booi kansikinee.

english_verse: They must claw the desert sand in the dark for something to satisfy their hunger.
translation_verse: Ŋkùm nì falaa nìn yāntì binib gbanti kaa nìn gíti cáá mpɔn, ní ki nìn nyàab̀ tiba kí jī kitimpiliŋ kin wāā tiba kaa bí ki-pu nan ní.

english_verse: They gather tasteless shrubs for food and firewood,
translation_verse: Bi nìn lòol̄ nsugboomu faati, ní ki nìn ŋmóò isunyaan.

english_verse: and they are run out of towns, as though they were thieves.
translation_verse: Báà ŋma nìn dū-bi ki fá, ní bi nìn jì-bi ki tátí kii digaŋgam dambee,

english_verse: Their only homes are ditches or holes between rocks,
translation_verse: Bi kɔŋkooŋyi di nìn sá ibun in fóotèe poon nì ifal in dɔ̄ kitiŋee nì itaŋkpalɔkɔn.

english_verse: And like senseless donkeys they are chased away. Those Worthless Nobodies
translation_verse: Binib bin kaa bí tiban ubɔ kaa nyí bi-yiŋŋee, bi dū idɔ ki jìn̄-bi ki nyántì kitiŋ pu. *

english_verse: Those worthless nobodies make up jokes and songs to disgrace me.
translation_verse: Ama kɔŋkɔnnee, man ní bi kíǹ ki cáa gà ilan, man di kpántì mmaam wanti ní bi cáa gbáà faawii.

english_verse: They are hateful and keep their distance, even while spitting in my direction.
translation_verse: Bi núutì-mi ní ki sáń-mi, bi tíiĺ ki làbitī-mi an kaa páb́-bi.

english_verse: God has destroyed me, and so they don't care what they do.
translation_verse: Kun puee Unimbɔti gbáń ki kpātì m-tɔŋmiiŋu ki nāaǹ-mi, bi yaa wál̀-mee, bi ŋáań bi nín là puee ní.

english_verse: Their attacks never stop, though I am defenseless, and my feet are trapped.
translation_verse: Dinikitil nee bíi jáà nì mi m-ŋaŋgiil pú, bi gāā-mi kinaakpaatakai ki nyàab̀ ḿ lítí. Bi bíi jáà nì mi ki là ḿ wāŋkì.

english_verse: Without any help, they prevent my escape, destroying me completely
translation_verse: Bi gāā ki kíntì-mi ki pée nyàab̀ kí nàan̄-mi, bi-kansikin ubɔ kaa nyàab̀ ditutundi.

english_verse: Terror has me surrounded; my reputation and my riches have vanished like a cloud. I Am Sick at Heart
translation_verse: Dinyoondi kùl̄ ki kāl̀ m-pu, ki ŋātì m-nyooti kii kubuŋuee. M-jajil mákal wáŋkì kii ditagbandee.

english_verse: I am sick at heart! Pain has taken its toll.
translation_verse: Kɔŋkɔnnee falaa di māntìi tú-mi, diŋuŋfil kaa ti pée bí-mi báà fiii.

english_verse: Night chews on my bones, causing endless torment,
translation_verse: M-kpabiŋ kɔkɔ wù ní kunyeeu, an kaa pūǹ-mi nsan ḿ gèeǹ gba.

english_verse: and God has shrunk my skin, choking me to death.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti cúú m-wampeeŋkaati mpɔn ki dáaĺ ki síkí m-sil.

english_verse: I have been thrown in the dirt and now am dirt myself.
translation_verse: U téé-mi ki tɔ́ tikpatin, m kpántì kii ntam nì ŋfantamee ní. *

english_verse: I beg God for help, but there is no answer; and when I stand up, he simply stares.
translation_verse: M-Nimbɔtiu, m bíi kūuntí ki yíì-si, ama ní aa bíi kíikí-mi. M yú a-nimbiin, ama ní aa fātìi tɔ́ gba yii unil sí.

english_verse: Soon he will send me home to the world of the dead, where we all must go.
translation_verse: M pée nyí a nín cáá-mi ki cáǹ ŋkúminee, laakin ní binifoobi kɔkɔ cée.

english_verse: I mourned for the poor and those who suffered.
translation_verse: Maa súń bin nìn bí dinimbinaamandi poonee puɔɔɔ? Bifalaadambi bɔti nìn kóò-mi inimɔɔn ní!

english_verse: But when I beg for relief and light, all I receive are disaster and darkness.
translation_verse: M nìn kā ki cí nnaam, ama nnaabu ní m dāa ká. M nìn kā ki cí ŋwalifi ní dibɔmbɔndi dɔ́miń. *

english_verse: My stomach is tied in knots; pain is my daily companion.
translation_verse: M-pɔbil bíil̀ ki bíi gbáà mpɔn, falaa wiiŋyi ŋmaniŋma poon ní m bí.

english_verse: My days are dark and gloomy and in the city council I stand and cry out,
translation_verse: M bɔ̄ntì, ama an kaa sá ŋwìiń di gbáń-mi ní m bɔ̄ntì! M sīlifí samaa kansikin ní ki gbáà ibiil bí jòoń-mi.

english_verse: making mournful sounds like jackals and owls.
translation_verse: M-biilii yāntì m kpántì sinsiŋkub bɔɔ, ní ki kpántì itulinjaa naalib.

english_verse: My skin is so parched, that it peels right off, and my bones are burning.
translation_verse: M-wuŋgbaŋŋu bɔ̄ntì ki kíǹ ki nákatíi lítí. Nnaanyeem yāntì m-wunti píĺ kpaŋkpam.

english_verse: I promised myself never to stare with desire at a young woman.
translation_verse: Man nì m-nimbiliŋ ŋá mpèé ŋubɔ yii ŋí taa kpèè usapɔɔn nì kɔdeei.

english_verse: In fact, God sends disaster on all who sin,
translation_verse: Ni lì yii: «Nnaabu dɔ̄ ki cí unikpiti, dinàandi dɔ̄ ki cí ukpitiŋal.»

english_verse: and he keeps a close watch on everything I do.
translation_verse: Too, Unimbɔti kaa kalin wāĺ m-saŋkindi níii? U kàaǹ m nín dúkutí m-taaŋi puee kɔkɔ! *

english_verse: I am not dishonest or deceitful,
translation_verse: M dī inyimɔn saŋŋuaaa, m-taaŋi yáb́ ki cūtìi mūul̀ m-jutaaa?

english_verse: and I beg God to prove my innocence.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti ń sòoǹ m-bɔti nì ibaamɔn! Waa làá ká tiba m-pu.

english_verse: If I have desired someone's wife and chased after her,
translation_verse: M-bɔɔ nimpuu yaa kɔ́-mi ní m cūtìi nákáǹ m-bɔɔ punyɔkɔpu ki cíitì-uee,

english_verse: then let some stranger steal my wife from me.
translation_verse: man m-ba nimpuu ń kpántí uninja ubɔ tɔntɔnliu, ní uninja un yaa pée lèe ń dòon̄ nì u!

english_verse: If I took someone's wife, it would be a horrible crime,
translation_verse: M yaa ŋá mimmee, m ŋá ticoobɔti dee, ikpiti in di máaǹ ditafadaaldee.

english_verse: sending me to destruction and my crops to the flames.
translation_verse: M-yìntitam ń bàà kpántí kii ŋŋmee kí wà kí nàan̄-mi, ní kí wà tin kɔkɔ m cááyee. *

english_verse: When my servants complained against me, I was fair to them.
translation_verse: M-tɔntɔnliu uninja àá unimpu yaa dɔ́miń m-cee ki yáliŋkì ní maa pílifiǹ-u ki ŋá tin u nyàab̀ee,

english_verse: Otherwise, what answer would I give to God when he judges me?
translation_verse: Unimbɔti yaa làá dāá sòoǹ m-bɔtee, m làá dāá ŋá mana? U yaa láa dɔ́miń ki cɔ́ŋkì-mi, m làá dāá kíí-u yii ba?

english_verse: After all, God is the one who gave life to each of us before we were born. I Have Never Cheated Anyone
translation_verse: Unimbɔti un máń-mi ki tākaǹ m-na poonee di kaa náań bi muɔɔɔ? Úǹ di náań ti-kɔkɔ ki tākaǹ ti-nab pooŋyin. *

english_verse: I have never cheated widows or others in need,
translation_verse: Maa yíì dalba dalba kí tīī unandaan kun u nyàab̀ee, kaa ti yāntì ukpiipu kāl̀ ki cíitì fám.

english_verse: and I have always shared my food with orphans.
translation_verse: Tijin tin m cááyee, maa jíń-tì m-baba, man nì ataŋkpiibil di dūu yākatì ki jíń.

english_verse: Since the time I was young, I have cared for orphans and helped widows.
translation_verse: M kpántì kii ditaŋkpiibil baayee ní doooo m-biyatin, ní ki pée mɔ́tí ukpiipu pu kaa gbèentí.

english_verse: If I have ever raised my arm to threaten an orphan when the power was mine,
translation_verse: M yaa dúkutì m-ŋal ki ŋá ditaŋkpiibil tiba, min kamaa m nyí yii bibɔsoonliibi kɔkɔ pá m-boonee,

english_verse: I hope that arm will fall from its socket.
translation_verse: m-gbigbipeeu ń bátí kí lítí kí wàatī m-peeku, ní m-ŋal ń tùkutī ŋŋalkpancɔ nyɔkɔm!

english_verse: I could not have been abusive; I was terrified at the thought that God might punish me.
translation_verse: Di sá yii m nìn fàŋkí Unimbɔti tafadaaldi, maa nìn ŋūǹ kí yūĺ u-nimbiin. *

english_verse: I have never openly or secretly
translation_verse: M nín ká ŋwìiń bíi ŋmíntí ní uŋmal bíi còom̄ ki cée,

english_verse: I have never laughed when my enemies were struck by disaster.
translation_verse: Asaluu gbáń m-nannanliu m fàal̄aaa, àá nnaabu ŋun jéetì u-puee tīī-mi mmɔn?

english_verse: Neither have I sinned by asking God to send down on them the curse of death.
translation_verse: Maa nìn ŋūǹ kí yàntī ikpiti ń nyā m-nyɔkɔn kí mèè mbusu kí tɔ̄ u-pu yii ú kpú.

english_verse: Many have attempted to hide their sins from others— but I refused.
translation_verse: M dū m-kpitii ki bál̀ kii binib tikpil nín ŋáań pueeee? M dū m-kpitii ki bál̀ m-naaa?

english_verse: And the fear of public disgrace never forced me to keep silent about what I had done. Why Doesn't God Listen?
translation_verse: Maa nìn fāŋkì tin bin kíǹee làá sòoǹ m-puee. Bi nìn ŋūǹ kí bèel̀-mi, ama tíǹ kaa nìn ká-mi, àá kaa nìn tí pīiǹ m-nyɔkɔ àá kí pìin̄-mi nsan ḿ taa nyā. *

english_verse: Why doesn't God All-Powerful listen and answer? If God has something against me, let him speak up or put it in writing!
translation_verse: Ubɔ kaa pée bí kí pīlifiǹ-mi deeyaa! M-bɔjoolkaati sɔ̀. An kíǹ Unimbɔti Mpɔŋkɔdaan nín kíí-mi! An yaa kíǹ m-nannanliibi nín ŋmàn̄ tin kí kɔ̄kɔl̀-mee,

english_verse: Then I would wear his charges on my clothes and forehead.
translation_verse: m làá dūú bùkun̄ m-gbigbipati pu, m làá dūú ŋá kii kibeefuuliiyee ní kí cíkiń.

english_verse: And with my head held high, I would tell him everything I have ever done.
translation_verse: M làá tùkù Unimbɔti tin kɔkɔ m ŋée, m làá dāá còom̀ kii dibɔtibilee ní kí yūĺ u-nimbiin. *

english_verse: I have never mistreated the land I farmed and made it mourn.
translation_verse: M-kpaatanti bíi yáliŋkí m-puɔɔɔ? M yāntì ipɔn in m cátèe súńaaa?

english_verse: Nor have I cheated my workers and caused them pain.
translation_verse: Maa fìkī ubɔ kpaajinti, kaa tí yāntì ti-dindambi kpíì ŋkùm.

english_verse: If I had, I would pray for weeds instead of wheat to grow in my fields. After saying these things, Job was silent.
translation_verse: M yaa ŋá mimmee, an nín bàà sá bilee ń nyēe, ikuŋkum ń nyā, an nín bàà sá ɔɔji ń nyēe, ukeenja ń nyā. * Yoob nyɔɔbunjoolkaaŋi dee.

english_verse: Finally, these three men stopped arguing with Job, because he refused to admit he was guilty.
translation_verse: Yoob nìn gbíntìi cɔ́ yii u sá deedeedaan, an puee Eeliifaasi nì Biilidaadi nì Soofaar nìn gbēeǹ kaa ti bíi kíikí-u.

english_verse: He was also angry with Job's three friends for not being able to prove that Job was wrong.
translation_verse: U nìn gíí Yoob bɔɔbi bitee mun pu diŋuul, kun puee baa nìn béè bi nín máaǹ kí kíí Yoob puee ki yāntì Unimbɔti fōō dibɔkpil.

english_verse: Elihu was younger than these three, and he let them speak first.
translation_verse: Eeliiwuu nìn cúú u-ba kí taa sòoǹ nì Yoob, di sá yii bin kɔkɔ kíǹee nìn kpíǹ-u.

english_verse: and he said to them: I am much younger than you, so I have shown respect by keeping silent.
translation_verse: Ubuusija Barakeel jipɔɔn Eeliiwuu sòon̄ yii: M dáá pɔ̀ɔǹ ní nimbi cíkitì. An pu ní m fāŋkì kaa bàà là kí dū tin ma mun nyée kí bíĺ ni-nimbiin.

english_verse: I once believed age was the source of wisdom;
translation_verse: M lī m-ban yii: «Binicikitikaabi di máaǹ kí sòoǹ, bin yúntèe di máaǹ kí dàkà iciin!»

english_verse: now I truly realize wisdom comes from God.
translation_verse: Ibaamɔn poonee, Unimbɔti Mpɔŋkɔdaan Fam di tìì unil dinyil.

english_verse: That's why I ask you to listen to me. I Eagerly Listened *
translation_verse: An pu ní m bíi gbàam̄-ni yii ní pīlifiǹ-mi: ma mun là kí sòoǹ tin m nyée. *

english_verse: You shouldn't say, “We know what's right! Let God punish him.”
translation_verse: Ní taa lì yii: «Ti ká iciin: Unimbɔti baba di ŋūǹ kí sòoǹ kí líí-u.»

english_verse: Job hasn't spoken against me, and so I won't answer him with your arguments.
translation_verse: An kaa sá man ní Yoob bíi sòoǹ nì, ama maa làá kíí-u kii nimbi nín kíí-u puee. *

english_verse: All of you are shocked; you don't know what to say.
translation_verse: Yoob, anyɔɔbun lóò a-bɔɔbi bita nee, baa ti cáá tiba kí sòoǹ nì si.

english_verse: But am I to remain silent, just because you have stopped speaking?
translation_verse: M kāl̀ ki cíitì. Bi nín kaa ti cáá tiba kí sòoǹ ki ŋmíl̀ee puee, maa làá nīn yú kí taa sòoǹ nì si.

english_verse: because I have so much to say, that I can't keep quiet.
translation_verse: M cáá tibɔti tikpil ki làá sòoǹ, ŋfam min bí m-nee téekí-mi ḿ sòoǹ.

english_verse: I am like a swollen wineskin, and I will burst
translation_verse: An nùuǹ m-poon sàbsab kii ndaamee, a lì kii ndaam lɔti tin làá pōōyee.

english_verse: I don't know how to be unfair or to flatter anyone—
translation_verse: Maa làá sòoǹ kí pɔ̀ gandi, kaa tí làá pàkà ubɔ fám.

english_verse: if I did, my Creator would quickly destroy me!
translation_verse: Maa nyí bi nín pàkà unil pu fámee, m yaa bàà ŋáań míǹ, m-náanliu bàà yōoǹ-mi dooooyee.

english_verse: Job, listen to me! Pay close attention. *
translation_verse: Ama sii Yoob, pīlifì tin m cáá kí sòoǹee, kpòon̄ a-tafal kí pīlifì m-nyɔɔbuŋŋi.

english_verse: just as surely as the Spirit of God All-Powerful gave me the breath of life.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti Fam di náań-mi, Unimbɔti Mpɔŋkɔdaan fooku di yāntì m bí dimaŋfalin.

english_verse: Now line up your arguments and prepare to face me.
translation_verse: A yaa ŋūǹ, a ŋūǹ kí kíí-mi, bɔ́ntí a-ba kí kpákáǹ-mi!

english_verse: We each were made from clay, and God has no favorites,
translation_verse: Unimbɔti nimbiinee, man nì si ŋmà ní, kuyɔkɔu ní bi dūu máń ma mun.

english_verse: so don't be afraid of me or what I might do. I Have Heard You Argue
translation_verse: An puee aa máaǹ kí fàŋkì-mi, àá kí dàkafì yii m làá wɔ́b́-si. *

english_verse: that you are innocent, guilty of nothing.
translation_verse: «M bí circir, maa ŋá ikpiti. M bí deedee kaa yīntì.

english_verse: You claim that God has made you his enemy,
translation_verse: Ama Unimbɔti gbíntìi kāntí dibɔkpil m-pu, u dū-mi ki kútì u-nannanliibi pu.

english_verse: that he has bound your feet and blocked your path.
translation_verse: U bá m-taaŋi akpambaa, u-nimbil pée cɔ́ tin kɔkɔ m ŋáańee pu ní.»

english_verse: But, Job, you're wrong— God is greater than any human.
translation_verse: Ama Yoob, yàntī ḿ tùkù-si yii a yīntì dijandi gbanti pu, di sá yii Unimbɔti jítiǹ unil kpataaa.

english_verse: So why do you challenge God to answer you?
translation_verse: Ba pu ní a yíiń-u tibuul? Úǹ kaa cáá kí tùkù ubɔ tin u ŋáańee. *

english_verse: God speaks in different ways, and we don't always recognize his voice. *
translation_verse: Unimbɔti dì isan tikpil pu ki sòoǹ, ama unil kaa dūu yíiń tiba.

english_verse: to give us warnings.
translation_verse: U lèekī ki dàkà-bi ki kpáafí-bi kaa gbèentí,

english_verse: God does this to make us turn from sin and pride
translation_verse: bí bàà fàtī bi-boon kí tīī bi-tuŋkpitiŋ, kí taa jēetí dilambilin.

english_verse: and to protect us from being swept away to the world of the dead.
translation_verse: Míǹ ní u ŋáań ki fìil̄ bi-nammu ki nyāntí ŋkúmin, u fìil̄-bi ki nyāntí nsan ŋun cáǹ unil ŋkúminee. *

english_verse: Sometimes we are punished with a serious illness and aching joints.
translation_verse: Ama Unimbɔti dù iween kí dáaĺ unil tafal kí bíĺ-u u-dooŋu pu: niinee ní nnaanyeem ń yàntī u-wunti jìkì kaa gbèentí,

english_verse: Merely the thought of our favorite food makes our stomachs sick,
translation_verse: ní tijin kaa ti mɔ̄ u-nyɔkɔn, ki kpáaǹ tijin tin u néeńee, u-nimbil kaa ti là kí wāl̀-tì.

english_verse: and we become so skinny that our bones stick out.
translation_verse: U dúntí ní baa ti wāĺ u-wunnanti, ní ú kpántí akpab ŋma.

english_verse: We feel death and the grave taking us in their grip.
translation_verse: U-taal kíǹ ki làkā ntaŋkpiifal pu ní, ŋkúm tuuŋyi di kíǹ ki yì u-maŋfal.

english_verse: One of a thousand angels then comes to our rescue by saying we are innocent.
translation_verse: Ama Unimbɔti tuuŋyi kutukub kutukub bin bí ki tútúǹ binibee ŋubɔbɔ ŋūǹ kí dàkà-u tin kítèe.

english_verse: The angel shows kindness, commanding death to release us, because the price was paid.
translation_verse: Ntuunee làá sɔ̄ u-saai ní kí gbàam̀ Unimbɔti yii: «Taa yàntī ú dòon̄ u-ŋaliŋu pu, m ká nsan ŋun pu m làá dī kí fīī-u kí lííyee.» *

english_verse: Our health is restored, we feel young again,
translation_verse: Niinee ní ubunlee ń fàtīí ŋá gbàlgbal kii kibikee, ní kí fàtīí gítí u-naacimpɔnti yuntiŋu.

english_verse: and we ask God to accept us. Then we joyfully worship God, and we are rewarded because we are innocent.
translation_verse: U yaa mēē Unimbɔtee, u pílifíǹ-u, u jáaḿ Unimbɔti nì dipɔɔpindi, di sá yii u fīī-u ki nyántì ŋkúm ŋaan.

english_verse: When that happens, we tell everyone, “I sinned and did wrong, but God forgave me
translation_verse: U gà ilan samaa nimbiin ki lì yii: «M nìn ŋá ikpiti, m nìn yīntì mara, ama Unimbɔti kaa dáaĺ m-tafal kii an nín bàà máaǹ puee.

english_verse: and rescued me from death! Now I will see the light.”
translation_verse: U fīī m-naŋki ki nyántì ŋkúm ŋaan, m làá nīn bí kí fàtīí ká ŋwalifi.» *

english_verse: God gives each of us chance after chance
translation_verse: Unimbɔti ŋáań tin bí nee kɔkɔ, ŋfunyɔm mili, mita ki tìì unil,

english_verse: to be saved from death and brought into the light that gives life.
translation_verse: kí ŋmā kí fīī udaan maŋfal kí nyāntí ditaŋkpiilin, ní kí yàntī binifoobi walifiŋu ń ŋmíntí u-pu.

english_verse: So, Job, pay attention and don't interrupt,
translation_verse: Yoob, a máaǹ kí pīlifiǹ-mi tiŋan, á ŋmīĺ fɔ́ŋfɔŋ kí yàntī ḿ sòoǹ.

english_verse: though I would gladly listen to anything you say that proves you are right.
translation_verse: A yaa cáá tiba kí sòoǹaaa, á sòoǹ, di sá yii án làá nīn sá-mi mmɔŋkpaan ḿ tīī-si mmɔ́ɔn.

english_verse: You men think you are wise, but just listen to me!
translation_verse: Nimbi bin sá biciŋfitiibee, pīlifìmaan tin m cáá kí sòoǹee, nimbi binyiliibee, pīlifimaan-mi.

english_verse: Then we can decide the case and give a just verdict.
translation_verse: Míǹ puee tí nyàab̀ kí béé tin bí deedeeyee, dicilpuee, tí nyàab̀ kí béé tin ŋān̄ee! *

english_verse: Job claims he is innocent and God is guilty of mistreating him.
translation_verse: Yoob bí ki lì yii: «M sá deedeedaan, ama Unimbɔti kaa là kí pɔ̀-mi.

english_verse: Job also argues that God considers him a liar and that he is suffering severely in spite of his innocence.
translation_verse: Min kamaa m sá deedeedaanee, m kpántì kii unyimɔndaanee. U yá-mi mpiin ki tīī-mi tiweendi, min kamaa maa ŋá ikpitee.»

english_verse: He spends his time with sinners,
translation_verse: U nì bikpitiŋaliibi di tāatí, u nì binikpitib di cáá mpèé.

english_verse: because he has said, “It doesn't pay to please God.” If Any of You Are Smart
translation_verse: Di sá u lī yii: «Ba ní an kútí unil ú nyàab̀ kí nīn fáatiǹ Unimbɔti ní?» *

english_verse: If any of you are smart, you will listen and learn that God All-Powerful does what is right.
translation_verse: Nimbi bin gbìl̀ tibɔti taapuee, pīlifìmaan-mi! Unimbɔti kaa ŋūǹ kí ŋá tikpitil dalba dalba, Yilpu fɔ́ŋŋŋ Nimbɔtiu kaa ŋūǹ kí ŋá tin kaa bí deedeeyee!

english_verse: God always treats everyone the way they deserve,
translation_verse: Ama u pà binib bi-tuuŋŋi paati ní, báà ŋma bimbim nín máaǹ kuŋyee ní u fòol̄.

english_verse: From the very beginning, God has been in control of all the world.
translation_verse: Ubɔ di dū kitiŋ ki kpāaǹ Unimbɔtaaa? Ama úǹ baba di cáá duulinya kɔkɔ pu mpɔn.

english_verse: If God took back the breath that he breathed into us,
translation_verse: Unimbɔti yaa bàà dàkafī úǹ baba pu, ní ki fàtīi fòol̄ u-fooku kun tìì dimaŋfalee,

english_verse: we humans would die and return to the soil.
translation_verse: binifoobi kɔkɔ bàà pée kúù dicilpu ní, ní binib ń fàtīí kpántí ntam. *

english_verse: The mighty God is the one who brings about justice, and you are condemning him.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti yaa bàà ná tin bí deedeeyee, u bàà ŋūǹ kí jī dibeelaaa? A là kí kpɔ̀ un baba bí deedee ki cáá mpɔnee bɔtaaa?

english_verse: And God created us all; he has no favorites, whether rich or poor.
translation_verse: Úǹ baba di sá un kaa yūlifí bibɔtiibi boonee, waa sòoǹ kí pɔ̀ ugaaja kí kpɔ̀ usoodaan bɔti, di sá yii úǹ di náań bi-kɔkɔ.

english_verse: Even powerful rulers die in the darkness of night when they least expect it, just like the rest of us. God Watches Everything We Do
translation_verse: Ni dāa kā kunyataasiiu tantaasee, bi kpíì. Samaa yíkí kaa kíikí bi-ba pu ní bí cúú bikpootiliibi kí kpɔ̀. Bi pée cútí upɔndaan ní kí kpɔ̀ sɔkɔmii.

english_verse: No evil person can hide in the deepest darkness.
translation_verse: Dibɔmbɔndi diba kaa bí ki bɔ̀ǹ kí ŋmā kí pìin̄-u nsan ú taa wāl̀ bikpitiŋaliibi. *

english_verse: And so, God doesn't need to set a time for judgment.
translation_verse: An kaa bàlifī Unimbɔti ń yíiń ubɔ tibuul ní udaan ń nín cù ú sòoǹ u-bɔti.

english_verse: Without asking for advice, God removes mighty leaders and puts others in their place.
translation_verse: An kaa bàlifī ú nyàab̀ kí béé ní kí nín nàan̄ abɔtibil, kí dū biba kí kàan̄ bi-paaŋŋu pu.

english_verse: He knows what they are like, and he wipes them out in the middle of the night.
translation_verse: Di sá yii u nyí bi-tuuŋŋi kɔkɔ, u kpákatí-bi kunyabaantiiu ní kí nàb̀ dúsi dusi.

english_verse: And while others look on, he punishes them because they were evil
translation_verse: U fátí-bi kí bíĺ binib nimbiin, kii digaŋgam dambee.

english_verse: The persons they mistreated had prayed for help, until God answered their prayers.
translation_verse: Bi yāntì bisoodambi biilii bāań-u, bi yāntì Unimbɔti gbìl̄ binandambi biilii pu! *

english_verse: But still, he punishes rulers who abuse their people.
translation_verse: ki pìintí unikpiti nsan ú taa jī binib pu dibeel, unil un di mɔ́ntí binibee.

english_verse: Job, you should tell God that you are guilty and promise to do better.
translation_verse: Tí dūú ŋmàntī yii ubɔ bí Unimbɔti yii: «M ŋá ikpiti, ama m pōoǹ yii maa ti làá ŋá ikpiti.

english_verse: Then ask him to point out what you did wrong, so you won't do it again.
translation_verse: Dàkà-mi ikpiti in ní maa ŋúń ki wál̀ee. M yaa yīntì, maa ti làá ŋá míǹ.»

english_verse: Do you make the rules, or does God? You have to decide— I can't do it for you; now make up your mind.
translation_verse: Sii ceeyee, Unimbɔti làá dáaĺ u-tafalaaa? M nyí an nín kaa ká-see. An sá sii di lēē, an kaa sá man, míǹ puee tùkù-mi tin a nyée. *

english_verse: Job, anyone with good sense can easily see
translation_verse: Binib bin cáá dinyilee nì biciŋfitiibi bin pílifiǹ-mee làá lì yii:

english_verse: that you are speaking nonsense and lack good judgment.
translation_verse: «Yoob bíi sòoǹ, ama waa nyí tin u sòoǹee, u-nyɔɔbuŋŋi dàkà yii waa nyí tiba.

english_verse: So I pray for you to suffer as much as possible for talking like a sinner.
translation_verse: U sòoǹ kii unikpitee, see bí gíti nyɔ̀kɔfì u-bɔti nee tiŋan.

english_verse: You have rebelled against God, time after time, and have even insulted us.
translation_verse: U ŋá ikpiti ní ki gíti yíkì kaa kíí u-ba pu, ki bíi jáà nì Unimbɔti kaa gbèentí. U yāntì ti kɔ́ digugufil poon.»

english_verse: Job, are you really innocent in the sight of God?
translation_verse: Yoob, mimmee a dàkafī yii an kítì á lì yii: «Unimbɔti, m bí deedeeee?»

english_verse: Don't you honestly believe it pays to obey him?
translation_verse: Di sá a bàlifī-u yii: «M-kpitii kaa ká-si, m nín kaa bíi ŋáań ikpitee, m páatì ba?»

english_verse: I will give the answers to you and your friends. *
translation_verse: Man m-ba di làá kíí-si, ní kí kíí kí kpáaǹ a-bɔɔbi mun!

english_verse: Look up to the heavens
translation_verse: Wáaǹ kí kpèè kutaa, kpèè atagban nín bí a-yilpu puee!

english_verse: Is any good you may have done at all helpful to him?
translation_verse: A yaa ti bí deedee, ba ní an kútí-u? Ba paatii ní u kāntí poon?

english_verse: The evil or good you do only affects other humans.
translation_verse: A-nijutiibi di làá jī a-kpitii pu falaa, a yaa tí bíi ŋáań tiŋanaaa, binib ní án làá kèetī. *

english_verse: In times of trouble, everyone begs the mighty God to have mercy.
translation_verse: Binib bin bi wɔ́b́ an tin nyāŋkèe bí ki yáliŋkí, bi yáliŋkí ki nyàab̀ ubɔ ń dāá fīī-bi kí nyāntí upɔɔl ŋaan.

english_verse: But after their Creator helps them through hard times, they forget about him,
translation_verse: Ama bi-kansikin ubɔ kaa bàlifī yii: «Unimbɔti un náań-mee bí la? Úǹ un yàntī binib gà ilan kunyataasiiu,

english_verse: though he makes us wiser than animals or birds.
translation_verse: ki dì ipeel pu ki dàkà-ti, nì inoon pu ki yàntī ti kāntí dinyilee?»

english_verse: God won't listen to the prayers of proud and evil people.
translation_verse: Binib gbáà ibiil an kɔkɔ pu ki nyàab̀ bí fīī-bi kí nyāntí binikpitib bin yòontí bi-ba yilpuee ŋaan, ama Unimbɔti kaa kíí-bi.

english_verse: If God All-Powerful refuses to answer their empty prayers,
translation_verse: Bi gbáà ibiil fám, ama Unimbɔti kaa pílifiǹ-bi, Unimbɔti Mpɔŋkɔdaan kaa fātìi tɔ́ gba. *

english_verse: Be patient a while longer; I have something else to say in God's defense.
translation_verse: Yoob, jī m-pu kimɔtii fiii ḿ dàkà-si. M gíti cáá kí sòoǹ Unimbɔti yil pu.

english_verse: God always does right— and this knowledge comes straight from God.
translation_verse: M-nyil nyánní ndandati ní, m làá pɔ̀ Unimbɔti m-náanliu.

english_verse: You can rest assured that what I say is true.
translation_verse: Tin m cáá kí tùkù-see sá ibaamɔn páaa ní, uciŋfiti páaa di bí kɔ́ĺ-si nee.

english_verse: Although God is mighty, he cares about everyone and makes fair decisions.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti sá mpɔndaan ní, waa kpèé ubɔ fám, u sá mpɔŋkpaandaan ní, u yaa lēē kí ŋá tiŋyee míǹ ní u ŋáań.

english_verse: The wicked are cut down, and those who are wronged receive justice.
translation_verse: Waa yàntī binikpitib ń nīn bí dimaŋfalin ki cá, ama u pɔ̀ binandambi.

english_verse: God watches over good people and places them in positions of power and honor forever.
translation_verse: Waa fàtī u-boon kí tīī deedeedambi. * U kàantí bibɔtiibi dibeel ní ki tìì-bi tinyool ki cáa cá jaanjaan. Ama bíǹ dūú kpántí bilambidambi ní.

english_verse: But when people are prisoners of suffering and pain, *
translation_verse: Báà bi yaa kpántì bisarkadambi bi bóob́-bi ikusakaaa, bi bíi jīǹ falaayaaa,

english_verse: God points out their sin and their pride,
translation_verse: Unimbɔti di bíi dàkà-bi atuŋkpiti ŋin bi ŋée, bi nín ŋá ikpiti in dilambil poonee.

english_verse: And if they obey, they will be successful and happy from then on.
translation_verse: Bi yaa pílifì ki sīntì bi-ba taapu ki tīī Unimbɔtee, bi làá kúntí bi-maŋfal wiiŋyi dipɔɔpindin ní kí kúntí bi-biŋŋi mmɔnni.

english_verse: But if they foolishly refuse, they will be rewarded with a violent death. Godless People Are Too Angry
translation_verse: Ama bi yaa kaa pílifèe, bi làá tàkan̄ nsan ŋun cáǹ unil ditaŋkpiilinee, ní kí kpú, di sá yii baa béè.

english_verse: Godless people are too angry to ask God for help when he punishes them.
translation_verse: Bin kaa fōō Unimbɔti ki kíí bi-pɔbiliŋinee gbíntí bi-ŋuul poon ní, Unimbɔti yaa bóob́-bi ikusakee, baa yíì-u ú jòoń-bi.

english_verse: So they die young in shameful disgrace.
translation_verse: Bi dáá pɔ̀ɔǹ ní kí kpú, bi-maŋfal wiiŋyi kúntí kii nlaakpaamuee ní.

english_verse: Hard times and trouble are God's way of getting our attention!
translation_verse: Unimbɔti dù disool ní kí fīī usoodaan, u ŋátí bi-tafaliŋ dinimbinaamandi poon ní.

english_verse: And at this very moment, God deeply desires to lead you from trouble and to spread your table with your favorite food.
translation_verse: Dinimbinaamandin ní Unimbɔti nyántìń-si ní ki nìn yāntì a nìn bí digbilin. Tijimmɔntiil di nìn tɔ́kɔ́ a-teebiliu pu.

english_verse: Now that the judgment for your sins has fallen upon you,
translation_verse: Ama Unimbɔti kūū a-bɔti kii binikpitibee, ní aa ŋūǹ kí kpántí tiba ibɔsoon in poon a bée.

english_verse: don't let your anger and the pain you endured make you sneer at God.
translation_verse: Taa yàntī tigaajati ń kīil̀-si! Taa dàkafì yii a ŋūǹ kí dū tiwampɔkaal kí dā Unimbɔti.

english_verse: Your reputation and riches cannot protect you from distress,
translation_verse: A-gaajati nì a-sindaariyau kaa ŋūǹ kí tɔ̄ ditundi, míǹ mbaantiim ní a-pɔ́ɔǹtam kaa ŋūǹ kí tūtuǹ-si.

english_verse: nor can you find safety in the dark world below.
translation_verse: Taa nín kā ki cɔ́tí yii kunyeeu kun bi làá kpìkitī atimbun kí fée ń mɔ́.

english_verse: God's power is unlimited. He needs no teachers
translation_verse: Tiŋman, Unimbɔti sá ukpaan ní ki cáá mpɔn. Udakal ulɔu di ŋūǹ kí dàkà kí jītíǹ-u?

english_verse: Others have praised God for what he has done, so join with them.
translation_verse: Binib pée gà ilan ní ki nyɔ́ŋkí-u. Si mun téetí kí nyɔ̄ŋkì-u u-tuuŋŋi pu.

english_verse: From down here on earth, everyone has looked up and seen
translation_verse: Báà ŋma ŋūǹ kí wāl̀ tin Unimbɔti ŋée, bi kāntí-tì ndan ní.

english_verse: how great God is— God is more than we imagine; no one can count the years he has lived. *
translation_verse: Di sá yii Unimbɔti sá ukpaan ní taa ŋūǹ kí gbìl̄ taapu, taa ŋūǹ kí kàaǹ u-biŋŋi.

english_verse: God gathers moisture into the clouds
translation_verse: U dátí nnyim ki cāabìń u-cee, ní kí dūú kpántí ntaanyim.

english_verse: Who can understand how God scatters the clouds and speaks from his home in the thunderstorm?
translation_verse: Ŋma di ŋūǹ kí gbìl̄ atagban nín còom̄ puee taapu? Kí gbìl̄ ditaadundi nín fátí pu kutagbɔŋunee taapu?

english_verse: And when God sends lightning, it can be seen at the bottom of the sea.
translation_verse: Úǹ di yàntī utaa ŋmóò ki ŋmíntí ki pùntī kutagbɔŋu, ama ní ki cáá dibɔmbɔndi ki bìintí tiŋku taapu.

english_verse: By producing such rainstorms, God rules the world and provides us with food.
translation_verse: Atagban gbanti ní u cáa sòoǹ binib bɔti ní ki tìì-bi tijin tikpil.

english_verse: Each flash of lightning is one of his arrows striking its target,
translation_verse: U dū ntaaŋmɔŋmɔ ki bál̀ u-ŋaan ní ki tìì-ŋi mara ŋí yā laakin u dàkà-ŋee.

english_verse: and the thunder tells of his anger against sin.
translation_verse: Ditaadundi di dàkà yii utaa làá nì kubuŋkpaaŋŋu dòoń, ki kpáaǹ tiwaŋkuti

english_verse: I am frightened and tremble all over,
translation_verse: M yaa gbìl̄ mimmee ní m-pɔbil ń bīil̀ ní ki kíǹ ki máfí.

english_verse: when I hear the roaring voice of God in the thunder,
translation_verse: Pīlifìmaan ditaadundi din sá Unimbɔti neelee, pīlifìmaan didundi din nyēē u-nyɔkɔnee.

english_verse: and when I see his lightning flash across the sky.
translation_verse: U yàntī utaa ŋmóò ki pùntī kutagbɔŋu, kí yòon̄ kitiŋ nyɔkɔ kiba kí cáá sāā kin kíǹee.

english_verse: and they force animals to seek shelter.
translation_verse: Ki kpáaǹ tiwaŋkuti sáń ki bāal̀ ní ki kíǹ ki dɔ̄ ti-naabakatin.

english_verse: The windstorms of winter strike,
translation_verse: Kubuŋkpaaŋŋu nyēeń ŋgiil pú ní tiwool ń nyānní ŋgan pú.

english_verse: and the breath of God freezes streams and rivers.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti yaa fōotèe, nnyim kìl̀ ní, ní mi-yilpu ń pɔ̄ɔkì kaŋkaŋ kii tikútee. *

english_verse: to release their cargo— sometimes as punishment for sin, sometimes as kindness. Consider Carefully
translation_verse: An yaa sá kí dáaĺ unil tafalaaa, an yaa sá kí dàkà u-nitaaa, ŋíǹ ní Unimbɔti tūǹ. *

english_verse: Job, consider carefully the many wonders of God.
translation_verse: Yoob, kpòon̄ a-tafal kí pīlifì tíǹ gbanti kɔkɔ tiŋan. Gbèen̄ kí kpèè Unimbɔti maamaacib!

english_verse: Can you explain why lightning flashes at the orders
translation_verse: A nyí Unimbɔti nín tìì atagban marab bin ki yàntī utaa ŋmóò làka lakeeee?

english_verse: of God who knows all things? Or how he hangs the clouds in empty space?
translation_verse: A nyí an nín ŋá pu kutagbɔŋu dàn̄ yilpueeee? Un nyí ki cíl̀ee di gbìl̀ an maamaaciu taapu.

english_verse: You almost melt in the heat of fierce desert winds when the sky is like brass.
translation_verse: Ŋyunti ŋun ŋgiil pú buŋku jītí an tùm̀ kpaŋkpamee, tiwan tin a pēēyee fòol̄ ní kí píĺ a-pu sìii.

english_verse: God can hammer out the clouds in spite of the oppressive heat, but can you?
translation_verse: Sii di nìn tútúǹ Unimbɔti ní u kpátì kutagbɔŋu, ki yāntì ku pɔ́ɔkì kaŋkaŋ kii digitil din bi dūntì tikúti ki nyūntèeee? *

english_verse: Tell us what to say to God! Our minds are in the dark, and we don't know how to argue our case.
translation_verse: Yàntī tí béé tin ti máaǹ kí tùkù Unimbɔtee. Ti bí dibɔmbɔndin kaa cáá tiba kí lì.

english_verse: Should I risk my life by telling God that I want to speak?
translation_verse: M yaa bíi sòoǹee, m máaǹ kí bàan̄-uaaa? Bi làá tùkù-u yii ubɔ sòon̄aaa?

english_verse: No one can stare at the sun after a breeze has blown the clouds from the sky.
translation_verse: Dicilpuee, taa ti wāĺ tiŋan: atagban dūu bīiǹ ŋwìiń pu. Niinee ní kubuŋu ń yīkì ní kí ŋàtī kutagbɔŋu.

english_verse: Yet the glorious splendor of God All-Powerful is brighter by far.
translation_verse: Ŋgan púee, ŋwalifi ŋubɔ nyánní ki jìl̀ kii sindaariyee, ŋwalifi ŋun kaa cáá jutee māntìi tú Unimbɔti.

english_verse: And so we humans fear God, because he shows no respect for those who are proud and think they know so much.
translation_verse: An pu ní binib máaǹ kí fàŋkì-u, ama waa dū bin yíì bi-ba biciŋfitiibee ki yíiń tiba.

english_verse: From out of a storm, the Lord said to Job:
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan yíiń Yoob kubuŋkpaaŋŋu poon ní ki bālifì-u yii:

english_verse: Why do you talk so much when you know so little?
translation_verse: Ŋma ní a sá ní ki sòoǹ kii ugbaanee, ki bíiĺ tin m bɔ́ntì kí ŋée ní?

english_verse: Now get ready to face me! Can you answer the questions I ask?
translation_verse: Gbìn̄ a-gbajau kí yūĺ kii uninjee! M làá bàlifì-si tibɔti ní á kíí-mi. Unimbɔti bālifì Yoob tiwannáaŋkaal pu

english_verse: How did I lay the foundation for the earth? Were you there?
translation_verse: La ní a nìn bí ŋyunti ŋun ní m bíl̀ kitiŋ nyeeleeee? A yaa nyí ibaamɔnee, á tùkù-mi.

english_verse: while morning stars sang, and angels rejoiced?
translation_verse: ŋyunti ŋun kutaafaau ŋmalbijaai gà ilan ki kìntī tɔb, ní Unimbɔti tuuŋyi fàal̀ee?

english_verse: When the ocean was born, I set its boundaries
translation_verse: Ŋyunti ŋun tiŋku nyim púń ki nyánní kitiŋinee, ŋma di nìn dū punuubi ki pīiǹ mi-pu ní?

english_verse: and wrapped it in blankets of thickest fog.
translation_verse: An sá man di dū atagban ki pēeǹ-u, m dū dipɔ̀ńdi din nyìm̀ee ki fìn̄-u.

english_verse: and said, “Your powerful waves stop here! They can go no farther.” Did You Ever Tell the Sun To Rise?
translation_verse: M tùkū-u yii: «Á dāan̄ doo, á taa bà lapu, a-nyiŋgbanti bilambidambee làá gbèen̄ doo ní!» *

english_verse: Did you ever tell the sun to rise? And did it obey?
translation_verse: A-maŋfal wiiŋyi poonee, a pée ŋúń ki tīī kutaa mara dibaba ja yii kú wúntáaa? A ŋúń ki kāaǹ ntaafaabɔmbɔm ŋu-paaŋŋu,

english_verse: Did it take hold of the earth and shake out the wicked like dust from a rug?
translation_verse: ŋú cúú kitiŋ nyɔɔgbaŋŋi kí cìŋkì binikpitib bin bí ki-puee ń lítáaa?

english_verse: Early dawn outlines the hills like stitches on clothing or sketches on clay.
translation_verse: Ntaafaabɔmbɔmee, kitiŋ mántí ní wèeee, a lì kii kuyɔkɔu kun pu bi dū kijalii ki nyīīyee, ní an ŋá kii kitiŋ pu wanti pēē tiwampeeŋkaalee.

english_verse: But its light is too much for those who are evil, and their power is broken.
translation_verse: Ama binikpitib kaa ti cáá bi-walifiŋu, ŋŋal ŋun bi bàà dúkutì kí fááyee cúu kɔ́fì. *

english_verse: Job, have you ever walked on the ocean floor?
translation_verse: A gíti láá cūtì dimɔɔl nyimbulnimbil laŋkaaa? A cōom̀ dimɔɔl taapu ki yìin̄aaa?

english_verse: Have you seen the gate to the world of the dead?
translation_verse: Bi dàkā-si ŋkúm punyɔmmu a káaa? A ká mpunyɔmu mun pìitī unil ń kɔ́ ŋkúm booŋŋuneeee?

english_verse: And how large is the earth? Tell me, if you know!
translation_verse: A nyí kitiŋ waaŋŋu nín sá pueeee? A yaa nyí tíǹ gbanti kɔkɔee, á tùkù-maa!

english_verse: Where is the home of light, and where does darkness live?
translation_verse: A nyí ŋwalifi nín kóò laakiŋyeeee? La ní dibɔmbɔndi kóò ní?

english_verse: I'm certain you must be able to, since you were already born when I created everything.
translation_verse: A máaǹ kí nīn nyí tiŋan, di sá yii bi nìn màl̄-si ŋyunti gbanti ní a-maŋfal pu wiiŋyi náaǹ tikpilku. *

english_verse: Have you been to the places where I keep snow and hail,
translation_verse: A ŋúń ki cūtì laakin bi kpáafí ntaayimeeee? A gíti dáá ká ataanyiŋkumbil cakalaauaaa?

english_verse: until I use them to punish and conquer nations?
translation_verse: M bɔ́ntì-bi ki cíitì dinimbinaamandi yuntiŋu ní, dikɔ̀ndi nì kujaau yuntiŋu ní m bɔ́ntì-bi.

english_verse: From where does lightning leap, or the east wind blow?
translation_verse: A nyí laakin ŋwalifi nyáńeeee? Ŋwìiń jeetilaŋki pú buŋku nyēeń la ní kí dāan̄ kitiŋ pu ní?

english_verse: Who carves out a path for thunderstorms? Who sends torrents of rain
translation_verse: Ŋma di cátì nsan ki bíl̀ utaa ní? Ŋma di cátì didandi ki tīī ditaadundi tagbandi ní?

english_verse: Rain that changes barren land to meadows green with grass.
translation_verse: Ŋma di yàntī utaa ń nì kitiŋkuliŋŋi ń cɔ́tí nnyim, timool ń nyā kí wíiǹ ní?

english_verse: Who is the father of the dew and of the rain?
translation_verse: Utaa cáá baaa? Ŋma di màl̄ dimalindi ní?

english_verse: Who gives birth to the sleet and the frost
translation_verse: Dinyintaŋkpal na sá ŋma ní? Nnyim min nyáń yilpu ki kìl̄ee, ŋma di màl̄-mì?

english_verse: that fall in winter, when streams and lakes freeze solid as a rock? Can You Arrange Stars?
translation_verse: Niinee ní nnyim ń dūú pɔ̄ɔkì kii ditaŋkpalee, ní dimɔɔl yilpu ń dūú jìlifì kí pɔ̄ɔkì. *

english_verse: Can you arrange stars in groups such as Orion and the Pleiades?
translation_verse: Kpèè iŋmalbi acuku. A ŋūǹ kí bóob́ dicukul diba dicilpuɔɔɔ, dicukul diba ní a ŋūǹ kí bútí ní?

english_verse: Do you control the stars or set in place the Big Dipper and the Little Dipper?
translation_verse: A ŋūǹ kí yàntī iŋmalbijaa ń nyā ŋyunti ŋun an máaǹee, àá kí kpòotī iŋmalbi in nyēē kutaa ŋgan pu púee?

english_verse: Do you know the laws that govern the heavens, and can you make them rule the earth?
translation_verse: A nyí marab bin di kpòotī kutaayeeee? Sii di kpòotī-bi kitiŋ puɔɔɔ?

english_verse: Can you order the clouds to send a downpour,
translation_verse: A ŋūǹ kí tīī atagban mara utaa ń nì nnyim ń gbí kí léeń a-puɔɔɔ?

english_verse: or will lightning flash at your command?
translation_verse: Utaa yaa ŋmɔ́ee, sii di tūǹní-uaaa? U tùkù-si yii: «M sèéee»?

english_verse: Did you teach birds to know that rain or floods are on their way?
translation_verse: Ŋma di tīī kinɔmbiki kin bi yíì yii Ibiisee iciin ní? Ŋma di tīī ukooja dinyil ní?

english_verse: Can you count the clouds or pour out their water
translation_verse: Ŋma di ŋūǹ kí kàaǹ atagban ní kí kpòon̄-ŋi nnyim min kā ŋi-poonee ń kpáatí kí fá ní?

english_verse: When lions are hungry, do you help them hunt?
translation_verse: Sii di cútí ipeel ki tìì ugbikintinaataaa? Sii di tìì agbikintipɔmbil tijin ŋi jīǹ

english_verse: Do you send an animal into their den?
translation_verse: ŋyunti ŋun ŋi gbāā itaŋkpalɔkɔn àá ŋi náká kimɔgbaayin kí cúú tibeeee?

english_verse: And when starving young ravens cry out to me for food, do you satisfy their hunger?
translation_verse: Sii di bɔ́ntí tijin ki tìì digaliŋgaal ŋyunti ŋun di-biyaamu bíi gbáà ibiil ki yíì Unimbɔti ki yìiǹ an kɔkɔ pu ŋkùm làá kpɔ̀-mueeee?

english_verse: When do mountain goats and deer give birth? Have you been there when their young are born? *
translation_verse: A nyí dibindi poon ŋyunti ŋun kijooŋɔjakai màal̀eeee? A gíti dáá ká icaŋkpalim nín màal̀ pueeee?

english_verse: Soon their young grow strong and then leave to be on their own.
translation_verse: Mbiyaamu pée tɔ́ mu-ba ní kí wíiǹ kí ká mpɔn, ní míǹ boonee mú yīkì mu-na cee kaa ti gítiń. *

english_verse: I alone help them survive in salty desert sand.
translation_verse: M yāntì kì kóò kuteeu pu. Laakin kì kóòyee sá kitiŋ kin cáá ŋyaamee ní.

english_verse: They stay far from crowded cities and refuse to be tamed.
translation_verse: Kíǹ bèel̄ kitiŋin wooku ní kaa gbìl̀ dalba ukpil ubɔ tátí ki-pu.

english_verse: Would a wild ox agree to live in your barn and labor for you?
translation_verse: Upɔɔnaa kíikí kí nīn sá a-tɔntɔnliuaaa? U kíikí kí dòon̄ a-naabakakun kunyeeuaaa?

english_verse: Could you force him to plow or to drag a heavy log to smooth out the soil?
translation_verse: A ŋūǹ kí kpàl̄-u ú kpɔ̀ tikpaalaaa? U kíikí kí páań a-boon ditantakalin kí dáaĺ akoooo?

english_verse: Can you depend on him to use his great strength and do your heavy work?
translation_verse: U nín cáá mpɔn tikpil puee pu ní a làá nīn máká u-pu kí yàntī ú tɔ̄ a-tundaaa?

english_verse: Can you trust him to harvest your grain or take it to your barn from the threshing place? An Ostrich Proudly Flaps Her Wings
translation_verse: A ŋūǹ kí nīn máká u-pu ú fàtīí gítiń kí cáań a-jincakaati kí páań kukaatuŋu puɔɔɔ? *

english_verse: An ostrich proudly flaps her wings, but not because she loves her young.
translation_verse: Taataa feeŋyi yaa gbáà tɔbee, an tìì nsiim min mɔ̄ee ní, ama waa ŋūǹ kí ŋàaǹ kí bà naakpaapiin.

english_verse: She abandons her eggs and lets the dusty ground keep them warm.
translation_verse: U tòó u-jiŋŋi kí bíĺ kitiŋ ní kí dūú ŋá ntamin an kákatí.

english_verse: And she doesn't seem to worry that the feet of an animal could crush them all.
translation_verse: U súntí yii kuwaŋkuluu kubɔ ŋūǹ kí còom̀ ŋi-pu, yii upeel ubɔ ŋūǹ kí tāā-ŋi ŋí wīī.

english_verse: She treats her eggs as though they were not her own, unconcerned that her work might be for nothing.
translation_verse: U ŋáań u-biyaamu ntoom kii waa yì-muee, an kaa ká-u yii u gīī mu-pu fám.

english_verse: I myself made her foolish and without common sense.
translation_verse: Kun di yì-tèe di sá yii maa tīī-u iciin, maa yākatì dinyil ki kpáaǹ-u.

english_verse: But once she starts running, she laughs at a rider on the fastest horse. Did You Give Horses Their Strength?
translation_verse: Ama u yaa yíkìi síl̀ kí sāǹee, utaamu nì utanjakal sá u-cee agbiil ní. *

english_verse: Did you give horses their strength and the flowing hair along their necks?
translation_verse: Sii di tìì utaamu mpɔnaaa? Sii di dū kugaŋŋu ki páaǹ u-sil puɔɔɔ?

english_verse: Did you make them able to jump like grasshoppers or to frighten people with their snorting?
translation_verse: Sii di yàntī u yùkufī kii unaakeeee? U yaa fōotèe, an cáá tifaandi ní.

english_verse: Before horses are ridden into battle, they paw at the ground, proud of their strength.
translation_verse: U cáá u-taaŋi ki fátí kitiŋ, ní kí dū u-ba kí bíĺ dikɔ̀ndin nì mpɔn.

english_verse: Laughing at fear, they rush toward the fighting,
translation_verse: Waa dū kufaaŋŋu ki yíiń tiba, ní kaa fàŋkí tiba, kitàataajiki kaa yàntī ú gítí u-boon.

english_verse: while the weapons of their riders rattle and flash in the sun.
translation_verse: Dibaatandi yaa ŋáań kuwoou u-pu u gbìl̄ee, kikpaŋ nì kitàataajiki yaa ŋmóò làka lakee,

english_verse: Unable to stand still, they gallop eagerly into battle when trumpets blast.
translation_verse: an kaa ti ŋáań-u malaa, u cútíí cóotí ní. Bi yaa búń dikantándee, waa ti ŋūǹ kí cúú u-ba.

english_verse: Stirred by the distant smells and sounds of war, they snort in reply to the trumpet.
translation_verse: Bi yaa búń dikantándee ní ú fòotī. Ndan ní u gbìl̀ kujaau nuŋu nì bijanjakpilib kuŋkuuntii nì kujaau biilii pu. *

english_verse: Did you teach hawks to fly south for the winter? *
translation_verse: Sii di tùkù ukaabu ú yīkì kí ŋàaǹ kí kpátí u-feeŋyi kí túĺ ŋgiil púɔɔɔ?

english_verse: where they can look down to spot their next meal?
translation_verse: Yilpu niin ní u cɔ́ŋkí ki kpèé kuwaŋkuluu kun u làá cúúyee, u-nimbiliŋ ŋūǹ kí wāl̀-ku ndan.

english_verse: Then their young gather to feast wherever the victim lies.
translation_verse: U-biyaamu nyù fatiku ní. Laakin diwaŋkpil yaa bée, niin ní u bí.

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful,
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan yíiń Yoob ní ki bālifì-u yii:

english_verse: but you have argued that I am wrong. Now you must answer me.
translation_verse: Sii un di jáà nì Unimbɔti Mpɔŋkɔdaanee, a làá gíti kpákáǹ-uaaa? Sii un di tìì Unimbɔti isaŋkee, a làá ŋmā kí kíí-uaaa?

english_verse: Job said to the Lord:
translation_verse: Niinee ní Yoob kíí ti-Dindaan yii:

english_verse: Then out of the storm the Lord said to Job:
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan kíí Yoob kubuŋkpaaŋŋun yii:

english_verse: Face me and answer the questions I ask!
translation_verse: Bɔ́ntí a-ba! Nín̄ sá uninja! M làá bàlifì-si tibɔti ní á kíí-mi.

english_verse: Are you trying to prove that you are innocent by accusing me of injustice?
translation_verse: A là kí lì yii maa sá deedeedaan deeyaa! A là kí kpɔ̀ m-bɔti kí pɔ̀ a-baaa?

english_verse: Do you have a powerful arm and a thundering voice that compare with mine?
translation_verse: A cáá mpɔn kii mama Unimbɔteeee? A-nyɔkɔ cá ndan kii ditaadundeeee?

english_verse: If so, then surround yourself with glory and majesty. *
translation_verse: An yaa sá mimmee, dū tinyool nì tikpaandi kí nyɔ̀kɔntì a-ba, dū kunyaaŋŋu nì jilma kí pèen̄!

english_verse: Show your furious anger! Throw down and crush
translation_verse: Yàntī a-ŋuul ń pōō, kpèè bilambidambi dibaba kí sìntīǹ-bi taapu.

english_verse: Wrap them in grave clothes and bury them together in the dusty soil.
translation_verse: Dū-bi kí síb́ ntamin dicilpu, dū-bi kí pìin̄ ŋkúm sarka diikun.

english_verse: Do this, and I will agree that you have won this argument. I Created You
translation_verse: Niinee ma mun làá gāā ilan kí nyɔ̄ŋkì-si, di sá yii a bàà pɔ́ɔǹ ki jáń ki jíń! Unaapuyiin bɔti

english_verse: I created both you and the hippopotamus. It eats only grass like an ox,
translation_verse: Kpèè unaapuyiin, kupeebiliŋŋu. Man di náań-u kii m nín náań si mun puee. U ŋmóò timool kii unaayee ní.

english_verse: but look at the mighty muscles in its body
translation_verse: Ama kpèè u-caŋ pu pɔŋŋu, kpèè mpɔn ŋun bí u-pool pu nambiliŋ puee!

english_verse: and legs. Its tail is like a cedar tree, and its thighs are thick.
translation_verse: U-juul pɔ̄ɔ̄ kii Seedir dɔŋuee, u-tapaŋŋi cáá igiin in dàfèe.

english_verse: The bones in its legs are like bronze or iron.
translation_verse: U-kpabiŋ pɔ̄ɔ̄ kii tasa kútee, u-takakal kpabiŋ náań nì tikúti piiŋyi ní.

english_verse: I made it more powerful than any other creature, yet I am stronger still.
translation_verse: Tin kɔkɔ m náańee poonee, úǹ di līī. Man u-náanliu baba di ŋūǹ kí pɔ̄ɔkiǹ-u.

english_verse: Undisturbed, it eats grass while the other animals play nearby. *
translation_verse: Ajoon di tìì-u timool u ŋmóò, ní ipeel māntìi tú-u ki gbíiĺ.

english_verse: It rests in the shade of trees along the riverbank
translation_verse: Ama isufi taapu ní u dɔ̀, kupuun, tikati kansikin ní u bāal̀.

english_verse: or hides among reeds in the swamp.
translation_verse: Isufi cáá i-booŋŋu ki bìintí u-pu, peepiliiyee sufii in bí mbun caŋinee māntìi tú-u.

english_verse: It remains calm and unafraid with the Jordan River rushing and splashing in its face.
translation_verse: Báà nnyinjil yaa pɔ̄ɔ̄yaaa, an kaa ká-u, báà gba nnyim yaa jɔ́m̀ ki tin bàn̄ u-nyɔkɔnaaa, an kaa sòoǹ nì u tiba.

english_verse: There is no way to capture a hippopotamus— not even by hooking its nose or blinding its eyes.
translation_verse: Ŋyunti ŋun u yaa wāĺee, ŋma di ŋūǹ kí cúú-u? Ŋma di ŋūǹ kí sàl̄-u kí sāā kí cíĺ u-maŋfal? Leefiyatan kupeebiliŋŋu

english_verse: Can you catch a sea monster by using a fishhook? Can you tie its mouth shut with a rope?
translation_verse: Kpèè, u-nimbiinee unil mákal ŋáań fám ní, unil yaa pée wál̀-uee, u-wunti kúù ní.

english_verse: Can it be led around by a ring in its nose or a hook in its jaw?
translation_verse: Ubɔ kaa wáatì kí táká-u tibɔti. Too, ŋma di sá-u kí jáǹ-mi?

english_verse: Will it surrender as a slave for life?
translation_verse: M làá sòoǹ kɔŋkɔnnee Leefiyatan taaŋi pu, ní kí sòoǹ u-pɔŋkpaaŋŋu nì u-nyaaŋku pu.

english_verse: Can it be tied by the leg like a pet bird for little girls?
translation_verse: Ŋma di ŋūǹ kí cúú u-wampeeŋkaati kí cátí nyɔkɔpu pú? Ŋma di ŋūǹ kí sāā kí pùutī u-gbampɔɔl?

english_verse: Is it ever chopped up and its pieces bargained for in the fish-market?
translation_verse: Ŋma di ŋúń ki cúú u-nyɔkɔ ki tábitì? Unil yaa pée wál̀ u-nyiŋŋee, dinyoondi cútí-u ní.

english_verse: Can it be killed with harpoons or spears?
translation_verse: Agbampɔɔ ikuul kupaau di bīī u-boon ki síkí ki cúú tɔb tiŋan.

english_verse: Wrestle it just once— that will be the end.
translation_verse: Ipɔkɔ pìl̄ tɔb ní ki síkí síkí áli gba kubuŋu kaa ŋūǹ kí jītí i-kansikin.

english_verse: Merely a glimpse of this monster makes all courage melt.
translation_verse: Mpɔkɔ kamaa dàb̄ ŋun dī-ŋuee ní i cúú tɔb an píkí, tiba kaa ŋūǹ kí yàkatī-i. *

english_verse: And if it is too fierce for anyone to attack, who would dare oppose me?
translation_verse: Leefiyatan yaa cíiǹee, ŋwalifi nyēē ní, ní u-nimbiin jìl̀ kii ntaafaawìińee.

english_verse: I am in command of the world and in debt to no one.
translation_verse: Aŋmilimbil nyēē u-nyɔkɔn ní ki ŋmóò an kɔkɔ pu làka laka.

english_verse: What powerful legs, what a stout body this monster possesses!
translation_verse: Nnyiim nyēē u-maŋfataabuŋyin, a lì kii daansee un tɔ́kɔ́ ŋŋmi puee, àá ikuŋkum in fōō ŋŋmi ki dùkùee.

english_verse: Who could strip off its armor or bring it under control with a harness?
translation_verse: U yaa fōotèe, akoon fòol̄ ŋŋmi ní aŋmilimbil nyēē u-nyɔkɔn.

english_verse: Who would try to open its jaws, full of fearsome teeth? *
translation_verse: Mpɔn ŋubɔ bí u-sil pu, u-nimbiinee, see tifaandi ń cúú-si. *

english_verse: Its back is covered with shield after shield,
translation_verse: Áli gba u-wunti pu laakin bí màlmalee pɔ̄ɔ̄ ki jítiǹ tikúti pu gba.

english_verse: than breath to breath. When This Monster Sneezes
translation_verse: U yaa yíkìi síl̀ee, inimbɔti fàŋkí, ní i-wunti ń kpú ní í sāǹ.

english_verse: When this monster sneezes, lightning flashes, and its eyes glow like the dawn.
translation_verse: Báà kpaca yaa gāā-uaaa, an kaa kóò, míǹ mbaantiim ní kikpaŋ nì kitàataajiki nì ipiin kaa ŋáań-u tiba.

english_verse: Sparks and fiery flames explode from its mouth.
translation_verse: Úǹ ceeyee, kukúluu bí kii timɔkulindee ní, ní tasa kúti bí kii ndɔ ŋun bùkūee.

english_verse: And smoke spews from its nose like steam from a boiling pot,
translation_verse: Mpiin kaa ŋūǹ kí yàntī ú sāǹ, ní kujaataafuŋ taŋkpal bí kii timɔkulindee.

english_verse: while its blazing breath scorches everything in sight.
translation_verse: Ditambɔndi sá u-cee kii ŋkpaŋkpaanee ní, kikpaŋ wooku mɔ̄ úǹ cee tilaal ní. *

english_verse: When this noisy monster appears, even the most powerful turn and run in fear.
translation_verse: Waa cáá juti kitiŋ pu, m náań-u ú taa nín̄ pée fàŋkí tiba ní.

english_verse: No sword or spear can harm it,
translation_verse: U kpèé ki sìŋkīǹ u-nannanliibi bin sá bikpaambee, úǹ di sá ipeecuncuti kɔkɔ bɔtiu.

english_verse: No one can oppose you, because you have the power to do what you want.
translation_verse: M nyí yii a ŋūǹ kí ŋá tikɔkɔ, a ŋūǹ kí ŋá tin kɔkɔ a lèe.

english_verse: You asked why I talk so much when I know so little. I have talked about things that are far beyond my understanding.
translation_verse: A lī yii: m sòon̄ kii ugbaanee ki bíil̀ tin a bɔ́ntì kí ŋée. Tiŋman, m sòon̄ tibɔti tin jítiǹ-mee, maa nìn gbìl̀ tì-taapu kaa nyí-tì mun!

english_verse: You told me to listen and answer your questions.
translation_verse: A nìn bí yii: «Pīlifì, m làá sòoǹ, m làá bàlifì-si tibɔti ní á kíí-mi.»

english_verse: I heard about you from others; now I have seen you with my own eyes.
