translation_verse: Tin bi nìn sòon̄ a-pu m gbìl̄ee baba ní m nìn pée nyí, ama kɔŋkɔnnee, m wál̀-si nì m-nimbil.

english_verse: The Lord said to Eliphaz: What my servant Job has said about me is true, but I am angry with you and your two friends for not telling the truth.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan nín sòon̄ nì Yoob míǹ ki dóòyee ní u bí uteemanja Eeliifaasi yii: «M gíí a-pu diŋuul ki kpáaǹ a-bɔɔbi liitil. Di sá yii naa sòon̄ m-pu ibaamɔn kii m-tɔntɔnliu Yoob nín sòon̄ puee.

english_verse: So I want you to go over to Job and offer seven bulls and seven goats on an altar as a sacrifice to please me. After this, Job will pray, and I will agree not to punish you for your foolishness.
translation_verse: Kɔŋkɔnnee, ní nyàab̀ inajaa iluli nì ipijaa iluli kí cùú ká m-tɔntɔnliu Yoob. Ni yaa bàn̄ee, ní dū tiwaŋkuti gbanti kí ŋá saraawɔkaa nimbi ni-ba yil pu. Ŋyunti gbantee, Yoob làá nīn bí ki mèé ki tìì-ni. M làá fōō u-wimmeem nì kulaŋŋaŋfitiiu ní kí taa kpèè ni-gbaandi pu kí kɔ́ǹ-ni icoo, min kamaa ní naa sòon̄ m-pu ibaamɔn kii úǹ nín sòon̄ puee.»

english_verse: Eliphaz, Bildad, and Zophar obeyed the Lord, and he answered Job's prayer. A Happy Ending
translation_verse: Uteemanja Eeliifaasi nì usuwaja Biilidaadi nì unaamaja Soofaar cūtìi ŋá kii ti-Dindaan nín bí yii bí ŋá puee. Ti-Dindaan nìn fōō Yoob wimmeem.

english_verse: After Job had prayed for his three friends, the Lord made Job twice as rich as he had been before.
translation_verse: Ŋyunti ŋun Yoob nìn bíi mèé ki tìì u-bɔɔbee ní ti-Dindaan fātìi gíiǹ tin kɔkɔ u nìn fōō u-ceeyee ki tīī-u. Yoob gaajawanti tin u nìn cááyee, ti-Dindaan nìn fātìi tīī-u míǹ mili pu ní.

english_verse: Then Job gave a feast for his brothers and sisters and for his old friends. They expressed their sorrow for the suffering the Lord had brought on him, and they each gave Job some silver and a gold ring.
translation_verse: Niinee Yoob naalib nì u-niisalib nì bin kɔkɔ nìn pée nyí-u njaminee dɔ́miń ki māntì u-pu. Bi nì u nìn kpáfì ki jíń tijin u-dumpu, ní bi dàkā-u dineendi ki ŋméeǹ-u agìń ŋin kɔkɔ ti-Dindaan nìn cáań ki tɔ́ u-puee pu. Míǹ boonee ní báà ŋma pú-u animbil kúti dikúndi diba nì sindaariya bɔmbiki kiba.

english_verse: In addition to seven sons, Job had three daughters,
translation_verse: U nìn gíti ká mbininjabiyaamu mululi nì nnimpubiyaamu muta.

english_verse: They were the most beautiful women in that part of the world, and Job gave them shares of his property, along with their brothers.
translation_verse: Kitiŋ kɔkɔ puee, baa nìn kāntí unimpu ubɔ ŋān̄ ki bàn̄ Yoob sapɔmbi. Bi-baa nìn tīī bi mun difakal kii u nín nìn tīī bi-niijab puee ní.

english_verse: and when he finally died, he was very old.
translation_verse: Yoob nìn púĺ ki kāl̀ ki bál̀ ní ki nín kpíì.

english_verse: God blesses those people who refuse evil advice and won't follow sinners or join in sneering at God.
translation_verse: Unil un kaa fòol̄ binikpitib saŋkii, kaa dìŋfī bikpitiŋaliibi tabɔbiliŋ, kaa tí kpáfí ki kàal̀ nì bibeeliliibee bí mmɔnneeee!

english_verse: ) The Way to Happiness
translation_verse: ) Nsan ŋun cáǹ unil nnaaminee

english_verse: Instead, they find happiness in the Teaching of the Lord, and they think about it day and night.
translation_verse: Ama kun tìì an niliu mmɔnnee di sá ú nīn tɔ́ ti-Dindaan marab, kí nīn kàaǹ-bi ki dàkafī bi-pu ŋwiimpu nì kunyeeu.

english_verse: They are like trees growing beside a stream, trees that produce fruit in season and always have leaves. Those people succeed in everything they do.
translation_verse: Udaan bí kii busubu bun yú mbun caŋin, ki lòoǹ ŋyunti ŋun an máaǹ bú lòoǹee ní. Bu-faati pée sɔ̀m̀ ŋma ní. Tin kamaa udaan ŋáańee bútí-u ní.

english_verse: That isn't true of those who are evil— they are like straw blown by the wind.
translation_verse: Ama an kaa bútí binikpitib míǹ báà fiii. Bíǹ bí kii tifeel tin kubuŋu yòontí ki féeńee ní.

english_verse: Sinners won't have an excuse on the day of judgment, and they won't have a place with the people of God.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti làá dāá sòoǹ kí kpɔ̀ binikpitib bɔti, bikpitiŋaliibi kaa dāa cáá mpaan Unimbɔti nib bin sá deedeedambee kansikin.

english_verse: The Lord protects everyone who follows him, but the wicked follow a road that leads to ruin.
translation_verse: Di sá yii ti-Dindaan nyí deedeedambi sàmbiyaamu, ama nsan ŋun binikpitib dèe cáǹ ŋkúmin ní.

english_verse: Why do the nations plot, and why do their people make useless plans?
translation_verse: Ba ŋá ní atimbun kpilib bíi bɔ́ntí kí já nì Unimbɔti nì ubɔti un u lēēyee míǹ? Bi nín bíi bɔ́ntí puee sá fám ní.

english_verse: The kings of this earth have all joined together to turn against the Lord and his chosen king.
translation_verse: Kitiŋ pu bɔtiibi bíi bōob̀ dikɔ̀ndi, biyidambi bíi sòoǹ kí kpāfì kinyɔkɔ kí já nì Unimbɔti nì ubɔti un u lēēyee.

english_verse: They say, “Let's cut the ropes and set ourselves free!”
translation_verse: Bi bí ki lì yii: «Yàntīmaan tí tìfī ikusaka in bi dūu bóob́-tee, kí lēē bi-baaŋi kí fá!»

english_verse: In heaven the Lord laughs as he sits on his throne, making fun of the nations.
translation_verse: Ama ti-Dindaan un kā yilpu u-beejal puee bí ki lāā-bi, ti-Dindaan bí ki bèel̄-bi.

english_verse: The Lord becomes furious and threatens them. His anger terrifies them as he says,
translation_verse: Niinee ní u sòon̄ nì bi u-ŋuul poon, ní ki fōō bi-pu mbum ní bi-wunti bíi jìkì.

english_verse: “I've put my king on Zion, my sacred hill.”
translation_verse: Unimbɔti lī yii: «Siiyɔn m-circir jool pu ní m kāaǹ ubɔti un m lēēyee.»

english_verse: I will tell the promise that the Lord made to me: “You are my son, because today I have become your father.
translation_verse: M làá lì tin ti-Dindaan sòon̄ee, u tùkū-mi yii: «Sii ubɔti, a sá m-jipɔɔn ní. Díǹ nee man di màl̄-si.

english_verse: Ask me for the nations, and every nation on earth will belong to you.
translation_verse: A yaa bālifì-mi, m làá dū atimbun ŋin kɔkɔ bí kitiŋ puee kí tīī-si á nīn kíǹ ki yì, ní kitiŋ kɔkɔwoooo ń kpántí a-yaka.

english_verse: You will smash them with an iron rod and shatter them like dishes of clay.”
translation_verse: Mpɔn ŋun a làá nīn cáa kpòotī-bee dāa pɔ̄ɔ̄ kii tikútee ní, ní á dāá nà-bi dúsi dusi kii diboolee.»

english_verse: Be smart, all you rulers, and pay close attention.
translation_verse: Kɔŋkɔnnee bibɔtiibi, nín̄ sámaan binib bin cáá iciinee! Kitiŋ pu kpootiliibi, ní yàntīmaan bí sāŋkì-ni.

english_verse: Serve and honor the Lord; be glad and tremble.
translation_verse: Ní jāam̀maan ti-Dindaan nì kufaaŋŋu poon, nín̄ fàal̀maan nì dijinjikil.

english_verse: Show respect to his son because if you don't, the Lord might become furious and suddenly destroy you. But he blesses and protects everyone who runs to him.
translation_verse: Ní gbàam̄maan u-nimbiin, an yaa kaa sá míǹ u làá gíí diŋuul, ní kí nàan̄-ni dicilpu niin! Ama bin kɔkɔ sáǹ ki kɔ́-uee bí mmɔnneeee!

english_verse: I have a lot of enemies, Lord. Many fight against
translation_verse: Daafiidi di ŋmàn̄ nlan nee ŋyunti ŋun u nìn sáǹ u-jipɔɔn un bi yíì Abisaloomee.

english_verse: me and say, “God won't rescue you!”
translation_verse: M-Dindaan, m-nannanliibi múkú m-pu tikpil! Bin yíkìi jáà nì mee wīikéeee!

english_verse: But you are my shield, and you give me victory and great honor.
translation_verse: Tikpil sòoǹ m-pu yii: «Unimbɔti kaa làá fīī-u!»

english_verse: I pray to you, and you answer from your sacred hill.
translation_verse: Ama sii m-Dindaanee, sii di sá m-gbampɔɔl ki wúń m-pu. Sii di tīī-mi tinyool ní m yaa còom̄ee m-yil gáań.

english_verse: I sleep and wake up refreshed because you, Lord, protect me.
translation_verse: M kúuǹ ki yíiń ti-Dindaan ú jòoń-mi, ní u kíiń-mi doooo u-circir jool pu.

english_verse: Ten thousand enemies attack from every side, but I am not afraid.
translation_verse: M kɔ́ ki dōoǹ ki gèen̄ áli ki dāa fīntì, di sá yii ti-Dindaan di wúń m-pu.

english_verse: Come and save me, Lord God! Break my enemies' jaws and shatter their teeth,
translation_verse: Maa fàŋkí binib kutukub kutukub bin māntìi tú-mi kí já nì mee.

english_verse: You are my God and protector. Please answer my prayer. I was in terrible distress, but you set me free. Now have pity and listen as I pray.
translation_verse: Daafiidi di ŋmàn̄ nlan nee ki tīī bilaŋgaaliibi kpiliu. Bi bɔ̀ɔ́ tibati ní ki gà-ŋu.

english_verse: How long will you people refuse to respect me? You love foolish things, and you run after what is worthless.
translation_verse: M yaa kúuǹ ki yíiń-see, á fōō m-wimmeem, Unimbɔti, sii di sòoǹ ki pɔ̀-mi! Ŋyunti ŋun dinimbinaamandi jéetì m-puee, sii di nyántì-mi. Sɔ̄ m-saai kí fōō m-wimmeem.

english_verse: The Lord has chosen everyone who is faithful to be his very own, and he answers my prayers.
translation_verse: Oo, nimbi binib nee, ni làá nīn sòoǹ ki bíiĺ-mi yéè kí tin cáá sāā ŋyunti ŋulɔŋu ní? Nimbi bin néeń ki kɔ́kɔĺ-mi fám ki sòoǹ tinyimɔmbɔtee?

english_verse: But each of you had better tremble and turn from your sins. Silently search your heart as you lie in bed.
translation_verse: Ama ní béémaan yii ti-Dindaan lēē bin bí deedeeyee bí nīn sá u-yab. M yaa kúuǹ ki yíiń ti-Dindaanee, u pílifíǹ-mi.

english_verse: There are some who ask, “Who will be good to us?” Let your kindness, Lord, shine brightly on us.
translation_verse: Ní ŋá saraabi min an máaǹee, ní kí nīn máká ti-Dindaan pu.

english_verse: You brought me more happiness than a rich harvest of grain and grapes.
translation_verse: Binib bí ki bàlifī bi-ba yii: «Ŋma di ŋūǹ kí yàntī tí ká nnaam dee? Ti-Dindaan, dàkà-ti a-laŋŋaŋfitiiku.»

english_verse: I can lie down and sleep soundly because you, Lord, will keep me safe.
translation_verse: A gbéeǹ m-pɔbil mmɔn, mmɔn gbanti jítiǹ bi nín yaa cáń bi-kpaajinti ki nyùn̄ bi-dafii bi bí mmɔn ŋun poonee.

english_verse: Listen, Lord, as I pray! Pay attention when I groan.
translation_verse: Daafiidi di ŋmàn̄ nlan nee ki tīī bilaŋgaaliibi kpiliu. Bi gà-ŋu ki búǹ awul ní.

english_verse: You are my King and my God. Answer my cry for help because I pray to you.
translation_verse: M-Dindaan, pīlifì tin m bíi sòoǹ nì see, kpèè m-yaliŋkii.

english_verse: Each morning you listen to my prayer, as I bring my requests to you and wait for your reply.
translation_verse: M-Nimbɔtiu un sá m-bɔtiuee, m yaa kūuntí ki yíì-see, á pīlifiǹ-mi. M-Dindaan, sii ní m mèé.

english_verse: You are not the kind of God who is pleased with evil. Sinners can't stay with you.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, kutaafaauee, a gbìl̀ m-neen pu. M kítí m-ba á ŋmā kí fōō-mi, ní m kíǹ ki kā ki cí.

english_verse: No one who boasts can stand in your presence, Lord, and you hate evil people.
translation_verse: Di sá yii a sá Unimbɔti un ná ikpitee ní, ukpitiŋal kaa kóò a-pu.

english_verse: You destroy every liar, and you despise violence and deceit.
translation_verse: Bilambidambi kaa ŋūǹ kí sútí kí pìl̄-si, a ná bin kɔkɔ ŋáań digaŋgam tuuŋŋee ní.

english_verse: You do what is right, and I ask you to guide me. Make your teaching clear because of my enemies.
translation_verse: Ama a-neendi din a cáá m-puee wīikí tikpil, an pu ní m ŋūǹ kí kɔ́ a-diikun. M ŋūǹ kí gbàan̄ nì dibasintil poon a-circir kɔŋkooŋŋu nyɔkɔpu kí jāam̀-si.

english_verse: Nothing they say is true! They just want to destroy. Their words are deceitful like a hidden pit, and their tongues are good only for telling lies.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, a-deedeeu puee, nín̄ kpòotī-mi, kun puee m cáá binannanliibi tikpil. Tàntī a-saŋŋu kí bíĺ m-nimbiin.

english_verse: Punish them, God, and let their own plans bring their downfall. Get rid of them! They keep committing crimes and turning against you.
translation_verse: Ibaamɔn kaa nyēē m-nannanliibi nyɔmmun báà fiii, tin pée kā bi-pɔbiliŋ poon bi dàkafēe di sá bí bīil̀ bi-jutiibi. Tibɔti tin bí bi-neenee cáǹ binib dikaakulin, ní bi-nyunculiŋ nín tábití ki sòoǹ tiŋyee sá diŋmatindi.

english_verse: Let all who run to you for protection always sing joyful songs. Provide shelter for those who truly love you and let them rejoice.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti, sòoǹ kí kpɔ̀ bi-bɔti kí dáaĺ bi-tafal! Yàntī bíǹ bi-ba nín bɔ́ntì puee ń nàan̄-bi! Jà-bi kí nyāntí a-nimbiin bi-kpitii pu, kun puee bi jáà nì si.

english_verse: Our Lord, you bless those who live right, and you shield them with your kindness.
translation_verse: Ama bin kɔkɔ sáǹ ki kɔ́-see làá nīn fàal̀, bi làá nīn pée gà ilan nì dipɔɔpindi ní. A làá nīn cí bin néeń-see ní bí nīn bí mmɔnni a-pu.

english_verse: Don't punish me, Lord, or even correct me when you are angry!
translation_verse: Daafiidi di ŋmàn̄ nlan nee ki tīī bilaŋgaaliibi kpiliu. Bi gà-ŋu ki bɔ̀ɔ́ tibati tin cáá iŋmii iniiyee ní.

english_verse: Have pity on me and heal my feeble body. My bones tremble with fear,
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, a gíí m-pu diŋuul, ama á taa sòoǹ kí kpɔ̀ m-bɔti, a fōō m-pu mbum, ama á taa dáaĺ m-tafal.

english_verse: and I am in deep distress. How long will it be?
translation_verse: M-Dindaan, sɔ̄ m-saai, di sá yii maa ti cáá mpɔn. Cáaǹ-mi m-Dindaan, di sá yii m yɔ̀l̄.

english_verse: Turn and come to my rescue. Show your wonderful love and save me, Lord.
translation_verse: M-wunti kɔkɔ bíi jìkì. Mimmee m-Dindaan, kí cáá sāā ŋyunti ŋulɔŋu ní?

english_verse: If I die, I cannot praise you or even remember you.
translation_verse: Gítiń kí fīī-mi kí líí, m-Dindaan. A-neeŋkpaandi puee, fīī-mi.

english_verse: My groaning has worn me out. At night my bed and pillow are soaked with tears.
translation_verse: Di sá yii ditaŋkpiilinee, ubɔ kaa ti téetí sii Unimbɔti pu. Ŋma di ŋūǹ kí nyɔ̄ŋkì-si niin? Báà ubɔ!

english_verse: Sorrow has made my eyes dim, and my sight has failed because of my enemies.
translation_verse: M yáliŋkì ki tin kpáàa gīī. M-siim yàntī kunyeeu kamaa m-dooŋu sù, m-nyinnyim sɔ̀ŋkī m-yikuŋkul.

english_verse: You, Lord, heard my crying, and those hateful people had better leave me alone.
translation_verse: Maa ti wāĺ tiŋan, m-nannanliibi nín yāntì m súń puee ŋmɔ́ ki bíil̀ m-nimbiliŋ.

english_verse: You have answered my prayer and my plea for mercy.
translation_verse: Sútímaan kí wàatī-mi, nimbi bikpitiŋaliibee kɔkɔ, di sá yii ti-Dindaan gbìl̀ m-siim.

english_verse: You, Lord God, are my protector. Rescue me and keep me safe from all who chase me.
translation_verse: Daafiidi di gāā kunimbaau laŋŋu nee. Kuusi un sá Beenjameen naakookunee pu ní u nìn gāā-ŋu ki tīī ti-Dindaan.

english_verse: Or else they will rip me apart like lions attacking a victim, and no one will save me.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan m-Nimbɔtiu, sii ní m sáǹ ki kɔ́, jòoń-mi kí fīī-mi kí nyāntí bin jì-mee ŋaan.

english_verse: I have not betrayed a friend or had pity on an enemy who attacks for no reason.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan m-Nimbɔtiu, m yaa ŋá tin kaa ŋān̄ee, m yaa ŋá ubɔ ikpiti,

english_verse: If I have done any of this, then let my enemies chase and capture me. Let them trample me to death and leave me in the dirt.
translation_verse: m yaa nyáń m-bɔɔ boon, àá m yaa fúkúl̀ un di ná-mi an kaa cáá taapuee,

english_verse: Get angry, Lord God! Do something! Attack my furious enemies. See that justice is done.
translation_verse: á yàntī m-nannanliu ń jà kí cúú-mi, kí tāā-mi kí kpɔ̀, ní kí tāā-mi kí ŋmàliŋkì ntamin.

english_verse: Make the nations come to you, as you sit on your throne above them all.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, yīkì nì a-ŋuul poon! M-nannanliibi díkíi gbí, yīkìi já nì bi, sii un là bí sòoǹ tibɔti nì ibaamɔnee, tūtuǹ-mi.

english_verse: Our Lord, judge the nations! Judge me and show that I am honest and innocent.
translation_verse: Kóoǹ binib kɔkɔ kí kpāfì bí màntīí tū-si, kàl̄ a-beejal pu yilpu kí jī bi-pu dibeel.

english_verse: You know every heart and mind, and you always do right. Now make violent people stop, but protect all of us who obey you.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, sii di sòoǹ dinibul kamaa bɔti, sòoǹ m-bɔti kí pɔ̀-mi, kun puee m sí deedee ní kaa ŋá tikpitil tiba mun.

english_verse: You, God, are my shield, the protector of everyone whose heart is right.
translation_verse: Sii un di sá deedee Nimbɔtiuee, sii un di nyí unil landɔkɔŋu nì kun kā u-pɔbilinee, kúntí bikpitiŋaliibi tuŋkpitiŋ kí yàntī án bútí deedeedaan.

english_verse: You see that justice is done, and each day you take revenge.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti di sá m-gbampɔɔl, úǹ di fìil̄ bin pɔbil bí diba nì uee.

english_verse: Whenever your enemies refuse to change their ways, you sharpen your sword and string your bow.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti sá un sòoǹ binib bɔti nì ibaamɔnee, ní ki ŋūǹ kí dàkà u-ŋuul baabadal.

english_verse: Your deadly arrows are ready with flaming tips.
translation_verse: Binikpitib yaa kaa kpántì bi-bee, Unimbɔti làá lòon̄ u-tàataajiki, ní kí píĺ u-tɔbu kí cīití-bi.

english_verse: An evil person is like a woman about to give birth to a hateful, deceitful, and rebellious child.
translation_verse: U bɔ́ntì u-janjawanti tin kùee, ní ki dū u-piiŋyi in fòol̄ ŋŋmi lìblibee ki páaǹ.

english_verse: The trouble they cause comes back on them, and their heads are crushed by their own evil deeds.
translation_verse: U gbìn̄ mbòó ki bàà píĺ kí sàl̄ bin kíǹee ní an dūu sàl̄ úǹ u-ba.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord! You always do right. I will sing about you, the Lord Most High.
translation_verse: Úǹ u-ba tuŋkpitiŋ fātìi gítì u-pu, tipɔmbɔti tin u bàà bɔ́ntì ki cíitì bibee fātìi lítì u-pu.

english_verse: Our Lord and Ruler, your name is wonderful everywhere on earth! You let your glory be seen in the heavens above.
translation_verse: Daafiidi di ŋmàn̄ nlan nee ki tīī bilaŋgaaliibi kpiliu. Bi gà-ŋu ki bɔ̀ɔ́ Gaati yab beeku ní.

english_verse: With praises from children and from tiny infants, you have built a fortress. It makes your enemies silent, and all who turn against you are left speechless.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, ti-Dindaan, bi wāĺ a nín sá ukpaan miŋyee duulinya kɔkɔ poon. A-yindi cáá tinyool kitiŋ kɔkɔ pu.

english_verse: I often think of the heavens your hands have made, and of the moon and stars you put in place.
translation_verse: A cáá campɔntib nì mbipɔmu nyɔŋkii ní ki cáa jáà nì a-nannanliibi. Bi-nyɔŋkii gbanti bí kii digundee ní a cáa pìintí bin jáà nì see nyɔmmu.

english_verse: Then I ask, “Why do you care about us humans? Why are you concerned for us weaklings?”
translation_verse: M yaa kpēē kutagbɔŋu kun sii a-ba náańee, uŋmal nì iŋmalbijaa in a dūu kāaǹ i-paaŋyi puee,

english_verse: You made us a little lower than you yourself, and you have crowned us with glory and honor.
translation_verse: m bàlifī m-ba yii ba ní unil sá ní a dàkafī u-pu míǹ? Nisaaleen sá ba ní aa mɔ̄ u-pu míǹ?

english_verse: You let us rule everything your hands have made. And you put all of it under our power—
translation_verse: A náań-u ki yāntì sii baba di jítiǹ-u fiii, ní ki dū tinyool nì jilma ki cíkiǹ-u kii kibeefuuliiyee.

english_verse: the sheep and the cattle, and every wild animal,
translation_verse: A dū-u ki kāaǹ tin kɔkɔ a náańee pu dibeel, a dū tikɔkɔ ki ŋá u-taaŋi taapu,

english_verse: the birds in the sky, the fish in the sea, and all ocean creatures.
translation_verse: tiwaŋkuti, inaa nì ipii nì iŋoobu, ki kpáaǹ gba ipeel,

english_verse: Our Lord and Ruler, your name is wonderful everywhere on earth!
translation_verse: nì inoon nì ijɔm nì tin kɔkɔ pée bí nnyiminee.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, with all my heart and tell about the wonders you have worked.
translation_verse: Daafiidi di ŋmàn̄ nlan nee ki tīī bilaŋgaaliibi kpiliu.

english_verse: God Most High, I will rejoice; I will celebrate and sing because of you.
translation_verse: M làá nyɔ̄ŋkì sii m-Dindaan nì m-pɔbil kɔkɔ, m làá sòoǹ a-maamaaci tuuŋŋi ŋin a ŋée kɔkɔ pu.

english_verse: When my enemies face you, they run away and stumble and are destroyed.
translation_verse: Kun ní a ŋée puee, m làá nīn gà ifaal nì dipɔɔpindi laŋyi. Yilpu fɔ́ŋŋŋ Nimbɔtiu, m làá gāā ilan kí nyɔ̄ŋkì-si.

english_verse: You take your seat as judge, and your fair decisions prove that I was in the right.
translation_verse: M-nannanliibi fātì bi-boon, bi gbéetì ki lítì ki kpíì a-nimbiin.

english_verse: You warn the nations and destroy evil people; you wipe out their names forever and ever.
translation_verse: Di sá yii a sòon̄ m-bɔti ki pɔ̀n̄-mi. A kāl̀ a-beejal pu ki sòon̄ tibɔti nì ibaamɔn.

english_verse: Our enemies are destroyed completely for all time. Their cities are torn down, and they will never be remembered again.
translation_verse: A sòon̄ ki kūū atimbun ŋin kaa nyí-see bɔti, ní ki nāaǹ binikpitib. A kúntì-bi múb kí nīn cá jaanjaan.

english_verse: You rule forever, Lord, and you are on your throne, ready for judgment.
translation_verse: Taa ti wāĺ ti-nannanliibi, kun puee baa ti pée bí ní. A nāaǹ bi-timmu ní bi súntì bi-pu kpataaa.

english_verse: You judge the world fairly and treat all nations with justice.
translation_verse: Ama ti-Dindaan úǹ kā u-beejal pu ní jaanjaan, u bɔ́ntì u-beejal kí sòoǹ duulinya bɔti.

english_verse: The poor can run to you because you are a fortress in times of trouble.
translation_verse: Úǹ di kpòotī duulinya nì ibaamɔn, ní ki sòoǹ binib bɔti deedee.

english_verse: Everyone who honors your name can trust you, because you are faithful to all who depend on you.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan sá kibalilaŋ ní ki tīī un bi wɔ́b́ee, ní ki sá kutaŋkpanaakoou dinimbinaamandi yuntiŋu poon.

english_verse: You rule from Zion, Lord, and we sing about you to let the nations know everything you have done.
translation_verse: Bin nyí-si mbaamɔminee ń nīn máká a-pu! Di sá yii sii ti-Dindaan kaa fàtī a-boon kí tīī bin nyàab̀-see!

english_verse: You did not forget to punish the guilty or listen to the cries of those in need.
translation_verse: Gāāmaan ilan kí nyɔ̄ŋkì ti-Dindaan un sá ubɔti Siiyɔn tiŋkinee. Sòom̀maan u-tunnyaaŋŋi pu kí tùkù atimbun kɔkɔ nib.

english_verse: Please have mercy, Lord! My enemies mistreat me. Keep me from the gates that lead to death,
translation_verse: Unimbɔti dátí binikpɔliibi tafal, ní kaa súntí bin bi kūūyee pu. Waa súntí bifalaadambi biilii pu.

english_verse: and I will sing about you at the gate to Zion. I will be happy there because you rescued me.
translation_verse: M-Dindaan, sɔ̄ m-saai! Kpèè m-nannanliibi nín bí ki sàantí-mi puee! Fīī-mi kí nyāntí ditaŋkpiilin,

english_verse: Our Lord, the nations fell into their own pits, and their feet were caught in their own traps.
translation_verse: án nín làá ŋá pu ḿ sīĺ Jeerusaleem nib nimbiin kí tùkù-bi tin ní a ŋá ki tīī-mi ní m bí ki nyɔ́ŋkí-see. M làá nīn fàal̀ kun puee a fīī-mi.

english_verse: You showed what you are like, and you made certain that justice is done, but evil people are trapped by their own evil deeds.
translation_verse: Binib bin kaa nyí-see gbìn̄ mbòó ki bíl̀ bi-nannanliibi ní bíǹ bi-ba jéetì ŋu-poon, kutaliŋŋu kun bi píĺee sàl̄ bíǹ bi-ba.

english_verse: The wicked will go down to the world of the dead to be with those nations that forgot about you.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan dàkā un ní u sée ki sòon̄ binib bɔti nì ibaamɔn. U dù unikpiti taliŋku ní kí fàtīí gíiǹ kí sàl̄-u.

english_verse: The poor and the homeless won't always be forgotten and without hope.
translation_verse: Bikpitiŋaliibee kɔkɔ nì bin kɔkɔ súntí Unimbɔti pu kaa jáaḿ-uee làá sìntī ditaŋkpiilin.

english_verse: Do something, Lord! Don't let the nations win. Make them stand trial in your court of law.
translation_verse: Ama Unimbɔti kpá kí súntí ufalaadaan pu, unandaan mun mákal kpá kí jēetí nnyimin jaanjaan.

english_verse: Make the nations afraid and let them all discover just how weak they are.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, yīkìm̄! Taa yàntī nisaaleen ń pɔ̄ɔkiǹ-si. Cáań binib bin kaa nyí-see a-nimbiin kí sòoǹ bi-bɔti.

english_verse: Why are you far away, Lord? Why do you hide yourself when I am in trouble?
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, ba pu ní a dátiǹ-ti míǹ? Ba pu ní dinimbinaamandi yuntiŋunee a bāal̀ ní?

english_verse: Proud and brutal people hunt down the poor. But let them get caught by their own evil plans!
translation_verse: Bikpitiŋaliibi cáá dilambil ní ki wɔ́b̀ unandaan. Yàntī bi-talinti tin bi píĺee ń fàtīí sàtì-bi.

english_verse: The wicked brag about their deepest desires. Those greedy people hate and curse you, Lord.
translation_verse: Ukpitiŋal bí ki gà u-bindi u-landɔkɔkpitii pu. Unil un jīǹ u-jutiibi puee tòó ti-Dindaan mbusu ki bèel̄-u.

english_verse: The wicked are too proud to turn to you or even think about you.
translation_verse: Ukpitiŋal nín yòontí u-ba yilpu puee, waa dū Unimbɔti ki yíiń tiba. U nín dàkafī puee di sá yii: «Unimbɔti kaa cáá mpɔn ŋubɔ.»

english_verse: They are always successful, though they can't understand your teachings, and they keep sneering at their enemies.
translation_verse: Tin kɔkɔ u yaa pée ŋáańee bútí-u ní. Unimbɔti bɔsooŋyi kaa lì-u tiba. U-nannanliibi kaa bí tiban u-cee.

english_verse: In their hearts they say, “Nothing can hurt us! We'll always be happy and free from trouble.”
translation_verse: U dàkafī u-pɔbilin ki lì yii: «Tiba kaa làá ŋá-mi, dinimbinaamandi diba kpá kí kɔ́-mi.»

english_verse: They curse and tell lies, and all they talk about is how to be cruel or how to do wrong.
translation_verse: U-nyɔkɔ poon gbí mbusu nì nnyimɔn nì tipɔmbɔti ŋma ní, u yáb̀ kí sòoǹ atuŋkpiti nì mbusu bɔti.

english_verse: They hide outside villages, waiting to strike and murder some innocent victim.
translation_verse: U nākantí ntiŋwaamu caŋin ki kù maanyiiba dibalin. U-nimbiliŋ pée cɔ́ uwɔfi pu ní.

english_verse: They are hungry lions hiding in the bushes, hoping to catch some helpless passerby. They trap the poor in nets and drag them away.
translation_verse: U náká u-balilaŋki ki cí kii gbikintee. U náká niin ki nyàab̀ unandaan kí cúú. U yaa cúú unandaanee ní ú dū-u kí ŋá u-laaŋkun.

english_verse: They crouch down and wait to grab a victim.
translation_verse: U-pɔŋŋu yaa nyāŋkì unandaanee puee, ní úǹ ń lítí,

english_verse: Do something, Lord God, and use your powerful arm to help those in need.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, yīkìm̄, Unimbɔti, yàntī falaa ń bà bikpitiŋaliibi gbanti. Taa súntí binandambi pu.

english_verse: The wicked don't respect you. In their hearts they say, “God won't punish us!”
translation_verse: Ba pu ní ukpitiŋal bèel̄ sii Unimbɔti ki lì u-pɔbilin yii: «Aa làá yíiń-mi ibeeyiin» ní?

english_verse: But you see the trouble and the distress, and you will do something. The poor can count on you, and so can orphans.
translation_verse: A wāĺ tin kɔkɔ bíi jītée, ki nyí binib bin bí digìńdi nì falaa poonee ní ki bɔ́ntì kí tɔ̀ bi-pɔntooŋyi. Un kaa cáá ubɔ ń tūtuǹ-uee dù u-ba ní kí ŋá a-ŋaan. Sii di sá ditaŋkpiibil jòońliu.

english_verse: Now break the power of all merciless people. Punish them for doing wrong and make them stop.
translation_verse: Nàan̄ unikpiti pɔŋŋu, kí dáaĺ u-tafal u-kpitii pu, ní ú wāŋkì a-nimbiin!

english_verse: Our Lord, you will always rule, but every godless nation will vanish from the earth.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan sá ubɔti ní jaanjaan, bin kaa jáaḿ-uee làá wāŋkì u-tiŋki pu.

english_verse: You listen to the longings of those who suffer. You offer them hope, and you pay attention to their cries for help.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, a pílifí unandaan wimmeem ní ki tìì-u kunyannyaau. A kpòontí a-tafal

english_verse: You defend orphans and everyone else in need, so that no one on earth can terrify others again.
translation_verse: ki pílifí ditaŋkpiibil nì un bi sàantée biilii ki pɔ̀-bi, án nín làá ŋá pu nisaaleen ń taa ti nín̄ sá tuutuutuu ki tīī u-nijutee.

english_verse: You tell me, “Watch out! Those evil people have put their arrows on their bows, and they are standing in the shadows, aiming at good people.
translation_verse: - Kpèè unikpiti píĺ butɔbu ki dū mpiin ki páaǹ kí dáaĺ kí yā unil un bí deedeeyee dibɔmbɔndin.

english_verse: What can an honest person do when everything crumbles?”
translation_verse: Tiwan kɔkɔ nyeel yaa bíil̀ee, deedeedaan gíti cáá tilati kí ŋá?

english_verse: The Lord is sitting in his sacred temple on his throne in heaven. He knows everything we do because he sees us all.
translation_verse: - Ti-Dindaan bí u-circir diikun, ti-Dindaan kā u-beejal pu yilpu. U-nimbiliŋ làaǹ binib kɔkɔ pu ní ki nyí tin bi ŋáańee kɔkɔ.

english_verse: The Lord tests honest people, but despises those who are cruel and love violence.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan di sòoǹ deedeedaan nì unikpiti bɔti, u ná un néeń tipɔmbɔtee tikpil.

english_verse: He will send fiery coals and flaming sulfur down on the wicked, and they will drink nothing but a scorching wind.
translation_verse: U làá dū amɔsiŋkoon nì farwata ŋmiŋu kí sìtī unikpiti pu kii utaa nín nì puee ní. U làá dū ŋweel buŋku kun kōō tikɔkɔee ní kí dáaĺ bi-tafal.

english_verse: The Lord always does right and wants justice done. Everyone who does right will see his face.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan sá deedeedaan ní ki néeń deedee tuuŋŋi, binib bin bí deedeeyee làá nīn bí u-nimbiin.

english_verse: Please help me, Lord! All who were faithful and all who were loyal have disappeared.
translation_verse: Daafiidi di ŋmàn̄ nlan nee ki tīī bilaŋgaaliibi kpiliu. Bi gà-ŋu ki bɔ̀ɔ́ tibati tin cáá iŋmii iniiyee ní.

english_verse: Won't you chop off all flattering tongues that brag so loudly?
translation_verse: Bi bí ki mɔ́ntí tɔb, bi cáá biibii nì nyɔɔmálmal ki ŋmàtíǹ tɔb.

english_verse: They say to themselves, “We are great speakers. No one else has a chance.”
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan ń pìin̄ nnyɔmu mun sòoǹ biibiiyee nì alimbil ŋin sòoǹ tilambibɔti

english_verse: But you, Lord, tell them, “I will do something! The poor are mistreated and helpless people moan. I'll rescue all who suffer.”
translation_verse: ki lì yii: «Nì ti-limbiliŋ nee, kun ti yaa lèe, see tí ká, ti nín cáá nnyɔmu nee, ubɔ kaa ti ŋūǹ kí tùkù-ti kun ti máaǹ kí ŋée.»

english_verse: Our Lord, you are true to your promises, and your word is like silver heated seven times in a fiery furnace.
translation_verse: Ama ní ti-Dindaan bí yii: «Bi bí ki sàantí unandaan, ní ufalaadaan tíminsí. An puee m làá dāan̄ kí fīī bin baa dū ki yíiń binibee.»

english_verse: But all who are wicked will keep on strutting, while everyone praises their shameless deeds.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, ŋúb́ unandaan, ní kí cīití-ti binikpitib nee cee.

english_verse: How much longer, Lord, will you forget about me? Will it be forever? How long will you hide?
translation_verse: Daafiidi di ŋmàn̄ nlan nee ki tīī bilaŋgaaliibi kpiliu.

english_verse: How long must I be confused and miserable all day? How long will my enemies keep beating me down?
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, a làá súntí m-pu kí cáá sāā ŋyunti ŋulɔŋu ní? Kí nīn pée cáa cá jaanjaanaaa? A làá fàtī a-kpaŋkpamboon kí tīī-mi kí cáá sāā ŋyunti ŋulɔŋu ní?

english_verse: Please listen, Lord God, and answer my prayers. Make my eyes sparkle again, or else I will fall into the sleep of death.
translation_verse: M làá nīn bí dipɔɔbiildin, kunimbaau ń nīn gbí m-pɔbilin kutaa kamaa yéè kí cáá sāā ŋyunti ŋulɔŋu ní? Bin ná-mee làá nīn jáà ki pɔ́ɔkíǹ-mi yéè kí cáá sāā ŋyunti ŋulɔŋu?

english_verse: My enemies will say, “Now we've won!” They will be greatly pleased when I am defeated.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, m-Nimbɔtiu, kpèè kí fōō m-wimmeem. Tīī-mi mpɔn, an yaa kaa sá míǹ m làá gèeǹ kí taa ti fìntī.

english_verse: I trust your love, and I feel like celebrating because you rescued me.
translation_verse: Taa yàntī bin ná-mee ń lì yii: «Ti ŋúń-u.» Taa yàntī ḿ lítí bin ná-mee ń ŋmā kí nīn fàal̀.

english_verse: Only a fool would say, “There is no God!” People like that are worthless; they are heartless and cruel and never do right.
translation_verse: Daafiidi di ŋmàn̄ nlan nee ki tīī bilaŋgaaliibi kpiliu. Ugbaan di lì u-ban yii: «Unimbɔti ubɔ kaa bí!» Baa pée nyí tiba ní ki ŋáań ntimbiil tuuŋŋi, ubɔ kaa pée bí ki ŋáań tin kítèe.

english_verse: From heaven the Lord looks down to see if anyone is wise enough to search for him.
translation_verse: Doooo yilpu ní Unimbɔti gbóoń ki kpēē binib kí kpèè ubɔ yaa bí ki cáá iciin ki nyàab̀ Unimbɔti.

english_verse: But all of them are corrupt; no one does right.
translation_verse: Bi-kɔkɔ wáŋkì, ugàntil kpá ki ŋáań tin kítèe, baa ubɔ kaa bí ki ŋáań tin ŋān̄ee, baa uniseen, an kpá.

english_verse: Won't you evil people learn? You refuse to pray, and you gobble up the Lord's people.
translation_verse: «Bikpitiŋaliibi nee kɔkɔ kaa kalin nyí níii? Bi mùul̄ m-nibul ki jīǹ, ní kaa pée jáaḿ-mi jaanjaan.»

english_verse: But you will be frightened, because God is on the side of every good person.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti làá kɔ́ǹ-bi dinyoondin, di sá yii u bí u-nib bin yú nì u deedeeyee cee.

english_verse: You may spoil the plans of the poor, but the Lord protects them.
translation_verse: «Ni gbáà ki kpìtī unandaan mákal, ama ti-Dindaan wúń u-pu.»

english_verse: I long for someone from Zion to come and save Israel! Our Lord, when you bless your people again, Jacob's family will be glad, and Israel will celebrate.
translation_verse: Ŋma làá nyānní doooo Siiyɔn kí fīī Isirayeel ní? Unimbɔti yaa láa fātìi gíiǹní u-nib bin bi nìn cúú kuyuŋuee, Jaakɔb naantiibi làá dāá nīn fàal̀, Isirayeel yab làá dāá nīn bí mmɔnni.

english_verse: Who may stay in God's temple or live on the holy mountain of the Lord?
translation_verse: Daafiidi di ŋmàn̄ nlan nee. Ti-Dindaan, ŋma di ŋūǹ kí kàl̄ a-circir kɔŋkooŋŋun? Ŋma di ŋūǹ kí nīn kóò Siiyɔn, a-circir jool pu?

english_verse: Only those who obey God and do as they should. They speak the truth
translation_verse: Ní ti-Dindaan kíí yii: «Asee unil un còom̄ disaŋkimmɔntiil, ki ŋáań tin ŋān̄, ki sòoǹ u-pɔbil poon baamɔŋyi,

english_verse: and don't spread gossip; they treat others fairly and don't say cruel things.
translation_verse: kaa kúŋfí u-jutiibi boon, kaa ŋáań u-bɔɔ tikpitil, ní kaa sìí u-nabikee.

english_verse: They hate worthless people, but show respect for all who worship the Lord. And they keep their promises, no matter what the cost.
translation_verse: Waa dū bin kaa fáatiǹ Unimbɔtee ki yíiń tiba, ama u tìì bin tɔ́ ti-Dindaanee jilma. U yaa pōoǹ kí ŋá tibee, waa kpántí, báà dipoondi gbanti yaa làá kɔ́ǹ-u digìńdin.

english_verse: They lend their money without charging interest, and they don't take bribes to hurt the innocent. Those who do these things will always stand firm.
translation_verse: U yaa pīnnì ubɔ animbilee, waa kā ki cí udaan ń dāá téeǹ-u kí páań. Waa fòol̄ tiwampɔkaal kí sòoǹ kí kpɔ̀ maanyiiba bɔti. «Binib bin bí mimmee kpá kí lítí.»

english_verse: Protect me, Lord God! I run to you for safety,
translation_verse: Daafiidi di ŋmàn̄ nlan nee. Wúń m-pu Unimbɔti, di sá yii sii ní m sáǹ ki kɔ́.

english_verse: and I have said, “Only you are my Lord! Every good thing I have is a gift from you.”
translation_verse: M bíi tùkù m-Dindaan yii: «Sii di sá man Dindaan.» Tiwammɔntiil tin kɔkɔ m cááyee nyánní a-cee ní.

english_verse: Your people are wonderful, and they make me happy,
translation_verse: Deedeedambi bin bí Isirayeel tiŋkinee, bíǹ di sá bikpaambi tiŋman, ní bi-bɔti mɔ̄ǹ-mi tikpil.

english_verse: but worshipers of other gods will have much sorrow. I refuse to offer sacrifices of blood to those gods or worship in their name.
translation_verse: Ama bin bìǹ ki nyàab̀ awaa jòońdee, bi nyàab̀ agìń ní ki kútí bi-ba pu. Man kaa làá dū fatiku kí fá awaa gbanti, m kpá kí pútí ŋi-yiŋŋi gba.

english_verse: You, Lord, are all I want! You are my choice, and you keep me safe.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, sii di sá m-fakal, sii di tìì-mi tin kɔkɔ lóò-mee, m-foolbooŋwu kā a-ŋaan ní.

english_verse: You make my life pleasant, and my future is bright.
translation_verse: A nín ŋmāntì pu ki tīī-mee fáatì-mi, tiŋman dijandi din a tīī-mee ŋān̄ tikpil.

english_verse: I praise you, Lord, for being my guide. Even in the darkest night, your teachings fill my mind.
translation_verse: M nyɔ́ŋkí ti-Dindaan un di sáŋkí-mee, kunyeeuee, m-landɔkɔjaatiŋu kpáafí-mi.

english_verse: I will always look to you, as you stand beside me and protect me from fear.
translation_verse: M-nimbikpeeŋu pée cɔ́ ti-Dindaan pu ní, kun puee u bí m-ŋaŋgiiliŋu pú ní tiba kaa ŋūǹ kí cìŋkì-mi.

english_verse: With all my heart, I will celebrate, and I can safely rest.
translation_verse: An pu ní m-pɔbil pīiǹ ní m fàal̀, m bí ŋgbansɔŋfin.

english_verse: I am your chosen one. You won't leave me in the grave or let my body decay.
translation_verse: Di sá yii aa làá dū-mi kí fá ŋkúm ń yòon̄-maaa, kaa làá tí yàntī man, a-deedee tɔntɔnliu ń kɔ́ ditaŋkpiilin.

english_verse: You have shown me the path to life, and you make me glad by being near to me. Sitting at your right side, I will always be joyful.
translation_verse: Sii di dàkà-mi dimaŋfal sàmbiki, m yaa bí a-nimbiinee, m-pɔbil sɔ̀m̀ ní. A yaa bí ki kɔ́ĺ-mee, m cáá mmɔn ŋun kaa kúntée ní.

english_verse: I am innocent, Lord! Won't you listen as I pray and beg for help? I am honest! Please hear my prayer.
translation_verse: Daafiidi wimmeem. Pīlifiǹ-mi, m-Dindaan, m bíi mèé-si á pɔ̀-mi ní. Kpòon̄ a-tafal kí pīlifì m-wimmeem min nyánní dipɔɔmɔntiilinee.

english_verse: Only you can say that I am innocent, because only your eyes can see the truth.
translation_verse: Sòoǹ m-bɔti kí pɔ̀-mi, a nyí ibaamɔn laŋki.

english_verse: You know my heart, and even during the night you have tested me and found me innocent. I have made up my mind never to tell a lie.
translation_verse: A kpēē m-pɔbil poon, ki dɔ́miń m-cee kunyeeu ki cɔ́ŋkì-mi, kaa ká tikpitil tiba m-ni. M lēē m-pɔbilin yii maa làá dū m-nyɔkɔ kí sòoǹ kí ŋá ikpiti,

english_verse: I don't do like others. I obey your teachings and am not cruel.
translation_verse: kii bin kíǹee nín ŋáań puee. M tɔ́ a-marab kaa dī bin ŋáań tipɔmbɔtee saŋŋu.

english_verse: I pray to you, God, because you will help me. Listen and answer my prayer!
translation_verse: Unimbɔti, sii ní m kūuntí ki yíì, di sá yii a làá kíí-mi, kpòon̄ a-tafal kí pīlifì tin m làá sòoǹee.

english_verse: Show your wonderful love. Your mighty arm protects those who run to you for safety from their enemies.
translation_verse: Dàkà a-nib dineeŋkpaandi din a cáá bi-puee, sii un fìil̄ bin kɔkɔwoooo sáń bi-nannanliibi ki kóò-see.

english_verse: Protect me as you would your very own eyes; hide me in the shadow of your wings.
translation_verse: Ŋúb́-mi kii sii a-ba nimbibulee, dū-mi kí báĺ a-feeŋyi taapu

english_verse: Don't let my brutal enemies attack from all sides and kill me.
translation_verse: binikpitib bin là kí nàan̄-mee nì m-nannanliibi bin māntìi tú-mi ki là kí kpɔ̀-mee ń taa ká-mi.

english_verse: They refuse to show mercy, and they keep bragging.
translation_verse: Bi cáá nnimbinaakulim kaa sūǹ isaa, ní ki cáá bi-nyɔmmu ki sòoǹ tilambibɔti.

english_verse: They have caught up with me! My enemies are everywhere, eagerly hoping to smear me in the dirt.
translation_verse: Bi tà ki kíbití-mi, bi kpáàa māntìi tú-mi. Bi pée cɔ́ŋkí-mi ki nyàab̀ ŋyuntimɔnti kí kùl̄-mi kí yā kitiŋ ní.

english_verse: They are like hungry lions hunting for food, or like young lions hiding in ambush.
translation_verse: Bi bí kii digbikintipɔmbil din bɔ́ntì ki cí kí cúú upeel kí tɔ̀ntēe ní, a lì kii upeecuncuti un náká ki cée.

english_verse: Do something, Lord! Attack and defeat them. Take your sword and save me from those evil people.
translation_verse: Yīkìm̄, m-Dindaan! Já kí pɔ̄ɔkiǹ bin ná-mee. Dū a-janjajiki kí fīī-mi kí nyāntí binikpitib ŋaan.

english_verse: Use your powerful arm and rescue me from the hands of mere humans whose world won't last. You provide food for those you love. Their children have plenty, and their grandchildren will have more than enough.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, dū a-ŋal pɔŋŋu kí jà-bi kí nyāntí binib kansikin. Jà-bi kí nyāntí binib kansikin nì duulinyan. Dū ditafadaaldi din a bɔ́ntì ki síiǹ-bee kí nyùntī-bi, bi-biyaamu mun ń nyɔ̀ kí díkí kí kíń kí tīī mu mun biyaamu.

english_verse: I am innocent, Lord, and I will see your face! When I awake, all I want is to see you as you are.
translation_verse: Ama man jandi púee, m làá nīn bí a-nimbiin kun puee maa cáá dibɔkpil diba m-ni. M yaa láa fīntèe, m-pɔbil làá sɔ̀ŋkì kun puee m bí laakin a bée.

english_verse: Death had wrapped its ropes around me, and I was almost swallowed by its flooding waters.
translation_verse: Tí nyɔ̄ŋkì ti-Dindaan! M kúuǹ ki yíiń ti-Dindaan ní u yāntì m jáń ki pɔ́ɔkiǹ m-nannanliibi.

english_verse: Ropes from the world of the dead had coiled around me, and death had set a trap in my path.
translation_verse: Ŋkúm kusakai nìn fìn̄-mi, dinàandi nyiŋgbeeŋŋu nìn yōoǹ-mi ki dóò,

english_verse: I was in terrible trouble when I called out to you, but from your temple you heard me and answered my prayer.
translation_verse: ditaŋkpiilin laaŋku nìn māntìi tú-mi, ní ŋkúm talinti píĺ ki dɔ̄ m-nimbiin.

english_verse: The earth shook and shivered, and the mountains trembled down to their roots. You were angry
translation_verse: M kúuǹ ki yíiń ti-Dindaan m-nimbinaamandi poon. M fáá mbiil m-Nimbɔtiu ń jòoń-mi. U gbìl̄ m-neen pu doooo u-diikun ní m-kuŋkuuntii kɔ́ u-tafalin.

english_verse: and breathed out smoke. Scorching heat and fiery flames spewed from your mouth.
translation_verse: Niinee ní kitiŋ fōō dijinjikil ki cīŋkì, ní ajoon nyeel cīŋkì, kun puee Unimbɔti gíí diŋuul.

english_verse: You opened the heavens like curtains, and you came down with storm clouds under your feet.
translation_verse: Ŋŋminyiim nìn nyēē u-maŋfataabuŋyin, ní aŋmilimbil ŋin nàantée nì amɔsiŋkoon nyēē u-nyɔkɔn.

english_verse: You rode on the backs of flying creatures and swooped down with the wind as wings.
translation_verse: Ní u cúú kutagbɔŋu ki cátì ní ki kpákatìń, ní ditagbandi din bɔ̀ǹee bí u-taaŋi taapu.

english_verse: Darkness was your robe; thunderclouds filled the sky, hiding you from sight.
translation_verse: U jɔ́m̀ ki kāl̀ keerubimbi pu ki ŋàan̄, ní ki dū kubuŋu ki kpántì ifeen ki kíǹ ki dàn̄.

english_verse: Hailstones and fiery coals lit up the sky in front of you.
translation_verse: Dibɔmbɔndi ní u dūu bīiǹ u-ba pu, ní atagban ŋin gbìfì nnyim gbí ŋi-poonee māntìi tú-u.

english_verse: Lord Most High, your voice thundered from the heavens, as hailstones and fiery coals poured down like rain.
translation_verse: Ŋwalifi nìn bí u-nimbiin, ní atagban jītí ki sá ataanyiŋkumbil nì amɔsiŋkoon.

english_verse: You scattered your enemies with arrows of lightning.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan sòon̄ní doooo yilpu kii ntaateenteenee, Yilpu Fɔ́ŋŋŋ Nimbɔtiu yāntì bi gbìl̄ u-nyɔkɔ pu.

english_verse: You roared at the sea, and its deepest channels could be seen. You snorted, and the earth shook to its foundations.
translation_verse: U tɔ́ u-piiŋyi ní u-nannanliibi yàl̄, ní u utaa ŋmɔ́ ki ŋmíntì bi-pu ní bi sáǹ ki kátì.

english_verse: You reached down from heaven, and you lifted me from deep in the ocean.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan tāā ki bíikì u-nannanliibi pu, ní ki fōō bi-pu diŋuul, an pu ní tiŋku poon nyim fóotì, ní kitiŋ nyeel cúu bīitì ki dɔ̄.

english_verse: You rescued me from enemies, who were hateful and too powerful for me.
translation_verse: Ní ti-Dindaan kāl̀ doooo yilpu ki tāntì u-ŋal ki cúú-mi ki nyántì inyiŋfi taapu.

english_verse: On the day disaster struck, they came and attacked, but you defended me.
translation_verse: U fōō-mi m-nannanliu un pɔ̄ɔ̄yee ŋaan, m-pulincɔntiibi bin pɔ̄ɔǹ-mee ŋaan.

english_verse: When I was fenced in, you freed and rescued me because you love me.
translation_verse: M-nimbinaamandi dal ní bi dɔ́miń ki jáń nì mi, ama ti-Dindaan dɔ́miń ki tíkiǹ-mi.

english_verse: You are good to me, Lord, because I do right, and you reward me because I am innocent.
translation_verse: U nyántì-mi digìńdin ki tīī-mi dibatɔl. U fīī-mi, kun puee u néeń-mi.

english_verse: I do what you want and never turn to do evil.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan di pàn̄-mi, kun puee m ŋá tin bí deedeeyee. U bīiǹ m-pu kun puee tikpitil tiba kaa táká m-ŋal.

english_verse: I keep your laws in mind and never look away from your teachings.
translation_verse: M nóó ti-Dindaan saŋŋu nì mbaamɔn, ní kaa fātì mboon ki tīī m-Nimbɔtiu.

english_verse: I obey you completely and guard against sin.
translation_verse: M ŋúb́ ti-Dindaan marab kɔkɔ, kaa fātì m-kpaŋkpamboon ki tīī u-bɔkpaaŋi.

english_verse: You have been good to me because I do right; you have rewarded me for being innocent by your standards.
translation_verse: Waa ká m-pu tiba kí wòoǹ-mi, ní m pɔ́ɔǹ m-ba kí taa ŋá ikpiti.

english_verse: You are always loyal to your loyal people, and you are faithful to the faithful.
translation_verse: An pu ní ti-Dindaan pàn̄-mi, kun puee m ŋá tin bí deedeeyee, ní u nyí mun yii m-ŋalii kaa táká ikpiti.

english_verse: With all who are sincere, you are sincere, but you treat the unfaithful as their deeds deserve.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, bin nóó-si nì dipɔbil dibee, a sí nì bi nì dipɔbil diba mun ní. Bin bí deedeeyee, a sí nì bi nì deedee ní.

english_verse: You rescue the humble, but you put down all who are proud.
translation_verse: A ŋáań bin pɔbiliŋ pīiǹee tiŋan, ama ní ki dàkà bikpitiŋaliibi yii a nyíǹ-bi.

english_verse: You, the Lord God, keep my lamp burning and turn darkness to light.
translation_verse: Di sá yii a fìil̄ dinibul din sīntiǹ di-ba taapuee, ama ní ki sìntīǹ bilambidambi taapu.

english_verse: You help me defeat armies and capture cities.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, sii di ŋmíntí m-saŋŋu kii ŋwalifee, sii di ŋmíntí-mi ní m-bɔmbɔndi ń wāŋkì.

english_verse: Your way is perfect, Lord, and your word is correct. You are a shield for those who run to you for help.
translation_verse: M ŋūǹ kí já nì dijanjakitil, kun puee a tútuǹ-mi. M ŋūǹ kí yùkū kí lákatí agun ŋin bi máń ki tú kitiŋee, kun puee man Nimbɔtiu bí m-cee.

english_verse: You make my feet run as fast as those of a deer, and you help me stand on the mountains.
translation_verse: Úǹ di sá Unimbɔti un tìì-mi mpɔnee, ní ki cátí nsammɔnti ki tìì-mi m còom̄.

english_verse: You teach my hands to fight and my arms to use a bow of bronze.
translation_verse: U yàntī m-taaŋi yáb̀ m sáń kii ucaŋkpalimee, ní ki yàntī ḿ jɔ̄m̀ kí tɔ́kɔń ajoon pu tiba á taa ŋá-mi.

english_verse: You alone are my shield. Your right hand supports me, and by coming to help me, you have made me famous.
translation_verse: Waa bífí-mi bi nín jáà puee ŋmaniŋma, ama u yàntī ḿ ŋmā kí dáaĺ butɔbu bun bi dū tasa kúti ki píĺee.

english_verse: You clear the way for me, and now I won't stumble.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, a tìì-mi digbampɔɔl din fìil̄-mee, ní a-ŋaŋgiil tíkí-mi, ní a nín tútúǹ-mi puee yāntì m nyáń diyindi.

english_verse: I kept chasing my enemies, until I caught them and destroyed them.
translation_verse: Sii puee m ŋūǹ kí dàatī malaa malaa, ní maa tà ki pántí.

english_verse: I stuck my sword through my enemies, and they were crushed under my feet.
translation_verse: M jì m-nannanliibi ní kí cúú-bi, m yaa kaa nāaǹ-bi maa fàtī m-boon.

english_verse: You helped me win victories, and you forced my attackers to fall victim to me.
translation_verse: Ní ḿ pɔ̀fì pɔ̀fì-bi ní baa ti ŋūǹ kí yīkì, ní ki kíǹ ki dɔ̄ m-taaŋi taapu fìlfil.

english_verse: You made my enemies run, and I killed them.
translation_verse: A tìì-mi mpɔn ḿ já kujaau, ní ki dù bin yíkìi jáà nì mee ki ŋáań m-taaŋi taapu.

english_verse: They cried out for help, but no one saved them; they called out to you, but there was no answer.
translation_verse: A yàntī m-nannanliibi sáń kukunsaŋu, ní ki nàantí bin ná-mee.

english_verse: I ground them to dust blown by the wind, and I poured them out like mud in the streets.
translation_verse: Bi kūuntí ki nyàab̀ dijòońdi, ní ubɔ kpá kí fīī-bi. Bi kúuǹ ki yíiń ti-Dindaan gba, ama waa kíí-bi.

english_verse: You rescued me from stubborn people, and you made me the leader of foreign nations, who are now my slaves.
translation_verse: M jáń ki pɔ́ɔkiǹ-bi ki nàn̄-bi dúsi dusi kii ŋkpɔŋkpɔm min kubuŋu yòontée, ki ŋàtī-bi ki féeń kii nsanni kpatee.

english_verse: They have lost all courage, and from their fortresses, they come trembling.
translation_verse: M tin pée lì yii m wàatī m-nyɔkɔ kí sòoǹee, binaacimbee tātìi gbāaǹ m-nimbiin ki kíǹ ki tɔ́-mi.

english_verse: You took revenge for me, and you put nations in my power.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan bí dimaŋfalin! Tí nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan m-taŋkpanaakooku! Tí pàkàmaan Unimbɔti un di sá m-fiiliuee!

english_verse: You protected me from violent enemies and made me much greater than all of them.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti tútuǹ-mi m jáń ki pɔ́ɔkiǹ m-nannanliibi, ní ki dū atimbun ki ŋá m-taaŋi taapu.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, and I will honor you among the nations.
translation_verse: U fīī-mi ki nyántì m-nannanliibi ŋaan. Tiŋman u yāntì m jáń ki pɔ́ɔkiǹ bin jáà nì mee, ní ki fīī-mi ki nyántì tipɔmbɔti dambi ŋaan.

english_verse: You give glorious victories to your chosen king. Your faithful love for David and for his descendants will never end.
translation_verse: An pu ní, m-Dindaan, m làá nyɔ̄ŋkì-si atimbun kansikin, ní kí gāā ilan kí pàkà a-yindi.

english_verse: The heavens keep telling the wonders of God, and the skies declare what he has done.
translation_verse: Daafiidi di ŋmàn̄ nlan nee ki tīī bilaŋgaaliibi kpiliu.

english_verse: Each day informs the following day; each night announces to the next.
translation_verse: Yilpu sòoǹ-ti Unimbɔti nyooti pu, ní kutagbɔŋu lèekī tin u ŋée ki dàkà-ti.

english_verse: They don't speak a word, and there is never the sound of a voice.
translation_verse: Ŋwiin kamaa sòoǹ Unimbɔti nyooti pu ki nàatī ŋwiin ŋun dī-ŋuee, ní kunyeeu kamaa mun bùsī kaa gbèentí ki tùkù kunyeeu kun dī-kuee.

english_verse: Yet their message reaches all the earth, and it travels around the world. In the heavens a tent is set up for the sun.
translation_verse: An kaa sá isoon poon, kaa tí sá nì anyɔɔbun mun, ditafal mun kaa tí gbìl̀ bi-nyɔkɔ pu.

english_verse: It rises like a bridegroom and gets ready like a hero eager to run a race.
translation_verse: Ama tin bi lèe bàn̄ kitiŋ kɔkɔ, ní tibɔti tin bi sòoǹee mun bàn̄ kitiŋgbeennyɔkɔ. Unimbɔti gāā tanti yilpu ki tīī ŋwìiń ŋú nīn kóò.

english_verse: It travels all the way across the sky. Nothing hides from its heat.
translation_verse: Ŋwìiń nyēē kii unimpucaan cal nín nyēeń u-diikun kutaafaau puee ní, a lì kii an nín mɔ̄ǹ un sáń kpaŋkpakantiku taatandee ú sāǹ puee.

english_verse: The Law of the Lord is perfect; it gives us new life. His teachings last forever, and they give wisdom to ordinary people.
translation_verse: Ŋu yíkí kutagbɔŋu gbeennyɔkɔ kiba ní kí yìiǹ kí tin dòon̄ kin kíǹee, tiba kaa ŋūǹ kí sāǹ kí nyā ŋu-tuntuŋkun. *

english_verse: The Lord's instruction is right; it makes our hearts glad. His commands shine brightly, and they give us light.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan marab ŋān̄ ní, bi tìì-ti dimaŋfapɔndi. Ti ŋūǹ kí nīn máká tin ti-Dindaan sòon̄ ki síiǹee pu, tíǹ di tìì ugbaan iciin.

english_verse: Worshiping the Lord is sacred; he will always be worshiped. All his decisions are correct and fair.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan bɔkpaaŋi tèen̄ ní, ŋi tìì unil pɔbil mmɔn. Ti-Dindaan marab wāĺ ní bɔ́iii, bi tìì unil dinimbiŋubitil ní.

english_verse: They are worth more than the finest gold and are sweeter than honey from a honeycomb.
translation_verse: An ŋān̄ binib ń nīn jáaḿ ti-Dindaan, bi làá nīn jáaḿ-u ní kí nīn cá jaanjaan. Ti-Dindaan marab sá ibaamɔn ní, marab gbanti kɔkɔ sá deedee marab ní.

english_verse: By your teachings, Lord, I am warned; by obeying them, I am greatly rewarded.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan marab cáá kunyampoou ki jítiǹ sindaariya, ki jítiǹ gba sindaariyamɔnti tikpil, ki mɔ̄ ki jítiǹ tisiil, ki mɔ̄ ki jítiǹ gba kisikampiŋ siiti tin bi dáá ŋmáaḿee.

english_verse: None of us know our faults. Forgive me when I sin without knowing it.
translation_verse: Kí kūtèe, bíǹ di dàkà man a-tɔntɔnliu. M yaa ŋúb́-bee, m fòol̄ tiwammɔntiil ní.

english_verse: Don't let me do wrong on purpose, Lord, or let sin have control over my life. Then I will be innocent, and not guilty of some terrible fault.
translation_verse: Ŋma di ŋūǹ kí béé yii u yīntì? M-Dindaan, dū m-kpitii in pu maa nyée kí pɔ̄-mi.

english_verse: Let my words and my thoughts be pleasing to you, Lord, because you are my mighty rock and my protector.
translation_verse: Kàkatī ikpiti in m nyí ki ŋée kí wàatī-mi, taa yàntī í jī m-pu dibeel. Niinee maa làá yìntīǹ-si kí fōō dibɔkpil.

english_verse: May the Lord send help from his temple and come to your rescue from Mount Zion.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan ń fōō a-wimmeem dinimbinaamandi yuntiŋu poon. Jaakɔb Nimbɔtiu u-ba ń wúń a-pu.

english_verse: May he remember your gifts and be pleased with what you bring.
translation_verse: Ú nyānní u-circir kɔŋkooŋŋun kí dāá tūtuǹ-si, ú nyānní Siiyɔn jool pu kí dāá jòoń-si.

english_verse: May God do what you want most and let all go well for you.
translation_verse: Ú fōō a-saraabi kɔkɔ, a-saraawɔkaabi mun ń fáatiǹ-u.

english_verse: Then you will win victories, and we will celebrate, while raising our banners in the name of our God. May the Lord answer all your prayers!
translation_verse: Ú tīī-si kun fáatì a-pɔbilee, ní kí yàntī tin a bɔ́ntì kí ŋée ń bútí-si.

english_verse: I am certain, Lord, that you will help your chosen king. You will answer my prayers from your holy place in heaven, and you will save me with your mighty arm.
translation_verse: Ú yàntī tí fàal̀ a-jajil pu, ní tí fáá sámbu kí nyɔ̄ŋkì ti-Nimbɔtiu, ti-Dindaan ń tīī-si tin kɔkɔ a yaa bālifèe.

english_verse: Some people trust the power of chariots or horses, but we trust you, Lord God.
translation_verse: Kɔŋkɔnnee, m béè yii ti-Dindaan tìì ubɔti un ní úǹ u-ba lēēyee dijajil. Doooo u-circir beel poon ní u fòol̄ u-wimmeem, ní ki cáá u-pɔŋkpaaŋŋu ki tìì-u ajajikpaan.

english_verse: Others will stumble and fall, but we will be strong and stand firm.
translation_verse: Biba máká bi-janjatɔrɔkub pu, ní biba mun máká bi-taamui pu, ama timbee, ti-Dindaan ti-Nimbɔtiu yindi pu ní ti máká.

english_verse: Give the king victory, Lord, and answer our prayers.
translation_verse: Bíǹ wunti làá kpú ní bí lítí, ama timbee, ti làá nīn yú dicancaal ní ki pɔ̄ɔ̄.

english_verse: Our Lord, your mighty power makes the king glad, and he celebrates victories that you have given him.
translation_verse: Daafiidi di ŋmàn̄ nlan nee ki tīī bilaŋgaaliibi kpiliu.

english_verse: You did what he wanted most and never told him “No.”
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, ubɔti bí dipɔɔpindin a-pɔŋŋu pu. U bí ki fàal̀ dijajil din ní a tīī-uee pu.

english_verse: You truly blessed the king, and you placed on him a crown of finest gold.
translation_verse: A tīī-u kun fáatì-uee, aa fātì a-boon ki tīī tin u bālifì-see.

english_verse: He asked to live a long time, and you promised him life that never ends.
translation_verse: Di sá a fōō-u ní ki bīiǹ u-pu, a dū sindaariya beefuuliiki ki cíkiǹ-u.

english_verse: The king is highly honored. You have let him win victories that have made him famous.
translation_verse: U mēē-si yii á tīī-u dimaŋfal ní a tīī-u, a tīī-u dimaŋfal din kaa cáá dikúntilee.

english_verse: You have given him blessings that will last forever, and you have made him glad by being so near to him.
translation_verse: Binib nyɔ́ŋkí-u kun puee a tútuǹ-u, a tīī-u tinyool nì diyindi.

english_verse: Lord Most High, the king trusts you, and your kindness keeps him from defeat.
translation_verse: A-biindi bí u-pu kí nīn cá jaanjaan, ní a nín bí u-cee puee tìì-u mmɔn.

english_verse: With your mighty arm, Lord, you will strike down all of your hateful enemies.
translation_verse: Di sá yii ubɔti máká ti-Dindaan pu ní, ní Yilpu Fɔ́ŋŋŋ Nimbɔtiu neeŋkpaandi ŋúb́-u waa cìŋkī.

english_verse: They will be destroyed by fire once you are here, and because of your anger, flames will swallow them.
translation_verse: Ubɔti, a làá cúú a-nannanliibi kɔkɔ, a kpá kí lántí bin ná-see.

english_verse: You will wipe their families from the earth, and they will disappear.
translation_verse: A yaa pée páaǹnée, a làá nàan̄-bi kii kipaai ŋmiŋuee ní. Ti-Dindaan làá dū-bi kí náĺ u-ŋuul poon, ní ŋŋmi ń wà-bi múb.

english_verse: All their plans to harm you will come to nothing.
translation_verse: A làá céetí bi-naantiibi kitiŋ pu, ní kí kúntí bi-niboolii binib kansikin.

english_verse: You will make them run away by shooting your arrows at their faces.
translation_verse: Báà bi yaa dākafì kí ŋá-si tikpitil, ní ki yaa bɔ́ntì kí já nì saaa, baa làá ŋmā kí ŋá-si tiba.

english_verse: Show your strength, Lord, so that we may sing and praise your power.
translation_verse: A làá tɔ̄-bi a-piiŋyi, ní kí yàntī bí sāǹ.

english_verse: I cry out day and night, but you don't answer, and I can never rest.
translation_verse: M-Nimbɔtiu, m-Nimbɔtiu, ba ŋá ní a dū-mi ki fá? M gbáń ibiil ki tin gīī, ama difiil dáá gbíntìi dátiǹ-mi.

english_verse: Yet you are the holy God, ruling from your throne and praised by Israel.
translation_verse: M-Nimbɔtiu, m kúuǹ ki yíiń-si ŋwiimpu, ama ní aa kíí-mi. M yíiń-si kunyeeu mun, ama ní kaa ká diŋuŋfil.

english_verse: Our ancestors trusted you, and you rescued them.
translation_verse: Too, sii mun di sá circirdaanee, a kā a-beejal pu ní Isirayeel nyɔ́ŋkí-si.

english_verse: When they cried out for help, you saved them, and you did not let them down when they depended on you.
translation_verse: Sii pu ní ti-baabi nìn máká, bi nìn máká a-pu ní a fìil̄-bi.

english_verse: But I am merely a worm, far less than human, and I am hated and rejected by people everywhere.
translation_verse: Bi nìn kūuntí ki yíì-si ní a fìil̄-bi, bi nìn dù bi-mákal kí páań a-pu ní icoo kaa jīǹ-bi.

english_verse: Everyone who sees me makes fun and sneers. They shake their heads,
translation_verse: Ama mamee, m kpántì kii ujiliŋkpaamee ní, maa ti sá nil. Binib sìí-mi ní báà ŋma kpèé-mi fám.

english_verse: and say, “Trust the Lord! If you are his favorite, let him protect you and keep you safe.”
translation_verse: Un yaa pée ká-mee bèel̄-mi ní, bi dɔ̀tī bi-nyunculiŋ ní ki gbákafí bi-yiliŋ ki lì yii:

english_verse: You, Lord, brought me safely through birth, and you protected me when I was a baby at my mother's breast.
translation_verse: «Kéè u bí yii u máká ti-Dindaan pu naa! Too, ti-Dindaan ń fīī-u tí kpèè. Ti-Dindaan yaa néeń-uee, ú jòoń-u tí kpèè!»

english_verse: Don't stay far off when I am in trouble with no one to help me.
translation_verse: Bi nín pée màl̄-mee, sii ŋaan ní m bí. Kí wàatī bí màal̀-mi muee, sii di nìn pée sá m-Nimbɔtiu.

english_verse: Enemies are all around like a herd of wild bulls. Powerful bulls from Bashan are everywhere.
translation_verse: Nín̄ bí ki kɔ́ĺ-mi, di sá dinimbinaamandi kaa dátiǹ-mi, ní ubɔ mun kpá kí jòoń-mi.

english_verse: My enemies are like lions roaring and attacking with jaws open wide.
translation_verse: M-nannanliibi tikpil māntìi gɔ́ń-mi kii inajaayee, Baasan tiŋki najakpaaŋyi māntìi tú-mi.

english_verse: I have no more strength than a few drops of water. All my bones are out of joint; my heart is like melted wax.
translation_verse: Bi wāaǹ bi-nyɔmmu bàaa m-pu, a lì kii gbikintib di cúú tinan ki làá tɔ̀ntēe.

english_verse: My strength has dried up like a broken clay pot, and my tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth. You, God, have left me to die in the dirt.
translation_verse: M kpántì kii nnyimee ní ki pùub̀, m-taaŋi kpíì maa ti ŋūǹ kí sīĺ, m-pɔbil dūntì m-poon kii nsikampimuee.

english_verse: Brutal enemies attack me like a pack of dogs, tearing at my hands and my feet.
translation_verse: M-neen kūń kii dikàlee, ní m-limbil dūu nákáǹ m-neen. A dū-mi ki síiǹ nnyiŋkúm saŋŋu pu.

english_verse: I can count all my bones, and my enemies just stare and sneer at me.
translation_verse: M-nannanliibi bin bí kii ibooyee māntìi gɔ́ń-mi, digaŋgam dambi dikitimɔndi māntìi tú-mi, bi sāā ki cíl̀ m-ŋalii nì m-taaŋi.

english_verse: They took my clothes and gambled for them.
translation_verse: M dúntì ki kíǹ akpab ŋma, ní m-nannanliibi kpèé-mi cìii.

english_verse: Don't stay far away, Lord! My strength comes from you, so hurry and help.
translation_verse: Bi dū m-wampeeŋkaati ki yākatì, ní ki tɔ́ m-bɔkutifɔkɔl pu kasi.

english_verse: Rescue me from enemy swords and save me from those dogs.
translation_verse: Ama sii m-Dindaan, á taa nín̄ dátiǹ-mi, sii un tìì-mi mpɔnee, dāan̄ malaa kí jòoń-mi.

english_verse: Don't let lions eat me. You rescued me from the horns of wild bulls,
translation_verse: Taa yàntī m-nannanliibi ń dū bi-tàataajimmu kí kpɔ̀-mi. Fīī-mi kí nyāntí iboo nee ŋaan.

english_verse: and when your people meet, I will praise you, Lord.
translation_verse: Fīī-mi kí nyāntí gbikinti nyɔmmun, kí nyāntí-mi upɔɔnaa yiŋyin. A fōō m-wimmeem.

english_verse: All who worship the Lord, now praise him! You belong to Jacob's family and to the people of Israel, so fear and honor the Lord!
translation_verse: M làá sòoǹ a-yindi pu kí tùkù m-nabiyaamu, m làá nyɔ̄ŋkì-si samaa kansikin.

english_verse: The Lord doesn't hate or despise the helpless in all of their troubles. When I cried out, he listened and did not turn away.
translation_verse: Nimbi bin tɔ́ ti-Dindaan ki jáaḿ-uee, ní nyɔ̄ŋkì-u! Nimbi Jaakɔb naantiibi kɔkɔ, ní tīī-u tinyool! Nimbi Isirayeel yab kɔkɔ, ní fàŋkì-u.

english_verse: When your people meet, you will fill my heart with your praises, Lord, and everyone will see me keep my promises to you.
translation_verse: Di sá yii waa dū unandaan ki fá u-nandaŋku poon, kaa tí fātì u-kpaŋkpamboon ki tīī-u, ama unandaan yaa kúuǹ ki yíiń-uee, u pílifíǹ-u ní.

english_verse: The poor will eat and be full, and all who worship you will be thankful and live in hope.
translation_verse: Samaa kɔkɔ kansikinee, m làá nyɔ̄ŋkì-si kun ní a ŋée pu. Bin tɔ́-si ki jáaḿ-see nimbiin ní m làá ŋá saraabi bin m nìn pōoǹ yii m làá ŋá kí tīī-see.

english_verse: Everyone on this earth will remember you, Lord. People all over the world will turn and worship you,
translation_verse: Unandaan làá jī ní kí díkí, bin nyàab̀ ti-Dindaanee làá nyɔ̄ŋkì-u. Unimbɔti ń tīī-ni mmaŋfafɔkɔn.

english_verse: People not yet born will be told, “The Lord has saved us!”
translation_verse: Bi-naantiibi làá dāá jāam̀-u, bi làá dāá sòoǹ ti-Dindaan pu kí tùkù bin dáá bíń ki dòońee.

english_verse: You, Lord, are my shepherd. I will never be in need.
translation_verse: Daafiidi di ŋmàn̄ nlan nee. Ti-Dindaan di kpàá-mi, an pu ní báà tiba kaa lóotí-mi.

english_verse: You let me rest in fields of green grass. You lead me to streams of peaceful water,
translation_verse: U yàntī m dɔ̀ kumɔsɔŋu pu, ní ki cáǹ-mi mbun ŋun poon nnyim sɔ̀m̀ fílfilee.

english_verse: and you refresh my life. You are true to your name, and you lead me along the right paths.
translation_verse: U pɔ̀ntī m-pɔŋŋu, u kpòotī-mi ki tàkantí nsan ŋun tèen̄ee poon, u-yindi pu ní u ŋáań míǹ.

english_verse: I may walk through valleys as dark as death, but I won't be afraid. You are with me, and your shepherd's rod makes me feel safe.
translation_verse: Báà m yaa còom̄ ŋkúm tantakal poonaaa, maa fàŋkí tiba, kun puee, sii ti-Dindaan bí m-cee. Ndɔ ŋun a cáa kpàá-mee di kpòotī-mi, ní a-kpandɔŋu tíkí-mi.

english_verse: You treat me to a feast, while my enemies watch. You honor me as your guest, and you fill my cup until it overflows.
translation_verse: M-nannanliibi nimbiin ní a ŋáań-mi tican. A yàantí m-yil pu talaalu kí ŋá-mi aatúuù, ní kí gbéeǹ m-yunyɔkaaku án gbí púm.

english_verse: Your kindness and love will always be with me each day of my life, and I will live forever in your house, Lord.
translation_verse: M nyí yii a-ŋanti nì a-neendi làá nīn pée bí m-cee ní m-maŋfal wiiŋyi kɔkɔ poon, ní ḿ nīn kóò sii, ti-Dindaan diikun kí nīn cá jaanjaan.

english_verse: The earth and everything on it, including its people, belong to the Lord. The world and its people belong to him.
translation_verse: Daafiidi di ŋmàn̄ nlan nee. Ti-Dindaan di yì kitiŋ nì tin kɔkɔ bí ki-puee, úǹ di tí yì duulinya nì binib bin bí u-nee.

english_verse: The Lord placed it all on the oceans and rivers.
translation_verse: Di sá yii úǹ di náań kitiŋ ki tɔ́kɔǹ tiŋkub pu, ní ki ŋúb́-kì gbīŋgbim inyiŋfi pu.

english_verse: Who may climb the Lord's hill or stand in his holy temple?
translation_verse: - Ŋma di cáá nsan kí jɔ̄m̀ ti-Dindaan jool pu ní? Ŋma di cáá nsan kí kɔ́ u-circir diikun?

english_verse: Only those who do right for the right reasons, and don't worship idols or tell lies under oath.
translation_verse: - See un kaa cáá u-ŋalii ki tūǹ atuŋkpiti, kaa dàkafī ilandɔkɔkpiti u-pɔbilin, kaa dù u-ba kí líí nì awaa, ní kaa pùtī kí mɔ̄ntì u-jutee.

english_verse: The Lord God, who saves them, will bless and reward them,
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan làá bìin̄ udaan boon. Unimbɔti u-fiiliu di làá lēē u-mɔ́ɔŋŋu.

english_verse: because they worship and serve the God of Jacob.
translation_verse: Binib bin nyàab̀ ti-Dindaan ki nóó Jaakɔb Nimbɔtiuee nín bí puee dee.

english_verse: Open the ancient gates, so that the glorious king may come in.
translation_verse: Mpunyɔmu, pìitī kí wàam̄maan! Cannaaku punuubi, pìitī kí wàam̄maan tinyool bɔtiu ń kɔ́nní!

english_verse: Who is this glorious king? He is our Lord, a strong and mighty warrior.
translation_verse: - Ŋma di sá tinyool bɔtiu ní? An sá ti-Dindaan upɔɔl nì ubaatandaan, ti-Dindaan ujanjakpil.

english_verse: Open the ancient gates, so that the glorious king may come in.
translation_verse: Mpunyɔmu, pìitī kí wàam̄maan! Cannaaku punuubi, pìitī kí wàam̄maan tinyool bɔtiu ń kɔ́nní!

english_verse: Who is this glorious king? He is our Lord, the All-Powerful!
translation_verse: - Ŋma di sá tinyool bɔtiu ní? - Bijanjaliibi Dindaan, úǹ di sá tinyool bɔtiu.

english_verse: I offer you my heart, Lord God,
translation_verse: Daafiidi di ŋmàn̄ nlan nee. M-Dindaan, m fātì m-ba ki túĺ-si.

english_verse: and I trust you. Don't make me ashamed or let enemies defeat me.
translation_verse: M-Nimbɔtiu, sii pu ní m máká, taa yàntī icoo ń cúú-mi, kí taa yàntī m-nannanliibi ń já kí pɔ̄ɔkiǹ-mi.

english_verse: Show me your paths and teach me to follow;
translation_verse: M-Dindaan, yàntī ḿ béé a-saŋŋu, dàkà-mi min a là ḿ nīn bée.

english_verse: guide me by your truth and instruct me. You keep me safe, and I always trust you.
translation_verse: Kpòotī-mi a-baamɔŋyi poon kí dàkà-mi. Di sá yii sii di sá Unimbɔti un fìil̄-mee, sii pu ní m máká baabadal.

english_verse: Please, Lord, remember, you have always been patient and kind.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, téetí yii doooo cannaaku ní a sá Unimbɔti un poon mɔ̄ ki cáá dineeŋkpaandee.

english_verse: Forget each wrong I did when I was young. Show how truly kind you are and remember me.
translation_verse: Taa ti téetí m-yìntitam nì m-kpitii in m ŋá m-naacimpɔntinee pu. A-neeŋkpaandi nì a-ŋanti puee, á téetí m-pu, m-Dindaan.

english_verse: You are honest and merciful, and you teach sinners how to follow your path.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan ŋān̄ ní ki bí deedee, an pu ní u dàkà ukpitiŋal nsan ŋun u máaǹ kí dēe.

english_verse: You lead humble people to do what is right and to stay on your path.
translation_verse: U kpòotī bin sīntiǹ bi-ba taapuee bí nīn ŋáań tin bí deedeeyee, ní ki dàkà-bi u-saŋŋu.

english_verse: In everything you do, you are kind and faithful to everyone who keeps our agreement with you.
translation_verse: Tin kɔkɔ ti-Dindaan ŋáańee sá dineendi nì ibaamɔn ŋma ní ki tīī bin ŋúb́ u-poondi ki tɔ́ u-marabee.

english_verse: Be true to your name, Lord, by forgiving each one of my terrible sins.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, a-yindi puee, dū m-kpitii kí pɔ̄-mi, di sá yii i wīikí tikpil.

english_verse: You will show the right path to all who worship you.
translation_verse: Unil yaa bí ní ki fàŋkí ti-Dindaanee, ti-Dindaan dàkà-u nsan ŋun u máaǹ kí nóóyee ní.

english_verse: Then they will have plenty, and their children will receive the land.
translation_verse: An niliuee làá nīn bí mmɔnni, ní u-nibooliŋu ń dāá fōō kitiŋ kí nīn kíǹ ki yì.

english_verse: Our Lord, you are the friend of your worshipers, and you make an agreement with all of us.
translation_verse: Bin fàŋkí ti-Dindaanee sá u-bɔɔbi ní, ní u yàntī bi béetí u-poondi.

english_verse: I always look to you, because you rescue me from every trap.
translation_verse: M-nimbikpeeŋu pée cɔ́ ti-Dindaan pu ní, di sá yii úǹ di nyāntí m-taaŋi kulaaŋŋu kun nìn sàl̄-mee poon.

english_verse: I am lonely and troubled. Show that you care and have pity on me.
translation_verse: Fàtī a-nimbiin kí túĺ-mi kí sɔ̄ m-saai, m-Dindaan, kun puee m bí m-baba ki gbí falaa.

english_verse: My awful worries keep growing. Rescue me from sadness.
translation_verse: Kunimbaau gbí m-pɔbilin, nyāntí-mi m-gìŋ́ŋi poon.

english_verse: See my troubles and misery and forgive my sins.
translation_verse: Kpèè m-falaau nì m-nimbinaamandi, ní kí dū m-kpitii kɔkɔ kí pɔ̄-mi.

english_verse: Look at all my enemies! See how much they hate me.
translation_verse: Kpèè m-nannanliibi nín wīikí puee, bi ná-mi ní an kaa cáá bí lì.

english_verse: I come to you for shelter. Protect me, keep me safe, and don't disappoint me.
translation_verse: Nín̄ wúń m-pu kí fīī-mi. Taa yàntī icoo ń jī-mi, di sá yii sii ní m sáǹ ki kɔ́.

english_verse: I obey you with all my heart, and I trust you, knowing that you will save me.
translation_verse: Tibulcin nì tin bí deedeeyee ń fīī-mi, kun puee m máká a-pu ní.

english_verse: Our God, please save Israel from all its troubles.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti, dā a-nib Isirayeel yab kí líí! Fīī-bi kí nyāntí bi-gìŋ́ŋi kɔkɔ poon.

english_verse: Show that I am right, Lord! I stay true to myself, and I have trusted you without doubting.
translation_verse: Daafiidi di ŋmàn̄ nlan nee. M-Dindaan, sòoǹ kí pɔ̀-mi, di sá yii m ŋáań tin bí deedeeyee, ní m máká sii m-Dindaan pu kaa gùgufī.

english_verse: Test my thoughts and find out what I am like.
translation_verse: Cɔ̄ŋkì-mi, m-Dindaan, cɔ̄ŋkì-mi. Cɔ̄ŋkì m-landɔkɔi nì m-pɔbil.

english_verse: I never forget your kindness, and I am always faithful to you.
translation_verse: Di sá yii maa pée súntí a-neeŋkpaandi din a cáá m-puee pu, a-baamɔŋyi di kpòotī-mi.

english_verse: I don't spend my time with worthless liars
translation_verse: Man nì binyimɔndambi kaa kpáfí ki kàal̀, man nì mpoonnyoon dambi kaa cáá nnyɔɔpee.

english_verse: I wash my hands, Lord, to show my innocence, and I worship at your altar,
translation_verse: M-Dindaan, m fíntí m-ŋalii kí dàkà yii m sá maanyiiba, ki còom̄ ki màntī nsaraafan,

english_verse: I love the temple where you live, and where your glory shines.
translation_verse: M-Dindaan, m néeń kí nīn bí a-diikun, laakin a lèekī a-nyooti ki dàkèe.

english_verse: Don't sweep me away, as you do sinners. Don't punish me with death as you do those people who are brutal
translation_verse: Á taa nàan̄-mi kii a nín làá nàan̄ binikpitib puee, kí taa kpɔ̀-mi kii a nín làá kpɔ̀ binikpɔliibi puee.

english_verse: or full of meanness or who bribe others.
translation_verse: Bi bɔ́ntì kí tɔ̄ atuŋkpiti, ní tiwan tin bi làá dūú ŋéeb́ binib nyɔmmuee gbí bi-ŋaan.

english_verse: I stay true to myself. Be kind and rescue me.
translation_verse: Ama mamee, baa kāntí tikpitil tiba m-pu. Sɔ̄ m-saai ní kí fīī-mi.

english_verse: Now I stand on solid ground! And when your people meet, I will praise you, Lord.
translation_verse: M còom̄ nsan ŋun cáá dimákalee pu. Laakin samaa yaa kpáfèe, niin ní m làá nyɔ̄ŋkì ti-Dindaan.

english_verse: You, Lord, are the light that keeps me safe. I am not afraid of anyone. You protect me, and I have no fears.
translation_verse: Daafiidi di ŋmàn̄ nlan nee. Ti-Dindaan di sá m-walifiŋu nì m-fiiliu, kin ŋma ní m làá gíti fàŋkì? Ti-Dindaan di wúń m-pu, kin ŋma di ŋūǹ kí fàaǹ-mi?

english_verse: Brutal people may attack and try to kill me, but they will stumble. Fierce enemies may attack, but they will fall.
translation_verse: Binikpitib yaa lúuń-mi kí cúú-mi kí tɔ̀ntēe, bíǹ m-nannanliibi nì bin kaa là kí wāl̀-mi gbantee di làá gbéetí ní kí lítí.

english_verse: Armies may surround me, but I won't be afraid; war may break out, but I will trust you.
translation_verse: Dijanjakitil yaa māntìi tú-mi, m-pɔbil kpá kí bīil̀. Báà m-nannanliibi yaa bíi jáà nì mi, m làá nīn gbíntìi máká ti-Dindaan pu.

english_verse: I ask only one thing, Lord: Let me live in your house every day of my life to see how wonderful you are and to pray in your temple.
translation_verse: Kuwambambaantiiu ní m mēē ti-Dindaan, ní kuwambambaantiiu gbanti ní m pée là: ḿ nīn kóò ti-Dindaan diikun m-maŋfal wiiŋyi kɔkɔ poon, kí ŋmā kí nīn pée kpèé ti-Dindaan nyaaŋku, ní kí nyàab̀ kí béé-u u-kɔŋkooŋŋun.

english_verse: In times of trouble, Lord, you will protect me. You will hide me in your tent and keep me safe on top of a mighty rock.
translation_verse: Dinimbinaamandi wiiŋŋuee, u làá dū-mi kí báĺ u-balilaŋkin. U làá dū-mi kí báĺ u-tantiu poon poon, ní kí dū-mi kí tɔ́kɔń ditaŋkpafɔkɔl pu yilpu yilpu.

english_verse: You will let me defeat all my enemies. Then I will celebrate, as I enter your tent with animal sacrifices and songs of praise.
translation_verse: Niin ní m làá nīn kpèé m-nannanliibi bin māntìi tú-mee m-yil gáań. M làá fáá ŋwiliili kí ŋá saraabi u-tantiun, ní kí gāā ilan in mɔ̄ee kí nyɔ̄ŋkì ti-Dindaan.

english_verse: Please listen when I pray! Have pity. Answer my prayer.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, m yaa kūuntí ki yíì-see, á sɔ̄ m-saai kí kíí-mi.

english_verse: My heart tells me to pray. I am eager to see your face,
translation_verse: M dàkafī a nín lī puee yii: «Nyàab̀maan-mi!» Too m-Dindaan, m nyàab̀-si.

english_verse: so don't hide from me. I am your servant, Lord, and you have helped me. Don't turn from me in anger. You alone keep me safe. Don't reject or desert me.
translation_verse: Taa fàtī a-boon kí tīī-mi! Taa gbāfì man a-tɔntɔnliu nì diŋuul. Sii di sá m-jòońliu, taa yàntī-mi, taa dū-mi kí fá, Unimbɔti, m-fiiliu.

english_verse: Even if my father and mother should desert me, you will take care of me.
translation_verse: Báà m-baa nì m-na yaa dū-mi ki fá, sii m-Dindaan làá fōō-mi.

english_verse: Teach me to follow, Lord, and lead me on the right path because of my enemies.
translation_verse: M-Dindaan, dàkà-mi a-saŋŋu. M-nannanliibi puee, kpòotī-mi kí tàkan̄ nsammɔnti pu.

english_verse: Don't let them do to me what they want. People tell lies about me and make violent threats,
translation_verse: Taa dū-mi kí líiǹ m-nannanliibi, di sá yii nnyimɔn seeradambi yíkìi jáà nì mi ki sòoǹ nì tininjati.

english_verse: but I know I will live to see how kind you are.
translation_verse: M cáá dimákal yii m làá nīn bí kí ká ti-Dindaan ŋanti binifoobi tiŋkin.

english_verse: Trust the Lord! Be brave and strong and trust the Lord.
translation_verse: - Nín̄ máká ti-Dindaan pu. Pɔ́ɔǹ a-ba kí ká dipɔbil. Nín̄ máká ti-Dindaan pu.

english_verse: Only you, Lord, are a mighty rock! Don't refuse to help me when I pray. If you don't answer me, I will soon be dead.
translation_verse: Daafiidi di ŋmàn̄ nlan nee. Sii m-Dindaan ní m kūuntí ki yíì. M-taŋkpanaakooku, taa kpáá a-tafaliŋ! Di sá yii a yaa ŋmí kaa kíí-mee, m làá nīn náań nì un sìntī ditaŋkpiilinee dee.

english_verse: Please listen to my prayer and my cry for help, as I lift my hands toward your holy temple.
translation_verse: Á pīlifì m-gbaamii ŋyunti ŋun m yaa bíi kūuntí ki yíì-si, ki yòontí m-ŋalii yilpu ki túl̀ circir kɔŋkooŋŋu watil púee.

english_verse: Don't drag me away, Lord, with those cruel people, who speak kind words, while planning trouble.
translation_verse: Taa nàan̄-mi kii a nín làá nàan̄ binikpitib, àá bikpitiŋaliibi puee. Bi sòoǹ nì bi-jutiibi kinyɔɔmɔɔi, ama ní ikpiti gbí bi-pɔbiliŋ poon.

english_verse: Treat them as they deserve! Punish them for their sins.
translation_verse: Dáaĺ bi-tafal kí nóó nì tin bi ŋée, kí nóó nì bi-tuŋkpitiŋ. Dáaĺ bi-tafal bi-tuuŋŋi pu, pà-bi tipaal tin máaǹ-bee.

english_verse: They don't pay any attention to your wonderful deeds. Now you will destroy them and leave them in ruin.
translation_verse: Di sá yii baa fātìi tɔ́ ti-Dindaan tuuŋŋi, atuun ŋin u dū u-ŋalii ki túńee. An puee ti-Dindaan ń nàan̄-bi kí taa ti yàntī bí yīkì.

english_verse: I praise you, Lord, for answering my prayers.
translation_verse: Bí nyɔ̄ŋkì ti-Dindaan, di sá yii u pílifì m-gbaamii.

english_verse: You are my strong shield, and I trust you completely. You have helped me, and I will celebrate and thank you in song.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan di sá m-balilaŋki nì m-gbampɔɔl. M dū m-mákal ki páaǹ u-pu, ní u tútuǹ-mi ní m bí dipɔɔpindin. M làá gāā ilan kí nyɔ̄ŋkì-u.

english_verse: You give strength to your people, Lord, and you save and protect your chosen ones.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan di sá u-nibul pɔŋŋu, úǹ di wúǹ ubɔti un u lēēyee pu ní ki fìil̄-u.

english_verse: Come save us and bless us. Be our shepherd and always carry us in your arms.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, fīī a-nib kí bìin̄ a-nibooliŋu boon. Nín̄ sá un kpàá-bee kí nīn kpèé-bi baabadal.

english_verse: All you angels in heaven, honor the glory and power of the Lord!
translation_verse: Daafiidi di ŋmàn̄ nlan nee. Nimbi ituun, ní nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan ti-Dindaan, sòom̀maan u-nyooti nì u-pɔŋŋu pu.

english_verse: Honor the wonderful name of the Lord, and worship the Lord most holy and glorious.
translation_verse: Nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan ti-Dindaan kí tīī u-yindi tinyool. Ní bòom̄maan ti-Dindaan nimbiin ŋyunti ŋun u yaa lēē u nín bí circir puee ki dàkēe.

english_verse: The voice of the Lord echoes over the oceans. The glorious Lord God thunders above the roar of the raging sea,
translation_verse: Bi gbìl̀ ti-Dindaan neen pu inyiŋfi pu. Unimbɔti tinyooldaan sòoǹ kii ditaadundee ní, ti-Dindaan cáá inyiŋfikpaan pu mpɔn.

english_verse: and his voice is mighty and marvelous.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan yaa sòoǹee, u dàkà u-pɔŋŋu ní, ti-Dindaan yaa sòoǹee, u dàkà u-kpaanti ní.

english_verse: The voice of the Lord destroys the cedar trees; the Lord shatters cedars on Mount Lebanon.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan yaa sòoǹee, seedir sufii kɔ́fí ní, ti-Dindaan kɔ́fí Leebanɔn seedir sufii.

english_verse: God makes Mount Lebanon skip like a calf and Mount Hermon jump like a wild ox.
translation_verse: U yàntī Leebanɔn jool yùkufī kii dinajapɔmbilee, ní Eermɔn jool yùkufī kii kupɔɔun najapɔmbilee.

english_verse: The voice of the Lord makes lightning flash
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan sòoǹ ní aŋmilimbil nyēē.

english_verse: and the desert tremble. And because of the Lord, the desert near Kadesh shivers and shakes.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan yaa sòoǹee, kuteeu cìŋkī ní, ti-Dindaan yàntī Kadeesi teeku cìŋkī.

english_verse: The voice of the Lord makes deer give birth before their time. Forests are stripped of leaves, and the temple is filled with shouts of praise.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan yaa sòoǹee, seeni sufii cìŋkī ní, ní kubambaŋŋun sufii faati gbátí. Báà ŋma lì ti-Dindaan diikun yii: «Bí nyɔ̄ŋkì Unimbɔti.»

english_verse: The Lord rules on his throne, king of the flood forever.
translation_verse: Nnyiŋgbeen yuntiŋuee, ti-Dindaan nìn pée kā dibeel ní, ti-Dindaan sá ubɔti ní kí nīn cá jaanjaan.

english_verse: Pray that our Lord will make us strong and give us peace.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan làá tīī u-nibul mpɔn, u làá bìin̄ u-nibul pu bí nīn bí ŋgbansɔŋfin.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord! You saved me from the grave and kept my enemies from celebrating my death.
translation_verse: Daafiidi di ŋmàn̄ nlan nee. Bi gāā-ŋu ki dū kunimbɔtidii ki sú Unimbɔti ní.

english_verse: I prayed to you, Lord God, and you healed me,
translation_verse: M-Dindaan, m làá nyɔ̄ŋkì-si, di sá yii a fīī-mi, ní kaa yāntì m-nannanliibi ŋúb́-mi ki bèel̄ ki lāā.

english_verse: saving me from death and the grave.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan m-Nimbɔtiu, m fáá mbiil á jòoń-mi ní a cáaǹ-mi.

english_verse: Your faithful people, Lord, will praise you with songs and honor your holy name.
translation_verse: M-Dindaan, a nyántìń m-naŋki ditaŋkpiilin. M bàà sìntī dikaakulin, ama ní a fātìi tīī-mi dimaŋfal.

english_verse: Your anger lasts a little while, but your kindness lasts for a lifetime. At night we may cry, but when morning comes we will celebrate.
translation_verse: Nimbi bin kɔkɔ sá ti-Dindaan nibee, ní gāāmaan ilan kí nyɔ̄ŋkì-u. Ní jāam̀maan-u kí lì yii u sá circirdaan.
