english_verse: You, Lord, were my friend, and you made me strong as a mighty mountain. But when you hid your face, I was crushed.
translation_verse: Ŋyunti ŋun m nìn bí tiba kaa páb́-mee, m nìn lì yii: «Tiba pée kpá kí ŋá-mi.»

english_verse: I prayed to you, Lord, and in my prayer I said,
translation_verse: A-ŋanti puee, m-Dindaan, a nìn wúń m-pu kii dijookpaandee. Ama a dāa fātì a-boon ki tīī-mee, ní dinyoondi kɔ́-mi.

english_verse: I thank you from my heart, and I will never stop singing your praises, my Lord and my God.
translation_verse: A yāntì m-kpisilaŋyi kpántì ifaal ŋool. A lēē kutukub bin m pēēyee, ki dū dijiŋaabɔkutil ki pēeǹ-mi.

english_verse: Listen to my prayer and hurry to save me. Be my mighty rock and the fortress where I am safe.
translation_verse: M-Dindaan, sii ní m sáǹ ki kɔ́, taa yàntī icoo ń jī-mi dalba dalba! A nín sá deedeedaan puee, fīī-mi.

english_verse: You, Lord God, are my mighty rock and my fortress. Lead me and guide me, so that your name will be honored.
translation_verse: Kpòon̄ a-tafal m-watil pú! Dāá fīī-mi malaa. Nín̄ sá m-taŋkpanaakooku, kibalilaŋ kin fìil̄-mee.

english_verse: Protect me from hidden traps and keep me safe.
translation_verse: Sii di sá m-taŋkpanaakooku nì m-balilaŋki. A-yindi puee, nín̄ dàkà-mi nsan kí nīn kpòotī-mi.

english_verse: You are faithful, and I trust you because you rescued me.
translation_verse: Nyāntí-mi kulaaŋŋu kun bi píĺ-mee poon, di sá yii sii di sá m-balilaŋki.

english_verse: I hate the worshipers of worthless idols, but I trust you, Lord.
translation_verse: M dū m-ba ki ŋá a-ŋaan ní, fīī-mi ti-Dindaan, ibaamɔn Nimbɔtiu.

english_verse: I celebrate and shout because you are kind. You saw all my suffering, and you cared for me.
translation_verse: M ná bin tòotī awaa ŋin kaa bí tibanee. Mamee, ti-Dindaan pu ní m máká.

english_verse: You kept me from the hands of my enemies, and you set me free.
translation_verse: M làá nīn fàal̀ ní kí nīn bí mmɔnni a-ŋanti pu, di sá yii a ká m-falaau ní ki béè dinimbinaamandi din poon m bée.

english_verse: Have pity, Lord! I am hurting and almost blind. My whole body aches.
translation_verse: Aa dū-mi ki ŋá unannanli ŋaan. A yōoǹ-mi ki síiǹ m-taaŋi pu ní ki yāntì m tɔ́ m-ba.

english_verse: I have known only sorrow all my life long, and I suffer year after year. I am weak from sin, and my bones are limp.
translation_verse: Sɔ̄ m-saai, ti-Dindaan, di sá yii m bí dinimbinaamandin. Kunimbaau ŋmɔ́ ki bíil̀ m-nimbiliŋ nì m-naŋki nì m-wunti kɔkɔ.

english_verse: My enemies insult me. Neighbors are even worse, and I disgust my friends. People meet me on the street, and they turn and run.
translation_verse: M-maŋfal wiiŋyi làá kúntí kunimbaau poon ní, abin ŋin kíǹ-mee làá kúntí diniindi digbál poon ní. M-kpitii puee, maa ti cáá mpɔn, an ŋmɔ́ ki bíil̀ m-kpabiŋ.

english_verse: I am completely forgotten like someone dead. I am merely a broken dish.
translation_verse: M-nannanliibi sìí-mi, ní m-kɔŋkɔnaatɔb kìntī. Bin nyí-mee fàŋkí-mi. Bi yaa wál̀-mi m páaǹnée bi sáń-mi ní.

english_verse: I hear the crowds whisper, “Everyone is afraid!” They are plotting and scheming to murder me.
translation_verse: Bi súntí m-pu kii unil un kpíìyee ní, m kpántì kii tiwan tin bi dūu fée ní.

english_verse: But I trust you, Lord, and I claim you as my God.
translation_verse: M gbìl̀ tibɔkpitil tin binib sòoǹ m-puee, dinyoondi māntìi tú-mi an kɔkɔ pu. Bi kpáfì kinyɔkɔ m-pu, bi bɔ́ntì kí lēē m-maŋfal.

english_verse: My life is in your hands. Save me from enemies who hunt me down.
translation_verse: Ama mamee, m máká sii ti-Dindaan pu ní. M lī yii: «Sii di sá m-Nimbɔtiu.»

english_verse: Smile on me, your servant. Have pity and rescue me.
translation_verse: M-maŋfal wiiŋyi kɔkɔ bí a-ŋaan. Fīī-mi m-nannanliibi nì bin kā m-puee ŋaan.

english_verse: You are wonderful, and while everyone watches, you store up blessings for all who honor and trust you.
translation_verse: Yàntī binyimɔndambi gbanti ń kpántí bimɔɔmiimbi, bíǹ bilambidambi bin yòontí bi-ba yilpu, ki sòoǹ ki bíiĺ deedeedaanee.

english_verse: You are their shelter from harmful plots, and you are their protection from vicious gossip.
translation_verse: Tiŋan tin a bɔ́ntì ki síiǹ bin fàŋkí-see wīikéeee! A ŋáań bin sáń ki kóò-see tiŋan gbanti binib kɔkɔ nimbiin ní.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, for showing great kindness when I was like a city under attack.
translation_verse: A cáá-bi ki bāal̀ laakin ní sii a-ba bée bí nīn dátiǹ tin binib bíi bɔ́ntí bi-puee. A cáá-bi ki bāal̀ a-balilaŋki bí nín dátiǹ binib siibiliŋ.

english_verse: I was terrified and thought, “They've chased me far away from you!” But you answered my prayer when I shouted for help.
translation_verse: Tí nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan ti-Dindaan! Di sá yii u dàkā-mi u-neeŋkpaandi ŋyunti ŋun ní m-nannanliibi nìn māntìi tú-mi kii bijanjaliibi nín màntī kí tū kitiŋ kí já nì kì puee.

english_verse: All who belong to the Lord, show how you love him. The Lord protects the faithful, but he severely punishes everyone who is proud.
translation_verse: M-pɔbil nìn bíil̀ ní m lī yii: «A fātì a-boon ki tīī-mi dee!» Ama a gbìl̄ m-gbaamii pu ŋyunti ŋun m fáá mbiil ki yíiń-see.

english_verse: Our Lord, you bless everyone whose sins you forgive and wipe away.
translation_verse: Daafiidi di ŋmàn̄ nlan nee. Unil un Unimbɔti dū u-yìntitam ki pú-u, ní ki pítì u-kpitiiyee bí mmɔnneeee!

english_verse: You bless them by saying, “You told me your sins, without trying to hide them, and now I forgive you.”
translation_verse: Unil un Unimbɔti kaa ti lì yii u ŋá ikpiti, ní udaan kaa cáá mili mili pɔbilee bí mmɔnneeee!

english_verse: Before I confessed my sins, my bones felt limp, and I groaned all day long.
translation_verse: M nín nìn ŋmí kaa bīitì m-kpitii puee, m nìn sūǹ ní baabadal ní an ŋmɔ́ ki bíil̀ m-kpabiŋ.

english_verse: Night and day your hand weighed heavily on me, and my strength was gone as in the summer heat.
translation_verse: Di sá yii ŋwiimpu nì kunyeeuee, a-ŋal nìn nyīī m-pu ki dátí m-tafal, ní m kūń kii dipeel pu wiiŋŋu nín gbáà busubu pu bu-kpiimi ń fóotí puee.

english_verse: So I confessed my sins and told them all to you. I said, “I'll tell the Lord each one of my sins.” Then you forgave me and took away my guilt.
translation_verse: Niinee ní m bīitì m-kpitii pu ki tùkū-si, maa bál̀-si m-yìntitam. M lī m-ban yii: «M làá bìitī m-kpitii pu kí tùkù m-Dindaan», ní a cúú m-kpitii nyiŋfiŋu ki nyīkitì m-pu.

english_verse: We worship you, Lord, and we should always pray whenever we find out that we have sinned. Then we won't be swept away by a raging flood.
translation_verse: An pu ní deedeedaan kamaa máaǹ kí mèè-si agìń yuntiŋu poon. Báà dinimbinaamandi yaa yíkì u-pu kii nnyiŋgbeenee, an kaa làá ŋá-u tiba.

english_verse: You are my hiding place! You protect me from trouble, and you put songs in my heart because you have saved me.
translation_verse: Sii di sá m-balilaŋki, sii di mɔ́tí m-pu agìń yuntiŋu poon. A yāntì binib bin māntìi tú-mee gà ifaal laŋyi a nín fīī-mee pu.

english_verse: You said to me, “I will point out the road that you should follow. I will be your teacher and watch over you.
translation_verse: M làá tīī-si dinyil ní kí dàkà-si nsan ŋun a máaǹ kí dēe. M làá sāŋkì-si, ní m-nimbiliŋ ń nīn bá a-pu.

english_verse: Don't be stupid like horses and mules that must be led with ropes to make them obey.”
translation_verse: Taa nín̄ sá ugbaan kii utaamu àá umamboonee. Tiwaŋkuti gbantee, tikúti nì ŋŋmii ní bi dūú kpàl̄ ti-nyɔmmu kí ŋmā kí kpòotī-tì.

english_verse: All kinds of troubles will strike the wicked, but your kindness shields those who trust you, Lord.
translation_verse: Unikpiti làá jī falaa tikpil, ama ti-Dindaan ŋanti māntìi tú un máká u-puee ní.

english_verse: You are the Lord's people. Obey him and celebrate! He deserves your praise.
translation_verse: Deedeedambi, nín̄ fàal̀maan ti-Dindaan pu. An máaǹ bin pɔbil bí diba nì Unimbɔtee ń nyɔ̄ŋkì-u.

english_verse: Praise the Lord with harps! Use harps with ten strings to make music for him.
translation_verse: Bɔ̀ɔ̀maan kubeeu kí jāam̀ ti-Dindaan, bɔ̀ɔ̀maan iŋmii saalaa beeku kí nyɔ̄ŋkì-u.

english_verse: Sing a new song. Shout! Play beautiful music.
translation_verse: Gāāmaan nlampɔɔn kí nyɔ̄ŋkì-u, bɔ̀ɔ̀maan tibɔɔkaal mmɔntiimin kí fáá ŋwiliili.

english_verse: The Lord is truthful; he can be trusted.
translation_verse: Di sá yii ti-Dindaan bɔti tèen̄ ní, bi ŋūǹ kí nīn máká u-tuuŋŋi kɔkɔ pu.

english_verse: He loves justice and fairness, and he is kind to everyone everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: U néeń tin sá deedee nì mbaamɔnee. Ti-Dindaan ŋanti gbí kitiŋ kɔkɔ.

english_verse: The Lord made the heavens and everything in them by his word.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan nyɔɔbundi ní u dūu náań kutagbɔŋu, ní ki sòon̄ ní tin kɔkɔ bí ku-puee nyáń.

english_verse: He scooped up the ocean and stored the water.
translation_verse: U kóoǹ amɔɔ nyim ki kpáfì dibɔɔbaantiil, ní ki cúú tiŋku nyiŋkpaammi ki kpáafì.

english_verse: Everyone in this world should worship and honor the Lord!
translation_verse: Kitiŋ kɔkɔ nib ń fàŋkì ti-Dindaan, duulinya nib kɔkɔ ń nīn tɔ́-u.

english_verse: As soon as he spoke the world was created; at his command, the earth was formed.
translation_verse: Úǹ di sòon̄ ní an ŋá u nín lī puee, úǹ di tīī mara ní tiwan kɔkɔ nyáń.

english_verse: The Lord destroys the plans and spoils the schemes of the nations.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan yāntì tin atimbun nib bàà bɔ́ntì kí ŋée ŋá fám. U kpītì tin bi bàà dākafì kí ŋée.

english_verse: But what the Lord has planned will stand forever. His thoughts never change.
translation_verse: Tin ti-Dindaan bɔ́ntì kí ŋée bí ní kí nīn cá jaanjaan, ní tin u dākafì kí ŋée bí kí nīn cá abin abin.

english_verse: The Lord blesses each nation that worships only him. He blesses his chosen ones.
translation_verse: Ditimbundi din Nimbɔtiu sá ti-Dindaanee bí mmɔnneeee! Dinibul din u lēē dí nīn sá u-gaajawantee bí mmɔnni!

english_verse: The Lord looks at the world
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan bíń doooo yilpu ní ki kpèé ki wāĺ binib kɔkɔ.

english_verse: from his throne in heaven, and he watches us all.
translation_verse: U kāń u-beejal pu ní u-nimbil làaǹ bin kɔkɔ bí kitiŋ puee pu.

english_verse: The Lord gave us each a mind, and nothing we do can be hidden from him.
translation_verse: Úǹ di náań bi-kɔkɔ pɔbil, u nyí tin bi ŋáańee kɔkɔ.

english_verse: Mighty armies alone cannot win wars for a king; great strength by itself cannot keep a soldier safe.
translation_verse: An kaa sá ubɔti janjaliibi nín pɔ̄ɔ̄yee pu ní u kāntí dijajil, kaa tí sá ubaatandaan kpabil pu ní u jáà ki pɔ́ɔkíǹ u-nannanliu.

english_verse: In war the strength of a horse cannot be trusted to take you to safety.
translation_verse: Kujaau taamui kaa tìì dijajil, i-pɔŋkpaaŋŋu kaa fìil̄.

english_verse: But the Lord watches over all who honor him and trust his kindness.
translation_verse: Ama ti-Dindaan nimbil bá bin fàŋkí-uee, nì bin máká u-neeŋkpaandee pu.

english_verse: He protects them from death and starvation.
translation_verse: U fìil̄-bi ŋkúm ŋaan ní ki kpīintí-bi ŋkùm yuntiŋu.

english_verse: We depend on you, Lord, to help and protect us.
translation_verse: Timbee, ti máká ti-Dindaan pu ní. Úǹ di tútúǹ-ti ní ki sá-ti digbampɔɔl.

english_verse: You make our hearts glad because we trust you, the only God.
translation_verse: Úǹ di yì-tì ní ti cáá dipɔɔpindi, ní ti máká u-circir yindi pu.

english_verse: Be kind and bless us! We depend on you.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, yàntī a-neeŋkpaandi ń nīn bí ti-pu kii timbi nín máká a-pu puee.

english_verse: With all my heart, I will praise the Lord. Let all who are helpless, listen and be glad.
translation_verse: M làá nyɔ̄ŋkì ti-Dindaan ŋyunti kamaa, u-nyɔŋkii làá nīn pée kā m-nyɔkɔn ní.

english_verse: Honor the Lord with me! Celebrate his great name.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan pu ní m làá nīn fàal̀. Bin sīntiǹ bi-ba taapuee ń pīlifì kí nīn fàal̀.

english_verse: I asked the Lord for help, and he saved me from all my fears.
translation_verse: Kūtìmaan m-pu tí lì yii u sá ukpaan. Càmaan dicilpuee tí yòon̄ u-yindi yilpu.

english_verse: Keep your eyes on the Lord! You will shine like the sun and never blush with shame.
translation_verse: M mēē ti-Dindaan ní u kíí-mi, u fīī-mi ki nyántì tin m fàŋkée kɔkɔ poon.

english_verse: I was a nobody, but I prayed, and the Lord saved me from all my troubles.
translation_verse: Bin kpèé u-watil púee bí dipɔɔpindin, icoo pée gíti kpá kí jī-bi.

english_verse: If you honor the Lord, his angel will protect you.
translation_verse: Unandaan fáá mbiil ní ti-Dindaan gbìl̄, ní ki fīī-u ki nyántì u-gìŋ́ŋi kɔkɔ poon.

english_verse: Discover for yourself that the Lord is kind. Come to him for protection, and you will be glad.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan tuuŋyi māntìi tú bin fàŋkí-uee, ní ki fìil̄-bi.

english_verse: Honor the Lord! You are his special people. No one who honors the Lord will ever be in need.
translation_verse: Ní dáań kí kpèè ti-Dindaan nín ŋān̄ puee. Un sáǹ ki kɔ́-uee bí mmɔnneeee!

english_verse: Young lions may go hungry or even starve, but if you trust the Lord, you will never miss out on anything good.
translation_verse: Ní fàŋkìmaan ti-Dindaan, nimbi bin sá u-yabee, di sá yii tiba kaa lóotí bin fàŋkí-uee.

english_verse: Come, my children, listen as I teach you to respect the Lord.
translation_verse: Tijin ŋūǹ kí lóó digbikintipɔmbil ŋkùm ń cúú-dì, ama tiba kaa lóotí bin nyàab̀ ti-Dindaanee.

english_verse: Do you want to live and enjoy a long life?
translation_verse: M-biyaamu, dāam̄maan kí pīlifì-mi, m làá dàkà-ni ní nīn fàŋkí ti-Dindaan.

english_verse: Then don't say cruel things and don't tell lies.
translation_verse: A là kí nīn bí dimaŋfalinaaa? A là mmaŋfafɔkɔn kí nīn bí mmɔnnaaa?

english_verse: Do good instead of evil and try to live at peace.
translation_verse: Cúú a-limbil kí taa sòoǹ tibɔkpitil, kí ŋúb́ a-nyɔkɔ kí taa mɔ̄ntì.

english_verse: If you obey the Lord, he will watch over you and answer your prayers.
translation_verse: Fàtī a-boon kí tīī ikpiti, kí ŋá tiŋan, nyàab̀ ŋgbansɔŋfi kí nīn ŋúb́ an píkí.

english_verse: But God despises evil people, and he will wipe them all from the earth, till they are forgotten.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan nimbil làaǹ deedeedambi pu, ní u-tafal gbàkā ki pílifí bi-biilii.

english_verse: When his people pray for help, he listens and rescues them from their troubles.
translation_verse: Ama ti-Dindaan kaa gèetíǹ bikpitiŋaliibi, u làá kpìtī bi-yiŋŋi kitiŋ pu.

english_verse: The Lord is there to rescue all who are discouraged and have given up hope.
translation_verse: Deedeedambi yaa gbáń ibiil ki yíiń ti-Dindaanee, u gbìl̀ ní ki nyāntí-bi bi-gìŋ́ŋi kɔkɔ poon.

english_verse: The Lord's people may suffer a lot, but he will always bring them safely through.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan bí ki pìlīǹ bin pɔbiliŋ bíil̀ee, ní ki fìil̄ bin kaa ti cáá dimákalee.

english_verse: Not one of their bones will ever be broken.
translation_verse: Deedeedaan kóò agìń tikpil poon, ama ti-Dindaan di nyāntí-u ŋi-kɔkɔ poon.

english_verse: The Lord saves the lives of his servants. Run to him for protection, and you won't be punished.
translation_verse: Unikpiti kpitii di làá kpɔ̀-u, Unimbɔti làá dáaĺ bin ná deedeedambee tafal.

english_verse: Shield me and help me.
translation_verse: Yòon̄ agbampɔɔ kiwaai nì dikpaandi, kí dāan̄ kí jòoń-mi.

english_verse: Aim your spear at everyone who hunts me down, but promise to save me.
translation_verse: Yòon̄ kikpaŋ nì kicɔkɔ kí kíntí bin bíi jì-mee. Tùkù-mi yii: «Man di làá fīī-si».

english_verse: Let all who want to kill me be disgraced and put to shame. Chase away and confuse all who plan to harm me.
translation_verse: Bin nyàab̀ kí kpɔ̀-mee, yàntī icoo ń cúú-bi bí fá bi-jilimau! Bin dàkafī m-pu tikpitilee, yàntī bí tūlifì bi-boon nì icoo.

english_verse: Send your angel after them and let them be like straw in the wind.
translation_verse: Yàntī ti-Dindaan tuuŋŋu yaa bīī bi-boon ki jì-bee, bí nīn bí kii tifeel tin kubuŋu yòontí ki féeńee.

english_verse: Make them run in the dark on a slippery road, as your angel chases them.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan tuuŋŋu yaa bíi jì-bee, bi-saŋŋu ń kpántí dibɔmbɔndi nì dijɔnjɔndi.

english_verse: I did them no harm, but they hid a net to trap me, and they dug a deep pit to catch and kill me.
translation_verse: Maa ŋá tiba ní bi gbìn̄ mbòó ki dū kulaaŋŋu ki píĺ yilpu, maa ŋá tiba ní bi gbìn̄ mbòó m-pu.

english_verse: Surprise them with disaster! Trap them in their own nets and let them fall and rot in the pits they have dug.
translation_verse: Yàntī nnaabukpaan ŋubɔ ń jēetí bi-pu dicilpu dicilpu! Yàntī kulaaŋŋu kun bi píĺee ń fàtīí sàl̄-bi, ní nnaabukpaanee ń nàan̄-bi.

english_verse: I will celebrate and be joyful because you, Lord, have saved me.
translation_verse: Niinee m làá dāá fàal̀ ti-Dindaan pu, án làá dāá nīn mɔ̄ǹ-mi, kun puee u fīī-mi.

english_verse: Every bone in my body will shout: “No one is like the Lord!” You protect the helpless from those in power; you save the poor and needy from those who hurt them.
translation_verse: M làá lì nì m-pɔbil kɔkɔ yii: «Ti-Dindaan, ŋma di bí kii sisee? Sii un fìil̄ uwɔfi un pɔ̄ɔǹ-uee ŋaan, ní ki fìil̄ unandaan nì ufalaadaan un mùul̄-uee ŋaanee.»

english_verse: Liars accuse me of crimes I know nothing about.
translation_verse: Nnyimɔn seeradambi yíkìi kāl̀ m-pu ki bàlifī-mi tibɔti tin pu maa kpáàa nyée.

english_verse: They repay evil for good, and I feel all alone.
translation_verse: M yaa ŋá-bi tiŋanee, tikpitil ní bi dù kí téeǹ-mi, bi-kɔkɔ dū-mi ki fá.

english_verse: When they were sick, I wore sackcloth and went without food. I truly prayed for them,
translation_verse: Bi nín nìn būǹee, m nìn dū kutuku ní ki pēeǹ kí dàkà m-nimbaaku. M nìn bōob̀ kinyɔkɔ ní ki mèé kaa gbèentí,

english_verse: as I would for a friend or a relative. I was in sorrow and mourned, as I would for my mother.
translation_verse: a lì kii m-bɔɔ àá m-nabiki yaa būǹ m nín ŋáań puee. M nìn còom̄ ní ki tīī ní ki sūǹ kii m-na di kpíìyee.

english_verse: I have stumbled, and worthless liars I don't even know surround me and sneer.
translation_verse: Ama ŋyunti ŋun m lítèe, bíǹ māntìi tú-mi ní ki fàal̀. Bi māntìi tú-mi kí já nì mi. Binicambi bin maa nyée kúŋfí m-boon kaa gbèentí.

english_verse: Worthless people make fun and never stop laughing.
translation_verse: Bi bèel̄-mi ní kaa gbèentí, ní ki gbìitī bi-nyiŋŋi m-pu.

english_verse: But all you do is watch! When will you do something? Save me from the attack of those vicious lions.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, a làá nīn kā ki kpèé kí cáá sāā ŋyunti ŋulɔŋu ní? Fīī-mi kí nyāntí dinimbinaamandi nee poon, kí nyāntí agbikintipɔmbil nee ŋaan.

english_verse: And when your people meet, I will praise you and thank you, Lord, in front of them all.
translation_verse: M làá jāam̀-si samaa kansikin, diniwul kansikinee, m làá nyɔ̄ŋkì-si.

english_verse: Don't let my brutal enemies be glad because of me. They hate me for no reason. Don't let them wink behind my back.
translation_verse: Taa yàntī bin ná-mi fámee ń nīn fàal̀ m-pu. Taa yàntī bin kaa là kí wāl̀-mee ń nīn kábití tɔb ki lāā.

english_verse: They say hurtful things, and they lie to people who want to live in peace.
translation_verse: Di sá yii baa sòoǹ nì unil ŋgbansɔŋfi poon, ama bi kúŋfí binib bin bí ŋgbansɔŋfin kitiŋ nee puee boon ní.

english_verse: They are quick to accuse me. They say, “You did it! We saw you ourselves.”
translation_verse: Bi wāaǹ bi-nyɔmmu bàaa m-pu ki lī yii: «Ti-nimbil baasii ká-u ní!»

english_verse: You see everything, Lord! Please don't keep silent or stay so far away.
translation_verse: Ama sii ti-Dindaan ká tin jítèe, taa nín̄ kā ki ŋmí. Ti-Dindaan, taa nín̄ dátiǹ-mi.

english_verse: Fight to defend me, Lord God,
translation_verse: Yīkì kí sòoǹ kí pɔ̀-mi, m-Nimbɔtiu, yīkì kí mɔ̄tì m-pu, m-Dindaan.

english_verse: and prove that I am right by your standards. Don't let them laugh at me
translation_verse: A-deedeeu puee, pɔ̀-mi ti-Dindaan, m-Nimbɔtiu, taa yàntī bí nīn fàal̀ m-pu.

english_verse: or say to each other, “Now we've got what we want! We'll gobble him up!”
translation_verse: Taa yàntī bí lì bi-pɔbilin yii: «Toooo! ti nín là puee sèé,» kí taa yàntī bí lì yii: «Ti dū-u ki náĺ.»

english_verse: Disappoint and confuse all who are glad to see me in trouble; disgrace and embarrass my proud enemies who say to me, “You are nothing!”
translation_verse: Yàntī icoo ń cúú bin kɔkɔ fàal̀ m-nimbinaamandi poonee! Yàntī icoo ń kɔ́ bin dàkafī yii bi jítiǹ-mee bí fá bi-jilimau.

english_verse: Let all who want me to win be happy and joyful. From now on let them say, “The Lord is wonderful! God is glad when all goes well for his servant.”
translation_verse: Ama yàntī bin là kí ká yii bi pɔ̀n̄-mee ń nīn bí mmɔn nì dipɔɔpindin. Yàntī bí nīn lì ki bùsī yii: «Ti-Dindaan sá ukpaan. An mɔ̄ǹ-u ú ŋá u-tɔntɔnliu tiŋan.»

english_verse: Then I will shout all day, “Praise the Lord God! He did what was right.”
translation_verse: M làá nīn sòoǹ a-deedeeu pu, ní kí nīn nyɔ́ŋkí-si baabadal.

english_verse: Sinners don't respect God; sin is all they think about.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan tɔntɔnliu Daafiidi di ŋmàn̄ nlan nee ki tīī bilaŋgaaliibi kpiliu.

english_verse: They like themselves too much to hate their own sins or even to see them.
translation_verse: M téetí ukpitiŋal nyɔɔbuŋkpitiŋ pu, úǹ ceeyee, á nīn fàŋkí Unimbɔtee kaa cáá taapu.

english_verse: They tell deceitful lies, and they don't have the sense to live right.
translation_verse: Di sá yii u cáǹ u-ba ŋkpaamin, an puee waa ŋūǹ kí ká ikpiti iba u-ni kí nīn ná-i.

english_verse: Those people stay awake, thinking up mischief, and they follow the wrong road, refusing to turn from sin.
translation_verse: Ikpiti nì inyimɔn nyɔɔbuŋŋi ŋma di nyēē u-nyɔkɔn, waa ti nyí tin bi yíì tiŋan diŋálee.

english_verse: Your love is faithful, Lord, and even the clouds in the sky can depend on you.
translation_verse: U yaa dɔ̄ u-dooŋu puee, tibɔkpitil ŋma ní u dàkafī. U tàkā nsaŋkpiti pu, waa yíití ikpiti.

english_verse: Your love is a treasure, and everyone finds shelter in the shadow of your wings.
translation_verse: A-deedeeu fɔ̀kɔ̀ ki jítì ajoofɔkɔ pu, ní a nín sòoǹ binib bɔti nì ibaamɔn puee nyóò kii nnyimbuuŋkpaanee. Ti-Dindaan, a fìil̄ binib nì tiwaŋkuti.

english_verse: You give your guests a feast in your house, and you serve a tasty drink that flows like a river.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti, a-neeŋkpaandi cáá kunyampooueeee! Binib sáń ki kóò a-feeŋyi booŋŋu taapu.

english_verse: The life-giving fountain belongs to you, and your light gives light to each of us.
translation_verse: A gbēentí-bi a-diikun gaajawanti, ní ki yàntī bi nyù a-ŋanti tin pùub̀ kii mbunee.

english_verse: Our Lord, keep showing love to everyone who knows you, and use your power to save all whose thoughts please you.
translation_verse: Sii di tīī tiwan tin kɔkɔ bée dimaŋfal, a-walfiŋun ní ti kāntí ŋwalifi.

english_verse: Don't let those proud and merciless people kick me around or chase me away.
translation_verse: Nín̄ gbíntìi nìkì ki néeń bin nyí-see, ní kí nīn ŋáań bin pɔbiliŋ bí diba nì see tiŋan.

english_verse: Look at those wicked people! They are knocked down, never to get up again.
translation_verse: Taa yàntī ulambidaan ń kɔ́nní m-pu, kí taa yàntī unikpiti ń jà-mi ḿ sāǹ.

english_verse: Don't be annoyed by anyone who does wrong, and don't envy them.
translation_verse: Daafiidi di ŋmàn̄ nlan nee. Taa gíí binikpitib pu diŋuul, taa nín̄ cáá bikpitiŋaliibi pu nnimbitaataam.

english_verse: Trust the Lord and live right! The land will be yours, and you will be safe.
translation_verse: Nín̄ máká ti-Dindaan pu kí nīn ŋáań tiŋan, mimmee a làá kàl̄ kitiŋ nee pu nì ŋgbansɔŋfi.

english_verse: Do what the Lord wants, and he will give you your heart's desire.
translation_verse: An nīn mɔ̄ǹ-si ti-Dindaan pu, ní ú tīī-si kun a-pɔbil fáatèe.

english_verse: Let the Lord lead you and trust him to help.
translation_verse: Dū a-bɔti kɔkɔ kí ŋá ti-Dindaan ŋaan, nín̄ máká u-pu, u làá ŋá kí tīī-si.

english_verse: Then it will be as clear as the noonday sun that you were right.
translation_verse: U làá yàntī a-deedeeu ń nyā kí páań kii ŋwiinee, ní binib ń ká a-baamɔŋyi kuwiŋkaŋu pu.

english_verse: Be patient and trust the Lord. Don't let it bother you when all goes well for those who do sinful things.
translation_verse: Ŋmīĺ fɔ́ŋfɔŋ ti-Dindaan nimbiin kí nīn máká u-pu. Taa gíí unil un an bútèe nì un mùul̀ee pu diŋuul.

english_verse: Don't be angry or furious. Anger can lead to sin.
translation_verse: Yàntī diŋuul, fá mbum. Taa gíí diŋuul, án làá yàntī á ŋá ikpiti.

english_verse: All sinners will disappear, but if you trust the Lord, the land will be yours.
translation_verse: Di sá yii Unimbɔti làá kpɔ̀ kí céetí bikpitiŋaliibi, ama bin máká ti-Dindaan puee di làá fōō kitiŋ kin u pōoǹ-bee kí nīn kíǹ ki yì.

english_verse: but the poor will take the land and enjoy a big harvest.
translation_verse: Ama bin sīntiǹ bi-ba taapuee làá dāá fōō kitiŋ kí nīn kíǹ ki yì, ní kí nīn bí ŋgbansɔŋfin mmɔm.

english_verse: Merciless people make plots against good people and snarl like animals,
translation_verse: Unikpiti dàkafī deedeedaan pu tibɔkpitil ní ki gbìitī u-pu anyin.

english_verse: but the Lord laughs and knows their time is coming soon.
translation_verse: Ama ní ti-Dindaan lāā-u, di sá yii ŋwiin ŋun u làá dáaĺ u-tafalee tóobiń.

english_verse: The wicked kill with swords and shoot arrows to murder the poor and the needy and all who do right.
translation_verse: Binikpitib dáaĺ ki fɔ́fì ntàataajimu ki píĺ bi-tɔfii kí kpɔ̀ unandaan nì ufalaadaan, kí làntì bin ŋáań tin bí deedeeyee.

english_verse: But they will be killed by their own swords, and their arrows will be broken.
translation_verse: Ama bíǹ bi-ba jimmu di làá fàtīí sāā bi-pɔbiliŋ, ní bi-tɔfii ń kɔ̄fì.

english_verse: It is better to live right and be poor than to be sinful and rich.
translation_verse: Fiii un deedeedaan cááyee sɔ́ǹ tigaajati tin binikpitib tikpil cááyee.

english_verse: The wicked will lose all of their power, but the Lord gives strength to everyone who is good.
translation_verse: Di sá yii binikpitib pɔŋŋu làá nàan̄, ama ti-Dindaan di tíkí deedeedambi.

english_verse: Those who obey the Lord are daily in his care, and what he has given them will be theirs forever.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan di nyí bin sí nì u deedeeyee wiiŋyi, ní kitiŋ kin bi fōō difakalee làá nīn bí ki cá talku.

english_verse: They won't be in trouble when times are bad, and they will have plenty when food is scarce.
translation_verse: Dinimbinaamandi yuntiŋuee, icoo kaa làá jī-bi, ŋkùm mun yuntiŋuee, bi làá ká kí jī kí díkí.

english_verse: Wicked people are enemies of the Lord and will vanish like smoke from a field on fire.
translation_verse: Tiŋman, binikpitib làá kpú kí céetí, ti-Dindaan nannanliibi làá nīn bí kii kumooun supumpukumee ní. Bi làá wāŋkì, bi làá wāŋkì kii nnyiimee.

english_verse: An evil person borrows and never pays back; a good person is generous and never stops giving.
translation_verse: Unikpiti pìntí ní kaa tēentí, ama deedeedaan úǹ poon mɔ̄ ní u tìì.

english_verse: Everyone the Lord blesses will receive the land; everyone the Lord curses will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Bin boon ti-Dindaan bīiǹee di dāa yì kitiŋ, ama u làá dāá kúntí bin u tɔ́ mbusuee.

english_verse: If you do what the Lord wants, he will make certain each step you take is sure.
translation_verse: Unil un bimbim fáatiǹ ti-Dindaanee, u yàntī udaan còom̄ ní kaa fàŋkí tiba.

english_verse: The Lord will hold your hand, and if you stumble, you still won't fall.
translation_verse: Báà udaan yaa gbéetì, waa làá lítí, di sá yii ti-Dindaan ŋúb́ u-ŋal.

english_verse: As long as I can remember, good people have never been left helpless, and their children have never gone begging for food.
translation_verse: M nìn sá unaacimpɔɔn ní kɔŋkɔnnee ki púĺ, ama maa láá pée ká ti-Dindaan dū deedeedaan ki fá, àá udaan biyaamu bí ki mèé tijin ki jīǹ.

english_verse: They gladly give and lend, and their children turn out good.
translation_verse: Baabadalee, úǹ sūǹ binib saai ní ki pìntí, ní u-biyaamu sá dibiindi.

english_verse: If you stop sinning and start doing right, you will keep living and be secure forever.
translation_verse: Fàtī a-boon kí tīī ikpiti kí ŋá tiŋan, ní kí kàl̄ kitiŋ nee pu kí nīn cá jaanjaan.

english_verse: The Lord loves justice, and he won't ever desert his faithful people. He always protects them, but destroys the children of the wicked.
translation_verse: Di sá yii ti-Dindaan néeń bí nīn sòoǹ binib bɔti nì ibaamɔn, ní kaa féeń bin sí nì u deedeeyee. U cí-bi ní baabadal, ama u làá kúntí binikpitib nibooliŋu.

english_verse: God's people will own the land and live here forever.
translation_verse: Deedeedambi làá dāá fōō kitiŋ kí nīn yì, ní kí kàl̄ ki-pu kí nīn cá jaanjaan.

english_verse: Words of wisdom come when good people speak for justice.
translation_verse: Deedeedaan nyɔkɔn ní iciin nyɔɔbuŋŋi nyēē, ní u-limbil sòoǹ binib bɔti nì ibaamɔn.

english_verse: They remember God's teachings, and they never take a wrong step.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti marab kā u-pɔbilin, u kpá kí tāā kí pántí.

english_verse: The wicked try to trap and kill good people,
translation_verse: Binikpitib cɔ́ŋkí deedeedaan, ní ki nyàab̀ kí kpɔ̀-u.

english_verse: but the Lord is on their side, and he will defend them when they are on trial.
translation_verse: Ama ti-Dindaan kaa làá dū-u kí ŋá bi-ŋaan. Bi yaa tí bíi sòoǹ u-bɔtaaa, waa làá yàntī bí kpɔ̀ u-bɔti.

english_verse: Trust the Lord and follow him. He will give you the land, and you will see the wicked destroyed.
translation_verse: Nín̄ máká ti-Dindaan pu kí nīn nóó u-saŋŋu. U làá yòon̄-si yilpu á fōō kitiŋ nee kí nīn kíǹ ki yì, ní kí ká u nín làá kúntí unikpiti puee.

english_verse: I have seen brutal people abuse others and grow strong like trees in rich soil.
translation_verse: M ká unikpiti ubɔ cáá u-pɔŋŋu ki fàantí binib, u nìn wíiǹ kii busukpaambuee ní.

english_verse: Suddenly they disappeared! I looked, but they were gone and no longer there.
translation_verse: Ama m jítì niinee, waa ti bí. M nyàab̄-u, ama maa ti ká-u.

english_verse: Think of the bright future waiting for all the families of honest, innocent, and peace-loving people.
translation_verse: Dáań ubulcindaan, kpèè deedeedaan. An niliuee kúntí ŋgbansɔŋfin ní.

english_verse: But not a trace will be left of the wicked or their families.
translation_verse: Ama Unimbɔti làá kúntí pɔɔgaatib dicilpu, ní kí kpɔ̀ kí céetí binikpitib naantiibi.

english_verse: The Lord protects his people, and they can come to him in times of trouble.
translation_verse: Deedeedambi fiil nyēeń ti-Dindaan cee ní. Dinimbinaamandi yuntiŋuee, úǹ ní bi sáń ki kóò.

english_verse: The Lord helps his people and saves them from the wicked because they run to him.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan di tútúǹ-bi ní ki jòoń-bi. U nyāntí-bi binikpitib ŋaan ní ki fìil̄-bi, kun puee bi sáǹ ki kɔ́-u.

english_verse: When you are angry, Lord, please don't punish me or even correct me.
translation_verse: Daafiidi di ŋmàn̄ nlan nee kí nīn téetí Unimbɔti pu.

english_verse: You shot me with your arrows, and you struck me with your hand.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, taa wòoǹ-mi nì diŋuul, taa dū mbum kí dáaĺ m-tafal.

english_verse: My body hurts all over because of your anger. Even my bones are in pain, and my sins
translation_verse: A dū a-piiŋyi ki yá-mi, ní ki dū a-ŋal ki fáá-mi ki lúkú.

english_verse: are so heavy that I am crushed.
translation_verse: A-ŋuul puee m-wunti kaa ti pɔ̄ɔ̄, m-kpitii puee m-kpabiŋ kaa ti pɔ̄ɔ̄.

english_verse: Because of my foolishness, I am covered with sores that stink and spread.
translation_verse: Di sá yii m-kpitii kpúkú ki jítì m-yil pu, i nyìm̀ m-pu kii diwaŋgul din nyìm̀ee ní.

english_verse: My body is twisted and bent, and I groan all day long.
translation_verse: M-gbaandi puee, m-buuŋyi sūū ki núù.

english_verse: Fever has my back in flames, and I hurt everywhere.
translation_verse: M-weeŋyi nyīī-mi ki bōoǹ taapu taapu, baabadalee m còom̄ kunimbaaun ní.

english_verse: I am worn out and weak, moaning and in distress.
translation_verse: Di sá yii m-wunti píl̀ kpaŋkpam, ní m-wunti kaa ti pɔ̄ɔ̄ báà fiii.

english_verse: You, Lord, know every one of my deepest desires, and my noisy groans are no secret to you.
translation_verse: Maa ti cáá mpɔn ní an nùkū-mi púsi pusi. M-pɔbil kɔ́ kunimbaaun ní m yáliŋkí.

english_verse: My heart is beating fast. I feel weak all over, and my eyes are red.
translation_verse: M-Dindaan, kun m lèe dɔ̄ a-nimbiin, a nyí m-yaliŋkii.

english_verse: Because of my sickness, no friends or neighbors will come near me.
translation_verse: M-pɔbil máfí, mpɔn kaa ti bí-mi, m-nimbiliŋ gba kaa ti wāĺ tiŋan.

english_verse: All who want me dead set traps to catch me, and those who want to harm and destroy me plan and plot all day.
translation_verse: M-bɔɔbi nì man nì bin nōotée kíǹ ki sáń-mi m-buuŋyi pu. M-dicaŋkun yab gba kaa ti là kí sútí kí pìl̄-mi.

english_verse: I am not able to hear or speak a word;
translation_verse: Bin là kí kpɔ̀-mee pīil̀-mi titalindi. Bin nyàab̀-mi tikpitilee sòoǹ ki mɔ̀tīi púntí-mi, ní ki cáá m-pu disambiil baabadal.

english_verse: I am completely deaf and can't make a sound.
translation_verse: Ama mamee, m kpántì kii utafakpaafuee ní, maa gbìl̀ tiba. M kpántì kii umuunee ní, maa gàtī tiba.

english_verse: I trust you, Lord God, and you will do something.
translation_verse: Tiŋman m kpántì kii unil un kaa gbìl̀ee ní, unil un kaa cáá kinyɔkɔ kí gàtī tibee.

english_verse: I said, “Don't let them laugh or brag when I slip and fall.”
translation_verse: Ama sii pu ní m máká, ti-Dindaan, sii ti-Dindaan m-Nimbɔtiu di làá kíí.

english_verse: I told you my sins, and I am sorry for them.
translation_verse: Too man di làá lítée, ní m-wàlifii dáá gbíntìi bí m-ni.

english_verse: Many deadly and powerful enemies hate me,
translation_verse: M bīitì m-yìntitam pu, m-kpitii fàantí-mi.

english_verse: and they repay evil for good because I try to do right.
translation_verse: M-nannanliibi cáá laafiya ki cáá mpɔn, bin ná-mi an kaa cáá taapuee wīikí tikpil.

english_verse: You are the Lord God! Stay nearby and don't desert me.
translation_verse: Bi cáá ikpiti ki pà tiŋan tin m ŋáań-bee, kun puee bi wòoǹ-mi yii m pá tiŋan boon.

english_verse: You are the one who saves me. Please hurry and help.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, taa dū-mi kí fá, m-Nimbɔtiu, taa nín̄ dátiǹ-mi.

english_verse: I felt a fire burning inside, and the more I thought, the more it burned, until at last I said:
translation_verse: M táb́ m-nyɔkɔ ní ki ŋmí, m yíì kaa pée sòon̄ tiba. Ama ní m-wàlifii mɔ̀tīi kútí,

english_verse: “Please, Lord, show me my future. Will I soon be gone?
translation_verse: ní m-pɔbil píĺ kpaŋkpam m-poon. An gíti lákatì ki kíǹ ki sèetī-mi kii ŋŋmee ní m dāa wāaǹ m-nyɔkɔ ki sòon̄.

english_verse: You made my life short, so brief that the time means nothing to you. “Human life is but a breath,
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, yàntī ḿ béé m-maŋfal wiiŋyi nín làá kúntí puee, yàntī ḿ béé iwiin in kíǹ-mi ḿ dūú kàl̄ kitiŋ nee puee, kí yàntī ḿ béé m-maŋfal wiiŋyi nín kaa pée náaǹ puee.

english_verse: and it disappears like a shadow. Our struggles are senseless; we store up more and more, without ever knowing who will get it all.
translation_verse: Kpèè, iwiin in a tīī-mi ḿ dūú kàl̄ kitiŋ puee bí kii diŋaantil waaŋŋuee ní. M-maŋfal wiiŋyi kaa pée sá a-cee tiba. Tiŋman, unifoo kamaa bí kii kubuŋuee ní.

english_verse: Save me from my sins. Don't let fools sneer at me.
translation_verse: Mimmee, m-Dindaan, ba ní ḿ nīn gíti kā ki cí? M máká sii pu ní.

english_verse: You treated me like this, and I kept silent, not saying a word.
translation_verse: Fīī-mi kí nyāntí m-kpitii kɔkɔn, taa yàntī bigbaambi ń lā-mi.

english_verse: “Won't you stop punishing me? You have worn me down.
translation_verse: M táb́ m-nyɔkɔ, maa ti làá wàan̄-kì, di sá yii sii di yāntì m bí falaa nee poon.

english_verse: “Listen, Lord, to my prayer! My eyes are flooded with tears, as I pray to you. I am merely a stranger visiting in your home as my ancestors did.
translation_verse: A wòoǹ unil ní ki dátí u-tafal u-kpitii pu. Kii dikoosibil nín ŋmóò disubil puee, míǹ ní a bíiĺ tin udaan néeńee. Tiŋman, unil sá ba, an yaa kaa sá kubuŋu.

english_verse: Stop being angry with me and let me smile again before I am dead and gone.”
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, pīlifì m-wimmeem nì m-biilii, kpòon̄ a-tafal kí pīlifì m-siim. Di sá yii m sá unikɔkaa ní a-cee, m sá unicaan ní kii m-naanjab kɔkɔ nín nìn sá puee.

english_verse: I patiently waited, Lord, for you to hear my prayer. You listened
translation_verse: Daafiidi di ŋmàn̄ nlan nee ki tīī bilaŋgaaliibi kpiliu.

english_verse: and pulled me from a lonely pit full of mud and mire. You let me stand on a rock with my feet firm,
translation_verse: M dū m-mákal kɔkɔ ki páaǹ ti-Dindaan pu, ní u tīntìń ki pílifì m-biilii.

english_verse: and you gave me a new song, a song of praise to you. Many will see this, and they will honor and trust you, the Lord God.
translation_verse: U dáaĺ-mi ki nyántì ŋkúm booŋŋun, u dáaĺ-mi ki nyántì tikpati tin nyóòyee poon. U yáatì-mi ki tɔ́kɔǹ ditaŋkpal pu, m yaa còom̄ee maa ti fàŋkí.

english_verse: You bless all of those who trust you, Lord, and refuse to worship idols or follow false gods.
translation_verse: U dū nlampɔɔn ki ŋá m-nyɔkɔn ḿ gāā kí nyɔ̄ŋkì úǹ ti-Nimbɔtiu. Binib tikpil làá ká ní kí fàŋkì, ní kí nīn kíǹ ki máká ti-Dindaan pu.

english_verse: Sacrifices and offerings are not what please you; gifts and payment for sin are not what you demand. But you made me willing to listen and obey.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan m-Nimbɔtiu, a-maamaaci tuuŋŋi ŋin a ŋá ki tīī-mee wīikéeee! Aa cáá juti. A bɔ́ntì tiwan tikpil kí tīī-ti. Maa làá ŋmā kí sòoǹ tin kɔkɔ a ŋée, kun puee tì wīikí tikpil.

english_verse: And so, I said, “I am here to do what is written about me in the book, where it says,
translation_verse: An kaa sá kuwaŋkuluu saraau àá tijimpin saraau ní a là, kaa tí sá saraawɔkaa àá ikpiti pɔ̄tam saraau ní a bàlifī. Ama a tīī-mi atafal ḿ pīlifiǹ-si.

english_verse: ‘I enjoy pleasing you. Your Law is in my heart.’ ”
translation_verse: An pu ní m bí yii: «M sèé, m dòoń a-cee. Kugbɔŋu poonee bi ŋmàn̄ tin m máaǹ kí ŋée.»

english_verse: When your people worshiped, you know I told them, “Our Lord always helps!”
translation_verse: M-Nimbɔtiu, an mɔ̄ǹ-mi ḿ ŋá min fáatiǹ-see, m kpáafí a-marab m-pɔbilin.

english_verse: When all your people met, I did not keep silent. I said, “Our Lord is kind. He is faithful and caring, and he saves us.”
translation_verse: Samaa kpafikpaandi poonee, m sòon̄ a-deedeeu pu. Kpèè maa ŋūǹ kí ŋmèè kí taa sòoǹ, ti-Dindaan, sii a-ba nyí míǹ.

english_verse: You, Lord, never fail to have pity on me; your love and faithfulness always keep me secure.
translation_verse: Maa dū a-deedeeu ki bál̀ m-pɔbilin, m sòon̄ a-baamɔŋyi nì a-fiil pu. Maa dū a-neeŋkpaandi nì a-baamɔŋyi ki bál̀ samaa kpafikpaandi poon.

english_verse: I have more troubles than I can count. My sins are all around me, and I can't find my way. My sins outnumber the hairs on my head, and I feel weak.
translation_verse: M-Dindaan, á taa kàkatī a-poommɔŋŋu kí wàatī-mi, yàntī a-neeŋkpaandi nì a-baamɔŋyi ń nīn pée wúń m-pu. *

english_verse: Please show that you care and come to my rescue. Hurry and help me!
translation_verse: Agìń tikpil lúuń-mi ajan kɔkɔ pu, m-kpitii māntìi gíb́-mi ní maa ti wāĺ. I wīikí ki jítiǹ m-yikpiti, ní m-wunti yɔ̄tì.

english_verse: I am poor and needy, but, Lord God, you care about me, and you come to my rescue. Please hurry and help.
translation_verse: Ama yàntī bin kɔkɔ nyàab̀-see ń nīn bí mmɔnni ki fàal̀. Yàntī bin néeń sii, ufiilee ń nīn pée lì yii: «Ti-Dindaan sá ukpaaneeee!»

english_verse: You protect them and keep them alive. You make them happy here in this land, and you don't hand them over to their enemies.
translation_verse: Unil un dàkafī ufalaadaan puee bí mmɔnneeee! Digìńdi wiiŋŋu dalee, ti-Dindaan làá fīī-u.

english_verse: You always heal them and restore their strength when they are sick.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan làá wúń u-pu ní kí tīī-u dimaŋfal. U làá yàntī ú nīn bí mmɔnni kitiŋ pu. Waa làá dū-u kí ŋá u-nannanliibi ŋaan.

english_verse: I prayed, “Have pity, Lord! Heal me, though I have sinned against you.”
translation_verse: U yaa dɔ̄ mbunlidoo pu, ti-Dindaan làá tíkiń-u. U làá cúú mbunlidooyee kí kpántí ŋgbampɔn dooŋu.

english_verse: My vicious enemies ask me, “When will you die and be forgotten?”
translation_verse: Mamee, m lī yii: «Ti-Dindaan, sɔ̄ m-saai kí cáaǹ-mi, di sá yii m yīntiǹ-si.»

english_verse: When visitors come, all they ever bring are worthless words, and when they leave, they spread gossip.
translation_verse: M-nannanliibi sòoǹ m-pu tibɔkpitil ki lì yii: «Ba dal ní u làá kpú bí súntí u-pu ní?»

english_verse: and they say, “You have some fatal disease! You'll never get well.”
translation_verse: Bin kɔkɔ ná-mee cáá m-bɔti ki lɔ́kɔfí ki tùkù tɔb, bi dàkafī m-pu tin kaa pée ŋān̄ee ŋma ní.

english_verse: My most trusted friend has turned against me, though he ate at my table.
translation_verse: Bi lì yii: «An sá kuweeŋkpiiu kubɔ di cúú-u. Laakin u dɔ̄ nee, waa ti làá ŋmā kí yīkì.»

english_verse: Have pity, Lord! Heal me, so I can pay them back.
translation_verse: Áli gba m-bɔɔmɔnti un pu m máká u jīǹ m-jintee fātìi bíi jáà nì mi.

english_verse: Then my enemies won't defeat me, and I will know that you really care.
translation_verse: Ama sii m-Dindaan, sɔ̄ m-saai kí fàtīí tīī-mi ŋgbampɔn, ḿ tɔ̀ m-nannanliibi ipɔntoon.

english_verse: You have helped me because I am innocent, and you will always be close to my side.
translation_verse: Kun m dūu béè yii m fáatiǹ-see di sá m-nannanliibi kaa jíń m-pu dinyandi.

english_verse: You, the Lord God of Israel, will be praised forever! Amen and amen.
translation_verse: A tútuǹ-mi ki cáaǹ-mi, ní ki yāntì m bí a-nimbiin kí nīn cá jaanjaan. *

english_verse: ) Longing for God
translation_verse: ) M-mákal bí Unimbɔtin ní

english_verse: As a deer gets thirsty for streams of water, I truly am thirsty for you, my God.
translation_verse: Koora dicaŋkun yab di ŋmàn̄ nlan nee ki tīī bilaŋgaaliibi kpiliu.

english_verse: In my heart, I am thirsty for you, the living God. When will I see your face?
translation_verse: Kii upeeman di tíkì ki fèefī ki nyàab̀ mbun nyim puee, míǹ ní ma mun tíkì ki fèefī ki nyàab̀-si, Unimbɔti.

english_verse: Day and night my tears are my only food, as everyone keeps asking, “Where is your God?”
translation_verse: Kii nnyinnyoo nín cútí unil u nyàab̀ nnyim puee, míǹ ní m nyàab̀ sii dimaŋfal Nimbɔtiu. Ba dal ní m làá ŋmā kí kɔ́ kunimbɔtidiin, kí yūĺ Unimbɔti nimbiin ní?

english_verse: Sorrow floods my heart, when I remember leading the worshipers to your house. I can still hear them shout their joyful praises.
translation_verse: M-nyinnyim di kpántì m-jinti ŋwiimpu nì kunyeeu, di sá yii bi bàlifī-mi kaa gbèentí yii: «A-Nimbɔtiuee baasii bí la ní?»

english_verse: Why am I discouraged? Why am I restless? I should trust you, Lord. I will praise you again because you help me,
translation_verse: Niinee ní án kɔ́ m-pɔbilin ní ḿ téetí dooooyee pu, ŋyunti ŋun samaa yaa nìn bí jiŋaal poon, m līī bi-nyɔkɔpu tí tin kɔ́ kunimbɔtidiin, ki gà ilan ki nyɔ́ŋkí Unimbɔti nì ifaalee.

english_verse: and you are my God. I am deeply discouraged, and so I think about you here where the Jordan begins at Mount Hermon and at Mount Mizar.
translation_verse: «Ba pu ní m bí kunimbaaun míǹ? Ba pu ní m yáliŋkí nì m-ba míǹ?» M làá nīn máká Unimbɔti pu. Tiŋman m làá nīn bí ki nyɔ́ŋkí-u, úǹ di sá m-fiiliu nì m-Nimbɔtiu.

english_verse: Your vicious waves have swept over me like an angry ocean or a roaring waterfall.
translation_verse: M-Nimbɔtiu, m-pɔbil bíil̀, an pu ní m téetì a-pu doooo dimɔɔl Jɔɔdan tiŋkin nì Eermɔn nì Miiseeyaar jooŋŋi yilpu.

english_verse: Every day, you are kind, and at night you give me a song as my prayer to you, the God of my life.
translation_verse: A yàntī inyiŋfi sìtī ki gà kuwoou, ní tinyiŋgban tiba cāabìń ti-juti. Tì nín lítí ki pùub̀ puee, tì dòoń ki bìintí m-pu.

english_verse: You are my mighty rock. Why have you forgotten me? Why must enemies mistreat me and make me sad?
translation_verse: Ŋwiimpuee, ti-Dindaan dàkà-mi u-neeŋkpaandi, ní kunyeeuee, m gà ilan ki nyɔ́ŋkí-u, ki mèé Unimbɔti un tìì-mi dimaŋfalee.

english_verse: Even my bones are in pain, while all day long my enemies sneer and ask, “Where is your God?”
translation_verse: M tùkū Unimbɔti un sá m-taŋkpanaakookuee yii: «Ba pu ní a súntì m-pu? Ba pu ní ḿ nīn bí kunimbaaun m-nannanliibi wɔ́b́-mi?»

english_verse: Why am I discouraged? Why am I restless? I trust you, Lord! And I will praise you again because you help me, and you are my God.
translation_verse: M-nannanliibi ŋá-mi tiweendi ki tin bàn̄ m-kpabiŋ. Bi sìí-mi ní ki bàlifī-mi baabadal yii: «A-Nimbɔtiuee bí la?»

english_verse: Show that I am right, God! Defend me against everyone who doesn't know you; rescue me from each of those deceitful liars.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti, sòoǹ m-bɔti kí pɔ̀-mi, mɔ̄tì m-pu binib bin kaa nyí-si nee cee. Fīī-mi kí nyāntí binyimɔndambi nì binikpɔliibi nee ŋaan.

english_verse: I run to you for protection. Why do you turn me away? Why must enemies mistreat me and make me sad?
translation_verse: Unimbɔti, sii ní m sáǹ ki kɔ́. Ba pu ní a dū-mi ki fá? Ba pu ní ḿ nīn bí kunimbaaun m-nannanliibi wɔ́b́-mi?

english_verse: Send your light and your truth to guide me. Let them lead me to your house on your sacred mountain.
translation_verse: Yàntī ḿ wāl̀ a-walfiŋu nì a-baamɔŋyi, í kpòotī-mi kí cùnnì a-circir jool pu, kí cáá-mi kí bànnì a-circir kɔŋkooŋŋun.

english_verse: Then I will worship at your altar because you make me joyful. You are my God, and I will praise you. Yes, I will praise you as I play my harp.
translation_verse: Niinee ní ḿ sútí kí pìl̄ sii Unimbɔti saraafaŋŋu, sii Unimbɔti un yàntī m bí dipɔɔpiŋkpaandinee. M làá bɔ̀ɔ̀ kubeeu kí nyɔ̄ŋkì-si, Unimbɔti, m-Nimbɔtiu.

english_verse: Why am I discouraged? Why am I restless? I trust you, Lord! And I will praise you again because you help me, and you are my God.
translation_verse: «Ba pu ní m bí kunimbaaun míǹ, ba pu ní m yáliŋkí nì m-ba míǹ?» M làá nīn máká Unimbɔti pu. Tiŋman m làá nīn bí ki nyɔ́ŋkí-u, úǹ di sá m-fiiliu nì m-Nimbɔtiu.

english_verse: Our God, our ancestors told us what wonders you worked and we listened carefully.
translation_verse: Koora dicaŋkun yab di ŋmàn̄ nlan nee ki tīī bilaŋgaaliibi kpiliu.

english_verse: You chased off the nations by causing them trouble with your powerful arm. Then you let our ancestors take over their land.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti, ti-tafal gbìl̄ ní ti-baabi mun máafì-ti atuŋkpaan ŋin ní a nìn ŋá bi-yuntiŋu, iyunti in jítèe poonee.

english_verse: Their strength and weapons were not what won the land and gave them victory! You loved them and fought with your powerful arm and your shining glory.
translation_verse: A nìn dū a-pɔŋkpaaŋŋu ki jìn̄ atimbun ní ki dū ti-baabi ki kāaǹ. A nìn dáaĺ anibul tafal ní ki yāntì an bútì ti-baabi.

english_verse: By your great power, we knocked our enemies down and trampled on them.
translation_verse: Sii di sá m-Bɔtiu nì m-Nimbɔtiu, tīī mara ní a-nibul ń ká dijajil.

english_verse: I don't depend on my arrows or my sword to save me.
translation_verse: Sii pu ní ti jáà ki pɔ́ɔkíǹ ti-nannanliibi, a-yindi pu ní ti tà ki mátí bin dòoń ki jáà nì tee.

english_verse: But you saved us from our hateful enemies, and you put them to shame.
translation_verse: Maa máká m-tɔbu pu, an kaa tí sá m-tàataajiki di tìì-mi dijajil.

english_verse: We boast about you, our God, and we are always grateful.
translation_verse: Sii di fìil̄-ti ti-nannanliibi ŋaan, ní ki kɔ̄ntí bin ná-tee icoo.

english_verse: But now you have rejected us; you don't lead us into battle, and we look foolish.
translation_verse: Ti làá nīn gà ilan ki nyɔ́ŋkí sii Unimbɔti baabadal, ní kí nīn jáaḿ-si kí taa gbèen̄.

english_verse: You made us retreat, and our enemies have taken everything we own.
translation_verse: Kɔŋkɔnnee, a dū-ti ki fá ki kɔ́ǹ-ti icoo. Aa ti lìntī ti-janjakitiŋ nyɔkɔpu.

english_verse: You let us be slaughtered like sheep, and you scattered us among the nations.
translation_verse: A yāntì taa ŋúń ki síl̀ ti-nannanliibi nimbiin, ní bi dɔ́miń ki fúkúl̀-ti pílpil.

english_verse: You sold your people for little or nothing, and you earned no profit.
translation_verse: A dū-ti ki tīī kii ipii in bi cáǹ kí kpɔ̀ee, a yāntì ti yàl̄ ki tin kóòń nnicantimun.

english_verse: You made us look foolish to our neighbors; people who live nearby insult us and sneer.
translation_verse: A dū a-nib ki nyáfì tilèel, kaa kpáàa nyàab̄ kí ká ipaati poon.

english_verse: Foreigners joke about us and shake their heads.
translation_verse: A yāntì ti-kɔŋkɔnaatɔb sìí-ti, ní bin māntìi tú-tee bèel̄-ti ki lāā.

english_verse: I am embarrassed every day, and I blush with shame.
translation_verse: A yāntì atimbun ŋin kíǹee cáá ti-bɔti ki gà ilan, ní bi bèel̄-ti ki gbákafí bi-yiliŋ.

english_verse: But others mock and sneer, as they watch my enemies take revenge on me.
translation_verse: Baabadalee, m-naabuŋu di dɔ̄ m-nimbiin m wāĺ, ní maa ti ŋūǹ kí yáatí m-yil icoo pu.

english_verse: All this happened to us, though we didn't forget you or break our agreement.
translation_verse: M gbìl̀ bi bèel̄-ti ki sìí-ti. M wāĺ unannanli nín bí ki tɔ̀ ipɔntoon puee.

english_verse: We always kept you in mind and followed your teaching.
translation_verse: Tin bí nee kɔkɔ bāań-ti, ama taa súntì a-pu, kaa tí fātì ti-boon ki tīī a-poondi.

english_verse: But you crushed us, and you covered us with deepest darkness where wild animals live.
translation_verse: Taa fātì ti-kpaŋkpamboon ki tīī-saaa, kaa yīntiǹ a-marab mun.

english_verse: We did not forget you or lift our hands in prayer to foreign gods.
translation_verse: Ama a jìn̄-ti ki tɔ́ laakin jiiŋkpaaibi kóòyee, ki dū dibɔmbɔŋkpaandi ki bīiǹ ti-pu.

english_verse: You would have known it because you discover every secret thought.
translation_verse: Ti yaa nìn súntì ti-Nimbɔtiu pu ní ki mēē awaa abee,

english_verse: We face death all day for you. We are like sheep on their way to be slaughtered.
translation_verse: sii Unimbɔti kaa bàà béetí-tàaa, sii un di nyí ti-pɔbiliŋ bɔɔŋŋee?

english_verse: Wake up! Do something, Lord! Why are you sleeping? Don't desert us forever.
translation_verse: Sii ti-Dindaan pu ní ti tūŋkí ŋkúm baabadal, ní bi ŋáań-ti kii ipii in bi cáǹ kí kpɔ̀ee.

english_verse: Why do you keep looking away? Don't forget our sufferings and all our troubles.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, fìntī! Ba pu ní a dɔ̄ ki gèeǹ ní? Yīkìm̄, taa dū-ti kí fá kí nīn cá jaanjaan!

english_verse: We are flat on the ground, holding on to the dust.
translation_verse: Ba pu ní a dū a-nimbiin ki bál̀-ti ki súntì ti-falaau nì bi nín wɔ́b́-ti puee míǹ?

english_verse: Do something! Help us! Show how kind you are and come to our rescue.
translation_verse: Di sá yii ti dɔ̄ ntamin ki fìlim̀, ki cìb̄ kitiŋ.

english_verse: My thoughts are filled with beautiful words for the king, and I will use my voice as a writer would use pen and ink.
translation_verse: Koora dicaŋkun yab di ŋmàn̄ nlan nee ki tīī bilaŋgaaliibi kpiliu. Bi bɔ̀ɔ́ kubeeu ní ki gà-ŋu. Dineendi laŋŋu.

english_verse: No one is as handsome as you! Your words are always kind. That is why God will always bless you.
translation_verse: Anyɔɔbunnyaan di gbí m-pɔbilin. M làá gāā nlammɔnti kí tīī ubɔti tinyool. M-nyɔkɔ ń nīn yáb̀ kí gāā nlan kii ugbaŋŋmal un yáb̀ee ŋmamɔɔŋŋuee.

english_verse: and ride out in splendor! Win victories for truth and mercy and justice. Do fearsome things with your powerful arm.
translation_verse: Ubaatandaan, yòon̄ a-gbajau kí gbìn̄. An di sá a-nyooti nì a-kpaanti daaŋku.

english_verse: Send your sharp arrows through enemy hearts and make all nations fall at your feet.
translation_verse: Jàkà nì kunyaaŋŋu kí mɔ̄tì ibaamɔn nì dibasintil nì deedee pu. A-ŋaŋgiil ń dàkà a-tuuŋŋi ŋin sá maamaaci tuuŋŋee.

english_verse: You are God, and you will rule forever as king. Your royal power brings about justice.
translation_verse: A-piiŋyi cɔ́m̀ tiŋan, - i sàatī ki kóò sii ubɔti nannanliibi pɔbiliŋ poon. Atimbun nib làá lítí a-taaŋi taapu.

english_verse: You love justice and hate evil. And so, your God chose you and made you happier than any of your friends.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti, a-beel bí ní ki cá jaanjaan. A jīǹ a-beel nì deedee ní.

english_verse: The sweet aroma of the spices myrrh, aloes, and cassia covers your royal robes. You enjoy the music of harps in palaces decorated with ivory.
translation_verse: A néeń tin bí deedeeyee ní ki ná tin kaa ŋān̄ee, an pu ní Unimbɔti, a-Nimbɔtiu lēē-si, ki sītì a-pu dipɔɔpindi kpam a jítiǹ a-jutiibi kɔkɔ.

english_verse: Daughters of kings are here, and your bride stands at your right side, wearing a wedding gown trimmed with pure gold.
translation_verse: A-wampeeŋkaati kɔkɔ sɔ́fì miiri nì disaaweendi nì kasiya talaalub ní, ní a-bɔtinaakooku kun bi dū kunti nyiŋŋi ki nákáǹ nákáǹee poonee, bi bɔ̀ɔ́ tibati ki gà ilan in tìì-si dipɔɔpindee.

english_verse: Bride of the king, listen carefully to me. Forget your own people and your father's family.
translation_verse: Ubɔti sapɔmbi bí ki ŋúb́ a-wanleeŋkaati, ní ubɔti nimpuu yú a-ŋaŋgiil pú ki lá sindaariyamɔnti wanléeŋkaati.

english_verse: The king adores you. He is your master, so do what he desires.
translation_verse: Pīlifì m-bisal, kpèè kí kpòon̄ a-tafal kí pīlifì. Súntí a-nibooliŋu nì a-baa dicaŋku yab pu.

english_verse: All of the richest people from the city of Tyre will try to influence you
translation_verse: Yàntī a-nyaaŋku ń fáatíǹ ubɔti! Úǹ di kíǹ ki sá a-dindaan, gbàan̄ u-nimbiin.

english_verse: with precious treasures. Your bride, my king, has inward beauty, and her wedding gown is woven with threads of gold.
translation_verse: Tiir yab bin sá bigaajakpaambee làá dāá pɔ̄-si tiwan á nīn kíǹ ki là-bi.

english_verse: Wearing the finest garments, she is brought to you, followed by her young friends, the bridesmaids.
translation_verse: Ubɔti bɔɔn di kóòń nì tinyookpaandee, sindaariya ní bi dūu nyūntì u-bɔkutil.

english_verse: Everyone is excited, as they follow you to the royal palace.
translation_verse: Dibɔkutil din u pēēyee cáá inyiŋfi kutuku pu, ní bi cáǹ-u ubɔti cee. Bisapɔmbi bin pá u-boon ki tútúǹ-uee mun kɔ́nní a-cee.

english_verse: I will make your name famous from now on, and you will be praised forever and ever.
translation_verse: Ubɔti, a-jipɔmbi làá dāá fōō a-naanjab yil kí kàl̄ dibeel, a làá dāá yàntī bí kpántí kitiŋ kɔkɔ pu abɔtibil.

english_verse: God is our mighty fortress, always ready to help in times of trouble.
translation_verse: Koora dicaŋkun yab laŋgaakpiliu laŋŋu, bi gà-ŋu nì kineejaka ní.

english_verse: And so, we won't be afraid! Let the earth tremble and the mountains tumble into the deepest sea.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti di sá timbi balilaŋki nì ti-pɔŋŋu, dinimbinaamandi yuntiŋuee, u pée bí ní kí jòoń-ti.

english_verse: Let the ocean roar and foam, and its raging waves shake the mountains.
translation_verse: An pu ní taa fàŋkí tiba, báà kitiŋ yaa bíi cìŋkāaa, ajoon yaa bíi kpìkitī ki lítí tiŋkunaaa,

english_verse: A river and its streams bring joy to the city, which is the sacred home of God Most High.
translation_verse: tiŋku nyiŋgbanti yaa yāŋkí tɔb ki ŋáań kuwoou ajoon cìŋkī.

english_verse: God is in that city, and it won't be shaken. He will help it at dawn.
translation_verse: Mbun ŋubɔ bí ki cāabìń dipɔɔpindi Unimbɔti tiŋkin, laakin sá Yilpu Fɔ́ŋŋŋ Nimbɔtiu circir kɔŋkooŋŋu páaayee.

english_verse: Nations rage! Kingdoms fall! But at the voice of God the earth itself melts.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti bí kitiŋ gbantin, tiba kpá kí ŋá-kì, kutaa tin pée lì yii ku wúntée, Unimbɔti bí kí jòoń-kì.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful is with us. The God of Jacob is our fortress.
translation_verse: Atimbun kɔ́ fìkil fikil poon, abee cīŋkì, Unimbɔti téeń ní kitiŋ dūntì.

english_verse: Come! See the fearsome things the Lord has done on earth.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti Mpɔŋkɔdaan bí ti-cee, Jaakɔb Nimbɔtiu di sá timbi balilaŋki.

english_verse: God brings wars to an end all over the world. He breaks the arrows, shatters the spears, and burns the shields.
translation_verse: Dāá kpèèmaan tin ti-Dindaan ŋée, maamaaci tuuŋŋi ŋin ní u ŋá kitiŋ puee.

english_verse: Our God says, “Calm down, and learn that I am God! All nations on earth will honor me.”
translation_verse: U yàntī tijáti gbèentí duulinya kɔkɔn, u kɔ́fí itɔfi, ki nyìitī ki gífí ŋkpamu, ní ki tùutī agbampɔɔ ŋŋmi.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful is with us. The God of Jacob is our fortress.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan téeń yii: «Gbèem̄maan kujaauee! Béémaan yii man di sá Unimbɔti! Man di jīǹ atimbun pu dibeel, man di jīǹ kitiŋ kɔkɔ pu dibeel.»

english_verse: All of you nations, clap your hands and shout joyful praises to God.
translation_verse: Koora dicaŋkun yab di gāā nlan nee.

english_verse: The Lord Most High is fearsome, the ruler of all the earth.
translation_verse: Anibul kɔkɔ nib, kpāafìmaan abaal, fáámaan ŋwiliili kí nyɔ̄ŋkì Unimbɔti nì ifaal.

english_verse: and he chose for us the land that was the pride of Jacob, his favorite.
translation_verse: U sīntì anibul ki ŋá ti-taapu, u dū atimbun ki ŋá ti-taaŋi taapu.

english_verse: God goes up to his throne, as people shout and trumpets blast.
translation_verse: U lēē ti-fakal ki tīī-ti, kun tìì Jaakɔb un u néeńee mmɔnee.

english_verse: the ruler of all the earth! Praise God with songs.
translation_verse: Gāāmaan ilan kí nyɔ̄ŋkì Unimbɔti, nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan-u! Gāāmaan ilan kí nyɔ̄ŋkì ti-bɔtiu, nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan-u!

english_verse: God rules the nations from his sacred throne.
translation_verse: Di sá yii Unimbɔti di sá kitiŋ kɔkɔ bɔtiu. Gāāmaan ilan in mɔ̄ee kí nyɔ̄ŋkì-u.

english_verse: beautiful and majestic, brings joy to all on earth. Mount Zion, truly sacred, is home for the Great King.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan sá ukpaan ní ki máaǹ bí nyɔ̄ŋkì-u úǹ ti-Nimbɔtiu tiŋkin, u-circir jool pu.

english_verse: God is there to defend it and has proved to be its protector.
translation_verse: Dì ŋān̄ ki fɔ̀kɔ̀ ní ki tìì kitiŋ kɔkɔ mmɔn. Ŋgan pú kúnti kuntee, Siiyɔn jool dee, ubɔtikpaan tiŋki.

english_verse: Kings joined forces to attack the city,
translation_verse: Siiyɔn guŋŋi poonee, bi nyí Unimbɔti nín sá bi-balilaŋkee.

english_verse: but when they saw it, they were terrified and ran away.
translation_verse: Kpèè, bibɔtiibi nìn kóoǹ ki kpáfì, bi còom̄ dicilpu ki cá kí já nì Siiyɔn tiŋki.

english_verse: or like seagoing ships wrecked by eastern winds.
translation_verse: Dibɔbil pu niin ní bi-wunti kpíì, a lì kii unimpu un kā imatiŋween puee.

english_verse: Mount Zion will celebrate, and all Judah will be glad, because you bring justice.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti, kii a-yindi nín gbītì ki tin sāā kitiŋ gbeennyɔkɔ puee, míǹ ní a-nyɔŋkii mun gbītì. Deedee gbí a-ŋaŋgiilin.

english_verse: Let's walk around Zion and count its towers.
translation_verse: Siiyɔn jool bíi fàal̀, Juuda timmu bí mmɔnni a-bɔsooŋyi pu.

english_verse: “Our God is like this forever and will always guide us.”
translation_verse: Kpèèmaan digundi din bi máń ki tú-dèe, kàam̀maan di-bɔtinaakɔti kí dāá dūú māafì bin baa láá màl̄ee

english_verse: Everyone on this earth, now listen to what I say!
translation_verse: Koora dicaŋkun yab di gāā nlan nee ki tīī bilaŋgaaliibi kpiliu.

english_verse: Listen, no matter who you are, rich or poor.
translation_verse: Anibul kɔkɔ ń pīlifì tin bí nee, duulinya kɔkɔ nib ń kpòon̄ bi-tafaliŋ kí pīlifì,

english_verse: I speak words of wisdom, and my thoughts make sense.
translation_verse: binifantantiibi nì binikpaambi, bigaajab nì bisoodambi kɔkɔ:

english_verse: I have in mind a mystery that I will explain while playing my harp.
translation_verse: m làá sòoǹ iciin nyɔɔbuŋŋi, tin kā m-pɔbilin m dàkafēe cáá taapu.

english_verse: Why should I be afraid in times of trouble, when I am surrounded by vicious enemies?
translation_verse: M kpōoǹ m-tafal ki pílifì dilaŋkpandi, m làá bɔ̀ɔ̀ m-beeku kí lēē m-pɔɔŋŋu taapu kí dàkà.

english_verse: They trust in their riches and brag about all their wealth.
translation_verse: Ba pu ní ḿ nīn fàŋkí iwiŋkpiti dal, ŋyunti ŋun m-nannanliibi māntìi tú-mee?

english_verse: You cannot buy back your life or pay off God!
translation_verse: Bi máká bi-gaajati pu, ní ki yòontí bi-ba yilpu bi-gaajati nín wīikí puee pu.

english_verse: It costs far too much to buy back your life. You can never pay God enough
translation_verse: Ama báà unil mun kaa ŋūǹ kí dā Unimbɔti cee u-juti maŋfal, àá kí pà úǹ u-ba maŋfal pu.

english_verse: We see that wise people die, and so do stupid fools. Then their money is left for someone else.
translation_verse: Unil ŋūǹ kí nīn bí jaanjaan kí taa kpú dalba dalbaaa?

english_verse: The grave will be their home forever and ever, although they once had land of their own.
translation_verse: Ti ká ki gíti káa! Biciŋfitiibi kúù, ní bigbaambi nì biwaatiibi mun kúù, ní kí búntí kí yàntī bi-gaajati ní biba ń dāá yòon̄.

english_verse: Here is what happens to fools and to those who trust the words of fools:
translation_verse: Unil nyooti kaa làá ŋmā kí yàntī ú taa kpú, u làá pée kpú kii kuwaŋkuluuee ní.

english_verse: They are like sheep with death as their shepherd, leading them to the grave. In the morning God's people will walk all over them, as their bodies lie rotting in their home, the grave.
translation_verse: Kpèè bin máká bi-ba puee kúntitam dee, nì bin pá bi-boon ki néeń bi nín sòoǹ puee.

english_verse: Don't let it bother you when others get rich and live in luxury.
translation_verse: Ama Unimbɔti làá dā m-naŋki kí nyāntí ditaŋkpiilin, tiŋman, u làá fīī-mi.

english_verse: Soon they will die and all their wealth will be left behind.
translation_verse: Ubɔ yaa kpántì ugaajee, án taa kɔ́-si nnimbitaataam, báà u-gaajati gbanti yaa mɔ̀tīi wīintí ki cá.

english_verse: We humans are praised when we do well, and all of us are glad to be alive.
translation_verse: Di sá yii u yaa kpíì, waa làá kpáaǹ báà tiba ní u-nyooti kaa làá táá-u kí kɔ́ dikaakulin.

english_verse: But we each will go down to our ancestors, never again to see the light of day.
translation_verse: Ŋyunti ŋun u nìn dáá bí dimaŋfalinee, u nìn pàkà u-ba ki lì yii: «Bi nyɔ́ŋkí-si, di sá yii an bútì-si tikɔkɔ poon!»

english_verse: Our human glory disappears, and, like animals, we die.
translation_verse: U làá cùú ŋàl̄ u-naanjab ditaŋkpiilin, bíǹ bin gíti kpá kí ká ŋwalifi dalba dalbee.

english_verse: From east to west, the powerful Lord God has been calling together everyone on earth.
translation_verse: Asaafi di ŋmàn̄ nlan nee. Unimbɔti Mpɔŋkɔdaan, ti-Dindaan sòon̄, u yíiń kitiŋ kɔkɔ tibuul, kí yòon̄ ŋwìiń nyalaŋki pú kí cáá sāā ŋu-jeetilaŋki.

english_verse: God shines brightly from Zion, the most beautiful city.
translation_verse: Doooo Siiyɔn, kitinnyaaŋŋi poon ní Unimbɔti páaǹní ŋwalifi māntìi tú-u.

english_verse: Our God approaches, but not silently; a flaming fire comes first, and a storm surrounds him.
translation_verse: Ti-Nimbɔtiu ń dāan̄ kí taa nín̄ ŋmí! Ŋŋmi ŋun fòol̄ bìlbilee līī u-nyɔkɔpu, ní kubuŋkpaaŋŋu māntìi tú-u.

english_verse: God comes to judge his people. He shouts to the heavens and to the earth,
translation_verse: Unimbɔti yíiń kutagbɔŋu kun dàn̄ yilpu nee, nì kitiŋ bí dāá kpèè u nín làá sòoǹ u-niboolii bɔti puee.

english_verse: “Call my followers together! They offered me a sacrifice, and we made an agreement.”
translation_verse: U bí yii: «Kóom̀maan bin yú nì mi deedeeyee kí kpāfì, bin ŋá saraa ki pūtì ki pōoǹ dipoondi nì mee!»

english_verse: The heavens announce, “God is the judge, and he is always honest.”
translation_verse: Kutagbɔŋu sòoǹ Unimbɔti deedeeu pu, di sá yii Unimbɔti u-ba di sòoǹ binib bɔti!

english_verse: My people, I am God! Israel, I am your God. Listen to my charges against you.
translation_verse: M-nibul pīlifì, m làá sòoǹ, Isirayeel, m làá sòoǹ kí kpɔ̀ a-bɔti, man di sá Unimbɔti, a-Nimbɔtiu.

english_verse: I won't accept your offerings of bulls and goats.
translation_verse: Maa làá lēē unaja a-dumpuɔɔɔ, kaa làá tí lēē iŋɔjaa a-naabakakun.

english_verse: Every animal in the forest belongs to me, and so do the cattle on a thousand hills.
translation_verse: Di sá yii man di yì kupɔɔun peelii nì ajoon kutukub kutukub pu peelii.

english_verse: I know all the birds in the mountains, and every wild creature is in my care.
translation_verse: M nyí inoon in kɔkɔ bí ajoon puee, man di tí yì kumooun peelii kɔkɔ.

english_verse: If I were hungry, I wouldn't tell you, because I own the world and everything in it.
translation_verse: Ŋkùm yaa bàà cáá-mee, an kaa sá sii ní m làá tùkù, di sá yii duulinya nì tin kɔkɔ bí u-poonee, man di yì.

english_verse: I don't eat the meat of bulls or drink the blood of goats.
translation_verse: M ŋmóò inajaa nantaaa, iŋɔjaa fatikuu ní m nyù ní?

english_verse: I am God Most High! The only sacrifice I want is for you to be thankful and to keep your word.
translation_verse: Ijaam ń nīn sá saraa un a làá ŋá kí tīī man Unimbɔtee, ní kí ŋá a nín pōoǹ yii a làá ŋá puee kí tīī man Yilpu Fɔ́ŋŋŋ Nimbɔtiu.

english_verse: Pray to me in time of trouble. I will rescue you, and you will honor me.
translation_verse: Niinee a yaa kɔ́ dinimbinaamandin ní ki yíiń-mee, m làá fīī-si ní á nyɔ̄ŋkì-mi.

english_verse: But to the wicked I say: “You don't have the right to mention my laws or claim to keep our agreement!
translation_verse: Ama Unimbɔti bíi tùkù unikpiti yii: «Ba pu ní a sòoǹ ki bùsī m-marab? Ba pu ní a sòoǹ m-poondi pu?

english_verse: You refused correction and rejected my commands.
translation_verse: Sii ná m-dàkatam ní ki féeń m-marab.

english_verse: You made friends with every crook you met, and you liked people who break their wedding vows.
translation_verse: A yaa ká unaayuuyee ní u-bɔti mɔ̄ǹ-si, sii nì bilaakpaadambi di kpáfí ki kàal̀.

english_verse: You talked only about violence and told nothing but lies;
translation_verse: A yāntì a-nyɔkɔ sòoǹ tibɔkpitil, ní a-limbil sòoǹ tinyimɔmbɔti.

english_verse: you sat around gossiping, ruining the reputation of your own relatives.”
translation_verse: A yaa kāl̀ee, a-juti bɔti ŋma ní a sòoǹ, ní ki cāab̀ a-nabiki kiŋkiŋ disambiil.

english_verse: When you did all this, I didn't say a word, and you thought, “God is just like us!” But now I will accuse you.
translation_verse: Kpèè kun ní a ŋáań ki là ḿ nīn ŋmée. A dàkafī yii m bí kii siiyee níii? M làá wòoǹ-si ní kí bìitī a-tuŋkpitiŋ kɔkɔ pu kí bíĺ a-nimbiin.»

english_verse: You have ignored me! So pay close attention or I will tear you apart, and no one can help you.
translation_verse: Nimbi bin súntí man Unimbɔti puee, ní gbìl̄maan tibɔti gbanti taapu! An yaa kaa sá míǹ, m làá tɔ̀ntī-ni, ní ubɔ dāa kpá kí fīī-ni.

english_verse: The sacrifice that honors me is a thankful heart. Obey me, and I, your God, will show my power to save.
translation_verse: Un cáá ijaam ki ŋáań-mi saraayee, úǹ di tìì-mi tinyool. Udaan dī nsan ŋun poon m làá yàntī ú ká man Unimbɔti fiilee dee.

english_verse: You are kind, God! Please have pity on me. You are always merciful! Please wipe away my sins.
translation_verse: Daafiidi di ŋmàn̄ nlan nee ki tīī bilaŋgaaliibi kpiliu.

english_verse: I know about my sins, and I cannot forget the burden of my guilt.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti, a-neeŋkpaandi puee, á sɔ̄ m-saai. Sii un poon mɔ̄ tikpilee, pítí m-yìntitam.

english_verse: I have sinned and done wrong since the day I was born.
translation_verse: Di sá yii m nyí m nín yīntiǹ-see, m-kpitii dɔ̄ m-nimbiin ní baabadal.

english_verse: Wash me with hyssop until I am clean and whiter than snow.
translation_verse: Tiŋman, ikpitin ní bi màl̄-mi, m-na nín cáá m-poolee, m sá unikpiti ní.

english_verse: Let me be happy and joyful! You crushed my bones, now let them celebrate.
translation_verse: Tiŋman, min kamaa a dū ibaamɔn ki bál̀ dibɔmbɔndinee, tibɔbalkaal gbanti poon ní a dàkà-mi iciin.

english_verse: Create pure thoughts in me and make me faithful again.
translation_verse: Yàntī ḿ gbìl̄ mmɔn nì dipɔɔpindi m-ni, ní akpab ŋin a nàn̄ dúsi dusee ń yīkì kí nīn ŋōō.

english_verse: Don't chase me away from you or take your Holy Spirit away from me.
translation_verse: Fàtī a-boon kí tīī m-kpitii, pítí m-yìntitam kɔkɔ.

english_verse: Make me as happy as you did when you saved me; make me want to obey!
translation_verse: Unimbɔti, náań dipɔbil din bí circiree kí tīī-mi, dū ŋfam min pɔ̀ɔǹee kí ŋá m-ni.

english_verse: I will teach sinners your Law, and they will return to you.
translation_verse: Taa dū-mi kí fá, kí taa fàtīí fōō a-circir Fam m-cee.

english_verse: Keep me from any deadly sin. Only you can save me! Then I will shout and sing about your power to save.
translation_verse: Fàtīí tīī-mi mmɔn ŋun bí a-fiil poonee, ní nlammɔntiim fam ń nīn tíkí-mi.

english_verse: Help me to speak, and I will praise you, Lord.
translation_verse: M làá dàkà bikpitiŋaliibi a-saŋŋu, ní ikpitidambi ń fàtīí gítiń a-cee.

english_verse: Offerings and sacrifices are not what you want.
translation_verse: M-Nimbɔtiu, Unimbɔti m-fiiliu, fīī-mi nnikpaakoon bɔkpilin ní ḿ gāā ilan mpɔn kí sòoǹ a-deedeeu pu.

english_verse: The way to please you is to be truly sorry deep in our hearts. This is the kind of sacrifice you won't refuse.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, tábití m-nyunculiŋ ní ḿ dū m-nyɔkɔ kí gāā ilan kí nyɔ̄ŋkì-si.

english_verse: Please be willing, Lord, to help the city of Zion and to rebuild its walls.
translation_verse: Di sá yii a yaa là saraabi, m bàà ŋáań kí tīī-si. Bisaraawɔkaabi gba kaa fáatiǹ-si.

english_verse: Then you will be pleased with the proper sacrifices, and we will offer bulls on your altar once again.
translation_verse: Saraa un di fáatiǹ Unimbɔtee di sá dipɔbil din sīntiǹ di-ba taapuee. Unimbɔti, aa fàtī a-boon kí tīī dipɔbil din sīntiǹ di-ba kɔkɔee.

english_verse: You people may be strong and brag about your sins, but God can be trusted day after day.
translation_verse: Daafiidi di ŋmàn̄ nlan nee ki tīī bilaŋgaaliibi kpiliu.

english_verse: You plan brutal crimes, and your lying words cut like a sharp razor.
translation_verse: Ueedoomja Dooweegi nìn cūtìi tùkū Sayuul yii: «Daafiidi cūtì Ayiimeeleeki cee.»

english_verse: You would rather do evil than good, and tell lies than speak the truth.
translation_verse: Ubaatandaan, ba pu ní a yòontí a-ba a-kpitii pu míǹ? Unimbɔti ŋanti bí ní baabadal.

english_verse: You love to say cruel things, and your words are a trap.
translation_verse: A-limbil sòoǹ ki bɔ́ntí min a làá ŋá ikpitee, dì jītí kii bɔlfi un bi lōoǹee, ní ki yáb̀ ki sòoǹ tinyimɔmbɔti.

english_verse: God will destroy you forever! He will grab you and drag you from your homes. You will be uprooted and left to die.
translation_verse: A néeń tikpitil ki jítiǹ tiŋan, ní ki néeń nnyimɔn ki jítiǹ mbaamɔn.

english_verse: When good people see this fearsome sight, they will laugh and say,
translation_verse: A néeń kí sòoǹ kí bīil̀ unil, a-limbil ŋmàtíǹ binib ŋma ní.

english_verse: “Just look at them now! Instead of trusting God, they trusted their wealth and their cruelty.”
translation_verse: Unimbɔti u-ba di làá nàan̄-si múb, u làá dáaĺ-si kí nyāntí a-diikun, ní kí lēē-si binifoobi tiŋki pu.

english_verse: But I am like an olive tree growing in God's house, and I can count on his love forever and ever.
translation_verse: Deedeedambi làá dāá ká ní kí fàŋkì, ní kí dāá nīn lāā ki lì yii:

english_verse: I will always thank God for what he has done; I will praise his good name when his people meet.
translation_verse: «Kpèè ubaatandaan un kaa nìn sáǹ ki kɔ́ Unimbɔti, ama ní ki nìn máká u-gaajati pu, ki dàkafī yii u pɔ̄ɔ̄yee sèé!»

english_verse: From heaven God looks down to see if anyone is wise enough to search for him.
translation_verse: Bigbaambi lì bi-ban yii: «Unimbɔti kpá!» Bi gáatì ní ki ŋáań ntimbiil tuuŋŋi, bi-kansikin ubɔ kaa pée ŋáań tin kítèe.

english_verse: But all of them are crooked and corrupt. Not one of them does right.
translation_verse: Doooo yilpu ní Unimbɔti gbóoń ki kpēē binib, kí kpèè ubɔ yaa bí ki cáá iciin ki nyàab̀ Unimbɔti.

english_verse: Won't you lawbreakers learn? You refuse to pray, and you gobble up the people of God.
translation_verse: Bi-kɔkɔ wáŋkì, ugàntil kpá ki ŋáań tin kítèe, báà ubɔ kaa bí ki ŋáań tin ŋān̄ee, báà uniseen, an kpá ní.

english_verse: But you will be terrified worse than ever before. God will scatter the bones of his enemies, and you will be ashamed when God rejects you.
translation_verse: «Bikpitiŋaliibi nee kalin sá bigbaambi níii? Bi mùul̄ m-nibul ki jīǹ, ní kaa pée jáaḿ-mi dalba dalba.»

english_verse: I long for someone from Zion to come and save Israel! Our God, when you bless your people again, Jacob's family will be glad, and Israel will celebrate.
translation_verse: Niinee ní bi fāŋkì bi-wunti bíi jìkì, bíǹ bin kaa nìn fāŋkì ki kée, di sá yii Unimbɔti làá yàaǹ u-nibul nannanliibi kpabiŋ. Bi làá kɔ́ icoon, di sá yii Unimbɔti dū-bi ki fá.

english_verse: Save me, God, by your power and prove that I am right.
translation_verse: Daafiidi di ŋmàn̄ nlan nee ki tīī bilaŋgaaliibi kpiliu. Bi bɔ̀ɔ́ tibati ní ki gà-ŋu.

english_verse: Listen to my prayer and hear what I say.
translation_verse: Siifi yab nìn cūtìi tùkū Sayuul yii Daafiidi cūtìi bál̀ bi-cee.»

english_verse: Cruel strangers have attacked and want me dead. Not one of them cares about you.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti, a-yindi puee, fīī-mi. Dū a-pɔŋŋu kí sòoǹ m-bɔti kí pɔ̀-mi.

english_verse: You will help me, Lord God, and keep me from falling;
translation_verse: Unimbɔti, pīlifì m-wimmeem, kpòon̄ a-tafal kí pīlifì tibɔti tin nyēeń m-nyɔkɔnee.

english_verse: you will punish my enemies for their evil deeds. Be my faithful friend and destroy them.
translation_verse: Binicambi bíi jáà nì mi ní bin néeń tipɔmbɔtee bíi nyàab̀ kí kpɔ̀-mi. An nibee kaa dū Unimbɔti ki yíiń tiba.

english_verse: You have rescued me from all my troubles, and my own eyes have seen my enemies fall.
translation_verse: Yàntī bin cɔ́ŋkí-mee kpitii ń gítí bi-pu! A-baamɔŋyi puee, nàan̄-bi.

english_verse: Listen, God, to my prayer! Don't reject my request.
translation_verse: Daafiidi di ŋmàn̄ nlan nee ki tīī bilaŋgaaliibi kpiliu. Bi bɔ̀ɔ́ tibati ní ki gà-ŋu.

english_verse: Please listen and help me. My thoughts are troubled, and I keep groaning
translation_verse: Unimbɔti, pīlifì m-wimmeem, m yaa bíi gbàam̄-see, á taa fàtī a-boon kí tīī-mi.

english_verse: because my enemies attack with loud shouts. They treat me terribly and hold angry grudges.
translation_verse: Pīlifì-mi kí kíí-mi. Maa ti nyí tin poon m bée ní m bí ki yáliŋkí

english_verse: I am trembling with fear, completely terrified.
translation_verse: M-pɔbil máfí ní ŋkúm nyoondi cúú-mi.

english_verse: I wish I had wings like a dove, so I could fly far away and be at peace.
translation_verse: Kufaaŋŋu cúú-mi m bíi jìkì, ní m-wunti dūu kpíì.

english_verse: I would quickly find shelter from howling winds and raging storms.
translation_verse: Tiŋman, m bàà làá cù ndandati, kí tin nín̄ kóò kuteeun.

english_verse: Confuse my enemies, Lord! Upset their plans. Cruelty and violence are all I see in the city,
translation_verse: M bàà làá ŋá malaa kí ká kibalilaŋ, kí nīn dátiǹ kubuŋkpaaŋŋu nee.»

english_verse: and they are like guards on patrol day and night. The city is full of trouble, evil,
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, kɔ́ǹ-bi fìkil fikil poon, kí yàntī bi-limbiliŋ ń nyìŋfì. Di sá yii m ká tipɔmbɔti nì kunikpɔŋkpɔkɔu kitiŋ nee poon.

english_verse: We enjoyed being together, when we went with others to your house, our God.
translation_verse: Ama an sá sii, m-nabiki, m-bɔɔmɔnti, unil un man nì u tāatée!

english_verse: All who hate me are controlled by the power of evil. Sentence them to death and send them down alive to the world of the dead.
translation_verse: Ti nìn sòoǹ ní an mɔ̄ ní ki nìn còom̄ dicilpu míǹ kunimbɔtidiin.

english_verse: I ask for your help, Lord God, and you will keep me safe.
translation_verse: Yàntī m-nannanliibi ń kpú ŋkúntuntukum! Bí nīn wāĺ nì bi-nimbiliŋ ní kí sìntī ditaŋkpiilin, di sá yii ntoom bí bi-dumpui ki bí bi-pɔbiliŋin.

english_verse: Morning, noon, and night you hear my concerns and my complaints.
translation_verse: Mamee, Unimbɔti ní m yíì, ní úǹ ti-Dindaan di làá fīī-mi.

english_verse: I am attacked from all sides, but you will rescue me unharmed by the battle.
translation_verse: Kutaafaau nì ŋwiimpu nì kujoou, m yáliŋkí ki fátí diniindi. Ama u gbìl̄ m-neen pu,

english_verse: You have always ruled, and you will hear me. You will defeat my enemies because they won't turn and worship you.
translation_verse: ki fīī-mi ki wúń m-pu ŋyunti ŋun bi nìn bíi jáà nì mee, di sá yii m-nannanliibi nìn wīikí m-pu.

english_verse: Our Lord, we belong to you. We tell you what worries us, and you won't let us fall.
translation_verse: U-nyɔkɔ mɔ̄ kii tisiilee ní, ama ní u-poon tū kátí kati. U-nyɔɔbuŋŋi mèeǹ kii dikpajundee ní, ama ki jītí kii kitàataajikee.

english_verse: But what about those people who are cruel and brutal? You will throw them down into the deepest pit long before their time. I trust you, Lord!
translation_verse: Túutí a-waŋgul kí dūú túń ti-Dindaan, u làá tíkiń-si, u kpá kí yàntī tiba ń cìŋkì deedeedaan.

english_verse: but even when I am afraid, I keep on trusting you.
translation_verse: M-nannanliibi kā m-pu baabadal. Bin bí ki jáà nì mee wīikí tikpil.

english_verse: I praise your promises! I trust you and am not afraid. No one can harm me.
translation_verse: Ama ŋyunti ŋun kufaaŋŋu yaa cúú-mee, m dù m-mákal kí páań sii pu ní.

english_verse: Enemies spend the whole day finding fault with me; all they think about is how to do me harm.
translation_verse: M nyɔ́ŋkí Unimbɔti u-nyɔɔbundi pu, m máká u-pu ní kaa fàŋkí tiba. Ba ní nisaaleen ŋūǹ kí ŋá-mi?

english_verse: They attack from ambush, watching my every step and hoping to kill me.
translation_verse: Ŋwiin kamaayee, bi cútí m-nyɔɔbuŋŋi ki kpántí, bi pée dàkafī m-pu tikpitil ŋma ní.

english_verse: They won't get away with these crimes, God, because when you get angry, you destroy people.
translation_verse: Bi bāal̀ ki cɔ́ŋkí-mi ní ki kpèé tin kɔkɔ m ŋáańee ki pée nyàab̀ kí lēē m-maŋfal.

english_verse: You have kept record of my days of wandering. You have stored my tears in your bottle and counted each of them.
translation_verse: Atuŋkpiti nee puee, bi làá ŋmátáaa? Unimbɔti, a-ŋuul ń fáá binib nee kí lúkú!

english_verse: When I pray, Lord God, my enemies will retreat, because I know for certain that you are with me.
translation_verse: A kàan̄ ŋfunyɔm min m sáǹee. Tíkiń m-nyinnyim kí ŋá a-lookun. Aa kàan̄-mì ki ŋá a-gbɔŋkunaaa?

english_verse: I trust you and am not afraid. No one can harm me.
translation_verse: M nyɔ́ŋkí Unimbɔti tin u sòon̄ee pu, m nyɔ́ŋkí ti-Dindaan u-nyɔɔbundi pu.

english_verse: I will keep my promises to you, my God, and bring you gifts.
translation_verse: M máká Unimbɔti pu ní kaa fàŋkí tiba. Ba ní unil ŋūǹ kí ŋá-mi?

english_verse: You protected me from death and kept me from stumbling, so that I would please you and follow the light that leads to life.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti, m nín pōoǹ-si puee, m làá ŋá míǹ. M làá ŋá ijaam saraau kí tīī-si.

english_verse: God Most High, have pity on me! Have mercy. I run to you for safety. In the shadow of your wings, I seek protection till danger dies down.
translation_verse: Daafiidi nín sáǹ ki kɔ́ ntaŋkpalɔkɔn ki ŋmátì Sayuul ŋaanee ní u gāā nlan nee ki tīī bilaŋgaaliibi kpiliu.

english_verse: You will send help from heaven and save me, but you will bring trouble on my attackers. You are faithful, and you can be trusted.
translation_verse: Yilpu fɔ́ŋŋŋ Nimbɔtiu ní m yíì, Unimbɔti un làá ŋá tikɔkɔ kí tīī-mee.

english_verse: My enemies are fierce, much worse than lions! They have spears and arrows instead of teeth, and they have sharp swords instead of tongues.
