translation_verse: U làá tīiń-mi difiil doooo yilpu, u làá yàntī icoo ń cúú un kā m-puee. Unimbɔti làá dàkà-mi u-neeŋkpaandi nì u-deedeeu.

english_verse: May you, my God, be honored above the heavens; may your glory be seen everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: M dɔ̄ binib bin bí kii gbikintib bin ŋmóò binibee kansikin ní. Bi-nyiŋŋi cɔ́m̀ kii ŋkpamu nì ipiinee ní, ní bi-limbiliŋ jītí kii bɔlfee.

english_verse: Enemies set traps for my feet and struck me down. They dug a pit in my path, but fell in it themselves.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti, a sá ukpaan ki jítiǹ kutagbɔŋu, yàntī a-nyooti ń gbí kitiŋ kɔkɔ!

english_verse: I am faithful to you, and you can trust me. I will sing and play music for you, my God.
translation_verse: Bi dū kulaaŋŋu ki píĺ m-saŋŋu pu, maa ti cáá dimákal. Bi gbìn̄ mbòó ki píĺ-mi, ama bíǹ bi-ba di jéetì ŋu-poon.

english_verse: I feel wide awake! I will wake up my harp and wake up the sun.
translation_verse: M cáá dimákal, Unimbɔti, m lafun baasii cáá dimákal ní, m làá gāā nlan kí nyɔ̄ŋkì-si.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, for everyone to hear, and I will sing hymns to you in every nation.
translation_verse: M-naŋki, fìntī, iŋmii saalaa beeku saŋguu, fìntīmaanee, m làá péeǹ kutaa kí fìntī.

english_verse: Your love reaches higher than the heavens; your loyalty extends beyond the clouds.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, m làá nyɔ̄ŋkì-si anibul kansikin, m làá gāā ilan kí pàkà-si atimbun kansikin.

english_verse: May you, my God, be honored above the heavens; may your glory be seen everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Di sá yii a-neeŋkpaandi tùutī kutagbɔŋu, ní a-deedeeu sàatī atagban.

english_verse: Do you mighty people talk only to oppose justice? Don't you ever judge fairly?
translation_verse: Daafiidi di ŋmàn̄ nlan nee ki tīī bilaŋgaaliibi kpiliu. Bi gà-ŋu nì nneen ŋun sá «Taa yàntī bí bīil̀ee...» ní.

english_verse: You are always planning evil, and you are brutal.
translation_verse: Tiŋman, ni yaa sòoǹee, ibaamɔn ŋmí ní. Nnibiyaamu, ni sòoǹ binib bɔti deedeeee?

english_verse: You have done wrong and lied from the day you were born.
translation_verse: Aayee! Ni pée nyí ní ki ŋáań ikpiti, nimbi ni-ba di ŋáań tipɔmbɔti kitiŋ pu.

english_verse: Your words spread poison like the bite of a cobra
translation_verse: Binikpitib pée sá bikpitib doooo bi-na poon ní, bi tin pée lì yii bi màal̀-bee, bi kíĺ bi bíi mɔ́ntí.

english_verse: that refuses to listen to the snake charmer.
translation_verse: Bi cáá tilool kii ukoobuee ní. Bi bí kii ukoowaati un kpáá u-tafaliŋ,

english_verse: My enemies are fierce as lions, Lord God! Shatter their teeth. Snatch out their fangs.
translation_verse: kaa pílifí ikoobu laŋgaaliu laŋŋu, àá ukpaŋkpanti un bīń tiŋanee.

english_verse: Make them disappear like leaking water, and make their arrows miss.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti, gbá kí wūkul̀ bi-nyiŋŋi bi-nyɔmmun, ti-Dindaan, gbá kí fúkutí agbikintipɔmbil gbanti nyiŋŋi.

english_verse: Let them dry up like snails or be like a child that dies before seeing the sun.
translation_verse: Yàntī bí wāŋkì kii nnyim min dɔ̄ ki pùub̀ee! Yàntī bi-piiŋyi in bi tòóyee ń kpántí ipincal.

english_verse: Wipe them out quicker than a pot can be heated by setting thorns on fire.
translation_verse: Bí nīn bí kii yaaweel un còom̄ ki kōō ki cée! Bí taa wāl̀ ŋwìiń kii kibiki kin bi màl̄ kaa yōoǹee!

english_verse: Good people will be glad when they see the wicked getting what they deserve, and they will wash their feet in their enemies' blood.
translation_verse: Kí wàatī bi-bɔjanaakuŋŋi ń wíiǹ kí ŋá akpaanee, kunaakpaabuŋŋu kubɔ ń dāá yòon̄-ŋi, báà ŋi yaa dá láá sɔ̀m̀aaa, ŋi yaa kūńaaa, an kaa páb́.

english_verse: Everyone will say, “It's true! Good people are rewarded. God does indeed rule the earth with justice.”
translation_verse: Deedeedaan yaa láa ká Unimbɔti bíi dátí binikpitib tafalee, án làá dāá mɔ̄ɔkiǹ-u ní ú dāá fíntí u-taaŋi bi-fatikuu poon.

english_verse: Keep me safe from brutal people who want to kill me.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti, fīī-mi kí nyāntí m-nannanliibi ŋaan, wúń m-pu bin jáà nì mee ń taa ŋmā kí ŋá-mi tiba.

english_verse: But they are ready to attack. Do something! Help me! Look at what's happening.
translation_verse: Kpèè! Bi cí kí lēē m-maŋfal, bin pɔ̄ɔ̄yee bíi jáà nì mi. Ma mun kaa ŋá ikpiti ibaaa, kaa tí yīntì mun, ti-Dindaan!

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, you are the God of Israel. Punish the other nations and don't pity those terrible and rebellious people.
translation_verse: Maa ŋá tikpitil tiba, ama bi sáń kí cùú bɔ́ntí kí cīití-mi. Fìntī! Dāan̄ m-cee kí kpèè.

english_verse: My enemies return at evening, growling like dogs roaming the city.
translation_verse: Sii ti-Dindaan, Unimbɔti Mpɔŋkɔdaan, Isirayeel Nimbɔtiuee, fìntī kí dáaĺ atimbun nee kɔkɔ tafal. Taa sɔ̄ bin nyēē bi-bɔɔbi booŋyi nee saai.

english_verse: They curse, and their words cut like swords, as they say to themselves, “No one can hear us!”
translation_verse: Bi fàtīi gítiń kujoou kamaa ki mùuǹ kii ibooyee, ní ki còom̄ ki màntī kitiŋ.

english_verse: You, Lord, laugh at them and sneer at the nations.
translation_verse: Ntoonam di gbí bi-nyɔmmun, ní bi-nyɔɔbuŋŋi bí kii kitàataajikee. Bi dàkafī bi-ni yii: «Ŋma di làá gbìl̄?»

english_verse: You are my mighty fortress, and I depend on you.
translation_verse: Ama sii ti-Dindaan, a bí ní ki lāā-bi, a bèel̄ atimbun nee kɔkɔ nib.

english_verse: You love me and will let me see my enemies defeated.
translation_verse: Sii ní m kpèé, man pɔŋŋu. Unimbɔti di sá man taŋkpanaakooku.

english_verse: Don't kill them, or everyone may forget! Just use your mighty power to make them tremble and fall. You are a shield for your people.
translation_verse: Man Nimbɔtiu néeń-mi ní ki làá dāá fīī-mi. Man Nimbɔtiu làá yàntī ń jī m-nannanliibi pu dinyandi.

english_verse: My enemies are liars! So let them be trapped by their boastful lies.
translation_verse: Taa nàan̄-bi kɔŋkɔnnee, an yaa kaa sá míǹ, m-nibul làá súntí a-jajil pu. Dū a-pɔŋŋu kí gbāfì-bi kí fá ní kí sìntī-bi taapu, ti-Dindaan, ti-gbampɔɔl.

english_verse: Get angry and destroy them. Leave them in ruin. Then all the nations will know that you rule in Israel.
translation_verse: Bi yaa pée kíĺ isoonee, ikpiti ŋma di nyēē bi-nyɔmmun, yàntī bi-lambil ń kpántí kii kutaliŋŋuee kí sàl̀-bi, kun puee bi tòó mbusu ki mɔ́ntí inyimɔn!

english_verse: They search for scraps of food, and they snarl until they are stuffed.
translation_verse: Bi fàtīi gítiń kujoou kamaa ki mùuǹ kii ibooyee, ní ki còom̄ ki màntī kitiŋ.

english_verse: But I will sing about your strength, my God, and I will celebrate because of your love. You are my fortress, my place of protection in times of trouble.
translation_verse: Bi còom̄ ki nyàab̀ kun ní bi làá jēe, ní bi yaa kaa jíń ki díkée, ní bí kíĺ ki bíi gbóoĺ.

english_verse: You, God, are angry with us! We are rejected and crushed. Make us strong again!
translation_verse: Daafiidi di ŋmàn̄ nlan nee ki tīī bilaŋgaaliibi kpiliu bí nīn cáa dàkà. Bi bɔ̀ɔ́ kubeeu ní ki gà-ŋu.

english_verse: You made the earth shake and split wide open; now heal its wounds and stop its trembling.
translation_verse: Daafiidi cūtìi jáń nì Aram yab bin kóò Meesoopootamii nì Sooba timmunee. Bi nín kūnnée, Joowaab fātìi gítì ki kūū Eedoom yab binib kutukub saalaa nì bili Ŋyaam tantakalin. Niinee ní Daafiidi lī yii:

english_verse: You brought hard times on your people, and you gave us wine that made us stagger.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti, a dū-ti ki fá, ki yāntì ti yàl̄. Min kamaa a gíí ti-pu diŋuulee, fàtīí tīī-ti mpɔn.

english_verse: You gave a signal to those who worship you, so they could escape from enemy arrows.
translation_verse: A yāntì kitiŋ cīŋkì ki fáá iwèeń, fàtīí ŋéeb́ ki-wèeŋ́yi, di sá yii kàa ti yú ki pɔ̄ɔ̄.

english_verse: Answer our prayers, God! Use your powerful arm and give us victory. Then the people you love will be safe.
translation_verse: A yāntì a-nibul jíń falaa tikpil, a yāntì ti nyùn̄ ndaam min pɔ̄ɔ̄yee.

english_verse: Our God, you solemnly promised, “I would gladly divide up the city of Shechem and give away Succoth Valley piece by piece.
translation_verse: A tīī bin fàŋkí-see kudaaŋŋu bí sāǹ ipiin ń taa cúú-bi.

english_verse: The lands of Gilead and Manasseh are mine. Ephraim is my war helmet, and Judah is the symbol of my royal power.
translation_verse: Dū a-pɔŋkpaaŋŋu kí fīī-ti kí fōō ti-wimmeem, án nín làá ŋá pu a-nib bin a néeńee ń ká difiilee.

english_verse: Moab is merely my washbasin. Edom belongs to me, and I shout in triumph over the Philistines.”
translation_verse: Unimbɔti sòon̄ u-circir diiku poon. M jáń ki jíń! M làá yàkatī Siikeem tiŋki, ní kí ŋmàntī Sukooti tantakal.

english_verse: Our God, who will bring me to the fortress, or lead me to Edom?
translation_verse: Man di yì Galaadi, man di tí yì Manasee mun. Eefiraayiim di sá man janjafuuliiki, ní Juuda sá m-beel pɔŋŋu.

english_verse: Help us defeat our enemies! No one else can rescue us.
translation_verse: Ŋma di làá cùnnì-mi kitiŋ kin bi máń digundi ki túee poon ní? Ŋma di làá cùnnì-mi Eedoom tiŋkin,

english_verse: You will give us victory and crush our enemies.
translation_verse: an kaa sá sii Unimbɔti un di dū-ti ki fá, kaa ti cēentí ti-janjakitiŋeeee?

english_verse: Let me live with you forever and find protection under your wings, my God.
translation_verse: Di sá yii sii ní m sáń ki kóò, a sá digunlɔkɔl din pɔ̄ɔ̄yee ní m-nannanliibi nimbiin.

english_verse: You heard my promises, and you have blessed me, just as you bless everyone who worships you.
translation_verse: M bàà là kí nīn kóò a-circir kɔŋkooŋŋun baabadal, ní kí ká kibalilaŋ a-feeŋyi taapu.

english_verse: Let the king have a long and healthy life.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti, sii di gbìl̄ m-pooŋyi, ní ki tīī bin fàŋkí a-yindee kun bi lèe.

english_verse: May he always rule with you, God, at his side; may your love and loyalty watch over him.
translation_verse: Kūtì ubɔti mmaŋfafɔkɔn, yàntī ú kàl̄ kitiŋ pu doo kí yúntí tikpil tikpil!

english_verse: I will sing your praises forever, God, and will always keep my promises.
translation_verse: Ú nīn pée kā dibeel pu ki cá jaanjaan a-nimbiin. Yàntī a-neeŋkpaandi nì a-baamɔŋyi ń nīn wúń u-pu.

english_verse: Only God can save me, and I calmly wait for him.
translation_verse: Daafiidi di ŋmàn̄ nlan nee ki tīī bilaŋgaaliibi kpiliu.

english_verse: God alone is the mighty rock that keeps me safe and the fortress where I am secure.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti cee ní m kāntí dipɔɔsɔŋkil. U-cee ní m-fiil nyēeń.

english_verse: I feel like a shaky fence or a sagging wall. How long will all of you attack and assault me?
translation_verse: Úǹ di sá m-taŋkpanaakooku nì m-fiil. U sá m-balilaŋki, tiba kpá kí cìŋkì-mi.

english_verse: You want to bring me down from my place of honor. You love to tell lies, and when your words are kind, hatred hides in your heart.
translation_verse: Kí cáá sāā ŋyunti ŋulɔŋu ní ni làá kpāfì kí lùkù unibaanti kí líí-u kii digundi din wāntèe, àá kunaabakau kun bíi lítée ní?

english_verse: God alone is the mighty rock that keeps me safe, and he is the fortress where I feel secure.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti cee ní m kāntí dipɔɔsɔŋkil, u-cee ní m-mákal nyēeń.

english_verse: God saves me and honors me. He is that mighty rock where I find safety.
translation_verse: Úǹ di sá m-taŋkpanaakooku nì m-fiil. U sá m-balilaŋki, tiba kpá kí cìŋkì-mi.

english_verse: Trust God, my friends, and always tell him each of your concerns. God is our place of safety.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti di fìil̄-mi ki tìì-mi tinyool. Úǹ di sá m-taŋkpanaakooku nì laakin m sáń ki kóòyee.

english_verse: We humans are only a breath; none of us are truly great. All of us together weigh less than a puff of air.
translation_verse: Nimbi m-nibul, nín̄ mákámaan u-pu ŋyunti kamaa! Dūmaan tin páb́-nee kí bíĺ u-nimbiin. Unimbɔti ní ti sáń ki kóò.

english_verse: Don't trust in violence or depend on dishonesty or rely on great wealth.
translation_verse: Unil sá kii kubuŋuee ní, bikpaambeeee, ŋwaamueeee, ubɔ kaa bí tiban. Dū bi-kɔkɔ kí páań saniya pu kí ŋmàntī, bi-nyiŋfiŋu kaa làá bà kufoou nyiŋfiŋu gba.

english_verse: and I am very kind.” The Lord rewards each of us according to what we do.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti sòon̄ tibɔti tiba, u sòon̄ tibɔliliitiil tiba mun m gbìl̄, yii: «Unimbɔti di yì mpɔn.»

english_verse: Your love means more than life to me, and I praise you.
translation_verse: M nyàab̄-si a-kɔŋkooŋŋun, ki pée nyàab̀ kí wāl̀ a-pɔŋŋu nì a-nyooti.

english_verse: As long as I live, I will pray to you.
translation_verse: Di sá yii a-ŋanti jítiǹ dimaŋfal, an puee m làá nyɔ̄ŋkì-si.

english_verse: I will sing joyful praises and be filled with excitement like a guest at a banquet.
translation_verse: M làá nīn jáaḿ-si m-maŋfal wiiŋyi kɔkɔ poon, ní kí nīn yòontí m-ŋalii yilpu ki mèé-si.

english_verse: I think about you, God, before I go to sleep, and my thoughts turn to you during the night.
translation_verse: M làá jī tijimmɔntiil kí díkí, ní kí gāā ilan nì dipɔɔpindi kí nyɔ̄ŋkì-si.

english_verse: You have helped me, and I sing happy songs in the shadow of your wings.
translation_verse: M yaa dɔ̄ m-dooŋu puee, m téetí a-pu, ní ki mèé-si kunyamɔŋu kɔkɔ.

english_verse: I stay close to you, and your powerful arm supports me.
translation_verse: Di sá yii sii di jòoń-mi, ní m gāā ilan nì dipɔɔpindi a-feeŋyi booŋŋu taapu.

english_verse: All who want to kill me will end up in the ground.
translation_verse: M dū m-ba kɔkɔ ki nákáǹ-si, ní a-ŋaŋgiil tíkí-mi.

english_verse: Swords will run them through, and wild dogs will eat them.
translation_verse: Án nàan̄ bin nyàab̀ kí lēē m-maŋfalee! Bí sìntī taapu ditaŋkpiilin!

english_verse: Because of you, our God, the king will celebrate with your faithful followers, but liars will be silent.
translation_verse: Yàntī bí kpɔ̀-bi kujaau poon, bí kpántí sinsiŋkub jinti!

english_verse: Listen to my concerns, God, and protect me from my enemies' threats.
translation_verse: Daafiidi di ŋmàn̄ nlan nee ki tīī bilaŋgaaliibi kpiliu.

english_verse: Keep me safe from secret plots of corrupt and evil gangs.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti, pīlifì m-yaliŋkii. Fīī-mi kí nyāntí unannanli un m fàŋkée ŋaan.

english_verse: Their words cut like swords, and their cruel remarks sting like sharp arrows.
translation_verse: Fīī-mi kí nyāntí binikpitib nín bíi bɔ́ntí m-pu puee, nì bikpitiŋaliibi nín bíi kpáfí m-pu miŋyee poon.

english_verse: They fearlessly ambush and shoot innocent people.
translation_verse: Bi-limbiliŋ jītí kii bɔlfee, ní bi-nyɔɔbuŋŋi cáá tilool kii ilɔpiinee.

english_verse: They are determined to do evil, and they tell themselves, “Let's set traps! No one can see us.”
translation_verse: Bi bāal̀ kí tɔ̄ deedeedaan mpiin. Bi tòó-u dicilpu niin, kaa fàŋkí tiba.

english_verse: They make evil plans and say, “We'll commit a perfect crime. No one knows our thoughts.”
translation_verse: Bi tìì tɔb kunyannyaau bi-tuŋkpitiŋ poon, ki sòoǹ titalindi tin bi làá píĺ dibalinee pu yii: «Ŋma di làá wāl̀?»

english_verse: They will be destroyed by their own words, and everyone who sees them will tremble with fear.
translation_verse: Ama Unimbɔti làá tɔ̄-bi u-piiŋyi. Dicilpu niinee, bi fōō tiweendi.

english_verse: They will be afraid and say, “Look at what God has done and keep it all in mind.”
translation_verse: Bíǹ bi-ba nyɔɔbuŋŋi di fātìi gítì bi-pu. Bin kɔkɔ làá dāá ká-bee dāa gàatī bi-yiliŋ ní.

english_verse: May the Lord bless his people with peace and happiness and let them celebrate.
translation_verse: Báà ŋma làá dāá fàŋkì. Binib làá dāá māafì tin Unimbɔti ŋée, ní kí dāá gbìl̄ tin u ŋée taapu.

english_verse: Our God, you deserve praise in Zion, where we keep our promises to you.
translation_verse: Daafiidi di ŋmàn̄ nlan nee ki tīī bilaŋgaaliibi kpiliu. Nlan.

english_verse: Everyone will come to you because you answer prayer.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti un bí Siiyɔn tiŋkinee, an máaǹ tí nyɔ̄ŋkì-si, ní kí ŋá min ti pōoǹ-see.

english_verse: When our sins get us down, you forgive us.
translation_verse: Di sá yii a fòol̄ binib wimmeem. Unil kamaa dòoń a-cee.

english_verse: Our God, you save us, and your fearsome deeds answer our prayers for justice! You give hope to people everywhere on earth, even those across the sea.
translation_verse: Unil un a lēē ki yíiń ú dāan̄ a-ceeyee bí mmɔnneeee! Udaan làá nīn kóò a-kɔŋkooŋŋun. Ti làá dāá fōō tiwammɔntiil tin bí a-diikunee, circir wanti tin bí a-kɔŋkooŋŋunee.

english_verse: You silence the roaring waves and the noisy shouts of the nations.
translation_verse: Nì a-pɔŋŋu ní a dūu báaǹ ajoon ní ŋi bá ki pɔ̄ɔ̄, kun puee a dū mpɔn ki gbìn̄ a-caŋ kii gbajee.

english_verse: People far away marvel at your fearsome deeds, and all who live under the sun celebrate and sing because of you.
translation_verse: A pèefī tiŋkub wooku, ki pèefī bi-nyiŋgbanti fuuku, nì inibool kuŋkuuntii.

english_verse: You take care of the earth and send rain to help the soil grow all kinds of crops. Your rivers never run dry, and you prepare the earth to produce abundant grain.
translation_verse: A-maamaaci tuŋkpaaŋŋi ŋin a ŋée puee, duulinya nib kɔkɔ fāŋkì. A yàntī ŋwìiń nyalaŋki pú nì ŋwìiń jeetilaŋki pú timmu kūuntí nì dipɔɔpindi.

english_verse: You water all its fields and level the lumpy ground. You send showers of rain to soften the soil and help the plants sprout.
translation_verse: A kpèé kitiŋ, ki sɔ̀ŋkī-kì ntaanyim, ki gbéeǹ-kì tigaajati. Unimbɔti, nnyim gbí a-buŋŋu, a yàntī kitiŋ lòoǹ tikpaajin tiŋan, min ní a bɔ́ntí-kèe dee.

english_verse: Wherever your footsteps touch the earth, a rich harvest is gathered.
translation_verse: A yàantí ki-pɔŋyi, ki kpátí ki-tannaapikiŋ, ki yàntī utaa nì ki sɔ̀ŋkī-kì, ní ki tìì iwambool mpɔn í nyā.

english_verse: Meadows are filled with sheep and goats; valleys overflow with grain and echo with joyful songs.
translation_verse: Kuteeu pu naakpaapɔɔku mun cáá tigaajati tibaantiil ní, ní mmɔn māntìi tú ŋgbantamu.

english_verse: Tell everyone on this earth to shout praises to God!
translation_verse: Bilaŋgaaliibi kpiliu laŋŋu. Nlan. Kitiŋ pu kɔkɔ nib, fáámaan ŋwiliili kí nyɔ̄ŋkì Unimbɔti.

english_verse: Sing about his glorious name. Honor him with praises.
translation_verse: Gāāmaan ilan kí nyɔ̄ŋkì u-yindi, dūmaan inyɔŋki laŋyi kí tīī-u tinyool.

english_verse: Say to God, “Everything you do is fearsome, and your mighty power makes your enemies come crawling.
translation_verse: Ní lì Unimbɔti yii: «A-tuuŋŋi sá maamaaceeee!» A-pɔŋŋu nín sá ŋkpaan puee, a-nannanliibi pàkà-si.

english_verse: You are worshiped by everyone! We all sing praises to you.”
translation_verse: Kitiŋ pu nib kɔkɔ gbàantí a-nimbiin ki jáaḿ-si. Bi gà ilan ki nyɔ́ŋkí-si, bi gà ilan ki nyɔ́ŋkí a-yindi.

english_verse: Come and see the fearsome things our God has done!
translation_verse: Dāá kpèèmaan tin Unimbɔti ŋée, u-tuuŋŋi kɔ̄ntí binib dinyoondi.

english_verse: When God made the sea dry up, our people walked across, and because of him, we celebrated there.
translation_verse: U yāntì tiŋku fóotì ki kpántì kitiŋkuliŋŋi, binib dūtì dimɔɔl ŋkulimmi. An puee tí fàal̀ tin u ŋá nee pu.

english_verse: His mighty power rules forever, and nothing the nations do can be hidden from him. So don't turn against God.
translation_verse: Nì dibaatandi ní u jīǹ dibeel ki cá talku. U kpèé ki wāĺ atimbun kɔkɔ. Bin jáà nì uee ń taa nín̄ yòontí bi-ba yilpu!

english_verse: All of you people, come praise our God! Let his praises be heard.
translation_verse: Anibul kɔkɔ, jāam̀maan ti-Nimbɔtiu, nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan-u mpɔn mpɔn.

english_verse: God protects us from death and keeps us steady.
translation_verse: Úǹ di yāntì ti bí dimaŋfalin ní kaa yāntì ti-taaŋi ŋātì.

english_verse: You trapped us in a net and gave us heavy burdens.
translation_verse: A cáá-ti ki kɔ́ǹ kulaaŋŋun, a dū awaŋgul ŋin nyìm̀ee ki túǹ-ti.

english_verse: You sent war chariots to crush our skulls. We traveled through fire and through floods, but you brought us to a land of plenty.
translation_verse: A yāntì bitanjakaliibi dū itaamu ki tāā ti-yiliŋ pu ki jítì. Ti kɔ́ ŋŋmi nì nnyimin, ama a nyántì-ti ki kɔ́ǹ digbíl poon.

english_verse: I will bring sacrifices into your house, my God, and I will do what I promised
translation_verse: M làá cáań bisaraawɔkaabi a-diikun, m làá ŋá tin m pōoǹ yii m làá ŋá kí tīī-see.

english_verse: All who worship God, come here and listen; I will tell you everything God has done for me.
translation_verse: Nimbi bin kɔkɔ fàŋkí Unimbɔtee, dāá pīlifìmaan, m làá māafì-ni tin ní u ŋá ki tīī-mee.

english_verse: I prayed to the Lord, and I praised him.
translation_verse: M fáá mbiil ki yíiń-u, ní ki kíĺ ki bíi nyɔ́ŋkí-u.

english_verse: If my thoughts had been sinful, he would have refused to hear me.
translation_verse: M yaa bàà cáá ilandɔkɔkpiti m-nee, ti-Dindaan kaa bàà pílifíǹ-mi.

english_verse: But God did listen and answered my prayer.
translation_verse: Ama Unimbɔti pílifiǹ-mi, u kpōoǹ u-tafal ki pílifì m-wimmeem.

english_verse: Let's praise God! He listened when I prayed, and he is always kind.
translation_verse: Tí jāam̀ Unimbɔti, kun puee waa fātì u-boon ki tīī m-wimmeem, ní kaa ŋmīntì-mi u-ŋaŋkpaanti.

english_verse: Our God, be kind and bless us! Be pleased and smile.
translation_verse: Bilaŋgaaliibi kpiliu laŋŋu. Bi bɔ̀ɔ́ tibati ní ki gà-ŋu. Nlan.

english_verse: Let the nations celebrate with joyful songs, because you judge fairly and guide all nations.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti, anibul ń nyɔ̄ŋkì-si, anibul kɔkɔ ń kpāfì kí nyɔ̄ŋkì-si!

english_verse: Our God has blessed the earth with a wonderful harvest!
translation_verse: Unimbɔti, anibul ń nyɔ̄ŋkì-si, anibul kɔkɔ ń kpāfì kí nyɔ̄ŋkì-si!

english_verse: Pray for his blessings to continue and for everyone on earth to worship our God.
translation_verse: Kitiŋ lòon̄ tikpaajin, Unimbɔti, ti-Nimbɔtiu ń bìin̄ ti-pu!

english_verse: Do something, God! Scatter your hateful enemies. Make them turn and run.
translation_verse: Daafiidi di ŋmàn̄ nlan nee ki tīī bilaŋgaaliibi kpiliu. Nlan.

english_verse: Scatter them like smoke! When you come near, make them melt like wax in a fire.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti ń yīkì u-nannanliibi ń yàl̄, bin ná-uee ń sāǹ u-nimbiin.

english_verse: But let your people be happy and celebrate because of you.
translation_verse: Kii ŋŋminyiim nín wáŋkí puee, yàntī bí wāŋkì míǹ, kii kisikampiŋ nín dùntī ŋŋmin puee, míǹ ní an nàantí binikpitib Unimbɔti nimbiin.

english_verse: Our God, from your sacred home you take care of orphans and protect widows.
translation_verse: Gāāmaan ilan kí tīī Unimbɔti, gāāmaan ilan kí nyɔ̄ŋkì u-yindi, cátímaan nsan kí tīī un kā u-janjatɔrɔkuu pu ki páaǹní atagbannee. U-yindi di sá ti-Dindaan, nín̄ fàal̀maan u-nimbiin!

english_verse: You find families for those who are lonely. You set prisoners free and let them prosper, but all who rebel will live in a scorching desert.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti un di kóò u-circir kɔŋkooŋŋunee sá ataŋkpiibil baa nì un mɔ́tí bikpiipoobi puee ní.

english_verse: You set your people free, and you led them through the desert.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti di tìì un kaa cáá ubɔee kudicaŋu, ní ki tìì bisarkadambi mmɔn nì dibatɔl. Ama bin jáà nì Unimbɔtee kóò kitiŋkuliŋŋi pu ní.

english_verse: God of Israel, the earth trembled, and rain poured down. You alone are the God who rules from Mount Sinai.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti, ŋyunti ŋun a nìn nyáń ki līntì a-nibul nyɔkɔpuee, ŋyunti ŋun a nìn dū a-ba ki bíl̀ kuteeu puee,

english_verse: When your land was thirsty, you sent showers to refresh it.
translation_verse: kitiŋ nìn cīŋkì ní kutagbɔŋu cōotì Unimbɔti un sá Siinaayi jool Nimbɔtiuee nimbiin, Unimbɔti un sá Isirayeel Nimbɔtiuee nimbiin.

english_verse: Your people settled there, and you were generous to everyone in need.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti, a nìn yāntì utaa nìn̄ tiŋan pu, a-nibul nìn gīī ní a fātìi tīī-dì mpɔn.

english_verse: You gave the command, Lord, and a chorus of women told what had happened:
translation_verse: A-tiŋki pu ní a-nib kāl̀, a-ŋanti poonee, Unimbɔti, a bɔ́ntì mpaan gbanti ki tīī bifalaadambi.

english_verse: “Kings and their armies retreated and ran, and everything they left is now being divided.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan tīī mara, ní binimpoobi bin sòoǹ tibɔmɔntiilee dūu ŋá dikitikpaandi.

english_verse: And for those who stayed back to guard the sheep, there are metal doves with silver-coated wings and shiny gold feathers.”
translation_verse: Bibɔtiibi nì bi-janjakitiŋi sáǹ sáǹ, ní binimpoobi bin kíǹ mmɔŋkee yākatì tin bi sáǹ ki fée.

english_verse: God All-Powerful, you scattered the kings like snow falling on Mount Zalmon.
translation_verse: Ni dáá gbíntìi dɔ̄ kunaabakaunaaa? Animbil kúti náká náká dibeenanjil feeŋyi pu, ní sindaariyasoon náká náká di-kuti pu.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, Bashan is a mighty mountain covered with peaks.
translation_verse: Ŋyunti ŋun Unimbɔti Mpɔŋkɔdaan nìn bíi jì ki yàantí bibɔtiibee, ntaayim nìn bíi lítí Saalmɔn jool pu.

english_verse: Why is it jealous of Zion, the mountain you chose as your home forever?
translation_verse: Baasan jool sá Unimbɔti jool ní, Baasan jool sá dijool din cáá yilpu kúnti kunti wīikée.

english_verse: When you, Lord God, appeared to your people at Sinai, you came with thousands of mighty chariots.
translation_verse: Kin ba pu ní sii, dijool din cáá yilpu kúnti kunti wīikée ŋáań dijool din Unimbɔti lēē kí nīn kóò di-puee ipoompoon? Tiŋman, Unimbɔti làá nīn kóò niin ní talku.

english_verse: When you climbed the high mountain, you took prisoners with you and were given gifts. Your enemies didn't want you to live there, but they gave you gifts.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti cáá janjatɔrɔkub kutukub kutukub cutimaanyi. Ti-Dindaan bí bi-kansikin, Siinaayi jool din bí circir laŋkee pu.

english_verse: We praise you, Lord God! You treat us with kindness day after day, and you rescue us.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan Unimbɔti, a jɔ́m̀ yilpu niin kí nīn kóò. A cúú binib bi kíǹ ki sá bisarkadambi. Binib cáań-si tiwampɔkaal, ki kpáaǹ bin kaa tɔ́-see.

english_verse: You always protect us and save us from death.
translation_verse: Tí jāam̀ ti-Dindaan ŋwiin kamaa! U sá Unimbɔti ti-fiiliu un tūntí ti-gìŋ́ŋi ki tìì-tee ní.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, your terrible enemies are ready for war, but you will crush their skulls.
translation_verse: Ti-Nimbɔtiu sá Unimbɔti un fìil̄ee ní. Úǹ ti-Dindaan Unimbɔti di cáá mpɔn kí fīī-ti kí nyāntí ŋkúmin.

english_verse: You promised to bring them from Bashan and from the deepest sea.
translation_verse: Ama Unimbɔti làá wìil̀ u-nannanliibi yiliŋ, nì bin tú tiyikpifɔkɔl ki sá binikpɔliibee yaŋ.

english_verse: Then we could wash our feet in their blood, and our dogs could chew on their bones.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan bí yii: «M làá yòon̄ní-bi Baasan jool pu kí gíiǹní, m làá nyāntí-bi dimɔɔl taapu kí gíiǹní,

english_verse: We have seen crowds marching to your place of worship, our God and King.
translation_verse: án nín làá ŋá pu á còom̀ fatiku poon, ní a-booi ń ŋmɔ́ a-nannanliibi nantee.»

english_verse: Singers come first, and then the musicians, surrounded by young women playing tambourines.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti, ti ká binib nín còom̄ ki pàkà-si puee. M-Nimbɔtiu, m-bɔtiu bi còom̄ ki kóò a-kɔŋkooŋŋun.

english_verse: They come shouting, “People of Israel, praise the Lord God!”
translation_verse: Bilaŋgaaliibi līī, ní biwambɔɔliibi lúŋkì, ní bisapɔmbi bí kansikin ki cákafí cancakantib.

english_verse: The small tribe of Benjamin leads the way, followed by the leaders from Judah. Then come the leaders from Zebulun and Naphtali.
translation_verse: Ní jāam̀maan Unimbɔti ni-kooŋyi poon, nimbi bin nyeeŋu sá Isirayeelee, ní jāam̀ ti-Dindaan.

english_verse: Then kings will bring gifts to your temple in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti, dàkà a-pɔŋŋu, Unimbɔti, dàkà a-baatandi, sii un di túń atuŋkpaan ki tīī-tee.

english_verse: Force the Egyptians to bring gifts of bronze; make the Ethiopians hurry to offer presents.
translation_verse: Kpàtī tikatin waŋkuluku pu, inajaa nacaŋkpuŋku pu, kí kpáaǹ anibul ŋin bí kii anabil nee pu. Bi gbàantí ki tìì-si animbil kúti. Gbá kí yàaǹ anibul ŋin néeń kujaau nee.

english_verse: Now sing praises to God! Every kingdom on earth, sing to the Lord!
translation_verse: Bikàliŋkpaambi nyánní Eejipiti ki dɔ́miń, Eetiiyoopii yab tāntì bi-ŋalii ki túĺ Unimbɔti watil pú.

english_verse: Praise the one who rides across the ancient skies; listen as he speaks with a mighty voice.
translation_verse: Kitiŋ pu beeŋi, gāāmaan ilan kí nyɔ̄ŋkì Unimbɔti, nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan ti-Dindaan

english_verse: Tell about God's power! He is honored in Israel, and he rules the skies.
translation_verse: un jàkāń doooo cannaaku tagbɔŋku yilpuee. Pīlifìmaan, u tátiń mpɔmpɔn.

english_verse: The God of Israel is fearsome in his temple, and he makes us strong. Let's praise our God!
translation_verse: Sòom̀maan Unimbɔti pɔŋŋu pu. U jīǹ Isirayeel pu dibeel, ní u-pɔŋŋu bí atagbanni.

english_verse: Save me, God! I am about to drown.
translation_verse: Daafiidi di ŋmàn̄ nlan nee ki tīī bilaŋgaaliibi kpiliu. Bi bɔ̀ɔ́ tibati ní ki gà-ŋu.

english_verse: I am worn out from crying, and my throat is dry. I have waited for you till my eyes are blurred.
translation_verse: M nín sìntī tikpatin taapu taapu, ní m-taaŋi kaa gbèetī kitiŋ. M bí nnyim min nyóòyee poon, ní nnyinjil bíi yòontí-mi.

english_verse: There are more people who hate me for no reason than there are hairs on my head. Many terrible enemies want to destroy me, God. Am I supposed to give back something I didn't steal?
translation_verse: M gbáń ibiil ki tin gīī, m-neen séeb́. M nín kā ki kpèé a-saŋŋu pú puee yāntì m-nimbiliŋ gīī.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, ruler of Israel, don't let me embarrass anyone who trusts and worships you.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti, a nyí m-gbaandi pu, ní m-yìntitam kaa lìkī a-cee.

english_verse: It is for your sake alone that I am insulted and blush with shame.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan Unimbɔti Mpɔŋkɔdaan, taa yàntī man puee, icoo ń cúú bin máká a-puee. Isirayeel Nimbɔtiu, taa yàntī man puee, bí sìì bin nyàab̀-see.

english_verse: I am like a stranger to my relatives and like a foreigner to my own family.
translation_verse: Di sá yii sii pu ní bi sìí-mi, ní m-yil tīī kaa yáatí.

english_verse: My love for your house burns in me like a fire, and when others insult you, they insulted me as well.
translation_verse: M kpántì m-nabiyaamu cee unicaan, ní man nì bin pēē dinabiilee kaa ti nyí-mi.

english_verse: I cried and went without food, but they still insulted me.
translation_verse: Dineendi din m cáá a-diiku puee fòol̄ m-pɔbilin lìblib kii ŋŋmee. Asiibil ŋin bi sìí-see fàtīi gítiń man pu ní.

english_verse: They sneered at me for wearing sackcloth to show my sorrow.
translation_verse: M súń ki bóob́ kinyɔkɔ, ama ní binib sìí-mi.

english_verse: Rulers and judges gossip about me, and drunkards make up songs to mock me.
translation_verse: M dū kutuku ki pēeǹ kí dàkà m-nimbaaku, ní m-bɔti kpántì nlan bi gà.

english_verse: But I pray to you, Lord. So when the time is right, answer me and help me with your wonderful love.
translation_verse: Kpacantib puɔɔɔ, man bɔti ní bi sòoǹ, áli gba bidanyɔgbiliibi gà-mi ilan.

english_verse: Don't let me sink in the mud, but save me from my enemies and from the deep water.
translation_verse: Ama mamee, sii ti-Dindaan ní m bíi mèé, ŋyunti nee ní a máaǹ kí pīlifiǹ-mi. Unimbɔti, a-ŋanti wīikí tikpil, kíí-mi, di sá yii sii di sá difiil tiŋman pu.

english_verse: Don't let me be swept away by a flood or drowned in the ocean or swallowed by death.
translation_verse: Nyāntí-mi tikpati nee poon ḿ taa múĺ. Nyāntí-mi bin ná-mee ŋaan, nì mbúun nee poon.

english_verse: Answer me, Lord! You are kind and good. Pay attention to me! You are truly merciful.
translation_verse: Taa yàntī nnyinjil nee ń yòon̄-maaa, mbúun nee ń dū-mi kí náĺaaa, dikaakul nee mun ń dūú bìin̄ m-pu.

english_verse: Don't turn away from me. I am your servant, and I am in trouble. Please hurry and help!
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan kíí-mi, di sá yii a-neeŋkpaandi ŋān̄. A-poommɔŋŋu puee, fàtī a-ba kí túĺ-mi.

english_verse: Come and save me from my enemies.
translation_verse: Taa fàtī a-boon kí tīī man a-tɔntɔnliu. M bí dinimbinaamandin, kíí-mi malaa.

english_verse: You know how I am insulted, mocked, and disgraced; you know every one of my enemies.
translation_verse: Sútí kí pìl̄-mi kí fīī-mi. M-nannanliibi puee, fīī-mi.

english_verse: I am crushed by insults, and I feel sick. I had hoped for mercy and pity, but there was none.
translation_verse: A nyí bi nín sìí-mee, a nyí m-cooi nì bi nín sòoǹ ki bíiĺ-mi puee, a nyí m-nannanliibi kɔkɔ.

english_verse: Make their table a trap for them and their friends.
translation_verse: Bi dū ndabiim ki ŋá m-jinti poon, ní nnyinnyoo yaa cáá-mee, bi tìì-mi ndaam min gàm̀ee.

english_verse: Blind them with darkness and make them tremble.
translation_verse: Bi-jiŋaalib jinti ń kpántí-bi kutaliŋŋu, ní kí kpántí bin bi yíińee kpaalaa!

english_verse: Show them how angry you are! Be furious and catch them.
translation_verse: Bi-nimbiliŋ ń jɔ̀b̄ kí taa ti nín̄ wāĺ. Bí nīn pée bōō baabadal.

english_verse: Destroy their camp and don't let anyone live in their tents.
translation_verse: Kpáatí a-bum kí sìtī bi-pu, kí yàntī a-ŋuul ń jà kí cúú-bi.

english_verse: They cause trouble for people you have already punished; their gossip hurts those you have wounded.
translation_verse: Bi-kɔŋkooŋyi ń kpántí adigbun ubɔ ń taa ti kɔ́ bi-diiŋŋin,

english_verse: Make them guiltier than ever and don't forgive them.
translation_verse: kun puee bi sāaǹ un tafal a dáaĺee, ní ki sòoǹ bin a tīī tiweendee falaau pu.

english_verse: Wipe their names from the book of the living; remove them from the list of the innocent.
translation_verse: Gíiǹ bi-kpitii kɔkɔ kí túń-bi, taa pée dūú pɔ̄-bi.

english_verse: I am mistreated and in pain. Protect me, God, and keep me safe!
translation_verse: Pítí bi-yiŋŋi binifoobi gbɔŋkun, taa kàaǹ-bi kí kūtì deedeedambi pu.

english_verse: I will praise the Lord God with a song and a thankful heart.
translation_verse: Ama mamee m sá unandaan ki bíi jīǹ falaa, a-jòońdi làá wúń m-pu, Unimbɔti.

english_verse: This will please the Lord better than offering an ox or a full-grown bull.
translation_verse: M làá gāā nlan kí nyɔ̄ŋkì-si, ní kí jāam̀-si kí lì yii a sá ukpaan.

english_verse: When those in need see this, they will be happy, and the Lord's worshipers will be encouraged.
translation_verse: Tíǹ fáatiǹ sii, ti-Dindaan ki jítiǹ unaa, ki jítiǹ unaja nì iyin nì titafuŋfukul.

english_verse: The Lord will listen when the homeless cry out, and he will never forget his people in prison.
translation_verse: Bin sīntiǹ bi-ba taapuee làá ká míǹ ní kí nīn fàal̀. «Nimbi bin nyàab̀ Unimbɔtee, nimbi di yì mmaŋfafɔkɔn!

english_verse: Heaven and earth will praise our God, and so will the oceans and everything in them.
translation_verse: Di sá yii ti-Dindaan pílifíǹ bifalaadambi, waa féeń u-yab, ŋyunti ŋun bi yaa bí sarkanee.

english_verse: God will rescue Jerusalem, and he will rebuild the towns of Judah. His people will live there on their own land,
translation_verse: Kutagbɔŋu nì kitiŋ, nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan-u, ki kpáaǹ tiŋkub nì tin kɔkɔ bí bi-poonee.

english_verse: and when the time comes, their children will inherit the land. Then everyone who loves God will also settle there.
translation_verse: Di sá Unimbɔti làá fīī Siiyɔn jool, ní kí fàtīí mā Juuda timmu. U-nib làá dāá fōō-mu kí nīn kíǹ ki kóò.

english_verse: Save me, Lord God! Hurry and help.
translation_verse: Daafiidi di ŋmàn̄ nlan nee ki tīī bilaŋgaaliibi kpiliu kí téetí Unimbɔti pu.

english_verse: Embarrass and shame those who say, “We told you so!”
translation_verse: Bin nyàab̀ kí lēē m-maŋfalee, kɔ́ǹ-bi icoo! Bin nyàab̀-mi tikpitilee, bí gítí bi-boon kí fá bi-nyooti!

english_verse: I am poor and needy, but you, the Lord God, care about me. You are the one who saves me. Please hurry and help!
translation_verse: Ama yàntī bin kɔkɔ nyàab̀-see ń nīn bí mmɔnni ki fàal̀. Yàntī bin néeń sii ufiilee ń nīn pée lì yii: «Unimbɔti sá ukpaaneeee!»

english_verse: Save me, Lord God! Hurry and help.
translation_verse: Daafiidi di ŋmàn̄ nlan nee ki tīī bilaŋgaaliibi kpiliu kí téetí Unimbɔti pu.

english_verse: Embarrass and shame those who say, “We told you so!”
translation_verse: Bin nyàab̀ kí lēē m-maŋfalee, kɔ́ǹ-bi icoo! Bin nyàab̀-mi tikpitilee, bí gítí bi-boon kí fá bi-nyooti!

english_verse: I am poor and needy, but you, the Lord God, care about me. You are the one who saves me. Please hurry and help!
translation_verse: Ama yàntī bin kɔkɔ nyàab̀-see ń nīn bí mmɔnni ki fàal̀. Yàntī bin néeń sii ufiilee ń nīn pée lì yii: «Unimbɔti sá ukpaaneeee!»

english_verse: I run to you, Lord, for protection. Don't disappoint me.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, sii ní m sáǹ ki kɔ́, taa yàntī icoo ń cúú-mi dalba dalba.

english_verse: You do what is right, so come to my rescue. Listen to my prayer and keep me safe.
translation_verse: Fīī-mi kí wúń m-pu a-deedeeu poon. Kpòon̄ a-tafal m-watil pú, ní kí fīī-mi.

english_verse: Be my mighty rock, the place where I can always run for protection. Save me by your command! You are my mighty rock and my fortress.
translation_verse: Nín̄ sá kutaŋkpanaakoou kun m làá nīn sáń ki kóò ŋyunti kamaayee. A lēē yii a làá fīī-mi. Tiŋman, a sá m-taŋkpanaakooku nì m-balilaŋki!

english_verse: Come and save me, Lord God, from vicious and cruel and brutal enemies!
translation_verse: M-Nimbɔtiu, fīī-mi binikpitib ŋaan, nyāntí-mi binikpɔliibi nì bin dàkà tipɔmbɔtee ŋaan.

english_verse: I depend on you, and I have trusted you since I was young.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan Unimbɔti, sii pu ní m máká, doooo m-naacimpɔntin ní m máká a-pu.

english_verse: I have relied on you from the day I was born. You brought me safely through birth, and I always praise you.
translation_verse: Daliŋkin bi màl̄-mee, sii pu ní m báká, sii di nyántìń-mi m-na poon. Sii ní m làá nīn pée nyɔ́ŋkí.

english_verse: Many people think of me as something evil. But you are my mighty protector,
translation_verse: M nìn sá ŋabika ki tīī binib tikpil, ama sii ní m sáǹ ki kɔ́.

english_verse: and I praise and honor you all day long.
translation_verse: A-nyɔŋkii di pée gbí m-nyɔkɔn, ní m sòoǹ a-nyooti pu iwiin kɔkɔ.

english_verse: Don't throw me aside when I am old; don't desert me when my strength is gone.
translation_verse: M-puti poon nee, taa fá-mi, m-pɔŋŋu nín bātì nee, taa fàtī a-boon kí tīī-mi.

english_verse: My enemies are plotting because they want me dead.
translation_verse: M-nannanliibi sòoǹ m-pu, bin cɔ́ŋkí-mee kpáfì kinyɔkɔ m-pu.

english_verse: They say, “Now we'll catch you! God has deserted you, and no one can save you.”
translation_verse: Bi lì yii: «Unimbɔti dū-u ki fá, jàmaan kí cúú-u, ubɔ kpá ki làá fīī-u!»

english_verse: Come closer, God! Please hurry and help.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti, taa nín̄ dátiǹ-mi, m-Nimbɔtiu, dāá jòoń-mi malaa.

english_verse: Embarrass and destroy all who want me dead; disgrace and confuse all who want to hurt me.
translation_verse: Bin kɔ́kɔĺ-mee, yàntī icoo ń cúú-bi án nàan̄-bi! Bin nyàab̀-mi tikpitilee, yàntī icoo ń cúú-bi bí fá bi-nyooti!

english_verse: I will never give up hope or stop praising you.
translation_verse: Mamee, m làá nīn pée máká a-pu ní, m làá nīn pée gà ilan ní ki nyɔ́ŋkí-si.

english_verse: All day long I will tell the wonderful things you do to save your people. But you have done much more than I could possibly know.
translation_verse: M-nyɔkɔ làá nīn sòoǹ a-deedeeu nì a-fiil pu baabadal, di sá yii maa ŋūǹ kí kàaǹ a-ŋanti gbanti.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord God, for your mighty deeds and your power to save.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan Unimbɔti, m làá sòoǹ a-tuŋkpaaŋŋi pu, m làá téetí yii sii baba di sá deedeedaan.

english_verse: You have taught me since I was a child, and I never stop telling about your marvelous deeds.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti, doooo m-naacimpɔntin ní a dàkā-mi, ní m sòon̄ a-maamaaci tuuŋŋi pu ki dāa sāā díǹ.

english_verse: Don't leave me when I am old and my hair turns gray. Let me tell future generations about your mighty power.
translation_verse: Kɔŋkɔnnee m nín púĺ m-yikpiti píil̀ nee, Unimbɔti, taa fá-mi. Niinee m làá ŋmā kí sòoǹ a-tuŋkpaaŋŋi pu kí tùkù binipɔmbi, ní kí sòoǹ a-pɔŋŋu pu kí tùkù bin làá páanní bi-boonee.

english_verse: Your deeds of kindness are known in the heavens. No one is like you!
translation_verse: Unimbɔti, binib sòoǹ a-deedeeu pu kitiŋ kɔkɔ pu. Sii un di ŋá atuŋkpaanee, ŋma bí kii siiyee?

english_verse: You made me suffer a lot, but you will bring me back from this deep pit and give me new life.
translation_verse: A yāntì m kántì dinimbinaamandi nì agìń, ama a làá fàtīí tīī-mi dimaŋfal. A làá dáaĺ-mi kí nyāntí taapu ditaŋkpiilin.

english_verse: You will make me truly great and take my sorrow away.
translation_verse: A làá tí fàtīí ŋméeǹ-mi, ní kí gíiǹ m-nyooti kí tīī-mi.

english_verse: I will praise you, God, the Holy One of Israel. You are faithful. I will play the harp and sing your praises.
translation_verse: Man làá bɔ̀ɔ̀ kubeeu kí nyɔ̄ŋkì-si, m-Nimbɔtiu, m làá nyɔ̄ŋkì-si a-deedeeu pu. M làá bɔ̀ɔ̀ kubeeu kí pàkà-si, Isirayeel deedee Nimbɔtiu!

english_verse: You have rescued me! I will celebrate and shout, singing praises to you with all my heart.
translation_verse: M-nyunculiŋ làá tábití ḿ gāā ilan kí nyɔ̄ŋkì-si, m làá nīn tátí mpɔn ki fàal̀, di sá yii a fīī-mi.

english_verse: All day long I will announce your power to save. I will tell how you disgraced and disappointed those who wanted to hurt me.
translation_verse: Baabadalee, m-limbil làá nīn sòoǹ a-deedeeu pu, di sá yii icoo cúú bin nyàab̀-mi tikpitilee bi-yiliŋ tīntì.

english_verse: Please help the king to be honest and fair just like you, our God.
translation_verse: Saloomɔn di ŋmàn̄ nlan nee. Unimbɔti, yàntī ubɔti ń nín sòoǹ binib bɔti kii siiyee, kí tīī ubɔti jipɔɔn a-deedeeu.

english_verse: Let him be honest and fair with all your people, especially the poor.
translation_verse: Ú nīn kpòotī a-nibul nì deedee ní kí nīn sòoǹ biwɔfib bɔti nì ibaamɔn.

english_verse: Let peace and justice rule every mountain and hill.
translation_verse: Deedee puee, ajoon nì ŋgbantamu ń cáań a-nibul ŋgbansɔŋfi.

english_verse: Let the king defend the poor, rescue the homeless, and crush everyone who hurts them.
translation_verse: Ubɔti ń sòoǹ kí pɔ̀ dinibul wɔfib, ú nīn sá bifalaadambi fiiliu ní kí nà bin wɔ́b́-bee!

english_verse: Let the king live forever like the sun and the moon.
translation_verse: Ŋwìiń nì uŋmal yaa làá nīn pée bí ki ŋmíntée, binib làá nīn pée fàŋkí-si ní kí nīn cá jaanjaan!

english_verse: Let him be as helpful as rain that refreshes the meadows and the ground.
translation_verse: Ú kpákatiń kii utaa nín nì kusaaun puee, kii utaa nín nì tikpil ki sɔ̀ŋkī kitiŋ puee!

english_verse: Let the king be fair with everyone, and let there be peace until the moon falls from the sky.
translation_verse: Án bútí deedeedaan u-maŋfal wiiŋyi poon ní digbíl ń nīn bí kí cáá sāā daliŋkin uŋmal kaa ti làá nīn bée.

english_verse: Let his kingdom reach from sea to sea, from the Euphrates River across all the earth.
translation_verse: Ú jī dibeel kí yòon̄ tiŋku ubɔ kí cáá sāā un kíǹee, ní kí yòon̄ Eefiraati mɔɔl kí cáá sāā kitiŋ gbeennyɔkɔ!

english_verse: Force the desert tribes to accept his rule, and make his enemies crawl in the dirt.
translation_verse: Bin kóò kuteeunee làá dāá gbàan̄ u-nimbiin, ní u-nannanliibi ń dāá ŋmɔ́ ntam.

english_verse: Force the rulers of Tarshish and of the islands to pay taxes to him. Make the kings of Sheba and of Seba bring gifts.
translation_verse: Taarsiisi tiŋki nì ntimu mun nnyim māntìi túee bɔtiibi làá dāá cáań-u tiwampɔkaal, Sabaa nì Seeba timmu bɔtiibi làá dāá pà lampoo kí tīī-u.

english_verse: Make other rulers bow down and all nations serve him.
translation_verse: Bibɔtiibi kɔkɔ làá dāá gbàan̄ u-nimbiin, atimbun kɔkɔ làá dāá nīn bí u-taapu.

english_verse: Do this because the king rescues the homeless when they cry out, and he helps everyone who is poor and in need.
translation_verse: Di sá yii u làá dāá fīī uwɔfi un gbáà ibiilee, ní kí dāá fīī unandaan un kaa cáá ubɔ ń tūtuǹ-uee.

english_verse: The king has pity on the weak and the helpless and protects those in need.
translation_verse: U làá dāá sɔ̄ uwɔfi nì ufalaadaan saai, u làá dāá fīī bifalaadambi maŋfal.

english_verse: He cares when they hurt, and he saves them from cruel and violent deaths.
translation_verse: U làá dāá fīī-bi kí nyāntí diwɔ́bil nì tipɔmbɔtin, di sá bi-maŋfal cáá kunyampoou u-nimbiin.

english_verse: Long live the king! Give him gold from Sheba. Always pray for the king and praise him each day.
translation_verse: Ubɔti ń ká mmaŋfafɔkɔn! Bi làá dāá tīī-u Sabaa tiŋki sindaariyau. Bi làá dāá nīn mèé ki tìì-u ŋyunti kamaa, ní kí nīn mèé baabadal yii Unimbɔti ń bìin̄ u-boon!

english_verse: Let cities overflow with food and hills be covered with grain, just like Mount Lebanon. Let the people in the cities prosper like wild flowers.
translation_verse: Kitiŋ ń lòoǹ tiŋan, tikpaajin ń bìin̄ ajoon pu kí nīn cáá abil kii Leebanɔn jool puee, ní binib ń gbí kitiŋin kii kusaaun mɔsɔŋkuee.

english_verse: May the glory of the king shine brightly forever like the sun in the sky. Let him make nations prosper and learn to praise him.
translation_verse: Ubɔti yindi ń nīn bí ki cá jaanjaan, u-yindi ń nīn bí kii ŋwìiń nín bí pu jaanjaanee! Binib ń nīn cáá u-yindi ki mèé ki bìintí tɔb pu, ní atimbun kɔkɔ nib ń lì yii u bí mmɔnni.

english_verse: Lord God of Israel, we praise you. Only you can work miracles.
translation_verse: Tí nyɔ̄ŋkì ti-Dindaan Unimbɔti, Isirayeel Nimbɔtiu, úǹ baba di ŋáań maamaacib.

english_verse: We will always praise your glorious name. Let your glory be seen everywhere on earth. Amen and amen.
translation_verse: Tí nyɔ̄ŋkì u-yindi din cáá tinyoolee kí nīn cá jaanjaan! U-nyooti ń gbí kitiŋ kɔkɔ pu! Án ŋá míǹ, án lafun ŋá míǹ.

english_verse: This ends the prayers of David, the son of Jesse.
translation_verse: Jeesee jipɔɔn Daafiidi wimmeem nín kúntí laakiŋyee sɔ̀.

english_verse: ) God Is Good
translation_verse: ) Ba pu ní an bútí unikpiti ní?

english_verse: God is truly good to Israel, especially to everyone with a pure heart.
translation_verse: Asaafi di ŋmàn̄ nlan nee. Tiŋman, Unimbɔti ŋān̄ ki tīī Isirayeel, u ŋān̄ ki tīī bin pɔbil bí diba nì uee.

english_verse: because it made me jealous to see proud and evil people and to watch them prosper.
translation_verse: Di sá yii m nín ká an bútì bilambidambi puee, ní m kíǹ ki cáá binikpitib gbanti pu nnimbitaataam.

english_verse: They never have to suffer, they stay healthy,
translation_verse: Tiba kaa pée páb̀-bi áli bi-kúm dal, ní bi bí gbàlgbal ki cáá laafiya.

english_verse: Their pride is like a necklace, and they commit sin more often than they dress themselves.
translation_verse: An pu ní dibayoondi kpántì-bi tiwanléeŋkaal, ní tipɔmbɔti kpántì tiwampeeŋkaal bi cáa pèentí.

english_verse: Their eyes bulge with fat, and their minds are flooded with foolish thoughts.
translation_verse: Bi-nimbiin sá ŋkpam ŋma ní, tin bi dàkafī bi-pɔbilinee gíti lákatì.

english_verse: They sneer and say cruel things, and because of their pride, they make violent threats.
translation_verse: Bi bèel̄ binib ní ki sòoǹ tibɔkpitil ŋma. Bi yòontí bi-ba yilpu ní ki bɔ́ntí ki wɔ́b̀ bin kíǹee.

english_verse: They dare to speak against God and to order others around.
translation_verse: Bi wàantí bi-nyɔmmu kí já nì Unimbɔti, ní bi-limbiliŋ sòoǹ tikɔkɔ kitiŋ pu.

english_verse: God will bring his people back, and they will drink the water he so freely gives.
translation_verse: An pu ní Unimbɔti nib fātì bi-ba ki túĺ bi-watil pú, ní ki fòol̄ bi-nyɔɔbuŋŋi ki nyù kii nnyimee.

english_verse: Only evil people would say, “God Most High cannot know everything!”
translation_verse: Bi lì yii: «Mana ní Unimbɔti làá béé? Yilpu fɔ́ŋŋŋ Nimbɔtiu pée nyí tin bíi jītéeee?»

english_verse: Yet all goes well for them, and they live in peace.
translation_verse: Kpèèmaan binikpitib gbanti, tiba kaa pée páb̀-bi ní an bútí-bi ki kútí.

english_verse: What good did it do me to keep my thoughts pure and refuse to do wrong?
translation_verse: Mimmee m pée ŋá m-pɔbil circir ki fíntì m-ŋalii kí dàkà yii m sá maanyiiba fám deeyaa!

english_verse: I am sick all day, and I am punished each morning.
translation_verse: Falaa bà-mi baabadal, ní m bí ditafadaaldin kutaafaau kamaa.

english_verse: If I had said evil things, I would not have been loyal to your people.
translation_verse: Báà m yaa bàà bí yii: «M làá sòoǹ kii bíǹ nín sòoǹ pueeyaaa,» m nyáń a-nibul boon dee.

english_verse: It was hard for me to understand all this!
translation_verse: Ní m dākafì kí gbìl̄ taapu, ama ní m ká yii an pɔ̄ɔ̄ m-cee.

english_verse: Then I went to your temple, and there I understood what will happen to my enemies.
translation_verse: See m nín kɔ́ kunimbɔtidiinee ní m gbìl̄ tin dɔ̄ ki cí binikpitibee taapu.

english_verse: You will make them stumble, never to get up again.
translation_verse: Tiŋman, a làá dū-bi kí tɔ́kɔń dijɔnjɔndi pu, ní kí yàntī bí lítí kí nàan̄.

english_verse: They will be terrified, suddenly swept away and no longer there.
translation_verse: Ba ní an nāaǹ-bi dicilpu dicilpu mimmee! An dóò bi-pu dee, dinyoondi nāaǹ-bi!

english_verse: They will disappear, Lord, despised like a bad dream the morning after.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, a yaa yíkèe, bi làá wāŋkì kii unil nín dámintí pu kí fìntī kí súntée ní.

english_verse: Once I was bitter and brokenhearted.
translation_verse: Ŋyuntee, m-pɔbil nìn bí ntuntunni ní m-poon kaam nìn cɔ́tì.

english_verse: I was stupid and ignorant, and I treated you as a wild animal would.
translation_verse: M nìn sá ugbaan ní kaa gbìl̀ báà tiba taapu, m nìn bí kii kuwaŋkuluuee ní a-cee.

english_verse: But I never really left you, and you hold my right hand.
translation_verse: Nì míǹ kɔkɔee, m pée bí a-cee ní. A cúú m-ŋaŋgiil,

english_verse: Your advice has been my guide, and later you will welcome me in glory.
translation_verse: ki dàkā-mi nsan ŋun m máaǹ ki nóóyee, ní boonee á dāá fōō-mi nì tinyool.

english_verse: In heaven I have only you, and on this earth you are all I want.
translation_verse: Ŋma ní m làá nīn cáá yilpu beelin? M nín bí a-cee nee, ba ní m gíti là kitiŋ pu?

english_verse: My body and mind may fail, but you are my strength and my choice forever.
translation_verse: M-wunti nì m-pɔbil ŋūǹ kí bɔ́ń, ama Unimbɔti di sá m-taŋkpal din pɔ̄ɔ̄yee, ní ki sá m-fakal kí nīn cáa cá jaanjaan.

english_verse: All-Powerful Lord God, those who stay far from you will be lost, and you will destroy those who are unfaithful.
translation_verse: Di sá yii bin kɔkɔ fātì bi-boon ki tīī-see làá kpú kí céetí, a làá nàan̄ bin kaa yú nì si deedeeyee.

english_verse: It is good for me to be near you. I choose you as my protector, and I will tell about your wonderful deeds.
translation_verse: Ama kun tìì-mi mmɔnee di sá ḿ nīn bí ki pìlīǹ Unimbɔti. Ti-Dindaan Unimbɔti, m sáǹ ki kɔ́-si ní kí ŋmā kí sòoǹ a-tuuŋŋi pu.

english_verse: Our God, why have you completely rejected us? Why are you so angry with the ones you care for?
translation_verse: Asaafi di ŋmàn̄ nlan nee. Unimbɔti, ba pu ní a dū-ti ki fá talku? Ba pu ní a-ŋuul dàn̄ a-picaŋkpuŋku kun a kpàáyee pu míǹ?

english_verse: Remember the people you rescued long ago, the tribe you chose for your very own. Think of Mount Zion, your home;
translation_verse: Taa súntí a-nibul din a dá doooo ŋkilkaaminee, kunaakoou kun ní a fīī ku sá a-yɔkuee, Siiyɔn jool din a nìn dūu ŋá a-kɔŋkooŋŋuee pu.

english_verse: walk over to the temple left in ruins forever by those who hate us.
translation_verse: Còomìń kí dāá kpèè adigbuŋkati ŋin dɔ̄ doooo jaanjaan nee, unannanli gbáń ki bíil̀ tikɔkɔ Circir kɔŋkooŋŋun.

english_verse: Your enemies roared like lions in your holy temple, and they have placed their banners there.
translation_verse: A-nannanliibi fáá dijajil wiliilii a-circir kɔŋkooŋŋun. Bi dū bi-jajil ŋaabiki ki sākaǹ niin.

english_verse: It looks like a forest chopped to pieces.
translation_verse: Bi náań nì bidɔgaaliibi bin bí kubambaŋŋun ki gà isufi nì ncɔkɔmuee.

english_verse: They used axes and hatchets to smash the carvings.
translation_verse: Tiwan tin bi dū idɔ ki kpítèe, bi dū ncɔkɔmu nì akújal ki gbáń ki wīil̀ kɔkɔ.

english_verse: They burned down your temple and badly disgraced it.
translation_verse: Bi sēē a-circir kɔŋkooŋŋu ŋŋmi. Bi gbáń ki wīī a-diiku, ki kɔ́ǹ-ku tijɔkɔndi.

english_verse: They said to themselves, “We'll crush them!” Then they burned every one of your meeting places all over the country.
translation_verse: Bi lī bi-pɔbilin yii: «Tí nàam̄maan-bi dicilpu.» Bi wùn̄ ipaan in kɔkɔ bí kitiŋ nee poon bi kpáfí ki jáaḿ sii Unimbɔtee.

english_verse: There are no more miracles and no more prophets. Who knows how long it will be like this?
translation_verse: Taa ti wāĺ a-bítam daanti, bibɔnaatiliibi gíti kpá, ní ti-kansikin ubɔ mun kaa nyí daliŋkin ní tíǹ gbanti kɔkɔ làá kúntée.

english_verse: Our God, how much longer will our enemies sneer? Won't they ever stop insulting you?
translation_verse: Unimbɔti, kí cáá sāā ŋyunti ŋulɔŋu ní a-nannanliibi làá nīn bí ki lāā-si ní? Mimmee bi làá nīn pée bí ki kpèé a-yindi fám míǹ ki cáaa?

english_verse: Why don't you punish them? Why are you holding back?
translation_verse: Ba pu ní a kóoǹ a-ŋal, a-ŋaŋgiil? Tàntī-ŋu kí kpɔ̀ kí céetí-bi!

english_verse: Our God and King, you have ruled since ancient times; you have won victories everywhere on this earth.
translation_verse: Ama sii Unimbɔti un sá m-bɔtiu doooo ŋkilkaaminee, a fīī-ti ŋfunyɔm kupaau kitiŋ pu.

english_verse: By your power you made a path through the sea, and you smashed the heads of sea monsters.
translation_verse: A dū a-pɔŋŋu ki yākatì tiŋku nyim mili, ki fáá ki mátì tipeebilindi tin bí nnyiminee yiliŋ.

english_verse: You crushed the heads of the monster Leviathan, then fed him to wild creatures in the desert.
translation_verse: A gbáń ki wīī kupeebiliŋŋu Leefiyatan yil ní ki dū ku-wunti ki tīī kuteeun peelii ŋmɔ́.

english_verse: You opened the ground for streams and springs and dried up mighty rivers.
translation_verse: Sii di cátì nsan ki tīī inyimbul nì mbùmbiyaamu, sii di yāntì ibuŋkpaan in nyim kaa fóotée fóotì.

english_verse: You rule the day and the night, and you put the moon and the sun in place.
translation_verse: Sii di yì ŋwiimpu, ní ki yì kunyeeu mun, sii di kāaǹ uŋmal nì ŋwìiń i-paaŋyi pu.

english_verse: You made summer and winter and gave them to the earth.
translation_verse: Sii di yóoǹ kitiŋ kpaanyɔmmu kɔkɔ, sii di tí náań dipeel nì kuseeu.

english_verse: Remember your enemies, Lord! They foolishly sneer and won't respect you.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, téetí yii unannanli bíi lāā-si, dinibul din nib sá bigbaambi nee bíi kpèé a-yindi fám.

english_verse: You treat us like pet doves, but they mistreat us. Don't keep forgetting us and letting us be fed to those wild animals.
translation_verse: Taa dū a-nanjil naŋki kí líiǹ upeecuncuti, taa súntí a-nandambi pu talku.

english_verse: Remember the agreement you made with us. Violent enemies are hiding in every dark corner of the earth.
translation_verse: Téetí a-poondi pu, di sá yii tipɔmbɔti gbí kitiŋ nee saŋkaŋkpiliŋ laakin dibɔmbɔndi bée.

english_verse: Don't disappoint those in need or make them turn from you, but help the poor and homeless to shout your praises.
translation_verse: Taa ti yàntī icoo ń cúú un bi wɔ́b́ee, ama yàntī ufalaadaan nì unandaan ń nyɔ̄ŋkì a-yindi!

english_verse: Do something, God! Defend yourself. Remember how those fools sneer at you all day long.
translation_verse: Yīkìm̄ Unimbɔti, mɔ̄tì a-ba pu. Á taa súntí tiniyool nee nín sìí-si baabadal puee.

english_verse: Our God, we thank you for being so near to us! Everyone celebrates your wonderful deeds.
translation_verse: Asaafi di ŋmàn̄ nlan nee ki tīī bilaŋgaaliibi kpiliu.

english_verse: The earth trembles, and its people shake; you alone keep its foundations firm.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti bí yii: «Ŋyunti ŋun m síiǹee yaa láa bàn̄ee, m làá dāá sòoǹ binib bɔti nì ibaamɔn.

english_verse: You tell every bragger, “Stop bragging!” And to the wicked you say, “Don't boast of your power!
translation_verse: Kitiŋ yaa cīŋkì ki kpáaǹ tin kɔkɔ kóò ki-puee, man di ŋúb́ ki-jaantalkub an píkí.»

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, victory doesn't come from the east or the west or from the desert.
translation_verse: Ní taa nín còom̄ ni-yiliŋ gáań yilpu yilpu, ní taa nín̄ sòoǹ ki yòontí ni-ba yilpu.

english_verse: You are the one who judges. You can take away power and give it to others.
translation_verse: Aayee, an kaa sá ŋwìiń nyalaŋki pú àá ŋwìiń jeetilaŋki pú àá kuteeun ní tikpaandi nyēeń.

english_verse: You hold in your hand a cup filled with wine, strong and foaming. You will pour out some for every sinful person on this earth, and they will have to drink until it is gone.
translation_verse: Di sá yii Unimbɔti di sòoǹ binib bɔti, ki sìntī ubɔ taapu ní ki yòontí un kíǹee yilpu.»

english_verse: But I will always tell about you, the God of Jacob, and I will sing your praise.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan ŋúb́ u-ŋaan binikpitib bɔsooŋyi yuku, ndaam min bi tɔ́ dinyaalee kā ku-poon. U bātì-mì ki tīī kitiŋ pu nikpitib kɔkɔ bí nyɔ̀, bi làá nyɔ̀-mì kí kpáaǹ tidakpati kɔkɔ.

english_verse: Our Lord, you will destroy the power of evil people, but you will give strength to those who are good.
translation_verse: Mamee, m làá sòoǹ kí taa gbèen̄, m làá nīn gà ilan ki nyɔ́ŋkí Jaakɔb Nimbɔtiu.

english_verse: You, our God, are famous in Judah and honored in Israel.
translation_verse: Asaafi di ŋmàn̄ nlan nee ki tīī bilaŋgaaliibi kpiliu. Bi bɔ̀ɔ́ tibati ní ki gà-ŋu. Nlan.

english_verse: Your home is on Mount Zion, the city of peace.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti yāntì binib béè-u Juuda tiŋkin. U-yindi sá dikpaandi Isirayeel tiŋkin.

english_verse: There you destroyed fiery arrows, shields, swords, and all the other weapons.
translation_verse: Saleem tiŋkin ní u-tantiu bí, u-kɔŋkooŋŋu bí Siiyɔn jool pu ní.

english_verse: Brave warriors were robbed of what they had taken, and now they lie dead, unable to lift an arm.
translation_verse: A jìl̀ ki ŋān̄ tikpil, ajoon ŋin a jáń ki fōōyee pu.

english_verse: God of Jacob, when you roar, enemy chariots and horses drop dead in their tracks.
translation_verse: Bi fúkúl̀ bijanjaliibi bin cáá dipɔbilee wanti pílpil, bi gèen̄ kaa ti fīntì, bibaatandambi gbanti kɔkɔ ŋalii kpíì.

english_verse: Our God, you are fearsome, and no one can oppose you when you are angry.
translation_verse: Jaakɔb Nimbɔtiu, a nín tāā ki bíikèe, bitanjakaliibi nì itaamu wunti kpíì ní.

english_verse: From heaven you announced your decisions as judge! And all who live on this earth were terrified and silent
translation_verse: Sii di sá kuwambiiu. A yaa gíí diŋuulee, ŋma di ŋūǹ kí yūĺ a-nimbiin?

english_verse: when you took over as judge, ready to rescue everyone in need.
translation_verse: Doooo yilpu ní a yàntī bi gbìl̀ a nín sòoǹ binib bɔti puee. Kitiŋ pu nib fàŋkí ní kí ŋmīĺ díkí diki,

english_verse: Even the most angry people will praise you when you are furious.
translation_verse: ŋyunti ŋun ní sii Unimbɔti yaa yíkì ki bíi sòoǹ binib bɔti, kí fīī bin sá binandambi kitiŋ puee.

english_verse: Everyone, make your promises to the Lord your God and do what you promise. The Lord is fearsome, and all his servants should bring him gifts.
translation_verse: Ibaamɔnee, binib ŋuul sá inyɔŋki laŋyi ní ki tīī-si, ní a dù bin gbíntì diŋuul gbantinee ki gbìǹ a-caŋ kii dambalee.

english_verse: God destroys the courage of rulers and kings and makes cowards of them.
translation_verse: Pòom̄maan ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu ipoon, ní kí ŋá kii ni nín pōoǹ puee. Nimbi bin kɔkɔ māntìi tú-uee, ní cáaḿmaan ni-wampɔkaati kí tīī Unimbɔti un cáá tifaandee.

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord God, and I beg you to listen.
translation_verse: Asaafi di ŋmàn̄ nlan nee ki tīī bilaŋgaaliibi kpiliu Yeedutun.

english_verse: In days filled with trouble, I search for you. And at night I tirelessly lift my hands in prayer, refusing comfort.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti ní m kūuntí mpɔn ki yíì, Unimbɔti ní m yíì ní u làá pīlifiǹ-mi.

english_verse: Because of you, Lord God, I can't sleep. I am restless and can't even talk.
translation_verse: M yaa téetì Unimbɔti puee ní m yáliŋkí, m yaa bíi dàkafēe ní m-fam tìfī.

english_verse: I think of times gone by, of those years long ago.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, aa kíikí ḿ ŋúb́ ní kaa nín gèen̄, inaatuu kɔ́-mi ní maa ti nyí tin m làá sòoǹee.

english_verse: Each night my mind is flooded with questions:
translation_verse: M dàkafī iyunti in jítèe pu, abin ŋin jítì boon boonee pu.

english_verse: “Have you rejected me forever? Won't you be kind again?
translation_verse: M téetí m-laŋŋu pu kunyeeu, m dàkafī m-pɔbilin ní ki bàlifī m-ba yii:

english_verse: Is this the end of your love and your promises?
translation_verse: «Ti-Dindaan làá dū-ti kí fá talku níii? Waa ti làá pée dàkà-ti u-laŋŋaŋfitiikuɔɔɔ?

english_verse: Have you forgotten how to have pity? Do you refuse to show mercy because of your anger?”
translation_verse: U-neeŋkpaandi din u cááyee wáŋkì jaanjaan níii? Waa ti làá sòoǹ kí nīn cá jaanjaan níii?

english_verse: Then I said, “God Most High, what hurts me most is that you no longer help us with your mighty arm.”
translation_verse: Unimbɔti kalin súntì kí sɔ̄ ti-saai níii? Diŋuul kalin fōō u-poommɔŋŋu paaŋŋu níii?»

english_verse: Our Lord, I will remember the things you have done, your miracles of long ago.
translation_verse: Ní m bí ki lì yii: «Tin wù-mee di sá yii Yilpu fɔ́ŋŋŋ Nimbɔtiu kaa ti tútúǹ-ti nì u-ŋaŋgiil.»

english_verse: I will think about each one of your mighty deeds.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, m téetí a-tuuŋŋi pu. Tiŋman, m téetí a-maamaaci tuuŋŋi ŋin a nìn ŋáaǹee pu.

english_verse: Everything you do is right, and no other god compares with you.
translation_verse: M dàkafī tin ní a ŋée kɔkɔ pu, m dàkafī a-tuŋkpaaŋŋi pu.

english_verse: You alone work miracles, and you have let nations see your mighty power.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti, a-tuuŋŋi bí circir ní, unimbɔti ulɔu di sá ukpaan kii sii Unimbɔti?

english_verse: With your own arm you rescued your people, the descendants of Jacob and Joseph.
translation_verse: A sá Unimbɔti un ŋáań maamaacibee ní, a dàkā anibul ŋin kíǹee a-pɔŋŋu.

english_verse: The ocean looked at you, God, and it trembled deep down with fear.
translation_verse: A dū a-ŋal pɔŋŋu ki dá a-nibul ki líì, Jaakɔb nì Jooseefi naantiibi.

english_verse: Water flowed from the clouds. Thunder was heard above as your arrows of lightning flashed about.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti, inyiŋfi wál̀-si, inyiŋfi wál̀-si ní ki fāŋkì, ní tiŋku taapu taapu mun cīŋkì.

english_verse: Your thunder roared like chariot wheels. The world was made bright by lightning, and all the earth trembled.
translation_verse: Atagban yāntì ŋi-nyim còol̄, kutagbɔŋu yāntì bi gbìl̄ ku-neen pu, ní a-piiŋyi ŋàan̄ an kɔkɔ pu.

english_verse: You walked through the water of the mighty sea, but your footprints were never seen.
translation_verse: A-taadundi nìn gà kuwoou ki màntī, utaa nìn ŋmóò ki ŋmíntí duulinya, ní kitiŋ fāŋkì ki cīŋkì.

english_verse: You guided your people like a flock of sheep, and you chose Moses and Aaron to be their leaders.
translation_verse: Tiŋkun ní a cátì a-saŋŋu, ní ki cōom̀ ki jítì nnyim min nyóòyee poon, ní ubɔ kaa ká a-tabɔbiliŋ.

english_verse: My friends, I beg you to listen as I teach.
translation_verse: Asaafi di ŋmàn̄ nlan nee. M-nibul, pīlifì m-dàkatam tiŋan, kpòon̄ a-tafal kí pīlifì tin m cáá kí tùkù-see.

english_verse: I will give instruction and explain the mystery of what happened long ago.
translation_verse: M làá dū tibɔŋmantikaal kí sòoǹ, m làá sòoǹ tin jítì ki bí dibalinee pu.

english_verse: These are things we learned from our ancestors,
translation_verse: Kun ti gbìl̄ ki nyée, kun ti-baabi nìn máafì-tee,

english_verse: and we will tell them to the next generation. We won't keep secret the glorious deeds and the mighty miracles of the Lord.
translation_verse: taa làá dūú báĺ ti-biyaamu, ama ti làá māafì bin làá páań ti-boonee kun pu bi máaǹ kí nyɔ̄ŋkì ti-Dindaanee. Ti làá māafì-bi u-pɔŋŋu nì u-maamaaci tuuŋŋi ŋin u ŋée.

english_verse: God gave his Law to Jacob's descendants, the people of Israel. And he told our ancestors to teach their children,
translation_verse: U tīī Jaakɔb naantiibi abɔkpaa, u yóoǹ marab Isirayeel tiŋkin. U nìn tīī ti-baabi mara yii bí dū tibɔti gbanti kí dàkà bi-biyaamu.

english_verse: so that each new generation would know his Law and tell it to the next.
translation_verse: An yaa ŋá mimmee, bin làá páanní boonee, mbiyaamu mun bi làá dāá màal̀ee làá dāá yīkì kí béé-tì kí dūú nàatī bíǹ bi-ba biyaamu.

english_verse: Then they would trust God and obey his teachings, without forgetting anything God had done.
translation_verse: Mimmee bi làá dū bi-mákal kí páań Unimbɔti pu, kí taa súntí u-tuŋkpaaŋŋi pu ní kí nīn tɔ́ u-marab.

english_verse: They would be different from their ancestors, who were stubborn, rebellious, and unfaithful to God.
translation_verse: Niinee baa làá nīn bí kii bi-naanjab bin pɔbiliŋ nìn pɔ̄ɔ̄ bi-yiliŋ gáatèe. Bi-pɔbiliŋ kaa nìn bí diba nì Unimbɔti ní baa nìn pée máká u-pu.

english_verse: The warriors from Ephraim were armed with arrows, but they ran away when the battle began.
translation_verse: Eefiraayiim yab nìn bàl̄ abaatan ki tòó ipiin, nì míǹ kɔkɔee bi sáǹ ki kátì kujaaun.

english_verse: They broke their agreement with God, and they turned their backs on his teaching.
translation_verse: Di sá yii baa nìn ŋúb́ Unimbɔti poondi, bi nìn yíì kaa tɔ́ u-marab.

english_verse: They forgot all he had done, even the mighty miracles
translation_verse: Bi nìn súntì u-tuŋkpaaŋŋi nì u-maamaaci tuuŋŋi ŋin u nìn ŋá ki dàkā-bee pu.

english_verse: he did for their ancestors near Zoan in Egypt.
translation_verse: Bi-naanjab nimbiin ní u nìn ŋá maamaacib Eejipiti tiŋkin, Soowan satin.

english_verse: God made a path in the sea and piled up the water as he led them across.
translation_verse: U nìn cátì nsan tiŋkun bi cōom̀ ki jítì, u nìn yāntì nnyim gāā digundi.

english_verse: He guided them during the day with a cloud, and each night he led them with a flaming fire.
translation_verse: U nìn dū ditagbandi ki kpōotì-bi ŋwiimpu, ní ki dū ŋŋmi walifiŋu ki kpōotì-bi kunyeeu.

english_verse: God made water flow from rocks he split open in the desert, and his people drank freely, as though from a lake.
translation_verse: U nìn búkutì ataŋkpee kuteeun nnyim nyáń ki pùub̄ tikpil tikpil ní bi nyùn̄.

english_verse: He made streams gush out like rivers from rocks.
translation_verse: U yāntì kibùmbiki nyáń ditaŋkpalin ní nnyim pùub̄ kii ibuŋkpaanee.

english_verse: But in the desert, the people of God Most High kept sinning and rebelling.
translation_verse: Ama bi nìn pée gbíntìi yìntīǹ-u, ní ki jáà nì Yilpu Fɔ́ŋŋŋ Nimbɔtiu kuteeun.

english_verse: They stubbornly tested God and demanded from him what they wanted to eat.
translation_verse: Bi nìn lēē bi-pɔbilin kí cɔ̄ŋkì Unimbɔti kí kpèè ní ki bālifì-u ú tīī-bi tijin tin fáatiǹ-bee.

english_verse: They challenged God by saying, “Can God provide food out here in the desert?
translation_verse: Bi nìn nyáń Unimbɔti pu ki lī yii: «Unimbɔti lafun ŋūǹ kí tīī-ti tijin kuteeu nee poon tí jāaa?

english_verse: It's true God struck the rock and water gushed out like a river, but can he give his people bread and meat?”
translation_verse: Tiŋman u fáá ditaŋkpal nnyim nyáń ki pùub̄ tikpil tikpil. Ama u ŋūǹ kí tīī u-nibul tijin bí jī, kí tīī-bi tinan bí ŋmɔ́ɔɔ?»

english_verse: When the Lord heard this, he was angry and furious with Jacob's descendants, the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan nín gbìl̄ anyɔɔbun gbantee ní u gíí diŋuul. U nìn gíí Jaakɔb naantiibi pu diŋuul, u nìn fōō Isirayeel yab gbanti pu mbum.

english_verse: They had refused to trust him, and they had doubted his saving power.
translation_verse: Di sá yii baa nìn fōō Unimbɔti ki kíí, baa nìn máká u-pu yii u làá ŋmā kí fīī-bi.

english_verse: But God gave a command to the clouds, and he opened the doors in the skies.
translation_verse: U nìn tīī kutagbɔŋu kun dàn̄ nee mara, ní ki cúú yilpu punuubi ki pīitì.

english_verse: He gave them more than enough, and each one of them ate this special food.
translation_verse: Báà ŋma nìn jíń Unimbɔti tuuŋyi jinti, u nìn tīiń-bi tijin bi jíń ki díkí.

english_verse: God's mighty power sent a strong wind from the southeast,
translation_verse: U nìn yāntì ŋwìiń nyalaŋki pú buŋku jítì yilpu, u nìn dū u-pɔŋŋu ki cáań ŋgiil pú buŋku.

english_verse: Then God made the birds fall in the camp of his people near their tents.
translation_verse: U nìn yāntì i lítì bi-naapaal kansikin, ki māntìi tú bi-kɔŋkooŋyi.

english_verse: God gave his people all they wanted, and each of them ate until they were full.
translation_verse: Bi nìn jíń ki díkí tiŋan, di sá yii ti-Dindaan nìn tīī-bi kun bi lèe.

english_verse: But before they had swallowed the last bite,
translation_verse: Baa nìn dá láá jíń ki bál̀, tijin nìn dáá gbí bi-nyɔkɔn,

english_verse: God became angry and killed the strongest and best from the families of Israel.
translation_verse: ní Unimbɔti ŋuul jéetì bi-pu. U nìn kūū bi-kansikin bin cáá dikpabilee, ní ki lúkufì Isirayeel nipɔmbi.

english_verse: But the rest kept on sinning and would not trust God's miracles.
translation_verse: Nì míǹ kɔkɔee, bi nìn gbíntìi yìntīǹ-u. Baa nìn máká u-maamaaci tuuŋŋi pu.

english_verse: So he cut their lives short and made them terrified.
translation_verse: Niinee ní u kúntì bi-maŋfal wiiŋyi kii kubuŋuee, ki yāntì bi-biŋŋi kúntì dinyoondin.

english_verse: After he killed some of them, the others turned to him with all their hearts.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti yaa nìn bíi kù-bee ní bi kíǹ ki nyàab̀-u. Bi nìn kpántí bi-ba ní ki nyàab̀ u-jòońdi.

english_verse: They remembered God Most High, the mighty rock that kept them safe.
translation_verse: Bi nìn téetí yii Unimbɔti di sá bi-taŋkpanaakooku, yii Yilpu Fɔ́ŋŋŋ Nimbɔtiu di sá bi-fiiliu.

english_verse: But they tried to flatter God, and they told him lies;
translation_verse: Ama bi nìn cáá bi-nyɔmmu ki ŋmàtíǹ-u, bi nìn cáá bi-limbiliŋ ki mɔ́ntí-u.

english_verse: they were unfaithful and broke their promises.
translation_verse: Bi-pɔbil kaa nìn bí diba nì u, baa nìn fōō u-poondi ki kíí.

english_verse: Yet God was kind. He kept forgiving their sins and didn't destroy them. He often became angry, but never lost his temper.
translation_verse: Ama Unimbɔti úǹ poon nìn pée mɔ̄ ní, u nìn cáá bi-kpitii ki pūǹ-bi, kaa nìn nàantí-bi. Iyunti tikpilee, u nìn cútí u-ba u-ŋuul poon, kaa nìn fòol̄ mbum tikpil.

english_verse: God remembered that they were made of flesh and were like a wind that blows once and then dies down.
translation_verse: Waa nìn súntí yii bi sá binib nì nniwuŋgban, bi sá kubuŋu kun cá kaa ti gítińee.

english_verse: While they were in the desert, they often rebelled and made God sad.
translation_verse: Miŋa pu ní baa nìn jáń nì u kuteeun, kaa nìn táká-u laakin binib kaa kóòyee!

english_verse: They kept testing him and caused terrible pain for the Holy One of Israel.
translation_verse: Bi nìn pée cɔ́ŋkí Unimbɔti ní, ki nìn kɔ̄ntí Isirayeel Nimbɔtiu Circirdaan kunimbaau.

english_verse: They forgot about his power and how he had rescued them from their enemies.
translation_verse: Baa nìn téetí tin u nìn ŋá ki tīī-bi ŋwiin ŋun u nìn fīī-bi ki nyántì unannanli ŋaanee.

english_verse: God showed them all kinds of wonderful miracles near Zoan in Egypt.
translation_verse: U nìn ŋá maamaaci tuuŋŋi Eejipiti tiŋkin, u nìn ŋá maamaaci tuuŋŋi Soowan tiŋkin.

english_verse: He turned the rivers of Egypt into blood, and no one could drink from the streams.
translation_verse: U nìn yāntì bi-buŋyi nyim kpántì fatiku, baa nìn gíti ŋūǹ kí nyɔ̀ bi-bùmbiyaamu nyim.

english_verse: He sent swarms of flies to pester the Egyptians, and he sent frogs to cause them trouble.
translation_verse: U nìn dū isii in júntée ki tɔ́ bi-pu i nyùn̄ bi-fatikuu, ki dū kpaabi ki tɔ́ bi-pu bi bíil̀ tikɔkɔ.

english_verse: He destroyed their grapevines and their fig trees with hail and floods.
translation_verse: U nìn yāntì ataanyiŋkumbil lítì ki bíil̀ bi-fiinyi sati, ní ki yāntì utaaja nìn̄ ki bíil̀ Siikoomɔɔr sufii.

english_verse: Then he killed their cattle with hail and their other animals with lightning.
translation_verse: U nìn yāntì ataanyiŋkumbil kūū bi-naai nì bi-piii, ki yāntì utaa tɔ́ ki kūū bi-waŋkuti.

english_verse: God was so angry and furious that he went into a rage and caused them great trouble by sending swarms of destroying angels.
translation_verse: Kí kúntée ní Unimbɔti dū u-ŋuukpaandi nì u-bum nì dinimbinaamandi ki tɔ́ bi-pu kii nnaabu tuuŋyee.

english_verse: He killed the first-born son of each Egyptian family.
translation_verse: U nìn kūū Eejipiti yab jipɔŋkpilib kɔkɔ, u nìn kūū Kaam naantiibi biseebiyaamu bi-tantibin.

english_verse: Then God led his people out of Egypt and guided them in the desert like a flock of sheep.
translation_verse: Boonee, u nìn nyántì u-nibul kii kupicaŋkpuŋuee, u nìn péetì-bi ki cūnnì kuteeun kii apibilee.

english_verse: He led them safely along, and they were not afraid, but their enemies drowned in the sea.
translation_verse: U nìn kpōotì-bi ŋgbansɔŋfin ní baa nìn fāŋkì, ŋyunti ŋun nnyim nìn gbí ki léeǹ bi-nannanliibi puee.

english_verse: God brought his people to the sacred mountain that he had taken by his own power.
translation_verse: Míǹ boonee ní u cáá-bi ki kɔ́ǹ u-circir tiŋkin, dijool din u dū úǹ u-ba pɔŋŋu ki fōōyee.

english_verse: He made nations run from the tribes of Israel, and he let the tribes take over their land.
translation_verse: U nìn jìn̄ atimbun ŋin nib kóò niinee ki wāatì-bi, ki nìn dū kitiŋ ki yākatì-bi an kpántì bi-fakal. U nìn fōō Kanaan yab tiŋki ní ki dū Isirayeel naakɔti ki kāaǹ.

english_verse: But the people tested God Most High, and they refused to obey his laws.
translation_verse: Ama bi nìn cɔ́ŋkì Yilpu Fɔ́ŋŋŋ Nimbɔtiu, ki nìn jáń nì u, ní kaa tɔ́ u-bɔkpaaŋi.

english_verse: They were as unfaithful as their ancestors, and they were as crooked as a twisted arrow.
translation_verse: Bi nìn fātì bi-boon ki tīī-u ki nyáń u-boon kii bi-naanjab nín nìn ŋá puee. Kii butɔbu bun gíì ki gbàkēe, baa ŋūǹ kí nīn cáá bi-pu dimákal.

english_verse: God demanded all their love, but they made him angry by worshiping idols.
translation_verse: Bi nìn máń iwaatootipaan ŋgbantamu pu ki gbítì ti-Dindaan ŋuul. Bi nìn dū bi-waaŋi ŋin bi kpítèe ki kɔ́ǹ-u ipoompoon.

english_verse: So God became furious and completely rejected the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti nìn ká míǹ ní ki gíí diŋuul, u nìn dū Isirayeel ki fá kɔkɔ.

english_verse: Then he deserted his home at Shiloh, where he lived here on earth.
translation_verse: U nìn dū u-kɔŋkooŋŋu ŋun bí Siiloo tiŋkinee, tanti un bi nìn gāā-u ú nīn kóò binib kansikinee ki fá.

english_verse: He let enemies capture the sacred chest and let them dishonor him.
translation_verse: U nìn dū u-pɔŋŋu ki líì nì kuyuŋu, ki dū u-nyaaŋku ki ŋá binannanliibi ŋaan.

english_verse: God took out his anger on his chosen ones and let them be killed by enemy swords.
translation_verse: U nìn yāntì bi dū kitàataajiki ki kūū u-nibul, u nìn gíí binib bin sá u-yabee pu diŋuul.

english_verse: Fire destroyed the young men, and the young women were left with no one to marry.
translation_verse: Ŋŋmi wùn̄ bi-naacimpɔmbi, baa ti gà bisapɔmbi ilan.

english_verse: Priests died violent deaths, but their widows were not allowed to mourn.
translation_verse: Bi nìn dū ntàataajimu ki kūū bi-saraaŋaliibi ní bi-kpiipoobi kaa gāā ikpiisilan ki súń.

english_verse: Finally the Lord woke up, like a soldier startled from a drunken sleep.
translation_verse: Niinee ti-Dindaan cúu fīntì kii unil un gèen̄ee, a lì kii ubaatandaan un nyùn̄ ndaam ní an nyāatì-uee.

english_verse: God scattered his enemies and made them ashamed forever.
translation_verse: U fáá u-nannanliibi bi-boon pú, ní ki kɔ́ǹ-bi icoo kí nīn cáa cá jaanjaan.

english_verse: Then the Lord decided not to make his home with Joseph's descendants in Ephraim.
translation_verse: U nìn dū Jooseefi dicaŋku ki fá, kaa nìn lēē Eefiraayiim naakooku,

english_verse: Instead he chose the tribe of Judah, and he chose Mount Zion, the place he loves.
translation_verse: ama Juuda naakooku ní u lēē, Siiyɔn jool din u néeńee.

english_verse: There he built his temple as lofty as the mountains and as solid as the earth he made to last forever.
translation_verse: U máń u-Circir kɔŋkooŋŋu niin kii yilpuee, u máń-ŋu ŋú nīn bí ki cá jaanjaan kii kitiŋee.

english_verse: The Lord God chose David to be his servant and took him from tending sheep
translation_verse: U nìn lēē u-tɔntɔnliu Daafiidi, kunaabakaun ní u nìn lēeń-u.

english_verse: and from caring for lambs. Then God made him the leader of Israel, his own nation.
translation_verse: Ipii boon ní u páatìń-u ki cáań ki dū-u ki kpántì un kpàá u-nibul Jaakɔb naantiibee, dinibul din di sá u-yalee.

english_verse: David treated the people fairly and guided them with wisdom.
translation_verse: Daafiidi nìn kpāā-bi nì dipɔbil diba, ki nìn dū dinyil ki kpōotì-bi.

english_verse: Our God, foreign nations have taken your land, disgraced your temple, and left Jerusalem in ruins.
translation_verse: Asaafi di ŋmàn̄ nlan nee. Unimbɔti, binicambi dɔ́miń ki gbáb́ ki bīiǹ a-tiŋki pu, bi kɔ́ǹ a-circir diiku tijɔkɔndi, bi yāntì Jeerusaleem kpántì adigbuŋkati ŋma.

english_verse: They have fed the bodies of your servants to flesh-eating birds; your loyal people are food for savage animals.
translation_verse: Bi dū a-tɔntɔnliibi bin bi kūūyee wunti ki tīī inoon in ŋàaǹ kutaa puee í jī, bin sí nì si deedeeyee di kpántì ipeel jinti.

english_verse: All Jerusalem is covered with their blood, and there is no one left to bury them.
translation_verse: Bi kpáatì bin bi kūūyee fatikuu ki fá kii nnyimee, ki māntìi tú Jeerusaleem tiŋki, ní baa ti kpáàa cáá ubɔ ń síb́-bi.

english_verse: Every nation around us sneers and makes fun.
translation_verse: A yāntì ti-kɔŋkɔnaatɔb sìí-ti, ní bin māntìi tú-tee bèel̄-ti ki lāā.

english_verse: Our Lord, will you keep on being angry? Will your angry feelings keep flaming up like fire?
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, kí cáá sāā ŋyunti ŋulɔŋu ní diŋuul din a gíí jaanjaan nee làá gbèen̄, a-bum min fòol̄ lìblib kii ŋŋmi nee làá gbèen̄ ní?

english_verse: Get angry with those nations that don't know you and won't worship you!
translation_verse: Kpáatí a-bum kí sìtī atimbun ŋin kaa nyí-see pu, abee ŋin poon baa jáaḿ-see pu.

english_verse: They have gobbled up Jacob's descendants and left the land in ruins.
translation_verse: Di sá yii, ŋi tɔ̄ntì Jaakɔb naantiibi, ki bíil̀ bi-tiŋki.

english_verse: Don't make us pay for the sins of our ancestors. Have pity and come quickly! We are completely helpless.
translation_verse: Taa téetí ti-baabi kpitii pu kí dáaĺ ti-tafal, á yàntī a-saasɔl ń lìntī ti-nyɔkɔpu malaa, di sá yii ti-wunti kɔkɔ kpíì.

english_verse: Our God, you keep us safe. Now help us! Rescue us. Forgive our sins and bring honor to yourself.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti ti-fiiliu, a-yindi nyooti puee, dāá jòoń-ti. Fīī-ti kí dū ti-kpitii kí pɔ̄-ti a-yindi pu.

english_verse: Why should nations ask us, “Where is your God?” Let us and the other nations see you take revenge for your servants who died a violent death.
translation_verse: Ba pu ní a làá yàntī atimbun ń lì yii: «Bi-Nimbɔtiuee bí la ní?» Yàntī atimbun ń béé a nín làá tɔ̀ a-tɔntɔnliibi kúm pɔntooŋyi puee ti-nimbil ń ká!

english_verse: Listen to the prisoners groan! Let your mighty power save all who are sentenced to die.
translation_verse: Yàntī bisarkadambi timinsii ń bàń-si. Dū a-ŋal pɔŋŋu kí fīī binib bin an sá yii bi lēē kí kpɔ̀ee.
