english_verse: Each of those nations sneered at you, our Lord. Now let others sneer at them, seven times as much.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, téeǹ anibul ŋin māntìi tú-tee, asiibil ŋin ní bi sīī-see ŋfunyɔm miluli pu.

english_verse: Then we, your people, will always thank you. We are like sheep with you as our shepherd, and all generations will hear us praise you.
translation_verse: Ama timbi bin sá a-nibulee, kupicaŋkpuŋu kun ní a kpàáyee, ti làá nīn pée gà ilan ní ki nyɔ́ŋkí-si, kí nīn jáaḿ-si abin abin.

english_verse: Shepherd of Israel, you lead the descendants of Joseph, and you sit on your throne above the winged creatures. Listen to our prayer and let your light shine
translation_verse: Asaafi di ŋmàn̄ nlan nee ki tīī bilaŋgaaliibi kpiliu. Bi bɔ̀ɔ́ kubeeu ní ki gà-ŋu.

english_verse: for the tribes of Ephraim, Benjamin, and Manasseh. Save us by your power.
translation_verse: Sii un kpàá Isirayeel yabee, pīlifì. Sii un kpòotī Jooseefi naantiibi kii kupicaŋkpuŋuee, sii un bí keerubimbi kansikinee, lēē a-ba kí dàkà.

english_verse: Our God, make us strong again! Smile on us and save us.
translation_verse: Eefiraayiim nì Beenjameen nì Manasee naakɔti nimbiinee, nyàatī a-pɔŋŋu kí dāan̄ kí fīī-ti.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, how much longer will the prayers of your people make you angry?
translation_verse: Unimbɔti, fàtīí gíiǹní-ti, bútí ti-pu nnimbiin ní tí ká difiil.

english_verse: You gave us tears for food, and you made us drink them by the bowlful.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, Unimbɔti Mpɔŋkɔdaan, kí cáá sāā ŋyunti ŋulɔŋu ní a-nibul wimmeem làá nīn kɔ̄ntí-si diŋuul ní?

english_verse: Because of you, our enemies who live nearby laugh and joke about us.
translation_verse: Nnyinnyim di kpántì bi-jinti, a ŋmāntì nnyinnyim tikpil ki tīī-bi bi nyùn̄.

english_verse: Our God, make us strong again! Smile on us and save us.
translation_verse: A yāntì ti-puee, bin māntìi tú-tee bíi jáà, ní ti-nannanliibi bí ki lāā-ti.

english_verse: We were like a grapevine you brought out of Egypt. You chased other nations away and planted us here.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti Mpɔŋkɔdaan, fàtīí gíiǹní-ti, bútí ti-pu nnimbiin ní tí ká difiil.

english_verse: Then you cleared the ground, and we put our roots deep, spreading over the land.
translation_verse: A cóotìń fiinyi subu Eejipiti tiŋkin, ní ki jìn̄ atimbun ki dū-bu ki cóoǹ.

english_verse: Shade from this vine covered the mountains. Its branches climbed the mighty cedars
translation_verse: A ŋātì ki tāntì kitiŋ ki tīī-bu, ní bu báaǹ inyaan ki kpátì ki gbí kitiŋ nee kɔkɔ.

english_verse: and stretched to the sea; its new growth reached to the river.
translation_verse: Bu-booŋŋu bīī ajoon pu, ní bu-paŋŋi bīī seedir sukpaŋkpaaŋyi pu.

english_verse: Our Lord, why have you torn down the wall from around the vineyard? You let everyone who walks by pick the grapes.
translation_verse: Bu tɔ́ bu-paŋŋi ki tin bàn̄ Meediiteeranee tiŋkuu, ní bu-pambiyaamu tin bàn̄ Eefiraati mɔɔl.

english_verse: Now the vine is gobbled up by pigs from the forest and other wild animals.
translation_verse: Ba pu ní a yāntì digundi din māntìi tú-buee bátì bátì ki lítì, ní bisanjitiliibi kɔkɔ kìtī bu-biliŋ?

english_verse: With your own hands you planted its roots, and you raised it as your very own.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti Mpɔŋkɔdaan, fàtīí gítiń! Gbóoń doooo yilpu kí kpèè tin bíi jītée. Dāá fīī bufiinyisubu gbanti,

english_verse: Enemies chopped the vine down and set it on fire. Now show your anger and destroy them.
translation_verse: busubu bun ní sii a-ba cóoǹee, - a-jipɔɔn un ní a tīī mpɔnee.

english_verse: But help the one who sits at your right side, the one you raised to be your very own.
translation_verse: Bi sēē-bu ŋŋmi ki gāā-bu ki lúkú. Tāā kí bīikì ní bí kpú kí céetí.

english_verse: Then we will never turn away. Put new life into us, and we will worship you.
translation_verse: Dū a-ŋal kí páań unil un bí a-ŋaŋgiil púee pu, kinibiki kin ní a tīī mpɔnee pu.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, make us strong again! Smile on us and save us.
translation_verse: Niinee taa ti làá sútí kí wàatī-si. Yàntī tí nīn bí dimaŋfalin ní kí nīn nyɔ́ŋkí-si.

english_verse: Be happy and shout to God who makes us strong! Shout praises to the God of Jacob.
translation_verse: Asaafi di ŋmàn̄ nlan nee ki tīī bilaŋgaaliibi kpiliu. Bi gà-ŋu nì Gaati yab beeku ní.

english_verse: Sing as you play tambourines and the lovely sounding stringed instruments.
translation_verse: Fáámaan iwiliili kí tīī Unimbɔti un sá ti-pɔŋŋuee, kúum̀maan nì dipɔɔpindi kí nyɔ̄ŋkì Jaakɔb Nimbɔtiu.

english_verse: Sound the trumpets and start the New Moon Festival. We must also celebrate when the moon is full.
translation_verse: Tóoḿmaan nlan, bɔ̀ɔ̀maan ŋgaŋgamu, bɔ̀ɔ̀maan kubeeu nì saŋgu án nīn mɔ̄.

english_verse: This is the law in Israel, and it was given to us by the God of Jacob.
translation_verse: Búḿmaan ŋyin uŋmapɔɔn jiŋaaliu wiiŋŋu, nì uŋmal yaa jɔ́m̀ee jiŋaaliu wiiŋŋu.

english_verse: The descendants of Joseph were told to obey it, when God led them out from the land of Egypt. In a voice unknown to me, I heard someone say:
translation_verse: Di sá yii dibɔkpaal ní an sá ki tīī Isirayeel yab, Jaakɔb Nimbɔtiu nín yóoǹ bí nīn ŋáań puee dee.

english_verse: “I lifted the burden from your shoulder and took the heavy basket from your hands.
translation_verse: U yóoǹ Jooseefi naantiibi mara, ŋyunti ŋun u nyáń kí já nì Eejipiti tiŋkee. - M gbìl̄ nneen ŋun maa nyée sòon̄ nì mi yii:

english_verse: When you were in trouble, I rescued you, and from the thunderclouds, I answered your prayers. Later I tested you at Meribah Spring.
translation_verse: M túutì-si ditúndi din a túee, m fōō-si diwaŋgul din nyìm̀ ki kā a-ŋaanee.

english_verse: “Listen, my people, while I, the Lord, correct you! Israel, if you would only pay attention to me!
translation_verse: Ŋyunti ŋun a nìn bí dinimbinaamandinee, a nìn kúuǹ ki yíiń-mi ní m fīī-si. Ditaadundi poon ní m nìn kíí-si. M nìn cɔ́ŋkì-si Meeriiba nyim caŋin.

english_verse: Don't worship foreign gods or bow down to gods you know nothing about.
translation_verse: M-nibul, pīlifiǹ-mi, m làá kpāafì-si. Isirayeel, a yaa bàà làá pīlifiǹ-mi!

english_verse: I am the Lord your God. I rescued you from Egypt. Just ask, and I will give you whatever you need.
translation_verse: Aa máaǹ kí nīn cáá unimbɔticaan ubɔ a-cee! Á máaǹ kí gbàan̄ unimbɔticaan ubɔ taapu kí jāam̀-u!

english_verse: “But, my people, Israel, you refused to listen, and you would have nothing to do with me!
translation_verse: Di sá yii man di sá a-Dindaan a-Nimbɔtiu un di nyántìń-si Eejipiti tiŋkinee. Wàan̄ a-nyɔkɔ bàaa ní ḿ gbéeǹ-kì.

english_verse: So I let you be stubborn and keep on following your own advice.
translation_verse: Ama m-nibul kaa nìn pílifì m-nyɔkɔ, Isirayeel kaa nìn là m-bɔti.

english_verse: “My people, Israel, if only you would listen and do as I say!
translation_verse: Niinee ní m dū-bi ki líiǹ bi-pɔɔgbifiŋŋu bí nīn ŋáań bi nín là puee.

english_verse: I, the Lord, would quickly defeat your enemies with my mighty power.
translation_verse: M-nibul yaa bàà nìn pílifíǹ-mi, Isirayeel yab yaa bàà nìn nóó m-saŋŋu,

english_verse: Everyone who hates me would come crawling, and that would be the end of them.
translation_verse: án kaa bàà làá sūŋkì ní ḿ sìntī bi-nannanliibi taapu, ní kí bàà já nì bi-pulincɔntiibi.

english_verse: But I would feed you with the finest bread and with the best honey until you were full.”
translation_verse: Man ni-Dindaan nannanliibi bàà làá gbàan̄ m-nimbiin kí nīn kíǹ ki tɔ́-mi, ní an nīn kíǹ ki bí-bi míǹ ki cá jaanjaan.

english_verse: When all the other gods have come together, the Lord God judges them and says:
translation_verse: Asaafi di ŋmàn̄ nlan nee. Unimbɔti yáatìi yúl̀ yilpu kpafilin, inimbɔti kansikin, ki sòon̄ binib bɔti yii:

english_verse: “How long will you keep judging unfairly and favoring evil people?
translation_verse: «Kí cáá sāā ŋyunti ŋulɔŋu ní ni làá nīn pɔ̀ gandi, kí nīn tìì dibɔkpil dambi ibaamɔn ní?

english_verse: Be fair to the poor and to orphans. Defend the helpless and everyone in need.
translation_verse: Sòom̀maan uwɔfi nì ditaŋkpiibil bɔti deedee, kí sòoǹ unandaan nì ufalaadaan bɔti nì ibaamɔn.

english_verse: Rescue the weak and homeless from the powerful hands of heartless people.
translation_verse: Fīīmaan uwɔfi nì usoodaan, fīīmaan-bi kí nyāntí binikpitib ŋaan.

english_verse: “None of you know or understand a thing. You live in darkness, while the foundations of the earth tremble.
translation_verse: «Baa nyí kaa gbìl̀ tibɔti taapu mun. Bi còom̄ dibɔmbɔndin ní. An di yì-tì ní kitiŋ nyeel cīŋkì.

english_verse: “I, the Most High God, say that all of you are gods and also my own children.
translation_verse: Man nìn lī yii ni sá inimbɔti ní, yii ni-kɔkɔ sá Yilpu Fɔ́ŋŋŋ Nimbɔtiu jipɔmbi ní.

english_verse: But you will die, just like everyone else, including powerful rulers.”
translation_verse: Ama ni làá kpú kii binifantantiibee ní, ni làá kúntí kii abɔtibilee ní.»

english_verse: Do something, God! Judge the nations of the earth; they belong to you.
translation_verse: Yīkìm̄, Unimbɔti! Sòoǹ duulinya bɔti, di sá yii sii di yì atimbun kɔkɔ.

english_verse: Our God, don't just sit there, silently doing nothing!
translation_verse: Asaafi di ŋmàn̄ nlan nee.

english_verse: Your hateful enemies are turning against you and rebelling.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti, taa pée ŋùŋfì báà fiii, taa nín̄ kā ki ŋmí kaa bíi ŋáań tiba.

english_verse: They are sly, and they plot against those you treasure.
translation_verse: Kpèè a-nannanliibi cáá bi-ba ki yāŋkí an kɔkɔ pu, bin ná-see bíi gántí ayil.

english_verse: They say, “Let's wipe out the nation of Israel and make sure that no one remembers its name!”
translation_verse: Bi bíi bɔ́ntí kí ŋá a-nibul tikpitil, bi kpáfì kinyɔkɔ kí ŋá bin pu aa mɔ̄ee tikpitil.

english_verse: All of them fully agree in their plans against you, and among them are
translation_verse: Bi bíi lì yii: «Dāam̄maan tí kúntí bi-timbundi, bí taa ti téetí dalba dalba Isirayeel pu!»

english_verse: Edom and the Ishmaelites; Moab and the Hagrites;
translation_verse: Bi sòon̄ ki ŋá kinyɔɔbaantii, bi ŋá mpèé kí já nì si.

english_verse: Gebal, Ammon, and Amalek; Philistia and Phoenicia.
translation_verse: An sá Eedoom yab nì Isimaayeel yab, Moowaab yab nì Agaar naantiibi,

english_verse: Even Assyria has joined forces with Moab and Ammon.
translation_verse: Geebaal yab nì Amɔn yab nì Amaleeki yab, Fiiliistii yab ní kí kūtì bin kóò Tiir tiŋkinee.

english_verse: Treat their leaders as you did Oreb and Zeeb, Zebah and Zalmunna.
translation_verse: A nìn nāaǹ-bi Eeni-Dɔɔr, ní bi wūtì ki tīī kitiŋ ntiŋkpam.

english_verse: Our God, scatter them around like dust in a whirlwind.
translation_verse: Binib gbanti di nìn lī yii: «Tí fōōmaan Unimbɔti nakpaapɔɔku.»

english_verse: Just as flames destroy forests on the mountains,
translation_verse: M-Nimbɔtiu, yàntī bí kpántí ntam min kunaakpaabuŋŋu yòontée, àá tifeel tin kubuŋu yòontí ki féeńee.

english_verse: pursue and terrify them with storms of your own.
translation_verse: Kii ŋŋmi nín wù kupɔɔu puee, kii aŋmilimbil nín fòol̄ ajoon pu puee,

english_verse: Make them blush with shame, until they turn and worship you, our Lord.
translation_verse: dū a-buŋku kí jà-bi, dū a-buŋkpaaŋku kí fàaǹ-bi.

english_verse: Let them be forever ashamed and confused. Let them die in disgrace.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, yàntī icoo ń cúú-bi, án nín làá ŋá pu ní bí nyàab̀-see!

english_verse: Make them realize that you are the Lord Most High, the only ruler of earth!
translation_verse: Yàntī icoo nì dinyoondi ń nīn táá-bi ki cá talku, bí fá bi-jilimau kí kpú!

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, my King and my God, sparrows find a home near your altars; swallows build nests there to raise their young.
translation_verse: M-naŋki bíi fèefī ki nyàab̀ kí nīn bí a-cindin. M làá gāā ilan nì m-pɔbil kɔkɔ kí tīī dimaŋfal Nimbɔtiu.

english_verse: You bless everyone who lives in your house, and they sing your praises.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan Unimbɔti Mpɔŋkɔdaan, m-bɔtiu nì m-Nimbɔtiu, a-saraafaŋyi caŋinee, seer kāntí laakin u làá kɔ́ee, ní kikoosiyaakpaai kāntí ki-diiku kí kpàà ki-biyaamu.

english_verse: When they reach Dry Valley, springs start flowing, and the autumn rain fills it with pools of water.
translation_verse: Bin kāntí bi-pɔŋŋu a-cee, ki lēē bi-pɔbilin kí cù Jeerusaleem kí jāam̀-see bí mmɔnni!

english_verse: Your people grow stronger, and you, the God of gods, will be seen in Zion.
translation_verse: Bi yaa còom̄ ki jītí Baka sufii tantakalinee, bi yàntī an kpántí inyimbul ŋma ní, ní ukpaasiitaa ń gbéeǹ-dì anyimbɔbil.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, the God of Jacob, please answer my prayer!
translation_verse: Bi yaa còom̄ ki cée ní bi mɔ̀tīi kāntí mpɔn, ní kí tin nyā Unimbɔti nimbiin Siiyɔn jool pu.

english_verse: You are the shield that protects your people, and I am your chosen one. Won't you smile on me?
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan Unimbɔti Mpɔŋkɔdaan, pīlifì m-wimmeem. Jaakɔb Nimbɔtiu, kpòon̄ a-tafal kí pīlifì-mi.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, you are like the sun and also like a shield. You treat us with kindness and with honor, never denying any good thing to those who live right.
translation_verse: Ḿ nīn bí a-diikun ŋwiin ŋubɔ sɔ́ǹ ḿ nīn bí laaba fám iwiin kutuku. M lēē kí nīn bí m-Nimbɔtiu diiku punyɔkɔpu, míǹ sɔ́ǹ ḿ nīn kóò binikpitib dumpui.

english_verse: Our Lord, you have blessed your land and made all go well for Jacob's descendants.
translation_verse: Koora dicaŋkun yab di ŋmàn̄ nlan nee ki tīī bilaŋgaaliibi kpiliu.

english_verse: You have forgiven the sin and taken away the guilt of your people.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, a dàkà a-tiŋki a-neendi, a fātìi gíiǹní Jaakɔb naantiibi bin nìn bí kuyuŋuee.

english_verse: Your fierce anger is no longer aimed at us.
translation_verse: A pítì a-nibul yìntitam, a dū di-kpitii kɔkɔ ki pú-dì.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, you save us! Please bring us back home and don't be angry.
translation_verse: A nín nìn gíí ti-pu diŋuul diŋyee kúntì, a páatì ti-pu mbum min a nìn fōō ti-puee.

english_verse: Will you always be angry with us and our families?
translation_verse: Unimbɔti ti-Fiiliu, fàtīí gíiǹní-ti, kúntí diŋuul din a gíí ti-puee.

english_verse: Won't you give us fresh life and let your people be glad because of you?
translation_verse: A làá gíí ti-pu diŋuul kí nīn cá jaanjaanaaa? A-bum kaa bí ki làá gbèen̄ dalba dalbaaa?

english_verse: You are ready to rescue everyone who worships you, so that you will live with us in all your glory.
translation_verse: M làá pīlifì tin ti-Dindaan Unimbɔti sòoǹee, di sá u bí yii u làá tīī u-nibul, nì bin sí nì u deedeeyee ŋgbansɔŋfi, ama bí taa ti fàtīí gítí digbaandin.

english_verse: Love and loyalty will come together; goodness and peace will unite.
translation_verse: Tiŋman u-fiil kaa ti dátiǹ bin fàŋkí-uee, ní tinyool làá nīn bí ti-tiŋkin.

english_verse: Loyalty will sprout from the ground; justice will look down from the sky above.
translation_verse: Tiŋan nì ibaamɔn làá kpāfì, ní deedee nì ŋgbansɔŋfi ń kpàl̄ tɔb.

english_verse: Our Lord, you will bless us; our land will produce wonderful crops.
translation_verse: Ibaamɔn làá nyānní kitiŋin kii iwamboolee ní deedee ń nyānní yilpu kí kpákatiń.

english_verse: Justice will march in front, making a path for you to follow.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan di lafun tìì tin ŋān̄ee, ní ti-tiŋki lòoǹ tikpaajin.

english_verse: Please listen, Lord, and answer my prayer! I am poor and helpless.
translation_verse: Daafiidi wimmeem. Ti-Dindaan, kpòon̄ a-tafal kí pīlifiǹ-mi, fōō m-wimmeem, di sá yii m sá unandaan nì ufalaadaan ní.

english_verse: Protect me and save me because you are my God. I am your faithful servant, and I trust you.
translation_verse: Wúń m-pu di sá yii m sá deedeedaan, sii m-Nimbɔtiu, fīī man a-tɔntɔnliu un di máká a-puee.

english_verse: Be kind to me! I pray to you all day.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, sɔ̄ m-saai, di sá yii sii ní m kūuntí ki yíì baabadal.

english_verse: Make my heart glad! I serve you, and my prayer is sincere.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, sii ní m fātì m-ba ki túĺ, m gbàam̄-si ní, fàtīí tīī man a-tɔntɔnliu mmɔn.

english_verse: You willingly forgive, and your love is always there for those who pray to you.
translation_verse: Di sá yii sii ti-Dindaan ŋān̄ ní ki pūǹ ikpiti, a-neendi wīikí ki tīī bin yíì-see.

english_verse: Please listen, Lord! Answer my prayer for help.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, kpòon̄ a-tafal kí pīlifì m-wimmeem! Pīlifì m-gbaamii.

english_verse: When I am in trouble, I pray, knowing you will listen.
translation_verse: M-nimbinaamandi poonee, m kūuntí ki yíì-si, kun puee a fòol̄ m-wimmeem.

english_verse: No other gods are like you; only you work miracles.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, inimbɔti kansikinee, ubɔ kaa bí kii siiyee, ubɔ kaa ŋúń ki ŋá tin a ŋá nee.

english_verse: You created each nation, and they will all bow down to worship and honor you.
translation_verse: Atimbun ŋin kɔkɔ a náańee làá dāan̄ kí gbàan̄ sii ti-Dindaan nimbiin, ní kí nyɔ̄ŋkì a-yindi.

english_verse: You perform great wonders because you alone are God.
translation_verse: Di sá yii a sá ukpaan ní ki ŋáań maamaaci tuuŋŋi, sii baba di sá Unimbɔti!

english_verse: Teach me to follow you, and I will obey your truth. Always keep me faithful.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, dàkà-mi a-saŋŋu, ní ḿ còom̀ a-baamɔŋŋu poon. Yàntī ḿ nīn fàŋkí-si nì m-pɔbil kɔkɔ.

english_verse: With all my heart I thank you. I praise you, Lord God.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan m-Nimbɔtiu, m làá nīn nyɔ́ŋkí-si nì m-pɔbil kɔkɔ, ní kí nīn pée tìì-si tinyool baabadal.

english_verse: Your love for me is so great that you protected me from death and the grave.
translation_verse: Di sá yii a-neendi wīikí m-pu, a fīī m-naŋki ki nyántìń ditaŋkpiilin.

english_verse: Proud and violent enemies, who don't care about you, have ganged up to attack and kill me.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti, bilambidambi jáà nì mi, bin néeń tipɔmbɔtee dikitil nyàab̀ kí kpɔ̀-mi, baa pée dū-si ki yíiń tiba.

english_verse: But you, the Lord God, are kind and merciful. You don't easily get angry, and your love can always be trusted.
translation_verse: Ama sii ti-Dindaanee, a sá Unimbɔti un poon mɔ̄ ki cáá kulaŋŋaŋfitiiuee ní, aa gífí diŋuul malaa, ní a-neendi wīikí tikpilku ní a sá deedeedaan.

english_verse: I serve you, Lord, and I am the child of one of your servants. Look on me with kindness. Make me strong and save me.
translation_verse: Fàtī a-ba kí túĺ-mi kí sɔ̄ m-saai, tīī man a-tɔntɔnliu a-pɔŋŋu, fīī man un sá a-tɔntɔnliu jipɔɔnee.

english_verse: Show that you approve of me! Then my hateful enemies will feel like fools, because you have helped and comforted me.
translation_verse: Tīī-mi a-ŋanti daaŋku bin ná-mee ń ká ní icoo ń cúú-bi. Di sá yii sii ti-Dindaan di jòoń-mi ki ŋmēentí-mi.

english_verse: Zion was built by the Lord on the holy mountain,
translation_verse: Koora dicaŋkun yab di ŋmàn̄ nlan nee. Nlan. Ti-Dindaan máń Siiyɔn tiŋki ki tɔ́kɔǹ circir jooŋŋi pu.

english_verse: and he loves that city more than any other place in all of Israel.
translation_verse: U néeń-kì ki jítiǹ Isirayeel timmu mun kíǹee kɔkɔ.

english_verse: Zion, you are the city of God, and wonderful things are told about you.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti tiŋki, tinyool bɔti ŋma ní u sòoǹ a-pu.

english_verse: Egypt, Babylonia, Philistia, Phoenicia, and Ethiopia are some of those nations that know you, and their people all say, “I was born in Zion.”
translation_verse: M yaa làá kàaǹ anibul ŋin nyí-mee, kpèè Eejipiti nì Babiloon yab, Fiiliistii nì Tiir nì Eetiiyoopii nib kútì poon. Niin ní bi màl̄-bi.

english_verse: God Most High will strengthen the city of Zion. Then everyone will say, “We were born here too.”
translation_verse: Ama bi làá dāá sòoǹ Siiyɔn pu yii: «Bi màl̄ unil kamaa niin ní, Yilpu fɔ́ŋŋŋ Nimbɔtiu di tīī-kì mpɔn.»

english_verse: The Lord will make a list of his people, and all who were born here will be included.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan làá dāá kàaǹ anibul kɔkɔ, kí ŋmà yii: «Bi màl̄ ŋmɔŋŋmɔkɔ Siiyɔn tiŋkin.»

english_verse: All who sing or dance will say, “I too am from Zion.”
translation_verse: Bilaŋgaaliibi nì biŋɔliibi lì yii: «M-nyeeŋŋu kɔkɔ bí a-ni ní.»

english_verse: You keep me safe, Lord God. So when I pray at night,
translation_verse: Koora dicaŋkun yab di ŋmàn̄ nlan nee ki tīī bilaŋgaaliibi kpiliu. Eeman un sá Seera naantiiuee di dàkā nlan gbanti.

english_verse: please listen carefully to each of my concerns.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan Unimbɔti m-Fiiliu, m kūuntí ki yíì-si ŋwiimpu nì kunyeeu.

english_verse: I am deeply troubled and close to death;
translation_verse: Yàntī m-wimmeem ń bàń-si, kpòon̄ a-tafal kí pīlifì m-gbaamii.

english_verse: I am as good as dead and completely helpless.
translation_verse: Di sá yii agìń ŋma poon ní m bí, ní maa ti dátiǹ ŋkúm.

english_verse: I am no better off than those in the grave, those you have forgotten and no longer help.
translation_verse: Bi kàaǹ-mi ki kútí bin bí dikaakulinee pu ní, m bí kii unil un wuntin mpɔn dóòyee.

english_verse: your anger rolls over me like ocean waves.
translation_verse: A dū-mi ki bíl̀ dikaakulin taapu taapu, laakin dibɔmbɔŋkpaandi bée.

english_verse: You have made my friends turn in horror from me. I am a prisoner who cannot escape,
translation_verse: A-ŋuul nyìm̀ m-pu, a dū a-nyiŋgbanti kɔkɔ ki léeǹ m-pu.

english_verse: and I am almost blind because of my sorrow. Each day I lift my hands in prayer to you, Lord.
translation_verse: A jìn̄ bin m nyée ki wāatì-mi, m kíǹ ki cáá-bi titantan ní. M kpántì usarkadaan ní, maa ti ŋūǹ kí nyā.

english_verse: Do you work miracles for the dead? Do they stand up and praise you?
translation_verse: Falaa ŋmɔ́ ki bíil̀ m-nimbiliŋ. Baabadalee, m kūuntí ki yíì-si ní, m-Dindaan, m yòontí m-ŋalii yilpu ki túl̀ a-watil pu.

english_verse: Are your love and loyalty announced in the world of the dead?
translation_verse: Bitaŋkpiibi ní a làá ŋá maamaacib kí tīīii? Bin dɔ̄ bi-ŋalii puee làá yīkì kí nyɔ̄ŋkì-saaa?

english_verse: Do they know of your miracles or your saving power in the dark world below where all is forgotten?
translation_verse: Dikaakulin ní unil ŋūǹ kí sòoǹ a-neeŋkpaandi puɔɔɔ, ditaŋkpiilin ní u ŋūǹ kí sòoǹ a-deedeeu pu ní?

english_verse: Why do you reject me? Why do you turn from me?
translation_verse: Ama mamee, sii ti-Dindaan ní m gbáà ibiil ki yíì, kutaafaauee, m-wimmeem bàń a-nimbiin.

english_verse: Ever since I was a child, I have been sick and close to death. You have terrified me and made me helpless.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, ba pu ní a dū-mi ki fá, kaa ti là kí wāl̀-mi ní?

english_verse: Your anger is like a flood! And I am shattered by your furious attacks
translation_verse: Doooo m-biyatin ní m gbí falaa kaa dátiǹ ŋkúm, a kɔ́ǹ-mi dinyoondin ní maa ti nyí tin poon m bée.

english_verse: that strike each day and from every side.
translation_verse: A-ŋuul din fòol̄ lìblibee jítì m-pu, a-nyoondi nāaǹ-mi kɔkɔ.

english_verse: My friends and neighbors have turned against me because of you, and now darkness is my only companion.
translation_verse: Dì māntìi tú-mi baabadal kii nnyimee, di māntìi tú-mi an kɔkɔ pu.

english_verse: I will tell them, “God's love can always be trusted, and his faithfulness lasts as long as the heavens.”
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, a-ŋanti puee, m làá nīn gà ilan ki nyɔ́ŋkí-si baabadal, m làá sòoǹ kí yàntī binib ń béé a-baamɔŋyi kí nīn cá jaanjaan.

english_verse: You said, “David, my servant, is my chosen one, and this is the agreement I made with him:
translation_verse: Di sá m lī yii: «A-ŋanti bí ní baabadal, a dū a-baamɔŋyi ki ŋá yilpu ní.»

english_verse: David, one of your descendants will always be king.”
translation_verse: A lī yii: «M pūtì ki pōoǹ un m lēēyee dipoondi, m pūtì ki tùkū m-tɔntɔnliu Daafiidi yii:

english_verse: Our Lord, let the heavens now praise your miracles, and let all your angels praise your faithfulness.
translation_verse: A-naantiibi kansikin ubɔ làá nīn pée sá ubɔti ní, m làá tīī a-beel mpɔn dí nīn bí ki cá jaanjaan.»

english_verse: None who live in the heavens can compare with you.
translation_verse: Yilpu tuuŋyi nyɔ́ŋkí a-maamaaci tuuŋŋi, nì a-baamɔŋyi circirdambi kpafiŋin.

english_verse: You are the most fearsome of all who live in heaven; all the others fear and greatly honor you.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, ŋma sá a-juti yilpu? Si nì ŋma náań inimbɔti kansikin?

english_verse: You are Lord God All-Powerful! No one is as loving and faithful as you are.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti, circirdambi kpafil poonee, bi fàŋkí-si ní yɔ́kɔ́ yɔkɔ. A sá kuwambiiu ki jítiǹ bin kɔkɔ māntìi tú-see.

english_verse: You rule the roaring sea and calm its waves.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan Unimbɔti Mpɔŋkɔdaan, ŋma di cáá mpɔn kii siiyee? A-baamɔŋyi māntìi tú-si.

english_verse: You crushed the monster Rahab, and with your powerful arm you scattered your enemies.
translation_verse: Sii di cáá tiŋku un cáá dilambilee pu mpɔn, u-nyiŋgbanti yaa yíkèe, sii di yàntī tí dòon̄ soooo.

english_verse: The heavens and the earth belong to you. And so does the world with all its people because you created them
translation_verse: Sii di nàn̄ Raab kupeebiliŋŋu kun a kūūyee, nì a-kpabil ní a dūu gbáń ki yāaǹ a-nannanliibi.

english_verse: and everything else. Mount Tabor and Mount Hermon gladly praise you.
translation_verse: Sii di yì yilpu, sii di yì kitiŋ mun, sii di tí náań duulinya nì tin kɔkɔ bí u-puee.

english_verse: Your kingdom is ruled by justice and fairness with love and faithfulness leading the way.
translation_verse: Sii di yì ŋŋal ŋun cáá mpɔnee, ŋŋaŋgiil ŋun a yōoǹ yilpu kí dàkà a-kpabilee.

english_verse: Our Lord, you bless those who join in the festival and walk in the brightness of your presence.
translation_verse: A-beejal tɔ́kɔ́ deedee nì tin tèen̄ee pu ní, ní dineendi nì ibaamɔn līī a-nyɔkɔpu.

english_verse: We are happy all day because of you, and your saving power brings honor to us.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, binib bin nyí bi nín nyɔ́ŋkí-si puee bí mmɔnneeee! Bi còom̄ a-nimbiin walifiŋun ní.

english_verse: Your own glorious power makes us strong, and because of your kindness, our strength increases.
translation_verse: A-yindi puee, bi fàal̀ ní baabadal, a-deedeeu puee, bi-yindi yíkí yilpu.

english_verse: Our Lord and our King, the Holy One of Israel, you are truly our shield.
translation_verse: Sii di sá ti-pɔŋkpaaŋŋu, a-ŋanti pu ní ti còom̄ ti-yil gáań.

english_verse: and I will always be there to help and strengthen him.
translation_verse: M ká Daafiidi m-tɔntɔnliu, m bātì m-circir kpam ki sītì u-yil pu.

english_verse: “No enemy will outsmart David, and he won't be defeated by any hateful people.
translation_verse: M-ŋal làá nīn ŋúb́-u gbīŋgbim, m-ŋal làá tīī-u mpɔn.

english_verse: I will strike down and crush his troublesome enemies.
translation_verse: Unannanli ubɔ kpá kí túuǹ-u, unikpiti ubɔ mun kpá kí já kí pɔ̄ɔkiǹ-u.

english_verse: He will always be able to depend on my love, and I will make him strong with my own power.
translation_verse: M làá nà u-nannanliibi dúsi dusi u-nimbiin, m làá kpɔ̀ bin kɔkɔ ná-uee.

english_verse: I will let him rule the lands across the rivers and seas.
translation_verse: M-baamɔŋŋu nì m-neeŋkpaandi làá nīn bí u-cee, m-yindi puee, u làá nīn còom̄ u-yil gáań.

english_verse: He will say to me, ‘You are my Father and my God, as well as the mighty rock where I am safe.’
translation_verse: M làá dū tiŋku kí ŋá u-ŋaan, u làá nīn cáá ibun pu mpɔn.

english_verse: “I have chosen David as my first-born son, and he will be the ruler of all kings on earth.
translation_verse: U làá dāá yíiń-mi yii: <M-baa, sii di sá m-Nimbɔtiu nì kutaŋkpanaakoou kun fìil̄-mee!>

english_verse: My love for him will last, and my agreement with him will never be broken.
translation_verse: M làá yàntī ú kpántí m-jipɔŋkpiliu, kí nīn sá ukpaan ki jítiǹ kitiŋ pu bɔtiibi kɔkɔ.

english_verse: “One of David's descendants will always be king, and his family will rule until the sky disappears.
translation_verse: M làá dàkà-u m-neeŋkpaandi kí nīn cá jaanjaan, ní ki kpá kí kpìtī dipoondi din m pōoǹ-uee.

english_verse: Suppose some of his children should reject my Law and refuse my instructions.
translation_verse: U-naantiibi kansikin ubɔ làá nīn pée sá ubɔti ní, ní u-beel ń yúntí kii kutagbɔŋu nín làá yúntí puee.

english_verse: Or suppose they should disobey all of my teachings.
translation_verse: «Báà u-naantiibi yaa dū m-marab ki fá kaa nóó m-saŋŋu,

english_verse: Then I will correct and punish them because of their sins.
translation_verse: bi yaa yīntiǹ m-bɔkpaaŋi ní kaa ŋúb́ m-koobiliŋee,

english_verse: But I will always love David and faithfully keep all of my promises to him.
translation_verse: m làá dū ndɔ kí gbá-bi bi-yìntitam pu ní kí dū dinaalabil kí dáaĺ bi-tafal bi-kpitii pu.

english_verse: “I won't break my agreement or go back on my word.
translation_verse: Ama maa làá ŋmìntī-bi m-neeŋkpaandi, kaa tí làá fàtī m-boon kí tīī m-poondi.

english_verse: I have sworn once and for all by my own holy name, and I won't lie to David.
translation_verse: Maa làá kpèè m-poondi fám, kaa tí làá kpántí tin nyáń m-nyɔkɔnee.

english_verse: His family will always rule. I will let his kingdom last as long as the sun
translation_verse: M pūtì m-circir yindi dibaba ja yii maa làá mɔ̄ntì Daafiidi nnyimɔn.

english_verse: You are now angry, Lord, and you have turned your back on your chosen king.
translation_verse: U-beel làá nīn bí ki pɔ̄ɔ̄ ki cá jaanjaan kii uŋmal un bí atagban poon ki sá deedee seeradaaŋwuee.»

english_verse: You broke off your agreement with your servant, the king, and you completely destroyed his kingdom.
translation_verse: Ama a fātì a-boon ki tīī ubɔti un a lēēyee ki dū-u ki fá, ní ki gíí u-pu diŋuul.

english_verse: The walls of his city have been broken through, and every fortress now lies in ruins.
translation_verse: A nyáń dipoondi din a nìn pōoǹ a-tɔntɔnliuee boon, ní ki dū u-beefuuliiki ki lúkú kitiŋ ki kɔ́ǹ-kì tijɔkɔndi.

english_verse: All who pass by take what they want, and nations everywhere joke about the king.
translation_verse: A yāntì digundi din māntìi tú u-tiŋkee bátì bátì ki lítì, u-tiŋki kin bi máń digundi ki túee kpántì adigbuŋkati.

english_verse: You made his enemies powerful and let them celebrate.
translation_verse: Bisanjitiliibi fúkúl̀-u pílpil, ní u-kɔŋkɔnnaatɔb bèel̄-u.

english_verse: But you forced him to retreat because you did not fight on his side.
translation_verse: A tīī u-nannanliibi mpɔn, a yāntì u-pulincɔntiibi bí ki fàal̀.

english_verse: You took his crown and threw his throne in the dirt.
translation_verse: A fātì u-tàataajiki ki túĺ-u kaa tútúǹ-u kujaaun.

english_verse: You made an old man of him and put him to shame.
translation_verse: A yāntì u fá u-nyooti, ní ki téé u-beejal ki lúkú.

english_verse: No one can escape the power of death and the grave.
translation_verse: Téetí m-pu, unil maŋfal wiiŋyi kaa náaǹ! A náań nisaal kí kúntíǹ fám ní.

english_verse: Our Lord, where is the love you have always shown and that you promised so faithfully to David?
translation_verse: Unil ulɔu di bí kaa làá kpú dalba dalba, ki làá ŋmā kí fīī u-maŋfal kí taa kɔ́ ditaŋkpiilin?

english_verse: Remember your servant, Lord! People make jokes about me, and I suffer many insults.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, dineeŋkpaandi din a nìn dàkā doooo cannaaku, din a nìn pūtì ki pōoǹ Daafiidee bí la?

english_verse: I am your chosen one, but your enemies chase and make fun of me.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, téetí a-tɔntɔnliibi siibiliŋ pu, asiibil ŋin ní anibul tikpil sīī-mee.

english_verse: Our Lord, we praise you forever. Amen and amen.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, a-nannanliibi bí ki sìí-mi, man ubɔti un a lēēyee yaa jītée bi tíiĺ timɔtan ní.

english_verse: ) God Is Eternal
translation_verse: ) Unimbɔti bí kí nīn cá jaanjaan

english_verse: Our Lord, in all generations you have been our home.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti niliu Mooyiisi wimmeem. Ti-Dindaan, sii di sá ti-balilaŋki doooo abin abin.

english_verse: You have always been God— long before the birth of the mountains, even before you created the earth and the world.
translation_verse: Kí wàatī ajoon ń nīn bée, kí wàatī á náań kitiŋ nì duulinyee, sii di nìn sá Unimbɔti ní ki làá nīn pée sá Unimbɔti.

english_verse: At your command we die and turn back to dust,
translation_verse: A yàntī unil fàtīi gítí ntamin, di sá a lī yii: «Nisaal, fàtīí gítí laakin a nyánnée.»

english_verse: but a thousand years mean nothing to you! They are merely a day gone by or a few hours in the night.
translation_verse: Sii ceeyee, abin kutuku sá kii ŋwiin ŋubɔee ní, a lì kii fool un jítì nee, àá ŋyunti ŋun bijanjaliibi dūú sīĺ sintil kunyeeuee ní.

english_verse: You bring our lives to an end just like a dream. We are merely tender grass
translation_verse: A kúntí unil maŋfal wiiŋyi. I bí kii ŋgeemee ní, ní kutaafaauee í wāŋkì kii kumoouee.

english_verse: that sprouts and grows in the morning, but dries up by evening.
translation_verse: Kutaafaauee kumoou màtī ní kí wíiǹ, kujoouee ní kú fáaḿ kí kpā.

english_verse: Your furious anger frightens and destroys us,
translation_verse: Tiŋman, a-ŋuul púntí-ti, a-bum fàantí-ti.

english_verse: and you know all our sins, even those we do in secret.
translation_verse: A dū ti-yìntitam ki bíl̀ a-nimbiin, a-walfiŋu ŋmíntì ti-kpitii in ti ŋáań dibalinee pu.

english_verse: Your anger is a burden each day we live, then life ends like a sigh.
translation_verse: A-ŋuul pu ní ti-maŋfal wiiŋyi kúntí, ti-maŋfal wiiŋyi kúntí malaa kii diniindee ní.

english_verse: We can expect seventy years, or maybe eighty, if we are healthy, but even our best years bring trouble and sorrow. Suddenly our time is up, and we disappear.
translation_verse: Unil yaa tin yúntèe di sá u bàn̄ abin imuŋku ita nì saalaayee. Un pɔ̄ɔ̄yee di bà abin imuŋku inaa. Ama kun ti kāntí ŋi-poonee di sá agìń nì falaa. Ti-maŋfal wiiŋyi jītí malaa ní tí búntí.

english_verse: No one knows the full power of your furious anger, but it is as great as the fear that we owe to you.
translation_verse: Ŋma di ŋūǹ kí béé a-ŋuul pɔŋŋu? A-bum sá ŋkpaami kii an nín máaǹ bí fàŋkì-si puee ní.

english_verse: Teach us to use wisely all the time we have.
translation_verse: Yàntī tí béé yii ti-maŋfal wiiŋyi kaa náaǹ, án nín làá ŋá pu tí ká iciin ti-pɔbil poonee.

english_verse: When morning comes, let your love satisfy all our needs. Then we can celebrate and be glad for what time we have left.
translation_verse: Dàkà-ti a-neendi kutaafaau, ní tí nīn gà ilan ki fàal̀ ti-maŋfal wiiŋyi kɔkɔ poon.

english_verse: Make us happy for as long as you caused us trouble and sorrow.
translation_verse: Yàntī tí fàal̀ iwiin in nyɔkɔm a sīntiǹ-ti taapuee, abin ŋin nyɔkɔm ti ká nnaabuee.

english_verse: Do wonderful things for us, your servants, and show your mighty power to our children.
translation_verse: Yàntī timbi a-tɔntɔnliibi ń ká a-tuŋkpaaŋŋi, ní ti-biyaamu ń ká a nín sá ukpaan puee.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, treat us with kindness and let all go well for us. Please let all go well!
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan ti-Nimbɔtiu, yàntī a-saasɔl ń nīn bí ti-pu, yàntī án bútí-ti ti-tuuŋŋi kɔkɔ poon, tiŋman, yàntī án bútí-ti.

english_verse: Live under the protection of God Most High and stay in the shadow of God All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Unil un sáǹ ki kɔ́ Yilpu Fɔ́ŋŋŋ Nimbɔtiuee, Mpɔŋkɔdaan booŋŋu taapu ní udaan ŋùŋfī.

english_verse: Then you will say to the Lord, “You are my fortress, my place of safety; you are my God, and I trust you.”
translation_verse: M tùkù ti-Dindaan yii: «Sii di sá m-balilaŋki nì m-taŋkpanaakooku, ki sá m-Nimbɔtiu un pu ní m mákée!»

english_verse: The Lord will keep you safe from secret traps and deadly diseases.
translation_verse: - Ti-Dindaan di làá fīī-si kí nyāntí ukpan taliŋkun nì bìlbil kúm ŋaan.

english_verse: He will spread his wings over you and keep you secure. His faithfulness is like a shield or a city wall.
translation_verse: U làá dū u-kuti kí bīiǹ a-pu, ní á sāǹ kí kɔ́ u-feeŋyi taapu. U-baamɔŋyi sá digbampɔɔl nì tijanjawan ní.

english_verse: You won't need to worry about dangers at night or arrows during the day.
translation_verse: Aa làá fàŋkì dinyoondi din bí kunyeeueeyaaa, kaa làá fàŋkì ipiin in ŋàaǹ ŋwiimpueeyaaa,

english_verse: And you won't fear diseases that strike in the dark or sudden disaster at noon.
translation_verse: kaa làá fàŋkì bìlbil kúm min yìiǹ dibɔmbɔndineeyaaa, kaa làá fàŋkì kuweeŋkpiiu kun bìlim̄ kuwiŋkaŋu puee mun.

english_verse: You will not be harmed, though thousands fall all around you.
translation_verse: Báà binib kutuku yaa lítì ki kpíì a-caŋin, ní binib kutukub saalaa yaa lítì a-ŋaŋgiil pú, tiba kpá ki làá ŋá-si.

english_verse: And with your own eyes you will see the punishment of the wicked.
translation_verse: Nì a-nimbibulii ní a làá ká Unimbɔti nín làá pà binikpitib tipaal tiŋyee.

english_verse: The Lord Most High is your fortress. Run to him for safety,
translation_verse: - Tiŋman, sii ti-Dindaan ní m sáǹ ki kɔ́. A yaa yāntì Yilpu Fɔ́ŋŋŋ Nimbɔtiu kpántì a-balilaŋkee,

english_verse: and no terrible disasters will strike you or your home.
translation_verse: tikpitil tiba kaa làá bàń-si, nnaabu ŋubɔ kaa làá sútí kí pìlīǹ-si.

english_verse: God will command his angels to protect you wherever you go.
translation_verse: Di sá yii ti-Dindaan làá tīī u-tuuŋyi mara í nīn cí-si laakin kamaa a làá cùee.

english_verse: They will carry you in their arms, and you won't hurt your feet on the stones.
translation_verse: I làá nīn tíkí-si i-ŋaaŋyin, án nín làá ŋá pu a-taal ń taa gbéetí ditaŋkpalee.

english_verse: You will overpower the strongest lions and the most deadly snakes.
translation_verse: A làá tāā gbikinti nì ukoowaati pu kí còom̀, ki làá yáká digbikintipɔmbil nì ukoobu ditaal.

english_verse: The Lord says, “If you love me and truly know who I am, I will rescue you and keep you safe.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan bí yii: «U nín dū u-ba ki nákáǹ-mee puee, m làá fīī-u. U nín nyí-mee puee, m làá wúń u-pu.

english_verse: When you are in trouble, call out to me. I will answer and be there to protect and honor you.
translation_verse: U yaa kúuǹ ki yíiń-mee, m làá kíí-u. Man m-ba làá nīn bí u-cee dinimbinaamandi poon, m làá fīī-u ní kí tīī-u tinyool.

english_verse: You will live a long life and see my saving power.”
translation_verse: M làá tīī-u mmaŋfafɔkɔn, ní kí dàkà-u yii man di sá u-fiiliu.»

english_verse: It is wonderful to be grateful and to sing your praises, Lord Most High!
translation_verse: Inyɔŋki laŋŋu ŋun bi gà ŋwiŋŋuŋfikaa dalee.

english_verse: It is wonderful each morning to tell about your love and at night to announce how faithful you are.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, an ŋān̄ yii tí nyɔ̄ŋkì-si, kí gāā ilan kí tīī sii Yilpu Fɔ́ŋŋŋ Nimbɔtiu yindi tinyool!

english_verse: I enjoy praising your name to the music of harps,
translation_verse: An ŋān̄ yii kutaafaauee tí sòoǹ a-neeŋkpaandi pu, ní kunyeeuee, tí sòoǹ a-baamɔŋyi pu,

english_verse: because everything you do makes me happy, and I sing joyful songs.
translation_verse: kí bɔ̀ɔ̀ iŋmii saalaa beeku nì saŋgu kí nyɔ̄ŋkì-si.

english_verse: You do great things, Lord. Your thoughts are too deep
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, a-tuuŋŋi tìì-mi mmɔn, atuun ŋin a ŋée puee, m làá gāā ilan kí fàal̀.

english_verse: for an ignorant fool to know or understand.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, a-tuuŋŋi sá akpaaneeee, a-landɔkɔi nyóò tikpil!

english_verse: Though the wicked sprout and spread like grass, they will be pulled up by their roots.
translation_verse: Un kaa dàkafēe kaa nyí míǹ, ugbaan kaa ŋūǹ kí gbìl̄ taapu.

english_verse: and your hateful enemies will be scattered and then destroyed.
translation_verse: Ama sii ti-Dindaan di tɔ́kɔ́ tikɔkɔ pu kí nīn cáa cá jaanjaan.

english_verse: You have given me the strength of a wild ox, and you have chosen me to be your very own.
translation_verse: Kpèè a-nannanliibi, ti-Dindaan, kpèè a-nannanliibi kɔkɔ làá kpú kí céetí, bikpitiŋaliibi kɔkɔ làá yàl̄.

english_verse: My eyes have seen, and my ears have heard the doom and destruction of my evil enemies.
translation_verse: A tīī-mi upɔɔnaa pɔŋŋu, a bātì ŋkpam min sɔ́fèe ki sītì m-pu.

english_verse: Good people will prosper like palm trees, and they will grow strong like the cedars of Lebanon.
translation_verse: M-nimbil ká m-nannanliibi lítitam, m-tafal gbìl̄ bin jáà nì mee biilii pu.

english_verse: They will take root in your house, Lord God, and they will do well.
translation_verse: Deedeedaan wīintí kii bubabuee ní, u fɔ̀kɔntí kii Leebanɔn subu bun bi yíì seediree.

english_verse: They will be like trees that stay healthy and fruitful, even when they are old.
translation_verse: U bí kii busubu bun bi cóoǹ kunimbɔtidiinee ní, bu pɔ̀kɔtī ti-Nimbɔtiu cindin.

english_verse: And they will say about you, “The Lord always does right! God is our mighty rock.”
translation_verse: Báà bu yaa púĺaaa, bu gbíntìi lòoǹ ní, bu cáá ŋkpiim ní ki sɔ̀m̀.

english_verse: Our Lord, you are King! Majesty and power are your royal robes. You put the world in place, and it will never be moved.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan sá ubɔti. U dū tikpaandi ki pēeǹ kii dibɔkutilee, ní ki dū mpɔn ki gbìn̄ kii dambalee. An pu ní duulinya bá ki pɔ̄ɔ̄, kaa cìŋkī.

english_verse: You have always ruled, and you are eternal.
translation_verse: Doooo cannaaku ní a-beel bí ki bá ki pɔ̄ɔ̄, doooo jaanjaan ní a bí.

english_verse: The ocean is roaring, Lord! The sea is pounding hard.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, amɔɔ bíi yíkí yilpu, amɔɔ yāntì bi gbìl̄ ŋi-nyɔkɔ pu, amɔɔ bíi gà kuwoou.

english_verse: Its mighty waves are majestic, but you are even more majestic, and you rule over all.
translation_verse: A pɔ̄ɔ̄ ki jítiǹ nnyiŋkpaam wooku nì tiŋku nyiŋgbanti tin ŋān̄ee pu, sii ti-Dindaan un bí yilpuee di ŋān̄.

english_verse: Your decisions are firm, and your temple will always be beautiful and holy.
translation_verse: A-bɔkpaaŋi baasii sá ibaamɔn ní, ti-Dindaan, a-diiku máaǹ kí nīn sá circir diiku, kí nīn cáa cá jaanjaan.

english_verse: Lord God, you punish the guilty. Show what you are like and punish them now.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, sii Unimbɔti un tɔ̀ ipɔntoonee, lēē a-ba kí dàkà, sii Unimbɔti un tɔ̀ ipɔntoonee.

english_verse: You judge the earth. Come and help us! Pay back those proud people for what they have done.
translation_verse: Yīkìm̄, kitiŋ pu nib bɔsoonliu, kí pà bilambidambi bi-tuuŋŋi paati.

english_verse: All of those cruel people strut and boast,
translation_verse: Bi yòontí bi-ba yilpu ki sòoǹ tilambibɔti, bikpitiŋaliibi nee kɔkɔ dàkà bi-ba.

english_verse: and they crush and wound your chosen nation, Lord.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, bi wɔ́b̀ a-nibul, bi sàantí bin sá a-yabee.

english_verse: They murder widows, foreigners, and orphans.
translation_verse: Bi kù ukpiipu nì unicaan, ki kù ataŋkpiibil.

english_verse: Then they say, “The Lord God of Jacob doesn't see or know.”
translation_verse: Ní ki bí ki lì yii: «Ti-Dindaan kaa wāĺ, Jaakɔb Nimbɔtiu kaa fātìi tɔ́.»

english_verse: God gave us ears and eyes! Can't he hear and see?
translation_verse: Un di ŋá unil tafalee kaa gbìl̀aaa? Úǹ un náań unil nimbilee kaa wāĺaaa?

english_verse: God instructs the nations and gives knowledge to us all. Won't he also correct us?
translation_verse: Úǹ un dátí atimbun tafalee di kaa ŋūǹ kí dáaĺ unil tafalaaa? Ti-Dindaan un tìì unil dinyilee,

english_verse: The Lord knows how useless our plans really are.
translation_verse: u nyí unil landɔkɔi kɔkɔ! U nyí i nín kaa bí tibanee.

english_verse: Our Lord, you bless everyone that you instruct and teach by using your Law.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, unil un tafal a dátí, ki cáá a-marab ki dàkà-uee bí mmɔnneeee!

english_verse: You give them rest from their troubles, until a pit can be dug for the wicked.
translation_verse: Dinimbinaamandi yuntiŋuee, a yàntī u bí ŋgbansɔŋfin, ki cí bí gbà mbòó kí cīití binikpitib.

english_verse: You won't turn your back on your chosen nation.
translation_verse: Di sá yii ti-Dindaan kaa dù u-nibul kí fá, waa fàtī u-boon kí tīī bin sá u-yabee.

english_verse: Justice and fairness will go hand in hand, and all who do right will follow along.
translation_verse: Bi làá dāá fàtīí sòoǹ binib bɔti nì ibaamɔn, ní bin kɔkɔ pɔbil bí dibee ń dāá kíí míǹ.

english_verse: Who will stand up for me against those cruel people?
translation_verse: Ŋma di làá sòoǹ m-bɔti bikpitib nee cee kí tīī-mi? Ŋma di làá mɔ̄tì m-pu bikpitiŋaliibi nee cee?

english_verse: If you had not helped me, Lord, I would soon have gone to the land of silence.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan yaa kaa bàà jòoń-mi, an bàà kíǹ fiii m-naŋki ń kɔ́ diŋmiŋŋmidikil tiŋkin.

english_verse: When I felt my feet slipping, you came with your love and kept me steady.
translation_verse: M yaa bí yii: «M-taaŋi bíi yɔ̀tēe», ní sii ti-Dindaan neeŋkpaandi ń tíkiń-mi.

english_verse: And when I was burdened with worries, you comforted me and made me feel secure.
translation_verse: Ilandɔkɔ yaa bàà wíiǹ m-ni ki nyīŋfì m-puee, ní á ŋméeǹ-mi kí tīī-mi dipɔɔsɔŋkil.

english_verse: who gang up to murder innocent victims.
translation_verse: Bi kpáfí kinyɔkɔ ki lèekī deedeedaan maŋfal, ki sòoǹ maanyiiba bɔti ki kù-u.

english_verse: You, Lord God, are my fortress, that mighty rock where I am safe.
translation_verse: Ama ti-Dindaan di nìn kpántì m-balilaŋki. M-Nimbɔtiu di nìn sá kutaŋkpanaakoou kun m sáǹ ki kɔ́ee.

english_verse: You will pay back my enemies, and you will wipe them out for the evil they did.
translation_verse: U yāntì bi-kpitii gítì bi-pu, u dū bi-kpitii ki nāaǹ-bi. Ti-Dindaan ti-Nimbɔtiu di nāaǹ-bi.

english_verse: Sing joyful songs to the Lord! Praise the mighty rock where we are safe.
translation_verse: Dāam̄maan tí cùú nyɔ̄ŋkì ti-Dindaan, tí fáámaan iwiliili kí dàntì kutaŋkpanaakoou kun fìil̄-tee.

english_verse: Come to worship him with thankful hearts and songs of praise.
translation_verse: Tí cùmaan u-nimbiin kí jāam̀-u, tí gāāmaan ilan nì dipɔɔpindi kí nyɔ̄ŋkì-u.

english_verse: The Lord is the greatest God, king over all other gods.
translation_verse: Di sá yii ti-Dindaan di sá Unimbɔtikpaan, úǹ di sá ubɔtikpaan un tɔ́kɔ́ inimbɔti kɔkɔ puee.

english_verse: He holds the deepest part of the earth in his hands, and the mountain peaks also belong to him.
translation_verse: Kitiŋ taapu taapu kā u-ŋaan ní, úǹ di tí yì ajoon yilpu kúnti kunti.

english_verse: The ocean is the Lord's because he made it, and with his own hands he formed the dry land.
translation_verse: Úǹ di tí yì tiŋku, di sá yii úǹ di náań-u, ní ki yì kitiŋ kin ní u dū u-ŋal ki máńee.

english_verse: Bow down and worship the Lord our Creator!
translation_verse: Dāam̄maan, tí bòom̄maan kí gbàan̄ kí jāam̀-u, tí gbàam̄maan ti-tabiŋyiliŋ pu ti-Dindaan un náań-tee nimbiin.

english_verse: The Lord is our God, and we are his people, the sheep he takes care of in his own pasture. Listen to God's voice today!
translation_verse: Di sá yii úǹ di sá ti-Nimbɔtiu, ní timbi sá dinibul din u kpàáyee, kupicaŋkpuŋu kun u kpòotēe. Díǹ nee, ni yaa gbìl̄ tin u sòon̄ee,

english_verse: Don't be stubborn and rebel as your ancestors did at Meribah and Massah out in the desert.
translation_verse: ní taa ŋá mpɔɔgbifin kii ni nín nìn ŋá pu Meeriibayee, a lì kii tin nìn jítì Maasa, kuteeunee.

english_verse: For forty years they tested God and saw the things he did.
translation_verse: Ni-naanjab nìn kpákáǹ-mi ki nìn cɔ́ŋkì-mi niin, min kamaa bin nìn ká tin m ŋée.

english_verse: Then God got tired of them and said, “You never show good sense, and you don't understand what I want you to do.”
translation_verse: Abin imuŋku ilee, binib gbanti nìn yāntì m-naŋki nyáń nì bi, ní m nìn bí yii: «An sá dinibul din yiliŋ gáatèe ní, baa nyí kun m lèe.»

english_verse: In his anger, God told them, “You people will never enter my place of rest.”
translation_verse: Niinee, m-ŋuul poonee ní m pūtì ki lī yii: «Bi kpá kí kɔ́ m-ŋuŋfil laŋki!»

english_verse: Sing a new song to the Lord! Everyone on this earth, sing praises to the Lord,
translation_verse: Gāāmaan nlampɔɔn kí pàkà ti-Dindaan, duulinya kɔkɔ nib, gāāmaan ilan kí pàkà ti-Dindaan.

english_verse: sing and praise his name. Day after day announce, “The Lord has saved us!”
translation_verse: Gāāmaan ilan kí pàkà ti-Dindaan, ní nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan u-yindi. Ní nīn sòoǹ u-fiil pu ŋwiin kamaa.

english_verse: Tell every nation on earth, “The Lord is wonderful and does marvelous things!
translation_verse: Ní māafìmaan u-nyooti atimbun poon, kí māafì maamaacib bin u ŋáaǹee anibul kɔkɔ poon.

english_verse: The Lord is great and deserves our greatest praise! He is the only God worthy of our worship.
translation_verse: Di sá ti-Dindaan sá ukpaan ní ki máaǹ inyɔŋki, úǹ di sá kuwambiiu ki jítiǹ inimbɔti kɔkɔ.

english_verse: Other nations worship idols, but the Lord created the heavens.
translation_verse: Anibul ŋin kíǹee nimbɔtii kɔkɔ sá fám ní, ama ti-Dindaan di náań yilpu.

english_verse: Give honor and praise to the Lord, whose power and beauty fill his holy temple.”
translation_verse: Tinyool nì jilma bí u-nimbiin, mpɔn nì kunyaaŋŋu gbí u-kɔŋkooŋŋun.

english_verse: Tell everyone of every nation, “Praise the glorious power of the Lord.
translation_verse: Kitiŋ pu nibuliŋ, tīīmaan ti-Dindaan u-nyooti kí sòoǹ u-pɔŋŋu pu.

english_verse: He is wonderful! Praise him and bring an offering into his temple.
translation_verse: Tīīmaan ti-Dindaan u-yindi nyooti, ní cáaḿmaan ni-saraabi, ní kɔ́maan u-cindin.

english_verse: Announce to the nations, “The Lord is King! The world stands firm, never to be shaken, and he will judge its people with fairness.”
translation_verse: Tùkùmaan atimbun nib kɔkɔ yii: «Ti-Dindaan jīǹ dibeel, duulinya bá ki pɔ̄ɔ̄, kaa cìŋkī. U sòoǹ anibul bɔti nì ibaamɔn ní.»

english_verse: Tell the heavens and the earth to be glad and celebrate! Command the ocean to roar with all its creatures
translation_verse: Yilpu ń nīn fàal̀, kitiŋ ń nīn bí dipɔɔpindin, tiŋku ń nīn gà kuwoou, ki kpáaǹ tin kɔkɔ bí u-poonee!

english_verse: and the fields to rejoice with all their crops. Then every tree in the forest will sing joyful songs
translation_verse: Tisati ń nīn fàal̀ ki kpáaǹ tin kɔkɔ bí ti-poonee! Isufi in yú kubambaŋŋunee ń nīn kūuntí nì dipɔɔpindi

english_verse: to the Lord. He is coming to judge all people on earth with fairness and truth.
translation_verse: ti-Dindaan nimbiin. Di sá yii u dòoń, u dòoń kí dāá sòoǹ kitiŋ pu nib bɔti. U làá dū deedee kí sòoǹ duulinya bɔti, kí dū u-baamɔŋyi kí sòoǹ anibul bɔti.

english_verse: The Lord is King! Tell the earth to celebrate and all islands to shout.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan sá ubɔti, kitiŋ pu nib kɔkɔ ń nīn fàal̀, bin kóò ntimu mun kɔkɔ nnyim māntìi túee poonee ń nīn bí mmɔnni!

english_verse: Dark clouds surround him, and his throne is supported by justice and fairness.
translation_verse: Ditagbandi nì dibɔmbɔndi māntìi tú-u. U-beejal tɔ́kɔ́ deedee nì tin tèen̄ee pu ní.

english_verse: Fire leaps from his throne, destroying his enemies,
translation_verse: Ŋŋmi līī u-nyɔkɔpu, ní ki wù u-nannanliibi bin māntìi tú-uee.

english_verse: and his lightning is so bright that the earth sees it and trembles.
translation_verse: U yàntī itaaŋmɔŋmɔ ŋmíntí duulinya pu, kitiŋ kāntí-i ní ki jìkì nì tifaandi.

english_verse: Mountains melt away like wax in the presence of the Lord of all the earth.
translation_verse: Ajoon dùntī kii nsikampimuee kitiŋ kɔkɔ Dindaan nimbiin.

english_verse: The heavens announce, “The Lord brings justice!” Everyone sees God's glory.
translation_verse: Yilpu sòoǹ u-deedeeu pu, ní anibul kɔkɔ kāntí u-nyooti.

english_verse: Those who brag about the useless idols they worship are terribly ashamed, and all the false gods bow down to the Lord.
translation_verse: Icoo ń cúú bin kɔkɔ tòotī awaayee, bin nyɔ́ŋkí awaa ŋin kaa bí tibanee! Inimbɔti kɔkɔ, gbàam̄maan ti-Dindaan nimbiin.

english_verse: When the people of Zion and of the towns of Judah hear that God brings justice, they will celebrate.
translation_verse: Siiyɔn yab gbìl̄ ní an mɔ́ɔkiǹ-bi. Ti-Dindaan, a-bɔsooŋyi puee, Juuda timmu bíi fàal̀.

english_verse: The Lord rules the whole earth, and he is more glorious than all the false gods.
translation_verse: Di sá yii sii ti-Dindaan, Yilpu fɔ́ŋŋŋ Nimbɔtiu un kpòotī kitiŋ kɔkɔee, sii di tɔ́kɔ́ inimbɔti kɔkɔ pu.

english_verse: Love the Lord and hate evil! God protects his loyal people and rescues them from violence.
translation_verse: Nimbi bin néeń ti-Dindaanee, nín̄ námaan ikpiti. Ti-Dindaan wúǹ u-deedeedambi maŋfal pu, u fìil̄-bi ki nyāntí binikpitib ŋaan.

english_verse: If you obey and do right, a light will show you the way and fill you with happiness.
translation_verse: Ŋwalifi ŋmíntí deedeedambi, ní bin pɔbil bí diba nì Unimbɔtee fàal̀.

english_verse: You are the Lord's people! So celebrate and praise the only God.
translation_verse: Deedeedambi, ti-Dindaan puee, nín̄ fàal̀maan, ní kí nīn nyɔ́ŋkí u-circir yindi.

english_verse: Sing a new song to the Lord! He has worked miracles, and with his own powerful arm, he has won the victory.
translation_verse: Inyɔŋki laŋŋu. Gāāmaan nlampɔɔn kí pàkà ti-Dindaan, di sá yii u ŋáań maamaacib. U-ŋaŋgiil, u-ŋal ŋun bí circiree yāntì u jáń ki jíń.

english_verse: The Lord has shown the nations that he has the power to save and to bring justice.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan dàkā yii u sá u-fiil, u lēē u nín bí deedee puee ki dàkā atimbun kɔkɔ.

english_verse: God has been faithful in his love for Israel, and his saving power is seen everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: U téetì u-neeŋkpaandi nì u-deedeeu un u cáá Isirayeel yab puee pu. Kí cáá sāā kitiŋ gbeennyɔkɔee, bi ká ti-Nimbɔtiu fiil.

english_verse: Tell everyone on this earth to sing happy songs in praise of the Lord.
translation_verse: Kitiŋ pu nib kɔkɔ, fáámaan iwiliili kí dàntì ti-Dindaan, gāāmaan ilan mpɔn nì dipɔɔpindi kí nyɔ̄ŋkì-u.

english_verse: Make music for him on harps. Play beautiful melodies!
translation_verse: Bɔ̀ɔ̀maan kubeeu kí nyɔ̄ŋkì ti-Dindaan, bɔ̀ɔ̀maan kubeeu kí gāā ilan kí kìntī.

english_verse: Sound the trumpets and horns and celebrate with joyful songs for our Lord and King!
translation_verse: Ní búḿmaan akantán nì iyin kí nyɔ̄ŋkì-u, ní fáámaan iwiliili kí dàntì ti-Dindaan, ubɔti.

english_verse: Command the ocean to roar with all its creatures, and the earth to shout with all its people.
translation_verse: Tiŋku ń nīn gà kuwoou, ki kpáaǹ tin kɔkɔ bí u-poonee! Kitiŋ nì tin kɔkɔ bí ki-puee mun ń gāā kuwoou.

english_verse: Order the rivers to clap their hands, and all the hills to sing together.
translation_verse: Ibun ń kpāafì abaal, ajoon ń kpāfì dicilpuee kí gāā ilan nì dipɔɔpindi

english_verse: Let them worship the Lord! He is coming to judge everyone on the earth, and he will be honest and fair.
translation_verse: ti-Dindaan nimbiin. Di sá yii u dòoń kí sòoǹ kitiŋ pu nib bɔti. U làá sòoǹ duulinya bɔti nì ibaamɔn, ní kí sòoǹ anibul bɔti deedee.

english_verse: Our Lord, you are King! You rule from your throne above the winged creatures, as people tremble and the earth shakes.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan di sá ubɔti, anibul ń nīn jìkì nì tifaandi! U kā u-beejal din tɔ́kɔ́ keerubimbi puee, kitiŋ ń cìŋkì!

english_verse: You are praised in Zion, and you control all nations.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan sá ukpaan Siiyɔn tiŋkin, - ní ki tɔ́kɔ́ anibul kɔkɔ pu.

english_verse: Only you are God! And your power alone, so great and fearsome, is worthy of praise.
translation_verse: Bí nyɔ̄ŋkì a-yiŋkpaandi din cáá tifaandee! - Dì sá circir yindi ní!

english_verse: You are our mighty King, a lover of fairness, who sees that justice is done everywhere in Israel.
translation_verse: Kun tìì ubɔti mpɔnee di sá ú nīn néeń ibaamɔn. Sii di yóoǹ marab bin tèen̄ee. Sii di ŋá tin bí deedee nì tin tèen̄ee Isirayeel tiŋkin.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, we praise you and kneel down to worship you, the God of holiness!
translation_verse: Ní nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan ti-Dindaan ti-Nimbɔtiu, ní gbàam̄maan u-beejal taapu! - U sá circirdaan ní.

english_verse: Moses and Aaron were two of your priests. Samuel was also one of those who prayed in your name, and you, our Lord, answered their prayers.
translation_verse: Mooyiisi nì Aarɔn bin nìn sá u-saraaŋaliibi kansikin bibee, nì Samiyeel un nìn sá bin yíì u-yindee kansikin ubɔee, nìn yíì ti-Dindaan ní u nìn kíikí-bi.

english_verse: You spoke to them from a thick cloud, and they obeyed your laws.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti nìn sòoǹ nì bi ditagbancancaal poon. Bi nìn ŋúb́ u-bɔkpaaŋi, nì marab bin u nìn tīī-bee.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, you answered their prayers and forgave their sins, but when they did wrong, you punished them.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan Unimbɔti, sii a-ba di nìn kíikí-bi. A nìn sá Unimbɔti un jīǹ bi-pu kimɔtiiyee, ama a nìn dátí bi-tafal bi-yìntitam pu.

english_verse: We praise you, Lord God, and we worship you at your sacred mountain. Only you are God!
translation_verse: Nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan ti-Dindaan ti-Nimbɔtiu. Gbàam̄maan kí túĺ u-circir jool. - Di sá yii ti-Dindaan ti-Nimbɔtiu sá circirdaan ní.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord, everyone on this earth.
translation_verse: Ijaam saraau laŋŋu. Kitiŋ kɔkɔ nib, ní fáámaan iwiliili kí dàntì ti-Dindaan.

english_verse: Be joyful and sing as you come in to worship the Lord!
translation_verse: Jāam̀maan-u nì ifaal, dāam̄maan u-nimbiin nì dipɔɔpindi.

english_verse: You know the Lord is God! He created us, and we belong to him; we are his people, the sheep in his pasture.
translation_verse: Béémaan yii ti-Dindaan di sá Unimbɔti, úǹ di náań-ti ní ki yì-ti. Ti sá u-nibul nì kupicaŋkpuŋu kun u kpàáyee.

english_verse: Be thankful and praise the Lord as you enter his temple.
translation_verse: Ní dīmaan u-diiku punyɔmmu kí kɔ́ kí nīn jáaḿ-u, ní kɔ́ u-cindin kí nīn nyɔ́ŋkí-u. Ní nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan-u, ní pàkàmaan u-yindi.

english_verse: The Lord is good! His love and faithfulness will last forever.
translation_verse: Di sá yii ti-Dindaan ŋān̄, u-neeŋkpaandi bí kí nīn cá jaanjaan, ní u-baamɔŋyi bí kí nīn cá abin abin.

english_verse: I will sing to you, Lord! I will celebrate your kindness and your justice.
translation_verse: Daafiidi di ŋmàn̄ nlan nee. M làá gāā ilan a-neeŋkpaandi nì a-deedeeu pu. Sii ti-Dindaan ní m làá gāā ilan kí nyɔ̄ŋkì.

english_verse: Please help me learn to do the right thing, and I will be honest and fair in my own kingdom.
translation_verse: M làá nóó deedeedambi saŋŋu. Ŋyunti ŋulɔŋu ní a làá dāan̄ m-cee ní? - M làá nīn bí nì dipɔbil diba m-dicaŋkun.

english_verse: I refuse to be corrupt or to take part in anything crooked,
translation_verse: Maa là tiwan tin kaa bí tibanee. M ná bin fātì bi-boon ki tīī Unimbɔtee tuuŋŋi, atuun gbanti kpá kí dáb́-mi.

english_verse: and I won't be dishonest or deceitful.
translation_verse: Biibiidambi làá nīn dátiǹ-mi, maa là kí béé ukpitiŋal gba.

english_verse: Anyone who spreads gossip will be silenced; no one who is conceited will be my friend.
translation_verse: Bin cāab̀ bi-jutiibi disambiil dibalinee, m làá nàan̄-bi. Bilambidambi nì bin yòontí bi-ba yilpuee, maa gèetíǹ-bi.

english_verse: I will find trustworthy people to serve as my advisors; only an honest person will serve as an official.
translation_verse: M-nimbikpeeŋu làá nīn cɔ́ kitiŋ nee baamɔndambi pu, ní bí nīn kàal̀ ki kɔ́l̀-mi. Un còom̄ deedeedambi saŋkindee di làá nīn bí m-tundin.

english_verse: No one who cheats or lies will have a position in my royal court.
translation_verse: Un mùul̄ u-jutee kaa làá nīn cáá mpaan m-dicaŋkun. M-nimbil kaa là kí wāl̀ un sòoǹ tinyimɔmbɔtee.

english_verse: Each morning I will silence any lawbreakers I find in the countryside or in the city of the Lord.
translation_verse: Kutaafaau kamaayee, m làá nīn nàantí binikpitib bin kɔkɔ bí kitiŋ nee puee, kí kúntí bikpitiŋaliibi kɔkɔ ti-Dindaan tiŋkin.

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord! Please listen.
translation_verse: Ufalaadaan un kaa ti cáá mpɔn ní ki tíminsí ti-Dindaan nimbiinee wimmeem.

english_verse: My days disappear like smoke, and my bones are burning as though in a furnace.
translation_verse: Á taa fàtī a-boon kí tīī-mi dinimbinaamandi wiiŋŋu dal. Kpòon̄ a-tafal kí pīlifiǹ-mi. Daliŋkin m yaa yíiń-see, á kíí-mi malaa.

english_verse: I am wasting away like grass, and my appetite is gone.
translation_verse: M-maŋfal wiiŋyi bíi jītí kii nnyiimee, m-kpabiŋ bíi wù kii amɔsiŋkoonee.

english_verse: My groaning never stops, and my bones can be seen through my skin.
translation_verse: M-pɔbil bíi kōō kii kumoou kun bi gāāyee, m súntí kí jī m-jinti gba.

english_verse: I am like a lonely owl in the desert
translation_verse: Aniim ŋin m fátée puee, m dúntìi kíǹ akpab ŋma ní.

english_verse: or a restless sparrow alone on a roof.
translation_verse: Man nì kuteeun tulinjool di kíǹ ki náań, m bí kii kitulinjakpatibooi kin bí adigbuŋkatinee ní.

english_verse: My enemies insult me all day, and they use my name for a curse word.
translation_verse: Ŋgeem kaa ti bí-mi, m kpántì kii unoon un tɔ́kɔ́ kudii yilpu u-babee ní.

english_verse: Instead of food, I have ashes to eat and tears to drink,
translation_verse: M-nannanliibi sìí-mi ní baabadal, bi bèel̄-mi ní ki cáá m-yindi ki tòó binib mbusu.

english_verse: because you are furious and have thrown me aside.
translation_verse: Ŋfantam di kpántì m-jinti, nyinnyim ní m cáa ŋmàlintí m-nyɔkaatin.

english_verse: My life fades like a shadow at the end of day and withers like grass.
translation_verse: A-ŋuul nì a-bum poonee, a dúkutì-mi ki tɔ́ ki fá ndandati.

english_verse: Our Lord, you are King forever and will always be famous.
translation_verse: M-maŋfal wiiŋyi bíi jītí ki cá kii mboonee, ní m bíi kōō kii kumoouee.

english_verse: You will show pity to Zion because the time has come.
translation_verse: Ama sii ti-Dindaanee, a làá nīn kā dibeel ní kí nīn cá jaanjaan, ní bi làá nīn téetí a-pu abin abin.

english_verse: We, your servants, love each stone in the city, and we are sad to see them lying in the dirt.
translation_verse: A làá yīkì kí dàkà Siiyɔn a-ŋanti, di sá yii ŋyunti bàn̄ á sɔ̄ ki-saai, tiŋman, ŋyunti lafun bàn̄.

english_verse: Our Lord, the nations will honor you, and all kings on earth will praise your glory.
translation_verse: Timbi a-tɔntɔnliibi néeń ki-taŋkpeeŋi, ki-tam gba cútí-ti isaa.

english_verse: You will rebuild the city of Zion. Your glory will be seen,
translation_verse: Atimbun làá fàŋkì sii ti-Dindaan yindi, ní kitiŋ pu bɔtiibi kɔkɔ ń fàŋkì a-nyooti.

english_verse: and the prayers of the homeless will be answered.
translation_verse: Di sá yii ti-Dindaan làá fàtīí mā Siiyɔn tiŋki, u làá dāá lēē u-ba kí dàkà u-nyooti poon.

english_verse: Future generations must also praise the Lord, so write this for them:
translation_verse: U làá dāá pīlifiǹ bin bi fúkúl̀ee, ní kaa làá dāá gbāfì bi-wimmeem.

english_verse: “From his holy temple, the Lord looked down at the earth.
translation_verse: Bí ŋmà tin bí nee kí síiń bin làá dāá páanní boonee, ní dinibul din bi fātìi náańee ń dāá nyɔ̄ŋkì ti-Dindaan.

english_verse: He listened to the groans of prisoners, and he rescued everyone who was doomed to die.”
translation_verse: U gbóonní doooo yilpu u-circir kɔŋkooŋŋun ki kpēē, ti-Dindaan gbóonní doooo yilpu ki kpēē kitiŋ

english_verse: when people from every nation meet to worship you.
translation_verse: Niinee bi làá dāá sòoǹ ti-Dindaan yindi pu Siiyɔn tiŋkin, ní kí dāá sòoǹ u-nyɔŋkii pu Jeerusaleem tiŋkin,

english_verse: I should still be strong, but you, Lord, have made an old person of me.
translation_verse: ŋyunti ŋun anibul nì abee yaa láa kpáfì kí jāam̀ ti-Dindaanee.

english_verse: You will live forever! Years mean nothing to you. Don't cut my life in half!
translation_verse: M dáá bí nsanni ki cá ní u bātì m-pɔŋŋu pu. U bātì m-maŋfal wiiŋyi pu.

english_verse: In the beginning, Lord, you laid the earth's foundation and created the heavens.
translation_verse: An pu ní m téeń mpɔn yii: «M-Nimbɔtiu, sii un bí kí nīn cá jaanjaanee, taa yòon̄-mi m-maŋfal wiiŋyi kansikin.»

english_verse: They will all disappear and wear out like clothes. You change them, as you would a coat, but you last forever.
translation_verse: Dooooyee ní a náań kitiŋ, a dū a-ŋalii ní ki náań yilpu.

english_verse: Every generation of those who serve you will live in your presence.
translation_verse: Ama siiyee, aa kpántí, ní a-maŋfal wiiŋyi kaa kúntí mun.

english_verse: With all my heart I praise the Lord, and with all that I am I praise his holy name!
translation_verse: Daafiidi di ŋmàn̄ nlan nee. M làá jāam̀ ti-Dindaan nì m-naŋki kɔkɔ, m làá jāam̀ u-circir yindi nì m-pɔbil kɔkɔ.

english_verse: With all my heart I praise the Lord! I will never forget how kind he has been.
translation_verse: M làá jāam̀ ti-Dindaan nì m-naŋki kɔkɔ, kaa làá súntí u-ŋanti báà tiba pu.

english_verse: The Lord forgives our sins, heals us when we are sick,
translation_verse: Úǹ di cáá m-yìntitam kɔkɔ ki pūǹ-mi, ní ki cāantí m-weeŋyi kɔkɔ.

english_verse: and protects us from death. His kindness and love are a crown on our heads.
translation_verse: U nyāntí-mi ŋkúm bookun, ní ki cáá dineeŋkpaandi nì disaasɔl ki cīkintí-mi kii kibeefuuliiyee.

english_verse: Each day that we live, he provides for our needs and gives us the strength of a young eagle.
translation_verse: U tìì-mi tiwammɔntiil m-puti poon, u yàntī m fàtīi kpántí unipɔɔn kii ukaalunee.

english_verse: For all who are mistreated, the Lord brings justice.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan tūǹ deedee tuuŋŋi, u sòoǹ bin kɔkɔ bi sàantée bɔti nì ibaamɔn.

english_verse: He taught his Law to Moses and showed all Israel what he could do.
translation_verse: U nìn yāntì Mooyiisi béè u-sàmbiyaamu, ní Isirayeel yab béè u-tuŋkpaaŋŋi.

english_verse: The Lord is merciful! He is kind and patient, and his love never fails.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan poon mɔ̄ ní ki cáá kulaŋŋaŋfitiiu, waa gífí diŋuul malaa ní u-neendi wīikí tikpilku.

english_verse: The Lord won't always be angry and point out our sins;
translation_verse: Waa sòoǹ unil bɔti kaa gbèentí, kaa tí díkì ubɔ pu an kaa kúntí.

english_verse: How great is God's love for all who worship him? Greater than the distance between heaven and earth!
translation_verse: Kii kitiŋ nì kutagbɔŋu nín dátì nì tɔb puee, míǹ ní dineeŋkpaandi din u cáá bin fàŋkí-uee puee wīikí.

english_verse: How far has the Lord taken our sins from us? Farther than the distance from east to west!
translation_verse: Kii ŋwìiń nyalaŋki nín dátì nì ŋu-jeetilaŋki puee, míǹ ní u kàkatī ti-kpitii ki wàatī-ti.

english_verse: Just as parents are kind to their children, the Lord is kind to all who worship him,
translation_verse: Kii ubaati poon nín mɔ̄ u-biyaamu pu puee, míǹ ní ti-Dindaan mun poon mɔ̄ bin fàŋkí-uee pu.

english_verse: because he knows we are made of dust.
translation_verse: Di sá yii úǹ nyí kun u dūu máń-tee, waa súntí yii ntam ní ti sá.

english_verse: We humans are like grass or wild flowers that quickly bloom.
translation_verse: Unilee, u-maŋfal wiiŋyi bí kii kumoouee ní, kii tisatin supumpukumee, míǹ ní u púkuḿ.

english_verse: But a scorching wind blows, and they quickly wither to be forever forgotten.
translation_verse: Di sá yii kubuŋu yaa fáá nsupumpukumee, mì wáŋkí ní, aa ti béetí laakin mì nìn bée.

english_verse: The Lord is always kind to those who worship him, and he keeps his promises to their descendants
translation_verse: Ama ti-Dindaan neeŋkpaandi bí bin fàŋkí-uee pu ní ki cá talku. U-deedeeu làá nīn bí bi-naantiibi pu,

english_verse: God has set up his kingdom in heaven, and he rules the whole creation.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan dū u-beejal ki yóoǹ yilpu, ní ki jīǹ dibeel tin kɔkɔ pée bée pu.

english_verse: All of you mighty angels, who obey God's commands, come and praise your Lord!
translation_verse: Jāam̀maan ti-Dindaan, nimbi u-tuuŋyi in di cáá mpɔn ki ŋáań u-nyɔɔbundi nín lī puee, ki tɔ́-u ŋyunti ŋun ni yaa gbìl̄ u-nyɔkɔpuee.

english_verse: All of you thousands who serve and obey God, come and praise your Lord!
translation_verse: Jāam̀maan ti-Dindaan, nimbi u-janjakitiŋ kɔkɔ, nimbi u-tɔntɔnliibi bin ŋáań u nín là puee.

english_verse: All of God's creation and all that he rules, come and praise your Lord! With all my heart I praise the Lord!
translation_verse: Ní jāam̀maan ti-Dindaan nimbi u-wannaaŋkaati, laakin kamaa ní ni yaa bí u-beelinee. M làá jāam̀ ti-Dindaan nì m-naŋki kɔkɔ.

english_verse: I praise you, Lord God, with all my heart. You are glorious and majestic, dressed in royal robes
translation_verse: M làá jāam̀ ti-Dindaan nì m-naŋki kɔkɔ! Ti-Dindaan m-Nimbɔtiu, a sá ukpaan tikpilku! Tinyool nì jilma ní a pēē,

english_verse: and surrounded by light. You spread out the sky like a tent,
translation_verse: ní ki dū ŋwalifi ki bīiǹ a-ba pu kii dibɔkutikpaandee. A kpátì kutagbɔŋu kii tantee.

english_verse: and you built your home over the mighty ocean. The clouds are your chariot with the wind as its wings.
translation_verse: A máń a-kɔŋkooŋŋu inyiŋfi in bí yilpuee pu. Atagban di sá-si janjatɔrɔku, a còom̄ kubuŋu feeŋyi pu ní.

english_verse: The winds are your messengers, and flames of fire are your servants.
translation_verse: Kubuŋu di sá a-tuuŋyi, ní aŋmilimbil sá a-tɔntɔnliibi.

english_verse: You built foundations for the earth, and it will never be shaken.
translation_verse: A dū kitiŋ ki tɔ́kɔǹ ki-nyeel pu, kì kpá kí cìŋkì ŋwindal.

english_verse: You covered the earth with the ocean that rose above the mountains.
translation_verse: A dū tiŋku ki bīiǹ ki-pu kii dibɔkutilee, inyiŋfi nìn bīī ajoon pu.

english_verse: down the mountains and through the valleys to the place you prepared.
translation_verse: ki dàb̄ ajoon, ki sīntì atantakan ki nín cá laakin a bɔ́ntì ki síiǹ-iee.

english_verse: Now you have set boundaries, so that the water will never flood the earth again.
translation_verse: A síiǹ-i kikpaanyɔkɔ kin iaa máaǹ kí pùub̀ kí jītée, án nín làá ŋá pu i taa ti dāan̄ kí bìin̄ kitiŋ puee.

english_verse: You provide streams of water in the hills and valleys,
translation_verse: A cáǹ nnyim min nyēē anyimbulnimbilinee ibunni, mì pùub̀ ajoon kansikin,

english_verse: so that the donkeys and other wild animals can satisfy their thirst.
translation_verse: ní ipeel kɔkɔ dòoń ki nyù. Niin ní kumooun mammu nyù.

english_verse: Birds build their nests nearby and sing in the trees.
translation_verse: Inoon kóò ki kɔ́ĺ-mì, ní ki gà ilan tifaalin.

english_verse: From your home above you send rain on the hills and water the earth.
translation_verse: A yàntī utaa nyēeń yilpu ki nì ajoon pu, a yàntī nnyim bà kitiŋ.

english_verse: You let the earth produce grass for cattle, plants for our food,
translation_verse: Sii di yàntī timool nyēē ní tiwaŋkuti kāntí ki jīǹ, ní ki yàntī tin unil kùee nyēē. Kitiŋ di tìì unil u-jikaati.

english_verse: wine to cheer us up, olive oil for our skin, and grain for our health.
translation_verse: Kíǹ di tìì unil ndaam min u nyù an mɔ̄ǹ-uee, ki tìì-u ŋkpam min u ŋmìtī u-nimbiin ŋān̄ee, ní ki tìì-u tijin tin u jīǹ ki kāntí mpɔnee.

english_verse: Our Lord, your trees always have water, and so do the cedars you planted in Lebanon.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan sufii kāntí ntaanyim min máaǹee, Leebanɔn sufii in u cóoǹ bi yíì seediree.

english_verse: Birds nest in those trees, and storks make their home in the fir trees.
translation_verse: Inoon pāantí i-diti i-pu, ní naakpaapiimbi kóò siipreesi sufii pu.

english_verse: Wild goats find a home in the tall mountains, and small animals can hide between the rocks.
translation_verse: Njooŋɔjamu kóò ajoon ŋin fɔ̀kɔ̀ee pu, ní itaŋkpalɔkɔ sá ŋkɔŋkoon ki tīī ijangbeenapul.

english_verse: You created the moon to tell us the seasons. The sun knows when to set,
translation_verse: A náań uŋmal tí nīn cáa béetí iyunti, nì ŋwìiń ŋu nyí kukúluu kun ŋu máaǹ kí jēetée.

english_verse: and you made the darkness, so the animals in the forest could come out at night.
translation_verse: A yaa cáań dibɔmbɔndee ní kunyeeu ń mɔ́, ní kubambaŋŋun peelii kɔkɔ ń kíĺ ki bíi còom̄.

english_verse: Lions roar as they hunt for the food you provide.
translation_verse: Agbikintipɔmbil mùuǹ ki nyàab̀ upeel kí ŋmɔ́, ní ki bàlifī sii Unimbɔti á tīī-ŋi ŋi-jinti.

english_verse: But when morning comes, they return to their dens,
translation_verse: Ŋwìiń yaa nyáńee ní ŋí jītíi kɔ́ kí dòon̄ ŋi-diiŋŋin,

english_verse: then we go out to work until the end of day.
translation_verse: ní unil ń nyā kí búntí u-tundi, kí gbàfì kí cáá sāā kujoou.

english_verse: Our Lord, by your wisdom you made so many things; the whole earth is covered with your living creatures.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, a-tuuŋŋi wīikéeee! A dū iciin ní ki ŋá atuun gbanti kɔkɔ, a-wannaaŋkaati di gbí kitiŋ kɔkɔ.

english_verse: But what about the ocean so big and wide? It is alive with creatures, large and small.
translation_verse: Kpèè tiŋku di dɔ̄ pàaa kí cée, tiwaŋkuti tikpaandi nì ŋwaamu gbí poon an kaa cáá ŋkaan.

english_verse: And there are the ships, as well as Leviathan, the monster you created to splash in the sea.
translation_verse: Meelab tɔ́kɔ́ u-pu ki cá ki gítiń, ní kupeebiliŋŋu Leefiyatan kun a náańee bí u-poon ki gbíiĺ.

english_verse: All of these depend on you to provide them with food,
translation_verse: Tiwaŋkuti gbanti kɔkɔ máká a-pu á tīī-tì tijin ŋyunti ŋun a máaǹee tí jī.

english_verse: and you feed each one with your own hand, until they are full.
translation_verse: A yaa tīī-tèe ní tí yòon̄ kí jī, a yaa tāntì a-ŋalee ní tí ká kí jī kí díkí.

english_verse: But when you turn away, they are terrified; when you end their life, they die and rot.
translation_verse: Ama a yaa fātì a-boon ki tīī-tèe, ní tifaandi ń cúú-tì. A yaa cúú ti-fooku ki lēēyee ní tí kpú kí fàtīí gítí ntamin.

english_verse: You created all of them by your Spirit, and you give new life to the earth.
translation_verse: A yaa tīī-tì a-fookuee, a náań-tì dee, ní kí fàtīí pɔ̀ntī tikɔkɔ kitiŋ pu.

english_verse: Our Lord, we pray that your glory will last forever and that you will be pleased with what you have done.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan nyooti ń nīn bí ki cá jaanjaan! An nīn mɔ̄ǹ ti-Dindaan u-tuuŋŋi pu!

english_verse: You look at the earth, and it trembles. You touch the mountains, and smoke goes up.
translation_verse: U yaa kpēē kitiŋee, kì cìŋkī ní, u yaa gbēē ajoonee, ŋi dùkù ní.

english_verse: As long as I live, I will sing and praise you, the Lord God.
translation_verse: M-maŋfal wiiŋyi kɔkɔ poonee, m làá gāā ilan kí pàkà ti-Dindaan, iwiin in kíǹ-mi nee, m làá dūú gāā ilan kí nyɔ̄ŋkì m-Nimbɔtiu ní.

english_verse: I hope my thoughts will please you, because you are the one who makes me glad.
translation_verse: M-yaliŋkii ń nīn fáatiǹ-u. Mamee, ti-Dindaan pu ní m làá nīn fàal̀.

english_verse: Destroy all wicked sinners from the earth once and for all. With all my heart I praise you, Lord! I praise you!
translation_verse: Bikpitiŋaliibi ń kúntí kitiŋ pu, binikpitib ń taa ti nín̄ bí! Tiŋman, m làá jāam̀ sii ti-Dindaan! Aleeluya, nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan ti-Dindaan!

english_verse: Praise the Lord and pray in his name! Tell everyone what he has done.
translation_verse: Ní nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan ti-Dindaan kí yòon̄ u-yindi yilpu, ní yàntīmaan anibul kɔkɔ ń béé u-tuŋkpaaŋŋi.

english_verse: Sing praises to the Lord! Tell about his miracles.
translation_verse: Ní gāāmaan ilan kí pàkà-u, kí gāā ilan kí nyɔ̄ŋkì-u, ní dàkafìmaan u-maamaaci tuuŋŋi kɔkɔ pu.

english_verse: Celebrate and worship his holy name with all your heart.
translation_verse: Nimbi bin nyàab̀ ti-Dindaanee, án nīn mɔ̄ǹ-ni u-circir yindi pu, ní nīn bí dipɔɔpindin.

english_verse: Trust the Lord and his mighty power.
translation_verse: Ní nyàab̀maan ti-Dindaan nì u-pɔŋŋu, nyàab̀maan kí nīn bí u-nimbiin.

english_verse: Remember his miracles and all his wonders and his fair decisions.
translation_verse: Ní téetímaan maamaaci tuuŋŋi ŋin u ŋáaǹee nì u-tuŋkpaaŋŋi pu, nì ibɔsoon in kɔkɔ ní u sòon̄ee.

english_verse: You belong to the family of Abraham, his servant; you are his chosen ones, the descendants of Jacob.
translation_verse: Nimbi u-tɔntɔnliu Abraam naantiibi, nimbi Jaakɔb naantiibi bin u lēēyee, téetímaan.

english_verse: The Lord is our God, bringing justice everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Úǹ di sá ti-Dindaan ti-Nimbɔtiu, úǹ di sòoǹ kitiŋ pu nib kɔkɔ bɔti.

english_verse: He will never forget his agreement or his promises, not in thousands of years. *
translation_verse: Waa pée súntí u-poondi pu dalba dalba, tibɔti tin u yóoǹ án nīn sá mara ki tīī anaantitɔntɔkɔ kutuku puee.

english_verse: when he said, “I'll give you the land of Canaan.”
translation_verse: ki lī-u yii: «M làá tīī-si Kanaan tiŋki, án nīn sá sii nì a-naantiibi wanti.»

english_verse: At the time there were only a few of us, and we were homeless.
translation_verse: Baa nìn náaǹ báà fiii, bi nìn pée sá binikaaŋkaabi ní ki kāl̀ niin kunicaŋu.

english_verse: We wandered from nation to nation, from one country to another.
translation_verse: Bi nìn kàal̀ atimbun ní ki kpántí, ki kàal̀ dibeel diba poon ní ki yíkí ki nìkì din kíǹ poon.

english_verse: God did not let anyone mistreat our people. Instead he protected us by punishing rulers
translation_verse: Ama Unimbɔti kaa kíí báà unil ń sàaǹ-bi, bi-pu ní u dáaĺ bibɔtiibi tafal ki lī yii:

english_verse: and telling them, “Don't touch my chosen leaders or harm my prophets!”
translation_verse: «Ní taa gbēē bin m lēēyee, ní taa pée ŋá m-bɔnaatiliibi tikpitil tiba.»

english_verse: God kept crops from growing until food was scarce everywhere in the land.
translation_verse: U nìn cáań ŋkùm kitiŋee pu, tijin kaa nìn gíti bí binib ń jī.

english_verse: But he had already sent Joseph, sold as a slave into Egypt,
translation_verse: U nìn dū unil ubɔ ki tú bi-nyɔkɔpu, Jooseefi un bi nìn nyáfì u kpántì uyumbuee.

english_verse: with chains of iron around his legs and neck.
translation_verse: Bi nìn bá u-taaŋi akpambaa, bi nìn dū ikusaka ki tɔ́ u-neen,

english_verse: Joseph remained a slave until his own words had come true, and the Lord had finished testing him.
translation_verse: ki cáá sāā ŋyunti ŋun ní tin u nìn sòon̄ee dāa jítì míǹ deedeedeeyee. Ti-Dindaan nyɔɔbundi nìn cɔ́ŋkì-u ki pɔ̀n̄-u.

english_verse: Then the king of Egypt set Joseph free
translation_verse: Ubɔti nìn pú kinyɔkɔ bí báatí-u u-kpambaaŋi, anibul kpiliu nìn yāntì bi líì-u.

english_verse: and put him in charge of everything he owned.
translation_verse: U nìn dū-u ki kāaǹ u-dicaŋku pu ukpil, ní ki nìn yāntì u kpòotī tin kɔkɔ u cááyee,

english_verse: Joseph was in command of the officials, and he taught the leaders how to use wisdom.
translation_verse: kí ŋmā kí dàkà u-bɔtibiliŋ u nín là puee, ní kí ŋmā kí tīī bitindaŋkpilib iciin.

english_verse: Jacob and his family came and settled in Egypt as foreigners.
translation_verse: Míǹ boonee, Isirayeel nìn cūtì Eejipiti tiŋkin, Jaakɔb nìn kpántì unicaan Kaam tiŋkin.

english_verse: They were the Lord's people, so he let them grow stronger than their enemies.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan nìn pú u-nibul mmaal ní ki tīī-bi mpɔn ki jítiǹ bi-nannanliibi.

english_verse: They served the Lord, and he made the Egyptians plan hateful things against them.
translation_verse: U nìn cúú Eejipiti yab pɔbiliŋ ki kpántì, bi nìn kíǹ ki ná u-nibul ní ki nìn ŋmātiǹ u-tɔntɔnliibi.

english_verse: God sent his servant Moses. He also chose and sent Aaron
translation_verse: Niinee ní u dū u-tɔntɔnliu Mooyiisi nì Aarɔn un u nìn lēēyee ki tú.

english_verse: to his people in Egypt, and they worked miracles and wonders there.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti nìn yāntì bi ŋáaǹ maamaaci daanti Eejipiti tiŋkin, bi nìn ŋáaǹ maamaaci tuuŋŋi Kaam tiŋkin.

english_verse: Moses and Aaron obeyed God, and he sent darkness to cover Egypt.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti nìn cáań dibɔmbɔndi ní an dūu mɔ́, ama báà ubɔ kaa nìn kpákáǹ u-nyɔɔbundi.

english_verse: God turned their rivers into streams of blood, and the fish all died.
