translation_verse: U nìn yāntì nnyim kpántì fatiku ní ki yāntì ijɔm in bí mi-poonee kpíì.

english_verse: Frogs were everywhere, even in the royal palace.
translation_verse: Kpaabi nìn gbí Eejipiti tiŋkin ki kpáaǹ bi-bɔtiu diiŋŋin.

english_verse: When God gave the command, flies and gnats swarmed all around.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti nìn sòon̄ ní ikpiŋki dɔ́miń ní inaacib gbí kitiŋ kɔkɔ pu.

english_verse: In place of rain, God sent hailstones and flashes of lightning.
translation_verse: An nín bàà sá utaa ń nèe, u nìn yāntì ataanyiŋkumbil di lítì, ní utaa tɔ́ ní bi-tiŋki fōō ŋŋmi,

english_verse: He destroyed their grapevines and their fig trees, and he made splinters of all the other trees.
translation_verse: ki bíil̀ bi-fiinyi nì bi-fiigi sufii, ní ki kɔ́fì bi-tiŋki pu sufii.

english_verse: God gave the command, and more grasshoppers came than could be counted.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti nìn tí sòon̄ ní inaakicaan, nì inaakitoon in baa ŋūǹ kí kàaǹee dɔ́miń.

english_verse: They ate every green plant and all the crops that grew in the land of Egypt.
translation_verse: I nìn ŋmɔ́ bi-tiŋki pu mooti kɔkɔ, i nìn ŋmɔ́ kitiŋ nín lòon̄ tikpaajin tiŋyee.

english_verse: Then God took the life of every first-born son.
translation_verse: U nìn kūū Eejipiti yab biseebiyaamu nninjabiyaamu kɔkɔ, mun bi péé ki màl̄ ŋyunti ŋun bi-fatikuu dáá tùm̀ee.

english_verse: When God led Israel from Egypt, they took silver and gold, and no one was left behind.
translation_verse: U nìn nyántì u-nibul bi tú animbil nì sindaariya. Bi-naakɔti kansikinee, ubɔ kaa nìn gbíntì boon.

english_verse: The Egyptians were afraid and gladly let them go.
translation_verse: Bi nín nyáńee, an nìn mɔ́ɔkiǹ Eejipiti yab, di sá yii dinyoondi nìn kɔ́-bi.

english_verse: God hid them under a cloud and guided them by fire during the night.
translation_verse: U nìn kpátì ditagbandi ki bīiǹ bi-pu, ní ki dū ŋŋmi ki ŋmíntì-bi kunyeeu.

english_verse: When they asked for food, he sent more birds than they could eat.
translation_verse: Bi nìn mēē ní u yāntì njikpacimamu dɔ́miń, u nìn dū yilpu jinti ki kpíiǹ-bi.

english_verse: God even split open a rock, and streams of water gushed into the desert.
translation_verse: U nìn yāntì ditaŋkpal poon nnyim nyáń, ki pùub̄ ki jítì kuteeu pu kii mbunee.

english_verse: God never forgot his sacred promise to his servant Abraham.
translation_verse: Di sá yii waa nìn súntì u-circir poondi din u nìn pōoǹ u-tɔntɔnliu Abraamee pu.

english_verse: When the Lord rescued his chosen people from Egypt, they celebrated with songs.
translation_verse: U nìn nyántì u-nibul nì ifaal, bin bin u nìn lēēyee iwiliili poon.

english_verse: The Lord gave them the land and everything else the nations had worked for.
translation_verse: U nìn fōō atimbun aba timmu ki tīī-bi, ní bíǹ jíń anibul aba tuuŋŋi paati,

english_verse: He did this so that his people would obey all his laws. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: án nín làá ŋá pu bí nīn ŋúb́ u-bɔkpaaŋi kí nīn tɔ́ u-marabee. Aleeluya, nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan ti-Dindaan!

english_verse: We will celebrate and praise you, Lord! You are good to us, and your love never fails.
translation_verse: Aleeluya, nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan ti-Dindaan! Tí nyɔ̄ŋkì ti-Dindaan, di sá yii u ŋān̄, ní u-neeŋkpaandi bí ki cá jaanjaan.

english_verse: No one can praise you enough for all the mighty things you have done.
translation_verse: Ŋma di ŋūǹ kí sòoǹ ti-Dindaan tuŋkpaaŋŋi pu? Ŋma di làá yàntī bí gbìl̄ u-nyɔŋkii pu?

english_verse: You bless those people who are honest and fair in everything they do.
translation_verse: Bin ŋúb́ Unimbɔti marab, ki ŋáań ŋyunti kamaa tin bí deedeeyee bí mmɔnneeee!

english_verse: Remember me, Lord, when you show kindness by saving your people.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, a yaa bíi dàkà a-nibul a-ŋantee, á téetí m-pu! Jòoń-mi a-fiil pu.

english_verse: Let me prosper with the rest of your chosen ones, as they celebrate with pride because they belong to you.
translation_verse: Yàntī ḿ ká bin a lútèe naam, kí yàntī ḿ fàal̀ nì a-nibul ní kí nīn bí dipɔɔpindin nì bin sá a-yabee.

english_verse: We and our ancestors have sinned terribly.
translation_verse: Ti ŋá ikpiti kii ti-baabee, ti ŋá tin kaa kítèe ki fōō dibɔkpil.

english_verse: When they were in Egypt, they paid no attention to your marvelous deeds or your wonderful love. And they turned against you at the Red Sea.
translation_verse: Ŋyunti ŋun ti-baabi nìn bí Eejipiti tiŋkinee, baa nìn gbìl̄ ti-Dindaan maamaaci tuuŋŋi taapu. Bi nìn súntì u-neeŋkpaandi din u dàkā-bi ŋfunyɔm tikpilee pu, bi nìn jáń nì u dimɔɔl caŋin, Tikati mɔɔl caŋin.

english_verse: But you were true to your name, and you rescued them to prove how mighty you are.
translation_verse: Ama úǹ u-ba yindi puee, u nìn fīī-bi, ki lēē u-pɔŋŋu ki dàkā.

english_verse: You said to the Red Sea, “Dry up!” Then you led your people across on land as dry as a desert.
translation_verse: U nìn kpātì Tikati mɔɔl pu ní díǹ fóotì. U nìn yāntì bi cōom̀ dimɔɔl poon kii bi nín còom̄ kuteeun puee.

english_verse: and drowned every one of their enemies.
translation_verse: Nnyim nìn fātìi gbí ki léeǹ bi-nannanliibi pu, bi-kansikin báà ubɔ kaa nìn kíǹ.

english_verse: Then your people trusted you and sang your praises.
translation_verse: Niinee ní bi fōō Unimbɔti nyɔɔbundi ki kíí, ní ki gāā ilan ki nyɔ́ŋkì-u.

english_verse: But they soon forgot what you had done and rejected your advice.
translation_verse: Ama an kaa nìn pée súŋkì ní bi súntì tin u ŋée pu, baa nìn cíitì ú ŋá tin u nìn bɔ́ntì kí ŋée.

english_verse: They became greedy for food and tested you there in the desert.
translation_verse: Bi nìn ŋá nnimbitaataam kuteeun. Laakin ubɔ kaa nìn bée, bi nìn cɔ́ŋkì Unimbɔti.

english_verse: So you gave them what they wanted, but later you destroyed them with a horrible disease.
translation_verse: U nìn tīī-bi tin bi nìn bālifèe, ama ní ki dū didúntil weeŋŋu ki tɔ́ bi-pu.

english_verse: Everyone in camp was jealous of Moses and of Aaron, your chosen priest.
translation_verse: Bi nìn ŋá Mooyiisi pu ipoompoon dinaapaal pu ki kpáaǹ Aarɔn un ní bi nìn dūu sú ti-Dindaanee.

english_verse: Dathan and Abiram rebelled, and the earth opened up and swallowed them.
translation_verse: Kitiŋ nìn cúu látì ní ki dū Daatan ki náĺ, kì nìn bīiǹ Abiiram kitil pu.

english_verse: Then fire broke out and destroyed all of their followers.
translation_verse: Ŋŋmi nìn wùn̄ dikitil gbanti kɔkɔ, aŋmilimbil nìn wùn̄ binikpitib gbanti.

english_verse: At Horeb your people made and worshiped the statue
translation_verse: Bi nìn mɔ́ɔ́ dinabil Ooreeb jool taapu, bi nìn dū tikúti ki mɔ́ɔ́ diwaal ki gbāaǹ ki jáam̀-dì.

english_verse: of a bull, instead of you, their glorious God.
translation_verse: Bi nìn dū unaa un ŋmóò timoolee naŋku ki kpántì Unimbɔti un sá bi-nyootee.

english_verse: You worked powerful miracles to save them from Egypt, but they forgot about you
translation_verse: Bi nìn súntì Unimbɔti bi-fiiliu un di nìn túń atuŋkpaan Eejipiti tiŋkinee pu.

english_verse: and the fearsome things you did at the Red Sea.
translation_verse: Bi nìn súntì maamaaci tuuŋŋi ŋin u nìn ŋá Kaam tiŋkinee, titumbilindi tin u nìn ŋá Tikati mɔɔl caŋinee.

english_verse: You were angry and started to destroy them, but Moses, your chosen leader, begged you not to do it.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti nìn lēē yii u làá kúntí-bi, ama Mooyiisi, unil un u nìn lēēyee nìn yúl̀ u-nimbiin ki pīiǹ-u nsan ú taa kpɔ̀-bi u-ŋuul poon.

english_verse: They would not trust you, Lord, and they did not like the promised land.
translation_verse: Míǹ boonee, bi nìn kpēē kitimmɔntii nee fám, di sá yii baa nìn fōō Unimbɔti poondi ki kíí.

english_verse: They would not obey you, and they grumbled in their tents.
translation_verse: Bi nìn bí bi-tantibin ki gbùkum̄, baa nìn tɔ́ ti-Dindaan nyɔkɔ.

english_verse: So you threatened them by saying, “I'll kill you out here in the desert!
translation_verse: Niinee ní u yōoǹ u-ŋal yilpu ki pūtì kí kpɔ̀-bi kuteeun,

english_verse: I'll scatter your children everywhere in the world.”
translation_verse: kí jà bi-naantiibi bí yàl̄ atimbun kɔkɔn, ní kí yàntī bí kpú nnicantimun.

english_verse: Your people became followers of a god named Baal Peor, and they ate sacrifices offered to the dead.
translation_verse: Bi bàn̄ Peewɔɔree ní ki kíĺ ki bíi tòotī diwaal Baal, ní ki ŋmɔ́ tiwaŋkuti tin bi dūu tōotì bitaŋkpiibee nanti.

english_verse: They did such terrible things that you punished them with a deadly disease.
translation_verse: Bi nìn ŋá míǹ ki gbítì Unimbɔti ŋuul ní nnaabu jéetì bi-pu.

english_verse: But Phinehas helped them, and the sickness stopped.
translation_verse: Ama Piinaasi nìn yíkìi yúl̀ ki ŋáŋkì tibɔti, ní nnaabuee gbēeǹ.

english_verse: Now he will always be highly honored.
translation_verse: An pu ní ti-Dindaan yíiń-u deedeedaan kí nīn pée cáa cá abin abin.

english_verse: At Meribah Spring they turned against you and made you furious.
translation_verse: Bi nìn tí gbítì ti-Dindaan ŋuul Meeriiba nyimbuliŋu caŋin, ki kɔ́ǹ Mooyiisi digìńdin.

english_verse: Then Moses got into trouble for speaking in anger.
translation_verse: Bi nìn kɔ́ Mooyiisi poon ki lēē baadakam, ní úǹ sòon̄ kaa dākafì.

english_verse: Our Lord, they disobeyed you by refusing to destroy the nations.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan nín nìn bí-bi yii bí kpɔ̀ kí céetí atimbun ŋiŋyee, baa nìn ŋá míǹ.

english_verse: Instead they were friendly with those foreigners and followed their customs.
translation_verse: Ama bi nì binib bin kaa nyí Unimbɔtee nìn ŋá mpèé ní bi bífì bi-koobiliŋ ki kíǹ ki ŋáań míǹ.

english_verse: Then they fell into the trap of worshiping idols.
translation_verse: Bi nìn tōotì bi-waaŋi ní ŋíǹ kpántì-bi kutaliŋŋu.

english_verse: They sacrificed their sons and their daughters to demons
translation_verse: Bi nìn kūū bi-jipɔmbi nì bi-bisalib ki ŋá saraabi ki tīī arasiniibi.

english_verse: and to the gods of Canaan. Then they poured out the blood of these innocent children and made the land filthy.
translation_verse: Bi kūū maanyiibab, ki kūū bi-jipɔmbi nì bi-bisalib ki ŋá saraa ki tīī Kanaan yab waaŋi. Bi kūū binib míǹ ki kɔ́ǹ kitiŋ tijɔkɔndi.

english_verse: By doing such gruesome things, they also became filthy.
translation_verse: Bi-tuuŋŋi gbanti kɔ́ǹ-bi tijɔkɔndin, bi-bimbim yāntì bi kpántì kii kinimpulaakpaayee.

english_verse: Finally, Lord, you were angry and terribly disgusted with your people.
translation_verse: Niinee ti-Dindaan fōō u-nibul pu diŋuul, u nìn kíǹ ki ná bin sá u-yabee.

english_verse: So you put them in the power of nations that hated them.
translation_verse: U nìn dū-bi ki líì nì atimbun aba, u nìn dū-bi ki ŋá bi-nannanliibi taapu.

english_verse: They were mistreated and abused by their enemies,
translation_verse: Bi-nannanliibi nìn sāaǹ-bi ní ki nyīī-bi ki múĺ bi-taapu.

english_verse: but you saved them time after time. They were determined to rebel, and their sins caused their downfall.
translation_verse: Iyunti tikpilee, ti-Dindaan nìn fīī-bi, ama bíǹ nìn gbíntìi jáà nì u, ní ki nìn mɔ̀tīi múl̀ bi-kpitii poon.

english_verse: You answered their prayers when they were in trouble.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan nìn ká dinimbinaamandi din poon bi bée ŋyunti ŋun ní u gbìl̄ bi-biilii puee.

english_verse: You kept your agreement and were so merciful
translation_verse: U nìn téetì dipoondi din u nìn pōoǹ-bee pu. U-neeŋkpaandi puee, u nìn kpántì u-landɔkɔŋu.

english_verse: that their enemies had pity on them.
translation_verse: U nìn yāntì bin kɔkɔ cúú-bi ki cūnnì kuyuŋuee súń bi-saai.

english_verse: Save us, Lord God! Bring us back from among the nations. Let us celebrate and shout in praise of your holy name.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan ti-Nimbɔtiu, fīī-ti! Nyāntí-ti atimbuncaan ŋaan kí kóoǹ-ti kí kpāfì. Niinee ní tí jāam̀ a-circir yindi, ní kí nīn nyɔ́ŋkí-si dipɔɔpindin.

english_verse: Lord God of Israel, you deserve to be praised forever and ever. Let everyone say, “Amen! Shout praises to the Lord!”
translation_verse: Tí jāam̀ ti-Dindaan, Isirayeel Nimbɔtiu kí nīn cáa cá jaanjaan. Ní samaa kɔkɔ ń kíí yii: «Ameeni! Tiŋman, an lafun ŋá míǹ! Aleeluya, Nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan ti-Dindaan!»

english_verse: ) The Lord Is Good to His People
translation_verse: ) Tí jāam̀ Unimbɔti ufiil

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! He is good to us, and his love never fails.
translation_verse: Tí Nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan ti-Dindaan, di sá yii u ŋān̄, ní u-neeŋkpaandi bí kí nīn cá jaanjaan.

english_verse: Everyone the Lord has rescued from trouble should praise him,
translation_verse: Bin kɔkɔ ti-Dindaan dá ki líìyee ń lì míǹ. Bin ní ti-Dindaan dá ki nyántì unannanli ŋaanee,

english_verse: everyone he has brought from the east and the west, the north and the south.
translation_verse: bin u kóoǹní ntimu kɔkɔn, ŋwìiń nyalaŋki pú nì ŋwìiń jeetilaŋki pú, ŋgan pú nì ŋgiil pú ki kpáfèe ń lì míǹ.

english_verse: Some of you were lost in the scorching desert, far from a town.
translation_verse: Biba nìn tú ki yìiǹ kuteeun, ki còom̄ ki cá kitiŋkuliŋŋin, kaa nìn ká nsan ŋun cá kitiŋ kin poon binib kóòyee.

english_verse: You were hungry and thirsty and about to give up.
translation_verse: Ŋkùm nì nnyinnyoo nìn cúú-bi, ní bi-wunti yɔ̄tì.

english_verse: You were in serious trouble, but you prayed to the Lord, and he rescued you.
translation_verse: Bi-gìŋ́ŋi poonee, bi nìn fáá mbiil ti-Dindaan watil pú, ní úǹ nìn fīī-bi ki nyántì bi-nimbinaamandi poon.

english_verse: At once he brought you to a town.
translation_verse: U nìn dū-bi ki tākaǹ nsan ŋun tèen̄ee poon ki cūnnì-bi kitiŋ kin poon binib kóòyee.

english_verse: You should praise the Lord for his love and for the wonderful things he does for all of us.
translation_verse: Bí nyɔ̄ŋkì ti-Dindaan u-neeŋkpaandi nì u-maamaaci tuuŋŋi ŋin u ŋáań ki tìì binibee pu!

english_verse: To everyone who is thirsty, he gives something to drink; to everyone who is hungry, he gives good things to eat.
translation_verse: Di sá yii un ní nnyinnyoo nìn cááyee, u tīī-u u nyùn̄, ní ki tīī un ŋkùm nìn cááyee u jíń ki díkí.

english_verse: Some of you were prisoners suffering in deepest darkness and bound by chains,
translation_verse: Biba nìn kā dibɔmbɔndin nì ŋkúm jiliŋku booŋŋun, bi nìn bí falaa sarkaun ní bi bóob́-bi ikusaka.

english_verse: because you had rebelled against God Most High and refused his advice.
translation_verse: Di sá yii bi nìn jáń nì Unimbɔti marab, bi nìn kpēē Yilpu Fɔ́ŋŋŋ Nimbɔtiu bɔkpaaŋi fám.

english_verse: You were worn out from working like slaves, and no one came to help.
translation_verse: U nìn dū falaa ki sīntì-bi taapu, bi nìn gbéetì ki làá lítí ní báà ubɔ kaa nìn tútuǹ-bi.

english_verse: You were in serious trouble, but you prayed to the Lord, and he rescued you.
translation_verse: Bi-gìŋ́ŋi poonee, bi nìn fáá mbiil ti-Dindaan watil pú, ní úǹ nìn fīī-bi ki nyántì bi-nimbinaamandi poon.

english_verse: He brought you out of the deepest darkness and broke your chains.
translation_verse: U nìn dáaĺ-bi ki nyántì dibɔmbɔndi nì ŋkúm jiliŋku booŋŋuee poon ní ki nìn tīfì bi-kusakai.

english_verse: You should praise the Lord for his love and for the wonderful things he does for all of us.
translation_verse: Bí nyɔ̄ŋkì ti-Dindaan u-neeŋkpaandi, nì u-maamaaci tuuŋŋi ŋin u ŋáań ki tìì binibee pu!

english_verse: He breaks down bronze gates and shatters iron locks.
translation_verse: Di sá yii u wīil̀ tasa kúti punuubi ní ki nákatì tikpàlkaal tin sá tikútee.

english_verse: Some of you had foolishly committed a lot of sins and were in terrible pain.
translation_verse: Biba nìn kpántì bigbaambi ki jíń falaa bi-saŋkpitii pu, bi-kpitii puee, bi nìn jíń falaa tikpil.

english_verse: The very thought of food was disgusting to you, and you were almost dead.
translation_verse: Tijin kɔkɔ nìn núutì-bi, baa nìn gíti dátiǹ ŋkúm.

english_verse: You were in serious trouble, but you prayed to the Lord, and he rescued you.
translation_verse: Bi-gìŋ́ŋi poonee, bi nìn fáá mbiil ti-Dindaan watil pú, ní úǹ nìn fīī-bi ki nyántì bi-nimbinaamandi poon.

english_verse: By the power of his own word, he healed you and saved you from destruction.
translation_verse: U nìn dū u-nyɔɔbundi ki cáaǹ-bi ní ki fīī-bi ki nyántì ŋkúm ŋaan.

english_verse: You should praise the Lord for his love and for the wonderful things he does for all of us.
translation_verse: Bí nyɔ̄ŋkì ti-Dindaan u-neeŋkpaandi, nì u-maamaaci tuuŋŋi ŋin u ŋáań ki tìì binibee pu!

english_verse: You should celebrate by offering sacrifices and singing joyful songs to tell what he has done.
translation_verse: Bí ŋá saraabi kí jāam̀ Unimbɔti, bí fáá iwiliili kí dàntì-u u-tuuŋŋi pu.

english_verse: Some of you made a living by sailing the mighty sea,
translation_verse: Biba nìn kɔ́ meelab ki tɔ́kɔ́ tiŋku pu, bi nìn bí tiŋku pu ki bàntī.

english_verse: and you saw the miracles the Lord performed there.
translation_verse: Bíǹ gbantee nìn ká ti-Dindaan tuuŋŋi nì maamaacib bin u ŋáań tiŋku puee.

english_verse: At his command a storm arose, and waves covered the sea.
translation_verse: U sòoǹ ní kubuŋkpaaŋŋu ń kíĺ ki yòontí tinyiŋgban.

english_verse: You were tossed to the sky and to the ocean depths, until things looked so bad that you lost your courage.
translation_verse: Tinyiŋgbanee nìn yòontí bi-meelab ki tòó yilpu, ní ki fàtīi dù-bi ki múl̀ nnyimin. An nìn bíi ŋáań mimmee ní bi nyùn̄ ŋkpatim.

english_verse: You staggered like drunkards and gave up all hope.
translation_verse: Bi-nimbiliŋ nìn bíi bɔ̀ntī ní bi kpìntī kii udanyɔgbilee. Baa nìn gíti nyí tin bi làá ŋée.

english_verse: You were in serious trouble, but you prayed to the Lord, and he rescued you.
translation_verse: Bi-gìŋ́ŋi poonee, bi nìn fáá mbiil ti-Dindaan watil pú, ní úǹ nìn fīī-bi ki nyántì bi-nimbinaamandi poon.

english_verse: He made the storm stop and the sea be quiet.
translation_verse: U nìn yāntì kubuŋkpaaŋŋuee ŋmíl̀, ní tinyiŋgban mun dōoǹ soooo.

english_verse: You were happy because of this, and he brought you to the port where you wanted to go.
translation_verse: An ŋmíl̀ mimmee ní an mɔ́ɔkiǹ-bi, ní ti-Dindaan kpōotì-bi ki cūnnì meelayulilaŋki, laakin bi nìn là kí cùee.

english_verse: You should praise the Lord for his love and for the wonderful things he does for all of us.
translation_verse: Bí nyɔ̄ŋkì ti-Dindaan u-neeŋkpaandi, nì u-maamaaci tuuŋŋi ŋin u ŋáań ki tìì binibee pu!

english_verse: Honor the Lord when you and your leaders meet to worship.
translation_verse: Bí yòon̄ u-yindi yilpu samaa kansikin, kí nyɔ̄ŋkì-u bitindaŋkpilib kpafil poon.

english_verse: If you start doing wrong, the Lord will turn rivers into deserts,
translation_verse: Úǹ di yàntī mbun ń fóotí kí kpántí kuteeu, ní anyimbulnimbil ń gúń kí kpā,

english_verse: flowing streams into scorched land, and fruitful fields into beds of salt.
translation_verse: kí yàntī kitiŋ kin cáá ntiŋkpamee ń kpántí kitiŋ kin kpíìyee, binib bin kóò ki-puee tuŋkpitiŋ pu.

english_verse: But the Lord can also turn deserts into lakes and scorched land into flowing streams.
translation_verse: U tí ŋūǹ kí yàntī kuteeu ń kpántí kubɔɔu, ní kí yàntī kitiŋkuliŋŋi ń kpántí anyimbulnimbil.

english_verse: If you are hungry, you can settle there and build a town.
translation_verse: U cāabìń bin ŋkùm cááyee kí kàan̄ niin, bí náań kitiŋ kí nīn kíǹ ki kóò ki-pu.

english_verse: You can plant fields and vineyards that produce a good harvest.
translation_verse: Bi kù akpaan kí bɔ̄l̀, ní kí cóoń fiinyi sufii ní kí dāá kìtī abil.

english_verse: The Lord will bless you with many children and with herds of cattle.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan bìintí bi-boon ní bi bùtī, waa bàtī bi-waŋkuti wíiŋŋu pu.

english_verse: Sometimes you may be crushed by troubles and sorrows, until only a few of you are left to survive.
translation_verse: Ama biba wíiŋŋu nìn bātì, ní bi nìn dū diwɔ́bil nì nnaabu nì kunimbaau ki nyīī-bi ki sīntì taapu.

english_verse: But the Lord will take revenge on those who conquer you, and he will make them wander across desert sands.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan yāntì bi kíǹ ki kpèé abɔtibil fám. U yāntì ŋi tú ki yìiǹ kuteeu kun pu nsan kpée.

english_verse: You will see this because you obey the Lord, but everyone who is wicked will be silenced.
translation_verse: Bin pɔbiliŋ bí dibee yaa ká mimmee, bi fàal̀ ní, ama binikpitib kɔkɔ pìintí bi-nyɔmmu!

english_verse: Be wise! Remember this and think about the kindness of the Lord.
translation_verse: Ŋma sá uciŋfiti ní? Udaan ń kpāafì tibɔti nee, ní kí béé ti-Dindaan neeŋkpaandi! Udaan ń béé yii ti-Dindaan ŋān̄.

english_verse: I will start playing my harps before the sun rises.
translation_verse: M cáá dimákal, m-Nimbɔtiu, m làá gāā nlan kí nyɔ̄ŋkì-si nì m-naŋki kɔkɔ.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, for everyone to hear; I will sing hymns to you in every nation.
translation_verse: Iŋmii saalaa beeku nì saŋgu, fìntīmaanee, m làá péeǹ kutaa kí fìntī.

english_verse: Your love reaches higher than the heavens, and your loyalty extends beyond the clouds.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, m làá nyɔ̄ŋkì-si anibul kansikin, m làá gāā ilan kí pàkà-si atimbun kansikin.

english_verse: Our God, may you be honored above the heavens; may your glory be seen everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Di sá yii a-neeŋkpaandi wīikí ki jítiǹ kutagbɔŋu, ní a-baamɔŋyi wīikí ki tin sāā atagban.

english_verse: Answer my prayers and use your powerful arm to give us victory. Then the people you love will be safe.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti, a sá ukpaan ki jítiǹ kutagbɔŋu, yàntī a-nyooti ń gbí kitiŋ kɔkɔ!

english_verse: Our God, from your holy place you made this promise: “I will gladly divide up the city of Shechem and give away Succoth Valley piece by piece.
translation_verse: Dū a-pɔŋkpaaŋŋu kí fīī-ti kí fōō ti-wimmeem, án nín làá ŋá pu a-nib bin a néeńee ń ká difiilee.

english_verse: The lands of Gilead and Manasseh are mine. Ephraim is my war helmet, and Judah is my symbol of royal power.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti sòon̄ u-circir diiku poon. M jáń ki jíń! M làá yàkatī Siikeem tiŋki, ní kí ŋmàntī Sukooti tantakal.

english_verse: Moab is merely my washbasin, and Edom belongs to me. I shout with victory over the Philistines.”
translation_verse: Man di yì Galaadi, man di tí yì Manasee mun. Eefiraayiim di sá man janjafuuliiki, ní Juuda sá m-beel pɔŋŋu.

english_verse: Our God, who will bring me to the fortress or lead me to Edom?
translation_verse: Moowaab sá kusampeeu kun poon m fùul̀ee ní. M tákatì m-naatakal ki lúkú Eedoom tiŋki pu, m fátí dijajil kuŋkuuntii Fiiliistii tiŋki pu.

english_verse: Help us defeat our enemies! No one else can rescue us.
translation_verse: an yaa kaa sá sii Unimbɔti un di dū-ti ki fá, kaa ti cēentí ti-janjakitiŋee?

english_verse: Only you give us victory and crush our enemies.
translation_verse: Dāá tūtuǹ-ti tí já nì unannanli, di sá yii unil tūtuntam sá fám ní.

english_verse: Destructive and deceitful lies are told about me,
translation_verse: di sá yii binikpitib nì binyimɔndambi kɔ́kɔĺ-mi, bi sòoǹ ki bíiĺ-mi.

english_verse: I had pity and prayed for my enemies, but their words to me were harsh and cruel.
translation_verse: M yaa bíi dàkà-bi m-neendee ní bíǹ bí ki kɔ́kɔĺ-mi, ama ní m mèé ki tìì-bi.

english_verse: For being friendly and kind, they paid me back with meanness and hatred.
translation_verse: M yaa ŋá-bi tiŋanee, tikpitil ní bi dùú téeǹ-mi, ní m yaa tí dàkā-bi dineendee, bí dū kináŋ kí téeǹ-mi.

english_verse: My enemies said, “Find some worthless fools to accuse him of a crime.
translation_verse: Bi sòoǹ m-pu yii: «Tí lēē unil ubɔ ú jáǹ-u, ukɔkɔli ubɔ ń yūĺ u-ŋaŋgiil pú.

english_verse: Try him and find him guilty! Consider his prayers a lie.
translation_verse: Bi yaa sòon̄ u-bɔtee, ú jī dibɔkpil, ní u-wimmeem ń kpántí-u ikpiti.

english_verse: Cut his life short and let someone else have his job.
translation_verse: U-maŋfal wiiŋyi ń bàtī, ubɔ ń fōō u-tundi.

english_verse: Make orphans of his children and a widow of his wife;
translation_verse: U-jipɔmbi ń kpántí ataŋkpiibil ní u-nimpuu ń kpántí ukpiipu!

english_verse: make his children beg for food and live in the slums.
translation_verse: U-jipɔmbi ń kpántí naayeekub kí nīn mèé ki jīǹ, bí nīn nyēē bi-digbuŋkatiŋ poon ki mèé ki jīǹ!

english_verse: “Let the people he owes take everything he owns. Give it all to strangers.
translation_verse: Un u jíń dipɔndee ń dāá kóoǹ u-wanti kɔkɔ, ní binicambi ń dāá fūkul̀ u nín túń ditundi ki ká tiŋyee.

english_verse: Don't let anyone be kind to him or have pity on the children he leaves behind.
translation_verse: Ubɔ ń taa dàkà-u kulaŋŋaŋfitiiu, ubɔ ń taa sɔ̄ u-taŋkpiibiliŋ saai!

english_verse: Bring an end to his family, and from now on let him be a forgotten man.
translation_verse: U-naantiibi ń kúntí bí taa ti gbìl̄ bi-yiŋŋi pu abin ŋin dòońee poon!

english_verse: “Don't let the Lord forgive the sins of his parents and his ancestors.
translation_verse: Bí téetí ti-Dindaan u-baabi kpitii pu, tiba ń taa pítí u-na kpitii!

english_verse: Don't let the Lord forget the sins of his family, or let anyone remember his family ever lived.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan ń nīn pée téetí bi-kpitii pu ní kí yàntī bí taa ti téetí bi-pu kitiŋ pu!

english_verse: He was so cruel to the poor, homeless, and discouraged that they died young.
translation_verse: Di sá yii kijapaai nee kaa pée dākafì kí ŋá tiŋan, ama ní ki sāaǹ ki tin kūū ufalaadaan nì unandaan un wunti yɔ̄tèee.

english_verse: “He cursed others. Now place a curse on him! He never wished others well. Wish only trouble for him!
translation_verse: U nìn néeń ki tòó binib mbusu, mbusu ń gítí u-pu. Waa nìn pée néeń dibiindi bɔti, dibiindi ń sāǹ kí wàatī-u.

english_verse: He cursed others more often than he dressed himself. Let his curses strike him deep, just as water and olive oil soak through to our bones.
translation_verse: U nìn dū mbusu ki pēeǹ kii dibɔkutikpaandee, dí kɔ́ u-poon kii nnyimee ní kí kɔ́ u-kpabiŋin kii ŋkpamee.

english_verse: Let his curses surround him, just like the belt and clothes he wears each day.”
translation_verse: Dí nīn bīī u-pu kii tiwampeeŋkaalee, kí nīn pée gbìn̄ u-caŋ kii dambalee!»

english_verse: Those are the cruel things my enemies wish for me. Let it all happen to them!
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan nín làá pà bin kɔ́kɔĺ-mi ki sòoǹ ki bíiĺ-mee puee dee!

english_verse: Be true to your name, Lord God! Show your great kindness and rescue me.
translation_verse: Ama sii ti-Dindaan m-Nimbɔtiu, a-yindi puee, ŋá-mi tiŋan, a-neeŋkpaandi ŋanti puee, fīī-mi.

english_verse: I am poor and helpless, and I have lost all hope.
translation_verse: Di sá yii ufalaadaan nì unandaan ní m sá, m-poon kaam cɔ́tì.

english_verse: I am fading away like an evening shadow; I am tossed aside like a crawling insect.
translation_verse: M bíi cá dee kii mboon nín wáŋkí puee, bi bíi jì-mi kii unaakitoonee.

english_verse: I have gone without eating, until my knees are weak, and my body is bony.
translation_verse: M bóob́ kinyɔkɔ áli m-tabiŋyiliŋ kíǹ ki jìkì, ní m dúntì ki kíǹ akpab ŋma.

english_verse: When my enemies see me, they say cruel things and shake their heads.
translation_verse: Bi bèel̄-mi, ní bi yaa ká-mee, bi gbákafí bi-yiliŋ.

english_verse: Let others know that you alone have saved me.
translation_verse: Yàntī bí béé yii sii di ŋá, sii ti-Dindaan di ŋá míǹ ki tīī-mi.

english_verse: I don't care if they curse me, as long as you bless me. You will make my enemies fail when they attack, and you will make me glad to be your servant.
translation_verse: Bi tòó mbusu, ama ní sii bìintí. Bi yaa bíi jáà nì mi, icoo làá cúú-bi, ní man a-tɔntɔnliu ń nīn fàal̀.

english_verse: You will cover them with shame, just as their bodies are covered with clothes.
translation_verse: Yàntī icoo ń cúú bin kɔ́kɔĺ-mee, bí dū bi-cooi kí bìin̄ bi-ba pu kii dibɔkutikpaandee!

english_verse: I will sing your praises and thank you, Lord, when your people meet.
translation_verse: M làá gāā ilan mpɔn kí jāam̀ ti-Dindaan, m làá nyɔ̄ŋkì-u kunipaau kansikin.

english_verse: You help everyone in need, and you save them from death.
translation_verse: Di sá yii u yú ufalaadaan ŋaŋgiiliŋu pú kí fīī-u kí nyāntí bin bíi kù u-bɔtee ŋaan.

english_verse: The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at my right side, until I make your enemies into a footstool for you.”
translation_verse: Daafiidi di ŋmàn̄ nlan nee. Ti-Dindaan nín sòon̄ pu ki tùkū m-Dindaanee sèé: «Dāá kàl̄ m-ŋaŋgiil pú kí nīn cí ŋyunti ŋun m làá dū a-nannanliibi kí bíĺ a-taaŋi taapu á tāāyee.»

english_verse: The Lord will let your power reach out from Zion, and you will rule over your enemies.
translation_verse: Doooo Siiyɔn jool pu ní ti-Dindaan wāaǹ a-beel pɔŋŋu! Jī a-nannanliibi bin māntìi tú-see pu dibeel.

english_verse: Your glorious power will be seen on the day you begin to rule. You will wear the sacred robes and shine like the morning sun in all of your strength.
translation_verse: Anibul dòoń nì tininjati ŋwiin ŋun a kóoǹ a-janjakitil ki kpáfèe. Unimbɔti jool puee, a-nipɔmbi dòoń a-cee, kii dimalindi nín tòó pu ntaafaabɔmbɔmin puee ní.

english_verse: The Lord has made a promise that will never be broken: “You will be a priest forever, just like Melchizedek.”
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan di pūtì ki pōoǹ, u kpá kí kɔ́ntí u-nyɔkɔ yii: «A sá usaraaŋakpil ní kí nīn cá talku, kii Meelkiiseedeeki nín nìn sá puee.»

english_verse: The Lord is at your right side, and when he gets angry he will crush the other kings.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan bí a-ŋaŋgiil pú. U-ŋuul wiiŋŋu dalee, u làá nà bibɔtiibi ní.

english_verse: He will judge the nations and crack their skulls, leaving piles of dead bodies all over the earth.
translation_verse: U làá sòoǹ atimbun bɔti, ní anikpil ń nīn dɔ̄ an kɔkɔ fìlfil, u làá nà bikpootiliibi kitiŋ kɔkɔ pu.

english_verse: He will drink from any stream that he chooses, while winning victory after victory.
translation_verse: Ubɔti làá nyɔ̀ mbunni nyim nsanni, míǹ boonee ní kí gántí u-yil.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! With all my heart I will thank the Lord when his people meet.
translation_verse: Aleeluya, nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan ti-Dindaan! M làá nyɔ̄ŋkì ti-Dindaan nì m-pɔbil kɔkɔ deedeedambi kpafil kansikin.

english_verse: The Lord has done many wonderful things! Everyone who is pleased with God's marvelous deeds will keep them in mind.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan tuuŋŋi sá akpaan, bin kɔkɔ néeń-ŋee dàkafī ŋi-pu ní.

english_verse: Everything the Lord does is glorious and majestic, and his power to bring justice will never end.
translation_verse: U-tuuŋŋi sá tinyool nì jilma ní. U-deedeeu bí ní ki cá jaanjaan.

english_verse: The Lord God is famous for his wonderful deeds, and he is kind and merciful.
translation_verse: U là yii tí nīn téetí u-maamaaci tuuŋŋi pu. Ti-Dindaan sá ulaŋŋaŋfiti ní u-poon mɔ̄.

english_verse: He gives food to his worshipers and always keeps his agreement with them.
translation_verse: U tìì bin fàŋkí-uee tijin bi jīǹ, waa súntí u-poondi pu jaanjaan.

english_verse: He has shown his mighty power to his people and has given them the lands of other nations.
translation_verse: U dàkā u-nibul u-tuuŋŋi pɔŋŋu ŋyunti ŋun ní u fōō atimbun aba timmu ki tīī-bee.

english_verse: God is always honest and fair, and his laws can be trusted.
translation_verse: Tin u ŋáańee sá ibaamɔn nì deedee ní. Unil ŋūǹ kí nīn máká u-bɔkpaaŋi pu.

english_verse: They are true and right and will stand forever.
translation_verse: Ŋaa kpántí dalba dalba. Ibaamɔn nì deedee ní u dūu náań-ŋi.

english_verse: God rescued his people, and he will never break his agreement with them. He is fearsome and holy.
translation_verse: U fīī u-nibul ki líì ní ki pūtì ki pōoǹ-bi talku poondi. U-yindi bí circir ki cáá tifaandi.

english_verse: Respect and obey the Lord! This is the first step to wisdom and good sense. God will always be respected.
translation_verse: Á fàŋkì ti-Dindaanee di sá iciin kílilaŋki. Bin fàŋkí-u mimmee wálifì ní. Ti-Dindaan nyɔŋkii bí ní ki cá jaanjaan.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! The Lord blesses everyone who worships him and gladly obeys his teachings.
translation_verse: Aleeluya, nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan ti-Dindaan! Unil un fàŋkí ti-Dindaan ní ki néeń u-marab tikpilee bí mmɔnneeee!

english_verse: Their descendants will have great power in the land, because the Lord blesses all who do right.
translation_verse: U-naantiibi làá nīn sá bin cáá mpɔn kitiŋ puee ní. Ti-Dindaan bìintí bin pɔbiliŋ bí dibee maaliŋu pu ní.

english_verse: They will get rich and prosper and will always be remembered for their fairness.
translation_verse: Tigaajawan nì tigaajati bí u-dumpu, ní u yú nì ti-Dindaan deedee kí nīn cá jaanjaan.

english_verse: They will be so kind and merciful and good, that they will be a light in the dark for others who do the right thing.
translation_verse: Dibɔmbɔndi poonee, ŋwalifi nyēē ní ki ŋmíntí bin pɔbil bí dibee. Ti-Dindaan sá ulaŋŋaŋfiti ní u-poon mɔ̄ ní u sá deedeedaan.

english_verse: Life will go well for those who freely lend and are honest in business.
translation_verse: An ŋān̄ unil ń sɔ̄ isaa kí nīn pìntí, kí nīn tūǹ u-tuuŋŋi ki nóó nì marab!

english_verse: They won't ever be troubled, and the kind things they do will never be forgotten.
translation_verse: Tiba kaa pée ŋūǹ kí cìŋkì deedeedaan, u-kpátam boonee, binib làá nīn pée téetí u-pu ní.

english_verse: Bad news won't bother them; they have decided to trust the Lord.
translation_verse: Waa fàŋkí kubɔbiiu, u máká ti-Dindaan pu ní u-pɔbil sɔ̀m̀.

english_verse: They are dependable and not afraid, and they will live to see their enemies defeated.
translation_verse: U-mákal bá ki pɔ̄ɔ̄ ní waa fàŋkí tiba, ní ki cí kí ká u-nannanliibi lítitam.

english_verse: They will always be remembered and greatly praised, because they were kind and freely gave to the poor.
translation_verse: U pūǹ bifalaadambi tiwan nì tiniti, ní u-deedeeu bí ki cá jaanjaan. U-pɔŋŋu yíkí yilpu nì tinyool.

english_verse: When evil people see this, they angrily bite their tongues and disappear. They will never get what they really want.
translation_verse: Unikpiti yaa ká-uee ní ú gíí diŋuul, u ŋmóò u-nyiŋŋi ní u-wunti ń yɔ̀tī. Unikpiti nín dàkafī puee dāa kúntí fám ní.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! Everyone who serves him, come and praise his name.
translation_verse: Aleeluya, nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan ti-Dindaan! Nimbi bin sá ti-Dindaan tɔntɔnliibee, nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan-u, nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan ti-Dindaan yindi.

english_verse: Let the name of the Lord be praised now and forever.
translation_verse: Tí jāam̀maan ti-Dindaan kɔŋkɔnnee kí nīn cáa cá jaanjaan!

english_verse: From dawn until sunset the name of the Lord deserves to be praised.
translation_verse: Kí yòon̄ ŋwìiń nyalaŋki pú kí cáá sāā ŋwìiń jeetilaŋki púee, bí nyɔ̄ŋkì ti-Dindaan yindi!

english_verse: The Lord is far above all of the nations; he is more glorious than the heavens.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan di tɔ́kɔ́ atimbun kɔkɔ pu, ní u-nyooti jítì kutagbɔŋu pu.

english_verse: No one can compare with the Lord our God. His throne is high above,
translation_verse: Ŋma di bí kii ti-Dindaan ti-Nimbɔtiu? U bí doooo yilpu ki kā u-beejal pu,

english_verse: and he looks down to see the heavens and the earth.
translation_verse: ní ki kpèeń kutagbɔŋu nì kitiŋ.

english_verse: God lifts the poor and needy from dust and ashes,
translation_verse: U yòontí unandaan ntamin kí síiń, u nyāntí ufalaadaan titampummool poon,

english_verse: and he lets them take part in ruling his people.
translation_verse: kí dū-u kí kàan̄ abɔtibil kansikin, u-nibul bɔtibiliŋ kansikin.

english_verse: When a wife has no children, he blesses her with some, and she is happy. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: U tìì unimpuŋmaŋŋmanti kucadii, ní ú kpántí un bí mmɔnnee. Aleeluya, nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan ti-Dindaan!

english_verse: All of you nations, come praise the Lord! Let everyone praise him.
translation_verse: Atimbun kɔkɔ, nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan ti-Dindaan! Anibul kɔkɔ, pàkàmaan-u!

english_verse: God's love for us is wonderful; his faithfulness never ends. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Di sá yii u-neeŋkpaandi din u cáá ti-puee pɔ̄ɔ̄. Ti-Dindaan baamɔŋyi bí ní ki cá jaanjaan. Aleeluya, nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan ti-Dindaan!

english_verse: Tell the Lord how thankful you are, because he is kind and always merciful.
translation_verse: Nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan ti-Dindaan, di sá yii u ŋān̄, ní u-neeŋkpaandi bí kí nīn cá jaanjaan.

english_verse: Let Israel shout, “God is always merciful!”
translation_verse: Isirayeel yab ń lì yii: «U-neeŋkpaandi bí kí nīn cá jaanjaan!»

english_verse: Let the family of Aaron the priest shout, “God is always merciful!”
translation_verse: Aarɔn naantiibi ń lì yii: «U-neeŋkpaandi bí kí nīn cá jaanjaan!»

english_verse: Let every true worshiper of the Lord shout, “God is always merciful!”
translation_verse: Bin bin fàŋkí ti-Dindaanee ń lì yii: «U-neeŋkpaandi bí kí nīn cá jaanjaan!»

english_verse: When I was really hurting, I prayed to the Lord. He answered my prayer, and took my worries away.
translation_verse: M-nimbinaamandi poonee, m kúuǹ ki yíiń ti-Dindaan, ti-Dindaan kíí-mi ní ki yāntì m tɔ́ m-ba.

english_verse: The Lord is on my side, and I am not afraid of what others can do to me.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan bí m-cee, an puee maa fàŋkí tiba, ba ní unil làá ŋmā kí ŋá-mi?

english_verse: With the Lord on my side, I will defeat my hateful enemies.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan bí m-cee ní ki tútúǹ-mi, m-nimbil làá ká bin ná-mee lítitam.

english_verse: It is better to trust the Lord for protection than to trust anyone else,
translation_verse: An ŋān̄ á sāǹ kí kɔ́ ti-Dindaan ki jítiǹ á nīn máká unil pu!

english_verse: Nations surrounded me, but I got rid of them by the power of the Lord.
translation_verse: Atimbun kɔkɔ nib nìn māntìi tú-mi, ama ti-Dindaan yindi puee, m nāaǹ-bi.

english_verse: They attacked from all sides, but I got rid of them by the power of the Lord.
translation_verse: Ŋi nìn māntìi tú-mi an kɔkɔ pu, ama ti-Dindaan yindi puee, m nāaǹ-bi.

english_verse: They swarmed around like bees, but by the power of the Lord, I got rid of them and their fiery sting.
translation_verse: Ŋi nìn māntìi tú-mi kii inaŋgbansiiyee. Bi kpíì malaa kii ikuŋkum ŋmiŋuee, ti-Dindaan yindi puee, m nāaǹ-bi.

english_verse: Their attacks were so fierce that I nearly fell, but the Lord helped me.
translation_verse: Bi téé-mi mpɔn ḿ bàà lítí, ama ní ti-Dindaan jòoń-mi.

english_verse: My power and my strength come from the Lord, and he has saved me.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan di sá m-pɔŋŋu nì m-nyɔŋkii laŋŋu, úǹ di fīī-mi.

english_verse: From the tents of God's people come shouts of victory: “The Lord is powerful!
translation_verse: Ifaal nì dijajil laŋŋu nyēeń deedeedambi tantib poon yii: «Ti-Dindaan ŋaŋgiil tūǹ atuŋkpaan!

english_verse: With his mighty arm the Lord wins victories! The Lord is powerful!”
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan yōoǹ u-ŋaŋgiil yilpu, ti-Dindaan ŋaŋgiil tūǹ atuŋkpaan.»

english_verse: And so my life is safe, and I will live to tell what the Lord has done.
translation_verse: Maa làá kpú, m làá nīn bí dimaŋfalin kí māafì tin ti-Dindaan ŋée.

english_verse: He punished me terribly, but he did not let death lay its hands on me.
translation_verse: Tiŋman ti-Dindaan dáaĺ m-tafal, ama waa dū-mi ki ŋá ŋkúm ŋaan.

english_verse: Open the gates of justice! I will enter and tell the Lord how thankful I am.
translation_verse: Pìitīmaan-mi deedee punyɔmmu, ḿ dī kí kɔ́ kí nyɔ̄ŋkì ti-Dindaan.

english_verse: Here is the gate of the Lord! Everyone who does right may enter this gate.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan punyɔkɔki sèé: deedeedambi ń dī kí kɔ́!

english_verse: I praise the Lord for answering my prayers and saving me.
translation_verse: M làá nyɔ̄ŋkì-si, di sá yii a kíí-mi, ní ki fīī-mi.

english_verse: The stone that the builders tossed aside has now become the most important stone.
translation_verse: Ditaŋkpal din bidimaliibi nìn dūu fée di kpántì ditaŋkpal din ŋúb́ kudii pɔŋŋuee.

english_verse: The Lord has done this, and it is amazing to us.
translation_verse: An nyánní ti-Dindaan cee ní, an gbí mmaam ti-cee!

english_verse: This day belongs to the Lord! Let's celebrate and be glad today.
translation_verse: Ŋwiin ŋun ti-Dindaan ŋée sɔ̀. Ŋu-puee, tí nīn fàal̀ kí nīn bí dipɔɔpindin.

english_verse: God bless the one who comes in the name of the Lord! We praise you from here in the house of the Lord.
translation_verse: - Ti-Dindaan ń bìin̄ un dòoń u-yindi puee boon. Doooo ti-Dindaan diikun ní ti mèé ki bìintí ni-pu.

english_verse: The Lord is our God, and he has given us light! Start the celebration! March with palm branches all the way to the altar.
translation_verse: - Ti-Dindaan di sá Unimbɔti ní ki ŋmíntí-ti! - Nín̄ ŋúb́maan asupan ki nóó tɔb kí tin bà nsaraafan yiŋyi.

english_verse: The Lord is my God! I will praise him and tell him how thankful I am.
translation_verse: Sii di sá m-Nimbɔtiu, ní m làá nyɔ̄ŋkì-si. M-Nimbɔtiu, m làá yòon̄ a-yindi yilpu.

english_verse: Tell the Lord how thankful you are, because he is kind and always merciful.
translation_verse: Nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan ti-Dindaan, di sá yii u ŋān̄ ní u-neendi bí kí nīn cá jaanjaan.

english_verse: Our Lord, you bless everyone who lives right and obeys your Law.
translation_verse: Unil un baa kāntí tikpitil tiba u-saŋkindi poon, ní u ŋáań ti-Dindaan marab nín bí yii ú ŋá puee bí mmɔnneeee!

english_verse: You bless all those who follow your commands from deep in their hearts
translation_verse: Bin ŋúb́ u-bɔkpaaŋi ní ki nyàab̀-u nì bi-pɔbiliŋ kɔkɔee bí mmɔnneeee!

english_verse: and who never do wrong or turn from you.
translation_verse: An nibee kaa ŋáań tikpitil, bi nóó u-saŋŋu ní.

english_verse: You have ordered us always to obey your teachings;
translation_verse: Sii ti-Dindaan di tīī-ti a-bɔkpaaŋi ní ki là yii tí nīn ŋúb́-ŋi tiŋan.

english_verse: I don't ever want to stray from your laws.
translation_verse: Yàntī ḿ nīn cáá mbimbimɔntiim kí nīn tɔ́ a-koobiliŋ.

english_verse: Thinking about your commands will keep me from doing some foolish thing.
translation_verse: Niinee, m-nimbikpeeŋu yaa bá a-marab kɔkɔ puee, icoo kaa làá cúú-mi.

english_verse: I will do right and praise you by learning to respect your perfect laws.
translation_verse: M làá nyɔ̄ŋkì-si nì dipɔbil diba kí nīn bífí tin a sòon̄ ki síiǹ tì bí deedeeyee.

english_verse: I will obey all of them! Don't turn your back on me.
translation_verse: M làá nīn ŋúb́ a-koobiliŋ, taa dū-mi kí fá kɔkɔ. *

english_verse: Young people can live a clean life by obeying your word.
translation_verse: Mana ní unaacimpɔɔn ŋūǹ kí nīn cáá mbimbim min bí circiree? - See ú nīn ŋúb́ a-nyɔɔbundi.

english_verse: I worship you with all my heart. Don't let me walk away from your commands.
translation_verse: M nyàab̄-si nì m-pɔbil kɔkɔ, taa yàntī ḿ kàkatī kí wàatī a-marab.

english_verse: I treasure your word above all else; it keeps me from sinning against you.
translation_verse: M kpáafí a-nyɔɔbundi m-pɔbilin án nín làá ŋá pu ḿ taa yìntīǹ-see.

english_verse: I praise you, Lord! Teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, si nì ditundi, a nín dàkā-mi a-koobiliŋee pu.

english_verse: With my own mouth, I tell others the laws that you have spoken.
translation_verse: M-nyɔkɔ làá māafì tin ní a sòon̄ ki síiǹee.

english_verse: Obeying your instructions brings as much happiness as being rich.
translation_verse: M yaa nóó a-bɔkpaaŋee, an mɔ̄ǹ-mi kii m ká tigaajakpaandee.

english_verse: I will study your teachings and follow your footsteps.
translation_verse: M làá dàkafì a-bɔkpaaŋi pu ní m-nimbikpeeŋu ń nīn bá a-saŋyi pu.

english_verse: I will take pleasure in your laws and remember your words.
translation_verse: An mɔ̄ǹ-mi a-koobiliŋ pu, maa súntí a-nyɔɔbundi pu. *

english_verse: Treat me with kindness, Lord, so that I may live and do what you say.
translation_verse: Ŋá man a-tɔntɔnliu tiŋan ḿ nīn bí dimaŋfalin, ní kí nīn ŋúb́ a-nyɔɔbundi.

english_verse: Open my mind and let me discover the wonders of your Law.
translation_verse: Ŋúbití m-nimbiliŋ ní ḿ ŋmā kí wāl̀ maamaacib bin bí a-marab poonee.

english_verse: I live here as a stranger. Don't keep me from knowing your commands.
translation_verse: Unicaan ní m sá kitiŋ nee pu, taa dū a-marab kí báĺ-mi.

english_verse: What I want most and at all times is to honor your laws.
translation_verse: M-naŋki fèefī ki nyàab̀ tin a sòon̄ ki síiǹee ŋyunti kamaa.

english_verse: You punish those boastful, worthless nobodies who turn from your commands.
translation_verse: A kpàtī bilambidambi bin bi tɔ́ mbusu, bi fàtī bi-boon ki tìì a-marabee pu.

english_verse: Don't let them sneer and insult me for following you.
translation_verse: Kàkatī icoo nì kpeefam kí wàatī-mi, di sá yii m ŋúb́ a-bɔkpaaŋi.

english_verse: I keep thinking about your teachings, Lord, even if rulers plot against me.
translation_verse: Báà abɔtibil yaa kpáfì ki bíi sòoǹ ki bɔ́ntí m-pu tibɔkpitilaaa, man a-tɔntɔnliu làá nīn pée dàkafī a-koobiliŋ pu ní.

english_verse: Your laws are my greatest joy! I follow their advice.
translation_verse: An mɔ̄ǹ-mi a-bɔkpaaŋi pu, ŋíǹ di sá m-saŋkiliibi. *

english_verse: I am at the point of death. Let your teachings breathe new life into me.
translation_verse: M dɔ̄ kitiŋ ntamin, fàtīí tīī-mi dimaŋfal kí nóó nì a-nyɔɔbundi.

english_verse: When I told you my troubles, you answered my prayers. Now teach me your laws.
translation_verse: M tùkū-si m-bimbim nín bí puee ní a kíí-mi, dàkà-mi a-koobiliŋ.

english_verse: Help me to understand your teachings, and I will think about your marvelous deeds.
translation_verse: Yàntī ḿ gbìl̄ a-bɔkpaaŋi taapu, ní ḿ dàkafì a-maamaaci tuuŋŋi pu.

english_verse: I am overcome with sorrow. Encourage me, as you have promised to do.
translation_verse: Kunimbaau yāntì nnyinnyim nyáń-mi, fàtīí tīī-mi mpɔn kí nóó nì a-nyɔɔbundi.

english_verse: Keep me from being deceitful, and be kind enough to teach me your Law.
translation_verse: Kàkatī nnyimɔn saŋŋu kí wàatī-mi, ní a-laŋŋaŋfitiiku poonee, á yàntī ḿ béé a-marab.

english_verse: I am determined to be faithful and to respect your laws.
translation_verse: M lēē ibaamɔn saŋŋu, m tɔ́ tin a sòon̄ ki síiǹee.

english_verse: I follow your rules, Lord. Don't let me be ashamed.
translation_verse: M dū m-ba ki nákáǹ a-bɔkpaaŋi, ti-Dindaan, taa yàntī icoo ń jī-mi.

english_verse: I am eager to learn all that you want me to do; help me to understand more.
translation_verse: M bìǹ ki nyàab̀ kí nóó a-marab saŋŋu, di sá yii a yāntì m tɔ́ m-ba. *

english_verse: Point out your rules, Lord, and I won't disobey even one of them.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, dàkà-mi a-koobiliŋ saŋŋu, m làá nīn nóó-ŋu kí tin cáá kátí.

english_verse: Help me to understand your Law; I promise to obey it with all my heart.
translation_verse: Tīī-mi dinyil ḿ dūú ŋúb́ a-marab, m làá nīn tɔ́-bi nì m-pɔbil kɔkɔ.

english_verse: Direct me by your commands! I love to do what you say.
translation_verse: Kpòotī-mi kí tàkan̄ a-marab saŋŋu pu, di sá yii bi-poon ní m kāntí m-mɔŋŋu.

english_verse: Make me want to obey you, rather than to be rich.
translation_verse: Kpòon̄ m-pɔbil kí gíiǹ a-bɔkpaaŋi watil pú kí taa yàntī dí kpòon̄ kí gítí dulim gaajati pú.

english_verse: Take away my foolish desires, and let me find life by walking with you.
translation_verse: Cúú m-nimbikpeeŋu kí páatí tin kaa bí tibanee pu, kí yàntī ḿ nīn bí a-saŋŋu poon.

english_verse: I am your servant! Do for me what you promised to those who worship you.
translation_verse: A nín pōoǹ kí ŋá kí tīī bin fàŋkí-see puee, ŋá míǹ kí tīī man a-tɔntɔnliu.

english_verse: Your wonderful teachings protect me from the insults that I hate so much.
translation_verse: Kàkatī m-cooi in fàantí-mi nee kí wàatī-mi, di sá yii tin a sòon̄ ki síiǹee di ŋān̄.

english_verse: I long for your teachings. Be true to yourself and let me live.
translation_verse: Tiŋman, m lafun néeń a-bɔkpaaŋi, a-deedeeu puee, fàtīí tīī-mi dimaŋfal. *

english_verse: Show me your love and save me, Lord, as you have promised.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, dàkà-mi a-neeŋkpaandi, fīī-mi kí nóó nì a nín lī puee.

english_verse: Then I will have an answer for everyone who insults me for trusting your word.
translation_verse: Niinee m làá ká dinyɔɔbundi kí kíí bin sìí-mee, di sá yii a-nyɔɔbundi pu ní m máká.

english_verse: I rely on your laws! Don't take away my chance to speak your truth.
translation_verse: Yàntī ibaamɔn nyɔɔbuŋŋi ń nīn pée nyēē m-nyɔkɔn ŋyunti kamaa, di sá yii tin a sòon̄ ki síiǹee pu ní m máká.

english_verse: I will keep obeying your Law forever and ever.
translation_verse: M làá nīn pée ŋúb́ a-marau ní kí nīn pée cáa cá jaanjaan.

english_verse: I have gained perfect freedom by following your teachings,
translation_verse: M làá nīn còom̄ ki tɔ́ m-ba, di sá yii a-bɔkpaaŋi ní m nyàab̀.

english_verse: and I trust them so much that I tell them to kings.
translation_verse: M làá sòoǹ a-bɔkpaaŋi pu bibɔtiibi nimbiin ní an kaa làá nīn cáá-mi icoo.

english_verse: I love your commands! They bring me happiness.
translation_verse: A-marab tìì mmɔn, di sá yii m néeń-bi ní.

english_verse: I love and respect them and will keep them in mind.
translation_verse: M yòontí m-ŋalii kí túĺ a-marab watil pú, di sá yii m néeń-bi. M làá dàkafì a-bɔkpaaŋi pu. *

english_verse: Don't forget your promise to me, your servant. I depend on it.
translation_verse: Téetí dinyɔɔbundi din a lī man a-tɔntɔnliu puee, di-pu ní m máká.

english_verse: When I am hurting, I find comfort in your promise that leads to life.
translation_verse: Báà m yaa bí falaa poonaaa, m kāntí diŋmeendi, di sá yii tin a sòon̄ee di tìì-mi dimaŋfal.

english_verse: Conceited people sneer at me, but I obey your Law.
translation_verse: Bilambidambi bēel̀-mi tikpil, ama maa fātì m-boon ki tīī a-marab.

english_verse: I find true comfort, Lord, because your laws have stood the test of time.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, m téetí tin a nìn sòon̄ ki síiǹ dooooyee pu, an di tìì-mi diŋmeendi.

english_verse: I get furious when evil people turn against your Law.
translation_verse: M yaa ká binikpitib nín féeń a-marab puee, m fòol̄ mbum ŋkpitim pu ní.

english_verse: No matter where I am, your teachings fill me with songs.
translation_verse: Kitiŋ kin pu m kā kunicaŋu nee, a-bɔkpaaŋi di kpántì m-laŋyi.

english_verse: Even in the night I think about you, Lord, and I obey your Law.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, m téetí a-yindi pu kunyeeu, ní ki ŋúb́ a-marab.

english_verse: You have blessed me because I have always followed your teachings.
translation_verse: Tin di sá m-yatee di sá ḿ nīn ŋúb́ a-bɔkpaaŋi. *

english_verse: You, Lord, are my choice, and I will obey you.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, m lī yii dijandi din m lēēyee di sá ḿ nīn ŋúb́ a-nyɔɔbundi.

english_verse: With all my heart I beg you to be kind to me, just as you have promised.
translation_verse: M nyàab̄ kí nīn fáatiǹ-si nì m-pɔbil kɔkɔ, sɔ̄ m-saai kí nóó nì tin a sòon̄ee.

english_verse: I pay careful attention as you lead me, and I follow closely.
translation_verse: M dākafì m-saŋkindi pu, m là kí fàtīí nīn tɔ́ a-bɔkpaaŋi.

english_verse: As soon as you command, I do what you say.
translation_verse: M làá ŋá malaa, maa làá tàan̄ kí ŋúb́ a-marab.

english_verse: Evil people may set a trap, but I obey your Law.
translation_verse: Binikpitib ŋmiii māntìi tú-mi, ama maa súntí a-marab pu.

english_verse: Your laws are so fair that I wake up and praise you in the middle of the night.
translation_verse: M yíkí kunyataasiiu ní kí nyɔ̄ŋkì-si, di sá yii tin a sòon̄ ki síiǹee bí deedee.

english_verse: I choose as my friends everyone who worships you and follows your teachings.
translation_verse: M-bɔɔbi di sá bin kɔkɔ fàŋkí-si ní ki ŋúb́ a-bɔkpaaŋee.

english_verse: Our Lord, your love is seen all over the world. Teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, a-neeŋkpaandi gbí kitiŋ kɔkɔ pu, dàkà-mi a-koobiliŋ. *

english_verse: I am your servant, Lord, and you have kept your promise to treat me with kindness.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, a ŋá man a-tɔntɔnliu tiŋan ki nóó nì a-nyɔɔbundi.

english_verse: Give me wisdom and good sense. I trust your commands.
translation_verse: Dàkà-mi nlandɔkɔmɔnti nì dinyil, di sá yii m máká a-marab pu.

english_verse: Once you corrected me for not obeying you, but now I do obey.
translation_verse: Kí wàatī á sìntīǹ-mi taapuee, m nìn gáatì ní, ama kɔŋkɔnnee, m kíǹ ki ŋúb́ tin a sòon̄ee ní.

english_verse: You are kindhearted, and you do good things, so teach me your laws.
translation_verse: A ŋān̄ ní ki ŋáań tin ŋān̄ee, dàkà-mi a-koobiliŋ.

english_verse: My reputation is being ruined by conceited liars, but with all my heart I follow your teachings.
translation_verse: Bilambidambi sòon̄ tinyimɔmbɔti ki bíil̀-mi, ama mamee, m ŋúb́ a-bɔkpaaŋi nì m-pɔbil kɔkɔ ní.

english_verse: Those liars have no sense, but I find happiness in your Law.
translation_verse: Bi-pɔbiliŋ tīlifì, ama mamee, a-marab di tìì-mi mmɔn.

english_verse: When you corrected me, it did me good because it taught me to study your laws.
translation_verse: A nín sīntiǹ-mi taapuee ŋá-mi tiŋan, di sá yii an tútuǹ-mi m bífì a-koobiliŋ. *

english_verse: I would rather obey you than to have a thousand pieces of silver and gold.
translation_verse: Marab bin nyáń a-nyɔkɔnee ŋān̄ m-cee ki jítiǹ sindaariya nì animbil kúti kutukub cutimaanyi.

english_verse: You created me and put me together. Make me wise enough to learn what you have commanded.
translation_verse: A dū a-ŋalii ní ki máń-mi ní ki tīī-mi mpɔn, tīī-mi dinyil ḿ dūú bīfì a-marab.

english_verse: Your worshipers will see me, and they will be glad that I trust your word.
translation_verse: Bin fàŋkí-see yaa ká-mee, bi fàal̀ ní, di sá yii a-nyɔɔbundi pu ní m máká.

english_verse: Your decisions are correct, and you were right to punish me.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, m nyí tin a sòon̄ ki síiǹee nín sá deedeeyee, ní a cáá ibaamɔn a nín sīntiǹ-mi taapuee.

english_verse: I serve you, Lord. Comfort me with your love, just as you have promised.
translation_verse: A-neeŋkpaandee ń dāan̄ kɔŋkɔnnee kí ŋméeǹ-mi, kii a nín sòon̄ man a-tɔntɔnliu puee.

english_verse: I love to obey your Law! Have mercy and let me live.
translation_verse: Dàkà-mi a-poommɔŋŋu ḿ nīn bí dimaŋfalin, di sá yii a-marab di tìì-mi mmɔn.

english_verse: Put down those proud people who hurt me with their lies, because I have chosen to study your teachings.
translation_verse: Icoo ń cúú bilambidambi bin kɔ́kɔĺ-mi fámee! Mamee, m làá nīn dàkafī a-bɔkpaaŋi pu.

english_verse: Let your worshipers come to me, so they will learn to obey your rules.
translation_verse: Bin fàŋkí-see ń dāan̄ m-cee kí béé a-bɔkpaaŋi.

english_verse: Let me truly respect your laws, so I won't be ashamed.
translation_verse: M làá nīn ŋúb́ a-koobiliŋ nì m-pɔbil kɔkɔ, án nín làá ŋá pu icoo ń taa cúú-mee. *

english_verse: I long for you to rescue me! Your word is my only hope.
translation_verse: M kāl̀ ki cíitì a-fiil ki tin kpáàa gīī, m kā ki máká a-nyɔɔbundi pu.

english_verse: I am worn out from waiting for you to keep your word. When will you have mercy?
translation_verse: M kpēē tin a sòon̄ee saŋŋu pú m-nimbiliŋ tin kpáàa lóoĺ, ní m bàlifī yii: «Ŋyunti ŋulɔŋu ní a làá ŋméeǹ-mi ní?»

english_verse: My life is wasting away like a dried-up wineskin, but I have not forgotten your teachings.
translation_verse: M sá kii kuloou kun ŋŋminyiim ŋɔ́fì ku bɔ̄ntèe ní, ama maa súntì a-koobiliŋ pu.

english_verse: I am your servant! How long must I suffer? When will you punish those troublemakers?
translation_verse: Iwiin iŋa di kíǹ man a-tɔntɔnliu ḿ nīn bí dimaŋfalin ní? Ŋyunti ŋulɔŋu ní a làá sòoǹ bin sàantí-mee bɔti ní?

english_verse: Those proud people reject your teachings, and they dig pits for me to fall in.
translation_verse: Bin yòontí bi-ba yilpu kaa fātìi tɔ́ a-marabee gbìn̄ mbòó ki píĺ kí sàl̄-mi.

english_verse: Your laws can be trusted! Protect me from cruel liars.
translation_verse: A-marab kɔkɔ sá ibaamɔn marab ní, maa ŋá tiba ní bi bíi sàantí-mi, dāá jòoń-mi.

english_verse: They have almost killed me, but I have been faithful to your teachings.
translation_verse: Bi nìn ŋman kūū-mi ki dóò ní, ama maa dū a-bɔkpaaŋi ki fá.

english_verse: Show that you love me and let me live, so that I may obey your commands.
translation_verse: A-neeŋkpaandi puee, tīī-mi dimaŋfal ní ḿ nīn ŋúb́ a-bɔkpaaŋi. *

english_verse: Our Lord, you are eternal! Your word will last as long as the heavens.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, a-nyɔɔbundi bí ní ki cá jaanjaan, dì bá yilpu ki pɔ̄ɔ̄ kiŋkiŋ.

english_verse: You remain faithful in every generation, and the earth you created will keep standing firm.
translation_verse: A-deedeeu bí kí nīn cá abin abin. A báaǹ kitiŋ ní kì bá ki pɔ̄ɔ̄.

english_verse: All things are your servants, and the laws you made are still in effect today.
translation_verse: Tikɔkɔ bí ti-laŋki ki dāa sāā díǹ ki nóó nì tin a sòon̄ ki síiǹee, di sá yii tin kɔkɔ bí duulinyanee sá a-tɔntɔnliibi ní.

english_verse: If I had not found happiness in obeying your Law, I would have died in misery.
translation_verse: A-marab yaa kaa bàà sá kun tìì-mi mmɔnnee, kɔnampu falaa bàà kūū-mi.

english_verse: I won't ever forget your teachings, because you give me new life when I follow them.
translation_verse: M kpá kí súntí a-bɔkpaaŋi pu jaanjaan, di sá yii a dī ŋi-pu ní ki tīī-mi dimaŋfal.

english_verse: I belong to you, and I have respected your laws, so keep me safe.
translation_verse: Sii di yì-mi, fīī-mi, di sá yii a-bɔkpaaŋi bɔti di páb́-mi.

english_verse: Brutal enemies are waiting to ambush and destroy me, but I obey your rules.
translation_verse: Binikpitib cí kí lēē m-maŋfal, ama m dàkafī a-bɔkpaaŋi pu.

english_verse: I deeply love your Law! I think about it all day.
translation_verse: M néeń a-marabeeee! M dàkafī bi-pu ŋwiin kamaa.

english_verse: Your laws never leave my mind, and they make me much wiser than my enemies.
translation_verse: A-marab yāntì m cáá iciin ki jítiǹ m-nannanliibi, di sá yii m dū-bi ki gāā m-bindi kí nīn cá jaanjaan.

english_verse: Thinking about your teachings gives me better understanding than my teachers,
translation_verse: M nyíǹ m-dàkaliibi kɔkɔ, di sá yii m dàkafī a-bɔkpaaŋi pu.

english_verse: and obeying your laws makes me wiser than those who have lived a long time.
translation_verse: M nyíǹ bitikpilib, di sá yii m kpáafí a-bɔkpaaŋi.

english_verse: I obey your word instead of following a way that leads to trouble.
translation_verse: M yíì kí nóó isaŋkpiti kí ŋmā kí nīn ŋúb́ a-nyɔɔbundi.

english_verse: You have been my teacher, and I won't reject your instructions.
translation_verse: Maa fātì m-boon ki tīī a nín sòon̄ pu ki síiǹee, di sá yii sii di dàkà-mi.

english_verse: Your teachings are sweeter than honey.
translation_verse: Tin a sòon̄ee mɔ̄ m-nyɔkɔn cɔ́ncɔŋ ki jítiǹ tisiil.

english_verse: They give me understanding and make me hate all lies.
translation_verse: A-bɔkpaaŋi puee, m cáá dinyil, an pu ní m ná tinyimɔmbɔti kɔkɔ. *

english_verse: Your word is a lamp that gives light wherever I walk.
translation_verse: A-nyɔɔbundi sá fitila ní ki ŋmíntí laakin m còom̄ee, ŋwalifi ki ŋmíntí m-saŋŋu.

english_verse: Your laws are fair, and I have given my word to respect them all.
translation_verse: M pūtì ki pōoǹ kí ŋúb́ tin a sòon̄ ki síiǹ tì bí deedeeyee, ní ki lafun làá ŋá míǹ.

english_verse: I am in terrible pain! Save me, Lord, as you have promised.
translation_verse: M jíń falaa tikpilku, ti-Dindaan, tīī-mi dimaŋfal kí nóó nì a-nyɔɔbundi.

english_verse: Accept my offerings of praise and teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, nlammɔntiim saraau un nyēē m-nyɔkɔnee ń fáatíǹ-si, kí dàkà-mi tin a sòon̄ ki síiǹee.

english_verse: I never forget your teachings, although my life is always in danger.
translation_verse: M bí dinimbinaamandin ní baabadal, ama maa súntì a-marau pu.

english_verse: Some merciless people are trying to trap me, but I never turn my back on your teachings.
translation_verse: Min kamaa binikpitib píĺ-mi kutaliŋŋuee, maa kākatì ki wāatì a-bɔkpaaŋi.

english_verse: They will always be my most prized possession and my source of joy.
translation_verse: A-bɔkpaaŋi di sá m-fakal kí nīn cáa cá jaanjaan, ŋíǹ di tìì m-pɔbil mmɔn.

english_verse: I have made up my mind to obey your laws forever, no matter what.
translation_verse: M lēē m-pɔbilin kí ŋá a-koobiliŋ nín bí yii ḿ ŋá puee, m-paatii dee kí nīn cáa cá jaanjaan. *

english_verse: I hate anyone whose loyalty is divided, but I love your Law.
translation_verse: M ná milimilidambi, ama ní ki néeń a-marau.

english_verse: You are my place of safety and my shield. Your word is my only hope.
translation_verse: Sii di sá m-balilaŋki nì m-gbampɔɔl. M máká a-nyɔɔbundi pu.

english_verse: All you worthless people, get away from me! I am determined to obey the commands of my God.
translation_verse: Binikpitibee, sútímaan kí wàatī-mi, ní ḿ nīn ŋúb́ m-Nimbɔtiu marab.

english_verse: Be true to your word, Lord. Keep me alive and strong; don't let me be ashamed because of my hope.
translation_verse: Nín̄ tíkí-mi kii a nín sòon̄ puee ní ḿ nīn bí dimaŋfalin, taa kɔ́ǹ-mi icoo m-mákal poon.

english_verse: Keep me safe and secure, so that I will always respect your laws.
translation_verse: Tíkiń-mi ní ḿ ká difiil, m-nimbikpeeŋu làá nīn pée cɔ́ a-koobiliŋ pu ní.

english_verse: You reject all deceitful liars because they refuse your teachings.
translation_verse: A dū bin kɔkɔ kākatì ki wāatì a-koobiliŋee ki fá, di sá yii bi-ŋáaǹtam sá nnyimɔn ní.

english_verse: As far as you are concerned, evil people are garbage, and so I follow your rules.
translation_verse: A féeń kitiŋ pu nikpitib kɔkɔ kii timool tin bi féeń ditampundi puee ní, an pu ní m néeń a-bɔkpaaŋi.

english_verse: I tremble all over when I think of you and the way you judge.
translation_verse: M-wunti kɔkɔ jìkì nì kufaaŋŋu a-nimbiin, ní a nín sòon̄ pu ki síiǹee fàantí-mi. *

english_verse: I did what was fair and right! Don't hand me over to those who want to mistreat me.
translation_verse: M tɔ́ tin a sòon̄ ki síiǹee ki ŋá tin bí deedeeyee, taa dū-mi kí ŋá bin sàantí-mee ŋaan.

english_verse: Take good care of me, your servant, and don't let me be harmed by those conceited people.
translation_verse: Líí man a-tɔntɔnliu dimákal yii m làá ká nnaam, yii bilambidambi kaa ti làá sàaǹ-mi!

english_verse: My eyes are weary from waiting to see you keep your promise to come and save me.
translation_verse: M kpēē a-jòońdi nì difiil din a pōoǹee saŋŋu pú m-nimbiliŋ tin kpáàa gīī.

english_verse: Show your love for me, your servant, and teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Dàkà man a-tɔntɔnliu a-neeŋkpaandi, bīfì-mi a-koobiliŋ.

english_verse: I serve you, so let me understand your teachings.
translation_verse: M sá a-tɔntɔnliu ní, tīī-mi dinyil ḿ béé a-bɔkpaaŋi.

english_verse: Do something, Lord! They have broken your Law.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, ŋyunti bàn̄ á tɔ̄ a-tundi: bi yīntiǹ a-marau.

english_verse: Your laws mean more to me than the finest gold.
translation_verse: An pu ní m néeń a-marab ki jítiǹ sindaariya, ki jítiǹ sindaariyamɔmmɔnti pu.

english_verse: I follow all your commands, but I hate anyone who leads me astray.
translation_verse: M ká yii a-bɔkpaaŋi kɔkɔ bí deedee ní, m ná tinyimɔmbɔti kɔkɔ. *

english_verse: Your teachings are wonderful, and I respect them all.
translation_verse: A-bɔkpaaŋi sá maamaaci bɔkpaaŋi, an pu ní m pɔ̄ɔntí ki dī-ŋi.

english_verse: Understanding your word brings light to the minds of ordinary people.
translation_verse: Unil yaa ká a-nyɔɔbundee, dì tìì-u ŋwalifi ní, dì tìì sɔkɔmii nib dinyil.

english_verse: I honestly want to know everything you teach.
translation_verse: M-nyɔkɔ wāā bàaa m fátí diniindi, di sá yii m baasii néeń a-marab ní.

english_verse: Think about me and be kind, just as you are to everyone who loves your name.
translation_verse: Fàtīń a-ba kí túĺ-mi kí sɔ̄ m-saai, kii a nín sòon̄ ki síiǹ kí ŋá bin néeń-see puee.

english_verse: Keep your promise and don't let me stumble or let sin control my life.
translation_verse: Dū a-nyɔɔbundi kí tīī-mi dimákal, taa yàntī tikpitil tiba ń nyàŋkiǹ-mi.

english_verse: Protect me from abuse, so I can obey your laws.
translation_verse: Fōō-mi bin sàantí-mee ŋaan kí líí, ní ḿ nīn ŋúb́ a-bɔkpaaŋi.

english_verse: Smile on me, your servant, and teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Bútí man a-tɔntɔnliu pu nnimbiin, ní kí bīfì-mi a-koobiliŋ.

english_verse: When anyone disobeys you, my eyes overflow with tears.
translation_verse: M-nyinnyim pùub̀ kii mbunee, di sá yii baa ŋúb́ a-marab. *

english_verse: Our Lord, you always do right, and your decisions are fair.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, a sá deedeedaan ní, ní tin a sòon̄ ki síiǹee tèen̄.

english_verse: All your teachings are true and trustworthy.
translation_verse: A-bɔkpaaŋi ŋin a tīīyee sá deedee ní bi ŋūǹ kí nīn máká ŋi-pu.

english_verse: It upsets me greatly when my enemies neglect your teachings.
translation_verse: M-bum fòol̄ m-ni lìblib kii ŋŋmee, kun puee m-nannanliibi súntí a-nyɔɔbundi pu.

english_verse: Your word to me, your servant, is like pure gold; I treasure what you say.
translation_verse: Bi cɔ́ŋkì ki béè tin a sòon̄ee baamɔŋyi, ní man a-tɔntɔnliu néeń-tì.

english_verse: Everyone calls me a nobody, but I remember your laws.
translation_verse: Maa bí tiban ní bi kpèé-mi fám, ama maa súntì a-bɔkpaaŋi pu.

english_verse: You will always do right, and your teachings are true.
translation_verse: A-deedeeu sá deedee un bí ki cá jaanjaanee, ní a-marab sá ibaamɔn marab.

english_verse: I am in deep distress, but I love your teachings.
translation_verse: Dinimbinaamandi nì kunimbaau cúú-mi, ama a-marab di tìì-mi mmɔn.

english_verse: Your rules are always fair. Help me to understand them and live.
translation_verse: A-bɔkpaaŋi bí deedee ní ki cá jaanjaan, tīī-mi dinyil ḿ nīn bí dimaŋfalin. *

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord! Please answer me. I promise to obey your laws.
translation_verse: M kúuǹ ki yíiń-si nì m-pɔbil kɔkɔ, kíí-mi, ti-Dindaan, m làá nīn ŋúb́ a-koobiliŋ.

english_verse: I beg you to save me, so I can follow your rules.
translation_verse: M kúuǹ ki yíiń-si, dāá fīī-mi ní ḿ nīn ŋúb́ a-bɔkpaaŋi.

english_verse: Even before sunrise, I pray for your help, and I put my hope in what you have said.
translation_verse: M yíkì ntaafaabɔmbɔm ki kúuǹ ki yíiń-si, m máká a-nyɔɔbundi pu.

english_verse: I lie awake at night, thinking of your promises.
translation_verse: Kunyamɔŋu kɔkɔee, maa pée dáb́, ki bí ki dàkafī tin a sòon̄ee pu.

english_verse: Show that you love me, Lord, and answer my prayer. Please do the right thing and save my life.
translation_verse: Pīlifiǹ-mi a-neeŋkpaandi poon, ti-Dindaan, tīī-mi dimaŋfal kí nóó nì tin a sòon̄ ki síiǹee.

english_verse: People who disobey your Law have made evil plans and want to hurt me,
translation_verse: Bin sáń ki pá ikpiti boonee sútì ki pìlīń-mi, bi sáǹ ki wāatì a-marab.

english_verse: but you are with me, and all your commands can be trusted.
translation_verse: Ama sii ti-Dindaan pìlīǹ-mi, ní a-marab kɔkɔ sá ibaamɔn.

english_verse: From studying your laws, I found out long ago you made them to last forever.
translation_verse: Dooooyee ní m nyí yii a tīī a-bɔkpaaŋi ŋí nīn bí ki cá jaanjaan. *

english_verse: I have not forgotten your Law! Look at the trouble I am in, and rescue me.
translation_verse: Kpèè m-falaau kí fīī-mi, di sá yii maa súntì a-marab pu.

english_verse: Be my defender and protector! Remember your promise and save my life.
translation_verse: Mɔ̄tì m-pu ní kí dā-mi kí líí, tīī-mi dimaŋfal kii a nín sòon̄ puee.

english_verse: Evil people won't obey you, and so they have no hope of being saved.
translation_verse: Difiil dátiǹ binikpitib, di sá yii baa nyàab̀ a-koobiliŋ.

english_verse: You are merciful, Lord! Please do the right thing and save my life.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, a-poon mɔ̄ tikpilku. Tīī-mi dimaŋfal kí nóó nì tin a sòon̄ ki síiǹee.

english_verse: I have a lot of brutal enemies, but still I never turn from your laws.
translation_verse: Bin sàantí-mee nì m-nannanliibi wīikí tikpil, ama maa fātì m-boon ki tīī a-bɔkpaaŋi.

english_verse: Those unfaithful people who refuse to obey you are disgusting to me.
translation_verse: M ká bin nyēē binib boonee ní m-naŋki nyáń nì bi, di sá yii baa ŋúb́ a nín sòon̄ puee.

english_verse: Remember how I love your laws, and show your love for me by keeping me safe.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, kpèè m nín néeń a-bɔkpaaŋi puee. Tīī-mi dimaŋfal kí nóó nì a-neeŋkpaandi.

english_verse: All you say can be trusted; your teachings are true and will last forever.
translation_verse: A-nyɔɔbundi nyeel di sá ibaamɔn, ní tin a sòon̄ ki síiǹee bí deedee kí nīn cá jaanjaan. *

english_verse: Rulers are cruel to me for no reason. But with all my heart I respect your words,
translation_verse: Abɔtibil sāaǹ-mi an kaa cáá taapu, ama kun m-pɔbil fàŋkée di sá a-nyɔɔbundi.

english_verse: because they bring happiness like treasures taken in war.
translation_verse: M fàal̀ tin a sòon̄ee pu, a lì kii tigaajakpaandi tiba ní m kée.

english_verse: I can't stand liars, but I love your Law.
translation_verse: M ná nnyimɔn, an cáá-mi titantan, ama a-marab ní m néeń.

english_verse: I praise you seven times a day because your laws are fair.
translation_verse: M nyɔ́ŋkí-si ŋfunyɔm mita ní ŋwiin tin a sòon̄ ki síiǹee nín sá deedeeyee pu.

english_verse: You give peace of mind to all who love your Law. Nothing can make them fall.
translation_verse: Bin néeń a-marabee bí dipɔɔsɔŋkilin ní, tiba kaa ŋūǹ kí yàntī bí gbéetí kí lítí.

english_verse: You are my only hope for being saved, Lord, and I do all you command.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, m máká a-fiil pu, ní ki tɔ́ a-marab.

english_verse: I love and obey your laws with all my heart.
translation_verse: M ŋúb́ a-bɔkpaaŋi, m baasii néeń-ŋi ní.

english_verse: You know everything I do. You know I respect every law you have given.
translation_verse: M ŋúb́ a-bɔkpaaŋi nì a-bɔkpaafikaati, di sá yii a nyí tin kɔkɔ m ŋáańee. *

english_verse: Please, Lord, hear my prayer and give me the understanding that comes from your word.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, yàntī m-kuŋkuuntii ń bàń-si, tīī-mi dinyil kí nóó nì a-nyɔɔbundi.

english_verse: Listen to my concerns and keep me safe, just as you have promised.
translation_verse: Yàntī m-gbaamii ń bàń-si, fīī-mi kí nóó nì a nín sòon̄ puee.

english_verse: If you will teach me your laws, I will praise you
translation_verse: M-nyunculiŋ ń tábití kí nyɔ̄ŋkì-si, di sá yii a dàkà-mi a-koobiliŋ.

english_verse: and sing about your promise, because all your teachings are what they ought to be.
translation_verse: M-nyɔkɔ làá dū tin a sòon̄ee kí gāā ilan, di sá yii a-marab kɔkɔ bí deedee ní.

english_verse: Be ready to protect me because I have chosen to obey your laws.
translation_verse: Tàntī a-ŋal kí jòoń-mi, di sá yii a-bɔkpaaŋi ní m lēē.

english_verse: I am waiting for you to save me, Lord. Your Law makes me happy.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, kun m baasii lèe di sá á fīī-mi, ní tin tìì-mi mmɔnee di sá a-marau.

english_verse: Keep me alive, so I can praise you, and let me find help in your teachings.
translation_verse: Tīī-mi dimaŋfal ḿ ŋmā kí nyɔ̄ŋkì-si, ní kí yàntī tin a sòon̄ ki síiǹee ń tūtuǹ-mi.

english_verse: I am your servant, but I have wandered away like a lost sheep. Please come after me, because I have not forgotten your teachings.
translation_verse: M tú ki yìiǹ kii dipibil din wáŋkèe. Nyàab̀ man a-tɔntɔnliu, di sá yii maa súntì a-marab pu.

english_verse: “Come and save me, Lord, from deceitful liars!”
translation_verse: «Ti-Dindaan, fīī-mi kí nyāntí binyimɔndambi nì bikiililiibi ŋaan.»

english_verse: What punishment is fitting for you deceitful liars?
translation_verse: Nimbi bikiililiibee, ditafadaaldi dilal bulifi ní Unimbɔti làá tīī-ni ní?

english_verse: Your reward should be sharp and flaming arrows!
translation_verse: - U làá dū kujaau piiŋyi, nì Amɔsiŋkoon ŋin fòol̄ lìblibee ní kí dáaĺ ni-tafal.

english_verse: But I must live as a foreigner among the people of Meshech and in the tents of Kedar.
translation_verse: Mbusu dɔ̄ ki cí-mi m nín kɔ́ Meeseeki tiŋkinee, nì m nín kāl̀ Keedaar yab kansikinee.

english_verse: I have spent too much time living among people who hate peace.
translation_verse: M kāl̀ binib bin ná ŋgbansɔŋfee kansikin ki yúntì tikpil.

english_verse: I am in favor of peace, but when I speak of it, all they want is war.
translation_verse: M yaa bíi sòoǹ nì bi nì ŋgbansɔŋfee, ní bíǹ là kujaau.

english_verse: It will come from the Lord, who created heaven and earth.
translation_verse: - M-jòońdi nyánní ti-Dindaan un náań yilpu nì taapuee cee ní.

english_verse: The Lord is your protector, and he won't go to sleep or let you stumble.
translation_verse: Waa làá yàntī a-taal ń ŋàtī, un cí-see kaa gèeǹ ki yìntī!

english_verse: The protector of Israel doesn't doze or ever get drowsy.
translation_verse: Kpèè, un cí Isirayeelee kaa dáb̀aaa, kaa gèeǹ mun.

english_verse: The Lord is your protector, there at your right side to shade you from the sun.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan di sá un cí-see, ti-Dindaan wúń a-pu. U bí a-tikindi.

english_verse: You won't be harmed by the sun during the day or by the moon at night.
translation_verse: Ŋwiimpuɔɔɔ, ŋwìiń kaa làá gbá-si, kunyeeuaaa, uŋmal kaa làá ŋá-si tiba.

english_verse: The Lord will protect you and keep you safe from all dangers.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan làá nyāntí-si tibɔkpitil kamaa poon, u làá nīn cí a-naŋki.

english_verse: The Lord will protect you now and always wherever you go.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan làá nīn cí-si a-cùtam nì a-gítintam kí yòon̄ kɔŋkɔnnee kí nīn cáa cá jaanjaan!

english_verse: It made me glad when they said, “Let's go to the house of the Lord!”
translation_verse: Daafiidi di ŋmàn̄ nlan nee. Bi yaa cá Jeerusaleem kí jāam̀ Unimbɔtee ní bi gà-ŋu. An mɔ́ɔkiǹ-mi ŋyunti ŋun bi bí-mi yii: «Tí cùmaan ti-Dindaan diikunee.»

english_verse: Jerusalem, we are standing inside your gates.
translation_verse: Jeerusaleem, ti bāań ki yú a-punyɔmmu nyɔkɔpu!

english_verse: Jerusalem, what a strong and beautiful city you are!
translation_verse: Jeerusaleem tiŋki, bi máń-si tiŋan, a-jaŋŋi kɔkɔ kpáfì ki ŋá ubaanti ki ŋān̄.

english_verse: Every tribe of the Lord obeys him and comes to you to praise his name.
translation_verse: Niin ní Isirayeel naakɔti, ti-Dindaan naakɔti dòoń ki nyɔ́ŋkí ti-Dindaan, kii an nín sá dibɔkpaal pu Isirayeel tiŋkinee.

english_verse: David's royal throne is here where justice rules.
translation_verse: Di sá yii niin ní ibɔsoon beejaliŋ, Daafiidi dicaŋku beejaliŋ bí.

english_verse: Jerusalem, we pray that you will have peace, and that all will go well for those who love you.
translation_verse: Mèèmaan yii Jeerusaleem ń ká ŋgbansɔŋfi: Jeerusaleem, bin néeń-see ń nīn bí dipɔɔsɔŋkilin!

english_verse: May there be peace inside your city walls and in your palaces.
translation_verse: Ŋgbansɔŋfi ń nīn bí a-guŋŋi poon, dipɔɔsɔŋkil ń nīn bí ubɔti dicaŋku poon!

english_verse: Because of my friends and my relatives, I will pray for peace.
translation_verse: M-nabiyaamu nì m-bɔɔbi puee, m mèé yii: «Ŋgbansɔŋfi ń nīn bí a-cee!»

english_verse: And because of the house of the Lord our God, I will work for your good.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan ti-Nimbɔtiu diiku puee, m mèé yii án bútí-si.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, I turn my eyes to you, on your throne in heaven.
translation_verse: Bi yaa cá Jeerusaleem kí jāam̀ Unimbɔtee ní bi gà-ŋu. M wáaǹ ki kpēē sii un kā a-beejal pu yilpuee watil pú.

english_verse: Servants look to their master, but we will look to you, until you have mercy on us.
translation_verse: Kii iyumbu nimbikpeeŋu nín cɔ́ bi-kpiliu ŋal pu puee, kii utɔntɔnli unimpu nimbikpeeŋu nín cɔ́ u-kpiliu pu puee, míǹ ní ti-mun nimbikpeeŋu cɔ́ ti-Dindaan ti-Nimbɔtiu pu, ki cí ú sɔ̄ ti-saai.

english_verse: Please have mercy, Lord! We have been insulted more than we can stand,
translation_verse: Sɔ̄ isaa, ti-Dindaan, sɔ̄ isaa! di sá yii bi gíti kpēē-ti fám an jítì mara pu.

english_verse: and we can't take more abuse from those proud, conceited people.
translation_verse: Bilambidambi sīī-ti an gíti lákatì, bin yòontí bi-ba yilpuee kpēē-ti fám an nyāŋkì.

english_verse: “The Lord was on our side! Otherwise, the enemy attack
translation_verse: «Ti-Dindaan yaa kaa bàà nìn bí ti-ceeyee» - binib nín nìn yíkì ki bíi jáà nì tee,

english_verse: would have killed us all, because it was furious.
translation_verse: bi-ŋuul nín nìn fòol̄ ti-pu lìblib kii ŋŋmee, bi bàà nìn dū-ti ki náĺ nì ti-nimbiliŋ.

english_verse: We would have been swept away in a violent flood
translation_verse: Nnyim bàà nìn yōoǹ-ti, mbunni nyim bàà nìn bīiǹ ti-pu.

english_verse: of high and roaring waves.”
translation_verse: Mbuŋkpaan nyim bàà nìn bīiǹ ti-pu ti múĺ.

english_verse: Let's praise the Lord! He protected us from enemies who were like wild animals,
translation_verse: Ti jáaḿ ti-Dindaan u nín kaa yāntì ti-nannanliibi tɔ̄ntì-tee!

english_verse: The Lord made heaven and earth, and he is the one who sends us help.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan u-ba di sá ti-jòońliu, úǹ di náań yilpu nì taapu.

english_verse: Everyone who trusts the Lord is like Mount Zion that cannot be shaken and will stand forever.
translation_verse: Bi yaa cá Jeerusaleem kí jāam̀ Unimbɔtee ní bi gà nlan nee. Bin máká ti-Dindaan puee bí kii Siiyɔn joolee ní, dàa cìŋkī, di bí ní ki cá talku.

english_verse: Just as Jerusalem is protected by mountains on every side, the Lord protects his people by holding them in his arms now and forever.
translation_verse: Kii ajoon nín māntìi tú Jeerusaleem tiŋki puee, míǹ ní ti-Dindaan māntìi tú u-nibul, kí yòon̄ kɔŋkɔnnee kí nīn cáa cá jaanjaan.

english_verse: He won't let the wicked rule his people or lead them to do wrong.
translation_verse: Ubɔti un sá unikpitee kaa làá ŋmā kí kpòotī deedeedambi tiŋki, an yaa sá fám, bi mun làá dāá kíĺ kí nīn bíi ŋáań tikpitil.

english_verse: Let's ask the Lord to be kind to everyone who is good and completely obeys him.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, bin ŋáań tiŋanee, bin pɔbil bí diba nì see, dàkà-bi a-laŋŋaŋfitiiku.

english_verse: When the Lord punishes the wicked, he will punish everyone else who lives an evil life. Pray for peace in Israel!
translation_verse: Ama bin dī isaŋkpitee, ti-Dindaan, ŋàtī-bi kí fá, kí kpáaǹ bikpitiŋaliibi! M mèé yii ŋgbansɔŋfi ń nīn bí Isirayeel pu!

english_verse: It seemed like a dream when the Lord brought us back to the city of Zion.
translation_verse: Bi yaa cá Jeerusaleem kí jāam̀ Unimbɔtee ní bi gà nlan nee. Ti-Dindaan nín nìn fātìi gíiǹní ti-sarkadambi Siiyɔn tiŋkinee, an nìn bí-ti kii kudamintiiuee ní.

english_verse: We celebrated with laughter and joyful songs. In foreign nations it was said, “The Lord has worked miracles for his people.”
translation_verse: Ti nìn pée bí ní ki lāā ní ki gà dipɔɔpindi laŋyi. Atimbun ŋin kíǹee nìn bí ki lì yii: «Ti-Dindaan túń atuŋkpaan ki tīī-bi.»

english_verse: And so we celebrated because the Lord had indeed worked miracles for us.
translation_verse: Tiŋman, ti-Dindaan nìn lafun túń atuŋkpaan ki tīī-ti, ní ti nìn bí dipɔɔpindin.

english_verse: Our Lord, we ask you to bless our people again, and let us be like streams in the Southern Desert.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, fàtīí gíiǹní ti-sarkadambi, kii a nín yàntī nnyim fàtīi gbéè Neegeeb teekun bùmbiyaamu puee.

english_verse: We cried as we went out to plant our seeds. Now let us celebrate as we bring in the crops.
translation_verse: Un yaa būul̀ nsiim poonee dāa cēē dipɔɔpindi poon ní.

english_verse: We cried on the way to plant our seeds, but we will celebrate and shout as we bring in the crops.
translation_verse: Un yaa tú iwambool ki cá kí bɔ̄l̀ ki sūǹee làá fàtīí gítiń ki tú tijin tin u cáńee nì dipɔɔpindi ní.

english_verse: Without the help of the Lord it is useless to build a home or to guard a city.
translation_verse: Saloomɔn di ŋmàn̄ nlan nee. Bi yaa cá Jeerusaleem kí jāam̀ Unimbɔtee ní bi gà-ŋu. Ti-Dindaan yaa kaa máń kudiiyee, bidimaliibi bíi pɔ̄ɔntí fám ní. Ti-Dindaan yaa kaa cí kitiŋee, bin cí-kèe cí fám ní.
