english_verse: It is useless to get up early and stay up late in order to earn a living. God takes care of his own, even while they sleep.
translation_verse: An sá fám ní ni yíkí kutaafaau pɔ̀lpɔl kí dāá dòon̄ kunyataasiiu, ki tūǹ ditundi ki gì ki pée nyàab̀ kun ni làá jēe. Ti-Dindaan tìì bin u néeńee min jítì mimmee, ŋyunti ŋun ní bíǹ dɔ̄ ki gèeǹee.

english_verse: Children are a blessing and a gift from the Lord.
translation_verse: Mbiyaamu sá tigaajati tin ti-Dindaan tììyee ní, ní mmaal sá dibiindi.

english_verse: Having a lot of children to take care of you in your old age is like a warrior with a lot of arrows.
translation_verse: Mbininjabiyaamu mun uninja màal̀ u-naacimpɔntinee sá kii ipiin in kā ujanjal ŋaanee ní.

english_verse: The more you have, the better off you will be, because they will protect you when your enemies attack you in court.
translation_verse: Un gbéeǹ u-baatandi ipiinee bí mmɔneeee! U nì u-nannanliibi yaa bíi sòoǹ tibɔti kubɔtinaakoounee, icoo kaa làá cúú-u.

english_verse: The Lord will bless you if you respect him and obey his laws.
translation_verse: Bi yaa cá Jeerusaleem kí jāam̀ Unimbɔtee ní bi gà nlan nee. Bin kɔkɔ fàŋkí ti-Dindaan, ki nóó u-saŋŋuee bí mmɔnneeee!

english_verse: Your fields will produce, and you will be happy— all will go well.
translation_verse: A nín túń ditundi ki ká kuŋyee ní a làá jī. A làá nīn bí mmɔnni, ní án bútí-si!

english_verse: Your wife will be as fruitful as a grapevine, and just as an olive tree is rich with olives, your home will be rich with healthy children.
translation_verse: A-dumpuee, a-nimpuu làá nīn bí kii bufiinyisubu bun lòoǹ tikpilee, ní a-jipɔmbi ń nīn bí kii ɔliifi supɔmbiliŋee ki māntìi tú a-teebiliu.

english_verse: This is how the Lord will bless everyone who respects him.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan nín làá bìin̄ un fàŋkí-uee pu puee dee.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will bless you from Zion and let Jerusalem prosper as long as you live.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan ń bìin̄ a-boon doooo Siiyɔn jool pu, ní á ká án nín làá bútí Jeerusaleem pu a-maŋfal wiiŋyi kɔkɔ poonee,

english_verse: May you live long enough to see your grandchildren. Let's pray for peace in Israel!
translation_verse: ní kí ká a-biyaamu biyaamu. Isirayeel ń nīn bí ŋgbansɔŋfin!

english_verse: Since the time I was young, enemies have often attacked! Let everyone in Israel say:
translation_verse: Bi yaa cá Jeerusaleem kí jāam̀ Unimbɔtee ní bi gà nlan nee. Bi jáń nì mi ŋfunyɔm kupaau doooo m-naacimpɔntin... - Isirayeel ń lì yii:

english_verse: “Since the time I was young, enemies have often attacked! But they have not defeated me,
translation_verse: «Bi jáń nì mi ŋfunyɔm kupaau doooo m-naacimpɔntin» -, ama baa ŋúń ki ŋá-mi tiba.

english_verse: though my back is like a field that has just been plowed.”
translation_verse: M-boon kpántì kii kitiŋee bikpaabi kùn̄ tikpaal, bi cátì ŋu-pu adan ŋin fɔ̀kɔ̀ee.

english_verse: I pray that all who hate the city of Zion will be made ashamed and forced to turn and run.
translation_verse: Bin kɔkɔ ná Siiyɔn tiŋkee, icoo ń cúú-bi bí gítí bi-boon!

english_verse: May they be like grass on the flat roof of a house, grass that dries up as soon as it sprouts.
translation_verse: Bí nīn bí kii timool tin nyáń kudii yilpuee. Taa láá wíiǹ ní kí kpā.

english_verse: Don't let them be like wheat gathered in bundles.
translation_verse: Kumoou gbanti kaa gbéè un cēē-kùee ŋantil, kaa bàn̄ un kōontée ń páań u-ŋalii pu.

english_verse: And don't let anyone who passes by say to them, “The Lord bless you! I give you my blessing in the name of the Lord.”
translation_verse: Bisanjitiliibi kaa lì yii: «Ti-Dindaan ń bīiǹ ni-boon!» Ti mèé yii ti-Dindaan ń bìin̄ ni-boon u-yindi pu.

english_verse: From a sea of troubles I cry out to you, Lord.
translation_verse: Bi yaa cá Jeerusaleem kí jāam̀ Unimbɔtee ní bi gà nlan nee. Dinimbinaamandi poonee, m kūuntí ki yíì-si, ti-Dindaan.

english_verse: Won't you please listen as I beg for mercy?
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, pīlifiǹ-mi, kpòon̄ a-tafal kí pīlifì m-gbaamii.

english_verse: If you kept record of our sins, no one could last long.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, a yaa bàà ŋmà ti-yìntitam ki yōontée, ti-Dindaan, ŋma bàà ŋmátí?

english_verse: But you forgive us, and so we will worship you.
translation_verse: Ama sii di pūǹ ikpiti, an pu ní bi máaǹ kí fàŋkì-si.

english_verse: With all my heart, I am waiting, Lord, for you! I trust your promises.
translation_verse: M cɔ́tí ti-Dindaan pu, m cɔ́tí nì m-naŋki kɔkɔ, ní ki máká u-nyɔɔbundi pu.

english_verse: I wait for you more eagerly than a soldier on guard duty waits for the dawn. Yes, I wait more eagerly than a soldier on guard duty waits for the dawn.
translation_verse: M-naŋki fèefī ki nyàab̀ ti-Dindaan ki jítiǹ sooja un cí sintilee nín là kutaa ń wúntí puee, ki jítiǹ sooja un cí sintilee nín là kutaa ń wúntí puee.

english_verse: Israel, trust the Lord! God is always merciful and has the power to save you.
translation_verse: Isirayeel yab, nín̄ mákámaan ti-Dindaan pu, di sá yii ti-Dindaan cee ní dineeŋkpaandi bí, u cáá isan tikpil in pu u làá dī kí fīī-see.

english_verse: Israel, the Lord will save you from all your sins.
translation_verse: Úǹ di làá fīī Isirayeel yab kí nyāntí bi-kpitii poon.

english_verse: But I have learned to feel safe and satisfied, like a young child in its mother's arms.
translation_verse: Ama m ŋmíl̀ díkí diki ní ki kāl̀ soooo kii kibiki kin kā ki-na taaŋi puee. M-pɔbil sɔ̀m̀ kii kibiki gbantee ní.

english_verse: People of Israel, you must trust the Lord now and forever.
translation_verse: Isirayeel yab, nín̄ mákámaan ti-Dindaan pu, kí yòon̄ kɔŋkɔnnee kí nīn cáa cá jaanjaan.

english_verse: Mighty God of Jacob, remember how he promised:
translation_verse: Daafiidi di nìn pūtì ki pōoǹ ti-Dindaan, Jaakɔb Nimbɔtikpaaŋwu yii:

english_verse: “I won't go home or crawl into bed
translation_verse: «M kpá kí kɔ́ m-diikun, m kpá kí dòon̄ m-dooŋu pu,

english_verse: until I find a home for you, the mighty Lord God of Jacob.”
translation_verse: kin tin sāā ŋyunti ŋun m làá ká mpaan kí tīī ti-Dindaan, kí ká ŋkɔŋkoon ki tīī Jaakɔb Nimbɔtikpaaŋwuee!»

english_verse: When we were in Ephrath, we heard that the sacred chest was somewhere near Jaar.
translation_verse: Ti nìn gbìl̄ Dipoondi Dakaau pu Eefiraata tiŋkin, ti nìn ká-u Yaari satin.

english_verse: Then we said, “Let's go to the throne of the Lord and worship at his feet.”
translation_verse: Tí kɔ́maan ti-Dindaan kɔŋkooŋŋun, tí gbàan̄ u-beejal taapu!

english_verse: Come to your new home, Lord, you and the sacred chest with all its power.
translation_verse: Yīkìm̄, ti-Dindaan, dāan̄ a-ŋuŋfil paaŋŋu pu, sii nì Dakaa un poon ní a-pɔŋŋu bée!

english_verse: Let victory be like robes for the priests; let your faithful people celebrate and shout.
translation_verse: A-saraaŋaliibi ń dū ibaamɔn kí pèen̄ kii tiwampeeŋkaalee, bin yú nì si deedeeyee ń nīn fàal̀!

english_verse: David is your chosen one, so don't reject him.
translation_verse: A-tɔntɔnliu Daafiidi puee, taa fàtī a-boon kí tīī ubɔti un ní a lēēyee.

english_verse: You made a solemn promise to David, when you said, “I, the Lord, promise that someone in your family will always be king.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan nìn pōoǹ Daafiidi dipoondi nee. Ibaamɔn pu u kpá kí nyā dipoondi gbanti boon: «A-naantiibi kansikin ubɔ ní m làá dāá lēē kí kàan̄ a-beejal pu.

english_verse: If they keep our agreement and follow my teachings, then someone in your family will rule forever.”
translation_verse: A-jipɔmbi yaa ŋúb́ m-poondi nì abɔkpaa ŋin m tīī-bee, bi mun jipɔmbi làá dāá kàl̄ a-beejal pu kí nīn cá jaanjaan.»

english_verse: You have gladly chosen Zion as your home, our Lord.
translation_verse: Di sá ti-Dindaan lafun lēē Siiyɔn jool, ki là dí nīn sá u-kɔŋkooŋŋu.

english_verse: You said, “This is my home! I will live here forever.
translation_verse: U nìn lī yii: «M-ŋuŋfil paaŋŋu sèé kí nīn cáa cá jaanjaan. Doo ní m là kí nīn kóò.

english_verse: I will bless Zion with food, and even the poor will eat until they are full.
translation_verse: M làá bìin̄ Siiyɔn tiŋki boon kí tīī-kì tin kɔkɔ kì nyàab̀ee, m làá tīī bisoodambi bin kóò ki-nee tijin bí jī kí báĺ.

english_verse: Victory will be like robes for the priests, and its faithful people will celebrate and shout.
translation_verse: M làá dū difiil kí pèen̄ ki-saraaŋaliibi, ní deedeedambi bin kóò ki-nee ń nīn fàal̀.

english_verse: I will give mighty power to the kingdom of David. Each of my chosen kings will shine like a lamp
translation_verse: M làá lēē Daafiidi naantiiu ubɔ Siiyɔn tiŋkin niin ú nīn cáá mpɔŋkpaan. Udaan làá nīn bí kii fitila un kaa kúù jaanjaanee ní.

english_verse: and wear a sparkling crown. But I will disgrace their enemies.”
translation_verse: M làá dāá dū icoo kí pèen̄ u-nannanliibi, ama ní úǹ beefuuliiki ń nīn jìl̀ u-yil pu.»

english_verse: It is as beautiful as olive oil poured on Aaron's head and running down his beard and the collar of his robe.
translation_verse: An bí kii ŋkpam min sɔ́fì bi bātì ki sītì Aarɔn yil pu, mi pùub̀ ki sìntìń u-nyimpul pu, ki pùub̀ ki sìntìń u-wampeeŋkaati nyɔɔgbaŋŋi pu puee ní.

english_verse: It is like the dew from Mount Hermon, falling on Zion's mountains, where the Lord has promised to bless his people with life forevermore.
translation_verse: An bí kii Eermɔn jool malindi nín pùub̀ ki sìntìń Siiyɔn jooŋŋi pu puee ní. Di sá yii niin ní ti-Dindaan lēē kí tīī dibiindi nì dimaŋfal kí nīn cáa cá jaanjaan.

english_verse: Everyone who serves the Lord, come and offer praises. Everyone who has gathered in his temple tonight,
translation_verse: Bi yaa cá Jeerusaleem kí jāam̀ Unimbɔtee ní bi gà nlan nee. Ti-yab, jāam̀maan ti-Dindaan, nimbi bin kɔkɔ sá ti-Dindaan tɔntɔnliibee, nimbi bin bí ti-Dindaan diikun kunyeeuee.

english_verse: lift your hands in prayer toward his holy place and praise the Lord.
translation_verse: Yòom̄maan ni-ŋalii kí túĺ Circir kɔŋkooŋŋu ní kí jāam̀ ti-Dindaan.

english_verse: The Lord is the Creator of heaven and earth, and I pray that the Lord will bless you from Zion.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan ń bìin̄ ni-boon doooo Siiyɔn jool pu, úǹ un náań yilpu nì taapuee!

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! You are his servants, so praise his name.
translation_verse: Aleeluya, nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan ti-Dindaan! Nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan ti-Dindaan yindi, nimbi ti-Dindaan tɔntɔnliibi, nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan-u,

english_verse: All who serve in the temple of the Lord our God,
translation_verse: nimbi bin bí ti-Dindaan diikun, ki bí ti-Nimbɔtiu diiku cindinee.

english_verse: come and shout praises. Praise the name of the Lord! He is kind and good.
translation_verse: Nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan ti-Dindaan, di sá yii u ŋān̄, gāāmaan ilan kí nyɔ̄ŋkì u-yindi, di sá yii di mɔ̄.

english_verse: He chose the family of Jacob and the people of Israel for his very own.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan lēē Jaakɔb ú nīn sá u-yɔu, u lēē Isirayeel ú nīn sá u-gaajawammɔntiiti.

english_verse: The Lord is much greater than any other god.
translation_verse: Tiŋman, man nyí yii ti-Dindaan sá ukpaan, timbi Dindaan jítiǹ inimbɔti kɔkɔ.

english_verse: He does as he chooses in heaven and on earth and deep in the sea.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan ŋáań tin kɔkɔ u yaa lèe yilpu nì taapu, tiŋkubin nì inyiŋfi taapu taapu.

english_verse: The Lord makes the clouds rise from far across the earth, and he makes lightning to go with the rain. Then from his secret place he sends out the wind.
translation_verse: U yàntī atagban ń nyānní kitiŋ gbeennyɔkɔ kí dāan̄, u yàntī utaa ń ŋmɔ́ kí nì, u nyāntí kubuŋu laakin u kpáafì-kuee.

english_verse: The Lord killed the first-born of people and animals in the land of Egypt.
translation_verse: Úǹ di kūū Eejipiti yab biseebiyaamu nninjabiyaamu kí yòon̄ binib kí cáá sāā tiwaŋkuti.

english_verse: God used miracles and wonders to fight the king of Egypt and all of his officials.
translation_verse: Sii Eejipiti tiŋki poonee, u nìn ŋá tidaandi nì maamaacib ki dáaĺ Faaroo nì u-tɔntɔnliibi kɔkɔ tafal.

english_verse: He destroyed many nations and killed powerful kings,
translation_verse: Úǹ di nāaǹ atimbun kupaau, ki kūū bibɔtiibi bin cáá mpɔnee:

english_verse: including King Sihon of the Amorites and King Og of Bashan. He conquered every kingdom in the land of Canaan
translation_verse: bíǹ di sá Amɔɔr yab bɔtiu Siiwɔn, nì Baasan tiŋki bɔtiu Ɔɔgi, nì Kanaan yab bɔtiibi kɔkɔ.

english_verse: The name of the Lord will be remembered forever, and he will be famous for all time to come.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, a-yindi làá nīn pée bí ní ki cá jaanjaan. Bi làá nīn pée téetí a-pu ní abin abin.

english_verse: The Lord will bring justice and show mercy to all who serve him.
translation_verse: Di sá yii ti-Dindaan sòoǹ ki pɔ̀ u-nibul, u sūǹ u-tɔntɔnliibi saai.

english_verse: Idols of silver and gold are made and worshiped in other nations.
translation_verse: Animbil kúti nì sindaariya ní bi dūu mɔ́ɔ́ atimbun ŋin kíǹee waaŋi, binib di dū bi-ŋalii ki mɔ́ɔ́-ŋi.

english_verse: They have a mouth and eyes, but they can't speak or see.
translation_verse: Ŋi cáá kinyɔkɔ, ní kaa sòoǹ. Ŋi cáá animbil, ní kaa wāĺ.

english_verse: They are completely deaf, and they can't breathe.
translation_verse: Ŋi cáá atafal, ní kaa gbìl̀. Báà kufoou kaa bí ŋi-nyɔmmun!

english_verse: Everyone who makes idols and all who trust them will end up as helpless as their idols.
translation_verse: Bin mɔ́ɔ́-ŋee ń nīn bí kii ŋi nín bí puee, ki kpáaǹ bin kɔkɔ máká ŋi-puee.

english_verse: Everyone in Israel, come praise the Lord! All the family of Aaron
translation_verse: Isirayeel yab, jāam̀maan ti-Dindaan. Aarɔn naantiibi, jāam̀maan ti-Dindaan.

english_verse: and all the tribe of Levi, come praise the Lord! All of his worshipers, come praise the Lord.
translation_verse: Leefii yab, jāam̀maan ti-Dindaan. Nimbi bin fàŋkí ti-Dindaanee, jāam̀maan ti-Dindaan.

english_verse: Praise the Lord from Zion! He lives here in Jerusalem. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Jāam̀maan ti-Dindaan un kóò Jeerusaleem Siiyɔn jool puee. Aleeluya, nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan ti-Dindaan!

english_verse: Praise the Lord! He is good. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan ti-Dindaan, di sá yii u ŋān̄, u-neeŋkpaandi bí ní ki cá jaanjaan.

english_verse: Praise the God of all gods. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan inimbɔti kɔkɔ Nimbɔtiu, di sá yii u-neeŋkpaandi bí ní ki cá jaanjaan.

english_verse: Praise the Lord of lords. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan bidindambi kɔkɔ Dindaan, di sá yii u-neeŋkpaandi bí ní ki cá jaanjaan.

english_verse: Only God works great miracles. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Úǹ baba di ŋá bimaamaacikpaambi, di sá yii u-neeŋkpaandi bí ní ki cá jaanjaan.

english_verse: With wisdom he made the sky. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: U dū u-ciiŋyi ní ki náań yilpu, di sá yii u-neeŋkpaandi bí ní ki cá jaanjaan.

english_verse: The Lord stretched the earth over the ocean. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: U kpátì kitiŋ ki páaǹ inyiŋfi pu, di sá yii u-neeŋkpaandi bí ní ki cá jaanjaan.

english_verse: He made the bright lights in the sky. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: U ŋá iwalfi ikpaan: di sá yii u-neeŋkpaandi bí ní ki cá jaanjaan,

english_verse: He lets the sun rule each day. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: ŋwìiń ŋú nīn bí ŋwiimpu ki ŋmíntí, di sá yii u-neeŋkpaandi bí ní ki cá jaanjaan,

english_verse: He lets the moon and the stars rule each night. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: uŋmal nì iŋmalbijaa í nīn bí kunyeeu ki ŋmíntí, di sá yii u-neeŋkpaandi bí ní ki cá jaanjaan.

english_verse: God struck down the first-born in every Egyptian family. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: U kūū Eejipiti yab biseebiyaamu nninjabiyaamu, di sá yii u-neeŋkpaandi bí ní ki cá jaanjaan.

english_verse: He rescued Israel from Egypt. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: U nìn nyántì Isirayeel yab kitiŋ gbantin, di sá yii u-neeŋkpaandi bí ní ki cá jaanjaan.

english_verse: God used his great strength and his powerful arm. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Nì atuŋkpaan nì mpɔŋkpaan tuuŋŋi ní u nìn dūu ŋá míǹ, di sá yii u-neeŋkpaandi bí ní ki cá jaanjaan.

english_verse: He split the Red Sea apart. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: U nìn cúú Tikati mɔɔl ki yākatì mili, di sá yii u-neeŋkpaandi bí ní ki cá jaanjaan,

english_verse: The Lord brought Israel safely through the sea. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: ki yāntì Isirayeel yab cōom̀ ki jítì, di sá yii u-neeŋkpaandi bí ní ki cá jaanjaan.

english_verse: He destroyed the Egyptian king and his army there. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ama u nìn yāntì Faaroo nì u-janjaliibi gbíntì niin, di sá yii u-neeŋkpaandi bí ní ki cá jaanjaan.

english_verse: The Lord led his people through the desert. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: U nìn kpōotì u-nibul bi jítì kuteeu pu, di sá yii u-neeŋkpaandi bí ní ki cá jaanjaan.

english_verse: Our God defeated mighty kings. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: U nìn nāaǹ bibɔtikpaambi, di sá yii u-neeŋkpaandi bí ní ki cá jaanjaan,

english_verse: And he killed famous kings. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: u nìn kūū bibɔtiibi bin cáá mpɔnee, di sá yii u-neeŋkpaandi bí ní ki cá jaanjaan.

english_verse: One of them was Sihon, king of the Amorites. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Bíǹ di sá Amɔɔr yab bɔtiu Siiwɔn, di sá yii u-neeŋkpaandi bí ní ki cá jaanjaan,

english_verse: Another was King Og of Bashan. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: nì Baasan bɔtiu Ɔɔgi, di sá yii u-neeŋkpaandi bí ní ki cá jaanjaan.

english_verse: God took away their land. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: U nìn dū bi-timmu ki tīī difakal, di sá yii u-neeŋkpaandi bí ní ki cá jaanjaan,

english_verse: He gave their land to Israel, the people who serve him. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: ki tīī u-tɔntɔnliibi Isirayeel yab bí nīn yì, di sá yii u-neeŋkpaandi bí ní ki cá jaanjaan.

english_verse: God saw the trouble we were in. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: U nìn téetì ti-pu ŋyunti ŋun bi nìn sīntiǹ-ti taapuee, di sá yii u-neeŋkpaandi bí ní ki cá jaanjaan,

english_verse: He rescued us from our enemies. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: ní ki nyántì-ti ti-nannanliibi ŋaan, di sá yii u-neeŋkpaandi bí ní ki cá jaanjaan.

english_verse: He gives food to all who live. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: U tìì tiwan tin kɔkɔ cáá kufoouee tijin tì jīǹ, di sá yii u-neeŋkpaandi bí ní ki cá jaanjaan.

english_verse: Praise God in heaven! God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Tí nyɔ̄ŋkì yilpu Nimbɔtiu, di sá yii u-neeŋkpaandi bí ní ki cá jaanjaan!

english_verse: Beside the rivers of Babylon we thought about Jerusalem, and we sat down and cried.
translation_verse: Ti nìn kā niin Babiloon mɔɔŋi gbaŋŋi, ki sūǹ ki téetí Siiyɔn pu.

english_verse: We hung our small harps on the willow trees.
translation_verse: Ti nìn dū ti-bati ki sākaǹ isufi in nìn bí niinee pu.

english_verse: Our enemies had brought us here as their prisoners; now they wanted us to sing and entertain them. They insulted us and shouted, “Sing about Zion!”
translation_verse: Niin ní bin nìn cúú-ti kuyuŋuee nìn bālifì-ti yii tí gāā ilan. Bin nìn sàantí-tee nìn bālifì-ti yii tí gāā dipɔɔpindi laŋyi. Bi nìn lī yii: «Gāāmaan-ti Siiyɔn laŋyi iba!»

english_verse: Here in a foreign land, how can we sing about the Lord?
translation_verse: - Ama mana ní ti làá ŋmā kí gāā ti-Dindaan laŋŋu kitincaŋ poon?

english_verse: Jerusalem, if I forget you, let my right hand go limp.
translation_verse: Jeerusaleem, daliŋkin m yaa súntì a-puee, m-ŋaŋgiil ń fáká!

english_verse: Let my tongue stick to the roof of my mouth, if I don't think about you above all else.
translation_verse: M yaa kaa bíi dàkafī a-pu, Jeerusaleem yaa kaa kpántì m-pɔɔpindi kɔkɔee, m-limbil ń nákań m-lammi!

english_verse: Our Lord, punish the Edomites! On the day Jerusalem fell, they shouted, “Completely destroy the city! Tear down every building!”
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, taa súntí Eedoom yab nín ŋá pu ŋwiin ŋun bi jáń ki fōō Jeerusaleemee. Bi nìn bí ki lì yii: «Ní kpēelikì kitiŋ nee, ní kpēelikì-kì kí kpáaǹ ki-nyeel!»

english_verse: Babylon, you are doomed! I pray the Lord's blessings on anyone who punishes you for what you did to us.
translation_verse: Babiloon yab, nnaabu dɔ̄ ki cí-ni, bin làá téeǹ-si tikpitil tin a ŋá-tee bí mmɔnneeee!

english_verse: May the Lord bless everyone who beats your children against the rocks!
translation_verse: Bin làá cúú a-bipɔmmu kí páań ditaŋkpal pu kí nèe bí mmɔnni!

english_verse: With all my heart I praise you, Lord. In the presence of angels I sing your praises.
translation_verse: Daafiidi di ŋmàn̄ nlan nee. Ti-Dindaan, m làá nyɔ̄ŋkì-si nì m-pɔbil kɔkɔ. M làá gāā ilan kí pàkà-si inimbɔti nimbiin.

english_verse: I worship at your holy temple and praise you for your love and your faithfulness. You were true to your word and made yourself more famous than ever before.
translation_verse: M làá gbàan̄ a-circir diikun, a-neeŋkpaandi nì a-deedeeu puee, m làá pàkà-si, di sá yii a ŋá a nín pōoǹ puee ki jítiǹ min ti bàà dàkafēe.

english_verse: When I asked for your help, you answered my prayer and gave me courage.
translation_verse: Ŋwiin ŋun m yíiń-see, a kíí-mi, a tīī-mi kunyannyaau nì mpɔn.

english_verse: All kings on this earth have heard your promises, Lord, and they will praise you.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, kitiŋ pu bɔtiibi kɔkɔ ń nyɔ̄ŋkì-si, ŋyunti ŋun bi yaa gbìl̄ a-nyɔkɔ poon nyɔɔbuŋŋee!

english_verse: You are so famous that they will sing about the things you have done.
translation_verse: Bí gāā ilan kí pàkà ti-Dindaan tuuŋŋi yii: «Ti-Dindaan nyooti wīikéeee!

english_verse: Though you are above us all, you care for humble people, and you keep a close watch on everyone who is proud.
translation_verse: Min kamaa ti-Dindaan bíń yilpu yilpuee, u wāĺ un sīntiǹ u-ba taapuee, u bí ndandati ní ki nyí un yòontí u-ba yilpuee.»

english_verse: I am surrounded by trouble, but you protect me against my angry enemies. With your own powerful arm you keep me safe.
translation_verse: M yaa bí dinimbinaamandinaaa, a tìì-mi dimaŋfal. A tàntī a-ŋal ki jáà nì m-nannanliibi, ní ki cáá a-ŋaŋgiil ki fìil̄-mi.

english_verse: You, Lord, will always treat me with kindness. Your love never fails. You have made us what we are. Don't give up on us now!
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan làá ŋá tikɔkɔ kí tīī-mi. Ti-Dindaan, a-neeŋkpaandi bí ní ki cá jaanjaan. Taa fá bin a dū a-ŋal ki náańee.

english_verse: You have looked deep into my heart, Lord, and you know all about me.
translation_verse: Daafiidi di ŋmàn̄ nlan nee ki tīī bilaŋgaaliibi kpiliu. Ti-Dindaan, a cɔ́ŋkì-mi ki béè-mi.

english_verse: You know when I am resting or when I am working, and from heaven you discover my thoughts.
translation_verse: M yaa kāaa, m yaa yíkàaa, a nyí, a bí ndandati ní ki nyí m-landɔkɔi.

english_verse: You notice everything I do and everywhere I go.
translation_verse: M yaa còom̄aaa, m yaa dɔ̄ ki gèeǹaaa, a nyí, a nyí tin kɔkɔ m ŋáańee.

english_verse: Before I even speak a word, you know what I will say,
translation_verse: Maa láá wāaǹ kinyɔkɔ ki lī tiba ní a nyí tin kɔkɔ m là kí lèe.

english_verse: and with your powerful arm you protect me from every side.
translation_verse: A bí m-boon ki bí m-nyɔkɔpu, a dū a-ŋal ki páaǹ m-pu.

english_verse: I can't understand all of this! Such wonderful knowledge is far above me.
translation_verse: A nín nyí-mi pu tikpilee cáá-mi maamaaci, an jítì m-landɔkɔŋu pu ḿ ŋmā kí gbìl̄ taapu.

english_verse: Where could I go to escape from your Spirit or from your sight?
translation_verse: La ní m ŋūǹ kí cù kí nīn dátiǹ a-Fam ní? La ní m ŋūǹ kí sāǹ kí cù ní aa bí niin ní?

english_verse: If I were to climb up to the highest heavens, you would be there. If I were to dig down to the world of the dead you would also be there.
translation_verse: M yaa nín jɔ́ḿ yilpuɔɔɔ, a bí niin, m yaa tí dɔ̄ ditaŋkpiilinaaa, a bí niin.

english_verse: Suppose I had wings like the dawning day and flew across the ocean.
translation_verse: M yaa túkú ifeen ki ŋàan̄ ki búntì ditiŋkugbandi lapu pu yal kí nīn kóòyaaa,

english_verse: Even then your powerful arm would guide and protect me.
translation_verse: a-ŋal bí niin mun kí kpòotī-mi, a-ŋaŋgiil bí niin kí tíkiń-mi.

english_verse: Or suppose I said, “I'll hide in the dark until night comes to cover me over.”
translation_verse: M yaa bí yii: «Dibɔmbɔndi ń dāá bìin̄ m-pu, ŋwalifi ŋun māntìi tú-mee ń kpántí kunyeeuaaa!»

english_verse: But you see in the dark because daylight and dark are all the same to you.
translation_verse: sii ceeyee, dibɔmbɔndi kaa sá dibɔmbɔndi, ní kunyeeu wāĺ kii ŋwìińee. Dibɔmbɔndi nì ŋwalifi sá sii cee tiwambaantiil ní.

english_verse: You are the one who put me together inside my mother's body,
translation_verse: Sii di náań m-landɔkɔjaatiŋu, sii di máń-mi ki tākaǹ m-na poon.

english_verse: and I praise you because of the wonderful way you created me. Everything you do is marvelous! Of this I have no doubt.
translation_verse: M jáaḿ-si, kun puee a náań-mi ní m-wunti sá maamaaci ní ki ŋān̄ tikpil. A-tuuŋŋi sá maamaaci tuuŋŋi, m nyí míǹ tiŋan.

english_verse: Nothing about me is hidden from you! I was secretly woven together out of human sight,
translation_verse: Ŋyunti ŋun a nìn bíi nāantí-mi dibalin, ní ki nìn bíi māā-mi ki tàkantí m-na poonee, m-wunti laaba kaa nìn bí dibalin a-cee.

english_verse: but with your own eyes you saw my body being formed. Even before I was born, you had written in your book everything about me.
translation_verse: Ŋyunti ŋun m nìn dáá sá nnaantee, a nìn wāĺ-mi. Kí wàatī iwiin in a tīī-mi ḿ dūú kàl̄ kitiŋ puee ń kíĺee, a nìn ŋmàn̄ i-nyɔkɔm ki ŋá a-gbɔŋkun ki síiǹ.

english_verse: Your thoughts are far beyond my understanding, much more than I could ever imagine.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti, a-landɔkɔi pɔ̄ɔ̄ ḿ ŋmā kí gbìl̄ taapu, i wīikí ní an kaa cáá ŋkaan.

english_verse: I try to count your thoughts, but they outnumber the grains of sand on the beach. And when I awake, I will find you nearby.
translation_verse: M yaa bí yii ḿ kàaǹ-iee, i làá nīn wīikí ki jítiǹ dibul pu. M yaa fīntèe, m gbíntìi bí a-cee.

english_verse: How I wish that you would kill all cruel and heartless people and protect me from them!
translation_verse: Unimbɔti, an sá á kúntí binikpitib ní kí jà binikpɔliibi kí wàatī-mi.

english_verse: They are always rebelling and speaking evil of you.
translation_verse: Bi cáá a-yindi ki ŋmàtíǹ binib ní, bi yíì a-yindi ki cáa ŋáań ikpiti.

english_verse: You know I hate anyone who hates you, Lord, and refuses to obey.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, mana ní ḿ taa nín̄ ná bin ná-see, maa là kí ká bin jáà nì see.

english_verse: They are my enemies too, and I truly hate them.
translation_verse: M baasii ná-bi ní, bi kpántì man m-ba nannanliibi ní.

english_verse: Look deep into my heart, God, and find out everything I am thinking.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti, kpèè m-pɔbil poon kí béé-mi, cɔ̄ŋkì-mi ní kí béé m-landɔkɔi.

english_verse: Don't let me follow evil ways, but lead me in the way that time has proven true.
translation_verse: Kpèè m yaa tàkā nsaŋkpiti poon, ní kí kpòotī-mi kí tàkan̄ a-saŋŋu pu.

english_verse: Rescue me from cruel and violent enemies, Lord!
translation_verse: Daafiidi di ŋmàn̄ nlan nee ki tīī bilaŋgaaliibi kpiliu.

english_verse: They think up evil plans and always cause trouble.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, fīī-mi kí nyāntí binikpitib ŋaan, wúń m-pu bin dàkà tipɔmbɔtee cee.

english_verse: Their words bite deep like the poisonous fangs of a snake.
translation_verse: Bi pée dàkafī kí ŋá tikpitil ŋma ní, baabadalee, bi jāantí binib ní.

english_verse: Protect me, Lord, from cruel and brutal enemies, who want to destroy me.
translation_verse: Bi-limbiliŋ jītí kii ukoobuee, ukoowaati looti kā bi-nyɔkɔn.

english_verse: Those proud people have hidden traps and nets to catch me as I walk.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, taa yàntī ḿ kɔ́ binikpitib ŋaan. Bin dàkà tipɔmbɔti, ki nyàab̀ ḿ lítée ceeyee, wúń m-pu.

english_verse: You, Lord, are my God! Please listen to my prayer.
translation_verse: Bilambidambi píĺ-mi kutaliŋŋu. Bi dū iŋmii nì kulaaŋŋu ki píĺ-mi nsan caŋin, bi píĺ-mi kpalaabi.

english_verse: You have the power to save me, and you keep me safe in every battle.
translation_verse: Ama m bí ti-Dindaan yii: «A sá m-Nimbɔtiu! Ti-Dindaan, kpòon̄ a-tafal kí pīlifì m-gbaamii.

english_verse: Don't let the wicked succeed in doing what they want, or else they might never stop planning evil.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan Unimbɔti, sii un di sá mpɔn ŋun fìil̄-mee, dikɔ̀ndi wiiŋŋuee, a bìintí m-yil pu.

english_verse: Dump flaming coals on them and throw them into pits where they can't climb out.
translation_verse: Yàntī bi nín sòon̄ kí ŋá-mi tikpitil tiŋyee ń fàtīí gítí bíǹ bi-ba yil pu!»

english_verse: Our Lord, I know that you defend the homeless and see that the poor are given justice.
translation_verse: Bin cāab̀ bi-jutiibi disambiilee kaa máaǹ kí kàl̄ kitiŋ nee poon. Nnaabu ń nīn pée kā unil un dàkà tipɔmbɔtee pu!

english_verse: Your people will praise you and will live with you because they do right.
translation_verse: M nyí yii ti-Dindaan làá sòoǹ unandaan bɔti kí tīī-u, u làá sòoǹ kí pɔ̀ ufalaadaan.

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord! Please listen when I pray and hurry to help me.
translation_verse: Daafiidi di ŋmàn̄ nlan nee. Ti-Dindaan, m kúuǹ ki yíiń-si, dāá jòoń-mi malaa, m yaa yíì-see, á kpòon̄ a-tafal kí pīlifiǹ-mi.

english_verse: Think of my prayer as sweet-smelling incense, and think of my lifted hands as an evening sacrifice.
translation_verse: Yàntī m-wimmeem ń nīn sá kii talaalu tūukaayee a-nimbiin, ní m-ŋalii in m yōoǹ yilpuee ń nīn sá kii kujoou saraauee.

english_verse: Help me to guard my words whenever I say something.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, ŋúb́ m-nyɔkɔ, nín̄ cí m-nyunculiŋ punyɔkɔ.

english_verse: Don't let me want to do evil or waste my time doing wrong with wicked people. Don't let me even taste the good things they offer.
translation_verse: Taa yàntī tibɔkpitil ń nyānní m-pɔbil poon, kí taa yàntī ḿ kūtì bikpitiŋaliibi pu kí ŋá atuŋkpiti. Maa làá dáká bi-jiŋaalib jinti.

english_verse: Let your faithful people correct and punish me. My prayers condemn the deeds of those who do wrong, so don't let me be friends with any of them.
translation_verse: Dineendi poonee, deedeedaan ŋūǹ kí fáá-mi, kí dáaĺ m-tafal, ama m yíì binikpitib ń dàkà-mi dineendi. Min kamaa bi bíi ŋáań ikpitee, m làá nīn gbíntìi mèé.

english_verse: Everyone will admit that I was right when their rulers are thrown down a rocky cliff,
translation_verse: Bi yaa láa dū bi-kpilib ki lúkú ditaŋkpal puee, m-nannanliibi làá dāá béé yii tin m nìn sòoǹee sá mbaamɔn.

english_verse: and their bones lie scattered like crushed rocks on top of a grave.
translation_verse: Kii kitiŋ nín fátí ŋwèeń puee, míǹ ní ditaŋkpiil làá wàan̄ kinyɔkɔ kí dū bi-kpabiŋ ŋin yàl̄ee kí náĺ.

english_verse: You are my Lord and God, and I look to you for safety. Don't let me be harmed.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan Unimbɔti, m-nimbikpeeŋu cɔ́ a-pu ní, sii ní m sáǹ ki kɔ́. Taa yàntī ḿ lántí dimaŋfal.

english_verse: Protect me from the traps of those violent people,
translation_verse: Nyāntí-mi kutaliŋŋu kun ní bi píĺ-mee nì bikpitiŋaliibi laanti poon.

english_verse: and make them fall into their own traps while you help me escape.
translation_verse: Bikpitiŋaliibi talinti làá fàtīí sàl̄-bi, ama man làá yùkū kí lákatí.

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord. I beg for mercy.
translation_verse: Daafiidi di ŋmàn̄ nlan nee. U nín nìn bí ntaŋkpalɔkɔnee ní u nìn mēē míǹ.

english_verse: I tell you all my worries and my troubles,
translation_verse: M fátí mbiil mpɔn ki yíì ti-Dindaan, m fátí mbiil mpɔn ki gbàam̄ ti-Dindaan.

english_verse: and whenever I feel low, you are there to guide me. A trap has been hidden along my pathway.
translation_verse: M dū m-yaliŋkii ki bíl̀ u-nimbiin, m dū m-nimbinaamandi ki bíl̀ u-nimbiin.

english_verse: Even if you look, you won't see anyone who cares enough to walk beside me. There is no place to hide, and no one who really cares.
translation_verse: M-wunti yaa yɔ̄tèe, sii nyí laakin m cée. Nsan ŋun poon m tàkēe, bi píĺ-mi kutaliŋŋu.

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord! You are my place of safety, and you are my choice in the land of the living. Please answer my prayer. I am completely helpless.
translation_verse: Kpèè m-ŋaŋgiil pú, a làá ká yii, báà ubɔ kaa nyí-mi. Maa cáá laakin m làá sāǹ kí báĺee, m-bɔti kaa ká báà ubɔ.

english_verse: Rescue me from this prison, so I can praise your name. And when your people notice your wonderful kindness to me, they will rush to my side.
translation_verse: Pīlifì m-biilii, di sá yii m gbí falaa! Fīī-mi kí nyāntí bin sàantí-mee ŋaan, di sá yii bi pɔ̄ɔ̄ ki jítiǹ-mi.

english_verse: Listen, Lord, as I pray! You are faithful and honest and will answer my prayer.
translation_verse: Daafiidi di ŋmàn̄ nlan nee. Ti-Dindaan, pīlifì m-wimmeem, kpòon̄ a-tafal kí pīlifì m-gbaamii. A nín ŋān̄ ki sá deedeedaan puee, kíí-mi.

english_verse: I am your servant. Don't try me in your court, because no one is innocent by your standards.
translation_verse: Taa sòoǹ man a-tɔntɔnliu bɔti, di sá yii unifoo ubɔ kaa bí ki sá deedeedaan a-nimbiin.

english_verse: My enemies are chasing me, crushing me in the ground. I am in total darkness, like someone long dead.
translation_verse: M-nannanliu sāaǹ-mi, u dū-mi ki lúkú kitiŋ ki tàn̄ tàn̄. U yāntì m kɔ́ dibɔmbɔndin kii bin kpíì dooooyee.

english_verse: I have given up hope, and I feel numb all over.
translation_verse: M-wunti yɔ̄tì, maa ti cáá mpɔn.

english_verse: I remember to think about the many things you did in years gone by.
translation_verse: M téetí iyunti in jítèe pu, m dàkafī tin kɔkɔ a ŋée pu, m dàkafī a-tuuŋŋi pu.

english_verse: Then I lift my hands in prayer, because my soul is a desert, thirsty for water from you.
translation_verse: M yōoǹ m-ŋal ki túĺ-si, m fèefī ki nyàab̀-si kii kitiŋ nín fèefī ki nyàab̀ utaa puee.

english_verse: Please hurry, Lord, and answer my prayer. I feel hopeless. Don't turn away and leave me here to die.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, kíí-mi malaa, maa ti cáá ŋfam. Taa fàtī a-boon kí tīī-mi, an yaa kaa sá mimmee, an dóò m-pu.

english_verse: Each morning let me learn more about your love because I trust you. I come to you in prayer, asking for your guidance.
translation_verse: Yàntī ḿ gbìl̄ a-neeŋkpaandi pu kutaafaau, di sá yii sii pu ní m máká. Dàkà-mi nsan ŋun m máaǹ kí nóóyee, di sá yii sii watil pú ní m fātì m-ba ki túĺ.

english_verse: Please rescue me from my enemies, Lord! I come to you for safety.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, fīī-mi kí nyāntí m-nannanliibi ŋaan, sii ní m sáǹ ki kɔ́.

english_verse: You are my God. Show me what you want me to do, and let your gentle Spirit lead me in the right path.
translation_verse: Bīfì-mi ḿ ŋmā kí ŋá tin fáatiǹ-see, di sá yii sii di sá m-Nimbɔtiu. A-Fam ŋān̄ ní, mí kpòotī-mi kí dī kitiŋ kin kaa cáá diganlakalee pu.

english_verse: I am your servant. Show how much you love me by destroying my enemies.
translation_verse: A-neeŋkpaandi poonee, a làá kúntí m-nannanliibi, kí kpɔ̀ bin jáà nì mee kɔkɔ, di sá yii m sá a-tɔntɔnliu ní.

english_verse: I praise you, Lord! You are my mighty rock, and you teach me how to fight my battles.
translation_verse: Daafiidi di ŋmàn̄ nlan nee. M jáaḿ ti-Dindaan, m-taŋkpanaakooku! U dàkà-mi bi nín jáà kujaau puee, u bɔ́ntí-mi ki cīití dikɔ̀ndi wiiŋŋu.

english_verse: You are my friend, my fortress, where I am safe. You are my shield, and you made me the ruler of our people.
translation_verse: U sá m-mákal nì m-taŋkpanaakooku, ki sá m-balilaŋki nì m-fiiliu, ki sá m-gbampɔɔl, úǹ ní m sáń ki kóò. Úǹ di dū m-nibooliŋu ki ŋá m-taapu.

english_verse: Why do we humans mean anything to you, our Lord? Why do you care about us?
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, unil sá ba ní u-bɔti páb́-si míǹ, nisaal sá ba ní a dàkafī u-pu míǹ?

english_verse: We disappear like a breath; we last no longer than a faint shadow.
translation_verse: Unil náań nì kubuŋu ní, ní u-wiiŋyi bí kii mboon nín jītí puee.

english_verse: Open the heavens like a curtain and come down, Lord. Touch the mountains and make them send up smoke.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, kpáb́ kutagbɔŋu kí kpákatiń. Gbēē ajoon ŋí nīn bíi dùkù.

english_verse: Use your lightning as arrows to scatter my enemies and make them run away.
translation_verse: Yàntī utaa ń ŋmɔ́ kí jà a-nannanliibi kí yàaǹ, tɔ̄ń a-piiŋyi kí jà-bi bí sāǹ.

english_verse: Reach down from heaven and set me free. Save me from the mighty flood
translation_verse: Tàntī a-ŋal doooo yilpu kí fīī-mi. Fīī-mi kí nyāntí nnyiŋkpaam nee ni, nì binicambi ŋaan.

english_verse: of those lying foreigners who never tell the truth.
translation_verse: Bíǹ bin nyɔmmu sòoǹ tinyimɔmbɔti ní bi yaa yōoǹ bi-ŋaŋgiil ki pūtì bi mɔ́ntée.

english_verse: In praise of you, our God, I will sing a new song, while playing my harp.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti, m làá gāā nlampɔɔn kí nyɔ̄ŋkì-si, m làá bɔ̀ɔ̀ iŋmii saalaa beeku kí tīī-si tinyool.

english_verse: By your power, kings win wars, and your servant David is saved from deadly swords.
translation_verse: Sii di tìì bibɔtiibi dijajil, sii di fīī a-tɔntɔnliu Daafiidi kitàataajiki kin kùee cee ki líì.

english_verse: Won't you keep me safe from those lying foreigners who never tell the truth?
translation_verse: Fīī-mi kí nyāntí binicambi bin nyɔmmu sòoǹ tinyimɔmbɔti, ní bi yaa yōoǹ bi-ŋaŋgiil ki pūtì bi mɔ́ntée ŋaan.

english_verse: Let's pray that our young sons will grow like strong plants and that our daughters will be as lovely as columns in the corner of a palace.
translation_verse: Yàntī bi-pɔntinee, ti-jipɔmbi ń nīn bí kii isufi in wíiǹ tiŋanee, ní ti-bisalib ń nīn bí kii jaantalkub bin bi kpítì ki dūu nyáantì kubɔtinaakoouee!

english_verse: May our barns be filled with all kinds of crops. May our fields be covered with sheep by the thousands,
translation_verse: Yàntī ti-cakalaabi ń gbí, kí nīn cáá tijin kɔkɔ nì ti-bulifi! Yàntī ti-piii nì ti-ŋoobui ń bùtī ŋfunyɔm kutuku pu, ŋfunyɔm kutukub saalaa pu ti-naakpaapɔɔkun!

english_verse: and every cow have calves. Don't let our city be captured or any of us be taken away, and don't let cries of sorrow be heard in our streets.
translation_verse: Ti-naai ń nīn bí màlmal! Ti-tiŋki guŋŋi ń taa bátí kí lítáaa, bí taa cúú-ti kuyuŋuaaa, kí taa gbìl̄ binib gbáà ibiil ti-mɔŋkijaai pu!

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, you give these blessings to all who worship you.
translation_verse: Dinibul din cáá tin bí nee kɔkɔee bí mmɔnneeee! Dinibul din Nimbɔtiu sá ti-Dindaanee bí mmɔnni!

english_verse: I will praise you, my God and King, and always honor your name.
translation_verse: Daafiidi di ŋmàn̄ inyɔŋki laŋŋu nee. M-Nimbɔtiu, m-bɔtiu, m làá yòon̄ a-yindi yilpu, m làá jāam̀-si kí nīn cáa cá jaanjaan.

english_verse: I will praise you each day and always honor your name.
translation_verse: M làá nīn jáaḿ-si baabadal ní kí nīn nyɔ́ŋkí a-yindi kí taa gbèen̄.

english_verse: You are wonderful, Lord, and you deserve all praise, because you are much greater than anyone can understand.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan sá ukpaan ní ki máaǹ inyɔŋki, baa ŋūǹ kí dū u nín sá ukpaan puee kí ŋmàntīǹ tiba.

english_verse: Each generation will announce to the next your wonderful and powerful deeds.
translation_verse: Ŋyunti ŋubɔ poon nib làá sòoǹ a-tuuŋŋi pu kí nàatī ŋun làá dāá páańee yab, bi làá māafì a-tuŋkpaaŋŋi ŋin a túńee!

english_verse: I will keep thinking about your marvelous glory and your mighty miracles.
translation_verse: M làá sòoǹ kí gíti sòoǹ a-nyooti nín ŋān̄ puee pu, m làá sòoǹ kí bùsì a-maamaaci tuuŋŋi pu.

english_verse: Everyone will talk about your fearsome deeds, and I will tell all nations how great you are.
translation_verse: Bi làá sòoǹ a-pɔŋkpaaŋŋu pu! Mamee, m làá māafì a-tuŋkpaaŋŋi pu.

english_verse: They will celebrate and sing about your matchless mercy and your power to save.
translation_verse: Bí téetí a-ŋaŋkpaanti pu, bí nīn gà ilan ki fàal̀ a nín sá deedeedaanee pu.

english_verse: You are merciful, Lord! You are kind and patient and always loving.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan poon mɔ̄ ní ki cáá kulaŋŋaŋfitiiu, waa gífí diŋuul malaa ní u-neendi wīikí tikpilku.

english_verse: You are good to everyone, and you take care of all your creation.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan ŋān̄ ki tīī báà ŋma, u-poon mɔ̄ u-wannaaŋkaati kɔkɔ pu.

english_verse: All creation will thank you, and your loyal people will praise you.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, a-wannaaŋkaati kɔkɔ ń nyɔ̄ŋkì-si, bin yú nì si deedeeyee ń jāam̀-si!

english_verse: They will tell about your marvelous kingdom and your power.
translation_verse: Bí lì yii a-beel cáá tinyool, bí sòoǹ a-pɔŋŋu pu!

english_verse: Then everyone will know about the mighty things you do and your glorious kingdom.
translation_verse: Mimmee bi làá yàntī binib ń béé a-tuŋkpaaŋŋi, nì a-beel nyooti nín jìl̀ puee.

english_verse: Your kingdom will never end, and you will rule forever. Our Lord, you keep your word and do everything you say.
translation_verse: A-beel sá jaanjaan beel ní, a-pɔŋŋu bí ní ki cá abin abin. Ti-Dindaan yaa pōoǹ kí ŋá puee, míǹ ní u ŋáań, u dàkà u-neendi u-tuuŋŋi kɔkɔ poon.

english_verse: When someone stumbles or falls, you give a helping hand.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan di tīkintí bin kɔkɔ cá kí lítée, úǹ di yáatí bin bōōyee.

english_verse: Everyone depends on you, and when the time is right, you provide them with food.
translation_verse: Bi-kɔkɔ nimbikpeeŋu cɔ́ a-pu nì dimákal, ní a tìì-bi tijin ŋyunti ŋun an máaǹee.

english_verse: By your own hand you satisfy the desires of all who live.
translation_verse: Sii di tàntī a-ŋal ní ki tìì tin kɔkɔ cáá kufoouee tijin tí jī kí díkí.

english_verse: Our Lord, everything you do is kind and thoughtful,
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan sá deedeedaan tin u ŋáańee kɔkɔ poon, u dàkà u-neendi u-tuuŋŋi kɔkɔ poon.

english_verse: and you are near to everyone whose prayers are sincere.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan pìlīǹ bin kɔkɔ yíì-uee, bin yíì-u nì mbaamɔnee.

english_verse: You satisfy the desires of all your worshipers, and you come to save them when they ask for help.
translation_verse: Bin fàŋkí-uee yaa là kuŋyee, u ŋáań ki tìì-bi ní, u pílifí bi-biilii ní ki fìil̄-bi.

english_verse: You take care of everyone who loves you, but you destroy the wicked.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan wúǹ bin kɔkɔ néeń-uee pu, ama u làá kpɔ̀ kí céetí binikpitib kɔkɔ.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, and everyone will respect your holy name forever.
translation_verse: M làá gāā ilan kí nyɔ̄ŋkì ti-Dindaan, tin kɔkɔ cáá kufoouee ń jāam̀ u-circir yindi kí nīn pée cá jaanjaan.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! With all that I am, I will shout his praises.
translation_verse: Aleeluya, nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan ti-Dindaan! M làá nyɔ̄ŋkì ti-Dindaan nì m-naŋki kɔkɔ!

english_verse: I will sing and praise the Lord God as long as I live.
translation_verse: M làá nīn nyɔ́ŋkí ti-Dindaan m-maŋfal wiiŋyi kɔkɔ poon, ŋyunti ŋun ní m bí dimaŋfalinee, m làá nīn nyɔ́ŋkí m-Nimbɔtiu ní.

english_verse: You can't depend on anyone, not even a great leader.
translation_verse: Ní taa nín̄ máká abɔtibil, àá unil un kaa cáá mpɔn kí fīīyee pu.

english_verse: Once they die and are buried, that will be the end of all their plans.
translation_verse: Bi yaa kpíì ki fātìi gítì ntaminee, tin bi nìn bɔ́ntì kí ŋée mun kúntì dee.

english_verse: The Lord God of Jacob blesses everyone who trusts him and depends on him.
translation_verse: Un jòońliu sá Jaakɔb Nimbɔtiu ní udaan máká ti-Dindaan u-Nimbɔtiu puee bí mmɔnneeee!

english_verse: God made heaven and earth; he created the sea and everything else. God always keeps his word.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan di náań yilpu nì taapu, nì tiŋku nì tin kɔkɔ bí u-poonee. Úǹ di ŋúb́ ibaamɔn kí nīn cá jaanjaan.

english_verse: He gives justice to the poor and food to the hungry. The Lord sets prisoners free
translation_verse: U sòoǹ ki ŋáŋkí bin bi sàantée bɔti, u tìì bin ŋkùm cááyee tijin. Ti-Dindaan tìì bisarkadambi dibatɔl,

english_verse: and heals blind eyes. He gives a helping hand to everyone who falls. The Lord loves good people
translation_verse: ti-Dindaan ŋúbití bijɔfub nimbiliŋ, ti-Dindaan yáatí bin bōōyee, ti-Dindaan néeń deedeedambi.

english_verse: and looks after strangers. He defends the rights of orphans and widows, but destroys the wicked.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan wúǹ binikɔkaabi pu, u tīkintí ditaŋkpiibil nì ukpiipu, ama u yàntī binikpitib nín bɔ́ntì tiŋyee ŋáań fám.

english_verse: The Lord God of Zion will rule forever! Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan sá ubɔti ní kí nīn cá jaanjaan. Siiyɔn, u sá a-Nimbɔtiu ní kí nīn cá abin abin. Aleeluya, nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan ti-Dindaan!

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! Shout the Lord's praises in the highest heavens.
translation_verse: Aleeluya, nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan ti-Dindaan! Nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan ti-Dindaan doooo yilpu, nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan-u yilpu yilpu.

english_verse: All of you angels, and all who serve him above, come and offer praise.
translation_verse: Nimbi u-tuuŋyi kɔkɔ, nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan-u, nimbi u-janjakitil kɔkɔ, nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan-u.

english_verse: Sun and moon, and all of you bright stars, come and offer praise.
translation_verse: Ŋwìiń nì uŋmal, nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan-u, nimbi iŋmalbijaa in jìl̀ee, nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan-u.

english_verse: Highest heavens, and the water above the highest heavens, come and offer praise.
translation_verse: Nimbi yilpu yilpu fɔ́ŋŋŋ, nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan-u, nimbi inyiŋfi in bí yilpu yilpuee, nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan-u.

english_verse: Let all things praise the name of the Lord, because they were created at his command.
translation_verse: Bi-kɔkɔ ń nyɔ̄ŋkì ti-Dindaan yindi, di sá yii u nìn tīī mara ní tiwan gbanti kɔkɔ náań.

english_verse: He made them to last forever, and nothing can change what he has done.
translation_verse: U dū-tì ki kāaǹ ti-paaŋyi kí nīn cáa cá jaanjaan, u síiǹ-tì mara un kaa bí kí kpántée.

english_verse: All creatures on earth, you obey his commands, so come praise the Lord!
translation_verse: Nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan ti-Dindaan, doooo taapu, tiŋkub nì tiŋku poon peebilinti,

english_verse: Sea monsters and the deep sea, fire and hail, snow and frost, and every stormy wind, come praise the Lord!
translation_verse: nì ŋŋmi nì ditaanyiŋkumbil nì dipɔ̀ńdi nì kubuŋu nì kubuŋkpaaŋŋu kun bí u-nyɔɔbundi taapuee.

english_verse: All mountains and hills, fruit trees and cedars,
translation_verse: Nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan-u, ajoon nì ŋgbantamu, nì isufi in lòoǹ abilee nì seedir dɔi kɔkɔ,

english_verse: every wild and tame animal, all reptiles and birds, come praise the Lord!
translation_verse: nì ipeel nì tiwaŋkuti kɔkɔ, nì inoon nì tin fù ti-pool puee.

english_verse: Every king and every ruler, all nations on earth,
translation_verse: Nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan-u, kitiŋ pu bɔtiibi, nì anibul kɔkɔ, nì abɔtibil nì kitiŋ pu kpootiliibi kɔkɔ,

english_verse: every man and every woman, young people and old, come praise the Lord!
translation_verse: nì binaacimpɔmbi nì bisapɔmbi mun, nì bitikpilib nì mbiyaamu.

english_verse: All creation, come praise the name of the Lord. Praise his name alone. The glory of God is greater than heaven and earth.
translation_verse: Bí nyɔ̄ŋkì ti-Dindaan yindi, di sá yii úǹ baba yindi di sá diyiŋkpaandi, u-nyooti tɔ́kɔ́ kitiŋ nì yilpu pu.

english_verse: Like a bull with mighty horns, the Lord protects his faithful nation Israel, because they belong to him. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: U yāntì u-nibul yil kíǹ ki gáań. An sá dinyandi ní ki tīī bin kɔkɔ néeń-uee, Isirayeel yab, dinibul din pìlīǹ-uee. Aleeluya, nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan ti-Dindaan!

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! Sing him a new song of praise when his loyal people meet.
translation_verse: Aleeluya, nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan ti-Dindaan! Gāāmaan nlampɔɔn kí pàkà ti-Dindaan. Nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan ti-Dindaan bin néeń-uee kpafil poon!

english_verse: People of Israel, rejoice because of your Creator. People of Zion, celebrate because of your King.
translation_verse: Isirayeel yab, nín̄ fàal̀maan ni-náanliu pu, Siiyɔn yab, an nīn mɔ̄ǹ-ni ni-bɔtiu pu.

english_verse: Praise his name by dancing and playing music on harps and tambourines.
translation_verse: Bí nyɔ̄ŋkì ti-Dindaan nì diŋool, bí bɔ̀ɔ̀ kigaŋgaŋ nì kubeeu kí nyɔ̄ŋkì-u.

english_verse: The Lord is pleased with his people, and he gives victory to those who are humble.
translation_verse: Di sá yii ti-Dindaan nibul di tìì-u dipɔɔpindi, u tìì bin sīntiǹ bi-ba taapuee jilma ki fìil̄-bi.

english_verse: All of you faithful people, praise our glorious Lord! Celebrate and worship.
translation_verse: Bin néeń Unimbɔtee ń nīn fàal̀ kí nīn tìì-u tinyool! Báà bi yaa dɔ̄ bi-dooŋu puɔɔɔ, bí nīn gà ilan nì dipɔɔpindi!

english_verse: Praise God with songs on your lips and a sword in your hand.
translation_verse: Bí gāā ilan mpɔn kí yòon̄ Unimbɔti yilpu, kí nīn ŋúb́ bi-ŋaan kitàataajiki kin jītí ajan liitilee

english_verse: Take revenge and punish the nations.
translation_verse: kí tɔ̀ atimbun ipɔntoon, ní kí dáaĺ anibul tafal.

english_verse: Put chains of iron on their kings and rulers.
translation_verse: Bí bóob́ bi-bɔtiibi ikusaka ní kí bā bi-kàliŋkpilib akpambaa.

english_verse: Punish them as they deserve; this is the privilege of God's faithful people. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Bí dáaĺ atimbun gbanti tafal kii an nín ŋmàn̄ puee. An sá jilma ní ki tīī bin kɔkɔ néeń Unimbɔtee. Aleeluya, nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan ti-Dindaan!

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! Praise God in his temple. Praise him in heaven, his mighty fortress.
translation_verse: Aleeluya, nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan ti-Dindaan! Nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan Unimbɔti u-Circir kɔŋkooŋŋun, nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan-u u-pɔŋŋu ŋun bí kutagbɔŋunee pu!

english_verse: Praise our God! His deeds are wonderful, too marvelous to describe.
translation_verse: Nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan-u u-tuŋkpaaŋŋi pu, nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan-u u nín sá ukpaŋkpaanee pu!

english_verse: Praise God with trumpets and all kinds of harps.
translation_verse: Nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan-u nì dikantándi, nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan-u nì iŋmii saalaa beeku nì saŋgu.

english_verse: Praise him with tambourines and dancing, with stringed instruments and woodwinds.
translation_verse: Nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan-u nì kigaŋgaŋ nì diŋool, nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan-u nì tibati nì awul.

english_verse: Praise God with cymbals, with clashing cymbals.
translation_verse: Nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan-u nì cancakantib ŋwaamu, nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan-u nì cancakantib bikpaambi.

english_verse: Let every living creature praise the Lord. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Tin kɔkɔ pée cáá kufoouee ń nyɔ̄ŋkì ti-Dindaan! Aleeluya, nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan ti-Dindaan!

english_verse: These are the proverbs of King Solomon of Israel, the son of David.
translation_verse: Daafiidi jipɔɔn Saloomɔn un sá Isirayeel bɔtiuee laŋkpaŋŋi. Kun pu ní bi ŋmàn̄ kugbɔŋu neeyee

english_verse: Proverbs will teach you wisdom and self-control and how to understand sayings with deep meanings.
translation_verse: Alaŋkpan nee yàntī unil ń béé iciin kí dàkà-u ú nīn nyí tibɔti tin cáá taapuee.

english_verse: You will learn what is right and honest and fair.
translation_verse: Ŋi yàntī unil ń ká didàkamɔntiil, kí nīn bí deedee, kí nīn cáá tibulcin ní kí nīn nóó ibaamɔn saŋŋu.

english_verse: From these, an ordinary person can learn to be smart, and young people can gain knowledge and good sense.
translation_verse: Ŋi yàntī sɔkɔmii nib ń nīn wálifì, ki tìì binipɔmbi dinyil nì nlandɔkɔ.

english_verse: If you are already wise, you will become even wiser. And if you are smart, you will learn to understand
translation_verse: Uciŋfiti pílifí-ŋi ní ki mɔ̀tīi cíkití iciin, ní ŋi kpòotī unyil ki tàkantí nsammɔnti pu

english_verse: proverbs and sayings, as well as words of wisdom, and all kinds of riddles.
translation_verse: ú ŋmā kí béé alaŋkpan nì ipɔɔn nì biciŋfitiibi bɔti tin bí dibalin bi lèekī ki dàkèe.

english_verse: Respect and obey the Lord! This is the beginning of knowledge. Only a fool rejects wisdom and good advice. Warnings against Bad Friends
translation_verse: Á fàŋkì ti-Dindaan di sá iciin kílilaŋki. See bigbaambi tafal di kaa fātìi tɔ́ didàkal nì biciŋfitiibi saŋkii. Á nīn nyí nì a-ba nì binaacimpɔmbi bin dī isaŋkpitee

english_verse: My child, obey the teachings of your parents,
translation_verse: M-jipɔɔn, pīlifì a-baa dàkal, taa kpèè a-na dàkatam fám.

english_verse: and wear their teachings as you would a pretty hat or a lovely necklace.
translation_verse: Án di dāa sá kifuunyaaŋŋi ki cíkí a-yil, nì tiléeŋkaal tin a lá a-neenee.

english_verse: Don't be tempted by sinners or listen
translation_verse: M-jipɔɔn, bikpitiŋaliibi yaa là kí kīil̀-see, á taa kíí.

english_verse: when they say, “Come on! Let's gang up and kill somebody, just for the fun of it!
translation_verse: Bi yaa lī yii: «Dāan̄ kí nóó-ti tí cùú nákań nsanni, binib yaa jītée tí kpɔ̀-bi. Tí cùú píĺ kpaalaa kí cúú maanyiiba un kaa ŋá-ti tibee.

english_verse: They're well and healthy now, but we'll finish them off once and for all.
translation_verse: Tí yàntī bí sìntī ditaŋkpiilin nì bi-nimbiliŋ, bí kɔ́ dikaakulin nì bi-laafiyau.

english_verse: We'll take their valuables and fill our homes with stolen goods.
translation_verse: Ti làá ká tiwan tin pɔ̄ɔ̄ kudaauee nì ti-bulifi. Ti làá gbéeǹ ti-dumpui nì tiwan tin ti fúkúl̀ee.

english_verse: If you join our gang, you'll get your share.”
translation_verse: Sii mun wanti làá nīn bí poon, kun puee ti làá dū ti-kɔkɔ yati kí kpāfì dicilpu ní!»

english_verse: Don't follow anyone like that or do what they do.
translation_verse: M-jipɔɔn, taa nóó an nib gbanti, sii nì bi ń taa pèen̄ nsan.

english_verse: They are in a big hurry to commit some crime, perhaps even murder.
translation_verse: Di sá yii bi sáń ki cá kí ŋá ikpiti ní, bi yáb̀ nnikpaakoon pu.

english_verse: They are like a bird that sees the bait, but ignores the trap.
translation_verse: An sá fám ní bí píĺ kutaliŋŋu unoon nimbilin.

english_verse: They gang up to murder someone, but they are the victims.
translation_verse: Ama bíǹ pīil̀ bi-ba ní kutaliŋŋu, bíǹ bi-ba maŋfal ní bi pīil̀ kpaalaabi.

english_verse: The wealth you get from crime robs you of your life. Wisdom Speaks
translation_verse: Míǹ ní an sá ki tīī un kamaa yù bunaayubuee. Bu làá dāá lēē bin ni bu bée maŋfal. Iciin yíì binib ki kpáafí-bi

english_verse: Wisdom shouts in the streets wherever crowds gather.
translation_verse: Iciin bíi kūuntí mpɔn adan pu, i bí ki sòoǹ mpɔn mpaampiin pu.

english_verse: She shouts in the marketplaces and near the city gates as she says to the people,
translation_verse: Iciin kūuntí ki yíì binib sampaambi pu, i sòoǹ ki báakí tin i cáá kí lèe ntimu punyɔmmu nyɔkɔpu.

english_verse: Listen as I correct you and tell you what I think.
translation_verse: Pīlifìmaan tin m cáá kí wòoǹ-nee. M làá yàntī m-fam ń kpákatí ni-pu ní kí yàntī ní béé m-bɔti.

english_verse: you rejected my advice and paid no attention when I warned you.
translation_verse: Ni fá m-saŋkii kɔkɔ, kaa kíí ḿ wòoǹ-ni.

english_verse: or when trouble and distress surround you like a whirlwind, I will laugh and make fun.
translation_verse: Di sá yii ŋwindalee dinyoondi làá dāá jēetí ni-pu kii umɔfiintaayee. Dinimbinaamandi làá dāá jēetí ni-pu kii kunaakpaabuŋŋuee, ní kunimbaau nì nnaabu ń dāá kɔ́-ni an kaa cáá bí lì.

english_verse: You will ask for my help, but I won't listen; you will search, but you won't find me.
translation_verse: Niinee ni làá dāá yíiń-mi, ama maa làá dāá kíí-ni, ni làá dāá nyàab̀-mi, ama naa làá dāá ká-mi.

english_verse: No, you would not learn, and you refused to respect the Lord.
translation_verse: Kun puee ni ná dinyil, ní kaa lēē kí nīn fàŋkí ti-Dindaan.

english_verse: You rejected my advice and paid no attention when I warned you.
translation_verse: Naa fōō m-saŋkii, kaa fātìi tɔ́ tin ní m kpáafì-nee.

english_verse: “Now you will eat the fruit of what you have done, until you are stuffed full with your own schemes.
translation_verse: Mimmee kun ní ni-bimbikpitim búĺee, kúǹ ní ni làá cā, atuŋkpiti ŋin ni bɔ́ntì ki làá ŋée di làá kpíiǹ-ni.

english_verse: But if you listen to me, you will be safe and secure without fear of disaster.”
translation_verse: Ama un kamaa di yaa pílifì-mee làá nīn bí ŋgbansɔŋfin, ní kaa làá fàŋkì nnaabu.»

english_verse: My child, you must follow and treasure my teachings and my instructions.
translation_verse: M-biki, fōō tin ní m dàkà-see, kpāafì m-marab a-ni.

english_verse: Keep in tune with wisdom and think what it means to have common sense.
translation_verse: Kpòon̄ a-tafal kí pīlifì iciin, kpòon̄ a-pɔbil kí gíiǹ dinyil watil pú.

english_verse: Beg as loud as you can for good common sense.
translation_verse: Mèè dinyil dí tūtuǹ-si, yíiń tibɔti taapu digbilindi dí jòoń-si.

english_verse: Search for wisdom as you would search for silver or hidden treasure.
translation_verse: Nyàab̀ an wanti kii animbilee, nyàab̀-tì kii tigaajawan tin bí dibalinee.

english_verse: Then you will understand what it means to respect and to know the Lord God.
translation_verse: Niinee a làá gbìl̄ unil ń nīn fàŋkí ti-Dindaanee taapu, ní á ŋmā kí nīn nyí Unimbɔti.

english_verse: All wisdom comes from the Lord, and so do common sense and understanding.
translation_verse: Di sá yii ti-Dindaan di tìì iciin, u-cee ní dinyil nì tibɔti taapu digbilindi nyēeń.

english_verse: God gives helpful advice to everyone who obeys him and protects those who live as they should.
translation_verse: Úǹ di tútúǹ deedeedambi, ní ki wúǹ bibulcinnib pu kii digbampɔɔlee.

english_verse: God sees that justice is done, and he watches over everyone who is faithful to him.
translation_verse: U tíkí bin nóó deedee saŋŋuee, ki cí bin yú nì u deedeeyee.

english_verse: Wisdom will control your mind, and you will be pleased with knowledge.
translation_verse: Niinee ní iciin ń kɔ́ a-pɔbilin, ní dinyil ń yàntī a-naŋki ń nīn bí mmɔnni.

english_verse: Sound judgment and good sense will watch over you.
translation_verse: Nlandɔkɔmɔnti làá nīn wúń a-pu, ní dinyil ń nīn cí-si.

english_verse: Wisdom will protect you from evil schemes and from those liars
translation_verse: Tiwan gbanti làá tūtuǹ-si á taa ŋá tin kaa ŋān̄ee. Tì làá fīī-si binib bin sòoǹ tinyimɔmbɔtee ŋaan.

english_verse: who turned from doing good to live in the darkness.
translation_verse: Tì làá fīī-si binib bin féeń ibaamɔn saŋŋu ki kíǹ ki nóó dibɔmbɔndi sàmbiyaamuee ŋaan.

english_verse: Most of all they enjoy being mean and deceitful.
translation_verse: An mɔ̄ǹ-bi bí nīn ŋáań tin kaa ŋān̄ee, bi tūǹ atuŋkpiti ki fàal̀.

english_verse: Wisdom will protect you from the smooth talk of a sinful woman,
translation_verse: Mimmee a làá nyā ubɔ nimpuu ŋaan, uninjamɔnnil un cáá nyɔɔmálmalee.

english_verse: who breaks her wedding vows and leaves the man she married when she was young.
translation_verse: U yāntì u-taafaabɔɔn, ní ki súntì dipoondi din u pōoǹ u-Nimbɔtiu nimbiinee pu.

english_verse: The road to her house leads down to the dark world of the dead.
translation_verse: U-bimbim cáǹ-u ŋkúmin, ní u-ŋáaǹtam cáǹ-u ditaŋkpiilin.

english_verse: Visit her, and you will never find the road to life again.
translation_verse: Ubɔ kaa cūtì u-cee ki fātìi gítìń, ki kíntì dimaŋfal saŋŋu.

english_verse: Follow the example of good people and live an honest life.
translation_verse: An puee fōō binimɔntiibi bimbim, dī deedeedambi tabɔbiliŋ.

english_verse: If you are honest and innocent, you will keep your land;
translation_verse: Di sá yii deedeedambi di làá nīn kóò kitiŋ pu, bibulcinnib di làá gbíntí ki-pu.

english_verse: if you do wrong and can never be trusted, you will be rooted out.
translation_verse: Binikpitib bíǹ làá nyā kitiŋ pu, bi làá jà bin kaa bí deedeeyee kí nyāntí kitiŋ pu.

english_verse: My child, remember my teachings and instructions and obey them completely.
translation_verse: M-biki, taa súntí tin m dàkā-see, kpāafì m-marab a-pɔbilin.

english_verse: They will help you live a long and prosperous life.
translation_verse: M-saŋkii puee, a làá ká mmaŋfafɔkɔn ní kí jī nnaam a-maŋfal wiiŋyi poon.

english_verse: Let love and loyalty always show like a necklace, and write them in your mind.
translation_verse: Nín̄ pée ŋáań tiŋan, kí nīn nóó ibaamɔn saŋŋu. Dū tiwan gbanti kí léeń a-neen, dū-tì kí ŋmà a-pɔbilin.

english_verse: God and people will like you and hold you in high esteem.
translation_verse: Niinee Unimbɔti nì binib làá nīn néeń-si, ní kí nīn pàkà-si.

english_verse: With all your heart you must trust the Lord and not your own judgment.
translation_verse: Nín̄ máká ti-Dindaan pu nì a-pɔbil kɔkɔ, kí taa nín̄ máká a-nyil pu.

english_verse: Always let him lead you, and he will clear the road for you to follow.
translation_verse: Dū tin kɔkɔ a làá ŋée kí ŋá u-ŋaan, ní ú kpòotī-si a-sàmbiyaamu kɔkɔ poon.

english_verse: Don't ever think that you are wise enough, but respect the Lord and stay away from evil.
translation_verse: Taa dàkafì yii a sá uciŋfiti, ama á nīn fàŋkí ti-Dindaan ní kí fàtī a-boon kí tīī ikpiti.

english_verse: This will make you healthy, and you will feel strong.
translation_verse: Án làá cáaǹ a-gbaŋweeŋyi ní kí tīī-si mpɔn.

english_verse: Honor the Lord by giving him your money and the first part of all your crops.
translation_verse: Dū a-gaajawanti nì a-kpaajinti ticɔfikaal kí tīī ti-Dindaan tinyool.

english_verse: Then you will have more grain and grapes than you will ever need.
translation_verse: Niinee tikpaajin làá gbí a-cakalaabi ní ndaam ń gbí a-lɔnti kí pùtifì.

english_verse: My child, don't turn away or become bitter when the Lord corrects you.
translation_verse: M-biki, ti-Dindaan yaa bíi dátí a-tafalee, á taa dūú kpèè fám, u yaa bíi wòoǹ-see, an taa wà-si.

english_verse: The Lord corrects everyone he loves, just as parents correct a child they dearly love. The Value of Wisdom
translation_verse: Di sá yii ti-Dindaan wòoǹ un u néeńee kii ubaati nín wòoǹ u-jipɔɔn un u lèe puee ní.

english_verse: God blesses everyone who has wisdom and common sense.
translation_verse: Unil un ká iciinee, unil un cáá dinyilee bí mmɔnneeee!

english_verse: Wisdom is worth more than silver; it makes you much richer than gold.
translation_verse: Di sá yii á nīn cáá iciinee jítiǹ á nīn cáá animbil. Ipaati in i tììyee jítiǹ sindaariya pu.

english_verse: Wisdom is more valuable than precious jewels; nothing you want compares with her.
translation_verse: Iciin pɔ̄ɔ̄ kudaau ki jítiǹ abeedimbil, tin unil bìǹ ki nyàab̀ee tiba kaa bàn̄ iciin.

english_verse: In her right hand Wisdom holds a long life, and in her left hand are wealth and honor.
translation_verse: I tìì unil mmaŋfafɔkɔn, ki tìì tigaajati nì tinyool.

english_verse: Wisdom makes life pleasant and leads us safely along.
translation_verse: I-saŋyi mɔ̄, ní i-sàmbiyaamu poon cáá ŋgbansɔŋfi.

english_verse: Wisdom is a life-giving tree, the source of happiness for all who hold on to her.
translation_verse: Iciin sá kii busubu bun tìì dimaŋfalee ní ki tīī unil un ŋúb́-iee, un cáá-iee bí mmɔnneeee.

english_verse: By his wisdom and knowledge the Lord created heaven and earth.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan dū iciin ní ki náań kitiŋ, ní ki dū dinyil ki náań yilpu.

english_verse: By his understanding he let the ocean break loose and clouds release the rain.
translation_verse: Nì u-nyil pu ní nnyim min bí kitiŋ taapuee tɔ́nní ki yāaǹ, ní atagban yàntī utaa nì. Ti-Dindaan wúǹ uciŋfiti pu

english_verse: My child, use common sense and sound judgment! Always keep them in mind.
translation_verse: M-biki, dū a-ba kí nákáǹ dinyil nì nlandɔkɔmɔnti, taa pée fàtī a-boon kí tīī tiwan tili gbanti jaanjaan.

english_verse: They will help you to live a long and beautiful life.
translation_verse: Tì làá yàntī á ká dimaŋfamɔntiil nì tiŋan.

english_verse: You will walk safely and never stumble;
translation_verse: A làá còom̀ a-saŋŋu poon nì ŋgbansɔŋfi, ní a-taal kaa làá gbéetí tiba.

english_verse: you will rest without a worry and sleep soundly.
translation_verse: A yaa làá dòon̄ee, aa làá fàŋkì tiba, a làá gèeǹ ŋgeemmɔntiim a-dooŋu pu.

english_verse: So don't be afraid of sudden disasters or storms that strike those who are evil.
translation_verse: Aa làá fàŋkì atulim abaaa, binikpitib kaa làá dāan̄ kí táká-si.

english_verse: Do all you can for everyone who deserves your help.
translation_verse: A yaa cáá ŋŋmamee, á taa yíí yii saa làá tūtuǹ unil un nyàab̀ ditutundee.

english_verse: Don't tell your neighbor to come back tomorrow, if you can help today.
translation_verse: A yaa ŋūǹ kí tīī a-juti kun u mēē-see, á taa tùkù-u yii: «Nín̄ cá kí fu gítiń fool ḿ fu tīī-si.»

english_verse: Don't try to be mean to neighbors who trust you.
translation_verse: Sii nì a-bɔɔ yaa kóò ní u máká a-puee, á taa nyàab̀ nsàmbiyaamu kí ŋá-u tikpitil.

english_verse: Don't argue just to be arguing, when you haven't been hurt.
translation_verse: Á taa táká unil tibɔti fám ní já, udaan kaa ŋá-si tiba.

english_verse: Don't be jealous of cruel people or follow their example.
translation_verse: Taa nín̄ cáá bin ŋáań tipɔmbɔtee pu nnimbitaataam, kí taa nóó bi-tabɔbiliŋ.

english_verse: The Lord doesn't like anyone who is dishonest, but he lets good people be his friends.
translation_verse: Di sá yii ti-Dindaan ná ikpitidambi, ama ní ki néeń bin bí deedeeyee.

english_verse: He places a curse on the home of everyone who is evil, but he blesses the home of every good person.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan tòó binikpitib dumpui mbusu, ama ní ki bìintí deedeedambi kɔŋkooŋyi pu.

english_verse: The Lord sneers at those who sneer at him, but he is kind to everyone who is humble.
translation_verse: U bèel̄ bin bèel̄-uee, ama ní ki ŋáań bin sìntīǹ bi-ba taapuee tiŋan.

english_verse: You will be praised if you are wise, but you will be disgraced if you are a stubborn fool.
translation_verse: Kun dɔ̄ ki cí biciŋfitiibee di sá tinyool, ama bigbaambee, icoo di dɔ̄ ki cí-bi.

english_verse: My child, listen closely to my teachings and learn common sense.
translation_verse: M-biyaamu, pīlifìmaan ubaati dàkatam. Ní pīlifì tiŋan ní kí kpántí binyiliibi.

english_verse: When I was still very young and my mother's favorite child, my father
translation_verse: Ma mun nìn sá m-baa jipɔmmɔntiu ní, ní m-na nìn néeń-mi tikpil kii dijipɔmbaabilee.

english_verse: said to me: “If you follow my teachings and keep them in mind, you will live.
translation_verse: M-baa nìn dàkà-mi ki lì yii: «Cúú m-nyɔɔbuŋŋi kí ŋá a-pɔbilin, kí nīn nóó m-bɔkpaaŋi tiŋan, mimmee a làá kàl̄ kitiŋ pu kí yúntí.

english_verse: Be wise and learn good sense; remember my teachings and do what I say.
translation_verse: Ká iciin nì dinyil, kí taa súntí m-nyɔɔbuŋŋi puɔɔɔ, kí taa fàtī a-boon kí tīī-ŋi mun.

english_verse: “If you love Wisdom and don't reject her, she will watch over you.
translation_verse: Taa dū iciin kí fá, i làá nīn cí-si, nín̄ néeń-i, i làá nīn wúń a-pu.

english_verse: The best thing about Wisdom is Wisdom herself; good sense is more important than anything else.
translation_verse: Iciin kílilaŋki di sá á pɔ́ɔǹ kí bīfì kí béé-i, dū tin kɔkɔ a cááyee kí sú kí ŋmā kí ká dinyil.

english_verse: If you value Wisdom and hold tightly to her, great honors will be yours.
translation_verse: Dū iciin kí nákáǹ a-ba kpátí kpati, i làá yòon̄ a-yindi yilpu. Bìb̄ iciin, i làá tīī-si tinyool.

english_verse: It will be like wearing a glorious crown of beautiful flowers.” The Right Way and the Wrong Way
translation_verse: I làá nīn sá kii ŋŋaamɔntee ki yíĺ a-yil, ní kí nīn sá kii kibeefuulii kimɔmmɔntiiyee ki cíkí a-yil pu.» Taa nín̄ cáá binikpitib bimbim

english_verse: My child, if you listen and obey my teachings, you will live a long time.
translation_verse: M-biki, pīlifiǹ-mi, fōō m-nyɔɔbuŋŋi ní kí kàl̄ kitiŋ pu kí yúntí.

english_verse: I have shown you the way that makes sense; I have guided you along the right path.
translation_verse: M bíi dàkà-si iciin saŋŋu, m kpòotī-si á nīn còom̄ deedee sàmbiyaamu pu ní.

english_verse: Your road won't be blocked, and you won't stumble when you run.
translation_verse: Mimmee a yaa bíi còom̄ee, tiba kaa làá lìkin̄-si, a yaa tí bíi sáńaaa, aa làá gbéetí.

english_verse: Hold firmly to my teaching and never let go. It will mean life for you.
translation_verse: Nín̄ ŋúb́ tin bi dàkā-see, taa dū-tì kí fá. Nín̄ ŋúb́-tì, kun puee tíǹ di sá a-maŋfal.

english_verse: Don't follow the bad example of cruel and evil people.
translation_verse: Taa fōō binikpitib bimbim, kí taa nóó bikpitiŋaliibi saŋŋu.

english_verse: Turn aside and keep going. Stay away from them.
translation_verse: Yàntī-ŋu, taa nóó-ŋu. Gɔ́ntí-ŋu ní kí cùú dī laaba.

english_verse: They can't sleep or rest until they do wrong or harm some innocent victim.
translation_verse: Di sá yii an nibee yaa kaa ŋá tin kaa ŋān̄ee, baa ŋūǹ kí gèeǹ, bi yaa kaa yāntì ubɔ lítì, ŋgeem kaa cútí-bi.

english_verse: The lifestyle of good people is like sunlight at dawn that keeps getting brighter until broad daylight.
translation_verse: Nsan ŋun deedeedambi nóóyee sá kii ntaafaabɔmbɔm walifiŋuee ní, ŋu pée nyàatī ní ki pɔ́ɔkí ki cá áli kutaa ń dāá wúntí kɔkɔ.

english_verse: The lifestyle of the wicked is like total darkness, and they will never know what makes them stumble.
translation_verse: Ama binikpitib bíǹ saŋŋu sá dibɔmbɔndi ní. Baa wāĺ tin dɔ̄ nsanni bi làá cùú gbéetée. Nín̄ cáá mbimbimɔntiim

english_verse: My child, listen carefully to everything I say.
translation_verse: M-biki, pīlifì m-nyɔɔbuŋŋi tiŋan, kpòon̄ a-tafal kí pīlifì m-saŋkii.

english_verse: Don't forget a single word, but think about it all.
translation_verse: A-nimbiliŋ ń nīn pée cɔ́ i-pu, dū-i kí ŋá a-pɔbil poon poon.

english_verse: Knowing these teachings will mean true life and good health for you.
translation_verse: I sá dimaŋfal ní ki tīī bin ká-iee, ní ki sá ŋgbampɔn ki tīī bi-wunti kɔkɔ.

english_verse: Carefully guard your thoughts because they are the source of true life.
translation_verse: Kpèè a-pɔbil tiŋan, di sá yii díǹ di sá a-maŋfal nyeeŋu.

english_verse: Never tell lies or be deceitful in what you say.
translation_verse: Cúú a-nyɔkɔ kí taa pée sòoǹ tinyimɔmbɔti, kí taa pée sòoǹ kí bīil̀ a-juti.

english_verse: Keep looking straight ahead, without turning aside.
translation_verse: Á nīn pée kpèé a-nimbiin, yàntī a-nimbikpeeŋu ń nīn pée bá nyɔkɔpu.

english_verse: Know where you are headed, and you will stay on solid ground.
translation_verse: Á kpèè nsan ŋun a làá dēe tiŋan, a-sàmbiyaamu ń nīn sá mun tèen̄ee.

english_verse: Don't make a mistake by turning to the right or the left.
translation_verse: Taa kpèetī kí cù ŋgiil puɔɔɔ, kí taa kpèetī kí cù ŋgan pú. Sāǹ kí wàatī tin kaa ŋān̄ee.

english_verse: My son, if you listen closely to my wisdom and good sense,
translation_verse: M-biki, pīlifì iciin in m dàkà-see tiŋan, kpòon̄ a-tafal kí pīlifì isaŋki in m-nyil tììyee.

english_verse: you will have sound judgment, and you will always know the right thing to say.
translation_verse: Mimmee a làá kpāafì nlandɔkɔmɔnti ní kí nīn sòoǹ nì dinyil.

english_verse: The words of an immoral woman may be as sweet as honey and as smooth as olive oil.
translation_verse: Di sá yii ubɔ nimpuu nyɔkɔ mɔ̄ kii tisiilee ní ki mèeǹ kii ŋkpamee.

english_verse: But all that you really get from being with her is bitter poison and pain.
translation_verse: Ama án dāa kúntée u-nyɔkɔ túŋkí ní kátí kati kii kisutuntuŋee, ní ki jītí pámpam kii kitàataajiki kin jītí ajan liitil púee.

english_verse: If you follow her, she will lead you down to the world of the dead.
translation_verse: An nimpuuee bimbim cáǹ ŋkúmin ní, ditaŋkpiilin ní u còom̄ ki cá.

english_verse: She has missed the path that leads to life and doesn't even know it.
translation_verse: Waa nóó nsan ŋun cáǹ-u dimaŋfalinee, u yīntì nsan ní kaa kpáàa nyí.

english_verse: My son, listen to me and do everything I say.
translation_verse: An puee pīlifiǹ-mi, m-biki. Taa dū m-saŋkii kí fá.

english_verse: Stay away from a bad woman! Don't even go near the door of her house.
translation_verse: Taa cù an nimpuuee cee, kí taa pée sútí kí pìl̄ u-diiku punyɔkɔpu gba.

english_verse: You will lose your self-respect and end up in debt to some cruel person for the rest of your life.
translation_verse: Án yaa kaa sá míǹ, u làá bīil̀ a-jilmau, ní kí yàntī uninja un kaa sūǹ isaayee ń nàan̄-si.

english_verse: Strangers will get your money and everything else you have worked for.
translation_verse: Ní binicambi ń dāá jī a-gaajawanti, ní a-tundi paati ń dāá kɔ́ binifantantiibi ŋaan.

english_verse: When it's all over, your body will waste away, as you groan
translation_verse: Ŋyunti ŋun a tóob́ ŋkúm a-wunti dóò ki pēefèe, ní a kíǹ ki yáliŋkí.

english_verse: You should be faithful to your wife, just as you take water from your own well.
translation_verse: A-nimpuu sá kii a-nyimbɔbil nyim nì min nyēeń a-lɔkɔunee ní. Nín̄ nyù nnyim gbanti!

english_verse: And don't be like a stream from which just any woman may take a drink.
translation_verse: Taa yàntī a-nyimbuliŋu ń pùub̀ kí nyā mmɔŋki àá a-bùmbiyaamu ń pùub̀ kí nyā didandi pu.

english_verse: Save yourself for your wife and don't have sex with other women.
translation_verse: A-nimpuu ń nīn sá sii baba wanti, á taa yàntī sii nì binicambi ń kpāfì kí nīn yì-u.

english_verse: Be happy with the wife you married when you were young.
translation_verse: Yàntī a-nyimbuliŋu, a-taafaanimpuu pɔbil ń nīn sɔ̀m̀, yàntī u-bɔti ń nīn mɔ̄ǹ-si.

english_verse: She is beautiful and graceful, just like a deer; you should be attracted to her and stay deeply in love.
translation_verse: A-nimpuu cáá dineendi kii upeemanee, ki ŋān̄ kii ucaŋkpalimee. U-biiŋi ń nīn pée tìì-si mmɔn. Ŋyunti kamaayee u-neendi ń nīn pée gbéè-si kii ndaamee.

english_verse: Don't go crazy over a woman who is unfaithful to her own husband!
translation_verse: M-biki, ba pu ní a-nimbil máǹ ubɔ nimpuu pu ní ki ŋúb́ unimpu un aa nyée biiŋi ki ŋmáliŋkí ní?

english_verse: The Lord sees everything, and he watches us closely.
translation_verse: Di sá yii ti-Dindaan nyí unil kamaa bimbim, ní ki wāĺ tin kɔkɔ u ŋáańee.

english_verse: Sinners are trapped and caught by their own evil deeds.
translation_verse: Ikpiti kɔ̄ntí ukpitiŋal sarka, u-kpitii sàtī-u kii kutaliŋŋuee ní.

english_verse: They get lost and die because of their foolishness and lack of self-control.
translation_verse: U làá kpú u nín kaa ŋūǹ kí ŋúb́ u-ba puee. U-gbaandi nín wīikí puee di làá yàntī ú wāŋkì.

english_verse: My child, suppose you agree to pay the debt of someone, who cannot repay a loan.
translation_verse: M-biki, tí lì yii a fáá ubɔ ŋaan ki pōoǹ kí pà a-juti pɔndi,

english_verse: Then you are trapped by your own words,
translation_verse: ní tin nyáń a-nyɔkɔnee dūu bóob́-si ki sàl̄-si kii kutaliŋŋuee.

english_verse: and you are now in the power of someone else. Here is what you should do: Go and beg for permission to call off the agreement.
translation_verse: M-biki, kii a nín kɔ́ a-juti ŋaanee, ŋá tin bí nee kí nyā u-bɔtin. Cù u-cee kí lítí u-nimbiin kí gbàam̀-u.

english_verse: Do this before you fall asleep or even get sleepy.
translation_verse: A yaa kaa ŋúń ki ŋá míǹ, á taa pée púkuń ní kaa nín gèen̄.

english_verse: Save yourself, just as a deer or a bird tries to escape from a hunter.
translation_verse: Fōō a-ba kí líí kii ucaŋkpalim nín ŋmátí ukpan ŋaan puee, àá kii unoon nín ŋmátí kí nyā kutaliŋŋun puee. Taa nín̄ sá uwutijoodaan

english_verse: You lazy people can learn by watching an anthill.
translation_verse: Uwutijoodaan, cùú kpèè unaanyanti. Cùú kpèè u-bimbim kí kpántí uciŋfiti.

english_verse: How long will you lie there doing nothing at all? When are you going to get up and stop sleeping?
translation_verse: Uwutijoodaan, kí cáá sāā ŋyunti ŋulɔŋu ní a làá nīn pée dɔ̄ ki gèeǹ ní? Ŋyunti ŋulɔŋu ní a làá fìntī ŋgeem pu ní?

english_verse: Sleep a little. Doze a little. Fold your hands and twiddle your thumbs.
translation_verse: A là kí gèeǹ fiii, a là kí dáb́ fiii, a là kí dòon̄ fiii kí kpàl̄ iŋal.

english_verse: Suddenly, everything is gone, as though it had been taken by an armed robber.
translation_verse: A dɔ̄ mimmee ní disool ń cíliń a-pu kii unaayuuyee, ní falaa ń cúú-si kii bin fúkuĺ binibee. Kun dɔ̄ ki cí unyimɔndaanee

english_verse: They are always thinking up something cruel and evil, and they stir up trouble.
translation_verse: Ikpiti diŋál di kā u-pɔbilin. U pée dàkafī tin kaa ŋān̄ee ŋma pu ní, ki jāantí binib.

english_verse: But they will be struck by sudden disaster and left without a hope.
translation_verse: An pu ní nnaabu làá jēetí u-pu dicilpu dicilpu. Dibɔbilin niin ní án làá nàan̄-u nnyɔkɔ kpá! Tin ti-Dindaan kaa lèe

english_verse: There are six or seven kinds of people the Lord doesn't like:
translation_verse: Tiwan tiluu ní ti-Dindaan pée ná, ní kululuútiiu ní u-nimbil kaa là kí ká:

english_verse: Those who are too proud or tell lies or murder,
translation_verse: Unil un dàkà u-bee, unil un mɔ́ntí inyimɔnee, unil un kù maanyiibabee,

english_verse: those who make evil plans or are quick to do wrong,
translation_verse: unil un bɔ́ntí kí ŋá atuŋkpitee, unil un yáb̀ kí ŋá tin kaa ŋān̄ee,

english_verse: those who tell lies in court or stir up trouble in a family.
translation_verse: Unil un lèekī nnyimɔn seerauee. Kuwanluluútiiu di sá unil un jāantí nnabiyaamuee. Á nīn nyíǹ a-ba nì tilaakpaal

english_verse: always keep it in mind and never forget it.
translation_verse: Tí nīn pée kā a-pɔbilin, yàntī tí nīn sá tiléeŋkaal á dūú léeń a-neen.

english_verse: Their teaching will guide you when you walk, protect you when you sleep, and talk to you when you are awake.
translation_verse: Tì làá nīn kpòotī-si a-saŋkindi poon, ki làá nīn cí-si a-geem poon ní a yaa fīntèe í sāŋkì-si.

english_verse: The Law of the Lord is a lamp, and its teachings shine brightly. Correction and self-control will lead you through life.
translation_verse: Di sá yii tibɔkpaafikaal sá kii fitilee ní, ní didàkal sá kii ŋwalifee, ní iwoon sá kii dimaŋfal saŋŋuee.

english_verse: They will protect you from the flattering words of someone else's wife.
translation_verse: An wantee làá wúń a-pu kí nyāntí-si unimpu un saŋkindi kaa ŋān̄ee, nì ubɔ nimpuu nyɔɔmálmaluu ŋaan.

english_verse: Don't let yourself be attracted by the charm and lovely eyes of someone like that.
translation_verse: Taa nín̄ là an nimpuuee u-nyaaŋku pu, taa yàntī u-nimbikpeeŋu ń dáaĺ-si kí kɔ́ǹ u-taliŋkun.

english_verse: A woman who sells her love can be bought for as little as the price of a meal. But making love to another man's wife will cost you everything.
translation_verse: Di sá yii a yaa mɔ̄nnì kinimpulaakpaayee, kalaa nimbiliŋ ní a làá dūú pà, ama a yaa mɔ̄nnì ubɔ nimpuuee, a-maŋfal kɔkɔ ní a dūú pà.

english_verse: If you carry burning coals, you burn your clothes;
translation_verse: Ŋma dù ŋŋmi kí ŋá u-bɔkutilookun an kaa fōō?

english_verse: if you step on hot coals, you burn your feet.
translation_verse: Ŋma còom̄ amɔsiŋkoon pu u-taal kaa wùn̄?

english_verse: And if you go to bed with another man's wife, you pay the price.
translation_verse: Míǹ ní an sá ki tīī un di yaa mɔ̄nnì u-juti nimpuuee. Un di yaa gbēē-uee, see ú fōō ditafadaaldi.

english_verse: We don't put up with thieves, not even with one who steals for something to eat.
translation_verse: Baa wòoǹ unaayuu un yùn̄ kí jī kí kpɔ̀ ŋkùm u-poonee.

english_verse: And thieves who get caught must pay back seven times what was stolen and lose everything.
translation_verse: Ama ní bi yaa cúú-uee, see ú téeǹ tin u yùn̄ee miluli pu, see ú kóoǹ tin kɔkɔ u cáá u-dumpuee kí dūú pà dipɔndi.

english_verse: But if you go to bed with another man's wife, you will destroy yourself by your own stupidity.
translation_verse: Uninja un di yaa ŋá tilaakpaal nì ubɔ nimpuuee kaa cáá diyil. Un di ŋáań mimmee bíiĺ u-ba ní.

english_verse: You will be beaten and forever disgraced,
translation_verse: U làá fōō tiweendi, bí kpèè-u fám ní u-cooi kpá kí kúntí jaanjaan.

english_verse: because a jealous husband can be furious and merciless when he takes revenge.
