translation_verse: Di sá yii ipoompoon làá yàntī unimpuee cal ń fōō mbum ní ŋwiin ŋun u làá dāá tɔ̀ ipɔntoonee, disaasɔl dāa kpá.

english_verse: He won't let you pay him off, no matter what you offer.
translation_verse: Tiba kaa bí bí tīī-u án sɔ̀ŋkì u-pɔbil. Báà a yaa tīī-u tiwampɔkaal tikpil, waa làá fōō.

english_verse: My son, pay close attention and don't forget what I tell you to do.
translation_verse: M-biki, taa súntí m-nyɔɔbuŋŋi pu, kpāafì m-marab tiŋan.

english_verse: Obey me, and you will live! Let my instructions be your greatest treasure.
translation_verse: A yaa là kí nīn bí dimaŋfalinee, á nīn ŋúb́ m-marab nì tin m dàkā-see kii a nín ŋúb́ a-nimbibul puee.

english_verse: Keep them at your fingertips and write them in your mind.
translation_verse: Taa yàntī an wantee ń ŋmátí a-ŋaan, dū-tì kí ŋá a-pɔbilin.

english_verse: Let wisdom be your sister and make common sense your closest friend.
translation_verse: Yàntī iciin ń nīn sá a-niisal, kí yàntī dinyil ń nīn sá a-bɔɔmɔnti.

english_verse: They will protect you from the flattering words of someone else's wife.
translation_verse: Tì làá fīī-si ubɔ nimpuu ŋaan, uninjamɔnnil un cáá nyɔɔmálmalee ŋaan.

english_verse: From the window of my house, I once happened to see
translation_verse: Dalba m nìn yú m-tɔkɔlau caŋin ní ki kpèé mmɔŋki.

english_verse: It was late in the evening, sometime after dark.
translation_verse: U nìn bíi còom̄ didandi pu laakin uninjamɔnnil ubɔ kóòyee, ní u pāatì unimpuee dumpu saŋŋu.

english_verse: One of these young men turned the corner and was walking by the house of an unfaithful wife.
translation_verse: An nìn sá kujoou ní, ŋyunti ŋun ní kunyeeu bíi móotí an bíi bɔ̀ntēe.

english_verse: She was dressed fancy like a woman of the street with only one thing in mind.
translation_verse: Niinee ní unimpuee nyánní ki túŋkì-u nsan, ki pēē kii kinimpulaakpaayee ki cáá biibii pɔbil.

english_verse: She was one of those women who are loud and restless and never stay at home,
translation_verse: U gbí kufuu kaa cáá icoo, ní u-mul kaa cōontí u-dumpu.

english_verse: who walk street after street, waiting to trap a man.
translation_verse: An yaa sá adan pueeee, an yaa sá laakin binib kpáfí ki wīikéeyeeee, u pée nyàab̀ un làá mɔ̀nnì-uee ní.

english_verse: She grabbed him and kissed him, and with no sense of shame, she said:
translation_verse: U tú unaacimpɔɔnee nsanee ní ki kpàl̄-u ní ki sòon̄ nì dilambil yii:

english_verse: “I had to offer a sacrifice, and there is enough meat left over for a feast.
translation_verse: «M nìn pōoǹ Unimbɔti yii m làá ŋá ijaam saraau kí tīī-u, ní m ŋá saraa gbanti díǹ nee.

english_verse: So I came looking for you, and here you are!
translation_verse: An pu ní m bàà nyáń kí nyàab̀-si ní ki dūu ká-si nee.

english_verse: The sheets on my bed are bright-colored cloth from Egypt.
translation_verse: M dū satakpaambi nì Eejipiti tiŋkin satamɔntiibi ki páaǹ m-dooŋu pu.

english_verse: And I have covered it with perfume made of myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.
translation_verse: M yāaǹ-ŋu nì miiri nì disaaweendi nì siinamoom talaalub.

english_verse: “Let's go there and make love all night.
translation_verse: Dāan̄ tí cùú dòon̄ kí jī mmɔn áli kutaa nì ku-wuntil.

english_verse: My husband is traveling, and he's far away.
translation_verse: Di sá yii m-cal kaa bí mmɔŋki, u búntì nsandandati ŋubɔ.

english_verse: He took a lot of money along, and he won't be back home before the middle of the month.”
translation_verse: U gbéeǹ u-nimbifɔŋki animbil ní ki yōoǹ ki nín cá, waa làá fàtīí gítiń malaa.»

english_verse: And so, she tricked him with all of her sweet talk and her flattery.
translation_verse: U kíil̀ unaacimpɔɔnee míǹ ní úǹ dāa kíí, u yōoǹ nyɔɔmálmal ní ki ŋúń-u.

english_verse: At once he followed her like an ox on the way to be slaughtered, or like a fool on the way to be punished
translation_verse: Ní u kùl̄ ki páaǹ u-boon dicilpu niin kii unaa ní bi dàtī ki cáǹ kí kpɔ̀ee, a lì kii uwaati ní bi bóob́ ki cáǹ kí tɔ̄ ditafadaaldinee,

english_verse: and killed with arrows. He was no more than a bird rushing into a trap, without knowing it would cost him his life.
translation_verse: áli mpiin ń dāá sāā kí kɔ́ u-pɔɔl. Kii kinɔmbiki nín ŋàaǹ malaa malaa pu kí cáá ki-ba kí tɔ̄ kulaaŋŋun puee, waa nyí yii u-maŋfal ní u làá dūú pà tin u bíi ŋáańee pu.

english_verse: My son, pay close attention to what I have said.
translation_verse: Kɔŋkɔnnee, m-biyaamu, pīlifìmaan-mi ní kí kpòon̄ ni-tafal tiŋan kí pīlifì anyɔɔbun ŋin nyēē m-nyɔkɔnee.

english_verse: Don't even think about that kind of woman or let yourself be misled by someone like her.
translation_verse: Ní taa yàntī an nimpuu juti ń ŋmàtiǹ-ni. Ní taa nóó u-sàmbiyaamu kí wāŋkì.

english_verse: Such a woman has caused the downfall and destruction of a lot of men.
translation_verse: U tīī binib tikpil tiweendi ní ki kūū-bi, u kūū ki kpáaǹ bipɔɔbi gba.

english_verse: Her house is a one-way street leading straight down to the world of the dead.
translation_verse: U-dumpu di sá nsan ŋun cá bitaŋkpiibi kɔŋkooŋŋunee, ŋu sìntī ditaŋkpiilin ní cáaa.

english_verse: With great understanding, Wisdom is calling out
translation_verse: Iciin bí ki tátí ki yíì, dinyil bí ki kūuntí ki yíì. Naa gbìl̀aaa?

english_verse: as she stands at the crossroads and on every hill.
translation_verse: Ŋgbantamu mun bí didandi caŋinee, isampuyakati ní iciin yú.

english_verse: She stands by the city gate where everyone enters the city, and she shouts:
translation_verse: Kitiŋ punyɔkɔ caŋin, laakin binib dìŋfī ki kóòyee, iciin yú ki tátí mpɔn yii:

english_verse: “I am calling out to each one of you!
translation_verse: «Nimbi binib ní m yíì. Nimbi binifoobi ní m lì.

english_verse: Listen, because what I say is worthwhile and right.
translation_verse: Ní pīlifìmaan, tibɔti tin páb́ee ní m làá sòoǹ, deedee bɔti di làá nyānní m-nyɔkɔn.

english_verse: I always speak the truth and refuse to tell a lie.
translation_verse: Kun puee m-nyɔkɔ sòoǹ ibaamɔn ní, m-nyɔkɔ ń sòoǹ tibɔkpitilee, m kòó.

english_verse: Every word I speak is honest, not one is misleading or deceptive.
translation_verse: Deedee bɔti ŋma ní man pée sòoǹ, maa sòoǹ tinyimɔmbɔti àá biibii bɔti.

english_verse: “If you have understanding, you will see that my words are just what you need.
translation_verse: Tì sá ibaamɔn bɔti uciŋfiti cee, ní ki sá deedee bɔti unyil cee.

english_verse: Let instruction and knowledge mean more to you than silver or the finest gold.
translation_verse: Ní fōō tin man dàkèe kí yàntī animbil kúti, kí fōō dinyil kí yàntī sindaariyamɔnti.

english_verse: Wisdom is worth much more than precious jewels or anything else you desire.” Wisdom Speaks
translation_verse: Man Iciin pɔ̄ɔ̄ kudaau ki jítiǹ abeedimbil kpataaa. Tin ni bìǹ ki nyàab̀ee, tiba kaa bàn̄-mi.» Iciin lēē i-ba ki dàkā

english_verse: I am Wisdom—Common Sense is my closest friend; I possess knowledge and sound judgment.
translation_verse: «Man di sá Iciin, m baasii wálifì ní. M ŋáań tikɔkɔ nì nlandɔkɔ ní.

english_verse: If you respect the Lord, you will hate evil. I hate pride and conceit and deceitful lies.
translation_verse: Kí fàŋkì ti-Dindaanee, a ná ikpiti dee. Man ná dibadakal nì dilambil nì atuŋkpiti nì inyimɔn.

english_verse: I am strong, and I offer sensible advice and sound judgment.
translation_verse: Man tundi di sá ḿ nīn sáŋkí binib kí nīn kpáafí-bi. Man di baasii sá dinyil. Man di yì mpɔn.

english_verse: By my power kings govern, and rulers make laws that are fair.
translation_verse: Man pu ní bibɔtiibi jīǹ dibeel, ní biyidambi yōontí bimarabaamɔmbi.

english_verse: Every honest leader rules with help from me.
translation_verse: Man pu ní bibɔtiibi ŋúb́ bi-timmu, bi nì abɔtibil nì bibɔsoonliibi kɔkɔ.

english_verse: I love everyone who loves me, and I will be found by all who honestly search.
translation_verse: Man néeń bin néeń-mee ní. Bin yaa nyàab̀-mee kāntí-mi ní.

english_verse: I can make you rich and famous, important and successful.
translation_verse: Man di tìì tigaajati nì tinyool, nì tigaajawan tin yúntée nì dibútil.

english_verse: What you receive from me is more valuable than even the finest gold or the purest silver.
translation_verse: Tiwan tin m pūǹee ŋān̄ ki jítiǹ sindaariyamɔmmɔnti, tin m tììyee jítiǹ animbil kúti timɔntiil.

english_verse: I always do what is right,
translation_verse: M còom̄ deedee saŋŋu pu ní, ibaamɔn sàmbiyaamu pu ní m còom̄.

english_verse: and I give great riches to everyone who loves me.
translation_verse: M tìì bin néeń-mee tigaajati, ki gbēentí bi-dumpui tigaajawammɔntiil.

english_verse: From the beginning, I was with the Lord. I was there before he began
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan péé péé ki náań-mi ki wāatì ní ki nín náań tin kɔkɔ kíǹee.

english_verse: to create the earth. At the very first, the Lord gave life to me.
translation_verse: M nìn pée bí doooo jaanjaan, ki wāatì ní duulinya nín kíĺ kí nīn bí.

english_verse: When I was born, there were no oceans or springs of water.
translation_verse: Bi nín màl̄-mee, tiŋkub kaa nìn bí, inyimbul in jàkà nnyimee kaa nìn bí.

english_verse: My birth was before mountains were formed or hills were put in place.
translation_verse: Kí wàatī ajoon ń nyā kí nīn bée, kí wàatī ŋgbantamu ń nīn bée, man nìn pée bí ní.

english_verse: It happened long before God had made the earth or any of its fields or even the dust.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan kaa nìn dá láá náań kitiŋ nì ipaan. Waa nìn dá láá náań duulinya tampeepeekaam.

english_verse: I was there when the Lord put the heavens in place and stretched the sky over the surface of the sea.
translation_verse: M nìn bí ŋyunti ŋun u nìn dū kutagbɔŋu ki báaǹee, ŋyunti ŋun u nìn lūtì nloon ki māntìi tú tiŋkuee.

english_verse: I was with him when he placed the clouds in the sky and created the springs that fill the ocean.
translation_verse: M nìn bí ŋyunti ŋun u nìn kpátì atagban ki bīiǹ kutaa puee, nì ŋyunti ŋun tiŋku nyimbulii nìn tòoń nì mpɔnee.

english_verse: I was there when he set boundaries for the sea to make it obey him, and when he laid foundations to support the earth.
translation_verse: U nìn yóoǹ tiŋku kikpaanyɔkɔ kin nnyim kaa máaǹ kí gbí kí lákatée. U nìn bíl̀ dinyeel din pu kitiŋ làá nīn tɔ́kɔ́ee.

english_verse: I was right beside the Lord, helping him plan and build. I made him happy each day, and I was happy at his side.
translation_verse: Ŋyunti gbantee, m nìn bí u-cee kii utammakpilee. Kutaa kamaayee m-bɔti nìn mɔ̄ǹ-u, ní ŋyunti kamaa m nìn fàal̀ u-nimbiin.

english_verse: Pay attention, my children! Follow my advice, and you will be happy.
translation_verse: «Kɔŋkɔnnee, m-biyaamu, pīlifìmaan-mi, bin fōō m-saŋkiiyee bí mmɔnneeee!

english_verse: Listen carefully to my instructions, and you will be wise.
translation_verse: Ní pīlifìmaan tibɔti tin m dàkà-nee kí kpántí biciŋfitiibi, ní taa dū-tì kí fá.

english_verse: Come to my home each day and listen to me. You will find happiness.
translation_verse: Unil un pílifí m-bɔti, ki pée bí m-punyɔkɔpu baabadal, ki cí m-diiku punyɔkɔki nyɔkɔpuee bí mmɔnneeee!

english_verse: By finding me, you find life, and the Lord will be pleased with you.
translation_verse: Di sá yii un yaa ká-mee ká dimaŋfal, ní ti-Dindaan dàkà udaan u-ŋanti.

english_verse: But if you don't find me, you hurt only yourself, and if you hate me, you are in love with death.
translation_verse: Ama unil un yaa kaa ká-mee tìì u-ba ní tiweendi. Bin kɔkɔ ná-mee néeń ŋkúm ní.»

english_verse: Wisdom has built her house with its seven columns.
translation_verse: Iciin máń i-diiku nì ku-jaantalkub biluli bin pu ku tɔ́kɔ́ee.

english_verse: She has prepared the meat and set out the wine. Her feast is ready.
translation_verse: I kūū i-waŋkuti, ki ŋāaǹ i-daam ní ki bɔ́ntì tijin ki yóoǹ.

english_verse: She has sent her servant women to announce her invitation from the highest hills:
translation_verse: I tú i-tɔntɔnliibi binimpoobi kitiŋin bí jɔ̄m̀ kí tɔ́kɔń laakin bí yilpuee kí bāakì kí tùkù binib yii:

english_verse: “Everyone who is ignorant or foolish is invited!
translation_verse: «Nimbi bin kaa nyí tibee, dāam̄maan doo!» Ní i yāntì bi tùkū bigbaambi yii:

english_verse: All of you are welcome to my meat and wine.
translation_verse: «Ní dāam̄maan kí jī m-jinti, ní kí nyɔ̀ m-daam min m ŋāaǹee.

english_verse: If you want to live, give up your foolishness and let understanding guide your steps.” True Wisdom
translation_verse: Fámaan digbaandi ní kí nīn bí dimaŋfalin, ní kí nóó dinyil saŋŋu.» Uciŋfiti nì ulambidaan

english_verse: Correct a worthless bragger, and all you will get are insults and injuries.
translation_verse: A yaa sáŋkì ulambidaanee, u bèel̄-si ní, a yaa kpōotì unikpitee, asiibil ní a dāa kāntí.

english_verse: Any bragger you correct will only hate you. But if you correct someone who has common sense, you will be loved.
translation_verse: Á taa kpòotī ulambidaan, di sá yii u làá nīn ná-si, ama a yaa kpōotì uciŋfitee, u làá nīn néeń-si ní.

english_verse: If you have good sense, instruction will help you to have even better sense. And if you live right, education will help you to know even more.
translation_verse: A yaa sáŋkì uciŋfitee, u mɔ̀tīi cíkití iciin ní, a yaa dàkā deedeedaanee, u-nyil mɔ̀tīi gbēentí ní.

english_verse: Respect and obey the Lord! This is the beginning of wisdom. To have understanding, you must know the Holy God.
translation_verse: Á fàŋkì ti-Dindaan di sá iciin kílilaŋki, á béé un di sá circiree di dàkà yii a sá unyil.

english_verse: I am Wisdom. If you follow me, you will live a long time.
translation_verse: Tiŋman, man Iciin làá gbéeǹ a-wiiŋyi pu, m làá yàntī á kàl̄ kitiŋ pu kí yúntí.

english_verse: Good sense is good for you, but if you brag, you hurt yourself. A Foolish Invitation
translation_verse: A yaa sá uciŋfitee, sii di làá páatí a-ciiŋyi pu, a yaa sá ulambidaanee, sii baba di làá túń a-lambil gìńdi.

english_verse: She sits in front of her house and on the highest hills in the town.
translation_verse: U nyēē ní ki kā u-diiku punyɔkɔpu, dijal pu, kitiŋ poon laakin tɔ́kɔ́ yilpu yilpuee

english_verse: She shouts to everyone who passes by,
translation_verse: ní ki yíì bisanjitiliibi bin túĺ bi-saŋŋu cáaa ki cée yii:

english_verse: “If you are stupid, come on inside!” And to every fool she says,
translation_verse: «Nimbi bin kaa nyí tibee, dāam̄maan doo!» Ní u tùkù bigbaambi yii:

english_verse: “Stolen water tastes best, and the food you eat in secret tastes best of all.”
translation_verse: «Nnaayudaam mɔ̄ dinyɔl, ní tijin tin bi jīǹ dibalinee mɔ̄ dijil!»

english_verse: None who listen to Stupidity understand that her guests are as good as dead.
translation_verse: Ama bin cá u-ceeyee kaa nyí yii bi cá kí ŋàl̄ bin kaa ti bée pu, baa nyí yii ditaŋkpiilin ní bin u yíìyee cá.

english_verse: Here are some proverbs of Solomon: Children with good sense make their parents happy, but foolish children make them sad.
translation_verse: Saloomɔn laŋkpaŋŋi. Kibiki kin cáá iciinee yàntī ki-baa bí mmɔnni ní, kin kaa cáá iciinee sá kunimbaau ní ki tīī ki-na.

english_verse: What you gain by doing evil won't help you at all. Obeying God is the only way to be saved from death.
translation_verse: Tigaajati tin bi dī isaŋkpiti pu ki kée kaa kèetī, ama deedee saŋŋu nyāntí unil ŋkúmin.

english_verse: If you obey the Lord, you won't go hungry; if you are wicked, God won't let you have what you want.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan kaa yàntī deedeedaan ń kpú ŋkùm, ama waa yàntī binikpitib ń ká tin bi lèe.

english_verse: Laziness leads to poverty; hard work makes you rich.
translation_verse: Iŋal in jòon̄ee cāabìń disool ní, iŋal in tūǹ ditundee tìì tigaajati.

english_verse: At harvest season it's smart to work hard, but stupid to sleep.
translation_verse: Unil un cēē tikpaajin dipeel puee sá ulandɔkɔdaan ní, ama un dɔ̄ ki gèeǹ ŋyunti ŋun bi cēē tikpaajinee cāabìń icoo ní.

english_verse: Everyone praises good people, but evil hides behind the words of the wicked.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti bìintí deedeedaan pu, ama tipɔmbɔti nyɔɔbuŋŋi di gbí binikpitib sooŋyi poon.

english_verse: Good people are remembered long after they are gone, but the wicked are soon forgotten.
translation_verse: Bi téetí deedeedaan pu nì kupampakau, ama ní kí súntí binikpitib pu kí kpáaǹ bi-yiŋŋi.

english_verse: If you have good sense, you will listen and obey; if all you do is talk foolishly, you will destroy yourself.
translation_verse: Uciŋfiti kíikí kí nóó marab kí nīn tɔ́-bi, ama unil un sòoǹ kaa dàkafēe làá nàan̄ u-ba ní.

english_verse: You will be safe, if you always do right, but you will get caught, if you are dishonest.
translation_verse: Un cáá tibulcinee còom̄ nì ŋgbansɔŋfi, ama un dī isan in gɔ́ĺee, Unimbɔti làá nyāntí udaan kí páań mpaampiin pu.

english_verse: Deceit causes trouble, and foolish talk will bring you to ruin.
translation_verse: Unil un cáá ibaamɔn ki bāal̀ u-jutiibee sàantí-bi ní, ní un sòoǹ kaa dàkafēe nàantí u-ba.

english_verse: The words of good people are a source of life, but evil hides behind the words of the wicked.
translation_verse: Deedeedaan nyɔɔbuŋŋi sá kii nnyimbul ŋun tìì dimaŋfalee ní, ama tipɔmbɔti nyɔɔbuŋŋi di gbí binikpitib sooŋyi poon.

english_verse: Hatred stirs up trouble; love overlooks the wrongs that others do.
translation_verse: Kináŋ cāabìń kujaau binib kansikin ní, ama dineendi díǹ bìintí ikpiti kɔkɔ pu ní.

english_verse: If you have good sense, it will show when you speak. But if you are stupid, you will be beaten with a stick.
translation_verse: Iciin bí unil un cáá dinyilee nyɔɔbuŋŋin, ama mbambaan dɔ̄ ki cí ugbaan boon ní.

english_verse: If you have good sense, you will learn all you can, but foolish talk will soon destroy you.
translation_verse: Biciŋfitiibi kpáafí dinyil kii tigaajatee ní, ama bigbaambi nyɔɔbuŋŋi làá nàan̄-bi dicilpu dicilpu ní.

english_verse: Great wealth can be a fortress, but poverty is no protection at all.
translation_verse: Ugaaja wanti wúń u-pu kii digundee ní, ama bisoodambi sool di nàantí-bi.

english_verse: If you live right, the reward is a good life; if you are evil, all you have is sin.
translation_verse: Deedeedaan paati di sá dimaŋfal, ama unikpiti paati di sá ikpiti.

english_verse: Accept correction, and you will find life; reject correction, and you will miss the road.
translation_verse: Unil un kíikí bí kpāafì-uee tàkā dimaŋfal saŋŋun, ama un kaa là bí wòoǹ-uee wáŋkí ní.

english_verse: You can hide your hatred by telling lies, but you are a fool to spread lies.
translation_verse: Un ná u-juti dibalinee sá mpɔnnyoondaan, ama un kúŋfí u-juti boonee sá ugbaan ní.

english_verse: You will say the wrong thing if you talk too much— so be sensible and watch what you say.
translation_verse: Unil un sòoǹ tikpilee, see ú yìntī, ama un kaa sòoǹ tikpilee sá uciŋfiti ní.

english_verse: The words of a good person are like pure silver, but the thoughts of an evil person are almost worthless.
translation_verse: Deedeedaan nyɔɔbuŋŋi sá kii animbil kúti timɔntiilee ní, ama binikpitib pɔbiliŋ kaa bí tiban.

english_verse: Many are helped by useful instruction, but fools are killed by their own stupidity.
translation_verse: Deedeedaan nyɔɔbuŋŋi kèetī kunipaau ní, ama bigbaambi bíǹ kúù, kun puee baa nyí tiba.

english_verse: When the Lord blesses you with riches, you have nothing to regret.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan biindi baba di yì unil gaajati, u-pɔ́ɔǹtam kaa pée kútí tiba.

english_verse: Fools enjoy doing wrong, but anyone with good sense enjoys acting wisely.
translation_verse: Kí ŋá ikpitee sá agbiil ní ugbaan cee, míǹ ní iciin mɔ̄ unyil cee.

english_verse: What evil people dread most will happen to them, but good people will get what they want most.
translation_verse: Kun unikpiti fàŋkée di bàń-u, ama tin kā deedeedambi naŋki puee ní bi kāntí.

english_verse: Those crooks will disappear when a storm strikes, but God will keep safe all who obey him.
translation_verse: Utaafiiŋkaa tin lì yii u nì kí báatée, unikpiti kaa ti bí, ama deedeedaan úǹ yú kaa cìŋkī.

english_verse: Having a lazy person on the job is like a mouth full of vinegar or smoke in your eyes.
translation_verse: Kii ayeen nín nyàŋfī unil nyiŋŋi pu ní nnyiim kóò unil nimbiliŋin puee, míǹ ní uwutijoodaan sá ki tīī un yaa tú-uee.

english_verse: If you respect the Lord, you will live longer; if you keep doing wrong, your life will be cut short.
translation_verse: Unil un fàŋkí ti-Dindaanee maŋfal làá fɔ̀kɔn̄, ama binikpitib kaa bà bi-wiiŋŋu ní kí kpú.

english_verse: If you obey the Lord, you will be happy, but there is no future for the wicked.
translation_verse: Deedeedambi mákal cāabìń-bi dipɔɔpindi ní, ama binikpitib bíǹ mákal dāa pée kúntí nì fám ní.

english_verse: The Lord protects everyone who lives right, but he destroys anyone who does wrong.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan saŋŋu sá kutaŋkpanaakoou ní ki tīī deedeedaan, ama ní ki sá dinàandi ki tīī binib bin di ŋáań ikpitee.

english_verse: Good people will stand firm, but the wicked will disappear from the land.
translation_verse: Tiba kpá ki cìŋkì deedeedaan dalba dalba, ama binikpitib bíǹ kaa làá kàl̄ kitiŋ pu.

english_verse: Honest people speak sensibly, but deceitful liars will be silenced.
translation_verse: Iciin nyɔɔbuŋŋi di nyēē deedeedaan nyɔkɔn, bi làá dāá gíí kí tìl̄ bin sòoǹ tibɔkpitilee limbil.

english_verse: If you obey the Lord, you will always know the right thing to say. But no one will trust you if you tell lies.
translation_verse: Deedeedaan nyɔɔbuŋŋi mɔ̄ dipilifil, ama binikpitib bíǹ nyɔmmu nyēē tibɔkpitil ŋma ní.

english_verse: The Lord hates anyone who cheats, but he likes everyone who is honest.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan ná saniyab bin kaa ŋmàntī tiwan deedeeyee, ama tiwaŋŋmantikaal tin bí deedeeyee di fáatì ti-Dindaan pɔbil.

english_verse: Too much pride can put you to shame. It's wiser to be humble.
translation_verse: Dilambil di cāabìń icoo, ama binib bin sīntiǹ bi-ba taapuee di cáá iciin.

english_verse: When God is angry, money won't help you. Obeying God is the only way to be saved from death.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan ŋuul dalee, tigaajati kaa dāa kèetī, ama deedee saŋŋu di dāa nyāntí unil ŋkúmin.

english_verse: If you are truly good, you will do right; if you are wicked, you will be destroyed by your own sin.
translation_verse: Bibulcinnib deedeeu di tàntī bi-saŋŋu, ama ní binikpitib bíǹ lítí bi-tuŋkpitiŋ pu.

english_verse: Honesty can keep you safe, but if you can't be trusted, you trap yourself.
translation_verse: Deedeedambi deedeeu di fìil̄-bi, ama biibiidambi nimbitaataam di fàtīi sàtī-bi kii kutaliŋŋuee.

english_verse: When the wicked die, their hopes die with them.
translation_verse: Unikpiti yaa kpíìyee, u-mákal mun kúntì dee, ní dimákal din u cáá u-gaajati puee mun ń ŋá fám.

english_verse: Trouble goes right past the Lord's people and strikes the wicked.
translation_verse: Deedeedaan làá nyā dinimbinaamandin, ní unikpiti ń fōō u-yil kí kɔ́ di-ni.

english_verse: Dishonest people use gossip to destroy their neighbors; good people are protected by their own good sense.
translation_verse: Unyimɔndaan nyɔkɔ ní u cáa kù u-juti, ama deedeedambi nyil pu ní bi kāntí difiil.

english_verse: When honest people prosper and the wicked disappear, the whole city celebrates.
translation_verse: An yaa bútì deedeedambee, ifaal bí kitiŋin ní, ama binikpitib yaa kpíìyee, bi kūuntí ní ki fàal̀.

english_verse: Good people bring prosperity to their city, but deceitful liars can destroy a city.
translation_verse: Deedeedambi biindi di yì-tì ní an bútí bi-tiŋki, ama binikpitib nyɔɔbuŋŋi di nàantí-kì.

english_verse: It's stupid to say bad things about your neighbors. If you are sensible, you will keep quiet.
translation_verse: Unil un kpèé u-juti fámee kaa nyí tiba, ama unil un cáá dinyilee ŋmí ní.

english_verse: A gossip tells everything, but a true friend will keep a secret.
translation_verse: Unil un cāab̀ u-juti disambiilee kaa bāal̀ tibɔti, ama unil un pu bi mákée kaa sòoǹ.

english_verse: A city without wise leaders will end up in ruin; a city with many wise leaders will be kept safe.
translation_verse: Dinibul din baa kpòotī tiŋanee lítí ní, din cáá bisaŋkiliibi kupaauee di ŋmátí.

english_verse: A gracious woman will be respected, but a ruthless man will only get rich.
translation_verse: Unimpu un cáá kunyaaŋŋuee, bi pàkà-u ní, ama uninja un cáá difaŋgiilee kāntí tigaajati.

english_verse: Kindness is rewarded— but if you are cruel, you hurt yourself.
translation_verse: Unil un ŋáań binib tinitee ŋáań ki tìì u-ba ní, ama unil un cáá ntoomee kɔ̄ntí u-ba ní digìńdi.

english_verse: Meanness gets you nowhere, but goodness is rewarded.
translation_verse: Unikpiti tundi kaa cáá tipaal, ama tipaal dɔ̄ ki cí un tūǹ deedee tundee.

english_verse: Always do the right thing, and you will live; keep on doing wrong, and you will die.
translation_verse: Deedee saŋŋu cáǹ unil dimaŋfalin, ama unil un yaa nóó ikpiti saŋŋuee cá ŋkúmin ní.

english_verse: The Lord hates sneaky people, but he likes everyone who lives right.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan ná milimilidambi, ama bibulcinnib bɔti fáatiǹ-u ní.

english_verse: You can be sure of this: All crooks will be punished, but God's people won't.
translation_verse: Kí sɔ̄ kí lā, unikpiti kaa làá lóó ditafadaaldi, ama tiba kaa làá gbēē deedeedambi maaliŋun yab.

english_verse: A beautiful woman who acts foolishly is like a gold ring on the snout of a pig.
translation_verse: Unimpunyaan un kaa nyí tibee sá kii ugbeeti un túuń sindaariya bɔmbil u-maŋfalee ní.

english_verse: Good people want what is best, but troublemakers hope to stir up trouble.
translation_verse: Tin deedeedambi nyàab̀ee di sá tiŋan, ama tin binikpitib pée ŋūǹ kí nīn kā ki cée di sá ti-Dindaan ŋuul.

english_verse: Sometimes you can become rich by being generous or poor by being greedy.
translation_verse: Unil un ŋal tàntēe mɔ̀tīi kpántí ugaaja ní, ama un kpáafí tigaajati tikpilee kpántí usoodaan ní.

english_verse: Generosity will be rewarded: Give a cup of water, and you will receive a cup of water in return.
translation_verse: Án làá dāá bútí unil un di cáá tinitee, ní bí dāá pɔ̄ un pūǹ bin kíǹee bi nyùee ú nyɔ̀.

english_verse: Charge too much for grain, and you will be cursed; sell it at a fair price, and you will be praised.
translation_verse: Binib tòó bin kpáafí bi-kpaajinti kí dāá nyāfì boonee mbusu, ama ní ki mèé ki bìintí bin nyáfí-tì malaa malaayee pu.

english_verse: Try hard to do right, and you will win friends; go looking for trouble, and you will find it.
translation_verse: Binib pàkà unil un nyàab̀ kí nīn ŋáań tin ŋān̄ee ní, ama un nyàab̀ kí ŋá tikpitilee, tikpitil ní udaan làá ká.

english_verse: Trust in your wealth, and you will be a failure, but God's people will prosper like healthy plants.
translation_verse: Unil un máká u-gaajati puee làá lítí, ama án làá bútí deedeedambi kii busubu bun túkú tifaapɔnee ní.

english_verse: Fools who cause trouble in the family won't inherit a thing. They will end up as slaves of someone with good sense.
translation_verse: Unil un cāabìń fikil fikil u-dicaŋkunee dāa yáatí nì iŋaŋkulim ní. Ugbaan làá dāá kpántí uciŋfiti yumbuu.

english_verse: Live right, and you will eat from the life-giving tree. And if you act wisely, others will follow.
translation_verse: Atuun ŋin deedeedaan tūǹee sá kii busubu bun tìì dimaŋfalee ní. Uciŋfiti fìil̄ binib.

english_verse: If good people are rewarded here on this earth, all who are cruel and mean will surely be punished.
translation_verse: Deedeedaan fòol̄ u-paati kitiŋ pu doo ní, míǹ mbaantiim ní unikpiti nì ukpitiŋal mun fòol̄ bi-paati kitiŋ pu doo.

english_verse: To accept correction is wise, to reject it is stupid.
translation_verse: Unil un néeń ikpootee néeń dinyil ní. Ama unil un kaa là bí wòoǹ-uee sá ugbaan ní.

english_verse: The Lord likes everyone who lives right, but he punishes everyone who makes evil plans.
translation_verse: Unimɔnti bɔti fáatiǹ ti-Dindaan ní, ama u kù ilandɔkɔkpiti daan bɔti.

english_verse: Sin cannot offer security! But if you live right, you will be as secure as a tree with deep roots.
translation_verse: Unikpiti kaa bá ki pɔ̄ɔ̄, ama deedeedaan úǹ yú atajal ali ní.

english_verse: A helpful wife is a jewel for her husband, but a shameless wife will make his bones rot.
translation_verse: Unimpu tiŋman pu yɔu tìì u-cal tinyool ní, ama unimpu un kɔ̄ntí u-cal icooyee sá-u iween in ŋmóò ki bùkù akpabee ní.

english_verse: Good people have kind thoughts, but you should never trust the advice of someone evil.
translation_verse: Deedeedambi pée dàkafī kí ŋá tin bí deedeeyee, ama ní binikpitib dàkafī kí mùul̀.

english_verse: Bad advice is a deadly trap, but good advice is like a shield.
translation_verse: Binikpitib nyɔɔbuŋŋi sá titalindi tin kùee ní, ama deedeedambi nyɔɔbuŋŋi cāabìń difiil.

english_verse: Once the wicked are defeated, they are gone forever, but no one who obeys God will ever be thrown down.
translation_verse: Binikpitib yaa lítèe, bi-yindi kúntì dee, ama deedeedambi dicaŋku kpá kí kúntí jaanjaan.

english_verse: Good sense is worthy of praise, but stupidity is a curse.
translation_verse: Unil un cáá dinyilee, bi pàkà-u ní, ama bi kpèé un kaa nyí tibee fám.

english_verse: It's better to be ordinary and have only one servant than to think you are somebody and starve to death.
translation_verse: An sɔ́ á nīn cáá utɔntɔnli ubɔ ja bí kpèè-si fám ki jítiǹ á nīn néeń a-ba timɔn kaa cáá kí jī.

english_verse: Good people are kind to their animals, but a mean person is cruel.
translation_verse: Deedeedaan nyí kun lóò u-waŋkutee, ama unikpiti úǹ poon tū ní.

english_verse: Hard working farmers have more than enough food; daydreamers are nothing more than stupid fools.
translation_verse: Unil un kù u-saakuee jīǹ ki díkì ní, ama unil un jòó ki pá tin kaa bí tibanee boonee sá ugbaan ní.

english_verse: An evil person tries to hide behind evil; good people are like trees with deep roots.
translation_verse: Unikpiti cáá bikpitiŋaliibi wanti pu nnimbitaataam, see deedeedambi pɔ́ɔǹdi baba di kèetī.

english_verse: We trap ourselves by telling lies, but we stay out of trouble by living right.
translation_verse: Unikpiti bɔkpitii sá-u kutaliŋŋu ní, ama deedeedaan úǹ nyēē tibɔtin ní.

english_verse: We are rewarded or punished for what we say and do.
translation_verse: Unil nyɔɔbuŋŋi ŋūǹ kí yàntī ú ká tiwammɔntiil kii unil tundi nín yàntī ú fōō tipaal puee ní.

english_verse: Fools think they know what is best, but a sensible person listens to advice.
translation_verse: Ugbaan dàkafī yii tin u ŋáańee di pée ŋān̄, ama un fòol̄ isaŋkee di sá uciŋfiti.

english_verse: An honest person tells the truth in court, but a dishonest person tells nothing but lies.
translation_verse: Unil un sòoǹ ibaamɔnee nyāntí deedee mpaampiin pu, ama un lèekī inyimɔn seerabee nyāntí diyìntil ní mpaampiin pu.

english_verse: Sharp words cut like a sword, but words of wisdom heal.
translation_verse: Unil un sòoǹ kaa dàkafēe tìì tiweendi kii kitàataajikee ní, ama biciŋfitiibi bíǹ nyɔɔbuŋŋi cāabìń dicáaǹdi ní.

english_verse: Truth will last forever; lies are soon found out.
translation_verse: Ibaamɔn bɔti bí kí nīn cá jaanjaan, ama tinyimɔmbɔti kaa pée súŋkí ní kí wāŋkì.

english_verse: An evil mind is deceitful, but gentle thoughts bring happiness.
translation_verse: Inyimɔn bí bin dàkafī kí ŋá ikpitee pɔbiliŋin, ama ní dipɔɔpindi bí bin nyàab̀ ŋgbansɔŋfee yaŋin.

english_verse: Good people never have trouble, but troublemakers have more than enough.
translation_verse: Digìńdi báà diba kaa bàń deedeedaan, ama ní binikpitib bíǹ pée kāntí agìŋ́kpaan.

english_verse: The Lord hates every liar, but he is the friend of all who can be trusted.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan ná binyimɔndambi, ama ní ki néeń ibaamɔndambi.

english_verse: Be sensible and don't tell everything you know— only fools spread foolishness everywhere.
translation_verse: Unil un cáá iciinee bāal̀ tin u nyée ní, ama ugbaan úǹ bāakì u-gbaandi ki tùkù báà ŋma ní.

english_verse: Work hard, and you will be a leader; be lazy, and you will end up a slave.
translation_verse: Unil un cáá difaŋgiilee làá dāá nīn cáá mpɔn bin kíǹee pu, ama unil un yaa cáá diwutijoolee làá dāá kpántí uyumbu.

english_verse: Worry is a heavy burden, but a kind word always brings cheer.
translation_verse: Digìńdi yaa bàn̄ unilee, an nyìitī-u kí múĺ ní, ama dinyɔɔbummɔɔl di ŋūǹ kí sɔ̀ŋkì u-pɔbil.

english_verse: You are better off to do right, than to lose your way by doing wrong.
translation_verse: Deedeedaan dàkà u-juti nsammɔnti ní, ama binikpitib saŋŋu cáǹ bíǹ bi-ba diyìntilin ní.

english_verse: Anyone too lazy to cook will starve, but a hard worker is a valuable treasure.
translation_verse: Ukpan un sá uwutijoodaanee kaa kāntí upeel kí púĺ, ama unil un cáá difaŋgiilee cáá tigaajati.

english_verse: Living right is a pathway that leads to life and away from death.
translation_verse: Deedee saŋŋun ní dimaŋfal bí, nsan gbanti ŋúǹ kaa cáǹ unil ŋkúmin.

english_verse: Children with good sense accept correction from their parents, but stubborn children ignore it completely.
translation_verse: Kibiki kin cáá iciinee fòol̄ ki-baa dàkal, ama kin bèel̄ binibee kaa kíikí bí lìǹ-kì.

english_verse: You will be well rewarded for saying something kind, but all some people think about is how to be cruel and mean.
translation_verse: Tin nyēē unil nyɔkɔnee pu ní u kāntí njimmɔntiim, ama tipɔmbɔti ní biibiidambi jīǹ ki bí.

english_verse: Keep what you know to yourself, and you will be safe; talk too much, and you are done for.
translation_verse: Unil un ŋūǹ ki ŋúb̀ u-nyɔkɔee wúń u-maŋfal pu ní, ama unil un sòoǹ pùsi pusi kaa dàkafēe nàantí u-ba ní.

english_verse: No matter how much you want, laziness won't help a bit, but hard work will reward you with more than enough.
translation_verse: Uwutijoodaan kpèé ní làm kaa kāntí, ama ufaŋgiidaan úǹ kāntí tin kamaa u yaa lèe ní.

english_verse: A good person hates deceit, but those who are evil cause shame and disgrace.
translation_verse: Deedeedaan ná inyimɔn, unikpiti kɔ̄ntí binib icoo ní ki bíiĺ-bi.

english_verse: Live right, and you are safe! But sin will destroy you.
translation_verse: Tibulcin wúǹ ubulcindaan pu, ama ikpiti nàantí unikpiti.

english_verse: Some who have nothing may pretend to be rich, and some who have everything may pretend to be poor.
translation_verse: Binib biba yíì bi-ba bigaajab ní kaa cáá báà tiba, ní biba yíì bi-ba bisoodambi ama ní ki cáá tigaajakpaandi.

english_verse: The rich may have to pay a ransom, but the poor don't have that problem.
translation_verse: Ugaaja gaajati di fìil̄-u, ama ubɔ kaa wɔ́b̀ usoodaan.

english_verse: The lamp of a good person keeps on shining; the lamp of an evil person soon goes out.
translation_verse: Deedeedambi sá kii ŋwalifi ŋun wāĺ bɔ́iiyee ní, ama binikpitib bíǹ bí kii fitila un bíi kúùyee ní.

english_verse: Too much pride causes trouble. Be sensible and take advice.
translation_verse: Dilambil di yàntī unil tákà tibɔti, ama unil un fòol̄ isaŋkee di sá uciŋfiti.

english_verse: Money wrongly gained will disappear bit by bit; money earned little by little will grow and grow.
translation_verse: Tigaajati tin unil ká malaayee kaa yúntí, ama tigaajati tin unil ŋá soooo soooo ki kée kaa kúntí.

english_verse: Not getting what you want can break your heart, but a wish that comes true is a life-giving tree.
translation_verse: Unil yaa máká tiba pu ní kaa ká-tì malaayee, u-wunti yɔ̀tī ní, ama unil yaa ká tin fáatì u-pɔbilee, an bí kii busubu bun tìì dimaŋfalee ní.

english_verse: If you reject God's teaching, you will pay the price; if you obey his commands, you will be rewarded.
translation_verse: Unil un kpèé ki sìŋkīǹ isaŋkee làá kɔ́ agìń poon, ama un tɔ́ marabee làá ká ipaati.

english_verse: Sensible instruction is a life-giving fountain that helps you escape all deadly traps.
translation_verse: Uciŋfiti dàkatam sá dimaŋfal nyimbuliŋu ní. Ŋúǹ di yàntī unil ń gɔ́ntí ŋkúm talinti.

english_verse: Sound judgment is praised, but people without good sense are on the way to disaster.
translation_verse: Un cáá dinyil tikpilee bɔti fáatiǹ binib ní. Ama biibiidambi saŋŋu cáǹ dinàandin ní.

english_verse: If you have good sense, you will act sensibly, but fools act like fools.
translation_verse: Un nyí nì u-bee dàkafī ní kí nín ŋá tiba, ama ugbaan úǹ cáá u-gbaandi ki dàkà báà ŋma ní.

english_verse: Whoever delivers your message can make things better or worse for you.
translation_verse: Ntuun ŋun kaa ŋān̄ee cāabìń mbusu ní, ama ntuun ŋun sá mmɔntee cāabìń diŋaŋkil ní.

english_verse: All who refuse correction will be poor and disgraced; all who accept correction will be praised.
translation_verse: Disool nì icoo dɔ̄ ki cí un kaa là bí dàkà-uee, ama un kíikí bí wòoǹ-uee làá fōō kupampakau.

english_verse: It's a good feeling to get what you want, but only a stupid fool hates to turn from evil.
translation_verse: An sá mmɔn ní unil ń ká kun fáatiǹ-uee, an pu ní ugbaan kaa là kí fá atuŋkpiti.

english_verse: Wise friends make you wise, but you hurt yourself by going around with fools.
translation_verse: Unil un nōotí biciŋfitiibee kpántí uciŋfiti ní, ama un nōotí bigbaambee kɔ̄ntí u-ba agìńni.

english_verse: You are in for trouble if you sin, but you will be rewarded if you live right.
translation_verse: Nnaabu kā bikpitiŋaliibi pu kàti kati, ama nnaam di sá deedeedambi bíǹ paati.

english_verse: If you obey God, you will have something to leave your grandchildren. If you don't obey God, those who live right will get what you leave.
translation_verse: Unimɔnti naantiibi jīǹ u-gaajawanti difakal ní, ama unikpiti úǹ gaajatee, deedeedaan di jīǹ-tì.

english_verse: Even when the land of the poor produces good crops, they get cheated out of what they grow.
translation_verse: Bisoodambi kpaaŋŋi lòoǹ tikpil, ama bin kaa bí deedeeyee kpaaŋŋi yɔ́l̀ ní.

english_verse: If you love your children, you will correct them; if you don't love them, you won't correct them.
translation_verse: Unil un kaa gbáà u-bikee ná-kì dee. Unil un néeń u-bikee dátí ki-tafal ní.

english_verse: If you live right, you will have plenty to eat; if you don't live right, you will go away empty.
translation_verse: Deedeedaan cáá kí jī kí díkí, ama ní binikpitib pooŋi náká.

english_verse: A woman's family is held together by her wisdom, but it can be destroyed by her foolishness.
translation_verse: Unimpuciŋfiti máń u-diiku, ama unimpugbaan dù úǹ u-ba ŋalii ní kí gbá kí wīī-ku.

english_verse: By living right, you show that you respect the Lord; by being deceitful, you show that you despise him.
translation_verse: Unil un còom̄ deedee saŋkindee fàŋkí ti-Dindaan ní. Ama un dī isan in gɔ́ĺee kpèé-u fám dee.

english_verse: Proud fools are punished for their stupid talk, but sensible talk can save your life.
translation_verse: Ugbaan nyɔɔbuŋŋi poon ní a kāntí u-badakal, ama biciŋfitiibi nyɔɔbuŋŋi di wúǹ bi-pu.

english_verse: Without the help of an ox there can be no crop, but with a strong ox a big crop is possible.
translation_verse: Unil un kaa cáá inaa í kpɔ̀-u tikpaalee, u-cakalaau yú ukulim ní, ama un cáá inaa pɔ̄ɔ̄yee cáá tijin tikpil ní.

english_verse: An honest witness tells the truth; a dishonest witness tells nothing but lies.
translation_verse: Deedee seeradaaŋwu kaa mɔ́ntí, ama inyimɔn seeradaaŋwu mɔ́ntí ŋma ní.

english_verse: Make fun of wisdom, and you will never find it. But if you have understanding, knowledge comes easily.
translation_verse: Unil un dàkà u-bee nyàab̀ iciin ní kaa kāntí-i, ama an kaa pɔ̄ɔ̄ ulandɔkɔdaan úǹ ń ká dinyil.

english_verse: Stay away from fools, or you won't learn a thing.
translation_verse: Kàkatī a-ba kí wàatī ugbaan, di sá yii aa làá pée ká dinyil diba u-nyɔɔbuŋŋi poon.

english_verse: Wise people have enough sense to find their way, but stupid fools get lost.
translation_verse: Un nyí nì u-bee ciiŋyi di sá ú kpèè u-saŋkindi tiŋan, ama bigbaambi gbaandi di sá bí mɔ̄ntì bin kíǹee.

english_verse: Fools don't care if they are wrong, but God is pleased when people do right.
translation_verse: Bigbaambi kaa fātìi tɔ́ yii bí ŋāŋkì bi-yìntitam. Ama deedeedambi kansikin ní a kāntí Unimbɔti saasɔl.

english_verse: No one else can really know how sad or happy you are.
translation_verse: Unil un bí kunimbaaunee baba di nyí u-nimbaaku. U yaa tí bí mmɔnee, u nì ubɔ kaa tí ŋūǹ kí yàkatī u-mɔŋŋu.

english_verse: The tent of a good person stands longer than the house of someone evil.
translation_verse: Binikpitib diiku làá dāá lítí kí nàan̄, ama ní deedeedambi tantiu ń nīn yú ki pɔ̄ɔ̄.

english_verse: You may think you are on the right road and still end up dead.
translation_verse: Unil ŋūǹ kí dàkafì yii nsan ŋun u nóóyee ŋān̄, ama án dāá kúntée, ŋu cáǹ-u ŋkúmin ní.

english_verse: Sorrow may hide behind laughter, and happiness may end in sorrow.
translation_verse: Unil ŋūǹ kí nīn lāā ama ní u-pɔbil poonee, u bí kunimbaaun, ní dipɔɔpindi ń dāá kúntí nì kunimbaau.

english_verse: You harvest what you plant, whether good or bad.
translation_verse: Unil un pɔbil gáatèe làá dāá fōō digáatil paati, ní deedeedaan mun ń dāá fōō u-deedeeu paati.

english_verse: Don't be stupid and believe all you hear; be smart and know where you are headed.
translation_verse: Kinaatuui di fòol̄ tin kɔkɔ bi tùkù-uee, ama unil un nyí nì u-bee kpèé u-saŋkindi tiŋan ní.

english_verse: Only a stupid fool is never cautious— so be extra careful and stay out of trouble.
translation_verse: Uciŋfiti fàŋkí tikpitil ní ki gɔ́ntí-tì, ama ugbaan úǹ ŋáań tikɔkɔ malaa malaa, kun puee u máká u-ba pu.

english_verse: Fools have quick tempers, and no one likes you if you can't be trusted.
translation_verse: Unil un gífí diŋuul malaayee ŋáań tigbaambɔti, ní biibiidaan dátí kináŋ ki tòó u-ba pu.

english_verse: Stupidity leads to foolishness; be smart and learn.
translation_verse: Nnaatuumu fakal di sá digbaandi, ama binib bin nyí nì bi-bee nyooti di sá dinyil.

english_verse: The wicked will come crawling to those who obey God.
translation_verse: Binikpitib làá gbàan̄ binimɔntiibi nimbiin, ní bikpitiŋaliibi ń dāá yūĺ deedeedambi punyɔkɔpu ki nyàab̀ dijòońdi.

english_verse: You have no friends if you are poor, but you have lots of friends if you are rich.
translation_verse: Usoodaan kɔŋkɔnnaatɔb gba ná-u ní, ama bin néeń ugaajee wīikí tikpil ní.

english_verse: It's wrong to hate others, but God blesses everyone who is kind to the poor.
translation_verse: Unil un kpèé u-juti fámee ŋá ikpiti, ama un sūǹ binandambi saayee bí mmɔnni.

english_verse: It's a mistake to make evil plans, but you will have loyal friends if you want to do right.
translation_verse: Binib bin dàkafī ilandɔkɔkpitee wáŋkì dee, ama bin dàkafī nlandɔkɔmɔntee làá ká tiŋan nì ibaamɔn bi-saŋŋu pu.

english_verse: Hard work is worthwhile, but empty talk will make you poor.
translation_verse: Unil ń tɔ̄ ditundi nì difaŋgiilee cáá tipaal ní, ama kubɔcaau cāabìń disool ní.

english_verse: Wisdom can make you rich, but foolishness leads to more foolishness.
translation_verse: Biciŋfitiibi paatii di sá tigaajati, ama ní bigbaambi bíǹ gbíntíǹ bi-gbaandi.

english_verse: An honest witness can save your life, but liars can't be trusted.
translation_verse: Useeradaan un sòoǹ ibaamɔnee fìil̄ binib ní, ama un mɔ́ntí inyimɔnee nàantí binib ní.

english_verse: If you respect the Lord, you and your children have a strong fortress
translation_verse: Unil un fàŋkí ti-Dindaanee cáá dimákakpaandi, kun puee u sá kibalilaŋ ki tīī u-biyaamu.

english_verse: and a life-giving fountain that keeps you safe from deadly traps.
translation_verse: Unil ń fàŋkì ti-Dindaanee di sá dimaŋfal nyimbuliŋu. An di yàntī ú gɔ́ntí ŋkúm talinti.

english_verse: Rulers of powerful nations are held in honor; rulers of weak nations are nothing at all.
translation_verse: Dinibul din wīikée bɔtiu cáá tinyool ní, ama kitiŋ kin nib yaa bíi bàtēe bɔtiu beel bíi kúntí dee.

english_verse: It's smart to be patient, but it's stupid to lose your temper.
translation_verse: Unil un kaa gífí diŋuul malaayee cáá dinyil tikpil, ama un kaa pɔ̄ɔ̄ diŋuul digiilee dàkà u-gbaandi ní.

english_verse: It's healthy to be content, but envy can eat you up.
translation_verse: Dipɔɔsɔŋkil di yì ŋgbampɔn, ama ní ipoompoon sá iween in ŋmóò ki bùkù akpabee.

english_verse: If you mistreat the poor, you insult your Creator; if you are kind to them, you show him respect.
translation_verse: Unil un wɔ́b̀ binandambee sìí bi-náanliu ní, ama un sūǹ usoodaan saayee tìì Unimbɔti ní tinyool.

english_verse: In times of trouble the wicked are destroyed, but even at death the innocent have faith.
translation_verse: Unikpiti tuŋkpitiŋ di yàntī ú lítí, ama deedeedaan cáá dimákal ki kpáaǹ u-kúmin.

english_verse: Wisdom is found in the minds of people with good sense, but fools don't know it.
translation_verse: Iciin bí unil un cáá dinyilee pɔbilin ní, ama ŋma di ŋūǹ kí ká iciin bigbaambi kansikin?

english_verse: Doing right brings honor to a nation, but sin brings disgrace.
translation_verse: Ditimbundi din nóó deedee saŋŋuee yíkí yilpu ní, ama ní ikpiti íǹ kɔ̄ntí-dì icoo.

english_verse: Kings reward servants who act wisely, but they punish those who act foolishly.
translation_verse: Ubɔti pàkà u-tɔntɔnliu un cáá dinyilee ní, ama u gífí diŋuul un kɔ̄ntí-u icooyee pu.

english_verse: A kind answer soothes angry feelings, but harsh words stir them up.
translation_verse: Unil yaa kíí u-juti dinyɔɔbummɔɔndee, án sɔ̀ŋkī u-ŋuul ní, ama u yaa kíí mpɔn nì mpɔnee, án gbítí u-ŋuul ní.

english_verse: Words of wisdom come from the wise, but fools speak foolishness.
translation_verse: Biciŋfitiibi yaa bíi sòon̄ee, an nyàatī unil ń bīfì ní, ama bigbaambi bíǹ yaa wāaǹ bi-nyɔkɔee, tigbaambɔti ŋma di nyēē.

english_verse: The Lord sees everything, whether good or bad.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan nimbiliŋ làaǹ an kɔkɔ, ki kpèé binikpitib nì binimɔntiibi kɔkɔ.

english_verse: Kind words are good medicine, but deceitful words can really hurt.
translation_verse: Dinyɔɔbundi din sɔ̀ŋkī dipɔbilee sá kii busubu bun tìì dimaŋfalee ní, dinyɔɔbuŋkpil yaa ŋmàl̄ tibɔtinee, an yòontí unil pɔbil ní.

english_verse: Don't be a fool and disobey your parents. Be smart! Accept correction.
translation_verse: Ugbaan kaa fātìi tɔ́ u-baa dàkatam, ama un là bí kpòotī-uee sá uciŋfiti ní.

english_verse: Good people become wealthy, but those who are evil will lose what they have.
translation_verse: Tigaajati tikpaandi di bí deedeedaan dumpu, ama ní unikpiti gaajawanti cāabìń-u nnaabu.

english_verse: Words of wisdom make good sense; the thoughts of a fool make no sense at all.
translation_verse: Biciŋfitiibi nyɔɔbuŋŋi tìì binib dinyil, ama an kaa sá míǹ bigbaambi cee.

english_verse: The Lord is disgusted by gifts from the wicked, but it makes him happy when his people pray.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan ná binikpitib saraabi, ama deedeedambi bíǹ wimmeem tìì-u mmɔn.

english_verse: The Lord is disgusted with all who do wrong, but he loves everyone who does right.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan ná binikpitib bimbim, ama ní ki néeń unil un nóó deedee saŋŋuee.

english_verse: If you turn from the right way, you will be punished; if you refuse correction, you will die.
translation_verse: Un yaa fá nsammɔntee làá ká ditafadaaldi, unil un kaa là bí wòoǹ-uee làá kpú.

english_verse: If the Lord can see everything in the world of the dead, he can see in our hearts.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan nyí tin bí ki jītí ditaŋkpiil poon poon kábuee, ŋma nín yíiń tin ní unil dàkafī u-pɔbilinee.

english_verse: Those who sneer at others don't like to be corrected, and they won't ask help from someone with sense.
translation_verse: Ulambidaan kaa là bí kpòotī-u, an pu ní waa cá biciŋfitiibi cee.

english_verse: Happiness makes you smile; sorrow can crush you.
translation_verse: Dipɔɔpindi bútí nnimbiin ní, ama dipɔɔbiildi cāabìń diwuŋyɔtil ní.

english_verse: Anyone with good sense is eager to learn more, but fools are hungry for foolishness.
translation_verse: Unil un cáá iciinee nyàab̀ dinyil ní, ama bigbaambi nyɔmmunee, tigbaambɔti di gbí.

english_verse: The poor have a hard life, but being content is as good as an endless feast.
translation_verse: Unandaan ceeyee, iwiin kɔkɔ pée pɔ̄ɔ̄ ki tīī-u ní, ama un pɔbil sɔ̀m̀ee ceeyee, ŋwiin kamaa sá-u jiŋaal ní.

english_verse: It's better to obey the Lord and have only a little, than to be very rich and terribly anxious.
translation_verse: An sɔ́ unil ń nīn cáá tigaajawan fiii kí nīn fàŋkí ti-Dindaan, ki jítiǹ ú nīn cáá tigaajati tikpil ki bí iyaliŋki poon.

english_verse: A simple meal with love is better than a feast where there is hatred.
translation_verse: An sɔ́ unil ń ŋmɔ́ tikaŋkaŋfaal tin bi tɔ́kɔǹ nì dineendee ki jítiǹ unaa un bí màlmalee nanti tin bi dū kináŋ ki ŋāāyee.

english_verse: Losing your temper causes a lot of trouble, but staying calm settles arguments.
translation_verse: Unil un kaa pɔ̄ɔ̄ diŋuul digiilee sàal̄ kujaau ní, ama un kaa gífí diŋuul malaayee pèefī kujaau ní.

english_verse: A lazy person refuses to clear a thorny path, but everyone who does right walks on a smooth road.
translation_verse: Uwutijoodaan saŋŋu sá kii ikuŋkumee ní, ama deedeedaan saŋŋu ŋúǹ pée tèen̄ ní.

english_verse: Children with good sense make their parents happy, but foolish children despise them.
translation_verse: Kibiki kin cáá iciinee yàntī ki-baa pɔbil pīiǹ ní, ama ugbaanee, úǹ kpèé u-na fám ní.

english_verse: Stupidity brings happiness to senseless fools, but everyone with good sense follows the straight path.
translation_verse: Unil un kaa cáá iciinee fàal̀ u-gbaandi pu ní, ama unil un cáá dinyilee nóó deedee saŋŋu ní.

english_verse: Without good advice everything goes wrong— it takes careful planning for things to go right.
translation_verse: Unil yaa kaa bàlifī isaŋkee, tin u bɔ́ntée kaa còom̄, ama bisaŋkiliibi yaa wīikée an còom̄ ní.

english_verse: All who are wise follow a road that leads upward to life and away from death.
translation_verse: Unil un nyée nóó nsan ŋun jɔ́ḿ ki cá dimaŋfal laŋkee ní. Waa nōotí ŋun sìntī ditaŋkpiilin taapuee.

english_verse: The Lord destroys the homes of those who are proud, but he protects the property of widows.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan nàantí bilambidambi diiŋŋi, ama u mɔ́tí ukpiipu tampaaŋŋu pu.

english_verse: The Lord hates evil thoughts, but kind words please him.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan ná ilandɔkɔkpiti, ama u fáatì anyɔɔbummɔnti.

english_verse: Being greedy causes trouble for your family, but you protect yourself by refusing bribes.
translation_verse: Unil un néeń animbil tikpilee kɔ̄ntí u-dicaŋku agìńni ní. Ama un ná dinyɔɔŋeebil jimee cáá mmaŋfafɔkɔn ní.

english_verse: Good people think before they answer, but the wicked speak evil without ever thinking.
translation_verse: Deedeedaan dàkafī kí wàatī ní kí nín kíí tibɔti, ama binikpitib bíǹ wùliŋkī tibɔfan ní.

english_verse: A friendly smile makes you happy, and good news makes you feel strong.
translation_verse: Nnimbiin ŋun bútèe tìì mmɔn, ní tibɔmɔntiil tìì mpɔn.

english_verse: Healthy correction is good, and if you accept it, you will be wise.
translation_verse: Unil un pílifí isaŋki in tìì dimaŋfalee cáá u-kɔŋkooŋŋu biciŋfitiibi kansikin.

english_verse: You hurt only yourself by rejecting instruction, but it makes good sense to accept it.
translation_verse: Unil un kaa là bí kpòotī-uee ná u-ba ní, ama un fòol̄ iwoonee béetí iciin.

english_verse: Showing respect to the Lord will make you wise, and being humble will bring honor to you.
translation_verse: Á fàŋkì ti-Dindaanee, an bífí iciin ní. Kí wàatī á ká tinyoolee, see á sìntīǹ a-ba.

english_verse: We humans make plans, but the Lord has the final word.
translation_verse: Unil màkà, ama ti-Dindaan di lèekī min u làá ŋée.

english_verse: We may think we know what is right, but the Lord is the judge of our motives.
translation_verse: Unil dàkafī yii tin u pée ŋáańee kɔkɔ ŋān̄ ní, ama ti-Dindaan di kpèé ki wāĺ unil pɔbilin.

english_verse: Share your plans with the Lord, and you will succeed.
translation_verse: Tin kɔkɔ a là kí ŋée, dūú ŋá ti-Dindaan ŋaan, ní kí ŋmā kí ŋá tin a bɔ́ntèe.

english_verse: The Lord has a reason for everything he does, and he lets evil people live only to be punished.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan nyí kun pu ní u náań tiwan kɔkɔee. U náań unikpiti mun ki cíitì ŋwiin ŋun u làá dáaĺ u-tafalee ní.

english_verse: The Lord doesn't like anyone who is conceited— you can be sure they will be punished.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan ná bilambidambi, báà án ŋá pu, u làá dáaĺ bi-tafal.

english_verse: If we truly love God, our sins will be forgiven; if we show him respect, we will keep away from sin.
translation_verse: Dineeŋkpaandi nì ibaamɔn pu ní unil kāntí ikpiti pɔ̄tam. Unil un fàŋkí ti-Dindaanee sáń ikpiti ní.

english_verse: When we please the Lord, even our enemies make friends with us.
translation_verse: Unil bimbim yaa fáatiǹ ti-Dindaanee, u yàntī u nì u-nannanliibi gba ń mɔ̄ɔkì ní.

english_verse: It's better to be honest and poor than to be dishonest and rich.
translation_verse: Unil ń dī tibulcin pu kí ká tigaajawan fiiiyee sɔ́ǹ ú dī isaŋkpiti pu kí ká tigaajati tikpil.

english_verse: We make our own plans, but the Lord decides where we will go.
translation_verse: Unil pɔbil poon ní u bɔ́ntí nsan ŋun u làá còom̀ee, ama ti-Dindaan di lèekī ŋun u làá nóóyee. Alaŋkpan ŋin sòoǹ bibɔtiibi puee

english_verse: The Lord watches to see if we are fair or if we cheat others.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan cee ní saniyab bin bí deedeeyee nyēē, ataŋkpaŋmantikaa ŋin kā tilɔtinee kɔkɔ nyiŋfiŋu sá u-tundi ní.

english_verse: Justice makes rulers powerful. They should hate evil
translation_verse: Bibɔtiibi ná binib bin ŋáań ikpitee, di sá yii deedee di tìì dibeel mpɔn.

english_verse: An angry ruler can put you to death. So be wise! Don't make one angry.
translation_verse: Ubɔti ŋuul sá ŋkpituun ní, ama uciŋfiti ŋūǹ kí sɔ̀ŋkì-dì

english_verse: When a ruler is happy and pleased with you, it's like refreshing rain, and you will live.
translation_verse: Ubɔti nimbiin yaa ŋān̄ee, an sá dimaŋfal ní, u-ŋanti bí kii ukpaasiitaayee ní. Unil nín máaǹ kí nīn bí min samaa kansikinee laŋkpaŋŋi

english_verse: It's much better to be wise and sensible than to be rich.
translation_verse: Unil ń nīn cáá iciin sɔ́ǹ ú nīn cáá sindaariya. Unil ń nīn cáá dinyil sɔ́ǹ ú nīn cáá animbil kúti.

english_verse: God's people avoid evil ways, and they protect themselves by watching where they go.
translation_verse: Deedeedambi còom̄ nsan ŋun tèen̄ee poon ní ki gɔ́ntí tikpitil. Unil un nyí u nín còom̄ puee fìil̄ u-maŋfal ní.

english_verse: Too much pride will destroy you.
translation_verse: Dilambil cáǹ unil dinàandin, ní dibadakal cáǹ unil dilitilin.

english_verse: You are better off to be humble and poor than to get rich from what you take by force.
translation_verse: Unil ń sìntīǹ u-ba taapu kí nīn bí biwɔfib kansikinee sɔ́ǹ u nì bilambidambi ń nīn yàkatī tigaajawan.

english_verse: If you know what you're doing, you will prosper. God blesses everyone who trusts him.
translation_verse: Unil un yaa pílifí ti-Dindaan bɔtee, án làá bútí-u, un yaa máká ti-Dindaan puee bí mmɔnni.

english_verse: Good judgment proves that you are wise, and if you speak kindly, you can teach others.
translation_verse: Unil un sòoǹ tibɔti nì iciinee ní bi yíì unyil. Dinyɔɔbummɔɔndi din u sòoǹee di kútí dinyil.

english_verse: Good sense is a fountain that gives life, but fools are punished by their foolishness.
translation_verse: Iciin sá kii nnyimbul ŋun tìì dimaŋfalee ní ki tīī un cáá-iee. Bigbaambi bi-ba gbaandi di dátí bi-tafal.

english_verse: You can persuade others if you are wise and speak sensibly.
translation_verse: Unil un cáá iciinee dàkafī ní kí nín sòoǹ, ní u-nyil mɔ̀tīi kútí tin u sòoǹee pu mpɔn.

english_verse: Kind words are like honey— they cheer you up and make you feel strong.
translation_verse: Dinyɔɔbummɔɔndi sá kii tisiilee ní, tì mɔ̄ kinyɔkɔn ní ki tìì ŋgbampɔn.

english_verse: Sometimes what seems right is really a road to death.
translation_verse: Unil ŋūǹ kí dàkafì yii nsan ŋun u nóóyee ŋān̄, ama án dāá kúntée, ŋu cáǹ-u ŋkúmin ní.

english_verse: The hungrier you are, the harder you work.
translation_verse: Ŋkùm di yàntī utɔntɔnli ń tɔ̄ ditundi, di sá yii u-pool di páb̀-u ú tɔ̄ ditundi.

english_verse: Worthless people plan trouble. Even their words burn like a flaming fire.
translation_verse: Unil un kaa bí tibanee dàkafī kí ŋá tikpitil ní, tibɔti tin nyēē u-nyɔkɔnee sèetī kii ŋŋmee ní.

english_verse: Gossip is no good! It causes hard feelings and comes between friends.
translation_verse: Biibiidaan jāantí binib, ní ubɔmbɔtukul yàkatī bibɔɔtiibi.

english_verse: Don't trust violent people. They will mislead you to do the wrong thing.
translation_verse: Unil un ŋáań tipɔmbɔtee ŋmàtíǹ u-juti ní ki cáǹ-u nsaŋkpitin.

english_verse: When someone winks or grins behind your back, trouble is on the way.
translation_verse: Unil yaa dū u-nimbiliŋ ki ŋúb́ ki dākafì kí tɔ̄ atuŋkpiti, ní ki ŋmáaḿ u-nyunculiŋee, u pée ŋá tikpitil ki dóò dee.

english_verse: Gray hair is a glorious crown worn by those who have lived right.
translation_verse: Tiyikpipin sá tinyool beefuuliiki ní, bin nóó deedee saŋŋuee di kāntí-kì.

english_verse: Controlling your temper is better than being a hero who captures a city.
translation_verse: Unil un kaa gífí diŋuul malaayee jítiǹ ubaatandaan. Unil un ŋúb́ u-bee jítiǹ un di ŋūǹ kí já kí fōō kitimmɔŋee.

english_verse: We make our own decisions, but the Lord alone determines what happens.
translation_verse: Bi ŋūǹ kí tɔ̄ kasi tiba pu, ama ti-Dindaan di lèekī tin u là án ŋée.

english_verse: A dry crust of bread eaten in peace and quiet is better than a feast eaten where everyone argues.
translation_verse: Laakin ní a làá ká kinɔkatii kikuliŋŋi kí pɔ̀kɔ̄ ní ŋgbansɔŋfi bée sɔ́ǹ dicindi din poon busamɔntiibu bun pu tinan pée gbí, ama ní kujaau bée.

english_verse: A wise slave will be placed in charge of a no-good child, and that slave will be given the same inheritance that each child receives.
translation_verse: Uyumbu un wálifèe làá dāá fōō u-dindaan jipɔɔn un kɔ̄ntí-u icooyee paaŋŋu, ní u nì u-dindaan jipɔmbi ń dāá yàkatī difakal din u yóoǹ-bee.

english_verse: Silver and gold are tested by flames of fire; our thoughts are tested by the Lord.
translation_verse: Ŋŋmi ní bi cáa cɔ́ŋkí kí béé animbil kúti timɔntiil nì sindaariyamɔnti, ama ti-Dindaan di cɔ́ŋkí unil pɔbil kí béé di nín sá diŋyee.

english_verse: Troublemakers listen to troublemakers, and liars listen to liars.
translation_verse: Unikpiti pílifíǹ binib bin sòoǹ anyɔɔbuŋkpitee, ní unyimɔndaan pílifíǹ bin sòoǹ ki bíiĺ bi-jutiibee.

english_verse: By insulting the poor, you insult your Creator. You will be punished if you make fun of someone in trouble.
translation_verse: Unil un bèel̄ usoodaanee sìí u-náanliu ní. Un juti yaa bí dinimbinaamandin an mɔ̄ǹ-uee kaa làá lóó ditafadaaldi.

english_verse: Grandparents are proud of their grandchildren, and children should be proud of their parents.
translation_verse: Bitikpilib naantiibi di yì bi-nyooti, ama ní bibaatiibi yì bi-jipɔmbi yati.

english_verse: It sounds strange for a fool to talk sensibly, but it's even worse for a ruler to tell lies.
translation_verse: Tibɔmɔntiil kaa máaǹ ugbaan, míǹ ní inyimɔn kaa máaǹ unil un bi tìì disíndee.

english_verse: A bribe works miracles like a magic charm that brings good luck.
translation_verse: Bin cáá tiwan kí pɔ̄ee ceeyee, tiwampɔkaal sá kii diyimɔɔl sabilee ní. Laakin pú ní u yaa fātèe, an bútí-u ní.

english_verse: You will keep your friends if you forgive them, but you will lose your friends if you keep talking about what they did wrong.
translation_verse: Unil un súntí u-juti nín yìntīǹ-u puee kāntí bibɔɔtiibi, ama un pée téetí ki sòoǹ múlmulee yàkatī bibɔɔtiibi ní.

english_verse: A sensible person accepts correction, but you can't beat sense into a fool.
translation_verse: Á wòoǹ unyil dibaba ja làá tɔ̄ u-ni ditundi ki jítiǹ á gbá ugbaan anaalab dilaataal.

english_verse: A bear robbed of her cubs is far less dangerous than a stubborn fool.
translation_verse: Á tū digbiŋgbil din biyaamu bi cúúyee nsanni sɔ́ǹ ugbaan un bí ki tūǹ agbaantuunee.

english_verse: You will always have trouble if you are mean to those who are good to you.
translation_verse: Unil yaa dū tikpitil ki pàn̄ tiŋan tin bi ŋá-uee, u-dicaŋkun tikpitil làá nīn pée bí ní ki cá talku.

english_verse: The start of an argument is like a water leak— so stop it before real trouble breaks out.
translation_verse: Á kíĺ kunikpɔŋkpɔkɔu sá kii á pìitī nnyimbilkaam kí pɔ̄-mì nsan mí pùub̀ee ní. Dūú gbèen̄ kí taa yàntī án kpántí kujaau.

english_verse: The Lord doesn't like those who defend the guilty or condemn the innocent.
translation_verse: Unil un pɔ̀ dibɔkpil daanee nì unil un kù ibaamɔndaan bɔtee, ti-Dindaan ná binib gbanti liitil.

english_verse: Why should fools have money for an education when they refuse to learn?
translation_verse: Animbil yaa bí ugbaan ŋaanee, u làá dūú ŋá nì ba? Ú cáá dā iciinaaa? Míǹ kaa bí u-yilin.

english_verse: A friend is there to help, in any situation, and relatives are born to share our troubles.
translation_verse: Ubɔɔti dàkà u-neendi ŋyunti kamaa ní, ama kinabiki kíǹ bí kí tíkiń dinimbinaamandin ní.

english_verse: The wicked and the proud love trouble and keep begging to be hurt.
translation_verse: Un néeń kujaauee néeń ikpiti ní, un yòontí u-ba yilpuee dāa lítí.

english_verse: Dishonesty does you no good, and telling lies will get you in trouble.
translation_verse: An kaa bútí milimilidaan, ní nnaabu làá jēetí un kaa sòoǹ ibaamɔnee pu.

english_verse: It's never pleasant to be the parent of a fool and have nothing but pain.
translation_verse: Un màl̄ ugbaanee pée bí kunimbaaun ŋma ní. Un kaa nyí tibee baa kaa ŋūǹ kí nīn bí mmɔnni.

english_verse: If you are cheerful, you feel good; if you are sad, you hurt all over.
translation_verse: Dipɔɔpindi cāantí iween ní, ama kunimbaau bàtī unil pɔŋŋu ní.

english_verse: Crooks accept secret bribes to keep justice from being done.
translation_verse: Unikpiti fòol̄ tiwampɔkaal dibalin, kí taa sòoǹ tibɔti ti-pú.

english_verse: Anyone with wisdom knows what makes good sense, but fools can never make up their minds.
translation_verse: Unyil nimbikpeeŋu pée cɔ́ iciin pu ní, ama ugbaan úǹ nimbikpeeŋu cɔ́ ndandati ní kaa wāĺ tiba.

english_verse: Foolish children bring sorrow and pain to their parents.
translation_verse: Ugbaan tìì u-baa kunimbaau, ní ki tìì u-na un màl̄-uee nnyɔɔtun.

english_verse: It isn't fair to punish the innocent and those who do right.
translation_verse: An kaa ŋān̄ bí dáaĺ maanyiiba tafal báà fiii pu, an kaa tí ŋān̄ yii bí gbá jilmadaan u-baamɔŋyi pu.

english_verse: It makes a lot of sense to be a person of few words and to stay calm.
translation_verse: Unil un kaa sòoǹ tikpilee di cáá iciin, ní un dàkafī kí nín sòoǹee di cáá dinyil.

english_verse: It's selfish and stupid to think only of yourself and to sneer at people who have sense.
translation_verse: Unil un dàkafī u-baba puee kaa kàal̀ bin kíǹee cee, bi yaa là kí tūtuǹ-uee, ní ú gíí diŋuul.

english_verse: Fools have no desire to learn, instead they would rather give their own opinion.
translation_verse: Tin mɔ̄ǹ ugbaanee kaa sá yii ú gbìl̄ tibɔti taapu, ama ú lēē u-landɔkɔi kí bíĺ mpaampiin pu.

english_verse: Wrongdoing leads to shame and disgrace.
translation_verse: Atuŋkpiti di cāabìń kpeefam, ní icoo yàntī unil ń fá u-nyooti.

english_verse: Words of wisdom are a stream that flows from a deep fountain.
translation_verse: Unil nyɔɔbuŋŋi sá kii nnyim min nyóòyee, mbun ŋun gbée nì nnyimbul ŋun nyim sá kii iciin ki pùub̀ee ní.

english_verse: It's wrong to favor the guilty and keep the innocent from getting justice.
translation_verse: An kaa ŋān̄ bí dī dibɔkpil daan boon kí sòoǹ kí kpɔ̀ deedeedaan un cáá ibaamɔnee bɔti.

english_verse: Foolish talk will get you into a lot of trouble.
translation_verse: Ugbaan nyɔɔbuŋŋi cāabìń kunikpɔŋkpɔkɔu, ní tibɔti tin nyēē u-nyɔkɔnee dāa kúntí nì kujaau.

english_verse: Saying foolish things is like setting a trap to destroy yourself.
translation_verse: Ugbaan nyɔkɔ di nàantí-u, u-nyɔɔbuŋŋi sàtī-u kii kutaliŋŋuee ní.

english_verse: There's nothing so delicious as the taste of gossip! It melts in your mouth.
translation_verse: Ubɔmbɔtukul nyɔɔbuŋŋi sá tijin tin mɔ̄ee ní, tì kóò unil poon ní fíŋfiŋ.

english_verse: Being lazy is no different from being a troublemaker.
translation_verse: Unil un ŋáań diwutijool u-tundinee nì unil un bíiĺ ditundee sá kuyuu nì ku-bukul ní.

english_verse: The Lord is a mighty tower where his people can run for safety—
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan yindi di wúń m-pu, deedeedaan yaa sáǹ kí kɔ́-uee, u bí ŋgbansɔŋfin ní.

english_verse: It's stupid and embarrassing to give an answer before you listen.
translation_verse: Unil un kíikí tibɔti kí wàatī kí nín gbìl̄-tèe dàkà u-gbaandi ní ki kɔ̄ntí u-ba icoo.

english_verse: Being cheerful helps when you are sick, but nothing helps when you give up.
translation_verse: Unil mákal di tīkintí-u u-weeŋyi poon, ama u yaa kaa ti cáá dimákalee, ŋma di gíti ŋūǹ kí tūtuǹ-u?

english_verse: A gift will get you in to see anyone.
translation_verse: Tiwampɔkaal pìitī unil nsan ú ŋmā kí cù binikpaambi cee.

english_verse: You may think you have won your case in court, until your opponent speaks.
translation_verse: Unil un péé ki sòon̄ tibɔtee yati di bí kii tì ŋān̄ee. Ama u nì un cáá tɔbee yaa sòon̄ u-yatee ní bí ká yii an nyáń ti-ba.

english_verse: Drawing straws is one way to settle a difficult case.
translation_verse: Bi tòó kasi ní kí kúntí kujaau, ní kí pàtī bipɔɔbi.

english_verse: Make your words good— you will be glad you did.
translation_verse: Unil nyɔɔbuŋŋi di yì-tì ní ú ká kí jī. Tibɔti tin u sòoǹee di yàntī ní ú díkí.

english_verse: Words can bring death or life! Talk too much, and you will eat everything you say.
translation_verse: Ibɔsoon ŋūǹ kí cáań dimaŋfal àá ŋkúm, unil un néeń ki sòoǹee máaǹ kí kíí kí fōō isoon paati.

english_verse: A man's greatest treasure is his wife— she is a gift from the Lord.
translation_verse: Unil un ká unimpu ki cááyee ká tiwammɔntiil dee. An sá tiŋaŋkpaandi ní ti-Dindaan ŋá ki tīī-u.

english_verse: The poor must beg for help, but the rich can give a harsh reply.
translation_verse: Unandaan sòoǹ ki gbàam̄, ama ní ugaaja kíikí nì mpɔn.

english_verse: Some friends don't help, but a true friend is closer than your own family.
translation_verse: Unil yaa cáá bibɔɔtiibi tikpilee, án ŋūǹ kí bīil̀-u, ama ubɔɔti ubɔ bí ki ŋūǹ kí nīn nákáǹ-si ki jītíǹ kinabiki.

english_verse: It's better to be poor and live right than to be a stupid liar.
translation_verse: Unil un sá usoodaan ki còom̄ deedee saŋŋunee sɔ́ǹ unil un di sá unyimɔndaan ki sá ugbaanee.

english_verse: Willingness and stupidity don't go well together. If you are too eager, you will miss the road.
translation_verse: An kaa ŋān̄ unil ń nīn bí kaa cáá nlandɔkɔ. Unil un di jìkì tikpilee làá lítí ikpitin.

english_verse: We are ruined by our own stupidity, though we blame the Lord.
translation_verse: Unil u-ba gbaandi yaa nāaǹ-uee, ní ú dūú nyìntī ti-Dindaan pu.

english_verse: The rich have many friends; the poor have none.
translation_verse: Tigaajati yàntī unil bɔɔbi mɔ̀tīi wīintí ní, ama ní unandaan úǹ nì u-bɔɔ ń yàkatīǹ tɔbin.

english_verse: Everyone tries to be friends of those who can help them.
translation_verse: Binib tikpil cáá nyɔɔmálmal ki ŋmàtíǹ binikpaambi, ní báà ŋma bɔɔ sá unil un pūǹee.

english_verse: If you are poor, your own relatives reject you, and your friends are worse. When you really need them, they are not there.
translation_verse: Usoodaan nabiyaamu kɔkɔ kaa là u-bɔti, míǹ ní u-bɔɔbi mun sáń ki wàatī-u. U yaa bàà là kí sòoǹ nì bee, baa bí.

english_verse: Do yourself a favor by having good sense— you will be glad you did.
translation_verse: Unil un yaa cáá iciinee néeń u-ba. Un di yaa pɔ́ɔǹ kí gbìl̄ tibɔti taapuee làá gbìl̄ mmɔn.

english_verse: It isn't right for a fool to live in luxury or for a slave to rule in place of a king.
translation_verse: An kaa kítì yii ugbaan ń nīn bí mmɔnni, míǹ ní uyumbu kaa máaǹ kí nīn cáá bikpootiliibi pu mpɔn.

english_verse: It's wise to be patient and show what you are like by forgiving others.
translation_verse: Unil un cáá dinyilee kaa gífí diŋuul malaa, tin yì u-nyootee di sá u súntí tin bi yīntiǹ-uee pu.

english_verse: An angry king roars like a lion, but when a king is pleased, it's like dew on the crops.
translation_verse: Ubɔti yaa gíí diŋuulee, an bí kii gbikinti nín sūǹ puee ní. Ama u-ŋanti sá kii dimalindi nín tòó kumoou pu puee ní.

english_verse: Foolish children bring disgrace to their fathers. A nagging wife goes on and on like the drip, drip, drip of the rain.
translation_verse: Ugbaan sá dinimbinaamandi ní ki tīī u-baa. Unimpubɔmbɔdaan sá kii nnyim min còol̀ kaa gúǹee ní.

english_verse: You may inherit all you own from your parents, but a sensible wife is a gift from the Lord.
translation_verse: Unil ŋūǹ kí jī u-baabi diiku nì animbil difakal, ama ti-Dindaan di tìì uninja unimpu un cáá iciinee.

english_verse: If you are lazy and sleep your time away, you will starve.
translation_verse: Diwutijool cāabìń ŋgeem, ní ŋkùm cútí un kā ki kpàl̄ iŋalee.

english_verse: Obey the Lord's teachings and you will live— disobey and you will die.
translation_verse: Unil un tɔ́ marabee wúń u-maŋfal pu ní. Un kaa kpèé u-bimbim tiŋanee làá kpú ní.

english_verse: Caring for the poor is lending to the Lord, and you will be well repaid.
translation_verse: Unil un yaa pú unandaan tiwanee pīnnì ti-Dindaan ní, di sá yii ti-Dindaan làá dāá téeǹ-u.

english_verse: Correct your children before it's too late; if you don't punish them, trouble will come their way.
translation_verse: Dáaĺ a-biki tafal ŋyunti ŋun dimákal dáá béé, ama á taa nín gíí diŋuul kí tin nyàab̀ kí kpɔ̀-kì ní.

english_verse: People with bad tempers are always in trouble, and they need help over and over again.
translation_verse: Unil un yaa gíí diŋuul ŋkpitim puee máaǹ kí pà dipɔndi. Di sá yii a yaa yāntì-uee, a bíi tìì-u kunyannyaau ú fàtīí kíĺ dee.

english_verse: Pay attention to advice and accept correction, so you can live sensibly.
translation_verse: Pīlifì isaŋki, kí kíí bí dàkà-si ní kí kpántí uciŋfiti.

english_verse: We may make a lot of plans, but the Lord will do what he has decided.
translation_verse: Unil pɔbil poonee, u bɔ́ntí tiwan tikpil tin u làá ŋée, ama ti-Dindaan nín là puee di làá dāá pée ŋá.

english_verse: What matters most is loyalty. It's better to be poor than to be a liar.
translation_verse: Tin bi cí kí ká unil ceeyee di sá u-niti. An ŋān̄ unil ń nīn sá usoodaan ki jítiǹ ú nīn sá unyimɔndaan.

english_verse: Showing respect to the Lord brings true life— if you do it, you can relax without fear of danger.
translation_verse: Unil ń fàŋkì ti-Dindaanee tìì dimaŋfal. Udaan làá nīn bí digbilin ní kaa làá gbìl̄ tibɔkpitil tiba pu.

english_verse: Some people are too lazy to lift a hand to feed themselves.
translation_verse: Uwutijoodaan dùŋfī u-ŋal kí bɔ̄ disambilin, ama ní kaa ŋūǹ kí gíiǹní-ŋu u-nyɔkɔn.

english_verse: Stupid fools learn good sense by seeing others punished; a sensible person learns by being corrected.
translation_verse: A yaa gbáń ulambidaanee, un kaa nyí tibee kíǹ ki nyí nì u-ba ní. A yaa wòon̄ uciŋfitee, u làá bīfì iciin kí kūtì ní.

english_verse: Disgraceful children rob their father and chase their mother away.
translation_verse: Kibiki kin sāaǹ ki-baa ki jìn̄ ki-nee sá kibiki kin bíil̀-bi ki kɔ́ǹ-bi icooyee ní.

english_verse: If you stop learning, you will forget what you already know.
translation_verse: M-biki, a yaa gbēeǹ kaa ti bíi pílifí isaŋkee, a fātì a-boon ki tīī dinyil dee.

english_verse: A lying witness makes fun of the court system, and criminals think crime is really delicious.
translation_verse: A yaa yíiń maabiiban ń dāá lēē seerayee, waa dù deedee bɔti ki yíiń tiba. Tikpitil ní binikpitib jīǹ ki bí.

english_verse: A stupid fool should expect to be punished.
translation_verse: Bi bɔ́ntì ditafadaaldi ki cíitì bilambidambi, ní ki bɔ́ntì bigbaambi boon ki cíitì tigbati.

english_verse: It isn't smart to get drunk! Drinking makes a fool of you and leads to fights.
translation_verse: Ndaam yàntī unil ń kpántí ulambidaan, ní ndaam min pɔ̄ɔ̄yee yàntī ú kpántí kufuudaan. Unil un nyù-mì tikpilee kaa cáá iciin.

english_verse: An angry ruler is like a roaring lion— make either one angry, and you are dead.
translation_verse: Ubɔti yaa gíí diŋuulee, an bí kii gbikinti nín sūǹ puee ní. Unil un yaa gbítì ubɔti ŋuulee nyàab̄ tibɔti ki tɔ́ u-ba pu ní.

english_verse: It makes you look good when you avoid a fight— only fools love to quarrel.
translation_verse: An sá jilma ní ki tīī unil un yíití kunikpɔŋkpɔkɔuee. Ama ugbaan úǹ néeń kujaau ní.

english_verse: If you are too lazy to plow, don't expect a harvest.
translation_verse: Ukpaayoon yaa kaa kùn̄ tikpaal ti-yuntiŋu, waa dāa kāntí tiba kí cā kudiceeu.

english_verse: Someone's thoughts may be as deep as the ocean, but if you are smart, you will discover them.
translation_verse: Unil landɔkɔi sá kii lɔkɔ un nyóòyee nyim ní. Unil un cáá dinyilee di ŋūǹ kí dáaĺ-i kí nyāntí.

english_verse: There are many who say, “You can trust me!” But can they be trusted?
translation_verse: Binib tikpil lì yii bíǹ di sá bimɔntiibi. Ama ŋma di baasii ŋūǹ kí ká unil un bí deedeeyee?

english_verse: Good people live right, and God blesses the children who follow their example.
translation_verse: Deedeedaan còom̄ deedee saŋŋu ní, u-kpátam boonee u-biyaamu làá nīn bí mmɔnni!

english_verse: When rulers decide cases, they weigh the evidence.
translation_verse: Ubɔti yaa kāl̀ kubɔsoondiin kí sòoǹ tibɔtee, dicilpu malaayee, u kpáàa pée wál̀ tin kaa ŋān̄ee.

english_verse: Can any of us really say, “My thoughts are pure, and my sins are gone”?
translation_verse: Ŋma ŋūǹ kí lì yii: <M fíntì m-pɔbil píil̀ káŋkaŋ, m fíntì m-ba ki nyáń m-kpitiin?>

english_verse: The good or bad that children do shows what they are like.
translation_verse: Kibiki tuuŋŋi pu ní unil béetí yii kun kì ŋée ŋān̄ ki bí deedee.

english_verse: Hearing and seeing are gifts from the Lord.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan di náań atafal bí nīn cáa pílifí nì animbil bí nīn cáa kpèé.

english_verse: If you sleep all the time, you will starve; if you get up and work, you will have enough food.
translation_verse: Taa nín̄ néeń ŋgeem, a làá dāá kpántí usoodaan. Nín̄ wāĺ ní kí ká kí jī kí díkí.

english_verse: Sensible words are better than gold or jewels.
translation_verse: Sindaariya gbōō, ní abeedimbil dɔ̄ tilèel, ama iciin nyɔɔbuŋŋi di sá tin pée cáá kunyampoouee.

english_verse: You deserve to lose your coat if you loan it to someone to guarantee payment for the debt of a stranger.
translation_verse: Unil yaa yúl̀ unil un waa nyée boon kí pìnnì tibee, á fōō u-bɔkutil kí yóoń. U nín yúl̀ unicaan boonee puee, á fōō u-cee toolima kí yóoń.

english_verse: The food you get by cheating may taste delicious, but it turns to gravel.
translation_verse: Tinaayujin dá láá mɔ̄ unil nyɔkɔn ní. Ama boon kinyɔkɔ yaa gbée, an kpántí itaŋkpabiiti ní.

english_verse: Be sure you have sound advice before making plans or starting a war.
translation_verse: Isaŋki di yàntī unil ń ŋmā kí ŋá tin u bɔ́ntèe. A yaa làá cù kujaauee, a bɔ́ntí tiŋan ní.

english_verse: Children who curse their parents will go to the land of darkness long before their time.
translation_verse: Unil un di yaa kpēē ki sīŋkiǹ u-baa nì u-nee, u làá kpú kii fitila nín kúù dibɔmbɔndin puee ní.

english_verse: Getting rich quick may turn out to be a curse.
translation_verse: Unil yaa jíń difakal malaayee, kí dāá kúntée, dàa cáá dibiindi.

english_verse: Don't try to get even. Trust the Lord, and he will help you.
translation_verse: Taa lì yii a làá téeǹ ikpiti in bi ŋá-see. Nín̄ pée máká ti-Dindaan pu, u làá dāá fīī-si.

english_verse: The Lord hates dishonest scales and dishonest weights. So don't cheat!
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan ná tiwaŋŋmantikaal tin kaa bí deedeeyee. Saniya un kaa ŋmàntī tiwan deedeeyee mun kaa ŋān̄ u-cee.

english_verse: How can we know what will happen to us when the Lord alone decides?
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan di kpòotī unil u-saŋkindi poon. Nisaaleen làá ŋá mana kí béé laakin u cée.

english_verse: Our inner thoughts are a lamp from the Lord, and they search our hearts.
translation_verse: Unil fam sá fitila ní ti-Dindaan dūu tīī-u, ú nīn cáa ŋmíntí ki wāĺ u-poon fɔ́ŋfɔŋ.

english_verse: Rulers are protected by God's mercy and loyalty, but they must be merciful for their kingdoms to last.
translation_verse: Ubɔti ŋanti nì u-baamɔŋyi di wúń u-pu, tiŋan tin u ŋáańee di tíkí u-beejal.

english_verse: Young people take pride in their strength, but the gray hairs of wisdom are even more beautiful.
translation_verse: Mpɔn di sá binipɔmbi nyooti, ní tiyikpipin sá bitikpilib nyaaŋku.

english_verse: A severe beating can knock all of the evil out of you!
translation_verse: Tigbati buuŋyi sá tikpitil nyɔkɔŋu ní, míǹ mbaantiim ní i kóò kí bà unil poon fɔ́ŋfɔŋ.

english_verse: The Lord controls rulers, just as he determines the course of rivers.
translation_verse: Ubɔti pɔbil sá kii mbunee ní ti-Dindaan ŋaan, ní laakin pú ní u yaa lèe, ú kpòotī-dì kí túĺ.

english_verse: We may think we are doing the right thing, but the Lord always knows what is in our hearts.
translation_verse: Unil dàkafī yii tin kɔkɔ u ŋáańee ŋān̄ ní, ama un nyí tin kā unil pɔbilinee di sá ti-Dindaan.

english_verse: Doing what is right and fair pleases the Lord more than an offering.
translation_verse: Mbimbim min ŋān̄ ki bí deedeeyee ŋān̄ ti-Dindaan cee ki jítiǹ saraabi.

english_verse: Evil people are proud and arrogant, but sin is the only crop they produce.
translation_verse: Dibadakal nì dilambil di sá tin lèekī binikpitib kpitii ki dàkēe.

english_verse: If you plan and work hard, you will have plenty; if you hurry to get rich, you will end up poor.
translation_verse: Ufaŋgiifiti landɔkɔi kɔ̄ntí-u digbilin ní, ama kujinjikilaapaau daan kóò disoolin ní.

english_verse: Cheating to get rich is a foolish dream and no less than suicide.
translation_verse: Binib bin mɔ́ntì inyimɔn ki ká tigaajatee sá bin sáń ki kóò ŋkúm ŋaanee ní. Bi kāntí tiwan tin kaa bí tiban kaa yúntée ní.

english_verse: You destroy yourself by being cruel and violent and refusing to live right.
translation_verse: Tipɔmbɔti tin binikpitib ŋáańee di kù-bi, kun puee bi yíì kí tɔ̄ deedee tuuŋŋi.

english_verse: All crooks are liars, but anyone who is innocent will do right.
translation_verse: Unikpiti nóó nsan ŋun gɔ́ĺee ní, ama maanyiiba úǹ nóó nsan ŋun tèen̄ee ní.

english_verse: It's better to stay outside on the roof of your house than to live inside with a nagging wife.
translation_verse: An sɔ́ á nīn kóò digunlɔkɔlin ki jítiǹ si nì unimpu un néeń kujaauee ń nīn kóò.

english_verse: Evil people want to do wrong, even to their friends.
translation_verse: Unikpiti úǹ pée nyàab̀ kí ŋá ikpiti ŋma ní, waa sūǹ u-bɔɔ gba saai.

english_verse: An ignorant fool learns by seeing others punished; a sensible person learns by being instructed.
translation_verse: Bi yaa dáaĺ ulambidaan tafalee, un kaa nyí tibee cíikí ní. Bi yaa dàkā uciŋfitee, u-nyil mɔ̀tīi kútí ní.

english_verse: God is always fair! He knows what the wicked do and will punish them.
translation_verse: Deedeedaan nyí tin jītí unikpiti dicaŋkunee. U làá téé-bi kí tɔ̄ nnaabun.

english_verse: If you won't help the poor, don't expect to be heard when you cry out for help.
translation_verse: Unil un yaa kpáá u-tafal kaa pílifì unandaan kuŋkuuntiiyee, u mun yaa láa bíi kūuntí ki nyàab̀ dijòońdee, baa làá dāá pīlifiǹ-u.

english_verse: When justice is done, good citizens are glad and crooks are terrified.
translation_verse: Kí ŋá tin tèen̄ee sá mmɔn ní ki tīī deedeedaan, ama ní ki sá tifaandi ki tīī bikpitiŋaliibi.

english_verse: If you stop using good sense, you will find yourself in the grave.
translation_verse: Unil un yaa kākatì u-ba ki wāatì dinyil saŋŋuee làá cùú ŋàl̄ bitaŋkpiibi ní.
