english_verse: Heavy drinkers and others who live only for pleasure will lose all they have.
translation_verse: Unil un néeń ki jīǹ mmɔnee làá kpántí usoodaan. Un néeń ki nyù ndaam ki jīǹ tijin tin mèeǹee kpá kí kpántí ugaaja.

english_verse: God's people will escape, but all who are wicked will pay the price.
translation_verse: Unikpiti làá fōō deedeedaan paaŋŋu kí kɔ́ nnaabun, ní biibiidaan ń fōō ibaamɔndaan paaŋŋu.

english_verse: It's better out in the desert than at home with a nagging, complaining wife.
translation_verse: An sɔ́ unil ń nīn kóò u-baba kuteeun ki jítiǹ u nì unimpu un néeń kujaau u-nyɔkɔ pɔ̄ɔ̄yee ń nīn kóò.

english_verse: Be sensible and store up precious treasures— don't waste them like a fool.
translation_verse: Uciin dumpuee, tigaajamɔntiil nì ŋkpam bí ní, ama ugbaan úǹ yati kaa dɔ̀.

english_verse: If you try to be kind and good, you will be blessed with life and goodness and honor.
translation_verse: Unil un nyàab̀ kí nīn nóó deedee saŋŋu ki ŋáań tiŋanee làá dāá ká mmaŋfafɔkɔn nì deedee nì tinyool.

english_verse: One wise person can defeat a city full of soldiers and capture their fortress.
translation_verse: Uciŋfiti ŋūǹ ki kɔ́ bibaatandambi tiŋkin, kí gbá kí wīī digundi din bi máń ki tú-kì bi máká di-puee.

english_verse: Watching what you say can save you a lot of trouble.
translation_verse: Unil un ŋúb́ u-nyɔkɔ nì u-limbilee nyāntí u-ba tibɔtin ní.

english_verse: If you are proud and conceited, everyone will say, “You're a snob!”
translation_verse: Kpeefam daan di cáá dilambil ní ki dàkà u-ba, tin kamaa ní u yaa ŋáańee, dibadakal di līī.

english_verse: If you want too much and are too lazy to work, it could be fatal.
translation_verse: Tin uwutijoodaan bàà là ní kaa ŋūǹ kí kée di yì u-kúm, di sá yii waa kíikí kí dū u-ŋalii kí tɔ̄ ditundi.

english_verse: The Lord despises the offerings of wicked people with evil motives.
translation_verse: Binikpitib saraau sá ntimbiil ní, ŋma nín yíiń bí ŋá an saraabi nì ilandɔkɔkpiti.

english_verse: If you tell lies in court, you are done for; only a reliable witness can do the job.
translation_verse: Unil un lèekī nnyimɔn seerauee làá kpú, ama unil un gbìl̄ tibɔtee yaa làá sòoǹee, bi yàntī ú sòoǹ ní.

english_verse: Wicked people bluff their way, but God's people think before they take a step.
translation_verse: Unikpiti ŋáań kii u máká u-ba puee, ama ní deedeedaan úǹ máká u-saŋkindi pu.

english_verse: No matter how much you know or what plans you make, you can't defeat the Lord.
translation_verse: Unil ciiŋyi àá u-nyil àá u-landɔkɔŋu kaa bí tiban ti-Dindaan nimbiin.

english_verse: Even if your army has horses ready for battle, the Lord will always win.
translation_verse: Bi bɔ́ntí utaamu kí yóoń dikɔ̀ndi wiiŋŋu pu ní, ama dijajil díǹ nyēeń ti-Dindaan baba cee ní.

english_verse: Teach your children right from wrong, and when they are grown they will still do right.
translation_verse: Dàkà kibiki nsan ŋun kì máaǹ kí nóóyee, báà kì yaa láa púĺ, kì kpá kí fá-ŋu.

english_verse: The poor are ruled by the rich, and those who borrow are slaves of moneylenders.
translation_verse: Ugaaja cáá mpɔn bisoodambi pu, ní un jíń dipɔndee sá un u jíń dipɔndee yumbuu.

english_verse: Troublemakers get in trouble, and their terrible anger will get them nowhere.
translation_verse: Unil un yaa búĺ tin kaa bí deedeeyee, agìŋ́kpaan ní u làá cā, di sá yii mpɔn ŋun u cáa ŋáań tipɔmbɔtee làá kúntí.

english_verse: The Lord blesses everyone who freely gives food to the poor.
translation_verse: Unil un cáá tinitee làá ká Unimbɔti biindi, di sá yii u kpīintí unandaan.

english_verse: Arguments and fights will come to an end, if you chase away those who insult others.
translation_verse: Jà ulambidaan ní kunikpɔŋkpɔkɔu ń gbèen̄, mimmee kujaau nì asiibil mun kúntì dee.

english_verse: The king is the friend of all who are sincere and speak with kindness.
translation_verse: Un néeń unil un pɔbil bí diba nì Unimbɔti ní ki sòoǹ nì dineendee bɔɔ di sá ubɔti.

english_verse: The Lord watches over everyone who shows good sense, but he frustrates the plans of deceitful liars.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan nimbiliŋ pée bá dinyil pu ní, ama waa fòol̄ biibiidambi bíǹ nyɔɔbuŋŋi.

english_verse: Don't be so lazy that you say, “If I go to work, a lion will eat me!”
translation_verse: Uwutijoodaan di lì yii: «Gbikinti bí mmɔŋki! M yaa nyáń u làá tin cúú-mi nsanni!»

english_verse: The words of a bad woman are like a deep pit; if you make the Lord angry, you will fall right in.
translation_verse: Ubɔ nimpuu nyɔkɔ sá kpaalaa ní, unil un ti-Dindaan dūu fée di jēetí u-poon.

english_verse: All children are foolish, but firm correction will make them change.
translation_verse: Digbaandi jíń kibiki pɔbilin. Mbambaan ŋun bi cáa dátí ki-tafalee di nyāntí-kì digbaandin.

english_verse: Cheat the poor to make profit or give gifts to the rich— either way you lose. Thirty Wise Sayings
translation_verse: Bi yaa bíi wɔ́b̀ unandaanee, bi bíi tìì-u tigaajati ní, bi yaa tí pú ugaaja tiwanee, bi bíi kɔ̄ntí-u disool ní. Tibɔkpaafikaal tiba mun

english_verse: Here are some sayings of people with wisdom, so listen carefully as I teach.
translation_verse: Kpòon̄ a-tafal kí pīlifì biciŋfitiibi bɔti, pìitī a-pɔbil kí fōō tin m nyí kí dàkà-see.

english_verse: You will be glad that you know these sayings and can recite them.
translation_verse: A yaa dū-tì ki kpáafì a-pɔbilin ní ki yaa nyí-tì ki yóoǹ, án làá mɔ̄ɔkiǹ-si.

english_verse: I am teaching them today, so that you may trust the Lord.
translation_verse: M là á dū a-mákal kí ŋá ti-Dindaan ni ní. An pu ní m làá dū tibɔti gbanti kí dàkà si mun díǹ.

english_verse: I have written thirty sayings filled with sound advice.
translation_verse: M ŋmàn̄-si alaŋkpan mmuŋku nì saalaa ŋin sá isaŋki nì dinyilee.

english_verse: You can trust them completely to give you the right words for those in charge of you. –
translation_verse: Ŋi làá dàkà-si tin ŋān̄ ki sá ibaamɔnee, án nín làá ŋá pu bi yaa tú-see, á sòoǹ tibɔti ti-púee.

english_verse: Don't take advantage of the poor or cheat them in court.
translation_verse: Taa fūkul̀ uwɔfi wanti yii u nín sá uwɔfee pu, kí taa wɔ́b́ unandaan ibɔsoon laŋki, u nín kaa cáá ubɔee pu.

english_verse: The Lord is their defender, and what you do to them, he will do to you. –
translation_verse: Di sá yii ti-Dindaan di làá dāá mɔ̄tì bi-pu, ní kí dāá lēē binib bin fìkī-bee maŋfal.

english_verse: Don't make friends with anyone who has a bad temper.
translation_verse: Taa bɔ́ɔtí unil un cáá diŋuulee. Taa nīn tāatí unil un fòol̄ mbum malaayee.

english_verse: You might turn out like them and get caught in a trap. –
translation_verse: Yaa sá fám a làá fōō bi-bimbikpitim, ní án sàl̄-si kii kutaliŋŋuee.

english_verse: Don't guarantee to pay someone else's debt.
translation_verse: Taa fáá ubɔ ŋaan kí pòon̄ kí pà a-juti pɔndi.

english_verse: If you don't have the money, you might lose your bed. –
translation_verse: A yaa kaa ká kí téeǹee, a dāa dɔ̄ a-lambaŋki pu ní bí dāá cúú kí tíkití.

english_verse: Don't move a boundary marker set up by your ancestors. –
translation_verse: Taa cóotí ditaŋkpal din a-baabi nìn cóoǹ kikpaanyɔkɔee kí nìkī.

english_verse: If you do your job well, you will work for a ruler and never be a slave.
translation_verse: Kpèè unil un di nyí u-tundi tiŋanee. U ŋūǹ kí cù bibɔtiibi cee kí tɔ̄ ditundi. Waa làá nīn sá utɔntɔnli un pu baa nyée.

english_verse: Don't accept an invitation to eat a selfish person's food, no matter how good it is.
translation_verse: Á taa jī ukummunti jinti, ní kí taa yàntī u-jimmɔntiiti ń cúú-si nnimbitaataam.

english_verse: When you are invited to eat with a king, use your best manners.
translation_verse: Sii nì unikpaan yaa kāl̀ kí jī tijinee, á nīn nyíǹ a-ba nì un kā a-nimbiinee.

english_verse: Don't go and stuff yourself! That would be just the same as cutting your throat.
translation_verse: A yaa kpàà jīǹ tikpilee, á bàtī a-pool pu.

english_verse: Don't be greedy for all of that fancy food! It may not be so tasty. –
translation_verse: Taa yàntī u-jinti gbanti ń cúú-si nnimbitaataam. Tì ŋūǹ kí nīn sá-si kutaliŋŋu.

english_verse: People like that take note of how much you eat. They say, “Take all you want!” But they don't mean it.
translation_verse: Di sá yii waa sá un ní ni dàkafī yii u sée. U làá pée tùkù-si yii: <Jī kí nyɔ̀>, ama waa sòoǹ nì míǹ nì dipɔbil diba.

english_verse: Give up trying so hard to get rich.
translation_verse: Taa bìǹ kí nyàab̀ tigaajati, pée lēē a-landɔkɔŋu an pu.

english_verse: Your money flies away before you know it, just like an eagle suddenly taking off. –
translation_verse: A tin lì yii a-nimbil pāantí tigaajati puee, tì wáŋkì. Di sá yii tì túkù ifeen kii ukaalunee ní kí kɔ́ kutaa.

english_verse: Each bite will come back up, and all your kind words will be wasted. –
translation_verse: A làá wùliŋkì tijin tin a jíńee kɔkɔ kí fá, ní anyɔɔbummɔnti ŋin a sòon̄-uee ń kúntíǹ fám.

english_verse: Don't talk to fools— they will make fun of you. –
translation_verse: Taa sàaǹ a-ba yii a bíi kútí ugbaan tibɔti, kun puee u làá kpèè iciin nyɔɔbuŋŋi ŋin a sòoǹee fám ní.

english_verse: Don't move a boundary marker or take the land that belongs to orphans.
translation_verse: Taa cóotí ditaŋkpal din bi cóoǹ kikpaanyɔkɔee kí nìkī, kí kɔ́ kí fōō ataŋkpiibil kpaatanti.

english_verse: Listen to me, my children! Be wise and have enough sense to follow the right path.
translation_verse: M-biki, pīlifiǹ-mi kí kpántí uciŋfiti, ní kí nīn nóó deedee saŋŋu.

english_verse: Don't be a heavy drinker or stuff yourself with food.
translation_verse: Taa nín̄ tāatí binib bin nyù ndaam tikpilee, àá binib bin néeń ki sàfī tinanee.

english_verse: It will make you feel drowsy, and you will end up poor with only rags to wear. –
translation_verse: Di sá yii disool cútí udanyɔgbil nì unaŋŋmɔl, ní unil un néeń ŋgeemee dāa pèentí ikpalcati.

english_verse: Pay attention to your father, and don't neglect your mother when she grows old.
translation_verse: Pīlifiǹ a-baa un di màl̄-see, kí taa kpèè a-na fám yii u nín púĺee pu.

english_verse: Invest in truth and wisdom, discipline and good sense, and don't part with them.
translation_verse: Nyàab̀ kí ká ibaamɔn nì iciin nì nlandɔkɔmɔnti nì dinyil. A yaa ká tiwan gbantee, á ŋúb́-tì tiŋan.

english_verse: Make your father truly happy by living right and showing sound judgment.
translation_verse: An mɔ̄ǹ deedeedaan baa ki tin lákatì, ní unil un màl̄ uciŋfitee fàal̀.

english_verse: My son, pay close attention, and gladly follow my example.
translation_verse: M-biki, dū a-pɔbil kí tīī-mi, ní kí yàntī m-bimbim ń nīn sá-si ŋabika.

english_verse: Bad women and unfaithful wives are like a deep pit—
translation_verse: Á nīn nyí yii kinimpulaakpaai sá kpaalaa, ní ubɔ nimpuu sá lɔkɔ un nyɔkɔ kaa wāāyee.

english_verse: they are waiting to attack you like a gang of robbers with victim after victim. –
translation_verse: Bi mun nākantí ki cí kii digaŋgandambee. Aa ŋūǹ kí kàaǹ bininjab bin an nimpoobee yāntì bi nyáń bi-nimpoobi boonee. Udanyɔgbil bítam

english_verse: Who is always in trouble? Who argues and fights? Who has cuts and bruises? Whose eyes are red?
translation_verse: Ŋma bí falaa poon? Ŋma bí iyaliŋki poon? Ŋma néeń kujaau? Ŋma bí ki gbáà diniindi an kaa kúntí? Ŋma fòol̄ tiweendi fám? Ŋma nimbiliŋ máǹ cínciŋee?

english_verse: Everyone who stays up late, having just one more drink.
translation_verse: An sá bin kàal̀ ndaam taapu ki yúntée, an sá bin ŋmàlintí idafi in pɔ̄ɔ̄yee ki nyùee.

english_verse: Don't even look at that colorful stuff bubbling up in the glass! It goes down so easily,
translation_verse: Á taa kpèè ndaam nyaaŋku nì mì nín tòó cábcab pu kuyuunee. A yaa nyù-mèe, mì sìntī ní soooo a-neen.

english_verse: but later it bites like a poisonous snake.
translation_verse: Án dāa kúntée, mì dāa júntí-si kii ukoobuee ní, a lì kii ukoowaati nín júntí puee.

english_verse: You will see weird things, and your mind will play tricks on you.
translation_verse: A-nimbiliŋ dāa kíǹ ki kpèé ki wāĺ maamaaci wanti, ní a kíǹ ki sòoǹ fám fám.

english_verse: You will feel tossed about like someone trying to sleep on a ship in a storm.
translation_verse: Án dāa bí-si kii unil un dɔ̄ tiŋku kansikinee, àá unil un lúń ndɔ ŋun pu bi sàkantí meela satau yilpu kúnti kuntee ní.

english_verse: You will be bruised all over, without even remembering how it all happened. And you will lie awake asking, “When will morning come, so I can drink some more?”
translation_verse: A làá lì yii: «Bi gbáń-mi, ama an kaa píĺ-mi! Bi tāfì-mi tiŋan, ama maa gbìl̄ tiba! Ŋyunti ŋulɔŋu ní m làá fìntī ní kí gíti bàlifì bí cáań-mi ní?»

english_verse: Don't let evil people worry you or make you jealous.
translation_verse: Taa gíí binikpitib pu diŋuul, taa nín̄ cáá bikpitiŋaliibi pu nnimbitaataam.

english_verse: Don't be jealous of crooks or want to be their friends.
translation_verse: Taa nín̄ cáá bikpitiŋaliibi pu nnimbitaataam, taa nyàab̀ si nì bi ń nīn bɔ́ɔtí.

english_verse: All they think about and talk about is violence and cruelty. –
translation_verse: Di sá yii bi pée dàkafī kí ŋá tipɔmbɔti ŋma ní, ní ki sòoǹ tikpitil tin bi làá ŋée ŋma pu.

english_verse: They will soon be gone like the flame of a lamp that burns out. –
translation_verse: Di sá yii binikpitib foolbooŋwu kaa làá nīn ŋān̄, ní bikpitiŋaliibi bí kii fitila un bíi kúùyee.

english_verse: Use wisdom and understanding to establish your home;
translation_verse: Nì iciin ní bi māā kudii, nì dinyil ní bi dùú tīī-ku mpɔn.

english_verse: let good sense fill the rooms with priceless treasures. –
translation_verse: Nì nlandɔkɔ ní bi gbēentí kudii tigaajawammɔntiil nì tin cáá kunyampoouee.

english_verse: My children, you must respect the Lord and the king, and you must not make friends with anyone who rebels against either of them.
translation_verse: M-biki, fàŋkì ti-Dindaan nì ubɔti. Á taa nín nōotí binib bin là tikɔkɔ ń kpántée.

english_verse: Wisdom brings strength, and knowledge gives power.
translation_verse: Uciŋfiti cáá mpɔn ní. Unil un cáá dinyilee cáá mpɔn mili pu ní.

english_verse: Battles are won by listening to advice and making a lot of plans. –
translation_verse: A yaa làá cù kujaauee, a bɔ́ntí tiŋan ní, di sá yii bisaŋkiliibi wíiŋŋu di yì dijajil.

english_verse: Who knows what sudden disaster the Lord or a ruler might bring? More Sayings That Make Good Sense
translation_verse: Di sá yii nnaabu làá jēetí bi-pu dicilpu dicilpu, ní ŋma nyí ditafadaaldi din bi-liitil bɔ́ntì bi-puee? Biciŋfitiibi saŋkii iba mun

english_verse: Wisdom is too much for fools! Their advice is no good. –
translation_verse: Iciin bɔti pɔ̄ɔ̄ ki tīī ugbaan ń ŋmā kí gbìl̄ taapu. Bi yaa kpáfì kí sòoǹ kitiŋ pu bɔtee, u kā ki ŋmí ní.

english_verse: Here are some more sayings that make good sense: When you judge, you must be fair.
translation_verse: Biciŋfitiibi saŋkii iba mun gíti sɔ̀. An kaa ŋān̄ unil ń sòoǹ kí pɔ̀ digàndi.

english_verse: No one but troublemakers think up trouble.
translation_verse: Unil un pée dàkafī kí ŋá tikpitilee, bi yíì-u uŋmatinli ní.

english_verse: Everyone hates senseless fools who think up ways to sin. –
translation_verse: Ugbaan pée dàkafī kí ŋá tin kaa ŋān̄ee, ní binib ná un bèel̄ binibee.

english_verse: If you let the guilty go free, people of all nations will hate and curse you.
translation_verse: Ubɔsoonli yaa tùkū unikpiti yii: «A-bɔti ŋān̄ee», diniwul tòó-u mbusu, ní samaa kɔkɔ kíǹ ki ná-u.

english_verse: Don't give up and be helpless in times of trouble. –
translation_verse: A-wunti yaa yɔ̄tì dinimbinaamandi dalee, á nīn nyí yii a-pɔŋŋu kaa náaǹ dee.

english_verse: But if you punish the guilty, things will go well for you, and you will prosper.
translation_verse: Ama bin yaa kūū unikpiti bɔtee bí mmɔnni. Binib làá nīn mèé tiŋan ki bìintí bi-pu.

english_verse: Don't fail to rescue those who are doomed to die.
translation_verse: Fīī bin bi dàtī ki cáǹ ŋkúminee, bin bi dàtī ki cáǹ kí kpɔ̀ee, ŋá tiba kí fīī-bi.

english_verse: Don't say, “I didn't know it!” God can read your mind. He watches each of us and knows our thoughts. And God will pay us back for what we do. –
translation_verse: Án yaa yíì a làá lì yii: «Taa nìn béè míǹ!» Un di nyí tin kā unil pɔbilinee gbìl̀ taapu. Un kpèé-see pée nyí-tì, ní ki làá pà báà ŋma u-tuuŋŋi nín sá puee paati.

english_verse: Giving an honest answer is a sign of true friendship.
translation_verse: Unil yaa kíí tibɔti nì ibaamɔnee, u dàkā kubɔɔtiiu kumɔntiiu dee.

english_verse: Honey is good for you, my children, and it tastes sweet.
translation_verse: Ŋmɔ́ tisiil, m-biki, kun puee an ŋān̄ ní. Kisikampiŋ mɔ̄ kinyɔkɔn ní.

english_verse: Wisdom is like honey for your life— if you find it, your future is bright. –
translation_verse: Ama á nīn nyí yii míǹ ní iciin ŋān̄ ki tīī-si. A yaa cáá-iee, a-foolbooŋwu làá nīn ŋān̄ ní dimákal din a cááyee kaa làá gbíntí fám.

english_verse: Get your fields ready and plant your crops before starting a home.
translation_verse: Tɔ̄ mmɔŋki tuuŋŋi kí dóó, kí bɔ́ntí asaatuun kí wàatī ní kí nín mā kudii.

english_verse: Don't be a cruel person who attacks good people and hurts their families.
translation_verse: Unikpiti, taa nákań deedeedaan diiku boon kí fūkul̀ u-wanti kɔkɔ u-dumpu.

english_verse: Even if good people fall seven times, they will get back up. But when trouble strikes the wicked, that's the end of them. –
translation_verse: Di sá yii deedeedaan yaa lítì miluli pu, u làá fàtīí yīkì, ama digìńdi di làá jēetí binikpitib pu.

english_verse: Don't accuse anyone who isn't guilty. Don't ever tell a lie
translation_verse: Taa túń a-juti pu dibɔgabil fám. A là kí sòoǹ kí mɔ̄ntàaa?

english_verse: Don't be happy to see your enemies trip and fall down.
translation_verse: A-nannanliu yaa lítèe, án taa nín̄ mɔ̄ǹ-si, u yaa gbéetèe, á taa nín̄ fàal̀.

english_verse: The Lord will find out and be unhappy. Then he will stop being angry with them. –
translation_verse: An yaa kaa sá míǹ, ti-Dindaan làá ká ní án kaa làá mɔ̄ɔkiǹ-u, ní ú páatí u-ŋuul u-pu.

english_verse: I once walked by the field and the vineyard of a lazy fool.
translation_verse: M cōom̀ ki kpākaǹ uwutijoodaan ubɔ saaku, m kpākaǹ unil un kaa cáá dinyilee fiinyi sufii kpaabu.

english_verse: Thorns and weeds were everywhere, and the stone wall had fallen down.
translation_verse: M kpēēyee ikuŋkum di pée múkú an kɔkɔee, kumoou di nyáń ki jíń mpaan bukpaa kɔkɔnee, ataŋkpee gundi din māntìi tú-buee di dɔ̄ kitiŋee.

english_verse: When I saw this, it taught me a lesson:
translation_verse: M nín ká mimmee ní m dākafì an pu, m kpēēyee ní an dàkā-mi tibɔti nee.

english_verse: Sleep a little. Doze a little. Fold your hands and twiddle your thumbs.
translation_verse: A là kí gèeǹ fiii, a là kí dáb́ fiii, a là kí dòon̄ fiii kí kpàl̄ iŋal.

english_verse: Here are some more of Solomon's proverbs. They were copied by the officials of King Hezekiah of Judah.
translation_verse: Ubɔti Saloomɔn laŋkpaŋŋi aba gíti sèé. Juuda bɔtiu Eeseekiyaasi nib di ŋmàn̄-ŋi. Alaŋkpan aba mun

english_verse: Who can fully understand the thoughts of a ruler? They reach beyond the sky and go deep in the earth.
translation_verse: Taa nyí kutaa nín dátìń-ti puee, kaa nyí kitiŋ nín nyóò puee. Míǹ mbaantiim ní taa ŋūǹ kí béé tin kā bibɔtiibi pɔbiliŋinee.

english_verse: Silver must be purified before it can be used to make something of value.
translation_verse: A yaa lēē tijɔkɔndi tin bí animbil kúti puee, bi làá ŋmā kí dūú mɔ́ɔ́ tiwan tin cáá kunyaaŋŋuee.

english_verse: Evil people must be removed before anyone can rule with justice.
translation_verse: Jà binikpitib kí nyāntí ubɔti cee, ní deedee ń tīī u-beel mpɔn.

english_verse: Don't try to seem important in the court of a ruler.
translation_verse: Taa nín̄ yòontí a-ba ubɔti nimbiin, kí taa nín̄ fòol̄ binikpaambi paaŋŋu.

english_verse: It's better for the ruler to give you a high position than for you to be embarrassed in front of royal officials. Be sure you are right
translation_verse: Di sá yii an sɔ́ ubɔti ń tùkù-si yii: «Jɔ̄mìń kí kāl̀ m-cee doo!» ki jítiǹ bí sìntīǹ-si taapu unikpaan ubɔ nimbiin.

english_verse: before you sue someone, or you might lose your case and be embarrassed.
translation_verse: Tin a-nimbil kée, taa jìkì kí lì-tì ni yaa bí ibɔsoonni. A-juti yaa kpákáǹ-si yii aa cáá ibaamɔn, a làá ŋá mana.

english_verse: When you and someone else can't get along, don't gossip about it.
translation_verse: Sii nì a-juti yaa cáá tɔbee, ní kpèè kí ŋāŋkì, ama á taa dū tin ubɔ tùkū-si dibalinee kí māafì.

english_verse: The right word at the right time is like precious gold set in silver.
translation_verse: Dinyɔɔbundi din nyáń ŋyunti ŋun máaǹee ŋān̄ kii sindaariya wanti tin bi dū animbil kúti ki nyɔ̄kɔntèe ní.

english_verse: Listening to good advice is worth much more than jewelry made of gold.
translation_verse: Unil un pílifíǹ uciŋfiti wooŋyee bí kii sindaariya bɔmbil nì sindaariyamɔnti léeŋkaatee ní.

english_verse: A messenger you can trust is just as refreshing as cool water in summer.
translation_verse: Kii utaa nín nì kí sɔ̀ŋkì tikɔkɔ kutuntuŋu yuntiŋu puee, míǹ ní deedee tuuŋŋu sɔ̀ŋkī ŋu-kpiliu ŋun túń-ŋuee pɔbil.

english_verse: Broken promises are worse than rain clouds that don't bring rain.
translation_verse: Unil un pōoǹ kí pɔ̄ tiba ní kaa púee náań nì atagban nín lúntí, kubuŋu ń jītí utaa kaa nì puee ní.

english_verse: Patience and gentle talk can convince a ruler and overcome any problem.
translation_verse: Unil un cáá kimɔtii tikpilee ŋūǹ kí kpántí ubɔsoonli landɔkɔŋu, míǹ ní dilimbil din pɔ̀fèe ŋūǹ kí wīī dikpabil.

english_verse: Don't visit friends too often, or they will get tired of it and start hating you.
translation_verse: Taa nín̄ cá a-bɔɔ dumpu múlmul, an yaa kaa sá míǹ u-naŋki dāa nyēē-si, ní u kíǹ ki ná-si.

english_verse: Telling lies about friends is like attacking them with clubs and swords and sharp arrows.
translation_verse: Unil un lēē u-juti pu nnyimɔn seerauee bí kii ditambɔndi àá kitàataajiki àá mpiin ŋun cɔ́m̀ líkí likee ní.

english_verse: A friend you can't trust in times of trouble is like having a toothache or a sore foot.
translation_verse: Dinimbinaamandi yuntiŋu un yaa dū u-mákal ki páaǹ un nyēē binib boonee puee bí kii unil un dù u-nyindi din cìŋkēe kí jú tiwan, àá un còom̄ u-taal din wùee puee ní.

english_verse: Singing to someone in deep sorrow is like pouring vinegar in an open cut.
translation_verse: Á gāā un bí kunimbaaunee dipɔɔpindi laŋyee bí kii a cúú u-bɔkutil ki pēetì tiwool yuntiŋu àá a dū ndaam min nyàm̀ee ki sītì mbuun puee ní.

english_verse: If your enemies are hungry, give them something to eat. And if they are thirsty, give them something to drink.
translation_verse: Ŋkùm yaa cáá a-nannanliu, á tīī-u tijin ú jī, nnyinnyoo yaa tí cáá-u, á tīī-u nnyim ú nyɔ̀.

english_verse: This will be the same as piling burning coals on their heads. And the Lord will reward you.
translation_verse: A yaa ŋá mimmee, an bí kii amɔsiŋkoon ní a cáa pāantí u-yil puee, ní ti-Dindaan ń dāá pà-si.

english_verse: As surely as rain blows in from the north, anger is caused by cruel words.
translation_verse: Kubuŋu kun nyēeń ŋgan púee cāabìń utaa, ní tinyimɔmbɔti kɔ̄ntí binib diŋuul.

english_verse: It's better to stay outside on the roof of your house than to live inside with a nagging wife.
translation_verse: An sɔ́ á nīn kóò digunlɔkɔlin ki jítiǹ si nì unimpu un néeń kujaauee ń nīn kóò.

english_verse: Good news from far away refreshes like cold water when you are thirsty.
translation_verse: Dinyɔɔbummɔɔndi din nyánní ndandatee bí kii nnyinsɔm min sɔ̀ŋkī nneenee ní.

english_verse: When a good person gives in to the wicked, it's like dumping garbage in a stream of clear water.
translation_verse: Nnyimbul ŋun gbātèe àá dinyimbɔbil din nyim bíil̀ee sá kii deedeedaan un mátifí unikpiti nimbiinee ní.

english_verse: Expecting snow in summer and rain in the dry season makes more sense than honoring a fool.
translation_verse: Kii an nín kaa máaǹ ntaayim ń lítí dipeel pu, utaa ń nì ŋyunti ŋun bi cēē tikpaajinee, míǹ ní tinyool kaa máaǹ ugbaan.

english_verse: A curse you don't deserve will take wings and fly away like a sparrow or a swallow.
translation_verse: Kii udiyaal àá kikoosiyaakpaai nín yíkí ki ŋàaǹ puee, míǹ ní mbusu kaa lítí maanyiiba pu.

english_verse: Horses and donkeys must be beaten and bridled— and so must fools.
translation_verse: Utaamu máaǹ dinaalabil, ní kimaŋ máaǹ dikpàldi, ní ugbaan máaǹ ndɔ.

english_verse: But if you answer any fools, show how foolish they are, so they won't feel smart.
translation_verse: Ugbaan yaa bālifì tibɔti ŋgbaaŋyaaminee, á kíí-u ŋgbaaŋyaamin, án nín làá ŋá pu ú taa dū u-ba ki yíiń uciinee.

english_verse: Sending a message by a fool is like chopping off your foot just to spite yourself.
translation_verse: Un yaa dū tibɔti ki ŋúbiǹ ugbaanee ŋá kii unil un gāā ki gūutì a-taaŋi àá un dáaĺ agìń ki tɔ́ u-ba puee ní.

english_verse: A fool with words of wisdom is like an athlete with legs that can't move.
translation_verse: Kii ufaliŋfaan taaŋi nín fáká puee, míǹ ní dilaŋkpandi fáká ki kā ugbaan nyɔkɔn.

english_verse: Are you going to honor a fool? Why not shoot a slingshot with the rock tied tight?
translation_verse: Á tīī ugbaan jilmee bí kii á dū ditaŋkpal kí fúuń kujaataafuŋun kí bóob́ kí nákańee ní.

english_verse: A thornbush waved around in the hand of a drunkard is no worse than a proverb in the mouth of a fool.
translation_verse: Kii udanyɔgbil nín ŋúb́ ikuŋkum u-ŋaan puee, míǹ ní dilaŋkpandi fáká ugbaan nyɔkɔn.

english_verse: It's no smarter to shoot arrows at every passerby than it is to hire a bunch of worthless nobodies.
translation_verse: Ukpil un di fòol̄ ugbaan àá udanyɔgbil un jītée ditundee sá un ŋáań báà ŋma tiweendee ní.

english_verse: Dogs return to eat their vomit, just as fools repeat their foolishness.
translation_verse: Kii kibɔkɔ nín wùliŋkī kí fàtīí gíiǹ kí ŋmɔ́ puee, míǹ ní ugbaan fàtīi gítí u-gbaandi pu.

english_verse: There is more hope for a fool than for someone who says, “I'm really smart!”
translation_verse: A yaa tin ká unil yíì u-ba uciinee, a yaa pūtì máká ugbaan pu gba, an sɔ́. Uwutijoodaan bɔti

english_verse: Don't be lazy and keep saying, “There's a lion outside!”
translation_verse: Uwutijoodaan lì yii: «Upeecuncuti bí didandi pu! Gbikinti bí nsanni!»

english_verse: A door turns on its hinges, but a lazy person just turns over in bed.
translation_verse: Kii punuu nín màntī tikúti tin pu u sàkēe puee, min ní uwutijoodaan dɔ̄ u-dooŋu pu ki lábití.

english_verse: Some of us are so lazy that we won't lift a hand to feed ourselves.
translation_verse: Uwutijoodaan dùŋfī u-ŋal kí bɔ̄ disambilin, ama ní u-wutijool puee, an pɔ̄ɔ̄ ú fàtīí gíiǹní-ŋu u-nyɔkɔn.

english_verse: A lazy person says, “I am smarter than everyone else.”
translation_verse: Uwutijoodaan yíì u-ba uciin ki jítiǹ binib biluli bin kíikí tibɔti nì dinyilee. Alaŋkpan aba mun sɔ̀

english_verse: It's better to take hold of a mad dog by the ears than to take part in someone else's argument.
translation_verse: Unil un dù u-ba kí kɔ́ǹ kujaau kun kaa sá u-yɔkɔee poonee bí kii unil un là kí cúú kibɔkɔ ki dūu cúú ki-tafalee ní.

english_verse: It's no crazier to shoot sharp and flaming arrows
translation_verse: Kii unil un wáatèe nín tòó aŋmisaatee nì mpiin nì tiwan tin kùee puee,

english_verse: than to cheat someone and say, “I was only fooling!”
translation_verse: míǹ ní unil un kíiĺ u-juti, ní boonee kí lì yii: «M ŋáań-si tinaacinee» bí.

english_verse: Where there is no fuel a fire goes out; where there is no gossip arguments come to an end.
translation_verse: Idɔ yaa wùn̄ ki kúntèe, ŋŋmi kpíì dee, míǹ ní usambiidaan yaa kaa ti bée, kujaau mun kúntì.

english_verse: Troublemakers start trouble, just as sparks and fuel start a fire.
translation_verse: Akoon di tìì amɔsiŋkoon ní idɔ tìì aŋmilimbil, míǹ ní ubɔmbɔdaan nyàatī kujaau.

english_verse: There is nothing so delicious as the taste of gossip! It melts in your mouth.
translation_verse: Ubɔmbɔtukul nyɔɔbuŋŋi sá tijin tin mɔ̄ee ní, tì kóò unil poon ní fíŋfiŋ.

english_verse: Hiding hateful thoughts behind smooth talk is like coating a clay pot with a cheap glaze.
translation_verse: Anyɔɔbummɔɔn ŋin nyēē dipɔɔkpitilinee bí kii animbil kúti tin cáá tijɔkɔndi bi dūu nákáǹ kuyɔkɔu sambil puee ní.

english_verse: The pleasant talk of an enemy hides more evil plans
translation_verse: Unil un cáá kináŋee kaa sòoǹ kí dóó u-poon bɔti kɔkɔ, ama u-pɔbilinee, u bɔ́ntí tinyimɔmbɔti ní.

english_verse: than can be counted— so don't believe a word!
translation_verse: U yaa bíi sòoǹ nì si kinyɔɔmɔɔyee, taa fōō kí kíí, di sá yii u-pɔbilinee, tilandɔkɔkpiil di gbí.

english_verse: If you dig a pit, you will fall in; if you start a stone rolling, it will roll back on you.
translation_verse: Unil un yaa gbìn̄ mbòóyee làá dāá lítí ŋu-poon, un yaa bíntí ditaŋkpalee, dì làá gítiń kí tàb̄-u ní.

english_verse: Watch out for anyone who tells lies and flatters— they are out to get you.
translation_verse: Unil un mɔ́ntí u-jutiibee ná-bi ní ki ŋáań-bi tiweendi, ní un cáá nyɔɔmálmalee nàantí-bi.

english_verse: Don't brag about tomorrow! Each day brings its own surprises.
translation_verse: Taa nín̄ pàkà a-ba fool wiiŋŋu pu, di sá yii saa nyí tin làá jītí díǹ wiiŋŋuee.

english_verse: Stones and sand are heavy, but trouble caused by a fool is a much heavier load.
translation_verse: Ditaŋkpal nì dibul nyìm̀ tikpil, ama ugbaan ŋuul nyìm̀ nì tiwan liitil gbanti.

english_verse: An angry person is dangerous, but a jealous person is even worse.
translation_verse: Mbum ŋáań tipɔmbɔti ní diŋuul bí kii mbun ŋun gbée, ama ŋma ŋūǹ kí yūĺ ipoompoon íǹ nimbiin?

english_verse: A truly good friend will openly correct you.
translation_verse: Á wòoǹ unil mpaampiin pu sɔ́ nì á nīn néeń-u dibalin ubɔ kaa wāĺ.

english_verse: You can trust a friend who corrects you, but kisses from an enemy are nothing but lies.
translation_verse: A-bɔɔ yaa tīī-si tiweendee, án cáá dimákal, ama a-nannanliu yaa kpàl̄-see, á nīn nyíǹ a-ba.

english_verse: If you have had enough to eat, honey doesn't taste good, but if you are really hungry, you will eat anything.
translation_verse: Unil un jíń ki díkée yaa ká tisiilee, u yákafí ditaal ní, ama un ŋkùm cááyee ceeyee, tin tūee mɔ̄ ní.

english_verse: When you are far from home, you feel like a bird without a nest.
translation_verse: Kii kinɔmbiki nín yìiǹ kí cù ndan kí fá ki-diiku puee, míǹ ní unil un yìiǹ kí cù ndan kí fá u-dicaŋkuee bí.

english_verse: The sweet smell of incense can make you feel good, but true friendship is better still.
translation_verse: Ikpafi nì talaalub tìì unil pɔbil mmɔn, ama ní kubɔɔtiiu kun mɔ̄ee jítiǹ talaalumɔmmɔnti.

english_verse: Don't desert an old friend of your family or visit your relatives when you are in trouble. A friend nearby is better than relatives far away.
translation_verse: Taa fá a-bɔɔ, kí taa fá a-baa mun bɔɔ. Digìńdi yaa kɔ́-see, á taa cù a-nabiki cee. A-kɔŋkɔnnaatɔ un pìlīǹ-see sɔ́ǹ kinabiki kin bíń ndandatee.

english_verse: My child, show good sense! Then I will be happy and able to answer anyone who criticizes me.
translation_verse: M-biki, nín̄ cáá iciin kí tīī-mi dipɔɔpindi. Niinee ubɔ yaa bíi kpākantí-mee, ḿ ŋmā kí kíí-u.

english_verse: Be cautious and hide when you see danger— don't be stupid and walk right into trouble.
translation_verse: Un nyíǹ u-bee yaa ká nnaabu dòońee, u sáń kí báĺ ní. Ama bin kaa nyí tibee cáǹ bi-ba kí tɔ̄ poon ní án píĺ-bi.

english_verse: You deserve to lose your coat if you loan it to someone to guarantee payment for the debt of a stranger.
translation_verse: Ubɔ yaa yúl̀ unil un waa nyée boon kí pìnnì tibee, á fōō udaan bɔkutil kí yóoń, u nín yúl̀ unicaan boonee puee, á fōō u-cee toolima kí yóoń.

english_verse: A loud greeting early in the morning is the same as a curse.
translation_verse: Unil yaa téeń ki jáam̀ u-juti mpɔn kutaafaau pɔ̀lpɔlee, udaan jaamii gbanti kpántí mbusu ní.

english_verse: The steady dripping of rain and the nagging of a wife are one and the same.
translation_verse: Utaa yaa bíi nì nnyim nín còol̀ kaa gúǹ puee, míǹ ní unimpu un néeń kujaauee bí.

english_verse: It's easier to catch the wind or hold olive oil in your hand than to stop a nagging wife.
translation_verse: Unil ń ŋmā kí cúú-uee bí kii u bíi cútí kubuŋuee ní, àá kii ŋkpam ní u bíi nyàab̀ kí dū u-ŋal kí cúúyee.

english_verse: Just as iron sharpens iron, friends sharpen the minds of each other.
translation_verse: Tikúti ní bi cáa lòontí tikúti, unil nākantí u-juti ní kí cíkití.

english_verse: Take care of a tree, and you will eat its fruit; look after your master, and you will be praised.
translation_verse: Unil un kpèé u-fiigi subu tiŋanee làá dāá ŋmɔ́ bu-bil. Bi làá tīī utɔntɔnli un ŋúb́ u-kpiliu tiŋanee jilma.

english_verse: You see your face in a mirror and your thoughts in the minds of others.
translation_verse: Kii unil nín kpèé nnyimin kí wāl̀ u-ba puee, míǹ ní a kpèé unil nimbiin ní kí wāl̀ u-landɔkɔi nín sá puee.

english_verse: Death and the grave are never satisfied, and neither are humans.
translation_verse: Taapu taŋkpiil nì Mbookpaan kaa gbéè, míǹ ní unil nimbil kaa kpèé kí díkí.

english_verse: Gold and silver are tested in a red-hot furnace, but we are tested by praise.
translation_verse: Ŋŋmi ní bi cáa cɔ́ŋkí kí béé animbil kúti timɔntiil nì sindaariyamɔnti, ama bi nín pàkà unil puee di dàkà dinicil din ní u sée.

english_verse: No matter how hard you beat a fool, you can't pound out the foolishness.
translation_verse: Báà a yaa dū ŋkuntudɔ ki sáń ugbaan kukuntuu poon kii bi nín cùkutī tijimpin puee, u-gbaandi kaa làá nyā u-ni.

english_verse: You should take good care of your sheep and goats,
translation_verse: Nín̄ nyí a-waŋkuti tiŋan, kí nīn kpèé a-picaŋkpunti tiŋan.

english_verse: After the hay is cut and the new growth appears and the harvest is over,
translation_verse: Á gāā timool tisatin, ní timɔpɔn yaa bíi nyēēyee, á cù dijool pu kí kùliń timɔkulindi.

english_verse: you can sell lambs and goats to buy clothes and land.
translation_verse: Kpàà ipii kí cā i-kuti kí dūú ŋáĺ tiwampeeŋkaal, ní kí kpàà iŋɔjaa kí nyāfì kí dā kitiŋ kí kpɔ̀ tikpaal.

english_verse: From the milk of the goats, you can make enough cheese to feed your family and all your servants.
translation_verse: Kpàà iŋɔsal tikpil kí ká ŋŋɔbiim kí kpíiǹ a-ba, kí kpáaǹ a-dicaŋkun yab nì a-tɔntɔnliibi binimpoobi.

english_verse: Wicked people run away when no one chases them, but those who live right are as brave as lions.
translation_verse: Báà ubɔ yaa kaa bíi jì unikpiti, u sáń ní. Ama deedeedaan úǹ cáá dipɔbil kii digbikintipɔmbilee ní.

english_verse: In time of civil war there are many leaders, but a sensible leader restores law and order.
translation_verse: Binib yaa yíkì kaa kíí bi-ba pu kitiŋ kin poonee, bikpilib wīintí ní. Ama unil un cáá iciin nì dinyilee yaa bée, kitiŋ sɔ̀m̀ ní.

english_verse: When someone poor takes over and mistreats the poor, it's like a heavy rain destroying the crops.
translation_verse: Upɔɔl un di cáá ntoom ní ki wɔ́b̀ binandambee bí kii utaa un nì ki bíiĺ tikpaajinee ní.

english_verse: Lawbreakers praise criminals, but law-abiding citizens always oppose them.
translation_verse: Binib bin féeń Unimbɔti marauee pàkà binikpitib ní, ama ní binib bin ŋúb́ Unimbɔti marauee jáà nì bi.

english_verse: Criminals don't know what justice means, but all who respect the Lord understand it completely.
translation_verse: Binikpitib kaa gbìl̀ tin bí deedeeyee taapu, ama bin nyàab̀ ti-Dindaanee gbìl̀ tikɔkɔ taapu ní.

english_verse: It's better to be poor and live right, than to be rich and dishonest.
translation_verse: Unil un sá usoodaan ki còom̄ deedee saŋŋunee sɔ́ǹ unil un di sá ugaaja ki nóó isaŋkpitee.

english_verse: It makes good sense to obey the Law of God, but you disgrace your parents if you make friends with worthless nobodies.
translation_verse: Kibiki kin ŋúb́ Unimbɔti marauee sá unyil ní, ama un nōotí biyipɔɔdambee kɔ̄ntí u-baa ní icoo.

english_verse: If you make money by charging high interest rates, you will lose it all to someone who cares for the poor.
translation_verse: Unil un pìntí binib animbil kí dāá fōō kí páań kí kpántí ugaajee kōontí u-gaajati gbanti ki yōontí un sūǹ biwɔfib saayee ní.

english_verse: God cannot stand the prayers of anyone who disobeys his Law.
translation_verse: Unil un yaa lēē u-tafal Unimbɔti maraunee, ti-Dindaan ná udaan wimmeem gba ní.

english_verse: By leading good people to sin, you dig a pit for yourself, but all who live right will have a bright future.
translation_verse: Un yaa kíil̀ deedeedambi ki tɔ́ nsaŋkpitinee làá dāá jēetí mbòó ŋun úǹ u-ba gbìn̄ee poon. Ama bibulcinnib làá dāá jī nnaam.

english_verse: The rich think highly of themselves, but anyone poor and sensible sees right through them.
translation_verse: Ugaaja kā ki dàkafī yii úǹ di cáá iciin, ama usoodaan un cáá dinyilee nyí kun ní u sée.

english_verse: When an honest person wins, it's time to celebrate; when crooks are in control, it's best to hide.
translation_verse: Deedeedambi di yaa fōō mpɔnee, an sá ifaal ní. Ama binikpitib yaa fōō mpɔnee, báà ŋma bāal̀ ní.

english_verse: If you don't confess your sins, you will be a failure. But God will be merciful if you confess your sins and give them up.
translation_verse: Unil un yaa cáá u-kpitii ki bāal̀ee, an kaa bútí-u. Ama unil un bìitī u-kpitii pu kí dū-i kí fée kāntí u-kpitii pɔ̄tam.

english_verse: The Lord blesses everyone who is afraid to do evil, but if you are cruel, you will end up in trouble.
translation_verse: Unil un fàŋkí kí taa pée ŋá ikpitee bí mmɔnni, ama un yaa cáá mpɔɔgbifinee làá ká nnaabu.

english_verse: A ruler who mistreats the poor is like a roaring lion or a bear hunting for food.
translation_verse: Kii gbikinti nín sūǹ pu àá digbiŋgbil nín wúlìń puee, míǹ ní unikpiti un wɔ́b̀ dinibul din sá binandambee bí.

english_verse: A heartless leader is a fool, but anyone who refuses to get rich by cheating others will live a long time.
translation_verse: Uyidaan un kaa cáá dinyilee fìkì binib wanti ní. Ama un kaa néeń ki mùul̄ ki jīǹee kāntí mmaŋfafɔkɔn ní.

english_verse: Don't give help to murderers! Make them stay on the run for as long as they live.
translation_verse: Unil un kūū u-jutee sáń ki cá dikaakulin ní, ubɔ ń taa cúú-u.

english_verse: Honesty will keep you safe, but everyone who is crooked will suddenly fall.
translation_verse: Unil un cáá tibulcinee làá ká difiil, ama un nóó mili mili saŋŋuee làá lítí ŋubɔ poon.

english_verse: Work hard, and you will have a lot of food; waste time, and you will have a lot of trouble.
translation_verse: Unil un kù u-saakuee jīǹ ki díkì ní, ama unil un jòó ki pá tin kaa bí tibanee boonee làá nīn pée sá usoodaan ní.

english_verse: God blesses his loyal people, but punishes all who want to get rich quick.
translation_verse: Unil un bí deedeeyee làá ká dibiindi, ama un jìkì kí ká tigaajatee kaa làá lóó ditafadaaldi.

english_verse: It isn't right to be unfair, but some people can be bribed with only a piece of bread.
translation_verse: An kaa ŋān̄ unil ń pɔ̀ digàndi, ama fiii un bi làá nyíĺ kí ŋá-u ú jēe puee, unil ŋáań ikpiti gbanti.

english_verse: Don't be selfish and eager to get rich— you will end up worse off than you can imagine.
translation_verse: Unil un cáá nnimbitaataamee jòó ki pá tigaajati boon ní. Waa nyí yii disool làá kɔ́-u.

english_verse: If you cheat your parents and don't think it's wrong, you are a common thief.
translation_verse: Un yaa yù u-baa nì u-na ki lì yii: «An kaa sá ikpitee!» udaan nì digaŋgandambi sá ubaanti ní.

english_verse: Selfish people cause trouble, but you will live a full life if you trust the Lord.
translation_verse: Un cáá binib wanti pu nnimbitaataamee jāantí binib ní, ama un máká ti-Dindaan puee, an bútí-u ní.

english_verse: Only fools would trust what they alone think, but if you live by wisdom, you will do all right.
translation_verse: Unil un máká úǹ u-ba puee sá ugbaan ní, ama un còom̄ nì iciinee làá ká difiil.

english_verse: Giving to the poor will keep you from poverty, but if you close your eyes to their needs, everyone will curse you.
translation_verse: Un yaa pūǹ biwɔfibee, tiba kpá kí lóó udaan. Ama un yíì kaa fātìi tɔ́-bee làá kɔ́ mbusukpaanni.

english_verse: When crooks are in control, everyone tries to hide, but when they lose power, good people are everywhere.
translation_verse: Binikpitib yaa fōō mpɔnee, báà ŋma bāal̀ ní. Ama bi yaa kúntèe, deedeedambi bùtī tikpil ní.

english_verse: If you keep being stubborn after many warnings, you will suddenly discover you have gone too far.
translation_verse: Bi yaa bíi wòoǹ unil ní u pɔ́ɔkí u-pɔbilee, án làá nàan̄-u dibɔbilin niin ní nnyɔkɔ kpá.

english_verse: When justice rules a nation, everyone is glad; when injustice rules, everyone groans.
translation_verse: Deedeedambi yaa ŋúb́ kitiŋee, samaa kɔkɔ fàal̀ ní. Ama unikpiti yaa ŋúb́ kitiŋee, samaa kɔkɔ yáliŋkí ní.

english_verse: If you love wisdom your parents will be glad, but chasing after bad women will cost you everything.
translation_verse: Unil un néeń iciinee tìì u-baa dipɔɔsɔŋkil. Ama un gbōō ki cá nnimpulaakpaamu ceeyee bíiĺ u-gaajati ní.

english_verse: An honest ruler makes the nation strong; a ruler who takes bribes will bring it to ruin.
translation_verse: Ubɔti yaa nóó deedee saŋŋuee, u-tiŋki cá nyɔkɔpu ní. Ama un fòol̄ lampoo tikpilee gīintí u-tiŋki boon ní.

english_verse: Flattery is nothing less than setting a trap.
translation_verse: Unil un bíi pàkà u-jutee bíi pīil̀-u kutaliŋŋu dee.

english_verse: Your sins will catch you, but everyone who lives right will sing and celebrate.
translation_verse: Ikpiti in unikpiti ŋáańee sá kutaliŋŋu ní, ama deedeedaan úǹ fàal̀ ní an mɔ̄ǹ-u.

english_verse: The wicked don't care about the rights of the poor, but good people do.
translation_verse: Deedeedaan nyí biwɔfib bɔti, ama unikpiti úǹ kaa cáá dinyil kí ŋmā kí béé-tì.

english_verse: Sneering at others is a spark that sets a city on fire; using good sense can put out the flames of anger.
translation_verse: Binib bin kaa bí tibanee cāabìń fikil fikil kitiŋin, ama biciŋfitiibi bíǹ sɔ̀ŋkī binib pɔbil.

english_verse: Be wise and don't sue a fool. You won't get satisfaction, because all the fool will do is sneer and shout.
translation_verse: Uciŋfiti nì ugbaan yaa cáá tɔb ki bàn̄ ibɔsoon laŋkee, báà u yaa gíí diŋuulaaa, u yaa lāāyaaa, u kpá kí ŋùŋfì.

english_verse: A murderer hates everyone who is honest and lives right.
translation_verse: Binikpɔliibi ná bibulcinnib, ama deedeedambi nyàab̀ bíǹ ní.

english_verse: Don't be a fool and quickly lose your temper— be sensible and patient.
translation_verse: Ugbaan nyāntí u-ŋuul kɔkɔ ní mpaampiin pu, ama uciŋfiti cútí u-ba ní ki sɔ̀ŋkī u-ŋuul.

english_verse: A ruler who listens to lies will have corrupt officials.
translation_verse: Uyidaan yaa pílifí tinyimɔmbɔtee, u-kpambaliŋ kɔkɔ kpántí binikpitib ní.

english_verse: The poor and all who abuse them must each depend on God for light.
translation_verse: Unandaan nì un wɔ́b́-uee sá ubaanti ní, ti-Dindaan di tīī bi-liitil animbil ní bi cáa kpèé.

english_verse: Kings who are fair to the poor will rule a long time.
translation_verse: Ubɔti yaa sòoǹ biwɔfib bɔti nì ibaamɔnee, u-beel làá nīn bá ki pɔ̄ɔ̄ ní ki cá jaanjaan.

english_verse: Correct your children, and they will be wise; children out of control disgrace their mothers.
translation_verse: Mbambaan nì isaŋki dàkà kibiki iciin ní, kibiki kin ŋáań min kì lèe kɔ̄ntí ki-na icoo ní.

english_verse: Crime increases when crooks are in power, but law-abiding citizens will see them fall.
translation_verse: Binikpitib yaa ŋúb́ kitiŋee, ikpiti gbóotí ní. Ama deedeedambi làá dāá ká binikpitib gbanti lítitam.

english_verse: If you correct your children, they will bring you peace and happiness.
translation_verse: Dáaĺ a-biki tafal ní kí dāá ká diŋuŋfil. Kì làá dāá tīī-si dipɔɔpindi.

english_verse: Without guidance from God law and order disappear, but God blesses everyone who obeys his Law.
translation_verse: Dileedakal yaa kaa ti bée, dinibul ŋáań di nín là puee ní. Ama un yaa ŋúb́ Unimbɔti Marauee bí mmɔnni!

english_verse: Even when servants are smart, it takes more than words to make them obey.
translation_verse: Baa dátí utɔntɔnli tafal nì anyɔɔbun fám. Báà u yaa gbìl̄ taapu, waa làá ŋá míǹ.

english_verse: There is more hope for a fool than for someone who speaks without thinking.
translation_verse: A yaa tin ká unil sòoǹ kaa dàkafēe, a yaa pūtì máká ugbaan pu gba an sɔ́.

english_verse: Slaves that you treat kindly from their childhood will cause you sorrow.
translation_verse: Unil yaa sɔ̄kɔl̀ u-tɔntɔnliu doooo tibiyatinee, u làá dāá kpántí uwutijoodaan ní.

english_verse: A person with a quick temper stirs up arguments and commits a lot of sins.
translation_verse: Unil un kaa pɔ̄ɔ̄ diŋuul digiilee sàal̄ kujaau ní, unil un fōō mbumee ŋáań ikpiti tikpil ní.

english_verse: Too much pride brings disgrace; humility leads to honor.
translation_verse: Unil nín yòontí u-ba yilpu puee làá sìntīǹ-u taapu. Ama un sīntiǹ u-ba taapuee làá ká tinyool.

english_verse: If you take part in a crime you are your worst enemy, because even under oath you can't tell the truth.
translation_verse: Un nì unaayuu yaa pēē kinyɔkɔee ná u-ba ní. U nyí mbusu un dɔ̄ ki cí-uee, ama waa làá bìitī unaayuu pu.

english_verse: Don't fall into the trap of being a coward— trust the Lord, and you will be safe.
translation_verse: Á nīn fàŋkí binibee sá kii kutaliŋŋuee ní. Ama unil un máká ti-Dindaan puee kaa fàŋkí tiba.

english_verse: Many try to make friends with a ruler, but justice comes from the Lord.
translation_verse: Binib tikpil nyàab̀ bi-kpilib pampakaku ní, ama ti-Dindaan baba di sòoǹ unil kamaa bɔti.

english_verse: Good people and criminals can't stand each other.
translation_verse: Deedeedambi ná binikpitib, ní binikpitib ná deedeedambi.

english_verse: These are the sayings and the message of Agur son of Jakeh. Someone cries out to God, “I am completely worn out! How can I last?
translation_verse: Yaakee jipɔɔn Aguur nyɔɔbuŋŋi sèé. Uninja gbanti nín sòon̄ pu ki tùkū Itiyeel nì Itiyeel nì Ukaalee sèé:

english_verse: I am far too stupid to be considered human.
translation_verse: «Binib kansikinee, man di pée sá ugbaan, maa cáá dinyil din unil máaǹ kí nīn cááyee.

english_verse: I never was wise, and I don't understand what God is like.”
translation_verse: Maa bífì iciin in bàà làá yàntī ḿ béé Circirdaanee.

english_verse: Has anyone gone up to heaven and come back down? Has anyone grabbed hold of the wind? Has anyone wrapped up the sea or marked out boundaries for the earth? If you know of any who have done such things, then tell me their names and their children's names.
translation_verse: Ŋma di jɔ́m̀ yilpu ki fātìi sīntìń? Ŋma di cúú kubuŋu ki ŋá u-ŋaan ki ká? Ŋma di dū u-bɔkutil ki póob́ nnyim? Ŋma di yóoǹ kitiŋ kpaanyɔmmu kɔkɔ? Bi yíì udaan yii ba? Bi yíì u-jipɔɔn yii ba? A yaa nyí á tùkù-maa!

english_verse: Everything God says is true— and it's a shield for all who come to him for safety.
translation_verse: «Unil ŋūǹ kí nīn máká Unimbɔti nyɔɔbuŋŋi kɔkɔ pu. U sá digbampɔɔl ní ki tīī bin di sáń ki kóò-uee.

english_verse: Don't change what God has said! He will correct you and show that you are a liar.
translation_verse: Á taa kūtì tiba u-nyɔɔbuŋŋi pu. An yaa sá fám, u làá wòoǹ-si ní kí yíiń-si unyimɔndaan.

english_verse: There are two things, Lord, I want you to do for me before I die:
translation_verse: «M-Nimbɔtiu, tiwan tili ja pu ní m mèé-si, taa ŋmìntī-mi an wanti kí wàatī ḿ nín kpú.

english_verse: Make me absolutely honest and don't let me be too poor or too rich. Give me just what I need.
translation_verse: Kàkatī mili mili bimbim nì inyimɔn kí wàatī-mi. Taa tīī-mi disool, kí taa tīī-mi tigaajati mun. Tīī-mi tin làá pée ŋmàntī ḿ jī kí nīn bée.

english_verse: If I have too much to eat, I might forget about you; if I don't have enough, I might steal and disgrace your name.
translation_verse: Di sá yii m yaa sá ugaajee, m fàtī m-boon kí tīī-si ní kí lì yii: «Ŋma di sá ti-Dindaan ní?» M yaa tí sá usoodaanee, m ŋūǹ kí cùú yɔ̀ ní kí bīil̀ sii m-Nimbɔtiu yindi.

english_verse: Don't tell a slave owner something bad about one of the slaves. That slave will curse you, and you will be in trouble.
translation_verse: «Taa sòoǹ kí bīil̀ uyumbu u-dindaan cee. An yaa kaa sá míǹ, u làá tɔ̄-si mbusu ní ikpiti in a ŋée ń gítí a-pu.

english_verse: Some people curse their father and even their mother;
translation_verse: «Binib biba tòó bi-baabi mbusu, ní kaa mèé ki bìintí bi-nab pu.

english_verse: others think they are perfect, but they are stained by sin.
translation_verse: «Binib biba yíì bi-ba circirdambi, ama ní kaa fíntì tijɔkɔndi tin bí bi-puee.

english_verse: Some people are stuck-up and act like snobs;
translation_verse: «Binib biba cáá dilambil bi-yiliŋ gáań, ní bi kpèé bin kíǹee fám.

english_verse: Greed has twins, each named “Give me!” There are three or four things that are never satisfied:
translation_verse: Dikoosibil din nyù fatikuee cáá bisapɔmbi bili. Bi lì yii: «Tīī-mi! Tīī-mi!» Tiwan tita di bí kaa pée díkì, ní kunanaatiiu kun kaa lì yii: «An ŋmāntèe!»

english_verse: The world of the dead and a childless wife, the thirsty earth and a flaming fire.
translation_verse: Tíǹ di sá ditaŋkpiilin, nì unimpuŋmaŋŋmanti, nì kitiŋ kin pu utaa nì an kaa dɔ̄ee, nì ŋŋmi ŋun wù an kaa cáá ŋu bál̀ee.

english_verse: Don't make fun of your father or disobey your mother— crows will peck out your eyes, and buzzards will eat the rest of you.
translation_verse: Unil un yaa bèel̄ u-baa, ní kaa fātìi tɔ́ u-nee, tilaagaal tin bí mbunnee làá lúkutí udaan nimbiliŋ, ní kaajiikub ń dāá jī-u.

english_verse: There are three or four things I cannot understand:
translation_verse: Tiwan tita di bí ní ki jítì m-nyil pu, ní kunanaatiiu bí maa gbìl̀ ku-taapu.

english_verse: How eagles fly so high or snakes crawl on rocks, how ships sail the ocean or people fall in love.
translation_verse: Tíǹ di sá ukaabu un ŋàaǹ kutaa puee saŋŋu, nì ukoobu un còom̄ ataŋkpee puee saŋŋu, nì meela un dēē tiŋku nyim puee saŋŋu, nì nsan ŋun uninja dì ki cá unimpu ceeyee.

english_verse: An unfaithful wife says, “Sleeping with another man is as natural as eating.”
translation_verse: Unimpu un nyáń u-cal boonee nín ŋáań puee sèé: U jīǹ ní kí pítí u-nyɔkɔ ní kí lì yii: «Maa ŋá ikpiti iba!»

english_verse: There are three or four things that make the earth tremble and are unbearable:
translation_verse: Tiwan tita di bí ki cìŋkī kitiŋ, ní kunanaatiiu bí kàa là ki-nimbil ń ká.

english_verse: A slave who becomes king, a fool who eats too much,
translation_verse: Tíǹ di sá uyumbu ń kpántí ubɔti, nì unil un kaa bí tibanee ń ká tijin kí jī kí díkí,

english_verse: a hateful woman who finds a husband, and a slave who takes the place of the woman who owns her.
translation_verse: nì unimpu un kaa cáá mbimbimɔntiimee ń ká uninja kí mɔ̄ǹ, nì unimpuyumbu ń fōō u-kpiliu paaŋŋu.

english_verse: On this earth four things are small but very wise:
translation_verse: Tiwan tinaa di bí kitiŋ pu ki sá ŋwaŋwaamu, ama ní ki cáá iciin tikpil.

english_verse: Ants, who seem to be feeble, but store up food all summer long;
translation_verse: Icati kaa cáá mpɔn, ama i kōontí tijin dipeel pu ki kpáafí.

english_verse: badgers, who seem to be weak, but live among the rocks;
translation_verse: Kumooun jaŋgbeenapulii kaa cáá mpɔn, ama i ŋáań i-kɔŋkooŋyi ataŋkpee kansikin.

english_verse: locusts, who have no king, but march like an army;
translation_verse: Inaakitoon kaa cáá ubɔti, ama ní ki nóó tɔb dikitil.

english_verse: lizards, which can be caught in your hand, but sneak into palaces.
translation_verse: Dijikpal din unil ŋūǹ kí cúú nì u-ŋalee, ama di kóò dibeecindin.

english_verse: Those fearless lions who rule the jungle,
translation_verse: Tíǹ di sá gbikinti un sá ipeel kɔkɔ kansikin upɔɔl, kaa fàŋkí tibee,

english_verse: those proud roosters, those mountain goats, and those rulers who have no enemies.
translation_verse: nì ukooja un di còom̄ u-taŋambiyaamu puee, nì uŋɔja nì ubɔti un di līī u-janjaliibi nyɔkɔpuee.

english_verse: If you are foolishly bragging or planning something evil, then stop it now!
translation_verse: A yaa nìn ŋá digbaandi ní ki yōoǹ a-ba yilpu, ní boon a dākafèe, á pìin̄ a-nyɔkɔ pu.

english_verse: If you churn milk you get butter; if you pound on your nose, you get blood— and if you stay angry, you get in trouble.
translation_verse: Di sá yii a yaa ŋmáaḿ nnaabiimee, naanum di nyēē, a yaa fáá unil maŋfalee, fatiku di nyēē ní a yaa gíí diŋuulee, kujaau ní an cāabìń.

english_verse: These are the sayings that King Lemuel of Massa was taught by his mother.
translation_verse: Isaŋki in Maasa bɔtiu Leemuyeel fōō u-na ceeyee sèé:

english_verse: My son Lemuel, you were born in answer to my prayers, so listen carefully.
translation_verse: «Áù, m-jipɔɔn! Áù, m-poon biki! Áù, kibiki kin m mēē ki kée!

english_verse: Don't waste your life chasing after women! This has ruined many kings.
translation_verse: Taa dū a-pɔŋŋu kí fìtīǹ binimpoobi, taa nóó bin di yàntī bibɔtiibi wáŋkée.

english_verse: Kings and leaders should not get drunk or even want to drink.
translation_verse: Leemuyeel, bibɔtiibi kaa máaǹ kí nyɔ̀ ndaam, abɔtibil mun kaa máaǹ kí nyɔ̀ ndaam min pɔ̄ɔ̄yee.

english_verse: Drinking makes you forget your responsibilities, and you mistreat the poor.
translation_verse: Bi yaa nyùn̄ee, bi súntí marab pu, ní kaa ti mɔ́tí binandambi pu.

english_verse: Beer and wine are only for the dying or for those who have lost all hope.
translation_verse: Dūmaan ndaam min pɔ̄ɔ̄yee kí tīī bin làá kpúee, kí dū ndamam kí tīī binib bin di bí kunimbaaunee.

english_verse: Let them drink and forget how poor and miserable they feel.
translation_verse: Udaan yaa nyùn̄ee u làá súntí u-falaau pu, ní kaa ti làá téetí u-nimbaaku pu.

english_verse: But you must defend those who are helpless and have no hope.
translation_verse: Siiyee, sii máaǹ kí sòoǹ kí tīī binib bin yaa sòoǹ baa pílifíǹ-bee, binib bin bi dūu fée.

english_verse: Be fair and give justice to the poor and homeless. In Praise of a Good Wife
translation_verse: Á nīn sòoǹ tibɔti nì ibaamɔn, kí mɔ̄tì biwɔfib nì binandambi pu.» Unimpu tiŋman pu yɔu

english_verse: A truly good wife is the most precious treasure a man can find!
translation_verse: Ŋma ŋūǹ kí ká unimpu tiŋman pu yɔu? U pɔ̄ɔ̄ kudaau ki jítiǹ abeedimbil.

english_verse: Her husband depends on her, and she never lets him down.
translation_verse: U-cal cáá u-pu dimákal. Waa ŋáań u-cal gaajati fám fám.

english_verse: She is good to him every day of her life,
translation_verse: U-maŋfal wiiŋyi kɔkɔ poonee, u ŋáań u-cal tiŋan ŋma ní, waa ŋáań-u tikpitil.

english_verse: and with her own hands she gladly makes clothes.
translation_verse: U nyàab̀ ipii kuti nì gulfa un bí fálfalee, ní ki tūǹ ditundi nì difaŋgiil.

english_verse: She is like a sailing ship that brings food from across the sea.
translation_verse: U sá kii meela un tūntí tinyampuwanee ní, u cāabìń u-jikaati ndandati ní.

english_verse: She gets up before daylight to prepare food for her family and for her servants.
translation_verse: U fìntī ntaafaabɔmbɔm ní. U ŋáań tijin kí tīī u-dicaŋku, ní ki tìì u-tɔntɔnliibi bi-tundi.

english_verse: She knows how to buy land and how to plant a vineyard,
translation_verse: U kàal̀ ní kí dàkafì ní kí dā u-ba nì u-nimbiliŋ kusaau ní kí cóoń fiinyi sufii ku-pu.

english_verse: She knows when to buy or sell, and she stays busy until late at night.
translation_verse: U ká yii u-tundi còom̄-u tiŋan. U-fitilau pée wāĺ ní kunyeeu kɔkɔ ní u tūǹ ditundi.

english_verse: She spins her own cloth,
translation_verse: U pée ŋúb́ kigulfajantilii u-ŋaan, ní ki ŋál̀ tiwan.

english_verse: and she helps the poor and the needy.
translation_verse: U pūǹ bisoodambi tiwan, ní ki tútúǹ binandambi.

english_verse: Her family has warm clothing, and so she doesn't worry when it snows.
translation_verse: Tiwool yuntiŋuee, waa fàŋkí u-dicaŋku pu, kun puee u-dicaŋkun yab kɔkɔ cáá tiwool bɔkutiŋ.

english_verse: She does her own sewing, and everything she wears is beautiful.
translation_verse: U lù u-ba ndoo pu satab, ní ki pèentí iŋaamɔnti in bí fálfal ki máǹ cínciŋee wanti.

english_verse: Her husband is a well-known and respected leader in the city.
translation_verse: Akpambal yaa kpáfèe, bi tìì u-cal tinyool. U-cal kútí bitindaŋkpilib pu bi kpáfí ki kpèé kitiŋ pu bɔti.

english_verse: She makes clothes to sell to the shop owners.
translation_verse: Unimpuee ŋál̀ tiwampeeŋkaal ki nyáfí, ki lù dambalab ki nyáfíǹ binyampoobi.

english_verse: She is strong and graceful, as well as cheerful about the future.
translation_verse: U cáá mpɔn ní binib tìì-u jilma, u cáá dimákal foolboon pu.

english_verse: Her words are sensible, and her advice is thoughtful.
translation_verse: U sòoǹ nì iciin ní ki tìì isaŋkimɔnti nì tiniti.

english_verse: She takes good care of her family and is never lazy.
translation_verse: U-nimbil cɔ́ tin kɔkɔ pée jītí u-dicaŋkunee pu, ní waa jīǹ tijin tin pu waa nyántì kutuntuŋuee.

english_verse: Her children praise her, and with great pride her husband says,
translation_verse: U-biyaamu pàkà-u binib nimbiin, ní u-cal mun tìì-u tinyool.

english_verse: “There are many good women, but you are the best!”
translation_verse: U lì yii: «Binimpoobi tikpil bí ki sá tiŋman pu nimpoobi, ama sii jítiǹ bíǹ kɔkɔ!»

english_verse: Charm can be deceiving, and beauty fades away, but a woman who honors the Lord deserves to be praised.
translation_verse: Unimpu un bí gbàlgbalgbalee ŋūǹ kí ŋmàtiǹ unil, ní kunyaaŋŋu mun kaa yúntí, ama unimpu un fàŋkí ti-Dindaanee di máaǹ tinyool.

english_verse: Show her respect— praise her in public for what she has done.
translation_verse: Bi máaǹ kí tīī-u u-faŋgiil paati. Binib kɔkɔ máaǹ kí pàkà-u u-tundi pu.

english_verse: When the son of David was king in Jerusalem, he was known to be very wise, and he said:
translation_verse: Daafiidi jipɔɔn Uciŋfiti un sá ubɔti Jeerusaleem tiŋkinee nyɔɔbuŋŋi sèé.

english_verse: Nothing makes sense! Everything is nonsense. I have seen it all— nothing makes sense!
translation_verse: Uciŋfiti di lī yii: Kubuŋu fám, kubuŋu fám, tikɔkɔ pée sá kii kubuŋuee ní.

english_verse: What is there to show for all of our hard work here on this earth?
translation_verse: Nisaal bìǹ kitiŋ pu doo, ama ipaati ilai ní u cáá?

english_verse: People come, and people go, but still the world never changes.
translation_verse: Biba kúù ní bi màal̀ biba, ama ní kitiŋ kíǹ pée bí ki-laŋki.

english_verse: The sun comes up, the sun goes down; it hurries right back to where it started from.
translation_verse: Ŋwìiń nyēē, ŋwìiń jēetí, ní kí ŋá malaa kí fàtīí gítí ŋu-nyalaŋki.

english_verse: The wind blows south, the wind blows north; round and round it blows over and over again.
translation_verse: Kubuŋu jītí kí cù ŋgan pú, ní kí màntī ki gítí ŋgiil pú. Ku màntī ní kí màntī ní kí fàtīí màntī, ní kí fàtīí gítí laakin ku kílińee.

english_verse: All rivers empty into the sea, but it never spills over; one by one the rivers return to their source.
translation_verse: Ibun kɔkɔ pùub̀ ki kóò tiŋku poon, ama tiŋku kaa pée gbéè dalba dalba. Laakin ní ibun pùub̀ ki kóòyee, niin ní i gbíntìi pùub̀ ki kóò kaa gbèentí.

english_verse: All of life is far more boring than words could ever say. Our eyes and our ears are never satisfied with what we see and hear.
translation_verse: Anyɔɔbun kɔkɔ sátì an kaa cáá bí lì. An kaa cáá yii ditafal pílifì tibɔti ki bál̀, ní dinimbil mun kaa kpèé kí núutí.

english_verse: Someone might say, “Here is something new!” But it happened before, long before we were born.
translation_verse: Ti kāntí tiwan tibee ní kí lì yii: «Kpèè, tiwan nee sá tiwampɔn ní!» Ama an wantee nìn pée bí dooooyee ki wāatì ní timbi nín nyáń.

english_verse: No one who lived in the past is remembered anymore, and everyone yet to be born will be forgotten too. It Is Senseless To Be Wise
translation_verse: Timbee, ti súntí tin nìn jítì doooodooooyee pu. Bin mun làá dāá páannée làá dāá súntí tin làá dāá jītí timbi boonee pu. Uciŋfiti bífì ki béè duulinya poon bɔti

english_verse: I said these things when I lived in Jerusalem as king of Israel.
translation_verse: Man Uciŋfiti jíń Isirayeel nibul pu dibeel Jeerusaleem tiŋkin.

english_verse: With all my wisdom I tried to understand everything that happens here on earth. And God has made this so hard for us humans to do.
translation_verse: M dū m-ciiŋyi kɔkɔ kí béé tin kɔkɔ bíi jītí kitiŋ puee kí gbìl̄ ti-taapu. An sá digìŋ́kpaandi ní Unimbɔti dūu túǹ nisaalib.

english_verse: I have seen it all, and everything is just as senseless as chasing the wind.
translation_verse: M ká tin kɔkɔ ní binib ŋáań kitiŋ pu dooyee. Ama tíǹ kɔkɔ sá fám ní, an bí kii unil nín jì kubuŋu puee ní.

english_verse: If something is crooked, it can't be made straight; if something isn't there, it can't be counted.
translation_verse: Tiwan tin pɔ́ĺee, baa ŋūǹ kí tàntī-tì. Tin kaa bée, baa ŋūǹ kí kàaǹ-tì.

english_verse: I said to myself, “You are by far the wisest person who has ever lived in Jerusalem. You are eager to learn, and you have learned a lot.”
translation_verse: M lī m-ban yii: «M béè iciin ki yāntì i cūtì nyɔkɔpu ki jítiǹ bibɔtiibi bin kɔkɔ péeǹ-mi ki kāl̀ dibeel Jeerusaleem tiŋkinee.» M béè iciin tikpilku, ki ká dinyil tiŋan pu.

english_verse: Then I decided to find out all I could about wisdom and foolishness. Soon I realized that this too was as senseless as chasing the wind.
translation_verse: M bífì ki béè tin di sá iciinee nì tin kaa sée, tin sá dinyil nì tin sá digbaandee. M dáań ki ká yii tíǹ kɔkɔ sá kii unil nín jì kubuŋu puee ní.

english_verse: The more you know, the more you hurt; the more you understand, the more you suffer.
translation_verse: Iciin tikpil cāabìń agìń tikpil mun ní, míǹ ní dinyil tikpil mun cāabìń diwumpildi.

english_verse: I said to myself, “Have fun and enjoy yourself!” But this didn't make sense.
translation_verse: M lī m-ban yii: «Toooo! M làá jī mmɔn kí jī nnaam.» Ama m ká yii niin mun sá fám ní.

english_verse: Laughing and having fun is crazy. What good does it do?
translation_verse: Mmɔn sá digbaandi, ní ifaal mun kaa bí tiban.

english_verse: I wanted to find out what was best for us during the short time we have on this earth. So I decided to make myself happy with wine and find out what it means to be foolish, without really being foolish myself.
translation_verse: M lēē m-pɔbil poon yii m làá nīn kíǹ ki nyù ndaam kí nīn ŋáań kii bigbaambi nín ŋáań puee, kí nīn gbíntìi yì m-ba. M nìn là kí ká kun unil ŋūǹ kí ŋá án nīn sá tiŋan u-maŋfal wiiŋyi poon duulinya nee poonee ní.

english_verse: I did some great things. I built houses and planted vineyards.
translation_verse: M túń atuŋkpaan tikpil, ki máń m-ba adiin, ki kùn̄ fiinyi sufii kpaaŋŋi.

english_verse: I had flower gardens and orchards full of fruit trees.
translation_verse: M kùn̄ poojab nì isufi kpaaŋŋi ki cóoǹ isufi in lòoǹ abilee kɔkɔ nì i-bulifi.

english_verse: And I had pools where I could get water for the trees.
translation_verse: M gbìn̄ anyimbɔbil bí nīn lúù nnyim ki yàantí isufi in ní m cóoǹ cóoǹee.

english_verse: I owned slaves, and their sons and daughters became my slaves. I had more sheep and goats than anyone who had ever lived in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: M dá iyumbu bininjab nì binimpoobi, ki cáá bitɔntɔnliibi tikpil. M cáá inaa nì ipii nì iŋoobu ki jítiǹ bibɔtiibi bin nìn péeǹ-mi ki kāl̀ dibeel Jeerusaleem tiŋkinee kɔkɔ.

english_verse: Foreign rulers brought me silver, gold, and precious treasures. Men and women sang for me, and I had many wives who gave me great pleasure.
translation_verse: M nìn kóoǹ ntimu mun kɔkɔ bí m-taapuee nì mu-bɔtiibi gaajati nì bi-nimbiliŋ kúti nì bi-sindaariyab ki kpúkuǹ m-cee. Bilaŋgaaliibi bininjab nì binimpoobi nìn dòoń ki gà ilan ki kɔ̀ntī m-nimbiliŋ. M nìn cáá kun unifoo kamaa pée lèe, an dàkà yii kunimpupaau.

english_verse: I was the most famous person who had ever lived in Jerusalem, and I was very wise.
translation_verse: M kpántì unikpaan ki jítiǹ bibɔtiibi binib bin kɔkɔ kāl̀ Jeerusaleem tiŋkinee. Ama nì míǹ kɔkɔee, m-ciiŋyi dáá gbíntìi bí m-cee.

english_verse: I got whatever I wanted and did whatever made me happy. But most of all, I enjoyed my work.
translation_verse: Kun kamaa ní m-nimbil yaa wál̀ ní ku fáatiǹ-mee, maa nìn yíití kudɔŋu. Maa ŋmīntì m-pɔbil mmɔn báà ŋubɔ. Tiŋman, m jíń m-tuuŋŋi paati ní ki páatì m nín gīī ki túń ditundi diŋyee kɔkɔ pu.

english_verse: Then I thought about everything I had done, including the hard work, and it was simply chasing the wind. Nothing on earth is worth the trouble. Wisdom Comes from God
translation_verse: M kāl̀ ki kpēē atuun ŋin m túńee kɔkɔ nì digìńdi din m gīī ní ki túń an tuuŋŋee. M dáań ki ká yii tíǹ gbanti kɔkɔ mun sá kii kubuŋuee ní.

english_verse: I asked myself, “What can the next king do that I haven't done?” Then I decided to compare wisdom with foolishness and stupidity.
translation_verse: M nyàab̄ kí gbìl̄ iciin nì kuwaatiiu nì digbaandi taapu. M bālifì m-ba yii unil un làá dāá kàl̄ dibeel m-boonee làá dāá ŋá kii bin līntiǹ-ueeee?

english_verse: And I discovered that wisdom is better than foolishness, just as light is better than darkness.
translation_verse: Mama m-ba dáań ki ká yii iciin sɔ́ǹ digbaandi, kii ŋwalifi nín sɔ́ǹ dibɔmbɔndi puee ní.

english_verse: Wisdom is like having two good eyes; foolishness leaves you in the dark. But wise or foolish, we all end up the same.
translation_verse: Di sá yii uciŋfiti wāĺ laakin u còom̄ ki cée, ama ní ugbaan úǹ pée bí ki tìliŋkī dibɔmbɔndin ní ki cá, kaa wāĺ. Ama m nyí mun yii bi-liitil làá dāá pée kúntí mbaantiim ní.

english_verse: Finally, I said to myself, “Being wise got me nowhere! The same thing will happen to me that happens to fools. Nothing makes sense.
translation_verse: Niinee ní m lī m-pɔbil poon yii: «Tin dɔ̄ ki cí ugbaanee di dɔ̄ ki cí ma mun. Mimmee m nín sá uciŋfiti ki jítiǹ-u nee, m páatì ba? M lī m-ban yii tíǹ kɔkɔ mun sá kubuŋu ní.»

english_verse: Suddenly I realized that others would someday get everything I had worked for so hard, then I started hating it all.
translation_verse: M ná ditundi din m gīī digìńdi ki túń kitiŋ pu dooyee kɔkɔ. Di sá yii un làá dāá fōō m-yil m-kpátam boonee di làá dāá jī tin kɔkɔ ní m ŋá ki yóoǹee.

english_verse: Who knows if those people will be sensible or stupid? Either way, they will own everything I have earned by hard work and wisdom. It doesn't make sense.
translation_verse: Udaan yaa làá dāá nīn sá uciŋfiti àá ugbaanaaa, ubɔ kaa nyí. Ama úǹ di làá dāá jī tiwan tin kɔkɔ ní m gīī digìńdi ki dàkā iciin ki ká kitiŋ pu dooyee. Niin mun sá kii unil nín jì kubuŋu puee ní.

english_verse: I thought about all my hard work, and I felt depressed.
translation_verse: M nín ká digìńdi din m gīī kitiŋ pu dooyee, ní m-wunti yɔ̄tì.

english_verse: When we use our wisdom, knowledge, and skill to get what we own, why do we have to leave it to someone who didn't work for it? This is senseless and wrong.
translation_verse: Á kpèè yii unil ń dū iciin nì dinyil kí tɔ̄ ditundi ní án bútí-u tiŋan, kí dāá dū tin kɔkɔ u gīī digìńdi ki ká gbantee kí tīī ubɔ un kaa pée ŋá tibee. Niin gbanti mun sá kii kubuŋuee ní, ki wù tikpil.

english_verse: What do we really gain from all of our hard work?
translation_verse: Di sá yii unil nín tūǹ ditundi kí gbá kí gīī kitiŋ nee puee, ba ní u páatí ní?

english_verse: Our bodies ache during the day, and work is torture. Then at night our thoughts are troubled. It just doesn't make sense.
translation_verse: Tiŋman, unil maŋfal wiiŋyi kɔkɔ poonee, u pɔ̄ɔntí kí jī falaa kí tɔ̄ ditundi. Kunyeeu gbee, waa ŋūǹ kí ŋùŋfì. Niin mun sá kubuŋu fám ní.

english_verse: The best thing we can do is to enjoy eating, drinking, and working. I believe these are God's gifts to us,
translation_verse: Kun pée sá binifoobi naamee di sá bí jī kí nyɔ̀ ní kí fàal̀ digìńdi din bi gīīyee pu. M dáań ki ká yii Unimbɔti di tīī nnaam gbanti.

english_verse: and no one enjoys eating and living more than I do.
translation_verse: Di sá yii ŋma di ŋūǹ kí jī kí nīn bí mmɔnni an yaa kaa nyánní Unimbɔti cee.

english_verse: If we please God, he will make us wise, understanding, and happy. But if we sin, God will make us struggle for a living, then he will give all we own to someone who pleases him. This makes no more sense than chasing the wind.
translation_verse: Unil un bɔti fáatì Unimbɔtee, udaan ní u tìì iciin nì dinyil nì dipɔɔpindi. Ama unil un ŋáań ikpitee, u yàntī u kōontí tigaajawan ki kpáafí un fáatiǹ-uee ní. An mun kaa cáá taapu ní ki bí kii unil nín jì kubuŋu puee.

english_verse: Everything on earth has its own time and its own season.
translation_verse: Kitiŋ nee puee, tiwan kamaa cáá ti-yuntiŋu, ní ŋyunti kamaa cáá ti-wanti.

english_verse: There is a time for birth and death, planting and reaping,
translation_verse: Ŋyunti bí bí màal̀ unil ní ŋyunti bí ú kpú, ŋyunti bí bí cóoń busubu, ní ŋyunti bí bí fùkù-bu.

english_verse: There is a time for finding and losing, keeping and giving,
translation_verse: Ŋyunti bí bí nyàab̀ ní ŋyunti bí bí fá.

english_verse: There is also a time for love and hate, for war and peace. What God Has Given Us To Do
translation_verse: Ŋyunti bí bí nīn néeń ní ŋyunti bí bí nīn ná. Kujaau yuntiŋu bí ní ŋgbansɔŋfi yuntiŋu bí.

english_verse: What do we gain by all our hard work?
translation_verse: Ba paatii ní un tūǹ ditundee kāntí u-tundi gìńdi poon?

english_verse: I have seen what difficult things God demands of us.
translation_verse: M kpēē atuun ŋin ní Unimbɔti dūu túǹ unil puee.

english_verse: God makes everything happen at the right time. Yet none of us can ever fully understand all he has done, and he puts questions in our minds about the past and the future.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti yàntī tikɔkɔ bàń ti-yuntiŋu ní. U gíti tí tīī binifoobi nlandɔkɔ bí béé tin jítèe nì tin bí ki dòońee. Nì míǹ kɔkɔee, baa ŋūǹ kí béé tin kɔkɔ Unimbɔti ŋée.

english_verse: I know the best thing we can do is to always enjoy life,
translation_verse: M nyí mun yii nnaam min pée bí ki tīī-bee di sá bí jī mmɔn bi-maŋfal wiiŋyi poon kí fàal̀.

english_verse: because God's gift to us is the happiness we get from our food and drink and from the work we do.
translation_verse: Unil yaa ká kí jī, kí nyɔ̀ ní ki bíi jīǹ u-tundi puee, an sá Unimbɔti pɔl ní.

english_verse: Everything God has done will last forever; nothing he does can ever be changed. God has done all this, so that we will worship him.
translation_verse: M nyí mun yii tin kɔkɔ ní Unimbɔti ŋáańee làá nīn pée bí kí nīn cá jaanjaan, tiba kaa kútí tin u ŋée puɔɔɔ, tiba kaa bàtī mun. Unimbɔti ŋáań míǹ yii unil ń nīn fàŋkí-u ní.

english_verse: Everything that happens has happened before, and all that will be has already been— God does everything over and over again. The Future Is Known Only to God
translation_verse: Tibɔti tin bíi jītí kɔŋkɔnnee nìn pée jítì dooooyee. Tin bí ki làá jītí fool boonee mun nìn pée jítì dooooyee ní. Unimbɔti yàntī tin kɔkɔ pée jītée fàtīi kífí mpɔm ní. Tikɔkɔ kúntíǹ ŋkúm ní

english_verse: So I told myself that God has set a time and a place for everything. He will judge everyone, both the wicked and the good.
translation_verse: Niinee ní m lī m-ban yii Unimbɔti làá sòoǹ deedeedaan nì unikpiti bɔti. Di sá yii tiwan kɔkɔ cáá ti-yuntiŋu, ní u làá sòoǹ ti-tuuŋŋi kɔkɔ bɔti.

english_verse: I know God is testing us to show us that we are merely animals.
translation_verse: M lī m-pɔbilin binifoobi pu yii: Unimbɔti là kí ká bi nín cáá kudapɔɔu kuŋyee ní kí dàkà-bi yii bi bí kii tiwaŋkutee ní.

english_verse: Like animals we breathe and die, and we are no better off than they are. It just doesn't make sense.
translation_verse: Di sá yii unil nín kúntíǹ puee, míǹ mbaantiim ní kuwaŋkuluu mun kúntíǹ. Unil kúù ní kuwaŋkuluu mun kúù. Bi-kɔkɔ pée cáá kufoobaantiiuee ní. Unil kaa jítiǹ kuwaŋkuluu, kun puee tikɔkɔ pée sá kii kubuŋuee ní.

english_verse: All living creatures go to the same place. We are made from earth, and we return to earth.
translation_verse: Tin kɔkɔ pée cáá kufoouee nín kúntíǹ puee dee. Kufoou kamaa nyánní ntamin ní ki làá fàtīí gítí ntamin.

english_verse: Who really knows if our spirits go up and the spirits of animals go down into the earth?
translation_verse: Ubɔ kaa ŋūǹ kí lì yii unil fooku kúǹ jɔ́ḿ yilpu yilpu, ama ní kuwaŋkuluu kúǹ yɔkɔ sìntī kitiŋ taapu taapu.

english_verse: I looked again and saw people being mistreated everywhere on earth. They were crying, but no one was there to offer comfort, and those who mistreated them were powerful.
translation_verse: M gíti dáań ki ká mun yii diwɔ́bil bí kitiŋ pu doo tikpil. Bin bi wɔ́b̀ee bí ki gbòoǹ pɔ̀ɔɔɔ, ama ní báà ubɔ kaa bí kí ŋméeǹ-bi. Mpɔn kā bin sàantí-bee ŋaan, ní ubɔ kaa bí kí ŋméeǹ-bi.

english_verse: I said to myself, “The dead are better off than the living.
translation_verse: Niinee m ká yii bin kpíìyee bí mmɔnni ki jítiǹ binifoobi.

english_verse: But those who have never been born are better off than anyone else, because they have never seen the terrible things that happen on this earth.”
translation_verse: Ama un baa láá màl̄ee úǹ gíti bí mmɔnni ki jítiǹ bitaŋkpiibi nì binifoobi. Di sá yii úǹ kaa ká atuŋkpiti ŋin bi tūǹ kitiŋ nee puee.

english_verse: Then I realized that we work and do wonderful things just because we are jealous of others. This makes no more sense than chasing the wind.
translation_verse: M ká mun yii unil gì ki là án bútí-u u-tuuŋŋi poon, kun puee u là kí jītíǹ u-juti ní. An mun kaa cáá taapu, an bí kii unil nín jì kubuŋu puee ní.

english_verse: Fools will fold their hands and starve to death.
translation_verse: Ugbaan di kā ki kpàl̄ iŋal ní ŋkùm ń kpɔ̀-u.

english_verse: Yet a very little food eaten in peace is better than twice as much earned from overwork and chasing the wind.
translation_verse: Ama unil ń ká diŋuŋfil fiii sɔ́ ki jítiǹ á tɔ̄ ditundi din di sá kii bi nín jì kubuŋu puee kí gīī kí tin kpáàa lákatí a-ba puee.

english_verse: Once again I saw that nothing on earth makes sense.
translation_verse: M gíti dáań ki ká yii tibɔti tiba bí kitiŋ pu doo ki sá kii unil nín jì kubuŋu puee:

english_verse: For example, some people don't have friends or family. But they are never satisfied with what they own, and they never stop working to get more. They should ask themselves, “Why am I always working to have more? Who will get what I leave behind?” What a senseless and miserable life! It Is Better To Have a Friend
translation_verse: Unil di bí u-baba nì u-baba, kaa cáá ubɔɔtaaa, kaa cáá kibikaaa, kaa cáá kinabiki mun. An niliuee tūǹ ditundi kaa gbèentí kí mɔ̀tīí ká tigaajati. Ama ní u bàlifī u-ba yii: «Ŋma ní m tūǹ ditundi ki tìì ní? Ŋma pu ní m ŋmìntī m-ba mmɔn ní?» An mun bí kii unil nín jì kubuŋu puee ní. An sá dituŋfandi ní.

english_verse: You are better having a friend than to be all alone, because then you will get more enjoyment out of what you earn.
translation_verse: An sɔ́ binib ń nīn bí bili ki jítiǹ unil ń nīn bí u-baba, kun puee binib bili tundi nyēē nnyim ki jítiǹ unibaanti.

english_verse: If you fall, your friend can help you up. But if you fall without having a friend nearby, you are really in trouble.
translation_verse: Di sá yii bi-kansikin ubɔ yaa lítèe, un kíǹee làá yòon̄-u. Ama unil un bí u-babee bɔti gbí isaa, kun puee úǹ yaa lítèe, ubɔ kaa bí kí yòon̄-u.

english_verse: If you sleep alone, you won't have anyone to keep you warm on a cold night.
translation_verse: Míǹ mbaantiim, binib bili yaa kpáfì ki dɔ̄ee, an tùm̀ bi-pu ní, ama unil yaa dɔ̄ u-babee, u làá ŋá mana ní án nīn tùm̀ u-pu?

english_verse: Someone might be able to beat up one of you, but not both of you. As the saying goes, “A rope made from three strands of cord is hard to break.”
translation_verse: Bi ŋūǹ kí já kí pɔ̄ɔkiǹ unibaanti sɔkɔmii, ama an yaa sá binib bilee, an pɔ̄ɔ̄. Dipal din bi dū iŋmii ita ki pàal̄ee kaa tìfī sɔkɔmii.

english_verse: You may be poor and young, but if you are wise, you are better off than a foolish old king who won't listen to advice.
translation_verse: Campɔnti un sá usoodaan ki cáá iciinee sɔ́ǹ ubɔtigbaan un púĺ kaa ti kíikí bí sāŋkì-uee.

english_verse: Even if you were not born into the royal family and have been a prisoner and poor, you can still be king.
translation_verse: Báà campɔnti gbanti yaa nyánní sarkan ki kpántì ubɔti àá u yaa mèé u-beelin ki kāntí ki jīǹ,

english_verse: I once saw everyone in the world follow a young leader who came to power after the king was gone.
translation_verse: m ká yii kitiŋ nee puee, binib kɔkɔ làá nīn bí campɔnti gbanti jaaŋŋu pú ní ú dāá fōō ubɔtikpikee yil kí kàl̄ dibeel.

english_verse: His followers could not even be counted. But years from now, no one will praise him—this makes no more sense than chasing the wind.
translation_verse: U làá kpántí dinibukpaandi bɔtiu ní. Ama bin làá dāá páań u-boonee kaa dāa gíti bí dipɔɔpindin u-pu. Di sá yii tíǹ gbanti kɔkɔ sá fám ní ki bí kii bi nín jì kubuŋu puee. Taa nín sòoǹ ki bùsī anyɔɔbun Unimbɔti nimbiin

english_verse: Be careful what you do when you enter the house of God. Fools go there to offer sacrifices, because all they do is sin. But it's best just to listen when you go to worship.
translation_verse: Á dàkafì tiŋan kí wàatī kí nín sòoǹ, kí taa jìkì kí pòon̄ Unimbɔti ipoon. Di sá yii Unimbɔti bí yilpu ní sii bí kitiŋ pu. An puee á taa nín̄ sòoǹ tikpil.

english_verse: Don't talk before you think or make promises to God without thinking them through. God is in heaven, and you are on earth, so don't talk too much.
translation_verse: Unil yaa dàkafī tikpilee, u dámintí tidamintiil ní, ní un sòoǹ tikpilee sòoǹ tibɔfan.

english_verse: If you keep thinking about something, you will dream about it. If you talk too much, you will say the wrong thing.
translation_verse: A yaa pōoǹ Unimbɔti ipoonee, taa tàan̄ kí ŋá tin a pōoǹ-uee. Di sá yii Unimbɔti kaa gèetíǹ bin ŋáań tibɔti kaa dàkafēe. An puee a yaa pōoǹ-u puee, á ŋá míǹ.

english_verse: God doesn't like fools. So don't be slow to keep your promises to God.
translation_verse: An sɔ́ á taa pōoǹ Unimbɔti ipoon ki jítiǹ á pòon̄-u ní kí taa ŋmā kí ŋá tin a pōoǹee.

english_verse: Don't let your mouth get you in trouble! And don't say to the worship leader, “I didn't mean what I said.” God can destroy everything you have worked for, so don't say something that makes God angry.
translation_verse: Unil yaa dámintí tikpilee, u sòoǹ tikpil ní an kaa cáá taapu. Míǹ puee fàŋkì Unimbɔti. Biyidambi cáá bi-pɔŋŋu ki tūǹ atummɔnti

english_verse: And since the king is the highest official, he benefits most from the taxes paid on the land.
translation_verse: Unil un néeń animbilee kaa díkì animbil, míǹ ní un néeń tigaajatee, tin u cááyee kaa fáatiǹ-u. Tinee mun sá kii bi nín jì kubuŋu puee ní.

english_verse: If you love money and wealth, you will never be satisfied with what you have. This doesn't make a bit of sense.
translation_verse: Unil yaa cáá tigaajati tikpilee, binib bin jīǹ-tèe mun wīikí ní. Mimmee ipaati ilai ní udaan cáá, an yaa kaa sá ú nīn cáa kɔ̀ntī u-nimbiliŋ?

english_verse: The more you have, the more everyone expects from you. Your money won't do you any good—others will just spend it for you.
translation_verse: Utɔntɔnli yaa cáá tikpil kí jāaa, u yaa cáá fiii kí jāaa, u gèeǹ mmɔntiim ní. Ama ugaaja úǹ kaa ŋūǹ kí gèeǹ, kun puee u cáá tigaajawan tikpil.

english_verse: If you have to work hard for a living, you can rest well at night, even if you don't have much to eat. But if you are rich, you can't even sleep.
translation_verse: M dáań ki ká dinimbinaamandi bɔti tiba kitiŋ pu doo. Kijapaai kiba di kpáafì tigaajati ki yóoǹ, ní tigaajatee dāa cáań-u nnaabu.

english_verse: I have seen something terribly unfair. People get rich, but it does them no good.
translation_verse: U dū tigaajatee ki túń ditundi diba ní ki lítì. U dāa màl̄ kibininjabikee, waa ti cáá báà tiba nì tiba.

english_verse: Suddenly they lose everything in a bad business deal, then have nothing to leave for their children.
