translation_verse: «Ti-Dindaan Mpɔŋkɔdaan, Isirayeel Nimbɔtiu un beejal tɔ́kɔ́ Keerubimbi puee. Sii baba di sá kitiŋ nee kɔkɔ pu beeŋi Nimbɔtiu. Sii di náań kutagbɔŋu nì kitiŋ.

english_verse: Just look and see how Sennacherib has insulted you, the living God.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, kpòon̄ a-tafal kí pīlifì! Ti-Dindaan, ŋúbití a-nimbiliŋ kí kpèè! Pīlifì asiibil ŋin kɔkɔ ní Seenakeeriibi tuuŋyi sīī sii Unimbɔti un bí dimaŋfalinee!

english_verse: It is true, our Lord, that Assyrian kings have turned nations into deserts.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, an lafun sá tiŋman ní yii Asuur bɔtiibi kūū ki céetì atimbun ŋin kíǹee nib ki nāaǹ bi-timmu.

english_verse: As surely as I am the Lord, he will return by the way he came and will never enter Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Nsan ŋun u dī ki dɔ́mińee, nsan gbanti ní u làá fàtīí dī kí gítí. U-taal kpá kí tāā kitiŋ nee poon. Man ni-Dindaan di lī míǹ.

english_verse: I went to Hezekiah and told him that the Lord God of Israel had said: Hezekiah, you prayed to me about King Sennacherib of Assyria. Now this is what I say to that king: The people of Jerusalem hate and make fun of you; they laugh behind your back.
translation_verse: Tibɔti tin ní ti-Dindaan sòon̄ Seenakeeriibi puee sèé: <Siiyɔn tiŋki bíi kpèé-si fám, kì bíi bèel̄-si. Jeerusaleem tiŋki kinyannyaaŋŋi bí ki lāā-si ki gbákafí diyil.

english_verse: You let your officials insult me, the Lord. And here is what you have said about yourself, “I led my chariots to the highest heights of Lebanon's mountains. I went deep into its forest, cutting down the best cedar and cypress trees.
translation_verse: A dī a-tuuŋyi pu ki sīī man ni-Dindaan. «A lī yii: <Man Seenakeeriibi, m cáá janjatɔrɔkub náaǹ, an pu ní m ŋúń ki jɔ́m̀ ki tin bàn̄ ajoon yilpu, m jɔ́m̀ ki tin bàn̄ Leebanɔn jool yilpu. M gāatì ki-seedir sufii in pée fɔ̀kɔ̀ee, ki gāatì ki-siipreesi sufii in pée ŋān̄ee. M jɔ́m̀ ki bàn̄ ki-jooŋŋi ŋin fɔ̀kɔ̀ee yilpu, ki kɔ́ ki-bambaŋku kun múkúee poon.

english_verse: I dried up every stream in the land of Egypt, and I drank water from wells I had dug.”
translation_verse: M gbìn̄ lɔkɔb ntincamun ki nyùn̄ bi-nyim niin. M dū m-taaŋi ki tāā Eejipiti tiŋki, ní ki-buŋyi kɔkɔ fóotì.>»

english_verse: Sennacherib, now listen to me, the Lord. I planned all of this long ago. And you don't even know that I alone am the one who decided that you would do these things. I let you make ruins of fortified cities.
translation_verse: Mimmee Seenakeeriibi, saa nyí yii an sá man di bɔ́ntì tin bíi jītí nee kɔkɔ ki yóoǹ doooodooooyeeee? Saa nyí yii an yúntì tikpil m nín bɔ́ntì-tèeee? Kɔŋkɔnnee ní m yāntì tin m bɔ́ntèe bíi jītí. Man di lēē-si á nà ntimu mun bi máń agun ki māntìi túee kɔkɔ dúsi dusi.

english_verse: Their people became weak, terribly confused. They were like wild flowers or like tender young grass growing on a flat roof or like a field of grain before it matures.
translation_verse: Binib bin kóò ntimu gbantinee ŋalii jòon̄ fám ní, dinyoondi kɔ́-bi ní icoo cúú-bi. Bi bí kii timool tin bí tisatinee, kii kumɔsɔŋu kun dáá pɔ̀fèe, kii timool tin nyēē kudii yilpuee, àá tin nyēē tisatin kaa láá bīńee.

english_verse: I know all about you, even how fiercely angry you are with me.
translation_verse: A yaa kāaa, a yaa yúɔɔɔ, a yaa nyēēyaaa, a yaa kóòyaaa, a yaa tí gíí m-pu diŋuulaaa, m nyí.

english_verse: I have seen your pride and the tremendous hatred you have for me. Now I will put a hook in your nose, a bit in your mouth, then I will send you back to where you came from.
translation_verse: Tiŋman, a lafun gíí m-pu diŋuul, ní tibɔfan tin a sòon̄-mee kɔ́ m-tafalin. An pu ní m làá dū dibɔmbil kí túuń a-maŋfal, kí dū tikúti kí kpàl̄ a-nyɔkɔ kí ŋmā kí kpòotī-si. Nsan ŋun a dī ki dɔ́miń dooyee, nsan gbanti ní a làá fàtīí dī kí kpì.

english_verse: Hezekiah, I will tell you what's going to happen. This year you will eat crops that grow on their own, and the next year you will eat whatever springs up where those crops grew. But the third year, you will plant grain and vineyards, and you will eat what you harvest.
translation_verse: Eeseekiyaasi, kudaaŋŋu kun m tīī-see sèé. Dun bindi nee, ni làá jī dibindi din jítèe jinti tin sá aleenee, ní jiilee ní dāá tí jī míǹ. Ama dibintataatiil poonee, ni làá dāá kpɔ̀ kí bɔ̄l̀ kí cā ni-kpaajinti, ní kí dāá kpɔ̀ afiinyikpaan kí dāá kìtī abil kí ŋmɔ́.

english_verse: Those who survive in Judah will be like a vine that puts down deep roots and bears fruit.
translation_verse: Juuda beel nib bin làá dāá ŋmátée làá dāá nīn bí kii disupɔmbilee ní. Bi làá dāá tɔ̄ inyaampɔɔn kitiŋ poon ní kí dāá lòoǹ abil yilpu.

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, will see to it that some who live in Jerusalem will survive.
translation_verse: Di sá yii binib biba làá dāá kíń Jeerusaleem tiŋkin, bin ŋmátì kaa kpíìyee làá dāá yīkì kí yūĺ Siiyɔn jool pu. Ti-Dindaan Mpɔŋkɔdaan neeŋkpaandi puee, u làá dāá ŋá míǹ.

english_verse: I promise that the king of Assyria won't get into Jerusalem, or shoot an arrow into the city, or even surround it and prepare to attack.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan nín lī Asuur bɔtiu pu puee sèé: «Waa làá kɔ́ kitiŋ nee poon. Waa làá tɔ̄ mpimbambaanti doo. Waa làá dū digbampɔɔl kí lìkin̄ u-ba kí jáǹ-kì, kaa làá tí bíĺ ataŋkpuku ki-guŋŋi pu kí jáǹ-kì.

english_verse: After this, King Sennacherib went back to Assyria and lived in the city of Nineveh.
translation_verse: Niinee ní Asuur bɔtiu Seenakeeriibi yíkì dinaapaalee pu ki nín gítí Niiniifi tiŋkin ki cūtìi gbíntì niin.

english_verse: One day he was worshiping in the temple of his god Nisroch, when his sons, Adrammelech and Sharezer, killed him with their swords. They escaped to the land of Ararat, and his son Esarhaddon became king.
translation_verse: Dalba u gbāā u-waal Niisrooki diikun ki jáaḿ-dèe, ní u-jipɔmbi Adirameeleeki nì Sareeseer dū kitàataajiki ki gāā ki kūū-u ní ki sáǹ ki nín cá Ararati tiŋkin. U-jipɔɔn Asaradɔn di fōō u-yil ki kpántì ubɔti.

english_verse: Hezekiah turned toward the wall and prayed,
translation_verse: Niinee ní Eeseekiyaasi fātì u-nimbiin ki túĺ digundi ní ki mēē ti-Dindaan yii:

english_verse: You, Lord, will save me, and every day that we live we will sing in your temple to the music of stringed instruments. Isaiah's Advice to Hezekiah
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan sii di fīī-mi. An puee ti làá nīn bɔ̀ɔ́ tiwan ki nyɔ́ŋkí-si a-diikun ti-maŋfal wiiŋyi kɔkɔ poon.

english_verse: About this time, Hezekiah got sick and was almost dead. So I went in and told him, “The Lord says you won't ever get well. You are going to die, and so you had better start doing what needs to be done.”
translation_verse: Ŋyunti gbantee Eeseekiyaasi nìn búŋkì ki làá kpú. Ní Unimbɔti bɔnaatiliu Yeesaya, Amɔtisi jipɔɔn cūtìi māntì u-pu ní ki bí-u yii: «Ti-Dindaan bí yii á bɔ́ntí a-dicaŋku, di sá yii a làá kpú ní, saa làá ŋmátí.»

english_verse: I thought I would never again see you, my Lord, or any of the people who live on this earth.
translation_verse: M nìn gíti lī m-ban yii: maa làá ti ká ti-Dindaan binifoobi tiŋki pu doo deeyaa! Maa làá ti wāl̀ báà uniseen nimbiin duulinya nee poon deeyaa!

english_verse: “Don't forget that I have been faithful to you, Lord. I have obeyed you with all my heart, and I do whatever you say is right.” After this, he cried hard.
translation_verse: «M-Dindaan, m gbāam̀-si ní. Téetí yii m nóó-si nì ibaamɔn nì dipɔbil diba ní ki ŋá tin fáatiǹ-see.» U mēē mimmee ní ki súń tikpil.

english_verse: Then the Lord sent me
translation_verse: Ní ti-Dindaan sòon̄ nì Yeesaya ki bí-u yii

english_verse: with this message for Hezekiah: I am the Lord God, who was worshiped by your ancestor David. I heard you pray, and I saw you cry. I will let you live
translation_verse: ú gítí kí tùkù Eeseekiyaasi yii: «Ti-Dindaan, a-naanja Nimbɔtiu di lī yii: <M gbìl̄ a-wimmeem, ki ká a-nyinnyim. M làá fɔ̀kɔǹ a-maŋfal wiiŋyi abin saalku kí kūtì.

english_verse: There's nothing I can say in answer to you, since you are the one who has done this to me. My life has turned sour; I will limp until I die.
translation_verse: Tilati ní m gíti cáá kí sòoǹ ní ú kíí-mi ní, di sá yii úǹ di ŋá tin bí nee kɔkɔ. Kunimbaakpaaŋŋu kun kɔ́-mee puee, ŋgeem gíti kpá-mi.

english_verse: while I protect you and your city from the king of Assyria.
translation_verse: M làá fīī sii nì kitiŋ nee kí nyāntí Asuur bɔtiu ŋaan. M làá wúń kitiŋ nee pu>.»

english_verse: Now I will prove to you that I will keep my promise.
translation_verse: Ní Yeesaya bí Eeseekiyaasi yii: «Kpèè, kudaaŋŋu kun ti-Dindaan tīī-si kí dàkà yii u nín pōoǹ puee, u làá ŋá mimmee sɔ̀.

english_verse: Do you see the shadow made by the setting sun on the stairway built for King Ahaz? I will make the shadow go back ten steps. Then the shadow went back ten steps. King Hezekiah's Song of Praise
translation_verse: Too, ti-Dindaan làá yàntī mboon ŋun lítì Akaasi kɔliŋ puee ń fàtīí sútí kí jɔ̄m̀ akɔl saalaa pu.» Ní mboon lafun fātìi sútì ki jɔ́m̀ Akaasi kɔliŋ pu, akɔl saalaa ŋin pu ŋu bàà lítèe pu. Eeseekiyaasi mēē ŋwimmeem u nín ká dicáaǹdee

english_verse: This is what Hezekiah wrote after he got well:
translation_verse: Inyɔŋki laŋŋu ŋun Juuda bɔtiu Eeseekiyaasi gāā u nín nìn búŋkì ki dāa ká dicáaǹdee sèé:

english_verse: I thought I would die during my best years and stay as a prisoner forever in the world of the dead.
translation_verse: M nìn lī m-ban yii m-maŋfal wiiŋyi dijandi ní m dūu kāl̀ kitiŋ nee pu ní ki làá kpáàa fàtīí nīn gítí nee. Ditaŋkpiilin ní m làá púntí m-maŋfal wiiŋyi in kíǹee.

english_verse: My life was taken from me like the tent that a shepherd pulls up and moves. You cut me off like thread from a weaver's loom; you make a wreck of me day and night.
translation_verse: Bi dáaĺ ki fōō m-maŋfal, ki cáá-dì ki búntì ndandati ki wāatì-mi, kii bi nín cóotí upikpaal tantiu puee. Kii usatalul nín kpáb̀ sata un u lùn̄ee puee, míǹ ní bi kpáb́ ma mun maŋfal ki dóò. Bi gíí ki tīl̀ iŋmii. Kí yòon̄ ŋwiimpu kí cáá sāā kunyeeuee, mimmee a dóò m-bɔti dee!

english_verse: Until morning came, I thought you would crush my bones just like a hungry lion; both night and day you make a wreck of me.
translation_verse: Áli kutaa ń dāá wúntée, maa ti bí tiban. U wīil̀ m-kpabiŋ kɔkɔ, a lì kii gbikintee. Kí yòon̄ ŋwiimpu kí cáá sāā kunyeeuee, mimmee a dóò m-bɔti dee!

english_verse: I cry like a swallow; I mourn like a dove. My eyes are red from looking to you, Lord. I am in terrible trouble. Please come and help me.
translation_verse: M súń kii kikoosiyaakpaai àá udiyaalee, ki súń ki yáliŋkì kii dibeenanjilee. M-nimbiliŋ kpēē a-watil pú yilpu ki tin gīī. Ti-Dindaan, an bàn̄-mi, dāá jòoń-mi.

english_verse: Your words and your deeds bring life to everyone, including me. Please make me healthy and strong again.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, a béè tin bāań-mee, ní ki fātìi tīī-mi dimaŋfal. A fātìi tīī-mi mpɔn, ki yāntì ḿ bí dimaŋfalin.

english_verse: It was for my own good that I had such hard times. But your love protected me from doom in the deep pit, and you turned your eyes away from my sins.
translation_verse: Kpèè, m-nimbaaku kpántì dipɔɔpindi. Tiŋman, a-neendi puee, a nyántì-mi ŋkúm ŋaan, ki dū m-kpitii kɔkɔ ki ŋá a-kpaŋkpamboon.

english_verse: No one in the world of the dead can thank you or praise you; none of those in the deep pit can hope for you to show them how faithful you are.
translation_verse: Ubɔ kaa nyɔ́ŋkí-si ditaŋkpiilin, bitaŋkpiibi kaa ti ŋūǹ kí jāam̀-si. Binib bin gíti dáá sīntì dikaakulinee kaa ti máká a-ŋanti pu.

english_verse: Only the living can thank you, as I am doing today. Each generation tells the next about your faithfulness.
translation_verse: See unifoo baba di ŋūǹ kí nyɔ̄ŋkì-si, a lì kii man nín bíi nyɔ́ŋkí-si pu díǹ nee. Bibaatiibi di làá yàntī bi-biyaamu ń béé a-ŋanti.

english_verse: I had told King Hezekiah's servants to put some mashed figs on the king's open sore, and he would get well.
translation_verse: Ní Yeesaya bí yii: «Nàmaan fiigi subiliŋ kí cáań kí nákań ubɔti naliŋ pu, u làá pɔ̄ɔkì!»

english_verse: Then Hezekiah asked for proof that he would again worship in the Lord's temple.
translation_verse: Ní Eeseekiyaasi bí yii: «Ba daaŋku ní m làá dūú béé yii m làá gíti ŋmā kí cù ti-Dindaan diikun?»

english_verse: Hezekiah welcomed the messengers and showed them all the silver, the gold, the spices, and the fine oils that were in his storehouse. He even showed them where he kept his weapons. Nothing in his palace or in his entire kingdom was kept hidden from them.
translation_verse: Bin bi túee nín bàn̄ee, ní an mɔ́ɔkiǹ Eeseekiyaasi ní u yōoǹ-bi ki kɔ́ǹ kudii kun poon ní u nìn kpáafí u-gaajawanti nì animbil nì sindaariya nì talaalub nì ikpafi in sɔ́fèe ki dàkā-bi. U nìn dàkā-bi laakin u nìn kpáafí u-janjawanti mun nì tijanjawan kɔkɔ. Tiba kaa nìn kíǹ Eeseekiyaasi cindin nì u-beelin waa dūu dàkā-bi.

english_verse: Merodach Baladan, the son of Baladan, was now king of Babylonia. And when he learned that Hezekiah was well, he sent messengers with letters and a gift for him.
translation_verse: Ŋyunti gbantee, Babiloon bɔtiu Baladan jipɔɔn Meeroodaki-Baladan nìn gbìl̄ yii Eeseekiyaasi nìn búŋkì ní ki fātìi pɔ́ɔkì. Di sá ní u ŋmàn̄ kugbɔŋu ki nyàab̄ tiwampɔkaal ki tú bí cáá cùnnì kí tīī-u.

english_verse: I asked Hezekiah, “Where did these men come from? What did they want?” “They came all the way from Babylonia,” Hezekiah answered.
translation_verse: Míǹ boonee ní Unimbɔti bɔnaatiliu Yeesaya dɔ́miń ki ká ubɔti Eeseekiyaasi ní ki bālifì-u yii: «Binibee tùkū-si yii ba ní? Ní la ní bi nyánní?» Ní Eeseekiyaasi kíí yii: «Bi nyánní ndan ní. Doooo Babiloon tiŋkin ní bi nyánní.»

english_verse: “What did you show them?” I asked. Hezekiah answered, “I showed them everything in my kingdom.”
translation_verse: Ní Yeesaya gíti nìkī ki bālifì-u yii: «Ba ní bi ká a-beecindin?» Ní Eeseekiyaasi kíí yii: «Bi pée ká tin kɔkɔ pée bí m-beecindinee ní. Tiba kaa kíǹ m-nimbikpaafidiikun maa dūu dàkā-bi.»

english_verse: Then I told Hezekiah: I have a message for you from the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Niinee ní Yeesaya bí Eeseekiyaasi yii: «Pīlifì tibɔti tin ti-Dindaan Mpɔŋkɔdaan sòon̄ee:

english_verse: One day everything you and your ancestors have stored up will be taken to Babylonia. The Lord has promised that nothing will be left.
translation_verse: <Ŋwiin ŋubɔ bí ki dòoń, tin kɔkɔ bí a-dumpu nee nì tin kɔkɔ a-baabi kpáafì ki síiǹee, bi làá dāá kóoǹ kɔkɔ kí cùnnì Babiloon tiŋkin. Tiba kaa làá dāá kíń doo, ti-Dindaan di sòon̄ míǹ.

english_verse: Some of your own sons will be taken to Babylonia, where they will be disgraced and made to serve in the king's palace.
translation_verse: Bi làá dāá cúú a-jipɔmbi tikpil bin sisi a-ba màl̄ee, kí cùnnì Babiloon bɔtiu cee kí dū-bi kí ŋá bifaabi bí nīn tūǹ atuun ki tìì-u.>»

english_verse: Hezekiah thought, “At least our nation will be at peace for a while.” So he told me, “The message you brought from the Lord is good.”
translation_verse: Ní Eeseekiyaasi kíí Yeesaya yii: «Tibɔmɔntiil ní ti-Dindaan tùkū-si a cáań ki nāatì-mi nee.» Di sá yii u nìn lī u-neen yii: «Ti làá nīn bí ŋgbansɔŋfi nì dibatɔlin m-maŋfal wiiŋyi kɔkɔ poon.»

english_verse: Our God has said: “Encourage my people! Give them comfort.
translation_verse: Sɔ̀ŋkìmaan m-nibul pɔbil, sɔ̀ŋkìmaan bi-pɔbil, ni-Nimbɔtiu di lī míǹ.

english_verse: Speak kindly to Jerusalem and announce: Your slavery is past; your punishment is over. I, the Lord, made you pay double for your sins.”
translation_verse: Sòom̀maan kí sɔ̀ŋkì Jeerusaleem pɔbil, ní bāakì kí tùkù-kì yii ki-tumpɔɔŋi dóò, kì pàn̄ ki-kpitii kɔkɔ pu, ti-Dindaan yāntì kì pàn̄ ki-yìntitam kɔkɔ pɔndi mili pu.

english_verse: Someone is shouting: “Clear a path in the desert! Make a straight road for the Lord our God.
translation_verse: Nneel ŋubɔ bíi báakí ki lì yii: «Ní bɔ́ntímaan nsan kuteeun kí tīī ti-Dindaan, ní tàntīmaan nsanjaa kitiŋkuliŋŋin kí tīī ti-Nimbɔtiu.

english_verse: Fill in the valleys; flatten every hill and mountain. Level the rough and rugged ground.
translation_verse: Ní gbīŋkìmaan atantaka kɔkɔ, kí bìtī ajoon nì ŋgbantamu kɔkɔ! Ní tàntīmaan ipaan in bí kpábiti kpabitee, kí yàntī ŋgbantamu ń kpántí atantaka.

english_verse: Then the glory of the Lord will appear for all to see. The Lord has promised this!”
translation_verse: Niinee ti-Dindaan nyooti làá nyā mpaampiin pu, ní inifunaan kɔkɔ ń dāá wāl̀-tì. Ti-Dindaan di sòon̄ míǹ.»

english_verse: Someone told me to shout, and I asked, “What should I shout?” We humans are merely grass, and we last no longer than wild flowers.
translation_verse: Nneel ŋubɔ bí yii: «Bāakìm̄!» Ní m bālifì yii: «Ḿ bāakì yii ba?» Ní ŋu kíí-mi yii: «Bāakì yii binib kɔkɔ sá kii kumoouee ní, ní bi-nyaaŋku sá kii tisatin pumpukumee.

english_verse: At the Lord's command, flowers and grass disappear, and so do we.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan yaa púfì kumoou nì nsupumpukumee puee, kumoou kōō ní nsupumpukum ń yɔ́ĺ. - Tiŋman, binib kaa pée pɔ̄ɔ̄ kii kumoouee ní.

english_verse: Flowers and grass fade away, but what our God has said will never change. Your God Is Here!
translation_verse: Kumoou kōō ní nsupumpukum ń yɔ́ĺ, ama ti-Nimbɔtiu úǹ bɔti pée bí ní kí cá jaanjaan!» Tibɔmɔntiil tin sá bí dūú bāakèe

english_verse: There is good news for the city of Zion. Shout it as loud as you can from the highest mountain. Don't be afraid to shout to the towns of Judah: “Your God is here!”
translation_verse: Sii Siiyɔn un ŋúbiń tibɔmɔntiil kí nàatēe, jɔ̄m̀ dijool din fɔ̀kɔ̀ee yilpu kí téeń mpɔn. Sii Jeerusaleem un ŋúbiń tibɔmɔntiil kí nàatēe, téeń mpɔn mpɔn, á taa fàŋkì báà tiba. Tùkù Juuda timmu yii: «Kpèèmaan ni-Nimbɔtiu!

english_verse: Look! The powerful Lord God is coming to rule with his mighty arm. He brings with him what he has taken in war, and he rewards his people.
translation_verse: Kpèèmaan ti-Dindaan Unimbɔti! U dòoń nì mpɔn. U cáá mpɔn kí jī dibeel. Kpèèmaan, u cāabìń u-paati, u ŋúbiń u-gìńdi paatii.

english_verse: The Lord cares for his nation, just as shepherds care for their flocks. He carries the lambs in his arms, while gently leading the mother sheep. Who Compares with God?
translation_verse: U sá kii upikpaal un kpàá u-picaŋkpuŋkuee ní, u cáá u-ŋal ki kōontí u-pibiliŋ ki kpáfí. U yòontí u-pibiyaamu ki bìb̀, ní ki kpòotī ipinaati in cáá mbiyaamu ŋáaḿee ki cáǹ nsɔŋfin.» Duulinya Dindaan di sá ukpaan ki sá uciŋfiti

english_verse: Did any of you measure the ocean by yourself or stretch out the sky with your own hands? Did you put the soil of the earth in a bucket or weigh the hills and mountains on balance scales?
translation_verse: Ŋma di ŋmāntì tiŋku nyim u-ŋantilin? Ŋma di yātì u-ŋambiyaamu ki dūu ŋmāntì kutagbɔŋu? Ŋma di dū gbakiti ki ŋmāntì kitiŋ kɔkɔ tam? Ŋma di ŋmāntì ajoon saniyaluntikaa pu, àá ŋgbantamu saniyapaaŋkaa pu?

english_verse: Has anyone told the Lord what he must do or given him advice?
translation_verse: Ŋma di ŋmāntì ti-Dindaan Fam ki ká? Ulanil di sáŋkì-u dalba u ŋá tiba ki ká?

english_verse: Did the Lord ask anyone to teach him wisdom and justice? Who gave him knowledge and understanding?
translation_verse: Ŋma ní Unimbɔti pée bālifì isaŋki kí ŋmā kí sòoǹ tibɔti tiŋan, àá udaan dàkā-u dinyil àá iciin?

english_verse: To the Lord, all nations are merely a drop in a bucket or dust on balance scales; all of the islands are but a handful of sand.
translation_verse: Kpèè, atimbun sá kii nnyim nín nyēeń gbakiti nyɔɔgbandi kí jōō kitiŋ puee ní, a lì kii dibul kibilii di pá saniya puee. Kpèè, ntimu mun nnyim māntìi túee nyiŋfiŋu bí kii ŋkpɔŋkpɔmee ní.

english_verse: The cattle on the mountains of Lebanon would not be enough to offer as a sacrifice to God, and the trees would not be enough for the fire.
translation_verse: Leebanɔn tiŋki dɔi kɔkɔ kaa bà bí kpāā ŋŋmi nsaraafan pu, ní ki-waŋkuti kɔkɔ kaa bà bí ŋá ti-Dindaan saraawɔkaa.

english_verse: Who compares with God? Is anything like him?
translation_verse: Ŋma ní ni cáá Unimbɔti ki ŋmàntīǹ ní? Kunaŋu kulɔkɔ ní ni làá dū-u kí nántíǹ?

english_verse: Is an idol at all like God? It is made of bronze with a thin layer of gold, and decorated with silver.
translation_verse: Diwaalaaa? Ukúduntil di dūntì tikúti ki dūu mɔ́ɔ́-dì, ní goosimiiti dū sindaariya ki nyūntì-dì ní ki mɔ́ɔ́ animbil kúti léeŋkaati ki léeǹ-dì.

english_verse: Or special wood may be chosen because it doesn't rot— then skilled hands take care to make an idol that won't fall on its face. God Rules the Whole Earth
translation_verse: Un di yaa kaa cáá ŋŋmam kí ŋá an saraauee, nyàab̀ ndɔ ŋun kaa bùkùee ní kí tīī ukpiŋkpiiti un ŋūǹ u-tundi tiŋanee, ni úǹ ń dūú kpítí diwaal kí síiń-u.

english_verse: Don't you know? Haven't you heard? Hasn't it been clear since the time of creation?
translation_verse: Mimmee naa nyáaa? Baa sòon̄ ni gbìl̄aaa? Baa nìn báakì ki tùkū-ni doooo ŋkilkaaminaaa? Mimmee naa nyàab̄ ki béè kitiŋ náanliuaaa?

english_verse: God is the one who rules the whole earth, and we that live here are merely insects. He spread out the heavens like a curtain or an open tent.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan kóò kutagbɔŋu kun dàn̄ kitiŋ yilpuee, ní binib bin kóò kitiŋ puee bí u-cee kii icatee. U kpátì kutagbɔŋu kii ŋŋaalikiŋkaayee, ní ki dū-ku ki cóoǹ kii tantee ki kóò.

english_verse: God brings down rulers and turns them into nothing.
translation_verse: U nāaǹ duulinya yidambi, ní ki yāntì kitiŋ pu bɔsoonliibi kaa ti pée bí tiban.

english_verse: They are like flowers freshly sprung up and starting to grow. But when God blows on them, they wilt and are carried off like straw in a storm.
translation_verse: Bi tin lì yii bi lèekī-bi, kí kàan̄-bi, bí kàl̄ kí báań inyaanee ní ti-Dindaan fooku ń ŋàtī-bi kí fá ní bí kpā, ní kunaakpaabuŋŋu ń yòon̄-bi kii tifeelee.

english_verse: The holy God asks, “Who compares with me? Is anyone my equal?”
translation_verse: Unimbɔti Circirdaan di bālifì yii: «Ŋma ní ni ŋūǹ kí dū-mi kí ŋmàntīǹ ní? Ŋma di ŋūǹ kí nīn sá man juti ní?»

english_verse: Look at the evening sky! Who created the stars? Who gave them each a name? Who leads them like an army? The Lord is so powerful that none of the stars are ever missing. The Lord Gives Strength
translation_verse: Wáam̀maan kí kpèè kutaa. Ŋma di náań iŋmalbijaa ní? Ŋma di yàntī i-kɔkɔ nyēē ki kpáfí kii dijanjakitilee ní? Úǹ di yíì uŋmalbija kamaa nì u-yindi. U cáá dibaatandi nì mpɔŋkpaan, an puee u yaa yíiń-iee, i-kansikin báà ubɔ kaa fɔ́tí. Bin wunti bíi wɔ̀b̀ee làá fàtīí ká mpɔn

english_verse: You people of Israel say, “God pays no attention to us! He doesn't care if we are treated unjustly.” But how can you say that?
translation_verse: Isirayeel, Jaakɔb nibul, ba pu ní a sòoǹ yii: «M-Dindaan kaa wāĺ tin bāań-mee, m-Nimbɔtiu kaa pée wāĺ man baamɔŋyi.»

english_verse: Don't you know? Haven't you heard? The Lord is the eternal God, Creator of the earth. He never gets weary or tired; his wisdom cannot be measured.
translation_verse: Mimmee saa nyáaa? Baa sòon̄ a gbìl̄aaa? Ti-Dindaan di sá Unimbɔti kí nīn cá jaanjaan. Úǹ di náań kitiŋ kí yòon̄ ki-gbeennyɔkɔ kiba kí cáá tin sāā kin kíǹee. Waa wɔ̀b̀ dalba dalba, kaa tí gì mun. U-nyil kaa cáá kigbeennyɔkɔ.

english_verse: The Lord gives strength to those who are weary.
translation_verse: U tìì un kaa ti cáá mpɔnee mpɔn, ki tìì un gīīyee kunyannyaau.

english_verse: Even young people get tired, then stumble and fall.
translation_verse: Binipɔmbi gba gì kí wɔ̀b̄, bibaatandambi mun gbéetí ki lítí.

english_verse: But those who trust the Lord will find new strength. They will be strong like eagles soaring upward on wings; they will walk and run without getting tired.
translation_verse: Ama bin máká ti-Dindaan puee fàtīi pɔ̀ntī bi-pɔŋŋu ní. Bi yíkí ki ŋàaǹ kii ikaabuee ní. Bi sáń ama ní kaa gì, bi còom̄ ama ní bi-wunti kaa yɔ̀tī.

english_verse: Be silent and listen, every island in the sea. Have courage and come near, every one of you nations. Let's settle this matter!
translation_verse: Ntimu mun nnyim māntìi túee, ŋmīĺmaan kí pīlifiǹ-mi. Anibul kɔkɔ nib, fàtīí kámaan kunyannyaau. Ní sútiḿmaan kí dāá sòoǹ. Ti-kɔkɔ ń cùú kpāfì ibɔsoon laŋki.

english_verse: Who appointed this ruler from the east? Who puts nations and kings in his power? His sword and his arrows turn them to dust blown by the wind.
translation_verse: Ŋwìiń nyalaŋki púee, ubɔ dòoń. Laakin kamaa u yaa jítèe, u jáà ki jīǹ ŋma ní. Ŋma di yāntì u kíĺ nsan ní? Ŋma di dū anibul ki ŋá u-ŋaan ní? Ŋma di dū bibɔtiibi ki ŋá u-taaŋi taapu ní? U-tàataajiki càkà-bi músi musi ní u-tɔbu jì-bi kii kubuŋu nín yòontí tifeel puee.

english_verse: He goes after them so quickly that his feet barely touch the ground— he doesn't even get hurt.
translation_verse: U jì-bi ki jītí bi-kansikin báà tiba kaa ŋáań-u, ní u-taaŋi kaa kpáàa gbèetī kitiŋ gba.

english_verse: Who makes these things happen? Who controls human events? I do! I am the Lord. I was there at the beginning; I will be there at the end.
translation_verse: Ŋma di ŋá tíǹ gbanti kɔkɔ? Úǹ di bɔ́ntì tibɔti nín dòoń ki jītí puee ki síiǹ doooo ŋkilkaamin. Man di sá ni-Dindaan. M sá upeepeekaa, ki làá nīn pée sá míǹ áli duulinya kúntitam.

english_verse: Islands and foreign nations saw what I did and trembled as they came near. What Can Idols Do?
translation_verse: Ntimu mun nnyim māntìi túee yab ká-u ní ki fāŋkì. Kitiŋ gbeennyɔkɔ yab ká-u ní bi-wunti bíi jìkì. Bi sútí ki pìlìń, bi kāń nsan pu ki dòoń.

english_verse: Worshipers of idols comfort each other, saying, “Don't worry!”
translation_verse: Bi bíi tútúǹ tɔb, ní báà ŋma lì u-nabiki yii: «Ká dipɔbil!»

english_verse: Woodcarvers, goldsmiths, and other workers encourage one another and say, “We've done a great job!” Then they nail the idol down, so it won't fall over. The Lord's Chosen Servant
translation_verse: Ukpiŋkpiiti tìì goosimiiti kunyannyaau. Ucaa un cáá dinantaŋkul ki gbáà ki jɔ̀lifī tikútee tìì un gbáà ki tàntī-tèe kunyannyaau. U tùkù ukúduntil yii: «An ŋān̄.» Ní bí dū ipiin kí kpáá kí cúú diwaalee án taa nín̄ cìŋkī.

english_verse: Israel, you are my servant. I chose you, the family of my friend Abraham.
translation_verse: Ama sii Isirayeel, a sá m-tɔntɔnliu ní, Jaakɔb, a sá dinibul din ní m lēēyee ní, a sá m-bɔɔ Abraam naantiiu ní.

english_verse: From far across the earth I brought you here and said, “You are my chosen servant. I haven't forgotten you.”
translation_verse: M cūtì ki nyàabìń-si doooo kitiŋ gbeennyɔkɔ ní. M yíiń-si doooo ntindandatimun ní, ní ki lī yii: <M-tɔntɔnliu di sá-si, m lēē-si ní, maa dū-si ki fá.>

english_verse: Don't be afraid. I am with you. Don't tremble with fear. I am your God. I will make you strong, as I protect you with my arm and give you victories.
translation_verse: Taa fàŋkì, kun puee m bí a-cee. Taa nín̄ kā ki yáliŋkí, kun puee m sá a-Nimbɔtiu. M dòoń kí tīī-si mpɔn, kí tūtuǹ-si, kí dū m-ŋaŋgiil ŋun pɔ̄ɔ̄ ki tìì dijajilee kí wúń a-pu.

english_verse: Everyone who hates you will be terribly disgraced; those who attack will vanish into thin air.
translation_verse: Tiŋman, bin nyàab̀-si tikpitilee, icoo làá cúú-bi gbòooo bí fá bi-jilimau. Bin jáà nì see, án làá nàan̄-bi bí kpú kí céetí.

english_verse: You will look around for those brutal enemies, but you won't find them— they will be gone.
translation_verse: Bin tákà-si tibɔtee, a làá dāá nyàab̀-bi kaa làá ti ká-bi. Bin jáà nì see, án làá nàan̄-bi ní bí wāŋkì.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God. I am holding your hand, so don't be afraid. I am here to help you.
translation_verse: Di sá yii man a-Dindaanee, m sá a-Nimbɔtiu ní. Man di ŋúb́ a-ŋal ní ki bí-si yii: «Taa fàŋkì, m làá jòoń-si.» M dòoń kí jòoń-si

english_verse: People of Israel, don't worry, though others may say, “Israel is only a worm!” I am the holy God of Israel, who saves and protects you.
translation_verse: Jaakɔb nibul, sii un kpántì kii ujiliŋkpaamee, sii un kpántì kii utaŋkpiilee, taa fàŋkì. M dòoń kí jòoń-si. Man a-Dindaan di sòon̄ míǹ. Un di làá dā-si kí lííyee di sá Isirayeel Circir Nimbɔtiu.

english_verse: I will let you be like a log covered with sharp spikes. You will grind and crush every mountain and hill until they turn to dust.
translation_verse: Kpèè, m dū-si ki kpántì kii tɔrɔku un bi fù tijimpin pu an gbátée upɔmpɔɔn ní. A làá nà kí mátí ajoon ní dúsi dusi, kí yàntī ŋgbantamu ń kpántí kii tifeelee.

english_verse: A strong wind will scatter them in all directions. Then you will celebrate and praise me, your Lord, the holy God of Israel. The Lord Helps the Poor
translation_verse: A làá dāá càatī-bi kubuŋu ń yòon̄-bi, ní kunaakpaabuŋŋu ń yàaǹ-bi an kɔkɔ pu. Ama siiyee, a làá dāá nīn tátí ki fàal̀ ti-Dindaan pu, kí dāá nīn làntī Isirayeel Circir Nimbɔtiu pu. Kuteeu làá kpántí dinyimbɔbil

english_verse: When the poor and needy are dying of thirst and cannot find water, I, the Lord God of Israel, will come to their rescue. I won't forget them.
translation_verse: Bifalaadambi nì binandambi bí ki nyàab̀ nnyim kaa bíi kāntí, nnyinnyoo cúú-bi ní bi-neeŋyi kūń. Man ni-Dindaan làá fōō bi-wimmeem, man Isirayeel Nimbɔtiu kaa làá dū-bi kí fá.

english_verse: I will make rivers flow on mountain peaks. I will send streams to fill the valleys. Dry and barren land will flow with springs and become a lake.
translation_verse: M làá yàntī ibun ń pùub̀ ajoon ŋin yilpu kaa cáá isufee pu, kí yàntī inyimbul ń cɔ́tí atantaka poon. M làá yàntī kuteeu ń kpántí anyimbɔbil ní kí yàntī kitiŋkuliŋŋi ń kpántí inyimbul.

english_verse: I will fill the desert with all kinds of trees— cedars, acacias, and myrtles; olive and cypress trees; fir trees and pines.
translation_verse: Kuteeunee, m làá dāá cóoń seedir nì akasiya nì miirti nì ɔliifi sufii, ní kí dāá cóoń kitiŋkuliŋŋi pu siipreesi nì piini nì buwii sufii dicilpu.

english_verse: Everyone will see this and know that I, the holy Lord God of Israel, created it all. Idols Are Useless
translation_verse: Mimmee báà ŋma làá dāá ká, báà ŋma làá dāá béé, báà ŋma làá dāá dáań kí ká kí gbìl̄ taapu yii ti-Dindaan di túń atuun nee, Isirayeel Circir Nimbɔtiu di náań-tì. Awaa kaa bí tiban

english_verse: I am the Lord, the King of Israel! Come argue your case with me. Present your evidence.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan bí yii: «Ní cáaḿmaan ni-bɔti kí bíĺ bí sòoǹ kí tīī-ni», Jaakɔb nibul bɔtiu bí yii: «Ní dāá lìmaan tin ní ni cááyee kí mɔ̄tì ni-ba pu.

english_verse: Come near me, you idols. Tell us about the past, and we will think about it. Tell us about the future, so we will know what is going to happen.
translation_verse: Sútiḿmaan kí dāá tùkù-ti tin bí ki dòońee. Tibɔti tilati di dɔ́miń ki jítì ní? Ní dàkà-ti-tì ní timbi ń dàkafì ti-pu, àá ní tùkù-ti tin di bí ki dòoń foolboonee, ní tí béé tin bí ki dòońee.

english_verse: Prove that you are gods by making your predictions come true. Do something good or evil, so we can be amazed and terrified.
translation_verse: Ní tùkùmaan-ti tin làá fu dāan̄ foolboonee ní tí béé yii ni lafun sá inimbɔti. Ní ŋámaan tiŋan àá tikpitil tiba tí ká án ŋá-ti bitii ní kufaaŋŋu ń kɔ́-ti.

english_verse: You idols are nothing, and you are powerless. To worship you would be disgusting.
translation_verse: Ama nimbi ni-ba kaa bí tiban, tin ni ŋáańee mun kaa pée sá tiba. An sá ntimbiil ní unil ń lēē kí nīn nóó-ni.

english_verse: I, the Lord, appointed a ruler in the north; now he comes from the east to honor my name. He tramples kings like mud, as potters trample clay.
translation_verse: M lūkutìń unil ubɔ u yíkìń ŋgan pú ki dòoń. Doooo ŋwìiń nyalaŋki pú ní m yíiń-u. U bí ki tàń biyidambi pu kii bi nín tà tikpati puee, a lì kii uyɔɔmaati nín tà kuyɔkɔu puee.

english_verse: Did any of you idols predict what would happen? Did any of you get it right? None of you told about this or even spoke a word.
translation_verse: Ŋma nìn sòon̄ tin bí nee doooo ŋkilkaamin tí bàà nín̄ nyí-tì ki yóoǹ? Ŋma nìn sòon̄-tì doooo cannaaku tí bàà lì yii: <A sá míǹ ní?> Báà ubɔ kaa nìn sòon̄ ti-pu, báà ubɔ kaa nìn wāaǹ kinyɔkɔ, báà ubɔ kaa nìn gbìl̄ ni sòon̄ ti-pu.

english_verse: I was the first to tell the people of Jerusalem, “Look, it's happening!” I was the one who announced this good news to Zion.
translation_verse: Man di péé péé ki tùkū Siiyɔn yii: <Kpèè, bi sèé!> M tú ntuun ŋu cūnnì tibɔmɔntiil Jeerusaleem tiŋkin.

english_verse: None of these idols are able to give advice or answer questions.
translation_verse: «M kpēē ki māntìi tú kaa ká báà uniseen. Anibul ŋin kíǹee nimbɔtii kansikinee, usaŋkil kpá! M bàà làá bàlifì-i ní í bàà tùkù-mi.

english_verse: They are nothing, and they can do nothing— they are merely a passing breeze.
translation_verse: Ama binibee kaa bí tiban. Tin bi ŋáańee kɔkɔ sá fám ní. Bi-waaŋi kɔkɔ sá kubuŋu ní ki sá fám!»

english_verse: Here is my servant! I have made him strong. He is my chosen one; I am pleased with him. I have given him my Spirit, and he will bring justice to the nations.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan bí yii: «Kpèè, m-tɔntɔnliu, m ŋúb́ u-ŋal, m lēē-u ní m-pɔbil sɔ̀m̀ u-pu. M dū m-Fam ki ŋá u-pu ú dāá sòoǹ deedee bɔti kí tùkù atimbun kɔkɔ.

english_verse: He won't shout or yell or call out in the streets.
translation_verse: Waa làá dāá nīn tátí kaa làá dāá sòoǹ mpɔn, baa làá dāá gbìl̄ u-nyɔkɔ pu adan pu.

english_verse: He won't break off a bent reed or put out a dying flame, but he will make sure that justice is done.
translation_verse: Waa làá dāá púntí mmɔ́ɔn ŋun gíì ki gbàkēe, waa làá dāá gbíntí fitila un bíi fòol̄ bílbilee. Ama u làá dāá lēē tibɔti nín dɔ̄ nsan puee kí dàkà.

english_verse: He won't quit or give up until he brings justice everywhere on earth, and people in foreign nations long for his teaching.
translation_verse: Waa làá dāá wɔ̀b̄, u-wunti mun kaa làá dāá yɔ̀tī kí cáá sāā ŋyunti ŋun ní u làá dāá yóoń kitiŋ pu tibɔti nín dɔ̄ nsan puee. Ntimu mun nnyim māntìi túee dāa kā ki cí kí fōō u-marab.» Ŋwalifi làá ŋmíntí atimbun pu

english_verse: I am the Lord God. I created the heavens like an open tent above. I made the earth and everything that grows on it. I am the source of life for all who live on this earth, so listen to what I say.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan Unimbɔti di náań kutagbɔŋu ní ki kpátì-ku ki dāntì. Úǹ di kpátì kitiŋ nì tin kɔkɔ nyēē ki-puee. Úǹ di tīī binib bin kóò ki-puee dimaŋfal, ki tīī bin bí ki-puee kufoou. U nín tùkū u-tɔntɔnliu puee sèé:

english_verse: I chose you to bring justice, and I am here at your side. I selected you and sent you to bring light and my promise of hope to the nations.
translation_verse: «An sá man ni-Dindaan di yíiń-si deedee yíintam. M ŋúb́ a-ŋal, man di máń-si. M làá dī a-pu ní kí ŋá mpèé nì dinibul, sii di sá atimbun walifiŋu.

english_verse: You will give sight to the blind; you will set prisoners free from dark dungeons.
translation_verse: A làá ŋúbití bijɔfub nimbiliŋ, kí nyāntí bisarkadambi bi-sarkadiiŋŋin, kí yàntī bin pīī dibɔmbɔndinee ń nyā.»

english_verse: My name is the Lord! I won't let idols or humans share my glory and praise.
translation_verse: Man di sá ni-Dindaan, m-yindi dee. Maa làá dū m-nyooti kí tīī ubɔ fám, kaa làá dū m-jilmau kí tīī awaa.

english_verse: Everything has happened just as I said it would; now I will announce what will happen next. Sing Praises to the Lord
translation_verse: Tibɔpeekaal tíǹ jítì ki dóò dee. M bíi báakí ki tùkù-ni tipɔn ní nee. M bíi tùkù-ni tibɔpɔn gbanti ní gbìl̄ kí wàatī ní tí nín bàń. Ti-Dindaan làá tɔ̄ u-tundi

english_verse: Tell the whole world to sing a new song to the Lord! Tell those who sail the ocean and those who live far away to join in the praise.
translation_verse: Ní gāāmaan nlampɔɔn kí nyɔ̄ŋkì ti-Dindaan. Ní gāā ilan kí nyɔ̄ŋkì-u doooo kitiŋ kúntilaŋki, nimbi bin bí ki còom̄ tiŋku puee nì tin kɔkɔ di pée bí u-poonee, nì nimbi bin kóò ntimu mun nnyim māntìi túee.

english_verse: The Lord is marching out like an angry soldier, shouting with all his might while attacking his enemies. The Lord Will Help His People
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan làá nyā kii ubaatandaanee án lùkutī-u ú já kujaau kii ujanjalee. U fáá njanjakuŋkuunti mpɔn ki bɔ́ntì kí já nì u-nannanliibi. Tin ní ti-Dindaan bɔ́ntì ki làá ŋée

english_verse: For a long time, I, the Lord, have held my temper; now I will cry out and groan like a woman giving birth.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan bí yii: «An yúntì tikpil m kā ki ŋmí, m cúú m-ba kaa lī tiba. M bíi dùǹ kii unimpu di yáliŋkí imatiŋweenee, m-fam bíi tìfī, m fòotī kaa bà.

english_verse: I will destroy the mountains and what grows on them; I will dry up rivers and ponds.
translation_verse: «M làá kpēelikì ajoon nì ŋgbantamu, kí yàntī kumɔsɔŋu kɔkɔ ń kpā. M làá yàntī ibun ń kpántí kitiŋkuliŋŋi ní kí yàntī anyimbɔbil ń fóotí.

english_verse: I will lead the blind on roads they have never known; I will guide them on paths they have never traveled. Their road is dark and rough, but I will give light to keep them from stumbling. This is my solemn promise.
translation_verse: M làá kpòotī bijɔfub kí tàkan̄ didandi din baa nyée pu. M làá kpòotī-bi bí còom̀ nsan ŋun pu baa nìn nyée pu. M làá yàntī bi-nimbiinee dibɔmbɔndi ń kpántí ŋwalifi, ní laakin kamaa aganlaka bée ń cúú tàntī. Tin bí nee kɔkɔee, see m ŋá-tì, an kaa cáá yii m làá yíí kí taa ŋá.

english_verse: You people are deaf and blind, but the Lord commands you to listen and to see.
translation_verse: Nimbi bin sá bitafakpaafubee, ní pīlifìmaan tiŋan! Nimbi bin di sá bijɔfubee, ní ŋúbitímaan kí kpèè!

english_verse: The Lord always does right, and so he wanted his Law to be greatly praised.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan nín sá deedeedaanee puee, an mɔ́ɔkiǹ-u ú dàkà yii u-marau sá ukpaan ki ŋān̄.

english_verse: But his people were trapped and imprisoned in holes with no one to rescue them. All they owned had been taken, and no one was willing to give it back.
translation_verse: Ama ni sá dinibul din ní bi fúkúl̀ ki nāaǹee ní. Bi cúú ni-wanti kɔkɔ ki fōō. Bi dū ni-kɔkɔ ki tɔ́ mbòó poon sarka, ki dū-ni ki bál̀ asarkadiinni. Bi fúkúl̀-ni pílpil ní ubɔ kaa bí kí jòoń-ni. Bi cúú-ni ki cūnnì kuyuŋu, ní báà ubɔ kaa lī yii: <Gíiǹnímaan-bi!>

english_verse: Why won't his people ever learn to listen?
translation_verse: «Ni-kansikin ŋma làá pīlifì tibɔti nee tiŋan? Ŋma di làá gíiǹ nlandɔkɔ kí pīlifì-tì kɔŋkɔnnee?

english_verse: Israel sinned and refused to obey the Lord or follow his instructions. So the Lord let us be robbed of everything we owned.
translation_verse: «Ŋma di dū Isirayeel yab ki tīī bi nāaǹ? Ŋma di dū Jaakɔb yab ki tīī bi fúkúl̀? An kaa sá ti-Dindaanaaa? Di sá yii ti yīntiǹ-u, ki yíì kaa nóó u-saŋŋu ní kaa ŋúb́ u-marab.

english_verse: He was furious with us and punished our nation with the fires of war. Still we paid no attention. We didn't even care when we were surrounded and scorched by flames.
translation_verse: An pu ní ti-Dindaan kpáatì u-ŋuukpaandi nì kujaau bilisii ki sītì Isirayeel yab pu. Ku-poonee, bi sēē Isirayeel tiŋki ki māntìi tú, ama ní ki-nib kaa pée gbìl̄ taapu. Ŋŋmi fōō ki wùn̄ dinibul, ama ní baa kpáàa fōotìi yīkiǹ!»

english_verse: Descendants of Jacob, I, the Lord, created you and formed your nation. Israel, don't be afraid. I have rescued you. I have called you by name; now you belong to me.
translation_verse: Ama kɔŋkɔnnee, Jaakɔb ti-Dindaan un di náań-see, úǹ un di máń-see, Isirayeel nín sòon̄ puee sèé: «Taa fàŋkì, di sá yii m dá-si ki líì, ki yíiń-si nì a-yindi, man di yì-si.

english_verse: When you cross deep rivers, I will be with you, and you won't drown. When you walk through fire, you won't be burned or scorched by the flames.
translation_verse: A yaa bíi dùtī nnyim, m làá nīn bí a-cee, a yaa tí bíi dùtī ibun, i kpá ki làá yòon̄-si. A yaa bíi còom̄ ŋŋmi poon, ŋuaa làá wà-si, ní aŋmilimbil kaa làá gbēē-si.

english_verse: I am the Lord, your God, the Holy One of Israel, the God who saves you. I gave up Egypt, Ethiopia, and the region of Seba in exchange for you.
translation_verse: Di sá yii man a-Dindaan di sá a-Nimbɔtiu, man Isirayeel Circir Nimbɔtiu di sá a-Fiiliu. «M dū Eejipiti tiŋki ní ki tīī ki fātìi dá-si ki líì, ní ki dū Kuusi nì Seeba timmu ki kpántì-si ki fōō-si ki líì.

english_verse: To me, you are very dear, and I love you. That's why I gave up nations and people to rescue you.
translation_verse: Di sá yii a pɔ̄ɔ̄ kudaau m-nimbiin, ní maa mɔ̄ a-pu ki néeń-si. An puee m dū binib ki téeǹ a-yil, ní ki dū anibul ki pàn̄ a-maŋfal pɔndi.

english_verse: Don't be afraid! I am with you. From both east and west I will bring you together.
translation_verse: «Taa fàŋkì, kun puee m bí a-cee. M làá yòon̄ní a-naantiibi doooo ŋwìiń nyalaŋki pú kí gíiǹní, kí yòon̄ní-bi doooo ŋwìiń jeetilaŋki pú kí kpāfì.

english_verse: I will say to the north and to the south, “Free my sons and daughters! Let them return from distant lands.
translation_verse: M làá lì ŋgan pú yab yii: <Gíim̀maan-bi kí tīī-mi>, ní kí lì ŋgiil pú yab yii: <Taa cúúmaan-bi kí kàan̄!> Gíiǹnímaan m-jipɔmbi bin bíń ntindandatimunee, kí gíiǹní m-bisalib bin bíń kitiŋ kúntilaŋkee.

english_verse: They are my people— I created each of them to bring honor to me.” The Lord Alone Is God The Lord said:
translation_verse: Gíiǹnímaan binib bin fōō m-yindee, binib bin m náań, ki máń, ki nyántì bí nīn tìì-mi tinyoolee.» Nimbi di sá m-seeradambi

english_verse: Bring my people together. They have eyes and ears, but they can't see or hear.
translation_verse: Ní nyāntí dinibul nee doo! Dì cáá animbil ama ní kaa wāĺ, ki cáá atafal, ama ní kaa gbìl̀.

english_verse: Tell everyone of every nation to gather around. None of them can honestly say, “We told you so!” If someone heard them say this, then tell us about it now.
translation_verse: Atimbun kɔkɔ ń kóoǹ kí kpāfì dicilpu, anibul kɔkɔ ń kóoǹ kí kpāfì. Bi-kansikin ŋma di ŋūǹ kí tùkù-ti tin bíi jītí nee? Ŋma di ŋūǹ kí yàntī tí gbìl̄ tin jítèe? Bí cáań bi-seeradambi kí dàkà yii bi cáá mbaamɔn! Ní bi-seeradambi gbanti ń pīlifì bi nín sòon̄ puee kí lì yii: «An sá ibaamɔn!»

english_verse: My people, you are my witnesses and my chosen servant. I want you to know me, to trust me, and understand that I alone am God. I have always been God; there can be no others.
translation_verse: «Nimbi m-nibul di sá man seeradambi. Ni sá m-tɔntɔnliibi bin ní m lēēyee ní. M là yii ní fōō-mi kí kíí, kí béé kí gbìl̄ yii man di sá Unimbɔti. Kí wàatī ḿ nīn bée, unimbɔti ubɔ nìn kpá, ní m-boonee ubɔ mun kaa làá ti nín̄ bí. Ti-Dindaan di lī míǹ.

english_verse: I alone am the Lord; only I can rescue you.
translation_verse: M-baba nì m-baba di pée sá ni-Dindaan, man boonee, ufiil ubɔ nì ubɔ pée gíti kpá.

english_verse: I promised to save you, and I kept my promise. You are my witnesses that no other god did this. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Man di fìil̄, ki sòon̄ ki síiǹ ní ki yàntī binib béetí-tì. An sá man, kaa sá unimbɔticaan ubɔ un bi ŋūǹ kí ká ni-ceeyee. Ni sá m-seeradambi ní man sá Unimbɔti. Ti-Dindaan di lī míǹ.

english_verse: I am God now and forever. No one can snatch you from me or stand in my way. The Lord Will Prepare the Way
translation_verse: Míǹ ní m làá nīn sá kí nīn cá jaanjaan. Ubɔ kpá ki ŋūǹ kí fōō u-juti m-ŋaan. Tin ní m yaa ŋée, ubɔ kaa ŋūǹ kí kpántí-tì? M làá lēē unil ubɔ kí tɔ̄ ni-cee

english_verse: I, the Lord, will rescue you! I am Israel's holy God, and this is my promise: For your sake, I will send an army against Babylon to drag its people away, crying as they go.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan un di dá-ni ki líìyee, úǹ un sá Isirayeel Circir Nimbɔtiuee nín lī puee sɔ̀. Ni-puee, m làá tɔ̄ unil ubɔ Babiloon tiŋkin. M làá yàntī kitiŋ punyɔmmu ń cúú pìitī. Tiŋman, Babiloon yab ceeyee, mmɔn làá dāá kpántí iyaliŋki, bíǹ Kaaldee yab bin kā bi-meelabin ki bí ki tátí ki fàal̀ee.

english_verse: I am the Lord, your holy God, Israel's Creator and King.
translation_verse: Man di sá ni-Dindaan, ni-Circir Nimbɔtiu, Isirayeel Náanliu nì ni-Bɔtiu.» Nsampɔɔn làá dòon̄ kuteeun

english_verse: I am the one who cut a path through the mighty ocean.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan nín lī puee sèé. Úǹ di nìn tɔ́ didandi dimɔɔlin, ki cátì nsan nnyim min nyóòyee poon.

english_verse: I sent an army to chase you with chariots and horses; now they lie dead, unable to move. They are like an oil lamp with the flame snuffed out. Forget the Past The Lord said:
translation_verse: Úǹ di nìn nyántì janjatɔrɔkub nì itaamu, ki kpáaǹ ajanjakiti nì bibaatandambi dicilpu. Bi-kɔkɔ lítì kaa ti yíkì, bi kpíì kɔkɔ múb, ki wùn̄ ki kúntì kii ŋfitilaŋmiiyee.

english_verse: Forget what happened long ago! Don't think about the past.
translation_verse: «Ní taa ti téetí tibɔkpikil pu, ní taa ti dàkafì tin jítèe pu.

english_verse: I am creating something new. There it is! Do you see it? I have put roads in deserts, streams in thirsty lands.
translation_verse: Di sá yii m làá fàtīí ŋá tiwan mpɔm, tì kíĺ ki bíi nyēē gba, naa wāĺ-tàaa? M làá tɔ̄ nsan kuteeun, kí yàntī ibun ń cɔ́tí kitiŋkuliŋŋi pu.

english_verse: Every wild animal honors me, even jackals and owls. I provide water in deserts— streams in thirsty lands for my chosen people.
translation_verse: Kumooun peelii làá dāá nyɔ̄ŋkì-mi, ki kpáaǹ sinsiŋkub nì taataabi. Di sá yii m làá dāá yàntī nnyim ń pùub̀ kuteeun, ní ibun ń cɔ́tí kitiŋkuliŋŋi pu. Tiŋman, m làá tīī dinibul din m lēēyee nnyim dí nyɔ̀.

english_verse: I made them my own nation, so they would praise me.
translation_verse: Dinibul din m máń ki tīī m-bee làá dāá gāā ilan kí nyɔ̄ŋkì-mi.» Unimbɔti nì Isirayeel nibul cáá ibɔsoon

english_verse: I, the Lord, said to Israel: You have become weary of me, but not from worshiping me.
translation_verse: Jaakɔb, an kaa sá man ní a tíminsì ki yíiń, Isirayeel, a gīī nì mi ní.

english_verse: You have not honored me by sacrificing sheep or other animals. And I have not burdened you with demands for sacrifices or sweet-smelling incense.
translation_verse: Saa cáań apibil ki ŋá bisaraawɔkaabi ki tīī-mi, kaa tí kūū tiwaŋkuti ki ŋá saraabi ki tīī-mi tinyool. Man kaa dū-si ki kpántì uyumbu á nīn ŋáań tijin saraabi ki tìì-mi, kaa tí páb́-si yii á nīn sèetī talaalutuukaabi ki tìì-mi.

english_verse: You have not brought delicious spices for me or given me the best part of your sacrificed animals. Instead, you burden me down with your terrible sins.
translation_verse: An kaa sá man pu ní a dū a-nimbiliŋ ki dáal̀ talaalutuukaabi bin sɔ́fèe, kaa tí dū tiwaŋkuti saraabi kpam ki tīī-mi m ŋmɔ́ ki díkí. Ama a dū-mi ki kpántì uyumbu a-kpitii pu ní, a-yìntitam yāntì m gīī.

english_verse: But I wipe away your sins because of who I am. And so, I will forget the wrongs you have done.
translation_verse: Ama an sá mama m-ba di dū a-kpitii ki pú-si, maa làá ti téetí a-yìntitam pu.

english_verse: Meet me in court! State your case and prove that you are right.
translation_verse: Téetí-mi tin a cáá kí kɔ̄kɔl̀-mee man nì si tí cù ibɔsoon. Pée kàaǹ a-bɔti kí lēē kí dàkà yii tì ŋān̄.

english_verse: Your earliest ancestor and all your leaders rebelled against me.
translation_verse: A-naanja upeepeekaa nìn yīntiǹ-mi, ní a-bɔnaatiliibi yíkì ki bíi jáà nì mi.

english_verse: That's why I don't allow your priests to serve me; I let Israel be destroyed and your people disgraced.
translation_verse: An pu ní m kpákatì bikpilib bin m nìn kāaǹee, ki dū Jaakɔb nibul ki tīī bí kpɔ̀ kí céetí, ki dū Isirayeel yab ki tīī bi-nannanliibi ń bèel̀-bi.

english_verse: People of Israel, I have chosen you as my servant.
translation_verse: Kɔŋkɔnnee pīlifiǹ-mi, m-tɔntɔnliu, Jaakɔb nibul, Isirayeel, sii un ní m lēēyee.

english_verse: I am your Creator. You were in my care even before you were born. Israel, don't be terrified! You are my chosen servant, my very favorite.
translation_verse: Man a-Dindaan un máń-see, man un náań-si ki tākaǹ a-na poon, ní ki tútúǹ-see nín lī puee sèé: «Taa fàŋkì, m-tɔntɔnliu Jaakɔb, sii Yeesurun un ní m lēēyee.

english_verse: I will bless the thirsty land by sending streams of water; I will bless your descendants by giving them my Spirit.
translation_verse: Di sá yii m làá yàaǹ kitiŋ kin kūńee pu nnyim, kí yàntī ibun ń pùub̀ kitiŋkuliŋŋi pu. M làá dāá yàntī m-Fam ń kpákatiń a-biyaamu pu, ní kí bìin̄ a-naantiibi pu.

english_verse: They will spring up like grass or like willow trees near flowing streams.
translation_verse: Bi làá nyā kii timool nín nyēē kusaaun puee, kii isufi nín nyēē ki yú dibuŋgbándi puee.

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the first and the last, the one and only God. Israel, I have rescued you! I am your King.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, Isirayeel Bɔtiu un di dāā u-nibul ki líikée, ti-Dindaan Mpɔŋkɔdaan nín lī puee sèé: «Man di sá upeepeekaa ní ki sá uluŋkikaa, man boonee, unimbɔti ubɔ kaa ti bí.

english_verse: Can anyone compare with me? If so, let them speak up and tell me now. Let them say what has happened since I made my nation long ago, and let them tell what is going to happen.
translation_verse: Ŋma di bí kii man? Udaan ń téeń mpɔn kí sòoǹ kí cántí taapu kí tùkù-mi! Udaan ń lì tibɔti tin jítì doooo m nín náań dinibupeepeekaalee, ní kí lì tin bí ki dòoń fool boonee!

english_verse: Don't tremble with fear! Didn't I tell you long ago? Didn't you hear me? I alone am God— no one else is a mighty rock. Idols Can't Do a Thing The Lord said:
translation_verse: «Dinyoondi ń taa kɔ́-ni, ní taa pée fàŋkìmaan! Maa pée sòon̄-tì ki lēē-tì ki dàkā-ni dooooyeeee? Nimbi di sá m-seeradambaa! Unimbɔti ubɔ gíti bí ki kútì man puɔɔɔ? Aayee, ni-taŋkpal din pɔ̄ɔ̄yee, maa ti nyí diba ki kútì man pu! Binib bin mɔ́ɔ̀ awaayee kaa bí tiban

english_verse: Those people who make idols are nothing themselves, and the idols they treasure are just as worthless. Worshipers of idols are blind, stupid, and foolish.
translation_verse: Binib bin mɔ́ɔ̀ awaayee kɔkɔ kaa bí tiban. Bi-wammɔɔkaati tin bi néeń gbantee kaa kèetī tiba. Tiwan gbanti di sá bíǹ seeradambi, ama tì sá biseeradambi bin kaa wāĺ tibaaa, kaa nyí báà tibaaa, ní ki làá kɔ́ǹ-bi icooyee ní.

english_verse: Why make an idol or an image that can't do a thing?
translation_verse: Kí mā diwaal, kí mɔ́ɔ́ diwaal din kaa ŋūǹ kí kèetī tiba poonee, an sá digbaantundi ní.

english_verse: Everyone who makes idols and all who worship them are mere humans, who will end up sadly disappointed. Let them face me in court and be terrified. Idols and Firewood
translation_verse: Kpèè, icoo làá cúú bin kɔkɔ nóó diwaal gbantee. Bin máń diwaal gbantee mun pée sá binib ní. Bi-kɔkɔ ń kóoǹní kí kpāfì kí dāan̄: dinyoondi làá kɔ́-bi ní icoo ń cúú bi-kɔkɔ!

english_verse: A metalworker shapes an idol by using a hammer and heat from the fire. In his powerful hand he holds a hammer, as he pounds the metal into the proper shape. But he gets hungry and thirsty and loses his strength.
translation_verse: «Ucaa dù tikúti kí púĺ ŋŋmin, kí dū nsílin kí gbá ní kí dū u-pɔŋŋu kí mɔ́ɔ́ diwaal. Ama ŋkùm yaa cúú-uee, waa ti cáá mpɔn. U yaa kaa nyùn̄ nnyimee, digìńdi kɔ́-u dee.

english_verse: Some woodcarver measures a piece of wood, then draws an outline. The idol is carefully carved with each detail exact. At last it looks like a person and is placed in a temple.
translation_verse: «Ukpiŋkpiiti dù ŋŋmii ní kí ŋmàntī ndɔ, kí lēē u nín là diwaalee ń nīn bí puee, kí dū kicɔkɔ kí kpítí, ní kí dū kijijɔlfikaai kí jɔ̀lifì, ní kí kpítí-dì kí nántíǹ unil, ní di kíǹ ki cáá kunyaaŋŋu kii unilee. U yaa ŋá míǹ ki dóòyee ní ú yòon̄-dì kí cáá kɔ́ǹ kí yóoń kuwaadiin.

english_verse: Either cedar, cypress, oak, or any tree from the forest may be chosen. Or even a pine tree planted by the woodcarver and watered by the rain.
translation_verse: «U gāā seedir subu, ki lēē seeni subu nì teereebinti subu, isufi in bí kubambaŋŋunee kansikin ki yāntì i wíiǹ. U cóoǹ peeni subu ní utaa yāntì bu wíiǹ.

english_verse: Some of the wood is used to make a fire for heating or for cooking. One piece is made into an idol, then the woodcarver bows down and worships it.
translation_verse: Busubu gbanti ní binib làá dūú kpāā ŋŋmi. Búǹ ní binib làá dūú kpāā ŋŋmi kí wùl̀, àá kí dūú kpāā ŋŋmi kí púĺ kpɔnɔ. Busubaantiibuee ní bi tí dūú ŋá unimbɔti ki gbàantí ki jáaḿ. Bi dùú kpítí diwaal ní ki tòotī.

english_verse: Afterwards, he bows down to worship the wooden idol. “Protect me!” he says. “You are my god.”
translation_verse: Dijandi din kíǹee, ní bí dūú kpítí diwaal ki yíì-dì unimbɔti. Bi gbàantí di-nimbiin ki jáaḿ-dì, ki mèé-dì ki lì yii: <Fīī-mi, kun puee sii di sá m-nimbɔtiu!>»

english_verse: They don't have enough sense to say to themselves, “I made a fire with half of the wood and cooked my bread and meat on it. Then I made something worthless with the other half. Why worship a block of wood?”
translation_verse: Bi-kansikin ubɔ kaa kóò u-ban kí dàkafì, ubɔ kaa cáá iciin nì dinyil kí lì yii: «M dū ndɔ nee dijandi ki kpāā ŋŋmi, m púĺ kpɔnɔ ŋŋmi ŋun m kpāāyee pu, ki dū tinan ki páaǹ ki ŋɔ́fì ki ŋmɔ́. Mimmee, m làá dū digindi din kíǹee kí kpítí diwaal, ntimbiil wantaaa? Mimmee m làá gbàan̄ kí jāam̀ didɔgindaaa?»

english_verse: How can anyone be stupid enough to trust something that can be burned to ashes? No one can save themselves like that. Don't they realize that the idols they hold in their hands are not really gods? The Lord Won't Forget His People
translation_verse: Bi dū bi-ba ki tīī tin sá ŋfantamee ní. Bi-pɔbil din gáatèe yāntì bi-yiliŋ lábitì. Ŋaa ŋūǹ kí fīī-bi. Ama bi-kansikin ubɔ kaa lī yii: «Kun m ŋúb́ m-ŋaan nee kaa sá tinyimɔŋwan deeee?» A sá m-tɔntɔnliu ní, á taa súntí míǹ

english_verse: People of Israel, you are my servant, so remember all of this. Israel, I created you, and you are my servant. I won't forget you.
translation_verse: «Jaakɔb nibul, á téetí tin bí nee, Isirayeel nibul, a sá man tɔntɔnliu ní. M máń-si á nīn sá m-tɔntɔnliu ní. Isirayeel nibul, maa làá súntí a-pu.

english_verse: Turn back to me! I have rescued you and swept away your sins as though they were clouds. Sing Praises to the Lord
translation_verse: M yāntì a-yìntitam wáŋkì kii ditagbandee, ki yāntì a-kpitii wáŋkì kii ditaafaapɔ̀ńdee. Fàtīí gítiń m-cee, kun puee m dá-si ki líì ní.»

english_verse: Tell the heavens and the earth to start singing! Tell the mountains and every tree in the forest to join in the song! The Lord has rescued his people; now they will worship him. The Lord Created Everything
translation_verse: Yilpu, nín̄ tátí ki fàal̀, kun puee ti-Dindaan túń u-tundi. Kitiŋ taapu taapu, téeń mpɔn, ajoon, nín̄ gàmaan ipampakalan, ki kpáaǹ kubambaŋŋu nì ku-sufii kɔkɔ. Ti-Dindaan dá Jaakɔb nibul ki líì, u fīī Isirayeel ki lēē u-nyooti ki dàkā. Duulinya náanliu di sá iyunti kɔkɔ Dindaan

english_verse: Israel, I am your Lord, the source of your life, and I have rescued you. I created everything from the sky above to the earth below.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan un dá-si ki líìyee, úǹ un máń-si ki tākaǹ a-na poonee nín sòon̄ puee sèé: «Man ni-Dindaan di náań tikɔkɔ. Man baba di kpátì kutagbɔŋu ki dāntì yilpu, man di tí dū kitiŋ ki kpátì ki bíl̀ taapu, báà ubɔ kaa tútúǹ-mi.

english_verse: I make liars of false prophets and fools of fortunetellers. I take human wisdom and turn it into nonsense.
translation_verse: M ŋáań bibɔɔbi nín sòoǹ tiŋyee fám. M cúú bin kàal̀ abɔɔjalee yiliŋ ki lábitì. M pīiǹ biciŋfitiibi nyɔmmu, ní ki yāntì bi-ciiŋŋu kpántì tiwaatibɔti.

english_verse: I will make the message of my prophets come true. They are saying, “Jerusalem will be filled with people, and the Lord will rebuild the towns of Judah.”
translation_verse: Ama m-tɔntɔnliibi nín sòoǹ tiŋyee, m yàntī an ŋáań míǹ, ní m-tuuŋyi nín bɔ́ntì kí ŋá puee, m tí yàntī an ŋáań míǹ. M lī Jeerusaleem pu yii: <Binib ń fàtīí kɔ́-kì>, ki lī Juuda timmu pu yii: <Bí fàtīí mā-mu.> Tiŋman, bi làá fàtīí mā adiin kí tɔ́kɔń mu-digbuŋŋi pu.»

english_verse: I am the one who commands the sea and its streams to run dry.
translation_verse: M lī ibuŋkpaan in nyóòyee yii: «Ní kpāmaan, m làá yàntī ni-nyim ń fóotí.»

english_verse: I am also the one who says, “Cyrus will lead my people and obey my orders. Jerusalem and the temple will be rebuilt.”
translation_verse: M lī Siirusi pu yii: «U sá upikpaal un m lēēyee ní. U làá yàntī tin kɔkɔ m lèe ń ŋá. U làá lì Jeerusaleem tiŋki pu yii: <Bí fàtīí mā-kì>, ní kí lì kunimbɔtidii pu yii: <Bí fàtīí bíĺ ku-nyeel!>»

english_verse: The Lord said to Cyrus, his chosen one: I have taken hold of your right hand to help you capture nations and remove kings from power. City gates will open for you; not one will stay closed.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan sòon̄ nì Siirusi, ubɔti un ní úǹ u-ba lēēyee yii: «M cúú a-ŋal kí dū atimbun kí ŋá a-ŋaan. M làá cúú bibɔtiibi pɔŋyi kí fōō bi-ŋaan, ní kí pìitī ntimu punyɔmmu mun pīīyee a-nimbiin.

english_verse: As I lead you, I will level mountains and break the iron bars on bronze gates of cities.
translation_verse: Mama m-ba làá nīn līī a-nyɔkɔpu, m làá cúú aganlaka kí làkatī a-saŋŋu pu, kí gbá kí wìil̀ tasa kúti punuubi ní kí gbá kí bīil̀ tikúti kpàlkaati.

english_verse: I will give you treasures hidden in dark and secret places. Then you will know that I, the Lord God of Israel, have called you by name.
translation_verse: M làá tīī-si tigaajawan tin bí dibalinee, tigaajati tin bi dūu bál̀ee. Niinee a làá béé yii man di sá ni-Dindaan. Siirusi, m yíiń a-yindi, man di sá Isirayeel Nimbɔtiu.

english_verse: Cyrus, you don't even know me! But I have called you by name and highly honored you because of Israel, my chosen servant.
translation_verse: M-tɔntɔnliu Jaakɔb nibul pu, Isirayeel nibul din m lēēyee pu ní m yíiń a-yindi ki tīī-si jilma, nì min kɔkɔ saa nyí-mee.

english_verse: Only I am the Lord! There are no other gods. I have made you strong, though you don't know me.
translation_verse: Man di sá ni-Dindaan, ubɔ pée gíti kpá. Báà unimbɔti kaa ti pée bí ki kútì man pu. M dū dambala ki gbìn̄ a-caŋ kí tīī-si mpɔn nì min kɔkɔ saa nyí-mee.

english_verse: Now everyone from east to west will learn that I am the Lord. No other gods are real.
translation_verse: Kí yòon̄ ŋwìiń nyalaŋki pú kí cáá sāā ŋu-jeetilaŋki púee, báà ŋma làá béé yii tiba kaa ti pée bí ki kútì man pu. Man di sá ni-Dindaan, ubɔ pée gíti kpá.

english_verse: I create light and darkness, happiness and sorrow. I, the Lord, do all this.
translation_verse: Man di mɔ́ɔ̀ ŋwalifi ní ki nāantí dibɔmbɔndi, man di nyāntí nnaam ní ki cāabìń nnaabu. An sá man ni-Dindaan di ŋáań tíǹ gbanti kɔkɔ.

english_verse: Tell the heavens to send down justice like showers of rain. Prepare the earth for my saving power to sprout and produce justice that I, the Lord, create. The Lord's Mighty Power The Lord said:
translation_verse: «Yilpu, yàntī dipɔ̀ńdi ń nyānní kutaa pu kí tɔ̄ń. Atagban ń yàntī deedee ń sìtīń kitiŋ pu kii utaayee. Kitiŋ ń wàan̄ kinyɔkɔ, difiil ń púkuḿ ní deedee ń nyā. Man ni-Dindaan di náań tíǹ gbanti kɔkɔ.» Kuyɔkɔu nì uyɔɔmaati

english_verse: Israel, you have no right to argue with your Creator. You are merely a clay pot shaped by a potter. The clay doesn't ask, “Why did you make me this way? Where are the handles?”
translation_verse: Mbusu dɔ̄ ki cí unil un kpākantí un máń-uee. Unil sá kii aboon kansikin dibee ní. Kuyɔkɔu bàlifī uyɔɔmaati yii: «Ba ní a ŋáańeeee»? Tiwan tin bi máńee kaa lì un máń-tèe yii: «Waa nyí ditundi tiŋan.»

english_verse: Children don't have the right to demand of their parents, “What have you done to make us what we are?”
translation_verse: Mbusu dɔ̄ ki cí un di yaa lī ubaati yii: «Ba ní a màl̄ nee ní?», àá un di yaa lī umati yii: «Ba ní a màl̄ nan ní?»

english_verse: I am the Lord, the Creator, the holy God of Israel. Do you dare question me about my own nation or about what I have done?
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, Isirayeel Circir Nimbɔtiu nín sòon̄ u-nibul din u máńee puee sèé: «Ni bàlifī-mi tin làá bàń m-biyaamu puee. Ni làá tīī-mi mara ditundi din m túńee puɔɔɔ?

english_verse: I created the world and covered it with people; I stretched out the sky and filled it with stars.
translation_verse: Man di ŋá kitiŋ ní ki náań inifunaan ki-pu. Man nì m-ŋalii ní m dūu kpátì yilpu ki dāntì, ní iŋmalbijaa in bí niinee kɔkɔ bí m-taapu.

english_verse: I have done the right thing by placing Cyrus in power, and I will make the roads easy for him to follow. I am the Lord All-Powerful! Cyrus will rebuild my city and set my people free without being paid a thing. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Lord Alone Can Save
translation_verse: Man di lūkutìń unil nee ki nóó nì deedee saŋŋu, ní ki làá cúú aganlaka kɔkɔ kí làkatī u-saŋŋu pu. Úǹ di làá fàtīí mā m-tiŋki, Jeerusaleem ní kí gíiǹní m-nib bin cūtì kuyuŋuee. Baa dāa cáá tiba kí pàaa, kaa làá tīī tiba mun.» Ti-Dindaan Mpɔŋkɔdaan di lī míǹ. Isirayeel, Unimbɔti bí a-cee

english_verse: My people, I, the Lord, promise that the riches of Egypt and the treasures of Ethiopia will belong to you. You will force into slavery those tall people of Seba. They will bow down and say, “The only true God is with you; there are no other gods.”
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan nín lī puee sèé: «Eejipiti yab tundi paati, Kuusi yab bantiliibi nimbiliŋ nì Seeba yab tijawɔkɔlee, tíǹ kɔkɔ làá kɔ́ a-ŋaan á nīn kíǹ ki yì. Binib gbanti kɔkɔ làá dāá nīn gbìn̄ ikusaka ki pá a-boon. Bi làá dāá gbàan̄ a-nimbiin kí dāá mèè ŋwimmeem kí lì yii: <Sii baba cee ní Unimbɔti bí, báà ubɔ kaa ti pée bí ki kútì u-pu!>»

english_verse: People of Israel, your God is a mystery, though he alone can save.
translation_verse: Isirayeel Nimbɔtiu, sii un di fìil̄ee, a lafun sá Unimbɔti un bál̀ee ní.

english_verse: Anyone who makes idols will be confused and terribly disgraced.
translation_verse: Icoo làá cúú bin kpítí awaayee kɔkɔ, ní sòoǹ kí bīil̀ bi-yindi. Bi còom̄ dicilpu ki cá bi-yiliŋ tīī.

english_verse: The Lord alone is God! He created the heavens and made a world where people can live, instead of creating an empty desert. The Lord alone is God; there are no others.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan nín lī puee sèé. Ti-Dindaan di náań yilpu, úǹ Unimbɔti di máń kitiŋ, ki nyántì-kì ní ki yāntì kì bá ki pɔ̄ɔ̄. Waa náań-kì kí nīn dɔ̄ fám, u máń-kì yii binib ń nīn kóò ki-pu ní. U bí yii: «Man di sá ni-Dindaan, ubɔ kaa ti pée bí ki kútì man pu.

english_verse: The Lord did not speak in a dark secret place or command Jacob's descendants to search for him in vain. The Lord speaks the truth, and this is what he says
translation_verse: Maa sòon̄ dibalin, dibɔmbɔndi poon laaba. Maa lī Jaakɔb naantiibi yii: <Ní nyàab̀maan-mi kubuŋu pu.> Man di sá ni-Dindaan, m sòoǹ tin bí deedeeyee ní, m lì tin sá mbaamɔn ki cáá dikílee ní.» Atimbun làá kpántí ŋi-ba

english_verse: to every survivor from every nation: “Gather around me! Learn how senseless it is to worship wooden idols or pray to helpless gods.
translation_verse: Ní kpāfìmaan kí dāan̄, nimbi bin ŋmátì ki nyáń atimbunee. Ní sútí kí pìl̄maan dicilpu. Binib bin tú bi-waakpitikaaŋi, ki mèé unimbɔti un kaa ŋūǹ kí fīī-bee, bidambi kaa nyí tiba.

english_verse: “Why don't you get together and meet me in court? Didn't I tell you long ago what would happen? I am the only God! There are no others. I bring about justice, and have the power to save.
translation_verse: Sòom̀maan, ní cáaḿmaan kun dàkà yii ni-bɔti ŋān̄ee. Ní kpāfìmaan kí sòoǹ dicilpu. Ŋma di sòon̄ tin bíi jītí kɔŋkɔnnee pu ŋkilkaamin? Ŋma di nìn dū-tì ki nāatì doooo cannaaku? An kaa sá man, ni-Dindaanaaa? Unimbɔti ubɔ kaa ti bí ki kútì man pu. Man boonee deedee Nimbɔtiu, Unimbɔti un fìil̄ee ubɔ pée gíti kpá.

english_verse: “I invite the whole world to turn to me and be saved. I alone am God! No others are real.
translation_verse: Nimbi bin kɔkɔ kóò kitiŋ kúntilaŋkee, ní fàtīí gítiḿmaan m-cee, ni làá ká difiil, kun puee man di sá Unimbɔti, ubɔ kaa ti bí ki kútì man pu.

english_verse: I have made a solemn promise, one that won't be broken: Everyone will bow down and worship me.
translation_verse: M pūtì m-ba yii ibaamɔn di làá nyā m-nyɔkɔn, m-nyɔɔbundi kpá ki làá kpántí: Ditabiŋyil kamaa làá dāá gbàan̄ m-nimbiin, dilimbil kamaa làá dāá pùtī kí lì yii:

english_verse: They will admit that I alone can bring about justice. Everyone who is angry with me will be terribly ashamed and will turn to me.
translation_verse: «Ti-Dindaan baba cee ní ibaamɔn nì mpɔn bí.» Bin kɔkɔ nìn pée jáń nì mee làá dāá dāan̄ m-cee nì icoo.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will give victory and great honor to the people of Israel.”
translation_verse: Ama ti-Dindaan puee, bi làá sòoǹ kí pɔ̀ Isirayeel naantiibi kɔkɔ, ní bí dāá nīn bí ki fàal̀.

english_verse: The gods Bel and Nebo are down on their knees, as wooden images of them are carried away on weary animals.
translation_verse: Diwaal Beeli kpōoǹ, diwaal Neeboo lítì. Bi dū ŋi-naŋku ki túǹ tiwaŋkuti. Dooooyee, bi yaa nìn tòotī-ŋee, bi nìn dúkutí-ŋi ní. Kɔŋkɔnnee, ŋíǹ di kpántì diwaŋgul din nyìm̀ee tiwaŋkuti tú ki gīīyee.

english_verse: They are down on their knees to rescue the heavy load, but the images are still taken to a foreign country.
translation_verse: Awaa kpōoǹ, ŋi-kɔkɔ lítì dicilpu. Ŋaa ŋúń ki fīī ŋi-naŋku, bi cáǹ ŋíǹ ŋi-ba kuyuŋu.

english_verse: You survivors in Israel, listen to me, the Lord. Since the day you were born, I have carried you along.
translation_verse: Pīlifìmaan-mi, Jaakɔb naantiibi, nimbi bin kíǹ Isirayeel nibul poonee, nimbi bin ní m ŋúb́ doooo ni-na poonee, nimbi bin m ŋúb́ doooo ŋyunti ŋun bi màl̄-nee.

english_verse: I will still be the same when you are old and gray, and I will take care of you. I created you. I will carry you and always keep you safe.
translation_verse: M làá nīn pée bí míǹ ní áli ni-putin. M làá nīn pée ŋúb́-ni ní áli ni-yikpiti ń pīil̀. Man di máń-ni, man di làá ŋúb́-ni. M làá kpèè-ni ní kí fīī-ni.

english_verse: Some people hire a goldsmith and give silver and gold to be formed into an idol for them to worship.
translation_verse: Binib fùtīń sindaariya bi-lɔtin. Bi ŋmàntī animbil kúti saniya pu. Bi cáa tìì goosimiiti yii ú mɔ́ɔ́-bi diwaal. Boonee ní bi gbàantí di-nimbiin ki jáaḿ-dì.

english_verse: They carry the idol on their shoulders, then put it on a stand, but it cannot move. They call out to the idol when they are in trouble, but it doesn't answer, and it cannot help.
translation_verse: Bíǹ di yòontí-dì kí páań bi-gbigbipati pu, kí cáá-dì kí cùnnì kí síiń mpaan ŋubɔ pu. Laakin ní bi síiǹ-dèe, niin ní dì pée sí. Unil yaa kúuǹ ki yíiń-dàaa, dàa kíikí, unil yaa tí kɔ́ dinimbinaamandinaaa, dàa fìil̄-u. Difiil tóobiń

english_verse: Now keep this in mind, you sinful people. And don't ever forget it. The Lord Alone Is God
translation_verse: Téetímaan tin bí nee pu kí ká kunyannyaau! Pɔɔgaatib, ní kɔ́maan ni-ban kí dàkafì!

english_verse: I alone am God! There are no other gods; no one is like me. Think about what happened many years ago.
translation_verse: Ní téetímaan tibɔkpikil tin nìn jítèe pu. Man di sá Unimbɔti, ubɔ pée gíti kpá. Unimbɔti ubɔ kaa ti pée bí kii mamee.

english_verse: and brought someone from a distant land to do what I wanted. He attacked from the east, like a hawk swooping down. Now I will keep my promise and do what I planned.
translation_verse: M yíiń ukaabu ubɔ doooo ŋwìiń nyalaŋki pú. Úǹ di làá dāá ŋá tin m bɔ́ntì ki síiǹee. U làá dāá nyānní kitiŋ kin dátèe ni. M yaa lī puee, míǹ ní m ŋáań. M nín bɔ́ntì kí ŋá puee, m làá ŋá míǹ.

english_verse: You people are stubborn and far from being safe, so listen to me.
translation_verse: Ní pīlifìmaan-mi, bipɔɔgbifindambi, nimbi bin dátiǹ difiilee.

english_verse: I will soon come to save you. I am not far away and will waste no time; I take pride in Israel and will save Jerusalem.
translation_verse: M làá cáań m-baamɔŋyi, iaa ti pée dátiǹ-ni báà fiii. M-fiil kaa làá sūŋkì ní kí bàń. M làá yàntī Siiyɔn ń ká m-fiil, m làá tīī Isirayeel m-nyaaŋku.

english_verse: City of Babylon, You are delicate and untouched, but that will change. Surrender your royal power and sit in the dirt.
translation_verse: Babiloon tiŋki, kpákatí a-beejal pu kí kàl̄ ntampukumin. Babiloon yab tiŋki, kàl̄ kitiŋ. Di sá yii dalba dalba baa làá ti pée yíiń-si yii <Babiloon kinyannyaaŋŋi>, <Babiloon tiŋki kin là ki-bee>.

english_verse: Start grinding grain! Take off your veil. Strip off your fancy clothes and wade across rivers.
translation_verse: Yòon̄ kunaau nì nnaamintidɔ kí nà ŋyim. Páatí a-ŋaabiiŋkaaŋu, kí kóoǹ a-wɔndoou, bìitī a-tapaŋŋi pu kí dùtī ibun.

english_verse: You will suffer the shame of going naked, because I will take revenge, and no one can escape.
translation_verse: Binib làá ká a-cancaŋgbeel, kí ká kun di kɔ̄ntí-si icooyee. Man làá tɔ̀ ipɔntoon, ní an kaa cáá yii ubɔ làá pìin̄-mi nsan.

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the holy God of Israel. I am their Savior.
translation_verse: Un di dá-ti ki líìyee, bi yíì-u yii: «Ti-Dindaan Mpɔŋkɔdaan ní.» Úǹ di sá Isirayeel Circir Nimbɔtiu.

english_verse: Babylon, be silent! Sit in the dark. No longer will nations accept you as their queen.
translation_verse: Babiloon yab tiŋki, tàtīí kàl̄ kí taa pée mūlifì tiba. Kɔ́ kí báĺ dibɔmbɔndin. Di sá yii baa ti làá pée yíiń-si dalba dalba yii: <Un jīǹ abee kɔkɔ pu dinyandee>.

english_verse: I was angry with my people. So I let you take their land and bring disgrace on them. You showed them no mercy, but were especially cruel to those who were old.
translation_verse: M nìn gíí m-nibul pu diŋuul ní. M nìn dū bin m yèe ki fá, ní ki nìn dū-bi ki ŋá a-ŋaan. Ama ní aa súń bi-saai báà fiii, a wɔ́b́ bijaŋkpilib an ti kpáàa jítì mara pu.

english_verse: You thought that you would be queen forever. You didn't care what you did; it never entered your mind that you might get caught.
translation_verse: A nìn bí ki lì yii: «M làá nīn pée bí kí nīn sá un jīǹ dinyandee ní ki cá jaanjaan.» Aa dākafì a-pɔbil poon tibɔti nee pu, kaa dākafì foolboon pu.

english_verse: You think that you alone are all-powerful, that you won't be a widow or lose your children. All you care about is pleasure, but listen to what I say.
translation_verse: Kɔŋkɔnnee pīlifì tin bí nee, sii umɔnjil. A pée kā a-beejal pu nì dimákal ki lì a-pɔbil poon yii: «Man baba di pée bí, ubɔ kaa ti bí kii mamee. Dalba dalba maa làá kpántí ukpiipu, ní m-biyaamu mun kpá ki làá kpú.»

english_verse: Your magic powers and charms will suddenly fail, then you will be a widow and lose your children.
translation_verse: Tibɔti gbanti liitil làá bàń-si dicilpu dicilpu ní, ŋwimbaanti. A-biyaamu làá kpú ní á kpántí ukpiipu. Bikpaŋkpantiibi nì bibɔɔbi kaa làá ŋmā kí pìin̄ nsan tíǹ ń taa bàń-si.

english_verse: You hid behind evil like a shield and said, “No one can see me!” You were fooled by your wisdom and your knowledge; you felt sure that you alone were in full control.
translation_verse: A nìn máká a-tuŋkpitiŋ pu ní ki nìn lì yii: «Ubɔ kaa wāĺ-mi.» An sá a-ciiŋyi nì a-nyil di nìn kíil̀-si, di sá yii a nìn lì a-pɔbil poon yii: «Man baba di pée bí, maa cáá juti!»

english_verse: Keep using your magic powers and your charms as you have always done. Maybe—just maybe— you will frighten somebody!
translation_verse: Nín̄ pée gbíntìi nìkì ki ŋáań a-bɔɔtuuŋŋi nì a-kpaŋkpantiiku. Atuun gbanti pu ní a gīī doooo a-biyatin. An yaa yíì a làá dāá páatí ŋi-pu, an yaa yíì a làá ŋmā kí fàaǹ bin kíǹee ŋi-pu.

english_verse: You have worn yourself out, asking for advice from those who study the stars and tell the future month after month. Go ask them how to be saved from what will happen.
translation_verse: A bālifì dibalifil ki tin kpáàa gīī. Bin cútí kutagbɔŋu kí yàkatī yàkatī, ki kpèé iŋmalbijaa ki nàatī tin làá jītí a-pu uŋmal kamaayee ń dāan̄ kí fīī-si!

english_verse: People who trust the stars are as helpless as straw in a flaming fire. No one can even keep warm, sitting by a fire that feeds only on straw.
translation_verse: Bi làá dāá kpántí kii timɔkulindee ní, ní ŋŋmi ń dāá wà-bi. Baa làá ŋmátí kí nyā aŋmilimbilin. An kaa dāa sá kii kpɔnɔŋmiŋu, àá kii ŋŋmiwulkaayee!

english_verse: These are the fortunetellers you have done business with all of your life. But they don't know where they are going, and they can't save you.
translation_verse: Míǹ ní bibɔɔbi bin pu a nìn gīī doooo a-biyatinee làá nīn sá ki tīī-si. Kɔŋkɔnnee, bíǹ di tú ki yìiǹ an kɔkɔ puee, ní bi-kansikin ubɔ kaa ŋūǹ kí fīī-si.

english_verse: People of Israel, you come from Jacob's family and the tribe of Judah. You claim to worship me, the Lord God of Israel, but you are lying.
translation_verse: Pīlifìmaan tin bí nee, Jaakɔb nibul, nimbi bin bi yíì Isirayeel yab ní ni nyánní Juuda nyeeŋunee. Ni pòontí ipoon ti-Dindaan yindi pu, ní ki mèé ki yíì Isirayeel Nimbɔtiu, ama ní kaa ŋáań míǹ nì ibaamɔn nì deedee poon.

english_verse: You call Jerusalem your home and say you depend on me, the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel.
translation_verse: Ni yíì ni-ba yii <Circir tiŋki yab>, ní ki máká Isirayeel Nimbɔtiu pu, úǹ un bi yíì yii <Ti-Dindaan Mpɔŋkɔdaanee>. Ní pīlifìmaan tin bí nee.

english_verse: Long ago I announced what was going to be, then without warning, I made it happen.
translation_verse: M sòon̄ tibɔkpikil pu ki síiǹ an yúntì. Tì nìn nyáń m-nyɔkɔn, ní m nìn yāntì ni gbìl̄-tì. Dicilpu dicilpuee ní m yāntì tì dɔ́miń.

english_verse: I knew you were stubborn and hardheaded.
translation_verse: M nyí a-pɔɔgbifiŋŋu pu. Di sá yii a-pɔbil tīlifì ní a-yil pɔ̄ɔ̄.

english_verse: You heard what I said, and you have seen it happen. Now admit it's true! I will show you secrets you have never known.
translation_verse: Ni nìn gbìl̄ tin m nìn sòon̄ ki yóoǹee, ní ni ká tin kɔkɔ dɔ́miń ki jítèe. Mimmee nimbi kaa béè mimmaaa? Kí yòon̄ kɔŋkɔnnee kí nīn cée, tibɔpɔn pu ní m làá sòoǹ. M nìn dū-tì ki bál̀ ní naa nìn dáá nyí-tì.

english_verse: You have never been willing to listen to what I say; from the moment of your birth, I knew you would rebel. The Lord Warns Israel
translation_verse: Naa nìn pílifì, kaa nìn béè, ni-tafaliŋ pée kpá ti-pu an yúntì. M nyí ni nín sá bin nyēē bi-jutiibi boonee, ní bi yíì-ni yii: <pɔɔgaatib doooo ni-na poon>.

english_verse: I, the Lord, am true to myself; I will be praised for not punishing and destroying you.
translation_verse: M-yindi pu ní m tāaǹ m-ŋuul ni-pu, m-nyooti pu ní m ká kimɔtii ni-pu, án nín làá ŋá pu ḿ taa kúntí-nee.

english_verse: I tested you in hard times just as silver is refined in a heated furnace.
translation_verse: Kpèè, m cɔ́ŋkì-ni ŋŋmin, ama an kaa nín sá kii ŋŋmi ŋun bi cáa cɔ́ŋkí animbil kútee, nnaabu ŋmiŋun ní m cɔ́ŋkì-ni.

english_verse: I did this because of who I am. I refuse to be dishonored or share my praise with any other god.
translation_verse: An sá man m-ba yindi pu. Tiŋman ní, man m-ba yindi pu ní m ŋá míǹ. Di sá yii maa kíikí bí bīil̀ m-yindi. Maa kíikí kí dū m-nyooti kí tīī ubɔ. Un di làá ŋá tin ti-Dindaan bɔ́ntèe

english_verse: Israel, my chosen people, listen to me. I alone am the Lord, the first and the last.
translation_verse: Pīlifìmaan-mi, Jaakɔb nibul, sii Isirayeel nibul din m yíińee. M pée gbíntìi sá ubaantee ní, man di sá upeepeekaa ki sá uluŋkikaa.

english_verse: With my own hand I created the earth and stretched out the sky. They obey my every command. The Lord Speaks to the Nations
translation_verse: Man m-ba ŋal ní m dūu máń kitiŋ, nì m-ŋalii ní m dūu kpátì kutagbɔŋu. M yaa yíiń tiwan gbanti liitilee, tì dòoń ní dicilpu dicilpu.

english_verse: Gather around me, all of you! Listen to what I say. Did any of your idols predict this would happen? Did they say that my friend would do what I want done to Babylonia?
translation_verse: Ni-kɔkɔ ń kóoǹní kí kpāfì kí pīlifìmaan: M cáá ubɔti ubɔ. U làá ŋá Babiloon tiŋki m nín là puee, u làá dàkà Babiloon yab m-pɔŋŋu. Ni-kansikin ŋma di sòon̄ tibɔti nee ki yóoǹ.

english_verse: I was the one who chose him. I have brought him this far, and he will be successful.
translation_verse: An sá m-baba nì m-baba di sòon̄. Man di yíiń-u, ki yāntì u dɔ́miń. M làá yàntī ú ŋmā kí tɔ̄ u-tundi.

english_verse: Come closer and listen! I have never kept secret the things I have said, and I was here before time began. It Is Best To Obey the Lord By the power of his Spirit the Lord God has sent me
translation_verse: Ní sútiń kí pìl̄maan-mi kí pīlifì tin bí nee! Doooo ŋkilkaaminee, maa sòon̄ dibalin. Ŋyunti ŋun ní tibɔti nee nìn jítèe, man nìn bí ní. - Ama kɔŋkɔnnee ti-Dindaan Unimbɔti di dū-mi ki tú nì u-Fam -. Áù, a yaa bàà nìn pílifiǹ-mi!

english_verse: with this message: People of Israel, I am the holy Lord God, the one who rescues you. For your own good, I teach you, and I lead you along the right path.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan un dá-si ki líìyee, Isirayeel Circir Nimbɔtiu nín lī puee sèé: «Man di sá ni-Dindaan a-Nimbɔtiu. Man di dàkà-si tin làá ŋmā kí kèetī-see. Man di kpòotī-si nsan ŋun a còom̄ee pu.

english_verse: How I wish that you had obeyed my commands! Your success and good fortune would then have overflowed like a flooding river.
translation_verse: Áù, a yaa bàà nìn pílifì tin m nìn kpáafì-see tiŋanee, a-gbansɔŋfiŋu bàà làá nīn sá kii dimɔɔlee, ní a-deedeeu ń bàà nín̄ bí kii tiŋku nyiŋgbantee.

english_verse: Your nation would be blessed with more people than there are grains of sand along the seashore. And I would never have let your country be destroyed.
translation_verse: A-naantiibi bàà làá nīn wīikí kii dibulee, ní a-nibooliŋu ń bàà nín̄ wīikí kii itaŋkpabiitee. Bi-yindi bàà kpá kí wāŋkì m-nimbiin jaanjaan!» Unimbɔti nibul nyáń Babiloon tiŋkin

english_verse: Now leave Babylon! Celebrate as you go. Be happy and shout for everyone to hear, “The Lord has rescued his servant Israel!
translation_verse: Ní nyāmaan Babiloon tiŋkin! Ní sām̀maan-kì! Ní bāakìmaan tibɔti nee nì ifaal poon, ní yàntī tí gbìtī kí tin bà kitiŋ kúntilaŋki. Ní lìmaan yii: «Ti-Dindaan fīī u-tɔntɔnliu Jaakɔb ki líì.»

english_verse: He led us through the desert and made water flow from a rock to satisfy our thirst.
translation_verse: Kuteeu kun pu u nìn dū Isirayeel yab ki dēe, nnyinnyoo kaa nìn cúú-bi. Bi-puee, u nìn yāntì nnyim nyáń ditaŋkpalin, u búkutì ditaŋkpal ní nnyim pùubìń.

english_verse: But the Lord has promised that none who are evil will live in peace.”
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan bí yii: «Binikpitib kpá kí ká ŋgbansɔŋfi.»

english_verse: Everyone, listen, even you foreign nations across the sea. The Lord chose me and gave me a name before I was born.
translation_verse: Ntimu mun nnyim māntìi túee yab, ní pīlifìmaan-mi. Nimbi bin kóòń ntindandatimunee, ní kpòon̄ ni-tafal kí pīlifì. Baa láá màl̄-mi ní ti-Dindaan yíiń-mi. Doooo m-na poon ní u yíiń m-yindi.

english_verse: He made my words pierce like a sharp sword or a pointed arrow; he kept me safely hidden in the palm of his hand.
translation_verse: U yāntì m-nyɔkɔ kpántì kii kitàataajiki kin jītée. U dū u-ŋal ki bīiǹ m-pu. U dū-mi ki kpántì mpiin ŋun cɔ́m̀ee, ní ki dū-mi ki bál̀ u-baatandi poon.

english_verse: The Lord said to me, “Israel, you are my servant; and because of you I will be highly honored.”
translation_verse: U tùkū-mi yii: «Isirayeel, sii di sá m-tɔntɔnliu. Sii pu ní m làá dī kí dàkà m-nyooti.»

english_verse: I said to myself, “I'm completely worn out; my time has been wasted. But I did it for the Lord God, and he will reward me.”
translation_verse: M bí ki lì m-ban yii: «Man gīī digìńdi fám ní, m bɔ̄ɔ̄ abaa ki tīī kutaa.» Ama ti-Dindaan di làá pɔ̀-mi, u kpáafì m-paati ki cíitì-mi.

english_verse: Even before I was born, the Lord God chose me to serve him and to lead back the people of Israel. So the Lord has honored me and made me strong.
translation_verse: Kɔŋkɔnnee ti-Dindaan sòon̄. Úǹ di máń-mi ki tākaǹ m-na poon ḿ nīn sá u-tɔntɔnliu. U là yii ḿ fàtīí gíiǹní Jaakɔb naantiibi u-cee, ḿ kóoǹ Isirayeel nibul kí kpāfì. M ká disíndi ti-Dindaan nimbiin, di sá yii m-Nimbɔtiu di sá m-pɔŋŋu.

english_verse: Now the Lord says to me, “It isn't enough for you to be merely my servant. You must do more than lead back survivors from the tribes of Israel. I have placed you here as a light for other nations; you must take my saving power to everyone on earth.” The Lord Will Rescue His People
translation_verse: U bí-mi yii: «Á nīn sá m-tɔntɔnliu kí yòon̄ Jaakɔb naakɔti yilpu, ní kí gíiǹní Isirayeel yab bin ŋmátèe. Ama an kaa dóò. M lēē-si á nīn sá atimbun walifiŋu, kí cáá difiil kí bànnì kitiŋ gbeennyɔkɔ.» Bin bínní kuyuŋuee kɔkɔ gítintam

english_verse: Israel, I am the holy Lord God, the one who rescues you. You are slaves of rulers and of a nation who despises you.
