Now this is what I promise: Kings and rulers will honor you by kneeling at your feet. You can trust me! I am your Lord, the holy God of Israel, and you are my chosen ones. The Lord Will Lead His People Home
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan Ufiil, Isirayeel Circir Nimbɔtiu nín sòon̄ puee sèé. Sii un ní bi kpèé fámee, sii un báà ubɔ kaa là kí wāl̀ee, sii un sá biwɔ́biliibi yumbuuee, u bí-si yii: «Bibɔtiibi yaa láa wál̀-see, bi làá dāá yīkì bi-beejaliŋ pu kí yūĺ. Abɔtibil yaa láa ká a páaǹnée, bi làá dāá gbàan̄ a-nimbiin ní. Ti-Dindaan un sá deedeedaanee pu, Isirayeel Circir Nimbɔtiu un lēē-see pu ní bi làá dāá ŋá míǹ.»

english_verse: This is what the Lord says: I will answer your prayers because I have set a time when I will help by coming to save you. I have chosen you to take my promise of hope to other nations. You will rebuild the country from its ruins, then people will come and settle there.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan nín lī puee sèé: «M-niti yuntiŋuee, m nìn pílifiǹ-si, ní difiil wiiŋŋuee, m nìn tútuǹ-si. Man di máń-si kí ŋmā kí dī a-pu kí ŋá mpèé nì dinibul nee. M làá fàtīí fōō kitiŋ nee ní kí fàtīí yàkatī atinjan ŋin dɔ̄ ki bíil̀ nee.

english_verse: You will set prisoners free from dark dungeons to see the light of day. On their way home, they will find plenty to eat, even on barren hills.
translation_verse: M bí bisarkadambi yii: <Nyānnímaan!>, nimbi bin kóò dibɔmbɔndinee: <Nyānnímaan mpaampiin pu!> Bi làá dāá ká tijin asaŋkaŋkpil pu kí jī, kí dāá ká ŋgbantamu kɔkɔ pu tijin kí jī.

english_verse: They won't go hungry or get thirsty; they won't be bothered by the scorching sun or hot desert winds. I will be merciful while leading them along to streams of water.
translation_verse: Ŋkùm kaa dāa gíti cútí-baaa, nnyinnyoo kaa dāa gíti cútí-bi. Nnantantum kaa dāa gíti sèetī-baaa, ŋwìiń mun kaa dāa gíti píl̀-bi. Di sá yii m làá dū dineendi ní kí kpòotī-bi, ní kí cáá-bi kí cùnnì inyimbul in sɔ̀m̀ee laŋki bí nyɔ̀.

english_verse: I will level the mountains and make roads.
translation_verse: M làá tɔ̄ m-jooŋŋi kɔkɔ pu isan, ní kí dāá ŋāŋkì m-daŋŋi kɔkɔ tiŋan.

english_verse: Then my people will return from distant lands in the north and the west and from the city of Syene. The Lord's Mercy
translation_verse: Kpèè, bíǹ di nyánní ndandati ki dòońee. Biba nyánní ŋgan pú ní biba mun nyánní ŋwìiń nyalaŋki pú, ní biba nyánní Eejipiti tiŋki ŋgiil pú.»

english_verse: Tell the heavens and the earth to celebrate and sing; command every mountain to join in the song. The Lord's people have suffered, but he has shown mercy and given them comfort.
translation_verse: Yilpu, nín̄ tátí ki fàal̀! Kitiŋ, nín̄ kūuntí nì dipɔɔpindi! ajoon, fáámaan iwiliili! Di sá yii ti-Dindaan bíi sɔ̀ŋkī u-nibul pɔbil, u bíi dàkà binandambi u-neendi. Man kaa súntì a-pu

english_verse: The people of Zion said, “The Lord has turned away and forgotten us.”
translation_verse: Siiyɔn nìn bí ki lì yii: «Ti-Dindaan dū-mi ki fá, m-Dindaan súntì m-pu.»

english_verse: The Lord answered, “Could a mother forget a child who nurses at her breast? Could she fail to love an infant who came from her own body? Even if a mother could forget, I will never forget you.
translation_verse: Ama ní ti-Dindaan kíí yii: Unimpu súntí u-bipɔŋki puɔɔɔ? U ŋūǹ kí taa ti dàkà u-poon biki dineendaaa? Báà u yaa súntì ki-pu, man kaa làá súntí a-pu!

english_verse: A picture of your city is drawn on my hand. You are always in my thoughts!
translation_verse: Kpèè, m ŋmàn̄ a-yindi m-ŋal poon, ŋyunti kamaa m wāĺ a-guŋŋi m-nimbiin.

english_verse: “Your city will be built faster than it was destroyed— those who attacked it will retreat and leave.
translation_verse: Jeerusaleem tiŋki, bin làá fàtīí mā-see di sánní malaa malaa ki dòońee. Bin nìn kpéelikì-si ki nāaǹ-see làá sāǹ kí wàatī-si.

english_verse: Look around! You will see your people coming home. As surely as I live, I, the Lord, promise that your city with its people will be as lovely as a bride wearing her jewelry.” Jerusalem's Bright Future
translation_verse: Yáatí kí kpèè kí màntīí tū: a-biyaamu kɔkɔ kóoǹ ki kpáfì ki dòoń a-cee. Man ni-Dindaan un bí dimaŋfalinee di lī yii, a làá dū-bi kí léeń kii tiléeŋkaalee, kí dū-bi kí gbìn̄ kii ubɔnti nín fùul̀ nnyim pu kí dū dambala kí cúú puee.

english_verse: Jerusalem is now in ruins! Nothing is left of the city. But it will be rebuilt and soon overcrowded; its cruel enemies will be gone far away.
translation_verse: Di sá yii a-tiŋki kin bi nāaǹ kì kpántì adigbuŋkati ubɔ kaa ti kóò ki-puee kaa làá dāá nīn gíti wāā kí bà a-nib ń kɔ́. Ama bin nìn nāaǹ-see làá sāǹ kí búntí ndan kí wàatī-si.

english_verse: Jerusalem is a woman whose children were born while she was in deep sorrow over the loss of her husband. Now those children will come and seek room in the crowded city,
translation_verse: A-jipɔmbi bin a nìn dākafì yii baa ti bée, a làá dāá gbìl̄ bi lì yii: «Mpaan kaa wāā ki tīī-mi. Sútí fiii ma mun ń ká mpaan kí kɔ́».

english_verse: and Jerusalem will ask, “Am I really their mother? How could I have given birth when I was still mourning in a foreign land? Who raised these children? Where have they come from?”
translation_verse: Niinee ní á dāá bàlifì a-ba yii: «Ŋma di kalin màl̄ mbiyaamu nee ki tīī-mi dee? Maa nìn cáá mbiyaamu, m nìn sá uŋmaŋŋmanti ní. Bi nìn cúú-mi kuyuŋu ní ki dū-mi ki fá. Kin bin bí nee, ŋma di nín lōō-bi dee? Ŋyunti ŋun m nìn kíǹ m-babee, bíǹ nìn bí la dee?»

english_verse: The Lord God says: “I will soon give a signal for the nations to return your sons and your daughters to the arms of Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan Unimbɔti nín lī puee sèé: «Kpèè, m làá dúkutí m-ŋal kí túĺ atimbun watil pú kí tīī-bi kudaaŋŋu. Bi làá dāá ŋúbiń a-jipɔmbi bi-ŋalii poon kí gíiǹní, kí dāá túnní a-bisalib bi-gbigbil pu kí gíiǹní.

english_verse: The kings and queens of those nations where they were raised will come and bow down. They will take care of you just like a slave taking care of a child. Then you will know that I am the Lord. You won't be disappointed if you trust me.” The Lord Is on Our Side
translation_verse: Bibɔtiibi di làá dāá nīn dàkà a-biyaamu, ní bɔtiisalib ń dāá nīn lòó-mu. Bi làá dāá gbàan̄ a-nimbiin bi-yigbeeŋi tūū kitiŋ. Bi làá dāá líntí a-taaŋi kpɔŋkpɔm. Niinee ní a làá dāá béé yii man di sá ni-Dindaan, ní bin kɔkɔ máká m-puee, icoo kaa jīǹ-bi.»

english_verse: Is it possible to rescue victims from someone strong and cruel?
translation_verse: Bi ŋūǹ kí fōō ubaatandaan cee tiwan tin u jáń ki fōōyee u-ŋaanaaa? Bi ŋūǹ kí cúú usarkadaan kí fōō uwɔ́bil ŋaanaaa?

english_verse: But the Lord has promised to fight on our side and to rescue our children from those strong and violent enemies.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan nín lī puee sèé: «Toooo! m làá fàtīí fōō ubaatandaan cee un u cúuń kujaaunee, kí fōō uwɔ́bil cee tiwan tin u jáń ki fōońee! Man di làá já nì bin di jáà nì see, mama m-ba di làá fīī a-biyaamu.

english_verse: He will make those cruel people dine on their own flesh and get drunk from drinking their own blood. Then everyone will know that the Lord is our Savior; the powerful God of Israel has rescued his people.
translation_verse: M làá yàntī bin sàantí-see ń fàtīí ŋmɔ́ bíǹ bi-ba nanti. Bi làá dāá nyɔ̀ bíǹ bi-ba fatikuu kí gbí kii bi nín yaa nyùn̄ ndapɔm bi gbéè puee. Niinee, unifoo kamaa làá dāá béé yii man di sá a-Dindaan un fìil̄-see. Man di dá-si ki líì, man Jaakɔb Nimbɔtikpaaŋwu!»

english_verse: I came and called out, but you didn't answer. Have I lost my power to rescue and save? At my command oceans and rivers turn into deserts; fish rot and stink for lack of water.
translation_verse: M nín dɔ́mińee, ba pu ní maa ká báà ubɔ? M nín yíińee, ba pu ní báà ubɔ kaa kíí? Mimmee m-ŋal kaa fɔ̀kɔ̀ kí ŋmā kí fōō-ni kí líí níii? Maa cáá mpɔn kí ŋmā kí fīī-naaa? Ní kpèè, m yaa pée kpìl̄ tiŋkuee, see ú kpā, ní kí yàntī amɔɔ ń kpántí kuteeu. Nnyim kpátam puee, ní nnyinnyoo ń kpɔ̀ ijɔm, ní í sūū kí nūukì.

english_verse: I make the sky turn dark like the sackcloth you wear at funerals.” God's Servant Must Suffer
translation_verse: M tí ŋūǹ kí dū dibɔmbɔndi kí bìin̄ kutagbɔŋu pu, ní kí pèen̄-ku tiwan kii ku kā dikpoolee.» Ti-Dindaan tɔntɔnliu

english_verse: The Lord God gives me the right words to encourage the weary. Each morning he awakens me eager to learn his teaching;
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan Unimbɔti dàkà-mi tin m máaǹ kí lèe ḿ ŋmā kí sɔ̀ŋkì un wunti yɔ̄tèe pɔbil. Kutaafaau kamaayee, u fìntī-mi ní ki ŋátí m-tafal ḿ nīn pílifí kii ubifilee.

english_verse: he made me willing to listen and not rebel or run away.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan Unimbɔti ŋátì m-tafal, ní maa mɔ́tí m-ba pu, kaa sútí ki gítí boon.

english_verse: I let them beat my back and pull out my beard. I didn't turn aside when they insulted me and spit in my face.
translation_verse: M fātì m-boon ki tīī binib bin gbáà-mee, ki fātì m-taŋkpundi ki tīī bin dátí ki fùkù m-nyimpulee. Maa bál̀ m-nimbiin bin bèel̄-mi, ní ki tíiĺ timɔtan ki sìtī m-puee cee.

english_verse: But the Lord God keeps me from being disgraced. So I refuse to give up, because I know God will never let me down.
translation_verse: Di sá yii ti-Dindaan Unimbɔti di tútúǹ-mi, an pu ní bi-siibiliŋ kaa ká-mi. M yàntī m-nimbiin ń pɔ̄ɔkì kii ditaŋkpalee. M nyí yii icoo pée kpá kí cúú-mi.

english_verse: My protector is nearby; no one can stand here to accuse me of wrong.
translation_verse: Un di pɔ̀-mee bí ki kɔ́ĺ-mi. Ŋma di làá táká-mi tibɔti? Udaan ń nyā tí yūĺ ubɔsoonli nimbiin! Ŋma di làá kɔ̄kɔl̀-mi? Udaan ń nyānní kí yūĺ m-nimbiin!

english_verse: The Lord God will help me and prove I am innocent. My accusers will wear out like moth-eaten clothes.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan Unimbɔti di tútúǹ-mi, kin ŋma di gíti ŋūǹ kí kpɔ̀ m-bɔti? M-nannanliibi kɔkɔ làá sátí kii tiwampeeŋkaalee ní, dikɔtuul di làá ŋmɔ́-bi. Pīlifìmaan ti-Dindaan tɔntɔnliu

english_verse: None of you respect the Lord or obey his servant. You walk in the dark instead of the light; you don't trust the name of the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Ni-kansikin ŋma di fàŋkí ti-Dindaan? Udaan máaǹ kí pīlifiǹ u-tɔntɔnliu. Ŋma di cōom̀ dibɔmbɔndin kaa ká ŋwalifi ní? Udaan ń nīn máká ti-Dindaan pu, kí dū u-ba kí fìtīǹ u-Nimbɔtiu!

english_verse: Go ahead and walk in the light of the fires you have set. But with his own hand, the Lord will punish you and make you suffer.
translation_verse: Ama nimbi bin kpà ŋŋmi, ipiin in fòol̄ lìblibee māntìi tú-nee, ní kɔ́maan ni-ŋmiŋu ŋun fòol̄ lìblibee poon, ipiin in ni tūū ŋŋmee kansikin. An sá man ŋal pɔŋŋu di làá ŋá míǹ, agìń poon ní ni làá dāá kpú.

english_verse: If you want to do right and obey the Lord, follow Abraham's example. He was the rock from which you were chipped.
translation_verse: «Ní pīlifìmaan-mi, nimbi bin nyàab̀ ibaamɔnee, nimbi bin bí ki nyàab̀ man ni-Dindaanee. Ní kpèèmaan ditaŋkpal din bi dūu kpítì-nee, kí kpèèmaan mbòó ŋun poon bi nyántìń-nee.

english_verse: God chose Abraham and Sarah to be your ancestors. The Lord blessed Abraham, and from that one man came many descendants.
translation_verse: Ní kpèèmaan ni-baa Abraam, kí kpèè Saara un màl̄-nee. Abraam kaa nìn cáá kibiki ŋyunti ŋun m nìn yíiń-uee. Ama ní m bīiǹ u-boon ki yāntì u kpántì ditimbuŋkpaandi naanja.»

english_verse: Though Zion is in ruins, the Lord will bring comfort, and the city will be as lovely as the garden of Eden that he provided. Then Zion will celebrate; it will be thankful and sing joyful songs. The Lord's Victory Will Last
translation_verse: Tiŋman, ti-Dindaan làá sɔ̄ Siiyɔn tiŋki saai, u làá sɔ̄ ki-digbuŋkatiŋ saai. U làá yàntī kitiŋ kin kpántì kii kuteeuee ń kpántí kii Eedeen kpaabuee. U làá dū kitiŋkuliŋŋi gbanti kí kpántí kii ti-Dindaan kpaabuee. Dipɔɔpindi nì ifaal làá nīn bí ki-poon, bi làá nīn gà ipampakalan ní ki bɔ̀ɔ́ tiwambɔɔkaal ki-poon.

english_verse: The Lord says: You are my people and nation! So pay attention to me. My teaching will cause justice to shine like a light for every nation.
translation_verse: «Ní pīlifìmaan-mi tiŋan, m-nibul. M-timbundin yab, kpòom̄maan ni-tafal kí pīlifì-mi. Di sá yii man di làá nyāntí mara, ní ibaamɔn in m làá cáańee làá nīn ŋmíntí anibul kɔkɔ.

english_verse: Those who live across the sea are eagerly waiting for me to rescue them. I am strong and ready; soon I will come to save and to rule all nations.
translation_verse: M-deedeeu tóobiń, m-fiil nyáń ki páaǹní. M làá dū mpɔŋkpaan ní kí sòoǹ anibul bɔti. Ntimu mun nnyim māntìi túee làá nīn máká m-pu, ní kí nīn cɔ́tí m-pɔŋkpaaŋŋu pu.

english_verse: Look closely at the sky! Stare at the earth. The sky will vanish like smoke; the earth will wear out like clothes. Everyone on this earth will die like flies. But my victory will last; my saving power never ends.
translation_verse: Wáaǹ kí kpèè kutaa, ní kí tìntī kí kpèè kitiŋ. Kutagbɔŋu làá wāŋkì kii nnyiimee, kitiŋ làá sátí kii tiwampeeŋkaalee, ní ki-nib ń kpú kpú kii isiiyee. Ama man fiil làá nīn bí ní ki cá jaanjaan, m-deedeeu pée kpá kí kúntí dalba dalba.

english_verse: If you want to do right and obey my teaching with all your heart, then pay close attention. Don't be discouraged when others insult you and say hurtful things.
translation_verse: «Pīlifìmaan-mi, nimbi bin nyí tin bí deedeeyee, nimbi dinibul din ŋúb́ m-marau di-pɔbilinee. Ní taa fàŋkìmaan nisaaleen siibiliŋ, kí taa yàntī binib beelii ń yɔ̀tī ni-wunti.

english_verse: They will be eaten away like a moth-eaten coat. But my victory will last; my saving power will never end. A Prayer for the Lord's Help
translation_verse: Dikɔtuul làá mɔ́-bi kii tiwampeeŋkaalee, akoosibil làá ŋmɔ́-bi kii ipii kuti wampeeŋkaatee. Ama man deedeeu làá nīn bí ki cá jaanjaan, m-fiil làá nīn bí ní ki cá abin abin.» Ti-Dindaan, fìntim̄

english_verse: Wake up! Do something, Lord. Be strong and ready. Wake up! Do what you did for our people long ago. Didn't you chop up Rahab the monster?
translation_verse: Fìntim̄, ti-Dindaan fìntim̄! Dàkà a-pɔŋkpaaŋŋu! Fìntim̄ kii a nín nìn ŋá pu cannaakuee, kii a nín nìn ŋá pu njaminee! Sii di nāaǹ Raab, ki sāā ki pūutì tiŋkun peebiliŋku.

english_verse: Didn't you dry up the deep sea and make a road for your people to follow safely across?
translation_verse: Sii di tí yāntì tiŋku nyim fóotì, ki yāntì tiŋkukpaŋkpaan nyim kūń. Sii di tɔ́ nsan tiŋku poon, ní ki yāntì binib bin a fīī ki líìyee cōom̀ ki jítì.

english_verse: Now those you have rescued will return to Jerusalem, singing on their way. They will be crowned with great happiness, never again to be burdened with sadness and sorrow. The Lord Gives Hope
translation_verse: Binib bin ti-Dindaan dá ki líìyee làá dāá fàtīí gítiń. Bi làá dāá kɔ́nní Siiyɔn tiŋkin ki fàal̀, ní dipɔɔpindi din kaa cáá dikúntilee dāa ŋmíntí bi-nimbiiŋyi. Mmɔŋkpaan làá dāá gbí-bi, ní falaa nì iyaliŋki ń dāá wāŋkì.

english_verse: I am the Lord, the one who encourages you. Why are you afraid of mere humans? They dry up and die like grass.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan bí yii: «An sá man di bíi sɔ̀ŋkī ni-pɔbil. M-nibul, ba pu ní a fàŋkí nisaaleen un kúùyee ní? U nì kumoou kúntitam sá mbaantiim ní.

english_verse: I spread out the heavens and laid foundations for the earth. But you have forgotten me, your Lord and Creator. All day long you were afraid of those who were angry and hoped to oppress you. Where are they now?
translation_verse: A súntì a-Dindaan un náań-see pu, úǹ di kpátì kutagbɔŋu ki dāntì yilpu, ní ki náań kitiŋ. Baabadalee, a kā ki fàŋkí yɔ́kɔ́ yɔkɔ uwɔ́bil ŋuul pu, kii u bɔ́ntì ki làá nàan̄-see! Uwɔ́bil ŋuul gbantee baasii bí la ní?

english_verse: Everyone crying out in pain will be quickly set free; they will be rescued from the power of death and never go hungry.
translation_verse: Án kaa làá sūŋkì usarkadaan un kaa ti cáá dimákalee làá tɔ̄ u-ba. Waa làá kpú u-sarkaun, ní tijikaal kpá kí lóó-u dalba dalba.

english_verse: I will help them because I am your God, the Lord All-Powerful, who makes the ocean roar.
translation_verse: Man di sá a-Dindaan a-Nimbɔtiu. Man di kùtī tiŋku ní ki yàntī u-nyiŋgbanti wòoǹ. M-yindi di sá ni-Dindaan Mpɔŋkɔdaan.

english_verse: I have told you what to say, and I will keep you safe in the palm of my hand. I spread out the heavens and laid foundations for the earth. Now I say, “Jerusalem, your people are mine.” A Warning to Jerusalem
translation_verse: Man di kpátì kutagbɔŋu ní ki náań kitiŋ, ní ki bí Siiyɔn yii: <Sii di sá m-nibul! M dū m-nyɔɔbuŋŋi ki ŋá a-nyɔkɔn, ní ki dū m-ŋal booŋŋu ki līkiǹ a-pu.» Jeerusaleem, fìntī!

english_verse: Jerusalem, wake up! Stand up! You've drunk too much from the cup filled with the Lord's anger. You have swallowed every drop, and you can't walk straight.
translation_verse: Jeerusaleem, fìntī, fìntī kí yīkì kí yūĺ! Ti-Dindaan yāntì a nyùn̄ u-ŋuul kii ndaamee. A nyùn̄-dì ki tin dóò kɔkɔ, ní a-nimbiliŋ kíǹ ki bɔ̀ntī.

english_verse: Not one of your many children is there to guide you or to offer a helping hand.
translation_verse: A-jipɔmbi bin a màl̄ee kansikinee, báà ubɔ kaa dàkā-si nsan. A-jipɔmbi bin a kpēē bi cíkitèe, báà ubɔ kaa cúú a-ŋal kí tíkiń-si.

english_verse: You have been destroyed by war and by famine; I cannot comfort you.
translation_verse: Ibɔl nee táá tɔb ili ili ki bāań-si: difukuldi nì dinàandi, ŋkùm nì kujaau. Ama ŋma di làá yāliŋkì a-pu? Ŋma di làá sɔ̀ŋkì a-pɔbil?

english_verse: The Lord your God is angry, and on every street corner your children lie helpless, like deer trapped in nets.
translation_verse: A-jipɔmbi dɔ̄ an kɔkɔ fìlfil asaŋkaŋkpil pu. Kii kutaliŋŋu nín sàtī mpeewumu puee, míǹ ní bi dɔ̄ kaa ti cáá mpɔn. Ti-Dindaan ŋuul di fáá-bi, a-Nimbɔtiu di kpìl̄-bi.

english_verse: You are in trouble and drunk, but not from wine. So pay close attention
translation_verse: «Kɔŋkɔnnee, pīlifì tin bí nee, sii Jeerusaleem un gbí inimɔɔnee: A gbí, ama an kaa sá ndaam ní a nyùn̄.

english_verse: to the Lord your God, who defends you and says, “I have taken from your hands the cup filled with my anger that made you drunk. You will never be forced to drink it again.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, a-kpiliu, a-Nimbɔtiu un mɔ́tí a-nibul puee nín lī puee sɔ̀. M làá fàtīí fōō m-ŋuul kɔŋkɔŋwu un yàntī a-nimbiliŋ bɔ̀ntēe. Aa ti làá pée nyɔ̀ m-ŋuul dalba dalba.

english_verse: Jerusalem, wake up! Stand up and be strong. Holy city of Zion, dress in your best clothes. Those foreigners who ruined your sacred city won't bother you again.
translation_verse: Fìntim̄, Siiyɔn, fìntī malaa! Fàtīí ká a-pɔŋkpaaŋŋu! Circir tiŋki Jeerusaleem, dū a-wannyaanti kí pèen̄. Di sá yii kí yòon̄ díǹ kí nīn cée, bin kaa gíí dikpancandee, bin di kaa bí circiree pée gíti kpá kí kɔ́ a-ni.

english_verse: Zion, rise from the dirt! Free yourself from the rope around your neck. Suffering Will End
translation_verse: Gbāfì kukpɔŋkpɔŋu a-wunti pu kí fá. Jeerusaleem usarkadaan, yīkì kí fàtīí fōō a-paaŋŋu! Sii Siiyɔn tiŋki uyumbu, léetí a-neen kpancikiliu.

english_verse: The Lord says: My people, you were sold, but not for money; now you will be set free, but not for a payment.
translation_verse: Di sá ti-Dindaan di lī yii: «Bi dū-ni ki nyáfì kaa fōō tiba, míǹ mbaantiim ní bi làá fàtīí dā-ni kí taa pà báà gboo.»

english_verse: Long ago you went to Egypt where you lived as foreigners. Then Assyria was cruel to you,
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan Unimbɔti gíti lī yii: «Ŋkilkaaminee, Eejipiti tiŋkin ní m-nibul nìn cūtìi kɔ́. Kí kúntée, Asuur yab wɔ́b́-bi.

english_verse: and now another nation has taken you prisoner for no reason at all. Your leaders groan with pain, and day after day my own name is cursed.
translation_verse: Too, kɔŋkɔnnee ba ní m páatì? Ti-Dindaan di lī míǹ! Bi cúú m-nibul ki cūnnì kuyuŋu kaa pàn̄ báà tiba. Bin jíń bi-pu dinyandee kūuntí nì dijajil, ní baabadalee, bi bí ki sòoǹ ki bíiĺ m-yindi. Ti-Dindaan di lī míǹ!

english_verse: My people, you will learn who I am and who is speaking because I am here. A Message of Hope for Jerusalem
translation_verse: An puee m-nibul làá dāá béé ŋwindal un ní m baasii sée. Yaadalee bi làá dāá béé yii man di sòon̄ ki bí yii: <M dòoń!>» Ti-Dindaan fātìi gítìń Jeerusaleem

english_verse: What a beautiful sight! On the mountains a messenger announces to Jerusalem, “Good news! You're saved. There will be peace. Your God is now King.”
translation_verse: Kpèè an nín ŋān̄ á ká ntuun ŋun sòoǹ ŋgbansɔŋfi bɔtee ń páanní ajoon pu puee! Ŋu sòoǹ ŋgbansɔŋfi nì dipɔɔpindi nì difiil pu. Ntuun ŋun di nàatī-ti difiil bɔtee, Jeerusaleem, ŋu bí ki tùkù-si yii: «A-Nimbɔtiu sá ubɔti!»

english_verse: Everyone on guard duty, sing and celebrate! Look! You can see the Lord returning to Zion.
translation_verse: Pīlifì binib bin a yóoǹ sintilee. Bi kpáfì dicilpu ki tátí mpɔn mpɔn, di sá yii bíǹ bi-ba nimbil ká ti-Dindaan nín fàtīi gítiń Siiyɔn tiŋkinee.

english_verse: Jerusalem, rise from the ruins! Join in the singing. The Lord has given comfort to his people; he comes to your rescue.
translation_verse: Jeerusaleem digbuŋŋi, ni-kɔkɔ ń kpāfì dicilpu kí nīn tátí mpɔn ki fàal̀! Di sá yii ti-Dindaan bíi sɔ̀ŋkī u-nibul pɔbil, u bíi fìil̄ Jeerusaleem tiŋki.

english_verse: The Lord has shown all nations his mighty strength; now everyone will see the saving power of our God. A Command To Leave Babylon
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan làá lēē u-circir pɔŋŋu kí páań mpaampiin pu atimbun kɔkɔ ń ká. Ní kitiŋ kúntilaŋki yab kɔkɔ ń dāá ká ti-Nimbɔtiu fiil. Ní yīkìmaan Babiloon tiŋkin

english_verse: Leave the city of Babylon! Don't touch anything filthy. Wash yourselves. Be ready to carry back everything sacred that belongs to the Lord.
translation_verse: Nín̄ cámaan! Nín̄ cámaan! Nyāmaan niin! Ní taa gbēēmaan tin kaa bí circiree. Nimbi bin tú ti-Dindaan diikun wantee, ní ŋámaan ni-ba circir kí nyā Babiloon tiŋkin.

english_verse: You won't need to run. No one is chasing you. The Lord God of Israel will lead and protect you from enemy attacks. The Suffering Servant
translation_verse: Min bí neeyee, naa làá nīn sáń kii ni sáń kukunsaŋuee, àá kii bi jì-nee, di sá yii ti-Dindaan di làá nīn līī ni-nyɔkɔpu, Isirayeel Nimbɔtiu di làá nīn pá ni-boon. Ti-Dindaan tɔntɔnliu

english_verse: The Lord says: My servant will succeed! He will be given great praise and the highest honors.
translation_verse: «Kpèè, án làá bútí m-tɔntɔnliu. U làá yīkì kí kàl̄ mpaan ŋun jítiǹ ipaan kɔkɔee pu, ní kí fōō tinyool.

english_verse: Many were horrified at what happened to him. But everyone who saw him was even more horrified because he suffered until he no longer looked human.
translation_verse: Binib tikpil nín ká-uee, an nìn kɔ́-bi tiwool, di sá yii u-nimbiin nìn cúu kpántì, ní waa nìn pée gíti náań nì nisaal.

english_verse: My servant will make nations worthy to worship me; kings will be silent as they bow in wonder. They will see and think about things they have never seen or thought about before.
translation_verse: Míǹ mbaantiim u-puee, án làá ŋá atimbun tikpil bitii, ní bibɔtiibi kaa dāa gíti nyí tin bi làá lèe. Di sá yii bi làá ká tin baa láá máafì-bi ki kée, ní kí dāá wāl̀ tin baa gbìl̄ dalba dalbee.»

english_verse: Has anyone believed us or seen the mighty power of the Lord in action?
translation_verse: Ŋma di fōō tibɔti tin ti gbìl̄ee ki kíí? Ŋma ní ti-Dindaan lēē u-pɔŋŋu ki dàkā?

english_verse: Like a young plant or a root that sprouts in dry ground, the servant grew up obeying the Lord. He wasn't some handsome king. Nothing about the way he looked made him attractive to us.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan nimbiin ní u wíiǹ kii disupɔmbilee, kii nsunyaan ŋun nyáń kitiŋkuliŋŋi pu ki túkúee. Waa nìn cáá kunyaaŋŋu àá jilma ubɔ kí ŋmā kí dáaĺ ti-nimbikpeeŋu. Tiba kaa nìn bí u-ni kí ŋmā kí fáatíǹ-ti.

english_verse: He was hated and rejected; his life was filled with sorrow and terrible suffering. No one wanted to look at him. We despised him and said, “He is a nobody!”
translation_verse: Binib nìn kpēē ki sīŋkiǹ-u ní ki nìn fātì bi-boon ki tīī-u. U nìn sá unil un jíń falaayee, ki nìn mántiǹ iyaliŋki. Kii unil un ní báà ubɔ kaa là kí wāl̀ee, ti nìn kpēē-u fám, kaa nìn dū-u ki yíiń tiba.

english_verse: He suffered and endured great pain for us, but we thought his suffering was punishment from God.
translation_verse: Ama an sá ti-weeŋyi ní u nìn fōō, timbi falaau ní u nìn yōoǹ ki túǹ. Ní timbi nìn dàkafī yii Unimbɔti di bíi dátí u-tafal míǹ, Unimbɔti di fáá-u ki sīntiǹ-u taapu.

english_verse: He was wounded and crushed because of our sins; by taking our punishment, he made us completely well.
translation_verse: Ama timbi yìntitam pu ní u nìn fōō tiweendi, timbi kpitii pu ní bi nìn sāaǹ-u. Ditafadaaldi din tìì ŋgbansɔŋfee jéetì u-pu. Tiweendi tin u nìn fōōyee di tìì-ti dicáaǹdi.

english_verse: All of us were like sheep that had wandered off. We had each gone our own way, but the Lord gave him the punishment we deserved.
translation_verse: Ti-kɔkɔ nìn tú ki yìiǹ kii ipiiyee, ní báà ŋma túĺ u-saŋŋu. Ama ní ti-Dindaan dū ti-kɔkɔ yìntitam tafadaaldi ki túǹ-u.

english_verse: He was painfully abused, but he did not complain. He was silent like a lamb being led to the butcher, as quiet as a sheep having its wool cut off.
translation_verse: Bi sāaǹ-u, ama ní u sīntiǹ u-ba taapu kaa wāaǹ kinyɔkɔ. Kii bi nín cáǹ upii kí kpɔ̀ puee, àá kii bi nín cēē dipibil kuti di ŋmí kaa sūǹ puee, míǹ ní u nìn ŋmí kaa wāaǹ kinyɔkɔ.

english_verse: He was condemned to death without a fair trial. Who could have imagined what would happen to him? His life was taken away because of the sinful things my people had done.
translation_verse: Bi nìn cúú-u mpɔn, ki sòon̄ u-bɔti, ki cáá-u ki búntì. U-yuntiŋu yab ŋma di nìn súń u-pu? Bi lēē u-maŋfal binifoobi tiŋkin. Bi gbáń-u u fōō tiweendi u-nibul yìntitam pu.

english_verse: He wasn't dishonest or violent, but he was buried in a tomb among cruel, rich people.
translation_verse: Bi síb́-u binikpitib kansikin. U-kaakul bí bigaajab yaŋ kansikin. Ama waa ŋá tipɔmbɔti tibaaa, nnyimɔn ŋubɔ mun kaa nyáń u-nyɔkɔn.

english_verse: The Lord decided his servant would suffer as a sacrifice to take away the sin and guilt of others. Now the servant will live to see his own descendants. He did everything the Lord had planned.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan di nìn yāntì falaa bàn̄-u. Min kamaa sii Unimbɔti dū u-maŋfal ki ŋá dibɔkpil saraau bin kíǹee puee, u làá ká u-naantiibi ní kí kàl̄ kí yúntí. Ti-Dindaan làá dī u-pu kí ŋá u nín là puee.

english_verse: By suffering, the servant will learn the true meaning of obeying the Lord. Although he is innocent, he will take the punishment for the sins of others, so that many of them will no longer be guilty.
translation_verse: U nín jíń falaa uŋyee puee, u làá dāá ká ŋwalifi ní kí nīn bí nnaamin. M-tɔntɔnliu, deedeedaan tiŋman pu yɔuee, làá yàntī binib tikpil ń kpántí deedeedambi, kun puee úǹ u-ba di fōō bi-yìntitam ki túǹ.

english_verse: The Lord will reward him with honor and power for sacrificing his life. Others thought he was a sinner, but he suffered for our sins and asked God to forgive us.
translation_verse: An puee ní m làá kàaǹ-u kí kūtì binikpaambi pu. U nì mpɔndambi di làá yàkatī tiwan tin ní bi jáń ki fōōyee. Di sá yii u dū u-maŋfal ki sú ki kpíì, ní ki kíí bi kàan̄-u ki tɔ́ binikpitibin. Tiŋman, u kíí ki túǹ binib tikpil kpitii, ní ki mēē binib bin di ŋá ikpitee yil pu.

english_verse: Sing and shout, even though you have never had children! The Lord has promised that you will have more children than someone married for a long time.
translation_verse: Unimpuŋmaŋŋmanti un kaa màl̄ ki kée, nín̄ kūuntí nì dipɔɔpindi. Sii un kaa nyí imatiŋween ki kée, nín̄ fátí iwiliili kí nīn fàal̀, di sá yii sii unimpu un a-cal cāntèe làá màal̀ mbiyaamu kí jītíǹ un cáá calee. Ti-Dindaan di lī míǹ.

english_verse: You and your descendants will take over the land of other nations. You will settle in towns that are now in ruins.
translation_verse: Di sá yii a làá wàan̄ a-tiŋki ŋŋaŋgan pú nì ŋŋaŋgiil pú, a-nibooliŋu làá fōō atimbun kí nīn kíǹ ki yì. Bi làá dāá kàl̄ ntimu mun bi dūu fée poon.

english_verse: Don't be afraid or ashamed and don't be discouraged. You won't be disappointed. Forget how sinful you were when you were young; stop feeling ashamed for being left a widow.
translation_verse: Taa fàŋkì tiba, icoo kaa làá ti cúú-si. Taa yàntī yári yari ń kɔ́-si, baa làá ti kpèè kí sìŋkīǹ-si. A làá súntí a-pɔnti cooi, aa ti làá téetí bi nín sīī-si pu ŋyunti ŋun a sá ukpiipuee.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful, the Holy God of Israel, rules all the earth. He is your Creator and husband, and he will rescue you.
translation_verse: Di sá yii un náań-see, úǹ di sá a-cal. U-yindi di sá <Ti-Dindaan Mpɔŋkɔdaan>. Un dá-si ki líìyee di sá Isirayeel Circir Nimbɔtiu, úǹ ní bi yíì yii <Kitiŋ kɔkɔ Nimbɔtiu>.

english_verse: You were like a young wife, brokenhearted and crying because her husband had divorced her. But the Lord your God says, “I am taking you back!
translation_verse: Kii unimpu un u-cal cāntèe, a nìn kɔ́ kunimbaakpaaŋŋun. Ama ti-Dindaan fātìi yíiń-si. A-Nimbɔtiu bí yii: «Unil kíikí kí fá unimpu un u cáá u-naacimpɔntineeee?»

english_verse: I rejected you for a while, but with love and tenderness I will embrace you again.
translation_verse: M nìn dū-si ki fá ŋyunti ŋubɔ poon fiii, ama m-neeŋkpaandi puee, m làá fàtīí gíiǹní-si.

english_verse: For a while, I turned away in furious anger. Now I will have mercy and love you forever! I, your protector and Lord, make this promise.” The Lord Promises Lasting Peace
translation_verse: M nìn gíí a-pu diŋuul ŋkpitim pu, ní ki nìn fātì m-kpaŋkpamboon ki tīī-si. Ama m-neendi din kaa cáá dikúntilee puee, m làá dàkà-si m-saasɔl. Man a-Dindaan un dá-si ki líìyee di lī míǹ.

english_verse: I once promised Noah that I would never again destroy the earth by a flood. Now I have promised that I will never again get angry and punish you.
translation_verse: «M làá ŋá kii Noowa yuntiŋuee ní. M nìn pōoǹ yii m kpá kí gíti yàntī nnyiŋgbeen ń dāan̄ kitiŋ pu. Míǹ mbaantiim ní díǹ nee m tí pūtì yii maa làá ti gíí diŋuul a-pu ní kaa nín kpìl̄-si.

english_verse: Every mountain and hill may disappear. But I will always be kind and merciful to you; I won't break my agreement to give your nation peace. The New Jerusalem
translation_verse: Báà ajoon yaa kpīkitì, ní ŋgbantamu yaa cīŋkì, dineendi din m cáá a-puee kpá kí kpántí, ní dipoondi din m pōoǹ-si kí yàntī á nīn bí ŋgbansɔŋfinee kpá kí kpìtī. Man a-Dindaan un dàkà-si u-saasɔlee di lī míǹ.» Jeerusaleempɔɔn

english_verse: Jerusalem, you are sad and discouraged, tossed around in a storm. But I, the Lord, will rebuild your city with precious stones; for your foundation I will use blue sapphires.
translation_verse: Jeerusaleem tiŋki unandaan, sii un ní kubuŋkpaaŋŋu cīŋkì ní ubɔ kpá kí ŋméeǹ-see. Man a-Dindaan di lī-si yii: «Kpèè, m làá fàtīí mā-si kí tɔ́kɔń ataŋkpamɔnti ŋin máǹee pu. A-nyeel làá nīn sá ataŋkpamɔnti abɔn ŋin bi yíì yii safiiree ní.

english_verse: Your fortresses will be built of rubies, your gates of jewels, and your walls of gems.
translation_verse: M làá dū ataŋkpamɔnti ŋin bi yíì yii rubiisee kí mā a-guŋŋi yilpu, ní kí dū ataŋkpamɔnti ŋin jìl̀ee kí mā a-punyɔmmu.

english_verse: I will teach your children and make them successful.
translation_verse: M làá dāá dàkà a-biyaamu kɔkɔ, ní bí dāá nīn bí ŋgbansɔŋfin.

english_verse: You will be built on fairness with no fears of injustice; every one of your worries will be taken far from you.
translation_verse: Deedee poon ní a làá dāá nīn bá kaa cìŋkī. Ubɔ kaa ti làá wɔ́b́-si jaanjaan, ní aa ti làá fàŋkì tiba mun. Ubɔ kaa ti làá fàaǹ-si, dinyoondi kaa làá ti cúú-si dalba dalba.

english_verse: I will never send anyone to attack your city, and you will make prisoners of those who do attack.
translation_verse: Ubɔ di yaa táká-see, an kaa nyánní man cee. Un kamaa di yaa táká-see, see udaan ń lítí a-nimbiin.

english_verse: Don't forget that I created metalworkers who make weapons over burning coals. I also created armies that can bring destruction.
translation_verse: Kpèè, man di náań ucaa un di fùkum̄ amɔsiŋkoon ŋmiŋu kí mɔ́ɔ́ tijanjawan tin kamaayee. Man di tí nāantí unil un ŋūǹ kí bīil̀-tèe.

english_verse: Weapons made to attack you won't be successful; words spoken against you won't hurt at all. My servants, Jerusalem is yours! I, the Lord, promise to bless you with victory.
translation_verse: Tijanjawan tin kamaa ní bi yaa mɔ́ɔ́ kí dūú já nì see, án kaa làá ŋá-si báà tiba. Ní ubɔ yaa cūnnì-si ibɔsoonee, a làá sòoǹ kí líí-u. «Difakal din man ni-Dindaan bɔ́ntì ki yóoǹ m-tɔntɔnliibee dee, m nín làá sòoǹ kí pɔ̀-bi puee dee. Man ni-Dindaan di lī míǹ.»

english_verse: If you are thirsty, come and drink water! If you don't have any money, come, eat what you want! Drink wine and milk without paying a cent.
translation_verse: Nimbi bin nnyinnyoo cááyee, dāam̄maan, nnyim bí doo! Báà ni yaa kaa cáá animbil, dāam̄maan! Dāmaan tijin kí jī, an sá faalaa ní! Dāam̄maan kí dā ndaam nì nnaabiim kí taa pà tiba.

english_verse: Why waste your money on what really isn't food? Why work hard for something that doesn't satisfy? Listen carefully to me, and you will enjoy the very best foods.
translation_verse: Ba pu ní ni jīǹ animbil tiwan tin kaa kpīintée pu? Ba pu ní ni gì digìńdi fám tiwan tin kaa díkèe pu? Ní pīlifìmaan, pīlifìmaan-mi, ní kí ká tijimmɔntiil kí jī, ní kí jī tijin tin mɔ̄ee.

english_verse: Pay close attention! Come to me and live. I will promise you the eternal love and loyalty that I promised David.
translation_verse: Ní kpòon̄ ni-tafal kí pīlifì ní kí dāan̄ m-cee, ní pīlifì ní kí dāá ká dimaŋfal. M làá pòon̄-ni dipoondi din làá nīn bí ki cá jaanjaanee, m làá ŋá-ni tiŋan tin m nìn pōoǹ Daafiidee.

english_verse: I made him the leader and ruler of the nations; he was my witness to them.
translation_verse: Kpèè, m nìn yāntì u kpántì anibul seeradaaŋwu, ki nìn kāaǹ-u ú nīn sá atimbun bɔtiu nì ŋi-kpiliu.

english_verse: You will call out to nations you have never known. And they have never known you, but they will come running because I am the Lord, the holy God of Israel, and I have honored you. God's Words Are Powerful
translation_verse: Kpèè, a làá kúuǹ kí yíiń ditimbundi din ní saa nyée, ditimbundi din kaa nyí-see làá sāǹní kí dāan̄ a-cee. Di làá sāǹní kí dāan̄ a-Dindaan a-Nimbɔtiu un sá Isirayeel Circir Nimbɔtiuee pu, di sá yii úǹ di tīī-si tinyool. Ti-Dindaan ŋáań tin u pōoǹee ní

english_verse: Turn to the Lord! He can still be found. Call out to God! He is near.
translation_verse: Nyàab̀maan ti-Dindaan, ŋyunti ŋun u ŋūǹ kí yàntī ní ká-uee. Ní yíiḿmaan-u ŋyunti ŋun ní u bí ki pìlīǹ-nee.

english_verse: Give up your evil ways and your evil thoughts. Return to the Lord our God. He will be merciful and forgive your sins.
translation_verse: Unikpiti ń fá u-saŋkpitii, ukpitiŋal ń fá u-landɔkɔkpitii. Bí gítiń ti-Dindaan cee, di sá yii u làá sɔ̄ bi-saai! Bí gítiń ti-Nimbɔtiu cee, di sá yii u pūǹ ikpiti nì dipɔbil diba ní!

english_verse: The Lord says: “My thoughts and my ways are not like yours.
translation_verse: Di sá yii ni-landɔkɔi nyáń i-ba nì man landɔkɔi, ní man saŋyi nyáń i-ba nì ni-yai, ti-Dindaan di lī míǹ.

english_verse: Just as the heavens are higher than the earth, my thoughts and my ways are higher than yours.
translation_verse: Kii kutagbɔŋu nín bíń yilpu ki dátì nì kitiŋ puee, míǹ ní m-saŋyi dátì nì ni-saŋyi, ní m-landɔkɔi dátì nì ni-yai.

english_verse: “Rain and snow fall from the sky. But they don't return without watering the earth that produces seeds to plant and grain to eat.
translation_verse: Utaa nyēeń yilpu ní ki nì ní ntaayim nyēeń yilpu ki lítí. Bi yaa kaa sɔ̄ŋkì kitiŋ, kaa tīī kitiŋ ntiŋkpam, kaa yāntì iwambool nyánnée, baa fàtīí gítí yilpu. Míǹ ní bi tìì iwambool nì tijikaal.

english_verse: That's how it is with my words. They don't return to me without doing everything I send them to do.” God's People Will Celebrate
translation_verse: Míǹ mbaantiim ní dinyɔɔbundi din nyēē m-nyɔkɔnee kaa fàtīí gítiń m-cee kaa túń ditundi din pu dì nyáńee. Dì ŋáań tin m lèe ní ki tūǹ ditundi din m dūu ŋúbiǹ-dèe.

english_verse: When you are set free, you will celebrate and travel home in peace. Mountains and hills will sing as you pass by, and trees will clap.
translation_verse: Tiŋman, nì dipɔɔpindi ní ni làá nyā Babiloon tiŋkin, ní bí fàtīí gíiǹní-ni ni-tiŋkin nì ŋgbansɔŋfi. Ni yaa láa jītée, ajoon nì ŋgbantamu dāa kūuntí nì dipɔɔpindi ní tisatin sufii kɔkɔ dāa kpáafí abaal.

english_verse: Cypress and myrtle trees will grow in fields once covered by thorns. And then those trees will stand as a lasting witness to the glory of the Lord.
translation_verse: Laakin bàà sá kukuŋkuncikuu ń nyēe, siipreesi subu di dāa nyēē niin, laakin bàà sá ŋkuŋkumbɔmu ń nyēe, miirti subu di dāa nyēē niin. Án dāa sá diyiŋkpaandi ní ki tīī ti-Dindaan, kudaaŋkpaaŋŋu kun làá nīn pée bí ki cá jaanjaanee.

english_verse: The Lord said: Be honest and fair! Soon I will come to save you; my saving power will be seen everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan nín lī puee sèé: «Nín̄ nóómaan mara kí nīn ŋáań tin bí deedeeyee. Di sá yii difiil din m làá cáańee tóob́ kí bàń dee. Án làá lēē kí dàkà-ni yii m là kí fīī-ni ní.

english_verse: Foreigners who worship me must not say, “The Lord won't let us be part of his people.” Men who are unable to become fathers must no longer say, “We are dried-up trees.”
translation_verse: Unicaan un di dū u-ba ki nákáǹ ti-Dindaanee ń taa dàkafì kí lì yii: «Báà án ŋá pu, ti-Dindaan làá nyāntí-mi u-nibul kansikin!» Ufaal mun ń taa dàkafì kí lì yii: «Man pée sá busukulimbu ní!»

english_verse: To them, I, the Lord, say: Respect the Sabbath, obey me completely, and keep our agreement.
translation_verse: Di sá yii ti-Dindaan nín lī puee sèé: «Bifaabi bin di tɔ́ m-wiŋŋuŋfikaai, ki lēē kí nīn ŋáań tin di fáatì-mi, ní ki ŋúb́ m-poondi marab tiŋanee,

english_verse: Then you will be like monuments in my temple with your names written on them. This will be much better than having children, because these monuments will stand there forever.
translation_verse: m làá cóoń-bi ditaŋkpal m-Diiku nì m-cindi poon, bí nīn cáa téetí bi-yiŋŋi pu. Án di dāa cáá kudapɔɔu ki jítiǹ jipɔmbi nì bisalib. M làá dāá tīī-bi diyindi din làá nīn pée bí ki cá jaanjaan, kaa làá kpìtī dalba dalbee.»

english_verse: Foreigners will follow me. They will love me and worship in my name; they will respect the Sabbath and keep our agreement.
translation_verse: Binicambi bin di dū bi-ba ki nákáǹ ti-Dindaan ki tɔ́-u, ki néeń-u, ki sá u-tɔntɔnliibee, ti-Dindaan nín sòon̄ bi-pu puee sɔ̀. Bi yaa tɔ́ ŋwiŋŋuŋfikaa kaa bíil̀-ŋu, ní ki ŋúb́ m-poondee,

english_verse: I will bring them to my holy mountain, where they will celebrate in my house of worship. Their sacrifices and offerings will always be welcome on my altar. Then my house will be known as a house of worship for all nations.
translation_verse: m làá dāá yàntī bí dāan̄ m-circir jool pu, ní kí dāá yàntī bí fàal̀ m-wimmeem Diikun. M làá dāá fōō saraabi nì tiwampɔkaal tin bi cāabìń ki pāantí m-saraafaŋŋu puee. Di sá yii bi làá dāá nīn yíì m-Diiku yii: <Anibul kɔkɔ wimmeem Diiku ní.>

english_verse: I, the Lord, promise to bring together my people who were taken away, and let them join the others. God Promises To Punish Israel's Leaders
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan Unimbɔti un kóoǹ Isirayeel yab ki kpáfèe nín lī puee sɔ̀. M nìn pée kóoǹ biba ki kpáfì bi-cee, m làá fàtīí kóoǹ biba mun kí kūtì. Bin kaa máaǹ kí nīn sá bikpilibee

english_verse: Come from the forest, you wild animals! Attack and gobble up your victims.
translation_verse: Nimbi ipeel in kɔkɔ kóò tisatinee, nimbi ipeel in kɔkɔ kóò kubambaŋŋunee, dāá jīmaan tijineeee!

english_verse: You leaders of Israel should be watchdogs, protecting my people. But you can't see a thing, and you never warn them. Dozing and daydreaming are all you ever do.
translation_verse: Binib bin cí Isirayeel tiŋkee kɔkɔ sá bijɔfub ní, baa pée kāntí tiba. Bi-kɔkɔ sá iboo in sá imuunee ní, iaa ŋūǹ kí gbōol̀. I tātìi dɔ̄ ki dámintí, ní ki néeń ŋgeem.

english_verse: You stupid leaders are a pack of hungry and greedy dogs that never get enough. You are shepherds who mistreat your own sheep for selfish gain.
translation_verse: Bi sá kii iboo in cáá mpooyee ní, bi jīǹ kaa díkì. Ama bíǹ di bàà sá bipikpaaliibi! Baa pée gbìl̀ tibɔti taapu báà fiii. Bi pée ŋáań tin fáatiǹ-bee ní, báà ŋma pée dàkafī u-jandi ŋmaniŋma pu ní.

english_verse: You say to each other, “Let's drink till we're drunk! Tomorrow we'll do it again. We'll really enjoy ourselves.”
translation_verse: Bi lì yii: «Dāam̄maan tí cùú nyàab̀ ndaam! Ti làá nyɔ̀ ndaam min pɔ̄ɔ̄yee kí gbí. Fool mun làá fu nín̄ bí kii díǹ nee ní, ndaam kíǹ ki wīikí tikpil!»

english_verse: God's faithful people are dragged off and killed, and no one even cares. Evil sweeps them away,
translation_verse: Bi kù deedeedambi ní an kaa ká báà ubɔ. Bibulcinnib wáŋkí ní báà ubɔ kaa kpáà béetí gba. Tiŋman, bin tɔ́ Unimbɔtee wáŋkí binikpitib toonam pu.

english_verse: but in death they find peace for obeying God. The Lord Condemns Idolatry
translation_verse: Ama ŋgbansɔŋfi làá dāan̄, ní bin nóó deedee saŋŋuee ń dòon̄ kí gèeǹ kí taa fàŋkì tiba. Ti-Dindaan bíi wòoǹ biwaatootiliibi

english_verse: You people are unfaithful! You go to fortunetellers, and you worship idols. Now pay close attention!
translation_verse: Sútiḿmaan doo nee, nimbi usoopu biyaamu. Ni sá bilaakpaadambi nì nlaakpaamu.

english_verse: Who are you making fun of? Who are you sneering at? Look how your sins have made fools of you.
translation_verse: Ŋma ní ni bèel̄ ní? Ŋma ní ni dɔ̀tī kinyɔkɔ ki nyāntí dilimbil ní? Ni lafun sá pɔɔgaatib ní, inyimɔn nibooliŋu.

english_verse: All you think about is sex under those green trees where idols are worshiped. You sacrifice your children on altars built in valleys under rocky slopes.
translation_verse: Ni mɔ̀nnì tɔb teereebinti sufii caŋin, nì busubu bun kamaa faati yaa múkúee taapu. Ni cáá mbiyaamu ki tòotī ibun nì itaŋkpalɔkɔn.

english_verse: You have chosen to worship idols made of stone; you have given them offerings of wine and grain. Should I be pleased?
translation_verse: Mbun poon taŋkpeeŋi ŋin jɔ̀m̀ pɔ́lpɔlee ní a là, ŋíǹ di sá a-gaajawammɔntiiti, Isirayeel. Ŋíǹ ní a féeń ndaam, ní ki tòotī! Ní ní bí yii tin bí nee ń sɔ̀ŋkì man pɔbilaaa?

english_verse: You have spread out your beds on the tops of high mountains, where you sacrifice to idols.
translation_verse: A bɔ́ntì a-dooŋu dijoofɔŋfɔkɔl pu. Niin ní a jɔ́ḿ ki tòotī.

english_verse: Even in your homes you have placed pagan symbols all around your huge beds. Yes, you have rejected me, sold yourselves to your lovers, and gone to bed with them.
translation_verse: A dū a-waal ki kúĺ ki lúntì dikampiil dɔŋu boon. A bāal̀-mi ní kí cúú a-wanti kí pèetī, kí jɔ̄m̀ a-dooŋu ŋun wāāyee pu. Sii nì a-bɔmbi pūtì ki pōoǹ tɔb, a-bɔmbi bin a néeń bi dɔ̀ nì si, ní a kpèé bi-ninjatee!

english_verse: You smear on olive oil and all kinds of perfume to worship the god Molech. You even seek advice from spirits of the dead.
translation_verse: A ŋúb́ ŋkpam ki cūnnì ki pú diwaal Mooleeki, ki pú-dì talaalub mun. A tú ituun i cūtì ntindandatimun, a sīntì taapu ki tin bàn̄ ditaŋkpiilin.

english_verse: Though you tired yourself out by running after idols, you refused to stop. Your desires were so strong that they kept you going.
translation_verse: A pɔ́ɔǹ tikpil ní a-pɔ́ɔǹtam yāntì a gīī. Ama aa lī yii: <M yaan pūtìi yāntì an bàà sɔ́!> A fātìi ká mpɔn mpɔmin, ní kaa yɔ̄tì a-wunti.

english_verse: Did you forget about me and become unfaithful because you were more afraid of someone else? Have I been silent so long that you no longer fear me?
translation_verse: Ŋma di yāntì dinyoondi kɔ́-si ní a fāŋkì ki mɔ́ntì nnyimɔn, ki súntì m-pu, ní kaa ti dàkafī m-pu ní? M kāl̀ diŋmiŋŋmil an yúntì. An pu ní aa nìn gíti fàŋkí-mi.

english_verse: You think you're so good, but I'll point out the truth.
translation_verse: Ama m làá bìitī a-bɔɔŋŋi pu. Aa làá ká ipaati iba tin a ŋáańee poon. Án kaa làá kèetī-si.

english_verse: Ask your idols to save you when you are in trouble. Be careful though— it takes only a faint breath to blow them over. But if you come to me for protection, this land and my holy mountain will always belong to you. The Lord Helps the Helpless
translation_verse: A yaa láa kúuǹ ki nyàab̀ dijòońdee, a-waaŋi ŋin a kóoǹ ki kpúkuǹee ń dāá fīī-si! Kubuŋu làá yòon̄ ŋi-kɔkɔ kí fá, kufoou làá kpáaǹ ŋi-kɔkɔ. Ama un kamaa di yaa sáǹ ki kɔ́-mee làá dāá fōō kitiŋ nee kí nīn kíǹ ki yì, ní kí dāá fōō m-circir jool mun. Unimbɔti nibul làá ká dicáaǹdi

english_verse: The Lord says, “Clear the road! Get it ready for my people.”
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan bí yii: «Ní gbīŋkìmaan didandi, ní cátímaan nsan malaa, ní lēēmaan aganlaka ŋin dɔ̄ m-nibul saŋŋu puee.»

english_verse: Our holy God lives forever in the highest heavens, and this is what he says: Though I live high above in the holy place, I am here to help those who are humble and depend only on me.
translation_verse: Di sá yii circir Nimbɔtiu un bí yilpu fɔ́ŋŋŋ ní u-kɔŋkooŋŋu bí kí nīn cá jaanjaanee, nín lī puee sèé: «Man Unimbɔti un bí circiree, m kóò yilpu fɔ́ŋŋŋ ní. Ama m bí bin bi wɔ́b́ bi sīntiǹ bi-ba taapuee cee. M làá tīī bin sīntiǹ bi-ba taapuee dimaŋfal, m làá tīī bin bi wɔ́b́ee dimaŋfal.

english_verse: My people, I won't stay angry and keep on accusing you. After all, I am your Creator. I don't want you to give up in complete despair.
translation_verse: Maa làá nīn kɔ́kɔĺ m-nibul kí nīn cá jaanjaan, maa làá gíí di-pu diŋuul kí nīn cáa cá talku. M yaa ŋá míǹ, binib bin m náańee kaa làá nīn gíti cáá dimaŋfal.

english_verse: Your greed made me furious. That's why I punished you and refused to be found, while you kept returning to your old sinful ways.
translation_verse: Isirayeel nimbiliŋ nín máǹ tiwan kɔkɔ pu puee yāntì u yīntì. An yāntì m gíí diŋuul, ní m-ŋuul poonee m fáá-u. M-nimbil kaa nìn gíti là kí wāl̀-u. Ama ní waa pée fātìi tɔ́ ní ki ŋá u nín là puee.

english_verse: I know what you are like! But I will heal you, lead you, and give you comfort, until those who are mourning
translation_verse: M ká u-bimbim, ama man làá cáaǹ-u. M làá kpòotī-u, ní kí sɔ̀ŋkì u-pɔbil. Bin kā dikpoolee,

english_verse: start singing my praises. No matter where you are, I, the Lord, will heal you and give you peace.
translation_verse: m làá dū inyɔŋki laŋyi kí ŋá bi-nyɔmmun. Bin bínní ndandatee ń nīn bí ŋgbansɔŋfin, bin bí kɔŋkɔmee ń nīn bí dipɔɔsɔŋkilin.» Ti-Dindaan di lī míǹ. «Tiŋman, m làá cáaǹ m-nibul!»

english_verse: But I, the Lord, have promised that none who are evil will live in peace.
translation_verse: M-Nimbɔtiu bí yii: «Binikpitib kpá kí ká ŋgbansɔŋfi!»

english_verse: Shout the message! Don't hold back. Say to my people Israel: You've sinned! You've turned against the Lord.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan di bí-mi yii: Téeń mpɔn, taa mɔ̄tì a-ba pu! Kúuǹ mpɔn kii dikantándee! Tùkù m-nibul di-yìntitam, tùkù Jaakɔb naantiibi bi-kpitii.

english_verse: Day after day, you worship him and seem eager to learn his teachings. You act like a nation that wants to do right by obeying his laws. You ask him about justice, and say you enjoy worshiping the Lord.
translation_verse: Kutaa kamaayee, bi nyàab̀-mi, ní ki là kí béé m-saŋyi. Bi bí kii ditimbundi din ŋáań tin bí deedee kaa féeń di-Nimbɔtiu marabee ní. Bi là yii ḿ nīn sòoǹ tibɔti nì deedee, ní ki là ḿ nīn pìlīǹ-bi.

english_verse: You wonder why the Lord pays no attention when you go without eating and act humble. But on those same days that you give up eating, you think only of yourselves and abuse your workers.
translation_verse: Ama ní bi bí ki lì yii: <Ba pu ní tí nīn bōob̀ kinyɔkɔ ŋyunti ŋun ní sii kaa wāĺ-tee? Ba pu ní tí sìntīǹ ti-ba taapu ŋyunti ŋun ní sii kaa nyí yii ti bíi ŋáań tibee? Niinee ní m kíí yii: Ni-nyɔɔboobil wiiŋŋuee, ni gíti tūǹ atuun ŋin cāabìń-ni ipaatee, ní ki sàantí ni-tɔntɔnliibi.

english_verse: You even get angry and ready to fight. No wonder God won't listen to your prayers!
translation_verse: Ni bōob̀ kinyɔkɔ ní ki kpákà ki jáà, ní ki gbáà tɔb aŋaŋkul. Naa ŋūǹ kí bóob́ kinyɔkɔ míǹ kí nīn kā ki cí yii bí gbìl̄ ni-nyɔkɔ pu yilpu.

english_verse: Do you think the Lord wants you to give up eating and to act as humble as a bent-over bush? Or to dress in sackcloth and sit in ashes? Is this really what he wants on a day of worship?
translation_verse: Dinyɔɔboobil din fáatì-mee nín máaǹ kí nīn bí puee deeee? Ni nín máaǹ kí sìntī ni-ba taapu puee deeee? Ní nīn tīī diyil kii kukaluuee, àá kí nīn pēē kpɔsata, àá kí nīn dɔ̄ ŋfantam poon ní? An ní ni yíì yii dinyɔɔboobilaaa, ŋwiin ŋun fáatì man ni-Dindaaneeee?

english_verse: I'll tell you what it really means to worship the Lord. Remove the chains of prisoners who are bound unjustly. Free those who are abused!
translation_verse: Dinyɔɔboobil din man lèe sèé. Á gbìntī binib bin kaa ŋá tiba bi bóob́-bi ikusakee, kí cúú diwaŋgul din nyìkī bi-puee kí nyìkitī, kí tīī bin bi wɔ́b́ee dibatɔl, an dàkà yii kí kúntí tin kɔkɔ nyìkī bi-pu baa tɔ́ bi-bee.

english_verse: Share your food with everyone who is hungry; share your home with the poor and homeless. Give clothes to those in need; don't turn away your relatives.
translation_verse: Sii nì un ŋkùm cááyee ń yàkatī a-jinti kí jī, kí fōō uwɔfi un kaa cáá kikɔlaŋee a-dumpu. Á tīī un kaa cáá kí pèen̄ee tiwan ú pèen̄. Á taa fàtī a-boon kí tīī a-nabiki.

english_verse: Then your light will shine like the dawning sun, and you will quickly be healed. Your honesty will protect you as you advance, and the glory of the Lord will defend you from behind.
translation_verse: Niinee a-walfiŋu làá nyā kí páań kii ntaafaawìińee, ní a-buuŋyi kaa làá pée sūŋkì ní kí kpú. A-baamɔŋyi di làá nīn līī a-nyɔkɔpu, ní ti-Dindaan nyooti ń nīn pá a-boon.

english_verse: When you beg the Lord for help, he will answer, “Here I am!” Don't mistreat others or falsely accuse them or say something cruel.
translation_verse: A yaa láa yíińee, ti-Dindaan làá dāá kíí-si. A yaa láa kúuǹee, u làá dāá lì yii: «M sèé!» A yaa kúntì a-tiŋkin kun nyìkī binib pu, kaa ti dàkà bin kíǹee kiŋambiki ki lāā-bi, kaa ti sòoǹ ki bíiĺ-bi,

english_verse: Give your food to the hungry and care for the homeless. Then your light will shine in the dark; your darkest hour will be like the noonday sun.
translation_verse: ki yaa ŋmìntī a-ba un ŋkùm cááyee ń ká kí jī, ki cáa kpīintí binandambee, a-walfiŋu làá nīn ŋmíntí dibɔmbɔndin, dibɔmbɔndi làá nīn sá a-cee kii ŋwiimpuee ní.

english_verse: The Lord will always guide you and provide good things to eat when you are in the desert. He will make you healthy. You will be like a garden that has plenty of water or like a stream that never runs dry.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan di làá nīn pée kpòotī-si. Báà kuteeun, u làá tīī-si á jī kí díkí ní kí tīī a-kpabiŋ mpɔn. A làá nīn sá kii bukpaa bun bi yāaǹ nnyim tiŋanee, kii nnyimbul ŋun nyim kaa fóotí jaanjaanee.

english_verse: You will rebuild those houses left in ruins for years; you will be known as a builder and repairer of city walls and streets.
translation_verse: A làá fàtīí mā adiin ŋin nìn lítèe. A làá mā-ŋi kí tɔ́kɔń adinyee ŋin bi nìn dūu fá abin abinee pu. Bi làá dāá yíiń-si yii: «Dinibul din fàtīi māā digundi, laakin bátì bátì ki lítèe, nì din ŋáŋkí kitiŋ sàmbiyaamuee.» Ŋwiŋŋuŋfikaa ŋun di fáatì Unimbɔtee

english_verse: But first, you must start respecting the Sabbath as a joyful day of worship. You must stop doing and saying whatever you please on this special day.
translation_verse: «Tí dūú ŋmàntī tin bí nee: Aa tūǹ ditundi diba ŋwiŋŋuŋfikaa dal, kaa bàntī m-circir wiiŋŋu dal. A yíì ŋwiŋŋuŋfikaa yii <Mmɔn wiiŋŋu>, ki yíì ti-Dindaan circir wiiŋŋu yii <tinyool wiiŋŋu>, ki tɔ́-ŋu kaa tūǹ diba, kaa bàntī kaa gbíntí kubɔcaau pu ŋwiin gbanti dal.

english_verse: Then you will truly enjoy knowing the Lord. He will let you rule from the highest mountains and bless you with the land of your ancestor Jacob. The Lord has spoken!
translation_verse: Niinee man a-Dindaan làá kpántí a-pɔɔpindi. M làá yàntī á còom̀ kí jītí kitiŋ nee jooŋŋi pu kii ujajilee. M làá yàntī á jī a-naanja Jaakɔb tiŋki difakal.» Tiŋman man a-Dindaan di lī míǹ.

english_verse: The Lord hasn't lost his powerful strength; he can still hear and answer prayers.
translation_verse: Kpèè, ti-Dindaan ŋal kaa bí kigiŋgiŋ kaa ŋūǹ kí fīī-ni, u-tafal mun kaa kpáá kaa ŋūǹ kí gbìl̄ tin ni sòoǹee!

english_verse: Your sins are the roadblock between you and your God. That's why he doesn't answer your prayers or let you see his face.
translation_verse: Ama an sá ni-yìntitam di cāabìń diyakatil ni nì ni-Nimbɔtiu kansikin. Ni-kpitii di yì-tì ní u fātì u-boon, kí taa gbìl̄ tin ni sòoǹee.

english_verse: Your talk is filled with lies and plans for violence; every finger on your hands is covered with blood.
translation_verse: Di sá yii ni-ŋalii táká fatiku, ní tikpitil táká ni-ŋambiyaamu. Ni cáá ni-nyɔmmu ki mɔ́ntí inyimɔn, ní ki sòoǹ ki bíiĺ ni-jutiibi.

english_verse: You falsely accuse others and tell lies in court; sin and trouble are the names of your children.
translation_verse: Ubɔ kaa yíì u-juti tibuul ki nóó deedee saŋŋu. Naa dì ibaamɔn kí mɔ̄tì ni-jutiibi pu. Ni máká tin kaa bée pu, ki sòoǹ tinyimɔmbɔti. Ni cáá ikpiti pool ní ki màl̄ nnaabu.

english_verse: You eat the deadly eggs of poisonous snakes, and more snakes crawl out from the eggs left to hatch. You weave spider webs,
translation_verse: Bi náká ukoowaati jiŋŋi pu, ki lù tinaŋgbantalindi. Un di yaa ŋmɔ́ an jiŋŋee kúù ní. Dijindi din kamaa pu ní bi yaa nákáǹee kákatí ukoobu ní.

english_verse: but you can't make clothes with those webs or hide behind them. You're sinful and brutal.
translation_verse: Bi-naŋgbantalinti kaa ŋál̀ tiwampeeŋkaal, ní unil kaa ŋūǹ kí dū tin bi lùn̄ee kí bìin̄. Atuun ŋin ní bi tūǹee sá atuŋkpiti ŋma ní, ní bi cáá bi-ŋalii ki ŋáań tipɔmbɔti ŋma!

english_verse: You hurry off to do wrong or murder innocent victims. All you think about is sin; you leave ruin and destruction wherever you go.
translation_verse: Ni sáń malaa malaa kí cùú ŋá ikpiti, ni yáb̀ kí cùú kpɔ̀ maanyiibab. Ni-landɔkɔi sá ilandɔkɔkpiti. Laakin kamaa ní ni yaa jítèee, ni ŋáań tipɔmbɔti ní ki bíiĺ tikɔkɔ.

english_verse: You don't know how to live in peace or to be fair with others. The roads you make are crooked; your followers cannot find peace. The People Confess Their Sins
translation_verse: Naa nyí ŋgbansɔŋfi saŋŋu, baa kāntí deedee laakin ní ni còom̄ee. Ni-saŋyi kɔkɔ sá in gɔ́ĺ gɔ́ĺee ní, un kamaa di yaa dī-iee kpá kí ká ŋgbansɔŋfi. Unimbɔti nibul béè yii di yīntì

english_verse: No one has come to defend us or to bring about justice. We hoped for a day of sunshine, but all we found was a dark, gloomy night.
translation_verse: An pu ní Unimbɔti kaa bíi mɔ́tí ti-pu, kaa bíi sòoǹ kí pɔ̀-ti. Ti bàà cɔ́tí kí ká ŋwalifi, ama ní ti kɔ́ dibɔmbɔndin. Ti bàà kā ki cí án nyáatí ti-pu, ama ní ti bí ki còom̄ an bɔ̀ǹ ti-pu.

english_verse: We feel our way along, as if we were blind; we stumble at noon, as if it were night. We can see no better than someone dead.
translation_verse: Ti bí ki táfí kii bijɔfub di náká digundee. Ti bí ki tìliŋkī kii bin kaa wāĺ laakin bi còom̄ ki cée. Ti gbéetí kuwiŋkaŋu pu kii ti bí ntaafaabɔmbɔminee. Ti baasii pée cáá ŋgbampɔn tiŋan, ama ní ti bí kii bitaŋkpiibee.

english_verse: How often have we sinned and turned against you, the Lord God? Our sins condemn us! We have done wrong.
translation_verse: Di sá yii ti yīntiǹ-si tikpil, ní ti-kpitii kɔ́kɔĺ-ti. Ti pée dàkafī ti-yìntitam pu ní kaa gbèentí, ti nyí ti nín ŋá-si ikpitee.

english_verse: We have rebelled and refused to follow you. Our hearts were deceitful, and so we lied; we planned to abuse others and turn our backs on you.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, ti yīntiǹ-si, ki nyáń a-boon, ti gbēeǹ kaa ti nóó sii ti-Nimbɔtiu. Ti pée sòoǹ min ní ti làá ŋá kí wɔ́b́ bin kíǹee kí já nì see ní. Ti bɔ́ntí ti-pɔbilin kí sòoǹ tinyimɔmbɔti ŋma ní.

english_verse: Injustice is everywhere; justice seems far away. Truth is chased out of court; honesty is shoved aside.
translation_verse: An pu ní bi dū ibaamɔn ki ŋá ŋkpaŋkpamboon ní taa ŋūǹ kí bà deedee laŋki. Di sá yii ibaamɔn kaa ti bí kubɔsoondiin, ní kí sòoǹ tibɔti deedeeyee kaa ti bí ku-ni.

english_verse: Everyone tells lies; those who turn from crime end up ruined. The Lord Will Rescue His People When the Lord noticed that justice had disappeared, he became very displeased.
translation_verse: Tiŋman, ibaamɔn wáŋkì, ní un là kí nīn yú deedeeyee, bi fúkuĺ-u. Ti-Dindaan làá ŋá tiba Ti-Dindaan wál̀ tíǹ kɔkɔ. U ká yii ibaamɔn kpátam kaa sá tiwammɔntiil.

english_verse: It disgusted him even more to learn that no one would do a thing about it. So with his own powerful arm, he won victories for truth.
translation_verse: U dáań ki ká yii báà uniseen kpá, an ŋá-u bitii yii ubɔ kaa pée bíi ŋáań tiba. An pu ní u lēē yii úǹ u-ba làá tɔ̄ u-tundi, u-deedeeu làá tīī-u mpɔn ú ŋá míǹ.

english_verse: Justice was the Lord's armor; saving power was his helmet; anger and revenge were his clothes.
translation_verse: U dū deedee ki pēeǹ kii dijanjabɔkutilee, ki dū difiil ki cíkiǹ kii kijanjafuuliiyee. U dū ipɔntoon bɔkutil ki pēeǹ, ní ki dū ipoompoon ki bīiǹ kii dibɔkutipaaŋkaalee.

english_verse: Now the Lord will get furious and do to his enemies, both near and far, what they did to his people.
translation_verse: U làá téeǹ báà ŋma tin u máaǹee. U-ŋuul sá ki tīī u-nannanliibi ní, ní ditafadaaldi sá ki tīī bin kaa là u-bɔtee, ki kpáaǹ gba ntimu mun nnyim māntìi túee.

english_verse: He will attack like a flood in a mighty windstorm. Nations in the west and the east will then honor and praise his wonderful name.
translation_verse: Niinee, binib làá dāá fàŋkì ti-Dindaan yindi doooo ŋwìiń jeetilaŋki, ní kí dāá fàŋkì u-nyooti doooo ŋwìiń nyalaŋki. Di sá yii ti-Dindaan làá dāá dāan̄ kii mbun ŋun nyim pùub̀ mpɔn, kubuŋkpaaŋŋu téekí-mèe ní.

english_verse: The Lord has promised to rescue the city of Zion and Jacob's descendants who turn from sin.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan làá dāan̄ Siiyɔn tiŋkin, kí fīī Isirayeel nibul poon binib bin di fá bi-kpitiiyee. Ti-Dindaan di lī míǹ.

english_verse: The Lord says: “My people, I promise to give you my Spirit and my message. These will be my gifts to you and your families forever. I, the Lord, have spoken.”
translation_verse: Ní ti-Dindaan kútì ki lī yii: «Mpèé ŋun làá nīn bí man nì bi kansikinee sèé: <M-Fam bí ni-pu, m-nyɔɔbuŋŋi kā ni-nyɔkɔn. Ŋi làá nīn sá ki tīī ni nì ni-biyaamu nì ni-naantiibi ní kí yòon̄ kɔŋkɔnnee kí nīn cáa cá jaanjaan. M kpá kí fàtīí fōō-dì.> Man ni-Dindaan di lī míǹ.»

english_verse: Jerusalem, stand up! Shine! Your new day is dawning. The glory of the Lord shines brightly on you.
translation_verse: Jeerusaleem, yīkì kí ŋmíntí, di sá yii a-walfiŋu bāań, ti-Dindaan nyooti nyáń a-pu kii ŋwìińee.

english_verse: The earth and its people are covered with darkness, but the glory of the Lord is shining upon you.
translation_verse: Tiŋman, kpèè dibɔmbɔndi bīī kitiŋ pu ní kunyeeu mɔ́ ki bīiǹ anibul pu. Ama sii puee, ti-Dindaan làá nyā kii ŋwìińee ní u-nyooti ń ŋmíntí-si.

english_verse: Nations and kings will come to the light of your dawning day. Crowds Are Coming to Jerusalem The Lord said:
translation_verse: Atimbun làá còom̀ kí dāan̄ a-walfiŋu cee, ní bibɔtiibi ń dāá dāan̄ ŋwalifi ŋun nyáń a-puee cee.

english_verse: Open your eyes! Look around! Crowds are coming. Your sons are on their way from distant lands; your daughters are being carried like little children.
translation_verse: Yáatí a-yil kí kpèè kí màntīí tū, bi-kɔkɔ kóoǹ ki kpáfì ki dòoń a-cee. A-jipɔmbi nyánní ndandati ki dòoń, binib ŋúbiń a-bisalib ki cāabìń.

english_verse: When you see this, your faces will glow; your hearts will pound and swell with pride. Treasures from across the sea and the wealth of nations will be brought to you.
translation_verse: A làá dāá ká míǹ ní án mɔ̄ɔkiǹ-si tikpil, a-pɔbil làá dāá pīil̀ ní kí sɔ̀ŋkì. Di sá yii tiŋkub gaajati làá dāá kpìntìń kí dāan̄ a-cee, ní atimbun gaajawanti ń dāá kóoǹ kí dāan̄ a-cee.

english_verse: Your country will be covered with caravans of young camels from Midian and Ephah. The people of Sheba will bring gold and spices in praise of me, the Lord.
translation_verse: Igutaamu tikpil làá dāá kóoǹní kí léeń a-pu, án dāa sá Madiyan nì Eeyifa timmu gutaamui. I-kɔkɔ làá dāá nyānní Sabaa tiŋkin ní kí dāan̄. I làá dāá nīn tú sindaariya nì talaalutuukaa, ní kí dāá nīn gà ilan ki nyɔ́ŋkí ti-Dindaan.

english_verse: Every sheep of Kedar will come to you; rams from Nebaioth will be yours as well. I will accept them as offerings and bring honor to my temple.
translation_verse: Keedaar tiŋki piii nì ki-ŋoobui làá dāá kóoǹní kí kpāfì a-nimbiin. A dāa ŋūǹ kí dū Neebayɔti tiŋki pijaai kí ŋá a nín là puee. Bi làá dāá cáá-i kí jɔ̄m̀ m-saraafaŋŋu pu, ní ḿ dāá fōō saraabi bin a làá dū-i kí ŋée. M làá dāá nyāantì m-diiku ní kí tīī-ku tinyool.

english_verse: What is that sailing by like clouds or like doves flying home?
translation_verse: Bilab di bínní lapu nee ní? Bi ŋàaǹ kii atagbanee, a lì kii abeenanjil di ŋàaǹ ki cá ŋi-diiŋŋi watil púee.

english_verse: On those distant islands your people are waiting for me, the Lord. Seagoing ships lead the way to bring them home with their silver and gold. I, the holy Lord God of Israel, do this to honor your people, so they will honor me. Jerusalem Will Be Rebuilt The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ntimu mun nnyim māntìi túee máká m-pu. Taarsiisi tiŋki meelab di līiń nyɔkɔpu ki cāabìń a-jipɔmbi bin bíń ndandatee, nì bi-nimbiliŋ nì bi-sindaariyau. Bi dòoń kí tīī ti-Dindaan a-Nimbɔtiu tinyool, kí tīī Isirayeel Circir Nimbɔtiu tinyool, di sá yii úǹ di tīī-si jilma gbanti.

english_verse: Jerusalem, your city walls will be rebuilt by foreigners; their rulers will become your slaves. I punished you in my anger; now I will be kind and treat you with mercy.
translation_verse: Binicambi di làá fàtīí mā a-guŋŋi ní bi-bɔtiibi ń dāá nīn bí a-tundin. Di sá yii m-ŋuul poonee m nìn dáaĺ a-tafal, ama m-niti poonee, m làá dàkà-si m-saasɔl.

english_verse: Your gates will be open day and night to let the rulers of nations lead their people to you with all their treasures.
translation_verse: A-punyɔmmu dāa pée wāā ní. Mu làá dāá nīn pée wāā ní ŋwiimpu nì kunyeeu. Niinee ní bí dāá cáań atimbun ŋin kíǹee gaajati kí kɔ́ǹní, ŋi-bɔtiibi dāa pá tɔb pu kí kɔ́nní.

english_verse: Any nation or kingdom that refuses to serve you will be wiped out.
translation_verse: Atimbun nì abee ŋin làá dāá yíí kí taa nín̄ bí a-tundinee làá dāá wāŋkì. Atimbun gbanti làá dāá nàan̄ ní pílpil.

english_verse: Wood from Lebanon's best trees will be brought to you— the pines, the firs, and the cypress trees. It will be used in my temple to make beautiful the place where I rest my feet.
translation_verse: Leebanɔn tiŋki nyooti làá dāá dāan̄ a-cee, ki kpáaǹ idɔpiŋkaa kɔkɔ dicilpu. I làá yàntī m-circir kɔŋkooŋŋu ń nīn ŋān̄. Míǹ ní m làá ŋá kí tīī laakin m-taaŋi yūlifée tinyool.

english_verse: The descendants of enemies who hated and mistreated you will kneel at your feet. They will say, “You are Zion, the city of the Lord, the holy One of Israel.”
translation_verse: Binib bin nìn ŋúb́-si ki sàantée jipɔmbi làá dāá dāan̄ kí sìntīǹ bi-ba taapu kí tīī-si. Bin kɔkɔ nìn kpèé-si fámee làá dāá gbàan̄ a-taaŋi taapu. Bi làá dāá yíiń-si yii <Ti-Dindaan tiŋki>, <Isirayeel Circir Nimbɔtiu jool Siiyɔn!>

english_verse: You were hated and deserted, rejected by everyone. But I will make you beautiful, a city to be proud of for all time to come.
translation_verse: Bi nìn dū-si ki fá, kaa nìn là a-bɔti, ní báà ubɔ kaa nìn gíti dòoń a-cee. Kɔŋkɔnnee m làá nyāantì-si ní binib ń nīn fàal̀ a-pu kí nīn cá abin abin.

english_verse: You will drain the wealth of kings and foreign nations. You will know that I, the mighty Lord God of Israel, have saved and rescued you.
translation_verse: Atimbun ŋin kíǹee di làá dāá kpíiǹ-si ní á dāá jī bibɔtiibi gaajawanti. Niin ní a làá dāá béé yii man a-Dindaan di sá a-Fiiliu, un dá-si ki líìyee di sá Jaakɔb Nimbɔtiu Mpɔŋkɔdaan.

english_verse: I will bring bronze and iron in place of wood and stone; in place of bronze and iron, I will bring gold and silver. I will appoint peace and justice as your rulers and leaders.
translation_verse: An nín bàà sá ḿ cáań tasa kútee, sindaariya ní m làá cáań. An nín bàà sá ḿ cáań tikútee, animbil kúti ní m làá cáań. An nín bàà sá ḿ cáań idɔee, tasa kúti ní m làá cáań. An nín bàà sá ḿ cáań ataŋkpeeyee, tikúti ní m làá cáań. Man puee, ŋgbansɔŋfi di làá nīn kpòotī-ni ní deedee ń nīn sá ni-kpiliu.

english_verse: Violence, destruction, and ruin will never again be heard of within your borders. “Victory” will be the name you give to your walls; “Praise” will be the name you give to your gates.
translation_verse: Baa làá ti gbìl̄ bi sòoǹ tipɔmbɔti pu a-tiŋkin, kaa làá ti gbìl̄ bi sòoǹ dinàandi àá dibiildi pu a-tiŋki kpaanyɔmmu poon. A làá dāá nīn yíì a-guŋŋi yii <Difiil>, kí dāá nīn yíì a-punyɔmmu yii <Inyɔŋki>.

english_verse: You won't need the light of the sun or the moon. I, the Lord your God, will be your eternal light and bring you honor.
translation_verse: An kaa ti làá nīn sá ŋwìiń di làá nīn ŋmíntí-si ŋwiimpu, àá uŋmal kunyeeu. Man ni-Dindaan a-Nimbɔtiu di làá nīn sá-si ŋwalifi kí nīn cá jaanjaan, ní kí nīn ŋmíntí-si nì m-walifiŋu kɔkɔ.

english_verse: Your sun will never set or your moon go down. I, the Lord, will be your everlasting light, and your days of sorrow will come to an end.
translation_verse: Kí yòon̄ kí nīn cée, a-wìiŋ́ŋu kaa làá ti jēetí, ní a-ŋmaliu kaa làá ti wāŋkì. Di sá yii man a-Dindaan di làá nīn kíǹ ki sá-si ŋwalifi kí nīn cá jaanjaan. Iwiin in a dūu kāl̀ dikpoolee làá kúntí.

english_verse: Your people will live right and always own the land; they are the trees I planted to bring praise to me.
translation_verse: A-nibul kɔkɔ làá dāá nīn sá deedeedambi, bi làá dāá fōō kitiŋ difakal kí nīn cá jaanjaan. M dū m-ŋalii ki máń-bi bí lēē m-nyooti kí dàkà. Bi sá kii busubu bun man m-ba cóoǹee ní.

english_verse: Even the smallest family will be a powerful nation. I am the Lord, and when the time comes, I will quickly do all this.
translation_verse: Ni-kansikin un pée sá kiwaayee làá dāá màal̀ binib kutuku, ní un kaa bí tibanee ń dāá kpántí ditimbundi din pɔ̄ɔ̄yee baa. Ŋyunti yaa láa bāańee, man ni-Dindaan làá dāá yàntī tibɔti gbanti ń jītí malaa malaa.

english_verse: The Spirit of the Lord God has taken control of me! The Lord has chosen and sent me to tell the oppressed the good news, to heal the brokenhearted, and to announce freedom for prisoners and captives.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan Unimbɔti Fam bí m-pu. Tiŋman, u lēē-mi ḿ sòoǹ tibɔmɔntiil kí tīī biwɔfib. U túnní-mi ḿ cáaǹ bin pɔbiliŋ bíil̀ee, kí bāakì kí tùkù bin bi cúú kuyuŋuee yii bi làá líí-bi, kí tùkù bisarkadambi yii bi làá ká dibatɔl.

english_verse: This is the year when the Lord God will show kindness to us and punish our enemies. The Lord has sent me to comfort those who mourn,
translation_verse: U túnní-mi ḿ bāakì kí tùkù binib yii: «Dibindi din ní ti-Dindaan làá sɔ̄ bi-saayee sèé! Ŋwiin ŋun ní ti-Dindaan làá tɔ̀ u-nannanliibi ipɔntoonee sèé! U túnní-mi ḿ sɔ̀ŋkì bin kā dikpoolee pɔbil.

english_verse: especially in Jerusalem. He sent me to give them flowers in place of their sorrow, olive oil in place of tears, and joyous praise in place of broken hearts. They will be called “Trees of Justice,” planted by the Lord to honor his name.
translation_verse: Siiyɔn pu ní bi kā dikpool. M làá pítí ŋfantam min bi dūu pùkū bi-yilee kí dū ŋŋaamɔnti kí fìn̄ bi-yiliŋ. M làá cúú kpɔsata kí pèetī-bi ní kí dū ŋkpam min sɔ́fèe kí ŋmìtī-bi. M làá dū dijiŋaabɔkutil kí pèen̄-bi ní dí fōō diwuŋyɔtil paaŋŋu. Niinee bi làá dāá yíiń-bi yii isufi in tìì Unimbɔti tinyoolee, bukpaa bun dàkà ti-Dindaan nyootee.

english_verse: They will hire foreigners to take care of their sheep and their vineyards.
translation_verse: Binicambi làá dāá dāan̄ kí nīn kpàá ni-piii nì ni-ŋoobui. Laaba nib làá dāá dāan̄ kí nīn kù ni-sati nì ni-fiinyi kpaaŋŋi.

english_verse: But they themselves will be priests and servants of the Lord our God. The treasures of the nations will belong to them, and they will be famous.
translation_verse: Nimbee, bi làá dāá yíiń-ni yii <Ti-Dindaan saraaŋaliibi>. Bi làá dāá nīn yíì-ni yii <Ti-Nimbɔtiu tɔntɔnliibi>. Ni làá dāá jī atimbun nib gaajawanti pu, ní kí dāá nīn gà ni-biŋŋi bi-gaajati pu.

english_verse: I, the Lord, love justice! But I hate robbery and injustice. My people, I solemnly promise to reward you with an eternal agreement.
translation_verse: Di sá yii man ni-Dindaan néeń ibaamɔn bɔti ní, m ná bunaayubu nì tin kaa bí deedeeyee. M làá dāá pà-ni ni-paati nín pée sá puee ní deedee, m làá dāá yóoń man nì ni kansikin mpèé ŋun làá nīn bí ki cá jaanjaanee.»

english_verse: Your descendants will be known in every nation. All who see them will realize that they have been blessed, by me, the Lord. Celebrate and Shout
translation_verse: Ni-naantiibi làá dāá nyā diyindi atimbun ŋin kíǹee kɔkɔ poon, binib làá dāá béé-bi anibul kansikin. Bin kɔkɔ di yaa láa pée ká-bee làá dāá béé yii bíǹ di sá dinibul din boon ti-Dindaan bīiǹee. Ijaam laŋŋu

english_verse: I celebrate and shout because of my Lord God. His saving power and justice are the very clothes I wear. They are more beautiful than the jewelry worn by a bride or groom.
translation_verse: An mɔ̄ǹ-mi tikpil m-Dindaan pu, m bí dipɔɔpindin m-Nimbɔtiu pu. Di sá yii u dū difiil ki pēeǹ-mi kii dibɔkutilee, ní ki dū u-deedeeu ki bīiǹ m-pu kii dibɔkutipaaŋkaalee kii unimpucaan cal un di dū jiŋaal ŋaabuŋu ki fìn̄ u-yilee, a lì kii unimpucaan di dū abeedimbil ki nyáantì u-bee.

english_verse: The Lord will bring about justice and praise in every nation on earth, like flowers blooming in a garden.
translation_verse: Tiŋman, kii kitiŋ nín yàntī tiwan ń pā kí nyā pu, ní bukpaa ń yàntī ŋwambool ń nyā puee, míǹ ní ti-Dindaan làá yàntī deedee nì inyɔŋki ń pā kí nyā atimbun kɔkɔ nimbiin.

english_verse: Your great victory will be seen by every nation and king; the Lord will even give you a new name.
translation_verse: Atimbun làá dāá ká a-deedeeu, ní bibɔtiibi kɔkɔ ń dāá ká a-nyooti. Bi làá dāá páań-si diyindi din ní a-Dindaan làá dāá lēē bí nīn yíì-see.

english_verse: You will be a glorious crown, a royal headband for the Lord your God.
translation_verse: A làá dāá nīn sá kii kibeefuulii kinyaaŋŋi a-Dindaan ŋaan, ní kí nīn sá ubɔti ŋaayilkaaŋu a-Nimbɔtiu ŋaan.

english_verse: Your people will take the land, just as a young man takes a bride. The Lord will be pleased because of you, just as a husband is pleased with his bride.
translation_verse: Kii unaacimpɔɔn nín cāab̀ usapɔɔn puee, míǹ mbaantiim ní bin làá dāá fàtīí mā-see làá dāá nīn sá a-cal. Kii unimpucaan bɔti nín mɔ̄ǹ u-cal puee, míǹ ní a-bɔti làá dāá nīn mɔ̄ǹ a-Nimbɔtiu.

english_verse: Jerusalem, on your walls I have stationed guards, whose duty it is to speak out day and night, without resting. They must remind the Lord
translation_verse: Jeerusaleem, m kāaǹ biciitiliibi a-guŋŋi pu. An yaa sá ŋwiimpuɔɔɔ, kunyeeuɔɔɔ, baa pée máaǹ kí nīn kā ki ŋmí. «Nimbi bin di téetí ti-Dindaan Jeerusaleem puee, ní taa ŋùŋfì.

english_verse: and not let him rest till he makes Jerusalem strong and famous everywhere.
translation_verse: Ní taa pée yàntī ú ŋùŋfì kí tin sāā ŋyunti ŋun u làá dāá fàtīí yòon̄ Jeerusaleem tiŋki yilpu ní duulinya kɔkɔ ń nīn nyɔ́ŋkí-kèe.»

english_verse: The Lord has given his word and made this promise: “Never again will I give to your enemies the grain and grapes for which you struggled.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan pūtì ki pōoǹ yii: «Man ni-Dindaan un sá Mpɔŋkɔdaanee nín lī puee sɔ̀. Dalba dalba maa làá ti dū a-kpaajinti kí tīī a-nannanliibi bí jī, dalba dalba binicambi kaa làá ti nyɔ̀ a-damam min a gīī digìńdi ki kée.

english_verse: As surely as you harvest your grain and grapes, you will eat your bread with thankful hearts, and you will drink your wine in my temple.”
translation_verse: Ama bin cáń tikpaajinee di làá dāá jī-tì ní kí dāá nyɔ̄ŋkì man ni-Dindaan. Bin di yaa láa kītì fiinyi subiliŋee di làá dāá nyɔ̀ ŋi-damam m-Circir kɔŋkooŋŋu cindin.»

english_verse: People of Jerusalem, open your gates! Repair the road to the city and clear it of stones; raise a banner to help the nations find their way.
translation_verse: Jeerusaleem yab, nyāmaan, ní nyāmaan kitiŋin malaa. Ní cátímaan nsan m-nibul ń dī. Ní gbīŋkìmaan abɔbil didandi pu kí kóom̀maan ataŋkpee kí fá ní kí cóoḿmaan kiŋaabiki anibul nimbiin.

english_verse: Here is what the Lord has said for all the earth to hear: “Soon I will come to save the city of Zion and to reward you.
translation_verse: Tibɔti tin ti-Dindaan sòon̄ bi tin gbìl̄-tì doooo kitiŋ kuntilaŋkee sèé: «Ní tùkùmaan Siiyɔn tiŋki yii: <Kpèè a-Fiiliu di dòońee. Kpèè úǹ di dòoń ki ŋúbiń u-paatee, u-tundi paatii di līiń u-nyɔkɔpuee.>

english_verse: Then you will be called, ‘The Lord's Own People, The Ones He Rescued!’ Your city will be known as a good place to live and a city full of people.”
translation_verse: Bi làá dāá yíiń a-nib yii <Dinibul din di bí circiree>, <binib bin ní ti-Dindaan dá ki líìyee>. Baa ti làá yíiń-si yii <kitiŋ kin bi dūu fée>, bi làá dāá nīn kíǹ ki yíì-si yii <Kitinneeŋkaai ní>».

english_verse: Who is this coming from Bozrah in Edom with clothes stained red? Who is this hero marching in his glorious uniform? “It's me, the Lord! I have won the battle, and I can save you!”
translation_verse: Ŋma di nyánní Eedoom tiŋkin, Bɔsiraa, ki-tiŋyilin ní? Udaan wampeeŋkaati jōotì mmam. U pēē tiwampeeŋkaal tinyaandi ki còom̄ diyil gáań ki máká u-pɔŋŋu pu. Ti-Dindaan bí yii: «An sá man di sòoǹ binib bɔti nì deedee, m cáá mpɔn kí fīī-ni.»

english_verse: What are those red spots? Your clothes look stained from trampling on grapes.
translation_verse: «Ba pu ní a-bɔkutil jōotì mmam, ní a-wampeeŋkaati náań nì unil un tà ki fɔ́bití fiinyi subiliŋ kubɔbikunee?»

english_verse: “I alone trampled the grapes! None of the nations helped. I trampled nations in my anger and stained my clothes with their blood.
translation_verse: «Man baba di tāā ki fɔ́bitì fiinyi subilŋ kubɔbikun. Anibul kansikin, báà uniseen kaa nìn kútì m-pu. M tàn̄ ki mátì-bi m-ŋuul poon, ní ki nàn̄-bi m-bum poon. Bi-fatikuu yāaǹ m-bɔkutiŋ pu, ní m-wampeeŋkaati kɔkɔ mántì.

english_verse: I did this because I wanted to take revenge— the time had come to rescue my people.
translation_verse: Di sá yii m lēē m-pɔbilin kí tɔ̀ ipɔntoon ní. Ŋyunti bāań ḿ fīī m-nibul kí líí.

english_verse: No one was there to help me or to give support; my mighty arm won the battle, strengthened by my anger.
translation_verse: M nìn kpēē ama kaa ká ubɔ ń tūtuǹ-mi. An nìn ŋá-mi bitii. Ubɔ kaa nìn bí kí tíkiń-mi. Niinee ní m-ŋal pɔŋŋu tútuǹ-mi, ní m-ŋuukpaandi tīī-mi mpɔn.

english_verse: In my fury I trampled on nations and made them drunk; their blood poured out everywhere on earth.” The Lord's Goodness to His People
translation_verse: M-ŋuul poonee m nàn̄ anibul kunaau, m nyūntì-bi m-bum kii ndaamee bi gbí, ní ki yāntì bi-fatikuu pùub̄ kitiŋ.» Ti-Dindaan nín ŋáań u-nibul tiŋan tiŋyee

english_verse: I will tell about the kind deeds the Lord has done. They deserve praise! The Lord has shown mercy to the people of Israel; he has been kind and good.
translation_verse: M làá téetí ti-Dindaan ŋanti nì tin pu ti máaǹ kí nyɔ̄ŋkì-uee pu: tin kɔkɔ ti-Dindaan ŋá ki tīī-tee, tiŋaŋkpaandi tin u ŋá ki tīī Isirayeel nibulee, tin kɔkɔ u ŋá u-neendin, nì u-laŋŋaŋfitiikuee pu.

english_verse: The Lord rescued his people, and said, “They are mine. They won't betray me.”
translation_verse: U nìn lī yii: «Bi lafun sá m-nibul ní, bi sá m-jipɔmbi bin kaa làá mɔ̄ntì-mee ní.» U nìn kpántì bi-fiiliu.

english_verse: It troubled the Lord to see them in trouble, and his angel saved them. The Lord was truly merciful, so he rescued his people. He took them in his arms and carried them all those years.
translation_verse: Bi-nimbinaamandi kamaa poonee, an kaa nìn sá ntuun ŋubɔ di fīī-bi, ama ti-Dindaan u-ba di nìn fīī-bi. U-neendi nì u-saasɔl poonee, u nìn fīī-bi ki líì. U nìn yōoǹ-bi ki túǹ kii iyunti in nìn jítèe poonee.

english_verse: Then the Lord's people turned against him and made his Holy Spirit sad. So he became their enemy and attacked them.
translation_verse: Ama bíǹ nìn jáń nì u, ní ki nìn kɔ́ǹ u-Circir Fam kunimbaau. Niinee ní ti-Dindaan dūu kpántì bi-nannanliu, ní ki kíĺ ki bíi jáà nì bi.

english_verse: But his people remembered what had happened during the time of Moses. Didn't the Lord bring them and their leaders safely through the sea? Didn't he give them his Holy Spirit?
translation_verse: Niinee ní u-nibul téetì iyunti in jítèe pu, iyunti in Mooyiisi nìn bí di-ceeyee pu ki lī yii: «Un di nìn nyántì u-picaŋkpuŋku nì u-pikpaaliu dimɔɔlinee bí la? Un di nìn yāntì u-Circir Fam bí bi-kansikinee bí la ní?

english_verse: The glorious power of the Lord marched beside Moses. The Lord will be praised forever for dividing the sea.
translation_verse: Úǹ di nìn tāntì u-ŋampɔfiŋu ki cúú Mooyiisi ŋaŋgiil ki tíkiǹ-u. Úǹ di nìn cúú nnyim ki yākatì mili bi-nimbiin, ní ki nyáń diyindi kí nīn cá jaanjaan.

english_verse: He led his people across like horses running wild without stumbling.
translation_verse: U nìn yāntì bi cōom̀ tiŋku un nyóòyee poon ki dūtì kii utaamu un sáń kuteeunee, kaa nìn gbéetì ki lítì.

english_verse: His Spirit gave them rest, just as cattle find rest when led into a valley. The name of the Lord was praised for doing these things. A Prayer for Mercy and Help
translation_verse: Bi nìn náań nì tiwaŋkuti tin sìntī ditantakalinee ní. Ti-Dindaan Fam nìn kpòotī-bi ki cáǹ diŋuŋfil laŋki ní.» Míǹ ní ti-Dindaan, a nìn kpōotì a-nibul ki nyáń diyiŋkpaandi. Isirayeel yab mēē ki gbāam̀ bi-Dindaan

english_verse: Please, Lord, look down from your holy and glorious home in the heavens and see what's going on. Have you lost interest? Where is your power? Show that you care about us and have mercy!
translation_verse: Kpèeń doooo yilpu, circir paaŋŋu nì laakin cáá kunyaaŋŋu a kóòyee. Kpèè tin bíi jītí ti-puee. A-neendi din nìn fòol̄ ti-pu lìblibee bí la? A-pɔŋŋuee bí la? A-poommɔŋŋu nì a-laŋŋaŋfitiikuee bí la?

english_verse: Our ancestors Abraham and Jacob have both rejected us. But you are still our Father; you have been our protector since ancient times.
translation_verse: Di sá yii sii di sá ti-Baa. Abraam kaa nyí timbi, Jaakɔb mun kaa nyí-ti. Sii ti-Dindaan di sá ti-Baa, sii ní bi yíì doooo jaanjaan yii <Ti-Fiiliu>.

english_verse: Why did you make us turn away from you, our Lord? Why did you make us want to disobey you? Please change your mind! We are your servants, your very own people.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan, ba ŋá ní a yāntì ti wáŋkì ki fá a-saŋyi, ki yāntì ti-pɔbiliŋ tīlifì taa ti fàŋkí-si míǹ? Dineendi din a cáá timbi a-tɔntɔnliibi bin sá a-nibulee puee, fàtīí gítiń.

english_verse: For a little while, your temple belonged to us; and now our enemies have torn it down.
translation_verse: Timbi a-circir nibul, taa kpáàa kāl̀ kitiŋ kin a tīī-tee ni ki yúntì. Ti-nannanliibi nàn̄ a-circir paaŋŋu dúsi dusi.

english_verse: Be a spark that starts a fire causing water to boil. Then your enemies will know who you are; all nations will tremble because you are nearby.
translation_verse: a yaa láa ŋá titumbilindi tin baa láá ká ki kée. Tiŋman, a làá kpákatiń ní ajoon ń cìŋkì a-nimbiin.

english_verse: You are the only God ever seen or heard of who works miracles for his followers.
translation_verse: A túŋkí unil un tūǹ deedee tuuŋŋi nì mmɔnee, nì binib bin téetí a-pu ki nóó a-saŋŋuee. Ti-yìntitam puee, a gíí diŋuul. Ama isan gbanti pu ní ti làá ká difiil.

english_verse: You help all who gladly obey and do what you want, but sin makes you angry. Only by your help can we ever be saved.
translation_verse: Ti-kɔkɔ nìn sá kii unil un kɔ́ tijɔkɔndee, ní ti-tummɔntiŋ kɔkɔ cáá titantan kii ticaliŋkpun tin bi dūu pítì fatikuee. Ti-kɔkɔ pée kūń kii tifaalee, ní ti-kpitii yòontí-ti ki féeń kii kubuŋuee.

english_verse: We are unfit to worship you; each of our good deeds is merely a filthy rag. We dry up like leaves; our sins are storm winds sweeping us away.
