english_verse: You people in Judah and Jerusalem have been unfaithful to the Lord. You have disgraced the temple that he loves, and you have committed the disgusting sin of marrying the worshipers of other gods.
translation_verse: Juuda yab kaa yúl̀ deedee. Bi túń ntimbiil tuuŋŋi Jeerusaleem tiŋkin nì Isirayeel timmu kɔkɔ poon. Di sá yii bi kpēē ki sīŋkiǹ circir kɔŋkooŋŋu ŋun ti-Dindaan néeń tikpilee. Bi cáá binimpoobi bin nóó awaayee.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will no longer let those who are guilty belong to his people, even if they eagerly decide to offer the Lord a gift.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan ń nyāntí unil un ŋáań mimmee nì u-dicaŋku kɔkɔ Isirayeel nibul kansikin. Ú nyāntí kí kpáaǹ un cāabìń saraabi u-yindi pu ki tìì ti-Dindaan Mpɔŋkɔdaanee.

english_verse: And what else are you doing? You cry noisily and flood the Lord's altar with your tears, because he isn't pleased with your offerings and refuses to accept them.
translation_verse: Tin ni gíti ŋáańee sèé: «Ni-nyinnyim gbéè ti-Dindaan saraafaŋŋu pu, ni sūǹ ki yáliŋkí, di sá yii waa ti fàtīí tɔ̄ ni-saraabi, kaa tí fòol̄-bi.

english_verse: And why isn't God pleased? It's because he knows that each of you men has been unfaithful to the wife you married when you were young. You promised that she would be your partner, but now you have broken that promise.
translation_verse: Ní ni bàlifī yii ba pu ní an bí míǹ? Kun puee ni nìn pōoǹ u-nimbiin yii ni làá yūĺ nì ni-taafaanimpuu deedee. Ama ní ni nyáń u-boon. Unimpu gbanti mun di nìn sá ni-ŋàliŋu ní ni nìn pōoǹ-u dipoondi.

english_verse: Didn't God create you and your wife to become like one person? And why did he do this? It was so you would have children, and then lead them to become God's people. Don't ever be unfaithful to your wife.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan kaa yāntì ni nì u kpántì unibaanti ki cáá tiwumbaantiil nì kufoou kubaantiiuaaa? Ní unibaantee nyàab̀ ba? U nyàab̀ mmaabùti ŋun Unimbɔti tììyee. Ní nīn nyíǹ ni-ba tiŋan. Ubɔ ń taa nyā u-taafaanimpuu boon.

english_verse: The Lord God All-Powerful of Israel hates anyone who is cruel enough to divorce his wife. So take care never to be unfaithful!
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan Isirayeel Nimbɔtiu di lī yii, unil un jìn̄ u-nimpuu kináŋee, udaan ŋá tipɔmbɔti dee, ti-Dindaan Mpɔŋkɔdaan di lī míǹ. Ní nīn nyí nì ni-ba kí taa nyā ni-pooŋyi boon.» Ti-Dindaan làá tɔ̄ń u-tuuŋŋu

english_verse: You have worn out the Lord with your words. And yet, you ask, “How did we do that?” You did it by saying, “The Lord is pleased with evil and doesn't care about justice.”
translation_verse: Ni nín sòoǹ puee, ni kɔ̄ntí ti-Dindaan digìńdi. Ni lì yii: «Nì mana ní ti kɔ̄ntí-u digìńdi?» An sá ni nín lì yii: <Bin ŋáań ikpitee ŋān̄ ti-Dindaan cee, ní bi-bɔti fáatì-u.> Ni gíti lì mun yii: <Unimbɔti un sòoǹ tibɔti deedeeyee bí la?>

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, will send my messenger to prepare the way for me. Then suddenly the Lord you are looking for will appear in his temple. The messenger you desire is coming with my promise, and he is on his way. A Day of Change
translation_verse: Kpèè, m làá tɔ̄ń m-tɔntɔnliu. U làá cátí nsan ń dòon̄ m-nimbiin. Dicilpu dicilpu ni-Dindaan un ni nyàab̀ee làá dāan̄ kí kɔ́ u-diikun. Kpèèmaan dipoondi tuuŋŋu ŋun ni kā ki cée. Ŋu dòoń. Ti-Dindaan Mpɔŋkɔdaan di lī míǹ.

english_verse: On the day the Lord comes, he will be like a furnace that purifies silver or like strong soap in a washbasin. No one will be able to stand up to him.
translation_verse: U yaa láa bāańee, ŋma dāa ŋūǹ kí ŋmátí? Ŋma di dāa ŋūǹ kí yūĺ u-nimbiin. U yaa láa páaǹnée, ŋma dāa ŋūǹ kí nīn yú u-taaŋi pu? Di sá yii u bí kii ŋŋmi ŋun dùntī tikútee ní, a lì kii un fíntí tiwanee fɔfɔuee.

english_verse: and the offerings of the people of Judah and Jerusalem will please him, just as they did in the past. Don't Cheat God
translation_verse: Ŋyunti gbantee, ti-Dindaan dāa fòol̄ Jeerusaleem yab nì Juuda yab bin kíǹee saraabi kii dooooyee, abin ŋin jítèe.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful said: I'm now on my way to judge you. And I will quickly condemn all who practice witchcraft or cheat in marriage or tell lies in court or rob workers of their pay or mistreat widows and orphans or steal the property of foreigners or refuse to respect me.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan Mpɔŋkɔdaan nín lī puee sèé: <M làá dāá dāan̄ ni-kansikin kí sòoǹ ni-bɔti. M làá dāá sòoǹ kí kpɔ̀ bikpaŋkpantiibi nì bilaakpaadambi nì bin pùtī fám fámee, nì bin di mùul̄ bipaadambi nì bikpiipoobi nì ataŋkpiibilee, nì bin di kaa fàŋkí-mi ki sàantí unicaanee. Ti-Dindaan Mpɔŋkɔdaan di lī míǹ. Gítiḿmaan ti-Dindaan cee

english_verse: Descendants of Jacob, I am the Lord All-Powerful, and I never change. That's why you haven't been wiped out,
translation_verse: Man ni-Dindaan, maa kpántí, ní nimbee, ni pée gbíntìi sá Jaakɔb naantiibi ní.

english_verse: even though you have ignored and disobeyed my laws ever since the time of your ancestors. But if you return to me, I will return to you. And yet you ask, “How can we return?”
translation_verse: Ni kākatì ki wāatì m-dàkatam kaa nóó-bi kii ni-naanjab nín nìn ŋá puee. Fàtīí gítiḿmaan m-cee, ní ma mun ń fàtīí gítiń ni-cee. Man ni-Dindaan Mpɔŋkɔdaan di lī míǹ. Ama ní ni lì yii: <Nì mana ní tí fàtīí gítiń a-cee?

english_verse: You people are robbing me, your God. And, here you are, asking, “How are we robbing you?” You are robbing me of the offerings and of the ten percent that belongs to me.
translation_verse: Unil ŋūǹ kí mɔ̄ntì Unimbɔtaaa? Ama ní nimbi bí ki mɔ́ntí-mi. Ni gíti bālifì-mi yii: <Tilati poon ní ti mɔ́ntí-si.> Ni mɔ́ntí-mi tisaalaatiil nì saraabi poon.

english_verse: That's why your whole nation is under a curse.
translation_verse: Mbusu jéetì ni-pu kun puee ni mɔ́ntí-mi, nimbi dinibul nee.

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful, and I challenge you to put me to the test. Bring the entire ten percent into the storehouse, so there will be food in my house. Then I will open the windows of heaven and flood you with blessing after blessing.
translation_verse: Cáaḿmaan tisaalaatiil nín sá puee m-diikun tijin ń nīn bí baabadal kí taa dóó. Ti-Dindaan Mpɔŋkɔdaan di lī yii: <Cɔ̄ŋkìmaan-mi tibɔti gbanti pu kí kpèè m yaa kaa pīitì kutagbɔŋu punyɔmmu utaa ń nì ní ḿ bìin̄ ni-pu tikpil.

english_verse: I will also stop locusts from destroying your crops and keeping your vineyards from producing.
translation_verse: Ni-puee m làá kúntí tijinjin tí taa ti bīil̀ ni-kpaajinti, ní ni-fiinyi sukpaaŋŋi ń lòoǹ, man ni-Dindaan Mpɔŋkɔdaan di lī míǹ.

english_verse: Everyone of every nation will talk about how I have blessed you and about your wonderful land. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken!
translation_verse: Atimbun kɔkɔ làá lì yii ni bí mmɔnni, kun puee nimbi tiŋkin ní mmɔn dāa bí. Ti-Dindaan Mpɔŋkɔdaan di lī míǹ. Ti-Dindaan làá dāá lēē u-deedeeu kí dàkà

english_verse: You have said horrible things about me, and yet you ask, “What have we said?”
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan bí yii: «Ni sòoǹ-mi anyɔɔbun ŋin pɔ̄ɔ̄yee. Ní ni bàlifī yii: <Tilati ní ti sòon̄ ti-kansikin ki bíil̀-si ní?>

english_verse: Here is what you have said: “It's foolish to serve the Lord God All-Powerful. What do we get for obeying God and from going around looking sad?
translation_verse: Ni lì yii: <Kí tɔ̄ Unimbɔti tundee kaa cáá ipaati iba. Ti ŋúb́ u-marab, ki yíiń binib ti kāl̀ dikpool, ti-Dindaan Mpɔŋkɔdaan ń bàà sɔ̄ ti-saai, ama taa ká ipaati iba.

english_verse: See how happy those arrogant people are. Everyone who does wrong is successful, and when they put God to the test, they always get away with it.” Faithfulness Is Rewarded
translation_verse: Kɔŋkɔnnee, ti ká yii bin yòontí bi-ba yilpuee di bí mmɔnni, ní an bútí bin ŋáań ikpitee. Báà gba bi yaa gbítì Unimbɔti ŋuul, tiba kaa ŋáań-bi.»

english_verse: All those who truly respected the Lord and honored his name started discussing these things, and when God saw what was happening, he had their names written as a reminder in his book.
translation_verse: Bin fàŋkí Unimbɔtee nín nìn bí ki sòoǹ tɔb puee dee. Ti-Dindaan nìn gbìl̄ tin bi sòon̄ee. Bi nìn ŋmàn̄ bin fàŋkí ti-Dindaanee nì bin sīntiǹ bi-ba ki tīī-uee yiŋŋi u-nimbiin.

english_verse: Then the Lord All-Powerful said: You people are precious to me, and when I come to bring justice, I will protect you, just as parents protect an obedient child.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan Mpɔŋkɔdaan bí yii: «Ŋwiin ŋun m làá dāá lēē m-pɔŋŋu kí dàkèe, bi làá dāá nīn sá man gaajawanti. M làá dāá dàkà-bi kulaŋŋaŋfitiiu kii ubaati nín dàkà u-jipɔɔn un bí u-cee ki tūǹ-u ditundee puee.

english_verse: Then everyone will once again see the difference between those who obey me by doing right and those who reject me by doing wrong.
translation_verse: Niin ní ni làá fàtīí ká digàntil din bí deedeedambi nì binikpitib kansikinee, nì digàntil din bí bin nóó Unimbɔti ki tūǹ u-tundee nì bin káa nóó-uee kansikin.

english_verse: “A virgin will have a baby boy, and he will be called Immanuel,” which means “God is with us.”
translation_verse: «Usapɔɔn un kaa nyí uninjee làá cáá dipool kí màal̀ kibininjabiki, bi làá pɔ̄-kì diyindi yii Eemanuyeel.» - Eemanuyeel taapu di sá yii «Unimbɔti bí ti-cee.»

english_verse: more to the birth of the Messiah. The Birth of Jesus (Luke
translation_verse: ní Asɔɔr màl̄ Sadooki, ní Sadooki màl̄ Akim, ní Akim màl̄ Eeliyuudi

english_verse: This is how Jesus Christ was born. A young woman named Mary was engaged to Joseph from King David's family. But before they were married, she learned that she was going to have a baby by God's Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Bi nín màl̄ Yeesu Kriisitoo puee sɔ̀. U-na Maarii nìn sá Jooseefi bɔɔn ní. Kí wàatī bí nín cáá tɔbee, Unimbɔti Fam pɔŋŋu yāntì Maarii cáá dipool.

english_verse: Joseph was a good man and did not want to embarrass Mary in front of everyone. So he decided to quietly call off the wedding.
translation_verse: U-bɔɔn Jooseefi nìn là kí nóó mara nín lī puee, ama ní kaa là kí bìitī Maarii mun pu, ní ki là kí yàntī-u dibalin.

english_verse: While Joseph was thinking about this, an angel from the Lord appeared to him in a dream. The angel said, “Joseph, the baby that Mary will have is from the Holy Spirit. Go ahead and marry her.
translation_verse: U bíi dàkafī mimmee, ní ti-Dindaan tuuŋŋu dɔ́miń ki sòon̄ nì u kudamintiiun yii: «Jooseefi, Daafiidi naantiiu, taa fàŋkì kí cáá Maarii, kun puee Unimbɔti Fam di yāntì u cáá kibiki kin u làá màal̀ nee pool.

english_verse: Then after her baby is born, name him Jesus, because he will save his people from their sins.”
translation_verse: U làá màal̀ kibininjabiki ní á dāá pɔ̄-kì diyindi yii Yeesu, kun puee úǹ di làá dāá fīī u-niboolii bi-kpitiin.»

english_verse: So the Lord's promise came true, just as the prophet had said,
translation_verse: Tin bí nee kɔkɔ bāań ki ŋá kii ti-Dindaan nín yāntì u-bɔnaatiliu sòon̄ miŋyee ní yii:

english_verse: After Joseph woke up, he and Mary were soon married, just as the Lord's angel had told him to do.
translation_verse: Jooseefi fīntì ŋgeem puee, ní ki cūtì ki cáá Maarii kii ti-Dindaan tuuŋŋu nín bí yii ú ŋá puee.

english_verse: But they did not sleep together before her baby was born. Then Joseph named him Jesus.
translation_verse: Ama waa gbēē-u áli ki dāa sāā ŋyunti ŋun u màl̄ kibininjabikee ní Jooseefi pú kibikee diyindi yii Yeesu.

english_verse: When Jesus was born in the village of Bethlehem in Judea, Herod was king. During this time some wise men from the east came to Jerusalem
translation_verse: Bi màl̄ Yeesu Beetileem ní, Juudee tiŋki kiban. Ŋyunti gbantee Eeroodi di nìn sá ubɔti, ní bin nyí iŋmalbijaa bɔtee biba nyánní ŋwìiń nyalaŋki pú ki bāań Jeerusaleem,

english_verse: and said, “Where is the child born to be king of the Jews? We saw his star in the east and have come to worship him.”
translation_verse: ní ki bālifì yii: «Juuda yab bɔtiu un bi dáá màl̄ nee bí la? Ti ká u-ŋmalbijau nyáń ŋwìiń nyalaŋki pú ní ti dɔ́miń kí gbàan̄ kí jāam̀-u.»

english_verse: When King Herod heard about this, he was worried, and so was everyone else in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ubɔti Eeroodi nín gbìl̄ mimmee, ní u-pɔbil bíil̀, ki kpáaǹ Jeerusaleem nib kɔkɔ.

english_verse: Herod brought together the chief priests and the teachers of the Law of Moses and asked them, “Where will the Messiah be born?”
translation_verse: U nìn yíiń Juuda yab saraaŋaliibi nì bimaradakaliibi ki kpáfì ní ki bālifì-bi yii: «La ní an lī yii bi làá màal̀ Meesiya ní?»

english_verse: They told him, “He will be born in Bethlehem, just as the prophet wrote,
translation_verse: Ní bi kíí-u yii: «Beetileem, kitiŋ kin bí Juudeeyee, kun puee Unimbɔti bɔnaatiliu nìn ŋmàn̄ yii:

english_verse: ‘Bethlehem in the land of Judea, you are very important among the towns of Judea. From your town will come a leader, who will be like a shepherd for my people Israel.’ ”
translation_verse: <Sii Beetileem, kitiŋ kin bí Juudeeyee, tiŋmanee, aa sá kitiŋwaai Juudee tiŋkpaammu kansikin, kun puee sii poon ní ubɔti un làá kpàà Isirayeel yab man nibulee làá nyānní.>»

english_verse: Herod secretly called in the wise men and asked them when they had first seen the star.
translation_verse: Niinee ní Eeroodi yíiń bin nyí iŋmalbijaa bɔtee dibalin ki bālifì-bi ŋyunti ŋun páaa ní bi ká uŋmalbijee,

english_verse: He told them, “Go to Bethlehem and search carefully for the child. As soon as you find him, let me know. I also want to go and worship him.”
translation_verse: ní ki bí yii bí nīn cá Beetileem, kí nyàab̀ mmɔntiimin kí béé laakin kibikee bée. U nìn bí-bi yii: «Ni yaa ká-kèe, ní dāan̄ kí tùkù ma mun ń cù kí gbàan̄ kí jāam̀-kì.»

english_verse: The wise men listened to what the king said and then left. And the star they had seen in the east went on ahead of them until it stopped over the place where the child was.
translation_verse: Ubɔti tùkū-bi mimmee, ní bi búntì, ní ki ká uŋmalbijee līntì bi-nyɔkɔpu ki bàn̄ laakin bi màl̄ kibikee, ní ki yúl̀ kutaa pu ki bíitì niin.

english_verse: They were thrilled and excited to see the star.
translation_verse: Bi nín ká uŋmalbijee yúl̀ee ní an mɔ́ɔkiǹ-bi tikpil

english_verse: When the men went into the house and saw the child with Mary, his mother, they knelt down and worshiped him. They took out their gifts of gold, frankincense, and myrrh and gave them to him.
translation_verse: ní bi kɔ́ kudiin ki ká kibiwaayee nì ki-na Maarii ní ki gbāaǹ ki jáam̀-kì, ní ki pīitì bi-gaajawanti ki lēē sindaariya nì talaalutuukaa nì talaalu un bi yíì miiree ki dūu pú-kì.

english_verse: Later they were warned in a dream not to return to Herod, and they went back home by another road. The Escape to Egypt
translation_verse: Boonee ní Unimbɔti sòon̄ nì bi kudamintiiu poon yii bí taa fàtīí dī Eeroodi cee, ní bi páaǹ nsan ŋubɔ ki nín kùǹ bi-dumpu. Bi kpáaǹ Yeesu ki búntì Eejipiti

english_verse: After the wise men had gone, an angel from the Lord appeared to Joseph in a dream and said, “Get up! Hurry and take the child and his mother to Egypt! Stay there until I tell you to return, because Herod is looking for the child and wants to kill him.”
translation_verse: Bin nyí iŋmalbijaa bɔtee nín kùǹee, ní Unimbɔti tuuŋŋu dɔ́miń ki tùkū Jooseefi kudamintiiun yii: «Yīkì kí yòon̄ kibiki nì ki-na kí sāǹ kí nīn cá Eejipiti tiŋkin kí kàl̄ niin kí nīn cí ŋyunti ŋun m làá tùkù-si á fàtīí gítińee, kun puee Eeroodi làá nyàab̀ kí kpɔ̀ kibiki nee.»

english_verse: That night, Joseph got up and took his wife and the child to Egypt,
translation_verse: Ní Jooseefi yíkì ki yōoǹ kibiki nì ki-na kunyeeu ki búntì Eejipiti,

english_verse: where they stayed until Herod died. So the Lord's promise came true, just as the prophet had said, “I called my son out of Egypt.” The Killing of the Children
translation_verse: ní ki kāl̀ niin áli Eeroodi dāa kpíì. Mimmee an ŋá min ti-Dindaan nìn yāntì u-bɔnaatiliu sòon̄ee dee yii: «M yíiń m-jipɔɔn ń nyānní Eejipiti.» Eeroodi kūū mbiyaawaamu

english_verse: When Herod found out that the wise men from the east had tricked him, he was very angry. He gave orders for his men to kill all the boys who lived in or near Bethlehem and were two years old and younger. This was based on what he had learned from the wise men.
translation_verse: Eeroodi nín dāa béè yii bin nyí iŋmalbijaa bɔtee ŋmātiǹ-u kaa ti gítìń u-ceeyee, ní u fōō diŋuul tikpil ní ki pú kinyɔkɔ yii bí cù Beetileem tiŋkin nì ntimu mun māntìi tú-kèe kí kpɔ̀ mbininjabiyaamu mun cáá abin alee nì mun kaa láá bàn̄ alee, ki táá nì ŋyunti ŋun bin nyí iŋmalbijaa bɔtee nìn tùkū-uee.

english_verse: So the Lord's promise came true, just as the prophet Jeremiah had said,
translation_verse: An ŋá míǹ kí dàkà Unimbɔti bɔnaatiliu Yeereemii nín nìn lī puee dee, yii:

english_verse: “In Ramah a voice was heard crying and weeping loudly. Rachel was mourning for her children, and she refused to be comforted, because they were dead.” The Return from Egypt
translation_verse: «Bi gbìl̄ Raama tiŋkin dituweel, nsiim, nì iyaliŋki tikpil, an sá Raseel di bíi sūǹ u-biyaamu pu, kaa là bí ŋméeǹ-u, kun puee mu kpíì.» Yeesu gítìń Isirayeel tiŋkin

english_verse: After King Herod died, an angel from the Lord appeared in a dream to Joseph while he was still in Egypt.
translation_verse: Ubɔti Eeroodi nín kpíìyee, ní ti-Dindaan tuuŋŋu dɔ́miń Jooseefi cee kudamintiiun Eejipiti,

english_verse: The angel said, “Get up and take the child and his mother back to Israel. The people who wanted to kill him are now dead.”
translation_verse: ní ki bí-u yii: «Yīkìm̄ kí yòon̄ kibiki nì ki-na ní gítí Isirayeel tiŋkin, kun puee bin bàà nìn nyàab̀ kí kpɔ̀-kèe kpíì, baa ti bí.»

english_verse: Joseph got up and left with them for Israel.
translation_verse: Ní Jooseefi yíkì ki yōoǹ kibiki nì ki-na ki nín gítí Isirayeel tiŋkin.

english_verse: But when he heard that Herod's son Archelaus was now ruler of Judea, he was afraid to go there. Then in a dream he was told to go to Galilee,
translation_verse: Ama u fāŋkì kí cùú kàl̄ Juudee tiŋkin kun puee u gbìl̄ yii Arkeelayusi di fōō u-baa Eeroodi beel Juudee. Kudamintiiun ní Unimbɔti dàkā-u, ní u túĺ Galiilee watil pú,

english_verse: and they went to live there in the town of Nazareth. So the Lord's promise came true, just as the prophet had said, “He will be called a Nazarene.”
translation_verse: ní ki cūtìi kāl̀ Galiilee tiŋki kin bi yíì Naasaareetee. An ŋá kii Unimbɔti bɔnaatiliibi nín nìn sòon̄ ki síiǹ puee dee, yii: «Bi làá dāá nīn yíì-u unaasaareetija ní.»

english_verse: Do something to show you have really given up your sins.
translation_verse: Nín̄ tūm̀maan atuun ŋin dàkà yii ni fá ni-kpitiiyee

english_verse: He said, “Turn back to God! The kingdom of heaven will soon be here.”
translation_verse: «Kpántímaan ni-bimbim kun puee Unimbɔti Beel sútì ki pìlīń-ni.»

english_verse: John wore clothes made of camel's hair. He had a leather strap around his waist and ate grasshoppers and wild honey.
translation_verse: Yoowaneesi nìn pēē ugutaamu kuti bɔkutil ní ki gbìn̄ ŋgban dambalau u-caŋin, ní ki ŋmóò inaakitoon nì tisiil ŋmaniŋma.

english_verse: From Jerusalem and all Judea and from the Jordan River Valley crowds of people went to John.
translation_verse: Jeerusaleem yab nì Juudee kɔkɔ, nì bin kóò Jɔɔdan buŋŋu caŋinee kɔkɔ yab nìn dòoń Yoowaneesi cee

english_verse: They told how sorry they were for their sins, and he baptized them in the river.
translation_verse: ki bìitī bi-kpitii pu ní Yoowaneesi fùul̀-bi Unimbɔti nyim Jɔɔdan buŋŋun.

english_verse: Many Pharisees and Sadducees also came to be baptized. But John said to them: You bunch of snakes! Who warned you to run from the coming judgment?
translation_verse: Yoowaneesi nín ká yii Fariisab nì Sadusab dòoń ú fàl̀-bi Unimbɔti nyimee, ní u bí-bi yii: «Nimbi bin tū kii ikoowaatee! Ŋma tùkū-ni yii ní sāǹ kí nyā Unimbɔti ŋuul din dòońee ni?

english_verse: An ax is ready to cut the trees down at their roots. Any tree that doesn't produce good fruit will be chopped down and thrown into a fire.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti bɔ́ntì kicɔkɔ ki bíl̀ isufi taapu kí kpìkitī-i. Busubu bun kamaa yaa kaa lòoǹ abimɔntee, bi làá gāā-bu kí tɔ̄ ŋŋmin ní.

english_verse: His threshing fork is in his hand, and he is ready to separate the wheat from the husks. He will store the wheat in a barn and burn the husks in a fire that never goes out. The Baptism of Jesus (Mark
translation_verse: Úǹ ŋúb́ u-yubakalkaaku, ní ki làá bàkal̀ kí gàntī tifin nì idi, ní kí dū idi kí ŋá kulɔŋŋun ní kí dū tifinee kí dūú tɔ̄ ŋŋmi ŋun kaa kúù jaanjaanee ni.» Yoowaneesi fùl̄ Yeesu Unimbɔti nyim (Maar

english_verse: Jesus left Galilee and went to the Jordan River to be baptized by John.
translation_verse: Niinee ní Yeesu nyánní Galiilee ki dɔ́miń Jɔɔdan buŋŋu caŋin Yoowaneesi cee ú fàl̀-u Unimbɔti nyim.

english_verse: But John kept objecting and said, “I ought to be baptized by you. Why have you come to me?”
translation_verse: Ní Yoowaneesi yíì, ki bí-u yii: «Man di bàà máaǹ kí dāan̄ sii cee sii ń fàl̀ man, ní sii gíti dòoń man ń fàl̀-saaa?»

english_verse: Jesus answered, “For now this is how it should be, because we must do all God wants us to do.” Then John agreed.
translation_verse: Ní Yeesu bí-u yii: «Kíí tí ŋá míǹ kɔŋkɔnnee, kun puee an máaǹ tí ŋá míǹ kí nóó min kɔkɔ Unimbɔti bàlifēe.» Niinee ní Yoowaneesi kaa ti kpákáǹ-u, ní ki fùl̄-u.

english_verse: So Jesus was baptized. And as soon as he came out of the water, the sky opened, and he saw the Spirit of God coming down on him like a dove.
translation_verse: Ŋyunti ŋun Yoowaneesi fùl̄-u ki dóò, u bíi nyēeń nnyiminee, kpalaayee ní kutagbɔŋu cúu pīitì, ní u wál̀ Unimbɔti Fam kpákatìń u-pu ki bí kii dibeenanjilee.

english_verse: Then a voice from heaven said, “This is my own dear Son, and I am pleased with him.”
translation_verse: Niinee ní Unimbɔti sòon̄ní kutaa pu yii: «Un bí nee di sá man Jipɔɔn un m néeń tikpilee, úǹ ní m-pɔbil fáatì.»

english_verse: When Jesus heard that John had been put in prison, he went to Galilee.
translation_verse: Yeesu nín gbìl̄ yii bi cúú Yoowaneesi ki pīiǹ sarkee ní u yíkì ki nín cá Galiilee.

english_verse: But instead of staying in Nazareth, Jesus moved to Capernaum. This town was beside Lake Galilee in the territory of Zebulun and Naphtali.
translation_verse: U bàn̄ee kaa kóò Naasaareeti ní ki tin kóòń Kapeernayum Galiilee mɔɔl caŋin, laakin sá Sabulɔn nì Neefitalii tiŋkinee.

english_verse: Then the devil came to him and said, “If you are God's Son, tell these stones to turn into bread.”
translation_verse: Ní Sitaan sútì ki pìl̄-u, ní ki bí-u yii: «A yaa lafun sá Unimbɔti Jipɔɔn, tīī ditaŋkpal nee mara dí kpántí kpɔnɔ.»

english_verse: Jesus answered, “The Scriptures also say, ‘Don't try to test the Lord your God!’ ”
translation_verse: Ní Yeesu kíí-u yii: «An lī Unimbɔti gbɔŋku poon yii: <Á taa cɔ̄ŋkì ti-Dindaan a-Nimbɔtiu.>»

english_verse: Finally, the devil took Jesus up on a very high mountain and showed him all the kingdoms on earth and their power.
translation_verse: Ní Sitaan tí cáá-u ki jɔ́m̀ dijoofɔŋfɔkɔl diba pu, ní ki yāntì u ká abee ŋin bí duulinyanee kɔkɔ nì ŋi-nyooti,

english_verse: The devil said to him, “I will give all this to you, if you will bow down and worship me.”
translation_verse: ní ki bí-u yii: «A yaa gbāaǹ ki jáam̀-mi, m làá dū an kɔkɔ kí tīī-si.»

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Go away Satan! The Scriptures say: ‘Worship the Lord your God and serve only him.’ ”
translation_verse: Niinee Yeesu bí-u yii: «Sitaan, sútí niin kí wàatī-mi! Kun puee an ŋmàn̄ Unimbɔti gbɔŋku poon yii: <Ti-Dindaan a-Nimbɔtiu baba ní an sá á jāam̀, kí nīn bí úǹ baba tundin.>»

translation_verse: «<Ti-Dindaan tùkū m-Dindaan yii: Kàl̄ m-ŋaŋgiil pú kí nīn cí ŋyunti ŋun m làá yàntī á nīn kíǹ ki tɔ́kɔ́ a-nannanliibi puee.>

english_verse: “What do you think about the Messiah? Whose family will he come from?” They answered, “He will be a son of King David.”
translation_verse: «Ni dàkafī Meesiya pu yii ba ní? Ŋma naantiiu ní u sá ní?» Ní bi kíí-u yii: «Daafiidi naantiiu.»

english_verse: Jesus replied, “How then could the Spirit lead David to call the Messiah his Lord? David said,
translation_verse: Ní Yeesu bí-bi yii: «Kin, ba pu ní Unimbɔti Fam yāntì Daafiidi u-ba yíiń-u yii u-Dindaan ní? Di sá u bí yii:

english_verse: If David called the Messiah his Lord, how can the Messiah be a son of King David?”
translation_verse: «Mimmee, Daafiidi yaa yíì Meesiya yii u-Dindaanee, mana ní u gíti ŋūǹ kí nīn sá u-naantiiu mun?»

english_verse: No one was able to give Jesus an answer, and from that day on, no one dared ask him any more questions.
translation_verse: Bi-kansikin ubɔ kaa ŋúń ki kíí-u báà dinyɔɔbumbaantiil. Kí yòon̄ ŋyunti gbantee ubɔ kaa ti mākaǹ kí bàlifì-u tiba kí kpèè u-nyɔkɔn.

english_verse: And now your temple will be deserted.
translation_verse: Too, kɔŋkɔnnee Unimbɔti làá fá ni nì ni-diiku.

english_verse: Jerusalem, Jerusalem! Your people have killed the prophets and have stoned the messengers who were sent to you. I have often wanted to gather your people, as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings. But you wouldn't let me.
translation_verse: «Jeerusaleem yab, Jeerusaleem yab, nimbi di kù Unimbɔti bɔnaatiliibi ní ki cáá ataŋkpee ki yāŋkí ki kù bin Unimbɔti túnní ni-ceeyee! Miŋa pu ní maa mākaǹ kí bàà kóoǹ ni-kɔkɔ kí kpāfì m-cee kii ukoonaati nín kōontí u-biyaamu u-taapu puee? Ama ní ni yíì.

english_verse: Anyone who swears by the altar also swears by everything on it.
translation_verse: Un di yaa pūtì nsaraafanee, pūtì ki kpáaǹ tin kɔkɔ pá nsaraafan puee dee.

english_verse: Jesus said to the crowds and to his disciples:
translation_verse: Niinee, Yeesu bí kunipaauee nì u-boonnooliibi yii:

english_verse: The Pharisees and the teachers of the Law are experts in the Law of Moses.
translation_verse: «Bimaradakaliibi nì Fariisab di bí ki dàkà Mooyiisi marab.

english_verse: So obey everything they teach you, but don't do as they do. After all, they say one thing and do something else.
translation_verse: Míǹ puee, ní nīn ŋáaḿmaan min bi dàkà-nee, ama ní taa fōō bíǹ bi-ba bimbim, kun puee baa ŋáań tin bi dàkà yii binib ń nīn ŋáańee.

english_verse: They pile heavy burdens on people's shoulders and won't lift a finger to help.
translation_verse: Bi nyāntí marab bin nyìm̀ kii awaŋgulee ní ki tūntí binib ní kaa là kí dū bi-ŋambiki kí dáb́ awaŋgulee kí tūtuǹ binib.

english_verse: Everything they do is just to show off in front of others. They even make a big show of wearing Scripture verses on their foreheads and arms, and they wear big tassels for everyone to see.
translation_verse: Bi pée tūǹ bi-tuuŋŋi kɔkɔ binib ń nīn wāĺ-bi ní. Bi wàantí igban in pu bi ŋmà Unimbɔti bɔti ki cáa fìǹ bi-ŋalii nì bi-yigbeeŋee, ní ki fɔ̀kɔntí bi-bɔkutiŋ gbeeŋgbeeŋyi.

english_verse: They love the best seats at banquets and the front seats in the synagogues.
translation_verse: Bi néeń ki kàal̀ ikakaamɔnti diinabin nì nyɔkɔpu kakaai akpafidiinni,

english_verse: And when they are in the market, they like to have people greet them as their teachers.
translation_verse: ki néeń bí nīn jáaḿ-bi binibin, ki néeń bí nīn yíì-bi <Ukpil, ukpil.>

english_verse: But none of you should be called a teacher. You have only one teacher, and all of you are like brothers and sisters.
translation_verse: Ama nimbi ń taa yàntī bí nīn yíì-ni <Ukpil>, kun puee ni cáá ukpibaanti ní, ní ni-kɔkɔ sá nnabiyaamu.

english_verse: Don't call anyone on earth your father. All of you have the same Father in heaven.
translation_verse: Ní taa yíiń ubɔ kitiŋ pu <ni-Baa>, kun puee ni-Baa pée sá ubambaanti ní, ki bí yilpu.

english_verse: None of you should be called the leader. The Messiah is your only leader.
translation_verse: Ní taa yàntī bí nīn yíì-ni <Uyidaan>, kun puee ubaanti di sá ni-Yidaaŋwu, úǹ di sá Meesiya.

english_verse: You Pharisees and teachers of the Law of Moses are in for trouble! You're nothing but show-offs. You lock people out of the kingdom of heaven. You won't go in yourselves, and you keep others from going in.
translation_verse: «Mbusu dɔ̄ ki cí-ni, nimbi bimaradakaliibi nì Fariisab mpoonnyoondambi, kun puee ni fìkì tin kɔkɔ bikpiipoobi cááyee, ní ki mèé ŋwimmeem min yúntí fɔ́rrree bí ká-ni. An pu ní Unimbɔti làá dāá dáaĺ ni-tafal tikpil!]

english_verse: You Pharisees and teachers of the Law of Moses are in for trouble! You're nothing but show-offs. You travel over land and sea to win one follower. And when you have done so, you make that person twice as fit for hell as you are.
translation_verse: «Mbusu dɔ̄ ki cí-ni, nimbi bimaradakaliibi nì Fariisab mpoonnyoondambi, kun puee ni yìiǹ tiŋkub nì kitiŋ jaaŋŋi kɔkɔ pu ki nyàab̀ un làá kpántí ni-boonnooliuee, ní ni yaa ŋúń ki yāntì u kpántì u-bee, ní ní yàntī ú kpántí un làá dāá kɔ́ ditafadaaldinee mili pu kí jītíǹ nimbi.

english_verse: You are in for trouble! You are supposed to lead others, but you are blind. You teach that it doesn't matter if a person swears by the temple. But you say it does matter if someone swears by the gold in the temple.
translation_verse: «Mbusu dɔ̄ ki cí-ni, nimbi bijɔfub bin kpòotī binibee, kun puee ni lì yii: <Unil yaa pūtì kunimbɔtidiiyee, an kaa sá tiba, ama un yaa pūtì sindaariya un bí kunimbɔtidiinee, ú ŋá min u pūtèe.>

english_verse: You blind fools! Which is greater, the gold or the temple that makes the gold sacred?
translation_verse: Bigbaambi, bijɔfub! Ba di páb́ ní? Sindaariyaaa, kunimbɔtidii kun yāntì sindaariyee kpántì circiree?

english_verse: You also teach that it doesn't matter if a person swears by the altar. But you say it does matter if someone swears by the gift on the altar.
translation_verse: Ni tí lì yii: <Unil yaa pūtì nsaraafanee, an kaa sá tiba, ama un di yaa pūtì saraa un pá nsaraafan puee, ú ŋá min u pūtèe.>

english_verse: Are you blind? Which is more important, the gift or the altar that makes the gift sacred?
translation_verse: Bijɔfub, tilati di páb́ ní? Saraayaaa, nsaraafan ŋun pu saraayee pá ki kpántì circiree ní?

english_verse: And anyone who swears by the temple also swears by God, who lives there.
translation_verse: Un di yaa pūtì kunimbɔtidiiyee, pūtì Unimbɔti un kóò kudii gbantinee dee.

english_verse: To swear by heaven is the same as swearing by God's throne and by the one who sits on that throne.
translation_verse: Un yaa pūtì kutaayee, pūtì Unimbɔti beejal nì Unimbɔti un kā di-puee dee.

english_verse: You Pharisees and teachers are show-offs, and you're in for trouble! You give God a tenth of the spices from your garden, such as mint, dill, and cumin. Yet you neglect the more important matters of the Law, such as justice, mercy, and faithfulness. These are the important things you should have done, though you should not have left the others undone either.
translation_verse: «Mbusu dɔ̄ ki cí-ni, nimbi bimaradakaliibi nì Fariisab mpoonnyoondambi, kun puee ni pà tikuŋfaal tin kɔkɔ ni kùee saalaa kamaa pu kubɔ kubɔ, ama ní ki yíití, kaa nóó marab bin bɔti páb́ee, an dàkà yii: á nīn cáá ibaamɔn, kí nīn sūǹ binib saai, kí nīn yú deedee. Tin bàà máaǹ ní ŋée dee, ní kí nín dū tin kíǹee kí páań boon.

english_verse: You blind leaders! You strain out a small fly but swallow a camel.
translation_verse: Bikpootiliibi bin jɔ̀b̄ee! Ni jákà ki lèekī isii ni-nyɔkaatin, ama ní ki nátí igutaamu.

english_verse: You Pharisees and teachers are show-offs, and you're in for trouble! You wash the outside of your cups and dishes, while inside there is nothing but greed and selfishness.
translation_verse: «Mbusu dɔ̄ ki cí-ni, nimbi bimaradakaliibi nì Fariisab mpoonnyoondambi, kun puee ni fíntí tiyuti nì asambil boon, ama ní ni-naayutuuŋŋi nì tiwan tin ni fìkēe gbí poon.

english_verse: You blind Pharisee! First clean the inside of a cup, and then the outside will also be clean.
translation_verse: Fariisab bijɔfub! Ní péé kí fíntímaan kuyuu poon, ní boon mun ń kpáàa nyā.

english_verse: You Pharisees and teachers are in for trouble! You're nothing but show-offs. You're like tombs that have been whitewashed. On the outside they are beautiful, but inside they are full of bones and filth.
translation_verse: «Mbusu dɔ̄ ki cí-ni, nimbi bimaradakaliibi nì Fariisab mpoonnyoondambi, kun puee ni náań nì akaakul ŋin bi píil̀ boonee ní. Ŋi ŋān̄ nnimbikpee, ama ní ŋi-poonee anikpil sūū ní akpab gbí.

english_verse: That's what you are like. Outside you look good, but inside you are evil and only pretend to be good.
translation_verse: Míǹ ní ni mun bí. Binib wāĺ-ni ŋgban puee yii ni sá deedeedambi, ama mpoonnyoon nì ikpiti di gbí ni ni.

english_verse: You Pharisees and teachers are nothing but show-offs, and you're in for trouble! You build monuments for the prophets and decorate the tombs of good people.
translation_verse: «Mbusu dɔ̄ ki cí-ni, nimbi bimaradakaliibi nì Fariisab mpoonnyoondambi, kun puee ni māā Unimbɔti bɔnaatiliibi akaakumɔnti ní ki nyāantí bin yúl̀ deedeeyee kaakuliŋ,

english_verse: And you claim you would not have taken part with your ancestors in killing the prophets.
translation_verse: ní ki lì yii: <Ti yaa bàà nìn bímaan ti-naanjab yuntiŋu, taa bàà nìn kútí bi-pu bí kpɔ̀ Unimbɔti bɔnaatiliibi gbanti.>

english_verse: But you prove you really are the relatives of the ones who killed the prophets.
translation_verse: Míǹ ní ni bíi lèekī ni-ba pu seera yii ni sá bin kūū Unimbɔti bɔnaatiliibee naantiibi.

english_verse: So keep on doing everything they did.
translation_verse: Mimmee, púntímaan ni-naanjab nín nìn kíĺ ditundi diŋyee!

english_verse: You are nothing but snakes and the children of snakes! How can you escape going to hell?
translation_verse: Nimbi bin tū kii ikoowaatee! Mana ní ni dàkafī yii ni ŋūǹ kí ŋmátí kí taa kɔ́ ditafadaaldi laŋki?

english_verse: I can promise that you people living today will be punished for all these things! Jesus Loves Jerusalem (Luke
translation_verse: Ibaamɔn ní m tùkù-ni, nnikpaakoonee tafadaaldi làá dāá lítí nimbi waanee nib pu ní.» Yeesu yáliŋkì Jeerusaleem pu (Kpèè Luuki

translation_verse: M tùkù-ni yii, kí yòon̄ díǹ kí nīn cée, naa làá ti ká-mi kí nīn cí ŋyunti ŋun ni làá dāá sòoǹ m-pu yii: <Unimbɔti ń bìin̄ un dòoń ti-Dindaan yindi puee.>»

english_verse: After Jesus left the temple, his disciples came over and said, “Look at all these buildings!”
translation_verse: Ŋyunti ŋun Yeesu nyáń kunimbɔtidiin ki cée, ní u-boonnooliibi sútìń ki pìl̄-u ní ki bí yii ú kpèè bi nín baasii máń kunimbɔtidii puee.

english_verse: Jesus replied, “Do you see these buildings? They will certainly be torn down! Not one stone will be left in place.” Warning about Trouble (Mark
translation_verse: Ní u bí-bi yii: «Kéè ni ká kɔkɔ neeyaa! Ibaamɔn ní m tùkù-ni, ditaŋkpal diba kaa làá dāá nīn gíti tɔ́kɔ́ di-juti pu, an kɔkɔ làá dāá wīī ní.» Falaa un làá bàń kitiŋ kúntitamee (Kpèè Maar

english_verse: Many will come and claim to be me. They will say they are the Messiah, and they will fool many people.
translation_verse: Di sá yii binib tikpil làá dāá dū man yindi kí kpántí bi-yaŋ kí lì yii bíǹ di sá <Meesiya> ní ki làá dāá kīil̀ binib tikpil.

english_verse: You will soon hear about wars and threats of wars, but don't be afraid. These things will have to happen first, but that isn't the end.
translation_verse: Ni làá dāá gbìl̄ bi sòoǹ tijáti tin bi bíi jáàyee nì tin gíti bí ki dòońee bɔti ama, ní nīn nyíǹ ni-ba ni-pɔbiliŋ ń taa bīil̀. An máaǹ tíǹ kɔkɔ ń bàń, ama niin kaa dá láá sá duulinya kúntitam.

english_verse: Later, as Jesus was sitting on the Mount of Olives, his disciples came to him in private and asked, “When will this happen? What will be the sign of your coming and of the end of the world?”
translation_verse: Yeesu nìn kā Ɔliifi sufii jool pu, ní u-boonnooliibi dɔ́miń ki ká-u bi-ŋmaniŋma ní ki bālifì-u yii: «Tùkù-ti ŋyunti ŋun tin a bàà lēe làá dāá bàńee, nì kudaaŋŋu kun làá dāá dàkà-ti ŋyunti ŋun a làá gítińee nì ŋyunti ŋun duulinya mun làá kúntée.»

english_verse: Nations and kingdoms will go to war against each other. People will starve to death, and in some places there will be earthquakes.
translation_verse: Ditimbundi diba dāa yíkí kí jáǹ diba, ní dibeel diba yab mun ń jáǹ diba. Ŋkùm làá dāá nyā, ní kitiŋ ń dāá cìŋkì ajan kupaau pu.

english_verse: It will be a terrible time for women who are expecting babies or nursing young children.
translation_verse: Ama falaa dɔ̄ ki cí bipɔdambi nì bimatib iwiin gbanti poon!

english_verse: Jesus answered: Don't let anyone fool you.
translation_verse: Niinee ní Yeesu kíí-bi yii: «Ní nīn nyíǹ ni-ba ubɔ ń taa ŋmàtiǹ-ni.

english_verse: But this is just the beginning of troubles.
translation_verse: Tíǹ kɔkɔee dāa sá kii imatiŋween nín kífí puee ní.

english_verse: You will be arrested, punished, and even killed. Because of me, you will be hated by people of all nations.
translation_verse: «Binib làá dāá cúú-ni kí tīī bí sàaǹ-ni ní kí kpɔ̀-ni. Atimbun kɔkɔ nib làá dāá nīn ná-ni ni nín fōō man ki kííyee pu.

english_verse: Many will give up and will betray and hate each other.
translation_verse: Ŋyunti gbantee, binib tikpil làá dāá fá bi-fookiiu un bi cáá man puee, kí nīn kíǹ ki nyáfí tɔb ki ná tɔb.

english_verse: Many false prophets will come and fool a lot of people.
translation_verse: Bin yíì bi-ba yii Unimbɔti bɔnaatiliibi kin kaa sée làá dāá dāan̄ kí ŋmàtiǹ binib tikpil mun.

english_verse: Someone may say, “Here is the Messiah!” or “There he is!” But don't believe it.
translation_verse: «Ŋyunti gbantee, ubɔ yaa tùkū-ni yii: <Meesiya bí doo,> àá <U bíń lapu,> ní taa fōō kí kíí.

english_verse: And pray that you won't have to escape in winter or on a Sabbath.
translation_verse: Mèèmaan Unimbɔti an bɔtee ń taa bàń-ni kuseeun, kí taa nín̄ sá ŋwiŋŋuŋfikaa dal,

translation_verse: «Ni làá ká kuwaŋkpitiu kun cāabìń ntimbiilee, kun pu Unimbɔti bɔnaatiliu Daniyeel nìn sòon̄ee sí kunimbɔtidiin. - Un kàaǹ tibɔti neeyee ń gbìl̄ ti-taapu! -

english_verse: If you are living in Judea at that time, run to the mountains.
translation_verse: Ŋyunti gbantee, Juudee tiŋki yab ń nīn sáń ki dàb̀ ajoon.

english_verse: If you are out in the field, don't go back for your coat.
translation_verse: ní un yaa láa bí kusaauee ń taa láa lì yii u làá gítiń mmɔŋki kí yòon̄ u-bɔkutil.

english_verse: If God doesn't make the time shorter, no one will be left alive. But because of God's chosen ones, he will make the time shorter.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti yaa kaa bàà bātì falaayee wiiŋyi pu, unibaanti kaa bàà ŋmátí. Ama binib bin u lútì bi sá u-yabee pu ní u bātì iwiin gbanti pu.

english_verse: So when you see all these things happening, you will know the time has almost come.
translation_verse: Míǹ mbaantiim, ni yaa láa ká tin m máafì nee bíi jītée, béémaan yii m-dāantam tóobiń, m sútì ki pìlìń kipunyɔkɔ dee.

english_verse: When the Son of Man appears, things will be just as they were when Noah lived.
translation_verse: Tin nìn jítì Noowa yuntiŋuee, man Kinibiki yaa làá dāá dāan̄ee, míǹ mbaantiim di làá tí jītí.

english_verse: No one knows the day or hour. The angels in heaven don't know, and the Son himself doesn't know. Only the Father knows.
translation_verse: «Báà ubɔ kaa nyí ŋwiin nì kukúluu kun ni an bɔti làá bàńee. Unimbɔti tuuŋyi in bí yilpuee kaa nyí, man u-Jipɔɔn gba kaa nyí, see Ubaati Unimbɔti baba di nyí.

english_verse: People were eating, drinking, and getting married right up to the day the flood came and Noah went into the big boat.
translation_verse: Kí wàatī nnyiŋgbeen ń bàńee, binib nìn jīǹ ki nyù, ní ki cāab̀ binimpoobi ki cáá bi-bisalib ki pūǹ ticati, áli Noowa dāa kpáàa kɔ́ meelan,

english_verse: They didn't know anything was happening until the flood came and swept them all away. This is how it will be when the Son of Man appears.
translation_verse: ní baa kpáàa béè kun dɔ̄ ki cí-bee ní nnyiŋgbeen dɔ́miń ki yōoǹ bi-kɔkɔ. Míǹ mbaantiim ní man Kinibiki yaa làá dāá dāan̄ee, án làá ŋá.

english_verse: Two men will be in the same field, but only one will be taken. The other will be left.
translation_verse: Bininjab bili dāa gbāā kusaaun ki kù, ní ḿ yòon̄ ubɔ kí yàntī un kíǹee.

english_verse: So be on your guard! You don't know when your Lord will come.
translation_verse: An puee, ní taa nín̄ gèem̀maan, kun puee naa nyí ŋwiin ŋun ní ni-Dindaan làá fàtīí gítińee.

english_verse: Homeowners never know when a thief is coming, and they are always on guard to keep one from breaking in.

translation_verse: Míǹ puee, ni mun bɔ́ntímaan kí nīn cí, kun puee man Kinibiki làá dāan̄ kukúluu kun naa dàkafī yii m làá dāan̄ee ní.» Utɔntɔŋkpiti nì utɔntɔmmɔnti bɔti (Kpèè Luuki

english_verse: Who are faithful and wise servants? Who are the ones the master will put in charge of giving the other servants their food supplies at the proper time?
translation_verse: «Ŋma di sá utɔntɔnli un bí deedee ki cáá iciinee ní? Úǹ di sá un u-kpiliu dū u-tɔntɔnjutiibi ki ŋúbiǹ ú nīn tìì-bi tijin ŋyunti ŋun máaǹ ú nīn tìì-bee.

english_verse: Servants are fortunate if their master comes and finds them doing their job.
translation_verse: An sá mmɔn ki tīī utɔntɔnli gbanti u-kpiliu yaa láa fātìi bàn̄ ki ká-u, u bíi tūǹ u-tundee.

english_verse: You may be sure a servant who is always faithful will be put in charge of everything the master owns.
translation_verse: Ibaamɔn ní m tùkù-ni, ukpilee dù u-gaajawanti kɔkɔ ní kí kūtì kí ŋúbíǹ utɔntɔnlee.

english_verse: Suppose this evil servant starts beating the other servants and eats and drinks with people who are drunk.
translation_verse: ní ú kíĺ ki bíi gbáà u-tɔntɔnjutiibi ní u nì bidanyɔgbiliibi bí ki jīǹ ki nyù.

english_verse: If that happens, the master will surely come on a day and at a time when the servant least expects him.
translation_verse: Niinee ní u-kpiliu ń dāá dūú túuǹ-u ŋwiin nì kukúluu kun pu waa nyí yii u làá bàńee,

translation_verse: ní kí dáaĺ u-tafal ŋkpitim pu, kí pà-u mpoonnyoondambi paati. Niin ní u làá sɔ̄ ní u-nyiŋŋi ń nīn gà tɔb kàkaka.»

translation_verse: «Ti-Dindaan Isirayeel Nimbɔtiu ń ká inyɔŋki, kun puee u gíiǹní u-landɔkɔŋu u-niboolii pu ki fīī-bi ki líì.

english_verse: Our God has given us a mighty Savior from the family of David his servant.
translation_verse: U nyántìń-ti Ufiil mpɔndaan ubɔ, udaan sá u-tɔntɔnliu ubɔti Daafiidi maaliŋu poon ní.

english_verse: Long ago the Lord promised by the words of his holy prophets
translation_verse: Kii u nín nìn yāntì u-circir bɔnaatiliibi bin nìn bí njaminee sòon̄ ki síiǹ puee,

english_verse: to save us from our enemies and from everyone who hates us.
translation_verse: yii: u làá nyāntí-ti ti-nannanliibi nì bin kɔkɔ ná-tee ŋaan.

english_verse: God said he would be kind to our people and keep his sacred promise.
translation_verse: U làá dàkà ti-naanjab u-saasɔl, kí téetí u-circir poondi din u nìn pōoǹ-bee pu,

english_verse: that he would rescue us from our enemies. Then we could serve him without fear,
translation_verse: U nìn pōoǹ-u yii u làá nyāntí-ti ti-nannanliibi ŋaan, tí ŋmā kí nóó-u kí taa fàŋkì,

english_verse: by being holy and good as long as we live.
translation_verse: kí nīn bí circir nì deedee u-nimbiin áli ti-kúm dal.

english_verse: You, my son, will be called the prophet of God Most High. You will go ahead of the Lord to get everything ready for him.
translation_verse: Ní sii, kibiki, bi làá dāá nīn yíì-si Yilpu Fɔ́ŋŋŋ Nimbɔtiu bɔnaatiliu ní. Di sá yii sii di làá dāá nīn līī ti-Dindaan nyɔkɔpu kí ŋāŋkì u-saŋŋu,

english_verse: You will tell his people that they can be saved when their sins are forgiven.
translation_verse: ní u-nibul ń béé yii u làá dāá fīī-bi kí dū bi-kpitii kí pɔ̄-bi.

english_verse: God's love and kindness will shine upon us like the sun that rises in the sky.
translation_verse: Kun puee Unimbɔti nín cáá tiŋan u-poon mɔ̄ puee, u làá yàntī yilpu walifiŋu ń ŋmíntí ti-pu kii ŋwìiń nín nyēē puee.

english_verse: On us who live in the dark shadow of death this light will shine to guide us into a life of peace.
translation_verse: Ŋu làá ŋmíntí bin bí dibɔmbɔndinee nì bin bin bí ŋkúm saŋŋu puee, kí kpòotī-ti kí gíiǹ ŋgbansɔŋfi saŋŋun.»

english_verse: As John grew up, God's Spirit gave him great power. John lived in the desert until the time he was sent to the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Kibikee nìn wīintí ní ki-ciiŋyi mun wīintí. U nìn kóòń kuteeun ní áli ki tin sāā daliŋkin u kíĺ ki bíi sòoǹ nì Isirayeel yab Unimbɔti bɔtee.

english_verse: About that time Emperor Augustus gave orders for the names of all the people to be listed in record books.
translation_verse: Ŋyuntee ní gɔminakpaan Oogusti yóoǹ mara yii bí kàaǹ ntimu kɔkɔ nib.

english_verse: At this time a man named Simeon was living in Jerusalem. Simeon was a good man. He loved God and was waiting for him to save the people of Israel. God's Spirit came to him
translation_verse: Uninja ubɔ nìn bí Jeerusaleem, bi yíì-u Simeeyɔn. U nìn yú deedee ki tɔ́ Unimbɔti ní ki nìn kā ki cí un làá dāan̄ kí fīī Isirayeel yabee. Unimbɔti Fam nìn bí u-cee,

english_verse: These first records were made when Quirinius was governor of Syria.
translation_verse: Dikaampeepeekaalee nìn sá ŋyunti ŋun Kriniyusi nìn sá gɔmina Siirii tiŋkinee ní.

english_verse: Everyone had to go to their own hometown to be listed.
translation_verse: Báà ŋma nìn cá u-naanja tiŋkin bí kàaǹ-u.

english_verse: So Joseph had to leave Nazareth in Galilee and go to Bethlehem in Judea. Long ago Bethlehem had been King David's hometown, and Joseph went there because he was from David's family.
translation_verse: Míǹ puee ní Jooseefi mun yíkì Naasaareeti Galiilee tiŋkin ki nín cá ubɔti Daafiidi dumpu Beetileem, Juudee tiŋkin, kun puee u nìn sá Daafiidi naantitɔntɔkɔl ní.

english_verse: Mary was engaged to Joseph and traveled with him to Bethlehem. She was soon going to have a baby,
translation_verse: U nì u-bɔɔn Maarii un nìn sá upɔdaanee di nìn cūtì dikàandi gbanti.

english_verse: she gave birth to her first-born son. She dressed him in baby clothes and laid him on a bed of hay, because there was no room for them in the inn. The Shepherds
translation_verse: U nìn màl̄ u-biseemal kibininjabiki ní ki dū iŋaabu ki fìn̄-kì. U nìn dū-kì ki bíl̀ laakin bi ŋáań tiwaŋkuti timool tì ŋmóòyee, kun puee binib nìn gbí kunicandii poon, baa nìn ŋūǹ kí kɔ́ niin. Unimbɔti tuuŋŋu dɔ́miń bipikpaaliibi cee

english_verse: That night in the fields near Bethlehem some shepherds were guarding their sheep.
translation_verse: Kitiŋ gbanti poonee, bipikpaaliibi biba nìn dɔ̄ tisatin ki kpàá bi-piii.

english_verse: All at once an angel came down to them from the Lord, and the brightness of the Lord's glory flashed around them. The shepherds were frightened.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti tuuŋŋu ŋubɔ nìn cílìń bi-pu, ní ti-Dindaan walifiŋu ŋmíntì ki māntì ki tú-bi ní bi fāŋkì tikpil.

english_verse: But the angel said, “Don't be afraid! I have good news for you, which will make everyone happy.
translation_verse: Ní ntuunee bí-bi yii: «Taa fàŋkìmaan! Dinyɔɔbummɔɔndi din làá mɔ̄ɔkiǹ báà ŋma tikpilee ní m cáań-ni.

english_verse: This very day in King David's hometown a Savior was born for you. He is Christ the Lord.
translation_verse: Dinyɔɔbundi gbanti di sá yii díǹ nyeeku nee, bi màl̄-ni Ufiil ubɔ Daafiidi dumpu Beetileem. Úǹ di sá Kriisitoo, ti-Dindaan.

english_verse: You will know who he is, because you will find him dressed in baby clothes and lying on a bed of hay.”
translation_verse: Min ni làá dūu béé an bikee di sá, ni yaa bàn̄ee, ni làá ká ki dɔ̄ laakin bi ŋáań tiwaŋkuti timoolee, bi dū iŋaabu ki fìn̄-kì.»

english_verse: Suddenly many other angels came down from heaven and joined in praising God. They said:
translation_verse: Kpalaayee, ní Unimbɔti tuuŋyi dikitikpaandi diba nyánní yilpu ki dɔ́miń ki kútì ŋun béeyee pu. I nìn kíĺ ki bíi nyɔ́ŋkí Unimbɔti yii:

english_verse: “Praise God in heaven! Peace on earth to everyone who pleases God.”
translation_verse: «Inyɔŋki sá ki tīī Unimbɔti un bí yilpu fɔ́ŋŋŋee, ní u-gbansɔŋfiŋu sá ki tīī taapu doo nib bin fáatì-uee.» Bipikpaaliibi búntì Beetileem

english_verse: After the angels had left and gone back to heaven, the shepherds said to each other, “Let's go to Bethlehem and see what the Lord has told us about.”
translation_verse: Ituunee yíkì ki nín gítí yilpuee, ní bipikpaaliibee sòon̄ yii: «Tí cùmaan Beetileem! See tí ká tin di bāań ní ti-Dindaan yāntì bi dɔ́miń ki tùkū-tee.»

english_verse: They hurried off and found Mary and Joseph, and they saw the baby lying on a bed of hay.
translation_verse: Niinee ní bi yíkì malaa malaa ki búntì. Bi bàn̄ee, ki ká Maarii nì Jooseefi nì kibiki, kíǹ dɔ̄ laakin bi ŋáań tiwaŋkuti timool tì ŋmóòyee poon.

english_verse: When the shepherds saw Jesus, they told his parents what the angel had said about him.
translation_verse: Bi ká kibikee, ní ki máafì Unimbɔti tuuŋŋu nín dɔ́miń ki tùkū-bi kibiki gbanti bɔti puee.

english_verse: But Mary kept thinking about all this and wondering what it meant.
translation_verse: Ama Maarii úǹ dū an bɔti kɔkɔ ki kpáafì u-pɔbilin ki dàkafī ti-pu.

english_verse: As the shepherds returned to their sheep, they were praising God and saying wonderful things about him. Everything they had seen and heard was just as the angel had said.
translation_verse: Ní bipikpaaliibi fātìi nín gítí bi-pikpaaku laŋki ki nyɔ́ŋkí Unimbɔti ki pàkà-u bi nín gbìl̄ tiŋyee nì tin bi kée pu. Di sá yii ntuunee nín pée tùkū-bi puee, míǹ deedee ní bi ká. Bi pú kibiki diyindi

english_verse: Eight days later Jesus' parents did for him what the Law of Moses commands. And they named him Jesus, just as the angel had told Mary when he promised she would have a baby. Simeon Praises the Lord
translation_verse: An tú winniiyee, bi gíí kibiki dikpancandi ní ki pú-kì diyindi yii Yeesu, kii Unimbɔti tuuŋŋu nín nìn pée tùkū u-na pu kí wàatī ú nín cáá dipoolee. Bi cáá Yeesu kunimbɔtidiin

english_verse: The time came for Mary and Joseph to do what the Law of Moses says a mother is supposed to do after her baby is born. They took Jesus to the temple in Jerusalem and presented him to the Lord,
translation_verse: Ŋyunti ŋun sá bí ŋá Maarii akoobil kii Unimbɔti nín yāntì Mooyiisi ŋmàn̄ marab puee bàn̄ee, ní bi yōoǹ kibiki ki cáa cūnnì Jeerusaleem tiŋkin kí cáá-kì kí ŋá ti-Dindaan ŋaan.

english_verse: just as the Law of the Lord says, “Each first-born baby boy belongs to the Lord.”
translation_verse: An ŋmàn̄ ti-Dindaan marau poon yii: «Kibiseebiki yaa sá kininjabikee, an sá bí gàntī kíǹ ki-ba kí yóoń ti-Dindaan

english_verse: The Law of the Lord also says parents have to offer a sacrifice, giving at least a pair of doves or two young pigeons. So that is what Mary and Joseph did.
translation_verse: ní kí cáá abeenanjipɔmbil ali àá nnanjilimu muli kí ŋá saraa, kii ti-Dindaan nín síiǹ mara puee.»

english_verse: and told him that he would not die until he had seen Christ the Lord.
translation_verse: ní ki nìn tùkū-u yii u làá ká Meesiya ní kí nín kpú.

english_verse: When Mary and Joseph brought Jesus to the temple to do what the Law of Moses says should be done for a new baby, the Spirit told Simeon to go into the temple.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti Fam kpōotì Simeeyɔn ki kɔ́ǹ kunimbɔtidiin ŋyunti ŋun Yeesu na nì u-baa cáá-u niin kí ŋá mara nín bālifì miŋyee.

english_verse: Simeon took the baby Jesus in his arms and praised God,
translation_verse: Simeeyɔn nìn fōō-kì u-ŋaan ki jáam̀ Unimbɔti ki lī yii:

english_verse: “Lord, I am your servant, and now I can die in peace, because you have kept your promise to me.
translation_verse: «M-Dindaan, a nín nìn pōoǹ puee, an ŋá míǹ! Kɔŋkɔnnee, yàntī a-tɔntɔnliu ń kpú nì ŋgbansɔŋfi,

english_verse: and foreign nations will also see this.
translation_verse: un a bɔ́ntì ki yóoǹ inibool kɔkɔee.

english_verse: Your mighty power is a light for all nations, and it will bring honor to your people Israel.”
translation_verse: Úǹ di sá ŋwalifi ŋun làá yàntī atimbul kɔkɔ ń béé-see. Úǹ di làá tīī a-nibul Isirayeel yab tinyool.»

english_verse: Jesus' parents were surprised at what Simeon had said.
translation_verse: Niinee, ní Yeesu baa nì u-na bākatì nì tibɔti tin Simeeyɔn bíi sòoǹ bi-biki puee.

english_verse: Then he blessed them and told Mary, “This child of yours will cause many people in Israel to fall and others to stand. The child will be like a warning sign. Many people will reject him,
translation_verse: Ní Simeeyɔn mēē Unimbɔti ń bìin̄ bi-pu. U mēē ki dóòyee, ní ki bí Maarii yii: «Kpèè, Unimbɔti lēē kibiki nee. Ki-puee Isirayeel yab tikpil làá lítí ní tikpil mun ń yīkì. Úǹ di làá dāá nīn sá Unimbɔti daaŋku kun binib làá dāá kpákaǹee,

english_verse: and you, Mary, will suffer as though you had been stabbed by a dagger. But all this will show what people are really thinking.” Anna Speaks about the Child Jesus
translation_verse: ki làá dāá bìitī binib tikpil landɔkɔi in bál̀ bi-pɔbiliŋ poonee. Ama sii ubinaati, bi nín làá dāá ŋá-u puee làá dāá kɔ́ kí dóó-si, kii kitàataajiki ní bi dūu sāā a-pɔbilee.» Unimbɔti bɔnaatiliu Ana

english_verse: The prophet Anna was also there in the temple. She was the daughter of Phanuel from the tribe of Asher, and she was very old. In her youth she had been married for seven years, but her husband died.
translation_verse: Unimpu ubɔ mun nìn bí, bi yíì-u Ana. U nìn sá Unimbɔti bɔnaatiliu. Fanuyeel un sá Aseer naantitɔntɔkɔlee bisal dee. U nín mɔ́ǹ ticatee, u ŋá abin aluli ní u-cal kpíì,

english_verse: At this time Anna came in and praised God. She spoke about the child Jesus to everyone who hoped for Jerusalem to be set free. The Return to Nazareth
translation_verse: Ŋyunti gbanti ní unimpuee bàn̄ ki ŋmāntiǹ-bi kunimbɔtidiin ní ki bíi pàkā Unimbɔti, ní ki sòoǹ kibikee bɔti ki tùkù bin kɔkɔ kā ki cí Unimbɔti ń dāá fīī Jeerusaleem yabee. Jooseefi nì Maarii nín kùǹ Naasaareeti

english_verse: After Joseph and Mary had done everything that the Law of the Lord commands, they returned home to Nazareth in Galilee.
translation_verse: Yeesu baa nì u-na ŋá ti-Dindaan nín yóoǹ mara bí ŋá puee ki dóòyee, ní bi fātìi nín gítí bi-dumpu Naasaareeti, Galiilee tiŋkin.

english_verse: The child Jesus grew. He became strong and wise, and God blessed him. The Boy Jesus in the Temple
translation_verse: Kibikee nìn wīintí ki cíkití ki cáá iciin tikpil, ní Unimbɔti bīī ki-boon. Yeesu ŋá abin saalaa nì ali ki kɔ́ kunimbɔtidiin

english_verse: Every year Jesus' parents went to Jerusalem for Passover.
translation_verse: Dibindi sá kamaayee, Yeesu baa nì u-na cá Jeerusaleem ní ki jīǹ Dilákatil jiŋaaliu.

english_verse: And when Jesus was twelve years old, they all went there as usual for the celebration.
translation_verse: Yeesu bàn̄ abin saalaa nì alee, u-baa nì u-na tí cá Jeerusaleem jiŋaal kii mara nín bālifì puee, ní ki kpáaǹ-u.

english_verse: After Passover his parents left, but they did not know that Jesus had stayed on in the city.
translation_verse: Bi jíń jiŋaal ki dóòyee, ní Yeesu úǹ gbíntì niin, ní u-baa nì u-na nín kùnní, kaa nyí yii Yeesu gbíntìń.

english_verse: They thought he was traveling with some other people, and they went a whole day before they started looking for him.
translation_verse: Bi nìn cōom̀ ŋwimmɔn ki dàkafī yii u bí bi-saŋkinjutiibi bin kíǹee cee. Boonee ní bi kíǹ ki bíi nyàab̀-u bi-nabiyaamu nì bi-bɔɔbi cee.

english_verse: Three days later they found Jesus sitting in the temple, listening to the teachers and asking them questions.
translation_verse: Winta dalee, ní bi dāa ká-u kunimbɔtidiin, u kā bimaradakaliibi kansikin ki pílifí bi nín sòoǹ puee, ní ki bàlifī-bi tibɔti.

english_verse: Everyone who heard him was surprised at how much he knew and at the answers he gave.
translation_verse: Bin kɔkɔ nìn bí niin ki pílifée nìn bākatì u nín cáá iciin ki kíikí tibɔti miŋyee.

english_verse: When his parents found him, they were amazed. His mother said, “Son, why have you done this to us? Your father and I have been very worried, and we have been searching for you!”
translation_verse: U-baa nì u-na bāań ki ká-u niinee, ní bi bākatì, ní u-na bí yii: «M-biki, ba ŋá ní a ŋá-ti mimmee! Man nì a-baa nyàab̄-si, ti-nimbiliŋ mántì.»

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Why did you have to look for me? Didn't you know that I would be in my Father's house?”
translation_verse: Ní u bí-bi yii: «Ba ŋá ní ni nyàab̄-mi? Naa nyí yii m máaǹ kí nīn bí m-Baa diikunaaa?»

english_verse: But they did not understand what he meant.
translation_verse: Ama baa nìn gbìl̄ u nín sòon̄ puee taapu.

english_verse: Jesus went back to Nazareth with his parents and obeyed them. His mother kept on thinking about all that had happened.
translation_verse: Niinee ní u yíkìi nóó-bi ki nín gítí Naasaareeti, ní ki sīntiǹ u-ba ki tīī-bi. Ní u-na cúú tin kɔkɔ jítì kunimbɔtidiinee ki kpáafì u-pɔbilin.

english_verse: Jesus became wise, and he grew strong. God was pleased with him and so were the people.
translation_verse: Yeesu nìn wīintí ní u-ciiŋyi mun wīintí, ní u nìn mɔ̀tīi fáatíǹ Unimbɔti nì binib.

english_verse: When tax collectors came to be baptized, they asked John, “Teacher, what should we do?”
translation_verse: Ní bifɔtiliibi mun dɔ́miń bí fàl̀-bi Unimbɔti nyim, ní ki bālifì Yoowaneesi yii: «Ukpil, ti máaǹ kí ŋá mana ní?»

english_verse: Do something to show that you really have given up your sins. Don't start saying you belong to Abraham's family. God can turn these stones into children for Abraham.
translation_verse: Lòom̀maan abil ŋin dàkà yii ni kpántì ni-bimbimee, kí taa nín̄ kā ki dàkafī yii Abraam sá ni-naanja! M tùkù-ni ibaamɔn ní, di sá Unimbɔti ŋūǹ kí dū ataŋkpee nee kí kpántí Abraam naantiibi.

english_verse: But to Herod the ruler, he said, “It was wrong for you to take Herodias, your brother's wife.” John also said Herod had done many other bad things.
translation_verse: Yoowaneesi wòon̄ ubɔti Eeroodi un nìn cáá u-maan nimpuu Eeroodiyadee nì u nín túń atuŋkpiti tikpil ŋin ki kútèe.

english_verse: Annas and Caiaphas were the Jewish high priests. At that time God spoke to Zechariah's son John, who was living in the desert.
translation_verse: ní Ana nì Kaayiifi sá bisaraaŋakpilib. Ŋyunti gbanti ní Unimbɔti nìn sòon̄ nì Yoowaneesi, Sakari jipɔɔn kuteeun.

english_verse: Isaiah the prophet wrote about John when he said, “In the desert someone is shouting, ‘Get the road ready for the Lord! Make a straight path for him.
translation_verse: An nóó nì Unimbɔti bɔnaatiliu Yeesaya nín ŋmàn̄ u-gbɔŋku poon puee yii: «Ubɔ báakí kuteeun yii: Bɔ́ntímaan ti-Dindaan saŋŋu kí tàntīmaan u-sàmbiyaamu kí cīití-u.

english_verse: Fill up every valley and level every mountain and hill. Straighten the crooked paths and smooth out the rough roads.
translation_verse: Atantaka kɔkɔ làá dāá gbīŋkì, ajoon nì ŋgbantamu kɔkɔ làá bìtī. Asaŋgɔŋgɔl làá tàntī. Isan in cáá abɔbil abɔbilee làá ŋāŋkì.

english_verse: Then everyone will see the saving power of God.’ ”
translation_verse: Ní báà ŋma ń dāá ká Unimbɔti nín fìil̄ binib puee.»

english_verse: Crowds of people came out to be baptized, but John said to them, “You bunch of snakes! Who warned you to run from the coming judgment?
translation_verse: Yoowaneesi nìn lì kunipaau kun nìn dòoń ú fàl̀-bi nnyimee yii: «Nimbi bin tū kii ikoowaatee, ŋma di tùkū-ni yii ni ŋūǹ kí sāǹ kí ŋmátí Unimbɔti ŋuul din dòońee ni?

english_verse: The crowds asked John, “What should we do?”
translation_verse: Ní kunipaauee bíi bàlifī-u yii: «Mimmee, ti làá ŋá mana ní kí fáatí Unimbɔti?»

english_verse: Some soldiers asked him, “And what about us? What do we have to do?” John told them, “Don't force people to pay money to make you leave them alone. Be satisfied with your pay.”
translation_verse: Ní soojab mun dɔ́miń ki bālifì-u yii: «Timbi máaǹ kí ŋá mana?» Ní u kíí-bi yii: «Ní taa nín̄ dàkà binib mpɔn, kí taa nín̄ gífí inyimɔn ki tūntí binib pu, ama ní yàntī tipaal tin ni fòol̄ uŋmal uŋmalee ń nīn mɔ̄ǹ-ni.»

english_verse: John said, “I am just baptizing with water. But someone more powerful is going to come, and I am not good enough even to untie his sandals. He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and with fire.
translation_verse: Niinee ní Yoowaneesi bí bi-kɔkɔ yii: «Man fùul̀-ni nì nnyim ní, ama ubɔ dòoń, u-pɔŋŋu jítiǹ man yɔŋu. Man kaa kpántì kí nīn sá u-yumbuu kí kútí u-naataaŋmiii gba. Úǹ di làá dāá fàl̀-ni nì Unimbɔti Fam nì ŋŋmi.

english_verse: In many different ways John preached the good news to the people.
translation_verse: Míǹ ní Yoowaneesi nìn sáŋkí binib, ki gíti kútí-bi tibɔti tikpil ní ki sòoǹ nì bi tibɔmɔntiil.

english_verse: Finally, Herod put John in jail, and this was the worst thing he had done. The Baptism of Jesus (Matthew
translation_verse: Niinee ní Eeroodi gíti túń dituŋkpitil diba ki kútì, di sá yii u cúú Yoowaneesi ki pīiǹ kudii. Bi fùl̄ Yeesu Unimbɔti nyim (Kpèè Maat

english_verse: While everyone else was being baptized, Jesus himself was baptized. Then as he prayed, the sky opened up,
translation_verse: Báà ŋma nìn cá bi fùul̀-bi Unimbɔti nyim. Yeesu mun nìn fùl̄ Unimbɔti nyim. U fùl̄ ki bíi mèéyee, kutagbɔŋu cúu pīitì,

translation_verse: ní Unimbɔti Fam kpákatìń u-pu ki náań nì dibeenanjil ní bi gbìl̄ Unimbɔti sòon̄ní kutaa pu yii: «Sii di sá man Jipɔɔn un m néeń tikpilee, sii ní m-pɔbil fáatì.» Yeesu naanjab yiŋŋi (Kpèè Maat

translation_verse: Ubɔ yaa fáá a-taŋkpanjil diba ntampee, á fàtī din kíǹee kí tīī-u ú fáá. Ubɔ yaa yōoǹ a-kpalibuee, á yàntī ú yòon̄ a-bɔkutiwaaki mun.

translation_verse: Utumbifil kaa bí ki jítiǹ u-kpiliu, ama, u yaa bífì tiŋanee, u dāa kpántí kii u-kpiliuee ní.

english_verse: You can see the speck in your friend's eye, but you don't notice the log in your own eye.
translation_verse: «Ba pu ní a wāĺ kimɔmbiki kin kā a-nabiki nimbilinee ní kaa wāĺ didɔjal din kā sii yalinee?

english_verse: How can you say, “My friend, let me take the speck out of your eye,” when you don't see the log in your own eye? You show-offs! First, get the log out of your own eye; then you can see how to take the speck out of your friend's eye. A Tree and Its Fruit (Matthew
translation_verse: Àá mana ní sii un kaa wāĺ didɔjal din kā a-nimbilinee ŋūǹ kí lì a-nabiki yii: <M-nabiki, yàntī ḿ lēē-si kimɔmbiki a-nimbilin!> Mpoonnyoondaan, lēē didɔjal din kā sii a-ba nimbilinee kí wàatī, kí nín wāl̀ mmɔntiimin kí lēē kimɔmbiki kin kā a-nabiki nimbilinee.» Busubu nì bu-biliŋ bɔti (Kpèè Maat

translation_verse: «Busumɔntiibu kaa lòoǹ asubikpiti, míǹ ní busukpitibu mun kaa lòoǹ asubimɔnti.

english_verse: You can tell what a tree is like by the fruit it produces. You cannot pick figs or grapes from thornbushes.
translation_verse: Busubu kamaa bil pu ní bi béetí-bu. Baa kìtī kɔŋkib abɔjanaakun pu, kaa tí tòó atuun kikuŋkumbɔŋ pu.

translation_verse: M làá dàkà-ni bin dòoń m-cee ki pílifí m-bɔti ki kpáafí-tee nín náań nì kuŋyee.

translation_verse: Di sá, man cáá bikpilib bin taapu m bée, ní ki cáá soojab bin mun bí man taapuee. M ŋūǹ kí tùkù ubɔ yii: <Cù doo,> ní ú cù, ki ŋūǹ kí tùkù ubɔ mun yii: <Dāan̄ doo,> ní ú dāan̄, ní kí bí m-tɔntɔnliu una yii: <Ŋá yéè,> ní ú ŋá.»

english_verse: When Jesus heard this, he was so surprised that he turned and said to the crowd following him, “In all of Israel I've never found anyone with this much faith!”
translation_verse: Yeesu nín gbìl̄ mimmee, an ŋá-u bitii ní ki mɔ́ɔkiǹ-u, ní u fātì ki bí kunipaau kun nóó-uee yii: «Ibaamɔn ní m sòoǹ, maa láá pée ká ubɔ cáá fookii yéè Isirayeel yab kansikin gba.»

english_verse: At that time Jesus was healing many people who were sick or in pain or were troubled by evil spirits, and he was giving sight to a lot of blind people.
translation_verse: Ŋyunti ŋun bi bāań Yeesu ceeyee, u bíi cāantí bibunliibi tikpil iween kupaau, ki jì arasiniibi binib pu, ki ŋúbití bijɔfub nimbiliŋ.

People who have leprosy are being healed, and the deaf can now hear. The dead are raised to life, and the poor are hearing the good news.
translation_verse: Ní u fātìi kíí bin Yoowaneesi túnnée yii: «Nín̄ cámaan kí tùkù Yoowaneesi tin ni kée nì tin ni gbìl̄ee: bijɔfub nimbiliŋ ŋúbití, bideembi còom̄, binyaŋgbantiibi pɔ́ɔkí, bitafakpaafub kíǹ ki gbìl̀, bitaŋkpiibi fìkitī, ní biwɔfib gbìl̀ tibɔmɔntiil.

english_verse: After John's messengers had gone, Jesus began speaking to the crowds about John: What kind of person did you go out to the desert to see? Was he like tall grass blown about by the wind?
translation_verse: Yoowaneesi boonnooliibee nín gítée, ní Yeesu bíi sòoǹ nì kunipaau Yoowaneesi pu yii: «Ni cūtì kuteeun kí kpèè Yoowaneesee, dinicil dilal ní u sá ní? U-bɔti kpántí kii kubuŋu nín fīintí dikaliŋgbaandi pueeee? Aayee.

english_verse: What kind of man did you really go out to see? Was he someone dressed in fine clothes? People who wear expensive clothes and live in luxury are in the king's palace.
translation_verse: Kin ba ní ni cūtìí kpèè ní? Uninja ubɔ un pēē abɔkutimɔnteeee? Aayee. Bin pēē agaajabɔkuti ki bí mmɔntiiminee bí bibɔtiibi dumpui ní.

english_verse: What then did you go out to see? Was he a prophet? He certainly was! I tell you that he was more than a prophet.
translation_verse: Kin ba pu ní ni baasii cūtì ki kpēē Yoowaneesi ní? Ni cūtìí kpèè-u yii u nín sá Unimbɔti bɔnaatiliuee níii? Tiŋman ní m sòoǹ nì ni, un ni ká niinee jítiǹ Unimbɔti bɔnaatiliibi.

english_verse: In the Scriptures, God calls John his messenger and says, “I am sending my messenger ahead of you to get things ready for you.”
translation_verse: Kun puee Yoowaneesi pu ní Unimbɔti gbɔŋku poon sòon̄ yii: Unimbɔti bí yii: <M làá tɔ̄ń m-tuuŋŋu ŋú lìntīń a-nyɔkɔpu kí ŋānkì-si nsan.>»

english_verse: No one ever born on this earth is greater than John. But whoever is least important in God's kingdom is greater than John.

english_verse: Everyone had been listening to John. Even the tax collectors had obeyed God and had done what was right by letting John baptize them.
translation_verse: Dinikitil kɔkɔ, ki kpáaǹ bifɔtiliibi gba, pílifiǹ Yoowaneesi ní ki béè yii Unimbɔti sá deedeedaan ní ki yāntì Yoowaneesi fùl̄-bi Unimbɔti nyim.

english_verse: But the Pharisees and the experts in the Law of Moses refused to obey God and be baptized by John.
translation_verse: Ama ní Fariisab nì bimaradakaliibi yíì min Unimbɔti bàà là bí ŋée, kaa cāntì Yoowaneesi fùl̄-bi Unimbɔti nyim.

english_verse: Jesus went on to say: What are you people like? What kind of people are you?
translation_verse: Ní Yeesu gíti bí yii: «Ba ní m làá dū kí ŋmàntīǹ nimbi waanee nib dee? Ni náań nì ba deeyaaa?

english_verse: You are like children sitting in the market and shouting to each other, “We played the flute, but you would not dance! We sang a funeral song, but you would not cry!”
translation_verse: Ni náań nì mbiyaamu mun kā mmɔŋki ki tátí mu-jutiibi pu yii: <Ti búń-ni awul, naa ŋɔ́ń, ní ti gāā-ni ikpiisilan, naa súń.>

english_verse: John the Baptist did not go around eating and drinking, and you said, “John has a demon in him!”
translation_verse: Di sá Yoowaneesi un fùul̀ binib Unimbɔti nyimee dɔ́miń, kaa jīǹaaa, kaa nyù ndaam, ní naa fōō-u ní ki bí yii arasinii di bí u-pu.

english_verse: But because the Son of Man goes around eating and drinking, you say, “Jesus eats and drinks too much! He is even a friend of tax collectors and sinners.”
translation_verse: Ní man Kinibiki dɔ́miń ki jīǹ ki nyù ní ni bí yii: <Kpèèmaan, uninja nee, úǹ sá upoofu nì udanyɔl ní ki bɔ́ɔtí bifɔtiliibi nì binikpitib bin kɔkɔ kíǹee.>»

english_verse: Yet Wisdom is shown to be right by what its followers do. Simon the Pharisee
translation_verse: Ama bin fōō Unimbɔti ciiŋyi ki kííyee dàkà yii i sá deedee. Yeesu pú unimpu ubɔ u-kpitii

english_verse: A Pharisee invited Jesus to have dinner with him. So Jesus went to the Pharisee's home and got ready to eat.

english_verse: When a sinful woman in that town found out that Jesus was there, she bought an expensive bottle of perfume.
translation_verse: Kinimpulaakpaai kiba nìn bí kitiŋ gbantin. U nín gbìl̄ yii Yeesu bí Fariisee dumpu ki jīǹee ní u yōoǹní talaalu un kā ditaŋkpal kpalbaunee.

english_verse: Then she came and stood behind Jesus. She cried and started washing his feet with her tears and drying them with her hair. The woman kissed his feet and poured the perfume on them.

english_verse: The Pharisee who had invited Jesus saw this and said to himself, “If this man really were a prophet, he would know what kind of woman is touching him! He would know that she is a sinner.”
translation_verse: Ufariisaja un nìn yíiń Yeesu bí jēe nín ká mimmee ní u bíi dàkafī u-pɔbilin yii: «Kijapaai nee yaa bàà lafun sá Unimbɔti bɔnaatiliu, u bàà béetí unimpu un gbèetī-u nee nín sá dinimpucil diŋyee, kun puee u sá kilaakpaai ní.»

english_verse: Jesus said to the Pharisee, “Simon, I have something to say to you.” “Teacher, what is it?” Simon replied.
translation_verse: Ní Yeesu bí-u yii: «Siimɔn, m cáá tiba ki làá tùkù-si.» Ní Siimɔn kíí-u yii: «Ukpil, sòoǹ.»

translation_verse: Ní Yeesu bí yii: «Kijapaai kiba nìn pīnnì binib bili animbil. Ubɔ nìn cáá-u dipɔndi animbil jitɔmbi alaataa aŋmoo, ní un kíǹee imuŋku ili nì saalaa.

english_verse: But Jesus told the woman, “Because of your faith, you are now saved. May God give you peace!”
