translation_verse: Fariisab biba nìn bí bin bi nìn túnní Yoowaneesi ceeyee kansikin,

english_verse: They asked him, “Why are you baptizing people, if you are not the Messiah or Elijah or the Prophet?”
translation_verse: ní bíǹ bālifì-u yii: «A yaa kaa sá Meesiya, kaa sá Eelii, kaa tí sá Unimbɔti bɔnaatiliu un ti cée, kin ba pu ní a fùul̀ binib Unimbɔti nyim?»

english_verse: John told them, “I use water to baptize people. But here with you is someone you don't know.
translation_verse: Ní Yoowaneesi kíí-bi yii: «Man fùul̀ binib nnyim ní, ama ubɔ bí ni-kansikin, naa nyí-u,

english_verse: Even though I came first, I am not good enough to untie his sandals.”
translation_verse: úǹ di làá dāá dāan̄ man boon. Man kaa kpántì kí gútí u-naatakaŋ ŋmiii gba.»

english_verse: John said this as he was baptizing east of the Jordan River in Bethany. The Lamb of God
translation_verse: Bi nìn bí Beetanii, kitiŋ kin bí Jɔɔdan buŋgbandi lapu pu, laakin Yoowaneesi fùul̀ binib nnyimee, ní ki sòoǹ an bɔti gbanti. Unimbɔti pibil

english_verse: The next day, John saw Jesus coming toward him and said: Here is the Lamb of God who takes away the sin of the world!
translation_verse: Kutaa wúntèe ní Yoowaneesi ká Yeesu dòoń u-cee, ní u bí yii: «Kpèèmaan, Unimbɔti pibil din lèekī binib kɔkɔ kpitiiyee dee!

english_verse: He is the one I told you about when I said, “Someone else will come, who is greater than I am, because he was alive before I was born.”
translation_verse: Úǹ pu ní m fu sòon̄ yii: <Uninja ubɔ làá dāá dāan̄ man boon, ama úǹ jítiǹ man, kun puee úǹ pée bí ní bi nín màl̄ man.>

english_verse: I didn't know who he was. But I came to baptize you with water, so that everyone in Israel would see him.
translation_verse: Maa nìn nyí un ní an sée, ama an sá yii Isirayeel yab ń béé-uee pu ní man dɔ́miń ki bíi fùul̀ binib Unimbɔti nyim.»

english_verse: I was there and saw the Spirit come down on him like a dove from heaven. And the Spirit stayed on him.
translation_verse: Ní Yoowaneesi gíti lī yii: «M ká Unimbɔti Fam lafun nyánní yilpu kii dibeenanjilee ki kpákatìń Yeesu pu.

english_verse: Before this I didn't know who he was. But the one who sent me to baptize with water had told me, “You will see the Spirit come down and stay on someone. Then you will know that he is the one who will baptize with the Holy Spirit.”
translation_verse: Maa nìn nyí un ní an sée, ama Unimbɔti un túnní-mi ḿ nīn fùul̀ binib u-nyimee bí-mi yii: <A yaa láa ká man Fam kpákatìń ki kóò un puee, úǹ di làá fàl̀ binib Circir Fam.>

english_verse: I saw this happen, and I tell you that he is the Son of God. The First Disciples of Jesus
translation_verse: M ká mimmee, ní ki sòoǹ ki tùkù-ni yii úǹ di sá Unimbɔti Jipɔɔn.» Biboonnooliibi bin Yeesu péé péé ki yíińee

english_verse: The next day, John was there again, and two of his followers were with him.
translation_verse: Kutaa tí wúntèe, Yoowaneesi nì u-boonnooliibi bili tí yú.

english_verse: When he saw Jesus walking by, he said, “Here is the Lamb of God!”
translation_verse: U ká Yeesu bíi jītée ní u kpēē-u dímmm ki bí yii: «Kpèèmaan, Unimbɔti pibil sèé!»

english_verse: John's two followers heard him, and they went with Jesus.
translation_verse: Yoowaneesi boonnooliibi bilee gbìl̄ mimmee, ní ki nóó Yeesu.

english_verse: When Jesus turned and saw them, he asked, “What do you want?” They answered, “Rabbi, where do you live?” The Hebrew word “Rabbi” means “Teacher.”
translation_verse: Yeesu fātìi kpēē bi nóó-uee, ní ki bí-bi yii: «Ni nyàab̀ ba?» Ní bi bí yii: «Rabii, la ní a kóò ní?» - Rabii taapu di sá yii, Udakal. -

english_verse: Jesus replied, “Come and see!” It was already about four o'clock in the afternoon when they went with him and saw where he lived. So they stayed on for the rest of the day.
translation_verse: Ní Yeesu bí yii: «Dāam̄maan kí cùú béé laakin m kóòyee.» Ní bi nóó-u ki cūtìi béè laakin u kóòyee, ní ki kpáàa gbíntì niin yaadal wiiŋŋu. An nìn sá tikúti tinaa kujoou ní bi nìn cūtì.

english_verse: One of the two men who had heard John and had gone with Jesus was Andrew, the brother of Simon Peter.
translation_verse: Andree un sá Siimɔn Peetroo naalee nìn sá binib bilee kansikin ubɔ bin nìn gbìl̄ Yoowaneesi nyɔɔbundi gbanti ki nóó Yeesuee,

english_verse: The first thing Andrew did was to find his brother and tell him, “We have found the Messiah!” The Hebrew word “Messiah” means the same as the Greek word “Christ.”
translation_verse: ní Andree péé ki cūtìi ká u-maan Siimɔn ki tùkū-u yii: «Timbi ká Meesiya!» - An dàkà yii Kriisitoo. -

english_verse: Andrew brought his brother to Jesus. And when Jesus saw him, he said, “Simon son of John, you will be called Cephas.” This name can be translated as “Peter.” Jesus Chooses Philip and Nathanael
translation_verse: Ní u cáá Siimɔn ki cūnnì Yeesu cee. Ní Yeesu kpēē-u ní ki bí yii: «Sii di sá Siimɔn Yoowaneesi jipɔɔn. Bi làá nīn kíǹ ki yíì-si Keefaasi ní», an dàkà yii Peetroo. Yeesu yíiń Fiiliipi nì Natanayeel

english_verse: Philip then found Nathanael and said, “We have found the one that Moses and the Prophets wrote about. He is Jesus, the son of Joseph from Nazareth.”
translation_verse: Boonee ní Fiiliipi ká Natanayeel, ki tùkū-u yii: «Timbi ká un pu ní Mooyiisi nìn ŋmàn̄ u-marab gbɔŋkun ki kpáaǹ Unimbɔti bɔnaatiliibi mun sòon̄ u-puee. An sá Yeesu Jooseefi jipɔɔn un sá Naasaareetee.»

english_verse: Nathanael asked, “Can anything good come from Nazareth?” Philip answered, “Come and see.”
translation_verse: Ní Natanayeel bālifì-u yii: «Mimmee, tiwammɔntiil ŋūǹ kí nyānní Naasaareeti mun deeee?» Ní Fiiliipi bí-u yii: «Dāan̄ kí cùú kpèè.»

english_verse: When Jesus saw Nathanael coming toward him, he said, “Here is a true descendant of our ancestor Israel. And he isn't deceitful.”
translation_verse: Yeesu kpēēyee, Natanayeel dòoń u-cee, ní u bíi sòoǹ u-pu yii: «Un bí nee di sá uisirayeelja páaa, kaa sá milimilidaan.»

english_verse: “How do you know me?” Nathanael asked. Jesus answered, “Before Philip called you, I saw you under the fig tree.”
translation_verse: Ní Natanayeel bālifì-u yii: «A ŋá mana ní ki nyí-mi?» Ní Yeesu kíí-u yii: «Min a bí fiigi subu taapuee ní man ká-si ki wāatì ní Fiiliipi dāa nín yíiń-see.»

english_verse: Nathanael said, “Rabbi, you are the Son of God and the King of Israel!”
translation_verse: Niinee ní Natanayeel bí-u yii: «Ukpil, a sá Unimbɔti Jipɔɔn ki sá Isirayeel yab mun bɔtiu!»

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Did you believe me just because I said that I saw you under the fig tree? You will see something even greater.
translation_verse: Ní Yeesu bí-u yii: «M nín bí yii m ká-si fiigi subu taapuee pu ní a fōō ki kííii? A làá gíti ká tin jítiǹ tin bí neeyee.

english_verse: I tell you for certain you will see heaven open and God's angels going up and coming down on the Son of Man.”
translation_verse: Ibaamɔn ní m tùkù-ni, ni làá dāá ká kutagbɔŋu cúu pīitì, ní Unimbɔti tuuŋyi sìntīń ki jɔ́ḿ man Kinibiki pu.»

english_verse: Three days later Mary, the mother of Jesus, was at a wedding feast in the village of Cana in Galilee.
translation_verse: Winta dalee, tinimpucan tiba nìn bí Kana, Galiilee timbiliikin. Yeesu na mun nìn bí niin,

english_verse: Jesus and his disciples had also been invited and were there.
translation_verse: ní bi nìn yíiń Yeesu mun nì u-boonnooliibi bí dāan̄.

english_verse: When the wine was all gone, Mary said to Jesus, “They don't have any more wine.”
translation_verse: Ndaam dāa dóòyee, ní Yeesu na bí-u yii: «Bi-daam dóòyaa!»

english_verse: Jesus replied, “Mother, my time hasn't yet come! You must not tell me what to do.”
translation_verse: Ní Yeesu kíí-u yii: «M-na, sii di làá tùkù-mi m nín làá ŋá pueeee? Ŋyunti ŋun m làá tɔ̄ m-tundee kaa láá ŋmāntì.»

english_verse: Mary then said to the servants, “Do whatever Jesus tells you to do.”
translation_verse: Niinee ní Yeesu na bí bitɔntɔnliibi bin bí niinee yii: «U yaa bí ní ŋá puee, ŋámaan míǹ.»

english_verse: At the feast there were six stone water jars that were used by the people for washing themselves in the way that their religion said they must. Each jar held about
translation_verse: Ataŋkpee lɔnti tiluu nìn yú. Niin ní bi nìn jòotī nnyim ki fíntí, kii Juuda yab koobiliŋ nín sá puee. Kulɔŋŋu kamaa nìn fòol̄ nnyim liitirib dilaataal ní.

english_verse: Jesus told the servants to fill them to the top with water. Then after the jars had been filled,
translation_verse: Ní Yeesu bí bitɔntɔnliibee yii bí lúń nnyim kí gbéeǹ tilɔn gbanti. Ní bi lafun lúń ki gbéeǹ yátí yati.

english_verse: he said, “Now take some water and give it to the man in charge of the feast.” The servants did as Jesus told them,
translation_verse: Niinee ní Yeesu bí-bi yii: «Jōōmaan kí cáá tīī ukpil un kpèé tijinee!» Ní bi jōō ki cáa tīī-u.

english_verse: and the man in charge drank some of the water that had now turned into wine. He did not know where the wine had come from, but the servants did. He called the bridegroom over
translation_verse: Ukpilee dákée, nnyimee kpántì ndaam. Waa nìn nyí laakin ndaamee nyánnée, see bitɔntɔnliibi bin nìn lúń nnyimee di nyí. Niinee ní u yíiń unimpucaan cal,

english_verse: and said, “The best wine is always served first. Then after the guests have had plenty, the other wine is served. But you have kept the best until last!”
translation_verse: ní ki bí-u yii: «Bi péetí kí cáań ndamɔntiim, ní binib yaa nyùn̄ an nyāatì-bee ní bí nín nyāntiń min kaa mɔ̄tìi mɔ̄ee. Ní sii dū ndamɔntiim ki kpáafì ki dāa cāabìń-mi naŋkɔnampuɔɔɔ?»

english_verse: But Jesus was talking about his body as a temple.
translation_verse: Ama Yeesu nìn sòoǹ u-wunti pu ní ki nántiǹ kunimbɔtidii.

english_verse: Not long before the Jewish festival of Passover, Jesus went to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Juuda yab jiŋaaliu un bi yíì Dilákatil jiŋaaliuee nìn tóobińee, ní Yeesu nín cá Jeerusaleem.

english_verse: So he took some rope and made a whip. Then he chased everyone out of the temple, together with their sheep and cattle. He turned over the tables of the moneychangers and scattered their coins.
translation_verse: Ní u nyàab̄ iŋmii ki dūu ŋá dinaalabil, ní ki jìn̄-bi ki nyántì nì bi-piii nì bi-naai kɔkɔ, ní ki dū binimbikpantiliibi nimbiliŋ ki yàl̄ kitiŋ, ní ki lábitì bi-teebilib ki cìb̄,

english_verse: The disciples then remembered that the Scriptures say, “My love for your house burns in me like a fire.”
translation_verse: Niinee ní u-boonnooliibi téetì tibɔti tin bi ŋmàn̄ Unimbɔti gbɔŋkunee, yii: «Ti-Dindaan, m nín mɔ́tí a-diiku nee pu miŋyee di wù m-pɔbilin kii ŋŋmee.»

english_verse: “Destroy this temple,” Jesus answered, “and in three days I will build it again!”
translation_verse: Ní Yeesu kíí-bi yii: «Wīīmaan kunimbɔtidii nee, iwiin ita dal m làá fàtīí mā-ku.»

english_verse: There he found people selling cattle, sheep, and doves in the temple. He also saw moneychangers sitting at their tables.
translation_verse: U bàn̄ ki kɔ́ kunimbɔtidiinee ní ki ká bin nyáfí inaa, nì ipii nì abeenanjilee nì binimbikpantiliibi kā.

english_verse: Jesus said to the people who had been selling doves, “Get those doves out of here! Don't make my Father's house a marketplace.”
translation_verse: ní ki bí bin nyáfí abeenanjilee yii: «Nyāntímaan ni-wanti nee doo. Ní taa nín̄ cáá m-Baa diiku ki kpántí kunyɔmpudii!»

english_verse: The Jewish leaders asked Jesus, “What miracle will you work to show us why you have done this?”
translation_verse: Ní Juuda yab kpilib bí-u yii: «Dàkà-ti kudaaŋŋu ní tí béé yii a cáá nsan kí ŋá min a ŋá nee!»

english_verse: And when he was raised from death, his disciples remembered what he had told them. Then they believed the Scriptures and the words of Jesus. Jesus Knows What People Are Like
translation_verse: Boon u nín dāa fīkitì ditaŋkpiilinee ní u-boonnooliibi téetì yii u nìn lī míǹ, ní ki fōō tin bi nìn ŋmàn̄ Unimbɔti gbɔŋkunee nì Yeesu nín sòon̄ tin u-fìkititam puee ki kíí. Yeesu nyí tin bí unil pɔbilinee kɔkɔ

english_verse: In Jerusalem during Passover many people put their faith in Jesus, because they saw him work miracles.
translation_verse: Yeesu nín nìn bí Jeerusaleem Dilákatil jiŋaaliu yuntiŋuee ní binib tikpil kántì maamaacib bin u ŋáańee ní ki fōō-u ki kíí.

english_verse: But Jesus knew what was in their hearts, and he would not let them have power over him.
translation_verse: Ama Yeesu kaa nìn máká bi-pu. Di sá yii u nyí bi-kɔkɔ nín sá biŋyee.

english_verse: No one had to tell him what people were like. He already knew.
translation_verse: Waa nyàab̀ ubɔ ń tùkù-u kun bi sée, kun puee u nyí tin bí unil pɔbilinee.

english_verse: There was a man named Nicodemus who was a Pharisee and a Jewish leader.
translation_verse: Uninja ubɔ nìn bí, bi yíì-u Niikoodeem. U nìn bí Fariisab jandi pú ní ki sá Juuda yab kpiliu ubɔ.

english_verse: One night he went to Jesus and said, “Rabbi, we know that God has sent you to teach us. You could not work these miracles, unless God were with you.”
translation_verse: Ukpilee nìn dɔ́miń Yeesu cee kunyeeu kubɔ ní ki bí-u yii: «Ukpil, ti nyí yii Unimbɔti di túnní-si á dāan̄ kí dàkà-ti. Di sá yii, Unimbɔti yaa kaa bí unil cee, waa ŋūǹ kí ŋá maamaacib kii bin a ŋáań nee.»

english_verse: Jesus replied, “I tell you for certain that you must be born from above before you can see God's kingdom!”
translation_verse: Ní Yeesu kíí-u yii: «Ibaamɔn ní m tùkù-si, Unimbɔti yaa kaa fātìi màl̄ unil mpɔm, u kpá kí ká Unimbɔti Beel.»

english_verse: Nicodemus asked, “How can a grown man ever be born a second time?”
translation_verse: Ní Niikoodeem bālifì-u yii: «Mimmee, mana ní bi gíti ŋūǹ kí màal̀ unil un púĺee mpɔm? Unil ŋūǹ kí fàtīí gíti kɔ́ u-na poon bí màal̀-uaaa?»

english_verse: Jesus answered: I tell you for certain that before you can get into God's kingdom, you must be born not only by water, but by the Spirit.
translation_verse: Ní Yeesu gíti bí-u yii: «Ibaamɔn, ibaamɔn ní m tùkù-si, ubɔ kaa ŋūǹ kí kɔ́ Unimbɔti Beelin bi yaa kaa fātìi màl̄ udaan mpɔm nì nnyim nì Unimbɔti Famin.

english_verse: Humans give life to their children. Yet only God's Spirit can change you into a child of God.
translation_verse: Bin binib màal̀ee di sá nnibiyaamu, ní bin Unimbɔti Fam màal̀ee mun sá ŋfam.

english_verse: Don't be surprised when I say that you must be born from above.
translation_verse: M nín bí yii: <Ni-kɔkɔ máaǹ Unimbɔti ń fàtīí màal̀-ni mpɔmee>, án taa bàkatīǹ-si.

english_verse: Only God's Spirit gives new life. The Spirit is like the wind that blows wherever it wants to. You can hear the wind, but you don't know where it comes from or where it is going.
translation_verse: Kubuŋu jītí ki cá laakin pú ku yaa lèe, ní a gbìl̀ ku-wooku pu ní kaa nyí laakin pú ku nyáńeeyaaa, kaa nyí laakin pú ku cée mun, míǹ ní an ŋáań bin kɔkɔ Unimbɔti Fam màal̀ee.»

english_verse: “How can this be?” Nicodemus asked.
translation_verse: Ní Niikoodeem bí-u yii: «Mana ní an ŋūǹ kí ŋá míǹ?»

english_verse: Jesus replied: How can you be a teacher of Israel and not know these things?
translation_verse: Ní Yeesu fātìi kíí-u yii: «Sii un sá udakakpaan ki dàkà Isirayeel yabee di kaa nyí tin bí neeee?

english_verse: I tell you for certain we know what we are talking about because we have seen it ourselves. But none of you will accept what we say.
translation_verse: Ibaamɔn, Ibaamɔn ní m tùkù-si nee, ti sòoǹ nì ni tin ti nyée nì tin ti kée, ní naa là kí fōō tin ti lèe.

english_verse: If you don't believe when I talk to you about things on earth, how can you possibly believe if I talk to you about things in heaven?
translation_verse: M sòon̄ nì ni taapu doo bɔti tin báà ŋma nyée, ní naa là kí fōō kí kíí, kin m yaa láa póotì ki bíi sòoǹ yilpu bɔti tin naa wāĺee, ni dāa ŋáań mana kí fōō tíǹ kí kíí?

english_verse: No one has gone up to heaven except the Son of Man, who came down from there.
translation_verse: Báà ubɔ kaa láá pée jɔ́m̀ yilpu, asee man Kinibiki kin nyánní yilpu ki sīntìńee.

english_verse: And the Son of Man must be lifted up, just as the metal snake was lifted up by Moses in the desert.
translation_verse: «Kii Mooyiisi nín nìn lúntì kukoonaŋu ndɔ pu kuteeun binib kpèé ki pɔ́ɔkée, míǹ mbaantiim ní bi làá dāá dū man Kinibiki kí lúntí yilpu,

english_verse: Then everyone who has faith in the Son of Man will have eternal life.
translation_verse: án nín làá ŋá pu un sá kamaa yaa láa fōō-mi ki kííyee ń dāá ká dimaŋfal din kaa cáá dikúntilee.

english_verse: God loved the people of this world so much that he gave his only Son, so that everyone who has faith in him will have eternal life and never really die.
translation_verse: Kun puee Unimbɔti néeń kitiŋ pu nib kɔkɔ tikpil, míǹ pu ní u dū u-Jipɔmbaabil ki tīī, án nín làá ŋá pu un sá kamaa yaa fōō-u ki kííyee ń taa kpú, ama ú ká dimaŋfal din kaa cáá dikúntilee.

english_verse: God did not send his Son into the world to condemn its people. He sent him to save them!
translation_verse: Unimbɔti nín túnní u-Jipɔɔn duulinyan doo nee, an kaa sá u là kí kpɔ̀ binib bɔti, ama u là bi-kɔkɔ ń ká difiil u-Jipɔɔn pu ní.

english_verse: No one who has faith in God's Son will be condemned. But everyone who doesn't have faith in him has already been condemned for not having faith in God's only Son.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti kaa dāa gíti kù bin fōō u-Jipɔɔn gbanti ki kííyee bɔti, ama un kaa fōō-u ki kííyee bɔti kpíì, u nín kaa fōō Unimbɔti Jipɔmbaabil ki kííyee pu.

english_verse: The light has come into the world, and people who do evil things are judged guilty because they love the dark more than the light.
translation_verse: Kun cāabìń dibɔkpilee sèé: di sá yii ŋwalifee dɔ́miń duulinyan doo, ní binib là dibɔmbɔndi, kaa là ŋwalifi, kun puee bi tūǹ atuŋkpiti.

english_verse: People who do evil hate the light and won't come to the light, because it clearly shows what they have done.
translation_verse: Un sá kamaa yaa ŋáań ikpitee ná ŋwalifi ní kaa cá ŋwalifin, kun puee u fàŋkí yii ŋwalifi làá bìitī u-tuŋkpitiŋ pu.

english_verse: But everyone who lives by the truth will come to the light, because they want others to know that God is really the one doing what they do. Jesus and John the Baptist
translation_verse: Ama un nóó ibaamɔnee cá Unimbɔti walifiŋun ní bí ká yii Unimbɔti pu ní u tūǹ atummɔnti.» Yoowaneesi nì Yeesu

english_verse: Later, Jesus and his disciples went to Judea, where he stayed with them for a while and was baptizing people.
translation_verse: Míǹ boonee ní Yeesu nì u-boonnooliibi búntì Juudee watil pú ki kāl̀ niin ki fùul̀ binib Unimbɔti nyim.

english_verse: John's followers got into an argument with a Jewish man about a ceremony of washing.
translation_verse: Niinee ní Yoowaneesi boonnooliibi biba nì Ujuudaja ubɔ bíi kpákà bi-marab bin sá yii bí nīn fíntí bi-ba ki kpáaǹ tiwan kɔkɔee pu.

english_verse: They went to John and said, “Rabbi, you spoke about a man when you were with him east of the Jordan. He is now baptizing people, and everyone is going to him.”
translation_verse: Ní bi cūtì Yoowaneesi cee ki bí-u yii: «Ukpil, sii nì un nìn bí Jɔɔdan gbandi lapu puee, un pu a nìn sòon̄ yii u sá unikpaanee, báà ŋma di yíkí sii cee ki cá u-cee u fùul̀-bi Unimbɔti nyimee.»

english_verse: John replied: No one can do anything unless God in heaven allows it.
translation_verse: Ní Yoowaneesi kíí-bi yii: «Unil kaa ŋūǹ kí nīn cáá tiba Unimbɔti yaa kaa tīī-u kudɔŋu.

english_verse: You surely remember how I told you that I am not the Messiah. I am only the one sent ahead of him.
translation_verse: Nimbi ni-ba ni gbìl̄ m nín nìn lī yii: <Man di kaa sá Meesiya, bi túnní man ń lìntīń u-nyɔkɔpuee.>

english_verse: At a wedding the groom is the one who gets married. The best man is glad just to be there and to hear the groom's voice. That's why I am so glad.
translation_verse: Un cáá unimpucaanee, unimpucaan cal dee, ama unimpucaan cal bɔɔ bí niin ki pílifí u-bɔɔ neen, ní an mɔ̄ǹ-u tikpil. An mɔŋŋuee di sá man yɔŋu nee.

english_verse: Jesus must become more important, while I become less important. The One Who Comes from Heaven
translation_verse: An máaǹ úǹ nyooti ń nīn wīintí ní man yati ń nīn bàtī!» Un nyánní yilpuee

english_verse: God's Son comes from heaven and is above all others. Everyone who comes from the earth belongs to the earth and speaks about earthly things. The one who comes from heaven is above all others.
translation_verse: Di sá un nyánní yilpuee di tɔ́kɔ́ tikɔkɔ pu. Un bí taapu dooyee di sá taapu yɔu ní ki sòoǹ taapu doo bɔti. Un nyánní yilpu ki tɔ́kɔ́ tikɔkɔ puee

english_verse: He speaks about what he has seen and heard, and yet no one believes him.
translation_verse: di sòoǹ tin u kée nì tin u gbìl̄ee, ní báà ubɔ kaa fōō u-bɔti ki kíí.

english_verse: But everyone who does believe him has shown that God is truthful.
translation_verse: Un di yaa fōō u nín lī puee ki kííyee, udaan dàkà yii Unimbɔti sá mbaamɔndaan dee,

english_verse: The Son was sent to speak God's message, and he has been given the full power of God's Spirit.
translation_verse: kun puee un Unimbɔti túnnée sòoǹ Unimbɔti bɔti ní. Di sá Unimbɔti tìì-u u-Fam ní an kaa cáá bí dūú ŋmàntī.

english_verse: The Father loves the Son and has given him everything.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti néeń u-Jipɔɔn ki dū tikɔkɔ ki ŋá u-ŋaan.

english_verse: Everyone who has faith in the Son has eternal life. But no one who rejects him will ever share in that life, and God will be angry with them forever.
translation_verse: Un yaa fōō u-Jipɔɔn gbanti ki kííyee kāntí dimaŋfal din kaa cáá dikúntilee. Un yíì kaa fōō-u ki kííyee kaa kāntí dimaŋfal gbanti. Unimbɔti ŋuul làá nīn pée dàn̄ udaan pu ní.

english_verse: But Jesus' disciples were really the ones doing the baptizing, and not Jesus himself. Jesus and the Samaritan Woman
translation_verse: - ama an kaa nìn sá Yeesu u-ba di nìn fùul̀-bi nnyim, an sá u-boonnooliibi di nìn fùul̀-bi. -

english_verse: Jesus left Judea and started for Galilee again.
translation_verse: Ní u yíkì Juudee ki nín gítí Galiilee.

english_verse: This time he had to go through Samaria,
translation_verse: Kí wàatī kí nín bà Galiileeyee, see ú dī Samaarii watil pú.

english_verse: “You are a Jew,” she replied, “and I am a Samaritan woman. How can you ask me for a drink of water when Jews and Samaritans won't have anything to do with each other?”
translation_verse: Ní unimpuee kíí-u yii: «Sii sá Ujuudaja ní, ba pu ní a mèé man un sá Usamaariinimpuee nnyim?» - Di sá yii Juuda yab nì Samaarii yab kaa nìn kpí. -

english_verse: “Sir,” the woman said, “you don't even have a bucket, and the well is deep. Where are you going to get this life-giving water?
translation_verse: Ní unimpuee bí-u yii: «Ukpil, aa cáá guuka, lɔkɔ mun di nyóòyee, kin a làá ŋá mana kí kánní nnyim min tìì dimaŋfalee gbanti?

english_verse: Our ancestor Jacob dug this well for us, and his family and animals got water from it. Are you greater than Jacob?”
translation_verse: Ti-naanja Jaakɔb di nìn gbìn̄-ti lɔkɔ nee, ki nyùn̄ u-ba lɔkɔ gbanti nyim, ki kpáaǹ u-biyaamu nì u-waŋkuti. Mimmee, sii dàkafī yii a jítiǹ Jaakɔbaaa?»

english_verse: But no one who drinks the water I give will ever be thirsty again. The water I give will become in that person a flowing fountain that gives eternal life.”
translation_verse: Ama un yaa nyùn̄ nnyim min man tììyee, nnyinnyoo kaa ti cútí udaan jaanjaan, kun puee nnyim min man tììyee kpántí nnyimbul u-pɔbilin, ní ki kíǹ ki pùub̀ ki tìì-u dimaŋfal din kaa cáá dikúntilee.»

english_verse: The woman replied, “Sir, please give me a drink of that water! Then I won't get thirsty and have to come to this well again.”
translation_verse: Ní unimpuee bí-u yii: «Ukpil, yaa sée tīī-mi a-nyim gbanti ḿ nyɔ̀, nnyinnyoo ń taa ti cúú-mi, ḿ taa nín̄ gíti dòoń doo ki lúù nnyim.»

english_verse: Jesus told her, “Go and bring your husband.”
translation_verse: Ní Yeesu bí-u yii: «Cùú yíiń a-cal kí fàtīí gítiń doo!»

english_verse: The woman answered, “I don't have a husband.” “That's right,” Jesus replied, “you're telling the truth. You don't have a husband. You have already been married five times, and the man you are now living with isn't your husband.”
translation_verse: kun puee a mɔ́ǹ bininjab biŋmoo dee ki yíkì, ní un cee a bí kɔŋkɔnnee mun kaa tí sá a-cal. Míǹ puee, a sòon̄ a-baamɔŋyi ní.»

english_verse: The woman said, “Sir, I can see that you are a prophet.
translation_verse: Ní unimpuee bí yii: «Ukpil, kɔŋkɔnnee m ká yii a baasii sá Unimbɔti bɔnaatiliu ní.

english_verse: My ancestors worshiped on this mountain, but you Jews say Jerusalem is the only place to worship.”
translation_verse: Di sá ti-naanjab nìn jáaḿ Unimbɔti dijool nee pu ní, ní nimbi Juuda yab bí yii Jeerusaleem ní bi máaǹ kí cùú jāam̀ ti-Baa Unimbɔti.»

english_verse: Jesus said to her: Believe me, the time is coming when you won't worship the Father either on this mountain or in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ní Yeesu bí-u yii: «Unimpuee, á pīlifiǹ-mi! Ŋyunti ŋubɔ dòoń an kaa dāa gíti bàlifī yii unil ń cù dijool nee puɔɔɔ, Jeerusaleem ní kí jāam̀ Unimbɔti.

english_verse: You Samaritans don't really know the one you worship. But we Jews do know the God we worship, and by using us, God will save the world.
translation_verse: Nimbi Samaarii yab, naa nyí kun ni jáaḿee, ama timbee ti nyí un ti jáaḿee, kun puee Unimbɔti dū difiil ki dīń Juuda yab pu ní.

english_verse: But a time is coming, and it is already here! Even now the true worshipers are being led by the Spirit to worship the Father according to the truth. These are the ones the Father is seeking to worship him.
translation_verse: Kɔŋkɔnnee, ŋyunti ŋubɔ dòoń, ŋu bāań gba, ŋun ni ní bin jáaḿ ti-Baa Unimbɔti mmɔntiiminee làá nīn jáaḿ-u nì Ŋfamin nì ibaamɔn. Kun puee bin jáaḿ-u mimmee ní ti-Baa Unimbɔti nyàab̀.

english_verse: God is Spirit, and those who worship God must be led by the Spirit to worship him according to the truth.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti sá Ŋfam ní: míǹ puee, bin jáaḿ-uee máaǹ kí jāam̀-u nì ŋfamin nì ibaamɔn.»

english_verse: The woman said, “I know that the Messiah will come. He is the one we call Christ. When he comes, he will explain everything to us.”
translation_verse: Ní unimpuee bí-u yii: «M nyí yii Meesiya - an dàkà yii Kriisitoo - làá dāan̄. Úǹ yaa láa bāańee, ní u làá tùkù-ti tikɔkɔ.»

english_verse: “I am that one,” Jesus told her, “and I am speaking to you now.”
translation_verse: Ní Yeesu bí-u yii: «An sá man un bíi sòoǹ nì si nee di sá Kriisitoo.»

english_verse: The disciples returned about this time and were surprised to find Jesus talking with a woman. But none of them asked him what he wanted or why he was talking with her.
translation_verse: Niinee ní Yeesu boonnooliibi bāań, ní an ŋá-bi bitii bi nín ká u nì unimpu bíi sòoǹee, ama baa bālifì yii: «A là ba u-cee?» àá «A sòoǹ nì u tilati?»

english_verse: The woman left her water jar and ran back into town, where she said to the people,
translation_verse: Niinee ní unimpuee yāntì u-nyimbool ki fātìi nín gítí kitiŋin ki tùkū binib yii:

english_verse: “Come and see a man who told me everything I have ever done! Could he be the Messiah?”
translation_verse: «Dāá kpèèmaan uninja ubɔ bīitì m-bɔɔŋŋi pu! An kaa kalin sá Meesiya?»

english_verse: Everyone in town went out to see Jesus.
translation_verse: Ní bi yíkìń kitiŋin ki nín dòoń Yeesu cee.

english_verse: While this was happening, Jesus' disciples were saying to him, “Teacher, please eat something.”
translation_verse: Unimpuee búntèe, ní u-boonnooliibi bíi lì yii: «Ukpil, dāá jī tijin!»

english_verse: But Jesus told them, “I have food you don't know anything about.”
translation_verse: Ní u bí-bi yii: «Man cáá tijin tin nimbi kaa nyée.»

english_verse: His disciples started asking each other, “Has someone brought him something to eat?”
translation_verse: Niinee ní u-boonnooliibi kíǹ ki bíi bàlifī tɔb yii: «Ubɔ kalin cáań-u tijin níii?»

english_verse: Jesus said: My food is to do what God wants! He is the one who sent me, and I must finish the work that he gave me to do.
translation_verse: Ní Yeesu bí-bi yii: «M-jinti di sá ḿ ŋá un túnní-mee nín là puee, kí tɔ̄ u-tundi.

english_verse: You may say there are still four months until harvest time. But I tell you to look, and you will see that the fields are ripe and ready to harvest.
translation_verse: Kéè, ni cáá yii an kíǹ iŋmal inaa dee, kudiceeuaa! Ama man tùkù-ni yii ní wáaǹ kí kpèè, tijin kūń ki ŋmāntì dical.

english_verse: Even now the harvest workers are receiving their reward by gathering a harvest that brings eternal life. Then everyone who planted the seed and everyone who harvests the crop will celebrate together.
translation_verse: Kii un cēēyee nín kōontí ki kpáfí ki fòol̄ u-paati puee, míǹ mbaantiim ni mun cáaḿmaan binib m-cee ḿ tīī-bi dimaŋfal din kaa cáá dikúntilee. Ní án mɔ̄ɔkiǹ un búĺee nì un cáńee kɔkɔ.

english_verse: So the saying proves true, “Some plant the seed, and others harvest the crop.”
translation_verse: Kun puee dilaŋkpandi din lì yii: <Ubɔ būul̀ ní ubɔ ń dāá cēe> sá tiŋman ní.

english_verse: I am sending you to harvest crops in fields where others have done all the hard work.
translation_verse: Míǹ puee, m tú-ni ní cùú cā laakin biba búĺee ní, nimbi ń páatí bíǹ gìńdi pu.»

english_verse: A lot of Samaritans in that town put their faith in Jesus because the woman had said, “This man told me everything I have ever done.”
translation_verse: Unimpuee nín tùkū-bi yii Yeesu bīitì u-bɔɔŋŋi puee, ní Samaarii yab bin kóò kitiŋ gbantinee tikpil fōō Yeesu ki kíí.

english_verse: They came and asked him to stay in their town, and he stayed on for two days.
translation_verse: Samaarii yab gbanti nín dāa bāań ki ká-uee, ní bi mēē-u yii ú kàl̄ bi-cee, ní u lafun kāl̀ iwiin ili.

english_verse: Many more Samaritans put their faith in Jesus because of what they heard him say.
translation_verse: Binib tikpil nìn gíti fōō-u ki kíí tin u nìn sòon̄ nì bee pu.

english_verse: They told the woman, “We no longer have faith in Jesus just because of what you told us. We have heard him ourselves, and we are certain that he is the Savior of the world!” Jesus Heals an Official's Son (Matthew
translation_verse: Ní binibee lī unimpuee yii: «Ti nín fōō ki kíí nee, an kaa ti sá sii nín lī puee ŋmaniŋma pu. U sòon̄ ti mun ti-ba gbìl̄ ki béè yii, ibaamɔn, u sá duulinya kɔkɔ Fiiliu.» Yeesu cáaǹ ukàlinjakpaan ubɔ biki

english_verse: Jesus had said, “Prophets are honored everywhere, except in their own country.” Then two days later he left
translation_verse: Kun puee úǹ u-ba nìn lī yii: «Unimbɔti bɔnaatiliu dumpu yab kaa tɔ́-u.»

english_verse: and went to Galilee. The people there welcomed him, because they had gone to the festival in Jerusalem and had seen everything he had done.
translation_verse: U nín bàn̄ Galiileeyee, niin yab fōō-u tiŋan, kun puee bi nìn cūtì Jeerusaleem ki ká u nín nìn ŋá tin kɔkɔ jiŋaalinee.

english_verse: While Jesus was in Galilee, he returned to the village of Cana, where he had turned the water into wine. There was an official in Capernaum whose son was sick.
translation_verse: Ní u fātìi gítì Kana, Galiilee timbiliiki, laakin u nìn dū nnyim ki kpántì ndaamee. Gɔmina kàlinjakpaaŋwu ubɔ nìn bí Kapeernayum u-jipɔɔn būǹ.

english_verse: And when the man heard that Jesus had come from Judea, he went and begged him to keep his son from dying.
translation_verse: U nín gbìl̄ yii Yeesu nyánní Juudee ki dɔ́miń Galiileeyee, ní u dɔ́miń u-cee ki gbāam̀-u ú cù Kapeernayum kí cáaǹ u-jipɔɔn un būǹ ki làá kpúee.

english_verse: Jesus told the official, “You won't have faith unless you see miracles and wonders!”
translation_verse: Ní Yeesu bí-u yii: «Ni yaa kaa ká maamaacib nì tidaandi, naa fòol̄ kí kíí!»

english_verse: The man replied, “Lord, please come before my son dies!”
translation_verse: Ní ukàlinjakpaanee bí-u yii: «Ukpil, dāan̄ tí cù malaa, m-biki ń taa kpú!»

english_verse: Jesus then said, “Your son will live. Go on home to him.” The man believed Jesus and started back home.
translation_verse: Ní Yeesu kíí-u yii: «Nín̄ cá, a-jipɔɔn pɔ́ɔkì.» Uninjee fōō Yeesu nín lī puee ní ki nín cá.

english_verse: Some of the official's servants met him along the road and told him, “Your son is better!”
translation_verse: U bí nsanni ki fàtīi kùǹee, ní u-tɔntɔnliibi biba túŋkìń-u ki tùkū-u yii: «A-jipɔɔn pɔ́ɔkì.»

english_verse: He asked them when the boy got better, and they answered, “The fever left him yesterday at one o'clock.”
translation_verse: Ní u bālifì-bi yii: «Ŋyunti ŋulɔŋu ní an yāntì-u?» Ní bi kíí-u yii: «Fool, wiŋkpooti kukúluu kubɔ, ní an cāntì-u, u-wunti kaa ti tùm̀.»

english_verse: The boy's father realized that at one o'clock the day before, Jesus had told him, “Your son will live!” So the man and everyone in his family put their faith in Jesus.
translation_verse: Niinee ní u béè yii kukúluu gbanti deedee ní Yeesu tùkū-u yii: «A-jipɔɔn pɔ́ɔkì». Ní u nì u-dicaŋku kɔkɔ fōō Yeesu ki kíí.

english_verse: This was the second miracle that Jesus worked after he left Judea and went to Galilee.
translation_verse: Yeesu nín yíkì Juudee ki fātì Galiileeyee, maamaacililiiti un u ŋée dee.

english_verse: Later, Jesus went to Jerusalem for another Jewish festival.
translation_verse: Boonee ní Yeesu nín jɔ́ḿ Jeerusaleem kun puee Juuda yab nìn cáá jiŋaal ubɔ.

english_verse: In the city near the sheep gate was a pool with five porches, and its name in Hebrew was Bethzatha.
translation_verse: Dinyimbɔbil diba nìn bí Jeerusaleem, kadantikub biŋmoo māntìi tú-dì, bi yíì-dì eebru sooŋyin yii Beeteesda, di bí ki nákáǹ kipunyɔkɔ kin bi yíì ipii punyɔkɔkee.

english_verse: Beside the pool was a man who had been sick for
translation_verse: Uninja ubɔ nìn bí niin ki būǹ doooo abin ali kpá imuŋku ili.

english_verse: You have not believed his message, because you refused to have faith in the one he sent.
translation_verse: kaa kpáafí u-bɔti mun ni-ni, kun puee naa fōō un u túnnée ki kíí.

english_verse: When Jesus saw the man and realized that he had been crippled for a long time, he asked him, “Do you want to be healed?”
translation_verse: Yeesu ká u dɔ̄ee, ní ki béè yii u būǹee an yúntì, ní u bālifì-u yii: «A là kí pɔ̄ɔkàaa?»

english_verse: The man answered, “Sir, I don't have anyone to put me in the pool when the water is stirred up. I try to get in, but someone else always gets there first.”
translation_verse: Ní ubunlee kíí-u yii: «Ukpil, bi yaa gbātì nnyimee, maa cáá ubɔ ń yòon̄-mi kí tɔ̄ niin. Ŋyunti ŋun m bíi pɔ̄ɔntí ki cée ní ubɔ ń péeǹ-mi kí cùú jēetí.»

english_verse: Jesus told him, “Pick up your mat and walk!”
translation_verse: Niinee ní Yeesu bí-u yii: «Yīkìí yūĺ kí yòon̄ a-kampeeku kí còom̀!»

english_verse: Right then the man was healed. He picked up his mat and started walking around. The day on which this happened was a Sabbath.
translation_verse: Kpalaa niinee ní uninjee pɔ́ɔkì ki yōoǹ u-kampeeku ki kíǹ ki bíi còom̄. An nìn sá ŋwiŋŋuŋfikaa dal ní.

english_verse: When the Jewish leaders saw the man carrying his mat, they said to him, “This is the Sabbath! No one is allowed to carry a mat on the Sabbath.”
translation_verse: Míǹ pu ní Juuda yab kpilib nìn bí uninja un ká dicáaǹdee yii: «Díǹ di sá ŋwiŋŋuŋfikaa dal. Aa cáá nsan kí bùkun̄ a-kampeeku.»

english_verse: But he replied, “The man who healed me told me to pick up my mat and walk.”
translation_verse: Ní u kíí-bi yii: «Un cáaǹ-mee di bí-mi yii ḿ yòon̄ m-kampeeku kí nīn còom̄.»

english_verse: They asked him, “Who is this man that told you to pick up your mat and walk?”
translation_verse: Ní bi bālifì-u yii: «Ŋma di bí-si yii á yòon̄ a-kampeeku kí nīn còom̄aaa?»

english_verse: But he did not know who Jesus was, and Jesus had left because of the crowd.
translation_verse: Uninjee kaa nìn nyí un di cáaǹ-uee, di sá yii Yeesu nìn nyáń kunipaau kansikin ki búntì.

english_verse: Later, Jesus met the man in the temple and told him, “You are now well. But don't sin anymore or something worse might happen to you.”
translation_verse: Boonee ní Yeesu dāa ká uninjee kunimbɔtidiin ní ki bí-u yii: «A nín pɔ́ɔkì pu nee, á taa ti ŋá ikpiti, án nín làá ŋá pu tiba ń taa láa gíti bàń-si kí jītíǹ tin bí neeyee!»

english_verse: The man left and told the leaders that Jesus was the one who had healed him.
translation_verse: Niinee, uninjee cūtìi tùkū Juuda yab kpilib yii an sá Yeesu di cáaǹ-u.

english_verse: They started making a lot of trouble for Jesus because he did things like this on the Sabbath.
translation_verse: Míǹ pu ní Juuda yab nìn nyáń Yeesu pu u nín ŋá míǹ ŋwiŋŋuŋfikaa dalee pu.

english_verse: But Jesus said, “My Father has never stopped working, and this is why I keep on working.”
translation_verse: Ní Yeesu kíí-bi yii: «M-Baa tūǹ ditundi baabadal, míǹ ní ma mun tūǹ.»

english_verse: Now the leaders wanted to kill Jesus for two reasons. First, he had broken the law of the Sabbath. But even worse, he had said God was his Father, which made him equal with God. The Son's Authority
translation_verse: Tibɔti tin u lēe puee, Juuda yab kpilib mɔ̄tìi bíi nyàab̀ kí kpɔ̀-u. An kaa sá u nín yīntì mara un sá bí taa tɔ̄ ditundi ŋwiŋŋuŋfikaayee ŋmaniŋma pu, an sá u nín lī yii Unimbɔti di sá u-Baayee, ki cáá u-ba ki ŋmàntīǹ Unimbɔtee pu. Unimbɔti Jipɔɔn pɔŋŋu

english_verse: Jesus told the people: I tell you for certain the Son cannot do anything on his own. He can do only what he sees the Father doing, and he does exactly what he sees the Father do.
translation_verse: Niinee ní Yeesu bí-bi yii: «Ibaamɔn, ibaamɔn ní m sòoǹ nì ni, tin Ubaati ŋáańee ní u-Jipɔɔn kāntí ki ŋáań. An yaa sá fám, waa ŋūǹ kí ŋá tiba u-ba pu. Tin kɔkɔ Ubaati ŋáańee, u-Jipɔɔn mun ŋáań míǹ mbaantiim ní.

english_verse: The Father loves the Son and has shown him everything he does. The Father will show him even greater things, and you will be amazed.
translation_verse: Kun puee Ubaati néeń u-Jipɔɔn, ní ki dàkà-u tin kɔkɔwoooo u ŋáańee. U làá dāá gíti dàkà-u tin jítiǹ tin bí neeyee gba, án làá ŋá-ni maamaaci.

english_verse: Just as the Father raises the dead and gives life, so the Son gives life to anyone he wants to.
translation_verse: Kii Ubaati nín fìkitī bitaŋkpiibi ki tìì-bi dimaŋfal puee, míǹ mbaantiim ní u-Jipɔɔn mun tìì un un u yaa lèe dimaŋfal.

english_verse: The Father doesn't judge anyone, but he has made his Son the judge of everyone.
translation_verse: Ubaati kaa sòoǹ báà ubɔ bɔti. U dū ibɔsoon kɔkɔ ki ŋá u-Jipɔɔn ŋaan ní,

english_verse: The Father wants all people to honor the Son as much as they honor him. When anyone refuses to honor the Son, this is the same as refusing to honor the Father who sent him.
translation_verse: án nín làá ŋá pu binib kɔkɔ ń nīn tìì-u jilma kii bi nín tìì Ubaati puee. Un kaa tīī Ubaati Jipɔɔn jilmee kaa tīī Ubaati un túnní-uee mun jilma dee.

english_verse: I tell you for certain that everyone who hears my message and has faith in the one who sent me has eternal life and will never be condemned. They have already gone from death to life.
translation_verse: «Ibaamɔn, ibaamɔn ní m tùkù-ni, un yaa pílifì m-bɔti ki fōō un túnní-mee ki kííyee kāntí dimaŋfal din kaa cáá dikúntilee. Udaan kaa dāa gíti bí ibɔsoon ni, u nyáń ŋkúmin ki póotì dimaŋfalin.

english_verse: I tell you for certain the time will come, and it is already here, when all of the dead will hear the voice of the Son of God. And those who listen to it will live!
translation_verse: Ibaamɔn, ibaamɔn ní m tùkù-ni, ŋyunti ŋubɔ dòoń, ŋu bāań gba, ŋun ni bitaŋkpiibi làá gbìl̄ Unimbɔti Jipɔɔn neenee, ní bin yaa láa gbìl̄ u-neen gbantee dāa kāntí dimaŋfal.

english_verse: The Father has the power to give life, and he has given that same power to the Son.
translation_verse: Ubaati nín cáá mpɔn kí tīī dimaŋfal puee, míǹ ní u tīī u-Jipɔɔn mpɔn u mun ń nīn tìì dimaŋfal,

english_verse: And he has given his Son the right to judge everyone, because he is the Son of Man.
translation_verse: ní ki tīī-u mpɔn ú nīn sá ubɔsoonli kun puee u sá Kinibiki.

english_verse: Don't be surprised! The time will come when all of the dead will hear the voice of the Son of Man,
translation_verse: Tin bí nee kɔkɔ ń taa bàkatīǹ-ni, kun puee ŋyunti ŋubɔ dòoń ní bin kɔkɔ dɔ̄ akaakul poonee làá dāá gbìl̄ u-neen pu

english_verse: and they will come out of their graves. Everyone who has done good things will rise to life, but everyone who has done evil things will rise and be condemned.
translation_verse: kí nyānní. Bin yaa ŋá tiŋanee ń fìkitī kí ká dimaŋfal, ní bin yaa ŋá ikpitee ń fìkitī kí kɔ́ ibɔsoon ni.

english_verse: I cannot do anything on my own. The Father sent me, and he is the one who told me how to judge. I judge with fairness, because I obey him, and I don't just try to please myself. Witnesses to Jesus
translation_verse: Maa ŋūǹ kí ŋá tiba m-ba. M-bɔsooŋyi nóó nì un túnní-mee nín tùkù-mi puee ní. M sòoǹ tibɔti deedee kun puee maa nyàab̀ kí ŋá min man m-ba lèe, see un túnní-mee nín là puee. Unimbɔti di lèekī Yeesu pu seera

english_verse: If I speak for myself, there is no way to prove I am telling the truth.
translation_verse: M yaa sòon̄ tiba m-ba pu, an kaa ŋūǹ kí dàkà ibaamɔn,

english_verse: But there is someone else who speaks for me, and I know what he says is true.
translation_verse: ama ubɔ di lèekī m-pu seera, ní m nyí yii tin u sòoǹ m-puee sá ibaamɔn.

english_verse: You sent messengers to John, and he told them the truth.
translation_verse: Ni nìn tú binib Yoowaneesi cee ní u sòon̄-ni ibaamɔn m-pu.

english_verse: I don't depend on what people say about me, but I tell you these things so that you may be saved.
translation_verse: Kun pu m lì mimmee di sá m là ní ká difiil, an yaa sá fám, maa nyàab̀ ubɔ ń lēē m-pu seera.

english_verse: John was a lamp that gave a lot of light, and you were glad to enjoy his light for a while.
translation_verse: Yoowaneesi nìn sá fitila ní ki ŋmíntí nyáka nyaka, ní ni nìn kíí ki nóó u-walifiŋu gbanti ŋyunti ŋubɔ poon, ní an mɔ̄ǹ-ni.

english_verse: But something more important than John speaks for me. I mean the things that the Father has given me to do! All of these speak for me and prove that the Father sent me.
translation_verse: Ama m cáá kun lèekī m-pu seera ki jítiǹ Yoowaneesee: di sá yii atuun ŋin m-Baa tīī-mi ḿ tɔ̄ m bíi tūnnèe sòoǹ ki dàkà m-pu yii m-Baa di lafun túnní-mi.

english_verse: The Father who sent me also speaks for me, but you have never heard his voice or seen him face to face.
translation_verse: Ní m-Baa un túnní-mee mun u-ba lèekī seera m-pu. Naa láá pée gbìl̄ u-neen pu dalba, kaa láá ká u-nimbiin dalba,

english_verse: You search the Scriptures, because you think you will find eternal life in them. The Scriptures tell about me,
translation_verse: Ni bífí Unimbɔti gbɔŋku poon ki dàkafī yii niin ní ni ŋūǹ kí ká dimaŋfal din kaa cáá dikúntilee. An sá man pu ní kugbɔŋuee sòoǹ,

english_verse: but you refuse to come to me for eternal life.
translation_verse: ama naa là kí dāan̄ man cee kí ká dimaŋfal.

english_verse: I don't care about human praise,
translation_verse: «Man kaa nyàab̀ binib pampakaku,

english_verse: but I do know that none of you love God.
translation_verse: di sá yii m nyí-ni, naa cáá Unimbɔti neendi ni-ni.

english_verse: I have come with my Father's authority, and you have not welcomed me. But you will welcome people who come on their own.
translation_verse: M-Baa di túnní-mi, ní naa là kí fōō-mi, ama bin dòoń bi-ba puee, ni fòol̄ bíǹ.

english_verse: How could you possibly believe? You like to have your friends praise you, and you don't care about praise that the only God can give!
translation_verse: Mana ní ni ŋūǹ kí fōō kí kíí, nimbi bin néeń ni-jutiibi ń nīn pàkà-nee, kaa nyàab̀ kupampakau kun Unimbɔtibaanti tììyee?

english_verse: Don't think that I will be the one to accuse you to the Father. You have put your hope in Moses, yet he is the very one who will accuse you.
translation_verse: Ní taa dàkafì yii man làá dāá bàlifì-ni tibɔti m-Baa nimbiin. An sá Mooyiisi di làá dāá bàlifì-ni tibɔti, úǹ un pu ni dū ni-mákal ki ŋée.

english_verse: Moses wrote about me, and if you had believed Moses, you would have believed me.
translation_verse: Ni yaa bàà fōō Mooyiisi ki kííyee, ni bàà tí fòol̄ ma mun ní kí kíí, di sá yii man bɔti ní Mooyiisi nìn ŋmàn̄.

english_verse: But if you don't believe what Moses wrote, how can you believe what I say?
translation_verse: Ni nín kaa fōō tin Mooyiisi nìn ŋmàn̄ee ki kííyee, ni làá ŋá mana kí fōō man bɔti kí kíí?»

english_verse: The disciples gathered them up and filled twelve large baskets with what was left over from the five barley loaves.
translation_verse: Bi kóoǹ kpɔnɔb biŋmooyee katiŋi ŋin bi nìn ŋmɔ́ ki kíǹee, ki gbéeǹ tikabiti saalaa nì tili.

english_verse: The disciples wanted to take him into the boat, but suddenly the boat reached the shore where they were headed. The Bread That Gives Life
translation_verse: Niinee ní bi bí yii bí kpáaǹ-u, kpalaayee, buŋalimbu mun pūtì dūu sāā dimɔɔgbandi laakin bi cée. Kunipaau bíi nyàab̀ Yeesu

english_verse: They replied, “What miracle will you work, so that we can have faith in you? What will you do?
translation_verse: Ní bi bí-u yii: «Maamaaci ulɔu ní a làá dàkà-ti kí wàatī ní tí nín fōō-si kí kíí ní? Àá kudaaŋŋu kulɔkɔ ní a làá ŋá tí ká?

english_verse: No one can come to me, unless the Father who sent me makes them want to come. But if they do come, I will raise them to life on the last day.
translation_verse: Ubɔ kaa ŋūǹ kí dāan̄ m-cee an yaa kaa sá m-Baa un túnní-mee di cáań udaan, kí wàatī ní man ń nín fìkitī-u ŋwinjoolkaa dal.

english_verse: “There is a boy here who has five small loaves of barley bread and two fish. But what good is that with all these people?”
translation_verse: «Kinaacimpɔmbiki kiba bí doo ki cáań ɔɔji yim kpɔnɔb biŋmoo nì ijɔm ili. An kaa nín ŋūǹ kí ŋá kunipaau nee tiba ní.»

english_verse: The ground was covered with grass, and Jesus told his disciples to tell everyone to sit down. About
translation_verse: Ní Yeesu bí-bi yii: «Yàntīmaan binib ń kàl̄!» Kumɔsɔŋu kubɔ nìn bí niin tikpil, ní bi kāl̀ ku-pu. Bi nìn bàn̄ kii kutukub biŋmoo nyɔkɔm.

english_verse: They got into a boat and started across for Capernaum. Later that evening Jesus had still not come to them,
translation_verse: ki kɔ́ buŋalimbu ki fātìi nín cá Kapeernayum watil. Kunyeeu mun nìn mɔ́ Yeesu kaa láá bāań bi-cee.

english_verse: Jesus crossed Lake Galilee, which was also known as Lake Tiberias.
translation_verse: Míǹ boonee ní Yeesu dūtì Galiilee mɔɔgbandi lapu pu - bi gíti yíì dimɔɔlee yii Tiibeeriyaadi mɔɔl. -

english_verse: A large crowd had seen him work miracles to heal the sick, and those people went with him.
translation_verse: Kunipaau nín kántì u ŋáaǹ maamaacib bin ki cáaǹ bibunliibee puee ní bi nìn nóó-u.

english_verse: Philip answered, “Don't you know that it would take almost a year's wages just to buy only a little bread for each of these people?”
translation_verse: Ní Fiiliipi kíí-u yii: «Báà ti yaa dū animbil jitɔmbi alaataa ali ki dá kpɔnɔb, an kaa làá bà bi-kɔkɔ kikatii kikatii gba.»

english_verse: Andrew, the brother of Simon Peter, was one of the disciples. He spoke up and said,
translation_verse: Ní u-boonnooliibi kansikin ubɔ, Siimɔn Peetroo naal un bi yíì Andreeyee, bí-u yii:

english_verse: Jesus took the bread in his hands and gave thanks to God. Then he passed the bread to the people, and he did the same with the fish, until everyone had plenty to eat.
translation_verse: Ní Yeesu yōoǹ kpɔnɔbee ki jáam̀ Unimbɔti an pu ki wāatì ní ki dūu yākatì-bi, ní ki tí yākatì ijɔm mun, min báà ŋma lèe.

english_verse: The people ate all they wanted, and Jesus told his disciples to gather up the leftovers, so that nothing would be wasted.
translation_verse: Bi jíń ki díkée, ní u bí u-boonnooliibi yii: «Tòòmaan akati ŋin kíǹee, tiba ń taa bīil̀!»

english_verse: Jesus realized that they would try to force him to be their king. So he went up on a mountain, where he could be alone. Jesus Walks on the Water (Matthew
translation_verse: Yeesu béè yii bi làá cúú-u mpɔn kí kàan̄ dibeelee, ní u fātìi tí nín jɔ́ḿ digbantandi pu u-baba. Yeesu tɔ́kɔ́ǹ nnyim pu ki cōom̀ (Kpèè Maat

english_verse: The people who had stayed on the east side of the lake knew that only one boat had been there. They also knew that Jesus had not left in it with his disciples. But the next day
translation_verse: Kutaa wúntèe, kunipaau gbíntìi kā dimɔɔgbandi lapu pu. Bi nìn ká yii buŋalimbaantiibu di yú niin, ní Yeesu kaa kɔ́ buŋalimbu gbanti, u-boonnooliibi ŋmaniŋma di kɔ́ ki búntì.

english_verse: Don't work for food that spoils. Work for food that gives eternal life. The Son of Man will give you this food, because God the Father has given him the right to do so.”
translation_verse: Ní taa nín̄ tūǹ ditundi tijin tin kaa yúntée pu, nín̄ tūm̀maan tijin tin yúntí ki tìì dimaŋfal din kaa cáá dikúntilee pu. Tijin gbantee, man Kinibiki di làá tīī-ni tíǹ, di sá yii man ní m-Baa Unimbɔti tīī an pɔŋŋu daaŋku.»

english_verse: One of the prophets wrote, “God will teach all of them.” And so everyone who listens to the Father and learns from him will come to me.
translation_verse: Kii Unimbɔti bɔnaatiliibi nín ŋmàn̄ puee yii: <Unimbɔti làá dàkà bi-kɔkɔ bí béé-u.> Mimmee, bin kɔkɔ yaa pílifì m-Baa ki fōō u nín dàkà puee dòoń man cee ní.

english_verse: They started arguing with each other and asked, “How can he give us his flesh to eat?”
translation_verse: Niinee ní Juuda yab bíi kpákà bi-ŋmaniŋma tikpil yii: «Nì mana ní u ŋūǹ kí tīī-ti u-wunti tí ŋmɔ́ míǹ?»

english_verse: That evening, Jesus' disciples went down to the lake.
translation_verse: Kujoou jóotèe ní Yeesu boonnooliibi nín sìntī dimɔɔlin

english_verse: and a strong wind was making the water rough.
translation_verse: Kubuŋkpaaŋŋu kubɔ kíĺ ki bíi jītí ki yòontí tinyiŋgban.

english_verse: When the disciples had rowed for five or six kilometers, they saw Jesus walking on the water. He kept coming closer to the boat, and they were terrified.
translation_verse: Bi nín ŋàal̄ ki bàn̄ ataŋkpee aŋmoo kii aluu nyɔkɔmee, ní ki ká Yeesu nín tɔ́kɔń nnyim pu ki còomìń ki dòoń buŋalimbu ceeyee, ní bi fāŋkì.

english_verse: But he said, “I am Jesus! Don't be afraid!”
translation_verse: Ní Yeesu bí-bi yii: «Taa fàŋkìmaan, an sá man!»

english_verse: some boats from Tiberias sailed near the place where the crowd had eaten the bread for which the Lord had given thanks.
translation_verse: Ama iŋaliŋfi iba nìn nyánní Tiibeeriyaadi tiŋkin ki bāań laakin ti-Dindaan nìn mēē ki pàkā Unimbɔti ki wāatì ní bi nín ŋmɔ́ kpɔnɔbee caŋin.

english_verse: They saw that Jesus and his disciples had left. Then they got into the boats and went to Capernaum to look for Jesus.
translation_verse: Kunipaauee nín kaa ká Yeesu kaa ká u-boonnooliibi muee ní bi kɔ́ iŋaliŋfee ki búntì Kapeernayum kí nyàab̀ Yeesu. Yeesu di sá tijin tin tìì dimaŋfalee

english_verse: They found him on the west side of the lake and asked, “Rabbi, when did you get here?”
translation_verse: Bi bàn̄ niin ki ká-uee, ní ki bí yii: «Ukpil, ŋyunti ŋulɔŋu ní a bāań doo ní?»

english_verse: Jesus answered, “I tell you for certain that you are not looking for me because you saw the miracles, but because you ate all the food you wanted.
translation_verse: Ní Yeesu bí-bi yii: «Ibaamɔn, ibaamɔn ní m tùkù-ni, ni nín ŋmɔ́ kpɔnɔb ki díkée pu ní ni nyàab̀-mi, kaa sá maamaacib bin dàkā-ni m nín sá uŋyee pu.

english_verse: “What exactly does God want us to do?” the people asked.
translation_verse: Niinee ní bi bālifì-u yii: «Ti máaǹ kí ŋá mana ní án nīn sá min Unimbɔti lèe ní?»

english_verse: Jesus answered, “God wants you to have faith in the one he sent.”
translation_verse: Ní Yeesu kíí-bi yii: «Unimbɔti nín là miŋyee di sá ní fōō man un u túnnée kí kíí.»

english_verse: For example, when our ancestors were in the desert, they were given manna to eat. It happened just as the Scriptures say, ‘God gave them bread from heaven to eat.’ ”
translation_verse: Ti-naanjab nìn jīǹ tijin tin bi yíì maanee kuteeun, kii an nín ŋmàn̄ Unimbɔti gbɔŋku poon puee, yii: <U nìn tìì-bi tijin tin nyēeń yilpuee ní bi jīǹ.>»

english_verse: Jesus then told them, “I tell you for certain that Moses wasn't the one who gave you bread from heaven. My Father is the one who gives you the true bread from heaven.
translation_verse: Niinee ní Yeesu kíí-bi yii: «Ibaamɔn, ibaamɔn ní m tùkù-ni, an kaa sá Mooyiisi di tīī-ni tijin tin nyēeń yilpuee, m-Baa di tìì tijimmɔntiil tin nyēeń yilpuee.

english_verse: And the bread that God gives is the one who came down from heaven to give life to the world.”
translation_verse: Tijin tin Unimbɔti tììyee di sá un nyánní yilpu ki tìì binib kɔkɔ dimaŋfalee.»

english_verse: The people said, “Sir, give us this bread and don't ever stop!”
translation_verse: Ní bi bí-u yii: «Ukpil, nín̄ pée tìì-ti tijinee baabadal!»

english_verse: Jesus replied: I am the bread that gives life! No one who comes to me will ever be hungry. No one who has faith in me will ever be thirsty.
translation_verse: Ní Yeesu bí-bi yii: «Man di sá tijin tin tìì dimaŋfalee. Un yaa dɔ́miń m-ceeyee, ŋkùm kaa ti cútí udaan jaanjaan, míǹ ní un yaa tí fōō-mi ki kííyee, nnyinnyoo kaa ti cútí udaan jaanjaan.

english_verse: I have told you already that you have seen me and still do not have faith in me.
translation_verse: Ama, m pée tùkū-ni: ni-nimbiliŋ ká tin m ŋée ní naa fōō-mi ki kíí.

english_verse: Everything and everyone that the Father has given me will come to me, and I won't turn any of them away.
translation_verse: Bin bin m-Baa tīī-mee kɔkɔ làá dāan̄ m-cee. Un di yaa dɔ́miń m-ceeyee, maa làá fá udaan,

english_verse: I didn't come from heaven to do what I want! I came to do what the Father wants me to do. He sent me,
translation_verse: kun puee m nyánní yilpu ki dɔ́miń kí ŋá un túnní-mee nín là puee ní, an kaa sá man m-ba nín là puee.

english_verse: and he wants to make certain that none of the ones he has given me will be lost. Instead, he wants me to raise them to life on the last day.
translation_verse: Un túnní-mee nín là puee di sá ḿ taa fá bin u tīī-mee kansikin báà ubɔ kí dāá fìkitī bi-kɔkɔ ŋwinjoolkaa dal.

english_verse: My Father wants everyone who sees the Son to have faith in him and to have eternal life. Then I will raise them to life on the last day.
translation_verse: M-Baa nín là min miŋyee sèé, yii un sá kamaa yaa ká man u-Jipɔɔn ki fōō-mi ki kííyee ń ká dimaŋfal din kaa cáá dikúntilee, ní man ń dāá fìkitī-u ŋwinjoolkaa dal.»

english_verse: The people started grumbling because Jesus had said he was the bread that had come down from heaven.
translation_verse: Yeesu nín lī yii úǹ di sá tijin tin nyánní yilpuee pu ní Juuda yab bíi gbùkum̄ u-pu

english_verse: They were asking each other, “Isn't he Jesus, the son of Joseph? Don't we know his father and mother? How can he say that he has come down from heaven?”
translation_verse: ki lì yii: «An kaa sá Yeesu, Jooseefi jipɔɔn un timbi nyí u-baa nì u-neeee? Kin an ŋá mana ní u gíti lì yii úǹ di nyánní yilpu ní?»

english_verse: Jesus told them: Stop grumbling!
translation_verse: Ní Yeesu kíí-bi yii: «Ní taa nín̄ gbùkum̄ ni-ŋmaniŋma míǹ!

english_verse: The only one who has seen the Father is the one who has come from him. No one else has ever seen the Father.
translation_verse: Báà ubɔ kaa ká m-Baa Unimbɔti, asee man un nyánní u-ceeyee, man baba di ká-u.

english_verse: I tell you for certain that everyone who has faith in me has eternal life.
translation_verse: «Ibaamɔn, ibaamɔn ní m tùkù-ni, un yaa fōō-mi ki kííyee cáá dimaŋfal din kaa cáá dikúntilee.

english_verse: I am the bread that gives life!
translation_verse: Man di sá tijin tin tìì dimaŋfalee.

english_verse: Your ancestors ate manna in the desert, and later they died.
translation_verse: Nì min kɔkɔ ni-naanjab nìn ŋmɔ́ maana kuteeunee, boonee bi dāa kpíì.

english_verse: But the bread from heaven has come down, so that no one who eats it will ever die.
translation_verse: Ama tijin tin nyánní yilpuee, un yaa jíń tintee kaa ti kúù jaanjaan.

english_verse: I am that bread from heaven! Everyone who eats it will live forever. My flesh is the life-giving bread I give to the people of this world.
translation_verse: Man di sá tijin tin nyánní yilpu ki cáá dimaŋfalee. Un yaa jíń tijin gbantee làá nīn bí kí nīn cá jaanjaan. Tijin tin m làá tīī binib kɔkɔ ń nīn cáá dimaŋfalee di sá m-wunti.»

english_verse: Jesus answered: I tell you for certain that you won't live unless you eat the flesh and drink the blood of the Son of Man.
translation_verse: Ní Yeesu fātìi bí-bi yii: «Ibaamɔn, ibaamɔn ní m tùkù-ni, ni yaa kaa ŋmɔ́ man Kinibiki wunti, kaa nyùn̄ m-fatikuu muee, naa làá ká dimaŋfal.

english_verse: But if you do eat my flesh and drink my blood, you will have eternal life, and I will raise you to life on the last day.
translation_verse: Ama sii un yaa ŋmɔ́ m-wunti ki nyùn̄ m-fatikuuee ká dimaŋfal din kaa cáá dikúntilee, ní ḿ dāá fìkitī-si ŋwinjoolkaa dal.

english_verse: My flesh is the true food, and my blood is the true drink.
translation_verse: Kun puee m-wunti di sá tijimmɔntiil ní m-fatikuu mun sá tinyɔkaal tin sá timɔntiilee.

english_verse: If you eat my flesh and drink my blood, you are one with me, and I am one with you.
translation_verse: Un yaa ŋmɔ́ m-wunti ki nyùn̄ m-fatikuuee bí m-ni ní ma mun bí udaan ni.

english_verse: The living Father sent me, and I have life because of him. Now everyone who eats my flesh will live because of me.
translation_verse: M-Baa un túnní-mee nín cáá dimaŋfal puee ní u-puee ma mun cáá dimaŋfal. Míǹ ní un yaa fōō-mi ki jíńee mun kāntí dimaŋfal man pu.

english_verse: The bread that comes down from heaven isn't like what your ancestors ate. They died, but whoever eats this bread will live forever.
translation_verse: Tijin tin nyánní yilpuee nín bí puee dee. Tíǹ kaa bí kii tin ni-naanjab nìn jíń, boonee ki dāa kpíìyee. Sii un di yaa jíń tijin gbantee làá nīn kíǹ ki bí kí nīn cá jaanjaan.»

english_verse: Jesus was teaching in a synagogue in Capernaum when he said these things. The Words of Eternal Life
translation_verse: Tin tin Yeesu nìn sòon̄ Kapeernayum kpafidiikun ki dàkā binibee dee. Yeesu di cáá tibɔti tin tìì dimaŋfalee

english_verse: Many of Jesus' disciples heard him and said, “This is too hard for anyone to understand.”
translation_verse: Yeesu boonnooliibi tikpil nín gbìl̄ tibɔti gbantee, ní bi bíi lì yii: «Tibɔti nee pɔ̄ɔ̄ tikpil! Ŋma di ŋūǹ kí pīlifì-tì?»

english_verse: Jesus knew that his disciples were grumbling. So he asked, “Does this bother you?
translation_verse: Yeesu béè yii u-boonnooliibi bíi gbùkum̄ tibɔti gbanti puee ní u bālifì-bi yii: «Tibɔti gbanti páb́-ni níii?

english_verse: What if you should see the Son of Man go up to heaven where he came from?
translation_verse: Mimmee, ni yaa láa ká man Kinibiki fātìi jɔ́ḿ laakin m nìn pée bíńee fáà?

english_verse: The Spirit is the one who gives life! Human strength can do nothing. The words that I have spoken to you are from that life-giving Spirit.
translation_verse: Unil nì u-pɔ́ɔǹtam kɔkɔ sá fám ní, see Ŋfam di tìì dimaŋfal din kaa cáá dikúntilee. Míǹ ní m-bɔti tin m sòon̄ nì nee sá Unimbɔti Fam ní ki sá dimaŋfal.

english_verse: But some of you refuse to have faith in me.” Jesus said this, because from the beginning he knew who would have faith in him. He also knew which one would betray him.
translation_verse: Ama ni-kansikin biba bí, kaa fōō ki kíí.» Kun di yì-tì Yeesu sòon̄ mimmee di sá u nìn pée nyí bin kaa fōō ki kííyee doooo ŋkilkaamin, nì un làá dāá dū-u kí tīī binannanliibee.

english_verse: Then Jesus said, “You cannot come to me, unless the Father makes you want to come. That is why I have told these things to all of you.”
translation_verse: Ní u lī-bi yii: «Míǹ pu ní m tùkū-ni yii ubɔ kaa ŋūǹ kí dāan̄ m-cee an yaa kaa tin sá m-Baa Unimbɔti di cáań-u.»

english_verse: Because of what Jesus said, many of his disciples turned their backs on him and stopped following him.
translation_verse: Ki yōoǹ an yuntiŋu ní Yeesu boonnooliibi tikpil yíì, kaa ti nóó-u.

english_verse: Jesus then asked his twelve disciples if they also were going to leave him.
translation_verse: Niinee ní Yeesu bí u-kpambaliŋ saalaa nì alee yii: «Kin nimbi fáà, ni mun kaa làá nīn cáaa?»

english_verse: Simon Peter answered, “Lord, there is no one else that we can go to! Your words give eternal life.
translation_verse: Ní Peetroo kíí-u yii: «Ti-Dindaan, sii di cáá tibɔti tin tìì dimaŋfal din kaa cáá dikúntilee. Ŋma cee ní ti làá gíti cù?

english_verse: We have faith in you, and we are sure that you are God's Holy One.”
translation_verse: Timbi fōō sii ní ki kíí, ní ki nyí yii sii di sá Circirdaan un nyánní Unimbɔti ceeyee.»

english_verse: Jesus told his disciples, “I chose all twelve of you, but one of you is a demon!”
translation_verse: Niinee ní Yeesu bí yii: «Man di kaa nìn lēē-ni binib saalaa nì bilaaa? Ama ni-kansikinee, ubɔ sá Sitaan ní!»

english_verse: Jesus was talking about Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot. He would later betray Jesus, even though he was one of the twelve disciples.
translation_verse: Juudasi un sá Siimɔn Isikaariyɔti jipɔɔnee pu ní u nìn sòon̄ míǹ. Di sá yii nì min kɔkɔ Juudasi mun nìn sá u-kpambaliŋ saalaa nì alee kansikin dibee, úǹ di làá dū-u kí ŋúbíǹ binannanliibi.

english_verse: Jesus decided to leave Judea and to start going through Galilee because the leaders of the people wanted to kill him.
translation_verse: Míǹ boonee, Yeesu nìn kíǹ ki bíi yìiǹ Galiilee timmun, kaa là kí yìiǹ Juudee watil, kun puee Juuda yab yidambi nìn nyàab̀ kí kpɔ̀-u.

english_verse: It was almost time for the Festival of Shelters,
translation_verse: Juuda yab jiŋaaliu un bi yíì Tibìń jiŋaaliuee tóobińee,

english_verse: and Jesus' brothers said to him, “Why don't you go to Judea? Then your disciples can see what you are doing.
translation_verse: ní Yeesu naalib bí-u yii: «Yīkì doo kí nīn cá Juudee, án nín làá ŋá pu a-boonnooliibi mun ń tin ká atuun ŋin a tūǹee.

english_verse: No one does anything in secret, if they want others to know about them. So let the world know what you are doing!”
translation_verse: Unil yaa là bí ká-uee, waa gíti tūǹ u-tuuŋŋi dibalin, míǹ puee, tɔ̄ a-tuuŋŋi gbanti báà ŋma ń ká.»

english_verse: Even Jesus' own brothers had not yet become his followers.
translation_verse: Di sá yii Yeesu naalib mun gba kaa nìn là kí fōō-u kí kíí.

english_verse: Jesus answered, “My time hasn't yet come, but your time is always here.
translation_verse: Niinee ní Yeesu kíí-bi yii: «An yaa sá nimbee, iyunti kɔkɔ pée ŋān̄ ki tīī-ni ní, man yuntiŋu kaa láá bāań.

english_verse: The people of this world cannot hate you. They hate me, because I tell them that they do evil things.
translation_verse: Duulinya yab kaa ŋūǹ kí nīn ná nimbi, ama bi ná man, kun puee man sòoǹ yii tin bi ŋáańee sá atuŋkpiti.

english_verse: Go on to the festival. My time hasn't yet come, and I am not going.”
translation_verse: Nimbi nín̄ cámaan jiŋaal gbanti. Man kaa làá cù. Di sá yii m-yuntiŋu kaa láá ŋmāntì.»

english_verse: Jesus said this and stayed on in Galilee. Jesus at the Festival of Shelters
translation_verse: U lī-bi mimmee, ní ki gbíntìi kā Galiilee. Yeesu cūtì Tibìń jiŋaaliu

english_verse: After Jesus' brothers had gone to the festival, he went secretly, without telling anyone.
translation_verse: U-naalib búntì jiŋaal gbanti, boonee ní u mun dāa dī dibalin ki cūtì, kaa là bí ká-u.

english_verse: During the festival the leaders of the people looked for Jesus and asked, “Where is he?”
translation_verse: Jiŋaal gbantinee, Juuda yab kpilib nìn nyàab̀-u ki bàlifī tɔb yii: «U nín bí la dee?»

english_verse: The crowds even got into an argument about him. Some were saying, “Jesus is a good man,” while others were saying, “He is lying to everyone.”
translation_verse: Ní binib tikpil nìn lɔ́kɔfí Yeesu bɔti pu samaa kansikin, biba bí yii: «U sá unimɔnti.» Ní biba mun bí yii: «Waa sá unimɔnti, u sá uŋmatinli ní.»

english_verse: But the people were afraid of their leaders, and none of them talked in public about him.
translation_verse: Míǹ puee, ubɔ kaa nìn sòoǹ mpɔn, di sá yii bi nìn fàŋkí Juuda yab kpilib.

english_verse: When the festival was about half over, Jesus went into the temple and started teaching.
translation_verse: Bi jíń jiŋaal ki kɔ́ kansikinee, ní Yeesu nín jɔ́ḿ kunimbɔtidiin ki cūtìi bíi dàkà binib.

english_verse: The leaders were surprised and said, “How does this man know so much? He has never been taught!”
translation_verse: Juuda yab kpilib nìn bākatì sèeee, ní ki bíi lì yii: «An ŋá mana ní unil nee nyí Unimbɔti gbɔŋku míǹ, úǹ un kaa ŋá an sukuliuee?»

english_verse: Jesus replied: I am not teaching something I thought up. What I teach comes from the one who sent me.
translation_verse: Ní Yeesu bí-bi yii: «M-dàkatam nee nyēeń un túnní-mee cee ní, an kaa sá man m-ba dàkatam.

english_verse: If you really want to obey God, you will know if what I teach comes from God or from me.
translation_verse: Un yaa là kí ŋá min Unimbɔti lèe, udaan làá béé m-dàkatam nee yaa nyēeń Unimbɔti ceeyaaa, an yaa tí sá man m-ba pɔŋŋu pu ní m sòoǹ.

english_verse: If I wanted to bring honor to myself, I would speak for myself. But I want to honor the one who sent me. This is why I tell the truth and not a lie.
translation_verse: Un sòoǹ u-ba bindi puee nyàab̀ kí yòon̄ u-ba yilpu ní, ama un nyàab̀ kí yòon̄ un túnní-uee yindi yilpuee di cáá ibaamɔn, nnyimɔn kpá udaan úǹ ni.

english_verse: Didn't Moses give you the Law? Yet none of you obey it! So why do you want to kill me?
translation_verse: Mooyiisi di nìn tīī-ni marab àá an kaa sá míǹ? Kin, ba ŋá ní ni-kansikin báà ubɔ kaa tɔ́ marab gbanti?

english_verse: The crowd replied, “You're crazy! What makes you think someone wants to kill you?”
translation_verse: Ba di yì-tì ní ni là kí kpɔ̀-mi?» Ní samaayee bí-u yii: «Arasinii kā a-pu níii? Ŋma di là kí kpɔ̀-si ní?»

english_verse: Jesus answered: I worked one miracle, and it amazed you.
translation_verse: Ní Yeesu kíí-bi yii: «Ditumbaantiil din m ŋá ŋwiŋŋuŋfikaa dalee pu ní ni kɔkɔ bākatì nee.

english_verse: Moses commanded you to circumcise your sons. But it wasn't really Moses who gave you this command. It was your ancestors, and even on the Sabbath you circumcise your sons
translation_verse: Ama ni kíikí ki gífí ni-biyaamu akpancan ŋwiŋŋuŋfikaa dal, kun puee Mooyiisi di nìn tīī-ni mara gbanti. - Ama an kaa nìn sá Mooyiisi di náanní, doooo ni-naanjab ní an nìn kíliń. -

english_verse: in order to obey the Law of Moses. Why are you angry with me for making someone completely well on the Sabbath?
translation_verse: Ni nín kaa là kí yìntī Mooyiisi marabee puee, ní ni gífí ŋwiŋŋuŋfikaa dal. Mimmee, ba pu ní ni fōō man pu diŋuul yii m cáaǹ uninja ubɔ weeŋyi kɔkɔ ŋwiŋŋuŋfikaa dal?

english_verse: Don't judge by appearances. Judge by what is right.
translation_verse: Ní taa pɔ̀ digàndi ama ní tɔ́kɔń ibaamɔn pu kí sòoǹ nì deedee.» Yeesu di kalin sá Meesiyaaa?

english_verse: Some of the people from Jerusalem were saying, “Isn't this the man they want to kill?
translation_verse: Niinee ní Jeerusaleem yab biba bíi lì yii: «An kaa sá un bi là kí kpɔ̀ee deeee?

english_verse: Yet here he is, speaking for everyone to hear. And no one is arguing with him. Do you suppose the authorities know he is the Messiah?
translation_verse: Kin, an ŋá mana ní u yú ki tɔ́ u-ba mpaampiin pu doo ki sòoǹ, ubɔ kaa bíi lì-u tiba! Àá biyidambi kalin béè yii úǹ di sá Meesiya ní?

english_verse: But how could that be? No one knows where the Messiah will come from, but we know where this man comes from.”
translation_verse: Ama uninja nee úŋ̀wuee, ti nyí laakin u nyánnée, an yaa sá Meesiyayee, ubɔ kaa dāa béetí laakin ní úǹ sée.»

english_verse: As Jesus was teaching in the temple, he shouted, “Do you really think you know me and where I came from? I didn't come on my own! The one who sent me is truthful, and you don't know him.
translation_verse: Ŋyuntee, Yeesu nìn bí kunimbɔtidiin ki dàkà, ní ki téeń mpɔn yii: «Ni nyí-mi, ki nyí laakin mun m sée yaa! Maa dɔ́miń m-ba pu, un sá ibaamɔndaanee di túnní-mi, ní naa nyí-u.

english_verse: But I know the one who sent me, because I came from him.”
translation_verse: Ama man nyí-u, kun puee u-cee ní m nyánní, úǹ di túnní-mi.»

english_verse: Some of the people wanted to arrest Jesus right then. But no one even laid a hand on him, because his time had not yet come.
translation_verse: Niinee ní bi bíi nyàab̀ kí cúú-u, ama báà ubɔ ŋal kaa máań u-pu, kun puee u-yuntiŋu kaa láá bāań.

english_verse: A lot of people in the crowd put their faith in him and said, “When the Messiah comes, he surely won't perform more miracles than this man has done!” Officers Sent To Arrest Jesus
translation_verse: Samaa kansikinee, binib tikpil nìn fōō-u ki kíí, ní ki lì yii: «Mimmee, Meesiya yaa láa bāańee, u dāa ŋūǹ kí ŋá maamaacib kí jītíǹ kijapaai nee deeee?» Bi tú bí bàà cù kí cúuń Yeesu

english_verse: When the Pharisees heard the crowd arguing about Jesus, they got together with the chief priests and sent some temple police to arrest him.
translation_verse: Fariisab nín gbìl̄ samaa bíi sòoǹ Yeesu pu míǹ bi-ŋmaniŋmee, ní bi nì bisaraaŋakpilib tú soojab ń cù kí cúuń-u.

english_verse: But Jesus told them, “I will be with you a little while longer, and then I will return to the one who sent me.
translation_verse: Ní Yeesu tùkū-bi yii: «Ŋyunti fiii ní m làá gíti ŋá ni-kansikin, ní kí nīn gítí un túnní-mee cee.

english_verse: You will look for me, but you won't find me. You cannot go where I am going.”
translation_verse: Di sá yii ni làá dāá nyàab̀-mi, kaa làá dāá ká-mi, kun puee naa làá dāá ŋmā kí dāan̄ laakin m làá nīn bée.»

english_verse: The people asked each other, “Where can he go to keep us from finding him? Is he going to some foreign country where our people live? Is he going there to teach the Greeks?
translation_verse: Niinee ní Juuda yab kpilib bíi bàlifī tɔb yii: «La ní u kalin nín cá ní ki nín tùkù-ti yii taa làá ŋmā kí ká-u ní? Àá, u làá kalin cù Juuda yab bin yàl̄ ki kɔ́ Greeki yab timmunee cee kí dàkà Greeki yab Unimbɔti bɔti ní?

english_verse: What did he mean by saying that we will look for him, but won't find him? Why can't we go where he is going?” Streams of Life-Giving Water
translation_verse: U nín bí yii: Ni làá nyàab̀-mi, kaa làá ká-mi, ki gíti lī-ti yii: Naa làá ŋmā kí dāan̄ laakin m làá nīn bée, taapu nín sá yii ba dee?» Ibun in nyim tìì dimaŋfalee

english_verse: On the last and most important day of the festival, Jesus stood up and shouted, “If you are thirsty, come to me and drink!
translation_verse: Ŋwiin ŋun jiŋaal kúntée bɔti di nìn páb́. Ŋwiin gbanti ní Yeesu nìn yúl̀ samaa kansikin ki téeń yii: «Un ní nnyinnyoo yaa cááyee ń dāan̄ m-cee kí nyɔ̀!

english_verse: Have faith in me, and you will have life-giving water flowing from deep inside you, just as the Scriptures say.”
translation_verse: Un di yaa fōō-mi ki kííyee, nnyim min tìì dimaŋfalee làá kpántí mbun kí nīn pùub̀ udaan pɔbilin, kii Unimbɔti gbɔŋku poon an nín ŋmàn̄ ki síiǹ puee.»

english_verse: Jesus was talking about the Holy Spirit, who would be given to everyone that had faith in him. The Spirit had not yet been given to anyone, since Jesus had not yet been given his full glory. The People Take Sides
translation_verse: Bin fōō Yeesu ki kííyee nín làá fōō Unimbɔti Fam miŋyee pu ní Yeesu nìn bíi sòoǹ nì bi. Ŋyunti gbantee, Unimbɔti Fam kaa láá dɔ́miń kun puee Yeesu kaa nìn dáá fōō u-nyooti. Samaa yākatì Yeesu pu

english_verse: When the crowd heard Jesus say this, some of them said, “He must be the Prophet!”
translation_verse: Kunipaauee kansikin biba gbìl̄ an nyɔɔbuŋŋee, ní ki bí yii: «Unil nee lafun sá Unimbɔti bɔnaatiliu un ti cée ní!»

english_verse: Others said, “He is the Messiah!” Others even said, “Can the Messiah come from Galilee?
translation_verse: Ní biba mun bí yii: «Úǹ di sá Meesiya!» Ní biba mun gíti bí yii: «Meesiya ŋūǹ kí nyānní Galiileeee?

english_verse: The Scriptures say that the Messiah will come from the family of King David. Doesn't this mean that he will be born in David's hometown of Bethlehem?”
translation_verse: Ama Unimbɔti gbɔŋku tùkù-ti yii Meesiya làá dāá nīn sá Daafiidi maaliŋun, ní ki sá Beetileem, kitiŋ kin ni Daafiidi nìn sée.»

english_verse: The people started taking sides against each other because of Jesus.
translation_verse: Yeesu puee kunipaauee nìn cúu yākatì mili.

english_verse: Some of them wanted to arrest him, but no one laid a hand on him. The Leaders Refuse To Have Faith in Jesus
translation_verse: Ní bi-kansikin biba bàà nìn là kí cúú-u, ama báà ubɔ ŋal kaa máań u-pu. Juuda yab tindaŋkpilib kaa fōō Yeesu ki kíí

english_verse: When the temple police returned to the chief priests and Pharisees, they were asked, “Why didn't you bring Jesus here?”
translation_verse: Soojab nín fātìi gítì bisaraaŋakpilib nì Fariisab ceeyee, ní bi bālifì soojabee yii: «Ba ŋá ní naa cáań-u ní?»

english_verse: They answered, “No one has ever spoken like this man!”
translation_verse: Ní soojab kíí-bi yii: «Doooo nee, taa láá ká ubɔ sòoǹ kii kijapaai nee!»

english_verse: The Pharisees said to them, “Have you also been fooled?
translation_verse: Ní Fariisab fātìi bí soojabee yii: «Ni mun yāntì u kíil̀-ni naaa?

english_verse: Not one of the chief priests or the Pharisees has faith in him.
translation_verse: Ni ká biyidambi kansikin ubɔ àá Fariisab kansikin ubɔ fōō-u ki kííii?

english_verse: And these people who don't know the Law are under God's curse anyway.”
translation_verse: An sá binifantantiibi bin kaa nyí Unimbɔti marab ki sá mbusudambee, bíǹ di fōō-u ki kíí.»

english_verse: Nicodemus was there at the time. He was a member of the council, and was the same one who had earlier come to see Jesus. He said,
translation_verse: Niikoodeem un nìn cūtìi ká Yeesu ŋyunti ŋubɔee mun nìn ŋmàl̄ Fariisab kansikin. Úǹ di bí yii:

english_verse: “Our Law doesn't let us condemn people before we hear what they have to say. We cannot judge them before we know what they have done.”
translation_verse: «Ti-marab poonee, an pú-ti nsan tí kpɔ̀ unil bɔti fám, kaa bālifì-u ki béè kun u ŋéeee?»

english_verse: Then they said, “Nicodemus, you must be from Galilee! Read the Scriptures, and you will find that no prophet is to come from Galilee.” A Woman Caught in Sin
translation_verse: Ní bi kíí-u yii: «A mun sá Galiilee níii? Nyàab̀ Unimbɔti gbɔŋku poon kí kpèè! Aa làá ká bi ŋmàn̄ laaba yii Unimbɔti bɔnaatiliu ubɔ nyánní Galiilee.» Yeesu fīī kinimpulaakpaai kiba [

english_verse: Everyone else went home,
translation_verse: Niinee ní bi-kɔkɔ yāaǹ ki nín kùn̄ bi-dumpui.

english_verse: but Jesus walked out to the Mount of Olives.
translation_verse: Ní Yeesu, úǹ nín jɔ́ḿ Ɔliifi sufii jool pu.

english_verse: Then early the next morning he went to the temple. The people came to him, and he sat down and started teaching them.
translation_verse: Ku wúntì kutaafaau pɔ̀lpɔlee, ní u fātìi nín gítiń kunimbɔtidiin, ní binib tikpil tí dɔ́miń u-cee. Niinee ní u kāl̀ ki bíi dàkà-bi Unimbɔti bɔti.

english_verse: The Pharisees and the teachers of the Law of Moses brought in a woman who had been caught in bed with a man who wasn't her husband. They made her stand in the middle of the crowd.
translation_verse: Ní bimaradakaliibi nì Fariisab cáań-u unimpu ubɔ, bi nìn cúú-u u bíi ŋáań tilaakpaal. Ní bi cáá-u ki yóoǹ kunipaau kansikin,

english_verse: Then they said, “Teacher, this woman was caught sleeping with a man who isn't her husband.
translation_verse: ní ki bí Yeesu yii: «Ukpil, unimpu nee bíi ŋáań tilaakpaal ní ti cúú-u.

english_verse: The Law of Moses teaches that a woman like this should be stoned to death! What do you say?”
translation_verse: Mooyiisi marab poonee, u bí-ti yii tí dū ataŋkpee kí yāŋkì an nimpoobee kí kpɔ̀. Mimmee, sii ká yii ba?»

english_verse: They asked Jesus this question, because they wanted to test him and bring some charge against him. But Jesus simply bent over and started writing on the ground with his finger.
translation_verse: Bi nìn píĺ Yeesu ki là ú sòoǹ kí kɔ́ bi-bɔtinee, ní bi cáań-u an bɔti. Ní Yeesu bōoǹ ki cáá u-ŋambiki ki ŋmà kitiŋ.

english_verse: They kept on asking Jesus about the woman. Finally, he stood up and said, “If any of you have never sinned, then go ahead and throw the first stone at her!”
translation_verse: Bi gbíntìi bíi bàlifī-uee, ní Yeesu yáatì, ní ki bí-bi yii: «Ni-kansikin un di yaa kaa pée ŋá ikpiti ki kée ń péé péé kí dū ditaŋkpal kí yā unimpu nee!»

english_verse: Once again he bent over and began writing on the ground.
translation_verse: U lī mimmee ní ki fātìi tí bōoǹ ki bíi ŋmà kitiŋ.

english_verse: The people left one by one, beginning with the oldest. Finally, Jesus and the woman were there alone.
translation_verse: Binibee nín gbìl̄ mimmee, ní bi kíǹ ki sútí ubɔ ubɔ ki wàatī unimpuee, ki kíliń bitikpilib ki dāa dūu kúntì ŋwaamu, ní an tin kíǹ Yeesu baba, ní unimpuee yú ki kɔ́ĺ-u.

english_verse: Jesus stood up and asked her, “Where is everyone? Isn't there anyone left to accuse you?”
translation_verse: Ní Yeesu yáatì ki bí yii: «Unimpuee, bin cáań-see bí la? Kéè, báà ubɔ kaa ŋá-si tibaa!»

english_verse: “No sir,” the woman answered. Then Jesus told her, “I am not going to accuse you either. You may go now, but don't sin anymore.” Jesus Is the Light for the World
translation_verse: Ní unimpuee kíí-u yii: «Aayee, ukpil, báà ubɔ kaa ŋá-mi tiba.» Ní Yeesu bí-u yii: «Ma mun kaa làá ŋá-si tiba. Á nīn cá kí taa ti ŋá ikpiti.»] Yeesu di sá ŋwalifi

english_verse: Once again Jesus spoke to the people. This time he said, “I am the light for the world! Follow me, and you won't be walking in the dark. You will have the light that gives life.”

translation_verse: Ní u kíí-bi yii: «M pée tùkū-ni ní naa pílifiǹ-mi. Ba pu ní ni là ḿ gíti bùsì kí lì nliliitiim? Àá ni mun là kí kpántí u-boonnooliibi ní?»

english_verse: The leaders insulted the man and said, “You are his follower! We are followers of Moses.
translation_verse: Niinee ní bi bíi sìí-u yii: «Sii di sá kijapaai gbanti boonnooliu, ama timbi sá Mooyiisi boonnooliibi ní.

english_verse: We are sure God spoke to Moses, but we don't even know where Jesus comes from.”
translation_verse: Kun puee, ti nyí yii Unimbɔti nìn sòon̄ nì Mooyiisi, ama un bí nee úŋ̀wuee, taa kpáàa nyí laakin gba ní u yaa nyánnée.»

english_verse: “How strange!” the man replied. “He healed my eyes, and yet you don't know where he comes from.
translation_verse: Ní kijapaayee kíí-bi yii: «Tin sá maamaacee sɔ̀. Nimbi kaa nyí laakin u nyánnée, u mun di ŋúbitì man nimbiliŋ.

english_verse: We know that God listens only to people who love and obey him. God doesn't listen to sinners.
translation_verse: Ti nyí yii Unimbɔti kaa pílifíǹ binikpitib, ama un yaa tɔ́-u ki ŋáań min min ní u lèe, udaan ní u pílifíǹ.

english_verse: And this is the first time in history anyone has ever given sight to someone born blind.

english_verse: The leaders told the man, “You have been a sinner since the day you were born! Do you think you can teach us anything?” Then they said, “You can never come back into any of our synagogues!”

english_verse: When Jesus heard what had happened, he went and found the man. Then Jesus asked, “Do you have faith in the Son of Man?”

translation_verse: Ní u kíí-u yii: «Ukpil, úǹ di sá ŋma ní ḿ fōō-u kí kíí ní?»

translation_verse: Ní Yeesu bí yii: «A wāĺ-uaa! Úǹ di bíi sòoǹ nì si nee.»

translation_verse: Ní Yeesu bí yii: «M dɔ́miń duulinya nee ni ibɔsoon ní. Bin yaa jɔ̀b̄ee ń wāl̀ ní bin wāĺee ń jɔ̀b̄.»

translation_verse: Yeesu bí yii: «Ibaamɔn, ibaamɔn ní m sòoǹ nì ni, un yaa kaa dī kipunyɔkɔ ki kɔ́ kupikpuŋkpuŋun ní ki yaa dī laabee, udaan sá digaŋgandaan ki sá unaayuu.

translation_verse: Iaa nōotí uniyaŋyan. I sáń-u ní, kun puee iaa nyí u-neen.»

english_verse: Jesus told the people this story. But they did not understand what he was talking about. Jesus Is the Good Shepherd
translation_verse: Yeesu nìn dū tibɔti nee ki ŋmāntì, ama ní baa nìn gbìl̄ ti-taapu. Yeesu di sá upikpaamɔnti

english_verse: Jesus said: I tell you for certain that I am the gate for the sheep.
translation_verse: Míǹ puee ní Yeesu gíti lī yii: «Ibaamɔn, ibaamɔn ní m sòoǹ nì ni, man di sá kupikpuŋkpuŋu punyɔkɔki.

english_verse: Everyone who came before me was a thief or a robber, and the sheep did not listen to any of them.
