english_verse: I am the gate. All who come in through me will be saved. Through me they will come and go and find pasture.
translation_verse: Man di sá kipunyɔkɔ. Un yaa dīń man pu ki kóońee kāntí difiil. Udaan ŋūǹ kí nīn kóò ki nyēē ki kāntí u-jinti.

english_verse: A thief comes only to rob, kill, and destroy. I came so everyone would have life, and have it fully.
translation_verse: Kun pu unaayuu dòońee di sá ú yɔ̀, kí kpɔ̀, kí bīil̀. Mamee m dɔ́miń í ká dimaŋfal ní, tiba nì tiba ń taa lóó-i dimaŋfal gbantin.

translation_verse: «Man di sá upikpaamɔnti, upikpaamɔnti piii pu ní u kúntí u-maŋfal.

english_verse: Hired workers run away because they don't care about the sheep.

translation_verse: Man di sá upikpaamɔnti. M nyí m-piii ní m-piii mun nyí-mi,

translation_verse: M cáá ipii iba in kaa láá kóoń m-pikpuŋkpuŋku nee poonee. See ḿ cáań-i. I làá dāá gbìl̄ m-neen, ní kupicaŋkpuŋu ń ŋá kubaantiiu, ní upikpaal mun ń nīn sá ubaanti.

translation_verse: «Kun pu m-Baa néeń-mee di sá m tìì m-maŋfal ní kí fàtīí fōō-dì.

translation_verse: Ní Juuda yab dɔ́miń ki māntì ki tú-u ní ki bí yii: «Áli kí tin sāā ŋyunti ŋulɔŋu ní a làá sòoǹ-ti ibaamɔn ní ti-landɔkɔi ń wāl̀ ní? Sii di yaa sá Meesiya, á cántí kí tùkù-ti!»

english_verse: Jesus answered: I have told you, and you refused to believe me. The things I do by my Father's authority show who I am.
translation_verse: Ní Yeesu kíí-bi yii: «M pée tùkū-ni dooooyee, ní naa fōō-mi ki kíí. Atuun ŋin m cáá m-Baa pɔŋŋu ki tūǹ nee sòoǹ m-pu,

english_verse: But since you are not my sheep, you don't believe me.
translation_verse: ní naa fōō-mi ki kíí, kun puee naa sá m-piii.

english_verse: My sheep know my voice, and I know them. They follow me,
translation_verse: M-piii gbìl̀ m-neen pu, ní ma mun nyí-i, ní i nóó-mi.

translation_verse: M tīī-i dimaŋfal din kaa cáá dikúntilee, i kpá kí kpú jaanjaan, báà ubɔ mun kaa tí ŋūǹ kí fōō-i m-ŋaan.

english_verse: My Father gave them to me, and he is greater than all others. No one can snatch them from his hands,
translation_verse: M-Baa un tīī-mi-iee cáá mpɔn ki jítiǹ báà ŋma. Míǹ ní ubɔ kaa ŋūǹ kí fōō tiba m-Baa ŋaan.

english_verse: and I am one with the Father.
translation_verse: Man nì m-Baa Unimbɔti, ti sá ubaanti ní.»

english_verse: Once again the people picked up stones in order to kill Jesus.
translation_verse: Niinee ní Juuda yab tí fātìi píí ataŋkpee kí yāŋkì kí kpɔ̀-u.

english_verse: But he said, “I have shown you many good things my Father sent me to do. Which one are you going to stone me for?”
translation_verse: Ní Yeesu bí-bi yii: «M dū m-Baa pɔŋŋu ki túń atummɔnti tikpil ni-nimbilin. Mimmee, atuun gbanti kansikinee, dilal pu ní ni là kí yāŋkì-mi ataŋkpee kí kpɔ̀ na?»

english_verse: They answered, “We are not stoning you because of any good thing you did. We are stoning you because you did a terrible thing. You are just a man, and here you are claiming to be God!”
translation_verse: Ní Juuda yab kíí-u yii: «An kaa sá atummɔnti pu ní ti là kí yāŋkì-si ataŋkpee kí kpɔ̀, an sá a nín sòon̄ ki bíil̀ Unimbɔtee pu. Kun puee sii sá unifantanti ní ki ŋèeǹ nì Unimbɔti.»

english_verse: Jesus replied: In your Scriptures doesn't God say, “You are gods”?
translation_verse: Ní Yeesu kíí-bi yii: «An kaa ŋmàn̄ ni-marau poon yii: <M bí yii, ni sá inimbɔtaaa?>

english_verse: If I don't do as my Father does, you should not believe me.
translation_verse: M yaa kaa bíi tūǹ m-Baa tuuŋŋi, ní taa fōō-mi kí kíí.

english_verse: But if I do what my Father does, you should believe because of that, even if you don't have faith in me. Then you will know for certain that the Father is one with me, and I am one with the Father.
translation_verse: Ní m yaa bíi tūǹ-ŋi, báà ni yaa kaa làá fōō-mi kí kíí, fōōmaan atuun ŋin m bíi tūǹee kí kíí kí baasii béé yii Ubaati bí m-ni ní ma mun bí Ubaatin.»

english_verse: When Jesus heard this, he said, “His sickness won't end in death. It will bring glory to God and his Son.”
translation_verse: Yeesu gbìl̄ mimmee, ní ki bí yii: «Laasaar weeŋyi nee kaa sá-u ŋkúm, i sá kí tīī Unimbɔti tinyool, ní ki làá tīī u-Jipɔɔn mun tinyool.»

english_verse: But he stayed where he was for two more days.

translation_verse: Ní boonee, u tùkū u-boonnooliibi yii: «Tí gítímaan Juudee!»

translation_verse: Ní m nyí yii tin ní u sòoǹee cāabìń dimaŋfal din kaa cáá dikúntilee. Míǹ puee, tin m sòon̄ee, tin m-Baa tīī-mi ḿ sòoǹee dee.»

english_verse: It was before Passover, and Jesus knew that the time had come for him to leave this world and to return to the Father. He had always loved his followers in this world, and he loved them to the very end.
translation_verse: Kutaa ń wúntí Dilákatil jiŋaaliuee, Yeesu nìn nyí yii ŋyunti ŋun u làá yīkì kitiŋ nee pu kí gítí u-Baa ceeyee bāań. U nìn néeń u-yab bin bí duulinyan dooyee, ki gíti néeń-bi ki lákatì áli ki tin kátì-ku.

english_verse: Even before the evening meal started, the devil had made Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot, decide to betray Jesus.
translation_verse: Ŋyunti ŋun u nì u-boonnooliibi kā ki jīǹ tijoojinee, mimmee Sitaan pée lūkutì Juudasi Isikaariyɔti, Siimɔn jipɔɔn ú dū Yeesu kí nyāfiǹ u-nannanliibi dee.

english_verse: Jesus knew he had come from God and would go back to God. He also knew that the Father had given him complete power.
translation_verse: Yeesu mun nìn pée nyí yii u nyánní Unimbɔti cee ní ki làá fàtīí gítí Unimbɔti cee, ní ki nyí yii u-Baa Unimbɔti dū tikɔkɔwoooo ki ŋá u-ŋaan.

english_verse: So during the meal Jesus got up, removed his outer garment, and wrapped a towel around his waist.
translation_verse: U nì u-boonnooliibi bíi jīǹee ní Yeesu yíkì tijin pu, ní ki pēetì u-bɔkutifɔkɔl ní ki dū ŋŋaabu ŋubɔ ki gbìn̄ u-caŋ,

english_verse: He put some water into a large bowl. Then he began washing his disciples' feet and drying them with the towel he was wearing.
translation_verse: ní ki jōō nnyim ki ŋá kisampeeyin, ní ki kíĺ ki bíi fíntí u-boonnooliibi taaŋi, ní ki cáá ŋŋaabu ŋun u gbìn̄ u-caŋee ki cáa pítí bi-taaŋi.

english_verse: But when he came to Simon Peter, this disciple asked, “Lord, are you going to wash my feet?”
translation_verse: U fíntì ki bāań Siimɔn Peetrooyee ní Siimɔn bí yii: «Ti-Dindaan, sii a-ba di làá fíntí man taaŋaaa?»

english_verse: Jesus answered, “You don't really know what I am doing, but later you will understand.”
translation_verse: Ní Yeesu kíí-u yii: «Tin m bíi ŋáań nee, aa gbìl̀ taapu kɔŋkɔnnee, ama boonee a làá dāá gbìl̄.»

english_verse: “You will never wash my feet!” Peter replied. “If I don't wash you,” Jesus told him, “you don't really belong to me.”
translation_verse: Ní Peetroo bí yii: «M yíì kpataaa, a kpá kí fíntí m-taaŋi.» Ní Yeesu kíí-u yii: «A yaa kaa yāntì m fíntì-si, mimmee, aa sá m-yɔu.»

english_verse: Peter said, “Lord, don't wash just my feet. Wash my hands and my head.”
translation_verse: Ní Siimɔn Peetroo kíí-u yii: «An yaa sá míǹ, ti-Dindaan, taa fíntí m-taaŋi ŋmaniŋma, fíntí kí kpáaǹ m-ŋalii nì m-yil!»

english_verse: Jesus answered, “People who have bathed and are clean all over need to wash just their feet. And you, my disciples, are clean, except for one of you.”
translation_verse: Ní Yeesu kíí-u yii: «Un yaa fùl̄ee kaa ti fùul̀, see ataa ŋmaniŋma ní u fíntí, kun puee waa ti cáá tijɔkɔndi. Míǹ ní ni mun bí circir, ama an kaa sá ni-kɔkɔ.»

english_verse: Jesus knew who would betray him. That is why he said, “except for one of you.”
translation_verse: Di sá yii Yeesu nìn nyí un làá dū-u kí tīī u-nannanliibee, míǹ pu ní u bí yii: «An kaa sá ni-kɔkɔ di bí circir.»

english_verse: After Jesus had washed his disciples' feet and had put his outer garment back on, he sat down again. Then he said: Do you understand what I have done?
translation_verse: Yeesu fíntì bi-taaŋi ki dóòyee, ní ki fātìi dū u-bɔkutilee ki pēeǹ, ní ki fātìi kāl̀, ní ki bālifì-bi yii: «Tin m ŋá-ni nee, ni gbìl̄ taapuɔɔɔ?

english_verse: You call me your teacher and Lord, and you should, because that is who I am.
translation_verse: Ni yíì-mi yii Ukpil nì ni-Dindaan, ní ni máaǹ kí yíiń-mi míǹ, kun puee míǹ ní m lafun sá.

english_verse: I have set the example, and you should do for each other exactly what I have done for you.
translation_verse: M ŋá míǹ ki dàkā-ni ni mun ń nīn ŋáań míǹ ki tìì tɔb ní.

english_verse: I tell you for certain that servants are not greater than their master, and messengers are not greater than the one who sent them.
translation_verse: Ibaamɔn, ibaamɔn ní m sòoǹ nì ni, utɔntɔnli kaa jítiǹ u-kpiliu, míǹ ní un bi túee kaa jítiǹ un túnní-uee.

english_verse: I am not talking about all of you. I know the ones I have chosen. But what the Scriptures say must come true. And they say, “The man who ate with me has turned against me!”
translation_verse: «An kaa sá ni-kɔkɔ pu ní m sòoǹ, kun puee m nyí bin m lútèe. Tin bí nee ń ŋá kii Unimbɔti gbɔŋku poon nín lī puee, yii: <Un jīǹ m-jintee fātìi bíi jáà nì mi.>

english_verse: I am telling you this before it all happens. Then when it does happen, you will believe who I am.
translation_verse: M tùkù-ni tin bí nee ki yōontí kɔŋkɔnnee kí wàatī ní an bàń, án nín làá ŋá pu tì yaa láa bāańee ní fōō kí kíí yii <man di sá un m sée>.

english_verse: So the disciple leaned toward Jesus and asked, “Lord, which one of us are you talking about?”
translation_verse: Ní u sútì ki mɔ̄tìi nákáǹ Yeesu ní ki bālifì-u yii: «Ukpil, an sá ŋma ní?»

english_verse: After Jesus had said these things, he was deeply troubled and told his disciples, “I tell you for certain that one of you will betray me.”
translation_verse: Yeesu lī míǹ ki dóòyee, ní an gbēē u-pɔbil, ní u bí yii: «Ibaamɔn, ibaamɔn ní m sòoǹ nì ni, ni-kansikin ubɔ di làá dū-mi kí tīī m-nannanliibi.»

english_verse: Jesus' favorite disciple was sitting next to him at the meal,
translation_verse: Un Yeesu nìn néeń u-boonnooliibi kansikinee kā ki nákáǹ-u.

english_verse: and Simon motioned for this disciple to find out which one Jesus meant.
translation_verse: Ní Siimɔn Peetroo ŋá-u kudaaŋŋu yii ú bàlifì-u kí kpèè un pu ní u sòon̄ee.

english_verse: No one at the meal understood what Jesus meant.
translation_verse: Bin nìn kā ki jīǹee, báà ubɔ kaa béè kun pu ní u lī-u mimmee.

english_verse: But because Judas was in charge of the money, some of them thought that Jesus had told him to buy something they needed for the festival. Others thought that Jesus had told him to give some money to the poor.
translation_verse: Biba nìn dàkafī yii Yeesu là ú cùú dā tin tin bi làá cáá jī jiŋaalee, àá u là ú tīī biwɔfib tiba ní. Di sá yii Juudasi di nìn ŋúb́ bi-nimbiliŋ.

english_verse: Judas took the piece of bread and went out. It was already night. The New Command
translation_verse: Juudasi fōō kpɔnɔee, ní ki nyáń malaa. Kunyeeu nìn mɔ́. Marapɔɔn

english_verse: Then, after God is given glory because of him, God will bring glory to him, and God will do it very soon.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti yaa ká u-nyooti man nee, míǹ ní ma mun làá ká m-nyooti Unimbɔtin an kaa làá yúntí.

english_verse: My children, I will be with you for only a little while longer. Then you will look for me, but you won't find me. I tell you just as I told the people, “You cannot go where I am going.”
translation_verse: M-biyaamu, ŋyunti fiii di kíǹ ḿ gíti kàl̄ ni-cee. Míǹ boonee ni làá dāá nyàab̀-mi. Kii m nín nìn tùkū Juuda yab puee, naa làá ŋmā kí cù laakin m cée. Kɔŋkɔnnee, m tùkū ni mun dee.

english_verse: Simon Peter asked, “Lord, where are you going?” Jesus answered, “You can't go with me now, but later on you will.”
translation_verse: Ní Siimɔn Peetroo bālifì-u yii: «Ti-Dindaan, la ní a cá?» Ní Yeesu kíí-u yii: «Aa ŋūǹ kí nóó-mi laakin m cée kɔŋkɔnnee, ama boonee, a dāa nōotí-mi.»

english_verse: Peter asked, “Lord, why can't I go with you now? I would die for you!”
translation_verse: Ní Peetroo bí-u yii: «Ti-Dindaan, ba pu ní maa ŋūǹ kí nóó-si kɔŋkɔnnee? Báà an yaa sá ŋkúm, m làá dū m-maŋfal kí tīī a-pu.»

english_verse: “Would you really die for me?” Jesus asked. “I tell you for certain before a rooster crows, you will say three times that you don't even know me.”
translation_verse: Ní Yeesu kíí-u yii: «A làá lafun dū a-maŋfal kí tīī man puɔɔɔ? Ibaamɔn, ibaamɔn ní m sòoǹ nì si, kí wàatī ukooja ń bāakèe, a làá néé yii saa nyí-mi diba dibee mita.»

english_verse: Jesus said to his disciples, “Don't be worried! Have faith in God and have faith in me.
translation_verse: Ní Yeesu nìkī ki lī yii: «Ni-pɔbiliŋ ń taa bīil̀. Ní fōō Unimbɔti kí kíí, kí fōōmaan ma mun kí kíí.

english_verse: There are many rooms in my Father's house. I wouldn't tell you this, unless it was true. I am going there to prepare a place for each of you.
translation_verse: Ikɔŋkoon tikpil bí m-Baa dumpu, m làá cù kí bɔ́ntí-i kí yóoń-ni. I yaa kaa bàà bí tiŋman, m bàà tùkù kí cántí-ni.

english_verse: After I have done this, I will come back and take you with me. Then we will be together.
translation_verse: M yaa cūtì ki bɔ́ntì ipaan gbantee, ní ḿ gítiń kí yòon̄-ni, án nín làá ŋá pu laakin m làá nīn bée, ni mun ń nīn bí m-cee niinee.

english_verse: You know the way to where I am going.”
translation_verse: Ni nyí laakin m cée, ki nyí nsan mun.»

english_verse: Thomas said, “Lord, we don't even know where you are going! How can we know the way?”
translation_verse: Ní Toomasi bí-u yii: «Ti-Dindaan, taa nyí laakin a cée! Ti làá ŋá mana kí béé nsan?»

english_verse: “I am the way, the truth, and the life!” Jesus answered. “Without me, no one can go to the Father.
translation_verse: Ní Yeesu kíí-u yii: «Man di sá nsan, ki sá ibaamɔn ki sá dimaŋfal. Ubɔ kaa ŋūǹ kí dī laaba kí dāan̄ m-Baa Unimbɔti cee, see ú dīń man pu.

english_verse: If you had really known me, you would have known the Father. But from now on, you do know him, and you have seen him.”
translation_verse: Ni yaa bàà nyí-mee, ni bàà nyí m-Baa mun ní. Ama kɔŋkɔnnee ni nyí-u, ki ká-u mun.»

english_verse: Philip said, “Lord, show us the Father. That is all we need.”
translation_verse: Niinee ní Fiiliipi bí-u yii: «Ti-Dindaan, dàkà-ti a-Baa Unimbɔti ti-pɔbiliŋ ń sɔ̀ŋkì.»

english_verse: Jesus replied: Philip, I have been with you for a long time. Don't you know who I am? If you have seen me, you have seen the Father. How can you ask me to show you the Father?
translation_verse: Ní Yeesu kíí-u yii: «Fiiliipi, m nín bí ni-cee an yúntì pu nee, ní saa nyí-maaa? Un yaa ká-mee, ká m-Baa mun dee. Kin ba pu ní sii gíti lì yii ḿ dàkà-ni m-Baa?

english_verse: Don't you believe that I am one with the Father and that the Father is one with me? What I say isn't said on my own. The Father who lives in me does these things.
translation_verse: Aa nyí yii man bí m-Baa ni, ní m-Baa mun bí man naaa? Tibɔti tin m sòoǹ nì nee, maa sòoǹ-tì m-ba pu, an sá m-Baa un bí m-nee di tūǹ u-tundi.

english_verse: Have faith in me when I say that the Father is one with me and that I am one with the Father. Or else have faith in me simply because of the things I do.
translation_verse: Fōō kí kíímaan yii m bí m-Baa ni ní m-Baa mun bí man ni. Báà ni yaa kaa fōō m-bɔti ki kíí, kpèèmaan m-tuuŋŋi ŋin m ŋá nee pu kí fōō kí kíí.

english_verse: I tell you for certain that if you have faith in me, you will do the same things I am doing. You will do even greater things, now that I am going back to the Father.
translation_verse: Ibaamɔn, ibaamɔn ní m sòoǹ nì ni, un yaa fōō-mi ki kííyee làá tɔ̄ atuun ŋin m tūǹee, úǹ làá tɔ̄ ŋin jítiǹ man yaŋ nee gba, kun puee m cá m-Baa cee ní.

english_verse: Ask me, and I will do whatever you ask. This way the Son will bring honor to the Father.
translation_verse: Ní tin kɔkɔ ni yaa mēē m-yindi puee, m làá ŋá míǹ kí tīī-ni, ní m-Baa ń ká tinyool u-Jipɔɔn pu.

english_verse: I will do whatever you ask me to do. The Holy Spirit Is Promised
translation_verse: Ni yaa mēē tiba m-yindi pu, m làá ŋá míǹ kí tīī-ni. Yeesu pōoǹ kí tɔ̄ń Circir Fam

english_verse: Then I will ask the Father to send you the Holy Spirit who will help you and always be with you.
translation_verse: ní man ń mèè m-Baa Unimbɔti ú gíti tīiń-ni Ututunli ubɔ un làá nīn bí ni-cee kí nīn cá jaanjaanee.

english_verse: The Spirit will show you what is true. The people of this world cannot accept the Spirit, because they don't see or know him. But you know the Spirit, who is with you and will keep on living in you.
translation_verse: Úǹ di sá Unimbɔti Fam ibaamɔndaan, un duulinya nib kaa ŋūǹ kí fōōyee, kun puee baa wāĺ-uaaa, kaa nyí-u mun. Ama an yaa sá nimbi, ni nyí-u kun puee u kóò ni-cee ní ki làá dāá nīn bí ni-ni.

english_verse: I won't leave you like orphans. I will come back to you.
translation_verse: «Maa làá dū-ni kí fá kii ataŋkpiibilee, m làá fàtīí gítiń ni-cee.

english_verse: In a little while the people of this world won't be able to see me, but you will see me. And because I live, you will live.
translation_verse: An kíǹ fiii duulinya nib kaa làá ti ká-mi, ama nimbi làá ká-mi, kun puee m bí dimaŋfalin, míǹ ní ni mun làá nīn bí dimaŋfalin.

english_verse: Then you will know I am one with the Father. You will know you are one with me, and I am one with you.
translation_verse: Ŋwiin gbanti yaa láa bāańee, ni dāa béetí yii man bí m-Baa ni, ní nimbi bí man ni, ní man bí ni mun ni.

english_verse: If you love me, you will do what I have said, and my Father will love you. I will also love you and show you what I am like.
translation_verse: Un yaa cáá man marab ki ŋúb́-bee, udaanee di néeń-mi. Míǹ ní m-baa làá nīn néeń un néeń-mee, ma mun ń nīn néeń-u, ní kí nyāntí m-ba kí dàkà udaan.»

english_verse: The other Judas, not Judas Iscariot, then spoke up and asked, “Lord, what do you mean by saying that you will show us what you are like, but you will not show the people of this world?”
translation_verse: Ní Juudi - an kaa nín sá Juudasi Isikaariyɔti - bí-u yii: «Ti-Dindaan, mana ní a làá ŋá ní kí nyāntí a-ba kí dàkà timbi, ní kí taa dàkà duulinya nib?»

english_verse: Jesus replied: If anyone loves me, they will obey me. Then my Father will love them, and we will come to them and live in them.
translation_verse: Ní Yeesu kíí-u yii: «Un yaa néeń-mee làá nīn ŋúb́ m-bɔti. M-Baa làá nīn néeń udaan, ní man nì m-Baa ń dāan̄ kí nīn kóò udaan cee.

english_verse: But anyone who doesn't love me, won't obey me. What they have heard me say doesn't really come from me, but from the Father who sent me.
translation_verse: Un kaa néeń-mee kaa ŋúb́ m-bɔti. M-bɔti tin m sòoǹ nì nee nyánní m-Baa un túnní-mee cee ní, an kaa sá m-ba pu ní m sòoǹ.

english_verse: I have told you these things while I am still with you.
translation_verse: «M tùkū-ni tin bí nee ŋyunti ŋun m dáá bí ni-cee nee.

english_verse: But the Holy Spirit will come and help you, because the Father will send the Spirit to take my place. The Spirit will teach you everything and will remind you of what I said while I was with you.
translation_verse: Ama Ututunlee, Circir Fam min m-Baa làá dāá tɔ̄ń man yindi puee, làá dāá dàkà-ni tikɔkɔ, ní kí téetí-ni tin kɔkɔ m sòon̄ nì nee.

english_verse: I give you peace, the kind of peace only I can give. It isn't like the peace this world can give. So don't be worried or afraid.
translation_verse: «Ŋgbansɔŋfi ní m cáań-ni, man gbansɔŋfiŋu ní m dūu tīī-ni, maa tìì kii duulinya nín tìì puee. Ní taa bàkatī kí taa fàŋkì mun.

english_verse: You have already heard me say I am going and I will also come back to you. If you really love me, you should be glad I am going back to the Father, because he is greater than I am.
translation_verse: Ni gbìl̄ m nín lī yii m làá nīn cá kí dāá fàtīí gítiń ni-ceeyee. Ni yaa bàà néeń-mee, an bàà mɔ́ɔkíǹ-ni kii m nín cá m-Baa ceeyee pu, kun puee m-Baa jítiǹ man.

english_verse: I am telling you this before I leave, so when it does happen, you will have faith in me.
translation_verse: M tùkū-ni kɔŋkɔnnee ki yóoǹ kí wàatī ní án nín bàń, ní ŋyunti ŋun ní an yaa láa bāańee, ní ŋmā kí mɔ̀tīí fōō kí kíí.

english_verse: I cannot speak with you much longer, because the ruler of this world is coming. But he has no power over me.
translation_verse: Maa làá ti sòoǹ nì ni tikpil, kun puee duulinya bɔtiu Sitaan dòoń. Waa nín ŋūǹ kí ŋá-mi tiba.

english_verse: I obey my Father, so everyone in the world might know that I love him. It is time for us to go now.
translation_verse: Ama duulinya nib máaǹ kí béé yii m néeń m-Baa, an pu ní min ní m-Baa yaa bí ḿ ŋée, míǹ ní m ŋáań. Yīkìmaan, tí nīn cá.»

english_verse: Jesus said to his disciples: I am the true vine, and my Father is the gardener.
translation_verse: Ní Yeesu bí yii: «Man di sá fiinyi subu tiŋman, ní m-Baa sá un ŋáŋkí-buee.

english_verse: He cuts away every branch of mine that doesn't produce fruit. But he trims clean every branch that does produce fruit, so that it will produce even more fruit.
translation_verse: Apan ŋin túkú m-pu kaa lòoǹee, u gà-ŋi ki féeń ní. Apan ŋin lòoǹee, u ŋáŋkí-ŋi, ní ŋí mɔ̀tīí lòoǹ.

english_verse: You are already clean because of what I have said to you.
translation_verse: Tibɔti tin m sòon̄ nì nee, tì ŋáŋkì nimbi.

english_verse: Stay joined to me, and I will stay joined to you. Just as a branch cannot produce fruit unless it stays joined to the vine, you cannot produce fruit unless you stay joined to me.
translation_verse: Ní nīn bímaan man ni, ní ma mun ń nīn bí ni-ni. Kii dipandi nín kaa ŋūǹ kí lòoǹ abil di-baba asee dí nīn túkú busubu puee, míǹ mbaantiim ní ni yaa kaa bí man ni, naa ŋūǹ kí lòoǹ abil.

english_verse: I am the vine, and you are the branches. If you stay joined to me, and I stay joined to you, then you will produce lots of fruit. But you cannot do anything without me.
translation_verse: «Man di sá fiinyi subu, ní nimbi sá apan. Un yaa bí man ni ma mun bí udaan nee lòoǹ abil ní tikpil, kun puee ni yaa kaa bí man ni, naa ŋūǹ kí ŋá tiba.

english_verse: If you don't stay joined to me, you will be thrown away. You will be like dry branches that are gathered up and burned in a fire.
translation_verse: Un yaa kaa bí man nee, bi gà-u kí fá kii disupandee ní, ní ú kpā. Asupaŋkulimee, bi kōontí-ŋi kí tɔ̄ ŋŋmin, ní án wà.

english_verse: Stay joined to me and let my teachings become part of you. Then you can pray for whatever you want, and your prayer will be answered.
translation_verse: Ni yaa bí man ni, ní ma mun bɔti bí ni-nee, bàlifìmaan tin tin ni yaa lèe, ni làá ká kudɔŋu.

english_verse: When you become fruitful disciples of mine, my Father will be honored.
translation_verse: Tin tìì m-Baa tinyoolee di sá ní lòoǹ abil tikpil ní kí nīn sá man boonnooliibi.

english_verse: I have loved you, just as my Father has loved me. So remain faithful to my love for you.
translation_verse: Kii m-Baa nín néeń-mi puee, míǹ ní ma mun néeń-ni. Nín̄ bímaan m-neendin.

english_verse: If you obey me, I will keep loving you, just as my Father keeps loving me, because I have obeyed him.
translation_verse: Ni yaa ŋúb́ m-marabee, mimmee, ni bí m-neendin dee, kii ma mun nín ŋúb́ m-Baa marab ki bí u-neendin puee.

english_verse: I have told you this to make you as completely happy as I am.
translation_verse: «M sòoǹ nì ni tin bí nee án nín làá ŋá pu m-pɔɔpindi ń nīn bí ni-ni, ní ni-pɔbiliŋ ń mɔ̀tīí gíti pīil̀ee.

english_verse: Now I tell you to love each other, as I have loved you.
translation_verse: Mara un m síiǹ-nee sèé: ní nīn néeḿmaan tɔb, kii man nín néeń-ni puee.

english_verse: The greatest way to show love for friends is to die for them.
translation_verse: Dineeŋkpaandi diba kaa ti bí kí bà unil ń dū u-maŋfal kí kúntí u-bɔɔbi pu.

english_verse: And you are my friends, if you obey me.
translation_verse: Ni yaa ŋáań min m bàlifī-nee, mimmee ni kpántì m-bɔɔbi dee.

english_verse: Servants don't know what their master is doing, and so I don't speak to you as my servants. I speak to you as my friends, and I have told you everything my Father has told me.
translation_verse: Maa ti yíì-ni m-tɔntɔnliibi, kun puee utɔntɔnli kaa nyí tin u-kpiliu ŋáańee. M yíì-ni m-bɔɔbi ní, kun puee m dàkā-ni tin kɔkɔwoooo m gbìl̄ m-Baa ceeyee.

english_verse: You did not choose me. I chose you and sent you out to produce fruit, the kind of fruit that will last. Then my Father will give you whatever you ask for in my name.
translation_verse: Man di lēē nimbi, kaa sá nimbi di lēē man. M tú-ni ní cùú lòoǹ abil, abil ŋin làá yúntée, mimmee, m-Baa làá tīī-ni tin kɔkɔ ni yaa mēē-u man yindi puee.

english_verse: So I command you to love each other. The World's Hatred
translation_verse: Tin tin m síiǹ-nee, di sá ní nīn néeń tɔb.» Duulinya ná Yeesu nì u-yab

english_verse: If the people of this world hate you, just remember that they hated me first.
translation_verse: «Duulinya nib yaa ná-nee, ní béé yii man ní bi péé ki ná.

english_verse: If you belonged to the world, its people would love you. But you don't belong to the world. I have chosen you to leave the world behind, and this is why its people hate you.
translation_verse: Ni yaa bàà sá duulinya yabee, duulinya yab bàà néeń-ni, kun puee ni sá u-yab. Ama m lútì-ni ki nyántì duulinya nib kansikin. Naa ti sá duulinya yab, an pu ní bi ná-ni.

english_verse: Remember how I told you that servants are not greater than their master. So if people mistreat me, they will mistreat you. If they do what I say, they will do what you say.
translation_verse: Ní téetímaan tin tin m nìn tùkū-nee, yii: <Utɔntɔnli kaa jítiǹ u-kpiliu.> Bi yaa páb́ man, bi làá dāá páb́ ni mun, bi yaa bàà pílifì man bɔti, bi bàà dāa pílifí ni mun yati.

english_verse: People will do to you exactly what they did to me. They will do it because you belong to me, and they don't know the one who sent me.
translation_verse: Man pu ní bi làá ŋá-ni tin bí nee kɔkɔ, kun puee baa nyí un túnní-mee.

english_verse: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not be guilty of sin. But now they have no excuse for their sin.
translation_verse: M yaa kaa bàà dɔ́miń ní kaa bàà sòon̄ nì bi, baa bàà cáá ikpiti. Ama kɔŋkɔnnee, baa ti cáá nnaakpal báà ŋubɔ bi-kpitii pu.

english_verse: Everyone who hates me also hates my Father.
translation_verse: Un yaa ná-mee ná m-Baa mun dee.

english_verse: I have done things no one else has ever done. If they had not seen me do these things, they would not be guilty. But they did see me do these things, and they still hate me and my Father too.
translation_verse: M yaa kaa bàà ŋá maamaacib bin bin báà ubɔ kaa ŋée bi-kansikin, baa bàà cáá ikpiti. Ama bi kántì m-maamaacib, ní ki gbíntì ki ná man nì m-Baa.

english_verse: This is why the Scriptures are true when they say, “People hated me for no reason.”
translation_verse: Too! An ŋá kii bi-marab gbɔŋku poon nín lī ki síiǹ puee dee yii: <Bi ná-mi fám, an kaa cáá taapu.>

english_verse: I will send you the Spirit who comes from the Father and shows what is true. The Spirit will help you and will tell you about me.
translation_verse: «M yaa bàn̄ m-Baa ceeyee, m làá tɔ̄ń-ni Ututunli, úǹ di sá Unimbɔti Fam ibaamɔndaan un nyánní m-Baa ceeyee. U yaa láa bāańee, u làá sòoǹ m-pu,

english_verse: Then you will also tell others about me, because you have been with me from the beginning.
translation_verse: ní ni mun ń dāá lēē m-pu seera, kun puee ni pée bí m-cee doooo ŋkilkaamin ní.

english_verse: I am telling you these things, so that you will not turn away.
translation_verse: «M sòon̄ nì ni tin bí nee án nín làá ŋá pu ní taa láa fá ni-fookiiu m-puee.

english_verse: You will be chased out of the synagogues. And the time will come when people will kill you and think they are doing God a favor.
translation_verse: Bi làá dāá jà-ni kí nyāntí akpafidiinni, áli gba, ŋyunti ŋubɔ bí ki dòoń bi làá kpɔ̀-ni ki dàkafī yii bi ŋá Unimbɔti lammi.

english_verse: They will do these things because they don't know either the Father or me.
translation_verse: Kun pu bi làá ŋá mimmee di sá yii baa nyí m-Baayaaa, kaa nyí ma mun.

english_verse: I am saying this to you now, so that when the time comes, you will remember what I have said. The Work of the Holy Spirit I was with you at the first, and so I didn't tell you these things.
translation_verse: Ama m tùkū-ni tin bí nee, ní ti-yuntiŋu yaa láa bāańee ní dāá téetí yii m nìn pée tùkū-ni-tì. Circir Fam tundi «Maa tùkū-ni tin bí nee doooo ŋkilkaamin kun puee m dáá bí ni-ceeyee pu.

english_verse: But now I am going back to the Father who sent me, and none of you asks me where I am going.
translation_verse: «Kɔŋkɔnnee, m làá nīn cá un túnní-mee cee, ní ni-kansikin ubɔ kaa bālifì-mi yii: <A cá la?>

english_verse: You are very sad from hearing all of this.
translation_verse: M nín sòon̄-ni puee ní kunimbaau kɔ́-ni.

english_verse: But I tell you I am going to do what is best for you. This is why I am going away. The Holy Spirit cannot come to help you until I leave. But after I am gone, I will send the Spirit to you.
translation_verse: Ama, ibaamɔn ní m sòoǹ nì ni, m nín cá m-Baa ceeyee, an sá ni-paatii, kun puee m yaa búntèe, m làá tɔ̄ń Ututunli ni-cee. M yaa kaa yíkì, waa làá dāan̄ ni-cee.

english_verse: The Spirit will come and show the people of this world the truth about sin and God's justice and the judgment.
translation_verse: U yaa láa bāańee, u làá yàntī duulinya nib ń béé yii bi bí ikpitin, kí yàntī bí béé kun di sá deedeeyee, kí yàntī bí béé Unimbɔti bɔsooŋyi in dɔ̄ ki cí-bee.

english_verse: The Spirit will show them that they are wrong about sin, because they didn't have faith in me.
translation_verse: U làá yàntī bí béé yii bi bí ikpitin, kun puee baa fōō-mi ki kíí,

english_verse: They are wrong about God's justice, because I am going to the Father, and you won't see me again.
translation_verse: ki làá yàntī bí béé kun sá deedeeyee, kun puee m nín cá m-Baa cee ní naa làá ti wāl̀-mi,

english_verse: And they are wrong about the judgment, because God has already judged the ruler of this world.
translation_verse: ní ki làá yàntī bí béé yii ibɔsoon dɔ̄ ki cí-bi, kun puee Unimbɔti sòon̄ duulinya bɔtiu bɔti.

english_verse: I have much more to say to you, but right now it would be more than you could understand.
translation_verse: «Tibɔti tikpil bàà bí ḿ sòoǹ nì ni, ama tì jítiǹ-ni kɔŋkɔnnee.

english_verse: The Spirit shows what is true and will come and guide you into the full truth. The Spirit doesn't speak on his own. He will tell you only what he has heard from me, and he will let you know what is going to happen.
translation_verse: Ama Unimbɔti Fam ibaamɔndaanee yaa láa bāańee, úǹ di làá dàkà-ni ibaamɔn kɔkɔ. Waa làá sòoǹ u-ba pɔŋŋu pu, u làá dāá tùkù-ni tin tin u gbìl̄ee, kí dàkà-ni tin bí ki dòońee.

english_verse: The Spirit will bring glory to me by taking my message and telling it to you.
translation_verse: U làá dāá tīī-mi tinyool, kun puee u làá dāá fōō tin tin m cááyee kí tùkù-ni.

english_verse: Everything the Father has is mine. This is why I have said that the Spirit takes my message and tells it to you. Sorrow Will Turn into Joy
translation_verse: Tin kɔkɔ m-Baa Unimbɔti cááyee sá ma mun wanti ní. An pu ní m tùkū-ni yii Unimbɔti Famee làá dāá fōō tin m cááyee kí tùkù-ni.» Dinimbinaamandi làá kpántí dipɔɔpindi

english_verse: Jesus told his disciples, “For a little while you won't see me, but after a while you will see me.”
translation_verse: «An kíǹ fiii, naa làá ti ká-mi, ní an yaa láa tí kútì fiii boonee, ní ni làá fàtīí tí ká-mi.»

english_verse: They said to each other, “What does Jesus mean by saying that for a little while we won't see him, but after a while we will see him? What does he mean by saying he is going to the Father?
translation_verse: Niinee ní u-boonnooliibi biba bíi lì tɔb cee yii: «Taapu nín sá yii ba dee, yii: <An kíǹ fiii naa làá ti ká-mi, ní an yaa fātìi kútì fiii boonee, ní ni làá fàtīí tí ká-mee?> U gíti lī mun yii: <M cá m-Baa cee>. Mimmee, u là kí tùkù-ti yii ba dee?

english_verse: What is this ‘little while’ that he is talking about? We don't know what he means.”
translation_verse: <An kíǹ fiii> gbanti taapu baasii nín sá yii ba dee? Taa gbìl̀ tin u là kí sòoǹ nì ti nee taapu!»

english_verse: Jesus knew they had some questions, so he said: You are wondering what I meant when I said that for a little while you won't see me, but after a while you will see me.
translation_verse: Yeesu béè yii bi là kí bàlifì-uee, ní u bí-bi yii: «M nín bí yii: <An kíǹ fiii naa làá ti ká-mi, ní an yaa fātìi tí kútì fiii boonee, ní ni làá fàtīí tí ká-mee> pu ní ni bíi bàlifī tɔb naaa?

english_verse: I tell you for certain that you will cry and be sad, but the world will be happy. You will be sad, but later you will be happy.
translation_verse: Ibaamɔn, ibaamɔn ní m sòoǹ nì ni, ni làá dāá nīn sūǹ ki tíminsí ní duulinya yab fàal̀. Ni làá dāá nīn bí dinimbinaamandin, ama ni-nimbinaamandi làá dāá kpántí-ni dipɔɔpindi.

english_verse: When a woman is about to give birth, she is in great pain. But after it is all over, she forgets the pain and is happy, because she has brought a child into the world.
translation_verse: Imatiŋween yaa bāań unimpuee, u kíǹ ki bí dinimbinaamandin ní, kun puee u-falaau yuntiŋu bāań-u. Ama u yaa màl̄ ki dóòyee ní án mɔ̄ɔkiǹ-u, ní ú súntí u-falaau pu, kun puee u màl̄ unil.

english_verse: You are now very sad. But later I will see you, and you will be so happy that no one will be able to change the way you feel.
translation_verse: «Míǹ mbaantiim ní ni mun bí dinimbinaamandin kɔŋkɔnnee. Ama m làá dāá fàtīí gíti ká-ni ní ni-pɔbiliŋ ń pīil̀. Báà ubɔ kaa dāa ŋūǹ kí lēē ni-pɔɔpindi gbanti.

english_verse: When that time comes, you won't have to ask me about anything. I tell you for certain the Father will give you whatever you ask for in my name.
translation_verse: «An wiiŋŋu gbantee, naa dāa gíti bàlifī-mi tiba nì tiba pu. Ibaamɔn, ibaamɔn ní m sòoǹ nì ni, tin kɔkɔ ni yaa mēē m-Baa m-yindi puee, u làá tīī-ni kudɔŋu.

english_verse: You have not asked for anything in this way before, but now you must ask in my name. Then it will be given to you, so you will be completely happy.
translation_verse: Áli nìn díǹee, naa láá mēē m-yindi pu tiba, mèèmaan tiba, ni làá fōō kudɔŋu, ni-pɔbiliŋ ń mɔ̀tīí pīil̀.» Yeesu jáń ki pɔ́ɔkiǹ duulinya

english_verse: I have used examples to explain to you what I have been talking about. But the time will come when I will speak to you plainly about the Father and will no longer use examples like these.
translation_verse: «Tibɔŋmantikaal ní m cáa bíi sòoǹ nì ni tin bí nee kɔkɔ. Ŋyunti ŋubɔ dòoń ŋun ni maa làá gíti dū tibɔŋmantikaal kí sòoǹ nì nee. M làá dāá sòoǹ m-Baa Unimbɔti pu kí cántí.

english_verse: You will ask the Father in my name, and I won't have to ask him for you.
translation_verse: Ŋwiin gbanti yaa láa bāańee, ni làá dāá nīn mèé m-Baa Unimbɔti man yindi pu. Maa bí yii man di làá dāá nīn mèé m-Baa ni-pu,

english_verse: God the Father loves you because you love me, and you believe I have come from him.
translation_verse: kun puee m-Baa Unimbɔti u-ba néeń-ni. U néeń-ni kun puee ni néeń man ki fōō ki kíí yii m nyánní Unimbɔti cee.

english_verse: I came from the Father into the world, but I am leaving the world and returning to the Father.
translation_verse: M nyánní m-Baa cee ní ki dɔ́miń duulinyan. Kɔŋkɔnnee m làá fàtīí yīkì duulinyan kí nīn gítí m-Baa cee.»

english_verse: The disciples said, “Now you are speaking plainly to us! You are not using examples.
translation_verse: Niinee ní u-boonnooliibi bí yii: «An kaa sá nì tibɔŋmantikaal ní a cáa bíi sòoǹ nì ti nee, min bí nee a baasii bíi sòoǹ ki cántí-ti ní nee.

english_verse: At last we know that you understand everything, and we don't have any more questions. Now we believe you truly have come from God.”
translation_verse: Kɔŋkɔnnee ti nyí yii a nyí tikɔkɔ, an kaa ti páb́ yii ubɔ ń bàlifì-si tiba. An pu ní ti fōō ki kíí yii a nyánní Unimbɔti cee.»

english_verse: Jesus replied: Do you really believe me?
translation_verse: Ní Yeesu kíí-bi yii: «Ni fōō ki kíí kɔŋkɔnneeyaa!

english_verse: The time will come and is already here when all of you will be scattered. Each of you will go back home and leave me by myself. But the Father will be with me, and I won't be alone.
translation_verse: Too, ŋyunti ŋubɔ dòoń, ŋu bāań gba, ŋun ni ni-kɔkɔ làá sāǹ kí yàl̄ ni-ba ni-ba kí kíń man babee, ama maa bí m-baba nì m-baba, m-Baa bí m-cee.

english_verse: I have told you this, so that you might have peace in your hearts because of me. While you are in the world, you will have to suffer. But cheer up! I have defeated the world.
translation_verse: M tùkū-ni tin bí nee án nín làá ŋá pu man puee, ní nīn cáá ŋgbansɔŋfee. Falaa dɔ̄ ki cí-ni duulinyan doo ní jī, ama ni-wunti ń taa yɔ̀tī! Di sá yii m jáń ki pɔ́ɔkiǹ duulinya.»

english_verse: After Jesus had finished speaking to his disciples, he looked up toward heaven and prayed: Father, the time has come for you to bring glory to your Son, in order that he may bring glory to you.
translation_verse: Yeesu sòon̄ míǹ ki dóòyee, ní ki wáaǹ ki kpēē kutaa ní ki bí yii: «M-Baa, kɔŋkɔnnee ŋyunti bāań! Tīī a-Jipɔɔn tinyool, án nín làá ŋá pu a-Jipɔɔn mun ń tīī-si tinyoolee.

english_verse: And you gave him power over all people, so he would give eternal life to everyone you give him.
translation_verse: Kun puee sii di tīī-u mpɔn binib kɔkɔ pu, yii ú tīī bin kɔkɔwoooo a dūu ŋá u-ŋaanee dimaŋfal din kaa cáá dikúntilee.

english_verse: Eternal life is to know you, the only true God, and to know Jesus Christ, the one you sent.
translation_verse: Dimaŋfal gbanti di sá bí béé sii un baba sá Unimbɔtibaamɔnee, kí béé Yeesu Kriisitoo un a túnnée mun.

english_verse: I have brought glory to you here on earth by doing everything you gave me to do.
translation_verse: M dàkā duulinya nib a-nyooti, m dóò ditundi din a tīī-mi ḿ tɔ̄ee.

english_verse: Now, Father, give me back the glory I had with you before the world was created.
translation_verse: M-baa, kɔŋkɔnnee, tīī-mi tinyool a-cee, tinyool tin m nìn cáá a-cee dooooyee, ki wāatì ní a nín náań duulinyee.

english_verse: You have given me some followers from this world, and I have shown them what you are like. They were yours, but you gave them to me, and they have obeyed you.
translation_verse: «M yāntì binib bin a nyántì duulinya nib kansikin ki tīī-mee béè-si. Sii di nìn yì-bi, ní ki dū-bi ki tīī-mi, ní bi fōō a-bɔti.

english_verse: They know that you gave me everything I have.
translation_verse: Kɔŋkɔnnee, bi béè yii tin kɔkɔ a tīī-mee nyánní a-cee.

english_verse: I told my followers what you told me, and they accepted it. They know I came from you, and they believe you are the one who sent me.
translation_verse: Tibɔti tin a tīiń-mee m cáań ki tùkū-bi, ní bi fōō ki béè yii ibaamɔn m nyánní sii cee, ní ki fōō ki kíí yii sii di túnní-mi.

english_verse: I am praying for them, but not for those who belong to this world. My followers belong to you, and I am praying for them.
translation_verse: «Bíǹ pu ní m mèé-si nee. An kaa sá duulinya nib pu ní m mèé. M mèé-si binib bin a tīī-mi nee pu ní, kun puee sii di yì-bi.

english_verse: All I have is yours, and all you have is mine, and they will bring glory to me.
translation_verse: Tin kɔkɔ m cááyee, sii di yì, ní tin kɔkɔ si mun cááyee, man di yì. Bíǹ pu ní bi tìì-mi tinyool.

english_verse: Holy Father, I am no longer in the world. I am coming to you, but my followers are still in the world. So keep them safe by the power of the name you have given me. Then they will be one with each other, just as you and I are one.
translation_verse: Man kaa ti bí duulinyan. Man dòoń sii cee ní, ní bíǹ làá nīn gbíntìi bí duulinyan. M-Baa circirdaan, dū mpɔn ŋun bí a-yindi din a tīī-mee nee kí ŋúb́-bi, án nín làá ŋá pu bí kpāfì ubaanti kii man nì si nín ŋá ubaanti puee.

english_verse: While I was with them, I kept them safe by the power you have given me. I guarded them, and not one of them was lost, except the one who had to be lost. This happened so that what the Scriptures say would come true.
translation_verse: Man nì bi nín nìn bée, m dū a-pɔŋŋu ŋun a tīī-mee ki ŋúb́-bi, ní ki mɔ́tì bi-pu, ní báà ubɔ bi-kansikin kaa wáŋkì, asee un baba làá pée wāŋkì, kii a-gbɔŋku nín nìn pée sòon̄ ki síiǹ puee.

english_verse: I am on my way to you. But I say these things while I am still in the world, so my followers will have the same complete joy that I do.
translation_verse: Kɔŋkɔnnee, m dòoń a-cee. M nín dáá bí duulinyan ki sòoǹ tin nee, an sá kí ŋmā kí yàntī bí ká dipɔɔpindi, man pɔɔpimmɔntiil.

english_verse: I have told them your message. But the people of this world hate them, because they don't belong to this world, just as I don't.
translation_verse: M cáań-bi a-bɔti, ní duulinya yab ná-bi, kun puee baa sá duulinyan, kii ma mun nín kaa sá duulinyan puee.

english_verse: Father, I don't ask you to take my followers out of the world, but keep them safe from the evil one.
translation_verse: Maa mèé-si yii á yòon̄-bi duulinyan, á ŋúb́-bi, bí taa jēetí Sitaan ŋaan.

english_verse: They don't belong to this world, and neither do I.
translation_verse: Baa sá duulinya yab, kii ma mun nín kaa sá duulinyan yɔu puee.

english_verse: Your word is the truth. So let this truth make them completely yours.
translation_verse: Á dū a-baamɔŋyi kí ŋá bi-ni, kí yàntī bí kpántí a-yab kɔkɔ: a-bɔti di sá ibaamɔn.

english_verse: I am sending them into the world, just as you sent me.
translation_verse: Kii a nín túnní-mi duulinyan puee, míǹ ní ma mun tú-bi duulinyan.

english_verse: I have given myself completely for their sake, so they may belong completely to the truth.
translation_verse: M kúntì m-ba kɔkɔ ki tīī-si bi-pu, án nín làá ŋá pu ibaamɔn ń yàntī bi mun ń kúntí bi-ba kí tīī-see.

english_verse: I am not praying just for these followers. I am also praying for everyone else who will have faith because of what my followers will say about me.
translation_verse: «An kaa sá bíǹ baba pu ní m mèé-si. M mèé-si ki kpáaǹ bin bin làá dāá pīlifì bi-bɔti kí fōō-mi kí kííyee pu ní.

english_verse: I want all of them to be one with each other, just as I am one with you and you are one with me. I also want them to be one with us. Then the people of this world will believe that you sent me.
translation_verse: M-Baa, yàntī bi-kɔkɔ ń ŋá ubaanti kii sii nín bí man ni, ma mun bí sii ni puee. Bi-kɔkɔ ń ŋá ubaanti nì ti, án nín làá ŋá pu duulinya nib ń lafun béé yii sii di túnní-mee.

english_verse: I have honored my followers in the same way you honored me, in order that they may be one with each other, just as we are one.
translation_verse: M yāntì bi fōō a-nyooti tin a nìn tīī-mee án nín làá ŋá pu bi-kɔkɔ ń ŋá ubaantee, kii man nì si nín ŋá ubaanti puee.

english_verse: I am one with them, and you are one with me, so they may become completely one. Then this world's people will know that you sent me. They will know that you love my followers as much as you love me.
translation_verse: Man ń nīn bí bi-ni kii sii nín bí man ni puee, án nín làá ŋá pu bí ŋá ubaanti mbaamɔmin, duulinya nib ń bée yii sii di túnní-mi, ki néeń-bi kii a nín néeń man puee.

english_verse: Father, I want everyone you have given me to be with me, wherever I am. Then they will see the glory you have given me, because you loved me before the world was created.
translation_verse: «M-Baa, m là yii laakin m bée, bin kɔkɔwoooo a tīī-mee ń nīn bí m-cee niin kí ká m-nyooti, tinyool tin a tīī-mee. Di sá yii a néeń-mi ki wāatì ní ki nín náań yilpu nì taapu.

english_verse: Good Father, the people of this world don't know you. But I know you, and my followers know that you sent me.
translation_verse: M-Baa deedeedaan, duulinya nib kaa nyí-si, ama man nyí-si, ní bin bí nee béè yii sii di túnní-mi.

english_verse: I told them what you are like, and I will tell them even more. Then the love you have for me will become part of them, and I will be one with them.
translation_verse: M yāntì bi béè-si, ki làá yàntī bí mɔ̀tīí béé-si, án nín làá ŋá pu dineendi din a cáá m-puee ń nīn bí bi-ni, ní ma mun m-ba ń nīn bí bi-nee.»

english_verse: One of the high priest's servants was there. He was a relative of the servant whose ear Peter had cut off, and he asked, “Didn't I see you in the garden with that man?”
translation_verse: Ní usaraaŋakpil tɔntɔnliu ubɔ un nabiki tafal Peetroo bàà gāā ki wúkutèe bí-u yii: «Maa bàà ká si nì u bukpaanaaa?»

english_verse: Jesus again asked, “Who are you looking for?” “We are looking for Jesus from Nazareth,” they answered.
translation_verse: Ní Yeesu fātìi tí bālifì-bi yii: «Ŋma ní ni nyàab̀ ní?» Ní bi bí yii: «Ti nyàab̀ Yeesu Naasaareeti yɔuee ní.»

english_verse: This time Jesus replied, “I have already told you that I am Jesus. If I am the one you are looking for, let these others go.
translation_verse: Ní Yeesu kíí-bi yii: «Kéè, m pée tùkū-ni yii m sèéyaa! An yaa sá man ní ni nyàab̀ee, ní yàntī bin bí nee ń nīn cá!»

english_verse: Then everything will happen, just as I said, ‘I did not lose anyone you gave me.’ ”
translation_verse: Mimmee an ŋá kii u nín bàà sòon̄ puee dee, yii: «Maa fá bin a tīī-mee kansikin báà ubɔ.»

english_verse: Simon Peter had brought along a sword. He pulled it out and struck at Malchus, the servant of the high priest, cutting off his right ear.
translation_verse: Niinee ní Siimɔn Peetroo dáaĺ ki fɔ́fì u-tàataajiki, ki gāā ki wúkutì usaraaŋakpil tɔntɔnliu ubɔ ŋaŋgiitafal. Bi nìn yíì utɔntɔnli gbanti Maalkusi ní.

english_verse: The Roman officer and his men, together with the temple police, arrested Jesus and tied him up.
translation_verse: Niinee ní disoojakitilee nì bi-kpiliu nì Juuda yab pilisib cúú Yeesu ki bóob́-u,

english_verse: Peter stayed outside near the gate. But the other disciple came back out and spoke to the girl at the gate. She let Peter go in,
translation_verse: ní Peetroo nìn gbíntìi sí kipunyɔkɔ boon mmɔŋki. Ní uboonnool un usaraaŋakpil nìn nyée nyáń ki ká unimpu un nìn cí kipunyɔkɔpuee ní ki cáá Peetroo ki kɔ́ǹ.

english_verse: but asked him, “Aren't you one of that man's followers?” “No, I am not!” Peter answered.
translation_verse: Ní unimpu un nìn cí kipunyɔkɔpuee bālifì Peetroo yii: «A mun kaa sá uninja nee boonnooliibi ubɔɔɔ?» Ní Peetroo bí-u yii: «Aayee, maa sá.»

english_verse: It was cold, and the servants and temple police had made a charcoal fire. They were warming themselves around it, when Peter went over and stood near the fire to warm himself. Jesus Is Questioned by the High Priest (Matthew
translation_verse: Tiwool nìn bí, an pu ní bitɔntɔnliibi nì pilisib kpāā ŋŋmi ki sí ki wùl̀, ní Peetroo mun yú bi-cee niin ki wùl̀. Usaraaŋakpil bālifì Yeesu tibɔti (Kpèè Maat

english_verse: The high priest questioned Jesus about his followers and his teaching.
translation_verse: Niinee ní usaraaŋakpil bíi bàlifī Yeesu u-boonnooliibi bɔti nì tibɔti tin u dàkèe pu.

english_verse: Why are you questioning me? Why don't you ask the people who heard me? They know what I have said.”
translation_verse: Ba pu ní a bàlifī-mi? Bàlifì bin pílifì tin m sòon̄ee. Bālifì-bi tin m lēe, bíǹ nyí tin m sòon̄ee.»

english_verse: Jesus was still tied up, and Annas sent him to Caiaphas the high priest. Peter Again Denies that He Knows Jesus (Matthew
translation_verse: Yeesu ŋalii gbíntìi bóob́ee, ní Aani dū-u ki tīī usaraaŋakpil Kaayiifi. Peetroo fātìi tí néé yii waa nyí Yeesu (Kpèè Maat

english_verse: ) Pilate went back out and said, “I don't find this man guilty of anything!
translation_verse: ) Piilati sòon̄ míǹ ki dóòyee, ní ki nyáń ki tí nín cá Juuda yab cee, ní ki bí-bi yii: «Maa ká kun pu ní kijapaai nee máaǹ ditafadaaldee.

english_verse: It was early in the morning when Jesus was taken from Caiaphas to the building where the Roman governor stayed. But the crowd waited outside. Any of them who had gone inside would have become unclean and would not be allowed to eat the Passover meal.
translation_verse: Ní bi yōoǹní Yeesu Kaayiifi cee ki cáá-u ki nín cá gɔmina Piilati cee. An nìn dáá sá kutaafaau pɔ̀lpɔl ní. Juuda yab kaa nìn là kí kɔ́ gɔmina diikun kun puee bi là kí nīn bí circir kí ŋmā kí jī Dilákatil jiŋaaliu.

english_verse: Pilate came out and asked, “What charges are you bringing against this man?”
translation_verse: Míǹ pu ní gɔmina Piilati nyánní ki dɔ́miń bi-cee, ní ki bālifì-bi yii: «Ba ní uninja nee ŋá ní ni cáań-u ní?»

english_verse: They answered, “He is a criminal! That's why we brought him to you.”
translation_verse: Ní bi kíí-u yii: «U yaa kaa bàà sá unikpiti, taa bàà cāabìń-u kí tīī-si!»

english_verse: And so what Jesus said about his death would soon come true.
translation_verse: An ŋá míǹ kí dàkà Yeesu nín nìn sòon̄ u-kúm min u làá kpúee puee dee.

english_verse: Pilate then went back inside. He called Jesus over and asked, “Are you the king of the Jews?”
translation_verse: Ní Piilati nín kóò kudiin ki yíiń Yeesu, ní ki bālifì-u yii: «Mimmee, sii di sá Juuda yab bɔtiuaaa?»

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Are you asking this on your own or did someone tell you about me?”
translation_verse: Ní Yeesu kíí-u yii: «Tin tin a lī nee, sii a-ba di dākafì míǹ naaa, ubɔ di tùkū-si míǹ man pu ní?»

english_verse: “You know I'm not a Jew!” Pilate said. “Your own people and the chief priests brought you to me. What have you done?”
translation_verse: Ní Piilati kíí-u yii: «M sá Ujuudajaaa? A-yab nì bisaraaŋakpilib di dū-si ki tīiń-mi. Mimmee, ba ní a ŋá ní?»

english_verse: Jesus answered, “My kingdom doesn't belong to this world. If it did, my followers would have fought to keep me from being handed over to our leaders. No, my kingdom doesn't belong to this world.”
translation_verse: Ní Yeesu kíí-u yii: «M-beel kaa sá taapu doo beel. M-beel yaa bàà sá duulinyan yal, m-tɔntɔnliibi bàà jáà kí mɔ̄tì m-pu ní. Baa bàà kíikí bí dū-mi kí tīī Juuda yab kpilib. Ama, m-beel kaa sá taapu doo yal.»

english_verse: “So you are a king,” Pilate replied. “You are saying that I am a king,” Jesus told him. “I was born into this world to tell about the truth. And everyone who belongs to the truth knows my voice.”
translation_verse: Ní Piilati bí-u yii: «Mimmee, a sá ubɔti níii?» Ní Yeesu kíí-u yii: «Sii di lī. M dɔ́miń bi màl̄-mi duulinyan ḿ dàkà binib kun di sá ibaamɔnee ní. Un kamaa sá ibaamɔn yɔuee pílifí tin m sòoǹee ní.»

english_verse: Pilate asked Jesus, “What is truth?” Jesus Is Sentenced to Death (Matthew
translation_verse: Ní Piilati bālifì-u yii: «Ba di sá ibaamɔn ní?» Piilati lēē yii bí kpɔ̀ Yeesu (Kpèè Maat

english_verse: And since I usually set a prisoner free for you at Passover, would you like for me to set free the king of the Jews?”
translation_verse: Kii ni-marau nín pée sá puee, Dilákatil jiŋaaliu kamaayee, m gīintí usarkadaan ubɔ ní kí líí-ni. Mimmee, ni là ḿ gíiǹ Juuda yab bɔtiu kí líí-naaa?»

english_verse: Pilate gave orders for Jesus to be beaten with a whip.
translation_verse: Niinee ní Piilati dū Yeesu ki tīī bí gbá-u anaalab.

english_verse: The soldiers made a crown out of thorn branches and put it on Jesus. Then they put a purple robe on him.
translation_verse: Soojab nìn dū ikuŋkum ki lùn̄ kibeefuulii ki dūu cíkiǹ Yeesu, ní ki dū dibɔkutil diba dì máǹ cínciŋ ki dūu pēeǹ-u.

english_verse: They came up to him and said, “Hey, you king of the Jews!” They also hit him with their fists.
translation_verse: Ní bi sútíi kɔ́l̀-u, ní ki lì yii: «Juuda yab bɔtiu, ti jáaḿ-si!» ní ki fátí-u.

english_verse: Once again Pilate went out. This time he said, “I will have Jesus brought out to you again. Then you can see for yourselves that I have not found him guilty.”
translation_verse: Ní Piilati fātìi tí nyánní, ní ki bí Juuda yab yii: «Kpèèmaan, m làá nyāntiń-ni-u mmɔŋki, ní béé yii man kaa ká kun pu ní kijapaai nee máaǹ ditafadaaldee.»

english_verse: Jesus came out, wearing the crown of thorns and the purple robe. Pilate said, “Here is the man!”
translation_verse: Ní Yeesu nyáń ki cíkí ikuŋkum fuuliiki ki pēē dibɔkutimandi cínciŋ, ní Piilati bí-bi yii: «Kpèèmaan unil!»

english_verse: When the chief priests and the temple police saw him, they yelled, “Nail him to a cross! Nail him to a cross!” Pilate told them, “You take him and nail him to a cross! I don't find him guilty of anything.”
translation_verse: Bisaraaŋakpilib nì bi-pilisibee nín pée ká-uee, ní bi bíi tátí yii: «Bí kpáá-u ndɔpuntikaa pu! Bí kpáá-u ndɔpuntikaa pu!» Ní Piilati bí-bi yii: «Yòom̄maan-u kí cùú kpáá-u nimbi ni-ba ndɔpuntikaa pu, kun puee man kaa ká kun ní u ŋá ki máaǹ ditafadaaldee!»

english_verse: The crowd replied, “He claimed to be the Son of God! Our law says that he must be put to death.”
translation_verse: Ní Juuda yab kíí-u yii: «Timbi marau poonee, u máaǹ ŋkúm, kun puee u bí yii u sá Unimbɔti Jipɔɔn.»

english_verse: When Pilate heard this, he was terrified.
translation_verse: Piilati gbìl̄ mimmee, ní tifaandi mɔ̄tìi gíti kɔ́-u,

english_verse: He went back inside and asked Jesus, “Where are you from?” But Jesus did not answer.
translation_verse: ní u nín kóò kudiin, ki bālifì Yeesu yii: «A baasii nyánní la ní?» Ní Yeesu kaa kíí-u báà tiba.

english_verse: “Why won't you answer my question?” Pilate asked. “Don't you know I have the power to let you go free or to nail you to a cross?”
translation_verse: Ní Piilati bí-u yii: «Man ní saa làá kííii? Aa nyí yii m cáá mpɔn kí gíiǹ-si kí líí, ki cáá mpɔn kí yàntī bí kpáá-si ndɔpuntikaa puɔɔɔ?»

english_verse: Jesus replied, “If God had not given you the power, you couldn't do anything at all to me. But the one who handed me over to you did something even worse.”
translation_verse: Ní Yeesu kíí-u yii: «Aa cáá mpɔn ŋubɔ ki kútì ŋun Unimbɔti tīiń-si yilpuee. Míǹ pu ní un dū-mi ki ŋúbíǹ-see kpitii wīikíǹ sii yai.»

english_verse: Then Pilate wanted to set Jesus free. But the crowd again yelled, “If you set this man free, you are no friend of the Emperor! Anyone who claims to be a king is an enemy of the Emperor.”
translation_verse: Ki yōoǹ ŋyunti gbanti ní Piilati bíi nyàab̀ kí gíiǹ Yeesu kí líí. Ama ní Juuda yab bíi kūuntí ki lì yii: «A yaa gíiǹ kijapaai nee ki líìyee, aa ti sá gɔmina Seesaar bɔɔ! Un kamaa yaa yíì u-ba ubɔtee di sá Seesaar pulincɔnti.»

english_verse: When Pilate heard this, he brought Jesus out. Then he sat down on the judge's bench at the place known as “The Stone Pavement.” In Aramaic this pavement is called “Gabbatha.”
translation_verse: Piilati gbìl̄ mimmee, ní ki nyántìń Yeesu mmɔŋki ki dɔ́miń ki kāl̀ dibɔsoonjal pu laakin bi yíì ataŋkpee paaŋŋuee, .

english_verse: It was about noon on the day before Passover, and Pilate said to the crowd, “Look at your king!”
translation_verse: An nìn sá kuwiŋkuluu nyɔkɔm ní kutaa ń wúntí Dilákatil jiŋaaliu. Ní u lī Juuda yab yii: «Kpèèmaan, ni-bɔtiu sèé!»

english_verse: Then Pilate handed Jesus over to be nailed to a cross. Jesus Is Nailed to a Cross (Matthew
translation_verse: Niinee ní Piilati dū Yeesu ki tīī-bi bí cáá-u kí kpáá ndɔpuntikaa pu. Bi kpáá Yeesu ndɔpuntikaa pu (Kpèè Maat

english_verse: The soldiers first broke the legs of the other two men who were nailed there.
translation_verse: Niinee soojab dɔ́miń ki kɔ́fì bin bin bi nìn kpáá idɔpuntikaa pu nì Yeesu dicilpuee upeepeekaa nì uliliiti taaŋi.

english_verse: So the chief priests went to Pilate and said, “Why did you write that he is King of the Jews? You should have written, ‘He claimed to be King of the Jews.’ ”
translation_verse: Ní Juuda yab saraaŋakpilib bí Piilati yii: «Taa ŋmà yii: <Un sá Juuda yab bɔtiuee>, ŋmà yii: <Uninja nee bí yii úǹ di sá Juuda yab bɔtiu.>»

english_verse: When Jesus saw his mother and his favorite disciple with her, he said to his mother, “This man is now your son.”
translation_verse: Yeesu ká u-na nì u-boonnooliu un u néeńee yú ki kɔ́ĺ tɔb, ní u bí u-na yii: «M-na, kpèè a-jipɔɔn sèé»,

english_verse: ) Jesus was taken away,
translation_verse: ) Niinee ní bi cáá Yeesu ki búntì.

english_verse: and he carried his cross to a place known as “The Skull.” In Aramaic this place is called “Golgotha.”
translation_verse: Ní Yeesu yōoǹ u-dɔpuntikaaŋu ki nyánní kitiŋin ki nín cá laakin bi yíì Kuyikpabiku laŋkee,

english_verse: There Jesus was nailed to the cross, and on each side of him a man was also nailed to a cross.
translation_verse: Niin ní soojab kpáá Yeesu ndɔpuntikaa pu, ní ki gíti kpáá binib bili ki ŋàl̄-u, ubɔ u-ŋaŋgiil pú, un kíǹee u-ŋaŋgan pú ní úǹ sáká kansikin.

english_verse: Pilate ordered the charge against Jesus to be written on a board and put above the cross. It read, “Jesus of Nazareth, King of the Jews.”
translation_verse: Piilati nìn ŋmàn̄ tiŋmaŋmabiti ki tīī bí cáá nákań Yeesu dɔpuntikaaŋu pu. U nìn ŋmàn̄ yii: «Yeesu Naasaareeti yɔu, un sá Juuda yab bɔtiuee.»

english_verse: The words were written in Hebrew, Latin, and Greek. The place where Jesus was taken wasn't far from the city, and many of the people read the charge against him.
translation_verse: Juuda yab tikpil nìn kàan̄ tiŋmaŋmabiti gbanti, kun puee laakin bi nìn kpáá Yeesuee nìn pìlīǹ kitiŋin, ní bi nìn ŋmàn̄ eebru sooŋyin ki ŋmàn̄ Room sooŋyin ní ki ŋmàn̄ greeki sooŋyin.

english_verse: But Pilate told them, “What is written will not be changed!”
translation_verse: Ní Piilati kíí-bi yii: «Tin tin m ŋmàn̄ee, tíǹ dee.»

english_verse: The soldiers said to each other, “Let's not rip it apart. We will gamble to see who gets it.” This happened so the Scriptures would come true, which say, “They divided up my clothes and gambled for my garments.” The soldiers then did what they had decided.
translation_verse: Ní soojabee bíi lì tɔb yii: «Tí taa cátí dibɔkutil gbanti, tí tɔ̄maan kasi kí kpèè ŋma di làá jī díǹ.» Ní bi lafun ŋá míǹ. Min bi ŋá nee nóó nì Unimbɔti bɔti nín nìn sòon̄ ki síiǹ puee, yii: «Bi dū m-wampeeŋkaati ki yākatì, ní ki tɔ́ kasi m-bɔkutifɔkɔl pu.» Soojab nín nìn ŋá puee dee.

english_verse: Jesus' mother stood beside his cross with her sister and Mary the wife of Clopas. Mary Magdalene was standing there too.
translation_verse: Yeesu na nì Yeesu nawaa, nì Maarii Kloopasi nimpuu nì Maarii un sá Magidalaa tiŋkinee di nìn sí ki kɔ́ĺ Yeesu dɔpuntikaaŋu.

english_verse: But when they came to Jesus, they saw he was already dead, and they did not break his legs.
translation_verse: Bi bāań Yeesuee, ní ki ká yii u kpíì dooooyee, míǹ pu ní baa ti kɔ́fì úǹ taaŋi.

english_verse: In the place where Jesus had been nailed to a cross, there was a garden with a tomb that had never been used.
translation_verse: Laakin bi nìn kpáá Yeesuee, bukpaa bubɔ nìn bí niin. Bu-poon ní dikaakupɔndi din ni baa láá síb́ báà ubɔee nìn bí.

english_verse: Jesus knew that he had now finished his work. And in order to make the Scriptures come true, he said, “I am thirsty!”
translation_verse: Míǹ boonee, Yeesu ká yii kɔŋkɔnnee tikɔkɔ dóòyee, ní u bí yii: «Nnyinnyoo cáá-mi.» An ŋá kii Unimbɔti gbɔŋku nín nìn pée sòon̄ ki síiǹ puee dee.

english_verse: A jar of cheap wine was there. Someone then soaked a sponge with the wine and held it up to Jesus' mouth on the stem of a hyssop plant.
translation_verse: Dibool diba nìn yú niin, ndamam min gàm̀ee kā poon, ní bi dū kuca ki bɔ́ ndaamee poon ní ki dūu túuń isɔpi kpaŋkpaaŋŋu pu, ní ki cáa gbēē Yeesu nyɔkɔ.

english_verse: kilograms of spices made from myrrh and aloes. This was the same Nicodemus who had visited Jesus one night.
translation_verse: Yeesu nyùn̄ee ní ki bí yii: «Tikɔkɔ dóò», ní ki tīntì u-yil ní ki dū u-fam ki tīī ki kpíì. Bi dū kikpaŋ ki sāā Yeesu tikindi

english_verse: The next day would be both a Sabbath and the Passover. It was a special day for the Jewish people, and they did not want the bodies to stay on the crosses during this day. So they asked Pilate to break the men's legs and take their bodies down.
translation_verse: Ŋwìiń bíi jēetí ŋwiŋŋuŋfikaa ń kíĺee, Juuda yab kpilib kaa nìn là bin bi kpááyee wunti ń nīn lúń idɔpuntikaa pu ŋwiin gbanti. Ŋwiŋŋuŋfikaa gbanti nìn sá ŋwiŋkpaan ní, míǹ pu ní bi nìn mēē Piilati yii bí kɔ̄fì bi-taaŋi bí kpú malaa, bí cúú-bi kí kpáatí.

english_verse: One of the soldiers stuck his spear into Jesus' side, and blood and water came out.
translation_verse: Ama ní sooja ubɔ bi-kansikin dū kikpaŋ ki sāā u-tikindi, ní fatiku nì nnyim nyáń.

english_verse: We know this is true, because it was told by someone who saw it happen. Now you can have faith too.
translation_verse: Un bíi lèekī seera tibɔti nee puee baasii ká-tì ní, ní u-seerauee sá ibaamɔn, ní u nyí yii tin u sòoǹee sá ibaamɔn, ni mun ń ŋmā kí fōō kí kíí.

english_verse: All this happened so that the Scriptures would come true, which say, “No bone of his body will be broken”
translation_verse: Tin bí nee ŋá míǹ, án ŋmā kí nóó nì Unimbɔti gbɔŋku nín nìn lī ki síiǹ puee, yii: «Baa làá wīī u-kpabil báà diba.»

english_verse: and “They will see the one in whose side they stuck a spear.” Jesus Is Buried (Matthew
translation_verse: Laaba mun gíti lī yii: «Bi làá dāá ká un tikindi bi sāā ki cíl̀ee.» Bi síb́ Yeesu

english_verse: The tomb was nearby, and since it was the time to prepare for the Sabbath, they were in a hurry to put Jesus' body there.
translation_verse: Niin ní bi nìn cáá Yeesu ki síb́ kun puee án nìn sá kutaa ń wúntí Juuda yab wiŋŋuŋfikaaŋuaa, ní dikaakulee mun nìn pìl̄ niin.

english_verse: Joseph from Arimathea was one of Jesus' disciples. He had kept it secret though, because he was afraid of the Jewish leaders. But now he asked Pilate to let him have Jesus' body. Pilate gave him permission, and Joseph took it down from the cross.
translation_verse: Míǹ boonee, Jooseefi un sá Arimatee tiŋkinee, cūtì ki mēē Piilati nsan kí yòon̄ Yeesu wunti. - Jooseefi gbanti nìn sá Yeesu boonnooliu ní kaa là binib ń béé, kun puee u nìn fàŋkí Juuda yab. - Ní Piilati pú-u nsan, ní u cūtìi yōoǹ Yeesu wunti.

english_verse: The two men wrapped the body in a linen cloth, together with the spices, which was how the Jewish people buried their dead.
translation_verse: Bi yōoǹ Yeesu wunti mimmee, ní ki dū iŋaabu ki fìn̄-u ki dū talaalubee ki yāaǹ u-pu, kii Juuda yab koobiliŋ nín bàlifī bi yaa làá síb́ unil bí ŋá puee.

english_verse: Thomas replied, “You are my Lord and my God!”
translation_verse: Niinee ní Toomasi ń bí-u yii: «M-Dindaan, m-Nimbɔtiu!»

english_verse: On Sunday morning while it was still dark, Mary Magdalene went to the tomb and saw that the stone had been rolled away from the entrance.
translation_verse: Ŋwiŋŋuŋfikaa jítì kutaa wúntì, kutaafaau pɔ̀lpɔl an dáá bɔ̀ǹee, Maarii un sá Magidalaa tiŋkinee nín cá dikaakul laŋki, ní ki ká yii ditaŋkpal din bi nìn dūu pīiǹ dikaakul nyɔkɔ puee kaa ti pīī.

english_verse: The disciple who got there first then went into the tomb, and when he saw it, he believed.
translation_verse: Niinee ní Yeesu boonnooliu un nìn péé péé ki bàn̄ee mun kɔ́, ki ká, ní ki fōō ki kíí yii u fīkitì.

english_verse: Although Thomas the Twin was one of the twelve disciples, he wasn't with the others when Jesus appeared to them.
translation_verse: Ama ŋyunti ŋun Yeesu dɔ́mińee, Toomasi un bi gíti yíì Ata ki sá Yeesu kpambaliŋ saalaa nì alee kansikin dibee, nìn kpá.

english_verse: and saw two angels inside. They were dressed in white and were sitting where Jesus' body had been. One was at the head and the other was at the foot.
translation_verse: ní ki ká Unimbɔti tuuŋyi ili kā laakin bi nìn bíl̀ Yeesu wuntee ki pēē tiwampin. Ŋubɔ kā u-yil laŋki, ní ŋun kíǹee mun kā u-taaŋi laŋki.

english_verse: She ran to Simon Peter and to Jesus' favorite disciple and said, “They have taken the Lord from the tomb! We don't know where they have put him.”
translation_verse: Ní u fātìi sáǹ, ki cūtì Siimɔn Peetroo nì Yeesu boonnooliu un u néeńee cee, ní ki bí-bi yii: «Bi cúú ti-Dindaan ki lēē dikaakulin. Taa nyí laakin bi cáá-u ki ŋée!»

english_verse: Peter and the other disciple started for the tomb.
translation_verse: Ní Peetroo nì uboonnool un béeyee nín cá dikaakul laŋki.

english_verse: They ran side by side, until the other disciple ran faster than Peter and got there first.
translation_verse: Bi-liitil kɔkɔ nìn sáń ki cá, ní uboonnool un béeyee sáǹ ki jítì Peetroo pu, ki péé ki bàn̄ dikaakul laŋki malaa.

english_verse: When Simon Peter got there, he went into the tomb and saw the strips of cloth.
translation_verse: Boonee ní Siimɔn Peetroo mun bāań ki nín kóò dikaakul poon, ní ki ká iŋaabu in nìn fìn̄ Yeesu wuntee dɔ̄ kitiŋ

english_verse: He also saw the piece of cloth that had been used to cover Jesus' face. It was rolled up and in a place by itself.
translation_verse: nì ŋŋaabu ŋun nìn fìn̄ u-yilee. Ŋŋaabu gbanti nì in nìn fìn̄ u-wuntee kaa nìn dɔ̄ dibɔɔbaantiil, ŋúǹ nìn póob́ ki dɔ̄ ŋkpaanceeti laaba.

english_verse: Mary Magdalene stood crying outside the tomb. She was still weeping, when she stooped down
translation_verse: Maarii nìn yú ki kɔ́ĺ dikaakul ki sūǹ. U yú ki sūǹee, ní ki gbóoń ki kpēē dikaakul poon,

english_verse: The angels asked Mary, “Why are you crying?” She answered, “They have taken away my Lord's body! I don't know where they have put him.”
translation_verse: Ní ituunee bālifì-u yii: «Unimpuee, ba ŋá ní a sūǹ?» Ní u kíí-i yii: «Bi yōoǹ m-Dindaan. Maa nyí laakin bi dū-u ki ŋée!»

english_verse: Jesus asked her, “Why are you crying? Who are you looking for?” She thought he was the gardener and said, “Sir, if you have taken his body away, please tell me, so I can go and get him.”
translation_verse: Ní Yeesu bālifì-u yii: «Unimpuee, ba ŋá ní a sūǹ ní? Ŋma ní a nyàab̀ ní?» Unimpuee nyí kii bukpaadaan di bíi bàlifī-u, míǹ pu ní u bí yii: «Ukpil, sii di yaa yōoǹ-u, dàkà-mi laakin a cáá-u ki ŋée, m làá cùú yòon̄-u».

english_verse: Jesus told her, “Don't hold on to me! I have not yet gone to the Father. But tell my disciples I am going to the one who is my Father and my God, as well as your Father and your God.”
translation_verse: Ní Yeesu bí-u yii: «Taa gbēē-mi, di sá yii maa láá jɔ́m̀ m-Baa cee. Ama nín̄ cá kí tùkù m-nabiyaamu yii m nín jɔ́ḿ m-Baa un sá ni-Baayee, m-Nimbɔtiu un sá ni-Nimbɔtiuee cee.»

english_verse: and showed them his hands and his side. When the disciples saw the Lord, they became very happy.
translation_verse: U bíi sòoǹ mimmee, ní ki dàkā-bi u-ŋalii nì u-takakal. U-boonnooliibi nín ká ti-Dindaan mimmee, ní an mɔ́ɔkiǹ-bi tikpil.

english_verse: The disciples were afraid of the Jewish leaders, and on the evening of that same Sunday they locked themselves in a room. Suddenly, Jesus appeared in the middle of the group. He greeted them
translation_verse: Ŋwiŋŋuŋfikaa jítì, ku wúntì kujoouee ní Yeesu boonnooliibi kpáfì ki kā kudii kubɔn ki pīiǹ mpunyɔmu nì saafii, kun puee bi fàŋkí Juuda yab kpilib. Ní Yeesu cílìń, ki dɔ́miń ki yúl̀ bi-kansikin, ní ki bí-bi yii: «Ni-pɔbiliŋ ń nīn sɔ̀m̀!»

english_verse: After Jesus had greeted them again, he said, “I am sending you, just as the Father has sent me.”
translation_verse: Ní Yeesu gíti lī-bi yii: «Ni-pɔbiliŋ ń nīn sɔ̀m̀! Kii m-Baa nín túnní-mi puee, ma mun tú nimbi.»

english_verse: Then he breathed on them and said, “Receive the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: U lī mimmee, ní ki púfì bi-pu, ní ki bí yii: «Fōōmaan Unimbɔti Fam.

english_verse: If you forgive anyone's sins, they will be forgiven. But if you don't forgive their sins, they will not be forgiven.” Jesus and Thomas
translation_verse: Ni yaa dū bin kpitii ki pú-bee, bi làá ká bi-kpitii pɔ̄tam. Ni yaa kaa dū bin kpitii ki pú-bee, baa làá ká bi-kpitii pɔ̄tam.» Yeesu nì Toomasi bɔti

english_verse: So they told him, “We have seen the Lord!” But Thomas said, “First, I must see the nail scars in his hands and touch them with my finger. I must put my hand where the spear went into his side. I won't believe unless I do this!”
translation_verse: Ní u-boonnooliibi bin nìn bée bí-u yii: «Ti ká ti-Dindaan!» Ní Toomasi kíí-bi yii: «M-nimbiliŋ yaa kaa ká u-ŋalii laakin bi kpááyee, m yaa kaa dū m-ŋambiki ki bɔ́ laakin bi kpááyee, ki yaa kaa dū m-ŋal ki bɔ́ u-takakal laakin bi nìn sāāyee, maa làá fōō kí kíí.»

english_verse: A week later the disciples were together again. This time, Thomas was with them. Jesus came in while the doors were still locked and stood in the middle of the group. He greeted his disciples
translation_verse: Iwiin inii boonee, Yeesu boonnooliibi fātìi kpáfì kudiin. Toomasi mun nìn bí bi-kansikin. Bi dū mpunyɔmu ki pīiǹ ki kpàl̄, ama ní Yeesu cílìń bi-kansikin, ní ki bí-bi yii: «Ni-pɔbiliŋ ń nīn sɔ̀m̀!»

english_verse: and said to Thomas, “Put your finger here and look at my hands! Put your hand into my side. Stop doubting and have faith!”
translation_verse: Ní u bí Toomasi yii: «Dāá kpèè m-ŋalii, kí cáań a-ŋambiki kí máań! Cáań a-ŋal kí máań m-takakal, kí fōō kí kíí, kí taa nín̄ gíti kpākantí!»

english_verse: Jesus said, “Thomas, do you have faith because you have seen me? The people who have faith in me without seeing me are the ones who are really blessed!” Why John Wrote His Book
translation_verse: Ní Yeesu kíí-u yii: «A nín ká-mee ní a nín fōō ki kííyaa! Bin kaa ká-mi ki fōō ki kííyee bí mmɔnneeee!» Kun pu bi ŋmàn̄ kugbɔŋu neeyee

english_verse: Jesus worked many other miracles for his disciples, and not all of them are written in this book.
translation_verse: Yeesu nìn ŋáaǹ maamaacib tikpil u-boonnooliibi kansikin bin ní baa ŋmàn̄ ki ŋá kugbɔŋu nee poonee.

english_verse: But these are written so that you will put your faith in Jesus as the Messiah and the Son of God. If you have faith in him, you will have true life.
translation_verse: Bi yaa ŋmàn̄ tin bí neeyee, an sá ní fōō kí kíí yii Yeesu sá Unimbɔti Jipɔɔn ki sá Meesiya. Ni yaa fōō-u ki kíí mimmee, ní ká dimaŋfal u-yindi pu.

english_verse: Jesus later appeared to his disciples along the shore of Lake Tiberias.
translation_verse: Boonee ní Yeesu fātìi tí nyántì u-ba u-boonnooliibi ká-u Tiibeeriyaadi mɔɔgbandi. Bi nín ká-u, tin jítèe sèé.

english_verse: Simon Peter, Thomas the Twin, Nathanael from Cana in Galilee, and the brothers James and John, were there, together with two other disciples.
translation_verse: Siimɔn Peetroo nì Toomasi un bi yíì Atee nì Natanayeel - un sá Kana Galiilee timbiliikinee - nì Seebeedee jipɔmbi nì Yeesu boonnooliibi bili biba mun di nìn kpáfì ki bí dicilpu.

english_verse: Simon Peter said, “I'm going fishing!” The others said, “We will go with you.” They went out in their boat. But they didn't catch a thing that night.
translation_verse: Ní Siimɔn Peetroo bí-bi yii: «M cá dilaantɔl.» Ní bi bí-u yii: «Ti mun làá nóó-si kí cù.» Ní bi búntì ki cūtìi kɔ́ buŋalimbun. Ama, yaadal nyeekuee, baa nìn cúú báà tiba nì tiba.

english_verse: Early the next morning Jesus stood on the shore, but the disciples did not realize who he was.
translation_verse: Kutaa bíi wúntée, Yeesu dɔ́miń ki yú dimɔɔgbandi, ama u-boonnooliibi kaa nìn béè yii an sá úǹ di yú.

english_verse: Jesus shouted, “Friends, have you caught anything?” “No!” they answered.
translation_verse: Ní Yeesu bí-bi yii: «Binaacimpɔmbee, naa cúú ijɔmaaa?» Ní bi kíí-u yii: «Aayee, taa cúú.»

english_verse: So he told them, “Let your net down on the right side of your boat, and you will catch some fish.” They did, and the net was so full of fish that they could not drag it up into the boat.
translation_verse: Ní u bí-bi yii: «Dūmaan kulaaŋŋu kí tɔ̄ buŋalimbu ŋgiil pú, ni làá cúú ijɔm.» Ní bi dū kulaaŋŋu ki dūu tɔ́, ní an cúú ijɔm tikpil, áli gba baa ti kpáàa ŋūǹ kí dáaĺ kí nyāntiń.

english_verse: Jesus' favorite disciple told Peter, “It's the Lord!” When Simon heard it was the Lord, he put on the clothes he had taken off while he was working. Then he jumped into the water.
translation_verse: Niinee ní uboonnool un Yeesu nìn néeńee bí Peetroo yii: «An sá ti-Dindaan!» Siimɔn Peetroo nín gbìl̄ yii an sá ti-Dindaanee, ní u dū u-bɔkutil ki pēeǹ, kun puee u nìn pēetì ní ki jéetì nnyimin ki wáŋkìi dūtì.

english_verse: When the disciples got out of the boat, they saw some bread and a charcoal fire with fish on it.
translation_verse: Bi kpákatì kitiŋee ní ki ká ijɔm pá amɔsiŋkoon pu, nì kpɔnɔ.

english_verse: Jesus told his disciples, “Bring some of the fish you just caught.”
translation_verse: Ní Yeesu bí-bi yii: «Ní cáań ijɔm in ni cúúyee iba.»

english_verse: Jesus said, “Come and eat!” But none of the disciples dared ask who he was. They knew he was the Lord.
translation_verse: Ní Yeesu bí-bi yii: «Dāan̄ kí jīmaan tijin!» Ní u-boonnooliibi kansikin báà ubɔ kaa wāaǹ ki bālifì-u yii: «Sii di sá ŋma?» Bi nìn nyí yii an sá ti-Dindaan.

english_verse: Jesus took the bread in his hands and gave some of it to his disciples. He did the same with the fish.
translation_verse: Ní Yeesu sútìń, ki dū kpɔnɔ ki tīī-bi, ní ki tīī-bi ijɔm mun.

english_verse: This was the third time Jesus appeared to his disciples after he was raised from death. Jesus and Peter
translation_verse: Yeesu nín nìn kpíì ki fīkitèe, min bí nee di sá ntataatiim min u nìn nyántì u-ba ki dàkā u-boonnooliibee. Yeesu bālifì Peetroo yii: «A néeń-maaa?»

english_verse: When Jesus and his disciples had finished eating, he asked, “Simon son of John, do you love me more than the others do?” Simon Peter answered, “Yes, Lord, you know I do!” “Then feed my lambs,” Jesus said.
translation_verse: Bi jíń tijin ki dóòyee, ní Yeesu bālifì Siimɔn Peetroo yii: «Siimɔn, Yoowaneesi jipɔɔn, a néeń-mi ki jítiǹ bin bí neeee?» Ní u kíí-u yii: «Iiin, m-Dindaan, a nyí m nín néeń-see.» Ní Yeesu bí yii: «Á nīn kpàá m-pibiliŋ.»

english_verse: Jesus asked a second time, “Simon son of John, do you love me?” Peter answered, “Yes, Lord, you know I love you!” “Then take care of my sheep,” Jesus told him.
translation_verse: Ní u gíti bālifì-u nliliitiim yii: «Siimɔn, Yoowaneesi jipɔɔn, a néeń-maaa?» Ní u bí yii: «Iiin, m-Dindaan, a nyí m nín néeń-see.» Ní Yeesu bí-u yii: «Á nīn kpàá m-piii.»

english_verse: Jesus asked a third time, “Simon son of John, do you love me?” Peter was hurt because Jesus had asked him three times if he loved him. So he told Jesus, “Lord, you know everything. You know I love you.” Jesus replied, “Feed my sheep.
translation_verse: Ní u gíti bālifì-u ntataatiim yii: «Siimɔn, Yoowaneesi jipɔɔn, a néeń-maaa?» An nìn kɔ́ Peetroo kunimbaau min ní Yeesu nìn bālifì-u ntataatiim yii, a néeń-maaayee, ní u kíí Yeesu yii: «M-Dindaan, a nyí tikɔkɔ, ki nyí m nín néeń-see!» Ní Yeesu bí-u yii: «Á nīn kpàá m-piii.

english_verse: I tell you for certain that when you were a young man, you dressed yourself and went wherever you wanted to go. But when you are old, you will hold out your hands. Then others will wrap your belt around you and lead you where you don't want to go.”
translation_verse: Ibaamɔn, ibaamɔn ní m sòoǹ nì si, a nín nìn sá unaacimpɔɔnee, a nìn gbìǹ a-dambalau a-ba, ní ki cá laakin a yaa lèe. Ama a yaa láa púĺee, a dāa tàntī a-ŋalii, ní ubɔ ń gbìn̄-si dambala, ní kí cáá-si kí cùnnì laakin aa bàà là kí cùee.»

english_verse: Jesus said this to tell how Peter would die and bring honor to God. Then he said to Peter, “Follow me!” Jesus and His Favorite Disciple
translation_verse: Yeesu nìn sòon̄ an bɔti kí dàkà Peetroo ŋkúm min u làá dāá kpú kí tīī Unimbɔti tinyoolee. U lī míǹ ki dóòyee, ní ki bí yii: «Nín̄ nóó-mi!» Yeesu nì uboonnool un u nìn néeńee

english_verse: Peter turned and saw Jesus' favorite disciple following them. He was the same one who had sat next to Jesus at the meal and had asked, “Lord, who is going to betray you?”
translation_verse: Peetroo fātèe, ki ká uboonnool un Yeesu néeńee di dòoń bi-boonee. Úǹ di sá un, bi nìn bíi jīǹ tijin u sútì ki nákáǹ Yeesu, ki bālifì-u yii: «Ti-Dindaan, ŋma di làá dū-si kí tīī a-nannanliibee?»

english_verse: When Peter saw this disciple, he asked Jesus, “Lord, what about him?”
translation_verse: Peetroo ká-uee, ní ki bālifì Yeesu yii: «Ti-Dindaan, tilati di làá bàń unee úǹ ní?»

english_verse: Jesus answered, “What is it to you, if I want him to live until I return? You must follow me.”
translation_verse: Ní Yeesu kíí-u yii: «M yaa là ú nīn bí kí nīn cí m-gítintam, tíǹ kaa ká-si. Sii dee, nóó-mi!»

english_verse: So the rumor spread among the other disciples that this disciple would not die. But Jesus did not say he would not die. He simply said, “What is it to you, if I want him to live until I return?”
translation_verse: An nyɔɔbundi pu ní nnabiyaamu kíǹ ki lì yii uboonnoolee úǹ kaa làá ti kpú. Ama Yeesu kaa nìn lī yii uboonnoolee kaa làá kpú. Tin tin u nìn lēe di sá yii: «M yaa là ú nīn bí kí nīn cí m-gítintam, tíǹ ká-si la?» Tibɔkuntikaal

english_verse: This disciple is the one who told all of this. He wrote it, and we know he is telling the truth.
translation_verse: Uboonnool gbanti di ŋmàn̄ tibɔti nee, ní ti nyí yii tin kɔkɔwoooo u sòon̄ Yeesu puee sá ibaamɔn.

english_verse: Jesus did many other things. If they were all written in books, I don't suppose there would be room enough in the whole world for all the books.
translation_verse: Yeesu gíti túń atuun tikpil. Bi yaa bàà làá ŋmà u-tuuŋŋi ŋin u túńee diba diba, maa pàkā yii duulinya bàà ŋūǹ tigbɔn gbanti kɔkɔ.

english_verse: Theophilus, I first wrote to you about all that Jesus did and taught from the very first
translation_verse: Teewoofiil, M nìn ŋmàn̄ m-gbɔmpeepeekaaku poon tin kɔkɔ Yeesu nìn kíĺ ki ŋáań, ki dàkèe,

english_verse: until he was taken up to heaven. But before he was taken up, he gave orders to the apostles he had chosen with the help of the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: doooo ŋkilkaam áli ki tin sāā ŋwiin ŋun u jɔ́m̀ yilpuee. U-kúm nì u-fìkititam boonee, kí wàatī kí nín jɔ̄m̀ee, u kpáafì akpambal ŋin u nìn lútèe nì Unimbɔti Fam pɔŋŋu.

english_verse: While he was still with them, he said: Don't leave Jerusalem yet. Wait here for the Father to give you the Holy Spirit, just as I told you he has promised to do.
translation_verse: U nì bi nín nìn dáá bée, u nìn kpáafì-bi yii bí taa yīkì Jeerusaleem tiŋkin. U nìn bí-bi yii: «Ní kàl̄ kí cīití ti-Baa Unimbɔti nín nìn pōoǹ dipoondi diŋyee, dipoondi din bɔti m nìn sòon̄ nì nee.

english_verse: John baptized with water, but in a few days you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit. Jesus Is Taken to Heaven
translation_verse: Kun puee nì nnyim ní Yoowaneesi nìn fùul̀ binib. Ama nimbee, nì iwiŋkaaŋkaa poonee, Unimbɔti làá fàl̀-ni nì Circir Fam.» Yeesu jɔ́m̀ yilpu

english_verse: While the apostles were still with Jesus, they asked him, “Lord, are you now going to give Israel its own king again?”
translation_verse: Ŋyuntee, akpambal nì Yeesu nìn kpáfì ki kēe, bi bālifì Yeesu yii: «Ti-Dindaan, an sá ŋyunti nee ní a làá fàtīí yàntī Isirayeel yab ń fōō dibeelaaa?»

english_verse: Jesus said to them, “You don't need to know the time of those events that only the Father controls.
translation_verse: Ní u kíí-bi yii: «M-Baa nín dū úǹ u-ba pɔŋŋu ki síiǹ iyunti nì iwiin iŋyee kaa sá ni-yati.

english_verse: But the Holy Spirit will come upon you and give you power. Then you will tell everyone about me in Jerusalem, in all Judea, in Samaria, and everywhere in the world.”
translation_verse: Ama Circir Fam làá kpákatiń ni-pu kí tīī-ni mpɔn ŋubɔ. Míǹ boonee, ni làá lēē m-pu seera Jeerusaleem tiŋkin nì Juudee nì Samaarii timmun, kí tin sāā kutagbɔŋu nì kitiŋ kúntinyɔkɔ.»

english_verse: After Jesus had said this and while they were watching, he was taken up into a cloud. They could not see him,
translation_verse: U lī míǹ ki dóòyee, u-kpambaliŋ bíi kpèé-uee, ní an yōoǹ-u ki cáa nín jɔ́ḿ yilpu, ní ditagbandi diba dɔ́miń ki līkiǹ u nì bi kansikin, ní baa ti wāĺ-u.

english_verse: but as he went up, they kept looking up into the sky. Suddenly two men dressed in white clothes were standing there beside them.
translation_verse: Bi dáá gbíntìi yú ki kpèé yilpu u nín cá puee, kpalaayee, bininjab bili dee bi-nimbiin ki pēē tiwampin,

english_verse: They said, “Why are you men from Galilee standing here and looking up into the sky? Jesus has been taken to heaven. But he will come back in the same way you have seen him go.” Someone To Take the Place of Judas
translation_verse: ní ki bí-bi yii: «Galiilee yab, ba pu ní ni yú ki kpèé kutaa pu míǹ? Yeesu un ni ká u yíkì ni-kansikin ki jɔ́ḿ yilpu nee, làá dāá fàtīí tí gítiń míǹ mbaantiim kii ni nín ká u jɔ́m̀ pu nee ní.» Bi lēē Maatiyasi ú fōō Juudasi paaŋŋu

english_verse: The Mount of Olives was about a kilometer from Jerusalem. The apostles who had gone there were Peter, John, James, Andrew, Philip, Thomas, Bartholomew, Matthew, James the son of Alphaeus, Simon, known as the Eager One, and Judas the son of James. After the apostles returned to the city, they went upstairs to the room where they had been staying.
