translation_verse: Bi bāań niinee, ki jɔ́m̀ diditɔntɔkɔl din ni bi nìn pée kpààa kpáfée. An nìn sá Peetroo nì Yoowaneesi nì Yakubu nì Andree nì Fiiliipi nì Toomasi nì Baateeleemii nì Maatiiu nì Yakubu Alfee jipɔɔn nì Siimɔn un nìn là kí jáǹ Room yabee, nì Yakubu jipɔɔn Juudi.

english_verse: The apostles often met together and prayed with a single purpose in mind. The women and Mary the mother of Jesus would meet with them, and so would his brothers.
translation_verse: Bíǹ kɔkɔ nìn kpáfì kinyɔɔbaantii ki mɔ̀tīi mèé ŋwimmeem, bi nì binimpoobi biba, nì Yeesu na Maarii, nì Yeesu naalib mun.

english_verse: Then Judas bought some land with the money he was given for doing that evil thing. He fell headfirst into the field. His body burst open, and all his insides came out.
translation_verse: Unil gbanti dū ntoonam nimbiliŋ ki dá kusaau. Niin ní u lítì dicincibil, u-pool pōō, u-nai kɔkɔ yāaǹ.

english_verse: When the people of Jerusalem found out about this, they called the place Akeldama, which in the local language means “Field of Blood.”
translation_verse: Jeerusaleem yab kɔkɔ nín gbìl̄ an bɔti gbantee, ní bi pú kusaau gbanti diyindi bi-sooŋyin yii: Akeeldama, an taapu sá yii: fatiku saaku. -

english_verse: In the book of Psalms it says, “Leave his house empty, and don't let anyone live there.” It also says, “Let someone else have his job.”
translation_verse: Ilan gbɔŋkun ní ubɔti Daafiidi nìn sòon̄ ki síiǹ yii: <U-kɔŋkooŋŋu ń kpántí kudigbuŋu, ubɔ ń taa ti kɔ́ kudii gbantin,> ní ki gíti ŋmàn̄ yii: <Ubɔ ń fōō u-tundi.>

english_verse: So we need someone else to help us tell others that Jesus has been raised from death. He must also be one of the men who was with us from the very beginning. He must have been with us from the time the Lord Jesus was baptized by John until the day he was taken to heaven.
translation_verse: kí yòon̄ daliŋkin Yoowaneesi fùl̄-u Unimbɔti nyim kí tin cáá sāā ŋwiin ŋun u yíkì ki nín jɔ́ḿ yilpuee. An máaǹ yii binib gbanti kansikin ubɔ nín kūtì ti-pu kí kpántí Yeesu fìkititam seeraleeliu.»

english_verse: Two men were suggested: One of them was Joseph Barsabbas, known as Justus, and the other was Matthias.
translation_verse: Peetroo lī míǹ ki dóòyee, ní bi cáań binib bili, Jooseefi un bi yíì Baarsabaasi ki gítì páaǹ-u diyindi yii Justuusee, nì Maatiyasi.

english_verse: Then they all prayed, “Lord, you know what everyone is like! Show us the one you have chosen
translation_verse: Ní bi mēē yii: «Ti-Dindaan, sii di nyí báà ŋma pɔbil. Dàkà-ti un ní a lēē bi-kansikinee,

english_verse: to be an apostle and to serve in place of Judas, who got what he deserved.”
translation_verse: udaan ń kpántí a-kpambal kí nīn bí mpaan ŋun Juudasi dūu fá ki búntì u-laŋkee.»

english_verse: They drew names, and Matthias was chosen to join the group of the eleven apostles.
translation_verse: Bi tɔ́ kasee, Maatiyasi jíń, ní bi dū-u ki ŋàl̄ akpambal saalaa nì dibee pu.

english_verse: On the day of Pentecost all the Lord's followers were together in one place.
translation_verse: Pantikooti wiiŋŋu dalee, bi-kɔkɔ nìn kpáfì ki bí dibɔɔbaantiil.

english_verse: Suddenly there was a noise from heaven like the sound of a mighty wind! It filled the house where they were meeting.
translation_verse: Dicilpu kpalaayee, kuwoou kubɔ nyánní yilpu kii kubuŋkpaaŋŋu kubɔee, ní ki dɔ́miń ki gbí kudii kun poon bi nìn kēe.

english_verse: The Holy Spirit took control of everyone, and they began speaking whatever languages the Spirit let them speak.
translation_verse: Ní Circir Fam sīntìń ki kɔ́ bi-kɔkɔn mmɔntiim, ní bi kíǹ ki sòoǹ isooncaan in Ŋfam tīī-bi bí sòoǹee.

english_verse: Many religious Jews from every country in the world were living in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Iwiin gbantee, Juuda yab bin nóó Unimbɔti deedeeyee nìn dɔ́miń Jeerusaleem, ki nyánní atimbun ŋin kɔkɔ bí duulinyanee.

english_verse: And when they heard this noise, a crowd gathered. But they were surprised, because they were hearing everything in their own languages.
translation_verse: Kuwoou bíi gèe, ní samaa sáǹní ki bāańee, ní ki gíti bākatì, kun puee bi-kɔkɔ nìn gbìl̀ bi-sooŋyin binibee nín sòoǹ puee.

english_verse: They were excited and amazed, and said: Don't all these who are speaking come from Galilee?
translation_verse: Ní bi bākatì sèeee, an ŋá-bi bitii, ní bi kíǹ ki bíi sòoǹ nì tɔb yii: «Bin kɔkɔ sòoǹ nee kaa sá Galiilee yabaaa?

english_verse: Then why do we hear them speaking our very own languages?
translation_verse: Kin, an ŋá mana ní ti-kɔkɔ nee gbìl̀ nì ti-timmu sooŋyi poon tin bi sòoǹ nee?

english_verse: Some of us are from Parthia, Media, and Elam. Others are from Mesopotamia, Judea, Cappadocia, Pontus, Asia,
translation_verse: Ti-kansikin biba sá Paati, biba sá Meedi nì Eelam, biba mun sá Meesoopootamii nì Juudee nì Kapadoosi nì Pɔnti nì Asii nì

english_verse: Phrygia, Pamphylia, Egypt, parts of Libya near Cyrene, Rome,
translation_verse: Friijii nì Paŋfilii nì Eejipiti nì Liibii jandi din pìlīǹ Siireenee yab, nì bin kɔkɔ nyánní Roomee.

english_verse: Crete, and Arabia. Some of us were born Jews, and others of us have chosen to be Jews. Yet we all hear them using our own languages to tell the wonderful things God has done.
translation_verse: Biba sá Juuda yab, ní biba mun sá binicambi bin fōō Juuda yab marabee, Kreeti yab nì Bilaalibub. Kin an ŋá mana ní ti gbìl̀ bi sòoǹ Unimbɔti tunnyaaŋŋi bɔti timbi kɔkɔ sooŋyin?»

english_verse: Everyone was excited and confused. Some of them even kept asking each other, “What does all this mean?”
translation_verse: Ní bi bākatì, kaa ti nyí tin poon ní bi bée, ní ki kíǹ ki lì tɔb cee yii: «Ba bɔti nín sèé dee?»

english_verse: Others made fun of the Lord's followers and said, “They are drunk.” Peter Speaks to the Crowd
translation_verse: Ama biba nìn bí ki bèel̄-bi, yii: «Bi nyùn̄ ndaam ní ki gbí!» Peetroo nyɔɔbundi

english_verse: Peter stood with the eleven apostles and spoke in a loud and clear voice to the crowd: Friends and everyone else living in Jerusalem, listen carefully to what I have to say!
translation_verse: Niinee ní Peetroo yáatìi yúl̀, u nì akpambal saalaa nì dibee, ní ki yōoǹ dinyɔɔbundi ki téeń mpɔn ki bí-bi yii: «Nimbi Juuda yab, nì nimbi bin kɔkɔ kóò Jeerusaleemee, ŋátímaan ni-tafaliŋ kí pīlifì tibɔti tin m làá sòoǹ nee.

english_verse: You are wrong to think that these people are drunk. After all, it is only nine o'clock in the morning.
translation_verse: Binib nee kaa gbí ndaam, kii nimbi nín dàkafī puee, kun puee an dáá sá ntaafaawìiń ní.

english_verse: But this is what God told the prophet Joel to say,
translation_verse: Ama tin ni wāĺ nee, Unimbɔti bɔnaatiliu Jooweel nín nìn lī puee dee yii:

english_verse: “When the last days come, I will give my Spirit to everyone. Your sons and daughters will prophesy. Your young men will see visions, and your old men will have dreams.
translation_verse: <Iyuntijoolkaayee, m làá dāá yàntī m-Fam ń kpákatiń unil sá kamaa pu, ni-jipɔmbi nì ni-bisalib dāa nàatī m-nyɔɔbuŋŋi, ni-naacimpɔmbi dāa wālifí tin dòońee, ní ni-jaŋkpilib mun dāa dámintí tidamintiil.

english_verse: In those days I will give my Spirit to my servants, both men and women, and they will prophesy.
translation_verse: Ibaamɔn, iwiin gbantee, m dāa yàntī m-Fam ń kpákatiń m-tɔntɔnliibi bininjab nì binimpoobi pu, ní bí nàatī m-nyɔɔbuŋŋi.

english_verse: “I will work miracles in the sky above and wonders on the earth below. There will be blood and fire and clouds of smoke.
translation_verse: M dāa ŋáań maamaacib yilpu, ní kí dàkà tidaandi taapu. Ni làá dāá ká fatiku nì ŋŋmi nì ŋŋminyiim.

english_verse: The sun will turn dark, and the moon will be as red as blood before the great and wonderful day of the Lord appears.
translation_verse: Ŋwìiń dāa kpántí dibɔmbɔndi ní uŋmal ń kpántí kii fatikuee kí wàatī ní ti-Dindaan wiŋkpaaŋŋuee nyooti ń nín bàń.

english_verse: Then the Lord will save everyone who asks for his help.”
translation_verse: Niinee, un sá kamaa yaa láa fōō ki kíí ki mēē ti-Dindaanee dāa kāntí difiil.>

english_verse: Now, listen to what I have to say about Jesus from Nazareth. God proved he sent Jesus to you by having him work miracles, wonders, and signs. All of you know this.
translation_verse: «Isirayeel yab, pīlifìmaan tibɔti nee. Unimbɔti yāntì Yeesu Naasaareeti yɔu ŋáaǹ maamaaci tuuŋŋi nì tidaandi ni-kansikin, ki dàkā-ni yii úǹ di lafun túnní-u ni-cee, kii nimbi ni-ba nín nyí puee, kun puee tikɔkɔ jítì ni-nimbiin ní.

english_verse: God had already planned and decided that Jesus would be handed over to you. So you took him and had evil men put him to death on a cross.
translation_verse: Kii Unimbɔti nín nyí ki là, ki lēē ki yóoǹ puee, ní ni dū-u ki tīī bin kaa nyí Unimbɔtee kpáá-u ndɔpuntikaa pu ki kūū-u.

english_verse: But God set him free from death and raised him to life. Death could not hold him in its power.
translation_verse: Ní Unimbɔti fīkitì-u, ki bútì-u ŋkúm kusakai. Kun puee ŋkúm kaa ŋūǹ kí nīn ŋúb́-u.

english_verse: What David said are really the words of Jesus, “I always see the Lord near me, and I will not be afraid with him at my right side.
translation_verse: A lì kii Daafiidi nín nìn sòon̄ min u-puee yii: <M wāĺ ti-Dindaan ŋyunti sá kamaa m-nimbiin, tiba kaa làá ŋá-mi kun puee u tíkí-mi m-ŋaŋgiil pú.

english_verse: Because of this, my heart will be glad, my words will be joyful, and I will live in hope.
translation_verse: Míǹ puee m bí dipɔɔpindin ní ki sòoǹ an mɔ̄ǹ-mi. Nì min kɔkɔ m-wunti bí iwɔfinee, m máká yii m làá dāá fàtī kí ká dimaŋfal,

english_verse: The Lord won't leave me in the grave. I am his holy one, and he won't let my body decay.
translation_verse: kun puee aa làá dāá fá-mi ditaŋkpiilin, kaa làá yàntī a-tɔntɔmmɔntiu un a lēēyee wunti ń sūū.

english_verse: He has shown me the path to life, and he makes me glad by being near me.”
translation_verse: A yāntì m béè dimaŋfal sàmbiyaamu, a-nimbiin ní a làá dāá gbéeǹ-mi dipɔɔpindi.>

english_verse: My friends, it is right for me to speak to you about our ancestor David. He died and was buried, and his tomb is still here.
translation_verse: «Nnabiyaamu, càntī ḿ mɔ̀tīí tùkùmaan-ni ti-naanja Daafiidi bɔti. U kpíì ní bi síb́-u. U-kaakul gbíntìi dáá bí ti-kansikin áli nìn díǹ.

english_verse: But David was a prophet, and he knew that God had made a promise he would not break. He had told David someone from his own family would someday be king.
translation_verse: Daafiidi nìn sá Unimbɔti bɔnaatiliu ní. U nìn nyí Unimbɔti nín pūtì ki pōoǹ-u yii u làá dū úǹ Daafiidi naantiiu ubɔ kí kàan̄ u-beejal puee.

english_verse: David knew this would happen, and so he told us Christ would be raised to life. He said God would not leave him in the grave or let his body decay.
translation_verse: An nìn sá Meesiya fìkititam pu ní u nìn sòon̄ ki yóoǹ yii: <Waa làá dāá gbíntí ditaŋkpiilin, u-wunti mun kaa làá dāá sūū.>

english_verse: All of us can tell you that God has raised Jesus to life!
translation_verse: «Yeesu gbanti ní Unimbɔti fīkitì, timbi kɔkɔ ká ki sá seeradambi.

english_verse: Jesus was taken up to sit at the right side of God, and he was given the Holy Spirit, just as the Father had promised. Jesus is also the one who has given the Spirit to us, and this is what you are now seeing and hearing.
translation_verse: Ti-Baa Unimbɔti kāaǹ-u yilpu u-ŋaŋgiil pú, ní ki tīī-u u-Fam, kii u nín nìn pée pōoǹ puee. Tin tin ni wāĺ ki gbìl̄ kɔŋkɔnneeyee, Circir Fam min Yeesu tīiń-tee tuuŋŋi dee.

english_verse: David didn't go up to heaven. So he wasn't talking about himself when he said, “The Lord told my Lord to sit at his right side,
translation_verse: Di sá Daafiidi u-ba kaa nìn jɔ́m̀ yilpu, ama ki mun lī ki síiǹ yii: <Ti-Dindaan tùkū m-Dindaan yii: Kàl̄ m-ŋaŋgiil pú

english_verse: until he made my Lord's enemies into a footstool for him.”
translation_verse: kí nīn cí ŋyunti ŋun m làá dāá yàntī á nīn kíǹ ki tɔ́kɔ́ a-nannanliibi puee.>

english_verse: Everyone in Israel should then know for certain that God has made Jesus both Lord and Christ, even though you put him to death on a cross.
translation_verse: «Isirayeel maaliŋun yab kɔkɔ, béémaan nì ibaamɔn poon yii, Yeesu un ni kpáá ndɔpuntikaa puee, Unimbɔti dū-u ki ŋá ti-Dindaan ki lēē yii ú nīn sá Meesiya.»

english_verse: When the people heard this, they were very upset. They asked Peter and the other apostles, “Friends, what should we do?”
translation_verse: Bi nín gbìl̄ tibɔti gbantee, ní bi-pɔbiliŋ máĺ tiŋan, ní bi fātìi bālifì Peetroo nì akpambal ŋin kíǹee yii: «Ti-nabiyaamu, mimmee, ti làá ŋá mana?»

english_verse: Peter said to them, “Turn to God and be baptized, every one of you, in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of your sins, and you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Ní Peetroo kíí-bi yii: «Kpántímaan ni-bimbim, báà ŋma ń yàntī bí fàl̀-u Unimbɔti nyim Yeesu Kriisitoo yindi pu, ní Unimbɔti ń dū ni-kpitii kí pɔ̄-ni. Ní ní fōō Circir Fam min Unimbɔti nìn pōoǹee.

english_verse: This promise is for you and your children. It is for everyone our Lord God will choose, no matter where they live.”
translation_verse: Kun puee u-poondi gbanti sá ki tīī nimbi, nì ni-biyaamu, ki kpáaǹ bin bí ndanee, nì dinikitikpaandi din kɔkɔwoooo ti-Dindaan ti-Nimbɔtiu làá dāá yíińee.»

english_verse: Peter told them many other things as well. Then he said, “I beg you to save yourselves from what will happen to all these evil people.”
translation_verse: Peetroo gíti yōoǹ anyɔɔbun tikpil ki sòoǹ ki sáŋkí-bi yii: «Nyāmaan waanee nib bin nóó isaŋkpitee kansikin, kí kámaan difiil!»

english_verse: They spent their time learning from the apostles, and they were like family to each other. They also broke bread and prayed together. Life among the Lord's Followers
translation_verse: Bi nìn pɔ̄ɔntí bi-ba ki bífí tin akpambal dàkà-bee, ki kpáfí kinyɔɔbaantii nì kunabitiiun, ki jīǹ ti-Dindaan jikaati, ki kpáfí dicilpu ki mèé Unimbɔti.

english_verse: Everyone was amazed by the many miracles and wonders that the apostles worked.
translation_verse: Tifaandi nìn kɔ́ báà ŋma maamaacib nì tidaandi tin akpambal nìn ŋáańee pu.

english_verse: All the Lord's followers often met together, and they shared everything they had.
translation_verse: Bin nìn fōō ki kííyee nìn kpáfí dibɔbibaantiil, ní báà ŋma wanti nìn sá ki tīī bi-kɔkɔ.

english_verse: They would sell their property and possessions and give the money to whoever was in need.
translation_verse: Bi nìn nyáfí bi-sati nì bi-wammɔntiiti, ní ki yàkatī ki tìì báà ŋma nín máaǹ puee.

english_verse: Day after day they met together in the temple. They broke bread together in different homes and shared their food happily and freely,
translation_verse: Kutaa kamaayee, bi nìn dòoń múlmul kunimbɔtidiin dicilpu ki nyɔ́ŋkí Unimbɔti, ki kpáfí akiti akiti adiinni ki jīǹ ti-Dindaan jikaati, ki jīǹ tijikaal nì dipɔɔbaantiil nì dipɔɔpindi poon,

english_verse: while praising God. Everyone liked them, and each day the Lord added to their group others who were being saved.
translation_verse: ki nyɔ́ŋkí Unimbɔti. Samaa kɔkɔ nìn néeń bi-bɔti. Ní kutaa sá kamaayee, ti-Dindaan gbēentí bin kāntí difiilee wíiŋŋu.

english_verse: The time of prayer was about three o'clock in the afternoon, and Peter and John were going into the temple.
translation_verse: Dalba ní Peetroo nì Yoowaneesi nìn nóó ki jɔ́ḿ kunimbɔtidiin tikúti tita wimmeem yuntiŋu.

english_verse: A man who had been born lame was being carried to the temple door. Each day he was placed beside this door, known as the Beautiful Gate. He sat there and begged from the people who were going in.
translation_verse: Kunimbɔtidiiyee nìn cáá kipunyɔkɔ kin bi nìn yíì yii Kipunyɔkɔnyaaŋŋee. Uninja ubɔ, u nìn sá ufaliŋfaan doooo u-biyatin, ní bi nìn cāabìń-u ki kàantí kutaa sá kamaa Kipunyɔkɔnyaaŋŋee nyɔkɔpu, ú nīn mèé bin jītí ki kóò kunimbɔtidiinee animbil.

english_verse: The man saw Peter and John entering the temple, and he asked them for money.
translation_verse: Uninjee ká Peetroo nì Yoowaneesi cá kí kɔ́ee, ní u bíi mèé-bi animbil.

english_verse: But they looked straight at him and said, “Look up at us!”
translation_verse: Ní bi dū bi-nimbikpeeŋu ki báaǹ u-pu, ní Peetroo bí yii: «Kpèè doo!»

english_verse: The man stared at them and thought he was going to get something.
translation_verse: Niinee ní u bíi kpèé-bi címmm, ki bàà cí kí fōō tiba bi-cee.

english_verse: But Peter said, “I don't have any silver or gold! But I will give you what I do have. In the name of Jesus Christ from Nazareth, get up and start walking.”
translation_verse: Ní Peetroo bí-u yii: «Maa cáá animbil kaa cáá sindaariya, ama tin m cááyee, m làá tīī-si kudɔŋu. Nì Yeesu Kriisitoo Naasaareeti yɔu yindi puee, yīkìí còom̀!»

english_verse: Peter then took him by the right hand and helped him up. At once the man's feet and ankles became strong,
translation_verse: Ní Peetroo cúú u-ŋaŋgiil ki dúkutì-u yilpu. Dicilpu niinee, u-taaŋi ŋin fàl̄ee tāntì ki ŋáŋkì,

english_verse: and he jumped up and started walking. He went with Peter and John into the temple, walking and jumping and praising God.
translation_verse: ní u yùkū ki yúl̀, ní ki kíǹ ki bíi còom̄. U nì bi kɔkɔ táá ki kɔ́ kunimbɔtidiin, ní u còom̄ ki yùkufī ki tìintí ki nyɔ́ŋkí Unimbɔti.

english_verse: Everyone saw him walking around and praising God.
translation_verse: Kunipaau kɔkɔ nín ká u còomìń ki nyɔ́ŋkí Unimbɔtee,

english_verse: They knew he was the beggar who had been lying beside the Beautiful Gate, and they were completely surprised. They could not imagine what had happened to the man. Peter Speaks in the Temple
translation_verse: bi béè-u yii úǹ di nìn kàal̀ kunimbɔtidii punyɔkɔnyaaŋkee nyɔkɔpu ki mèé animbilee. Ní an ŋá-bi maamaaci, bi bākatì kijapaayee nín ká dicáaǹdi puee. Peetroo sòon̄ kunimbɔtidiin

english_verse: While the man kept holding on to Peter and John, the whole crowd ran to them in amazement at the place known as Solomon's Porch.
translation_verse: Uninjee gbíntìi ŋúb́ Peetroo nì Yoowaneesi ki nóó-bee, binib kɔkɔ bākatì ki sáǹní ki dɔ́miń bi-cee kadantiku un bi yíì Saloomɔn kadantikuuee taapu.

english_verse: Peter saw that a crowd had gathered, and he said: Friends, why are you surprised at what has happened? Why are you staring at us? Do you think we have some power of our own? Do you think we were able to make this man walk because we are so religious?
translation_verse: Peetroo ká mimmee, ní ki bí samaayee yii: «Nimbi Isirayeel yab, ba ŋá ní tin bí nee ŋá-ni maamaaci? Ba ŋá ní ni dū ni-nimbikpeeŋu ki báaǹ ti-pu míǹ, a lì kii timbi ti-ba pɔŋŋu àá ti-deedeeu Unimbɔti nimbiin di yāntì uninja nee ká dicáaǹdee?

english_verse: The God that Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and our other ancestors worshiped has brought honor to his Servant Jesus. He is the one you betrayed. You turned against him when he was being tried by Pilate, even though Pilate wanted to set him free.
translation_verse: Di sá Abraam nì Isaaki nì Jaakɔb Nimbɔtiu, ti-naanjab Nimbɔtiuee di ŋá míǹ kí tīī u-tɔntɔnliu Yeesu tinyool. Úǹ ní ni cúú ki tīī Piilati yii naa là-u, bí kpɔ̀-u, ŋyunti ŋun Piilati u-ba bàà nìn là kí gíiǹ-u kí lííyee.

english_verse: You rejected Jesus, who was holy and good. You asked for a murderer to be set free,
translation_verse: Ni yíì yii naa là Yeesu un sá circir ki bí deedeeyee, ama ní ki gbāam̀ yii ú gíiǹ unikpɔl kí tīī-ni,

english_verse: and you killed the one who leads people to life. But God raised him from death, and all of us can tell you what he has done.
translation_verse: ní ki kūū dimaŋfal Dindaan. Ama Unimbɔti fīkitì-u ditaŋkpiilin, timbi kɔkɔwoooo nìn ká ki sá biseeradambi.

english_verse: You see this man, and you know him. He put his faith in the name of Jesus and was made strong. Faith in Jesus made this man completely well while everyone was watching.
translation_verse: Uninja un ni wāĺ ki nyí nee, Yeesu un ti fōō ki kííyee yindi pu ní kijapaai nee ká dicáaǹdi. Ti nín fōō-u ki kííyee di yì-tì ní uninja nee pɔ́ɔkì tiŋan ni-kɔkɔ nimbiin nee.

english_verse: My friends, I am sure you and your leaders didn't know what you were doing.
translation_verse: «Kɔŋkɔnnee, m-nabiyaamu, m nyí yii naa nìn nyí ní ki ŋáaǹ tin bí nee, ki kpáaǹ ni-yidambi mun.

english_verse: But God had his prophets tell that his Messiah would suffer, and now he has kept this promise.
translation_verse: Ama Unimbɔti nín nìn dī u-bɔnaatiliibi kɔkɔ nyɔmmu pu ki sòon̄ puee, yii Meesiya làá dāá jī falaayee, an lafun ŋá míǹ.

english_verse: So turn to God! Give up your sins, and you will be forgiven.
translation_verse: Míǹ puee, fámaan ni-kpitii kí gítímaan Unimbɔti cee kí wàatī ní ú kpìtī ni-kpitii kɔkɔ.

english_verse: Then the time will come when the Lord will give you fresh strength. He will send you Jesus, his chosen Messiah.
translation_verse: Niinee, ti-Dindaan làá tīiń-ni diŋuŋfil yuntiŋu, kí tɔ̄ń Yeesu un u lēē yii ú nīn sá Meesiya ki tīī-nee.

english_verse: But Jesus must stay in heaven until God makes all things new, just as his holy prophets promised long ago.
translation_verse: Kun puee u dáá kā Unimbɔti cee kí nīn cí ŋyunti ŋun Unimbɔti làá dāá kpántí tikɔkɔ mpɔm, kii u nín nìn yāntì u-circir bɔnaatiliibi sòon̄ dooooyee puee.

english_verse: Moses said, “The Lord your God will choose one of your own people to be a prophet, just as he chose me. Listen to everything he tells you.
translation_verse: Mooyiisi nìn lī yii: <Ti-Dindaan ni-Nimbɔtiu làá dāá lēē ni-nabiyaamu kansikin ubɔ, ú nīn sá Unimbɔti bɔnaatiliu kii mamee. Ní dāá pīlifì tin kɔkɔwoooo u làá sòoǹ nì nee.

english_verse: No one who disobeys this prophet will be one of God's people any longer.”
translation_verse: Un sá kamaa yaa kaa dāa pílifiǹ Unimbɔti bɔnaatiliu gbantee, bi làá dāá nyāntí-u Unimbɔti samaau kansikin kí kpɔ̀-u.>»

english_verse: Samuel and all the other prophets who came later also spoke about what is now happening.
translation_verse: Ní Peetroo nìkī ki bí yii: «Unimbɔti bɔnaatiliibi kɔkɔ, bin nìn sòon̄ doooo Samiyeel yuntiŋu ki kpáaǹ bin dāa páaǹní u-boonee, báà ŋma nìn nāatì tibɔti gbanti wiiŋyi pu.

english_verse: You are really the ones God told his prophets to speak to. And you were given the promise God made to your ancestors. He said to Abraham, “All nations on earth will be blessed because of someone from your family.”
translation_verse: Nimbi di sá bin jíń tin Unimbɔti nìn pōoǹ ki tīī u-bɔnaatiliibee, ki fōō u nín nìn pūtì ki pōoǹ tin kí ŋá kí tīī ti-naanjabee mun. Dipoondi gbanti poon ní u lī Abraam yii: <A-dicaŋku pu ní m làá dāá dī kí bìin̄ duulinya timbuliŋ kɔkɔ pu.>

english_verse: God sent his chosen Son to you first, because God wanted to bless you and make each one of you turn away from your sins.
translation_verse: Nimbi pu ní Unimbɔti fīkitì u-tɔntɔnliu Yeesu. U dū-u ki túnní ni-cee mpeepeekaam, ú dāan̄ kí ŋá-ni tiŋan kí nyāntí báà ŋma u-tuŋkpitiŋ poon.»

english_verse: The apostles were still talking to the people, when some priests, the captain of the temple guard, and some Sadducees arrived.
translation_verse: Ŋyunti ŋun Peetroo nì Yoowaneesi nìn dáá bíi sòoǹ nì kunipaauee, ní bisaraaŋaliibi nì Sadusab nì bin cí kunimbɔtidiiyee kpiliu bāań.

english_verse: These men were angry because the apostles were teaching the people that the dead would be raised from death, just as Jesus had been raised from death.
translation_verse: An kaa nìn mɔ́ɔkiǹ-bi, kun puee bi bíi sòoǹ nì samaa Yeesu bɔti ki dàkà yii bitaŋkpiibi làá dāá fìkitī.

english_verse: It was already late in the afternoon, and they arrested Peter and John and put them in jail for the night.
translation_verse: Ní bi cúú Peetroo nì Yoowaneesi ki cáa tɔ́ sarkan áli kutaa nì ku-wuntil, kun puee an nìn sá kujoou ní.

english_verse: But a lot of people who had heard the message believed it. So by now there were about
translation_verse: Nì míǹ kɔkɔee, bin nìn gbìl̄ bi-nyɔɔbuŋŋi gbantee tikpil nìn fōō ki kíí. Bi-wíiŋŋu nìn bàn̄ kii kutukub biŋmoo nyɔkɔm.

english_verse: The next morning the leaders, the elders, and the teachers of the Law of Moses met in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Kutaa wúntèe, Juuda yab yidambi nì bitindaŋkpilib nì bimaradakaliibi kpáfì Jeerusaleem.

english_verse: The high priest Annas was there, as well as Caiaphas, John, Alexander, and other members of the high priest's family.
translation_verse: Bin nìn bée di sá usaraaŋakpil Aani, nì Kaayiifi nì Yoowaneesi nì Aleekisandir nì bin kɔkɔwoooo nìn sá usaraaŋakpil dicaŋkunee.

english_verse: They brought in Peter and John and made them stand in the middle while they questioned them. They asked, “By what power and in whose name have you done this?”
translation_verse: Ní bi nyántì Peetroo nì Yoowaneesi ki yóoǹ bi-kansikin ní ki bālifì-bi yii: «Ŋma pɔŋŋu pu nì ŋma yindi pu ní ni ŋá míǹ ní?»

english_verse: Peter was filled with the Holy Spirit and told the nation's leaders and the elders:
translation_verse: Niinee Unimbɔti Fam kpákatìń Peetroo pu, ní u kíí-bi yii: «Biyidambi nì bikpilib, m ŋá-ni gaafalaa.

english_verse: You are questioning us today about a kind deed in which a man who could not walk was healed.
translation_verse: Ni bàlifī kí béé díǹ tiŋan tin ní ti ŋá uninja neeyee taapu, nì an nín ŋá pu ní u ká dicáaǹdeeee?

english_verse: But there is something we must tell you and everyone else in Israel. This man is standing here completely well because of the power of Jesus Christ from Nazareth. You put Jesus to death on a cross, but God raised him to life.
translation_verse: Míǹ puee, ni-kɔkɔ ń béé tiŋan, ki kpáaǹ Isirayeel yab kɔkɔ, yii an sá Yeesu Kriisitoo Naasaareeti yɔu yindi pu ní u pɔ́ɔkì. An sá u-pɔŋŋu pu ní uninja nee yú ni-nimbiin nì u-gbampɔŋŋu nee. Nimbi di kpáá Yeesu ndɔpuntikaa pu, ama Unimbɔti fīkitì-u ditaŋkpiilin.

english_verse: He is the stone you builders thought was worthless, and now he is the most important stone of all.
translation_verse: Úǹ pu ní an ŋmàn̄ Unimbɔti gbɔŋkun yii: <Ditaŋkpal din nimbi bidimaliibi dūu fée di kpántì ditaŋkpal din ŋúb́ kudii pɔŋŋuee.>

english_verse: Only Jesus has the power to save! His name is the only one in all the world that can save anyone.
translation_verse: Baa ŋūǹ kí dī ubɔ pu kí ká difiil see Yeesu baba pu. Di sá yii taapu doo Unimbɔti kaa ti tīī ufiil ubɔ un pu timbi binib máaǹ kí dī kí ká difiilee.»

english_verse: The officials were amazed to see how brave Peter and John were, and they knew that these two apostles were only ordinary men and not well educated. The officials were certain these men had been with Jesus.
translation_verse: Biyidambee nín ká Peetroo nì Yoowaneesi sòoǹ nì tininjatee, an ŋá-bi maamaaci, kun puee bi ká yii bi sá binifantantiibi, kaa nyí kugbɔŋu. Ama bi béè yii bi nì Yeesu di nìn tāatí.

english_verse: But they could not deny what had happened. The man who had been healed was standing there with the apostles.
translation_verse: Bi nín ká uninja un pɔ́ɔkèe yú bi-ceeyee, baa ti ŋūǹ kí lì tiba.

english_verse: The officials commanded them to leave the council room. Then the officials said to each other,
translation_verse: Ní bi bí Peetroo nì Yoowaneesi ń nyā kubɔsoondiin kí wàatī-bi, ní ki kíǹ ki bàlifī tɔb yii:

english_verse: “What can we do with these men? Everyone in Jerusalem knows about this miracle, and we cannot say it didn't happen.
translation_verse: «Ti làá nín ŋá binib nee mana dee? Kun puee Jeerusaleem yab kɔkɔ ká yii bi ŋá maamaacikpaan ubɔ, timbi ti-ba kaa ti ŋūǹ kí néé.

english_verse: But to keep this thing from spreading, we will warn them never again to speak to anyone about the name of Jesus.”
translation_verse: Ama, tibɔti gbanti ń taa gbìtī kí cù ndan samaa kɔkɔ ceeyee, tí dū mpɔmpiin kí pìim̄maan-bi nsan bí taa ti pée sòon̄ Yeesu yindi gbanti pu báà ubɔ cee.»

english_verse: So they called the two apostles back in and told them they must never, for any reason, teach anything about the name of Jesus.
translation_verse: Niinee ní bi yíiń-bi ki pīiǹ-bi nsan bí taa ti sòoǹ kí dàkà binib Yeesu gbanti yindi pu báà fiii.

english_verse: Peter and John answered, “Do you think God wants us to obey you or to obey him?
translation_verse: Ní Peetroo nì Yoowaneesi fātìi kíí-bi yii: «An ŋān̄ Unimbɔti nimbiin yii tí pīlifiǹ nimbi kí yàntī Unimbɔtaaa? Kíímaan-ti!

english_verse: We cannot keep quiet about what we have seen and heard.”
translation_verse: Ama timbee, taa ŋūǹ kí nīn ŋmí kí taa sòoǹ tin tin ti kée nì tin ti gbìl̄ee.»

english_verse: The officials could not find any reason to punish Peter and John. So they threatened them and let them go. The man who was healed by this miracle was more than
translation_verse: Uninja un nìn ká maamaaci cáaǹtam gbantee nìn jítì abin imuŋku ili pu. Yeesu boonnooliibi mèé ki nyàab̀ mpɔn

english_verse: As soon as Peter and John had been set free, they went back and told the others everything the chief priests and the leaders had said to them.
translation_verse: Bi gíiǹ Peetroo nì Yoowaneesi ki líìyee, ní bi búntì bi-yab cee ní ki bàn̄ ki máafì-bi tin kɔkɔ bisaraaŋakpilib nì bikpilib līń-bee.

english_verse: When the rest of the Lord's followers heard this, they prayed together and said: Master, you created heaven and earth, the sea, and everything in them.
translation_verse: Bi gbìl̄ mimmee, bi-kɔkɔ kpáfì dicilpu kinyɔɔbaantii ki mēē Unimbɔti yii: «Ti-Dindaan, sii di náań yilpu nì taapu, kitiŋ nì tiŋku nì tin kɔkɔwoooo pée bée.

english_verse: And by the Holy Spirit you spoke to our ancestor David. He was your servant, and you told him to say: “Why are all the Gentiles so furious? Why do people make foolish plans?
translation_verse: Sii di yāntì a-Circir Fam dī ti-naanja a-tɔntɔnliu Daafiidi pu ki sòon̄ yii: <Ba ŋá ní atimbun yòontí ŋi-ba yilpu ki sòoǹ tibɔfan míǹ? Ba ŋá ní samaa cáá ilandɔkɔkpiti in kaa làá tɔ̄ ditundee míǹ?

english_verse: The kings of earth prepare for war, and the rulers join together against the Lord and his Messiah.”
translation_verse: Duulinya bɔtiibi nì biyidambi kpáfì ki bóob́ dikɔ̀ndi kí jáǹ ti-Dindaan Unimbɔti nì ubɔti un u lēēyee.>

english_verse: Here in Jerusalem, Herod and Pontius Pilate got together with the Gentiles and the people of Israel. Then they turned against your holy Servant Jesus, your chosen Messiah.
translation_verse: An lafun ŋá míǹ, yii kitiŋ nee poon Eeroodi nì Pɔnsi Piilati nì binicambi nì Isirayeel yab kpáfì kí jáǹ a-circir tɔntɔnliu Yeesu, un a lēē u sá Meesiyayee.

english_verse: They did what you in your power and wisdom had already decided would happen.
translation_verse: Kujaau kun bi jáń nì Yeesuee yāntì bi ŋáaǹ tin kɔkɔwoooo a nìn lī ki yóoǹ a-pɔŋŋu nì a-ciiŋyi pu dooooyee.

english_verse: Lord, listen to their threats! We are your servants. So make us brave enough to speak your message.
translation_verse: Kɔŋkɔnnee, ti-Dindaan, kpèè bi nín lī yii bi làá ŋá-ti ntoomee puee, kí tūtuǹ timbi a-tɔntɔnliibi tí nīn sòoǹ a-bɔti nì tininjati.

english_verse: Show your mighty power, as we heal people and work miracles and wonders in the name of your holy Servant Jesus.
translation_verse: Á tàntī a-ŋal kí dàkà a-pɔŋŋu, bibunliibi ń ká dicáaǹdi, maamaacib nì tidaandi ń ŋá a-circir tɔntɔnliu Yeesu yindi pu.»

english_verse: After they had prayed, the meeting place shook. They were all filled with the Holy Spirit and bravely spoke God's message. Sharing Possessions
translation_verse: Bi mēē ki dóòyee, dibɔbilin niinee kitiŋ cīŋkì, ní Circir Fam gbí bi-kɔkɔ mmɔntiim, ní bi kíĺ ki bíi sòoǹ Unimbɔti bɔti, kaa fàŋkí. Bin fōō ki kííyee nyɔɔpeeŋu

english_verse: The group of followers all felt the same way about everything. None of them claimed that their possessions were their own, and they shared everything they had with each other.
translation_verse: Bin kɔkɔwoooo nìn fōō Yeesu ki kííyee nìn pēē kinyɔkɔ ní bi-pɔbiliŋ nìn sá diba. Ubɔ kaa nìn lì yii tin u cááyee sá u-baba yati, ama báà ŋma wanti nìn sá ki tīī bi-kɔkɔ ní.

english_verse: In a powerful way the apostles told everyone that the Lord Jesus was now alive. God greatly blessed his followers,
translation_verse: Nì mpɔŋkpaan ní Yeesu kpambaliŋ nìn sòoǹ ki lèekī ti-Dindaan Yeesu fìkititam seerau, ní Unimbɔti biindi nìn bí bi-pu tikpil.

english_verse: and no one went in need of anything. Everyone who owned land or houses would sell them and bring the money
translation_verse: Bi-kansikinee, ubɔ kaa nìn bí ki sá usoodaan, kun puee bin nìn cáá akpaan àá adiinee nìn nyáfí ní ki cāabìń tin bi nyáfèe nimbiliŋ ki bīil̀ Yeesu kpambaliŋ nimbiin,

english_verse: to the apostles. Then they would give the money to anyone in need.
translation_verse: ní bi yàkatī bi-kansikin báà ŋma nín máaǹ miŋyee.

english_verse: Ananias and his wife Sapphira also sold a piece of property.
translation_verse: Ama, uninja ubɔ nìn bí, bi yíì-u Ananiyasi. U nì u-nimpuu Safiira nìn kpáfì ki nyáfì bi-kpaatanti,

english_verse: But they agreed to cheat and keep some of the money for themselves. So when Ananias took the rest of the money to the apostles,
translation_verse: ní ki bātì animbil, ki kíǹ ŋin kíǹee ki cáa bíl̀ Yeesu kpambaliŋ nimbiin. U-nimpuu mun nìn nyí min u-cal ŋée.

english_verse: Peter said, “Why has Satan made you keep back some of the money from the sale of the property? Why have you lied to the Holy Spirit?
translation_verse: Ní Peetroo bí yii: «Ananiyasi, ba ŋá ní a yāntì Sitaan jíń a-pɔbil poon mpaan míǹ? A mɔ́ntì Unimbɔti Fam ki bātì tikpaatan nimbiliŋ pu.

english_verse: The property was yours before you sold it, and even after you sold it, the money was still yours. What made you do such a thing? You didn't lie to people. You lied to God!”
translation_verse: Sii di yì a-kpaatanti, a ŋūǹ kí dū-tì kí yóoń. A nín tí nyáfì-tèe, sii di yì an nimbiliŋ. Kin an ŋá mana ní a yāntì nlandɔkɔkpiti fōō mpaan a-pɔbil poon míǹ? An kaa sá binib ní a mɔ́ntì, an sá Unimbɔti.»

english_verse: As soon as Ananias heard this, he dropped dead, and everyone who heard about it was frightened.
translation_verse: Ŋyunti ŋun Ananiyaasi gbìl̄ mimmee, ní u lítì ki kpíì. Tifaandi nìn kɔ́ bin kɔkɔwoooo gbìl̄ an bɔtee.

english_verse: Some young men came in and wrapped up his body. Then they took it out and buried it.
translation_verse: Ní binaacimpɔmbi yíkì ki dū sata ki bīiǹ-u, ní ki yōoǹ-u ki cáa síb́.

english_verse: Three hours later Sapphira came in, but she did not know what had happened to her husband.
translation_verse: An yúntì ki bàn̄ kii tikúti titee, ní u-nimpuu kóoń, kaa kpáàa béè tin jítèe.

english_verse: Peter asked her, “Tell me, did you sell the property for this amount?” “Yes,” she answered, “that's the amount.”
translation_verse: Ní Peetroo bālifì-u dinyɔɔbundi yii: «Tùkù-mi, ni nín nyáfì tikpaatan puee nimbiliŋ sɔ̀ɔɔ?» Ní u kíí yii: «Iiin, ti nín nyáfì puee dee.»

english_verse: Then Peter said, “Why did the two of you agree to test the Lord's Spirit? The men who buried Ananias are by the door, and they will carry you out!”
translation_verse: Niinee Peetroo bí-u yii: «Ba ŋá ní sii nì a-cal kpáfì ki cɔ́ŋkì ti-Dindaan Fam míǹ? Kpèè, bin síb́ a-calee di dòoń kupunyɔkɔpuee! Bi làá dāá yòon̄ si mun.»

english_verse: At once she fell at Peter's feet and died. When the young men came back in, they found Sapphira lying there dead. So they carried her out and buried her beside her husband.
translation_verse: Kpalaa niinee, ní u mun lítì Peetroo taaŋi taapu ki kpíì. Binaacimpɔmbi kóońee, ki ká u kpíì, ní bi yōoǹ u mun ki cáa síb́ ki kɔ́ĺ u-cal.

english_verse: The church members were afraid, and so was everyone else who heard what had happened. Peter's Unusual Power
translation_verse: Tifaandi nìn kɔ́ Kriisitoo nikitil kɔkɔ nì bin kɔkɔ nìn pée gbìl̄ an bɔtee. Bi nín nìn ŋáań maamaacib puee

english_verse: The apostles worked many miracles and wonders among the people. All of the Lord's followers often met in the part of the temple known as Solomon's Porch.
translation_verse: Yeesu kpambaliŋ nìn ŋáań tidaandi nì maamaacib tikpil samaa kansikin. Bin fōō ki kííyee nìn kpáfí dicilpu dibɔɔbaantiil Saloomɔn kadantikuu taapu.

english_verse: No one outside their group dared join them, even though everyone liked them very much.
translation_verse: Tifaandi nìn kɔ́ bin kaa fōō ki kííyee, ní bi-kansikin báà ubɔ kaa ti là kí sútíí pìl̄-bi, ama nì míǹ kɔkɔee bi nìn pàkà-bi.

english_verse: Then sick people were brought out to the road and placed on mats. It was hoped that Peter would walk by, and his shadow would fall on them and heal them.
translation_verse: An yāntì áli gba binib cāabìń bibunliibi ki bīil̀ nlambamu nì tikampati pu adan pu, án nín làá ŋá pu Peetroo yaa jītée, u-jiliŋku kpaŋkpam ń lítí biba puee.

english_verse: A lot of people living in the towns near Jerusalem brought those who were sick or troubled by evil spirits, and they were all healed. Trouble for the Apostles
translation_verse: Binib tikpil mun nìn nyēeń ntimu mun kaa dátiǹ Jeerusaleemee, ki cāabìń bibunliibi nì bin pu arasiniibi nìn kā bi wáatèe, ní bi-kɔkɔ kāntí dicáaǹdi. Bi sāaǹ Yeesu kpambaliŋ

english_verse: The high priest and all the other Sadducees who were with him became jealous.
translation_verse: Niinee usaraaŋakpil nì u-yab kɔkɔ, an dàkà yii Sadusab jandi, kíǹ ki ná Yeesu kpambaliŋ.

english_verse: They arrested the apostles and put them in the city jail.
translation_verse: Bi nìn yíkìi cúú Yeesu kpambaliŋ ki pīiǹ-bi kudii.

english_verse: But that night an angel from the Lord opened the doors of the jail and led the apostles out. The angel said,
translation_verse: Ama ní kunyeeuee ti-Dindaan tuuŋŋu ŋubɔ dɔ́miń ki pīitì kusarkadii punyɔmmu ki nyántì-bi, ní ki bí-bi yii:

english_verse: “Go to the temple and tell the people everything about this new life.”
translation_verse: «Cù kí yūĺmaan kunimbɔtidii poon kí dū dimaŋfal bɔti kɔkɔ kí sòoǹ, samaa ń gbìl̄.»

english_verse: So they went into the temple before sunrise and started teaching. The high priest and his men called together their council, which included all of Israel's leaders. Then they ordered the apostles to be brought to them from the jail.
translation_verse: Bi gbìl̄ mimmee, ní ki péé kutaafaau ki kɔ́ kunimbɔtidiin ní ki kíĺ ki bíi dàkà Unimbɔti bɔti. Niinee, usaraaŋakpil nì u-yab bāań ki yíiń bibɔsoonliibi kitil. Bi kpáfì ki tú bí yíiń Yeesu kpambaliŋee kusarkadiin.

english_verse: The temple police who were sent to the jail did not find the apostles. They returned and said,
translation_verse: Pilisib bàn̄ee, kaa ká-bi kusarkadiin, ní ki fātìi gítìń ki tùkū-bi yii:

english_verse: “We found the jail locked tight and the guards standing at the doors. But when we opened the doors and went in, we didn't find anyone there.”
translation_verse: «Ti bàn̄ee, kusarkadii pīī kpálkpal, ní soojab yú mpunyɔmu nyɔkɔpui, ní ti cúu pīitèe, báà ubɔ nì ubɔ kpá poon!»

english_verse: The captain of the temple police and the chief priests listened to their report, but they did not know what to think about it.
translation_verse: Bi gbìl̄ mimmee, ní bin kpèé kunimbɔtidiiyee kpiliu nì bisaraaŋakpilib bākatì nì Yeesu kpambaliŋ nín wáŋkì puee, kun puee tiba yaa làá gíti bàń-bi tibɔti nee poon sɔ̀, baa nyí.

english_verse: Just then someone came in and said, “Now those men you put in jail are in the temple, teaching the people!”
translation_verse: Ní ubɔ bāań ki bí-bi yii: «Binib bin ni cúú ki tɔ́ sarkanee di yú kunimbɔtidiin ki dàkà samaayee.»

english_verse: The captain went with some of the temple police and brought the apostles back. But they did not use force. They were afraid that the people might start throwing stones at them.
translation_verse: Ní bin kpèé kunimbɔtidiiyee kpiliu nì u-pilisib cūtì ki cáań-bi soooo, kaa ŋá-bi mpɔn, kun puee bi fàŋkí samaa ń taa tɔ̄-bi ataŋkpee.

english_verse: When the apostles were brought before the council, the high priest said to them,
translation_verse: Bi cáań-bee, ní ki cáá-bi ki cūnnì bibɔsoonliibi kitil nimbiin. Ní usaraaŋakpil bālifì-bi tibɔti yii:

english_verse: “We told you plainly not to teach in the name of Jesus. But look what you have done! You have been teaching all over Jerusalem, and you are trying to blame us for his death.”
translation_verse: «Taa bí-ni yii ní taa ti sòoǹ diyindi din pu ni sòoǹ nee pu kpataaa? Kpèèmaan, díǹ pu nee ni yāntì ni-bɔti gbanti gbītì Jeerusaleem kɔkɔ! Mimmee, ni là timbi ń jī kijapaai nee kpuulool deeyaa!»

english_verse: Peter and the apostles replied: We don't obey people. We obey God.
translation_verse: Ní Peetroo nì Yeesu kpambaliŋ ŋin kíǹee, kíí-u yii: «An máaǹ tí gbìl̄ Unimbɔti nyɔkɔ kí yàntī binib.

english_verse: You killed Jesus by nailing him to a cross. But the God our ancestors worshiped raised him to life
translation_verse: Nimbi di kpáá Yeesu ndɔpuntikaa pu ki kūū-u, ní ti-naanjab Nimbɔtiu fīkitì-u.

english_verse: and made him our Leader and Savior. Then God gave him a place at his right side, so that the people of Israel would turn back to him and be forgiven.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti dū-u ki kāaǹ u-ŋaŋgiil pú, ú nīn sá Ubɔti nì Ufiil ki tīī Isirayeel yab bí ŋmā kí fá bi-kpitii, Unimbɔti ń dūú pɔ̄-bi.

english_verse: We are here to tell you about all this, and so is the Holy Spirit, who is God's gift to everyone who obeys God.
translation_verse: Timbi nìn ká ki sá biseeradambi an bɔti pu, ki kpáaǹ Circir Fam min Unimbɔti tìì bin tɔ́-uee.»

english_verse: When the council members heard this, they became so angry they wanted to kill the apostles.
translation_verse: Bi gbìl̄ an bɔtee, ní ki fōō diŋuul ki là kí kpɔ̀ akpambal.

english_verse: But one of the members was the Pharisee Gamaliel, a highly respected teacher. He ordered the apostles to be taken out of the room for a little while.
translation_verse: Ama Fariisab kansikin ubɔ nìn bí niin, bi yíì-u yii Gamaliyeel, u sá umaradakal un samaa kɔkɔwoooo nìn tɔ́ee. Kijapaayee nìn yáatìi yúl̀ bibɔsoonliibi kitil kansikin ki pú kinyɔkɔ yii bí dá láá nyāntí akpambalee.

english_verse: Then he said to the council: Men of Israel, be careful what you do with these men.
translation_verse: Ní u bí-bi yii: «Isirayeel yab, ní kpèèmaan tiŋan nì tin ní ni là kí ŋá nì njapaamu nee!

english_verse: Later, when the people of our nation were being counted, Judas from Galilee showed up. A lot of people followed him, but he was killed, and all his followers were scattered.
translation_verse: Úǹ boonee, ní Juudasi ugaaliileeja mun yíkì ŋyunti ŋun bi kàan̄ binibee, ní ki dáaliń kunipaau ki gíiǹ u-jandi pú. Ní bi kūū u mun ní bin kɔkɔwoooo nìn nóó-uee yàl̄.

english_verse: So I advise you to stay away from these men. Leave them alone. If what they are planning is something of their own doing, it will fail.
translation_verse: Míǹ puee, tin m cáá ki làá tùkù-nee di sá yii, ní càntīmaan binib nee kí taa ŋá-bi tiba, kun puee atuun ŋin bi ŋáań nee yaa nyánní binib cee, ŋi bí kí dāá kúntí.

english_verse: But if God is behind it, you cannot stop it anyway, unless you want to fight against God. The council members agreed with what he said,
translation_verse: Ama an yaa nyánní Unimbɔti cee, naa ŋūǹ kí pìin̄-bi nsan. Ní kpèèmaan tiŋan kí taa jáǹ Unimbɔti kujaau!»

english_verse: and they called the apostles back in. They had them beaten with a whip and warned them not to speak in the name of Jesus. Then they let them go.
translation_verse: Niinee, bi-kɔkɔ kpáfì ki gbìlīǹ-u ní ki yíiń Yeesu kpambaliŋ, ní ki gbáń-bi anaalab, ní ki bí-bi yii bí taa ti sòoǹ Yeesu yindi pu, ní ki gíiǹ-bi ki líì.

english_verse: The apostles left the council and were happy, because God had considered them worthy to suffer for the sake of Jesus.
translation_verse: Nì dipɔɔpindi ní Yeesu kpambaliŋ nìn nyáń bibɔsoonliibi kitil nimbiin, kun puee Unimbɔti ŋá-bi tinyool ki yāntì bi jíń falaa Yeesu yindi pu.

english_verse: Every day they spent time in the temple and in one home after another. They never stopped teaching and telling the good news that Jesus is the Messiah.
translation_verse: Ní baabadal bi bí kunimbɔtidiin, nì binib dumpui ki sòoǹ ki dàkà tibɔmɔntiil tin sòoǹ Yeesu, Meesiya puee, kaa gbèentí.

english_verse: A lot of people were now becoming followers of the Lord. But some of the ones who spoke Greek started complaining about the ones who spoke Aramaic. They complained that the Greek-speaking widows were not given their share when the food supplies were handed out each day.
translation_verse: Iwiin gbanti poonee Yeesu boonnooliibi wíiŋŋu nìn gbéeǹ, ní Juuda yab bin gbìl̀ Greeki sooŋyee bíi gbùkum̄ nì Juuda yab bin pée bí bi-dumpu dooooyee, yii baa tìì bíǹ kpiipoobi tiwan tin bi yàkatī kutaa sá kamaayee kii bi nín tìì bin béeyee puee.

english_verse: The twelve apostles called the whole group of followers together and said, “We should not give up preaching God's message in order to serve at tables.
translation_verse: Ní Yeesu kpambaliŋ saalaa nì alee yíiń biboonnooliibi kɔkɔ, ní ki bí-bi yii: «An kaa máaǹ tí yàntī Unimbɔti bɔti disoondi kí nīn kpèé tijin laŋki.

english_verse: My friends, choose seven men who are respected and wise and filled with God's Spirit. We will put them in charge of these things.
translation_verse: Míǹ puee, nnabiyaamu, lēēmaan ni-kansikin bininjab biluli bin pu báà ŋma nyí yii bi sá binimɔntiibee nì bin ni Circir Fam gbí tiŋanee, binib bin cáá iciinee, tí dū ditundi gbanti kí ŋúbiǹ-bi.

english_verse: We can spend our time praying and serving God by preaching.”
translation_verse: Mimmee, timbi kāntí mpaan kí dū ti-yuntiŋu kɔkɔ kí mèè ŋwimmeem kí sòoǹ Unimbɔti bɔti tin sá ti-tundee.»

english_verse: This suggestion pleased everyone, and they began by choosing Stephen. He had great faith and was filled with the Holy Spirit. Then they chose Philip, Prochorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, and also Nicolaus, who worshiped with the Jewish people in Antioch.
translation_verse: Tibɔti gbanti mɔ́ɔkiǹ samaa kɔkɔ, ní bi lēē Eetiyeen, un nìn fōō ki kíí tikpil Circir Fam bí u-ni tiŋan puee, nì Fiiliipi nì Prookɔɔr nì Niikanɔɔr nì Tiimɔn nì Paameenasi nì Niikoolaa un sá Antiyɔɔsi ki fōō Juuda yab marabee.

english_verse: These men were brought to the apostles. Then the apostles prayed and placed their hands on the men to show they had been chosen to do this work.
translation_verse: Bi cáań-bi ki dàkā Yeesu kpambaliŋ, ní akpambalee mēē Unimbɔti ki tīī-bi, ní ki dū bi-ŋalii ki páaǹ bi-pu.

english_verse: God's message spread, and many more people in Jerusalem became followers. Even a large number of priests put their faith in the Lord. Stephen Is Arrested
translation_verse: Unimbɔti nyɔɔbundi mɔ̀tīi gbìtī ajan kɔkɔ, ní Yeesu boonnooliibi mɔ̀tīi wīintí tikpil Jeerusaleem tiŋkin, ki kpáaǹ bisaraaŋaliibi tikpil nìn fòol̄ Yeesu bɔti ki kíikí. Bi cúú Eetiyeen

english_verse: God gave Stephen the power to work great miracles and wonders among the people.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti nìn pú Eetiyeen diyimɔɔl nì mpɔn tikpil, ní u nìn ŋáań maamaacikpaambi nì tidaandi samaa kansikin.

english_verse: But some men from Cyrene and Alexandria were members of a group who called themselves “Free Men.” They started arguing with Stephen. Some others from Cilicia and Asia also argued with him.
translation_verse: Dikitil din bi nìn yíì iyumbu in bi líìyee kitilee nib nìn yíkì ki bíi kpākantí Eetiyeen. Bi nìn sá Juuda yab bin nyánní Siireen nì Aleekisandirii nì Siilisii nì Asiiyee ní.

english_verse: But they were no match for Stephen, who spoke with the great wisdom that the Spirit gave him.
translation_verse: Ama baa nìn ŋūǹ kí sòoǹ kí líí-u, iciin in Circir Fam nìn yàntī u sòoǹee pu.

english_verse: So they talked some men into saying, “We heard Stephen say terrible things against Moses and God!”
translation_verse: Míǹ puee bi tīī njapaamu mubɔ tiba dibalin bí lì yii: «Ti gbìl̄ u sòoǹ tibɔti ki bíiĺ Mooyiisi nì Unimbɔti yindi.»

english_verse: They turned the people and their leaders and the teachers of the Law of Moses against Stephen. Then they all grabbed him and dragged him in front of the council.
translation_verse: Ní an cúú kunipaauee poon ki kūtì ki kpáaǹ bitindaŋkpilib nì bimaradakaliibi, ní bi cūtìi cúuń-u mpɔn ki cáań bibɔsoonliibi kitil nimbiin.

english_verse: Some men agreed to tell lies about Stephen, and they said, “This man keeps on saying terrible things about this holy temple and the Law of Moses.
translation_verse: Ní bi yāntì binib biba mɔ́ntì nnyimɔn u-pu yii: «Uninja nee pée sòoǹ kaa gbèentí ki bíiĺ kunimbɔtidii nee nì Mooyiisi marab,

english_verse: We have heard him claim that Jesus from Nazareth will destroy this place and change the customs Moses gave us.”
translation_verse: kun puee timbi gbìl̄ u bí yii Yeesu Naasaareeti yɔu nee làá kpìtī kunimbɔtidii nee kí kpántí akoobil ŋin Mooyiisi nìn tīī ti-naanjabee.»

english_verse: Then all the council members stared at Stephen. They saw that his face looked like the face of an angel.
translation_verse: Bibɔsoonliibi bin nìn kēe kɔkɔ dū bi-nimbikpeeŋu ki báaǹ Eetiyeen pu, ní ki ká yii u-nimbiin kpántì kii Unimbɔti tuuŋŋu nimbiinee.

english_verse: The high priest asked Stephen, “Are they telling the truth about you?”
translation_verse: Ní usaraaŋakpil bālifì-u yii: «An sá míǹ tiŋmanaaa?»

english_verse: Stephen answered: Friends, listen to me. Our glorious God appeared to our ancestor Abraham while he was still in Mesopotamia, before he had moved to Haran.
translation_verse: Ní Eetiyeen kíí-u yii: «Nimbi m-baabi nì m-nabiyaamu, m ŋá-ni gaafalaa. Pīlifìmaan! Unimbɔti tinyooldaan dɔ́miń ti-naanja Abraam cee ŋyunti ŋun u dáá bí Meesoopootamiiyee, ki wāatì ní u nín kɔ́ Kaaran,

english_verse: God told him, “Leave your country and your relatives and go to a land that I will show you.”
translation_verse: ní ki bí-u yii: <Nyā a-tiŋkin nì a-dicaŋkun kí cù kitiŋ kin m làá dàkà-see ni.>

english_verse: Then Abraham left the land of the Chaldeans and settled in Haran. After his father died, Abraham came and settled in this land where you now live.
translation_verse: Ní u nyáń Kaldee tiŋkin ní ki cūtì ki kóò Kaaran tiŋkin. U-baa kúm boonee ní Unimbɔti cáań-u kitiŋ kin poon ni bí nee.

english_verse: God didn't give him any part of it, not even a square meter. But God did promise to give it to him and his family forever, even though Abraham didn't have any children.
translation_verse: Waa nìn tīī-u kitiŋ nee poon dijandi báà diba, áli gba waa nìn cáá tikpaatan wāā ki bàn̄ u-tabɔbil. Unimbɔti pōoǹ-u yii u làá dū kitiŋ gbanti kí tīī-u, án kpántí úǹ nì u-naantiibi kɔkɔ wanti. Míǹ gbee, Abraam kaa nìn dáá cáá kibiki.

english_verse: God said Abraham's descendants would live for a while in a foreign land. There they would be slaves and would be mistreated
translation_verse: Unimbɔti bí-u yii: <A-naantiibi làá nīn sá binicambi kitiŋ kiban, kí kpántí iyumbu, bí sàaǹ-bi áli abin tilaafati tili.>

english_verse: But he also said, “I will punish the nation that makes them slaves. Then later they will come and worship me in this place.”
translation_verse: Unimbɔti gíti lī-u yii: <Ama kitiŋ kin yab làá dāá sàaǹ-bi mimmee, mama m-ba di làá dāá dáaĺ bi-tafal. Boonee, a-naantiibee làá dāá nyā kitiŋ gbantin kí dāan̄ doo kí nīn nyɔ́ŋkí-mi.>

english_verse: God said to Abraham, “Every son in each family must be circumcised to show you have kept your agreement with me.” So when Isaac was eight days old, Abraham circumcised him. Later, Isaac circumcised his son Jacob, and Jacob circumcised his twelve sons.
translation_verse: Niinee Unimbɔti tīī-u digiil marau din sá u-poondi daaŋkuee. Míǹ puee Abraam màl̄ Isaakee, ní ki gíí-u dikpancandi iwiin inii dal, ní Isaaki mun gíí Jaakɔb, ní Jaakɔb gíí ti-naanjab bin sá tinaakɔti saalaa nì tilee.

english_verse: These men were our ancestors. Joseph was also one of our famous ancestors. His brothers were jealous of him and sold him as a slave to be taken to Egypt. But God was with him
translation_verse: «Ti-naanjabee nìn ná Jooseefi, ní ki dū-u ki nyáfì bí cáá-u kí cùnnì Eejipiti. Ama Unimbɔti nìn bí u-cee

english_verse: and rescued him from all his troubles. God made him so wise that the Egyptian king Pharaoh thought highly of him. The king even made Joseph governor over Egypt and put him in charge of everything he owned.
translation_verse: ki nyántì-u u-falaau kɔkɔ poon, ní ki tīī-u iciin ki yāntì u-bɔti fáatì Faaroo Eejipiti bɔtiu, ní Faaroo dū-u ki kāaǹ ú nīn sá gɔmina Eejipiti tiŋki kɔkɔ pu, ki kpáaǹ úǹ ubɔti cindi.

english_verse: Everywhere in Egypt and Canaan the grain crops failed. There was terrible suffering, and our ancestors could not find enough to eat.
translation_verse: Niinee ní ŋkùm miba nyáń Eejipiti nì Kanaan timmu kɔkɔn. An nìn sá falaakpaan ní. Ti-naanjab kaa nìn kāntí tiba kí jī.

english_verse: But when Jacob heard there was grain in Egypt, he sent our ancestors there for the first time.
translation_verse: Jaakɔb nín nìn gbìl̄ yii tijikaal bí Eejipitee, ní u tú ti-naanjab mpeepeekaam niin.

english_verse: It was on their second trip that Joseph told his brothers who he was, and the king learned about Joseph's family.
translation_verse: Nliliitiimee ní Jooseefi yāntì u-nabiyaamu béè-u, ní Faaroo béè kudicaŋu kun poon ní Jooseefi sée.

english_verse: Joseph sent for his father and his relatives. In all, there were
translation_verse: Niinee ní Jooseefi tú bí cáań u-baa Jaakɔb nì u-samaau kɔkɔ: bi nìn sá binib biŋmoo kpá imuŋku inaa.

english_verse: His father went to Egypt and died there, just as our ancestors did.
translation_verse: Jaakɔb cūtì Eejipitee, ní ki tin kpíì niin. Míǹ ní ti-naanjab mun kpíì niin.

english_verse: Later their bodies were taken back to Shechem and placed in the tomb that Abraham had bought from the sons of Hamor.
translation_verse: Ní bi yōoǹ bi-wunti ki cáa cūnnì Siikeem, ki tin síb́ dikaakul din Abraam nìn dá nì animbil Amɔɔr biyaamu cee Siikeemee.

english_verse: Finally, the time came for God to do what he had promised Abraham. By then the number of our people in Egypt had greatly increased.
translation_verse: «Ŋyunti ŋun an tóob́ Unimbɔti ń ŋá kii u nín nìn pōoǹ pu ki tīī Abraamee, ní Isirayeel yab būtì ki wíiǹ Eejipiti tiŋkin.

english_verse: Another king was ruling Egypt, and he didn't know anything about Joseph.
translation_verse: Ní ubɔtipɔɔn kāl̀, kaa nyí Jooseefi.

english_verse: He tricked our ancestors and was cruel to them. He even made them leave their babies outside, so they would die.
translation_verse: U dū iciin ki ŋúń ti-naanjab, ní ki cáá-bi ki sàantí, áli ki yāntì bi nyāntí bi-biyaamu ki féeń mu kúù.

english_verse: During this time Moses was born. He was a very beautiful child, and for three months his parents took care of him in their home.
translation_verse: An yuntiŋu ní bi nìn màl̄ Mooyiisi un nìn ŋān̄ Unimbɔti ceeyee, ní bi kpíiǹ-u iŋmal ita u-baa diiku poon.

english_verse: Then when they were forced to leave him outside, the king's daughter found him and raised him as her own son.
translation_verse: Bi dāa nyántì-u ki ŋman dūu fée, ní Faaroo bisal píí-u ki ŋúb́-u kii úǹ u-ba bikee.

english_verse: Moses was given the best education in Egypt. He was a strong man and a powerful speaker.
translation_verse: An di yì-tì ní Mooyiisi bífì Eejipiti yab ciiŋyi kɔkɔ, ki nìn pɔ̄ɔ̄ dibɔsoondin ki kpáaǹ atuunni.

english_verse: One day he saw an Egyptian mistreating one of them. So he rescued the man and killed the Egyptian.
translation_verse: Niin ní u ká Ueejipitija ubɔ bí ki sàantí u-nabiki kiba, ní u mɔ́tì ki kútì u-nabiki kin bi bíi sàantée pu, ní ki kūū Ueejipitijee ki tɔ̀n̄ ipɔntoon.

english_verse: Moses thought the rest of his people would realize God was going to use him to set them free. But they didn't understand.
translation_verse: U bàà nyí yii u-nabiyaamu làá béé yii úǹ pu ní Unimbɔti làá dī kí fīī-bi, ama baa ŋúń ki béè.

english_verse: But the man who had started the fight pushed Moses aside and asked, “Who made you our ruler and judge?
translation_verse: ní ki sáŋkì-bi yii: <M-bɔɔbi, ni sá nnabiyaamu ní. Ba ŋá ní ni sàantí tɔb míǹ?>

english_verse: When Moses heard this, he ran away to live in the country of Midian. His two sons were born there.
translation_verse: An bɔti puee, Mooyiisi sáǹ ki cūtìi kíǹ ki kóò Madiyan tiŋkin. Niin ní u màl̄ mbininjabiyaamu muli.

english_verse: Forty years later, an angel appeared to Moses from a burning bush in the desert near Mount Sinai.
translation_verse: «Abin imuŋku ili boonee, ní Unimbɔti tuuŋŋu dɔ́miń u-cee kisugbooi kin wù bìlbilee poon kuteeun, dijool din bi yíì Siinaayee caŋin.

english_verse: Moses was surprised by what he saw. He went closer to get a better look, and the Lord said,
translation_verse: Mooyiisi ká mimmee, ní an ŋá-u maamaaci. U sútì ki pìl̄ kí mɔ̀tīí kpèèyee, ní u gbìl̄ Unimbɔti neen lī yii:

english_verse: “I am the God who was worshiped by your ancestors, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.” Moses started shaking all over and didn't dare to look at the bush.
translation_verse: <Man di sá a-naanjab Nimbɔtiu, Abraam nì Isaaki nì Jaakɔb Nimbɔtiu!> Ní Mooyiisi wunti kíǹ ki bíi jìkì, ní waa ti là kí kpèè niin.

english_verse: The Lord said to him, “Take off your sandals, because the place where you are standing is holy.
translation_verse: Ní ti-Dindaan bí-u yii: <Tákatí a-naatakaŋ, kun puee kitiŋ kin pu a yú nee sá circir tiŋki ní.

english_verse: With my own eyes I have seen the suffering of my people in Egypt. I have heard their groans and have come down to rescue them. Now I am sending you back to Egypt.”
translation_verse: M ká ki gíti ká falaa un poon ní m-samaau bí Eejipitee, ki gbìl̄ bi-yaliŋkii mun pu, ní m kpákatìń kí fīī-bi. Kɔŋkɔnnee, nín̄ cá, m làá tɔ̄-si Eejipiti.>

english_verse: This was the same Moses that the people rejected by saying, “Who made you our leader and judge?” God's angel had spoken to Moses from the bush. And God had even sent the angel to help Moses rescue the people and be their leader.
translation_verse: «Mooyiisi un Isirayeel yab nìn yíì ki bí yii: <Ŋma kāaǹ-si á nīn sá ti-kpiliu nì ti-bɔsoonliuee?> úǹ ní Unimbɔti túnní bi-cee ú nīn sá bi-bɔtiu kí nīn sá bi-fiiliu, ní ntuun ŋun u nìn ká kisugbooyinee nìn bí ki tútúǹ-u.

english_verse: In Egypt and at the Red Sea and in the desert, Moses rescued the people by working miracles and wonders for
translation_verse: Úǹ di ŋáaǹ maamaacib nì tidaandi Eejipiti tiŋkin ki nyántì-bi niin, ki gíti ŋáaǹ maamaacib nì tidaandi Tikati mɔɔl poon, ki kpáaǹ kuteeun, laakin bi ŋá abin imuŋku ilee.

english_verse: Moses is the one who told the people of Israel, “God will choose one of your people to be a prophet, just as he chose me.”
translation_verse: Mooyiisi gbanti ubaanti tùkū Isirayeel yab yii: <Unimbɔti làá dāá lēē ni-nabiyaamu kansikin ubɔ, ú nīn sá Unimbɔti bɔnaatiliu kii mamee.>

english_verse: Moses brought our people together in the desert, and the angel spoke to him on Mount Sinai. There he was given these life-giving words to pass on to us.
translation_verse: Ŋyunti ŋun samaa nìn kpáfì kuteeunee, Mooyiisi di nìn sí ntuun ŋun nìn sòoǹ nì u Siinaayi jool pu nì ti-naanjab kansikinee. Mooyiisi di nìn fōō dimaŋfal nyɔɔbuŋŋi Unimbɔti cee ki cáań ki tīī-ti.

english_verse: But our ancestors refused to obey Moses. They rejected him and wanted to go back to Egypt.
translation_verse: «Ama ti-naanjab nìn yíì, kaa là kí pīlifiǹ-u. Bi-landɔkɔi gítì Eejipiti watil.

english_verse: Then they made an idol in the shape of a calf. They offered sacrifices to the idol and were pleased with what they had done.
translation_verse: Ŋyunti gbantee ní bi mɔ́ɔ́ dinabil, ní ki ŋá saraa ki tīī-dì ní ki bí ki jīǹ jiŋaal kun bíǹ bi-ba mɔ́ɔ́ nì bi-ŋaliiyee pu.

english_verse: God turned his back on his people and left them. Then they worshiped the stars in the sky, just as it says in the Book of the Prophets, “People of Israel, you didn't offer sacrifices and offerings to me during those
translation_verse: Niinee, Unimbɔti fātì u-boon ki tīī-bi, ki dū-bi ki líiǹ iŋmalbijaa, bí nīn tòotī-i, kii Unimbɔti bɔnaatiliibi nín nìn ŋmàn̄ bi-gbɔnti poon puee yii: <Unimbɔti bí yii, Isirayeel yab, man ní ni nìn ŋá saraabi ki tīī abin imuŋku ili ŋin ni nìn ŋá kuteeuneeee?

english_verse: Instead, you carried the tent where the god Molech is worshiped, and you took along the star of your god Rephan. You made those idols and worshiped them. So now I will have you carried off beyond Babylonia.”
translation_verse: Aayee, kun puee ni nìn tūntí diwaal Mooleeki waadiiku kun ni gāā nì satee, nì diwaal din bi yíì Rafanee ŋmalbijau. An waaŋi ŋin ni nìn máń ki jáaḿee puee, m làá cáá-ni Babiloon tiŋkin kuyuŋu.>

english_verse: The tent where our ancestors worshiped God was with them in the desert. This was the same tent that God had commanded Moses to make. And it was made like the model that Moses had seen.
translation_verse: Kuteeunee, ti-naanjab nìn cáá tanti un poon ataŋkpee ali ŋin pu marab nìn ŋmàn̄ ki kēe bée. Di sá yii Unimbɔti nìn tùkū Mooyiisi yii ú gāā tanti kii un u dàkā-uee nín bí puee ní Mooyiisi lafun ŋá míǹ.

english_verse: Later it was given to our ancestors, and they took it with them when they went with Joshua. They carried the tent along as they took over the land from those people that God had chased out for them. Our ancestors used this tent until the time of King David.
translation_verse: Boonee, ti-naanjab fōō tantee bi-baabi cee ki kpáàa nóó Joosuwa ki kɔ́ ntimu mun nibuliŋ Unimbɔti nìn jìn̄ bi-nyɔkɔpuee poon. Niin ní tanti gbanti yúl̀ ki dāa sāā Daafiidi yuntiŋu.

english_verse: He pleased God and asked him if he could build a house of worship for the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Daafiidi gbanti bɔti nìn fáatì Unimbɔti pɔbil, ní u mēē Unimbɔti yii ú càntī ú mā ŋkɔŋkoon kí tīī úǹ, bi-naanja Jaakɔb Nimbɔtiu.

english_verse: And it was finally King Solomon who built a house for God.
translation_verse: Asee Saloomɔn di dāa máń kunimbɔtidii gbanti.

english_verse: But the Most High God doesn't live in houses made by humans. It is just as the prophet said, when he spoke for the Lord,
translation_verse: «Ama yilpu Nimbɔtiu kaa kóò adiin ŋin binib cáá bi-ŋalii ki māāyee. A lì kii Unimbɔti bɔnaatiliibi nín nìn lī puee, yii:

english_verse: “Heaven is my throne, and the earth is my footstool. What kind of house will you build for me? In what place will I rest?
translation_verse: <Ti-Dindaan bí yii: Yilpu sá m-beejal, ní kitiŋ sá m-taaŋi siinlaŋki, kudii kulɔkɔ ní ni làá gíti mā-mi, àá mpaan ŋulɔŋu ní m làá dāá kàl̄ kí ŋùŋfì?

english_verse: You stubborn and hardheaded people! You are always fighting against the Holy Spirit, just as your ancestors did.
translation_verse: Eetiyeen nìkī ki lī yii: «Nimbi binib nee yiliŋ pɔ̄ɔ̄, ni-pɔbiliŋ dátiǹ Unimbɔti, naa là kí pīlifiǹ-u mun. Baabadal ni jáà nì Circir Fam, kii ni-naanjab nín nìn ŋáań puee.

english_verse: Is there one prophet that your ancestors didn't mistreat? They killed the prophets who told about the coming of the One Who Obeys God. And now you have turned against him and killed him.
translation_verse: Bíǹ di nìn sāaǹ Unimbɔti bɔnaatiliibi kɔkɔ, ki kūū bin nìn sòon̄ ki yóoǹ yii Deedeedaan làá dāá dāan̄ee. Kɔŋkɔnnee ni nyáfì Yeesu Deedeedaanee ki kūū-u.

english_verse: Angels gave you God's Law, but you still don't obey it. Stephen Is Stoned to Death
translation_verse: Nimbi di fōō Unimbɔti tuuŋŋu cee marab ki mun di kaa là kí ŋúb́-bi.» Eetiyeen kúm

english_verse: When the council members heard Stephen's speech, they were angry and furious.
translation_verse: Bibɔsooŋkpaambee gbìl̄ mimmee, an wùn̄-bi, ní bi fōō Eetiyeen pu diŋuul tikpil ní bi-nyiŋŋi gà tɔb kàkaka.

english_verse: But Stephen was filled with the Holy Spirit. He looked toward heaven, where he saw our glorious God and Jesus standing at his right side.
translation_verse: Ama Circir Fam gbí Eetiyeen, ní u dū u-nimbikpeeŋu ki báaǹ yilpu, ki ká Unimbɔti nyooti ní Yeesu yú Unimbɔti ŋaŋgiil pú.

english_verse: Then Stephen said, “I see heaven open and the Son of Man standing at the right side of God!”
translation_verse: Ní u bí yii: «Kpèèmaan, m ká yilpu cúu pīitì, ní Yeesu Kinibiki yú Unimbɔti ŋaŋgiil pú!»

english_verse: The council members shouted and covered their ears. At once they all attacked Stephen
translation_verse: Ní bi yíkìi tátí mpɔn ki kpáà bi-tafaliŋ, ní bi-kɔkɔ yíkìń u-pu kílkil,

english_verse: and dragged him out of the city. Then they started throwing stones at him. The men who had brought charges against him put their coats at the feet of a young man named Saul.
translation_verse: ki cúú-u ki dáaĺ-u ki nyántì kitiŋ kpaanceetiŋu, ní ki yáŋkì-u ataŋkpee ki kūū. Bin nìn lēē u-pu seerakpitee nìn cáań bi-bɔkutiŋ ki bíl̀ unaacimpɔɔn un bi nìn yíì Sɔɔlee cee.

english_verse: As Stephen was being stoned to death, he called out, “Lord Jesus, please welcome me!”
translation_verse: Ŋyunti ŋun bi bíi yāŋkí Eetiyeen ataŋkpeeyee, ní u bíi mèé yii: «Ti-Dindaan Yeesu, fōō m-naŋki!»

english_verse: He knelt down and shouted, “Lord, don't blame them for what they have done.” Then he died.
translation_verse: Niinee ní Eetiyeen gbāaǹ ki téeń mpɔn yii: «Ti-Dindaan, taa dū bi-kpitii nee kí dáaĺ bi-tafal!» U lī míǹ ki dóòyee, ní ki sīntì.

english_verse: Saul started making a lot of trouble for the church. He went from house to house, arresting men and women and putting them in jail. The Good News Is Preached in Samaria
translation_verse: Sɔɔl úǹ là kí kúntí Kriisitoo nikitilee, ní ki kóò adiinni ki cútí bininjab nì binimpoobi kɔkɔ ki cáǹ ki tòó sarkan. Fiiliipi sòon̄ Unimbɔti bɔti Samaarii tiŋkin

english_verse: The Lord's followers who had been scattered went from place to place, telling the good news.
translation_verse: Bin nìn yàl̄ee nìn cá ajan sá kamaa ki sòoǹ Meesiya bɔmɔntiiti.

english_verse: Philip went to the city of Samaria and told the people about Christ.
translation_verse: Fiiliipi nìn sīntì Samaarii tiŋkin ki bíi sòoǹ Kriisitoo bɔti.

english_verse: They crowded around Philip because they were eager to hear what he was saying and to see him work miracles.
translation_verse: Ŋyunti ŋun bi gbìl̄ Fiiliipi nyɔɔbundi, ki wāĺ maamaacib bin u nìn ŋáańee, samaa kɔkɔ nìn pílifí tin u sòoǹee tiŋan.

english_verse: Many people with evil spirits were healed, and the spirits went out of them with a shout. A lot of paralyzed and lame people were also healed.
translation_verse: Kun puee arasiniibi nìn gbáà ibiil ki nyēē biwaatiibi tikpil pu, ní bifaliŋfaambi nì bideembi tikpil kántì dicáaǹdi.

english_verse: Everyone in that city was very glad because of what was happening.
translation_verse: Ní dipɔɔpiŋkpaandi nìn jéetì kitiŋ gbanti poon.

english_verse: For some time a man named Simon had lived there and had amazed the people of Samaria. He practiced witchcraft and claimed to be somebody great.
translation_verse: Uninja ubɔ nìn bí kitiŋ gbantin, bi yíì-u Siimɔn. Kijapaayee nìn sá ukpaŋkpanti ki yāntì an ŋáań Samaarii yab maamaaci u-kpaŋkpantiiku pu, ki yíì u-ba yii unikpaan.

english_verse: Everyone, rich and poor, crowded around him. They said, “This man is the power of God called ‘The Great Power.’ ”
translation_verse: Binikpaambi nì mbiyaamu kɔkɔ nìn pílifíǹ-u tiŋan, ní ki lì yii: «Unil nee di sá Unimbɔti pɔŋŋu ŋun bi yíì mpɔŋkpaanee.»

english_verse: For a long time, Simon had used witchcraft to amaze the people, and they kept crowding around him.
translation_verse: Bi nìn pílifíǹ-u tiŋan kun puee u nìn cáá u-kpaŋkpantiiku ki ŋáań maamaacib an yúntì.

english_verse: But when they believed what Philip was saying about God's kingdom and about the name of Jesus Christ, they were all baptized.
translation_verse: Fiiliipi nìn sòon̄ tibɔmɔntiil tin sá Unimbɔti Beel nì Yeesu Kriisitoo bɔtee, ní bi fōō u-bɔti ki kíí, ní bininjab nì binimpoobi yāntì bi fùl̄-bi Unimbɔti nyim.

english_verse: Even Simon believed and was baptized. He stayed close to Philip, because he marveled at all the miracles and wonders.
translation_verse: Siimɔn u-ba fōō ki kíí. Bi fùl̄-u ki dóòyee, waa ti là kí sútí kí wàatī Fiiliipi. U nín ká Fiiliipi ŋáań tidaandi nì maamaacikpaŋkpaambee, ní u bākatì tikpil.

english_verse: The apostles in Jerusalem heard that some people in Samaria had accepted God's message, and they sent Peter and John.
translation_verse: Yeesu kpambaliŋ bí Jeerusaleem ki gbìl̄ yii Samaarii yab fōō Unimbɔti bɔti ki kííyee, ní bi lēē Peetroo nì Yoowaneesi ki túnní bi-cee.

english_verse: When the two apostles arrived, they prayed that these people would be given the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Bi bāań Samaarii yab ceeyee, ní ki mēē ki tīī-bi bí ŋmā kí fōō Circir Fam,

english_verse: Before this, the Holy Spirit had not been given to any of them, though some of them had been baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.
translation_verse: kun puee Circir Fam kaa nìn dáá kpákatìń Samaarii yab báà ubɔ pu. Bi nìn pée fùl̄-bi nnyim ti-Dindaan Yeesu yindi ŋmaniŋma pu ní.

english_verse: Peter and John then placed their hands on everyone who had faith in the Lord, and they were given the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Ní Peetroo nì Yoowaneesi dū bi-ŋalii ki páaǹ Samaarii yab pu, ní bi fōō Circir Fam.

english_verse: Simon noticed that the Spirit was given only when the apostles placed their hands on the people. So he brought money
translation_verse: Siimɔn nín ká yii akpambal dū bi-ŋalii ki páaǹ bi-pu bi fōō Circir Famee, ní u tīī Peetroo nì Yoowaneesi animbil,

english_verse: and said to Peter and John, “Let me have this power too! Then anyone I place my hands on will also be given the Holy Spirit.”
translation_verse: ní ki bí-bi yii: «Tīīmaan ma mun an pɔŋŋu, un pu ní m yaa dū m-ŋalii ki páaǹee, ú fōō Circir Fam.»

english_verse: Peter said to him, “You and your money will both end up in hell if you think you can buy God's gift!
translation_verse: Ní Peetroo fātìi kíí-u yii: «A nín dākafì yii bi dù animbil kí dā Unimbɔti pɔl puee, si nì a-nimbiliŋee kɔkɔ ń ŋá fám!

english_verse: You don't have any part in this, and God sees that your heart isn't right.
translation_verse: Aa pée cáá tiba nì tiba tin bíi jītí nee poon. Kun puee a-pɔbil kaa bí deedee Unimbɔti nimbiin.

english_verse: Get rid of these evil thoughts and ask God to forgive you.
translation_verse: Fá a-landɔkɔkpitii kí mèè ti-Dindaan, an yaa yíì min min a dākafì a-pɔbilinee u làá dūú pɔ̄-si,

english_verse: I can see that you are jealous and bound by your evil ways.”
translation_verse: kun puee m wāĺ a-poon tū kii tiloolee ní ikpiti kusakai bá-si.»

english_verse: Simon said, “Please pray to the Lord, so that what you said won't happen to me.”
translation_verse: Ní Siimɔn kíí-bi yii: «Gbàam̀maan ti-Dindaan ni-ba kí tīī-mi, án nín làá ŋá pu tin kɔkɔwoooo ni sòon̄ nee tiba ń taa bàń-mee!»

english_verse: After Peter and John had preached about the Lord, they returned to Jerusalem. On their way they told the good news in many villages of Samaria. Philip and an Ethiopian Official
translation_verse: Peetroo nì Yoowaneesi lēekì seerab ki sòon̄ Unimbɔti bɔti ki dóò Samaariiyee, ní ki fātìi nín gítí Jeerusaleem ki sòoǹ Tibɔmɔntiil Samaarii timbilimmu tikpil poon. Fiiliipi nì Ueetiiyoopiija ubɔ bɔti

english_verse: The Lord's angel said to Philip, “Go south along the desert road that leads from Jerusalem to Gaza.”
translation_verse: Ní ti-Dindaan tuuŋŋu ŋubɔ tùkū Fiiliipi yii: «Yīkì kí túĺ ŋgan pú kí dī nsan ŋun sìntī Jeerusaleem ki cá Gaasaayee, nsan ŋun baa ti dèe.»

english_verse: So Philip left. An important Ethiopian official happened to be going along that road in his chariot. He was the chief treasurer for Candace, the Queen of Ethiopia. The official had gone to Jerusalem to worship
translation_verse: Ní u yíkìi búntì. Niinee, Ueetiiyoopiija ubɔ u sá ufaal ki bí Eetiiyoopii nimpubɔtiu Kandaasi cee ki sá ukàlinjakpaan. Úǹ di nìn kpèé unimpubɔtee pijawanti kɔkɔ.

english_verse: and was now on his way home. He was sitting in his chariot, reading the book of the prophet Isaiah.
translation_verse: U nìn dɔ́miń Jeerusaleem ki jáam̀ Unimbɔti ki dóòyee ki fàtīi kùǹ. U nìn kā u-tɔrɔkuu pu itaamu dátí-u ní ki kàaǹ Unimbɔti bɔnaatiliu Yeesaya gbɔŋku poon.

english_verse: The Spirit told Philip to catch up with the chariot.
translation_verse: Ní Unimbɔti Fam tùkū Fiiliipi yii: «Còom̀ kí kíntí tɔrɔku nee!»

english_verse: Philip ran up close and heard the man reading aloud from the book of Isaiah. Philip asked him, “Do you understand what you are reading?”
translation_verse: Ní Fiiliipi sáǹ ki bàn̄ee, ki gbìl̄ kijapaayee bíi kàaǹ Yeesaya Unimbɔti bɔnaatiliu gbɔŋku poon. Ní u bālifì-u yii: «A gbìl̀ a nín kàaǹ puee taapuɔɔɔ?»

english_verse: The official answered, “How can I understand unless someone helps me?” He then invited Philip to come up and sit beside him.
translation_verse: Ní u kíí-u yii: «M yaa kaa ká ubɔ ń tùkù-mi taapu, m làá ŋá mana kí gbìl̄?» Ní u mēē Fiiliipi ń jɔ̄m̀ kí kàl̄ u-cee tɔrɔkun.

english_verse: The man was reading the passage that said, “He was led like a sheep on its way to be killed. He was silent as a lamb whose wool is being cut off, and he did not say a word.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti gbɔŋku jandi din u nìn bíi kàaǹee nín tùkù-ti puee sèé: «Bi cáá-u ki cūnnì kii bi nín cáǹ upii kí kpɔ̀ puee, kii bi nín cēē dipibil kuti di ŋmí kaa sūǹ puee, míǹ ní waa nìn wāaǹ ki lī tiba.

english_verse: He was treated like a nobody and did not receive a fair trial. How can he have children, if his life is snatched away?”
translation_verse: U sīntì u-ba taapu, baa pɔ̀n̄-u. Ŋma di làá dāá ŋmā kí tùkù u-maaliŋu yab tin jítèe, kun puee bi lēē u-maŋfal duulinyan.»

english_verse: The official said to Philip, “Tell me, was the prophet talking about himself or about someone else?”
translation_verse: Ní ukàlinjee bí Fiiliipi yii: «M gbàam̄-si, ŋma pu ní Unimbɔti bɔnaatiliu sòon̄ míǹ ní? Úǹ u-ba pu ní u sòon̄ mimmaaa, ubɔ pu ní?»

english_verse: So Philip began at this place in the Scriptures and explained the good news about Jesus.
translation_verse: Niinee ní Fiiliipi yōoǹ dinyɔɔbundi ki kíĺ ki bíi sòoǹ ki tɔ́kɔ́ǹ dijandi din u kàan̄ee pu ki bíi tùkù-u Yeesu Bɔmɔntiiti.

english_verse: As they were going along the road, they came to a place where there was some water. The official said, “Look! Here is some water. Why can't I be baptized?”
translation_verse: Ní Fiiliipi kíí-u yii: «An cáá nsan bí fàl̀-si Unimbɔti nyim a yaa fōō ki kíí nì a-pɔbil kɔkɔ». Ní ukàlinjee kíí-u yii: «M fōō ki kíí yii Yeesu Kriisitoo sá Unimbɔti Jipɔɔn.»]

english_verse: He ordered the chariot to stop. Then they both went down into the water, and Philip baptized him.
translation_verse: Ní u bí yii bí yóoń tɔrɔku, ní u nì Fiiliipi liitil nín sìntī ŋkpinni, ní Fiiliipi tin fùl̄-u Unimbɔti nyim.

english_verse: After they had come out of the water, the Lord's Spirit took Philip away. The official never saw him again, but he was very happy as he went on his way.
translation_verse: Bi nyánní nnyiminee, Unimbɔti Fam yōoǹ Fiiliipi. Ní ukàlinjee kaa ti ká-u, ama ní ki nìkī u-saŋŋu nì dipɔɔpindin.

english_verse: Philip later appeared in Azotus. He went from town to town, all the way to Caesarea, telling people about Jesus.
translation_verse: Fiiliipi, úǹ tin nyáń Asooti. Niinee u sòon̄ tibɔmɔntiil ki kpáaǹ ntimbilimu mun poon u jītée ki tin bàn̄ Seesaaree.

english_verse: Saul preached with such power that he completely confused the Jewish people in Damascus, as he tried to show them that Jesus is the Messiah.
translation_verse: Ŋyunti gbantee, Sɔɔl nìn mɔ̀tīi kāntí mpɔn, ki sòoǹ ki pɔ́ɔkíǹ Juuda yab bin bí Damaasee, ki dàkà-bi yii Yeesu lafun sá Meesiya.

english_verse: Now get up and go into the city, where you will be told what to do.”
translation_verse: Yīkìí kɔ́ kitiŋin. Niin ní bi làá tùkù-si min sá á ŋée.»

english_verse: I will show him how much he must suffer for worshiping in my name.”
translation_verse: Ní man m-ba ń dāá dàkà-u falaa un u làá jī m-yindi puee.»

english_verse: When Saul arrived in Jerusalem, he tried to join the followers. But they were all afraid of him, because they did not believe he was a true follower.
translation_verse: Niinee, Sɔɔl cūtì Jeerusaleem ki bàà là kí dū u-ba kí kɔ́ǹ Yeesu boonnooliibin. Ama bi-kɔkɔ nìn fàŋkí-u, kaa nyí yii u kpántì Yeesu boonnooliu.

english_verse: and he has seen a vision. He saw a man named Ananias coming to him and putting his hands on him, so he could see again.”
translation_verse: ní m yāntì u ká sii Ananiyasi kóoń ki dū a-ŋalii ki páaǹ u-pu ú ŋmā kí wāl̀.»

english_verse: Suddenly something like fish scales fell from Saul's eyes, and he could see. He got up and was baptized.
translation_verse: Dicilpu niin ní tiba nyánní u-nimbiliŋin ki lítì kii ijɔmpɔkɔee, ní u wál̀. Ní u yíkì bi fùl̄-u Unimbɔti nyim.

english_verse: Saul kept on threatening to kill the Lord's followers. He even went to the high priest
translation_verse: Ŋyunti gbantee, Sɔɔl kaa cāntì ti-Dindaan boonnooliibi nnikpaakoon. U nìn cūtì usaraaŋakpil cee

english_verse: and asked for letters to the leaders of the synagogues in Damascus. He did this because he wanted to arrest and take to Jerusalem any man or woman who had accepted the Lord's Way.
translation_verse: ki mēē-u yii ú tīī-u tigbɔn ú cáá cùnnì Damaasi kpafidiiŋŋi kpilib cee, án nín làá ŋá pu u yaa ká biba niin bin nóó nsan gbantee, uninjeeee, unimpueeee, ú cúú-u kí bóob́ kí cáań Jeerusaleemee.

english_verse: When Saul had almost reached Damascus, a bright light from heaven suddenly flashed around him.
translation_verse: U yíkì u-saŋkindi pu ki tóob́ Damaasee, kpalaayee, ŋwalifi ŋubɔ nyánní yilpu ki māntìi tú-u ki jìliŋkī,

english_verse: He fell to the ground and heard a voice saying, “Saul! Saul! Why are you so cruel to me?”
translation_verse: ní u lítì kitiŋ. Niinee ní u gbìl̄ nneen ŋubɔ bí-u yii: «Sɔɔl, Sɔɔl, ba ŋá ní a páb́-mi míǹ?»

english_verse: “Who are you?” Saul asked. “I am Jesus,” the Lord answered. “I am the one you are so cruel to.
translation_verse: Ní u bālifì yii: «An sá sii ŋma ní, m-Dindaan?» Ní ti-Dindaan kíí-u yii: «An sá man Yeesu un a páb̀ee.

english_verse: The men with Saul stood there speechless. They had heard the voice, but they had not seen anyone.
translation_verse: Tifaandi kɔ́ bininjab u nì bin nìn nóóyee. Bi yúl̀, kaa ti ŋūǹ kí wàan̄ kí lì tiba, kun puee bi gbìl̄ nneen pu ki mun kaa wāĺ báà ubɔ.

english_verse: Saul got up from the ground, and when he opened his eyes, he could not see a thing. Someone then led him by the hand to Damascus,
translation_verse: Ní Sɔɔl yáatìi yúl̀ ki ŋúbitì u-nimbiliŋee kaa ti wāĺ. Ní bi cúú u-ŋal ki dātì-u ki cáa cūnnì Damaasi.

english_verse: and for three days he was blind and did not eat or drink.
translation_verse: Ní u kāl̀ iwiin ita, kaa wál̀, kaa jíń, kaa nyùn̄ mun.

english_verse: A follower named Ananias lived in Damascus, and the Lord spoke to him in a vision. Ananias answered, “Lord, here I am.”
translation_verse: Ama Yeesu boonnooliu ubɔ nìn bí Damaasi, bi yíì-u yii Ananiyasi. Ti-Dindaan nyántì u-ba ki dàkā-u, ní ki yíiń-u yii: «Ananiyasi!» Ní u kíí yii: «M sèé, m-Dindaan.»

english_verse: The Lord said to him, “Get up and go to the house of Judas on Straight Street. When you get there, you will find a man named Saul from the city of Tarsus. Saul is praying,
translation_verse: Ní ti-Dindaan bí-u yii: «Yīkìí dī didandi din bi yíì didancancaalee kí nyàab̀ Juuda dumpu un bi yíì Sɔɔl u sá Taarsee. Sɔɔl gbanti bíi mèé ŋwimmeem

english_verse: Ananias replied, “Lord, a lot of people have told me about the terrible things this man has done to your followers in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ní Ananiyasi kíí-u yii: «M-Dindaan, m gbìl̄ binib tikpil cee tikpitil tin uninja nee ŋá a-yab bin bí Jeerusaleemee pu.

english_verse: Now the chief priests have given him the power to come here and arrest anyone who worships in your name.”
translation_verse: U dɔ́miń doo ki cáá mpɔn ŋun bisaraaŋakpilib tīiń-u ú nīn cáa bōob̀ bin kɔkɔwoooo nóó-see.»

english_verse: The Lord said to Ananias, “Go! I have chosen him to tell foreigners, kings, and the people of Israel about me.
translation_verse: Ní ti-Dindaan bí-u yii: «Nín̄ cá, kun puee uninja gbanti di sá un m lēē ú lēē seera m-pu bin kaa sá Juuda yabee nì bi-bɔtiibi, nì Isirayeel yab kɔkɔ nimbiinee.

english_verse: Ananias left and went into the house where Saul was staying. Ananias placed his hands on him and said, “Saul, the Lord Jesus has sent me. He is the same one who appeared to you along the road. He wants you to be able to see and to be filled with the Holy Spirit.”
