english_verse: or let any part of it become a slave of evil. Give yourselves to God, as people who have been raised from death to life. Make every part of your body a slave that pleases God.
translation_verse: Ní taa ti dū ni-wunti jaŋŋi kí tīī ikpiti ń nīn cáá-ŋi ki ŋáań min kaa bí deedeeyee. Dūmaan ni-ba kɔkɔ kí tīī Unimbɔti, kii binib bin kpíì ki fīkitèe, ú nīn cáá ni-wunti jaŋŋi ki tūǹ atuun ŋin bí deedeeyee.

english_verse: Don't let sin keep ruling your lives. You are ruled by God's undeserved grace and not by the Law. Slaves Who Do What Pleases God
translation_verse: Di sá yii ikpiti kaa ti máaǹ kí nīn jīǹ ni-pu mpaan, kun puee marab kaa ti cí-ni, Unimbɔti ŋanti di kíǹ ki cí-ni. Tí dū ti-ba kí tīī deedee tundi

english_verse: What does all this mean? Does it mean we are free to sin, because we are ruled by God's gift of undeserved grace and not by the Law? Certainly not!
translation_verse: Mimmee, tí lì yii ba? Tí nīn gbíntìi ŋáań ikpiti kun puee marab kaa ti cí-ti, Unimbɔti ŋanti di kíǹ ki cí-tee puɔɔɔ? Aayee, kpataaa!

english_verse: Don't you know that you are slaves of anyone you obey? You can be slaves of sin and die, or you can be obedient slaves of God and be acceptable to him.
translation_verse: Naa nyí yii a yaa sīntiǹ a-ba taapu ki tīī unil ki tūǹ u-tundee, a kpántì uyumbu ní ki tīī udaan un a sīntiǹ a-ba ki tīīyeeee? A ŋūǹ kí sìntīǹ a-ba kí tīī ikpiti in làá cáá-si ŋkúminee, ki tí ŋūǹ kí sìntīǹ a-ba kí nīn tɔ́ Unimbɔti kí kpántí deedeedaan.

english_verse: You used to be slaves of sin. But I thank God that with all your heart you followed the example set forth in the teaching you received.
translation_verse: Ama tí jāam̀maan Unimbɔti kun puee ni nìn sá ikpiti yumbui dooooyee, ní kɔŋkɔnnee ni sīntiǹ ni-pɔbiliŋ kɔkɔ ki tīī ibaamɔn in bi dàkā-ni kii bi nín dàkà an kɔkɔ puee.

english_verse: Now you are set free from sin and are slaves who please God.
translation_verse: Ni nyáń ikpiti yuŋkun ki kɔ́ deedee tuuŋŋi yuŋkun dee.

english_verse: I am using these everyday examples, because in some ways you are still weak. You used to let the different parts of your body be slaves of your evil thoughts. But now you must make every part of your body serve God, so that you will belong completely to him.
translation_verse: Ni nín kaa gbìl̀ tibɔti taapu malaayee pu ní m dū kuyuŋu bɔti tin tin binib nyée ki dūu ŋá tibɔŋmantikaal. Di sá yii, dooooyee, ni nìn dū ni-wunti jaŋŋi ní ki tīī tijɔkɔndi, ki ŋáań min kaa kítèe ní ki mɔ̄tìi kɔ́ diyìntilin. Kɔŋkɔnnee, ní fàtīí dūmaan ni-wunti jaŋŋi kí tīī deedee tuuŋŋi kí kpántí circir nib.

english_verse: When you were slaves of sin, you didn't have to please God.
translation_verse: Dooooyee, ŋyunti ŋun ni nìn sá ikpiti yumbuyee, ni nìn tɔ́ ni-ba tiba kaa páb́-ni ní ŋá min Unimbɔti lèe.

english_verse: But what good did you receive from the things you did? All you have to show for them is your shame, and they lead to death.
translation_verse: Ba biliŋ ní ni nìn lòoǹ ní? Atuun ŋin ni nìn tūǹee, díǹ pu nee ŋi cáá-ni icoo, atuunee di cāabìń ŋkúm.

english_verse: Now you have been set free from sin, and you are God's slaves. This will make you holy and will lead you to eternal life.
translation_verse: Kɔŋkɔnnee, ni nyánní ikpitin ki kpántì Unimbɔti yumbui. Abil ŋin ni lòoǹ niinee di sá circir tuuŋŋi, ní boonee, dimaŋfal din kaa cáá dikúntilee dɔ̄ ki cí-ni.

english_verse: Sin pays off with death. But God's gift is eternal life given by Jesus Christ our Lord.
translation_verse: Tipaal tin ikpiti pèe di sá ŋkúm, ama tin tin Unimbɔti pūǹ faalaayee di sá á ŋá ubaanti nì ti-Dindaan Yeesu Kriisitoo kí ká dimaŋfal din kaa cáá dikúntilee.

english_verse: My friends, you surely understand enough about law to know that laws only have power over people who are alive.
translation_verse: Nnabiyaamu, m pàkā yii m bíi sòoǹ nì binib bin nyí marabee ní. Ni nyí yii mara cáá mpɔn unil pu ŋyunti ŋun u dáá bí dimaŋfalinee ŋmaniŋma ní.

english_verse: For example, the Law says that a man's wife must remain his wife as long as he lives. But once her husband is dead, she is free
translation_verse: Míǹ ní unimpu yaa mɔ́ǹ ticatee, mara bóob́-u ki nákáǹ u-cal ŋyunti ŋun u dáá bí dimaŋfalinee. U-cal yaa kpíìyee, mara bútì-u ki nákatiǹ u-cal un u nìn nákée dee.

english_verse: to marry someone else. However, if she goes off with another man while her husband is still alive, she is said to be unfaithful.
translation_verse: Mimmee, unimpu cal yaa dáá bí, kaa kpíì, u yaa yíkìi mɔ́ǹ ubɔee, bi ŋūǹ kí yíiń-u kinimpulaakpaai. U-cal yaa kpíìyee, mara un bóob́-u ki nákáǹ u-calee cúu bútì dee, u ŋūǹ kí mɔ̄ǹ uninjapɔɔn ubɔ. Niinee, baa ti yíì-u kilaakpaai.

english_verse: That is how it is with you, my friends. You are now part of the body of Christ and are dead to the power of the Law. You are free to belong to Christ, who was raised to life so we could serve God.
translation_verse: M-nabiyaamu, míǹ mbaantiim, ni nín kpáfì ki kpíì nì Kriisitooyee, ni-kúmee yākatì ni nì marab kansikin. Kɔŋkɔnnee, ni kíǹ ki sá Kriisitoo un fīkitì ditaŋkpiilinee yab ní. Tí lòoǹ abimɔnti kí tīī Unimbɔti.

english_verse: When we thought only of ourselves, the Law made us have sinful desires. It made every part of our bodies into slaves who are doomed to die.
translation_verse: Dooooyee, ti nín nìn dáá bí ki ŋáań ti-ba lammee, marab nìn tútúǹ ti-landɔkɔkpitii in téekí-ti, ti tūǹ atuun ŋin cáǹ-ti ŋkúminee.

english_verse: But the Law no longer rules over us. We are like dead people, and it cannot have any power over us. Now we can serve God in a new way by obeying his Spirit, and not in the old way by obeying the written Law. The Battle with Sin
translation_verse: Dooooyee, marab nìn cúú-ti kuyuŋu, ama kɔŋkɔnnee ti yākatì tɔbin, baa ti cáá ti-pu mpɔn, ti tɔ́ ti-ba. Míǹ puee, ti ŋūǹ kí tɔ̄ ditundi min ní Circir Fam kpòotī-tee, an kaa ti sá min min kugbɔŋu poon marab nìn kpòotī-ti dooooyee. Mara nì ikpiti

english_verse: Does this mean that the Law is sinful? Certainly not! But if it had not been for the Law, I would not have known what sin is really like. For example, I would not have known what it means to want something that belongs to someone else, unless the Law had told me not to do this.
translation_verse: Mimmee, tí lì yii ba? Marab sá ikpiti deeyaaa? Aayee kpataaa! An yaa kaa sá marab pu, maa bàà nyí kun di sá ikpitee. Di sá yii marab yaa kaan lī yii: «Á taa nín̄ cáá nnimbitaataam», maa bàà nyí kun bi yíì nnimbitaataamee.

english_verse: It was sin that used this command as a way of making me have all kinds of desires. But without the Law, sin is dead.
translation_verse: Marab lī mimmee, ní tikpitil ká nsan kí kɔ́ǹ-mi tiwan kɔkɔ nnimbitaataam. Di sá yii, marab yaa kpée, ikpiti kaa cáá mpɔn.

english_verse: Before I knew about the Law, I was alive. But as soon as I heard that command, sin came to life,
translation_verse: Doooo min marab nìn kpée, m nìn bí dimaŋfalin. Ama marab nín bāańee, ikpiti dɔ́miń ki fōō mpaan,

english_verse: and I died. The very command that was supposed to bring life to me, instead brought death.
translation_verse: ní man kpíì. Mimmee, marab bin bàà sá ukpootil kí cáá-mi dimaŋfalinee fātìi téé-mi ki tɔ́ ŋkúmin.

english_verse: Sin used this command to trick me, and because of it I died.
translation_verse: Ní ikpiti dī marab pu ki ká nsan ki kíil̀-mi ki kūū-mi marab gbanti pu.

english_verse: Still, the Law and its commands are holy and correct and good.
translation_verse: Marab bi-ba bí circir, ní isaŋki in bi sáŋkí-tee mun bí circir ki bí deedee ki ŋān̄.

english_verse: Am I saying something good caused my death? Certainly not! It was sin that killed me by using something good. Now we can see how terrible and evil sin really is.
translation_verse: Mimmee, tin sá tiwammɔntiilee di cáań-mi ŋkúmaaa? Aayee, kpataaa! An sá ikpiti di cáań míǹ, ki dūu dīń tiwammɔntiil pu ki kūū-mi, ki dàkā i nín sá ikpiti iŋyee mbaamɔmin. Marab puee, ti béè yii ikpiti kaa lafun sàafì. Ti là kí ŋá tiŋan ní kaa ŋūǹ

english_verse: We know that the Law is spiritual. But I am merely a human, and I have been sold as a slave to sin.
translation_verse: Ti nyí yii marab lafun sá Unimbɔti wanti. Ama ní man sá nniwuŋgban, ikpiti dá-mi kuyuŋu.

english_verse: In fact, I don't understand why I act the way I do. I don't do what I know is right. I do the things I hate.
translation_verse: Maa nyí tin m ŋáańee, kun puee maa ŋáań tin m bàà là kí ŋée, ní ki ŋáań tin tin m ná, kaa bàà là kí ŋée.

english_verse: Although I don't do what I know is right, I agree that the Law is good.
translation_verse: M yaa bíi ŋáań tin tin maa là kí ŋée, mimmee m béè yii marab ŋān̄ dee.

english_verse: So I am not the one doing these evil things. The sin that lives in me is what does them.
translation_verse: Mimmee, an dàkà yii an kaa sá man m-ba di bíi ŋáań tikpitil, an sá ikpiti in bí m-nee di ŋáań.

english_verse: I know that my selfish desires won't let me do anything that is good. Even when I want to do right, I cannot.
translation_verse: M nyí tiŋman yii tiŋan kaa bí m-ni, an dàkà yii m-wuntin. Nì min kɔkɔ m bàà cáá nlandɔkɔmɔnti kí ŋá tiŋanee, mpɔn kpá ḿ ŋmā kí ŋá.

english_verse: Instead of doing what I know is right, I do wrong.
translation_verse: Tiŋan tin m bàà là kí ŋée, maa ŋáań tíǹ, tikpitil tin maa bàà là kí ŋée, tíǹ ní m ŋáań.

english_verse: And so, if I don't do what I know is right, I am no longer the one doing these evil things. The sin that lives in me is what does them.
translation_verse: Mimmee, m yaa bíi ŋáań tin tin maa bàà là kí ŋée, an kaa ti sá mama m-ba di bíi ŋáań, an sá ikpiti in bí m-nee di bíi ŋáań.

english_verse: The Law has shown me that something in me keeps me from doing what I know is right.
translation_verse: M dáań ki ká tiba: m yaa bàà bí yii ḿ ŋá tiŋanee, tikpitil ní m ŋáań.

english_verse: But in every part of me I discover something fighting against my mind, and it makes me a prisoner of sin that controls everything I do.
translation_verse: ama m ká yii mpɔn ŋubɔ bí m-wunti nì ti-jaŋŋin ki jáaǹ kun kun m-landɔkɔŋu fáatèe, ki dū-mi ki nyáfiǹ ikpiti pɔŋŋu ŋun bí m-wuntinee.

english_verse: What a miserable person I am. Who will rescue me from this body that is doomed to die?
translation_verse: Man nimbinaamandi neeee! Tiwun nee dátí-mi ki cáǹ ŋkúmin, ŋma di làá fīī-mi kí líí?

english_verse: Thank God! Jesus Christ will rescue me. So with my mind I serve the Law of God, although my selfish desires make me serve the law of sin.
translation_verse: Tí jāam̀maan Unimbɔti ti-Dindaan Yeesu Kriisitoo un fìil̄-tee pu! Mimmee, m-landɔkɔŋu poonee, m bàà là kí nóó Unimbɔti marab, ama iwɔfi in bí m-wuntinee là kí nóó ikpiti.

english_verse: If you belong to Christ Jesus, you won't be punished.
translation_verse: Kɔŋkɔnnee, bin nì Yeesu Kriisitoo ŋá ubaantee, dibɔkpil diba kaa ti dɔ̄ ki cí-bi.

english_verse: The Holy Spirit will give you life that comes from Christ Jesus and will set you free from sin and death.
translation_verse: Di sá yii Circir Fam min tīī-ti dimaŋfal Yeesu Kriisitoo puee marau nyántì-ti ikpiti nì ŋkúm marau ŋaan.

english_verse: The Law of Moses cannot do this, because our selfish desires make the Law weak. But God set you free when he sent his own Son to be like us sinners and to be a sacrifice for our sin. God used Christ's body to condemn sin.
translation_verse: Di sá yii Mooyiisi marab kaa nìn ŋúń ki ŋá míǹ, kun puee binib bí iwɔfin, kaa ŋūǹ kí nóó marabee. Ama ní Unimbɔti dū úǹ u-ba Jipɔɔn ki túnní, u dɔ́miń ki cáá tiwumbaantiil kii timbi bikpitibee, ki ŋúń ki lēē ikpiti. Unimbɔti ŋá míǹ ki kúntì mpɔn ŋun ikpiti cáá binib puee.

english_verse: He did this, so that we would do what the Law commands by obeying the Spirit instead of our own desires.
translation_verse: Mimmee, timbi bin kaa nóó mbimbikpitim ama ní ki nóó Circir Fam nín kpòotī-ti puee, ti kpántí deedeedambi kii marab nín là puee dee.

english_verse: People who are ruled by their desires think only of themselves. Everyone who is ruled by the Holy Spirit thinks about spiritual things.
translation_verse: Bin bin nóó mbimbikpitimee nyàab̀ kí nīn ŋáań tin fáatì-bee ní, ní bin nóó Circir Famee mun nyàab̀ kí nīn ŋáań tin Circir Fam lèe.

english_verse: If our minds are ruled by our desires, we will die. But if our minds are ruled by the Spirit, we will have life and peace.
translation_verse: Mbimbikpitim nín là tiwan tiŋyee di cāabìń ŋkúm. Circir Fam nín là kun kuŋyee di cāabìń mmaŋfafɔkɔn nì ŋgbansɔŋfi.

english_verse: Our desires fight against God, because they do not and cannot obey God's laws.
translation_verse: Bin nóó bi-bimbikpitim nín là puee sá Unimbɔti nannanliibi ní. Baa sìntīǹ bi-ba ki tìì Unimbɔti marab, kaa pée ŋūǹ gba.

english_verse: If we follow our desires, we cannot please God.
translation_verse: Bin nóó bi-bimbikpitim nín là puee kaa ŋūǹ kí fáatíǹ Unimbɔti.

english_verse: You are no longer ruled by your desires, but by God's Spirit, who lives in you. People who don't have the Spirit of Christ in them don't belong to him.
translation_verse: Ama nimbee, nimbi kaa nóó ni-bimbikpitim nín là puee. Min min Unimbɔti Fam lèe, míǹ ní ni nóó, kun puee u-Fam kóò ni-ni. Un yaa kaa cáá Kriisitoo Famee, kaa sá u-yɔu.

english_verse: But Christ lives in you. So you are alive because God has accepted you, even though your bodies must die because of your sins.
translation_verse: Kriisitoo yaa bí a-ni, nì min kɔkɔ ikpiti puee a-wunti làá kpúee, Circir Fam làá tīī-si dimaŋfal, kun puee a bí deedee.

english_verse: Yet God raised Jesus to life! God's Spirit now lives in you, and he will raise you to life by his Spirit.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti un fīkitì Yeesu Kriisitoo ditaŋkpiilinee Fam yaa kóò a-nee, Unimbɔti gbanti un fīkitì Kriisitoo ditaŋkpiilinee làá dāá yàntī u-Fam min kóò a-nee ń tīī a-wunti tin kúùyee dimaŋfal.

english_verse: My dear friends, we must not live to satisfy our desires.
translation_verse: Mimmee, m-nabiyaamu, taa ti cáá ti-bimbikpitim dipɔndi diba, kí nīn ŋáań mì nín là puee.

english_verse: If you do, you will die. But you will live, if by the help of God's Spirit you say “No” to your desires.
translation_verse: Ni yaa gbíntì ki ŋáań min ni-bimbikpitim lèe, ni kúù ní. Ama Circir Fam pɔŋŋu puee, ni yaa kūū tin ni-bimbikpitim là ní ŋée, ni kāntí dimaŋfal.

english_verse: Only those people who are led by God's Spirit are his children.
translation_verse: Di sá yii bin kɔkɔwoooo Unimbɔti Fam kpòotēe sá Unimbɔti biyaamu ní.

english_verse: God's Spirit doesn't make us slaves who are afraid of him. Instead, we become his children and call him our Father.
translation_verse: Mimmee, naa ti máaǹ kí nīn gbíntìi fàŋkí kii iyumbuee, kun puee ni fōō Unimbɔti Fam min yāntì Unimbɔti fōō-ti ti yíì-u yii ti-Baayee,

english_verse: God's Spirit makes us sure that we are his children.
translation_verse: ní Circir Fam mi-ba tùkù ti-pɔbiliŋ poon yii ti sá Unimbɔti biyaamu.

english_verse: His Spirit lets us know that together with Christ we will be given what God has promised. We will also share in the glory of Christ, because we have suffered with him. A Wonderful Future for God's People
translation_verse: Ti nín sá u-biyaamu puee, ti fòol̄ u-gaajawanti. Ti nì Kriisitoo di dāa fòol̄-tì. Ti yaa kpáfì ki jīǹ falaayee, boonee ti nì u di dāa tí fòol̄ tinyool. Tinyool tin bí ki dòońee

english_verse: I am sure what we are suffering now cannot compare with the glory that will be shown to us.
translation_verse: M nyí yii falaa un ti bíi jīǹ ti-yuntiŋu nee kaa wīikí ki bàn̄ Unimbɔti nyooti tin u làá dāá tīī-tee.

english_verse: In fact, all creation is eagerly waiting for God to show who his children are.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti nín náań tiwan tin kɔkɔee jìkì ki cí ŋwiin ŋun Unimbɔti làá dāá tīī u-biyaamu tinyool báà ŋma ń kée.

english_verse: Meanwhile, creation is confused, but not because it wants to be confused. God made it this way in the hope
translation_verse: Unimbɔti wannaaŋkaati gbanti kɔkɔ ŋá fám. Kaa sá yii tì là, Unimbɔti di yāntì an ŋá míǹ. Nì min kɔkɔ tì kpántì fámee, tì máká yii

english_verse: that creation would be set free from decay and would share in the glorious freedom of his children.
translation_verse: tì làá dāá nyā ntimbiil gbanti yuŋkun kí kpāfì nì Unimbɔti biyaamu kí tɔ̄ ti-ba ní kí fōō tinyool.

english_verse: We know that all creation is still groaning and is in pain, like a woman about to give birth.
translation_verse: Ti nyí yii Unimbɔti wannaaŋkaati gbanti kɔkɔ bí falaa ni áli ki dāa sāā díǹ kii upɔdaan nín yáliŋkí imatiŋween puee.

english_verse: The Spirit makes us sure about what we will be in the future. But now we groan silently, while we wait for God to show that we are his children. This means that our bodies will also be set free.
translation_verse: Ama an kaa sá tiwannáaŋkaal gbanti baba, ki kpáaǹ timbi bin Unimbɔti tìì u-Fam min yāntì ti dáká tin bí ki dòońee. Ti mun bí ki yáliŋkíǹ ti-ba ki cí ŋyunti ŋun ti làá kpántí Unimbɔti biyaamu mbaamɔminee, an dàkà yii ŋyunti ŋun u làá dāá fīī ti-wunti mun kí lííyee.

english_verse: And this hope is what saves us. But if we already have what we hope for, there is no need to keep on hoping.
translation_verse: Mimmee, ti ká difiil, ama ní an dáá nín bí dimákalin. A yaa ká kun a mákée, an kaa ti sá dimákal, kun puee tiwan tin a fōōyee, a gíti ŋūǹ kí nīn máká ti-puɔɔɔ?

english_verse: However, we hope for something we have not yet seen, and we patiently wait for it.
translation_verse: Ti yaa máká tin taa láá kée puee, see tí jī kimɔtii kí nīn kpèé nsan pú.

english_verse: In certain ways we are weak, but the Spirit is here to help us. For example, when we don't know what to pray for, the Spirit prays for us in ways that cannot be put into words.
translation_verse: Míǹ mbaantiim ní Circir Fam bí ki tútúǹ-ti ti-wɔfii poon, kun puee taa nyí min máaǹ tí mèèyee, ama Ŋfamee mi-ba yáliŋkí ki jítiǹ anyɔɔbun nín ŋūǹ kí sòoǹ tibɔti tiŋyee ki mèé Unimbɔti ti-pu.

english_verse: All of our thoughts are known to God. He can understand what is in the mind of the Spirit, as the Spirit prays for God's people.
translation_verse: Ní Unimbɔti un wāĺ binib pɔbiliŋ poonee béetí kun Ŋfam lèe, di sá yii kun mì mèéyee nóó nì kun Unimbɔti là kí tīī u-yabee ní.

english_verse: We know that God is always at work for the good of everyone who loves him. They are the ones God has chosen for his purpose,
translation_verse: Ní ti nyí yii tin kɔkɔ pée bàń bin néeń Unimbɔtee, Unimbɔti cáa kpántí tiŋan ní ki tìì-bi. Bíǹ ní u bɔ́ntì ki lēē ki síiǹ yii bí nīn sá u-yab.

english_verse: and he has always known who his chosen ones would be. He had decided to let them become like his own Son, so his Son would be the first of many children.
translation_verse: Bin u gāntì dooooyee ní u lēē ki yóoǹ bí kpántí kii u-Jipɔɔn nín bí puee, án nín làá ŋá pu u-Jipɔɔnee ń nīn sá ukpil u-nabiyaamu mun sá kunipaauee kansikinee.

english_verse: God then accepted the people he had already decided to choose, and he has shared his glory with them. God's Love
translation_verse: Bin u lēē dooooyee ki yóoǹee, u yíiń-bi. Bin u yíińee, ní u yāntì bi kpántì deedeedambi Unimbɔti nimbiin, ní bin u yāntì bi kpántì deedeedambee, u kɔ́ǹ-bi u-nyootin. Unimbɔti neendi wīikí

english_verse: What can we say about all this? If God is on our side, can anyone be against us?
translation_verse: Ti làá gíti lì tibɔti nee pu yii ba dee? Unimbɔti yaa yú ti-boonee, ŋma di gíti ŋūǹ kí ŋá-ti tiba?

english_verse: God did not keep back his own Son, but he gave him for us. If God did this, won't he freely give us everything else?
translation_verse: Timbi pu ní Unimbɔti kaa tāaǹ úǹ u-ba Jipɔɔn ki dū-u ki ŋá saraa, mana ní u ŋūǹ kí yíí kí taa tīī-ti tikɔkɔ kí kūtì u-Jipɔɔnee pu?

english_verse: If God says his chosen ones are acceptable to him, can anyone bring charges against them?
translation_verse: Unimbɔti bí yii bin u lútèe sá deedeedambi, kin, ŋma di gíti ŋūǹ kí ká tikpitil tiba bi-pu kí sòoǹ?

english_verse: Or can anyone condemn them? No indeed! Christ died and was raised to life, and now he is at God's right side, speaking to him for us.
translation_verse: Yeesu Kriisitoo un kpíì ki kpáàa fīkitì mun ki kā Unimbɔti ŋaŋgiil púee bí ki mèé ki tìì-ti. Kin ŋma di gíti ŋūǹ kí kpɔ̀ ti-bɔti?

english_verse: Can anything separate us from the love of Christ? Can trouble, suffering, and hard times, or hunger and nakedness, or danger and death?
translation_verse: Dineendi din Kriisitoo cáá ti-puee, tiba ŋūǹ kí yàkatī ti-kansikinaaa? Falaa di ŋūǹ kí yàkatī-taaa, dinimbinaamandaaa, disàandaaa, ŋkùmaaa, disoolaaa, mbusuaaa, ŋkúm?

english_verse: It is exactly as the Scriptures say, “For you we face death all day long. We are like sheep on their way to be butchered.”
translation_verse: Kii Unimbɔti gbɔŋku poon nín lī puee yii: «Sii ti-Dindaan pu ní, kí yòon̄ kutaafaau kí dāá mɔ́-kuee, ti tūŋkí ŋkúm, ní bi ŋáań-ti kii ipii in bi cáǹ kí kpɔ̀ee.»

english_verse: In everything we have won more than a victory because of Christ who loves us.
translation_verse: Tíǹ kɔkɔ poonee, un néeń-tee tútúǹ-ti ti jáà ki jīǹ ki kúntí tikɔkɔ.

english_verse: I am sure that nothing can separate us from God's love—not life or death, not angels or spirits, not the present or the future,
translation_verse: M nyí ibaamɔn poon yii tiba kaa ŋūǹ kí yàkatī dineendi din bí timbi nì ti-Dindaan kansikinee: ŋkúmaaa, dimaŋfalaaa, Unimbɔti tuuŋyaaa, an yaa tí sá abeedambi bin baa wāĺeeyaaa, tin tin poon ti bí kɔŋkɔnneeyaaa, tin bí ki dòońeeyaaa, mpɔndambaaa,

english_verse: and not powers above or powers below. Nothing in all creation can separate us from God's love for us in Christ Jesus our Lord!
translation_verse: an yaa sá tin bí yilpuee nì tin bí taapueeyaaa, an yaa tí sá tiwannáaŋkaal tin kɔkɔ kíǹeeyaaa, báà tiba nì tiba kaa ŋūǹ kí yàkatī timbi nì dineendi din Unimbɔti dī ti-Dindaan Yeesu Kriisitoo pu ki dàkā-tee.

english_verse: I am a follower of Christ, and the Holy Spirit is a witness to my conscience. So I tell the truth and I am not lying when I say
translation_verse: M sòoǹ ibaamɔn kii Kriisitoo yɔu nín máaǹ kí sòoǹ puee ní. Maa mɔ́ntí, Circir Fam mun sòoǹ m-pɔbil poon yii an sá tiŋman,

english_verse: my heart is broken and I am in great sorrow.
translation_verse: yii m-pɔbil poon gbí kunimbaakpaaŋŋu ní m yáliŋkí baabadal.

english_verse: I would gladly be placed under God's curse and be separated from Christ for the good of my own people.
translation_verse: M yaan ŋūǹ Unimbɔti ń ŋá-mi fám, man nì Kriisitoo ń yàkatī tɔbin, m-nabiyaamu man nì bin pēē mmaalee ń ŋmā kí ká difiilee, m bàà là.

english_verse: They are the descendants of Israel, and they are also God's chosen people. God showed them his glory. He made agreements with them and gave them his Law. The temple is theirs and so are the promises that God made to them.
translation_verse: M-nabiyaamu gbanti di sá Isirayeel yab bin Unimbɔti lútì bí nīn sá u-biyaamuee. U nì u-walifiŋu nìn kóò bi-kansikin, ní u nì bi ŋá mpèé. U tīī-bi marab ki dàkā-bi min ní bi làá nīn jáaḿ-uee, ki pōoǹ-bi ipoon.

english_verse: They have those famous ancestors, who were also the ancestors of the Christ. I pray that God, who rules over all, will be praised forever! Amen.
translation_verse: Bi-naanjab sá Jaakɔb jipɔmbi saalaa nì bilee ní. A yaa kpēē tinitanee, Kriisitoo mun sá bi-maaliŋu poon, Kriisitoo un di tɔ́kɔ́ tikɔkɔ nì tikɔkɔ pu ki sá Unimbɔti un máaǹ inyɔŋki baabadal kí nīn pée cá jaanjaanee! Ameeni.

english_verse: It cannot be said that God broke his promise. After all, not all of the people of Israel are the true people of God.
translation_verse: Isirayeel yab nín kaa fōō Yeesu ki kííyee, an kaa dàkà yii Unimbɔti poondi ŋá fám. Di sá yii an kaa sá bin kɔkɔ nyánní Isirayeel maaliŋunee di sá Isirayeel yab páaa.

english_verse: In fact, when God made the promise to Abraham, he meant only Abraham's descendants by his son Isaac. God was talking only about Isaac when he promised
translation_verse: An dàkà yii an kaa sá mmaal ŋun ti nyí nee di màal̀ Unimbɔti biyaamu. Abraam naantiibi bin Unimbɔti nìn pōoǹ ki tīīyee baba di sá bimɔntiibi,

english_verse: Sarah, “At this time next year I will return, and you will already have a son.”
translation_verse: kii Unimbɔti nín nìn pōoǹ-u puee yii: «Ŋyunti ŋun m yóoǹee yaa bāańee, m làá dāan̄, ní a-nimpuu Saara ń màal̀ kibininjabiki.»

english_verse: Don't forget what happened to the twin sons of Isaac and Rebekah.
translation_verse: Tiba mun gíti sɔ̀: Reebeeka mun bɔti bí. U màl̄ ti-naanja Isaaki mbininjabiyaamu muli ní.

english_verse: Even before they were born or had done anything good or bad, the Lord told Rebekah that her older son would serve the younger one. The Lord said this to show he makes his own choices and it wasn't because of anything either of them had done.
translation_verse: Kí wàatī ú màal̀ mbiyaamu gbantee, muaa láá nyáń ki ŋá tiŋanaaa, kaa láá ŋá ikpiti, ní Unimbɔti tùkū Reebeeka yii: «Ukpil di làá dāá nīn bí kiwaai taapu,» án ŋmā kí nóó nì Unimbɔti nín lēē ki síiǹ u-ban puee. Míǹ ní u yíì binib, kaa kpèé bi-tūntɔtam pu,

english_verse: That's why the Scriptures say that the Lord liked Jacob more than Esau.
translation_verse: kii an nín ŋmàn̄ puee, yii: «M néeń Jaakɔb, ní kaa là Eesayuu.»

english_verse: Are we saying God is unfair? Certainly not!
translation_verse: Ti yaa kpēē an bɔtee, ti làá lì yii Unimbɔti kaa sá ibaamɔndaanaaa? Aayee, kpataaa!

english_verse: Everything then depends on God's mercy and not on what people want or do.
translation_verse: Mimmee, an kaa nyēeń unil nín là pueeyaaa, kaa nyēeń u-pɔ́ɔǹtam pu, Unimbɔti di sūǹ unil saai kí fīī udaan.

english_verse: In the Scriptures the Lord says to the king of Egypt, “I let you become king, so that I could show you my power and be praised by all people on earth.”
translation_verse: Unimbɔti gbɔŋku poonee, ti kāntí yii Unimbɔti tùkū Eejipiti bɔtiu yii: «Kun pu m baasii kāaǹ-si dibeelee di sá ḿ dī a-pu kí dàkà m-pɔŋŋu kí yàntī ntimu nib kɔkɔ ń béé m-yindi.»

english_verse: Everything depends on what God decides to do, and he can either have pity on people or make them stubborn. God's Anger and Mercy
translation_verse: An dàkà yii Unimbɔti yaa là kí fīī binibaaa, u yaa tí là kí nyìŋfì bi-pɔbiliŋaaa, an bí úǹ cee ní. Unimbɔti ŋuul nì u-saasɔl

english_verse: Someone may ask, “How can God blame us, if he makes us behave in the way he wants us to?”
translation_verse: An yaa yíì, ubɔ ŋūǹ kí bàlifì-mi yii: «Kin mimmee, ba pu ní Unimbɔti gíti wòoǹ nnibiyaamu? Di sá ubɔ kaa yíití min Unimbɔti lèe.»

english_verse: But, my friend, I ask, “Who do you think you are to question God? Does the clay have the right to ask the potter why he shaped it the way he did?
translation_verse: M làá kíí udaan yii: «Unil, a sá ŋma ní ki kpākantí Unimbɔti? Tiwan tin bi máńee kaa ŋūǹ kí tùkù un máń-tèe yii: <Ba pu ní a máń-mi yéè?>»

english_verse: Doesn't a potter have the right to make a fancy bowl and a plain bowl out of the same lump of clay?”
translation_verse: Uyɔɔmaati ŋūǹ kí dū kuyɔkɔu kí mā kun kun u yaa lèe: u ŋūǹ kí dū-ku kí mā dibɔmɔntiil, ki tí ŋūǹ kí dūú mā kinyinsaŋ.

english_verse: God wanted to show his anger and reveal his power against everyone who deserved to be destroyed. But instead, he patiently put up with them.
translation_verse: Kin Unimbɔti fáà? U cáá nsan kí gíí diŋuul kí dàkà binib u-pɔŋŋu. U jíń kimɔtii tikpil bin bàà máaǹ ditafadaaldi ki ŋmāntì ú kúntí-bee pu,

english_verse: He did this by showing how glorious he is when he has pity on the people he has chosen to share in his glory.
translation_verse: ní ki kpáàa là kí dàkà u-nyooti nín wīikí pu tikpil tikpil ki tīī bin u fīī ki bɔ́ntì ki yóoǹ bí kɔ́ u-nyootinee.

english_verse: just as the Lord says in the book of Hosea, “Although they are not my people, I will make them my people. I will treat with love those nations that have never been loved.
translation_verse: Míǹ ní u lī Ooseeya gbɔŋku poon yii: «Bin kaa nìn sá m-nibulee làá dāá nīn kíǹ ki sá m-nibul, ní ditimbundi din maa nìn néeńee, m làá nīn kíǹ ki néeń-dì tikpil.

english_verse: “Once they were told, ‘You are not my people.’ But in that very place they will be called children of the living God.”
translation_verse: Ní laakin bi nìn tùkū-bi yii: <Naa sá man nibulee>, niin ní bi làá yíiń-bi yii Unimbɔti un bí dimaŋfalinee jipɔmbi.»

english_verse: And this is what the prophet Isaiah said about the people of Israel, “The people of Israel are as many as the grains of sand along the beach. But only a few who are left will be saved.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti bɔnaatiliu Yeesaya mun báakì ki sòon̄ Isirayeel yab bɔti yii: «Báà Isirayeel naantiibi yaa wīikí kii dibul din bí tiŋku gbandee, bi-kansikin binib fiii di làá kíń kí ŋmátí.

english_verse: The Lord will be quick and sure to do on earth what he has warned he will do.”
translation_verse: Di sá yii ti-Dindaan làá ŋá tin tin kɔkɔ u sòon̄ ki síiǹ yii u làá ŋá kitiŋ puee malaa.»

english_verse: Isaiah also said, “If the Lord All-Powerful had not spared some of our descendants, we would have been destroyed like the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah.” Israel and the Good News
translation_verse: Yeesaya gbanti di nìn gíti sòon̄ tibɔti nee ki yóoǹ dooooyee, yii: «Ti-Dindaan Mpɔŋkɔdaan yaa kaa bàà kíǹ ti-maaliŋu poon binib bibee, ti bàà kpántì kii Soodoom tiŋkee ní, ki bàà kíǹ ki náań nì Goomoora tiŋkee.» Isirayeel nì fookii un tìì difiilee

english_verse: What does all of this mean? It means that the Gentiles were not trying to be acceptable to God, but they found that he would accept them if they had faith.
translation_verse: Tibɔti tin ti sòon̄ee, ti làá kúntí-tì yii ba? Bin kaa sá Juuda yab, kaa nìn nyàab̀ kí nīn bí deedeeyee di kpántì deedeedambi Unimbɔti nimbiin, kun puee bi fōō-u ki kíí.

english_verse: It also means that the people of Israel were not acceptable to God. And why not? It was because they were trying to be acceptable by obeying the Law instead of by having faith in God. The people of Israel fell over the stone that makes people stumble,
translation_verse: Ba yì-tì? Kun puee bi dàkafī yii bi-tuuŋŋi pu ní bi ŋūǹ kí nīn bí deedee, kaa nyàab̀ kí fōō Unimbɔti kí kíí kí nīn bí deedee. Bi gbéetì ditaŋkpal

english_verse: just as God says in the Scriptures, “Look! I am placing in Zion a stone to make people stumble and fall. But those who have faith in that one will never be disappointed.”
translation_verse: din pu Unimbɔti gbɔŋku nìn ŋmàn̄ee yii: «Kpèè, m bíl̀ ditaŋkpagbéetikaal Siiyɔn, ditaŋkpal din líikí binibee. Un yaa fōō-dì ki kííyee, icoo kaa làá jī udaan.»

english_verse: Dear friends, my greatest wish and my prayer to God is for the people of Israel to be saved.
translation_verse: Nnabiyaamu, m-pɔbil poon nín là miŋyee nì tin tin m mèé Unimbɔti Isirayeel yab puee di sá bí ká difiil.

english_verse: I know they love God, but they don't understand
translation_verse: M ká bi-pɔ́ɔǹtam dinimbɔtinoolin, ama, bi-pɔ́ɔǹtam gbantee, baa béè ki dóò.

english_verse: what makes people acceptable to him. So they refuse to trust God, and they try to be acceptable by obeying the Law.
translation_verse: Di sá yii baa béè min ní Unimbɔti dì ki kpántí binib deedeedambi u-nimbiinee, ní ki bíi nyàab̀ bi-ba saŋŋu ŋun bi làá dī kí kpántí deedeedambee. Bi yíì, kaa sīntì bi-ba taapu Unimbɔti ń kpántí-bi deedeedambi.

english_verse: But Christ makes the Law no longer necessary for those who become acceptable to God by faith. Anyone Can Be Saved
translation_verse: Kriisitoo di dɔ́miń ki kúntì marab dītam. Kɔŋkɔnnee, bin kpántì deedeedambee di sá bin kɔkɔ fōō Kriisitoo ki kííyee. Ti-Dindaan fìil̄ bin kɔkɔ fōō-u ki kííyee

english_verse: Moses said a person could become acceptable to God by obeying the Law. He did this when he wrote, “If you want to live, you must do all the Law commands.”
translation_verse: Mooyiisi nìn ŋmàn̄ marab dītam nín cāabìń deedee uŋyee yii: «Un yaa nóó marab deedeeyee kāntí difiil bi-pu.»

english_verse: But people whose faith makes them acceptable to God will never ask, “Who will go up to heaven to bring Christ down?”
translation_verse: Ama deedee un nyēeń fookiinee nín sá puee sɔ̀. Unimbɔti gbɔŋku sòoǹ yii: «A-pɔbil poonee, taa lì yii, ŋma di ŋūǹ kí jɔ̄m̀ yilpu?» ,

english_verse: Neither will they ask, “Who will go down into the world of the dead to raise him to life?”
translation_verse: kí taa tí lì yii: «Ŋma di ŋūǹ kí sìntī taapu ditaŋkpiilin?»

english_verse: All who are acceptable because of their faith simply say, “The message is as near as your mouth or your heart.” And this is the same message we preach about faith.
translation_verse: Mimmee, tí lì yii ba? Unimbɔti gbɔŋku lī yii: «Dinyɔɔbundi gbanti bí ki kɔ́ĺ-si, ki bí a-nyɔkɔn nì a-pɔbilin.» Dinyɔɔbundi gbanti di sá fookii bɔti tin ti sòoǹee, yii.

english_verse: So you will be saved, if you honestly say, “Jesus is Lord,” and if you believe with all your heart that God raised him from death.
translation_verse: A yaa lī binib cee yii Yeesu sá a-Dindaan ki yaa fōō ki kíí a-pɔbilin yii Unimbɔti fīkitì-u ditaŋkpiilinee, a làá ká difiil.

english_verse: God will accept you and save you, if you truly believe this and tell it to others.
translation_verse: Di sá yii un kamaa yaa fōō Yeesu ki kíí u-pɔbil poonee kpántí deedeedaan u-nimbiin, ní un yaa lī u-nyɔkɔn yii u fōō-u ki kííyee, udaan kāntí difiil,

english_verse: The Scriptures say no one who has faith will be disappointed,
translation_verse: kii Unimbɔti gbɔŋku poon nín lī puee yii: «Un kamaa yaa fōō ti-Dindaan ki kííyee, icoo kaa jīǹ udaan.»

english_verse: no matter if that person is a Jew or a Gentile. There is only one Lord, and he is generous to everyone who asks for his help.
translation_verse: Mimmee, digàntil kaa bí un sá Juuda yɔuee nì un kaa sá Juuda yɔuee kansikin. Bi-kɔkɔ Dindaan sá ubaanti ní. Úǹ ŋáań bin kɔkɔ yíì u-yindi ú fīī-bee tiŋan tikpil,

english_verse: All who call out to the Lord will be saved.
translation_verse: kii an nín ŋmàn̄ puee yii: «Un kamaa yaa yíiń ti-Dindaan yindee kāntí difiil.»

english_verse: How can people have faith in the Lord and ask him to save them, if they have never heard about him? And how can they hear, unless someone tells them?
translation_verse: Ama, bi yaa kaa fōō-u ki kíí, bi làá ŋá mana kí yíiń-u? Bi yaa kaa gbìl̄ u-pu, mana ní bi làá fōō-u kí kíí? Ubɔ yaa kaa bíi sòoǹ u-pu, mana ní bi làá gbìl̄?

english_verse: And how can anyone tell them without being sent by the Lord? The Scriptures say it is a beautiful sight to see even the feet of someone coming to preach the good news.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti yaa kaa túnní binib, mana ní bi làá sòoǹ-tì? Kii an nín ŋmàn̄ puee yii: «Bin sòoǹ Tibɔmɔntiilee nín dòoń bi-taaŋi ŋānní puee.»

english_verse: Yet not everyone has believed the message. For example, the prophet Isaiah asked, “Lord, has anyone believed what we said?”
translation_verse: Ama bi-kɔkɔ kaa fōō tibɔmɔntiilee ki kíí, kii Yeesaya nín lī puee yii: «Ti-Dindaan, an kaa sá binib fiii di fōō ti-bɔti ki kííii?»

english_verse: No one can have faith without hearing the message about Christ.
translation_verse: Mimmee bi gbìl̀ ní ki nín fōō ki kíí, ní tin bi gbìl̄ ki fōō ki kííyee sá Kriisitoo bɔti.

english_verse: But am I saying that the people of Israel did not hear? No, I am not! The Scriptures say, “The message was told everywhere on earth. It was announced all over the world.”
translation_verse: Míǹ puee, Isirayeel yab kaa gbìl̄ tibɔmɔntiilee naaa? Bi gbìl̄-tì. An nóó nì min an ŋmàn̄ee dee, yii: «Kitiŋ kɔkɔ gbìl̄ bi-neeŋyi pu, ní tibɔti tin bi sòoǹee bàn̄ kitiŋgbeennyɔkɔ.»

english_verse: Did the people of Israel understand or not? Moses answered this question when he told that the Lord had said, “I will make Israel jealous of people who are a nation of nobodies. I will make them angry with people who don't understand a thing.”
translation_verse: Mimmee, Isirayeel yab kaa gbìl̄ tibɔtee taapu naaa? Dooooyee ní Mooyiisi nìn pée sòon̄ bi-pu yii: «Man Unimbɔti làá yàntī binib bin kaa bí tibanee ń nīn jīǹ mmɔn, ní án nīn wù nimbi, kí yàntī ní fōō diŋuul binib bin kaa nyí iciinee pu.»

english_verse: Isaiah was fearless enough to tell that the Lord had said, “I was found by people who were not looking for me. I appeared to the ones who were not asking about me.”
translation_verse: Ní Yeesaya mun sòon̄ ki cántì yii: «Bin bin kaa nìn nyàab̀ man Unimbɔtee ká-mi, ní m cáá m-ba ki dàkā bin kaa bàlifī m-puee.»

english_verse: And Isaiah said about the people of Israel, “All day long the Lord has reached out to people who are stubborn and refuse to obey.”
translation_verse: Ama tin u sòon̄ Isirayeel yab puee sèé: «M tāntì m-ŋalii kutaafaau áli kujoou ki yíìń bin kaa tɔ́-mi, bi-yiliŋ pɔ̄ɔ̄yee.»

english_verse: Am I saying that God has turned his back on his people? Certainly not! I am one of the people of Israel, and I myself am a descendant of Abraham from the tribe of Benjamin.
translation_verse: Mimmee, Unimbɔti fá Isirayeel yab naaa? Aayee, kpataaa! Kun puee man m-ba sá Isirayeel ní, ki sá Abraam naantiiu, ní ki sá Beenjameen naakookun.

english_verse: God did not turn his back on his chosen people. Don't you remember reading in the Scriptures how Elijah complained to God about the people of Israel?
translation_verse: Unimbɔti kaa fá u-nikitil din pu u pée nyí dooooyee. Naa kalin nyí Unimbɔti gbɔŋku nín sòon̄ pu dijandi din sòoǹ Eelii nín nìn bíi kɔ́kɔĺ Isirayeel yab Unimbɔti nimbiin pueeee? U bí yii:

english_verse: He said, “Lord, they killed your prophets and destroyed your altars. I am the only one left, and now they want to kill me.”
translation_verse: «Ti-Dindaan, bi kūū a-bɔnaatiliibi ki wīī a-saraafaŋyi, an pée kíǹ man baba ní, ní bi nyàab̀ kí kpɔ̀ ma mun!»

english_verse: This means that only a chosen few of the people of Israel found what all of them were searching for. And the rest of them were stubborn,
translation_verse: Tibɔti nee taapu sá yii ba dee? Isirayeel yab nín nyàab̀ kuŋyee, baa ká kudɔŋu, see bin Unimbɔti lútèe baba di ká kudɔŋu, ní u yāntì bin kíǹee kaa ŋūǹ kí gbìl̄ taapu,

english_verse: It is the same way now. God treated the people of Israel with undeserved grace, and so a few of them are still his followers.
translation_verse: Míǹ mbaantiim, ti-yuntiŋu nee, an kíǹ binib fiii bin Unimbɔti ŋá tiŋan ki lútì-bee.

english_verse: This happened because of God's undeserved kindness and not because of anything they have done. It could not have happened except for God's gift of undeserved grace.
translation_verse: U ŋá bidambi tiŋan ní ki lútì-bi, an kaa sá bi-tunnyaaŋku pu. An yaan sá bi-tunnyaaŋku puee, mimmee Unimbɔti kaa ti ŋá-bi tiŋan dee.

english_verse: just as the Scriptures say, “God made them so stupid that their eyes are blind, and their ears are still deaf.”
translation_verse: kii an nín ŋmàn̄ puee yii: «Unimbɔti tātì bi-lammi, ki yāntì bi-nimbiliŋ kaa wāĺ, bi-tafaliŋ kpáá, áli ki dāa sāā díǹ.»

english_verse: Then David said, “Turn their meals into bait for a trap, so that they will stumble and be given what they deserve.
translation_verse: Daafiidi mun lī yii: «Bi-jinti ń kpántí-bi kutaliŋŋu, kí nīn sá-bi kulaaŋŋu, bí lítí ikpitin kí ká ditafadaaldi din máaǹee,

english_verse: Blindfold their eyes! Don't let them see. Bend their backs beneath a burden that will never be lifted.” Gentiles Will Be Saved
translation_verse: bi-nimbiliŋ ń jɔ̀b̄ kí taa nín̄ wāĺ! Yàntī bí nīn pée bōō baabadal.»

english_verse: Do I mean that the people of Israel fell, never to get up again? Certainly not! Their failure made it possible for the Gentiles to be saved, and this will make the people of Israel jealous.
translation_verse: Ḿ bàlifì tibɔti nee: Mimmee, Juuda yab nín gbéetèe, bi lítì kɔkɔɔɔ? Aayee, kpataaa! Ama bi-lítitamee di yāntì atimbun ŋin kɔkɔ kíǹee ká difiil, án nín làá ŋá pu bi yaa ká bin béeyee, bi mun ń nyàab̀ee.

english_verse: But if the rest of the world's people were helped so much by their sin and loss, they will be helped even more by their full return.
translation_verse: Bi-yìntitam yaa cáań kitiŋ kɔkɔ nib tiwammɔntiilee, ní bi nín wáŋkì puee yaa cáań bin kaa sá Juuda yabee tiwammɔntiilee, kin Juuda yab kɔkɔ yaa fātìń Unimbɔti ceeyee, kun an làá cáańee làá nīn bí mana dee? Bin kaa sá Juuda yabee fiil

english_verse: I am now speaking to you Gentiles, and as long as I am an apostle to you, I will take pride in my work.
translation_verse: Kɔŋkɔnnee, m sòoǹ nì nimbi bin kaa sá Juuda yabee ní. Man sá Yeesu kpambal din u tú bin kaa sá Juuda yabee ceeyee ní, ní an mɔ̄ǹ-mi ditundi din u tīī-mee pu.

english_verse: I hope in this way to make some of my own people jealous enough to be saved.
translation_verse: M-landɔkɔŋu sá yii ḿ téé m-nabiyaamu Juuda yab bí nyàab̀ kí ká kun bin béeyee cááyee, ḿ ŋmā kí fīī bi-kansikin biba.

english_verse: When Israel rejected God, the rest of the people in the world were able to turn to him. So when God makes friends with Israel, it will be like bringing the dead back to life.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti nín yíì Juuda yab bí taa nín̄ gíti sá u-yabee di ŋáŋkì binib bin kɔkɔ kíǹee nì Unimbɔti kansikin. Mimmee, u yaa láa fātìi fōō Juuda yabee, án làá dāá nīn bí mana dee? An dāa sá bin nìn kpíìyee dimaŋfal ní.

english_verse: If part of a batch of dough is made holy by being offered to God, then all of the dough is holy. If the roots of a tree are holy, the rest of the tree is holy too.
translation_verse: Bi yaa nìn cáań tijincɔ̀fikaal ki tīī Unimbɔtee, tin kíǹee muee, úǹ di yì. Unimbɔti di yaa yì busubu nyaaŋyee, úǹ di yì asupan mun.

english_verse: You Gentiles are like branches of a wild olive tree made to be part of a cultivated olive tree. You have taken the place of some branches that were cut away from it. And because of this, you enjoy the blessings that come from being part of that cultivated tree.
translation_verse: Bi yaa gāā ɔliifi bumɔŋkisubu paŋŋi aba ní ki gāań sii kumooun subu pandi ki cáań ki túkuǹ ŋin béeyee paaŋyi pu, ní a kíǹ ki fòol̄ busumɔntiibuee nyaaŋyi kpiimee,

english_verse: But don't think you are better than the branches that were cut away. Just remember you are not supporting the roots of this tree. Its roots are supporting you.
translation_verse: sii ń taa nín̄ lámintí ki dàkà apan ŋin bi gāā ki fée. A yaa bíi lámintée, á béé yii an kaa sá sii di tú inyaan, inyaan di tú sii.

english_verse: Maybe you think those branches were cut away, so you could be put in their place.
translation_verse: A ŋūǹ kí lì yii: «Bi gāā apanee ki fá ní ki cáań man ki túkuǹ.»

english_verse: That's true enough. But they were cut away because they did not have faith, and you are where you are because you do have faith. So don't be proud, but be afraid.
translation_verse: Tiŋman bi lafun gāā-ŋi ki fá, kun puee baa cáá fookii ní sii fookiiu puee ní a túkú niin. Míǹ puee, á fàŋkì kí taa nín̄ lámintí.

english_verse: If God cut away those natural branches, couldn't he do the same to you?
translation_verse: Di sá yii Unimbɔti yaa kaa tāaǹ bumɔŋkisubu paŋŋee, á nīn nyí yii waa làá dāá tàan̄ si mun.

english_verse: Now you see both how kind and how hard God can be. He was hard on those who fell, but he was kind to you. And he will keep on being kind to you, if you keep on trusting in his kindness. Otherwise, you will be cut away too.
translation_verse: Nín̄ nyí Unimbɔti ŋanti nì u-tafadaaldi pu! U dáaĺ bin bin lítèe tafal, ní ki ŋá sii tiŋan. Á nīn gbíntìi bí u-ŋanti gbantin, an yaa kaa sá míǹ, see ú dāá gāā-si kí fá.

english_verse: If those other branches will start having faith, they will be made a part of that tree again. God has the power to put them back.
translation_verse: Bíǹ yaa kpántì bi-bimbim ki fōō Yeesu ki kííyee, u ŋūǹ kí fàtīí gíiǹní-bi kí túkuń laakin u nìn gāā-bee. Di sá yii Unimbɔti cáá mpɔn kí gíiǹ-bi kí túkuń mpɔm.

english_verse: After all, it wasn't natural for branches to be cut from a wild olive tree and to be made part of a cultivated olive tree. So it is much more likely that God will join the natural branches back to the cultivated olive tree. The People of Israel Will Be Brought Back
translation_verse: Kpèè, sii kumooun supandi din bi gāāyee, bi cáań-si ki túkuǹ bumɔŋkisubu bun kaa sá a-suyilee pu. Mimmee, an kaa pɔ̄ɔ̄ bí gíiǹní asupan ŋin bi gāāyee kí túkuń disuyil din pu ŋi nìn bí, bi gāā-ŋee. Isirayeel yab kɔkɔ làá ká difiil

english_verse: My friends, I don't want you Gentiles to be too proud of yourselves. So I will explain the mystery of what has happened to the people of Israel. Some of them have become stubborn, and they will stay like that until the complete number of you Gentiles has come in.
translation_verse: M-nabiyaamu, m là ní béé ibaamɔn iba i bí dibalin, án nín làá ŋá pu ní taa nín̄ yíì ni-ba yii biciŋfitiibee. Di sá yii Isirayeel yab dijandi kaa ŋūǹ kí gbìl̄ tibɔti nee taapu, kí dāá sāā ŋyunti ŋun ntimu mun kɔkɔ kíǹee yab ń dāá kɔ́ difiilinee.

english_verse: In this way all of Israel will be saved, as the Scriptures say, “From Zion someone will come to rescue us. Then Jacob's descendants will stop being evil.
translation_verse: Min ní Isirayeel yab kɔkɔ làá ká difiilee dee, kii an nín pée ŋmàn̄ puee yii: «Ufiil làá nyānní Siiyɔn ní kí lēē ikpiti in bí Jaakɔb yab kansikinee kí fá.

english_verse: This is what the Lord has promised to do when he forgives their sins.”
translation_verse: Man Unimbɔti yaa láa lēē bi-kpitii ki fée, an di dāa sá dipoondi din m pōoǹ-bee.»

english_verse: The people of Israel are treated as God's enemies, so the good news can come to you Gentiles. But they are still the chosen ones, and God loves them because of their famous ancestors.
translation_verse: A yaa kpēē bi nín fá Tibɔmɔntiil puee, bi kpántì Unimbɔti nannanliibi nimbi ń ká difiil. A yaa kpēē Unimbɔti nín lútì-bi puee, bi sá bin u néeńee bi-naanjab pu.

english_verse: God doesn't take back the gifts he has given or disown the people he has chosen.
translation_verse: Di sá yii Unimbɔti yaa pú ubɔ diyimɔɔl diba, àá u yaa tí yíiń ubɔee, waa kpántí u-landɔkɔŋu.

english_verse: At one time you Gentiles rejected God. But now Israel has rejected God, and you have been shown mercy.
translation_verse: Dooooyee, naa nìn tɔ́ Unimbɔti, ama, Juuda yab nín nìn yíì, kaa fōō u-bɔti puee ní u súń ni-saai kɔŋkɔnnee ki fīī-ni.

english_verse: And because of the mercy shown to you, they will also be shown mercy.
translation_verse: Míǹ mbaantiim, Juuda yab kaa tɔ́ Unimbɔti kɔŋkɔnnee ní Unimbɔti súń ni-saai, ama an sá bi mun ń ŋmā kí ká kɔŋkɔnnee Unimbɔti saasɔl ní.

english_verse: All people have disobeyed God, and that's why he treats them as prisoners. But he does this, so that he can have mercy on all of them.
translation_verse: Mimmee, Unimbɔti yāntì binib kɔkɔ gbíntì bi-yìntitam poon, ú ŋmā kí dàkà bi-kɔkɔ u nín sūǹ binib saai puee dee. Pɔɔl pàkà Unimbɔti ciiŋyi

english_verse: Who can measure the wealth and wisdom and knowledge of God? Who can understand his decisions or explain what he does?
translation_verse: Óo, Unimbɔti ciiŋyi nì u-nyítam nì u-ŋanti wīikéeee, an kaa cáá bi lì! U nín ŋáań u-bɔti miŋyee, unil kaa ŋūǹ kí béé, ní min min u lēē ki làá ŋée, unil kaa ŋūǹ kí gbìl̄ taapu,

english_verse: “Has anyone known the thoughts of the Lord or given him advice?
translation_verse: kun puee, kii Unimbɔti gbɔŋku poon nín lī puee yii: «Ŋma di ŋūǹ kí béé ti-Dindaan landɔkɔŋu? Ŋma di ŋūǹ kí sāŋkì-u mun?

english_verse: Has anyone loaned something to the Lord that must be repaid?”
translation_verse: Ŋma di péé ki tīī-u tiba ní an sá yii ú fàtīí téeǹ udaan?»

english_verse: Everything comes from the Lord. All things were made because of him and will return to him. Praise the Lord forever! Amen.
translation_verse: Úǹ di náań tikɔkɔ, úǹ di ŋúb́ tikɔkɔ, ní an kɔkɔ bí ki tīī-u. Unimbɔti gbanti ń ká tinyool kí nīn cá jaanjaan! Ameeni.

english_verse: Dear friends, God is good. So I beg you to offer your bodies to him as a living sacrifice, pure and pleasing. That's the most sensible way to serve God.
translation_verse: Nnabiyaamu, kii Unimbɔti nín dàkā-ti u-saasɔl puee, m mèé-ni yii ní dū ni-wunti kí tīī Unimbɔti kii saraa un bí circir kaa kpíì, ki fáatì-uee. An di làá nīn sá-ni dinimbɔtinoobaamɔndi din máaǹ ní nóóyee.

english_verse: Don't be like the people of this world, but let God change the way you think. Then you will know how to do everything that is good and pleasing to him.
translation_verse: Taa dūmaan ni-ba kí nántíǹ waanee bimbim, ama ní yàntī Unimbɔti ń pɔ̄-ni ilandɔkɔpɔɔn kí kpántí ni-bimbim. Míǹ ní ni ŋūǹ kí béé min ní Unimbɔti lèe, min ŋān̄ ki fáatì-u ki sá mmɔntiimee.

english_verse: I realize God has treated me with undeserved grace, and so I tell each of you not to think you are better than you really are. Use good sense and measure yourself by the amount of faith that God has given you.
translation_verse: Diyimɔɔl din Unimbɔti pú-mee puee ní m ŋūǹ kí tùkù ni-kɔkɔ yii ní taa nín̄ yòontí ni-ba yilpu min kaa máaǹee, ama nín̄ cáámaan ilandɔkɔ in kítì ki nóó nì fookii un Unimbɔti yākatì ki pú báà ŋmee.

english_verse: A body is made up of many parts, and each of them has its own use.
translation_verse: Kii tiwun nín sá tibaantiil ki cáá ajan tikpil, ŋi-tuuŋŋi kaa pēē puee,

english_verse: That's how it is with us. There are many of us, but we each are part of the body of Christ, as well as part of one another.
translation_verse: míǹ mbaantiim, ti nín wīikí min nee, Kriisitoo di kpáfì-ti tiwumbaantiil, ní báà ŋma túkú u-laŋki u-laŋki.

english_verse: God has also given each of us different gifts to use. If we can prophesy, we should do it according to the amount of faith we have.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti pú-ti diyimɔɔl ki yākatì báà ŋma u-pɔl, tí nīn cáa tūǹ atuun ŋin bí aba abee. Míǹ puee, sii un u-Fam tìì tibɔti a nàatēe, nín̄ nàatī án nīn nóó nì u nín tīī-si fookii uŋyee.

english_verse: If we can serve others, we should serve. If we can teach, we should teach.
translation_verse: Sii un u yaa tīī á nīn sá bin kíǹee tɔntɔnliuee, á nīn tūǹ ki tìì-bi. Sii un dàkèe, á dū a-ba kí tīī a-dàkatam.

english_verse: If we can encourage others, we should encourage them. If we can give, we should be generous. If we are leaders, we should do our best. If we are good to others, we should do it cheerfully. Rules for Christian Living
translation_verse: Sii un tìì binib kunyannyaauee, a mun ń dū a-ba kí tīiǹ kunyannyaau ditiil. Sii un pūǹ tiwanee, á nīn pūǹ nì dipɔbil diba. Sii un kpòotēe, á nīn kpòotī nì difaŋgiil. Sii un tútúǹ bifalaadambee, á tūtuǹ-bi nì dipɔɔpindi.

english_verse: Be sincere in your love for others. Hate everything that is evil and hold tight to everything that is good.
translation_verse: Ni-neendi ń taa nín̄ cáá mpoonnyoon. Ní nīn ná ikpiti, kí dū ni-ba kí nákáǹ tiŋan mmɔntiim.

english_verse: Love each other as brothers and sisters and honor others more than you do yourself.
translation_verse: Nín̄ néeḿmaan tɔb tiŋan kii nnabiyaamu nín néeń tɔb puee, kí nīn sá bipeekaabi ki tɔ́ bin kíǹee.

english_verse: Never give up. Eagerly follow the Holy Spirit and serve the Lord.
translation_verse: Ní nīn tūm̀maan ditundi nì difaŋgiil kí taa nín̄ sá biwutijoodambi, kí nīn pɔ̄ɔntí ki tūm̀maan ti-Dindaan tundi nì ni-pɔbiliŋ kɔkɔ.

english_verse: Let your hope make you glad. Be patient in time of trouble and never stop praying.
translation_verse: Án nīn mɔ̄ǹ-ni dimákal din ni cááyee pu, kí jīmaan kimɔtii falaa poon, kí nīn mèé múlmul.

english_verse: Take care of God's needy people and welcome strangers into your home.
translation_verse: Tūtum̀maan biwɔfib bin nóó Unimbɔtee, kí nīn fòol̄ binicambi bin kóò ni-puee nì mmɔn.

english_verse: Ask God to bless everyone who mistreats you. Ask him to bless them and not to curse them.
translation_verse: Mèèmaan yii Unimbɔti ń ŋá bin sàantí-nee tiŋan, ní nīn nyàab̀ bi-ŋanti kí taa nín̄ nyàab̀-bi tikpitil.

english_verse: When others are happy, be happy with them, and when they are sad, be sad.
translation_verse: Bin yaa bí dipɔɔpindinee, ní kūtì bi-pu, ni-kɔkɔ ń fàal̀maan. Bin yaa tí bíi sūǹee, ní kūtì bi mun pu, ni-kɔkɔ ń sɔ̄.

english_verse: Be friendly with everyone. Don't be proud and feel that you know more than others. Make friends with ordinary people.
translation_verse: Nín̄ mɔ̄maan tɔb cee. Ní taa nín̄ sá bin néeń timɔnee. Nín̄ sìntīmaan ni-ba taapu, kí taa dàkafìmaan yii ni sá biciŋfitiibi.

english_verse: Don't mistreat someone who has mistreated you. But try to earn the respect of others,
translation_verse: Ubɔ yaa ŋá-ni tikpitilee, ní taa dū tikpitil kí téeǹ-u. Pɔ́ɔm̀maan kí ŋá min kítèe binib kɔkɔ nimbiin.

english_verse: and do your best to live at peace with everyone.
translation_verse: Ni yaa ŋūǹee, ní yàntī ŋgbansɔŋfi ń nīn bí ni nì báà ŋma kansikin, tiba ń taa nyānní ni-cee.

english_verse: Dear friends, don't try to get even. Let God take revenge. In the Scriptures the Lord says, “I am the one to take revenge and pay them back.”
translation_verse: M-nabineeŋkaamu, ní taa tɔ̀maan ni-ba ipɔntoon. Yàntīmaan Unimbɔti ŋuul ń tɔ̄ di-tundi, kun puee an ŋmàn̄ yii: «Ti-Dindaan bí yii: Man di làá dāá tɔ̀ ipɔntoon, man di làá dāá pà bi-tuuŋŋi paati.

english_verse: The Scriptures also say, “If your enemies are hungry, give them something to eat. And if they are thirsty, give them something to drink. This will be the same as piling burning coals on their heads.”
translation_verse: Ama, ŋkùm yaa cáá a-nannanliu, á tīī-u tijin ú jī. Nnyinnyoo yaa tí cáá-u, á tīī-u nnyim ú nyɔ̀. A yaa bíi ŋáań mimmee, an bí kii amɔsiŋkoon ní a cáa pāantí u-yil puee.»

english_verse: Don't let evil defeat you, but defeat evil with good.
translation_verse: Ní taa yàntī tikpitil ń pɔ̄ɔkiǹ-ni, nimbi dūmaan tiŋan kí pɔ̄ɔkiǹ tikpitil.

english_verse: Obey the rulers who have authority over you. Only God can give authority to anyone, and he puts these rulers in their places of power.
translation_verse: Báà ŋma ń nīn tɔ́ biyidambi bin cáá mpɔn ki kpòotī kitiŋee, kun puee uyidaan ubɔ kaa bí Unimbɔti kaa kāaǹ-u. Unimbɔti di yāntì ní biyidambi kɔkɔ bí.

english_verse: People who oppose the authorities are opposing what God has done, and they will be punished.
translation_verse: Míǹ puee, un yaa yíì biyidambee jáaǹ mara un Unimbɔti yóoǹee dee. Bin yíití biyidambee dátiń ditafadaaldi ki tòó bi-ba pu ní.

english_verse: Rulers are a threat to evil people, not to good people. There is no need to be afraid of the authorities. Just do right, and they will praise you for it.
translation_verse: Di sá yii bin bin ŋáań tiŋanee kaa fàŋkí biyidambi, bin ŋáań tikpitilee di fàŋkí-bi. A yaa là biyidambi ń taa nín̄ cáá-si tifaandee, nín̄ ŋáań tiŋan, bi làá pàkà-si.

english_verse: After all, they are God's servants, and it is their duty to help you. If you do something wrong, you ought to be afraid, because these rulers have the right to punish you. They are God's servants who punish criminals to show how angry God is.
translation_verse: Bi bíi tūǹ Unimbɔti tundi ní, ki téekí-si á ŋá tiŋan. Ama a yaa ŋá digaŋgam, see á fàŋkì, kun puee an kaa sá fám ní bi cáá mpɔn ki dátí binib tafal. Bi yaa bíi dátí ubɔ tafalee, bi bíi tūǹ Unimbɔti tundi ki dàkà u-ŋuul din u cáá digaŋgam dambi puee dee.

english_verse: But you should obey the rulers because you know it is the right thing to do, and not just because of God's anger.
translation_verse: Míǹ pu ní an máaǹ yii tí nīn tɔ́ biyidambi. Tí taa fàŋkì ditafadaaldi ŋmaniŋma pu, tí nīn nyímaan yii míǹ di ŋān̄.

english_verse: You must also pay your taxes. The authorities are God's servants, and it is their duty to take care of these matters.
translation_verse: An pu ní ni pà lampoobee, bí ŋmā kí tɔ̄ ditundi gbanti mbaamɔmin, kun puee bi sá Unimbɔti tɔntɔnliibi ní.

english_verse: Let love be your only debt! If you love others, you have done all that the Law demands.
translation_verse: Ní taa nín̄ jīǹ báà ubɔ nì ubɔ apɔɔn. Dipɔndi din ni cááyee di sá ní nīn néeń tɔb. Sii un néeń a-jutiibee, sii ŋá min mara lèe kɔkɔ dee.

english_verse: In the Law there are many commands, such as, “Be faithful in marriage. Do not murder. Do not steal. Do not want what belongs to others.” But all of these are summed up in the command that says, “Love others as much as you love yourself.”
translation_verse: Di sá yii marab bin lì yii: «Á taa ŋá tilaakpaal, á taa kpɔ̀ unil, á taa yɔ̀, á taa nín̄ cáá nnimbitaataamee» nì marab bin kíǹee kɔkɔ taapu sá marabaanti nee ní yii: «Á nīn néeń a-juti kii sii a-bee.»

english_verse: No one who loves others will harm them. So love is all that the Law demands. The Day When Christ Returns
translation_verse: A yaa néeń a-jutee, aa ŋáań-u tikpitil. A yaa néeń binibee, a bíi ŋáań min mara lēe kɔkɔ dee. Tí bɔ́ntí kí cīití Yeesu gítintam

english_verse: You know what sort of times we live in, and so you should live properly. It is time to wake up. You know that the day when we will be saved is nearer now than when we first put our faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Míǹ puee, ní nīn néeḿmaan tɔb míǹ, kun puee ni nyí ŋyunti ŋun poon ti bí nee nín sá ŋuŋyee. Ŋyunti ŋun ti máaǹ kí fìntī ŋgeeminee bāań, di sá yii Yeesu gítintam sútì ki pìlīń-ti ki jítiǹ min min ti nìn péé péé ki fōō ki kííyee.

english_verse: Night is almost over, and day will soon appear. We must stop behaving as people do in the dark and be ready to live in the light.
translation_verse: Kunyeeu mɔ́ ki síitì, kutaa tóob́ diwuntil. Mimmee, tí fá dibɔmbɔndi poon tuuŋŋi ní kí dū ŋwalifin janjawanti kí pèen̄.

english_verse: So behave properly, as people do in the day. Don't go to wild parties or get drunk or be vulgar or indecent. Don't quarrel or be jealous.
translation_verse: Tí còom̀maan min kítèe, kii bi nín còom̄ ŋwiimpu puee, kí taa jī kí lákatí ti-ba pu, kí taa gbí ndaam, kí taa ŋá tilaakpaal, kí taa ŋá tijɔkɔndi, kí taa nín̄ jáà, kí taa nín̄ cáá tɔb pu kudɔ̀ŋu.

english_verse: Let the Lord Jesus Christ be as near to you as the clothes you wear. Then you won't try to satisfy your selfish desires.
translation_verse: Ní dūmaan ti-Dindaan Yeesu Kriisitoo bimbim kí pèen̄ kii tijanjawanee, kí taa fàtīí tɔ̄ ni-bimbikpitim kí ŋá mì nín là puee.

english_verse: Welcome all the Lord's followers, even those whose faith is weak. Don't criticize them for having beliefs that are different from yours.
translation_verse: Ní fōōmaan ni-kansikin bin kaa láá ká mpɔn Unimbɔti saŋŋu poonee, kí taa nín̄ kpākantí bi-landɔkɔi.

english_verse: Some think it is all right to eat anything, while those whose faith is weak will eat only vegetables.
translation_verse: Ubɔ máká yii u yaa jīǹ tikɔkɔ an kaa ŋáań-u tiba, ama un kaa láá ká mpɔn nnimbɔtisan poonee kaa là, ní ki jīǹ nnyim ŋma.

english_verse: But you should not criticize others for eating or for not eating. After all, God welcomes everyone.
translation_verse: Sii un jīǹ tikɔkɔ nì tikɔkɔee ń taa kpèè un gàntī ki jīǹee fám, ní sii un gàntēe ń taa bīil̀ un jīǹ tikɔkɔ nì tikɔkɔee, kun puee Unimbɔti fōō-u.

english_verse: What right do you have to criticize someone else's servants? Only their Lord can decide if they are doing right, and the Lord will make sure that they do right.
translation_verse: Sii di sá ŋma ní ki sòoǹ ubɔ tɔntɔnliu bɔti ní? U yaa yúɔɔɔ, u yaa tí lítàaa, an sá u-kpiliu bɔti, an kaa sá a-yati. Ama u làá nīn yú, kun puee ti-Dindaan cáá mpɔn kí tíkiń-u.

english_verse: Some of the Lord's followers think one day is more important than another. Others think all days are the same. But each of you should make up your own mind.
translation_verse: Biba dàkafī yii iwiin iba sá ikpaan ki jítiǹ iba, ní biba mun dàkafī yii iwiin kɔkɔ sá ibaanti ní. Báà ŋma ń nīn nyí u-ban yii min u ŋáańee di máaǹ.

english_verse: Any followers who count one day more important than another day do it to honor their Lord. And any followers who eat meat give thanks to God, just like the ones who don't eat meat.
translation_verse: Un gàntī iwiin iba yii i sá ikpaanee ŋáań míǹ ti-Dindaan pu ní, ní un jīǹ tikɔkɔ nì tikɔkɔee mun jīǹ míǹ ti-Dindaan pu, kun puee u jáaḿ Unimbɔti tijin gbanti pu ní kí nín jī. Un mun jīǹ nnyimee, ti-Dindaan pu ní u jīǹ míǹ, ní ki jáaḿ Unimbɔti.

english_verse: Whether we live or die, it must be for God, rather than for ourselves.
translation_verse: Di sá yii ubɔ kaa bí dimaŋfalin ki tīī u-ba, ubɔ kaa tí kúù ki tīī u-ba mun.

english_verse: Whether we live or die, it must be for the Lord. Alive or dead, we still belong to the Lord.
translation_verse: Ti yaa báaa, ti bí ki tīī ti-Dindaan ní, ti yaa tí kpíìyaaa, ti kpíì ki tīī ti-Dindaan ní. Ti yaa báaa, ti yaa tí kpíìyaaa, ti sá ti-Dindaan yab ní.

english_verse: This is because Christ died and rose to life, so that he would be the Lord of the dead and of the living.
translation_verse: Di sá yii Kriisitoo kpíì ki fīkitì kí ŋmā kí nīn sá bin kpíìyee nì bin bée kɔkɔ Dindaan ní.

english_verse: Why do you criticize other followers of the Lord? Why do you look down on them? The day is coming when God will judge all of us.
translation_verse: Kin sii, ba pu ní a sòoǹ ki bíiĺ a-nabiki? Ní si mun, ba pu ní a kpèé a-nabiki fám? Ti-kɔkɔ làá dāá cù Unimbɔti nimbiin ibɔsoon,

english_verse: In the Scriptures God says, “I swear by my very life that everyone will kneel down and praise my name!”
translation_verse: kii an nín ŋmàn̄ puee, yii: «Ti-Dindaan bí yii: Man Unimbɔti bí. Báà ŋma làá dāá gbàan̄ man nimbiin, dilimbil kamaa làá dāá nyɔ̄ŋkì man Unimbɔti.»

english_verse: And so, each of us must give an account to God for what we do. Don't Cause Problems for Others
translation_verse: Míǹ ní ti-kɔkɔ làá dāá sòoǹ ti-ba yil pu bɔti Unimbɔti nimbiin. Ubɔ ń taa yàntī u-nabiki ń lítí

english_verse: We must stop judging others. We must also make up our minds not to upset anyone's faith.
translation_verse: Tí gbèen̄ kí taa ti nín̄ sòom̀maan tɔb bɔti, ama á dàkafì min ní a làá ŋá a-nabiki ń taa gbéetáaa, kí taa lítí ikpitinee.

english_verse: The Lord Jesus has made it clear to me that God considers all foods fit to eat. But if you think some foods are unfit to eat, then for you they are not fit.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan Yeesu yāntì m béè ki nyí ibaamɔn yii tijin tiba kaa bí ki kɔ̄ntí unil tijɔkɔndi Unimbɔti nimbiin. Sii ubɔ yaa dàkafī yii tiba kaa ŋān̄ee, tì lafun kpántì tin kaa ŋān̄ee sii cee ní.

english_verse: If you are hurting others by the foods you eat, you are not guided by love. Don't let your appetite destroy someone Christ died for.
translation_verse: Tijin tiba pu ní a yaa yāntì an páb́ a-nabikee, mimmee, aa ti yàntī dineendi kpòotī-si dee. Tijikaal tin a jīǹee puee, taa yàntī un pu Kriisitoo kpíìyee ń wāŋkì.

english_verse: Don't let your right to eat bring shame to Christ.
translation_verse: Tin ŋān̄ a-ceeyee ń taa gíti pɔ̄ nsan bí nīn sòoǹ tikpitil.

english_verse: God's kingdom isn't about eating and drinking. It is about pleasing God, about living in peace, and about true happiness. All this comes from the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Di sá yii Unimbɔti Beel kaa sá tijikaal nì tinyɔkaal bɔti, an sá deedee nì nsɔŋfi nì dipɔɔpindi din u-Fam tììyee ní.

english_verse: If you serve Christ in this way, you will please God and be respected by people.
translation_verse: Un yaa nóó Kriisitoo mimmee fáatí Unimbɔti, ní binib mun lèekī u-mɔ́ɔŋŋu.

english_verse: We should try to live at peace and help each other have a strong faith.
translation_verse: Mimmee, tí nyàab̀maan tin làá cáań dipɔɔsɔŋkil ti-kansikinee nì tin làá tūtuǹ ti-nabiyaamu bí báań inyaan nnimbɔtisan poonee.

english_verse: Don't let your appetite destroy what God has done. All foods are fit to eat, but it is wrong to cause problems for others by what you eat.
translation_verse: Tijin puee, taa gbá kí kpìtī Unimbɔti tundi. Tikɔkɔ ŋān̄ ki tīī bí jī, ama an kaa ŋān̄ yii tijikaal tin a jīǹee puee, á yàntī a-nabiki ń lítí.

english_verse: It is best not to eat meat or drink wine or do anything else that causes problems for other followers of the Lord.
translation_verse: Tin ŋān̄ee di sá á taa ŋmɔ́ tinan, kí taa nyɔ̀ ndaam, kí taa ŋá tiba min ŋūǹ kí yàntī a-nabiki ń lítée.

english_verse: What you believe about these things should be kept between you and God. You are fortunate, if your actions don't make you have doubts.
translation_verse: Sii nín fōō ki kíí ki nyí tiŋyee, dūú kpāafì a-ban Unimbɔti nimbiin. Un yaa lēē min ŋān̄ u-cee u-pɔbil kaa máfée bí mmɔnni.

english_verse: But if you do have doubts about what you eat, you are going against your beliefs. And you know that is wrong, because anything you do against your beliefs is sin.
translation_verse: Ama un yaa bíi jīǹ tiba ní u-pɔbil máfée kɔ́ tibɔtin, kun puee u-pɔbil tùkù-u yii min u ŋáańee kaa máaǹ ú ŋá. A yaa ŋá tiba ní a-pɔbil máfée, an sá ikpiti ní.

english_verse: If our faith is strong, we should be patient with the Lord's followers whose faith is weak. We should try to please them instead of ourselves.
translation_verse: Timbi bin ká mpɔn Unimbɔti saŋŋu poonee, ti máaǹ kí tūtuǹ bin kaa láá ká mpɔnee kí jī kimɔtii bi-pu, kí taa nín̄ nyàab̀ min làá nīn fáatiǹ-tee.

english_verse: We should think of their good and try to help them by doing what pleases them.
translation_verse: Báà ŋma ń nyàab̀ min làá tūtuǹ u-jutee mmɔntiim ú báań inyaan.

english_verse: Even Christ did not try to please himself. But as the Scriptures say, “The people who insulted you also insulted me.”
translation_verse: Di sá yii Kriisitoo kaa nìn nyàab̀ kí ŋá min fáatì-uee, ama, kii an nín ŋmàn̄ puee yii: «Asiibil ŋin bi nìn sìí sii Unimbɔtee, lítì man pu.»

english_verse: And the Scriptures were written to teach and encourage us by giving us hope.
translation_verse: Di sá yii tin kɔkɔ bi nìn ŋmàn̄ Unimbɔti gbɔŋku poon dooooyee sá kí dàkà-ti tí nīn cáá kimɔtii nì kunyannyaau, kí nīn máká Unimbɔti pu.

english_verse: God is the one who makes us patient and cheerful. I pray that he will help you live at peace with each other, as you follow Christ.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti un di tìì kimɔtii nì kunyannyaauee ń tūtuǹ-ni ní ŋá ubaanti kii Yeesu Kriisitoo nín là puee.

english_verse: Then all of you together will praise God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ. The Good News Is for Jews and Gentiles
translation_verse: Ni-kɔkɔ ń ŋmā kí kpāfì kinyɔɔbaantii kí nyɔ̄ŋkì Unimbɔti un sá ti-Dindaan Yeesu Kriisitoo Baayee. Tibɔmɔntiil sá ki tīī anibul kɔkɔ

english_verse: Honor God by accepting each other, as Christ has accepted you.
translation_verse: Míǹ puee, kii Kriisitoo nín fōō-ni puee, ní nīn fòol̄maan tɔb án tīī Unimbɔti tinyool.

english_verse: I tell you that Christ came as a servant of the Jews to show that God has kept the promises he made to their famous ancestors. Christ also came,
translation_verse: An taapu sá yii Kriisitoo dɔ́miń Juuda yab kansikin ki túń ditundi ki ŋá min Unimbɔti nìn pōoǹ ki tīī bi-naanjabee ki dàkā yii Unimbɔti sá deedeedaan,

english_verse: so that the Gentiles would praise God for being kind to them. It is just as the Scriptures say, “I will tell the nations about you, and I will sing praises to your name.”
translation_verse: ní ki dɔ́miń bin kaa sá Juuda yabee mun ń nyɔ̄ŋkì Unimbɔti u-saasɔl pu, kii an nín ŋmàn̄ puee, yii: «An pu ní m làá nyɔ̄ŋkì-si atimbun kansikin, kí gāā ilan kí pàkà a-yindi.»

english_verse: The Scriptures also say to the Gentiles, “Come and celebrate with God's people.”
translation_verse: An gíti ŋmàn̄ yii: «Atimbun, fàal̀maan nì dinibul din Unimbɔti lútèe!»

english_verse: Again the Scriptures say, “Praise the Lord, all you Gentiles. All you nations, come and worship him.”
translation_verse: An gíti tí ŋmàn̄ yii: «Nimbi atimbun kɔkɔ ń nyɔ̄ŋkì ti-Dindaan, ní anibul kɔkɔ ń pàkà-u!»

english_verse: Isaiah says, “Someone from David's family will come to power. He will rule the nations, and they will put their hope in him.”
translation_verse: Yeesaya mun nìn lī yii: «Jeesee naantiiu ubɔ làá dāan̄, u làá dāá yīkì kí jī atimbun kɔkɔ pu dibeel, ní atimbunee kɔkɔ làá dāá nīn máká u-pu.»

english_verse: I pray that God, who gives hope, will bless you with complete happiness and peace because of your faith. And may the power of the Holy Spirit fill you with hope. Paul's Work as a Missionary
translation_verse: Unimbɔti un tìì dimákalee ń gbéeǹ-ni dipɔɔpindi kí tīī-ni ŋgbansɔŋfi mmɔntiimin ni nín fōō u-bɔti ki kíí puee, án nín làá ŋá pu u-Fam pɔŋŋu ń yàntī ní nīn cɔ́tí u-pu tikpil tikpilee. Pɔɔl bíi sòoǹ u-tundi bɔti

english_verse: My friends, I am sure that you are very good and that you have all the knowledge you need to teach each other.
translation_verse: M-nabiyaamu, man m-ba nyí yii ni sá binib bin tiŋan gbí ni-pɔbiliŋ, ki nyí tin kɔkɔ ni máaǹ kí nīn nyée, ki ŋūǹ kí nīn sáŋkí tɔb muee.

english_verse: But I have spoken to you plainly and have tried to remind you of some things. God treated me with undeserved grace!
translation_verse: Nì míǹ kɔkɔee, m ŋmàn̄ ki cántì ajan aba, kaa fāŋkì kí fàtīí téetí-ni tin ni nìn nyí dooooyee. M yaa ŋmàn̄-ni mimmee, an sá diyimɔɔl din Unimbɔti pú-mi

english_verse: He chose me to be a servant of Christ Jesus for the Gentiles and to do the work of a priest in the service of his good news. God did this so that the Holy Spirit could make the Gentiles into a holy offering, pleasing to him.
translation_verse: ḿ nīn sá Yeesu Kriisitoo tɔntɔnliu bin kaa sá Juuda yabee ceeyee pu. Unimbɔti dū Tibɔmɔntiil disoondi ki ŋúbiǹ-mi, an ŋman kii bisaraaŋaliibi tundi ní m bíi tūǹee, ḿ ŋmā kí dū bin kaa sá Juuda yabee kí tīī Unimbɔti, u-Circir Fam ń yàntī bí nīn sá saraamɔnti un làá fáatí-uee.

english_verse: Because of Christ Jesus, I can take pride in my service for God.
translation_verse: Man nì ti-Dindaan Yeesu Kriisitoo nín ŋá ubaantee puee ní m ŋūǹ kí nīn gàafī nì ditundi din m tūǹ ki tìì Unimbɔtee pu.

english_verse: In fact, all I will talk about is how Christ let me speak and work, so that the Gentiles would obey him.
translation_verse: Di sá yii maa làá wàan̄ kí lì tiba an yaa kaa sá tin Kriisitoo dī m-pu ki ŋá, ki cáań binib bin kaa sá Juuda yabee ń nīn tɔ́ Unimbɔtee. Kriisitooyee di yāntì m sòon̄ anyɔɔbun ki túń atuun

english_verse: Indeed, I will tell how Christ worked miracles and wonders by the power of the Holy Spirit. I have preached the good news about him all the way from Jerusalem to Illyricum.
translation_verse: ki ŋá tidaandi nì maamaacib, nì Unimbɔti Fam pɔŋŋu. Míǹ ní m sòon̄ Tibɔmɔntiil tin sá Kriisitoo yatee an kɔkɔ, ki yōoǹ Jeerusaleem ki dāa sāā Iliirii tiŋki.

english_verse: But I have always tried to preach where people have never heard about Christ. I am like a builder who doesn't build on someone else's foundation.
translation_verse: M pɔ̄ɔntí m-ba kí sòoǹ Tibɔmɔntiilee laakin binib kaa láá gbìl̄ Kriisitoo puee, án nín làá ŋá pu ḿ taa mā kí tɔ́kɔń laakin biba nìn kíĺee.

english_verse: It is just as the Scriptures say, “All who haven't been told about him will see him, and those who haven't heard about him will understand.” Paul's Plan To Visit Rome
translation_verse: Míǹ ní m ŋá kii an nín ŋmàn̄ puee yii: «Binib bin cee baa sòon̄ u-puee làá dāá ká-u, bin bin kaa nìn gbìl̄ u-puee làá dāá gbìl̄ taapu.» Pɔɔl là kí cùú màntì Room yab pu

english_verse: My work has always kept me from coming to see you.
translation_verse: Ditundi gbanti pu ní m mākafì miŋa nì miŋa kí dāan̄ ni-cee ní kaa ŋúń.

english_verse: Now there is nothing left for me to do in this part of the world, and for years I have wanted to visit you.
translation_verse: Kɔŋkɔnnee, maa ti cáá ditundi diba ntimu gbanti poon. M baasii nyàab̄ kí dāan̄ ni-cee abin kupaau sèé.

english_verse: So I plan to stop off on my way to Spain. Then after a short, but refreshing, visit with you, I hope you will quickly send me on.
translation_verse: M yaa làá cù Eespaanyee, see ḿ dīń ni-cee, man nì ni ń kàl̄, ní kpáàa tūtuǹ-mi ḿ cù kitiŋ gbantin. Mimmee m làá ŋmā kí kàl̄ ni-cee ŋyunti ŋubɔ fiii an mɔ̄ɔkiǹ-mi.

english_verse: I am now on my way to Jerusalem to deliver the money that the Lord's followers in Macedonia and Achaia collected for God's needy people.
translation_verse: Kun puee Kriisitoo yab bin bí Maseeduwaan nì Akayee kpáfì ki tɔ́ animbil kí tūtuǹ Kriisitoo yab bin bí Jeerusaleem ki sá bisoodambee.

english_verse: This is something they really wanted to do. But sharing their money with the Jews was also like paying back a debt, because the Jews had already shared their spiritual blessings with the Gentiles.
translation_verse: Bíǹ bi-ba di lēē yii bi làá ŋá míǹ, ní an lafun máaǹ bí ŋá-bi míǹ, kun puee Kriisitoo yab bin bí Jeerusaleemee dū Tibɔmɔntiil ki yākatì nì bi. Míǹ puee, an máaǹ bi mun ń dū bi-wanti kí tūtuǹ-bi.

english_verse: After I have safely delivered this money, I will visit you and then go on to Spain.
translation_verse: M yaa dū inannakan in bi nākaǹní-mee ki dūu tīī-bi, ki kpēē tibɔti gbanti ki dóòyee, m làá dīń ni-cee, ní kí nín nìkī Eespaanyi.

english_verse: And when I do arrive in Rome, I know it will be with the full blessings of Christ.
translation_verse: M nyí yii Kriisitoo làá bìin̄ m-dāantam ni-cee pu án nīn mɔ̄ tikpil.

english_verse: My friends, by the power of the Lord Jesus Christ and by the love that comes from the Holy Spirit, I beg you to pray sincerely with me and for me.
translation_verse: Ama, nnabiyaamu, m mèé-ni ti-Dindaan Yeesu Kriisitoo nì dineendi din Circir Fam tììyee pu, ni-nimbiliŋ ń nīn máǹ ŋwimmeem pu. Ní nīn mèé Unimbɔti ki tútúǹ-mi,

english_verse: Pray that God will protect me from the unbelievers in Judea, and that his people in Jerusalem will be pleased with what I am doing.
translation_verse: ḿ ŋmā kí nyā Juudee yab bin kaa fōō ki kííyee ŋaan, ní Unimbɔti yab bin bí Jeerusaleemee mun ń fōō nì dipɔbil diba ditutundi din m cáǹ kí tīī-bee.

english_verse: Ask God to let me come to you and have a pleasant and refreshing visit.
translation_verse: Míǹ ní, Unimbɔti yaa kíí, m làá ŋmā kí bàń ni-cee nì dipɔɔpindi man nì ni ń kàl̄ ḿ ŋùŋfì.

english_verse: I pray that God, who gives peace, will be with all of you. Amen.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti un tìì ŋgbansɔŋfee ń nīn bí ni-kɔkɔ cee. Ameeni.

english_verse: I have good things to say about Phoebe, who is a leader in the church at Cenchreae.
translation_verse: M dū ti-niisal Fooyibee un tūǹ ditundi Kriisitoo nikitil din bí Saŋkireeyee kansikinee ki ŋá ni-ŋaan.

english_verse: Welcome her in a way that is proper for someone who has faith in the Lord and is one of God's own people. Help her in any way you can. After all, she has proved to be a respected leader for many others, including me.
translation_verse: Fōōmaan-u ti-Dindaan pu kii Unimbɔti nib nín máaǹ kí nīn fòol̄ tɔb puee. Ní ajan ŋin kɔkɔ poon an bàlifī yii ní tūtuǹ-uee, ní tūtum̀maan-u. Míǹ ní u mun jòoń binib tikpil, ki kpáaǹ man m-ba.

english_verse: Give my greetings to Priscilla and Aquila. They have not only served Christ Jesus together with me,
translation_verse: Ní jāam̀ Priisiil nì Akiilasi, m-tɔntɔnjutiibi Yeesu Kriisitoo tundin.

english_verse: but they have even risked their lives for me. I am grateful for them and so are all the Gentile churches.
translation_verse: Bi kíí kí dū bi-ba kí tīī ŋkúm man ŋmátí. An kaa sá man baba di làá jāam̀-bi an pu, Kriisitoo nikitiŋ ŋin kaa sá Juuda yabee kɔkɔ mun làá jāam̀-bi.

english_verse: Greet the church that meets in their home. Greet my dear friend Epaenetus, who was the first person in Asia to have faith in Christ.
translation_verse: Ní jāam̀ Kriisitoo nikitil din kpáfí bi-dumpuee mun. Ní jāam̀ Eepayineeti, m-bɔɔ un m néeńee, un péé péé ki fōō ki kíí Asii tiŋkinee.

english_verse: Greet Mary, who has worked so hard for you.
translation_verse: Ní jāam̀ Maarii un túń ditundi tikpil ki tīī-nee.

english_verse: Greet my relatives Andronicus and Junia, who were in jail with me. They are highly respected by the apostles and were followers of Christ before I was.
translation_verse: Ní jāam̀ Androonikuusi nì Juniyaasi, man nì bin pēē kubaabinaatoou ki pēē sarka muee. Yeesu kpambaliŋ kansikinee, bi tɔ́-bi tikpil. Bíǹ péeǹ man ki fōō Kriisitoo ki kíí.

english_verse: Greet Ampliatus, my dear friend whose faith is in the Lord.
translation_verse: Ní jāam̀ Ampiliyatuu, m-bɔɔ un pu maa mɔ̄ ti-Dindaan puee.

english_verse: Greet Urbanus, who serves Christ along with us. Greet my dear friend Stachys.
translation_verse: Ní jāam̀ Urbeen, ti nì un kpáfí ki tūǹ ditundi Kriisitoo puee, kí jāam̀ m-bɔɔmɔnti Sitaku mun.

english_verse: Greet Apelles, a faithful servant of Christ. Greet Aristobulus and his family.
translation_verse: Ní jāam̀ Apeeleesi, un jíń falaa Kriisitoo pu, kaa lítèe. Ní jāam̀ Ariistoobul dicaŋkun yab.

english_verse: Greet Herodion, who is a relative of mine. Greet Narcissus and the others in his family, who have faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Ní jāam̀ Eeroodiyoon, man nì un pēēyee. Ní jāam̀ Naasiisi dicaŋkun yab bin sá ti-Dindaan yabee.

english_verse: Greet Tryphaena and Tryphosa, who work hard for the Lord. Greet my dear friend Persis. She also works hard for the Lord.
translation_verse: Ní jāam̀ Triifeeni nì Triifoosi, bin tūǹ ditummɔntiil ki tìì ti-Dindaanee, kí jāam̀maan ti-niisamɔnti Peersiidi un túń atummɔnti tikpil ki tīī ti-Dindaanee.

english_verse: Greet Rufus, that special servant of the Lord, and greet his mother, who has been like a mother to me.
translation_verse: Ní jāam̀ Rufusi un ti-Dindaan lútì ú tɔ̄ u-tundee, kí kpáàa jāam̀ u-na un kpántì ma mun nee.

english_verse: Greet Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, and Hermas, as well as our friends who are with them.
translation_verse: Ní jāam̀ Asiŋkiltu nì Fileegɔn nì Eermeesi nì Patrooba nì Eermaasi, nì ti-nabiyaamu mun bí bi-ceeyee.

english_verse: Greet Philologus, Julia, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas, and all of God's people who are with them.
translation_verse: Ní jāam̀ Filooloogu nì Julii nì Neeree nì u-niisal Oolimpa nì Unimbɔti yab bin kɔkɔ bí bi-ceeyee.

english_verse: Be sure to give each other a warm greeting. All of Christ's churches greet you.
translation_verse: Ni-kɔkɔ ń jāam̀maan tɔb tiŋan kii nnabiyaamuee. Kriisitoo nikitiŋ kɔkɔ jáamiń-ni. Tibɔkpaafikaal tijoolkaal

english_verse: My friends, I beg you to watch out for anyone who causes trouble and divides the church by refusing to do what all of you were taught. Stay away from them!
translation_verse: Nnabiyaamu, m kpáafí-ni ní nīn nyí nì ni-ba nì bin fá tibɔmɔntiil tin bi dàkā-nee ki cāabìń diyakatil, ki yàntī binib lítée. Sútí kí wàatīmaan bidambi.

english_verse: They want to serve themselves and not Christ the Lord. Their flattery and fancy talk fool people who don't know any better.
translation_verse: An nibee kaa nóó ti-Dindaan Kriisitoo. Bi nyàab̀ bi-ba jim ní, ní ki sòoǹ anyɔɔbummɔɔn ki kíiĺ binib, ki yàntī bin nyil kaa náaǹee lítí.

english_verse: I am glad that everyone knows how well you obey the Lord. But still, I want you to understand what is good and not have anything to do with evil.
translation_verse: Báà ŋma nyí ni nín tɔ́ ti-Dindaanee, an puee, m-pɔbil sɔ̀m̀ ni-pu. Ama m là ní nīn sá bin nyí ki ŋáań tiŋanee, kí nīn sá bin bí circir, kaa là ikpitee.

english_verse: Then God, who gives peace, will soon crush Satan under your feet. I pray that our Lord Jesus will be kind to you.
translation_verse: An kaa làá yúntí, Unimbɔti un tìì ŋgbansɔŋfee làá yàntī ní tāā kí mátí Sitaan. Ti-Dindaan Yeesu ŋanti ń nīn bí ni-pu!

english_verse: Timothy, who works with me, sends his greetings, and so do my relatives, Lucius, Jason, and Sosipater.
translation_verse: M-tɔntɔnjuti Tiimootee jáamiń-ni. Lusiyusi nì Jasɔn nì Soospatee, man nì bin pēēyee, mun jáamiń-ni.

english_verse: I, Tertius, also send my greetings. I am a follower of the Lord, and I wrote this letter.
translation_verse: Man Teertiyusi un ŋmàn̄ kugbɔŋu neeyee mun jáamiń-ni ti-Dindaan pu.

english_verse: Praise God! He can make you strong by means of my good news, which is the message about Jesus Christ. For ages and ages this message was kept secret,
translation_verse: Tí nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan Unimbɔti! Nì tibɔmɔntiil tin m sòoǹ Yeesu Kriisitoo puee, Unimbɔti cáá mpɔn kí báań-ni inyaan nnimbɔtisan poon. Doooo ŋyuntikpikee, tibɔtee nìn bí dibalin, Unimbɔti kaa nìn dáá bīitì ti-pu,

english_verse: but now at last it has been told. The eternal God commanded his prophets to write about the good news, so that all nations would obey and have faith.
