translation_verse: ama kɔŋkɔnnee u nyántì-tì mpaampiin pu. U dī tigbɔn tin u-bɔnaatiliibi ŋmàn̄ ki nāatì u-bɔtee pu ki yāntì atimbun kamaa nib béè ti-pu án nín làá ŋá pu bí fōō kí kíí kí nīn kíǹ ki tɔ́ Unimbɔtee. Jaanjaan Nimbɔtiu nín là puee dee.

english_verse: And now, because of Jesus Christ, we can praise the only wise God forever! Amen.
translation_verse: Míǹ puee, Unimbɔti un baba sá uciŋfitee ń ká tinyool Yeesu Kriisitoo pu kí nīn pée cá jaanjaan! Ameeni.

english_verse: From Paul, chosen by God to be an apostle of Christ Jesus, and from Sosthenes, who is also a follower.
translation_verse: An sá man Pɔɔl un Unimbɔti là ki yíiń-mi ḿ nīn sá Yeesu Kriisitoo kpambalee nì ti-nabiki Sɔsteen di jáaḿ-ni.

english_verse: To God's church in Corinth. Christ Jesus chose you to be his very own people, and you worship in his name, as we and all others do who call him Lord.
translation_verse: M ŋmàn̄ kugbɔŋu nee ki tīī nimbi Unimbɔti nikitil din bí Kɔranti, Unimbɔti lútì-ni ní nīn sá u-yab Yeesu Kriisitoo puee. U yíiń-ni ní nīn bí circir, ni nì bin kɔkɔ bí báà laakin ki jáaḿ ti-Dindaan Yeesu Kriisitoo bi-Dindaan un sá ti mun Dindaanee.

english_verse: My prayer is that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!
translation_verse: Ti-Baa Unimbɔti nì ti-Dindaan Yeesu Kriisitoo ń ŋá-ni tiŋan kí tīī-ni ŋgbansɔŋfi. Tiŋan tin ti fōō Kriisitoo ceeyee

english_verse: I never stop thanking my God for treating you with undeserved grace by giving you Christ Jesus,
translation_verse: M jáaḿ m-Nimbɔtiu múlmul ni-pu, tiŋan tin u ŋá-ni Yeesu Kriisitoo puee.

english_verse: Now you are certain that everything we told you about our Lord Christ Jesus is true.
translation_verse: Kriisitoo bɔti tin ti cáań ki sòon̄ nì nee, ni fōō-tì ki ŋúb́-tì tiŋan pu.

english_verse: You are not missing out on any blessings, as you wait for him to return.
translation_verse: Míǹ pu ní nimbi bin kā ki cí ti-Dindaan Yeesu Kriisitoo gítintamee, Unimbɔti pú-ni u-pɔ̄tam kɔkɔ, báà miba kaa lóò-ni.

english_verse: God can be trusted, and he chose you to be partners with his Son, our Lord Jesus Christ. Taking Sides
translation_verse: Unimbɔti yaa pōoǹ puee, see ú ŋá míǹ, an di sá yii u yíiń-ni yii ni nì u-Jipɔɔn ti-Dindaan Yeesu Kriisitoo ń ŋá ubaanti. Digàntil kɔ́ Kriisitoo nikitil kansikin

english_verse: My dear friends, as a follower of our Lord Jesus Christ, I beg you to get along with each other. Don't take sides. Always try to agree in what you think.
translation_verse: Nnabiyaamu, nì ti-Dindaan Yeesu Kriisitoo yindi puee, m gbàam̄-ni, ní nīn pēēmaan kinyɔkɔ, digàntil ń taa nín̄ bí ni-kansikin. Nín̄ pēēmaan kinyɔkɔ mmɔntiimin, ni-kɔkɔ bɔti ń nīn sá tibaantiil, ni-landɔkɔi mun ń nīn pēē.

english_verse: Several people from Chloe's family have already reported to me that you keep arguing with each other.
translation_verse: Di sá yii m-nabiyaamu, Kloowee dicaŋkun yab biba dɔ́miń ki tùkū-mi yii kujaau bí ni-kansikin.

english_verse: Has Christ been divided up? Was I nailed to a cross for you? Were you baptized in my name?
translation_verse: Mimmee, ni dàkafī yii Kriisitoo yākatì u-ba ajan kupaauaaa? Àá Pɔɔl ní bi kpáá ndɔpuntikaa pu ki tīī-ni ní? Àá Pɔɔl yindi pu ní bi fùl̄-ni Unimbɔti nyim ní?

english_verse: I thank God that I didn't baptize any of you except Crispus and Gaius.
translation_verse: M jáaḿ Unimbɔti m nín kaa fùl̄ ni-kansikin báà ubɔ nnyimee, asee Kriisipusi nì Gaayusi baba.

english_verse: Not one of you can say that you were baptized in my name.
translation_verse: An puee ni-kansikin ubɔ kaa ŋūǹ kí lì yii man yindi pu ní bi fùl̄-u nnyim.

english_verse: I did baptize the family of Stephanas, but I don't remember if I baptized anyone else.
translation_verse: Tiŋman! M téetí yii m nìn fùl̄ Steefanasi nì u-dicaŋkun yab Unimbɔti nnyim. M yaa gíti fùl̄ biba muɔɔɔ, maa ti nyí.

english_verse: Christ did not send me to baptize. He sent me to tell the good news without using words that sound wise and would make the cross of Christ lose its power. Christ Is God's Power and Wisdom
translation_verse: Di sá yii Kriisitoo kaa túnní-mi ḿ nīn fùul̀ binib Unimbɔti nnyim, ama u túnní-mi ḿ sòoǹ u-Bɔmɔntiiti ní. Maa làá dū binib ciiŋyi ní kí sòoǹ an bɔti. M yaa ŋá mimmee, m làá yàntī kun pu Yeesu Kriisitoo kpíì ndɔpuntikaa puee ń ŋá fám dee. Yeesu Kriisitoo di sá Unimbɔti pɔŋŋu nì u-ciiŋŋu

english_verse: The message about the cross doesn't make any sense to lost people. But for those of us who are being saved, it is God's power at work.
translation_verse: Kun puee ti nín sòoǹ yii Kriisitoo kpíì ndɔpuntikaa pu kí fīī binibee, an sá tiwaatibɔti ní ki tīī bin bí diwaŋkil saŋŋu poonee. Ama ní ki sá Unimbɔti pɔŋŋu ki tīī timbi bin bí difiil saŋŋunee,

english_verse: As God says in the Scriptures, “I will destroy the wisdom of all who claim to be wise. I will confuse those who think they know so much.”
translation_verse: kii an nín ŋmàn̄ Unimbɔti gbɔŋku poon puee yii: «M làá kúntí biciŋfitiibi ciiŋyi ní kí nàan̄ binyiliibi nyil.»

english_verse: What happened to those wise people? What happened to those experts in the Scriptures? What happened to the ones who think they have all the answers? Didn't God show that the wisdom of this world is foolish?
translation_verse: Niinee uciŋfiti, àá unyil gíti cáá tilati? Bin bí duulinya poon ki kpākantée bí la? Unimbɔti dàkā yii duulinya yab ciiŋŋu sá kuwaatiiu ní.

english_verse: God was wise and decided not to let the people of this world use their wisdom to learn about him. Instead, God chose to save only those who believe the foolish message we preach.
translation_verse: Di sá yii duulinya nì u-ciiŋŋuee, waa ŋúń ki béè Unimbɔti nì u-ciiŋŋu. An pu ní an fáatì Unimbɔti ń dī tibɔti tin ti sòoǹ bi cáa yíì tiwaatibɔti nee pu kí fīī bin fōō-u ki kííyee.

english_verse: Jews ask for miracles, and Greeks want something that sounds wise.
translation_verse: An yaa sá Juuda yabee, bíǹ nyàab̀ bí ŋá maamaacib bí ká án nīn sá-bi kudaaŋŋu, ní Greeki yab bíǹ nyàab̀ iciin.

english_verse: But we preach that Christ was nailed to a cross. Most Jews have problems with this, and most Gentiles think it is foolish.
translation_verse: Ama ní timbee, Kriisitoo un bi kpáá ndɔpuntikaa puee bɔti ní ti sòoǹ. An bɔtee di làkantí Juuda yab, ní ki sá bin kaa sá Juuda yabee cee tiwaatibɔti.

english_verse: Our message is God's power and wisdom for the Jews and the Greeks that he has chosen.
translation_verse: Ama Kriisitoo di sá Unimbɔti pɔŋŋu nì u-ciiŋŋu ki tīī binib bin Unimbɔti yíińee, bin sá Juuda yabee nì bin kaa sée.

english_verse: Even when God is foolish, he is wiser than everyone else, and even when God is weak, he is stronger than everyone else.
translation_verse: Di sá yii tin tin Unimbɔti ŋá binib cáa yíì tiwaatibɔtee jítiǹ binib ciiŋyi, ní tin u ŋá binib kpèé yii an sá iwɔfee pɔ̄ɔ̄ ki jítiǹ binib.

english_verse: But God chose the foolish things of this world to put the wise to shame. He chose the weak things of this world to put the powerful to shame.
translation_verse: Ama Unimbɔti lēē kun ní duulinya yíì kuwaatiiuee ní ki dūu kɔ́ǹ biciŋfitiibi icoo, ní ki lēē kun duulinya yíì iwɔsɔfee ní ki dūu kɔ́ǹ bipɔɔbi icoo.

english_verse: What the world thinks is worthless, useless, and nothing at all is what God has used to destroy what the world considers important.
translation_verse: U lēē tiwan tin bi kpèé ki sìŋkīǹ kaa dūu yíiń tibee, tin kaa pée bí tibanee ní u dūu sīntiǹ tin bi wāĺ yii tì bí tibanee taapu taapu.

english_verse: God did all this to keep anyone from bragging to him.
translation_verse: U ŋá míǹ unil báà ubɔ ń taa gāā u-bindi Unimbɔti nimbiin.

english_verse: You are God's children. He sent Christ Jesus to save us and to make us wise, acceptable, and holy.
translation_verse: Di sá yii úǹ Unimbɔti di yāntì ní ni nì Yeesu Kriisitoo ŋá ubaanti. U yāntì Yeesu kpántì timbi ciiŋŋu. Kriisitoo pu ní ti kpántì deedeedambi Unimbɔti nimbiin ki bí circir, u fōō-ti ki líì.

english_verse: So if you want to brag, do what the Scriptures say and brag about the Lord.
translation_verse: An pu ní an ŋmàn̄ Unimbɔti gbɔŋku poon yii: «Sii un yaa làá gāā a-bindee ń gāā ti-Dindaan nín ŋá tiŋyee pu.»

english_verse: Friends, when I came and told you the mystery that God had shared with us, I didn't use big words or try to sound wise.
translation_verse: Nnabiyaamu, m nín nìn dɔ́miń ni-cee ki sòon̄ nì ni Unimbɔti bɔti tin bí dibalinee, maa nìn dū anyɔɔbuŋkpaanaaa, kaa nìn tí dū binib ciiŋyi ní ki sòon̄ nì ni.

english_verse: In fact, while I was with you, I made up my mind to speak only about Jesus Christ, who had been nailed to a cross.
translation_verse: M lēē yii maa làá sòoǹ ni-kansikin báà tiba nì tiba, an yaa kaa sá Yeesu Kriisitoo un bi kpáá ndɔpuntikaa puee bɔti.

english_verse: At first, I was weak and trembling with fear.
translation_verse: An pu ní m kāl̀ ni-kansikin kii uwɔfee nì tifaandi yɔ́kɔ́ yɔkɔ.

english_verse: When I talked with you or preached, I didn't try to prove anything by sounding wise. I simply let God's Spirit show his power.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti bɔti tin m nìn cáań-nee nì min min m nìn dàkā-ni tibɔti gbantee kaa nìn nyánní binib ciiŋyi dàkatamin, ama an nìn sá Unimbɔti Fam pɔŋŋu tundi ní.

english_verse: That way you would have faith because of God's power and not because of human wisdom.
translation_verse: Mimmee ni-fookiiu kaa cɔ́ binib ciiŋyi pu, ama Unimbɔti pɔŋŋu pu ní an cɔ́. Unimbɔti ciiŋŋu

english_verse: We do use wisdom when speaking to people who are mature in their faith. But it isn't the wisdom of this world or of its rulers, who will soon disappear.
translation_verse: An puee bin béè nnimbɔtisan mmɔntiiminee, iciin ní ti dàkā-bi. An kaa nìn sá duulinya yab ciiŋyi, kaa tí sá ipɔŋkpiti in jíń abee duulinyan ki làá dāá kúntée ciiŋyi.

english_verse: We speak of God's hidden and mysterious wisdom that God decided to use for our glory long before the world began.
translation_verse: Timbee, Unimbɔti ciiŋyi in nìn bí dibalinee pu ní ti sòoǹ. Unimbɔti nìn pée lēē-i ki yóoǹ-ti án nīn sá ti-nyooti ki wāatì ní ki nín náań duulinya.

english_verse: The rulers of this world didn't know anything about this wisdom. If they had known about it, they would not have nailed the glorious Lord to a cross.
translation_verse: Duulinya bɔtiibi báà ubɔ kaa ŋúń ki béè Unimbɔti ciiŋyi gbanti. Bi yaa bàà nìn béè-i, baa bàà nìn kpáà ti-Dindaan tinyooldaan ndɔpuntikaa pu.

english_verse: But it is just as the Scriptures say, “What God has planned for people who love him is more than eyes have seen or ears have heard. It has never even entered our minds!”
translation_verse: An bí kii Unimbɔti gbɔŋku poon nín ŋmàn̄ puee yii: «Tin unil nimbil kaa kée, nì tin u-tafal kaa gbìl̄ee, nì tin unil kaa dākafì ki kée, tíǹ ní Unimbɔti bɔ́ntì ki yóoǹ bin néeń-uee.»

english_verse: God's Spirit has shown you everything. His Spirit finds out everything, even what is deep in the mind of God.
translation_verse: Di sá yii timbi ní Unimbɔti dī u-Fam pu ki dàkā-ti abɔɔn gbanti. Di sá yii Unimbɔti Fam gbanti di ŋūǹ kí béé tin Unimbɔti cááyee, ki kpáaǹ tin bí dibalin poon poon kábuee.

english_verse: You are the only one who knows what is in your own mind, and God's Spirit is the only one who knows what is in God's mind.
translation_verse: Ulanil ni-kansikin di ŋūǹ kí béé u-juti landɔkɔŋu? See úǹ u-ba fam min bí u-nee di ŋūǹ kí béé kun u sée. Míǹ mbaantiim ní ubɔ kaa ŋūǹ kí béé Unimbɔti landɔkɔŋu, see Unimbɔti Fam di ŋūǹ kí béé u-landɔkɔŋu.

english_verse: But God has given us his Spirit. This is why we don't think the same way that the people of this world think. This is also why we can recognize the blessings God has given us.
translation_verse: Timbee, an kaa sá duulinya Fam ní ti fōō, an sá Unimbɔti di tīī-ti u-Fam, án nín làá ŋá pu tí béé tiŋan tin kɔkɔ Unimbɔti ŋá-tee.

english_verse: Every word we speak was taught to us by God's Spirit, not by human wisdom. And this same Spirit helps us teach spiritual things to spiritual people.
translation_verse: An puee, anyɔɔbun ŋin ti cáa sòoǹee kaa sá binib nín dàkà iciin iŋyee nyɔɔbuŋŋi, ama an sá anyɔɔbun ŋin Unimbɔti Fam tīī-tee ní ti cáa sòoǹ ki bɔ́bití ibaamɔn in nyēeń Unimbɔti Fam nee ki tùkù bin cáá Unimbɔti Famee.

english_verse: This is why only someone who has God's Spirit can understand spiritual blessings. Anyone who doesn't have God's Spirit thinks these blessings are foolish.
translation_verse: Unil un dàkafī nniyaamin ŋmaniŋmee kaa ŋūǹ kí fōō ibaamɔn in Unimbɔti Fam sòoǹee. Úǹ ceeyee, an sá tiwaatibɔti ní. Waa ŋūǹ kí fōō-tì, kun puee Unimbɔti Fam baba di yàntī unil ń ŋmā kí béé kí gàntī.

english_verse: People who are guided by the Spirit can make all kinds of judgments, but they cannot be judged by others.
translation_verse: Unil un cáá Unimbɔti Famee di ŋūǹ kí nīn nyí tikɔkɔ ki gàntī, ama ubɔ kaa gbìl̀ úǹ bɔti taapu kí gàntī.

english_verse: The Scriptures ask, “Has anyone ever known the thoughts of the Lord or given him advice?” But we understand what Christ is thinking.
translation_verse: Kii Unimbɔti gbɔŋku poon nín lī puee yii: «Ŋma di nyí ti-Dindaan landɔkɔŋu? Ŋma di ŋūǹ kí sāŋkì-u?» Ama timbee, ti cáá Kriisitoo landɔkɔŋu ti-ni.

english_verse: My friends, you are acting like the people of this world. That's why I could not speak to you as spiritual people. You are like babies as far as your faith in Christ is concerned.
translation_verse: Nnabiyaamu, m nín dɔ́miń ni-ceeyee, maa ŋúń ki sòon̄ nì ni kii m nín sòoǹ bin cáá Unimbɔti Famee puee, ama m sòon̄ nì ni kii binib bin dī duulinyee ní, kii bin sá mbiyaapɔmu Kriisitoo saŋŋu poonee.

english_verse: So I had to treat you like babies and feed you milk. You could not take solid food, and you still cannot,
translation_verse: An puee m tīī-ni nnaabiim, an kaa sá tijin tin pɔ̄ɔ̄ naa ŋūǹee. Áli gba ki dāa sāā nìn díǹee, naa ŋūǹ tin pɔ̄ɔ̄yee,

english_verse: because you are not yet spiritual. You are jealous and argue with each other. This proves you are not spiritual and you are acting like the people of this world.
translation_verse: kun puee ni dáá bí kii duulinya nib nín bí puee ní. Di sá ŋyunti ŋun ní ipoompoon nì kunikpɔŋkpɔkɔu dáá bí ni-kansikinee, an dàkà yii ni sá duulinya yab dee ki ŋáań nniyaamin.

english_verse: Some of you say you follow me, and others claim to follow Apollos. Isn't this how ordinary people behave?
translation_verse: Ni-kansikin biba lì yii bíǹ sá Pɔɔl yab ní, ní biba mun lì yii bíǹ sá Apooloosi yab. Ni yaa bíi ŋáań mimmee, naa bíi ŋáań nniyaamin deeee?

english_verse: Apollos and I are merely servants who helped you to have faith. It was the Lord who made it all happen.
translation_verse: Ŋma di sá Apooloosi? Ní ŋma di sá Pɔɔl ní? Ti sá Unimbɔti tɔntɔnliibi bin pu ni dī ki fōō Unimbɔti ki kííyee ní. Unimbɔti di yākatì min sá tí ŋée ki tīī-ti.

english_verse: I planted the seeds, Apollos watered them, but God made them sprout and grow.
translation_verse: Man búĺ ní Apooloosi yāaǹ nnyim, ní Unimbɔti yāntì an nyáń ki wíiǹ.

english_verse: The one who plants is just as important as the one who waters. And each one will be paid for what they do.
translation_verse: Un búĺee nì un yāaǹ nnyimee ŋmà ní. Unimbɔti dāa pà-bi bi-tundi din bi túńee nín máaǹ puee ní.

english_verse: Apollos and I work together for God, and you are God's garden and God's building. Only One Foundation
translation_verse: Kun puee ti nì Unimbɔti di pēē ki tūǹ ditundi. Nimbi di sá u-saaku, ní ki sá u-diiku.

english_verse: God treated me with undeserved grace and let me become an expert builder. I laid a foundation on which others have built. But we must each be careful how we build,
translation_verse: Diyimɔɔl din Unimbɔti pú-mi ḿ nīn sá udimakpaan un cáá iciinee puee, m bíl̀ kudiiyee nyeel ní ubɔ ń dāá mā kí tɔ́kɔń, ama báà ŋma ń béé u nín māā ki tɔ̄kɔntí puee.

english_verse: Whatever we build on this foundation will be tested by fire on the day of judgment. Then everyone will find out if we have used gold, silver, and precious stones, or wood, hay, and straw.
translation_verse: Un yaa dū kun ní ki máń ki tɔ́kɔǹ kudiiyee puee, daliŋkin Unimbɔti làá dāá sòoǹ binib bɔtee, yaadal ní báà ŋma tuuŋŋi dāa nyēē mpaampiin pu. Di sá bi làá dāá dū báà ŋma tuuŋŋi ní kí ŋá ŋŋmin. Ŋŋmi ní bi làá dāá dūú cɔ̄ŋkì báà ŋma tundi kí béé di nín sá diŋyee.

english_verse: But if it is destroyed by the fire, we will lose everything. Yet we ourselves will be saved, like someone escaping from flames.
translation_verse: Ama un cee ní ŋŋmi yaa wùn̄ee, asaluu gbáń udaan dee. U làá dāá ká difiil, ama an dāa sá kii unil diiku nín fòol̄ pu ú sāǹ kí nyā kaa báb́ tiba puee ní.

english_verse: All of you surely know you are God's temple and his Spirit lives in you.
translation_verse: Naa nyí yii ni sá Unimbɔti diiku ní u-Fam kóò ni-naaa?

english_verse: Together you are God's holy temple, and God will destroy anyone who destroys his temple.
translation_verse: An puee, unil yaa kɔ́ǹ Unimbɔti diiku tijɔkɔndee, see Unimbɔti ń dāá dáaĺ udaan tafal, kun puee Unimbɔti diiku bí circir ní, ní nimbi di sá kudii gbanti.

english_verse: Don't fool yourselves! If any of you think you are wise in the things of this world, you will have to become foolish before you can be truly wise.
translation_verse: Ubɔ ń taa kīil̀ u-ba. Un yaa bí ni-kansikin ki dàkafī yii u cáá duulinya ciiŋyee, ú kpántí ugbaan kí ŋmā kí ká iciin in nyēeń Unimbɔti ceeyee.

english_verse: This is because God considers the wisdom of this world to be foolish. It is just as the Scriptures say, “God catches the wise when they try to outsmart him.”
translation_verse: Kun puee duulinya ciiŋyi sá Unimbɔti cee digbaandi ní. Míǹ ní an ŋmàn̄ Unimbɔti gbɔŋkun yii: «Unimbɔti gīintí biciŋfitiibi ciiŋyi ní ki fàtīi cáa cútí-bi.»

english_verse: The Scriptures also say, “The Lord knows that the plans made by wise people are useless.”
translation_verse: An gíti tí lī yii: «Ti-Dindaan nyí biciŋfitiibi landɔkɔi, ki nyí i nín sá fámee.»

english_verse: So stop bragging about what anyone has done. Paul and Apollos and Peter all belong to you. In fact, everything is yours, including the world, life, death, the present, and the future. Everything belongs to you,
translation_verse: an yaa sá Pɔɔlaaa, Apooloosaaa, Peetrooyaaa, an yaa tí sá duulinyaaa, dimaŋfalaaa, ŋkúmaaa, an yaa tí sá tiwan tin bí kɔŋkɔnneeyaaa, tin bí ki dòońeeyaaa, nimbi di yì tikɔkɔ,

english_verse: and you belong to Christ, and Christ belongs to God.
translation_verse: ní Kriisitoo yì nimbi, ní Unimbɔti yì Kriisitoo.

english_verse: Think of us as servants of Christ who have been given the work of explaining God's mysterious ways.
translation_verse: Míǹ puee ní nīn nyí yii ti sá Kriisitoo tɔntɔnliibi bin bin ní Unimbɔti dū u-bɔbalkaati ki ŋá ti-ŋaan tí sòoǹee ní.

english_verse: And since our first duty is to be faithful to the one we work for,
translation_verse: Bi yaa dū ditundi ki ŋá a-ŋaanee, tin bi kíǹ ki kpèé a-ceeyee di sá á tɔ̄ ditundee bí béé a-baamɔŋyi.

english_verse: it doesn't matter to me if I am judged by you or even by a court of law. In fact, I don't judge myself.
translation_verse: Mamee, nimbi di yaa bíi sòoǹ m-bɔtaaa, an yaa tí sá bibɔsoonliibaaa, tíǹ kaa ká-mi. Man m-ba kaa tí bíi sòoǹ m-ba bɔti.

english_verse: I don't know of anything against me, but this doesn't prove I am right. The Lord is my judge.
translation_verse: Ibaamɔn, m-pɔbil poonee maa gbìl̄ yii m ŋá tiba, ama míǹ di kaa dàkà yii maa ŋá tiba. Ti-Dindaan di sá un sòoǹ man bɔtee.

english_verse: So don't judge anyone until the Lord returns. He will show what is hidden in the dark and what is in everyone's heart. Then God will be the one who praises each of us.
translation_verse: An puee ní taa sòoǹ ubɔ bɔti kí nīn cí ŋyunti ń bàń. Ní taa sòoǹ ubɔ bɔti kí nīn cí ŋyunti ŋun ti-Dindaan làá bàńee. U yaa láa bāańee, u làá yàntī ŋwalifi ń ŋmíntí tin bál̀ dibɔmbɔndinee kí nyāntí binib landɔkɔi mpaampiin pu. Niin ní báà ŋma dāa fòol̄ kupampakau kun u máaǹee Unimbɔti cee.

english_verse: Friends, I have used Apollos and myself as examples to teach you the meaning of the saying, “Follow the rules.” I want you to stop saying one of us is better than the other.
translation_verse: Nnabiyaamu, m dū man nì Apooloosi bɔti tin m sòon̄ee ki dàkā kí cántí-ni tibɔti ní. Ní bīfì man nì Apooloosi cee min ni máaǹ kí nīn bée kí taa lákatí tin bi ŋmàn̄ Unimbɔti gbɔŋku poonee pu. Ní taa ŋá dilambil kí lēē ti-kansikin ubɔ, kí bí yii úǹ di sá tiba kí kpèè un kíǹee fám.

english_verse: What is so special about you? What do you have that you were not given? And if it was given to you, how can you brag?
translation_verse: Ŋma di yōoǹ-si yilpu ní a jítiǹ a-juti ní? Tin a cááyee Unimbɔti di kaa tīī-saaa? Kin Unimbɔti di yaa tīī-si ní, ba pu ní a cáá dilambil kii ubɔ di kaa tīī-see?

english_verse: Are you already satisfied? Are you now rich? Have you become kings while we are still nobodies? I wish you were kings. Then we could have a share in your kingdom.
translation_verse: Ni pūtì kpáàa ká tin kɔkɔ ni lèe! Ki pūtì kpáàa kpántì bigaajab ki kpántì bibɔtiibi timbi boon! Ni yaa bàà lafun kpántì bibɔtiibi ti mun ń bàà dāá kūtì ni-pu, an bàà ŋān̄!

english_verse: It seems to me that God has put us apostles in the worst possible place. We are like prisoners on their way to death. Angels and the people of this world just laugh at us.
translation_verse: An bí-mi kii Unimbɔti gíiǹ timbi akpambal boon binib kansikinee ní. Ti bí kii binib bin bi làá kpɔ̀ kunipaau nimbiinee, kun puee ti kpántì tinimbikɔntiwan ní duulinya nì ituun nì binib kpèé.

english_verse: Because of Christ we are thought of as fools, but Christ has made you wise. We are weak and hated, but you are powerful and respected.
translation_verse: Kriisitoo puee, timbi kpántì biwaatiibi ní, ní nimbi nín fōō-u ki kíí puee, ni kpántì biciŋfitiibi. Míǹ ní timbi sá ŋwɔsɔfimu ní nimbi sá bipɔɔbi. Binib kpèé timbi fám ní ki tìì nimbi jilma.

english_verse: Even today we go hungry and thirsty and don't have anything to wear except rags. We are mistreated and don't have a place to live.
translation_verse: Áli ki dāa sāā ŋyunti ŋun poon ti bí nee ti gbíntì ki bí ki jīǹ ŋkùm nì nnyinnyoo falaau. Taa cáá tiwampeeŋkaal, ní bi gbáà-ti ní ti tú ki yìiǹ ajan kɔkɔ pu.

english_verse: We work hard with our own hands, and when people abuse us, we wish them well. When we suffer, we are patient.
translation_verse: Míǹ boonee ti tūǹ atuun ki gì kí ŋmā kí ká tiba kí jī. Bi yaa sìí-tee, timbi mèé Unimbɔti ń bìin̄ bi-pu. Míǹ ní bi yaa sàantí-tee ní timbi jīǹ bi-pu kimɔtii.

english_verse: When someone curses us, we answer with kind words. Until now we are thought of as nothing more than the trash and garbage of this world.
translation_verse: Bi kúŋfí ti-boon ní timbi sòoǹ-bi tin mɔ̄ee, áli nìn díǹee, bi kpèé-ti kii duulinya tampummootee ní, a lì kii tiwaŋkpitil tin kaa bí tibanee.

english_verse: I am not writing to embarrass you. I want to help you, just as parents help their own dear children.
translation_verse: Maa ŋmàn̄ tibɔti nee kí kɔ́ǹ-ni icoo, ama kí kpāafì-ni kii ni nín sá m-biyaamu m néeń-ni puee ní.

english_verse: Ten thousand people may teach you about Christ, but I am your only father. You became my children when I told you about Christ Jesus,
translation_verse: Báà binib kutukub saalaa di yaa làá kpòotī-ni nnimbɔtisan poon, ni-baa làá nīn pée sá ubambaanti ní. Ní nīn nyí yii man di sá ni-baa, kun puee man di cáań Tibɔmɔntiil ki sòon̄ nì ni, ní ni fōō ki kíí.

english_verse: and I want you to be like me.
translation_verse: An puee, m bàlifī-ni yii ní fōō man bimbim kí nīn ŋáań man nín ŋáań puee.

english_verse: This is why I sent Timothy to you. I love him like a son, and he is a faithful servant of the Lord. Timothy will tell you what I do to follow Christ and how it agrees with what I always teach about Christ in every church.
translation_verse: An pu ní m dū m-jipɔɔn Tiimootee un sá m-bineeŋkaaki ki yú deedee ti-Dindaan saŋŋunee ki túnní ni-cee. U làá téetí-ni man nín dī Kriisitoo saŋŋu miŋyee, kii m nín dàkà Kriisitoo nikitiŋ kɔkɔ kansikin puee.

english_verse: Some of you think I am not coming for a visit, and so you are bragging.
translation_verse: Ni-kansikin biba nín dākafì yii maa ti làá gítiń ni-ceeyee puee, bi bí ki yòontí bi-ba yilpu.

english_verse: But if the Lord lets me come, I will soon be there. Then I will find out if the ones who are doing all this bragging really have any power.
translation_verse: Ama ti-Dindaan yaa là, an kaa làá ti yúntí, m làá dāan̄ ni-cee. M yaa láa bāańee, an kaa dāa sá bilambidambi gbanti nyɔɔbuŋŋi ní m làá pīlifì, ama tin bi ŋūǹ kí ŋée ní m làá kpèè.

english_verse: God's kingdom isn't just a lot of words. It is power.
translation_verse: Di sá yii Unimbɔti Beel kaa sá nì anyɔɔbun ŋmaniŋma, an sá Circir Fam nín tìì unil mpɔn ú ŋá kuŋkuŋyee.

english_verse: What do you want me to do when I arrive? Do you want me to be hard on you or to be kind and gentle?
translation_verse: Ni là ḿ dāan̄ ni-cee nì mbambaanaaa, ḿ dāan̄ nì dineendi nì nsɔŋfi ní?

english_verse: I have heard terrible things about some of you. In fact, you are behaving worse than Gentiles. A man is even sleeping with his own stepmother.
translation_verse: M gbìl̄ bi sòoǹ tijɔkɔndi tin bí ni-kansikinee pu. An jɔkɔntee, bin kaa fōō Yeesu ki kííyee kaa kíikí kí ŋá míǹ gba. M gbìl̄ yii ni-kansikin ubɔ cáá u-baa nimpuaa!

english_verse: You are proud, when you ought to feel bad enough to chase away anyone who acts like this.
translation_verse: Ni ŋáań míǹ ní ki gíti cáá dilambil kaa bí kunimbaaun kí nyāntí un ŋá an tundee ni-kansikin.

english_verse: You must then hand that man over to Satan. His body will be destroyed, but his spirit will be saved when the Lord Jesus returns.
translation_verse: ní dāá dū an niliuee kí tīī Sitaan. U làá sàaǹ u-wunti ní u-naŋki ń dāá ŋmátí ti-Dindaan gítintam.

english_verse: Stop being proud! Don't you know how a little yeast can spread through the whole batch of dough?
translation_verse: Kun pu ní ni dàkafī ki cáá dilambilee kaa ŋān̄. Naa nyí yii ŋkpɔnɔnyɔkɔ fiiiyee ní bi dù kí ŋá bukpɔnɔsaa ní án jɔ̄m̀aaa?

english_verse: Get rid of the old yeast! Then you will be like fresh bread made without yeast, and this is what you are. Our Passover lamb is Christ, who has already been sacrificed.
translation_verse: Nyāntímaan nnyɔɔkpiki gbanti ŋun sá ikpitee kí nīn sá circirdambi kii bukpɔnɔsaa bun kaa cáá nnyɔkɔee. Ni kpántì míǹ ki dóò, kun puee Kriisitoo un sá-ti Dilákatil jiŋaaliu pibilee dū u-ba ki ŋá saraa ipii yil pu ki tīī timbi.

english_verse: So don't celebrate the festival by being evil and sinful, which is like serving bread made with yeast. Be pure and truthful and celebrate by using bread made without yeast.
translation_verse: An puee, tí jīmaan ti-jiŋaaliu gbanti nì kpɔnɔb bin poon baa ŋá ŋkpɔnɔnyɔkɔ ŋun sá kii ikpiti nì tijɔkɔndee, ama án nīn sá kii kpɔnɔb bin kaa cáá nnyɔkɔee, ki sá circir nì ibaamɔnee.

english_verse: In my other letter I told you not to have anything to do with immoral people.
translation_verse: M nìn ŋmàn̄-ni kugbɔŋu ki tùkū-ni yii ní taa yàntī ni nì bin tūǹ ajɔkɔntuunee ń nīn kpáfí.

english_verse: But I wasn't talking about the people of this world. You would have to leave this world to get away from everyone who is immoral or greedy or who cheats or worships idols.
translation_verse: Maa nìn lì bin bí duulinyan ki tūǹ ajɔkɔntuunee nì nnimbitaataam dambi nì binaayub nì biwaatootiliibi. An yaa bàà sá bíǹ pu ní m lèe, m bàà lì yii ní nyā duulinya poon ní.

english_verse: I was talking about your own people who are immoral or greedy or worship idols or curse others or get drunk or cheat. Don't even eat with them!
translation_verse: M nín baasii là kí lì min kugbɔŋu gbanti poonee di sá: unil un lì yii u sá Kriisitoo yɔu, ama ní ki tūǹ ajɔkɔntuun àá ki cáá nnimbitaataam àá ki sá uwaatootil àá ki sìí binib àá ki sá udanyɔgbil àá unaayuuyee ní m lì. Ni nì an niliuee ń taa kpāfì kí jī tijin.

english_verse: Why should I judge outsiders? Aren't we supposed to judge only church members?
translation_verse: Man di kaa làá sòoǹ bin kaa nóó Yeesuee bɔti. Bin sá Kriisitoo yabee bɔti ní an sá ní sòoǹ.

english_verse: God judges everyone else. The Scriptures say, “Chase away any of your own people who are evil.”
translation_verse: Unimbɔti di làá sòoǹ bin kaa sá Kriisitoo yabee bɔti. Nyāntímaan unikpiti ni-kansikin.

english_verse: When one of you has a complaint against another, do you take your complaint to a court of sinners? Or do you take it to God's people?
translation_verse: Ba pu ní ni-kansikin ubɔ nì u-juti yaa cáá tɔb tibɔtee, ni cáa cáǹ bin kaa nóó Yeesuee cee, kaa cáa cáǹ bin nóó Yeesuee cee ní?

english_verse: Don't you know that God's people will judge the world? And if you are going to judge the world, can't you settle small problems?
translation_verse: Naa nyí yii bin fōō Yeesu ki kííyee di làá dāá sòoǹ duulinya yab bɔtaaa? Nimbi bin làá dāá sòoǹ duulinya yab bɔtee di kaa ŋūǹ kí sòoǹ tibɔti tin bí sɔkɔmiiyeeee?

english_verse: Don't you know we will judge angels? And if this is so, we can surely judge everyday matters.
translation_verse: Naa nyí yii timbi di làá dāá sòoǹ ituun bɔtaaa? Kin ataa aŋa pu ní taa ŋūǹ kí sòoǹ binib bɔti.

english_verse: Why do you take everyday complaints to judges who are not respected by the church?
translation_verse: Di sá yii nimbi kansikinee, ni yaa cáá tɔb tibee, bin Kriisitoo nikitil kaa dūu yíiń binibee, bíǹ ní nimbi cāabìń bí nīn sá bibɔsoonliibi.

english_verse: I say this to your shame. Aren't any of you wise enough to act as a judge between one follower and another?
translation_verse: Mimmee ni-kansikin ubɔ kaa bí ki cáá iciin kí nīn ŋáŋkí ni-kansikin bɔtaaa? Ni-cooi ní m bíi lì nee.

english_verse: Why should one of you take another to be tried by unbelievers?
translation_verse: Nimbee, ni nì ni-nabiki yaa cáá tɔb tibɔtee, see bin kaa nyí Unimbɔtee cee ní ni tin sòoǹ-tì.

english_verse: When one of you takes another to court, all of you lose. It would be better to let yourselves be cheated and robbed.
translation_verse: Kɔŋkɔnnee ni yīntì kpataaa ni nì ni-nabiyaamu nín cáá tɔb tibɔtee pu. Ba pu ní bi yaa ŋá-ni tin kaa kítèe, naa jīǹ kimɔtii ní? Ba pu ní naa yàntī un yùn̄-nee ń nīn cáa cá ní?

english_verse: Don't you know that evil people won't have a share in the blessings of God's kingdom? Don't fool yourselves! No one who is immoral or worships idols or is unfaithful in marriage or is a pervert or behaves like a homosexual
translation_verse: Naa nyí yii bin ŋáań tin kaa kítèe kaa làá dāá kɔ́ Unimbɔti Beelinaaa? Ubɔ ń taa mɔ̄ntì u-ba. Bin ŋáań tijɔkɔndee nì biwaatootiliibi nì bilaakpaadambi nì bin dɔ̀ nì bi-ninjajutiibee,

english_verse: will share in God's kingdom. Neither will any thief or greedy person or drunkard or anyone who curses and cheats others.
translation_verse: nì binaayub nì nnimbitaataam dambi nì bidanyɔgbiliibi nì bin sìí binibee nì biyipɔɔdambee kaa làá dāá kɔ́ Unimbɔti Beelin.

english_verse: Some of you used to be like that. But now the name of our Lord Jesus Christ and the power of God's Spirit have washed you and made you holy and acceptable to God. Honor God with Your Body
translation_verse: Míǹ poon ní ni-kansikin biba nìn bí. Ama Unimbɔti fùl̄-ni ki lēē ni-kpitii, ki gāntì-ni ki yóoǹ ní nīn sá u-yab. Ti-Dindaan Yeesu Kriisitoo nì Unimbɔti Fam puee, ni kpántì deedeedambi. Ní yàntī ni-wunti ń tīī ti-Dindaan tinyool

english_verse: Some of you say, “We can do anything we want to.” But I tell you not everything is good for us. So I refuse to let anything have power over me.
translation_verse: Ni-kansikin biba lì yii: «M cáá nsan kí ŋá tikɔkɔ», ama tikɔkɔ di kaa ŋān̄ ki tīī-mi. Báà m yaa cáá nsan kí ŋá tikɔkɔɔɔ, an kaa sá báà kuŋyee ní ḿ dū m-ba kí tīī kuyuŋu.

english_verse: You also say, “Food is meant for our bodies, and our bodies are meant for food.” But I tell you that God will destroy them both. We are not supposed to do indecent things with our bodies. We are to use them for the Lord who is in charge of our bodies.
translation_verse: «Tijin bí ki tīī dipool ní, ní dipool mun bí ki tīī tijin,» ama Unimbɔti làá dāá kúntí tíǹ liitil. Tiwun tíǹ kaa bí ki tīī dijɔkɔntundi, tì bí ki tīī ti-Dindaan ní, ní ti-Dindaan mun bí ki tīī tiwun.

english_verse: God will raise us from death by the same power he used when he raised our Lord to life.
translation_verse: Ní Unimbɔti un fīkitì ti-Dindaanee ń dāá dū u-pɔŋŋuee kí fìkitī ti mun.

english_verse: Don't you know that your bodies are part of the body of Christ? Is it right for me to join part of the body of Christ to a prostitute? No, it isn't!
translation_verse: Naa nyí yii ni-wunti sá Kriisitoo wunjaŋŋi níii? M kíikí kí yòon̄ Kriisitoo wunjaŋŋi kí dūú kpāfì nì kilaakpaai yɔŋuɔɔɔ? Aayee, báà fiii!

english_verse: Don't you know that a man who does that becomes part of her body? The Scriptures say, “The two of them will be like one person.”
translation_verse: Naa nyí yii un nì kilaakpaai yaa kpáfèe, udaan wunti nì kilaakpaai yati ŋá tibaantiilaaa? Kun puee Unimbɔti gbɔŋku poon lī yii: «Bi-liitilee ŋá ubaanti dee.»

english_verse: But anyone who is joined to the Lord is one in spirit with him.
translation_verse: Ama un nì ti-Dindaan yaa kpáfèe, udaan nì ti-Dindaan ŋá ubaanti ŋfamin dee.

english_verse: Don't be immoral in matters of sex. That is a sin against your own body in a way no other sin is.
translation_verse: Ní fámaan ajɔkɔntuun, di sá yii ikpiti in kíǹ binib ŋáańee kaa gbèetī tiwun, ama un ŋáań ajɔkɔntuunee, úǹ u-ba wunti ní u ŋáań ikpiti.

english_verse: You surely know that your body is a temple where the Holy Spirit lives. The Spirit is in you and is a gift from God. You are no longer your own.
translation_verse: Àá naa nyí yii ni-wunti sá Unimbɔti Fam min u tīī-nee diiku ní naa yì ni-ba?

english_verse: God paid a great price for you. So use your body to honor God.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti dá-ni nì kudapɔɔu ní, an puee ní kpáaǹ ni-wunti kí tīī-u tinyool.

english_verse: Now I will answer the questions you asked in your letter. You asked, “Is it best for people not to marry?”
translation_verse: Tí kpèè kugbɔŋu kun ni ŋmàn̄ee bɔti. An ŋān̄ ki tīī unil ń taa bàà cáá unimpu.

english_verse: Well, having your own husband or wife should keep you from doing something immoral.
translation_verse: Ama, án taa láa yàntī ní kɔ́ ajɔkɔntuun poonee, an máaǹ uninja kamaa ń nīn cáá u-nimpuu, ní unimpu kamaa ń nīn cáá u-cal.

english_verse: Husbands and wives should be fair with each other about having sex.
translation_verse: Uninja ń tɔ̄ u-tundi nín sá puee kí tīī u-nimpuu, ní unimpu mun ń ŋá míǹ mbaantiim kí tīī u-cal.

english_verse: A wife belongs to her husband instead of to herself, and a husband belongs to his wife instead of to himself.
translation_verse: Di sá yii an kaa sá unimpu di yì u-wunti u-ba, an sá u-cal di yì. Míǹ mbaantiim an kaa sá uninja di yì u-wunti u-ba, an sá u-nimpuu di yì.

english_verse: So don't refuse sex to each other, unless you agree not to have sex for a little while, in order to spend time in prayer. Then Satan won't be able to tempt you because of your lack of self-control.
translation_verse: An puee, ubɔ ń taa ŋmìntī u-juti báà tiba, asee ni yaa sòon̄ ki gbìlīǹ tɔb kí dū ŋyunti ŋubɔ kí taa gbēē tɔb kí ŋmā kí mèè. Ni nín mēē míǹ ki dóòyee, ní ní fàtīí kpāfì. An yaa kaa sá míǹ, ni nín kaa ŋūǹ kí nīn gbíntì ki ŋúb́ ni-ba ki ŋmèéyee puee, Sitaan ŋūǹ kí dī míǹ pu kí cɔ̄ŋkì-ni.

english_verse: In my opinion that is what should be done, though I don't know of anything the Lord said about this matter.
translation_verse: Tin m sòoǹ-ni nee, kaa sá mara ní m síiǹ-ni, m sáŋkí-ni ní.

english_verse: My advice for the unmarried and for widows is that it is acceptable for them to remain single, just as I am.
translation_verse: Ama, m tùkù bin kaa cáá binimpoobi àá kaa mɔ́ǹee nì bikpiipoobi yii an bàà ŋān̄ bí gbíntí míǹ kii man nín bí pu nee.

english_verse: But if you don't have enough self-control, then go ahead and get married. After all, it is better to marry than to burn with desire.
translation_verse: Ama bi yaa kaa ŋūǹ kí cúú bi-ba kí kàl̄ míǹ, bí mɔ̄ǹ àá bí cáá binimpoobi, kun puee an sɔ́ á cáá unimpu àá á mɔ̄ǹ ki jítiǹ á nīn kā ki wù fɔ̀rrr fám.

english_verse: I instruct married couples to stay together, and this is exactly what the Lord himself taught. A wife who leaves her husband
translation_verse: Nimbi binimpucaaliibi nì bicamɔnliibi ní m tìì mara nee, yii: Unimpu ń taa yīkì u-cal cee.

english_verse: should either stay single or go back to her husband. And a husband should not leave his wife.
translation_verse: U yaa tí cāntì u-calaaa, ú nīn kā míǹ kí taa mɔ̄ǹ ubɔ, àá u nì u-cal ń ŋāŋkì bi-kansikin ú fàtīí gítiń-u. Míǹ mbaantiim, uninja mun ń taa jà u-nimpuu.

english_verse: I don't know of anything else the Lord said about marriage. All I can do is to give you my own advice. If your wife isn't a follower of the Lord, but is willing to stay with you, don't divorce her.
translation_verse: Nimbi bin kíǹee, tin m làá tùkù-nee sèé, M lī yii a yaa cáá unimpu ní ki dāa fōō Yeesu ki kíí ní a-nimpuu kaa fōō Yeesu ki kíí, ama ní ki kíí kí nīn gbíntìi sá a-nimpuuee, á taa yàntī-u.

english_verse: If your husband isn't a follower, but is willing to stay with you, don't divorce him.
translation_verse: Míǹ ní unimpu mun yaa tí nóó Yeesu ní u-cal kaa nóó Yeesu, ama ní ki kíí ú nīn gbíntìi sá u-nimpuuee, ú taa yīkì-u.

english_verse: Your husband or wife who isn't a follower is made holy by having you as a partner. This also makes your children holy and keeps them from being unclean in God's sight.
translation_verse: Uninja un kaa nóó Yeesuee nimpuu nín nóó Yeesuee puee, u kíǹ ki pìl̄ Unimbɔti dee. Ní unimpu un kaa nóó Yeesuee mun kíǹ ki pìl̄ Unimbɔti u-cal un nóó Yeesuee pu. An yaa kaa sá mimmee, bi-biyaamu kaa bàà pìl̄ nì Unimbɔti. An nín sá mimmee puee, bi-biyaamu bí circir.

english_verse: If your husband or wife isn't a follower of the Lord and decides to divorce you, then you should agree to it. You are no longer bound to that person. After all, God chose you and wants you to live at peace.
translation_verse: Ama a yaa nóó Yeesu ní a-cal àá a-nimpuu kaa nóó Yeesu ní ki là kí càntī-see, pɔ̄-u nsan ú nīn cá, mara ubɔ kaa bóob́-si á cúú-u mpɔn kí kàan̄. Di sá yii Unimbɔti yíiń-ti tí dāan̄ kí nīn bí ŋgbansɔŋfin ní.

english_verse: And besides, how do you know if you will be able to save your husband or wife who isn't a follower? Obeying the Lord at All Times
translation_verse: Unimpu, a nyí yii sii nì a-cal yaa làá nīn gbíntì ki bí, a làá ŋmā kí fīī-uaaa? Àá uninja, a nyí yii sii nì a-nimpuu yaa làá nīn gbíntì ki bí a làá ŋmā kí fīī-u? Unimbɔti nín yíiń-ni puee, nín̄ bímaan míǹ

english_verse: In every church I tell the people to stay as they were when the Lord Jesus chose them and God called them to be his own. Now I say the same thing to you.
translation_verse: Tin bée di sá yii báà ŋma ń nīn ŋúb́ min ti-Dindaan tīī-u ki wāatì ní u nín fōō Yeesu ki kííyee. An marau ní m síiǹ Kriisitoo nikitiŋ kɔkɔ kansikin.

english_verse: If you are already circumcised, don't try to change it. If you are not circumcised, don't get circumcised.
translation_verse: Sii un yaa gíí dikpancandi ní ki nín fōō Yeesu ki kííyee ń taa nín̄ yáliŋkí yii a làá gíti ŋá mana. Sii un kaa gíí dikpancandi ní ki fōō Yeesu ki kííyee ń taa gíí.

english_verse: Being circumcised or uncircumcised isn't really what matters. The important thing is to obey God's commands.
translation_verse: A yaa gííyaaa, a yaa kaa gííyaaa, tíǹ bɔti kaa páb́, tin pée páb́ee di sá á nīn ŋúb́ Unimbɔti marab.

english_verse: So don't try to change what you were when God chose you.
translation_verse: Báà ŋma ń nīn gbíntì ki bí min ní u nìn pée bí ní ki nín fōō Yeesu ki kííyee.

english_verse: Are you a slave? Don't let that bother you. But if you can win your freedom, you should.
translation_verse: A yaa nìn sá uyumbu ní ki nín fōō Yeesu ki kíí, á taa nín̄ yáliŋkí, ama a yaa tí ŋūǹ kí fōō a-baaa, á pɔ́ɔǹ kí fōō a-ba.

english_verse: When the Lord chooses slaves, they become his free people. And when he chooses free people, they become slaves of Christ.
translation_verse: Uyumbu un fōō ti-Dindaan ki kííyee, ti-Dindaan nyántì-u ikpiti yuŋkun, míǹ ní un yì u-ba ki fōō Yeesu ki kííyee sá Kriisitoo yumbuu.

english_verse: God paid a great price for you. So don't become slaves of anyone else.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti dá-ni nì kudapɔɔu ní, an puee ní taa gíti dū ni-ba kí ŋá binib yumbui.

english_verse: I don't know of anything the Lord said about people who have never been married. But I will tell you what I think. And you can trust me, because the Lord has treated me with kindness.
translation_verse: An yaa kíǹ bin làá cáá binimpoobi nì bin làá mɔ̄ǹee bɔtee, ti-Dindaan kaa tīī-mi mara ḿ yóoń-bi, ama man nín dàkafī puee ní m làá lì kii m nín sá unil un ti-Dindaan pú diyimɔɔl bi cáá m-pu dimákalee pu.

english_verse: We are now going through hard times, and I think it is best for you to stay as you are.
translation_verse: Man ká yii, kii dinimbinaamandi din bí kɔŋkɔnnee puee, an ŋān̄ unil ń taa cáá unimpu.

english_verse: If you are married, stay married. If you are not married, don't try to get married.
translation_verse: A yaa gíti dáá cáá unimpuee, taa ti nyàab̀ nsan yii a làá jà-u. A yaa kaa láá tí cááyaaa, á taa ti cáá.

english_verse: It isn't wrong to marry, even if you have never been married before. But those who marry will have a lot of trouble, and I want to protect you from this.
translation_verse: Ama nì míǹ kɔkɔee, uninja yaa cáá unimpu, waa yīntì, míǹ ní unimpu mun yaa mɔ́ǹ waa yīntì. Ama digìŋ́kpaandi di làá bà binimpucaaliibi nì bicamɔnliibi. An pu ní m bàà là kí nyāntí-bi digìńdin.

english_verse: My friends, what I mean is that the Lord will soon come, and it won't matter if you are married or not.
translation_verse: Nnabiyaamu, tin m làá lèe di sá yii ŋyunti kaa ti náaǹ. An puee bin cáá binimpoobee ń nīn bí kii bin kaa cááyee,

english_verse: It will be all the same if you are crying or laughing, or if you are buying or are completely broke.
translation_verse: bin sūǹee ń nīn bí kii kunimbaau kaa cáá-bee, bin lāāyee ń nīn bí kii an kaa mɔ̄ǹ-bee, binyampoobi bin dāāyee ń nīn bí kii baa cáá tibee.

english_verse: It won't make any difference how much good you are getting from this world or how much you like it. This world as we know it is now passing away.
translation_verse: Bin bí ki jīǹ duulinya puee ń nīn bí kii baa bíi páatí tibee. Kun puee, ni nín wāĺ duulinya bí min nee, u làá dāá kúntí.

english_verse: I want all of you to be free from worry. An unmarried man worries about how to please the Lord.
translation_verse: M bàà là yii ní nīn tɔ́ ni-ba kí taa nín̄ nìiǹ, di sá yii ti-Dindaan tundi ŋmaniŋma pu ní un kaa cáá unimpuee nimbiliŋ máǹ ki nyàab̀ kí fáatí ti-Dindaan.

english_verse: But a married man has more worries. He must worry about the things of this world, because he wants to please his wife.
translation_verse: Ama un cáá unimpuee nimbiliŋ máǹ duulinya tuuŋŋi pu ní u nyàab̀ kí fáatíǹ u-nimpuu.

english_verse: So he is pulled in two directions. Unmarried women and women who have never been married worry only about pleasing the Lord, and they keep their bodies and minds pure. But a married woman worries about the things of this world, because she wants to please her husband.
translation_verse: Niinee u-landɔkɔi ŋá ili dee. Míǹ ní unimpu àá usapɔɔn un kaa mɔ́ǹee nimbiliŋ máǹ ti-Dindaan tundi pu, án nín làá ŋá pu u-wunti nì u-pɔbil ń nīn bí circiree. Ama unimpu àá usapɔɔn un mɔ́ǹee nimbiliŋ máǹ duulinya tuuŋŋi pu ní u nyàab̀ kí nīn fáatì u-cal.

english_verse: What I am saying is for your own good—it isn't to limit your freedom. I want to help you to live right and to love the Lord above all else.
translation_verse: Ni-ŋanti pu ní m sòoǹ tin bí nee, an kaa sá kí bàkan̄-ni. M là ní nīn ŋáań min ŋān̄ ki kítèe ní, kí dū ni-ba kɔkɔ kí ŋá ti-Dindaan ŋaan kí taa kíń báà laaba.

english_verse: But suppose you are engaged to someone old enough to be married, and you want her so much that all you can think about is getting married. Then go ahead and marry. There is nothing wrong with that.
translation_verse: Unaacimpɔɔn un di yaa bàà lēē yii waa làá cáá u-bɔɔn ní ki dāa gíti ká yii waa ŋūǹ kí cúú u-ba, án làá nīn pée páb́-u míǹ kí nīn cée, ú cáá u-bɔɔn, waa ŋá ikpiti.

english_verse: It is perfectly all right to marry, but it is better not to get married at all.
translation_verse: Un kaa ŋúń ki cúú u-ba ki cáá u-bɔɔnee cee ŋān̄. Ama un ŋúń ki cúú u-ba kaa cáá u-bɔɔnee cee ŋān̄ ki lákatì.

english_verse: A wife should stay married to her husband until he dies. Then she is free to marry again, but only to a man who is a follower of the Lord.
translation_verse: Unimpu un mɔ́ǹee máaǹ kí nīn pée náká u-cal ní bí nīn bí iyunti kɔkɔ. Ama u-cal yaa kpíìyee, u tɔ́ u-ba kí mɔ̄ǹ un u yaa lèe. Ama un fōō Yeesu ki kííyee ní an sá ú fàtīí mɔ̄ǹ.

english_verse: However, I think I am obeying God's Spirit when I say she would be happier to stay single.
translation_verse: Man ceeyee, u yaa gbíntì míǹ kaa mɔ́ǹ, u-pɔbil làá nīn sɔ̀m̀ ki jítiǹ u yaa mɔ́ǹ. Man nín dàkafī puee dee, ní m fōō ki kíí yii ma mun cáá Unimbɔti Fam.

english_verse: In your letter you asked me about food offered to idols. All of us know something about this subject. But knowledge makes us proud of ourselves, while love makes us helpful to others.
translation_verse: Tiwaŋkuti tin bi tōotì awaayee nanti bɔtee, ti nyí yii báà ŋma nyí, ama dinyil cāabìń dilambil ní, ní dineendi yàntī binib cá nyɔkɔpu nnimbɔtisan poon.

english_verse: In fact, people who think they know so much don't know anything at all.
translation_verse: Un dàkafī yii u nyí tibee kaa láá béè min sá ú bééyee.

english_verse: But God has no doubts about who loves him.
translation_verse: Ama un yaa néeń Unimbɔtee, Unimbɔti béè udaan dee.

english_verse: Even though food is offered to idols, we know that none of the idols in this world are alive. After all, there is only one God.
translation_verse: Ni nín bālifì yii ni ŋūǹ kí ŋmɔ́ tiwaatootinanaaayee, ti nyí yii diwaal kaa sá tiba duulinya poon, míǹ ní báà unimbɔti ubɔ gíti kpá see Unimbɔtibaantee.

english_verse: Many things in heaven and on earth are called gods and lords, but none of them really are gods or lords.
translation_verse: Binib dàkafī yii inimbɔti wīikí, iba bí yilpu ní iba bí taapu. Tiŋman, bíǹ ceeyee, inimbɔti wīikí ní bidindambi mun wīikí.

english_verse: We have only one God, and he is the Father. He created everything, and we live for him. Jesus Christ is our only Lord. Everything was made by him, and by him life was given to us.
translation_verse: Timbee, ti cáá Unimbɔtibambaanti ní, úǹ di sá Ubaati un náań tikɔkɔee. Úǹ pu ní ti bí. Ní ti-Dindaan sá ubaanti, úǹ di sá Yeesu Kriisitoo. Úǹ pu ní tiwan kɔkɔ bí, u-pu ní ti mun bí.

english_verse: Not everyone knows these things. In fact, many people have grown up with the belief that idols have life in them. So when they eat meat offered to idols, they are bothered by a weak conscience.
translation_verse: Ama bi-kɔkɔ kaa nyí míǹ. Di sá yii awaatuun mántiǹ biba, ní bi gbíntì ki ŋmóò tiwaatootinan, a lì kii diwaal di lafun baasii yì tinan gbantee, ní bi-pɔbiliŋ nín kaa pɔ̄ɔ̄ puee ní bí ŋá ikpiti.

english_verse: But food doesn't bring us any closer to God. We are no worse off if we don't eat, and we are no better off if we do.
translation_verse: Di sá yii tijin di kaa làá yàntī tí sútí kí pìl̄ Unimbɔti. Ti yaa jíńaaa, an kaa làá bàtī-ti tiba, ti yaa kaa jíńaaa, an kaa làá gbéeǹ-ti tiba.

english_verse: Don't cause problems for someone with a weak conscience, just because you have the right to eat anything.
translation_verse: Ama ní nīn nyíǹ ni-ba nì ni nín tɔ́ ni-ba ki ŋáań miŋyee, án taa yàntī bin kaa pɔ̄ɔ̄ nnimbɔtisan poonee ń lítí.

english_verse: You know all this, and so it doesn't bother you to eat in the temple of an idol. But suppose a person with a weak conscience sees you and decides to eat food that has been offered to idols.
translation_verse: Un kaa pɔ̄ɔ̄ nnimbɔtisan poonee yaa ká sii un nyí Unimbɔti bɔti tiŋanee yaa kā ditaŋgbandi diba taapu ki jīǹee, an kaa téekí-u ú ŋmɔ́ tiwaatootinanaaa?

english_verse: Then what you know has destroyed someone Christ died for.
translation_verse: Ní sii nyítam puee, kinabiki kin kaa láá béè ki dóòyee, kinabiki kin pu Kriisitoo kpíìyee ń wāŋkàaa?

english_verse: When you sin by hurting a follower with a weak conscience, you sin against Christ.
translation_verse: Ni nín bí ki ŋáań ni-nabiyaamu ikpiti min ki kɔ̄ntí bin kaa láá béè ki dóòyee landɔkɔi iweenee, an sá Kriisitoo ní ni ŋáań ikpiti gbanti.

english_verse: So if I hurt one of the Lord's followers by what I eat, I will never eat meat as long as I live.
translation_verse: An puee, tijin jītam di yaa làá yàntī m-nabiki ń lítée, m kpá kí ŋmɔ́ tinan, án nín làá ŋá pu m-nabiki ń taa lítée.

english_verse: I am free. I am an apostle. I have seen the Lord Jesus and have led you to have faith in him.
translation_verse: Maa tɔ́ m-baaa? Maa sá Yeesu kpambalaaa? Maa ká Yeesu ti-Dindaanaaa? M nín túń ti-Dindaan tundi ki nyántì kuŋyee di kaa sá nimbaaa?

english_verse: Others may think that I am not an apostle, but you are proof that I am an apostle to you.
translation_verse: Báà bin kíǹee yaa bí yii maa sá bíǹ cee Yeesu kpambal, nimbi máaǹ kí nīn nyí-mi yii m sá dikpambal. Ni nì ti-Dindaan nín ŋá ubaanti puee di dàkà yii m sá dikpambal.

english_verse: When people question me, I tell them
translation_verse: M nín sòoǹ tin ki tùkù bin kpākantí-mee dee.

english_verse: that Barnabas and I have the right to our food and drink.
translation_verse: Man kaa cáá nsan kí jī kí nyɔ̀ m-tundi puɔɔɔ?

english_verse: We each have the right to marry one of the Lord's followers and to take her along with us, just as the other apostles and the Lord's brothers and Peter do.
translation_verse: Maa cáá nsan ki mun ń yòon̄ unimpu un nóó Yeesuee kí ŋá m-nimpuu ú nīn táá-mi kii akpambal ŋin kíǹee nì ti-Dindaan nabiyaamu nì Peetroo nín ŋá pueeee?

english_verse: Are we the only ones who have to support ourselves by working at another job?
translation_verse: Àá an sá yii man nì Baarnaabaasi baba ní ń tɔ̄ ditundi ní kí nín ká kí jī ní?

english_verse: Do soldiers pay their own salaries? Don't people who raise grapes eat some of what they grow? Don't shepherds get milk from their own goats?
translation_verse: Ŋma di kóò tisoojati baa pà-u? Àá unil kaa ŋmóò busubu bun u cóoǹee biliŋaaa? Àá unaakpaal kaa nyù inaa in u kpàáyee naabiimaaa?

english_verse: I am not saying this on my own authority. The Law of Moses tells us not to muzzle an ox when it is grinding grain. But was God concerned only about an ox?
translation_verse: An ŋmàn̄ Mooyiisi marab poon yii: «Á taa bóob́ unaa un gbáà idee nyɔkɔ.» Mimmee inaa bɔti páb́ Unimbɔtaaa?

english_verse: No, he wasn't! He was talking about us. This was written in the Scriptures so that all who plow and all who grind the grain will look forward to sharing in the harvest.
translation_verse: An kaa sá timbi pu ní an sòon̄ mimmaaa? Tiŋman, an sá timbi pu ní bi sòon̄ míǹ. An máaǹ un kù idee nì un gbáàyee ń nīn cáá dimákal yii bi làá ká bi-paatii poon.

english_verse: When we told the message to you, it was like planting spiritual seed. So we have the right to accept material things as our harvest from you.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti bɔti ní timbi búĺ ni-pɔbiliŋin. Mimmee ni-wanti tin ni cáá duulinyanee, ti yaa fōō tiba poonee, ti fōō ki lákatàaa?

english_verse: If others have the right to do this, we have an even greater right. But we haven't used this right of ours. We are willing to put up with anything to keep from causing trouble for the message about Christ.
translation_verse: Biba yaa cáá nsan ki jīǹ ni-puee, timbi kaa máaǹ kí jī ni-pu kí jītíǹ bidambaaa? Ama min bàà máaǹ ní ŋá kí tīī-tee, ti ŋmēē kaa bālifì-ni an pu, án nín làá ŋá pu tiba ń taa lìkin̄-ni Kriisitoo Bɔmɔntiiti saŋŋunee.

english_verse: Don't you know that people who work in the temple make their living from what is brought to the temple? Don't you know that a person who serves at the altar is given part of what is offered?
translation_verse: Ni nyí yii bin tūǹ ditundi kunimbɔtidiinee, niin jinti ní bi jīǹ, ní bin ŋáań saraabee mun cáá bi-jandi saraabee poon.

english_verse: In the same way, the Lord wants everyone who preaches the good news to make a living from preaching this message.
translation_verse: Míǹ ní ti-Dindaan pú kinyɔkɔ yii bin sòoǹ Tibɔmɔntiilee ń nīn jīǹ bin cee bi sòoǹee ŋaan.

english_verse: But I have never used these privileges of mine, and I am not writing this because I want to start now. I would rather die than have someone rob me of the right to take pride in this.
translation_verse: Ama maa bālifì tin an sá ní ŋá kí tīī-mee tiba nì tiba pu. Maa tí bíi ŋmà yii ní ŋá kí tīī-mi. M yaa gbíntì míǹ ki kpíì, an sɔ́ ki jítiǹ ubɔ ń bàtī m-nyooti.

english_verse: I don't have any reason to brag about preaching the good news. Preaching is something God told me to do, and if I don't do it, I am doomed.
translation_verse: Tibɔmɔntiil sòontamee kaa sá-mi dilambitundi, ama an páb́-mi yii ḿ sòoǹ ní, kun puee an sá-mi mbusu ní m yaa kaa sòoǹ Tibɔmɔntiil gbantee.

english_verse: If I preach because I want to, I will be paid. But even if I don't want to, it is still something God has sent me to do.
translation_verse: M yaa tūǹ ditundi gbanti nì dipɔbil dibee, m cáá tipaal. M yaa kaa tí túń-dì nì dipɔbil dibaaa, ditundi din Unimbɔti tīī-mee dee.

english_verse: What pay am I given? It is the chance to preach the good news free of charge and not to use the privileges that are mine because I am a preacher.
translation_verse: Mimmee, m-paati di sá ba? M-paati di sá ḿ sòoǹ Tibɔmɔntiil kí tīī binib faalaa kí taa fōō tiba, ama ki mun bàà cáá nsan kí fōō tiba.

english_verse: I am not anyone's slave. But I have become a slave to everyone, so I can win as many people as possible.
translation_verse: M sá unil un yì u-bee ní, maa sá uyumbu. Ama kí ŋmā kí dáaliń kunipaau kí cáań Kriisitoo ceeyee, see m nín dū m-ba ki gíiǹ báà ŋma yumbuuee.

english_verse: When I am with the Jews, I live like a Jew to win Jews. They are ruled by the Law of Moses, and I am not. But I live by the Law to win them.
translation_verse: M yaa bí Juuda yab ceeyee, m gīintí m-ba kii Juuda yab nín bí puee ní, kí ŋmā kí cáań-bi Kriisitoo cee. M yaa bí bin dī Mooyiisi marabee ceeyee, m gīintí m-ba kii bi mun nín bí puee ní, kí ŋmā kí cáań-bi Kriisitoo cee. Ama ní kaa bí m-ba marabee taapu.

english_verse: And when I am with people who are not ruled by the Law, I forget about the Law to win them. Of course, I never really forget about the law of God. In fact, I am ruled by the law of Christ.
translation_verse: M yaa tí bí bin kaa nóó Mooyiisi marabee ceeyee, m tí gīintí m-ba kii unil un kaa nóó marabee ní, kí ŋmā kí cáań-bi Kriisitoo cee. Míǹ kaa dàkà yii maa tɔ́ Unimbɔti marab. M tɔ́-bi, Kriisitoo marab taapu ní m bí.

english_verse: When I am with people whose faith is weak, I live as they do to win them. I do everything I can to win everyone I possibly can.
translation_verse: M yaa bí bin kaa pɔ̄ɔ̄ nnimbɔtisanee ceeyee, m gīintí m-ba kii bi mun nín bí puee ní, kí ŋmā kí cáań-bi Kriisitoo cee. Míǹ ní m gīintí m-ba báà ŋma nín bí miŋyee kí ŋmā kí fīī biba tiŋman pu.

english_verse: I do all this for the good news, because I want to share in its blessings. A Race and a Fight
translation_verse: Tibɔmɔntiil pu ní m pée bí ki ŋáań míǹ kɔkɔee kí ŋmā kí dāá ká tiwammɔntiil an poon.

english_verse: You know that many runners enter a race, and only one of them wins the prize. So run to win!
translation_verse: Naa nyí yii bin kɔkɔ cá ki sáń kpaŋkpakantikuee, ubaanti di lìntī ní kí fōō tipaalaaa? Ni mun, nín̄ sáḿmaan min máaǹ ní sāǹ kí lìntī kí fōō tipaalee.

english_verse: Athletes work hard to win a crown that cannot last, but we do it for a crown that will last forever.
translation_verse: Bin bin cá ditaatandi kpaŋkpakantikuuee kòó tiwan tikpil, mbeefuulimu mun kúùyee pu ní bíǹ ŋáań kpaŋkpakantikubee. Ama timbee, ti sáń kí fōō kifuulii kin làá nīn bí jaanjaanee ní.

english_verse: I don't run without a goal. And I don't box by beating my fists in the air.
translation_verse: An pu ní m sáń m-nimbiliŋ bá kun m sáń ki nyàab̀ee pu. M yaa làá mɔ̀ee, m bɔ́ntí ní kí nín bɔ̄, maa bōotí fám fám.

english_verse: I keep my body under control and make it my slave, so I won't lose out after telling the good news to others.
translation_verse: M sàantí m-wunti ní ki ŋúb́-tì. M pɔ̄ɔntí ní, án nín làá ŋá pu ḿ taa sòoǹ nì bin kíǹee Unimbɔti bɔti kí wāŋkì m-bee.

english_verse: Friends, I want to remind you that all our ancestors walked under the cloud and went through the sea.
translation_verse: Nnabiyaamu, m là ní téetí ditagbandi din nìn còom̄ ki dī ti-naanjab ki ŋmíntí-bee, nì bi-kɔkɔ nín nìn dūtì Tikati mɔɔl puee bɔti.

english_verse: This was like being baptized and becoming followers of Moses.
translation_verse: Ditagbandee nì dimɔɔlee poon ní bi fùl̄-bi bí nīn nóó Mooyiisi,

english_verse: All of them also ate the same spiritual food
translation_verse: ní bi-kɔkɔ jíń tijikaal tin nyēeń Unimbɔti ceeyee.

english_verse: and drank the same spiritual drink, which flowed from the spiritual rock that followed them. That rock was Christ.
translation_verse: Bi-kɔkɔ di tí nyùn̄ nnyim min nyēeń Unimbɔti ceeyee. Di sá yii bi nìn nyùn̄ ditaŋkpakpaandi din nyánní Unimbɔti cee ki cēentí-bee nyim ní, ditaŋkpalee nìn sá Kriisitoo ní.

english_verse: But most of them did not please God. So they died, and their bodies were scattered all over the desert.
translation_verse: Ama nì míǹ kɔkɔee, bi-kansikin tikpil nìn ŋáań min kaa fáatiǹ Unimbɔtee, an pu ní bi nìn kpíì kuteeun.

english_verse: What happened to them is a warning to keep us from wanting to do the same evil things.
translation_verse: Tin nìn ŋá-bi nee sá kudaaŋŋu ki tīī timbi tí taa nín̄ cáá ilandɔkɔkpiti kii bíǹ nín nìn cáá ilandɔkɔkpiti puee.

english_verse: They worshiped idols, just as the Scriptures say, “The people sat down to eat and drink. Then they got up to dance around.” So don't worship idols.
translation_verse: Ni mun ń taa ti nóó awaa kii bi-kansikin biba nín nìn nóó puee, a lì kii an nín ŋmàn̄ Unimbɔti gbɔŋku poon puee yii: «Kunipaau kāl̀ ki jíń ki nyùn̄ ní ki yíkì ki ŋōō ki gɔ́ǹ diwaal.»

english_verse: Some of those people did shameful things, and in a single day about
translation_verse: Ti mun ń taa ŋá tilaakpaal kii bi-kansikin biba nín nìn ŋá puee, an di nìn yāntì binib kutukub mmuŋku nì bita lítì ki kpíì ŋwimbaanti.

english_verse: Some of you say, “We can do whatever we want to!” But I tell you not everything may be good or helpful.
translation_verse: Biba lì yii: «M cáá nsan kí ŋá tikɔkɔ,» ama tikɔkɔ mun kaa ŋān̄ ki tīī-ni. «Ti cáá nsan kí ŋá tikɔkɔ,» ama an kaa sá tikɔkɔ di tútúǹ-ti nnimbɔtisan poon.

english_verse: And don't try to test Christ, as some of them did and were later bitten by poisonous snakes.
translation_verse: Tí taa ti cɔ̄ŋkìmaan ti-Dindaan kii bi-kansikin biba nín nìn cɔ́ŋkì-u pu kin ikoobu dāa júntì ki kūū-bee.

english_verse: Don't even grumble, as some of them did and were killed by the destroying angel.
translation_verse: Ni mun ń taa gbùkum̀ kii bi-kansikin biba nín nìn gbūkum̀ pu ŋkúm tuuŋŋu dɔ́miń ki kūū ki céetì-bee.

english_verse: These things happened to them as a warning to us. All this was written in the Scriptures to teach us who live in these last days.
translation_verse: Ditafadaaldi gbanti nìn jéetì bi-pu kí nīn sá kudaaŋŋu ní. Bi ŋmàn̄ tibɔti gbanti kí kpāafì timbi bin bí ŋyuntijoolkaa nee poon nan ní.

english_verse: Even if you think you can stand up to temptation, be careful not to fall.
translation_verse: An puee sii un dàkafī yii a nín yú pu nee, a yú deedeeyee, á nīn nyí nì a-ba kí taa lítí.

english_verse: You are tempted in the same way that everyone else is tempted. But God can be trusted not to let you be tempted too much, and he will show you how to escape from your temptations.
translation_verse: Icɔŋki in bàń ni-puee pée ŋmàntī unil pɔŋŋu nyɔkɔm ní, kun puee Unimbɔti yaa pōoǹ puee see ú ŋá míǹ. Waa kíikí tin lákatiǹ ni-pɔŋŋu puee ń bàń-ni, di sá yii ŋyunti ŋun ní icɔŋki yaa bāań-nee, u làá tīī-ni mpɔn ní ŋmā kí ŋmèè, ní kí dàkà-ni nsan ní dī kí nyā.

english_verse: My friends, you must keep away from idols.
translation_verse: An puee nnabiyaamu, ní sāǹ awaa.

english_verse: I am speaking to you as people who have enough sense to know what I am talking about.
translation_verse: M sòon̄-ni kii bi nín sòoǹ binib bin cáá nlandɔkɔee puee ní. Nimbi ni-ba ń dàkafì tin m sòon̄ nee pu kí kpèè.

english_verse: When we drink from the cup we ask God to bless, isn't that sharing in the blood of Christ? When we eat the bread we break, isn't that sharing in the body of Christ?
translation_verse: Ndaam min pu ti jáaḿ Unimbɔti ti yaa làá jī ti-Dindaan jikaatee di kaa kpáfí-ti nì Kriisitoo fatikuu ubaantaaa? Kpɔnɔ un ti gífí ki yàkatēe, an di kaa kpáfí ti nì Kriisitoo wunti kí ŋá ubaantaaa?

english_verse: By sharing in the same loaf of bread, we become one body, even though there are many of us.
translation_verse: Kpɔnɔbambaanti ní an sá, ní bi gífí. Míǹ ní ti mun nín kpáfì ki sá kunipaau nee, ti kpántì tiwumbaantiil, kun puee ti-kɔkɔ ŋmɔ́ kpɔnɔbaanti gbanti.

english_verse: Aren't the people of Israel sharing in the worship when they gather around the altar and eat the sacrifices offered there?
translation_verse: Kpèèmaan Isirayeel yab bɔti: bin nìn jīǹ tin bi cāabìń ki ŋáań Unimbɔti saraayee, bi nì Unimbɔti un bi ŋáań saraayee ŋá ubaanti dee.

english_verse: Am I saying that either the idols or the food sacrificed to them is anything at all?
translation_verse: M nín lì pu nee dàkà yii diwaal bí tiban deeyaaa? Àá tiwaŋkuti tin bi tōotì-dèe nanti di bí tiban ní?

english_verse: No, I am not! This food is really sacrificed to demons and not to God. I don't want you to have anything to do with demons.
translation_verse: Aayee, kpataaa! Di sá tin bi tòotēe, bi cáa tìì arasiniibi ní, an kaa sá Unimbɔti. An puee maa là ni nì arasiniibi ń kpāfì ubaanti.

english_verse: You cannot drink from the cup of demons and still drink from the Lord's cup. You cannot eat at the table of demons and still eat at the Lord's table.
translation_verse: Naa ŋūǹ kí nyɔ̀ ti-Dindaan daam kí gíti nyɔ̀ arasiniibi mun yam. Naa tí ŋūǹ kí jī ti-Dindaan jikaati kí gíti jī arasiniibi mun yati.

english_verse: We would make the Lord jealous if we did this. And we are not stronger than the Lord. Always Honor God
translation_verse: Ti là kí táká ti-Dindaan tibɔti kí yòon̄ u-ŋuul naaa? Ti pɔ̄ɔǹ-uaaa? Ti-tuuŋŋi ń nīn tìì Unimbɔti tinyool

english_verse: We should think about others and not about ourselves.
translation_verse: Ubɔ ń taa nín̄ nyàab̀ úǹ u-ba ŋanti, ama ní nyàab̀ ni-jutiibi ŋanti.

english_verse: However, when you buy meat in the market, go ahead and eat it. Keep your conscience clear by not asking where the meat came from.
translation_verse: Ni ŋūǹ kí dā tinan tin bi nyáfí kinyɔŋinee kí ŋmɔ́ nì dipɔɔsɔŋkil kí taa bàlifì yii tì sá ba yati.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “The earth and everything in it belong to the Lord.”
translation_verse: Kun puee Unimbɔti gbɔŋku poon lī yii: «Kitiŋ nì tin kɔkɔ pée bí ki-puee, ti-Dindaan di yì.»

english_verse: If an unbeliever invites you to dinner, and you want to go, then go. Eat whatever you are served. Don't cause a problem for someone's conscience by asking where the food came from.
translation_verse: Tí lì yii ubɔ kaa nóó Yeesu ní ki yíiń-ni ní jī tijin. Ni yaa là ki cūtèe, tin u yaa cáań ki yóoǹ-nee, jīmaan. Ní taa lì yii ni là ni-pɔbiliŋ ń nīn sɔ̀m̀ee puee, ni làá bàlifì-u yii u-nanti gbanti sá ba yati.

english_verse: But if you are told it has been sacrificed to idols, don't cause a problem by eating it. I don't mean a problem for yourself, but for the one who told you. Why should my freedom be limited by someone else's conscience?
translation_verse: - An kaa sá nimbi ní án taa páb́, un tùkū-nee ní án taa páb́. «Ama ba pu ní an sá yii, án taa páb́ ubɔ puee, man batɔl cáá kigbeennyɔkɔ ní?

english_verse: If I give thanks for what I eat, why should anyone accuse me of doing wrong?
translation_verse: M yaa làá jī tijin ní ki yaa jáam̀ Unimbɔti ti-pu ní ki nín jíńee, ba pu ní bi gíti kpākantí-mi tijin tin pu m jáam̀ ki nín jíńee?»

english_verse: Don't cause problems for Jews or Greeks or anyone else who belongs to God's church.
translation_verse: Ni-bimbim ń taa yàntī bin sá Juuda yabee nì bin kaa sée, nì bin nóó Yeesuee ń lítí.

english_verse: You must follow my example, as I follow the example of Christ. Rules for Worship
translation_verse: Ní nīn dīmaan man tabɔbiliŋ kii ma mun nín dī Kriisitoo tabɔbiliŋ puee. Unimpu ń yíĺ ŋŋaabu Kriisitoo nikitilin

english_verse: I am proud of you, because you always remember me and obey the teachings I gave you.
translation_verse: M pàkà-ni kii ni nín téetí m-pu ŋyunti kamaa pu, ki ŋúb́ tibɔti tin m dàkā-nee kii m nín pée dàkā-ni-tì puee.

english_verse: Now I want you to know that Christ is the head of all men, and a man is the head of a woman. But God is the head of Christ.
translation_verse: Ama nì míǹ kɔkɔee, tibɔti tin m là ní bééyee sèé: Kriisitoo sá uninja kamaa yidaaŋwu, ní unimpu yidaaŋwu sá u-cal, ní Kriisitoo yidaaŋwu sá Unimbɔti.

english_verse: This means that any man who prays or prophesies with something on his head brings shame to his head.
translation_verse: Uninja di yaa bí ki mèé àá Unimbɔti tīī-u dinyɔɔbundi diba ní u bíi nàatī ní ki cíkí tiba u-yil puee, u kpèé Kriisitoo fám dee.

english_verse: But any woman who prays or prophesies without something on her head brings shame to her head. In fact, she may as well shave her head.
translation_verse: Ama unimpu di yaa bí ki mèé Unimbɔti àá Unimbɔti tīī-u dinyɔɔbundi diba ú nàatī ní tiba kaa bīī u-yil puee, u kpèé u-cal un sá u-yidaaŋwuee fám dee. An bí kii u tú diyibaakpandee ní.

english_verse: A woman should wear something on her head. It is a disgrace for a woman to shave her head or cut her hair. But if she refuses to wear something on her head, let her cut off her hair.
translation_verse: Ama unimpu yaa kaa là kí dū tiba kí bìin̄ u-yil puee, ú cā u-yikpiti àá ú kòol̀. Diyikpical àá dikooldi yaa tí cáá-u icooyaaa, ú nīn bìintí tiba u-yil pu.

english_verse: Men were created to be like God and to bring honor to God. This means a man should not wear anything on his head. Women were created to bring honor to men.
translation_verse: Uninja kaa máaǹ kí bìin̄ tiba u-yil pu, di sá yii úǹ sá Unimbɔti naŋku, ní ki sá u-nyooti. Ní unimpu sá uninja nyooti.

english_verse: It was the woman who was made from a man, and not the man who was made from a woman.
translation_verse: Di sá yii an kaa sá unimpu pu ní Unimbɔti lēē tiba ki náań uninja, ama an sá uninja pu ní u lēē tiba ki dūu náań unimpu.

english_verse: He wasn't created for her. She was created for him.
translation_verse: An kaa tí sá unimpu pu ní u náań uninja, ama an sá uninja pu ní u náań unimpu.

english_verse: And so, because of this, and also because of the angels, a woman ought to wear something on her head, as a sign of her authority.
translation_verse: An pu ní an sá yii ituun puee, unimpu máaǹ kí nīn yíĺ tiba kí bìin̄ u-yil pu, míǹ di dàkà yii waa yì u-ba.

english_verse: It is true that the first woman came from a man, but all other men have been given birth by women. Yet God is the one who created everything.
translation_verse: Di sá uninja pu ní bi lēē tiba ki náań unimpu, ní unimpu mun di màal̀ uninja, ama bíǹ kɔkɔee nyánní Unimbɔti cee ní.

english_verse: Ask yourselves if it is proper for a woman to pray without something on her head.
translation_verse: Nimbi ni-ba, ní dàkafì kí kpèè yii an ŋān̄ unimpu ń nīn mèé Unimbɔti kaa yíĺ tiba u-yil puɔɔɔ?

english_verse: This is how things are done in all of God's churches, and this is why none of you should argue about what I have said. Rules for the Lord's Supper
translation_verse: Ubɔ yaa cáá tiba kí kpákáǹ an puɔɔɔ, timbi nì Unimbɔti nikitiŋ nín ŋúb́ miŋyee dee. An nín máaǹ bí jī ti-Dindaan jikaati puee (Kpèè Maat

english_verse: Your worship services do you more harm than good. I am certainly not going to praise you for this.
translation_verse: Kɔŋkɔnnee m nín gbìl̄ tiŋyee puee m làá wòoǹ-ni ní, di sá yii ni nín kōontí ikoon in an bàà sá án tūtuǹ-ni kin an púntí-nee.

english_verse: I am told you can't get along with each other when you worship, and I am sure that some of what I have heard is true.
translation_verse: Mpeepeekaamee, m gbìl̄ yii ni yaa kpáfì kí jāam̀ Unimbɔtee, ni kpákà ní ki gàntī tɔb. - Man m-ba, m fōō yii an máaǹ ki sá míǹ.

english_verse: You are bound to argue with each other, but it is easy to see which of you have God's approval.
translation_verse: An lafun máaǹ digàntil ń nīn bí ni-kansikin, bí ŋmā kí béé bin yú deedeeyee. -

english_verse: You even start eating before everyone gets to the meeting, and some of you go hungry, while others get drunk.
translation_verse: Di sá yii nimbee, báà ŋma ŋáań malaa ní kí yòon̄ u-jinti ki bíi jīǹ u-baba. Ni nín ŋá mimmee ní ŋkùm làá kpɔ̀ biba ní bin kíǹee ń gbí ndaam.

english_verse: The Lord meant that when you eat this bread and drink from this cup, you tell about his death until he comes.
translation_verse: Di sá yii, iyunti in kɔkɔ ní ni yaa bíi ŋmóò kpɔnɔ nee ki nyù ndaam neeyee, ni bí ki sòoǹ ti-Dindaan kúm pu dee kí dāá sāā ŋyunti ŋun u làá fàtīí gítińee.

english_verse: If you fail to understand that you are the body of the Lord, you will condemn yourselves by the way you eat and drink.
translation_verse: Kun puee un di yaa ŋmɔ́ kpɔnɔ ki nyùn̄ ndaam kaa nyí ti-Dindaan wunti bɔti taapuee, u nín ŋmɔ́ ki nyùn̄ mimmee, ditafadaaldi ní u dáaĺ ki tɔ́ u-ba pu.

english_verse: After the meal, Jesus took a cup of wine in his hands and said, “This is my blood, and with it God makes his new agreement with you. Drink this and remember me.”
translation_verse: Bi jíń tijikaal ki dóòyee ní u tí yōoǹ ndaam ní ki bí yii: «Ndaam nee di sá m-fatikuu un làá nyēe, an di sá mpèéyee daaŋku. Ní nīn ŋáań míǹ ki nyù ki téetí m-pu.»

english_verse: I have already told you what the Lord Jesus did on the night he was betrayed. And it came from the Lord himself. He took some bread in his hands.
translation_verse: Ní kpèè tibɔti tin ti-Dindaan dàkā-mi m dū ki nāatì-nee. Di sá yii kunyeeu kun bi dū ti-Dindaan Yeesu ki ŋúbiǹ u-nannanliibee, u nìn yōoǹ kpɔnɔ

english_verse: Then after he had given thanks, he broke it and said, “This is my body, which is given for you. Eat this and remember me.”
translation_verse: ki jáam̀ Unimbɔti an pu ní ki cúu gífì, ní ki bí yii: «Doo di sá man wunti tin m dūu tīī ni-puee, nín̄ ŋáaḿmaan míǹ ki téetí m-pu.»

english_verse: But if you eat the bread and drink the wine in a way that isn't worthy of the Lord, you sin against his body and blood.
translation_verse: An puee, ubɔ yaa kaa bàà máaǹ kí ŋmɔ́ kpɔnɔ kí nyɔ̀ ndaam gbanti ní ki yaa ŋmɔ́ ki nyùn̄ee, u yīntiǹ ti-Dindaan wunti nì u-fatikuu.

english_verse: This is why you must examine the way you eat and drink.
translation_verse: Míǹ puee, báà ŋma ń cɔ̄ŋkì u-ba kí wàatī ní kí nín ŋmɔ́ kpɔnɔ kí nyɔ̀ ndaam gbanti.

english_verse: This is why many of you are sick and weak and why a lot of others have died.
translation_verse: An pu ní ni-kansikin biba sá bibunliibi nì bideembi, ní tikpil mun kpíì.

english_verse: If we carefully judge ourselves, we won't be punished.
translation_verse: Ti yaa cɔ́ŋkì ti-bee, Unimbɔti kaa dátí ti-tafal.

english_verse: But when the Lord judges and punishes us, he does it to keep us from being condemned with the rest of the world.
translation_verse: Ama ti-Dindaan yaa dátí ti-tafalee, an sá kí sāŋkì-ti, án nín làá ŋá pu tí taa láa nīn bí ditafadaakpaandi din poon duulinya nib làá dāá kɔ́ee nee.

english_verse: My dear friends, you should wait until everyone gets there before you start eating.
translation_verse: An puee nnabiyaamu, ni yaa kpáfì kí jī ti-Dindaan jikaatee, cīitímaan tɔb.

english_verse: If you really are hungry, you can eat at home. Then you won't condemn yourselves when you meet together. After I arrive, I will instruct you about the other matters.
translation_verse: Un ní ŋkùm yaa cááyee, udaan ń jīń u-dumpu, án nín làá ŋá pu ní taa nín̄ kpáfí ki dátí ditafadaaldi ki tòó ni-ba puee. An yaa sá tibɔti tin kíǹee, m yaa láa dɔ́mińee ní m dāa dàkà-ni-tì.

english_verse: My friends, you asked me about spiritual gifts.
translation_verse: Nnabiyaamu, m là ní béé Unimbɔti Fam nín pūǹ dipɔl diŋyee bɔti.

english_verse: I want you to remember that before you became followers of the Lord, you were led in all the wrong ways by idols that cannot even talk.
translation_verse: Ni téetí yii ni nín kaa nìn dáá nóó Yeesuee, an nìn dátí-ni ní ki cáǹ awaa ŋin bi máń ŋaa gbìl̀ kaa sòoǹee cee.

english_verse: Now I want you to know that if you are led by God's Spirit, you will say that Jesus is Lord, and you will never curse Jesus.
translation_verse: An pu ní m là ní béé yii unil un Unimbɔti Fam kpòotēe kaa ŋūǹ kí lì yii mbusu ń jēetí Yeesu pu, míǹ ní ubɔ kaa tí ŋūǹ kí lì yii: «Yeesu sá ti-Dindaan» Unimbɔti Fam yaa kaa kpōotì udaan.

english_verse: There are different kinds of spiritual gifts, but they all come from the same Spirit.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti Fam nín pūǹ dipɔl diŋyee bí u-ba u-ba, ama Unimbɔti Fam mbaantiimee di tìì míǹ.

english_verse: There are different ways to serve the same Lord,
translation_verse: Ní báà ŋma tundi nyēē di-ba di-ba, ama ní ti-kɔkɔ tūǹ ki tìì ti-Dindaan ubaanti.

english_verse: and we can each do different things. Yet the same God works in all of us and helps us in everything we do.
translation_verse: Ní báà ŋma cáá min ní u tūǹ u-tundee, ama Unimbɔtibaanti di yàntī ti-kɔkɔ ŋūǹ ki ŋáań míǹ.

english_verse: The Spirit has given each of us a special way of serving others.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti Fam tìì binib dipɔl ní bi tūǹ atuun an tútúǹ báà ŋma.

english_verse: Some of us can speak with wisdom, while others can speak with knowledge, but these gifts come from the same Spirit.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti Fam pūǹ ubɔ iciin ú sòoǹ tibɔti, míǹ mbaantiim ní mì tí pūǹ ubɔ mun dinyil ú sòoǹ tibɔti.

english_verse: To others the Spirit has given great faith or the power to heal the sick
translation_verse: Unimbɔti Famee mbaantiim di pūǹ ubɔ fookii, ní ki pūǹ ubɔ mun ú nīn ŋūǹ ki cāantí iween.

english_verse: or the power to work mighty miracles. Some of us are prophets, and some of us recognize when God's Spirit is present. Others can speak different kinds of languages, and still others can tell what these languages mean.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti Fam pūǹ ubɔ mpɔn ú nīn ŋáań maamaacib, ní kí pɔ̄ ubɔ mun ú nīn nàatī Unimbɔti nyɔɔbundi, kí pɔ̄ ubɔ mun ú nīn nyí kí gàntī Unimbɔti Fam tundi nì arasiniibi tuuŋŋi, ní kí pɔ̄ ubɔ ní úǹ sòoǹ isooncaan kupaau, ní kí pɔ̄ ubɔ ní úǹ ń gbìl̄ isooncaan taapu kí nàatī.

english_verse: But it is the Spirit who does all this and decides which gifts to give to each of us. One Body with Many Parts
translation_verse: Unimbɔti Fam mbaantiimee di tūǹ an tuuŋŋi kɔkɔ. Mì nín lēē miŋyee ní mì yàkatī mi-pɔl ki tìì báà ŋma. Tiwumbaantiil, ama ajan kupaau

english_verse: Some of us are Jews, and others are Gentiles. Some of us are slaves, and others are free. But God's Spirit baptized each of us and made us part of the body of Christ. Now we each drink from that same Spirit.
translation_verse: Míǹ ní bin sá Juuda yabee nì bin kaa sée, nì bin sá iyumbuee nì bin kaa sée, Unimbɔti Fam mbaantiim ní bi fùl̄ ti-kɔkɔ ti kpántì tiwumbaantiil. Míǹ ní Unimbɔti tīī ti-kɔkɔ u-Fam gbanti mbaantiim.

english_verse: Our bodies don't have just one part. They have many parts.
translation_verse: Tiwun kaa sá mbaantiim, an yākatì ajan kupaau ní.

english_verse: Suppose a foot says, “I'm not a hand, and so I'm not part of the body.” Wouldn't the foot still belong to the body?
translation_verse: Ditaal yaa bí yii: «Man kaa sá ŋŋal, an puee maa kútì tiwun pu», mimmee dàa lafun kútì tiwun puɔɔɔ?

english_verse: Or suppose an ear says, “I'm not an eye, and so I'm not part of the body.” Wouldn't the ear still belong to the body?
translation_verse: Àá ditafal yaa bí yii: «Man kaa sá dinimbil, míǹ puee maa kútì tiwun pu», mimmee dàa lafun kútì tiwun puɔɔɔ?

english_verse: If our bodies were only an eye, we couldn't hear a thing. And if they were only an ear, we couldn't smell a thing.
translation_verse: Tiwun kɔkɔ yaa sá dinimbilee, tì bàà ŋáań mana kí nīn gbìl̀? Àá tiwun kɔkɔ yaa bàà sá ditafalee, mana ní tì bàà ŋáań kí nīn gbìl̀ nsɔnsɔfi?

english_verse: But God has put all parts of our body together in the way that he decided is best.
translation_verse: Ama min Unimbɔti lèe ní u kāaǹ tiwun jaŋŋi tiwun pu.

english_verse: A body isn't really a body, unless there is more than one part.
translation_verse: Ajan kɔkɔ yaa dūu ŋá dijambaantiilee, tiwun kaa bàà bí deeyaa!

english_verse: It takes many parts to make a single body.
translation_verse: Tiŋmanee unil wunti jaŋŋi bí kupaau, ama ní ki sá tiwumbaantiil.

english_verse: That's why the eyes cannot say they don't need the hands. That's also why the head cannot say it doesn't need the feet.
translation_verse: An puee, dinimbil kaa ŋūǹ kí lì ŋŋal yii: «Maa là-si,» míǹ ní diyil mun kaa tí ŋūǹ kí lì ataa yii: «Maa là-ni.»

english_verse: In fact, we cannot get along without the parts of the body that seem to be the weakest.
translation_verse: Unil wunti jaŋŋi ŋin bi kpèé yii ŋaa pɔ̄ɔ̄yee, ŋíǹ di nín kèetī.

english_verse: We take special care to dress up some parts of our bodies. We are modest about our personal parts,
translation_verse: Ní ŋin ti kpèé ki ŋèen̄ee, ŋíǹ ní ti tìì tinyool, ní ŋin bɔti taa lèe, ŋíǹ ní ti kpèé tiŋan.

english_verse: but we don't have to be modest about other parts. God put our bodies together in such a way that even the parts that seem the least important are valuable.
translation_verse: Ama ajan ŋin sá amɔntee kaa nyàab̀ bí tīī-ŋi tinyool, Unimbɔti ŋá tiwun míǹ kí tīī dijandi din lóò tinyoolee tinyool ní,

english_verse: He did this to make all parts of the body work together smoothly, with each part caring about the others.
translation_verse: án nín làá ŋá pu digàntil ń taa nín̄ bí tiwun jaŋŋi kansikin ŋi-kɔkɔ ń nīn sūǹ tɔb puee.

english_verse: If one part of our body hurts, we hurt all over. If one part of our body is honored, the whole body will be happy.
translation_verse: Falaa yaa cúú dijandi dibee, an cúú ki kpáaǹ ajan kɔkɔ dee. Bi yaa tí bíi pàkà dijandi dibee, ŋin kɔkɔ kíǹee fàal̀ ní.

english_verse: Together you are the body of Christ. Each one of you is part of his body.
translation_verse: Ni-kɔkɔ sá Kriisitoo wunti ní, ní ni-kansikin báà ŋma sá tiwun jandi diba.

english_verse: First, God chose some people to be apostles and prophets and teachers for the church. But he also chose some to work miracles or heal the sick or help others or be leaders or speak different kinds of languages.
translation_verse: Míǹ ní Unimbɔti péé péé ki kāaǹ akpambal Kriisitoo nikitil kansikin, nliliitiimee, Unimbɔti bɔnaatiliibi, ntataatiimee, bidakaliibi, boonee ní u dū bin kíǹee ki páaǹ. U pú biba bí nīn ŋáań maamaacib, ki pú biba bí nīn cāantí bibunliibi, ní ki tīī biba ŋŋmam bí nīn tútúǹ binib, ní ki pú biba bí nīn kpòotī binib, ní ki pú biba bí nīn sòoǹ isooncaan kupaau.

english_verse: Not everyone is an apostle. Not everyone is a prophet. Not everyone is a teacher. Not everyone can work miracles.
translation_verse: Bi-kɔkɔ di sá akpambalaaa? Bi-kɔkɔ di sá Unimbɔti bɔnaatiliibaaa? Bi-kɔkɔ di sá bidakaliibaaa? Bi-kɔkɔ di ŋáań maamaacibaaa?

english_verse: Not everyone can heal the sick. Not everyone can speak different kinds of languages. Not everyone can tell what these languages mean.
translation_verse: Bi-kɔkɔ ní Unimbɔti pú bí nīn cāantí bibunliibaaa? Bi-kɔkɔ di sòoǹ isooncaanaaa? Bi-kɔkɔ di gbìl̀ isooncaan taapu ki nàatāaa?

english_verse: I want you to desire the best gifts. So I will show you a much better way.
