translation_verse: An puee, ní nyàab̀ Unimbɔti ń pɔ̄-ni dipɔl din jítiǹ ŋin kíǹeeyee. Ama m làá gíti dàkà-ni nsan ŋun jítiǹ i-kɔkɔee.

english_verse: What if I could speak all languages of humans and even of angels? If I did not love others, I would be nothing more than a noisy gong or a clanging cymbal.
translation_verse: Báà m yaa sòoǹ isooncaan, binib nì ituun sooŋyi, ní kaa cáá dineendee, tin m sòoǹee sá fám ní kii dawula àá diwaŋkilindi nín sūǹ pu fám an kaa cáá taapu puee ní.

english_verse: What if I could prophesy and understand all mysteries and all knowledge? And what if I had faith that moved mountains? I would be nothing, unless I loved others.
translation_verse: M ŋūǹ kí fōō dipɔl kí nīn nàatī Unimbɔti nyɔɔbundi, ki ŋūǹ kí nīn cáá dinyil kɔkɔ nì di-nyɔkɔm kí béé tin kɔkɔ bí dibalinee, kí nīn cáá fookii tiŋan án nīn kpìkitī ajoon, míǹ kɔkɔee m yaa kaa cáá dineendee, m sá fám ní.

english_verse: What if I gave away all that I owned and let myself be burned alive? I would gain nothing, unless I loved others.
translation_verse: Báà m yaa dū tiwan tin m cááyee kɔkɔ ki yākatì bifalaadambi, ki yaa dū m-ba gba ki tīī bi wùn̄ ŋŋmi, ama ní kaa cáá dineendee, tin kɔkɔ m ŋée sá fám ní, maa cáá ipaati.

english_verse: Love is patient and kind, never jealous, boastful, proud, or
translation_verse: Un cáá dineendee cáá kimɔtii ní ki cáá tiniti. Waa cáá nnimbitaataam, kaa dàkà u-ba, kaa cáá dilambil.

english_verse: rude. Love isn't selfish or quick tempered. It doesn't keep a record of wrongs that others do.
translation_verse: Un cáá dineendee kaa ŋáań min kaa kítèe, kaa cáá ikummunti, kaa cáá diŋuul, kaa díkì unil pu.

english_verse: Love rejoices in the truth, but not in evil.
translation_verse: Tin kaa bí deedeeyee kaa tìì un cáá dineendee dipɔɔpindi, see tin bí deedeeyee.

english_verse: Love is always supportive, loyal, hopeful, and trusting.
translation_verse: Úǹ pūǹ binib yìntitam kɔkɔ ní, ki cáá fookii nì dimákal, nì kimɔtii ŋyunti kamaa.

english_verse: Love never fails! Everyone who prophesies will stop, and unknown languages will no longer be spoken. All that we know will be forgotten.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti nyɔɔbundi nàatitam làá dāá gbèen̄, isooncaan sòontam làá dāá gbèen̄, dinyil làá dāá kúntí, ama dineendi kpá kí kúntí jaanjaan.

english_verse: But what is perfect will someday appear, and what isn't perfect will then disappear.
translation_verse: Ama tikɔkɔ yaa láa dɔ́ntì ki ŋá mmɔmmee, tin nìn wɔ̀b̄ee làá dāá wāŋkì.

english_verse: When we were children, we thought and reasoned as children do. But when we grew up, we quit our childish ways.
translation_verse: M nín nìn dáá sá kibikee, m nìn sòoǹ kii kibikee, ní ki dàkafī kii kibikee, ní ki kítí m-bɔti kii kibikee. Ama, m nín wíiǹ ki kpántì ukpaanee, m fá m nín nìn sá kibiki ki ŋáań min miŋyee.

english_verse: Now all we can see of God is like a cloudy picture in a mirror. Later we will see him face to face. We don't know everything, but then we will, just as God completely understands us.
translation_verse: Kɔŋkɔnnee, ti nín dáá wāĺ puee bí pùuu kii bi nín kpèé digitikpil poon ki wāĺ puee ní, ama ŋyunti dòoń, ti làá dāá wāl̀ bɔ́iii. Díǹ pu nee, maa nyí ki dóò, ama ŋyunti dòoń, m làá dāá béé nyíki nyiki kii Unimbɔti nín nyí-mi pu nan ní.

english_verse: For now there are faith, hope, and love. But of these three, the greatest is love.
translation_verse: Kɔŋkɔnnee tiwan tita di bí: fookii, dimákal nì dineendi, ama tiwan titee kansikinee, dineendi di līī.

english_verse: Love should be your guide. Be eager to have the gifts that come from the Holy Spirit, especially the gift of prophecy.
translation_verse: An puee ní péé péé kí nyàab̀ dineendi, kí nyàab̀ dipɔl din Unimbɔti Fam pūǹee, cilinjee: nyàab̀maan Unimbɔti nyɔɔbundi nàatitam pɔl.

english_verse: If you speak languages that others don't know, God will understand what you are saying, though no one else will know what you mean. You will be talking about mysteries that only the Spirit understands.
translation_verse: Un sòoǹ isooncaanee kaa bíi sòoǹ nì binib, u sòoǹ nì Unimbɔti ní, kun puee binib kaa gbìl̀ tin u sòoǹee taapu. Unimbɔti Fam pɔŋŋu di yàntī u sòoǹ tin bí dibalinee.

english_verse: But when you prophesy, you will be understood, and others will be helped. They will be encouraged and made to feel better.
translation_verse: Ama un fòol̄ Unimbɔti cee tibɔti ki nàatēe sòoǹ nì binib ní, ní bi-nimbɔtinóotam mɔ̀tīi cá nyɔkɔpu ki tìì-bi kunyannyaau ki sɔ̀ŋkī bi-pɔbiliŋ.

english_verse: By speaking languages that others don't know, you help only yourself. But by prophesying you help everyone in the church.
translation_verse: Un sòoǹ isooncaanee, úǹ baba ní an tútúǹ, ama un fòol̄ Unimbɔti cee tibɔti ki nàatēe tútúǹ Kriisitoo nikitil kɔkɔ dí cù nyɔkɔpu ní.

english_verse: I am glad for you to speak unknown languages, although I prefer that you would prophesy. In fact, prophesying does much more good than speaking unknown languages, unless someone can help the church by explaining what you mean.
translation_verse: M là báà ŋma ń nīn sòoǹ isooncaan, ama tin m baasii nyàab̀ ní nīn cááyee di sá ní nīn fòol̄ Unimbɔti cee tibɔti ki nàatī. Di sá un fòol̄ Unimbɔti cee tibɔti ki nàatēe jítiǹ un sòoǹ isooncaanee, asee ubɔ yaa bí ki ŋūǹ kí nàatī isooncaan taapu án tūtuǹ báà ŋma ń cù nyɔkɔpu baba.

english_verse: My friends, what good would it do, if I came and spoke unknown languages to you and didn't explain what I meant? How would I help you, unless I told you what God had shown me or gave you some knowledge or prophecy or teaching?
translation_verse: Nnabiyaamu, tí dū tibɔti nee kí ŋmàntī: tí lì yii m dɔ́miń ni-cee ní ki bí ki sòoǹ nì ni isooncaan in naa gbìl̀ee. Tin m sòoǹee yaa kaa kútì-ni tiba, àá kaa cántì, àá naa béè tiba poon, àá naa gbìl̄ Unimbɔti nín tīī dinyɔɔbundi diŋyee, àá kaa fōō didàkal diba poonee, mana ní án làá tūtuǹ-ni?

english_verse: If all musical instruments sounded alike, how would you know the difference between a flute and a harp?
translation_verse: Tí tí dū kí ŋmàntī nì tigbiŋgbiiliwan diwul àá kubeeu. Tiwanee liitil siim yaa kaa nyēē u-ba u-bee, mana ní bi ŋūǹ kí gàntī kí béé yii diwul di sūǹ nee, àá kubeeu di sūǹ nee?

english_verse: If a bugle call isn't clear, how would you know to get ready for battle?
translation_verse: Ukantámbunli yaa kaa búń dijanjakantándi ki cántì, mana ní bin kíǹee làá béé kí bɔ́ntí kujaau?

english_verse: This is how it is when you speak unknown languages. If no one can understand what you are talking about, you will only be talking to the wind.
translation_verse: Míǹ mbaantiim, ni yaa bíi sòoǹ isoon in baa gbìl̀ee, bi làá ŋá mana ní kí gbìl̄ taapu? Mimmee ni sòoǹ ki féeń dee.

english_verse: But if I don't understand the language that someone is using, we will be like foreigners to each other.
translation_verse: Ama, ubɔ yaa bíi sòoǹ nì mi isooncaanee, udaan sá man cee unicaan ní ma mun sá úǹ cee unicaan.

english_verse: If you really want spiritual gifts, choose the ones that will be most helpful to the church.
translation_verse: Kii ni nín bí ki nyàab̀ Unimbɔti Fam pɔl puee, ní nyàab̀ din làá yàntī Kriisitoo nikitil ń cù nyɔkɔpu nnimbɔtisan poonee tikpil.

english_verse: When we speak languages that others don't know, we should pray for the power to explain what we mean.
translation_verse: An puee un sòoǹ isooncaanee ń mèè Unimbɔti ń pɔ̄-u ŋŋmam ú nīn nàatī tin u sòoǹee taapu.

english_verse: For example, if I use an unknown language in my prayers, my spirit prays but my mind is useless.
translation_verse: Di sá yii m yaa bíi mèé nì isooncaanee, an sá m-fam di mèé, ní m-landɔkɔŋu kaa bíi ŋáań diba.

english_verse: Then what should I do? There are times when I should pray with my spirit, and times when I should pray with my mind. Sometimes I should sing with my spirit, and at other times I should sing with my mind.
translation_verse: Mimmee, an máaǹ ḿ mèè mana? M làá mèè nì m-fam ní kí mèè nì m-landɔkɔŋu mun binib ń gbìl̄ taapu, kí gāā ilan nì m-fam ní kí tí dū m-landɔkɔŋu kí gāā binib ń gbìl̄ taapu.

english_verse: Suppose some strangers are in your worship service, when you are praising God with your spirit. If they don't understand you, how will they know to say, “Amen”?
translation_verse: M yaa bíi mèé ki pàkà Unimbɔti nì ŋfamin ŋmaniŋma, mana ní ubɔ un kaa gbìl̀ taapuee ŋūǹ kí kíí yii «Ameeni», ŋyunti ŋun ní waa gbìl̀ tin a sòoǹee taapuee?

english_verse: You may be worshiping God in a wonderful way, but no one else will be helped.
translation_verse: Tiŋman a-wimmeem gbanti bàà ŋān̄, ama an kaa tútúǹ a-juti.

english_verse: I thank God that I speak unknown languages more than any of you.
translation_verse: M jáaḿ Unimbɔti, di sá yii m sòoǹ isooncaan ki jítiǹ ni-kɔkɔ.

english_verse: But words that make sense can help the church. This is why in church I would rather speak five words that make sense than to speak
translation_verse: Ama Kriisitoo nikitil kansikinee, an yaa sá anyɔɔbun aŋmoo ní ḿ sòoǹ binib ń gbìl̄ taapu án tūtuǹ-bee, m néeń míǹ ki jítiǹ ḿ sòoǹ isooncaan poon anyɔɔbun kutukub saalaa.

english_verse: My friends, stop thinking like children. Think like mature people and be as innocent as tiny babies.
translation_verse: Nnabiyaamu, ní taa nín̄ dàkafī kii mbiyaamu nín dàkafī puee, nín̄ cáámaan binicikitikaabi landɔkɔŋu. Ama ikpiti jandi púee, ní nīn bí kii mbiyaawaamuee kí taa nín̄ ŋáań ikpiti.

english_verse: In the Scriptures the Lord says, “I will use strangers who speak unknown languages to talk to my people. They will speak to them in foreign languages, but still my people won't listen to me.”
translation_verse: An ŋmàn̄ Unimbɔti gbɔŋku poon yii: ti-Dindaan lī yii: «M làá dāá dī binicambi biba pu ní bí sòoǹ nì m-samaau nee inicansoon, ama nì míǹ kɔkɔee, baa làá pīlifiǹ-mi.»

english_verse: Suppose everyone in your worship service started speaking unknown languages, and some outsiders or some unbelievers come in. Won't they think you are crazy?
translation_verse: An yaa sá yii Kriisitoo nikitil kɔkɔ yaa kpáfì kí jāam̀ Unimbɔti ní báà ŋma bí ki sòoǹ isooncaanee, un kaa nyí Yeesuee àá un pée kóoń kí pīlifèe yaa gbìl̄ ni nín sòoǹ miŋyee, waa yíì-ni biwaatiibaaa?

english_verse: But suppose all of you are prophesying when those unbelievers and outsiders come in. They will realize that they are sinners, and they will want to change their ways because of what you are saying.
translation_verse: Ama ni-kɔkɔ yaa bí ki fòol̄ Unimbɔti cee tibɔti ki nàatēe, án làá gbēē un kaa nyí Unimbɔtee àá un pée kóoń kí pīlifèe pɔbil ní ú béé yii u sá ukpiti, kun puee u gbìl̄ tin ni sòoǹee taapu,

english_verse: They will tell what is hidden in their hearts. Then they will kneel down and say to God, “We are certain that you are with these people.” Worship Must Be Orderly
translation_verse: ní ki wál̀ u-landɔkɔi in bál̀ u-pɔbilinee. Niinee ní ú tātìi dòon̄ dicincibil Unimbɔti nimbiin nì ijaam ní kí bí yii: «Tiŋman, Unimbɔti lafun bí ni-kansikin.» Fikil fikil ń taa nín̄ bí Kriisitoo nikitil kansikin

english_verse: My friends, when you meet to worship, you must do everything for the good of everyone there. That's how it should be when someone sings or teaches or tells what God has said or speaks an unknown language or explains what the language means.
translation_verse: Mimmee nnabiyaamu, an sá tí ŋá mana ní? Ni yaa kpáfì kí jāam̀ Unimbɔtee, ubɔ ń gāā ilan, ubɔ ń dàkà Unimbɔti bɔti. Unimbɔti yaa dàkā ubɔ tiba, ú sòoǹ, ní ubɔ ń sòoǹ isooncaan, ní ubɔ ń nàatī isooncaanee taapu. Tin báà ŋma làá ŋée ń tūtuǹ Kriisitoo nikitil ń cù nyɔkɔpu nnimbɔtisan poon.

english_verse: No more than two or three of you should speak unknown languages during the meeting. You must take turns, and someone should always be there to explain what you mean.
translation_verse: Ni yaa làá sòoǹ isooncaanee, án nīn sá binib bili kii bita, bí nīn sòoǹ ubɔ ubɔ, boonee ubɔ ń nàatī tin bi sòon̄ee taapu.

english_verse: If no one can explain, you must keep silent in church and speak only to yourself and to God.
translation_verse: Ubɔ yaa kaa bí kí nàatī tin bi sòoǹee taapuee, un bíi sòoǹ isooncaanee ń ŋmīĺ kí nīn kíǹ ki sòoǹ úǹ nì Unimbɔti kansikin ŋmaniŋma.

english_verse: If someone sitting there receives a message from God, the speaker must stop and let the other person speak.
translation_verse: Ama Unimbɔti yaa nyántì tibɔti tiba ki dàkā ni-kansikin ubɔee, un bíi sòoǹee ń ŋmīĺ.

english_verse: Let only one person speak at a time, then all of you will learn something and be encouraged.
translation_verse: Ni ŋūǹ ni-kɔkɔ ń nīn nàatī Unimbɔti nyɔɔbundi ubɔ ubɔ án nín làá ŋá pu ní béé kí ká kunyannyaauee.

english_verse: A prophet should be willing to stop and let someone else speak.
translation_verse: Ubɔnaatil máaǹ kí nīn cáá Ŋfam min tìì-u tibɔti u cáa nàatēe pu mpɔn.

english_verse: God wants everything to be done peacefully and in order. When God's people meet in church,
translation_verse: Kun puee Unimbɔti kaa sá fikil fikil Nimbɔtiu, ama ŋgbansɔŋfi Nimbɔtiu ní u sá. Kii Unimbɔti nikitiŋ kɔkɔ poon an nín pée sá puee,

english_verse: the women must not be allowed to speak. They must keep quiet and listen, as the Law of Moses teaches.
translation_verse: Kriisitoo nikitil kansikinee, binimpoobi máaǹ kí nīn kā ki ŋmí ní. Baa cáá nsan kí sòoǹ tiba. Bi máaǹ kí sìntīǹ bi-ba taapu kii Unimbɔti gbɔŋku poon nín lī puee.

english_verse: If there is something they want to know, they can ask their husbands when they get home. It is disgraceful for women to speak in church.
translation_verse: Bi yaa kaa gbìl̄ tiba taapuee, bí tin bàlifì bi-calib mmɔŋki. An kaa ŋān̄ binimpoobi ń sòoǹ tiba Unimbɔti nikitiŋ kansikin.

english_verse: God's message did not start with you people, and you are not the only ones it has reached.
translation_verse: Nimbi cee ní Unimbɔti bɔti nyáńaaa? Àá nimbi baba cee ní Unimbɔti bɔti dɔ́miń ní?

english_verse: If you think of yourself as a prophet or a spiritual person, you will know I am writing only what the Lord has commanded.
translation_verse: Un yaa nyí yii u sá Unimbɔti bɔnaatiliu àá Unimbɔti Fam tīī-u dipɔl dibee máaǹ kí béé yii tibɔti tin m ŋmàn̄ nee sá ti-Dindaan marau ní.

english_verse: So don't pay attention to anyone who ignores what I am writing.
translation_verse: Un kaa béè yii an sá ti-Dindaan marauee, ní yàntī udaan bɔti.

english_verse: My friends, be eager to prophesy and don't stop anyone from speaking languages that others don't know.
translation_verse: An puee nnabiyaamu, nyàab̀maan Unimbɔti ń tīī-ni dipɔl din làá yàntī ní nīn fòol̄ u-cee tibɔti ki nàatēe, ama kí taa pìin̄ bin sòoǹ isooncaanee nsan.

english_verse: But do everything properly and in order.
translation_verse: Ní nīn ŋáań tikɔkɔ án nīn kítí ki dī nì nsan.

english_verse: My friends, I want you to remember the message I preached and that you believed and trusted.
translation_verse: Nnabiyaamu, m téetí-ni Tibɔmɔntiil tin m nìn sòon̄ nì ni, ni fōō ki kíí ki sí ti-puee bɔti.

english_verse: You will be saved by this message, if you hold firmly to it. But if you don't, your faith was all for nothing.
translation_verse: Tibɔmɔntiil gbanti pu ní Unimbɔti fīī-ni. An puee ní nīn gbíntì ki ŋúb́-tì kii m nín nìn sòon̄ nì ni puee. Yaa sá fám, ni fōō ki kíí fám dee.

english_verse: I told you the most important part of the message exactly as it was told to me. This part is: Christ died for our sins, as the Scriptures say.
translation_verse: Tin bi dàkā-mee, tíǹ ní m cáań ki dàkā-ni. Tibɔti gbanti poonee, tin páb́ tikpilee di sá yii Kriisitoo kpíì timbi kpitii pu ní, kii Unimbɔti gbɔŋku nín lī puee.

english_verse: He was buried, and three days later he was raised to life, as the Scriptures say.
translation_verse: Bi síb́-u ní iwiin ita dalee, Unimbɔti fīkitì-u, kii an nín ŋmàn̄ pu Unimbɔti gbɔŋku poonee.

english_verse: Christ appeared to Peter, then to the twelve.
translation_verse: U lēē u-ba ki dàkā Peetroo nì u-kpambaliŋ saalaa nì alee.

english_verse: After this, he appeared to more than five hundred other followers. Most of them are still alive, but some have died.
translation_verse: Boonee u-boonnooliibi alaataa aŋmoo mun ká-u dicilpu. Bi-kansikin tikpil dáá bí kaa kpíì, ama biba mun kpíì.

english_verse: He also appeared to James, then to all of the apostles.
translation_verse: Boonee ní u lēē u-ba ki dàkā Yakubu, nì akpambal kɔkɔ.

english_verse: Finally, he appeared to me, even though I am like someone who was born at the wrong time.
translation_verse: Bíǹ kɔkɔ boon kpataaayee, ní u lēē u-ba ki dàkā ma mun, man un bí kii m-ŋmalii kaa bàn̄ ní bi màl̄-mee.

english_verse: I am the least important of all the apostles. In fact, I caused so much trouble for God's church that I don't even deserve to be called an apostle.
translation_verse: Man di sá kiwaai akpambal kansikin. Maa máaǹ bí yíiń-mi Yeesu kpambal báà fiii, kun puee m sāaǹ Unimbɔti nikitil.

english_verse: But God treated me with undeserved grace! He made me what I am, and his grace wasn't wasted. I worked much harder than any of the other apostles, although it was really God's grace at work and not me.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti ŋanti pu ní m sá kun m sá díǹ nee. Tiŋan tin u ŋá-mee cáá mpɔn ki yāntì m túń ditundi ki jítiǹ akpambal ŋin kíǹee. An kaa sá man m-ba di túń an tuuŋŋi, an sá Unimbɔti ŋanti tin bí m-nee di túń ditundi gbanti.

english_verse: But it doesn't matter if I preached or if they preached. All of you believed the message just the same. God's People Will Be Raised to Life
translation_verse: An puee an yaa sá mamaaa, an yaa tí sá bin kíǹeeyaaa, tin pu ti sòon̄ee dee, tin ni mun fōō ki kííyee dee. Ti mun làá dāá fìkitī

english_verse: If we preach that Christ was raised from death, how can some of you say the dead will not be raised to life?
translation_verse: Ti yaa sòon̄ ki tùkū-ni yii Unimbɔti fīkitì Kriisitoo ditaŋkpiilinee, mana ní ni-kansikin biba lì yii bitaŋkpiibi kaa bí kí fìkitī?

english_verse: If they won't be raised to life, Christ himself wasn't raised to life.
translation_verse: Bitaŋkpiibi yaa kaa fìkitī ditaŋkpiilinee, mimmee Kriisitoo mun kaa fīkitì deeyaa!

english_verse: And if Christ wasn't raised to life, our message is worthless, and so is your faith.
translation_verse: Kriisitoo yaa kaa bàà fīkitèe, Tibɔmɔntiil tin ti sòoǹee bàà sá fám ní, ní ni mun nín fōō ki kíí miŋyee ŋá fám.

english_verse: If the dead won't be raised to life, we have told lies about God by saying he raised Christ to life, when he really did not.
translation_verse: Áli gba ti bàà sá binyimɔndambi, kun puee ti mɔ́ntì ki túǹ Unimbɔti pu yii u fīkitì Kriisitoo ditaŋkpiilin, kin u mun kaa fīkitì-u, an yaa lafun sá tiŋman yii bitaŋkpiibi kaa fìkitēe.

english_verse: So if the dead won't be raised to life, Christ wasn't raised to life.
translation_verse: Bitaŋkpiibi yaa kaa fìkitēe, mimmee Kriisitoo mun kaa fīkitì dee.

english_verse: Unless Christ was raised to life, your faith is useless, and you are still living in your sins.
translation_verse: Kriisitoo yaa kaa fīkitì ditaŋkpiilinee, mimmee ni-fookiiu sá fám dee, ni dáá gbíntì ki bí ni-kpitii poon dee.

english_verse: And those people who died after putting their faith in him are completely lost.
translation_verse: An yaa sá mimmee, bin nóó Kriisitoo ki kpíìyee wáŋkì.

english_verse: If our hope in Christ is good only for this life, we are worse off than anyone else.
translation_verse: An yaa sá dimaŋfal din poon ti bí nee ŋmaniŋma pu ní ti yaa máká Kriisitoo puee, mimmee timbi falaau jítiǹ binib kɔkɔ yɔu dee.

english_verse: But Christ has been raised to life! And he makes us certain that others will also be raised to life.
translation_verse: Ama Kriisitoo fīkitì ditaŋkpiilin tiŋman. Bitaŋkpiibi bin làá dāá fìkitēe, úǹ di sá upeepeekaa ki fīkitì.

english_verse: Just as we will die because of Adam, we will be raised to life because of Christ.
translation_verse: Di sá yii unibaanti pu ní ŋkúm dī ki jéetì binib pu. Míǹ mbaantiim ní bitaŋkpiibi fìkititam tí dīń unibaanti pu kí fìkitī báà ŋma.

english_verse: Adam brought death to all of us, and Christ will bring life to all of us.
translation_verse: Kii inifunaan kɔkɔ nín cáá mpèé nì Adam ki kúù puee, míǹ mbaantiim ní bin kɔkɔ ŋá ubaanti nì Kriisitooyee làá dāá ká dimaŋfal.

english_verse: But we must each wait our turn. Christ was the first to be raised to life, and his people will be raised to life when he returns.
translation_verse: Ama an sá báà ŋma nì u-yuntiŋu ní. Kriisitoo di sá upeepeekaa ki fīkitì ditaŋkpiilin, ní bin nóó Kriisitooyee mun ń dāá fìkitī ŋyunti ŋun u yaa láa fātìi gítińee.

english_verse: Then after Christ has destroyed all powers and forces, the end will come, and he will give the kingdom to God the Father.
translation_verse: Boonee ní duulinya kúntitam ń nín bàń. Ŋyunti ŋun u yaa láa kúntì ipɔn kɔkɔ nì i-nyɔkɔmee ní ú dū Dibeel kí tīī u-Baa Unimbɔti.

english_verse: Christ will rule until he puts all his enemies under his power,
translation_verse: Kriisitoo làá jī dibeel míǹ ní kí tin sāā ŋyunti ŋun u làá já kí pɔ̄ɔkiǹ u-nannanliibi kí dū-bi kí ŋá u-taaŋi taapuee.

english_verse: and the last enemy he destroys will be death.
translation_verse: U-nannanliu un u làá kúntí katanjooliiyee di sá ŋkúm.

english_verse: When the Scriptures say he will put everything under his power, they don't include God. It was God who put everything under the power of Christ.
translation_verse: Kun puee an lī Unimbɔti gbɔŋku poon yii: «U dū tikɔkɔ ki ŋá u-taaŋi taapu.» Unimbɔti nín lī yii u dū tikɔkɔ ki ŋá u-taaŋi taapuee, kaa sá ki kpáaǹ úǹ Unimbɔti u-ba ní u kpáàa dūu ŋá u-taapu.

english_verse: After everything is under the power of God's Son, he will put himself under the power of God, who put everything under his Son's power. Then God will mean everything to everyone.
translation_verse: Ŋyunti ŋun ní tikɔkɔ yaa láa sīntiǹ ti-ba ki tīī Kriisitooyee, niinee ní úǹ Unimbɔti Jipɔɔn mun u-ba ń dāá sìntīǹ u-ba kí tīī Unimbɔti un sīntiǹ tikɔkɔ taapu ki tīī-uee, ní Unimbɔti ń nīn yì tikɔkɔ nì tikɔkɔ.

english_verse: If the dead are not going to be raised to life, what will people do who are being baptized for them? Why are they being baptized for those dead people?
translation_verse: Kpèèmaan bin yàntī bi fùul̀-bi Unimbɔti nyim bin kpíìyee yil puee: bin kúùyee yaa kaa bàà fìkitēe, ba pu ní bi yàntī bi fùul̀-bi Unimbɔti nyim bitaŋkpiibi yil pu?

english_verse: And why do we always risk our lives
translation_verse: Bi yaa kúù kaa fìkitī ní, ba pu ní ŋyunti kamaayee timbi bí dinimbinaamandin ní?

english_verse: and face death every day? The pride that I have in you because of Christ Jesus our Lord is what makes me say this.
translation_verse: Nnabiyaamu, baabadalee ŋkúm tà ki kíbití-mi ní. Ni nín nóó ti-Dindaan Yeesu Kriisitoo puee nín tìì-mi disíndi diŋyee di yì-tì ní m lì míǹ.

english_verse: What do you think I gained by fighting wild animals in Ephesus? If the dead are not raised to life, “Let's eat and drink. Tomorrow we die.”
translation_verse: An yaa sá yii unil yaa kpíì waa ti fìkitēe, mimmee m nín jáń nì kumooun peelii in bí Eefeesee, ba paatii ní m ká? An yaa sá yii bitaŋkpiibi kaa fìkitēe, mimmee càmaan tí ŋá kii dilaŋkpandi nín lī puee yii: «Tí jī kí nyɔ̀maan, kun puee fool ti làá fu kpú.»

english_verse: Be sensible and stop sinning. You should be embarrassed that some people still don't know about God. What Our Bodies Will Be Like
translation_verse: Ní gítiḿmaan ni-ban kí nīn cáá ilandɔkɔmɔnti kí taa ti ŋá ikpiti. Ni-kansikin biba kaa nyí Unimbɔti. M nín lī pu nee, an sá ni-cooi ní. Bin làá fìkitēe wunti

english_verse: Some of you have asked, “How will the dead be raised to life? What kind of bodies will they have?”
translation_verse: Ama ubɔ làá lì yii: «Mana ní bin kpíìyee làá fìkitī? Tiwun tilati ní bi làá dāá nīn cáá dee?»

english_verse: Don't be foolish. A seed must die before it can sprout from the ground.
translation_verse: Ugbaan, a yaa búĺ ŋwamboolee, ŋwamboolee yaa kaa kpíìyee, ŋuaa nyēē.

english_verse: Wheat seeds and all other seeds look different from the sprouts that come up.
translation_verse: Kí kūtèe, kun a búĺee sá idi àá iwambool iba ní an nyā ki sá tifaal, kaa ti sá ŋwambool ŋun a búĺee.

english_verse: This is because God gives everything the kind of body he wants it to have.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti di tìì ŋwamboolee u nín là ŋú nyā kí nīn bí miŋyee. Úǹ di tìì iwambool kɔkɔ nín máaǹ kí nyā kí nīn bí miŋyee.

english_verse: People, animals, birds, and fish are each made of flesh, but none of them are alike.
translation_verse: Tiwan tin kɔkɔ cáá kufoouee wunti kaa sá tibaantiil, binib wunti bí ti-ba, ipeel yati bí ti-ba, nnɔmbiyaamu yati bí ti-ba, ní ijɔm mun yati bí ti-ba.

english_verse: Everything in the heavens has a body, and so does everything on earth. But each one is very different from all the others.
translation_verse: Tiwun tin sá yilpu yatee bí, ní tin mun sá taapu dooyee yati bí. Tin sá yilpuee nyaaŋku nyáń ku-ba nì tin sá taapu dooyee.

english_verse: The sun isn't like the moon, the moon isn't like the stars, and each star is different.
translation_verse: Ŋwìiń nyaaŋku bí ku-ba ní uŋmal mun yɔkɔ bí ku-ba, áli gba iŋmalbijaa kansikinee i-nyaaŋku bí ku-ba ku-ba ní.

english_verse: That's how it will be when our bodies are raised to life. These bodies will die, but the bodies that are raised will live forever.
translation_verse: Míǹ mbaantiim ní bitaŋkpiibi yaa láa fīkitèe, an dāa bí. Tiwun tin kúùyee ní bi dù kí síb́, ní tí dāá fìkitī nì tiwun tin kaa kúùyee.

english_verse: These ugly and weak bodies will become beautiful and strong.
translation_verse: Kí wàatī bí dū-tì kí síb́ee, tàa ŋān̄, kaa pɔ̄ɔ̄ mun. Ama ní tí dāá fìkitī nì kunyaaŋŋu nì mpɔn.

english_verse: As surely as there are physical bodies, there are spiritual bodies. And our physical bodies will be changed into spiritual bodies.
translation_verse: Taapu doo wunti ní bi dùú síb́ ní tì yaa fīkitèe, Circir Fam ń dāá tīī-ti dimaŋfal. Míǹ puee, taapu doo wunti bí ní tiwun tin Circir Fam tīī dimaŋfalee mun bí.

english_verse: The first man was named Adam, and the Scriptures tell us that he was a living person. But Jesus, who may be called the last Adam, is a life-giving spirit.
translation_verse: Kii Unimbɔti gbɔŋku poon nín lī puee yii: «Adam unipeepeekaayee, Unimbɔti náań-u ní ki tīī-u dimaŋfal», ama Adam joolkaayee, úǹ sá Ŋfam min tìì dimaŋfalee ní.

english_verse: We see that the one with a spiritual body did not come first. He came after the one who had a physical body.
translation_verse: An kaa sá un nyánní Unimbɔti ceeyee di péetí kí dāan̄, an sá un nyánní taapu dooyee di péetí, ní un nyēeń Unimbɔti ceeyee ń páanní boon.

english_verse: The first man was made from the dust of the earth, but the second man came from heaven.
translation_verse: Ntam ní Unimbɔti dūu náań Adam peepeekaa ní u sá taapu doo, ama Adam liliitee nyánní Unimbɔti cee ní.

english_verse: Everyone on earth has a body like the body of the one who was made from the dust of the earth. And everyone in heaven has a body like the body of the one who came from heaven.
translation_verse: Binib bin sá taapu doo yabee náań nì un Unimbɔti dū ntam ki náańee ní, ní bin sá yilpu yabee náań nì un nyánní yilpuee.

english_verse: Just as we are like the one who was made out of earth, we will be like the one who came from heaven.
translation_verse: Ti nì un sá taapu dooyee nín náań pu nee, míǹ mbaantiim ní ti nì un sá yilpuee làá dāá nīn tí náań.

english_verse: My friends, I want you to know that our bodies of flesh and blood will decay. This means they cannot share in God's kingdom, which lasts forever.
translation_verse: Nnabiyaamu, tin m là kí tùkù-nee sèé: tiwun nì fatiku kaa ŋūǹ kí kɔ́ Unimbɔti Beelin, míǹ ní tin kúùyee kaa ŋūǹ kí fōō tin kaa kúùyee.

english_verse: I will explain a mystery to you. Not every one of us will die, but we will all be changed.
translation_verse: M làá tùkù-ni tibɔti tin nìn bí dibalinee: di sá yii ti-kɔkɔ kaa làá dāá kpú, ama ti-kɔkɔ wunti di làá dāá kpántí.

english_verse: It will happen suddenly, quicker than the blink of an eye. At the sound of the last trumpet the dead will be raised. We will all be changed, so we will never die again.
translation_verse: Dikantánjoolkaal yaa láa búńee, niin niin dicilpu kii dinimbil nín pée kábití puee, bitaŋkpiibi kpáàa fīkitì nì tiwun tin kaa ti kúùyee, ní timbi bin kíǹ kaa kpíìyee wunti ń cúú kpántí.

english_verse: Our dead and decaying bodies will be changed into bodies that won't die or decay.
translation_verse: Di sá yii tiwun tin bíiĺee dāa kpántí tin kaa bíiĺee, míǹ ní tiwun tin kúùyee dāa kpántí tin kaa kúùyee.

english_verse: The bodies we now have are weak and can die. But they will be changed into bodies that are eternal. Then the Scriptures will come true, “Death has lost the battle!
translation_verse: Ŋyunti ŋun ní tiwun tin bíiĺee yaa láa kpántì tin kaa bíiĺee, ní tiwun tin kúùyee yaa láa kpántì tin kaa ti kúùyee, ŋyunti gbantee an ŋá kii an nín ŋmàn̄ Unimbɔti gbɔŋku poon puee dee, yii: «Bi kúntì ŋkúm, dijajil ŋá dimɔndi.»

english_verse: Where is its victory? Where is its sting?”
translation_verse: «Too, ŋkúm, a-jajil bí la? Too, ŋkúm, a-looti bí la?»

english_verse: Sin is what gives death its sting, and the Law is the power behind sin.
translation_verse: Ŋkúm looti di sá ikpiti, ní ikpiti pɔŋŋu sá mara.

english_verse: But thank God for letting our Lord Jesus Christ give us the victory!
translation_verse: Tí jāam̀maan Unimbɔti u nín dìŋfī ti-Dindaan Yeesu Kriisitoo pu ki tìì-ti dijajil diŋyee pu.

english_verse: My dear friends, stand firm and don't be shaken. Always keep busy working for the Lord. You know that everything you do for him is worthwhile.
translation_verse: An puee, m-nabineeŋkaamu, ní nīn ŋúb́ an píkí, kí báań inyaan kí nīn tūm̀maan ti-Dindaan tundi kí taa gbèen̄, kí nīn nyí yii ni-tundi kaa làá gbíntí fám.

english_verse: When you collect money for God's people, I want you to do exactly what I told the churches in Galatia to do.
translation_verse: Tibɔti tin m cáá kí tùkù-ni tootoo un ni tòó kí tīī Kriisitoo yab bin bí Jeerusaleemee puee sɔ̀. Ni mun ń nīn ŋáań kii m nín dàkā Kriisitoo nikitiŋ ŋin bí Galaati tiŋkinee puee.

english_verse: That is, each Sunday each of you must put aside part of what you have earned. If you do this, you won't have to take up a collection when I come.
translation_verse: Kɔɔsil kamaayee, báà ŋma ń lēē min u kée dijandi din u làá tīīyee kí yóoń, án taa nín̄ sá yii man ḿ bàń ní ní nín kíĺ animbil ditɔl.

english_verse: Choose some followers to take the money to Jerusalem. I will send them on with the money and with letters which show that you approve of them.
translation_verse: Ní lēē binib biba, m yaa láa bāańee ḿ tīī-bi kugbɔŋu, kí tɔ̄-bi bí cáá ni-tootoou kí tīī Jeerusaleem yab.

english_verse: If you think I should go along, they can go with me. Paul's Travel Plans
translation_verse: An yaa tí sá yii ḿ cù m-baaa, man nì bi ń nóó kí cù. Pɔɔl bíi dàkafī kí còom̀ u-saŋŋu

english_verse: After I have gone through Macedonia, I hope to see you
translation_verse: M yaa làá dāan̄ ni-ceeyee, m làá dīń Maseeduwaan tiŋkin ní kí nín bàń-ni, kun puee m là kí dī Maseeduwaan ní.

english_verse: and visit with you for a while. I may even stay all winter, so that you can help me on my way to wherever I will be going next.
translation_verse: An yaa yíì m làá kàl̄ ni-cee fiii. Ni yaa kaa kpēē gba, ni-cee ní m làá kàl̄ ní tiwool yuntiŋu ń jītí, án nín làá ŋá pu ní tūtuǹ-mi ḿ nìkī m-saŋŋu laakin sá ḿ cùee.

english_verse: If the Lord lets me, I would rather come later for a longer visit than to stop off now for only a short visit.
translation_verse: Maa ti là kí dāá kàl̄ ni-cee fiii, ti-Dindaan yaa kííyee, m làá kàl̄ ni-cee kí yúntí ní.

english_verse: I will stay in Ephesus until Pentecost,
translation_verse: Ama m làá nīn bí Eefeesi tiŋkin ní kí tin sāā Pantikooti jiŋaaliu dal.

english_verse: because there is a wonderful opportunity for me to do some work here. But there are also many people who are against me.
translation_verse: Di sá yii nsan ŋubɔ pīitì ki dōoǹ ḿ dī kí tɔ̄ dituŋkpaandi, nì min kɔkɔ m-nannanliibi wīikí tikpilee.

english_verse: When Timothy arrives, give him a friendly welcome. He is doing the Lord's work, just as I am.
translation_verse: Tiimootee yaa bāań ni-ceeyee, ní fōō-u mmɔntiimin u-pɔbil ń nīn sɔ̀m̀, kun puee u mun tūǹ ti-Dindaan tundi kii mamee ní.

english_verse: Don't let anyone mistreat him. I am looking for him to return to me together with the other followers. So when he leaves, send him off with your blessings.
translation_verse: Ubɔ ń taa kpèè kí sìŋkīǹ-u, ama ní tūtuǹ-u ú fàtī kí gítiń m-cee nì dipɔɔsɔŋkil, di sá man nì nnabiyaamu mun bí dooyee kā ki cí-u.

english_verse: I have tried hard to get our friend Apollos to visit you with the other followers. He doesn't want to come just now, but he will come when he can. Personal Concerns and Greetings
translation_verse: M bàà tīī ti-nabiki Apooloosi kunyannyaau u nì nnabiyaamu mubɔ bí bàà dāan̄ ni-cee, ama waa là kí dāan̄ kɔŋkɔnnee. Ŋyunti ŋun sá ú dāan̄ee yaa láa bāańee, u dāa dòoń. Tibɔkpaafikaal nì ijaam

english_verse: Keep alert. Be firm in your faith. Stay brave and strong.
translation_verse: Ní nīn nyí nì ni-ba kí nīn ŋúb́ ni-fookiiu Kriisitoo ni án píkí, kí nīn cáá dipɔbil, kí nīn pɔ̄ɔ̄.

english_verse: Show love in everything you do.
translation_verse: Tin kɔkɔ ni yaa làá ŋée, ní nīn ŋáań nì dineendi.

english_verse: You know that Stephanas and his family were the first in Achaia to have faith in the Lord. They have done all they can for God's people. My friends, I ask you
translation_verse: Nnabiyaamu, m làá gíti kūtì-ni tiba: Kéè ni nyí Steefanasi nì u-dicaŋkuɔɔ, ni téetí yii bíǹ di sá bin péé péé ki fōō Yeesu ki kíí Greeki tiŋkin ki tútúǹ Unimbɔti yabee.

english_verse: to obey leaders like them and to do the same for all others who work hard with you.
translation_verse: An puee, ní dū ni-ba kí tīī an nibee jutiibi nì bin kɔkɔ bí bi-cee ki tūǹ ditundi nì dipɔbil dibee.

english_verse: I was glad to see Stephanas and Fortunatus and Achaicus. Having them here was like having you.
translation_verse: Steefanasi nì Fɔrtunatuusi nì Akayikuusi dāantam mɔ́ɔkiǹ-mi, di sá ni nín kpá m-ceeyee, bíǹ di téeǹ ni-yil pu ki ŋáań tin ni yaa bàà bí ni bàà làá ŋá kí tīī-mee.

english_verse: They made me feel much better, just as they made you feel better. You should appreciate people like them.
translation_verse: Bi tīī-mi kunyannyaau kii bi nín tīī ni mun puee. Binimɔntiibi bin bí mimmee máaǹ bí pàkà-bi.

english_verse: Greetings from the churches in Asia. Aquila and Priscilla, together with the church that meets in their house, send greetings in the name of the Lord.
translation_verse: Kriisitoo nikitiŋ ŋin bí Asii timmunee jáaḿ-ni. Akiilasi nì Priisiil nì bin kɔkɔ kōontí bi-dumpu ki jáaḿ Unimbɔtee jáaḿ-ni tiŋan ti-Dindaan pu.

english_verse: All the Lord's followers send their greetings. Give each other a warm greeting.
translation_verse: Nnabiyaamu mun kɔkɔ bí dooyee jáaḿ-ni. Ní jāam̀ tɔb nì kunabitiiu jaamii.

english_verse: I am signing this letter myself: PAUL.
translation_verse: Man Pɔɔl m-ba di dū m-ŋal ki ŋmàn̄ anyɔɔbun nee kí jāam̀-ni.

english_verse: I pray that God will put a curse on everyone who doesn't love the Lord. And may the Lord come soon.
translation_verse: Un kaa là ti-Dindaanee, udaan ń ŋá fám. Maranata – Ti-Dindaan dòoń! –

english_verse: I pray the Lord Jesus will be kind to you.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan Yeesu ŋanti ń nīn bí ni-pu.

english_verse: I love everyone who belongs to Christ Jesus.
translation_verse: M néeń ni-kɔkɔ Yeesu Kriisitoo pu.

english_verse: From Paul, chosen by God to be an apostle of Jesus Christ, and from Timothy, who is also a follower. To God's church in Corinth and to all of God's people in Achaia.
translation_verse: Man Pɔɔl un Unimbɔti là m sá Yeesu Kriisitoo kpambalee, nì ti-nabiki Tiimootee di ŋmàn̄ kugbɔŋu nee kí tīī nimbi Unimbɔti yab bin kóò Kɔranti tiŋkinee nì bin kɔkɔ sá Unimbɔti nikitil ki kóò Akaayi timmu mun kíǹee nee.

english_verse: I pray that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! Paul Gives Thanks
translation_verse: Ti-Baa Unimbɔti nì ti-Dindaan Yeesu Kriisitoo ń ŋá-ni tiŋan kí tīī-ni ŋgbansɔŋfi. Pɔɔl bíi pàkà Unimbɔti

english_verse: Praise God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ! The Father is a merciful God, who always gives us comfort.
translation_verse: Tí nyɔ̄ŋkìmaan Unimbɔti ti-Dindaan Yeesu Kriisitoo Baa un di sūǹ ti-saai ki ŋmēentí-ti tikɔkɔ poonee.

english_verse: He comforts us when we are in trouble, so that we can share this same comfort with others in trouble.
translation_verse: Falaabi bin kɔkɔ jēetí ti-puee, úǹ di ŋmēentí-ti, án nín làá ŋá pu ti mun ń dū diŋmeendi din ti fòol̄ u-ceeyee kí ŋméeǹ bin mun bí báà falaa un kamaa poonee.

english_verse: We share in the terrible sufferings of Christ, but also in the wonderful comfort he gives.
translation_verse: Kii Kriisitoo pu ti nín jīǹ falaa tikpil tikpil puee, míǹ mbaantiim ní u-puee ti tí fòol̄ diŋmeendi tikpil tikpil mun.

english_verse: We suffer in the hope that you will be comforted and saved. And because we are comforted, you will also be comforted, as you patiently endure suffering like ours.
translation_verse: Timbi yaa bí ki jīǹ falaayee, an sá nimbi ń ká diŋmeendi nì difiil pu. Ní timbi yaa ká diŋmeendee, an sá yii ni mun ń ká diŋmeendi kí ŋmā kí ŋmèè nì kimɔtii falaabi bin timbi bíi jīǹee jutiibi yaa láa bāań-nee.

english_verse: You never disappoint us. You suffered as much as we did, and we know that you will be comforted as we were.
translation_verse: Ti máká ni-pu mbaamɔmin, kun puee ti nyí yii ni mun bí ki jīǹ falaa kii ti mun nín bí ki jīǹ pu nan ní, an puee ní ni ŋūǹ kí fōō diŋmeendi din bí ki tīī-tee mun.

english_verse: My friends, I want you to know what a hard time we had in Asia. Our sufferings were so horrible and so unbearable that death seemed certain.
translation_verse: Nnabiyaamu, ti là ní béé falaa un ti jíń Asii tiŋkinee. Falaa gbanti nìn cúú-ti ki lákatì ti-pɔŋŋu pu. Taa nìn gíti máká yii ti làá nīn bí dimaŋfalin.

english_verse: In fact, we felt sure we were going to die. But this made us stop trusting in ourselves and start trusting God, who raises the dead to life.
translation_verse: Timbi ti-ba nìn pée ká yii tiba kaa ti bí, see ŋkúm ní ti làá kpú. Tin bí nee nìn bāań ti-pu án nín làá ŋá pu tí taa dū ti-mákal kí páań timbi ti-ba pu, ama tí nīn máká Unimbɔti un fìkitī bitaŋkpiibee pu.

english_verse: God saved us from the threat of death, and we are sure that he will do it again and again.
translation_verse: Úǹ di nyántì-ti dinimbinaamandi kúm gbanti poon, ní ki làá dāá nyāntí-ti. Ní ti cáá dimákal u-pu yii úǹ di làá dāá gíti nyāntí-ti,

english_verse: Please help us by praying for us. Then many people will give thanks for the blessings we receive in answer to all these prayers. Paul's Change of Plans
translation_verse: kun puee ti nyí yii ni bíi tútúǹ-ti ŋwimmeem poon. Di sá yii kunipaau yaa mēē ti-pu ní Unimbɔti fōō bi-wimmeemee, kunipaau làá dāá tí pàkà-u u nín ŋá tiŋan tin ki tīī-tee pu. Pɔɔl kpītì u-saŋŋu

english_verse: We can be proud of our clear conscience. We have always lived honestly and sincerely, especially when we were with you. And we were guided by God's gift of undeserved grace instead of by the wisdom of this world.
translation_verse: Kun pu an mɔ̄ǹ-tee di sá yii ti-pɔbiliŋ poonee, ti nyí yii ti dū dipɔbil diba nì mbimbimɔntiim ní ki kāl̀ duulinyan, cilinjee ni-kansikin. Tíǹ kɔkɔ nyánní Unimbɔti cee ní. An sá Unimbɔti ŋanti di kpōotì-ti, kaa sá unil ciiŋyi.

english_verse: I am not writing anything you cannot read and understand. I hope you will understand it completely,
translation_verse: Di sá yii tigbɔn tin kɔkɔ ti ŋmàn̄ ki tīī-nee poonee, taa ti kútì tiba kii tin ni kàan̄ ki gbìl̄ee. Ní m máká yii ni làá gbìl̄ tibɔti nee taapu tiŋan.

english_verse: just as you already partly understand us. Then when our Lord Jesus returns, you can be as proud of us as we are of you.
translation_verse: - Di sá yii naa láá gbìl̄ kɔkɔ ki dóò -: Ama ti-Dindaan Yeesu gítintam dalee, timbi puee, án làá dāá mɔ̄ɔkiǹ-ni, ní ni mun puee, án làá dāá mɔ̄ɔkiǹ ti mun.

english_verse: I was so sure of your pride in us that I had planned to visit you first of all. In this way you would have the blessing of two visits from me—
translation_verse: Tíǹ pu ní m máká ki bàà là kí dīń ni-cee án nín làá ŋá pu ní ká tiŋan mili puee.

english_verse: once on my way to Macedonia and again on my return from there. Then you could send me on to Judea.
translation_verse: M bàà dākafì yii ḿ dīń ni-cee ní kí nín càatī Maseeduwaan tiŋkin, ní boonee kí fàtīí tí dīń ni-cee ní bàà tūtuǹ-mi ḿ nìkī m-saŋkindi kí nīn cá Juudee tiŋkin.

english_verse: Do you think I couldn't make up my mind about what to do? Or do I seem like someone who says “Yes” or “No” simply to please others?
translation_verse: M nín bɔ́ntì kí còom̀ m-saŋŋu puee, an sá man di gāā m-bindi ki là kí cù-ŋu naaa? Àá m sá unil un nyɔkɔ kaa bīī tibɔti kí lì yii iiin, ní kí dāá fàtīí lì yii aayeeyee ní?

english_verse: God can be trusted, and so can I, when I say our answer to you has always been “Yes” and never “No.”
translation_verse: Ibaamɔn, Unimbɔti sá m-seeradaaŋwu. M-bɔti tin m sòon̄ nee kaa sá «Iiin» nì «Aayee» bɔti.

english_verse: This is because Jesus Christ the Son of God is always “Yes” and never “No.” And he is the one Silas, Timothy, and I told you about.
translation_verse: Di sá yii Unimbɔti Jipɔɔn Yeesu Kriisitoo un bɔti man nì Siilasi nì Tiimootee sòon̄ ni-cee niinee kaa sá «Iiin» nì «Aayee» bɔti. Ama, u-nee, an pée sá «Iiin» ŋmaniŋma ní.

english_verse: Christ says “Yes” to all God's promises. This is why we have Christ to say “Amen” for us to the glory of God.
translation_verse: Kun puee Unimbɔti nín pōoǹ tiŋyee, Yeesu pu ní an sá «Iiin» tiŋman. An puee Yeesu Kriisitoo pu ní ti lì yii «Ameeni» ki nyɔ́ŋkí Unimbɔti.

english_verse: And so God makes it possible for you and us to stand firmly together with Christ. God is also the one who chose us
translation_verse: Unimbɔti di báaǹ timbi nì nimbi inyaan Kriisitoo ni. Unimbɔti u-ba di lútì-ti.

english_verse: and put his Spirit in our hearts to show that we belong only to him.
translation_verse: Úǹ di dū u-daaŋku ki ŋá ti-pu, ní ki dū u-Fam ki ŋá ti-pɔbiliŋin kí dàkà-ti yii ti sá u-yab u kpáafì tiwammɔntiil ki yóoǹ kí dāá tīī-ti fool boon.

english_verse: God is my witness that I stayed away from Corinth, just to keep from being hard on you.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti pu ní m sòoǹ ibaamɔn. Kun pu maa dīń ni-cee Kɔranti tiŋkinee di sá maa là kí yòon̄ ni-pɔbiliŋ. M yaa mɔ́ntì ú kpɔ̀-mi.

english_verse: We are not bosses who tell you what to believe. We are working with you to make you glad, because your faith is strong.
translation_verse: Di sá yii taa là kí dū mpɔn kí dàkà-ni ni nín máaǹ kí fōō kí kíí puee. Ama ti là kí jòò-ni ní nīn cáá dipɔɔpindi ní, kun puee ni-fookiiu pɔ̄ɔ̄.

english_verse: I have decided not to make my next visit with you so painful.
translation_verse: An pu ní m ká yii an ŋān̄ ḿ taa dāan̄ ni-cee kí fàtīí tí kɔ́ǹ-ni kunimbaau.

english_verse: If I make you feel bad, who would be left to cheer me up, except the people I had made to feel bad?
translation_verse: Kun puee nimbi di tìì-mi kunyannyaau. Kin m yaa kɔ́ǹ-ni kunimbaauee, bilab di làá gíti tīī-mi dipɔɔpindi?

english_verse: The reason I want to be happy is to make you happy. I wrote as I did because I didn't want to visit you and be made to feel bad, when you should make me feel happy.
translation_verse: Kun yì-tì m ŋmàn̄-ni kugbɔŋuee di sá maa là kí bàń kí ká bin bàà làá tīī-mi dipɔɔpindee ń kɔ́ǹ-mi kunimbaaun, di sá m nyí yii man pɔɔpindi sá nimbi yal, ní ni mun pɔɔpindi sá man yal.

english_verse: At the time I wrote, I was suffering terribly. My eyes were full of tears, and my heart was broken. But I didn't want to make you feel bad. I only wanted to let you know how much I cared for you. Forgiveness
translation_verse: An nìn sá-mi kunimbaau nì dipɔɔbiildi nì nsiim ní m ŋmàn̄-ni kugbɔŋu. An kaa nìn sá kí kɔ́ǹ-ni kunimbaau pu ní m ŋmàn̄-ni, ama an nìn sá ní ŋmā kí béé dineendi din bulifi m cáá ni-puee ní. Pɔɔl dū un yīntiǹ-uee kpitii ki pú-u

english_verse: I don't want to be hard on you. But if one of you has made someone feel bad, I am not really the one who has been made to feel bad. Some of you are the ones.
translation_verse: Unil un di yaa cáań kunimbaau neeyee, an kaa sá man baba ní u kɔ́ǹ kunimbaau, u kɔ́ǹ ki kpáaǹ ni-kɔkɔ ní. Ama kí taa sòoǹ kí càatēe, ni-kansikin biba ní u kɔ́ǹ kunimbaau.

english_verse: Most of you have already pointed out the wrong that person did, and this is punishment enough for what was done.
translation_verse: Ni-kansikin kupaau nín kpáfì kinyɔkɔ ki dáaĺ udaan tafal miŋyee ŋmāntì.

english_verse: When people sin, you should forgive and comfort them, so they won't give up in despair.
translation_verse: Kɔŋkɔnnee ni máaǹ kí dūú pɔ̄-u kí tīī-u kunyannyaau ú taa gíti kɔ́ kunimbaakpaŋkpaaŋŋun.

english_verse: You should make them sure of your love for them.
translation_verse: An puee m gbāam̀-ni, ní dàkàmaan ni-neendi udaan pu.

english_verse: I also wrote because I wanted to test you and find out if you would follow my instructions.
translation_verse: M nìn ŋmàn̄-ni tibɔtee kí cɔ̄ŋkì-ni kí kpèè yii ni tɔ́-mi tiŋman puɔɔɔ!

english_verse: I will forgive anyone you forgive. Yes, for your sake and with Christ as my witness, I have forgiven whatever needed to be forgiven.
translation_verse: Ni yaa dū unil un kpitii ki pú-uee, ma mun làá dūú pɔ̄-u. Tiba yaa bí ki sá ḿ dūú pɔ̄ udaanee, nimbi puee, m dūu pú-u Kriisitoo nimbiin,

english_verse: I have done this to keep Satan from getting the better of us. We all know what goes on in his mind.
translation_verse: án nín làá ŋá pu tí taa yàntī Sitaan ń jī ti-pu dinyandee, kun puee ti nyí u-landɔkɔŋu. Tibɔti tin páb́ Pɔɔl Troowaasi tiŋkinee

english_verse: When I went to Troas to preach the good news about Christ, I found that the Lord had already prepared the way.
translation_verse: M nín bàn̄ Troowaasi tiŋkin kí sòoǹ Kriisitoo bɔmɔntiitee, m nìn ká yii ti-Dindaan pīitì-mi nsan ḿ sòoǹ-tì.

english_verse: But I was worried when I didn't find my friend Titus there. So I left the other followers and went on to Macedonia.
translation_verse: Ama m nín kaa ká m-nabiki Tiiti niinee, m-pɔbil kaa nìn sɔ̀m̀ ḿ kàl̄ niin. An pu ní m yíkì bi-cee ki búntì Maseeduwaan. Yeesu Kriisitoo tìì-ti dijajil

english_verse: I am grateful that God always makes it possible for Christ to lead us to victory. God also helps us spread the knowledge about Christ everywhere, and this knowledge is like the smell of perfume.
translation_verse: Tí jāam̀ Unimbɔti Kriisitoo pu, u nín cáá ti mun ki ŋáań u-jajil faalii poon puee. Ti nì Kriisitoo nín ŋá ubaantee puee, u dì ti-pu ki gbìtī ajan kɔkɔ Kriisitoo bɔti kii talaaluee.

english_verse: A lot of people try to get rich from preaching God's message. But we are God's sincere messengers, and by the power of Christ we speak our message with God as our witness.
translation_verse: Timbi kaa sá kii binib tikpil bin dū Unimbɔti bɔti ki kpántì dibàntilee, ti sá ibaamɔn nib ní, Unimbɔti di lēē-ti ki tú. Ti nín ŋá ubaanti nì Kriisitooyee pu ní ti sòoǹ Unimbɔti nimbiin.

english_verse: Are we once again bragging about ourselves? Do we need letters to you or from you to tell others about us? Some people do need letters telling about them.
translation_verse: Mimmee ti fātìi tí bíi dàkà ti-ba yii ti ŋá tiba deeyaaa? Àá an bàlifī yii tí cáań tigbɔn tin bi ŋmàn̄ ki pàkā-tee kí dàkà-ni naaa? Àá an sá yii tí bàlifì-ni ní ŋmà kugbɔŋu kí pàkà-ti ní, a lì kii biba nín ŋáań puee?

english_verse: But you are our letter, and you are in our hearts for everyone to read and understand.
translation_verse: Nimbi Kɔranti yab di sá kugbɔŋu kun báà ŋma wāĺ ki kàaǹee, ní kugbɔŋuee ŋmàn̄ ti-pɔbiliŋin.

english_verse: You are like a letter written by Christ and delivered by us. But you are not written with pen and ink or on tablets made of stone. You are written in our hearts by the Spirit of the living God.
translation_verse: Báà ŋma wāĺ yii ni sá kugbɔŋu kun Kriisitoo dī ti-pu ki ŋmàn̄ee ní. Waa ŋmàn̄ nì ŋgbaŋŋmamɔɔn. Ama Unimbɔti un bí dimaŋfalinee Fam di ŋmàn̄. Waa ŋmàn̄ ataŋkpee pu, u ŋmàn̄ binib pɔbiliŋin ní.

english_verse: We are sure about all this. Christ makes us sure in the very presence of God.
translation_verse: Kriisitoo puee dimákal din ti cáá Unimbɔti puee dee.

english_verse: We don't have the right to claim that we have done anything on our own. God gives us what it takes to do all we do.
translation_verse: Di sá taa bí yii ti ŋūǹ kí ŋá tiba ti-ba pɔŋŋu pu. Tin ti yaa ŋúń ki ŋée, an sá Unimbɔti pɔŋŋu di cāntì ti ŋúń ki ŋá.

english_verse: He makes us worthy to be the servants of his new agreement that comes from the Holy Spirit and not from a written Law. After all, the Law brings death, but the Spirit brings life.
translation_verse: Kun puee úǹ di tìì-ti ŋŋmam ní ti sòoǹ dipoompɔndi din u ŋée Bɔmɔntiiti. Dipoondi gbanti kaa sá mara un nìn sá nì tiŋmaŋmabitee, ama dì sá nì Unimbɔti Fam tundi ní. Di sá mara kù ní, ama Unimbɔti Fam míǹ tìì binib dimaŋfal ní.

english_verse: The Law of Moses brought only the promise of death, even though it was carved on stones and given in a wonderful way. Still the Law made Moses' face shine so brightly the people of Israel could not look at it, even though it was a fading glory.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti nín nìn ŋmàn̄ u-marab ataŋkpee puee, bi nìn ká u-nyooti. Ní Mooyiisi mun nimbiin nìn kíǹ ki jìl̀, ní Isirayeel yab kaa nìn gíti ŋūǹ kí kpèè-u. An nyootee sá tin jītée ní. Marab bin bi yaa yīntì an cāabìń ŋkúmee yaa nìn dɔ́miń nì kunyaaŋŋu míǹ,

english_verse: So won't the agreement the Spirit brings to us be even more wonderful?
translation_verse: kin ataa aŋa pu ní Unimbɔti Fam min tìì dimaŋfalee nyooti kaa máaǹ ki jítiǹ míǹ.

english_verse: If something that brings the death sentence is glorious, won't something that makes us acceptable to God be even more glorious?
translation_verse: An yaa sá yii marab bin làá cáań ŋkúmee pu ní Unimbɔti nyooti dɔ́miń ki jìl̀ mimmee, mana ní Unimbɔti Fam tundi din làá yàntī binib ń kpántí deedeedambi Unimbɔti nimbiinee nyooti làá nīn jìl̀ dee?

english_verse: In fact, the new agreement is so wonderful that the Law is no longer glorious at all.
translation_verse: Taa ŋūǹ kí dū tinyool tin nìn jítèe kí ŋmàntīǹ tin bí nee báà fiii. Kun puee, tíǹee sá tikpaandi ní.

english_verse: The Law was given with a glory that faded away. But the glory of the new agreement is much greater, because it will never fade away.
translation_verse: Tin bí ki làá jītée di yaa cáá tinyool mimmee, kin tin làá nīn pée bí kí nīn cée fáà!

english_verse: This wonderful hope makes us feel like speaking freely.
translation_verse: Ti nín cɔ́tí tin pu tikpilee dee. An pu ní ti cáá dipɔbil ki sòoǹ ki cántí tikɔkɔ.

english_verse: We are not like Moses. His face was shining, but he covered it to keep the people of Israel from seeing the brightness fade away.
translation_verse: Timbi kaa làá ŋá kii Mooyiisi nín nìn dū ŋŋaabu ki bīiǹ u-nimbiin Isirayeel yab ń taa kpèè-u kí nīn cí ŋyunti ŋun ní ŋwalifee làá dāá lēēyee.

english_verse: The people were stubborn, and something still keeps them from seeing the truth when the Law is read. Only Christ can take away the covering that keeps them from seeing.
translation_verse: Ama bi-landɔkɔi kaa cútí tibɔti malaa, a lì kii ŋŋaabuee dáá gbíntì ki lìkī bi-nimbiinee. Di sá yii bi yaa kàaǹ Dipooŋkpikil gbɔŋku poonee, baa gbìl̀ taapu, áli ki dāa sāā díǹee, bi-landɔkɔi kaa cútí tibɔti. See unil un fōō Kriisitoo ki kííyee baba nimbiin ní ŋŋaabu bìitī.

english_verse: When the Law of Moses is read, they have their minds covered over
translation_verse: Áli ki dāa sāā díǹ, bi yaa bíi kàaǹ Mooyiisi gbɔntee, an bí kii ŋŋaabuee lìkī bi-landɔkɔi ní baa gbìl̀ taapuee.

english_verse: with a covering that is removed only for those who turn to the Lord.
translation_verse: Unil un yaa fōō ti-Dindaan ki kííyee nimbiin ní ŋŋaabuee lèekī.

english_verse: The Lord and the Spirit are one and the same, and the Lord's Spirit sets us free.
translation_verse: Di sá yii ti-Dindaanee, Ŋfam dee. Laakin ti-Dindaan Fam yaa bée, niin ní dibatɔl bí.

english_verse: So our faces are not covered. They show the bright glory of the Lord, as the Lord's Spirit makes us more and more like our glorious Lord.
translation_verse: Timbi bin kɔkɔ nimbiin ŋŋaabuee lēēyee di sá bin pu ní bi wāĺ ti-Dindaan nyootee. Ti-Dindaan un di sá Ŋfamee di kpántí-ti míǹ, ní ti náań nì u, ní ki cáá tinyool tin wīintí ki cée.

english_verse: God has been kind enough to trust us with this work. This is why we never give up.
translation_verse: An sá tiŋan ní Unimbɔti ŋá-ti ní ki dū ditundi nee ki ŋúbiǹ-ti. An pu ní ti-wunti kaa yɔ̀tī di-pu.

english_verse: We don't do shameful things that must be kept secret. And we don't try to fool anyone or twist God's message around. God is our witness that we speak only the truth, so others will be sure we can be trusted.
translation_verse: Ti fá dibɔmbɔndi nì icoo tuuŋŋi. Taa ŋmàtíǹ binib, kaa kpántí Unimbɔti bɔti, ama Unimbɔti nimbiin ní ti sòoǹ ibaamɔn ki cántí ki tùkù binib ki nyàab̀ báà ŋma ń béé yii tin ti sòoǹee sá ibaamɔn.

english_verse: If there is anything hidden about our message, it is hidden only to someone who is lost.
translation_verse: An puee bin wáŋkèe ceeyee, Unimbɔti bɔti tin ti sòoǹ nee sá dibɔmbɔndi ní ki tīī-bi.

english_verse: The god who rules this world has blinded the minds of unbelievers. They cannot see the light, which is the good news about our glorious Christ, who shows what God is like.
translation_verse: Kun pu baa fōō-tì ki kííyee di sá Sitaan un sá duulinya nee bɔtiuee jɔ̀b̄-bi ki yāntì baa wāĺ Tibɔmɔntiilee nín ŋmíntí ki dàkà-bi Kriisitoo un sá Unimbɔti naŋkuee nyooti.

english_verse: We are not preaching about ourselves. Our message is that Jesus Christ is Lord. He also sent us to be your servants.
translation_verse: Di sá yii taa bíi sòoǹ nì ni timbi ti-ba bɔti, Yeesu Kriisitoo bɔti ní ti sòoǹ nì ni yii úǹ di sá ti-Dindaan. Úǹ pu ní timbi sá ni-tɔntɔnliibi.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “God commanded light to shine in the dark.” Now God is shining in our hearts to let you know that his glory is seen in Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Di sá Unimbɔti un bí yii: «Ŋwalifi ń ŋmíntí dibɔmbɔndinee,» úǹ u-ba di ŋmíntì ti-pɔbiliŋ poon ki yāntì ti ká Kriisitoo nimbiin Unimbɔti nyooti nín jìl̀ miŋyee.

english_verse: We often suffer, but we are never crushed. Even when we don't know what to do, we never give up.
translation_verse: Falaabi kɔkɔ nì bi-nyɔkɔm nyìitī-ti, ama ti mun kaa wìil̄. Tiwan tikpil bàkantí-ti, ama ti mun kaa páatí ti-mákal Unimbɔti pu.

english_verse: In times of trouble, God is with us, and when we are knocked down, we get up again.
translation_verse: Bi jì-ti, ama Unimbɔti kaa yàntī bí cúú-ti. Bi líikí-ti kitiŋ, ama ti mun kaa kúù.

english_verse: We face death every day because of Jesus. Our bodies show what his death was like, so his life can also be seen in us.
translation_verse: Yeesu puee, ŋyunti kamaayee ŋkúm pée kpàkaǹ-ti ní. Báà ti yaa jíń falaa ní ki dāa kpíì, binib làá béé yii Yeesu bí ti-ni.

english_verse: This means that death is working in us, but life is working in you.
translation_verse: Timbi bí ŋkúmin, ama ní ki cāabìń nimbi dimaŋfal.

english_verse: In the Scriptures it says, “I spoke because I had faith.” We have this same kind of faith. So we speak
translation_verse: A lì kii Unimbɔti gbɔŋku poon nín lī puee yii: «M fōō ki kíí, an pu ní m sòon̄.» Nlandɔkɔ gbanti mbaanti ní ti mun cáá, ti mun fōō Unimbɔti ki kíí, an pu ní ti sòoǹ.

english_verse: because we know that God raised the Lord Jesus to life. And just as God raised Jesus, he will also raise us to life. Then he will bring us into his presence together with you.
translation_verse: Ti nyí un fīkitì ti-Dindaan Yeesu ditaŋkpiilinee làá dāá fìkitī ti mun kii u nín fīkitì Yeesu puee, ní kí dāá cáá ti nì ni-kɔkɔ kí kàan̄ u-cee.

english_verse: All of this has been done for you, so more and more people will know how kind God is and will praise and honor him. Faith in the Lord
translation_verse: Nimbi pu ní ti jīǹ falaa gbanti, án nín làá ŋá pu Unimbɔti nín tīī diyimɔɔl diŋyee ń bà báà ŋma, bí kpāfì kunipaau kí jāam̀ Unimbɔti tinyooldaan u-ŋanti puee. Fookii ń nīn kpòotī-ti

english_verse: We never give up. Our bodies are gradually dying, but we ourselves are being made stronger each day.
translation_verse: An pu ní ti-wunti kaa yɔ̀tī. Báà an yaa sá yii ti-wunti tin poon ti bí nee yaa bíi nàantí ki sìntāaa, dimaŋfapɔndi din bí ti-nee làá nīn pée pɔ̀ntī ní ki cá.

english_verse: These little troubles are getting us ready for an eternal glory that will make all our troubles seem like nothing.
translation_verse: Kɔŋkɔnnee ti nín bíi jīǹ falaa un fiii nee di bíi bɔ́ntí tinyookpaandi tin kaa cáá dikúntil taa ŋūǹ kí dūú ŋmàntīǹ tibee ki yōontí-ti.

english_verse: Things that are seen don't last forever, but things that are not seen are eternal. This is why we keep our minds on the things that cannot be seen.
translation_verse: An puee timbi nimbikpeeŋu bá tin baa wāĺee pu ní, kaa sá tin bi wāĺ nee pu. Di sá tin bi wāĺee kaa yúntí, ama tin baa wāĺee, tíǹ làá nīn pée bí ní kí nīn cá jaanjaan.

english_verse: Our bodies are like tents that we live in here on earth. But when these tents are destroyed, we know that God will give each of us a place to live. These homes will not be buildings someone has made, but they are in heaven and will last forever.
translation_verse: Ti nyí yii tiwun tin poon ti kóò duulinya nee poonee yaa kpíìyaaa, Unimbɔti kpáafì-ti tiwumpɔn tiba yilpu. Tiwun gbanti tíǹ sá kii kudii kun úǹ u-ba máńee ní tí nīn kóò poon jaanjaan.

english_verse: While we are here on earth, we sigh because we want to live in that heavenly home.
translation_verse: Ama kɔŋkɔnnee ti bí ki yáliŋkí ki bàà nyàab̀ kí fōō yilpu wunti tin sá kii kudii kun Unimbɔti u-ba máńee.

english_verse: We want to put it on like clothes and not be naked.
translation_verse: Kun puee taa làá tin nín̄ bí yilpu kaa cáá tiwun.

english_verse: These tents we now live in are like a heavy burden, and we groan. But we don't do this just because we want to leave these bodies that will die. It is because we want to change them for bodies that will never die.
translation_verse: Tiŋman timbi bin dáá kóò tiwun nee poonee, ti bí digìńdi nì falaabi poon ní. Ama taa là kí nyā tiwun tin sá taapu doo yatee poon. Ti là kí dū yilpu wunti ní kí dūú bìin̄ tin béeyee pu, án nín làá ŋá pu ní tiwun tin kúùyee ń nīn fúuń tin kaa kúùyee poon kí ká dimaŋfalee.

english_verse: God is the one who makes all this possible. He has given us his Spirit to make us certain he will do it.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti u-ba di bí yii ti-wunti ń dāá kpántí míǹ. U-Fam min u tīī-tee di dàkà yii u kpáafì tiwammɔntiil ki yóoǹ-ti ti làá dāá fōō.

english_verse: So always be cheerful! As long as we are in these bodies, we are away from the Lord.
translation_verse: An puee ní ti cáá kunyannyaau baabadal. Ti nyí yii ti nín dáá kóò tiwun tin poonee, ti kóò ki dátiǹ ti-Dindaan.

english_verse: But we live by faith, not by what we see.
translation_verse: Ti fōō Unimbɔti nín lī puee ní ki kíí, taa láá ká nì ti-nimbiliŋ.

english_verse: We should be cheerful, because we would rather leave these bodies and be at home with the Lord.
translation_verse: Ti cáá kunyannyaau an júkufí-ti ti bàà là kí yīkì ti-wunti tin bí nee poon kí cù kí nīn bí ti-Dindaan cee.

english_verse: But whether we are at home with the Lord or away from him, we still try our best to please him.
translation_verse: Ama tin ti nyàab̀ee di sá báà ti yaa bí tiwun nee poonaaa, ti yaa nyáń ti-naaa, tí fáatí-u.

english_verse: We know what it means to respect the Lord, and we encourage everyone to turn to him. God himself knows what we are like, and I hope you also know what kind of people we are.
translation_verse: Ti nín fàŋkí Unimbɔti puee ní ti bí ki nyàab̀ binib ń fōō-u kí kíí. Unimbɔti wāĺ-ti míǹ pílpil, m nyí yii ni mun nyí ti-pu míǹ ni-pɔbiliŋ poon.

english_verse: We are not trying once more to brag about ourselves. But we want you to be proud of us, when you are with those who are not sincere and brag about what others think of them.
translation_verse: Kaa sá ti là kí fàtīí tí pàkà ti-ba ni-cee, ti là kí pɔ̄-ni nsan ní nīn mɔ̀ɔǹ ti-pu ní. Míǹ ní ni ŋūǹ kí ká tiba kí kíí bin di bí ki sòoǹ bi-nyɔmmu poon tibɔti fám ki kāntí tinyool, ama ní bi-pɔbiliŋ poon kūńee.

english_verse: If we seem out of our minds, it is between God and us. But if we are in our right minds, it is for your good.
translation_verse: Bi yaa yíì-ti biwaatiibaaa, an sá Unimbɔti pu ní bi yíì-ti míǹ. Bi yaa tí yíì-ti binimɔntiibaaa, an sá nimbi paatii ní.

english_verse: We are ruled by Christ's love for us. We are certain that if one person died for everyone else, then all of us have died.
translation_verse: Kriisitoo neendi di jíń mpaan timbi pu, timbi bin nyí yii unibaanti di kpíì ti-kɔkɔ puee, mimmee ti-kɔkɔ mun kpíì deeyee.

english_verse: And Christ did die for all of us. He died so we would no longer live for ourselves, but for the one who died and was raised to life for us.
translation_verse: Úǹ di kpíì ti-kɔkɔ pu, án nín làá ŋá pu bin bí dimaŋfalinee ń taa nín̄ bí ki tīī bi-ba, ama bí nīn bí ki tīī un kpíì ki fīkitì bi-puee.

english_verse: We are careful not to judge people by what they seem to be, though we once judged Christ in this way.
translation_verse: An puee taa ti kpèé ubɔ nniyaamin. Ki kpáaǹ dooooyee ti yaa nìn kpèé Kriisitoo nniyaaminaaa, kɔŋkɔnnee taa ti kpèé-u míǹ.

english_verse: Anyone who belongs to Christ is a new person. The past is forgotten, and everything is new.
translation_verse: Un nì Kriisitoo ŋá ubaantee kpántì unipɔɔn dee, tin sá tikpikilee jítì, tipɔn di kíǹ ki bí.

english_verse: God has done it all! He sent Christ to make peace between himself and us, and he has given us the work of making peace between himself and others.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti di ŋá míǹ kɔkɔ. U dī Kriisitoo pu ki yāntì ti nì u mɔ́ɔkì ní ki dū ditundi nee ki ŋá ti-ŋaan yii tí cáań binib u nì bi ń mɔ̄ɔkì.

english_verse: What we mean is that God was in Christ, offering peace and forgiveness to the people of this world. And he has given us the work of sharing his message about peace.
translation_verse: Di sá yii Kriisitoo pu ní Unimbɔti dī ki cáań binib ní u nì bi mɔ́ɔkì, kaa fātìi tɔ́ bi-kpitii in bi ŋée pu. U dū dimɔɔkil gbanti tundi ki ŋúbiǹ-ti tí sòoǹ nì binib.

english_verse: We were sent to speak for Christ, and God is begging you to listen to our message. We speak for Christ and sincerely ask you to make peace with God.
translation_verse: An puee Kriisitoo nyɔkɔpu ní ti làá sòoǹee, a lì kii Unimbɔti u-ba di dī timbi pu ki yíì-nee. Ti dū Kriisitoo ki gbāam̀-ni, ní kíí kí yàntī ni nì Unimbɔti ń mɔ̄ɔkì.

english_verse: Christ never sinned! But God treated him as a sinner, so Christ could make us acceptable to God.
translation_verse: Timbi kɔkɔ puee, Unimbɔti yāntì Kriisitoo un kaa ŋá ikpiti ki kée fōō timbi kpitii, án nín làá ŋá pu u-puee, tí kpántí deedeedambi Unimbɔti nimbiinee.

english_verse: We work together with God, and we beg you to make good use of God's gift of undeserved grace.
translation_verse: Di sá yii timbi nì Unimbɔti di bí ki tūǹ ditundi, an pu ní ti mèé-ni yii ní taa yàntī diyimɔɔl din ni fōō u-ceeyee ń ŋá fám.

english_verse: In the Scriptures God says, “When the time came, I listened to you, and when you needed help, I came to save you.” That time has come. This is the day for you to be saved.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti lī u-gbɔŋku poon yii: «M-niti yuntiŋuee, m nìn pílifiǹ-si, m nìn tútúǹ-si difiil wiiŋŋu a ká difiil.» An puee Unimbɔti niti yuntiŋu sèé, difiil wiiŋŋu sèé.

english_verse: We don't want anyone to find fault with our work, and so we try hard not to cause problems.
translation_verse: Taa là kí bàkan̄-ni báà tiba nì tiba poon, án nín làá ŋá pu ubɔ ń taa ká ibɔkpiti iba ti-tundi nee pu kí lèe.

english_verse: But in everything and in every way we show we truly are God's servants. We have always been patient, though we have had a lot of trouble, suffering, and hard times.
translation_verse: Ama ti pée dàkà ti-bimbim kɔkɔ poon yii ti sá Unimbɔti tɔntɔnliibi ní, ní ki jīǹ kimɔtii tikpil, falaabi nì kunimbaau nì dinimbinaamandi poon.

english_verse: We have been beaten, put in jail, and hurt in riots. We have worked hard and have gone without sleep or food.
translation_verse: Bi gbáà-ti ki cáǹ-ti ki pìintí kudii, ki mèé tijáti ki tòó ti-pu, ki yàntī ti tūǹ atuun ŋin pɔ̄ɔ̄yee, kaa kāntí ŋgeem, kaa jīǹ tijin.

english_verse: But we have kept ourselves pure and have been understanding, patient, and kind. The Holy Spirit has been with us, and our love has been real.
translation_verse: Ti-nyaŋkanti nì ti-nyil nì kimɔtii nì ti-niti nì Circir Fam pɔŋŋu nì dineembaamɔndi ní ti cáa dàkà yii ti sá Unimbɔti tɔntɔnliibi.

english_verse: We have spoken the truth, and God's power has worked in us. In all our struggles we have said and done only what is right.
translation_verse: Ti sòoǹ Unimbɔti bɔti tin sá ibaamɔnee nì u-pɔŋŋu ní ki dàkà yii ti sá Unimbɔti tɔntɔnliibi. Ti nín yú deedee nì Unimbɔtee di sá tijanjawan tin ti cáa jáàyee, nì tin ti cáa cí ti-bee.

english_verse: Whether we were honored or dishonored or praised or cursed, we always told the truth about ourselves. But some people said we did not.
translation_verse: Ŋyunti ŋubɔee, bi tìì-ti tinyool, ní ŋyunti ŋubɔee, bi kɔ̄ntí-ti icoo. Ŋyunti ŋubɔee, bi sòoǹ ti-pu tin ŋān̄ee, ní ŋyunti ŋubɔee, bi sòoǹ ti-pu tikpitil mun. Bi kpèé-ti kii binyimɔndambee, ama ní ti mun sòoǹ ibaamɔn.

english_verse: We are unknown to others, but well known to you. We seem to be dying, and yet we are still alive. We have been punished, but never killed,
translation_verse: Bi kpèé-ti kii báà ubɔ kaa nyí-tee, ama ní báà ŋma nyí-ti. Bi kpèé-ti kii bin làá kpúee, ama ní ti mun kaa kúù. Bi dátí ti-tafal, ama ní kaa kù-ti.

english_verse: and we are always happy, even in times of suffering. Although we are poor, we have made many people rich. And though we own nothing, everything is ours.
translation_verse: Bi kɔ̄ntí-ti kunimbaau, ní timbi bí dipɔɔpindin. Bi kpèé-ti yii ti sá bisoodambi, ama timbi di tìì binib tikpil Unimbɔti gaajati. Bi kpèé-ti yii taa pée cáá tiba nì tiba, ama ní ti mun di cáá tikɔkɔ nì tikɔkɔ.

english_verse: Friends in Corinth, we are telling the truth when we say there is room in our hearts for you.
translation_verse: Nimbi Kɔranti yab, ti sòon̄ nì ni ti-poon bɔti kɔkɔ ki pīitì ti-pɔbiliŋ ki tīī-ni.

english_verse: We are not holding back on our love for you, but you are holding back on your love for us.
translation_verse: Timbi pīitì ti-pɔbiliŋ ki tīī-ni, nimbi di kaa pīitì ni-yaŋ.

english_verse: I speak to you as I would speak to my own children. Please make room in your hearts for us. The Temple of the Living God
translation_verse: M bíi sòoǹ nì ni kii ubaati nín sòoǹ nì u-biyaamu puee ní: kii ti nín néeń-ni miŋyee puee, pìitīmaan ni-pɔbiliŋ kí tīī-ti. Taa fōōmaan bin kaa nyí Unimbɔtee bimbim

english_verse: Stay away from people who are not followers of the Lord! Can someone who is good get along with someone who is evil? Are light and darkness the same?
translation_verse: Ni nì binib bin kaa nyí Unimbɔtee ń taa kpāfì kí ŋá ubaanti. Nnyɔɔpee ŋulɔŋu di bí tin bí deedeeyee nì tin kaa bí deedeeyee kansikin? Mana ní dibɔmbɔndi nì ŋwalifi ŋūǹ kí kpāfì?

english_verse: Is Christ a friend of Satan? Can people who follow the Lord have anything in common with those who don't?
translation_verse: Mana ní Kriisitoo nì Sitaan ŋūǹ kí pèen̄ kinyɔkɔ? Àá ba nyɔɔpeeŋu di bí unimbɔtinool nì un kaa nyí Unimbɔtee kansikin ní?

english_verse: Do idols belong in the temple of God? We are the temple of the living God, as God himself says, “I will live with these people and walk among them. I will be their God, and they will be my people.”
translation_verse: Mana ní Unimbɔti nì awaa ŋun kí pèen̄ kudii? Timbi sá Unimbɔti un bí dimaŋfalinee diiku ní, a lì kii Unimbɔti u-ba nín lī puee, yii: «M làá nīn kóò m-nibul cee, ní kí nīn còom̄ bi-kansikin. Man di làá nīn sá bi-Nimbɔtiu, ní bíǹ ń nīn sá man nibul.»

english_verse: The Lord also says, “Leave them and stay away! Don't touch anything that isn't clean. Then I will welcome you
translation_verse: An pu ní Unimbɔti lī u-nibul yii: «Ní nyā binib nee kansikin kí gàntīmaan ni-ba, kí taa gbēē tin sá tijɔkɔndee, ní man ń nín fōō-ni,

english_verse: and be your Father. You will be my sons and my daughters, as surely as I am God, the All-Powerful.”
translation_verse: kí nīn kíǹ ki sá ni-Baa, ní ni mun ń nīn kíǹ ki sá man jipɔmbi nì m-bisalib. Ti-Dindaan Mpɔŋkɔdaan di lī míǹ.»

english_verse: My friends, God has made us these promises. So we should stay away from everything that keeps our bodies and spirits from being clean. We should honor God and try to be completely like him. The Church Makes Paul Happy
translation_verse: Nnabineeŋkaamu, an nín sá yii timbi ní Unimbɔti pōoǹ ipoon gbantee, tí fámaan atuŋkpiti ŋin kɔkɔ bíiĺ tiwun nì kinaŋee, kí fàŋkì Unimbɔti kí nyāntí ti-pɔbiliŋ poon tikpiil kɔkɔ kí nīn bí circir. Pɔɔl pɔbil píil̀

english_verse: Make a place for us in your hearts! We haven't mistreated or hurt anyone. We haven't cheated anyone.
translation_verse: Ní dū ni-pɔbiliŋ kí tīīmaan-ti, di sá yii taa yīntiǹ ubɔ ni-kansikin, kaa bíil̀ ubɔ ni-kansikin, kaa jíń ni-kansikin ubɔ.

english_verse: I am not saying this to be hard on you. But, as I have said before, you will always be in our thoughts, whether we live or die.
translation_verse: Kaa sá m là kí wòoǹ-nee pu ní m lì míǹ, di sá m pée lī dooooyee yii ni kɔ́ ti-pɔbiliŋin tiŋan. Báà dimaŋfalinaaa, ŋkúminaaa, ti làá nīn gbíntì ki bí míǹ ní.

english_verse: I trust you completely. I am always proud of you, and I am greatly encouraged. In all my trouble I am still very happy.
translation_verse: M cáá dimákakpaandi ni-pu, ni-bɔti mɔ̄ǹ-mi tikpil. Ti-falaabi poonee, dipɔɔpiŋkpaandi din m cáá ni-puee tīī-mi kunyannyaau.

english_verse: After we came to Macedonia, we didn't have any chance to rest. We were faced with all kinds of problems. We were troubled by enemies and troubled by fears.
translation_verse: Di sá yii ti nín bāań Maseeduwaanee, taa gbìl̄ mmɔn, ti kántì agìń kɔkɔ nì ŋi-bul ní timbi ti-ba bí kujaaun ní tifaandi kɔ́-ti.

english_verse: But God cheers up people in need, and this is what he did when he sent Titus to us.
translation_verse: Ama Unimbɔti un tìì bin wunti yɔ̄tèe kunyannyaauee tīiń-ti kunyannyaau ŋyunti ŋun ní Tiiti bāań ti-ceeyee.

english_verse: Of course, we were glad to see Titus, but what really made us glad is the way you cheered him up. He told how sorry you were and how concerned you were about me. And this made me even happier.
translation_verse: Kaa sá u nín dɔ́miń ti-ceeyee ŋmaniŋma pu ní ti ká kunyannyaau, ama u nín máafì-ti nimbi ni-ba nín tīī u mun kunyannyaau kuŋyee pu. U máafì-ti ni nín mɔ̀ ki nyàab̀ kí bàà gíti ká-mee, nì ni nín bí ki yáliŋkí m-pu miŋyee, an di gíti mɔ́ɔkiǹ-mi ki lákatì.

english_verse: I don't feel bad anymore, even though my letter hurt your feelings. I did feel bad at first, but I don't now. I know that the letter hurt you for a while.
translation_verse: An puee kugbɔŋu kun m nìn ŋmàn̄-nee yaa nìn kɔ́ǹ-ni kunimbaauaaa, an kaa ti páb́-mi kɔŋkɔnnee. Tin nìn páb́-mee di sá m nín ká yii kugbɔŋu gbanti kɔ́ǹ-ni kunimbaau ŋyunti ŋubɔ poon fiiiyee.

english_verse: Now I am happy, but not because I hurt your feelings. It is because God used your hurt feelings to make you turn back to him, and none of you were harmed by us.
translation_verse: Ama kɔŋkɔnnee an mɔ́ɔkiǹ-mi. An kaa sá an nín kɔ́ǹ-ni kunimbaauee, ama an nín kpántì ni-bimbimee pu. Mimmee timbi kaa ŋá-ni ikpiti iba dee, an sá Unimbɔti di dī ni-nimbaaku pu ki gíiǹní-ni u-cee.

english_verse: When God makes you feel sorry enough to turn to him and be saved, you don't have anything to feel bad about. But when this world makes you feel sorry, it can cause your death.
translation_verse: Kun puee kunimbaau kun Unimbɔti kɔ̄ntí binibee cāabìń dibakpántil ní, ní unil ń ká difiil, ní kunimbaauee kaa ti páb̀-u. Ama kunimbaau kun duulinya nee gìŋ́ŋi tììyee cáǹ ŋkúmin ní.

english_verse: Just look what God has done by making you feel sorry! You sincerely want to prove you are innocent. You are angry. You are shocked. You are eager to see that justice is done. You have proved that you were completely right in this matter.
translation_verse: Ni ká Unimbɔti nín kɔ́ǹ-ni kunimbaau kuŋyee nín cáań-ni tiŋan tiŋyeeyaa! Ni kíǹ ki ŋúb́ Unimbɔti bɔti mmɔntiimin, ki kíǹ ki bíi gbàam̄ ni-bɔkpil pu. Tikpitil tin ŋée kaa mɔ́ɔkiǹ-ni, ni kíǹ ki fàŋkí Unimbɔti, ní an júkufí-ni ní ká-ti. Ni kíǹ ki cáá difaŋgiil, ki kíǹ ki wāĺ yii an máaǹ bí dáaĺ ikpitidaan tafal. Tin ni ŋá nee puee, ni dàkā yii naa bí tibɔti gbantin.

english_verse: When I wrote you, it wasn't to accuse the one who was wrong or to take up for the one who was hurt. I wrote, so God would show you how much you do care for us.
translation_verse: An puee m yaa nìn ŋmàn̄-ni kugbɔŋuee, an kaa sá un ŋá ikpitee pu, kaa tí sá un bi ŋá ikpitee mun pu. Ama m là ní ká difaŋgiil din ni cáá ti-puee Unimbɔti nimbiin ní.

english_verse: And we were greatly encouraged. Although we were encouraged, we felt even better when we saw how happy Titus was, because you had shown he had nothing to worry about.
translation_verse: An di tīī-ti kunyannyaau. Tiiti nín bāańee, an kaa sá kunyannyaau ŋmaniŋma ní ti ká, ama ti ká dipɔɔpiŋkpaandi mun, kun puee an mɔ́ɔkiǹ-u tikpil kunyannyaau kun ni-kɔkɔ tīī-u ni-cee niinee.

english_verse: We had told him how much we thought of you, and you did not disappoint us. Just as we have always told you the truth, so everything we told him about you has also proved to be true.
translation_verse: Kí wàatī ú dāan̄ ni-ceeyee, ti nìn tīī-ni disíndi u-cee, ní naa kɔ́ǹ-ti icoo kii ti nín pée sòoǹ nì ni ibaamɔn baabadal puee. Míǹ ní disíndi din ti tīī-ni Tiiti ceeyee cūtì ki kāl̀ deedeedee.

english_verse: Titus loves all of you very much, especially when he remembers how you obeyed him and how you trembled with fear when you welcomed him.
translation_verse: U yaa téetì ni-kɔkɔ nín nìn tɔ́-u min min, ki pílifíǹ-u, ki fōō-u min min nì tifaandi yɔ́kɔ́ yɔkɔee, ní dineendi din u cáá ni-puee mɔ̀tīi wīintí.

english_verse: It makes me really glad to know I can depend on you.
translation_verse: An mɔ́ɔkiǹ-mi tikpil, kun puee kɔŋkɔnnee m kíǹ ki cáá ni-pu dimákal tikɔkɔ poon.

english_verse: My friends, we want you to know that the churches in Macedonia have shown others God's gift of undeserved grace.
translation_verse: Nnabiyaamu, ti là ní béé Unimbɔti nín ŋá tiŋan tin ki tīī Kriisitoo nikitiŋ ŋin bí Maseeduwaan ŋi túń ditundi diŋyee ní.

english_verse: Although they were going through hard times and were very poor, they were glad to give generously.
translation_verse: Bi nìn bí agìń tikpil poon, ama ní bi-pɔɔpindi nìn gíti lákatì. An di yāntì ní min kɔkɔ bi sá bisoodambee, bi dàkā bi-niti an nyāŋkì.

english_verse: They gave as much as they could afford and even more, simply because they wanted to.
translation_verse: M lēē bi-mɔ́ɔŋŋu yii bi tīī nì dipɔbil diba min bi ŋúńee áli ki jítiǹ min bi ŋūǹee pu kpataaa.

english_verse: They even asked and begged us to let them have the joy of giving their money for God's people.
translation_verse: Bi gbāam̀-ti tikpil, yii tí pée pɔ̄ bi mun diyimɔɔl bí tɔ̄ tootoo kí tūtuǹ Kriisitoo yab bin bí Juudeeyee.

english_verse: And they did more than we had hoped. They gave themselves first to the Lord and then to us, just as God wanted them to do.
translation_verse: Bi tīī ki jítì min pu timbi bàà dàkafēe, di sá yii bi dá láá péé ki dū bi-ba ki tīī ti-Dindaan ki wāatì ní ki ŋá Unimbɔti nín là puee, ki dū bi-ba ki tīī ti mun.

english_verse: Titus was the one who got you started doing this good thing, so we begged him to help you finish what you had begun.
translation_verse: An pu ní ti gbāam̀ Tiiti yii ú gítiń ni-cee kí tīī-ni kunyannyaau ní púntí ni-tootoou un u nìn tīī-ni kunyannyaau ni kíĺee kí tɔ̄ nì tiniti.

english_verse: You do everything better than anyone else. You have stronger faith. You speak better and know more. You are eager to give, and you love us better. Now you must give more generously than anyone else.
translation_verse: Ni cáá tikɔkɔ nì tikɔkɔ: ni cáá fookii, ki nyí disoondi, ki cáá dinyil, ki cáá difaŋgiil tikɔkɔ pu, nì dineendi ti mun pu. An puee ti là yii ní dū tin kɔkɔ ni cááyee kí dàkà tootoo nee poon ni-niti.

english_verse: I am not ordering you to do this. I am simply testing how real your love is by comparing it with the concern that others have shown.
translation_verse: Kaa sá mara ní m bíi tìì-ni, ama m bíi máafí-ni biba faŋgiil ní, ni mun ń ŋmā kí dàkà ni-neendi nín sá ibaamɔn puee.

english_verse: You know our Lord Jesus Christ treated us with undeserved grace by giving up all his riches, so you could become rich.
translation_verse: Kun puee ni nyí tiŋan tin ti-Dindaan Yeesu Kriisitoo ŋá-tee. Úǹ un sá ugaajee, u gíiǹ u-ba usoodaan, timbi ń kpántí bigaajab úǹ soodaŋku pu.

english_verse: A year ago you were the first ones to give, and you gave because you wanted to. So listen to my advice.
translation_verse: Man nín ká tin tibɔti nee poonee ní m là kí tùkù-ni: m ká yii an ŋān̄ ní nìkī ni-tundi din ni nìn kíĺ jiilee, kun puee nimbi di nìn péé péé ki kánní an landɔkɔŋu ní ki nìn péé ki tɔ́ mun.

english_verse: I think you should finish what you started. If you give according to what you have, you will prove you are as eager to give as you were to think about giving.
translation_verse: An puee kɔŋkɔnnee, ní púntímaan ni-tundi gbanti, án nín làá ŋá pu bí dāá ká min ni lēē ni-pɔbiliŋ poon yii ni làá ŋée, ní púntí kí ŋá ni-pɔŋŋu nyɔkɔm.

english_verse: It doesn't matter how much you have. What matters is how much you are willing to give from what you have.
translation_verse: Ni yaa làá tīī tiba nì dipɔbil dibee, an kaa sá ni nín làá tīī kuŋyee wíiŋŋu di sá tiba Unimbɔti cee, ní tīī min nyɔkɔm ni ŋūǹee di sá.

english_verse: I am not trying to make life easier for others by making life harder for you. But it is only fair
translation_verse: An kaa sá yii ní dū tin ni cááyee kɔkɔ kí jòò bin kíǹee kí ŋmìntī ni-ba, ama an máaǹ un bi tútúǹee nì un tútúǹ-uee kɔkɔ ń nīn ŋmà ní.

english_verse: for you to share with them when you have so much, and they have so little. Later, when they have more than enough, and you are in need, they can share with you. Then everyone will have a fair share,
translation_verse: Kɔŋkɔnnee ni cáá tikpil kí ŋmā kí tūtuǹ bin kaa cááyee, ní daliŋkin ní ni mun yaa lóòyee, ní bi mun ń jòoń nimbi, míǹ di làá yàntī ni-kɔkɔ ń ŋmàntī.

english_verse: just as the Scriptures say, “Those who gathered too much had nothing left. Those who gathered only a little had all they needed.” Titus and His Friends
translation_verse: A lì kii Unimbɔti gbɔŋku poon nín lī puee yii: «Un fāā tikpilee kaa cáá ki lákatì, ní tiba kaa lóò un fāā fiiiyee.» Tiiti nì u-tɔntɔnjutiibi

english_verse: I am grateful that God made Titus care as much about you as we do.
translation_verse: M jáaḿ Unimbɔti un di tīī Tiiti difaŋgiil ni-pu kii ti mun nín cáá ni-pu miŋyee.

english_verse: When we begged Titus to visit you, he said he would. He wanted to because he cared so much for you.
translation_verse: Ti nín bālifì-u yii ú cù ni-ceeyee, u kíí-ti yii u làá cù, áli gba úǹ u-ba nìn pée bɔ́ntì yii u dòoń ni-cee.

english_verse: With Titus we are also sending one of the Lord's followers who is well known in every church for spreading the good news.
translation_verse: Ti dū u nì kinabiki kin túń dituŋkpaandi Unimbɔti bɔti sòontam poon, Kriisitoo nikitiŋ kɔkɔ pàkà-uee, ki túnní ni-cee.

english_verse: The churches chose this follower to travel with us while we carry this gift that will bring praise to the Lord and show how much we hope to help.
