translation_verse: Kriisitoo nikitiŋ mun gíti lēē-u yii ú céeǹ-ti tí cáá tootoo un ti ŋá nì tinitee kí cùnnì Jeerusaleem. An di làá dàkà ti nín néeń kí tūtuǹ ti-jutiibi puee ní kí tīī ti-Dindaan tinyool.

english_verse: We don't want anyone to find fault with the way we handle your generous gift.
translation_verse: Taa là biba ń nīn bí ki sòoǹ ki bíiĺ-ti kunimbigbaau kun ti yōoǹ kí cáá yàkatī binib nee pu.

english_verse: But we want to do what pleases the Lord and what people think is right.
translation_verse: Ti là yii tin ti ŋáańee ń nīn ŋān̄ ti-Dindaan ceeyaaa, kí nīn ŋān̄ binib mun cee.

english_verse: We are also sending someone else with Titus and the other follower. We approve of this man. In fact, he has already shown us many times that he wants to help. And now he wants to help even more than ever, because he trusts you so much.
translation_verse: Ti túnní-bi ni-cee bi nì ti-nabiki kiba kin ti cɔ́ŋkì ŋfunyɔm tikpil ki ká yii u cáá difaŋgiil tikɔkɔ poonee. Ama kɔŋkɔnnee, u gíti mɔ̄tìi ká difaŋgiil dimákakpaandi din u cáá ni-puee pu.

english_verse: Titus is my partner, who works with me to serve you. The other two followers are sent by the churches, and they bring honor to Christ.
translation_verse: Tiiti úǹ sá man bɔɔ ní ki sá m-tɔntɔnjuti ni-cee. Bin kíǹee, Kriisitoo nikitiŋ di túnní-bi ní bi-bimbim tìì Kriisitoo tinyool.

english_verse: Treat them in such a way that the churches will see your love and will know why we bragged about you.
translation_verse: Dàkàmaan-bi ni-neendi, Kriisitoo nikitiŋ ń béé ibaamɔn yii ti cáá nsan kí nīn fàal̀ ni-pu.

english_verse: I don't need to write you about the money you plan to give for God's people.
translation_verse: An kaa bàlifī ḿ gíti ŋmà-ni kugbɔŋu kí tùkù-ni ti nín máaǹ kí tūtuǹ Kriisitoo yab bin bí Juudeeyee puee.

english_verse: I know how eager you are to give. And I have proudly told the Lord's followers in Macedonia that you people in Achaia have been ready for a whole year. Now your desire to give has made them want to give.
translation_verse: M nyí ni-landɔkɔmɔntii pu, m tīī-ni disíndi Maseeduwaan yab cee ki tùkū-bi yii doooo jiil ní nimbi nnabiyaamu Akaayi yab bɔ́ntì, ní ni-faŋgiil tīī binib tikpil kunyannyaau.

english_verse: This is why I am sending Titus and the two others to you. I want you to be ready, just as I promised. This will prove we were not wrong to brag about you.
translation_verse: An pu ní m dū nnabiyaamu nee ki túnní ni-cee, án nín làá ŋá pu disíndi din m tīī-nee, bí lafun ká yii ni máaǹ-dèe, kí lafun bɔ́ntí tikɔkɔ kii m nín tùkū-bi yii ní bɔ́ntí puee.

english_verse: Some followers from Macedonia may come with me, and I want them to find that you have the money ready. If you don't, I would be embarrassed for trusting you to do this. But you would be embarrassed even more.
translation_verse: An yaa sá fám, man nì Maseeduwaan yab biba yaa táań ki bāań ní naa láá bɔ́ntì ki dóòyee, ti-mákal din ti cáá ni-puee làá kpántí-ti icoo ní, icoo gbanti làá jī kí kpáaǹ ni mun.

english_verse: So I have decided to ask Titus and the others to spend some time with you before I arrive. This way they can arrange to collect the money you have promised. Then you will have the chance to give because you want to, and not because you feel forced to.
translation_verse: An puee ní m mēē nnabiyaamu nee bí péeǹ timbi kí dāan̄ ni-cee. Ní bɔ́ntí kí ŋá ni-niti tin ni pōoǹ kí ŋée, man dāa bàńee, an bɔ́ntì dee. Míǹ di làá dàkà yii ni tīī nì dipɔbil diba, naa tìì ki yáliŋkí.

english_verse: Remember this saying, “A few seeds make a small harvest, but a lot of seeds make a big harvest.”
translation_verse: Téetímaan yii un yaa búĺ fiiiyee dāa tí cēē fiii ní, ní un búĺ tikpilee mun dāa tí cēē tikpil.

english_verse: Each of you must make up your own mind about how much to give. But don't feel sorry that you must give and don't feel you are forced to give. God loves people who love to give.
translation_verse: An puee báà ŋma ń tīī min u-pɔbil fáatì ú tīīyee, án taa nín̄ sá nì kunimbaauaaa, dipabil bɔti, kun puee Unimbɔti néeń un tìì nì dipɔɔpindee ní.

english_verse: God can bless you with everything you need, and you will always have more than enough to do all kinds of good things for others.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti cáá mpɔn kí tīī-ni tiŋan kɔkɔ nì ti-nyɔkɔm tikpil tikpil, án nín làá ŋá pu ní nīn cáá baabadal tin kɔkɔ ni yaa lèe án lákatí ní nīn cáa tūǹ atummɔnti kɔkɔee.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “God freely gives his gifts to the poor, and always does right.”
translation_verse: A lì kii Unimbɔti gbɔŋku poon nín lī puee yii: «Un ŋáań biwɔfib tinitee, Unimbɔti làá bìin̄ u-boon ní u-niti ń nīn pée bí ki cá.»

english_verse: God gives seed to farmers and provides everyone with food. He will increase what you have, so you can give even more to those in need.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti un tìì ukpaal iwambool, ki tìì tijikaalee, làá tīī-ni iwambool kɔkɔ nì i-nyɔkɔm kí yàntī í lòoǹ, án nín làá ŋá pu ni-niti ń lòoǹ abimɔntee.

english_verse: You will be blessed in every way, and you will be able to keep on being generous. Then many people will thank God when we deliver your gift.
translation_verse: U làá yàntī ní nīn sá bigaajab kí ŋmā kí nīn ŋáań tiniti, án nín làá ŋá pu binib tikpil ń nīn jáaḿ Unimbɔti tin ni ŋáań ki tìì-bi ti cāabìń-bee pu.

english_verse: What you are doing is much more than a service that supplies God's people with what they need. It is something that will make many others thank God.
translation_verse: An kaa sá Kriisitoo yab bin lóò tibee ŋmaniŋma ní ni-tundi din ni tūǹee tútúǹ, ama an yàntī binib tikpil jáaḿ Unimbɔti múlmul.

english_verse: The way in which you have proved yourselves by this service will bring honor and praise to God. You believed the message about Christ, and you obeyed it by sharing generously with God's people and with everyone else.
translation_verse: Ni-tundi din ni tūǹee di dàkà binib bin ní ni sée, ní ki yàntī binib nyɔ́ŋkí Unimbɔti ni nín tɔ́ Kriisitoo Bɔmɔntiiti puee, ní ki nyɔ́ŋkí Unimbɔti ni-niti tin ni ŋáań ki tìì bíǹ nì bin kɔkɔ kaa cááyee.

english_verse: Now they are praying for you and want to see you, because God used you to bless them so very much.
translation_verse: Bi làá mèè ni-pu ní ki dàkà-ni dineeŋkpaandi, kun puee Unimbɔti ŋá-ni tiŋaŋkpaandi.

english_verse: Thank God for his gift that is too wonderful for words!
translation_verse: Tí jāam̀maan Unimbɔti u-pɔ̄tam nín kaa cáá jutee pu!

english_verse: Do you think I am a coward when I am with you and brave when I am far away? Well, I ask you to listen, because Christ himself was humble and gentle.
translation_verse: Man Pɔɔl m-ba, m dū Kriisitoo basintil nì u-niti ki sáŋkí-ni, man un ni lì yii m yaa bí ni-cee m-nyɔkɔ pɔ̀fì, ama ní m yaa bíń ndan, m sòoǹ nì anyɔɔbun ŋin pɔ̄ɔ̄yee.

english_verse: Some people have said we act like the people of this world. So when I arrive, I expect I will have to be firm and forceful in what I say to them. Please don't make me treat you that way.
translation_verse: Tin m mèé-nee di sá, m yaa láa bāań ni-ceeyee, ní taa láa yàntī ḿ tāā kí bīikì ni-kansikin biba pu, kun puee m nyí yii m yaa láa bāań, see ḿ dāá tāā kí bīikì bin lì yii ti-bimbim nì ti-bɔti tin ti dàkèe sá nniyaaminee pu.

english_verse: We live in this world, but we don't act like its people
translation_verse: Tiŋman ti lafun sá binib, ama dikɔ̀ndi din poon ti bí nee, taa jáà nniyaamin.

english_verse: or fight our battles with the weapons of this world. Instead, we use God's power that can destroy fortresses. We destroy arguments
translation_verse: Di sá tijanjawan tin ti cáa jáàyee kaa sá binib nín mɔ́ɔ̀ tiŋyee. Ama an sá mpɔn ŋun nyánní Unimbɔti ceeyee ní, ní ki bíiĺ ipɔn in pu binib mákée. Ní ti cáa kpìtī bi-nyimɔmbɔti,

english_verse: and every bit of pride that keeps anyone from knowing God. We capture people's thoughts and make them obey Christ.
translation_verse: nì alambil ŋin kɔkɔ bi cáá kaa là kí béé Unimbɔtee. An ní ti cáa cútí binib landɔkɔi ki gīintiń-bi bí nīn tɔ́ Kriisitoo.

english_verse: And when you completely obey him, we will punish anyone who refuses to obey.
translation_verse: Ti bɔ́ntì ki cí ŋyunti ŋun nimbi yaa láa dū ni-ba kɔkɔ ki tīī Unimbɔtee ní tí dāá dáaĺ bin bin kaa tɔ́ Unimbɔtee tafal.

english_verse: You judge by appearances. If any of you think you are the only ones who belong to Christ, then think again. We belong to Christ as much as you do.
translation_verse: Ní nīn kpèémaan tiwan ti-pú. Un yaa nyí u-ba pu yii u sá Kriisitoo yɔuee, ú béé tiŋan yii ti mun sá míǹ ní.

english_verse: Maybe I brag a little too much about the authority that the Lord gave me to help you and not to hurt you. Yet I am not embarrassed to brag.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan tīī-ti mpɔn tí dūú tūtuǹ-ni nnimbɔtisan poon, an kaa sá kí ŋá-ni tikpitil. An pu ní m sòoǹ kí gúntí m-ba, ní an kaa cáá-mi icoo!

english_verse: And I am not trying to scare you with my letters.
translation_verse: Kaa sá m nyàab̀ kí nīn ŋmà tigbɔn ki fàantí-ni.

english_verse: Some of you are saying, “Paul's letters are harsh and powerful. But in person, he is a weakling and has nothing worth saying.”
translation_verse: Di sá yii binib lì yii: «Pɔɔl gbɔnti tin u ŋmèe poonee, u sòoǹ ní an pɔ̄ɔ̄ kpaŋkpam, ama ní u yaa bí ti-kansikin ki sòoǹee ní u sá uwɔfi ní u-nyɔkɔ pɔ̀fì.

english_verse: Those people had better understand that when I am with you, I will do exactly what I say in my letters.
translation_verse: Bin bin dàkafī an landɔkɔŋuee ń béé yii ti nín yaa bí ndan ti sòoǹ ti-gbɔŋku poon an pɔ̄ɔ̄ miŋyee, míǹ ní ti yaa pée tí bí ni-nimbiinee, ti làá tí sòoǹ.

english_verse: We won't dare compare ourselves with those who think so much of themselves. But they are foolish to compare themselves with themselves.
translation_verse: Taa là kí dū ti-ba kí ŋmàntīǹ kii biba nín pàkà bi-ba min ki cáǹ bi-ba ki ŋmàntīǹ min bi lèe, an sá digbaandi ní.

english_verse: We won't brag about something we don't have a right to brag about. We will only brag about the work God has sent us to do, and you are part of that work.
translation_verse: Timbi kaa cáǹ ti-ba laakin taa bàn̄ee. Unimbɔti nín yóoǹ tí tɔ̄ kí gbèen̄ nimbi nyɔkɔmee di sá ti túń ki bàn̄ ni-cee nee.

english_verse: We are not bragging more than we should. After all, we did bring the message about Christ to you.
translation_verse: Timbi kaa lákatí laakin an sá tí sòoǹ kí gbèen̄ee pu. Míǹ ní taa tí ŋūǹ kí gbèen̄ nsanni kí taa bàń-ni. Míǹ pu ní ti péé ki dɔ́miń ni-cee ki sòon̄ nì ni Kriisitoo Bɔmɔntiiti.

english_verse: We don't brag about what others have done, as if we had done those things ourselves. But I hope as you become stronger in your faith, we will be able to reach many more of the people around you. That has always been our goal.
translation_verse: An puee taa lákatí ti-gbeennyɔkɔm pu, taa tí pàkà ti-ba biba tuuŋŋi pu. Ama ti-mákal di sá yii ni-fookiiu yaa bíi wīintée, ti nín túń ditundi ni-cee ki gbēeǹ laakiŋyee, an nìkī kí cù nyɔkɔpu tikpil, ama kí taa nín lákatí ti-kpaanyɔkɔ.

english_verse: Then we will be able to preach the good news in other lands where we cannot take credit for work someone else has already done.
translation_verse: Boonee ní ti dāa ŋūǹ kí cáá Tibɔmɔntiilee kí cùnnì ntimu mun bí ni-nyɔkɔpu ubɔ kaa láá cūtèe, kí taa nín̄ fòol̄ atuun ŋin biba túń laan sá bí tɔ̄ee nyooti ki gà ti-biŋŋi.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “If you want to brag, then brag about the Lord.”
translation_verse: An ŋmàn̄ Unimbɔti gbɔŋku poon yii: «Un pàkèe ń pàkà ti-Dindaan.»

english_verse: You may brag about yourself, but the only approval that counts is the Lord's approval.
translation_verse: An kaa sá a yaa bí ki pàkà a-bee di dàkà yii a lafun máaǹ kupampakau, see sii un Unimbɔti pàkèe.

english_verse: Please put up with a little of my foolishness.
translation_verse: M yaa gbíntì ki sòoǹ kii uwaatee, ní jīmaan m-pu kimɔtii, ní lafun jīmaan m-pu kimɔtii!

english_verse: I am as concerned about you as God is. You were like a virgin bride I had chosen only for Christ.
translation_verse: M néeń-ni kaa mɔ̄ ni-pu, ní dineendi gbanti nyánní unimbɔti cee. Di sá yii m bɔ́ntì-ni kí dū-ni kí tīī uninjabaanti ní: úǹ di sá Kriisitoo. Tiŋman, úǹ ní m làá dū-ni kí tīī kii usapɔɔn un kaa nyí uninjee.

english_verse: But now I fear that you will be tricked, just as Eve was tricked by that lying snake. I am afraid that you might stop thinking about Christ in an honest and sincere way.
translation_verse: Ama kii ukoobu nín nìn kíil̀ Awa puee, míǹ ní m fàŋkí ubɔ ń taa láa dāá cúú ni-landɔkɔi kí lábití kí yàntī ní fá Kriisitoo un ni nóó ibaamɔn nì dipɔbil dibee.

english_verse: We told you about Jesus, and you received the Holy Spirit and accepted our message. But you let some people tell you about another Jesus. Now you are ready to receive another spirit and accept a different message.
translation_verse: Kun puee ni jīǹ kimɔtii ki fòol̄ bin dòoń ki sòoǹ nì ni Yeesu ubɔ pu, kaa sá un timbi sòon̄ nì ni nee ní. Míǹ mbaantiim ní ni fòol̄ ŋfam miba min kaa sá Unimbɔti yam min ni fōōyee, ní ki tí fòol̄ tibɔcan tiba mun ki kíikí.

english_verse: I think I am as good as any of those super apostles.
translation_verse: M pàkā yii bíǹ bin ni yíì akpambamɔntee kaa jítiǹ-mi.

english_verse: I may not speak as well as they do, but I know as much. And this has already been made perfectly clear to you.
translation_verse: Nì min kɔkɔ ní maa ŋūǹ kí sòoǹee, m nyí Unimbɔti bɔti. Ti dàkā-ni míǹ ŋfunyɔm kupaau nimbi ni-ba ká míǹ.

english_verse: Was it wrong for me to lower myself and honor you by preaching God's message free of charge?
translation_verse: Mimmee, m nín cáań Unimbɔti bɔti ki sòon̄ ni-cee faalaa ki sīntì m-ba taapu nimbi ń yīkì yilpuee, m yīntàaa?

english_verse: I robbed other churches by taking money from them to serve you.
translation_verse: M nín dɔ́miń ni-cee ki sòon̄ Unimbɔti bɔtee, Kriisitoo nikitiŋ aba di nìn yì m-paati. M nìn fúkuĺ bíǹ ní ki cáa tútúǹ nimbi.

english_verse: Even when I was in need, I still didn't bother you. In fact, some of the Lord's followers from Macedonia brought me what I needed. I have not been a burden to you in the past, and I will never be a burden.
translation_verse: M nín nìn bí ni-ceeyee, maa nìn báká ubɔ pu. Animbil nín nìn lóò-mee, nnabiyaamu mun nìn nyánní Maseeduwaanee di nìn cáań-mi tin kɔkɔ nìn lóò-mee. M kpēē m-ba kaa nìn báká ubɔ pu báà tiba poon, ní ki làá nīn pée gbíntìi kpèé m-ba míǹ kí nīn cá.

english_verse: As surely as I speak the truth about Christ, no one in Achaia can stop me from bragging about this.
translation_verse: M sòoǹ nì ni Kriisitoo baamɔŋyi in bí m-nee ní yii: Akaayi tiŋki kɔkɔ poon ubɔ kpá kí lēē an nyandee m-pu.

english_verse: And it isn't because I don't love you. God himself knows how much I do love you.
translation_verse: Maa néeń-ni naaa, ba pu ní m lī míǹ? Unimbɔti nyí m nín néeń-nee.

english_verse: I plan to go on doing just what I have always done. Then those people won't be able to brag about doing the same things we are doing.
translation_verse: Min m ŋáań nee, m làá nīn pée gbíntìi ŋáań míǹ ní, kí kpìtī biŋmatinliibi bin mun là kí nīn pàkà bi-ba ki lì yii bi sá akpambal kii timbee dàkatam.

english_verse: Anyway, they are no more than false apostles and dishonest workers. They only pretend to be apostles of Christ.
translation_verse: Binib gbantee kaa sá akpambal. Bi mɔ́ntí yii bi tūǹ Unimbɔti tundi ní ki gīintí bi-ba Kriisitoo kpambaliŋ yam.

english_verse: And it is no wonder. Even Satan tries to make himself look like an angel of light.
translation_verse: Tinee kaa sá maamaaci bɔti, kun puee Sitaan u-ba ŋūǹ kí kpántí ŋwalifi tuuŋŋu.

english_verse: So why does it seem strange for Satan's servants to pretend to do what is right? Someday they will get exactly what they deserve. Paul's Sufferings for Christ
translation_verse: An puee an kaa sá atulim bɔti yii u-tɔntɔnliibi mun ŋūǹ kí gíiǹ bi-ba kii bitɔntɔnliibi bin bí deedeeyee. Unimbɔti làá dáaĺ bi-tafal bi-tuuŋŋi nín sá miŋyee ní. Pɔɔl nín jíń falaa uŋyee

english_verse: I don't want any of you to think I am a fool. But if you do, then let me be a fool and brag a little.
translation_verse: M gíti bùsī ki tùkù-ni yii ní taa dàkafì yii m sá uwaati. Ni yaa tí dàkafī mimmaaa, ní jī m-pu kimɔtii an pu, kí yàntī ma mun ḿ pàkà m-ba fiii.

english_verse: Yet if others want to brag about what they have done, so will I.
translation_verse: Binib bí ki pàkà bi-ba duulinyan doo wanti pu, an pu ní ma mun bíi pàkà m-ba.

english_verse: And since you are so smart, you will gladly put up with a fool.
translation_verse: Nimbi di bí yii ni cáá iciin, ama ní ki jīǹ kimɔtii biwaatiibi pu an mɔ̄ǹ-ni.

english_verse: In fact, you let people make slaves of you and cheat you and steal from you. Why, you even let them strut around and slap you in the face.
translation_verse: Bi cáá-ni ki sàantí kii iyumbuee, ki jīǹ ni-pu, ki kíiĺ-ni, ki kpèé-ni fám, ki fátí-ni itampa, ní ni jīǹ bi-pu kimɔtii.

english_verse: I am ashamed to say we are too weak to behave in such a way. If they can brag, so can I, but it is a foolish thing to do.
translation_verse: An sá-ti icoo ní yii timbi kaa cáá mpɔn kí ŋmā kí ŋá-ni míǹ. Ubɔ yaa ŋūǹ kí pàkà u-ba tiba puee, ma mun ŋūǹ kí pàkà m-ba. M bíi sòoǹ ŋwaatiyaamin dee.

english_verse: Are they Hebrews? So am I. Are they Jews? So am I. Are they from the family of Abraham? Well, so am I.
translation_verse: Di sá an nibee yaa dàkà bi-ba yii bi sá Eebru yabaaa, ma mun sá ueebruja ní, bi yaa bí yii bi sá Isirayeel yabaaa, ma mun sá Uisirayeelja ní. Bi yaa bí yii bi sá Abraam naantiibaaa, ma mun sá Abraam naantiiu ní.

english_verse: Are they servants of Christ? I am a fool to talk this way, but I serve him better than they do. I have worked harder and have been put in jail more times. I have been beaten with whips more and have been in danger of death more often.
translation_verse: Bi yaa bí yii bi sá Kriisitoo tɔntɔnliibaaa, man di nín sá ki jítiǹ-bi, m bíi sòoǹ ŋwaatiyaamin dee. M túń ditundi ki jítiǹ-bi. Bi pìintí-mi kudii múlmul ki jítiǹ-bi. Bi gbáń-mi ki jítiǹ-bi, m jēetí nnaabu ŋun sá ŋkúmee ni múlmul ki jítiǹ-bi.

english_verse: Five times my own people gave me
translation_verse: Juuda yab gbáń-mi anaalab diba kpá imuŋku ili ŋfunyɔm miŋmoo pu.

english_verse: Three times the Romans beat me with a big stick, and once my enemies stoned me. I have been shipwrecked three times, and I even had to spend a night and a day in the sea.
translation_verse: Room yab gbáń-mi ndɔ ŋfunyɔm mita pu, bi yáŋkì-mi ataŋkpee kí bàà kpɔ̀-mi diba pu, ŋfunyɔm mita pu ní iŋaliŋfi múĺ nnyimin nnyim bàà làá yòon̄-mi, ki gbíntì dalba nnyimin ŋwiimpu nì kunyeeu.

english_verse: During my many travels, I have been in danger from rivers, robbers, my own people, and foreigners. My life has been in danger in cities, in deserts, at sea, and with people who only pretended to be the Lord's followers.
translation_verse: M-saŋkiŋŋi ŋin m cōom̀ tikpilee poonee, m kántì dinimbinaamandi inyiŋgbeenni, ki kántì dinimbinaamandi digaŋgam dambi cee, ki kántì dinimbinaamandi m-jutiibi Juuda yab nì bin kaa sá Juuda yabee cee, ki kántì dinimbinaamandi ntimu poon nì kuteeun. M kántì dinimbinaamandi tiŋku pu, nì bin mɔ́ntí yii bi sá Kriisitoo yabee cee.

english_verse: I have worked and struggled and spent many sleepless nights. I have gone hungry and thirsty and often had nothing to eat. I have been cold from not having enough clothes to keep me warm.
translation_verse: M túń atuun ki gīī, ki ká dinimbinaamandi ki jíń falaa, kaa gèeǹ. Ŋkùm nì nnyinnyoo cúú-mi, m gbíntí ŋkùm múlmul, tiwool cútí-mi tiwampeeŋkaal kpá ḿ pèen̄.

english_verse: Besides everything else, each day I am burdened down, worrying about all the churches.
translation_verse: Falaabi tikpil kíǹ maa lī. Baabadalee Kriisitoo nikitiŋ kɔkɔ bɔti sá-mi diwaŋgul ní ki nyìm̀ m-pu.

english_verse: When others are weak, I am weak too. When others are tricked into sin, I get angry.
translation_verse: Un kaa pɔ̄ɔ̄yee puee, see ma mun ń nīn bí kii úŋ̀wuee kí taa nīn pɔ̄ɔ̄. Ubɔ yaa lítì ikpitinee, man ní an wù pɔ̀lpɔl.

english_verse: If I have to brag, I will brag about how weak I am.
translation_verse: An yaa sá ḿ pàkà m-bee, m-wɔfii pu ní m bàà pàkà m-ba.

english_verse: God, the Father of our Lord Jesus, knows I am not lying. And God is to be praised forever!
translation_verse: Unimbɔti ti-Dindaan Yeesu Baa yindi ń ká inyɔŋki kí nīn pée cá, di sá u nyí yii tin m sòoǹ nee maa mɔ́ntí.

english_verse: The governor of Damascus at the time of King Aretas had the city gates guarded, so he could capture me.
translation_verse: M nín nìn bí Damaasi tiŋkinee, gɔmina un nìn bí ubɔti Areetaasi tundinee nìn yāntì u-soojab yúl̀ kitiŋ gundi punyɔmmu caŋin kí bàà cúú-mi,

english_verse: But I escaped by being let down in a basket through a window in the city wall.
translation_verse: ní m-bɔɔbi dū-mi ki ŋá kukabikun ki dūu nāatì nì ŋŋmii digundi tɔkɔlau pu, ní m ŋmátì.

english_verse: I have to brag. There is nothing to be gained by it, but I must brag about the visions and other things that the Lord has shown me.
translation_verse: Míǹ puee ḿ nīn lámintáa! An kaa tútúǹ-ni. M làá tùkù-ni tin ti-Dindaan lēē ki dàkā-mi ki yāntì m béèyee.

english_verse: I know about one of Christ's followers who was taken up into the third heaven
translation_verse: M nyí kijapaai kiba, u nóó Kriisitoo. An nìn yōoǹ-u ki cáa jɔ́m̀ kutagbɔŋu yilpu yilpu fɔ́ŋŋŋ Unimbɔti cee dibindi diba kpá saalku sèé.

english_verse: I am planning to visit you for the third time. But I still won't make a burden of myself. What I really want is you, and not what you have. Children are not supposed to save up for their parents, but parents are supposed to take care of their children.
translation_verse: M tí bɔ́ntì kí dāan̄ ni-cee ntataatiim. Nimbi di kaa làá nīn yì m-jītam, di sá yii nimbi ní m là, kaa sá ni-nimbiliŋ. Kun puee an kaa sá mbiyaamu di kpīintí bibaatiibi, ama bibaatiibi di kpīintí mbiyaamu.

english_verse: As I said, only God really knows if this man was in his body at the time.
translation_verse: Tiŋman m nyí yii kijapaayee nìn jɔ́m̀ áli Unimbɔti Beelin.

english_verse: But he was taken up into paradise, where he heard things too wonderful to tell.
translation_verse: Niin ní u gbìl̄ tibɔti tin unil kaa ŋūǹ kí fàtīí gíiǹ-tì kí lèe, kaa máaǹ kí dū-tì kí tùkù ubɔ muee.

english_verse: I will brag about that man, but not about myself, except to say how weak I am.
translation_verse: An japaakee pu ní m máaǹ kí nīn lámintí, kaa sá man m-ba pu. M yaa làá tí lāmintàaa, see m-wɔfii pu.

english_verse: Yet even if I did brag, I would not be foolish. I would simply be speaking the truth. But I will try not to say too much. That way, none of you will think more highly of me than you should because of what you have seen me do and say.
translation_verse: M yaa bàà là kí pàkà m-bee, maa bàà sámaan uwaati, m bàà sòoǹ ibaamɔn ní. Ama maa là kí pàkà m-ba, kun puee maa là binib ń dàkafì m-pu ŋkpaamin bi nín wāĺ m ŋáań tiŋyee nì tin bi gbìl̄ m sòoǹee pu.

english_verse: Of course, I am now referring to the wonderful things I saw. One of Satan's angels was sent to make me suffer terribly, so that I would not feel too proud.
translation_verse: Kí wàatī ḿ taa dū tin Unimbɔti yāntì m béè an kaa bí dimaafilee kí ŋá dilambilee, ní u dū iween iba ní ki ŋá m-wunti pu. Iweenee sá kii Sitaan tuuŋŋuee ní ki gbáà-mi, án nín làá ŋá pu ḿ taa nín̄ cáá dilambilee.

english_verse: Three times I begged the Lord to make this suffering go away.
translation_verse: Ŋfunyɔm mita ní m mēē ti-Dindaan iween gbanti pu, yii ú lēē-i m-pu.

english_verse: But he replied, “My gift of undeserved grace is all you need. My power is strongest when you are weak.” So if Christ keeps giving me his power, I will gladly brag about how weak I am.
translation_verse: Ní u kíí-mi yii: «M-ŋanti tin m ŋáań-see ŋmāntì-si, kun puee sii wɔfii pu ní man dì ki dàkà m-pɔŋŋu.» Míǹ puee an mɔ̄ǹ-mi ḿ nīn pàkà m-ba m-wɔfii pu, án nín làá ŋá pu Kriisitoo pɔŋŋu ń nīn tūǹ m-pu ditundee.

english_verse: Yes, I am glad to be weak or insulted or mistreated or to have troubles and sufferings, if it is for Christ. Because when I am weak, I am strong. Paul's Concern for the Lord's Followers at Corinth
translation_verse: An pu ní m-wɔfii bɔti mɔ̄ǹ-mi. Bi nín sìí-mi puee, nì falaa un m jīǹee, nì bi nín páb̀-mi puee, nì dinimbinaamandi din m kāntée, Kriisitoo pu ní tíǹ kɔkɔ bàń m-pu míǹ, kun puee iwɔfi yaa kɔ́-mee, míǹ ní m kāntí mpɔn. Pɔɔl bíi yáliŋkí Kɔranti yab pu

english_verse: I have been making a fool of myself. But you forced me to do it, when you should have been speaking up for me. I may be nothing at all, but I am as good as those super apostles.
translation_verse: M yaa bíi sòoǹ kii uwaatee, nimbi di yāntì m sòoǹ míǹ, di sá yii nimbi di bàà máaǹ kí sòoǹ kí mɔ̄tì m-pu. Báà m yaa kaa bí tibanaaa, ni-kpambamɔntiŋee kaa jítiǹ-mi tiba nì tiba poon.

english_verse: When I was with you, I was patient and worked all the powerful miracles and signs and wonders of a true apostle.
translation_verse: Maamaacib nì tidaandi tin Unimbɔti pɔŋŋu yāntì m ŋá nì kimɔtii tikɔkɔ poon ni-ceeyee dàkà yii m sá Yeesu kpambal.

english_verse: You missed out on only one blessing the other churches received. That is, you didn't have to support me. Forgive me for doing you wrong.
translation_verse: Ba ní m ŋá ki tīī Kriisitoo nikitiŋ ŋin kíǹee ní kaa ŋá ki tīī nimbi. Tin baba maa yāntì ní ŋá kí tīī-mee di sá ni nín kaa kpíiǹ-mee, an puee ní dū m-yìntitam kí pɔ̄-mi!

english_verse: So I will gladly give all I have and all I am. Will you love me less for loving you too much?
translation_verse: Mamee, an mɔ̄ǹ-mi ḿ dū tin kɔkɔ m cááyee kí kúntí ni-pu kí kpáaǹ m-ba kí tūtuǹ-ni. Man yaa néeń nimbi míǹ tikpilee, nimbi kaa làá nīn néeń-maaa?

english_verse: You agree that I wasn't a burden to you. Maybe that's because I was trying to catch you off guard and trick you.
translation_verse: Nimbi ni-ba, ni làá ká yii maa sá digìńdi ki tīī-ni, ama biba lì yii an sá nciin ní m ŋá kí ŋmàtiǹ-ni kí jī.

english_verse: Were you cheated by any of those I sent to you?
translation_verse: M dī bin m túnní ni-ceeyee ubɔ pu ki jíń-ni tibaaa?

english_verse: I urged Titus to visit you, and I sent another follower with him. But Titus didn't cheat you, and we felt and behaved the same way he did.
translation_verse: Man nín dū Tiiti nì kinabiki kiba ki tú bí cù ni-ceeyee, bi jíń ni-wanti tibaaa? Man nì Tiiti landɔkɔŋu sá mbaanti ní, ní ti-ŋáaǹtam mun mbaantiim.

english_verse: Have you been thinking all along that we have been defending ourselves to you? Actually, we have been speaking to God as followers of Christ. But, my friends, we did it all for your good.
translation_verse: An yaa yíì ni pée kíĺ ki dàkafī dooooyee yii ti là ní nīn yíì-ti binimɔntiibee pu ní m sòoǹ míǹ? Aayee, kaa sá míǹ. Ti sòoǹ min Kriisitoo lèe ní Unimbɔti nimbiin. Nnabineeŋkaamu, tin kɔkɔ ti sòoǹ nì nee, an sá kí tūtuǹ-ni ní cù nyɔkɔpu nnimbɔtisan poon ní.

english_verse: I am afraid when I come, we won't be pleased with each other. I fear that some of you may be arguing or jealous or angry or selfish or gossiping or insulting each other. I even fear that you may be proud and acting like a mob.
translation_verse: M fàŋkí yii ḿ taa láa bàń ni-cee kí ká-ni min poon maa bàà lèe, ni mun ń ká man min poon naa bàà lèe. Maa là kí bàń kí ká-ni kujaau nì kináŋ nì diŋuul nì timɔn nì asiibil poon. Maa tí là kí bàń kí ká ni sòoǹ fám fám nì dilambil ki bí fìkil fikil poon.

english_verse: I am afraid God will make me ashamed when I visit you again. I will feel like crying because many of you have never given up your old sins. You are still doing things that are immoral, indecent, and shameful.
translation_verse: M fàŋkí yii m-dāantam ni-ceeyee, m-Nimbɔtiu ń taa sìntīǹ-mi taapu ni-cee ḿ sɔ̄ bin nìn ŋá ikpiti ki gbíntì ki ŋúb́ bi-bimbikpitim, tijɔkɔndi nì tilaakpaalee pu.

english_verse: I am on my way to visit you for the third time. And as the Scriptures say, “Any charges must be proved true by at least two or three witnesses.”
translation_verse: Ntataatiim ní m dòoń ni-cee nee. An ŋmàn̄ Unimbɔti gbɔŋku poon yii: «Binib bili kii bita seerau di cáá mbaamɔn.»

english_verse: During my second visit I warned you that I would punish you and anyone else who doesn't stop sinning. I am far away from you now, but I give you the same warning.
translation_verse: M cáá tibɔti kí kpāafì bin bin nìn ŋá ikpitee nì bin kɔkɔ kíǹee. M nín nìn dɔ́miń ni-cee nliliitiimee, m nìn lī-tì ní ki gíti bíi bùsī ki lì díǹ m-kpátam ni-cee. M nín làá dāan̄ min nee, m làá ŋá an nín máaǹ puee ní, maa làá kpèè ubɔ nimbiin.

english_verse: This should prove to you that I am speaking for Christ. When he corrects you, he won't be weak. He will be powerful!
translation_verse: Kii ni nín là kí ká kudaaŋŋu yii Kriisitoo di dì m-pu ki sòoǹee, ni làá lafun ká. Kriisitoo dàkà u-pɔŋŋu ni-kansikin, ama waa sá kiwɔfii.

english_verse: Although he was weak when he was nailed to the cross, he now lives by the power of God. We are weak, just as Christ was. But you will see that we will live by the power of God, just as Christ does.
translation_verse: Tiŋman, u dū u-ba ki ŋá kii uwɔfee ní bi kpáá-u ndɔpuntikaa pu, ama Unimbɔti pɔŋŋu yāntì u bí dimaŋfalin. Ti nì u nín ŋá ubaantee puee, ti mun bí iwɔfin ní, ama u-puee ti cáá dimaŋfal. Nì Unimbɔti pɔŋŋu puee ti bí dimaŋfalin ki tīī-ni.

english_verse: Test yourselves and find out if you really are true to your faith. If you pass the test, you will discover that Christ is living in you. But if Christ isn't living in you, you have failed.
translation_verse: Ní cɔ̄ŋkìmaan ni-ba kí kpèè ni yaa lafun fōō Yeesu Kriisitoo ki kíí tiŋman. Ní kpèè ni-ban tiŋan, naa ká yii u bí ni-naaa? U bí ni-ni, asee ni nín cɔ́ŋkì ki kpēēyee, ni yaa ká yii naa fōō-u ki kíí baba.

english_verse: We pray you will stop doing evil things. We don't pray like this to make ourselves look good, but to get you to do right, even if we are failures.
translation_verse: Ti mèé Unimbɔti ni-pu ní taa ŋá ikpiti iba. An kaa sá kí dàkà ti-ba yii ti túń ditummɔntiil, ama ti là ní nīn ŋáań tiŋan báà bi yaa bíi sòoǹ ki bíiĺ timbi.

english_verse: All we can do is to follow the truth and not fight against it.
translation_verse: Kun puee taa cáá mpɔn kí dūú já nì ibaamɔn, ti cáá mpɔn kí dūú tūtuǹ ibaamɔn ní.

english_verse: Even though we are weak, we are glad that you are strong, and we pray you will do even better.
translation_verse: An mɔ̄ǹ-ti ŋyunti kamaa timbi yaa bí iwɔfin, nimbi ń nīn pɔ̄ɔ̄yee pu. Ti mèé Unimbɔti ni-pu yii ní nīn sá binimbɔtinooliibi tiŋman pu yab.

english_verse: I am writing these things to you before I arrive. This way I won't have to be hard on you when I use the authority the Lord has given me. I was given this authority, so I could help you and not destroy you.
translation_verse: Kun pu m bí ndan ki ŋmà-nee di sá maa là ḿ dāá bàń ni-cee kí dū mpɔn ŋun ti-Dindaan tīī-mee kí wɔ́b́-ni. Mpɔn gbantee sá ḿ dūú tūtuǹ-ni ni-nimbɔtinóotam ń cù nyɔkɔpu ní, an kaa sá kí dūú nàan̄-ni.

english_verse: Goodbye, my friends. Do better and pay attention to what I have said. Try to get along and live peacefully with each other. Now I pray that God, who gives love and peace, will be with you.
translation_verse: Nnabiyaamu, tin m làá dū kí kàan̄ nee sèé: ní nīn cáámaan dipɔɔpindi, ni-nimbɔtinóotam ń nīn sá tiŋman pu yal kí nīn tìì tɔb kunyannyaau, kí nīn pēē kinyɔkɔ nì ŋgbansɔŋfi poon. Unimbɔti un sá dineendi nì ŋgbansɔŋfi daanee làá nīn bí ni-cee.

english_verse: Give each other a warm greeting. All God's people send their greetings.
translation_verse: Ní jāam̀maan tɔb kí kpàl̄ tɔb nnabiyaamin. Unimbɔti nikitil din bí dooyee jáaḿ-ni.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord Jesus Christ will bless you and be kind to you! May God bless you with his love, and may the Holy Spirit join all your hearts together.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan Yeesu Kriisitoo ŋanti nì Unimbɔti neendi nì u-Fam nín cāabìń nnyɔɔpee ŋuŋyee ń nīn bí ni-kɔkɔ cee.

english_verse: I pray that God the Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!
translation_verse: Ti-Baa Unimbɔti nì ti-Dindaan Yeesu Kriisitoo ń ŋá-ni tiŋan kí tīī-ni ŋgbansɔŋfi.

english_verse: Christ obeyed God our Father and gave himself as a sacrifice for our sins to rescue us from this evil world.
translation_verse: Yeesu di dū u-ba ki ŋá saraa ti-kpitii pu kí ŋmā kí nyāntí-ti ŋyuntikpiti ŋun poon ti bí nee. Míǹ ní Unimbɔti un sá ti-Baayee là.

english_verse: God will be given glory forever and ever. Amen. The Only True Message
translation_verse: Úǹ di máaǹ tinyool kí nīn pée cá jaanjaan! Ameeni. Yeesu bɔti baba di sá Tibɔmɔntiil

english_verse: I am shocked that you have so quickly turned from God, who chose you with his gift of undeserved grace. You have believed another message,
translation_verse: M bākatì tikpil yii ni pūtì kpáàa bíi féeń Unimbɔti un dī Kriisitoo ŋanti pu ki yíiń-nee, ki póotí tibɔpɔn tiba.

english_verse: when there is really only one true message. But some people are causing you trouble and want to make you turn away from the good news about Christ.
translation_verse: Ama Tibɔmɔntiil tiba kaa ti bí ki kútì Yeesu Bɔmɔntiiti pu. An sá binib biba di là kí lábití ni-landɔkɔi kí cúú Kriisitoo Bɔmɔntiiti kí kpántí.

english_verse: I pray that God will punish anyone who preaches anything different from our message to you! It doesn't matter if that person is one of us or an angel from heaven.
translation_verse: Un di yaa tí dɔ́mińee, - báà an yaa sá timbaaa, an yaa tí sá Unimbɔti tuuŋŋu di yaa nyánní yilpu - ki cáań-ni tibɔpɔn tin nyáń ti-ba nì Tibɔmɔntiil tin ti nìn péé péé ki sòon̄ nì nee, Unimbɔti ń ŋá udaan fám.

english_verse: I have said it before, and I will say it again. I hope God will punish anyone who preaches anything different from what you have already believed.
translation_verse: Ti pée tùkū-ni dooooyee, ní m gíti bíi bùsī-ni díǹ, yii ubɔ yaa sòon̄ nì ni tibɔti tin nyáń ti-ba nì tin tin ni nìn fōōyee, Unimbɔti ń ŋá udaan fám!

english_verse: I am not trying to please people. I want to please God. Do you think I am trying to please people? If I were doing that, I would not be a servant of Christ. How Paul Became an Apostle
translation_verse: Tin m sòoǹ nee, m là binib ń pàkà-mi níii? Unimbɔti pampakaku ní m nyàab̀. M nyàab̀ kí fáatíǹ binib níii? M yaan nyàab̀ kí fáatíǹ binibee, maa bàà sámaan Kriisitoo tɔntɔnliu. Min ní Pɔɔl kpántì Yeesu kpambalee

english_verse: My friends, I want you to know that no one made up the message I preach.
translation_verse: Nnabiyaamu, m là ní béé yii Tibɔmɔntiil tin m sòon̄ nì nee, an kaa sá unil di náań-tì,

english_verse: It wasn't given or taught to me by some mere human. My message came directly from Jesus Christ when he appeared to me.
translation_verse: kaa sá m ká-tì unil ubɔ cee, ubɔ mun kaa tí dàkā-mi-tì. An sá Yeesu Kriisitoo di nyántì-tì ki dàkā-mi.

english_verse: You know how I used to live as a Jew. I was cruel to God's church and even tried to destroy it.
translation_verse: Di sá yii ni gbìl̄ m nín nìn ŋáań min dooooyee. M nín nìn ŋúb́ Juuda yab marabee, m nìn sàantí Unimbɔti nikitil an gíti lákatì, ki nyàab̀ kí kúntí-dì.

english_verse: I was a much better Jew than anyone else my own age, and I obeyed every law our ancestors had given us.
translation_verse: M nìn ŋúb́ Juuda yab marab ki jítiǹ m-jutiibi tikpil man nì bin ŋmèe, ní ki nìn néeń m-naanjab koobiliŋ ki jítiǹ-bi.

english_verse: to show me his Son, so I would announce his message to the Gentiles. I didn't talk this over with anyone.
translation_verse: Ŋyunti ŋun u lēēyee ní u dū u-Jipɔɔn ki dàkā-mi m béè-u, án nín làá ŋá pu ḿ sòoǹ u-Jipɔɔnee pu kí tīī bin kaa sá Juuda yabee. Niinee, maa bālifì báà ubɔ isaŋki.

english_verse: I didn't say a word, not even to the men in Jerusalem who were apostles before I was. Instead, I went at once to Arabia, and afterwards I returned to Damascus.
translation_verse: Maa tí búntì Jeerusaleem kí cùú nyàab̀ bin péeǹ-mi ki kpántì akpambalee. M pée búntì Bilaalibub tiŋkin dicilpu ní. Boonee ní m dāa fātìi gítìń Damaasi tiŋkin.

english_verse: Three years later I went to visit Peter in Jerusalem and stayed with him for
translation_verse: Abin ata boonee ní m nín jɔ́m̀ Jeerusaleem kí béé Peetroo, ní ki kāl̀ u-cee iwiin saalku.

english_verse: The only other apostle I saw was James, the Lord's brother.
translation_verse: Maa ti ká Yeesu kpambal diba ki kútì see Yakubu, ti-Dindaan naal.

english_verse: And in the presence of God I swear I am telling the truth.
translation_verse: Tin tin m ŋmàn̄-nee, m ŋmàn̄-tì Unimbɔti nimbiin ní, maa mɔ́ntí.

english_verse: Later, I went to the regions of Syria and Cilicia.
translation_verse: Boonee ní m búntì Siirii nì Siilisii timmun.

english_verse: But no one who belonged to Christ's churches in Judea had ever seen me in person.
translation_verse: Ŋyunti gbantee, Kriisitoo nikitiŋ ŋin bí Juudee tiŋkinee kaa láá béè-mi.

english_verse: They had only heard that the one who had been cruel to them was now preaching the message that he had once tried to destroy.
translation_verse: Bi pée gbìl̄ bi sòon̄ yii: «Unil un nìn sàantí-ti tikpilee ki kíǹ ki bíi sòoǹ kɔŋkɔnnee fookii Bɔmɔntiiti tin u nìn nyàab̀ kí kúntée.»

english_verse: And because of me, they praised God.
translation_verse: Ní bi kíǹ ki bíi pàkà Unimbɔti m-pu.

english_verse: Fourteen years later I went to Jerusalem with Barnabas. I also took along Titus.
translation_verse: Dibindi diba kpá saalku boonee, ní m gítì Jeerusaleem. M nìn kpáaǹ Baarnaabaasi nì Tiiti.

english_verse: But I went there because God had told me to go, and I explained the good news I had been preaching to the Gentiles. Then I met privately with the ones who seemed to be the most important leaders. I wanted to make sure my work in the past and my future work would not be for nothing.
translation_verse: An sá Unimbɔti di nìn lēē ki dàkā-mi yii ḿ cù ní m cūtì. Ní m gāntì Kriisitoo nikitil kpilib ki kàan̄ ki tùkū-bi Tibɔmɔntiil tin m sòoǹ bin kaa sá Juuda yabee kansikinee. Maa là ditundi din m túńee nì din m bíi tūǹee ń ŋá fám.

english_verse: Titus went to Jerusalem with me. He was a Greek, but still he wasn't forced to be circumcised.
translation_verse: Ní baa páb́ Tiiti un sá Greeki, m-tɔntɔnjutee yii ú gíí dikpancandi.

english_verse: We went there because of those who pretended to be followers and had sneaked in among us as spies. They had come to take away the freedom Christ Jesus had given us, and they were trying to make us their slaves.
translation_verse: Ama biba dɔ́miń ki ŋmālim̀ ti-kansikin ki mɔ́ntì yii bi sá ti-nabiyaamu ama ní kaa sá. Bíǹ di bàà là ú gíí. An nibee ŋá soooo ki kɔ́ ti-kansikin kí cɔ̄ŋkì kí kpèè dibatɔl din ti cáá Yeesu Kriisitoonee, kí ŋmā kí gíiǹ-ti kuyuŋun.

english_verse: But we wanted you to have the true message. This is why we didn't give in to them, not even for a second.
translation_verse: Taa pée pú-bi mpaan ŋyunti ŋubɔ poon báà fiii, Tibɔmɔntiil baamɔŋyi ń nīn bí ki tīī-ni.

english_verse: Some of them were supposed to be important leaders, but I didn't care who they were. God doesn't have any favorites! None of these so-called special leaders added anything to my message.
translation_verse: An yaa kíǹ bin bi yíì binikpaambee - bi yaa sá biŋyee, man ceeyee an kaa páb́, kun puee Unimbɔti kaa gàntī binib -, binikpaambi kaa kútì tibɔti tiba Tibɔmɔntiil tin m sòoǹee pu.

english_verse: They realized God had sent me with the good news for Gentiles, and he had sent Peter with the same message for Jews.
translation_verse: Áli gba, bi ká yii Unimbɔti dū bin kaa sá Juuda yabee ki ŋúbiǹ-mi ḿ sòoǹ nì bi Tibɔmɔntiil, kii u nín dū bin sá Juuda yabee ki ŋúbiǹ Peetroo puee.

english_verse: God, who had sent Peter on a mission to the Jews, was now using me to preach to the Gentiles.
translation_verse: Di sá yii Unimbɔti un yāntì Peetroo kpántì Yeesu kpambal Juuda yab kansikinee di yāntì ma mun kpántì u-kpambal bin kaa sá Juuda yabee kansikin.

english_verse: James, Peter, and John realized that God had given me the message about his gift of undeserved grace. And these men are supposed to be the backbone of the church. They even gave Barnabas and me a friendly handshake. This was to show that we would work with Gentiles and that they would work with Jews.
translation_verse: Ní Yakubu nì Peetroo nì Yoowaneesi, bin pu bi nyí yii bi sá Kriisitoo nikitil kpilibee, béè yii Unimbɔti di pú-mi an pɔŋŋu. Bi nìn tīī man nì Baarnaabaasi kuboou ki dàkā yii ti-kɔkɔ ŋá ubaanti, timbi ń cù bin kaa sá Juuda yabee cee, bíǹ ń cù Juuda yab cee.

english_verse: They only asked us to remember the poor, and this was something I had always been eager to do. Paul Corrects Peter at Antioch
translation_verse: Ama tin baba bi mēē-tee di sá yii tí taa súntí biwɔfib pu, tibɔti tin mun nìn pée bí m-pɔbilin m ŋáańee dee. Pɔɔl wòon̄ Peetroo Antiyɔɔsi

english_verse: When Peter came to Antioch, I told him face to face that he was wrong.
translation_verse: Ama, ŋyunti ŋun Peetroo nìn dɔ́miń Antiyɔɔsee, m nìn wòon̄-u u-nimbiin, kun puee u nìn yīntì.

english_verse: He used to eat with Gentile followers of the Lord, until James sent some Jewish followers. Peter was afraid of the Jews and soon stopped eating with Gentiles.
translation_verse: Di sá yii, kí wàatī ní binib biba ń nyānní Yakubu cee kí dāan̄ Antiyɔɔsee, u nì bin kaa sá Juuda yabee nìn kpáfí ki jīǹ tijin. Binib bin là báà ŋma ń gīfì dikpancandee bāańee, ní u fāŋkì-bi, ní ki kíǹ ki bāal̀, kaa ti là u nì bin kaa sá Juuda yabee ń kpāfì.

english_verse: He and the others hid their true feelings so well that even Barnabas was fooled.
translation_verse: Ní Juuda yab bin kíǹee mun fōō u-biibiiu gbanti, áli gba ki téé Baarnaabaasi mun ki kɔ́ǹ biibii gbantin.

english_verse: But when I saw they were not really obeying the truth that is in the good news, I corrected Peter in front of everyone and said: Peter, you are a Jew, but you live like a Gentile. So how can you force Gentiles to live like Jews?
translation_verse: M nín ká yii baa ti bíi còom̄ deedee kii Tibɔmɔntiil baamɔŋyi nín sá puee, ní m lī Peetroo báà ŋma nimbiin yii: «Sii un sá Juuda yɔuee yaa kaa nóó Juuda yab bimbim, ní ki yaa fōō bin kaa sá Juuda yabee bimbimee, ba ŋá ní a là kí páb́ bin kaa sá Juuda yabee bí fōō Juuda yab bimbim?» Fookii pu ní unil dì kí ká difiil

english_verse: We are Jews by birth and are not sinners like Gentiles.
translation_verse: Bi màl̄ timbi ti sá Juuda yab, kaa sá biniyaŋyambi bikpitib.

english_verse: But we know that God accepts only those who have faith in Jesus Christ. No one can please God by simply obeying the Law. So we put our faith in Christ Jesus, and God accepted us because of our faith.
translation_verse: Nì míǹ kɔkɔee, ti nyí yii ti nín fōō Yeesu Kriisitoo ki kííyee di yàntī ti kpántí deedeedambi Unimbɔti nimbiin, an kaa sá Mooyiisi marab ŋúbitam pu. Ti mun fōō Yeesu Kriisitoo ki kíí ní ki kpántì deedeedambi dimákal din ti cáá Kriisitoo puee, kaa sá marabee ŋúbitam pu. Di sá yii báà ubɔ kaa ŋūǹ kí kpántí deedeedaan Unimbɔti nimbiin nì marab ŋúbitam pu.

english_verse: When we Jews started looking for a way to please God, we discovered that we are sinners too. Does this mean that Christ is the one who makes us sinners? No, it doesn't!
translation_verse: Ti nín nyàab̀ kí kpántí deedeedambi Kriisitoo puee, ti béè yii timbi mun sá binikpitib dee. Mimmee Kriisitoo yàntī tikpitil wīintáaa? Aayee, kpataaa!

english_verse: But if I tear down something and then build it again, I prove that I was wrong at first.
translation_verse: Ama, m yaa fātìi máń kun m nìn gbáń ki wīīyee, m kpántì uyintil dee m-ba.

english_verse: It was the Law itself that killed me and freed me from its power, so I could live for God. I have been nailed to the cross with Christ.
translation_verse: Di sá yii marabee yāntì m kpíì ki nyáń marab taapu, kí ŋmā kí nīn bí ki tīī Unimbɔti. Man nì Kriisitoo di kpáfì ki kpíì ndɔpuntikaa pu.

english_verse: I have died, but Christ lives in me. And I now live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave his life for me.
translation_verse: M nín bí nee, kaa ti sá man di bí, Kriisitoo di bí m-ni. M nín bí dimaŋfalinee, Unimbɔti Jipɔɔn ní m fōō ki kíí, úǹ di néeń-mi ki dū u-ba ki tīī man pu.

english_verse: I don't turn my back on God's gift of undeserved grace. If we can be acceptable to God by obeying the Law, it was useless for Christ to die.
translation_verse: Maa kpèé Unimbɔti ŋanti fám. An yaa bàà sá Mooyiisi marab ŋúbitam pu ní unil dì kí kpántí deedeedaan Unimbɔti nimbiinee, mimmee Kriisitoo kpíì fám deeyaa.

english_verse: You stupid Galatians! I told you exactly how Jesus Christ was nailed to a cross. Has someone now put an evil spell on you?
translation_verse: Galaati yab bigbaambi, ŋma di gátì ni-nimbiliŋ ní? Di sá yii bi nìn kàan̄ Yeesu Kriisitoo kúm ndɔpuntikaa pu bɔti, ní ni wál̀ míǹ kii foota ní bi dàkā-nee.

english_verse: I want to know only one thing. How were you given God's Spirit? Was it by obeying the Law of Moses or by hearing about Christ and having faith in him?
translation_verse: M là kí bàlifì-ni tibɔbaantiil ní kíí-mi: ni nín ŋúb́ Mooyiisi marabee ní ni fōō Unimbɔti Fam naaa, ni nín fōō Tibɔmɔntiil ki kííyee ní ni fōō ní?

english_verse: How can you be so stupid? Do you think that by yourself you can complete what God's Spirit started in you?
translation_verse: Ni sá bigbaambi níii? Ni kíĺ nì Unimbɔti Fam ki dī u-saŋŋu ní ki là kí kúntí nì ni-ba pɔ́ɔǹtamaaa?

english_verse: Have you gone through all of this for nothing? Is it all really for nothing?
translation_verse: Mimmee, tin kɔkɔ ni kántèe ŋá fám deeyaa! An kaa ŋūǹ kí ŋá fám.

english_verse: God gives you his Spirit and works miracles in you. But does he do this because you obey the Law of Moses or because you have heard about Christ and have faith in him?
translation_verse: Unimbɔti nín tìì-ni u-Fam ki ŋáań maamaacib ni-kansikinee, an sá ni nín ŋúb̀ Mooyiisi marabee pueeyaaa, ni nín fōō Tibɔmɔntiilee puee ní?

english_verse: And so, you should understand that everyone who has faith is a child of Abraham.
translation_verse: Ní béé yii bin fōō Unimbɔti ki kííyee di sá Abraam biyaamu.

english_verse: Long ago the Scriptures said God would accept the Gentiles because of their faith. This is why God told Abraham the good news that all nations would be blessed because of him.
translation_verse: An lī Unimbɔti gbɔŋku poon dooooyee ki síiǹ, yii anibul ŋin kaa sá Juuda yabee nín fōō Unimbɔti ki kíí puee ní Unimbɔti kpántí-bi deedeedambi. An pu ní u nìn tùkū Abraam tibɔmɔntiil nee dooooyee yii: «Unimbɔti làá dī sii pu ní kí bìin̄ anibul ŋin kɔkɔ bí kitiŋ puee pu.»

english_verse: This means everyone who has faith will share in the blessings given to Abraham because of his faith.
translation_verse: Mimmee, bin kɔkɔ fōō Unimbɔti ki kííyee kāntí dibiindi kii Abraam nín nìn fōō kí kíí ki ká dibiindi puee ní.

english_verse: Anyone who tries to please God by obeying the Law is under a curse. The Scriptures say, “Everyone who doesn't obey everything in the Law is under a curse.”
translation_verse: Ama, mbusu bí ki tīī un là kí dī Mooyiisi marab pu kí ŋmátée, kun puee an ŋmàn̄ yii: «Tin kɔkɔwoooo bi ŋmàn̄ marab gbɔŋku poon bí nīn ŋáańee, un sá kamaa yaa kaa ŋúb́ mimmee, mbusu bí ki tīī udaan.»

english_verse: No one can please God by obeying the Law. The Scriptures also say, “The people God accepts because of their faith will live.”
translation_verse: Ní an cántì ki tùkū-ti yii ubɔ kaa ŋūǹ kí ŋúb́ marab kí kpántí deedeedaan Unimbɔti nimbiin. Di sá an lī yii: «Deedeedaan kāntí dimaŋfal u-fookiiu pu ní.»

english_verse: The Law isn't based on faith. It promises life only to people who obey its commands.
translation_verse: Marab nì fookii kaa sá ubaanti: di sá Unimbɔti gbɔŋku poon lī yii: «Un yaa ŋáań min Mooyiisi marab lēe kɔkɔee di ŋmátí.»

english_verse: But Christ rescued us from the Law's curse, when he became a curse in our place. This is because the Scriptures say that anyone who is nailed to a tree is under a curse.
translation_verse: Ama Kriisitoo kpántì mbusudaan timbi pu ní ki nyántì-ti mbusu un marab cáańee poon, kii an nín ŋmàn̄ puee yii: «Un kamaa bi yaa lúntì busubu puee ń nīn sá-ni mbusudaan.»

english_verse: And because of what Jesus Christ has done, the blessing promised to Abraham was taken to the Gentiles. This happened so that by faith we would be given the promised Holy Spirit. The Law and the Promise
translation_verse: An di yì-tì ní Yeesu Kriisitoo puee, bin kaa sá Juuda yabee kāntí dibiindi din Abraam nìn kée. Ti nín fōō Unimbɔti ki kíí puee di yì-tì ní ti fòol̄ u-Fam min u nìn pōoǹee. Marab nì dipoondi bɔti

english_verse: My friends, I will use an everyday example to explain what I mean. Once someone agrees to something, no one else can change or cancel the agreement.
translation_verse: Nnabiyaamu, tí dū binib nín ŋáań puee kí ŋmàntīǹ tibɔti nee. Unil yaa bɔ́ntì u-bɔti ki ŋmàn̄ ki ŋá kugbɔŋun ki nyīī ŋŋal kii mara nín síiǹ puee, nì min kamaa an sá kinibiki di ŋée, ubɔ kaa ŋūǹ kí kpìtāaa, kaa tí ŋūǹ kí gbéeǹ tiba mun.

english_verse: That is how it is with the promises God made to Abraham and his descendant. The promises were not made to many descendants, but only to one, and that one is Christ.
translation_verse: Ní tin tin Unimbɔti nìn pōoǹ Abraamee, u nìn pōoǹ ki tīī u nì u-maaliŋu ní. Unimbɔti gbɔŋku poon kaa ŋmàn̄ yii, u nìn pōoǹ ki tīī Abraam biyaamu kupaau. U pée lī yii, u-maaliŋu, an dàkà yii u-maaliŋu poon unibaanti. Úǹ di sá Kriisitooyee.

english_verse: If we have to obey the Law in order to receive God's blessings, those blessings don't really come to us because of God's promise. But God was kind to Abraham and made him a promise.
translation_verse: An yaa sá marab pu ní Unimbɔti dì ki tìì-ti u-gaajatee, mimmee an kaa sá u-poondi pu dee. Ama an sá Unimbɔti nín nìn pōoǹ Abraam yii u làá tīī-u tigaajatee ní u tīī-u.

english_verse: What is the use of the Law? It was given later to show that we sin. But it was only supposed to last until the coming of that descendant who was given the promise. In fact, angels gave the Law to Moses, and he gave it to the people.
translation_verse: Mimmee, ba pu ní bi yóoǹ marab? Unimbɔti dū marab ki kútì dipoondi pu binib ń béé ikpiti nín sá kuŋyee, ní marabee ń nīn bí ki cí ŋyunti ŋun Abraam maaliŋu poon yɔu un pu u pōoǹ dipoondee ń dāá bàńee. Unimbɔti tuuŋyi di cáań marab ki dūu tīī Mooyiisi, ní úǹ dūu nāatì Isirayeel yab.

english_verse: There is only one God, and the Law did not come directly from him. Slaves and Children
translation_verse: Unil yaa bí u-baba nì u-baba ki ŋá u-bɔtee, unàatil kaa bí, míǹ ní Unimbɔti u-baba di pōoǹ dipoondi. Mooyiisi marab tundi

english_verse: Does the Law disagree with God's promises? No, it doesn't! If any law could give life to us, we could become acceptable to God by obeying that law.
translation_verse: Mimmee, Mooyiisi marab jáà nì Unimbɔti poondi deeyaaa? Aayee, kpataaa! Unimbɔti yaa nìn tīī marab bin pu binib ŋūǹ kí dī kí ŋmátée, binib bàà ŋūǹ kí kpántí deedeedambi Unimbɔti nimbiin marabee pu.

english_verse: But the Scriptures say that sin controls everyone, so that God's promises will be for anyone who has faith in Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Ama Unimbɔti gbɔŋku poon bɔti tùkū-ti yii kitiŋ kɔkɔwoooo nib pīī ikpitin. Mimmee bin yaa fōō ki kííyee ŋūǹ kí fōō tin Unimbɔti pōoǹee, bi nín fōō Yeesu Kriisitoo ki kííyee pu.

english_verse: The Law controlled us and kept us under its power until the time came when we would have faith.
translation_verse: Kí wàatī fookii yuntiŋu ń bàńee, ti nìn pīī marab sarkaun ki cí fookii ń bàń.

english_verse: In fact, the Law was to be our teacher until Christ came. Then we could have faith and be acceptable to God.
translation_verse: Marab di nìn cí-ti ki tin sāā ŋyunti ŋun Kriisitoo dāa bāańee, án nín làá ŋá pu tí ŋmā kí kpántí deedeedambi Unimbɔti nimbiin fookii puee.

english_verse: All of you are God's children because of your faith in Christ Jesus.
translation_verse: Kun puee ni nín fōō Yeesu Kriisitoo ki kííyee pu ní ni-kɔkɔ kpántì Unimbɔti biyaamu.

english_verse: And when you were baptized, it was as though you had put on Christ in the same way you put on new clothes.
translation_verse: Di sá yii nimbi bin kɔkɔ bi fùl̄ Unimbɔti nyim, ni ŋá ubaanti nì Yeesu Kriisitooyee, ni kpántì kii Kriisitoo nín bí puee dee.

english_verse: Faith in Christ Jesus is what makes each of you equal with each other, whether you are a Jew or a Greek, a slave or a free person, a man or a woman.
translation_verse: Digàntil kaa ti bí Juuda yab nì bin kaa sá Juuda yabee kansikin, kaa ti bí bin sá iyumbuee nì bin tɔ́ bi-bee kansikin, kaa tí bí bininjab nì binimpoobi mun kansikin. Nimbi kɔkɔ kpáfì ubaanti Yeesu Kriisitoo pu ní.

english_verse: So if you belong to Christ, you are now part of Abraham's family, and you will be given what God has promised.
translation_verse: Kii ni nín sá Kriisitoo yabee puee, ni kpántì Abraam maaliŋu poon yab ki ŋūǹ kí fōō tigaajati tin Unimbɔti nìn pōoǹee.

english_verse: Children who are under age are no better off than slaves, even though everything their parents own will someday be theirs.
translation_verse: M làá tí yòon̄ tibɔŋmantikaal tiba. Di sá yii un làá fōō u-baa gaajawantee yaa dáá sá kibikee, baa ŋūǹ kí gàntī u nì uyumbu, ama u mun di yì tikɔkɔ.

english_verse: This is because children are placed in the care of guardians and teachers until the time their parents have set.
translation_verse: U dáá bí binib bin ŋúb́-u ki kpèé u-wantee taapu ní ki cí ŋyunti ŋun u-baa yóoǹee ń dāá bàń.

english_verse: This is how it was with us. We were like children ruled by the powers of this world.
translation_verse: Míǹ mbaantiim, ŋyunti ŋun taa láá béè Kriisitoo saŋŋuee, ti nìn sá duulinya marab yumbui ní.

english_verse: But when the time was right, God sent his Son, and a woman gave birth to him. His Son obeyed the Law,
translation_verse: An sāā ŋyunti bāańee, ní Unimbɔti túnní u-Jipɔɔn ní ki yāntì unimpu màl̄-u, ní u mun bí Juuda yab marab taapu,

english_verse: so he could set us free from the Law, and we could become God's children.
translation_verse: án nín làá ŋá pu ú fīī timbi bin bí mara taapuee kí dū-ti kí kpántí Unimbɔti biyaamuee.

english_verse: Now that we are his children, God has sent the Spirit of his Son into our hearts. And his Spirit tells us that God is our Father.
translation_verse: Kun dàkà yii ni lafun sá u-biyaamuee di sá Unimbɔti túnní u-Jipɔɔn Fam ti-pɔbiliŋin. Ŋfamee di yì-tì ti yíì-u yii: «Ti-Baa.»

english_verse: You are no longer slaves. You are God's children, and you will be given what he has promised. Paul's Concern for the Galatians
translation_verse: Míǹ puee, aa ti sá uyumbu, a kíǹ ki sá u-biki ní. A nín sá u-bikee puee, ní u tìì-si u-gaajawanti. Pɔɔl bíi sáŋkí Galaati yab

english_verse: Before you knew God, you were slaves of gods that are not real.
translation_verse: Dooooyee, naa nìn nyí Unimbɔti ní ki nìn sá awaa yumbui, awaa ŋin kaa sá Unimbɔti, kaa máaǹ bí nóó-ŋee.

english_verse: But now you know God, or better still, God knows you. How can you turn back and become the slaves of those weak and pitiful powers?
translation_verse: Kɔŋkɔnnee, ni béè Unimbɔti, an dàkà yii Unimbɔti di béè-ni. Ba ŋá ní ni gíti là kí gítí duulinya marab bin kaa cáá mpɔn, kaa bí tibanee taapu kí nīn sá bi-yumbui kii dooooyee ní?

english_verse: You even celebrate certain days, months, seasons, and years.
translation_verse: Ni gàntī iwiin iba yii i sá ikpaan, ki gàntī iŋmal nì iyunti nì abin mbaantiim.

english_verse: I am afraid I have wasted my time working with you.
translation_verse: An puee, m fàŋkí yii digìńdi din m gīī ni-puee ń taa ŋá fám.

english_verse: My friends, I beg you to be like me, just as I once tried to be like you. Did you mistreat me
translation_verse: Nnabiyaamu, m mèé-ni yii ní nīn bímaan kii mamee, a lì kii ma mun nín nìn gíiǹ m-ba kii nimbee. Ama naa ŋá-mi tibeeee!

english_verse: when I first preached to you? No you didn't, even though you knew I had come there because I was sick.
translation_verse: Ni nyí yii m-weeŋyi di nìn yāntì m sòon̄ nì ni Tibɔmɔntiil mpeepeekaam.

english_verse: My illness must have caused you some trouble, but you didn't hate me or turn me away because of it. You welcomed me as though I were one of God's angels or even Christ Jesus himself.
translation_verse: Nì min kamaa m-weeŋyee bàà nìn ŋūǹ kí yàntī ní gīiǹ-mee, naa kpēē-mi fámaaa, kaa núutiǹ-mi. Áli gba, ni nìn gíti fōō-mi kii Unimbɔti tuuŋŋuaaa, Yeesu Kriisitoo u-bee ní.

english_verse: Where is that good feeling now? I am sure if it had been possible, you would have taken out your own eyes and given them to me.
translation_verse: Ba ŋá ní an kaa ti mɔ̄ǹ-ni kii dooooyee? Di sá yii m ŋūǹ kí sòoǹ ni-pu yii, ni yaan ŋūǹ, ni bàà lèekī ni-nimbiliŋ kí tīī-mi.

english_verse: Am I now your enemy, just because I told you the truth?
translation_verse: Ibaamɔn in m sòoǹ nì nee puee ní naa ti là m-bɔtaaa?

english_verse: Those people may be paying you a lot of attention, but it isn't for your good. They only want to keep you away from me, so you will pay them a lot of attention.
translation_verse: Binib nee nín cáá bi-ba ki nākantíǹ-ni dinakándi diŋyee, dàa sá dimɔntiil, bi là kí yàkatī man nì ni kansikin ní, kí dáaliń-ni kí nákáǹ bi-ba.

english_verse: It is always good to give your attention to something worthwhile, even when I am not with you.
translation_verse: An máaǹ tin ŋān̄ee pu ní unil ń dū u-ba kí nákáǹ-si kí nīn cá jaanjaan, kaa sá m yaa bí ni-kansikinee baba.

english_verse: My children, I am in terrible pain until Christ may be seen living in you.
translation_verse: M-bineeŋkaamu, an tí wù-mi tikpil kii imatiŋweenee kí nīn cí ŋyunti ŋun ni làá dāá kpántí kii Kriisitoo nín bí puee.

english_verse: I wish I were with you now. Then I would not have to talk this way. You really have me puzzled. Hagar and Sarah
translation_verse: M yaan bímaan ni-kansikin ŋyunti nee kí ŋmā kí béé m nín làá sòoǹ-ni puee! Kɔŋkɔnnee, m bíi yáliŋkí ni-pu. Agaar nì Saara bɔti

english_verse: Some of you would like to be under the rule of the Law of Moses. But do you know what the Law says?
translation_verse: Nimbi bin là kí nīn bí Mooyiisi marab taapuee, tùkùmaan-mi, naa gbìl̀ marab gbɔŋku poon bɔtaaa?

english_verse: In the Scriptures we learn that Abraham had two sons. The mother of one of them was a slave, while the mother of the other one had always been free.
translation_verse: Di sá yii an ŋmàn̄ yii Abraam nìn màl̄ mbininjabiyaamu muli, kiba sá unimpuyumbu biki ní kin kíǹee sá unimpu un yì u-bee biki.

english_verse: The son of the slave woman was born in the usual way. But the son of the free woman was born because of God's promise.
translation_verse: U màl̄ uyumbu biki nniyaamin, ama ní unimpu un yì u-bee biki màaltam sá Unimbɔti pòontam.

english_verse: All of this has another meaning as well. Each of the two women stands for one of the agreements God made with his people. Hagar, the slave woman, stands for the agreement that was made at Mount Sinai. Everyone born into her family is a slave.
translation_verse: Tibɔti nee ŋūǹ kí nīn sá-ti tibɔŋmantikaal: binimpoobi bili gbanti ŋūǹ kí dàkà min ní Unimbɔti nìn bóob́ u nì binib kansikinee. Bi nín nìn bóob́ tin Siinaayi jool puee di sá Agaar ní ki màal̀ ŋyumbubiyaamu.

english_verse: Hagar also stands for Mount Sinai in Arabia and for the present city of Jerusalem. She and her children are slaves.
translation_verse: Agaar gbanti sá Siinaayi jool din bí Bilaalibub tiŋkinee, ní ki sá Jeerusaleem nì u-biyaamu mun bí kuyuŋun díǹ pu nan ní.

english_verse: But our mother is the city of Jerusalem in heaven above, and she isn't a slave.
translation_verse: Ama Jeerusaleem un bí yilpuee sá un yì u-bee, úǹ di sá timbi na.

english_verse: The Scriptures say about her, “You have never had children, but now you can be glad. You have never given birth, but now you can shout. Once you had no children, but now you will have more children than a woman who has been married for a long time.”
translation_verse: Kun puee an ŋmàn̄ yii: «Unimpuŋmaŋŋmanti un kaa ŋúń ki màl̄ ki kée, án nīn mɔ̄ǹ-si! Sii un kaa nìn nyí imatiŋween ki kée, á nīn kūuntí nì dipɔɔpindi! Kun puee unimpu un bi cāntèe màl̄ mbiyaamu ki jítiǹ unimpu un cáá calee.»

english_verse: My friends, you were born because of this promise, just as Isaac was.
translation_verse: Nnabiyaamu, míǹ ní nimbi sá Unimbɔti pòontam biyaamu, kii Isaaki nín nìn sá puee.

english_verse: But the child who was born in the natural way made trouble for the child who was born because of the Spirit. The same thing is happening today.
translation_verse: Dooooyee, kibiki kin bi màl̄ nniyaaminee nìn páb̀ kibiki kin Unimbɔti Fam yāntì bi màl̄ee. Ní áli nìn díǹ an gbíntìi sá míǹ ní.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “Get rid of the slave woman and her son! He won't be given anything. The son of the free woman will receive everything.”
translation_verse: An ŋmàn̄ Unimbɔti gbɔŋku poon yii ba ní? An ŋmàn̄ yii: «Jà unimpuyumbu nì u-jipɔɔn. U-jipɔɔn nì unimpu un yì u-bee jipɔɔn kaa máaǹ kí yàkatī bi-baa gaajawanti.»

english_verse: My friends, we are children of the free woman and not of the slave.
translation_verse: Míǹ puee, m-nabiyaamu, timbi sá unimpu un yì u-bee biyaamu ní, taa sá unimpuyumbu biyaamu.

english_verse: Christ has set us free! This means we are really free. Now hold on to your freedom and don't ever become slaves of the Law again.
translation_verse: Kriisitoo nyántì-ti kuyuŋun tí nīn tɔ́ ti-ba ní. Míǹ puee, ní nīn bímaan dibatɔlee ni, kí taa gíti kɔ́ kuyuŋun.

english_verse: I, Paul, promise you that Christ won't do you any good if you get circumcised.
translation_verse: Ní pīlifìmaan-mi! Man Pɔɔl bíi tùkù-ni yii, ni yaa yāntì bi gíí-ni dikpancandee, naa ti bíi páatí tiba Kriisitoo pu.

english_verse: And if you try to please God by obeying the Law, you have cut yourself off from Christ and his gift of undeserved grace.
translation_verse: Nimbi bin kɔkɔ nyàab̀ kí nīn bí deedee Unimbɔti nimbiin nì marab ŋúbitam puee, ni nì Kriisitoo yākatì tɔbin, ni nyáń Unimbɔti bìintamin.

english_verse: But the Spirit makes us sure God will accept us because of our faith in Christ.
translation_verse: An yaa sá timbee, ti máká ní ki kā ki cí kí kpántí deedeedambi Unimbɔti nimbiin, kun puee ti fōō Kriisitoo ki kíí ní Unimbɔti Fam bí ti-ni.

english_verse: If you are a follower of Christ Jesus, it makes no difference whether you are circumcised or not. All that matters is your faith that makes you love others.
translation_verse: A yaa kpántì Yeesu Kriisitoo yɔuee, a yaa gíí dikpancandaaa, a yaa kaa gííyaaa, an kaa páb́, kun di páb́ee di sá a-fookiiu ń nīn tūǹ ditundi nì dineendi.

english_verse: You were doing so well until someone made you turn from the truth.
translation_verse: Ni nìn còom̄ tiŋan. Ŋma di pīiǹ-ni nsan ní gbèen̄ kí taa ti gbìl̄ kí tīiǹ ibaamɔn ní?

english_verse: And that person was certainly not sent by the one who chose you.
translation_verse: An kaa sá un di yíì-ni ní nīn nóó-uee cee ní tíǹ nyánní.

english_verse: A little yeast can change a whole batch of dough,
translation_verse: Ŋkpɔnɔnyɔkɔ fiii di yàntī kpɔnɔ saabu kɔkɔ jɔ́ḿ.

english_verse: but you belong to the Lord. This makes me certain you will do what I say, instead of what someone else tells you to do. Whoever is causing trouble for you will be punished.
translation_verse: Ama man máká ni-pu yii ti-Dindaan puee, naa làá kpántí ni-landɔkɔi. Un di yaa cáań fìkil fikil ni-kansikinee, báà udaan yaa yāntì ki sá un, ditafadaaldi dɔ̄ ki cí-u.

english_verse: My friends, if I still preach that people need to be circumcised, why am I in so much trouble? The message about the cross would no longer be a problem, if I told people to be circumcised.
translation_verse: Nnabiyaamu, m yaan bíi tùkù binib yii an máaǹ bí gíí dikpancandee, ba pu ní bi bàà gíti páb̀-mi? M yaan lī míǹ, Kriisitoo dɔpuntikaaŋu bɔti kaa bàà sá tibɔti tin páb̀ binibee.

english_verse: I wish everyone who is upsetting you would not only get circumcised, but would cut off much more!
translation_verse: M bàà là bin páb́-ni ní gííyee ń cù bí fàatī-bi.

english_verse: My friends, you were chosen to be free. So don't use your freedom as an excuse to do anything you want. Use it as an opportunity to serve each other with love.
translation_verse: Míǹ puee, nnabiyaamu, ni ká yii Unimbɔti yíiń nimbi ní nīn bí dibatɔlin. Ní taa lákatí dibatɔlee pu kí nīn ŋáań min ni-bimbikpitim lèe, ama ní nīn néeń tɔb kí nīn tútúǹ tɔb.

english_verse: All the Law says can be summed up in the command to love others as much as you love yourself.
translation_verse: Di sá yii marab kɔkɔ taapu di sá unee, yii: «Á nīn néeń a-juti kii sii a-bee.»

english_verse: But if you keep attacking each other like wild animals, you had better watch out or you will destroy yourselves. God's Spirit and Our Own Desires
translation_verse: Ama ní kpèè tiŋan: ni yaa bí ki júntí tɔb ki cátikí tɔbee, ni làá kúntí tɔb dee. Tí yàntī Unimbɔti Fam ń kpòotī-ti

english_verse: If you are guided by the Spirit, you won't obey your selfish desires.
translation_verse: Tin m tùkù-nee di sá yii ní yàntī Unimbɔti Fam ń kpòotī-ni, kí taa nín̄ nóó min ni-bimbikpitim bàlifēe.

english_verse: The Spirit and your desires are enemies of each other. They are always fighting each other and keeping you from doing what you feel you should.
translation_verse: Di sá yii, ti-bimbikpitim nín là min miŋyee, Unimbɔti Fam kaa là míǹ, ní min min Unimbɔti Fam lèe, ti-bimbikpitim mun kaa là míǹ. Tiwan tilee jáaǹ tɔb ní. An di yì-tì ní taa ŋūǹ kí ŋá min ti bàà là kí ŋée.

english_verse: But if you obey the Spirit, the Law of Moses has no control over you.
translation_verse: Ama Unimbɔti Fam yaa kpòotī-nee, naa ti bí Mooyiisi marab taapu.

english_verse: People's desires make them give in to immoral ways, filthy thoughts, and shameful deeds.
translation_verse: An kaa pɔ̄ɔ̄ tí béé mbimbikpitim nín tūǹ atuun ŋin ti-wuntinee: an di sá tilaakpaal, tijɔkɔndi, bimaramɔntiibi fátam,

english_verse: envious. They get drunk, carry on at wild parties, and do other evil things as well. I told you before, and I am telling you again: No one who does these things will share in the blessings of God's kingdom.
translation_verse: nnimbidiki, ndanyoon, mpoo, nì tin kɔkɔ náań nì tibɔti neeyee. Kii m nín nìn tùkū-ni puee, m tí bíi kpáafí-ni yii bin ŋáań an bɔti gbantee kaa dāa kóò Unimbɔti Beelin.

english_verse: gentle, and self-controlled. There is no law against behaving in any of these ways.
translation_verse: kí nīn mɔ̄, kí ŋúb́ a-ba. Mara ubɔ kaa bí ki jáà nì an bɔti gbanti.

english_verse: And because we belong to Christ Jesus, we have killed our selfish feelings and desires.
translation_verse: Di sá yii Yeesu Kriisitoo yab dū bi-bimbikpitim nì tin mì néeń ki lèe ki kpáá ndɔpuntikaa pu.

english_verse: God's Spirit has given us life, and so we should follow the Spirit.
translation_verse: Ŋfam nín tīī-ti dimaŋfalee, tí yàntī Ŋfamee ń nīn kpòotī ti-bimbim mun.

english_verse: But don't be conceited or make others jealous by claiming to be better than they are.
translation_verse: Tí taa nín̄ yòontí ti-ba yilpu, kí taa nín̄ tákà tɔb tibɔti, kí taa nín̄ cáá ipoompoon tɔb pu.

english_verse: My friends, you are spiritual. So if someone is trapped in sin, you should gently lead that person back to the right path. But watch out, and don't be tempted yourself.
translation_verse: Nnabiyaamu, ni yaa cúú ubɔ bíi ŋáań ikpitee, nimbi bin Unimbɔti Fam kpòotēe ń ŋá soooo kí gíiǹ-u nsammɔnti poon, ní kí nīn kpèé ni-ba tiŋan ki mun ń taa lítí ni-ba.

english_verse: You obey the law of Christ when you offer each other a helping hand.
translation_verse: Ní nīn tútúǹ tɔb ni-gìŋ́ŋi poon, mimmee, ni bíi ŋáań min Kriisitoo marau lēe dee.

english_verse: If you think you are better than others, when you really aren't, you are wrong.
translation_verse: Ubɔ yaa dākafì yii u bí tiban ní kaa bée, udaan kíiĺ u-ba ní.

english_verse: Do your own work well, and then you will have something to be proud of. But don't compare yourself with others.
translation_verse: Báà ŋma ń cɔ̄ŋkì u-ba kí kpèè u-tuuŋŋi, ní u yaa làá nín gāā u-bindaaa, ú gāā an nīn sá úǹ u-ba ŋmaniŋma tuuŋŋi pu. Ú taa dū kí ŋmàntīǹ u-jutiibi yaŋ pu.

english_verse: We each must carry our own load.
translation_verse: Di sá yii báà ŋma máaǹ kí kpèè u-ba bɔti ní.

english_verse: Share every good thing you have with anyone who teaches you what God has said.
translation_verse: Un bi yaa dàkà Unimbɔti bɔtee, udaan máaǹ kí lēē u-gaajawanti tin kɔkɔ u cááyee poon kí tīī un dàkà-uee.

english_verse: You cannot fool God, so don't make a fool of yourself! You will harvest what you plant.
translation_verse: Taa nín̄ kíiĺmaan ni-ba: baa gbíilíǹ Unimbɔti. Di sá yii kun unil yaa búĺee, kúǹ ní u dāa cēē.

english_verse: If you follow your selfish desires, you will harvest destruction, but if you follow the Spirit, you will harvest eternal life.
translation_verse: Un ŋáań min u-bimbikpitim lèe búĺ u-bimbikpitim dee, ní kí dāá cā ŋkúm. Ama un ŋáań min Circir Fam lèe búĺ Circir Fam dee, ní kí dāá cā dimaŋfal din kaa kúntée.

english_verse: Don't get tired of helping others. You will be rewarded when the time is right, if you don't give up.
translation_verse: Tí taa gīī kí gbèen̄ tiŋan diŋál. Ti-wunti yaa kaa yɔ̄tì, ŋyunti yaa láa bāań, ti làá dāá fōō tipaal.

english_verse: We should help people whenever we can, especially if they are followers of the Lord. Final Warnings
translation_verse: Míǹ puee, ŋyunti ŋun poon ti cáá mpaan nee, tí nīn ŋáań báà ŋma tiŋan, ama cilinjee tí nīn ŋáaḿmaan timbi nì bin pēē nnimbɔtisanee tiŋan. Isaŋkijoolkaa nì ŋwimmeem

english_verse: You can see what big letters I make when I write with my own hand.
translation_verse: Kpèèmaan, m nín dū m-ŋal ki ŋmàn̄ tiŋmaŋmabiti an gbìfì puee!

english_verse: Those people who are telling you to get circumcised are only trying to show how important they are. And they don't want to get into trouble for preaching about the cross of Christ.
translation_verse: Bin téekí-ni ní gíí dikpancandee là binib ń nīn nyí bi-pu dee. Kun pu bi ŋáań mimmee di sá baa là kí ká digìńdi Kriisitoo dɔpuntikaaŋu pu.

english_verse: They are circumcised, but they don't obey the Law of Moses. All they want is to brag about having you circumcised.
translation_verse: Di sá yii bin gífì dikpancandee bi-ba kaa ŋúb̀ Mooyiisi marab. Kun pu bi là ní gííyee di sá bi là kí gāā bi-biŋŋi yii, ni-wunti daaŋku nee, bíǹ di páb́-ni ní ni ŋá.

english_verse: But I will never brag about anything except the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ. Because of his cross, the world is dead as far as I am concerned, and I am dead as far as the world is concerned.
translation_verse: Maa là kí gāā m-bindi tiba pu kpataaa an yaa kaa sá ti-Dindaan Yeesu Kriisitoo dɔpuntikaaŋu baba pu. Man ceeyee duulinya kpíì ndɔpuntikaa pu, ní duulinya ceeyee ma mun kpíì ndɔpuntikaa pu.

english_verse: It doesn't matter if you are circumcised or not. All that matters is that you are a new person.
translation_verse: A yaa gíí dikpancandaaa, a yaa kaa gííyaaa, an kaa páb́, tin páb́ee di sá á kpántí unipɔɔn.

english_verse: If you follow this rule, you will belong to God's true people. God will treat you with undeserved kindness and will bless you with peace.
translation_verse: Bin kɔkɔ làá nóó min m lī nee, Unimbɔti ń tīī-bi ŋgbansɔŋfi kí sɔ̄ bi-saai, ki kpáaǹ bin sá Isirayeel yab kiŋkiŋ Unimbɔti nibulee.

english_verse: On my own body are scars that prove I belong to Christ Jesus. So I don't want anyone to bother me anymore.
translation_verse: Kí pée yòon̄ díǹ kí nīn cá, ubɔ ń taa ti ŋá-mi digìńdi, kun puee m-wunti buŋwati di sá Yeesu daanti.

english_verse: My friends, I pray that the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you! Amen.
translation_verse: Nnabiyaamu, ti-Dindaan Yeesu Kriisitoo ŋanti ń nīn bí ni-pu! Ameeni.

english_verse: From Paul, chosen by God to be an apostle of Christ Jesus. To God's people who live in Ephesus and are faithful followers of Christ Jesus.
translation_verse: Man Pɔɔl un Unimbɔti lēē ḿ nīn sá Yeesu Kriisitoo kpambalee di ŋmàn̄ kugbɔŋu nee. M ŋmàn̄-ku kí tīī nimbi Unimbɔti yab bin kóò Eefeesi tiŋkin ki yú deedee, ni nì Yeesu Kriisitoo ŋá ubaantee ní.

english_verse: I pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! Christ Brings Spiritual Blessings
translation_verse: Ti-Baa Unimbɔti nì ti-Dindaan Yeesu Kriisitoo ń ŋá-ni tiŋan kí tīī-ni ŋgbansɔŋfi. Unimbɔti ŋá-ti tiŋan Kriisitoo pu

english_verse: Praise the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ for the spiritual blessings that Christ has brought us from heaven!
translation_verse: Ti jáaḿ Unimbɔti un sá ti-Dindaan Yeesu Kriisitoo Baayee u nín ŋá-ti tiŋan tin, ki dī u-Fam pu ki tīī-ti yilpu wammɔntiiti kɔkɔ ti nì Yeesu Kriisitoo nín ŋá ubaantee puee.

english_verse: Before the world was created, God had Christ choose us to live with him and to be his holy and innocent and loving people.
translation_verse: Di sá yii, kí wàatī Unimbɔti ń náań duulinyee, u pée lútì-ti ki yóoǹ tí nīn sá u-yab, ti nì Kriisitoo ń ŋá ubaanti, tí nīn bí circir, ú taa ká ti-pu ikpiti iba. Unimbɔti neendi puee,

english_verse: God was kind and decided that Christ would choose us to be God's own adopted children.
translation_verse: ní u nìn pée lēē ki yóoǹ dooooyee yii, Yeesu Kriisitoo puee, u làá dāá dū-ti kí kpántí u-biyaamu. Di sá yii an nìn ŋān̄ u-cee ú ŋá míǹ,

english_verse: God treated us with undeserved grace because of the Son he dearly loves, and so we should praise God.
translation_verse: án nīn sá-u tinyool, tiŋaŋkpaandi tin u dī u-Jipɔnneeŋkaau pu ki ŋá ki tīī-tee pu.

english_verse: and by what Christ has done, God has shown us his own mysterious ways.
translation_verse: Di sá yii u yāntì ti béè u nín là kí dī Kriisitoo pu kí ŋá tin nìn bí dibalin dooooyee.

english_verse: Then when the time is right, God will do all he has planned, and Christ will bring together everything in heaven and on earth.
translation_verse: Tin u lēē kí ŋée di sá, ŋyunti yaa láa sāāyee, ú dāá kóoǹ tin bí yilpuee nì tin bí taapuee kɔkɔ kí kpāfì, Kriisitoo baba ń nīn sá ubɔti.

english_verse: God always does what he plans, and this is why he appointed Christ to choose us.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti ŋáań tikɔkɔ kii u nín lēē ki là kí ŋá miŋyee ní, di sá yii u lútì-ti ki yóoǹ dooooyee tí nīn sá u-yab, ti nì Kriisitoo nín ŋá ubaantee pu.

english_verse: He did this so we Jews would bring honor to him and be the first ones to have hope because of him.
translation_verse: Mimmee, timbi bin sá bipeepeekaabi ki máká Kriisitoo puee, tí nīn pàkà-u u-nyooti pu.

english_verse: Christ also brought you the truth, which is the good news about how you can be saved. You put your faith in Christ and were given the promised Holy Spirit to show you belong to God.
translation_verse: Nimbee, ni gbìl̄ ibaamɔn bɔti tin sá Kriisitoo Bɔmɔntiiti ki cáań-ni difiilee. Ni nín fōō ki kííyee pu, ní Unimbɔti dū u-daaŋku ki dáań-ni. Kudaaŋŋuee di sá Circir Fam min u nìn pōoǹee.

english_verse: The Spirit also makes us sure we will be given what God has stored up for his people. Then we will be set free, and God will be honored and praised. Paul's Prayer
translation_verse: U-Fam min u tīī-tee di dàkà yii difakal din u pōoǹ kí tīī-tee dáá bíń boon ki dòoń ti làá fōō-dì. Mì tīī-ti dimákal yii ti làá dāá fōō difakalee ŋyunti ŋun Unimbɔti yaa láa nyántì u-yab kɔkɔ doo ki cáa cūnnì u-ceeyee. U ŋá míǹ tí nīn pàkà-u u-nyooti pu ní. Pɔɔl wimmeem

english_verse: I have heard about your faith in the Lord Jesus and your love for all God's people.
translation_verse: An puee, m nín gbìl̄ bi sòoǹ ni-fookiiu un ni cáá ti-Dindaan Yeesu puee, nì dineendi din ni cáá Unimbɔti yab kɔkɔ puee,

english_verse: So I never stop being grateful for you, as I mention you in my prayers.
translation_verse: m yaa bíi mèéyee m jáaḿ Unimbɔti ni-pu múlmul.

english_verse: I ask the glorious Father and God of our Lord Jesus Christ to give you his Spirit. The Spirit will make you wise and let you understand what it means to know God.
translation_verse: M mèé ti-Baa tinyooldaan un sá ti-Dindaan Yeesu Kriisitoo Nimbɔtiuee ú tīī-ni iciin ní ŋmā kí béé-u, kí nīn nyí un Unimbɔti sée.

english_verse: My prayer is that light will flood your hearts and you will understand the hope given to you when God chose you. Then you will discover the glorious blessings that will be yours together with all God's people.
translation_verse: M gíti mèé-u yii ú ŋmíntí-ni ní wāl̀ tiwammɔntiil tin pu u yíiń-nee, ní béé tigaajati tin u kpáafì ki yóoǹ nimbi bin sá u-yabee nín wīikí ki cáá tinyool puee,

english_verse: I want you to know about the great and mighty power that God has for us followers. It is the same wonderful power he used
translation_verse: ní béé u-pɔŋkpaaŋŋu ŋun jítiǹ tikɔkɔ u cáa tūǹ timbi bin fōō-u ki kííyee pu atuunee. U-pɔŋkpaaŋŋu gbanti mbaantee ní u dàkā,

english_verse: when he raised Christ from death and let him sit at his right side in heaven.
translation_verse: ŋyunti ŋun u nìn fīkitì Kriisitoo ditaŋkpiilin ki yāntì u cūtìi kāl̀ u-ŋaŋgiil pú yilpuee.

english_verse: There Christ rules over all forces, authorities, powers, and rulers. He rules over all beings in this world and will rule in the future world as well.
translation_verse: Niin ní Kriisitoo tɔ́kɔ́ tikɔkɔ pu ki jīǹ dibeel biyidambi nì bibɔtiibi nì bipɔndambi kɔkɔ pu. Báà an yaa yāntì ki sá uŋyee, úǹ di jítiǹ báà ŋma duulinya un poon ti bí nee, nì un dáá bíń ki dòońee mun poon.

english_verse: God has put all things under the power of Christ, and for the good of the church he has made him the head of everything.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti dū tikɔkɔ ní ki ŋá Kriisitoo taapu. U dū-u tɔ́kɔǹ tikɔkɔ pu ní ki dū-u ki ŋá Kriisitoo Nikitil yil.

english_verse: The church is the body of Christ and is filled with Christ who completely fills everything.
translation_verse: Kriisitoo Nikitil di sá Kriisitoo wunti. Dinikitilee ni ní Kriisitoo bí gbīŋgbim ní Unimbɔti bí Kriisitoo ni mmɔm.

english_verse: In the past you were dead because you sinned and fought against God.
translation_verse: Dooooyee, ni nín nìn yìntī ki ŋáań ikpiti iŋyee puee, ni nìn kpíì Unimbɔti nimbiin.

english_verse: You followed the ways of this world and obeyed the devil. He rules the world, and his spirit has power over everyone who doesn't obey God.
translation_verse: Ni nìn ŋáań kii duulinya yab nín pée ŋáań puee ní, ki nóó arasiniibi bɔtiu un bí kutaa pu ki yàntī nnibiyaamu kaa tɔ́ Unimbɔtee.

english_verse: Once we were also ruled by the selfish desires of our bodies and minds. We had made God angry, and we were going to be punished like everyone else.
translation_verse: Ti-kɔkɔ mun nìn pée bí míǹ ní dooooyee, ki nóó timbi ti-ba nín là puee ní ki ŋáań min ní ti-pɔbiliŋ nì ti-landɔkɔi fáatèe. Ti nín nìn bí miŋyee, Unimbɔti tafadaaldi nìn dɔ̄ ki cí-ti kii an nín dɔ̄ ki cí bin béeyee puee ní.

english_verse: But God was merciful! We were dead because of our sins, but God loved us so much he made us alive with Christ, and God's gift of undeserved grace is what saves you.
translation_verse: nì min kɔkɔ ti nìn bí ŋkúmin ti-kpitii puee, u fātìi tīī-ti dimaŋfal ti nín kpáfì nì Yeesu Kriisitooyee. An sá u-ŋanti pu ní ni ká difiil.

english_verse: God raised us from death to life with Christ Jesus, and he has given us a place beside Christ in heaven.
translation_verse: Ti nì Kriisitoo nín ŋá ubaantee pu ní Unimbɔti fīkitì ti nì u, ki yāntì ti nì u kā yilpu.

english_verse: God did this so in the future world he could show how truly good and kind he is to us because of what Christ Jesus has done.
translation_verse: U dī Yeesu Kriisitoo pu ní ki ŋá-ti tiŋan gbanti, kí dàkà bin làá dāá dāan̄ boonee u-ŋanti nín wīikí ki jítiǹ tikɔkɔ puee.

english_verse: You were saved by faith in God, who treats us much better than we deserve. This is God's gift to you, and not anything you have done on your own.
translation_verse: Di sá yii Unimbɔti ŋanti pu nì ni nín fōō Kriisitoo ki kííyee pu ní ni ká difiil. Difiil gbantee, naa ŋá tiba ní ki ká-dì, u pú-ni-dì faalaa ní.
