english_verse: It isn't something you have earned, so there is nothing you can brag about.
translation_verse: An kaa tí sá ditundi pu, ní ubɔ ń nīn cáa gà u-bindi.

english_verse: God planned for us to do good things and to live as he has always wanted us to live. This is why he sent Christ to make us what we are. United by Christ
translation_verse: Kun puee ti sá Unimbɔti wannaaŋkaati ní. Ti nín ŋá ubaanti nì Yeesu Kriisitooyee ní u fātìi náań-ti mpɔm, tí ŋmā kí nīn tūǹ atummɔnti ŋin u nìn bɔ́ntì ki yóoǹ tí nīn tūǹee. Yeesu Kriisitoo puee, ti ŋá ubaanti

english_verse: Don't forget that you are Gentiles. In fact, you used to be called “uncircumcised” by those who take pride in being circumcised.
translation_verse: An puee, ní téetímaan dooooyee ni nín nìn bí miŋyee. Naa sá Juuda yab maaliŋun, nimbi ní Juuda yab bin gífí akpancanee yíì yii bin kaa gífée.

english_verse: At that time you did not know about Christ. You were foreigners to the people of Israel, and you had no part in the promises God had made to them. You were living in this world without hope and without God,
translation_verse: Téetímaan yii, ŋyunti gbantee, naa nìn dáá nyí Kriisitoo, ni nìn sá binicambi ní. Naa nìn sá Isirayeel tindambiyaamu. Unimbɔti nín nìn ŋá mpèé nì u-yab ki pōoǹ-bi dipoondee, ni nìn kpá poon. Ni nìn bí duulinyan kaa nyí Unimbɔti, kaa cɔ́tí tiba mun pu.

english_verse: and you were far from God. But Christ offered his life's blood as a sacrifice and brought you near God.
translation_verse: Ama nimbi bin nìn dátiǹ-uee, kɔŋkɔnnee ni nì Yeesu Kriisitoo nín ŋá ubaantee, ni sútìń ki pìl̄-u Kriisitoo kúm pu.

english_verse: Christ has made peace between Jews and Gentiles, and he has united us by breaking down the wall of hatred that separated us. Christ gave his own body
translation_verse: Di sá yii úǹ Kriisitoo di sá timbi gbansɔŋfiŋu. Úǹ di yāntì Juuda yab nì bin kaa sá Juuda yabee kpántì dinibubaantiil. Di sá yii kináŋ nìn pītì ti-kansikin kii digundee, ní u dū u-maŋfal ki tīī ki wīī digundee.

english_verse: to destroy the Law of Moses with all its rules and commands. He even brought Jews and Gentiles together as though we were only one person, when he united us in peace.
translation_verse: U kpītì Juuda yab marab nì tin bi nìn pée ŋáańee kɔkɔ. Ti nì u nín ŋá ubaantee pu ní u dū anibul alee ki ŋá dinibubaantiil din sá dipɔndee, ní ki cáań-ti ŋgbansɔŋfi.

english_verse: On the cross Christ did away with our hatred for each other. He also made peace between us and God by uniting Jews and Gentiles in one body.
translation_verse: Kriisitoo kúm ndɔpuntikaa pu di kúntì kináŋ, ki cāntì Juuda yab nì bin kaa sá Juuda yabee kpántì tiwumbaantiil, bi nì Unimbɔti mɔ́ɔkì.

english_verse: Christ came and preached peace to you Gentiles, who were far from God, and peace to us Jews, who were near God.
translation_verse: U dɔ́miń duulinyan ki sòon̄ dipɔɔsɔŋkil bɔti ki tīī nimbi bin kaa sá Juuda yab ki dátiǹ Unimbɔtee, nì timbi bin sá Juuda yab ki pìlīǹ-uee mun.

english_verse: And because of Christ, all of us can come to the Father by the same Spirit.
translation_verse: Di sá yii Kriisitoo pu ní timbi bin sá Juuda yabee nì nimbi bin kaa sée kɔkɔ ŋūǹ kí bà ti-Baa Unimbɔti nì u-Fam mbaantiim tūtuntam pu.

english_verse: You Gentiles are no longer strangers and foreigners. You are citizens with everyone else who belongs to the family of God.
translation_verse: Míǹ puee naa ti sá binicambi, kaa ti sá bin nyánní laabee. Ni kpántì ntindambiyaamu kii bin sá Unimbɔti yabee nín sá puee ní, ní ki sá Unimbɔti dicaŋkun yab.

english_verse: You are like a building with the apostles and prophets as the foundation and with Christ as the most important stone.
translation_verse: Ni sá kudii ní, ní kudiiyee nín tɔ́kɔ́ ataŋkpee ŋin puee di sá Yeesu Kriisitoo kpambaliŋ nì Unimbɔti bɔnaatiliibi, ní Yeesu sá ditaŋkpal din yì kudiiyee pɔŋŋuee.

english_verse: Christ is the one who holds the building together and makes it grow into a holy temple for the Lord.
translation_verse: Úǹ di yì-tì ní kudiiyee yú ki pɔ̄ɔ̄ ní ki wīintí ki jɔ́ḿ ki kpántí circir diiku ti-Dindaan pu.

english_verse: And you are part of that building Christ has built as a place for God's own Spirit to live.
translation_verse: Ni nì Yeesu Kriisitoo nín ŋá ubaantee puee, nimbi nì timbi di kpáfì ki ŋá kii kudii kun ni Unimbɔti kóò kí dūú dī u-Fam puee.

english_verse: Christ Jesus made me his prisoner, so I could help you Gentiles.
translation_verse: An puee, man Pɔɔl bí ki mèé Unimbɔti. M sá Yeesu Kriisitoo sarkadaaŋwu ki tūǹ ditundi ki tìì nimbi bin kaa sá Juuda yabee.

english_verse: You have surely heard about God's gift of undeserved grace in choosing me to help you.
translation_verse: Ni nyí yii Unimbɔti ŋá-mi tiŋan ki tīī-mi ditundi ḿ tɔ̄ kí tīī-ni.

english_verse: In fact, this letter tells you a little about how God has shown me his mysterious ways.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti bīitì tibɔbalkaal tin nìn bí dooooyee pu, ki dàkā-mi ní m béè. Tíǹ ní m ŋmàn̄-ni nì anyɔɔbuŋkaaŋkaa nee.

english_verse: As you read the letter, you will also find out how well I really do understand the mystery about Christ.
translation_verse: Ni yaa bíi kàaǹ tin m ŋmàn̄ nee, ni làá ká yii m béè Kriisitoo bɔti tin nìn bí dibalinee.

english_verse: No one knew about this mystery until God's Spirit told it to his holy apostles and prophets.
translation_verse: Dooooyee, Unimbɔti kaa nìn nyántì an bɔtee ki dàkā binib. Kɔŋkɔnnee u dī u-Fam pu ki yāntì u-circir kpambaliŋ nì u-bɔnaatiliibi béè-tì.

english_verse: And the mystery is this: Because of Christ Jesus, the good news has given the Gentiles a share in the promises God gave to the Jews. God has also let the Gentiles be part of the same body.
translation_verse: Tíǹ di sá tigaajati tin Unimbɔti tìì Juuda yabee. Ni mun làá fōō-tì, ni nì Juuda yab kɔkɔ kpántì unibaanti ní. Unimbɔti nín pōoǹ tin kí tīī bin sá Yeesu Kriisitoo yabee, u làá tīī ni mun kudɔŋu, Tibɔmɔntiil tin ni fōō ki kííyee pu.

english_verse: God treated me with kindness. His power worked in me, and it became my job to spread the good news.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti ŋá-mi tiŋan ki tīī-mi ditundi din sá ḿ nīn sòoǹ Tibɔmɔntiil ki tìì binibee. Nì u-pɔŋŋu ní u ŋá míǹ.

english_verse: I am the least important of all God's people. But God was kind and chose me to tell the Gentiles that because of Christ there are blessings that cannot be measured.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti yab kɔkɔ kansikinee, man di sá bin sá ŋwaamuee waaki. Nì míǹ kɔkɔee, Unimbɔti pú-mi diyimɔɔl ḿ sòoǹ nì bin kaa sá Juuda yabee Kriisitoo gaajati tin sá tikpaŋkpaandi, kaa cáá dikúntilee bɔti.

english_verse: God, who created everything, wanted me to help everyone understand the mysterious plan that had always been hidden in his mind.
translation_verse: U pú-mi diyimɔɔl ḿ dàkà binib ń béé tin Unimbɔti nìn lēē kí ŋá an nìn dáá bál̀ u-ni dooooyee. Unimbɔti un náań tikɔkɔee di dū-tì ki bál̀ áli ki dāa sāā ŋyunti ŋun bí nee.

english_verse: Then God would use the church to show the powers and authorities in the spiritual world that he has many different kinds of wisdom.
translation_verse: Ama kɔŋkɔnnee Unimbɔti yāntì Kriisitoo nikitil puee, ituun nì bin kɔkɔ sá bipɔndambi ki bí yilpuee béè Unimbɔti ciiŋyi nín wīikí ki bí tɔbin puee.

english_verse: God did this according to his eternal plan. And he was able to do what he had planned because of all Christ Jesus our Lord had done.
translation_verse: Míǹ ní u dī ti-Dindaan Yeesu Kriisitoo pu ki ŋá kii dooooyee u nín kaa nìn dáá náań duulinya ki lēē yii u làá dāá ŋá miŋyee.

english_verse: Christ now gives us courage and confidence, so we can come to God by faith.
translation_verse: Ti nín fōō Yeesu Kriisitoo ki kíí ti nì u ŋá ubaantee puee, ti ŋūǹ kí sútí kí pìl̄ Unimbɔti sɔkɔmii nì dimákal poon.

english_verse: This is why you should not be discouraged when I suffer for you. After all, it will bring honor to you. Christ's Love for Us
translation_verse: Míǹ puee, m mèé-ni yii m nín bíi jīǹ falaa ni-puee, ni-wunti ń taa yɔ̀tī. M-falaauee sá-ni tinyool ní. Yeesu Kriisitoo neendi

english_verse: I kneel in prayer to the Father.
translation_verse: An pu ní m gbàantí ti-Baa Unimbɔti nimbiin ki mèé ni-pu.

english_verse: All beings in heaven and on earth receive their life from him.
translation_verse: Úǹ cee ní bin bí yilpuee nì bin bí taapuee kíǹ ki nyí kubaatiiu.

english_verse: God is wonderful and glorious. I pray that his Spirit will make you become strong followers
translation_verse: Úǹ di sá tinyooldaan ki cáá tikɔkɔ, an puee ní m mèé-u án nín làá ŋá pu u-Fam ń tīī-ni mpɔn tikpil ni-pɔbiliŋinee.

english_verse: and that Christ will live in your hearts because of your faith. Stand firm and be deeply rooted in his love.
translation_verse: M gíti mèé-u yii Kriisitoo ń nīn bí ni-pɔbiliŋin, kun puee ni fōō ki kíí. M mèé-u yii ú yàntī ní nīn néeń tɔb kí báań inyaan, kí nīn yú ki pɔ̄ɔ̄,

english_verse: I pray that you and all God's people will understand what is called wide or long or high or deep.
translation_verse: ní ni nì Unimbɔti yab kɔkɔ ń ŋmā kí ká mpɔn kí gbìl̄ Kriisitoo neendi nín lālim̀ ki gbí ilaan kɔkɔ puee.

english_verse: I want you to know all about Christ's love, although it is too wonderful to be measured. Then your lives will be filled with all that God is.
translation_verse: Nì min kɔkɔ u-neendi wīikí tikpil ki jítiǹ unil nín ŋūǹ kí gbìl̄ miŋyee, m mèé-u yii ú yàntī ní béé, án nín làá ŋá pu tin kɔkɔ bí Unimbɔtinee ń nīn bí ni mun nee.

english_verse: I pray that Christ Jesus and the church will forever bring praise to God. His power at work in us can do far more than we dare ask or imagine. Amen.
translation_verse: Yeesu Kriisitoo puee, Kriisitoo Nikitil ń tīī Unimbɔti tinyool ŋyunti kamaa kí nīn pée cáa cá jaanjaan! Ameeni.

english_verse: As a prisoner of the Lord, I beg you to live in a way that is worthy of the people God has chosen to be his own.
translation_verse: An puee, man Pɔɔl un bí sarkan m nín nóó ti-Dindaanee puee, m mèé-ni yii ní nīn bí mbimbim min poon Unimbɔti yíiń-ni ní nīn bée.

english_verse: Always be humble and gentle. Patiently put up with each other and love each other.
translation_verse: Ní nīn sìntīǹ ni-ba taapu kí nīn mɔ̄, kí nīn cáá kimɔtii tɔb pu, kí nīn ŋúb́maan tɔb nì dineendi poon.

english_verse: Try your best to let God's Spirit keep your hearts united. Do this by living at peace.
translation_verse: Ní pɔ́ɔǹ ni-ba kí nīn ŋúb́ nnyɔɔpee ŋun Unimbɔti Fam tìì-nee, ŋgbansɔŋfi ń nīn bí ni-kansikin ní ŋá ubaanti.

english_verse: All of you are part of the same body. There is only one Spirit of God, just as you were given one hope when you were chosen to be God's people.
translation_verse: Yeesu wunti sá tibaantiil ní, ní Unimbɔti Fam mun sá mbaantiim. Míǹ ní ti-kɔkɔ máká kuwambaantiiu kun pu Unimbɔti yíiń-nee.

english_verse: We have only one Lord, one faith, and one baptism.
translation_verse: Ti-kɔkɔ Dindaan sá ubaanti, ní ti-fookiiu sá ubaanti, ní Unimbɔti nyim fàltam sá mbaantiim.

english_verse: There is one God who is the Father of all people. Not only is God above all others, but he works by using all of us, and he lives in all of us.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti sá ubaanti, ki sá tikɔkɔ Baa, ki tɔ́kɔ́ tikɔkɔ pu, ki dì tikɔkɔ pu ki tūǹ u-tundi ní ki bí tikɔkɔn.

english_verse: Christ has generously divided out his gifts to us.
translation_verse: Un sá kamaa fōō dipɔl kii Kriisitoo nín tīī-u puee.

english_verse: As the Scriptures say, “When he went up to the highest place, he led away many prisoners and gave gifts to people.”
translation_verse: Kii an nín ŋmàn̄ Unimbɔti gbɔŋku poon puee yii: «U nín jɔ́ḿ yilpuee, u kpáaǹ iyumbu ní ki pú binib apɔl.»

english_verse: When it says, “he went up,” it means that Christ had been deep in the earth.
translation_verse: Mimmee, dinyɔɔbundi din lī yii: «U jɔ́m̀ yilpuee» là kí lì yii ba dee? An taapu di sá yii u nìn dáá sīntìń taapu doo nee ní.

english_verse: This also means that the one who went deep into the earth is the same one who went into the highest heaven, so he would fill the whole universe.
translation_verse: Yeesu Kriisitoo un sīntìń taapu dooyee, úǹ ubaantee di tí jɔ́m̀ yilpu fɔ́ŋŋŋ kí gbí duulinya kɔkɔn.

english_verse: This will continue until we are united by our faith and by our understanding of the Son of God. Then we will be mature, just as Christ is, and we will be completely like him.
translation_verse: Míǹ di làá yàntī ti-kɔkɔ ń kpántí ubaanti ti nín fōō Unimbɔti Jipɔɔn Yeesu Kriisitoo ki kííyee pu, ní kí béé-u mbaamɔm. Mimmee, ti cíkití Unimbɔti bɔtin ní kí kpántí biniŋmambi, kii Kriisitoo u-ba nín bí puee.

english_verse: We must stop acting like children. We must not let deceitful people trick us by their false teachings, which are like winds that toss us around from place to place.
translation_verse: Ŋyunti gbantee, taa ti sá kii campɔntibee biŋmatinliibi cáá bi-bɔti ki ŋmàtíǹ-ti kii nnyim nì kubuŋu nín téekí buŋalimbu pu bu yìiǹ ajan kɔkɔ puee.

english_verse: Love should always make us tell the truth. Then we will grow in every way and be more like Christ, the head
translation_verse: Ama ti máaǹ kí nīn cáá dineendi ki sòoǹ Yeesu bɔti nì ibaamɔn, kí nīn wīintí kí tin ŋmàntīǹ Kriisitoo un sá u-nikitil yilee.

english_verse: of the body. Christ holds it together and makes all of its parts work perfectly, as it grows and becomes strong because of love. The Old Life and the New Life
translation_verse: Úǹ di kpáfì u-nikitil din sá u-wuntee, bi ŋá ubaanti, kii unil wunti jaŋŋi nín kpáfì ki nɔ̀b̄ tɔb pu puee. Ajan kɔkɔ yaa tūǹ ŋi-tundi nín sá puee, tiwun wīintí ní tiŋan. Míǹ ní dineendi yaa bí Kriisitoo nikitil kansikinee, dì cá nyɔkɔpu ní tiŋan. Kriisitoo yab bí dimaŋfapɔndin

english_verse: As a follower of the Lord, I order you to stop living like stupid, godless people.
translation_verse: Tibɔti tin m làá sòoǹ nì ni nee, ti-Dindaan nyɔkɔpu ní m làá sòoǹ-tì. Ni-bimbim ń taa nín̄ bí kii bin kaa nyí Unimbɔtee nín bí puee. Bíǹ nóó bi-landɔkɔkulimii ní.

english_verse: Their minds are in the dark, and they are stubborn and ignorant and have missed out on the life that comes from God. They no longer have any feelings about what is right,
translation_verse: Bi-pɔbiliŋ nín gbìfì baa nyí nnimbɔtisanee pu ní bi dáá bí dibɔmbɔndin ki lántì dimaŋfal din Unimbɔti tīīyee.

english_verse: and they are so greedy they do all kinds of indecent things.
translation_verse: Baa nyí icoo, ki dū bi-ba ki tīī atuŋkpiti ní ki ŋáań tijɔkɔndi kɔkɔ nì ti-bulifi ki cá, kaa gbèentí.

english_verse: But this isn't what you were taught about Jesus Christ. He is the truth, and you heard about him and learned about him.
translation_verse: Ni lafun gbìl̄ tikɔkɔ u-pu, ní bi dàkā-ni ni béè ibaamɔn in bí Yeesunee.

english_verse: Let the Spirit change your way of thinking
translation_verse: Ní yàntī Unimbɔti ń kpántí ni-pɔbiliŋ nì ni-landɔkɔi mpɔm.

english_verse: and make you into a new person. You were created to be like God, and so you must please him and be truly holy. Rules for the New Life
translation_verse: Ní nīn nóómaan mbimbipɔm min Unimbɔti náań ki nántiǹ u-yam min sá deedee nì circir ki nyánní ibaamɔnnee.

english_verse: We are part of the same body. Stop lying and start telling each other the truth.
translation_verse: An puee, ní fá inyimɔn. Báà ŋma ń sòoǹ u-juti ibaamɔn, kun puee ti-kɔkɔ kpáfì ki ŋá tiwumbaantiil ní.

english_verse: Don't get so angry that you sin. Don't go to bed angry
translation_verse: Ni yaa fōō diŋuulee, ní nīn nyí nì ni-ba kí taa kɔ́ ikpitin, kí taa nín̄ díkí diŋuul míǹ áli kunyeeu ń tin mɔ́.

english_verse: and don't give the devil a chance.
translation_verse: Ní taa pɔ̄maan Sitaan nsan.

english_verse: If you are a thief, quit stealing. Be honest and work hard, so you will have something to give to people in need.
translation_verse: Un nìn sá unaayuuyee ń taa ti yɔ̀. Ú pɔ́ɔǹ u-ba kí tɔ̄ ditundi min máaǹee kí kpíiǹ u-ba kí ká kí tūtuǹ uwɔfi.

english_verse: Stop all your dirty talk. Say the right thing at the right time and help others by what you say.
translation_verse: Tibɔkpitil ń taa nín̄ nyēē ni-nyɔmmun, ama ni yaa làá sòoǹee, nín̄ sòom̀maan tin làá tūtuǹ bin fōō Yeesu ki kííyee ń cù nyɔkɔpu, kí kèetī bin bí ki pílifée mun.

english_verse: Don't make God's Spirit sad. The Spirit makes you sure that someday you will be free from your sins.
translation_verse: Ní taa kɔ́ǹ Unimbɔti Fam kunimbaau, u-Famee ní u dūu dáań-ni ki síiǹ yii ŋwiin ŋubɔ dòoń u làá dāá fīī-ni kí líí kɔkɔ.

english_verse: Stop being bitter and angry and mad at others. Don't yell at one another or curse each other or ever be rude.
translation_verse: Ní nyāntímaan ni-kansikin ntuntun nì kináŋ nì diŋuul tɔb pu, nì kujaau, nì tɔb boon disambiil, kí kúntímaan ntoom nì mi-yalii kɔkɔ.

english_verse: Instead, be kind and merciful, and forgive others, just as God forgave you because of Christ.
translation_verse: Ama nín̄ sámaan binimɔntiibi, kí nīn sūǹ tɔb saai, kí nīn pūǹ tɔb kpitii, kii Kriisitoo puee, Unimbɔti nín dū ni mun kpitii ki pú-ni puee.

english_verse: Do as God does. After all, you are his dear children.
translation_verse: Ni nín sá Unimbɔti biyaamu mun u néeńee puee, nín̄ bímaan kii úǹ nín bí puee.

english_verse: Let love be your guide. Christ loved us and offered his life for us as a sacrifice that pleases God.
translation_verse: Ní nīn ŋáaḿmaan tikɔkɔ nì dineendi poon, kii Kriisitoo nín néeń-ti pu, ki dū u-ba ki ŋá saraa ki tīī Unimbɔti ti-pu u-saraauee fáatì Unimbɔtee.

english_verse: You are God's people, so don't let it be said that any of you are immoral or indecent or greedy.
translation_verse: Kɔŋkɔnnee ni sá Unimbɔti yab ní, an puee, an yaa sá tilaakpaal nì tin kɔkɔ pée sá dijɔkɔntundi nì nnimbitaataamee, bí taa gbìl̄ an bɔti pu gba ni-kansikin.

english_verse: Don't use dirty or foolish or filthy words. Instead, say how thankful you are.
translation_verse: An kaa ŋān̄ ní nīn sòoǹ anyɔɔbuŋkpil nì tibɔfan nì icoo bɔti, ama an ŋān̄ yii ní nīn pàkà Unimbɔti ní.

english_verse: Being greedy, indecent, or immoral is just another way of worshiping idols. You can be sure people who behave in this way will never be part of the kingdom that belongs to Christ and to God. Living as People of Light
translation_verse: Ní nīn nyí yii bin ŋáań tilaakpaal nì tin pée sá dijɔkɔntundee, nì bin cáá nnimbitaataamee: kun puee nnimbitaataam sá kii iwaatootee ní. An nibee kɔkɔ kaa làá dāá kɔ́ Kriisitoo nì Unimbɔti Beelin.

english_verse: Don't let anyone trick you with foolish talk. God punishes everyone who disobeys him and says foolish things.
translation_verse: Ní taa yàntī báà ubɔ ń dū tibɔfan kí ŋmàtiǹ-ni. An tuŋkpitiŋ pu ní Unimbɔti làá dāá fōō diŋuul bin kaa tɔ́-uee pu.

english_verse: So don't have anything to do with anyone like that.
translation_verse: An puee, ní taa cèeǹ bi-ni.

english_verse: You used to be like people living in the dark, but now you are people of the light because you belong to the Lord. So act like people of the light
translation_verse: Dooooyee, ni nìn dáá bí dibɔmbɔndin ní, ama kɔŋkɔnnee ni kɔ́ ŋwalifin, kun puee ni kpántì ti-Dindaan yab. Míǹ puee ni-bimbim ń nīn bí kii bin bí ŋwalifinee bimbim nín bí puee.

english_verse: and make your light shine. Be good and honest and truthful,
translation_verse: Kun puee ŋwalifi nín tìì tiŋyee di sá tiŋan kamaa nì deedee nì ibaamɔn.

english_verse: as you try to please the Lord.
translation_verse: Pɔ́ɔm̀maan ni-ba kí béé min fáatì ti-Dindaanee.

english_verse: Don't take part in doing those worthless things that are done in the dark. Instead, show how wrong they are.
translation_verse: Ní taa dū ni-ba kí cèeǹ bin sá dibɔmbɔndi yab ki tūǹ atuun ŋin kaa cáá ipaatee poon, ama ní nyāntí bi-tuŋkpitiŋ mpaampiin pu.

english_verse: It is disgusting even to talk about what is done in the dark.
translation_verse: An cáá icoo gba tí sòoǹ bi nín ŋáań tin dibalinee.

english_verse: But the light will show what these things are really like.
translation_verse: Bi yaa nyántì tin bi ŋáańee mpaampiin puee, ní ni béetí tin ní an baasii sée.

english_verse: Light shows up everything, just as the Scriptures say, “Wake up from your sleep and rise from death. Then Christ will shine on you.”
translation_verse: Kun puee tin kɔkɔ nyáń ŋwalifinee ní bi wāĺ, an pu ní an lī yii: «Sii un gèeǹee, fìntī, fìntī bitaŋkpiibi kansikin Kriisitoo ń ŋmíntí-si.»

english_verse: These are evil times, so make every minute count.
translation_verse: Ní taa nín̄ bíiĺ iyunti kun puee, iyunti in poon ti bí nee, ikpiti wíiǹ tikpil.

english_verse: Don't be stupid. Instead, find out what the Lord wants you to do.
translation_verse: Ní taa nín̄ sá bigbaambi, ama béémaan ti-Dindaan nín là ní nīn ŋáań miŋyee.

english_verse: Don't destroy yourself by getting drunk, but let the Spirit fill your life.
translation_verse: Ní taa nín̄ nyù idafi ki gbéè, kun puee an di bíiĺ unil, ama ní nīn gbéèmaan Unimbɔti Fam.

english_verse: When you meet together, sing psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs, as you praise the Lord with all your heart.
translation_verse: Ní nīn gà ni-kansikin ilan in bí Inyɔŋki laŋyi gbɔŋkunee nì Kriisitoo nikitil laŋyi, nì ilan in Unimbɔti Fam tìì-nee, kí nīn cáámaan an laŋyi ki gà ki tìì ti-Dindaan, kí nīn nyɔ́ŋkí-u nì ni-pɔbiliŋ kɔkɔ.

english_verse: Always use the name of our Lord Jesus Christ to thank God the Father for everything. Wives and Husbands
translation_verse: Nín̄ jáaḿmaan ti-Baa Unimbɔti ti-Dindaan Yeesu Kriisitoo yindi pu ŋyunti kamaa nì tikɔkɔ pu. Binimpoobi nì bi-calib bɔti

english_verse: Honor Christ and put others first.
translation_verse: Nimbi bin tɔ́ Kriisitooyee, sìntīmaan ni-ba taapu kí tīī man tɔb.

english_verse: A wife should put her husband first, as she does the Lord.
translation_verse: Nimbi binimpoobee, sìntīmaan ni-ba taapu kí tīī ni-calib kii ni nín fàŋkí ti-Dindaan puee.

english_verse: A husband is the head of his wife, as Christ is the head and the Savior of the church, which is his own body.
translation_verse: Kun puee uninja di sá unimpu yidaaŋwu, kii Kriisitoo nín sá uyidaan ki sá Ufiil ki tīī u-nikitil din sá u-wuntee puee.

english_verse: Wives should always put their husbands first, as the church puts Christ first.
translation_verse: Míǹ puee, binimpoobi máaǹ kí sìntīǹ bi-ba taapu tikɔkɔ poon kí tīī bi-calib, kii Kriisitoo nikitil nín sīntiǹ di-ba ki tīī-u puee.

english_verse: A husband should love his wife as much as Christ loved the church and gave his life for it.
translation_verse: Nimbi bininjabee, nín̄ néeḿmaan ni-nimpoobi, kii Kriisitoo nín néeń u-nikitil pu ki kpíì di-puee.

english_verse: He made the church holy by the power of his word, and he made it pure by washing it with water.
translation_verse: U ŋá míǹ u-nikitil ń nīn bí circir ní, di sá u fùl̄-bi nnyim ní ki dū u-nyɔɔbundi ki ŋáŋkì-bi.

english_verse: Christ did this, so he would have a glorious and holy church, without faults or spots or wrinkles or any other flaws.
translation_verse: Di sá yii u gāntì-bi bí dāan̄ Unimbɔti nimbiin nì kunyaaŋŋu, kí nīn jɔ̀m̀ pɔ́lpɔl kí nīn bí circir, bí taa ká bi-pu tiba.

english_verse: In the same way, a husband should love his wife as much as he loves himself. A husband who loves his wife shows he loves himself.
translation_verse: Míǹ mbaantiim ní bininjab mun máaǹ kí nīn néeń bi-nimpoobi kii bi nín néeń bíǹ bi-ba wunti puee. Un yaa néeń u-nimpuuee néeń u-ba dee.

english_verse: None of us hate our own bodies. We provide for them and take good care of them, just as Christ does for the church,
translation_verse: Kun puee ubɔ kaa bí ki ná u-ba wunti, ama u kpīintí-tì, ní ki kpèé-tì tiŋan, kii Kriisitoo nín kpèé u-nikitil puee.

english_verse: because we are each part of his body.
translation_verse: Di sá yii ti-kɔkɔ túkú u-wunti pu ní,

english_verse: As the Scriptures say, “A man leaves his father and mother to get married, and he becomes like one person with his wife.”
translation_verse: kii an nín ŋmàn̄ Unimbɔti gbɔŋku poon puee yii: «An pu ní uninja dāa nyēē u-baa nì u-na cee, ní u nì u-nimpuu ń nīn kíǹ ki bí, ní bi-liitilee ń kpántí unibaanti.»

english_verse: This is a great mystery, but I understand it to mean Christ and his church.
translation_verse: An sá tibɔkpaandi ní dijandi nee dàkà-ti. M làá tùkù-ni yii an sòoǹ Kriisitoo nì u-nikitil pu ní.

english_verse: So each husband should love his wife as much as he loves himself, and each wife should respect her husband.
translation_verse: Ama tin kíǹee di sá yii nimbee, báà ŋma ń nīn néeń u-nimpuu kii úǹ u-bee, ní unimpu mun ń nīn tɔ́ u-cal.

english_verse: Children, you belong to the Lord, and you do the right thing when you obey your parents. The first commandment with a promise says,
translation_verse: Mbiyaamu, ni nín sá ti-Dindaan yabee puee, ní nīn tɔ́ ni-baabi nì ni-nab, kun puee míǹ di ŋān̄.

english_verse: Parents, don't be hard on your children. Raise them properly. Teach them and instruct them about the Lord. Slaves and Masters
translation_verse: Nimbi bibaatiibee, ní taa nín̄ kɔ̄ntí ni-biyaamu aŋuu, ama nín̄ ŋúb́maan-mu, kí nīn dàkà-mu, ki sáŋkí-mu kii ti-Dindaan nín dàkà miŋyee. Iyumbu nì i-dindambi bɔti

english_verse: Slaves, you must obey your earthly masters. Show them great respect and be as loyal to them as you are to Christ.
translation_verse: Nimbi iyumbuee, nín̄ tɔ́maan ni-dindambi nì ni-pɔbiliŋ kɔkɔ kí nīn fàŋkí-bi. Ni yaa ŋáań mimmee, ni tɔ́ Kriisitoo dee.

english_verse: Try to please them at all times, and not just when you think they are watching. You are slaves of Christ, so with your whole heart you must do what God wants you to do.
translation_verse: An kaa sá bi yaa bée ŋmaniŋma ní ní nīn tūǹ atuun, bí wāl̀ kí pàkà-ni. Ama ni nín sá Kriisitoo yumbuyee puee, ní nīn ŋáań min fáatì Unimbɔtee nì dipɔbil diba.

english_verse: Gladly serve your masters, as though they were the Lord himself, and not simply people.
translation_verse: Ní tɔ̄maan ditundi míǹ mbaantiim kí tīī ni-dindambi kii ti-Dindaan u-ba ní ni tūǹ ki tììyee, an taa nín̄ sá kii binib ní ni tūǹ ki tììyee.

english_verse: You know that you will be rewarded for any good things you do, whether you are slaves or free.
translation_verse: Ní nīn nyí yii uyumbuɔɔɔ, un yì u-beeyaaa, ti-Dindaan làá dāá pà báà ŋma tummɔntiŋ ŋin u ŋée paati ní.

english_verse: Slave owners, you must treat your slaves with this same respect. Don't threaten them. They have the same Master in heaven that you do, and he doesn't have favorites. The Fight against Evil
translation_verse: Nimbi iyumbu dindambee, ni mun ń nīn ŋáaḿmaan ni-yumbui tiŋan mbaantiim kí taa nín̄ yòontí i-pɔbiliŋ. Ní nīn nyí yii nimbi nì ni-yumbuuyee, ni-kɔkɔ kpiliu sá ubaanti ní ki bí yilpu, úǹ kaa gàntī binib. Tijanjawan tin Unimbɔti tììyee

english_verse: Finally, let the mighty strength of the Lord make you strong.
translation_verse: Tibɔjoolkaal tin m làá dūú kàan̄-nee sèé: ní fōōmaan ti-Dindaan pɔŋkpaaŋŋu kí pɔ̄ɔkì.

english_verse: Put on all the armor that God gives, so you can defend yourself against the devil's tricks.
translation_verse: Ní dū tijanjawan tin kɔkɔ Unimbɔti tììyee kí pèen̄ kí ŋmā kí sīĺ deedee ŋyunti ŋun Sitaan yaa yíkìń ni-pu nì u-kīiltamee.

english_verse: We are not fighting against humans. We are fighting against forces and authorities and against rulers of darkness and powers in the spiritual world.
translation_verse: Kun puee an kaa sá ti làá jáǹ binib ní, an sá ti nì arasiniibi nì bi-bɔtiibi, nì bin kɔkɔ jīǹ abee dibɔmbɔndin, duulinyan dooyee, nì arasiniibi bin bí kutaa puee ní ti làá jáǹ.

english_verse: So put on all the armor that God gives. Then when that evil day comes, you will be able to defend yourself. And when the battle is over, you will still be standing firm.
translation_verse: An puee, fōōmaan tijanjawan tin kɔkɔ Unimbɔti tììyee, án nín làá ŋá pu ní an yaa láa píĺ ki pɔ́ɔkèe, ní ŋmā kí yūĺ kí já kí pɔ̄ɔkèe. Ni yaa jáń ki pɔ́ɔkèe, ní ní báań kí yūĺ.

english_verse: Be ready! Let the truth be like a belt around your waist, and let God's justice protect you like armor.
translation_verse: An puee ní bɔ́ntí ni-ba kí dū ibaamɔn in sá-ni dambalee kí gbìn̄ ni-cammu, ni-deedeeu ń nīn sá-ni dijanjabɔkutil ní dūú pèen̄.

english_verse: Your desire to tell the good news about peace should be like shoes on your feet.
translation_verse: Difaŋgiil din ni cáá ki sòoǹ Tibɔmɔntiil tin tìì binib ŋgbansɔŋfee ń nīn sá-ni anaataka ní táká.

english_verse: Let your faith be like a shield, and you will be able to stop all the flaming arrows of the evil one.
translation_verse: Ni-fookiiu un ni cáá Unimbɔti puee ń nīn sá-ni digbampɔɔl ní dūú gbíntí Sitaan ukpiti piiŋyi in u tòoń i sá ŋŋmee.

english_verse: Let God's saving power be like a helmet, and for a sword use God's message that comes from the Spirit.
translation_verse: Ní fōō difiil dí nīn sá-ni kijanjafuulii ní cíkiń, kí yòom̄maan kitàataajiki kin Unimbɔti Fam tììyee mun, an dàkà yii Unimbɔti nyɔɔbundi.

english_verse: Never stop praying, especially for others. Always pray by the power of the Spirit. Stay alert and keep praying for God's people.
translation_verse: Ní nīn mèémaan kí taa gbèen̄. Ní yàntī Circir Fam ń kpòotī-ni ni-wimmeem nì tin kɔkɔ ni bàlifēe poon. Ní fìntīmaan an bɔti pu, kí nīn mèémaan múlmul ki tìì Kriisitoo yab kɔkɔ.

english_verse: Pray that I will be given the message to speak and that I may fearlessly explain the mystery about the good news.
translation_verse: Mèèmaan Unimbɔti ma mun pu, ú tīī-mi tibɔti tin máaǹ ḿ sòoǹee, ḿ ŋmā kí sòoǹ Tibɔmɔntiil tin nìn bí dibalinee nì tininjati.

english_verse: I was sent to do this work, and this is the reason I am in jail. So pray that I will be brave and will speak as I should. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Nì min kɔkɔ m bí sarka poonee, man di sá un Yeesu Kriisitoo túnní, ḿ nīn sòoǹ Tibɔmɔntiil gbantee. An puee ní mèè Unimbɔti, án nín làá ŋá pu ḿ sòoǹ-tì ti-pú nì tininjatee. Tibɔjoolkaal nì ijaam

english_verse: I pray that God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will give peace, love, and faith to every follower!
translation_verse: Ti-Baa Unimbɔti nì ti-Dindaan Yeesu Kriisitoo ń tīī nnabiyaamu kɔkɔ ŋgbansɔŋfi, kí yàntī bí nīn néeń tɔb, kí nīn gbíntìi cáá fookii Unimbɔti pu.

english_verse: May God be kind to everyone who keeps on loving our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti ŋanti ń nīn bí bin kɔkɔ cáá ti-Dindaan Yeesu Kriisitoo pu dineendi kaa gbèentée pu.

english_verse: From Paul and Timothy, servants of Christ Jesus. To all God's people who belong to Christ Jesus at Philippi and to all your bishops and deacons.
translation_verse: Man Pɔɔl nì Tiimootee, timbi bin sá Yeesu Kriisitoo tɔntɔnliibee, di ŋmàn̄ kugbɔŋu nee. Ti ŋmàn̄-ku kí tīī nimbi bin sá Unimbɔti yab ki kóò Fiiliipi tiŋkin ki fōō Yeesu Kriisitoo ki kííyee, ki kpáaǹ bin kpòotī Kriisitoo nikitilee nì bin tútúǹ ditundi Kriisitoo nikitil kansikinee.

english_verse: I pray that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! Paul's Prayer for the Church in Philippi
translation_verse: Ti-Baa Unimbɔti nì ti-Dindaan Yeesu Kriisitoo ń ŋá-ni tiŋan kí tīī-ni ŋgbansɔŋfi. Pɔɔl mēē ki tīī Fiiliipi tiŋki yab

english_verse: Every time I think of you, I thank my God.
translation_verse: Ŋyunti sá kamaa, m yaa bíi dàkafī ni-bɔtee, m jáaḿ Unimbɔti ni-pu.

english_verse: And whenever I mention you in my prayers, it makes me happy.
translation_verse: Ŋyunti kamaa m yaa bíi mèé ni-kɔkɔ puee, m mèé nì dipɔɔpindi ní.

english_verse: This is because you have taken part with me in spreading the good news from the first day you heard about it.
translation_verse: Di sá ni nìn tútuǹ-ti, kí yòon̄ ŋwimpeepeekaa ŋun ni fōō Yeesu ki kííyee ki dāa dūu sāā díǹ, tí ŋmā kí sòoǹ Tibɔmɔntiil ajan kɔkɔ pu.

english_verse: God is the one who began this good work in you, and I am certain that he won't stop before it is complete on the day that Christ Jesus returns.
translation_verse: M nyí yii Unimbɔti un kíĺ ki bíi tūǹ ditummɔntiil nee ni-pɔbiliŋ poonee kaa làá gbèen̄. U làá nīn pée gbíntìi tūǹ míǹ ní kí nīn pée cí Yeesu Kriisitoo gítintam wiiŋŋu.

english_verse: You have a special place in my heart. So it is only natural for me to feel the way I do. All of you have helped in the work God has given me, as I defend the good news and tell about it here in jail.
translation_verse: An kítì ḿ nīn dàkafī ni-kɔkɔ pu míǹ ní, kun puee ni-bɔti kɔ́-mi tiŋan. Di sá yii, m yaa bí sarkanaaa, m yaa tí bí ki dàkà ki cántí Tibɔmɔntiilee baamɔŋyi nín sá pueeyaaa, ni-kɔkɔ kútí m-pu ki fòol̄ diyimɔɔbaantiil din Unimbɔti tīī-mee.

english_verse: God himself knows how much I want to see you. He knows I care for you in the same way Christ Jesus does.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti u-ba nyí yii m néeń ni-kɔkɔ nì dineembaamɔndi din nyánní Yeesu Kriisitoo ceeyee ní.

english_verse: I pray that your love will keep on growing and you will fully know and understand
translation_verse: M nín mèé ni-pu tiŋyee di sá yii Unimbɔti ń yàntī ni-neendi ń nīn wīintí ki cá baabadal, ní nīn mɔ̀tīi béetí ibaamɔn ki gàntī tiŋan nì tikpitil,

english_verse: how to make the right choices. Then you will still be pure and innocent when Christ returns. And until that day,
translation_verse: án nín làá ŋá pu ní ŋmā kí lēē tin kítèe. Ní Kriisitoo gítintam wiiŋŋu dalee, ní dāá nīn bí circir, bí taa ká ni-pu tiba.

english_verse: Jesus Christ will keep you busy doing good deeds that bring glory and praise to God. What Life Means to Paul
translation_verse: Yeesu Kriisitoo puee, ni làá dāá lòoǹ abil tikpil ŋin sá deedee tuuŋŋi ŋin tìì Unimbɔti tinyool nì inyɔŋkee. Kriisitoo di sá dimaŋfal

english_verse: My dear friends, I want you to know that what has happened to me has helped to spread the good news.
translation_verse: Nnabiyaamu, m là ní béé yii sarka un bi cúú-mi nee di yāntì ní Yeesu bɔti sòontam cūtì nyɔkɔpu malaa.

english_verse: The Roman guards and all the others know I am here in jail because I serve Christ.
translation_verse: Di sá yii gɔminakpaan kàliŋkpilib kɔkɔ nì bin kɔ kíǹee béè yii an sá Kriisitoo un m nóóyee pu ní m bí sarkan.

english_verse: Now most of the Lord's followers have become brave and are fearlessly telling the message.
translation_verse: Áli gba, man sarkau nee pu ní ti-nabiyaamu tikpil mɔ̀tīi dù bi-mákal ki ŋáań ti-Dindaan ni, ki kāntí kunyannyaau ki sòoǹ Unimbɔti bɔti, kaa fàŋkí.

english_verse: Some are preaching about Christ because they are jealous and envious of us. Others are preaching because they want to help.
translation_verse: Ama bi-kansikin bibee, an sá kináŋ kin bi cáá m-puee di yì-tì ní bi sòoǹ Kriisitoo bɔti ki kpākantí-mi, ní bin kíǹee, bíǹ baasii sòoǹ Unimbɔti bɔti nì nlandɔkɔmɔnti.

english_verse: They love Christ and know I am here to defend the good news about him.
translation_verse: Bin sòoǹ Unimbɔti bɔti nì nlandɔkɔmɔntee, bíǹ néeń-mi ní ki nyí yii Unimbɔti lēē-mi ḿ nīn dàkà yii Kriisitoo bɔti sá ibaamɔn.

english_verse: But the ones who are jealous of us are not sincere. They just want to cause trouble for me while I am in jail.
translation_verse: Ama bin béeyee, bíǹ sòoǹ Kriisitoo bɔti nì ilandɔkɔkpiti ki là kí kpákáǹ-mi, ki nyàab̀ kí gíti kɔ́ǹ-mi digìńdi kí kūtì sarka un poon m bí nee.

english_verse: But that doesn't matter. All that matters is that people are telling about Christ, whether they are sincere or not. This is what makes me glad. I will keep on being glad,
translation_verse: Bi yaa sòoǹ Unimbɔti bɔti ki là kí kpákáǹ-maaa, an yaa tí sá nì dipɔɔmɔntiilaaa, tíǹ kaa wù-mi. An sá man dipɔɔpindi ní ki làá nīn pée mɔ̄ǹ-mi ki cá, kun puee Kriisitoo bɔti ní bi-kɔkɔ sòoǹ.

english_verse: because I know that your prayers and the help that comes from the Spirit of Christ Jesus will keep me safe.
translation_verse: Di sá m nyí yii, nì ni-wimmeem pu, nì Yeesu Kriisitoo Fam tūtuntam puee, m làá ká difiil.

english_verse: I honestly expect and hope I will never do anything to be ashamed of. Whether I live or die, I always want to be as brave as I am now and bring honor to Christ.
translation_verse: M nín là tiwan tin ki cí tikpil ki cɔ́tí ti-puee di sá icoo ń taa cúú-mi tiba pu. Ama kɔŋkɔnnee kí nīn cée, m yaa làá kpúɔɔɔ, m yaa làá nīn tí báaa, ḿ mɔ̀tīí nīn cáá dipɔbil, m-wunti ń tīī Kriisitoo tinyool.

english_verse: If I live, it will be for Christ, and if I die, I will gain even more.
translation_verse: Ama mamee, Kriisitoo di sá man maŋfal, ní ŋkúm cāabìń-mi ipaati.

english_verse: I don't know what to choose. I could keep on living and doing something useful.
translation_verse: An yaa tí sá ḿ nīn bí dimaŋfal poon kí ŋmā kí tɔ̄ atummɔnti abaaa, maa nyí laakin m làá lēēyee.

english_verse: It is a hard choice to make. I want to die and be with Christ, because this would be much better.
translation_verse: Ajan gbanti liitil bí ki dátí-mi, m bàà là kí kpú kí cùú nīn kā Kriisitoo cee, míǹ di bàà ŋān̄ tikpil.

english_verse: But I know that all of you still need me. This is why I am sure I will stay on to help you grow and be happy in your faith.
translation_verse: M nín béè yii an sá mimmee, ní m nyí yii m làá nīn bí dimaŋfalin, man nì ni kɔkɔ làá nīn bí, ḿ tūtuǹ-ni ní ŋmā kí cù nyɔkɔpu, kí nīn bí dipɔɔpindin Unimbɔti saŋŋu poon.

english_verse: Then, when I visit you again, you will have good reason to take great pride in Christ Jesus because of me.
translation_verse: Mimmee m yaa fātìi tí gítìń ni-kansikinee, man puee, án làá dāá nīn mɔ̄ǹ-ni ki gíti lákatì ni nì Yeesu Kriisitoo nín ŋá ubaantee pu.

english_verse: Above all else, you must live in a way that brings honor to the good news about Christ. Then, whether I visit you or not, I will hear that all of you think alike. I will know that you are working together and are struggling side by side to get others to believe the good news.
translation_verse: Tin páb́ee di sá ni-bimbim ń nīn táá nì Kriisitoo Bɔmɔntiiti, ní báà m yaa dɔ́miń ni-ceeyaaa, m yaa kaa dɔ́mińaaa, ḿ nīn gbìl̀ bi sòoǹ ni nín pēē kinyɔkɔ pu ki báaǹ inyaan, ki jáà nì dipɔbil diba Tibɔmɔntiilee ń cù nyɔkɔpuee.

english_verse: Be brave when you face your enemies. Your courage will show them that they are going to be destroyed, and it will show you that you will be saved. God will make all of this happen,
translation_verse: Ní taa yàntī ni-nannanliibi ń fàaǹ-ni tiba poon. Ni nín bí miŋyee di làá dàkà bíǹ yii bi wáŋkì, ní kí dàkà nimbi yii ni yú difiil saŋŋu pu. Unimbɔti di làá yàntī bí béé míǹ.

english_verse: and he has blessed you. Not only do you have faith in Christ, but you suffer for him.
translation_verse: Di sá yii u pú-ni diyimɔɔl ní nīn nóó Kriisitoo kí taa fōō-u kí kíí ŋmaniŋma, ama ní jī falaa mun u-pu.

english_verse: You saw me suffer, and you still hear about my troubles. Now you must suffer in the same way.
translation_verse: Kɔŋkɔnnee, man nì ni kɔkɔ di kpáfì ki bí dimool poon. Dooooyee ní ni nìn ká yii m bí dimool gbantin, ní ni gbìl̄ yii m dáá gbíntìi bí ki mɔ̀ áli nìn díǹ.

english_verse: Christ encourages you, and his love comforts you. God's Spirit unites you, and you are concerned for others.
translation_verse: Yeesu Kriisitoo cee ní ni ká kunyannyaau ní u-neendi tīī-ni dipɔɔsɔŋkil, ni nì Unimbɔti Fam ŋá ubaanti, ni néeń tɔb ki sūǹ tɔb saai, kaa sá mimmaaa?

english_verse: Now make me completely happy! Live in harmony by showing love for each other. Be united in what you think, as if you were only one person.
translation_verse: An puee, m mèé-ni yii ní ŋámaan ubaanti kí nīn cáá tɔb pu dineendi, ni-pɔbiliŋ ń ŋá dibaantiil, ni-landɔkɔŋu mun ń nīn sá mbaanti. Ŋámaan míǹ, man pɔbil ń pīil̀ tiŋan.

english_verse: Care about them as much as you care about yourselves
translation_verse: Báà ŋma ń nīn nyàab̀ min ŋān̄ee ki tìì u-juti kí taa nín̄ dàkafī u-baba ŋmaniŋma ŋanti pu.

english_verse: and think the same way that Christ Jesus thought:
translation_verse: Ní nīn cáá Yeesu Kriisitoo landɔkɔŋu.

english_verse: Christ was truly God. But he did not try to remain equal with God.
translation_verse: Úǹ un sá Unimbɔti u-bee, waa nyàab̄ yii u nì Unimbɔti ń nīn ŋmà.

english_verse: Instead he gave up everything and became a slave, when he became like one of us.
translation_verse: Ama u yāntì tin kɔkɔ u nìn cááyee, ní ki fōō uyumbu bimbim. U dū u-ba ki nántiǹ binib, ki dɔ́miń nniyaamin,

english_verse: Christ was humble. He obeyed God and even died on a cross.
translation_verse: ní ki sīntì u-ba taapu, ní ki pílifiǹ Unimbɔti áli ki tin kpíì ŋkúm min sá ndɔpuntikaa pu kúmee.

english_verse: Then God gave Christ the highest place and honored his name above all others.
translation_verse: An puee ní Unimbɔti yōoǹ-u ki kāaǹ mpaan ŋun bí yilpu ki jítiǹ ipaan kɔkɔee, ní ki pú-u diyindi din jítiǹ ayin kɔkɔee,

english_verse: So at the name of Jesus everyone will bow down, those in heaven, on earth, and under the earth.
translation_verse: án nín làá ŋá pu bin bí yilpuee nì bin bí kitiŋ puee nì bin gíti bí kitiŋ taapuee, báà ŋma ń gbàan̄ u-tabiŋyiliŋ pu kí nīn tɔ́ Yeesu yindi,

english_verse: And to the glory of God the Father everyone will openly agree, “Jesus Christ is Lord!” Lights in the World
translation_verse: ní báà ŋma ń lì u-nyɔkɔn yii Yeesu Kriisitoo di sá ti-Dindaan, ní ti-baa Unimbɔti ń ká tinyool. Nín̄ ŋmíntímaan kii iŋmalbijaayee duulinyan

english_verse: My dear friends, you always obeyed when I was with you. Now that I am away, you should obey even more. So work with fear and trembling to discover what it really means to be saved.
translation_verse: An puee, m-nabineeŋkaamu, kii m nín bí ni-cee ki ká ni tɔ́ Unimbɔti ŋyunti kamaa miŋyee, kɔŋkɔnnee m nín kpá ni-cee pu nee, ní nīn gbíntìi tɔ́-u míǹ gbīŋgbim. Kii Unimbɔti nín fīī-ni puee, ní nīn fàŋkí-u, kí nīn tūm̀maan ditundi.

english_verse: God is working in you to make you willing and able to obey him.
translation_verse: Kun puee Unimbɔti di bíi tūǹ ni-ni ditundi ki yàntī ni néeń u nín là miŋyee ki ŋáań míǹ.

english_verse: Then you will be the pure and innocent children of God. You live among people who are crooked and evil, but you must not do anything they can say is wrong. Try to shine as lights among the people of this world,
translation_verse: Mimmee baa làá ká ni-pu tiba, ní ní nīn bí circir ki sá Unimbɔti biyaamu mun kaa cáá ikpiti iba duulinya nib binikpitib nì bikiililiibi kansikinee. Ní nīn wāĺ duulinyan kii iŋmalbijaayee,

english_verse: as you hold firmly to the message that gives life. Then on the day when Christ returns, I can take pride in you. I can also know that my work and efforts were not useless.
translation_verse: kí nīn báakí Unimbɔti bɔti tin sá dimaŋfalee. Ni yaa ŋá mimmee, daliŋkin Kriisitoo làá gítińee, m dāa mɔ̀ɔǹ ní, an di dāa dàkà yii m-tundi nì m-pɔ́ɔǹtam kaa ŋá fám.

english_verse: Your faith in the Lord and your service are like a sacrifice offered to him. And my own blood may have to be poured out with the sacrifice. If this happens, I will be glad and rejoice with you.
translation_verse: Ni-fookiiu sá kii saraa un ni tìì Unimbɔtee ní. An yaa yíì, bi yaa kūū-mee, m-fatikuu di dāa kútí ni-saraau gbanti pu. An yaa lafun sá mimmee, an dāa mɔ́ɔkíǹ-mi, ní ni mun ń dāá kūtì m-pu tí fàal̀.

english_verse: In the same way, you should be glad and rejoice with me. Timothy and Epaphroditus
translation_verse: Míǹ mbaantiim, ni mun dāa bí dipɔɔpindi poon ní ma mun ń kūtì ni-pu tí fàal̀. Tiimootee nì Eepafroodiiti

english_verse: I want to be encouraged by news about you. So I hope the Lord Jesus will soon let me send Timothy to you.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan Yeesu yaa lèe, m máká yii an kaa làá yúntí m làá tɔ̄ń Tiimootee ni-cee, án nín làá ŋá pu, u yaa láa fātìi gítìń ki máafì-mi ni nín bí lapu miŋyee, ḿ ká kunyannyaauee.

english_verse: I don't have anyone else who cares about you as much as he does.
translation_verse: Kun puee ubɔ kaa ti bí. Úǹ baba di kútì m-pu ti cáá nlandɔkɔbaanti ki dàkafī ni-pu tikpil.

english_verse: The others think only about what interests them and not about what concerns Christ Jesus.
translation_verse: Bin kɔkɔ kíǹee dàkafī bíǹ bi-ba bɔti pu ní kaa fātìi tɔ́ Yeesu Kriisitoo yati.

english_verse: But you know what kind of person Timothy is. He has worked with me like a son in spreading the good news.
translation_verse: Nimbi ni-ba nyí min ní Tiimootee gbanti nìn dàkā u-bimbimɔntiim, nì man nì u nín túń ditundi ki sòoǹ Unimbɔti bɔti kii kibiki nì ki-baayee.

english_verse: I hope to send him to you, as soon as I find out what is going to happen to me.
translation_verse: M yaa láa béè tin poon m bée, m làá tɔ̄ń-u ni-cee malaa.

english_verse: And I feel sure the Lord will also let me come soon.
translation_verse: M máká ti-Dindaan pu yii, án kaa làá ti yúntí, mama m-ba làá dāan̄ kí màntì ni-pu.

english_verse: I think I ought to send my dear friend Epaphroditus back to you. He is a follower and a worker and a soldier of the Lord, just as I am. You sent him to look after me,
translation_verse: M ká yii an máaǹ ḿ tɔ̄ń ni-cee m-nabiki Eepafroodiiti m-tɔntɔnjuti man nì un bōō dikɔ̀ndi puee. Úǹ ní ni nìn túnní m-cee, u cáań-mi tin nìn lóò-mi ni tútúǹní-mee.

english_verse: but now he is eager to see you. He is worried, because you heard he was sick.
translation_verse: U nyàab̀ kí dāan̄ kí fàtīí ká ni-kɔkɔ ní. U nín béè yii ni gbìl̄ yii u búŋkèe, an páb́-u tikpil.

english_verse: In fact, he was very sick and almost died. But God was kind to him, and also to me, and he kept me from being burdened down with sorrow.
translation_verse: U lafun búŋkì tikpil, áli ki tóob́ ŋkúm, ama ní Unimbɔti súń u-saai. An kaa sá úǹ baba saai, u súń ki kpáaǹ ma mun saai, kunimbaau ń taa dāan̄ kí gíti kūtì kunimbaau pu.

english_verse: Now I am more eager than ever to send Epaphroditus back again. You will be glad to see him, and I won't have to worry any longer.
translation_verse: An puee m jìkì kí dū-u kí tɔ̄ń ni-cee malaa, án nín làá ŋá pu, ni yaa gíti fātìi ká-uee, ni-pɔbiliŋ ń fàtīí tí sɔ̀ŋkì, ní ma mun nimbaaku ń bàtēe.

english_verse: Be sure to give him a cheerful welcome, just as people who serve the Lord deserve.
translation_verse: Míǹ puee, u yaa bāańee, ní fōō-u nì dipɔɔpiŋkpaandi ti-Dindaan pu. Binib bin bí kii úŋ̀wuee, ni máaǹ kí nīn tɔ́-bi ní,

english_verse: He almost died working for Christ, and he risked his own life to do for me what you could not.
translation_verse: kun puee Kriisitoo tundi puee, fiii di pée kpá ú bàà kpú. Waa fāŋkì ŋkúm ki tútúǹ-mi ditutundi din, ni yaa bàà bí doo, an bàà sá ní tūtuǹ-mee.

english_verse: Finally, my dear friends, be glad that you belong to the Lord. It doesn't bother me to write the same things to you that I have written before. In fact, it is for your own good.
translation_verse: Kɔŋkɔnnee m-nabiyaamu, tin kíǹee di sá yii ní nīn fàal̀maan ti-Dindaan pu. An kaa sá-mi digìńdi ḿ fàtīí kùbitī kí lì tin m nìn pée ŋmàn̄-ni dooooyee, an sá tiŋan ní ki tīī-ni.

english_verse: Watch out for those people who behave like dogs! They are evil and want to do more than just circumcise you.
translation_verse: Nín̄ nyím̀maan ni-ba nì bitɔntɔŋkpitib bin bimbim bí kii ibooyee. Bíǹ ceeyee, unil ń gíí dikpancandee di pée sá.

english_verse: But we are the ones who are truly circumcised, because we worship by the power of God's Spirit and take pride in Christ Jesus. We don't brag about what we have done,
translation_verse: Timbi di sá bin gíí digiil tiŋman pu yalee, kun puee Unimbɔti Fam di kpòotī timbi ní ti nóó-u. Yeesu Kriisitoo pu ní timbi fàal̀, kaa máká nisaal tundi pu.

english_verse: although I could. Others may brag about themselves, but I have more reason to brag than anyone else.
translation_verse: Ama m bàà ŋūǹ kí nīn máká nisaal tundi pu. Ubɔ yaa dàkafī yii u ŋūǹ kí dū u-mákal kí páań nisaal tundi puee, man bàà cáá nsan kí dàkafì míǹ kí jītíǹ udaan pu.

english_verse: I was circumcised when I was eight days old, and I am from the nation of Israel and the tribe of Benjamin. I am a true Hebrew. As a Pharisee, I strictly obeyed the Law of Moses.
translation_verse: Bi nín màl̄-mee, iwiin inii dal ní bi gíí-mi dikpancandi. M baasii sá Isirayeel nibul ní, ki sá Beenjameen naakookun, ki sá ujuudajabaamɔn. Juuda yab marab nóotamee, m nìn sá Fariisab kitilin ní,

english_verse: And I was so eager I even made trouble for the church. I did everything the Law demands in order to please God.
translation_verse: ní ki cáá difaŋgiil áli ki sàantí Kriisitoo nikitil. A yaa kpēē m nín ŋúb́ Juuda yab marab puee, m nìn bí deedee, kaa yīntì báà tiba.

english_verse: But Christ has shown me that what I once thought was valuable is worthless.
translation_verse: M bàà nìn nyí yii tíǹ gbanti sá-mi tiŋan ní, ama kɔŋkɔnnee, Kriisitoo puee, m kpèé-tì kii tiwan tin kaa cáá ipaatee ní.

english_verse: Nothing is as wonderful as knowing Christ Jesus my Lord. I have given up everything else and count it all as garbage. All I want is Christ
translation_verse: M nín béè yii m-Dindaan Yeesu Kriisitoo sá-mi tiŋan tin jítiǹ tikɔkɔee, an puee, tin kɔkɔ m nìn pée kpèé yii an sá-mi tiwammɔntiilee, m kíǹ ki kpèé-tì kii tiwan tin kaa cáá ipaatee ní. U-puee m fá tikɔkɔ, ní ki kíǹ ki kpèé-tì kii titampummoolee kí ŋmā kí ká Kriisitoo,

english_verse: and to know that I belong to him. I could not make myself acceptable to God by obeying the Law of Moses. God accepted me simply because of my faith in Christ.
translation_verse: man nì u ń ŋá ubaanti. Maa ti máká yii m nín ŋúb́ marabee pu ní m kpántì deedeedaan, ama m nín fōō Kriisitoo ki kííyee pu ní m kpántì deedeedaan, kii Unimbɔti nín yāntì bin fōō-u ki kííyee kpántì deedeedambi puee.

english_verse: All I want is to know Christ and the power that raised him to life. I want to suffer and die as he did,
translation_verse: Tin m nyàab̀ee di sá ḿ béé Kriisitoo nì u-fìkititam pɔŋŋu. Man nì u ń kpāfì kí jī u-falaau, m-bimbim ń kpú, ḿ nántíǹ Yeesu nín nìn kpíì puee,

english_verse: so that somehow I also may be raised to life. Running toward the Goal
translation_verse: ki cɔ́tí yii Unimbɔti làá dāá fìkitī ma mun ditaŋkpiilin. Sāǹ kí bà kigbèenlaŋ

english_verse: I have not yet reached my goal, and I am not perfect. But Christ has taken hold of me. So I keep on running and struggling to take hold of the prize.
translation_verse: An kaa sá yii m fōō tipaal, maa láá kpántì umɔnti ki dóò. Ama Yeesu Kriisitoo u-ba nín cúú-mi puee, m bíi pɔ̄ɔntí kí sāǹ kí cúú m-taatandi paati.

english_verse: My friends, I don't feel I have already arrived. But I forget what is behind, and I struggle for what is ahead.
translation_verse: Nnabiyaamu, m nyí yii maa láá bàn̄ kí cúú-tì. Tiba ní m ŋáań: di sá yii m súntí tin pu m jítèe, ní ki pɔ̄ɔntí kí bà tin bí nyɔkɔpuee.

english_verse: I run toward the goal, so I can win the prize of being called to heaven. This is the prize God offers because of what Christ Jesus has done.
translation_verse: An puee m sáń kí tin bà kigbèenlaŋ, ní kí tin fōō tipaal tin pu Unimbɔti yíiń-ti yilpu Yeesu Kriisitoo puee.

english_verse: All of us who are mature should think in this same way. And if any of you think differently, God will make it clear to you.
translation_verse: Timbi bin kɔkɔ bīń nnimbɔtisan poonee, tí nīn cáámaan nlandɔkɔ gbanti. Ama ní ni-kansikin biba landɔkɔi yaa tí nyáń i-baaa, Unimbɔti làá dàkà-ni ní béé an nín sá miŋyee.

english_verse: But we must keep going in the direction that we are now headed.
translation_verse: Tin páb́ee di sá yii, nsan ŋun ti pée kíĺ ki nóóyee, tí nīn gbíntì ki nóó-ŋu ki cá.

english_verse: My friends, I want you to follow my example and learn from others who closely follow the example we set for you.
translation_verse: Nnabiyaamu, nín̄ nóómaan m-tabɔbiliŋ kí dū ni-nimbikpeeŋu kí báań bin còom̄ kii ni nín ká timbi còom̄ miŋyee pu.

english_verse: I often warned you that many people are living as enemies of the cross of Christ. And now with tears in my eyes, I warn you again
translation_verse: M nìn tùkū-ni, ki làá gíti bùsì kí tùkù-ni nì nsiim, yii binib biba bí, bi-saŋkindi dàkà yii bi ná Kriisitoo un kpíì ndɔpuntikaa puee.

english_verse: that they are headed for hell! They worship their stomachs and brag about the disgusting things they do. All they can think about are the things of this world.
translation_verse: Tin dɔ̄ ki cí-bee di sá ditafadaaldi, kun puee bi nóó tin bi-pooŋŋi lèe, kaa nóó Unimbɔti. Tin kɔ̄ntí-bi icooyee di mɔ̄ǹ-bi, ní taapu doo wanti pu ní bi dàkafī.

english_verse: But we are citizens of heaven and are eagerly waiting for our Savior to come from there. Our Lord Jesus Christ
translation_verse: Ama timbi sá yilpu tindambiyaamu ní. Ti kā ki cí ti-Dindaan Yeesu Kriisitoo ń nyānní niin kí dāan̄ kí fīī-ti.

english_verse: has power over everything, and he will make these poor bodies of ours like his own glorious body.
translation_verse: U làá dāá dū mpɔn ŋun u cáá kí sìntīǹ tiwan kɔkɔ u-taapuee kí cúú ti-wunti tin bí iwɔfinee kí kpántí yilpu wunti kii u-yɔŋu nín bí puee.

english_verse: Dear friends, I love you and long to see you. Please keep on being faithful to the Lord. You are my pride and joy. Paul Encourages the Lord's Followers
translation_verse: An puee, m-nabineeŋkaamu mun m mɔ̀ ki bàà là kí gíti kée, nimbi bin tìì-mi dipɔɔpindi ki sá-mi tinyoolee, m-bɔɔbi, ni nín sá ti-Dindaan yabee puee, ní nīn gbíntìi bá ki pɔ̄ɔ̄ míǹ. Pɔɔl bíi sáŋkí Fiiliipi tiŋki yab

english_verse: Euodia and Syntyche, you belong to the Lord, so I beg you to stop arguing with each other.
translation_verse: M mèé ki gbàam̄ Eefoodii nì Sintiikee yii bí ŋá ubaanti mmɔntiim ti-Dindaan pu.

english_verse: And, my true partner, I ask you to help them. These women have worked together with me and with Clement and with the others in spreading the good news. Their names are now written in the book of life.
translation_verse: Míǹ puee, sii m-tɔntɔnjutimɔnti, m mèé-si yii á tūtuǹ-mi binimpoobi gbanti liitil, kun puee dikɔ̀ndi din poon m bí ki sòoǹ Unimbɔti bɔtee, binimpoobee mun tútúǹ-mi, bi nì Kleeman nì m-tɔntɔnjutiibi bin kíǹee. Unimbɔti ŋmàn̄ bi-yiŋŋi dimaŋfal gbɔŋkun.

english_verse: Always be glad because of the Lord! I will say it again: Be glad.
translation_verse: Ni nín bí ti-Dindaan ŋaan puee, nín̄ fàal̀maan ŋyunti sá kamaa. M gíti bùsī ki tùkù-ni yii, nín̄ fàal̀maan.

english_verse: Always be gentle with others. The Lord will soon be here.
translation_verse: Ní nīn mɔ̄ báà ŋma cee, ti-Dindaan tóobiń.

english_verse: Don't worry about anything, but pray about everything. With thankful hearts offer up your prayers and requests to God.
translation_verse: Ní taa nín̄ yáliŋkí tiba nì tiba pu, ama tin kamaa di yaa bāań-nee, ní dū ŋwimmeem nì igbaam kí mèè Unimbɔti tin lóò-nee pu, kí nīn jáaḿ-u u-ŋanti pu.

english_verse: Then, because you belong to Christ Jesus, God will bless you with peace that no one can completely understand. And this peace will control the way you think and feel.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti gbansɔŋfiŋu ŋun wīikí ki jítiǹ unil nyítamee, làá ŋúb́ ni-pɔbiliŋ nì ni-landɔkɔi ni nín sá Yeesu Kriisitoo yabee pu.

english_verse: Finally, my friends, keep your minds on whatever is true, pure, right, holy, friendly, and proper. Don't ever stop thinking about what is truly worthwhile and worthy of praise.
translation_verse: Nnabiyaamu, m-bɔjoolkaati sèé: ní nīn dàkafī tin máaǹ tinyoolee pu, an dàkà yii tin kɔkɔ sá tiŋmanee, tin kɔkɔ sá bí nyɔ̄ŋkèe, tin kɔkɔ bí deedeeyee, tin kɔkɔ bí circiree, tin kɔkɔ kítì dineendee, nì tin kɔkɔ bi pàkèe.

english_verse: You know the teachings I gave you, and you know what you heard me say and saw me do. So follow my example. And God, who gives peace, will be with you. Paul Gives Thanks for the Gifts He Was Given
translation_verse: Ní nīn ŋáaḿmaan tin ni bífì ki fōō m-ceeyee nì tin ni gbìl̄ m sòon̄ee nì tin ni ká m ŋáańee, ní Unimbɔti ŋgbansɔŋfi daan ń nīn bí ni-cee. Pɔɔl bíi jáaḿ Fiiliipi yab bi-wampɔkaati pu

english_verse: The Lord has made me very grateful that at last you have thought about me once again. Actually, you were thinking about me all along, but you didn't have any chance to show it.
translation_verse: M jáaḿ ti-Dindaan, an mɔ́ɔkiǹ-mi tikpil kii m nín ká ni fātìi tí bíi dàkafī m-pu ki tútúǹní-mi miŋyee. Ni nìn pée cáá nlandɔkɔ gbanti m-pu an yúntì, ní mpaan kaa nìn bí ní ŋá ni nín dàkafī m-pu miŋyee.

english_verse: I am not complaining about having too little. I have learned to be satisfied with whatever I have.
translation_verse: M nín bí ki sòoǹ nì ni pu nee, an kaa sá tiba di lóò-mi. M yaa cááyaaa, m yaa kaa tí cááyaaa, an kɔkɔ mɔ̄ǹ-mi ní.

english_verse: I know what it is to be poor or to have plenty, and I have lived under all kinds of conditions. I know what it means to be full or to be hungry, to have too much or too little.
translation_verse: M bífì kí nīn bí disoolin, ki tí bífì kí nīn bí digbíl mun poon. M yaa jíń ki díkáaa, m yaa tí dɔ̄ ŋkùmaaa, m yaa cáá ki lákatàaa, m yaa kaa tí cááyaaa, m bífì kí ŋmèè tin kamaa di yaa pée bāań-mee.

english_verse: Christ gives me the strength to face anything.
translation_verse: M ŋūǹ tikɔkɔ Kriisitoo un tìì-mi mpɔnee pu.

english_verse: It was good of you to help me when I was having such a hard time.
translation_verse: Ama ni nín kútì m-pu m jíń falaayee, ni túń ditundi.

english_verse: My friends at Philippi, you remember what it was like when I started preaching the good news in Macedonia. After I left there, you were the only church that became my partner by giving blessings and by receiving them in return.
translation_verse: Fiiliipi tiŋki yab, nimbi ni-ba nyí, m nín kíĺ Unimbɔti bɔti sòontam Maseeduwaan tiŋkin ki dāa yíkèe, Kriisitoo nikitil báà diba kaa ti tútuǹ-mi, see nimbi ŋmaniŋma di kíí ki tīiń-mi tin m bàà làá lóóyee.

english_verse: Even when I was in Thessalonica, you helped me more than once.
translation_verse: Di sá yii, doooo, min m nìn bí Teesalooniikee, nimbi di nìn tútúǹní-mi ŋfunyɔm kupaau pu.

english_verse: I am not trying to get something from you, but I want you to receive the blessings that come from giving.
translation_verse: M nín sòoǹ tin nee, kaa sá m nyàab̀ ní pɔ̄ń-mi tiba. M nyàab̀ ní nīn tūǹ atummɔnti kí ká ipaati tikpil ní.

english_verse: I have been paid back everything, and with interest. I am completely satisfied with the gifts you sent with Epaphroditus. They are like a sweet-smelling offering or like the right kind of sacrifice that pleases God.
translation_verse: Tin kɔkɔ ni tīiń-mee, m fōō, m kíǹ ki bí digbíl poon ní. Ni nín tīiń ni-tūtuntam puee, kɔŋkɔnnee m cáá tikɔkɔ nì tikɔkɔ. Ni-tūtuntam min Eepafroodiiti cáań-mee sɔ́fì fíŋfiŋ kii talaaluee, ní ki bí kii saraa un fáatì Unimbɔti u fòol̄ee.

english_verse: I pray that God will take care of all your needs with the wonderful blessings that come from Christ Jesus!
translation_verse: Kii m-Nimbɔtiu nín cáá tigaajawan tikpil nì tinyool puee, u làá tīī-ni tin kɔkɔ yaa lóò-nee Yeesu Kriisitoo pu.

english_verse: May God our Father be praised forever and ever. Amen. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Ti-Baa Unimbɔti ń ká tinyool kí nīn pée cá jaanjaan! Ameeni. Pɔɔl bíi kàantí Fiiliipi tiŋkin yab

english_verse: Give my greetings to all who are God's people because of Christ Jesus. The Lord's followers here with me send you their greetings.
translation_verse: Ní jāam̀ bin kɔkɔ pée sá Yeesu Kriisitoo yabee. Ti-nabiyaamu mun bí man cee dooyee mun jáaḿ-ni.

english_verse: All of God's people send their greetings, especially those in the service of the Emperor.
translation_verse: Bin sá Unimbɔti yabee kɔkɔ jáaḿ-ni, kí bántée, gɔminakpaan Seesaar dicaŋkun yab jáaḿ-ni.

english_verse: From Paul, chosen by God to be an apostle of Christ Jesus, and from Timothy, who is also a follower.
translation_verse: Man Pɔɔl un Unimbɔti là ḿ nīn sá Yeesu Kriisitoo kpambalee nì ti-nabiki Tiimootee di ŋmàn̄ kugbɔŋu nee.

english_verse: To God's people who live in Colossae and are faithful followers of Christ. I pray that God our Father will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! A Prayer of Thanks
translation_verse: Ti ŋmàn̄-ku kí tīī nimbi bin sá Unimbɔti yab bin bí Kooloosi, ki kpántì ti-nabimɔntiimu Kriisitoo puee ní. Ti-Baa Unimbɔti ń ŋá-ni tiŋan kí tīī-ni ŋgbansɔŋfi. Pɔɔl jáam̀ Unimbɔti Kooloosi yab pu

english_verse: Each time we pray for you, we thank God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Ŋyunti sá kamaa, ti yaa pée bíi mèé ki tìì-nee, ti jáaḿ Unimbɔti ti-Dindaan Yeesu Kriisitoo Baa ni-pu.

english_verse: We have heard of your faith in Christ and of your love for all God's people,
translation_verse: Di sá yii ti gbìl̄ ni nín cáá dimákal Yeesu Kriisitoo pu ki néeń Unimbɔti yab kɔkɔee.

english_verse: because what you hope for is kept safe for you in heaven. You first heard about this hope when you believed the true message, which is the good news.
translation_verse: Di sá yii ni dàkafī tipaal tin dɔ̄ ki cí-ni yilpuee pu. Ni béè an paati pu ŋyunti ŋun bi nìn péé péé ki sòon̄ nì ni ibaamɔn bɔtee.

english_verse: The good news is spreading all over the world with great success. It has spread in this same way among you, ever since the first day you learned the truth about God's wonderful kindness
translation_verse: Tibɔmɔntiil gbanti tin bi cáań-nee bíi gbìtī ki lòoǹ abimɔnti ajan kɔkɔ nib cee. Míǹ ní tì túń atunnyaan ni-cee, kí yòon̄ doooo ŋyunti ŋun ni nìn péé péé ki fōō-tì ki lafun béè Unimbɔti nín ŋáań binib tiŋan tiŋyee.

english_verse: from our good friend Epaphras. He works together with us for Christ and is a faithful worker for you.
translation_verse: Tíǹ ní Eepafrasi nìn dàkā-ni. Úǹ di sá ti-tɔntɔnjuti un ti néeńee, ki tūǹ Kriisitoo tundi deedee ki tútúǹ-ni.

english_verse: He is also the one who told us about the love that God's Spirit has given you. The Person and Work of Christ
translation_verse: U máafì-ti dineendi din Circir Fam yàntī ni cáá Unimbɔti yab puee.

english_verse: We have not stopped praying for you since the first day we heard about you. In fact, we always pray that God will show you everything he wants you to do and that you may have all the wisdom and understanding his Spirit gives.
translation_verse: Míǹ puee, kí yòon̄ daliŋkin ti gbìl̄ ni-puee, ti mun pée bí ki mèé kaa gbèentí ki tìì-ni yii Unimbɔti ń yàntī ní béé mmɔntiim tin u là ní ŋée, kí tīī-ni iciin kɔkɔ nì dinyil din Unimbɔti Fam tììyee ní gbìl̄ u-bɔti taapu.

english_verse: Then you will live a life that honors the Lord, and you will always please him by doing good deeds. You will come to know God even better.
translation_verse: Ú yàntī ni-bimbim ń nīn nóó nì bin sá ti-Dindaan yabee bimbim kí ŋmā kí fáatí-u ŋyunti sá kamaa. Míǹ ní ni làá nīn lòoǹ abimɔnti ŋin sá ní nīn tūǹ atummɔnti kɔkɔee, kí nīn mɔ̀tīi béetí Unimbɔti,

english_verse: His glorious power will make you patient and strong enough to endure anything, and you will be truly happy.
translation_verse: ú nīn tìì-ni mpɔn ŋyunti sá kamaa, kii u nín sá ipɔn nì tinyooldaan puee. Mpɔn gbanti làá yàntī ní nīn jīǹ kimɔtii ki pɔ̄ɔntí ŋyunti sá kamaa.

english_verse: I pray that you will be grateful to God for letting you have part in what he has promised his people in the kingdom of light.
translation_verse: Ní nīn jáaḿ ti-Baa Unimbɔti dipɔɔpindi poon u nín yāntì ní dāá ŋmā kí ká tin u síiǹ kí tīī u-yab u-dumpu, ŋwalifi laŋkee.

english_verse: God rescued us from the dark power of Satan and brought us into the kingdom of his dear Son,
translation_verse: Di sá yii u nyántì-ti dibɔmbɔndi pɔŋŋun ki cáań-ti u-Jipɔnneeŋkaau beel poon.

english_verse: who forgives our sins and sets us free.
translation_verse: U-Jipɔɔnee di yāntì Unimbɔti fīī-ti ki líì, ki dū ti-kpitii ki pú-ti. Kriisitoo nì u-tundi bɔti

english_verse: Christ is exactly like God, who cannot be seen. He is the first-born Son, superior to all creation.
translation_verse: Úǹ di sá Unimbɔti un baa wāĺee naŋku, ní ki līī tin kɔkɔwoooo Unimbɔti náańee nyɔkɔpu.

english_verse: Everything was created by him, everything in heaven and on earth, everything seen and unseen, including all forces and powers, and all rulers and authorities. All things were created by God's Son, and everything was made for him.
translation_verse: Di sá yii tiwan tin kɔkɔ bí yilpuee nì tin bí taapuee, tin bi wāĺee nì tin baa wāĺee, an yaa sá ituun in jīǹ abeeyee nì in sá bikpilibeeyeeee, an yaa tí sá in cáá mpɔneeyeeee, Unimbɔti nìn dī u-Jipɔɔnee pu ní ki náań tíǹ kɔkɔ. U-Jipɔɔnee di náań tikɔkɔ ki yì an kɔkɔ mun.

english_verse: God's Son was before all else, and by him everything is held together.
translation_verse: Úǹ di nìn bí ní boonee tiwan kɔkɔ dɔ́miń. Úǹ di yàntī tiwan kɔkɔ bí ti-laŋki.

english_verse: He is the head of his body, which is the church. He is the very beginning, the first to be raised from death, so that he would be above all others.
translation_verse: Úǹ di sá u-nikitil yil ní u-nikitil sá u-wunti. Úǹ di tìì dimaŋfal. Bin fīkitì ditaŋkpiilinee kansikinee, úǹ di sá ukpil, án nín làá ŋá pu ú kpántí upeepeekaa tikɔkɔ poonee.

english_verse: God himself was pleased to live fully in his Son.
translation_verse: Di sá yii Unimbɔti lēē yii u-Jipɔɔnni ní u làá nīn bí mmɔmin.

english_verse: And God was pleased for him to make peace by sacrificing his blood on the cross, so that all beings in heaven and on earth would be brought back to God.
translation_verse: U bóob́ kí dī u-pu u nì duulinya kɔkɔ ń mɔ̄ɔkì. U-Jipɔɔnee nín kpíì ndɔpuntikaa pu puee di cáań ŋgbansɔŋfi tin kɔkɔ bí yilpuee nì tin kɔkɔ bí taapuee pu.

english_verse: You used to be far from God. Your thoughts made you his enemies, and you did evil things.
translation_verse: Ni nín nìn cáá tilandɔkɔkpiil ki tūǹ atuŋkpiti puee, ni nì Unimbɔti kansikin nìn bíil̀, ní ni nìn sá u-nannanliibi.

english_verse: But his Son became a human and died. So God made peace with you, and now he lets you stand in his presence as people who are holy and faultless and innocent.
translation_verse: Ama kɔŋkɔnnee, Yeesu nín nìn kpántì unil ki kpíì puee ní Unimbɔti yāntì ni nì u mɔ́ɔkì. Mimmee, u làá cáań-ni u-nimbiin, ní nīn sá u-yab kí nīn bí circir, báà ubɔ ń taa ká ni-pu tikpitil kí lì.

english_verse: But you must stay deeply rooted and firm in your faith. You must not give up the hope you received when you heard the good news. It was preached to everyone on earth, and I myself have become a servant of this message. Paul's Service to the Church
translation_verse: Ama, ni máaǹ tibɔti tin ni nìn fōō ki kííyee, ní nīn ŋúb́-tì mmɔntiimin, kí nīn sí deedee kí báań inyaan kí taa lēē dimákal Tibɔmɔntiil tin ni gbìl̄ee pu. An bɔtee di sá tin bi sòon̄ ki tīī báà ŋma ajan kɔkɔee. Man mun Pɔɔl kpántì un kíǹ ki sòoǹ an bɔtee ní. Pɔɔl túń ditundi ki tīī Kriisitoo nikitiŋ

english_verse: I am glad I can suffer for you. I am pleased also that in my own body I can continue the suffering of Christ for his body, the church.
translation_verse: Kɔŋkɔnnee an mɔ́ɔkiǹ-mi m nín bíi jīǹ falaa ni-puee, an dàkà yii ḿ púntí falaa un Kriisitoo tīī-mee m-wuntin kí tīī u-nikitil din sá u-wuntee.

english_verse: God's plan was to make me a servant of his church and to send me to preach his complete message to you.
translation_verse: Kii Unimbɔti nín túǹ-mi ditúndi ḿ tɔ̄ ditundi kí tīī nimbi Kriisitoo nikitil puee, man kpántì utɔntɔnli ki tīī-ni: m-tundi di sá ḿ sòoǹ u-bɔtee kɔkɔ mmɔntiim.

english_verse: For ages and ages this message was kept secret from everyone, but now it has been explained to God's people.
translation_verse: Tibɔtee di sá tin nìn bí dibalin doooo abin abin, báà ubɔ kaa béè ti-puee, ní kɔŋkɔnnee Unimbɔti bīitì ti-pu ki tīī u-nib.

english_verse: God did this because he wanted you Gentiles to understand his wonderful and glorious mystery. And the mystery is that Christ lives in you, and he is your hope of sharing in God's glory.
translation_verse: U nín là puee di sá bí béé tibɔbalkaalee nín cáá kunyaaŋŋu tikpil ki tīī bin kaa sá Juuda yabee puee yii: Kriisitoo bí ni-pɔbiliŋin ki yàntī ni máká yii ni làá dāá jī Unimbɔti nyooti.

english_verse: We announce the message about Christ, and we use all our wisdom to warn and teach everyone, so all of Christ's followers will grow and become mature.
translation_verse: An puee, ti sòoǹ Yeesu Kriisitoo gbanti bɔti ki tìì unil sá kamaa, ki dù ti-ciiŋyi kɔkɔ ki dàkà ki kpáafí báà ŋma, bí ŋmā kí nīn sá binib bin bīńee, kun puee bi nì Yeesu Kriisitoo ŋá ubaanti.

english_verse: This is why I work so hard and use the mighty power he gives me.
translation_verse: Míǹ pu ní m gì ki dù mpɔŋkpaan ŋun Kriisitoo tìì-mee, mpɔn ŋun tūǹ ditundi man nee, ki cáa mɔ̀ dimool ni-pu.

english_verse: I want you to know what a struggle I am going through for you, for God's people at Laodicea, and for all of those followers who have never met me.
translation_verse: M nyàab̀ ní béé yii m bíi mɔ̀ dimool an pɔ̄ɔ̄, nimbi nì Lawoodiisee yab nì bin kɔkɔ kaa láá pée ká-mi dalbee pu.

english_verse: I do it to encourage them. Then as their hearts are joined together in love, they will be wonderfully blessed with complete understanding. And they will truly know Christ. Not only is he the key to God's mystery,
translation_verse: Di sá yii m là bí ká kunyannyaau bi-pɔbiliŋin, kí nīn néeń tɔb, kí nīn cáá nnyɔɔpee, kí nīn nyí an kɔkɔ taapu kí nīn cáá dimákal mmɔntiim. Mimmee, bi làá béé tin tin Unimbɔti nìn ŋúb́ dibalinee mbaamɔm, an dàkà yii Yeesu Kriisitoo,

english_verse: but all wisdom and knowledge are hidden away in him.
translation_verse: un ni ní iciin nì dinyil kɔkɔ bál̀ ki kēe.

english_verse: I tell you these things to keep you from being fooled by fancy talk.
translation_verse: M tùkù-ni tibɔti nee ní kpèè tiŋan, ubɔ ń taa dū kinyɔɔmɔɔi kí ŋmàtiǹ-ni.

english_verse: Even though I am not with you, I keep thinking about you. I am glad to know that you are living as you should and your faith in Christ is strong. Christ Brings Real Life
translation_verse: Báà m yaa kaa bí ni-kansikin, m-landɔkɔŋu bí ni-cee, ní an mɔ̄ǹ-mi m nín ká yii ni kpáfì mbaantiim ki sí deedee ki gbíntìi cáá dimákal Yeesu Kriisitoo puee. Tí nīn gbíntìi nóó Kriisitoo

english_verse: You have accepted Christ Jesus as your Lord. Now keep on following him.
translation_verse: Kii ni nín nìn fōō ti-Dindaan Yeesu Kriisitoo puee, ní nīn gbíntìi nóó-u míǹ.

english_verse: Plant your roots in Christ and let him be the foundation for your life. Be strong in your faith, just as you were taught. And be grateful.
translation_verse: Ní báań inyaan u-ni kí nīn wīintí, kí nīn ŋúb́ tin bi nìn dàkā-ni ni fōō ki kííyee mpɔn, kí nīn jáaḿ-u u-ŋanti pu tikpil.

english_verse: Don't let anyone fool you by using senseless arguments. These arguments may sound wise, but they are only human teachings. They come from the powers of this world and not from Christ.
translation_verse: Ní kpèè tiŋan ubɔ ń taa dū u-nyil nì u-bɔfanti tin tɔ́kɔ́ binib koobiliŋ nì duulinya marab pu kaa tɔ́kɔ́ Kriisitoo puee kí ŋmàtiǹ-ni.

english_verse: God lives fully in Christ.
translation_verse: Di sá yii Unimbɔti bimbim kɔkɔ bí Kriisitoo wuntin,

english_verse: And you are fully grown because you belong to Christ, who is over every power and authority.
translation_verse: ní nimbi kāntí tikɔkɔ u-cee, kun puee úǹ di sá ubɔti tin kɔkɔ cáá ipɔnee pu.

english_verse: Christ has also taken away your selfish desires, just as circumcision removes flesh from the body.
translation_verse: Ŋyunti ŋun ni nì Yeesu Kriisitoo ŋá ubaantee, u gíí-ni nì digiil din kaa sá tiwun gíitamee, ki gíí ki lēē ni-bimbikpitim.

english_verse: And when you were baptized, it was the same as being buried with Christ. Then you were raised to life because you had faith in the power of God, who raised Christ from death.
translation_verse: Kii bi nín síb̀ bin kúùyee puee, míǹ ní ni nì Kriisitoo nìn kpíì, ní bi síb́-ni ŋyunti ŋun bi nìn fùl̄-ni Unimbɔti nyimee. Boonee, ni nì u fīkitì, kun puee ni fōō ki kíí yii Unimbɔti cáá mpɔŋkpaan ki ŋúń ki fīkitì Kriisitoo.

english_verse: You were dead, because you were sinful and were not God's people. But God let Christ make you alive, when he forgave all our sins.
translation_verse: Dooooyee, ni-kpitii pu, nì ni nín kaa sá Juuda yab kaa gíí dikpancandee puee, naa nìn cáá dimaŋfal. Kɔŋkɔnnee, ni nì Kriisitoo nín ŋá ubaantee puee, Unimbɔti fīkitì-ni. U dū ti-kpitii kɔkɔ ki pú-ti,

english_verse: God wiped out the charges that were against us for disobeying the Law of Moses. He took them away and nailed them to the cross.
translation_verse: ní ki fōō kugbɔŋu kun poon bi nìn ŋmàn̄ ti-kpitii ki bóob́ yii bí dáaĺ ti-tafalee, ki kpītì ki dū ki kpáá Yeesu dɔpuntikaaŋu pu.

english_verse: There Christ defeated all powers and forces. He let the whole world see them being led away as prisoners when he celebrated his victory.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti gbákal̀ arasiniibi nì ŋfaŋkpitim pɔŋyi. U cáań-bi ki dàkā báà ŋma ń kpèè bin pu u jíń dinyandee. U-Jipɔɔn dɔpuntikaaŋuee di sá u-nyandi gbanti.

english_verse: Don't let anyone tell you what you must eat or drink. Don't let them say you must celebrate the New Moon festival, the Sabbath, or any other festival.
translation_verse: Mimmee, bi yaa bíi sòoǹ ni-pu yii naa kòó tijikaal tiba, kaa kòó tinyɔkaal tiba mun, nì ni nín kaa kàal̀ iwiin in bi nìn yóoǹee, kaa kàal̀ iŋmapɔɔn nì iwiŋŋuŋfikaa puee, ní taa yàntī án nīn páb́-ni.

english_verse: These things are only a shadow of what was to come. But Christ is real!
translation_verse: Di sá yii akoobilee di nìn dàkà tin dáá bí boon ki dòońee, an dàkà yii Kriisitoo.

english_verse: Don't be cheated by people who make a show of acting humble and who worship angels. They brag about seeing visions. But it is all nonsense, because their minds are filled with selfish desires.
translation_verse: Ubɔ ń taa ŋmàtiǹ-ni yii ni yīntì ni nín kaa là kí sìntī ni-ba taapu kí nīn jáaḿ Unimbɔti tuuŋyee. Di sá bi là kí lì yii bíǹ wāĺ ní. Ama baa máaǹ kí dàkà bi-ba kii bi nín yòontí bi-ba yilpu min nee, kun puee bi-landɔkɔi nyēeń bi-bimbikpitimin ní ki sá nniyaamin.

english_verse: They are no longer part of Christ, who is the head of the whole body. Christ gives the body its strength, and he uses its joints and muscles to hold it together, as it grows by the power of God. Christ Brings New Life
translation_verse: Baa ŋúb́ Yeesu Kriisitoo bɔti. Úǹ di sá diyil ki tīī tiwun kɔkɔ, ki tūkuntí akpab ní ki nɔ̀b̀ igiin, ki kpīintí tiwun ki yàntī tí nīn wīintí kii Unimbɔti nín là puee. Kpú nì Kriisitoo kí nīn bí dimaŋfalin nì u

english_verse: You died with Christ. Now the forces of the universe don't have any power over you. Why do you live as if you had to obey such rules as,
translation_verse: Ni nì Kriisitoo nín kpíì, u fīī-ni ki nyántì-ni duulinya marabinee, ba ŋá ní ni bí kii ni gíti sá taapu doo yabee? Ba ŋá ní ni gbíntìi dì akoobil ŋin sá yii:

english_verse: “Don't handle this. Don't taste that. Don't touch this.”?
translation_verse: «Taa cúú doo, taa dáká tinee, taa gbēē tin kíǹee.»

english_verse: After these things are used, they are no longer good for anything. So why be bothered with the rules that humans have made up?
translation_verse: An bɔtee sá binib marab nì bi-dàkatam ní. Ni yaa gíti dáá dū tijin gbanti ki jíńee, tì bíil̀ dee, an kaa cáá yii án làá ŋá-ni tiba.

english_verse: Obeying these rules may seem to be the smart thing to do. They appear to make you love God more and to be very humble and to have control over your body. But they don't really have any power over our desires.
translation_verse: Ibaamɔn, a yaa kpēē marab gbantee, a làá lì yii bi cáá iciin ŋyunti ŋun bi bí yii binib ń dī dipɔ́ɔǹdi saŋŋu, kí sìntī bi-ba taapu, kí yàntī án píĺ bi-wuntee, ama marabee kaa cáá mpɔn kí cúú tiwun ń taa ŋá min kaa kítèe.

english_verse: You have been raised to life with Christ. Now set your heart on what is in heaven, where Christ rules at God's right side.
translation_verse: Ama ni yaa nyí yii Kriisitoo kpáaǹ-ni ki kpíì ki fīkitèe, nín̄ nyàab̀maan tin bí yilpuee, laakin úǹ bí ki kā Unimbɔti ŋaŋgiil púee.

english_verse: Think about what is up there, not about what is here on earth.
translation_verse: Dūmaan ni-landɔkɔi kí dūú tɔ̄ yilpu wanti pu, kí taa dūú tɔ̄ taapu yati pu.

english_verse: You died, which means that your life is hidden with Christ, who sits beside God.
translation_verse: Di sá yii ni kpíì, ní ni-maŋfal bál̀ Kriisitoo ni Unimbɔti cee.

english_verse: Christ gives meaning to your life, and when he appears, you will also appear with him in glory.
translation_verse: Kriisitoo un sá ni-maŋfalee yaa láa páaǹnée, ni mun dāa pāantiń ní ki cáá tinyool kii úŋ̀wuee. Dimaŋfakpikil nì dimaŋfapɔndi

english_verse: Don't be controlled by your body. Kill every desire for the wrong kind of sex. Don't be immoral or indecent or have evil thoughts. Don't be greedy, which is the same as worshiping idols.
translation_verse: Mimmee, kpɔ̀maan taapu doo bimbikpitim min bí ni-nee, tin sá tilaakpaal nì tijɔkɔndi, ilandɔkɔkpiti nì nnimbitaataam min nì iwaatooti sá tiwambaantiilee.

english_verse: God is angry with people who disobey him by doing these things.
translation_verse: Ikpiti gbanti pu ní Unimbɔti làá dáaĺ bin kaa tɔ́-uee tafal.

english_verse: And this is exactly what you did, when you lived among people who behaved in this way.
translation_verse: Míǹ ní ni nìn ŋáań dooooyee, ŋyunti ŋun ni nìn dáá bí ikpitinee.

english_verse: But now you must stop doing such things. You must quit being angry, hateful, and evil. You must no longer say insulting or cruel things about others.
translation_verse: Ama kɔŋkɔnnee, ní fámaan ikpiti kɔkɔ, kí taa nín̄ fòol̄ mbiim, kí taa nín̄ cáá diŋuul nì tilandɔkɔkpiil. Ní taa yàntī asiibil nì tibɔfan ń nīn nyēē ni-nyɔmmun.

english_verse: And stop lying to each other. You have given up your old way of life with its habits.
translation_verse: Ní taa nín̄ mɔ́ntímaan tɔb. Di sá yii ni fá ni-bimbikpitim nì atuun ŋin ni nìn ŋáań dooooyee kɔkɔwoooo,

english_verse: Each of you is now a new person. You are becoming more and more like your Creator, and you will understand him better.
translation_verse: ní ki yōoǹ mbimbipɔm min pɔ̀ntī baabadal ki cá ki nántíǹ Unimbɔti un náań-mèe nín bí puee. Mimmee, án làá yàntī ní béé ni-Nimbɔtiuee mbaamɔm.

english_verse: It doesn't matter if you are a Greek or a Jew, or if you are circumcised or not. You may even be a barbarian or a Scythian, and you may be a slave or a free person. Yet Christ is all that matters, and he lives in all of us.
translation_verse: Míǹ puee, a yaa sá Juuda yɔuaaa, a yaa kaa sáaa, a yaa gíí dikpancandaaa, a yaa kaa gííyaaa, a yaa sá unicaanaaa, a yaa tí sá umɔnilaaa, a yaa sá uyumbuɔɔɔ, a yaa tí tɔ́ a-baaa, tíǹ kaa páb́. Un baba bɔti páb́ee di sá Kriisitoo un bí báà ŋmanee.

english_verse: God loves you and has chosen you as his own special people. So be gentle, kind, humble, meek, and patient.
translation_verse: Nimbi bin Unimbɔti lútì, ni kpántì u-yab bin u néeńee, ní nīn sūm̀maan tɔb saai kí nīn ŋáań tɔb tiŋan kí nīn sìntīǹ ni-ba taapu ki tìì tɔb, kí nīn cáá kimɔtii.

english_verse: Put up with each other, and forgive anyone who does you wrong, just as Christ has forgiven you.
translation_verse: Ní nīn ŋúb́maan tɔb. Ni-jutiibi yaa yīntiǹ-nee, ní nīn cáa pūǹ-bi. Kii ti-Dindaan nín dū ni-kpitii ki pú-ni puee, ni mun ń nīn cáa pūm̀maan tɔb míǹ mbaantiim.

english_verse: Love is more important than anything else. It is what ties everything completely together.
translation_verse: Tin páb́ ki jítiǹ tikɔkɔee di sá ní nīn néeń tɔb. Míǹ ní ni làá ŋmā kí nīn cáá nnyɔɔpee tiŋman pu.

english_verse: Each one of you is part of the body of Christ, and you were chosen to live together in peace. So let the peace that comes from Christ control your thoughts. And be grateful.
translation_verse: Yàntīmaan ŋgbansɔŋfi ŋun Kriisitoo tììyee ń nīn kpòotī ni-pɔbiliŋ. Di sá yii ŋúǹ pu ní Unimbɔti yíiń-ni ki kpáfì kii tiwumbaantiilee. Ní nīn jáaḿ Unimbɔti tiŋan tin u ŋáań ki tìì-nee pu.

english_verse: Let the message about Christ completely fill your lives, while you use all your wisdom to teach and instruct each other. With thankful hearts, sing psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs to God.
translation_verse: Kriisitoo bɔtee nì tì-gaajati kɔkɔ ń nīn bí ni-cee mmɔntiimin. Ní nīn dàkà tɔb u-bɔtee kí nīn kpáafímaan tɔb nì iciimmɔnti, kí nīn gà ilan nì ni-pɔbiliŋ kɔkɔ, ilan in kā Inyɔŋki laŋyi gbɔŋku poonee nì Kriisitoo nikitil laŋyi nì ilan in Unimbɔti Fam tìì-nee kí nīn cáa pàkà Unimbɔti u-ŋanti pu.
