english_verse: Whatever you say or do should be done in the name of the Lord Jesus, as you give thanks to God the Father because of him. Some Rules for Christian Living
translation_verse: Tin kamaa ni yaa làá lèe nì tin kamaa ni yaa làá ŋée, ŋámaan an kɔkɔ nì ti-Dindaan Yeesu pu, kí nīn dìmaan u-pu ki jáaḿ ti-Baa Unimbɔti. Unil nín máaǹ kí nīn bí min dicindinee

english_verse: A wife must put her husband first. This is her duty as a follower of the Lord.
translation_verse: Nimbi binimpoobee, nín̄ tɔ́maan ni-calib, min máaǹ ti-Dindaan yab ń ŋée dee.

english_verse: A husband must love his wife and not abuse her.
translation_verse: Nimbi bininjabee, nín̄ néeḿmaan ni-nimpoobi, kí taa nín̄ cáá bi-pu ntoom.

english_verse: Parents, don't be hard on your children. If you are, they might give up.
translation_verse: Nimbi bibaatiibee, ní taa nín̄ páb́ ni-biyaamu tikpil, mu-wunti ń yɔ̀tī.

english_verse: Slaves, you must always obey your earthly masters. Try to please them at all times, and not just when you think they are watching. Honor the Lord and serve your masters with your whole heart.
translation_verse: Nimbi iyumbuee, ní nīn gbìlim̀maan bin sá ni-dindambi taapu dooyee nyɔmmu iyunti kɔkɔ. Ní taa nín̄ tūǹ ditundi min fáatì-bee ŋyunti ŋun bi kpèé-nee ŋmaniŋma, ama ní nīn tūǹ bi-tuuŋŋi nì dipɔbil diba kii ni nín fàŋkí ti-Dindaan puee.

english_verse: Do your work willingly, as though you were serving the Lord himself, and not just your earthly master.
translation_verse: Báà ditundi din ní an yaa yāntì ki sée, tɔ̄maan-dì nì ni-pɔbiliŋ kɔkɔ, a lì kii ti-Dindaan ní ni tūǹ ki tìì, an kaa sá nnibiyaamuee.

english_verse: In fact, the Lord Christ is the one you are really serving, and you know he will reward you.
translation_verse: Ní nīn nyí yii ti-Dindaan làá dāá pà-ni tipaal tin sá kutindaŋuee. Di sá yii ni-Dindaan un ni baasii tūǹ ditundi ki tììyee di sá Kriisitoo.

english_verse: But Christ has no favorites! He will punish evil people, just as they deserve.
translation_verse: Un yaa ŋá ikpitee làá ká ikpiti paati, kun puee ti-Dindaan gbanti kaa gàntī binib.

english_verse: Slave owners, be fair and honest with your slaves. Don't forget that you have a Master in heaven.
translation_verse: Nimbi bin cáá iyumbuee, ní nīn ŋúb́-i mmɔntiimin, kí nīn ŋáań-i tiŋan, kí nīn nyí yii ni mun cáá ukpil ubɔ u bí yilpu. Tibɔkpaafikaal

english_verse: Never give up praying. And when you pray, keep alert and be thankful.
translation_verse: Ní nīn mèé múlmul kí taa gbèen̄, kí nīn wálifì kí nīn jáaḿ Unimbɔti u-ŋanti pu.

english_verse: Be sure to pray that God will make a way for us to spread his message and explain the mystery about Christ, even though I am in jail for doing this.
translation_verse: Ni yaa bíi mèéyee, ní nīn mèé ki tìì ti mun, yii Unimbɔti ń pìitī-ti nsan tí ŋmā kí sòoǹ u-bɔti kí bìitī tibɔbalkaal tin sá Kriisitoo yatee. Tibɔti gbanti pu ní m bí sarkan nee.

english_verse: Please pray that I will make the message as clear as possible.
translation_verse: Ní nīn mèé yii ḿ ŋmā kí nīn sòoǹ ki cántí-tì kii an nín máaǹ puee.

english_verse: When you are with unbelievers, always make good use of the time.
translation_verse: Ni-bimbiminee, ní nīn cáá iciin bin kaa láá fōō ki kííyee cee, kí taa dū iyunti in ni kāntí bi-ceeyee kí bīil̀.

english_verse: Be pleasant and hold their interest when you speak the message. Choose your words carefully and be ready to give answers to anyone who asks questions. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Ní nīn sòoǹ anyɔɔbummɔɔn ŋí nīn cáá taapu, kí nīn nyí min ní ni làá nīn kíikí báà ŋma án nīn kítèe. Ijaam in Pɔɔl dūu kúntèe

english_verse: Tychicus is the dear friend, who faithfully works and serves the Lord with us, and he will give you the news about me.
translation_verse: An yaa sá m-bɔtee, ti-nabineeŋkaaki Tiisiiki, un sá ti-tɔntɔnjuti ki tūǹ ditundi mmɔntiim ki tìì ti-Dindaanee, làá sòoǹ nì ni tin kɔkɔ m cááyee.

english_verse: I am sending him to cheer you up by telling you how we are getting along.
translation_verse: An pu ní m túnní-u ni-cee ní béé ti-gbampɔŋŋu pu kí ká kunyannyaau.

english_verse: Onesimus, the dear and faithful follower from your own group, is coming with him. The two of them will tell you everything that has happened here.
translation_verse: Úǹ nì ti-nabineeŋkaaki Ooneesiim un yú deedee ki sá ni-yɔu ubɔee làá dāá nīn táań, kí dāá tùkù-ni tin kɔkɔ bíi jītí dooyee.

english_verse: Aristarchus is in jail with me. He sends greetings to you, and so does Mark, the cousin of Barnabas. You have already been told to welcome Mark, if he visits you.
translation_verse: Ariistaarki man nì un bí sarkan dooyee jáamiń-ni, ní Maarki Baarnaabaasi naal mun tīiń-ni ijaam. Dooooyee, bi tùkū-ni Maarki gbanti bɔti ki yóoǹ. Mimmee, u yaa láa bāań ni-ceeyee, ní dāá fōō-u mmɔntiim.

english_verse: Jesus, who is known as Justus, sends his greetings. These three men are the only Jewish followers who have worked with me for the kingdom of God. They have given me much comfort.
translation_verse: Yeesu un bi yíì Justuusee mun jáamiń-ni. Juuda yab kansikinee, binib bita nee baba di sá man nì bin tūǹ ditundi Unimbɔti Beel ń cù nyɔkɔpuee. Bíǹ di tìì-mi kunyannyaau.

english_verse: Your own Epaphras, who serves Christ Jesus, sends his greetings. He always prays hard that you may fully know what the Lord wants you to do and that you may do it completely.
translation_verse: Ni-yɔu Eepafrasi, Yeesu Kriisitoo tɔntɔnliuee, mun tīiń-ni ijaam. U mèé ni-pu tikpil ŋyunti sá kamaa, kaa gbèentí, yii ní nīn gbíntìi ŋúb́ Yeesu Kriisitoo bɔti mmɔntiim kí wíiǹ kí kpántí biniŋmambi, kí ŋmā kí ŋá tin kɔkɔ Unimbɔti là ní ŋée.

english_verse: I have seen how much trouble he has gone through for you and for the followers in Laodicea and Hierapolis.
translation_verse: Mama m-ba ŋūǹ kí lì u-pu yii u gì nimbi nì Lawoodiisee yab nì Eerapooliisi yab pu digìńdi.

english_verse: Our dear doctor Luke sends you his greetings, and so does Demas.
translation_verse: Luuki, ti-nabineeŋkaaki un sá dɔkɔtee, nì Deemasi jáamiń-ni.

english_verse: Give my greetings to the followers at Laodicea, especially to Nympha and the church that meets in her home.
translation_verse: Ní jāam̀ nnabiyaamu mun bí Lawoodiiseeyee, nì Niŋfasi, kí kpáaǹ Kriisitoo nikitil din kpáfí u-dumpuee.

english_verse: After this letter has been read to your people, be sure to have it read in the church at Laodicea. And you should read the letter that I have sent to them.
translation_verse: Ni yaa kàan̄ kugbɔŋu nee ki tīī ni-yab ki dóòyee, ní dūú tīī Kriisitoo nikitil din bí Lawoodiiseeyee mun ń kàaǹ. Míǹ ní Lawoodiisee yab yaa tīiń-ni bi-yɔkuee ní kàaǹ ku mun.

english_verse: Remind Archippus to do the work that the Lord has given him to do.
translation_verse: Ní tùkù Arkiipi yii ú kpèè soooo kí tɔ̄ ditundi din ti-Dindaan tīī-uee tiŋan.

english_verse: I am signing this letter myself: PAUL. Don't forget that I am in jail. I pray that God will be kind to you.
translation_verse: Man Pɔɔl di dū m-ŋal ki ŋmàn̄ anyɔɔbun nee ki jáaḿ-ni. - Taa súntímaan yii m bí sarkan. - Unimbɔti ŋanti ń nīn bí ni-pu.

english_verse: From Paul, Silas, and Timothy. To the church in Thessalonica, the people of God the Father and of the Lord Jesus Christ. I pray that God will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!
translation_verse: Man Pɔɔl nì Siilasi nì Tiimootee di ŋmàn̄ kugbɔŋu nee. Ti ŋmàn̄-ku kí tīī nimbi Kriisitoo nikitil din bí Teesalooniiki ki sá ti-Baa Unimbɔti nì ti-Dindaan Yeesu Kriisitoo yabee. Unimbɔti ń ŋá-ni tiŋan kí tīī-ni ŋgbansɔŋfi. Teesalooniiki yab fookiiu nì bi-bimbim

english_verse: We thank God for you and always mention you in our prayers. Each time we pray,
translation_verse: Ti pàkà Unimbɔti ní baabadal ni-kɔkɔ pu, ní ti-wimmeem poonee ti téetí ki mèé ni-pu múlmul.

english_verse: we tell God our Father about your faith and loving work and about your firm hope in our Lord Jesus Christ. The Thessalonians' Faith and Example
translation_verse: Ti-wimmeem poon ti-Baa Unimbɔti nimbiinee, ti téetí atuun ŋin ni tūǹ ni-fookiiu nì ni-neendi puee nì ni-mákal din ni cáá ti-Dindaan Yeesu Kriisitoo puee nín pɔ̄ɔ̄ miŋyee.

english_verse: My dear friends, God loves you, and we know he has chosen you to be his people.
translation_verse: Nnabiyaamu, ti nyí yii Unimbɔti néeń-ni ní ki lútì-ni ní nīn sá u-yab.

english_verse: When we told you the good news, it was with the power and assurance that come from the Holy Spirit, and not simply with words. You knew what kind of people we were and how we helped you.
translation_verse: Kun puee Tibɔmɔntiil tin ti sòon̄ nì nee kaa sá nì kinyɔkɔn ŋmaniŋma, ama ti nìn sòon̄ nì Unimbɔti pɔŋŋu nì u-Fam tūtuntam ki tɔ́kɔ́ ibaamɔn pu páaa ní. Ni nyí ti-pu ti nín nìn dɔ́miń ki bí ni-kansikin nì mbimbim min kí tūtuǹ-nee.

english_verse: So, when you accepted the message, you followed our example and the example of the Lord. You suffered, but the Holy Spirit made you glad.
translation_verse: Ni nín fōō Unimbɔti bɔti ki kíí nì falaabi tikpil poon nì dipɔɔpindi din Unimbɔti Fam tììyee puee, ni kpántì bin fōō timbi nì ti-Dindaan didandee dee.

english_verse: You became an example for all the Lord's followers in Macedonia and Achaia.
translation_verse: Min ni ŋá nee dàkà Maseeduwaan nì Akaayi yab bin fōō ki kííyee mun ń fōō míǹ dee.

english_verse: And because of you, the Lord's message has spread everywhere in those regions. Now the news of your faith in God is known all over the world, and we don't have to say a thing about it.
translation_verse: Kun puee nimbi cee ní ti-Dindaan bɔti gbītì, ki bàn̄ Maseeduwaan nì Akaayi yab cee. Kaa sá bíǹ baba, ajan ŋin kɔkɔ kíǹee yab mun gbìl̄ ni nín fōō Unimbɔti ki kíí miŋyee. An kaa ti bàlifī yii timbi ń māafì-bi gba.

english_verse: Everyone is talking about how you welcomed us and how you turned away from idols to serve the true and living God.
translation_verse: Báà ŋma máafí ti nín dɔ́miń ni-cee ni fōō-ti pu, ki fá ni-waaŋi ki kíǹ ki nóó ibaamɔn Nimbɔtiu un bí dimaŋfalinee.

english_verse: They also tell how you are waiting for his Son Jesus to come from heaven. God raised him from death, and on the day of judgment Jesus will save us from God's anger.
translation_verse: Ni kā ki cí yii u-Jipɔɔn Yeesu ń nyānní yilpu kí dāan̄. Úǹ ní Unimbɔti fīkitì ditaŋkpiilin. Úǹ di fīī-ti ki nyántì Unimbɔti ŋuul din bí ki dòońee poon.

english_verse: My friends, you know our time with you wasn't wasted.
translation_verse: Nnabiyaamu, kii nimbi ni-ba nín pée nyí puee, kaa sá yii ti dɔ́miń ni-dumpu fám.

english_verse: As you remember, we had been mistreated and insulted at Philippi. But God gave us the courage to tell you the good news about him, even though many people caused us trouble.
translation_verse: Ni nyí yii bi sāaǹ-ti ki sīī-ti Fiiliipi tiŋkin ní ti dāa nín bāań ni-cee Teesalooniiki. Ama ní Unimbɔti tīī-ti kunyannyaau tí sòoǹ nì ni u-Bɔmɔntiiti nì dikɔ̀ndi poon.

english_verse: We didn't have any hidden motives when we won you over, and we didn't try to fool or trick anyone.
translation_verse: Ti-bɔti tin ti sòoǹee kaa sá tinyimɔmbɔti, kaa sá ilandɔkɔkpiti bɔti, kaa tí sá tibɔŋmatiŋkaal.

english_verse: God was pleased to trust us with his message. We didn't speak to please people, but to please God who knows our motives.
translation_verse: Ama Unimbɔti cɔ́ŋkì-ti ní ki dū u-Bɔmɔntiiti ki ŋúbiǹ-ti tí sòoǹ. An puee ní ti sòoǹ min làá nīn fáatiǹ Unimbɔti un wāĺ ti-pɔbiliŋinee, an kaa sá kí fáatíǹ binib.

english_verse: You also know we didn't try to flatter anyone. God himself knows what we did wasn't a cover-up for greed.
translation_verse: Nimbi ni-ba nyí yii taa sòon̄ nì ni tibɔkiilkaal ki ká jaanjaan. Taa tí sòoǹ ki nyàab̀ ni-cee animbil yam, Unimbɔti nyí ti-pu míǹ.

english_verse: We were not trying to get you or anyone else to praise us.
translation_verse: Taa nyàab̀ ubɔ ń tīī-ti tinyool. Taa nyàab̀ nimbi nyootaaa, kaa nyàab̀ bin kíǹee mun yati.

english_verse: But as apostles, we could have demanded help from you. After all, Christ is the one who sent us. We chose to be like children or like a mother nursing her baby.
translation_verse: Ama ti bàà cáá nsan kii ti nín sá Kriisitoo kpambaliŋee puee kí tùkù-ni yii nimbi di máaǹ kí nīn kpèé-ti, ama taa ŋá míǹ. Ti kāl̀ ni-cee ki mɔ̄ kii ubinaati nín mɔ̄ pu ki ŋúb́ u-biyaamuee ní.

english_verse: We cared so much for you, and you became so dear to us, that we were willing to give our lives for you when we gave you God's message.
translation_verse: Ti nín néeń-ni puee, ti là yii án taa nín̄ sá Unimbɔti bɔti ŋmaniŋma ní tí tīī-ni, ama tí dū ti-maŋfal kí kūtì kí tīī-ni, kun puee ni kɔ́-ti tiŋan tiŋan.

english_verse: My dear friends, you surely haven't forgotten our hard work and hardships. You remember how night and day we struggled to make a living, so we could tell you God's message without being a burden to anyone.
translation_verse: Nnabiyaamu, nimbi ni-ba ká ti nín túń atuun pu ŋwiimpu nì kunyeeu ki gīī kí ŋmā kí ŋúb́ ti-ba kí nīn sòoǹ Unimbɔti bɔti, án taa nín̄ sá yii ni-kansikin ubɔ ní ń nīn tú ti-gìńdee.

english_verse: Both you and God are witnesses that we were pure and honest and innocent in our dealings with you followers of the Lord.
translation_verse: Nimbi ni-ba ká. Unimbɔti mun ká yii ti-bimbim min ti dūu kāl̀ nimbi bin fōō Unimbɔti bɔti ki kííyee kansikinee bí circir ki bí deedee. Taa yīntì báà tiba nì tiba poon.

english_verse: You also know we did everything for you that parents would do for their own children.
translation_verse: Min ní ni nyí yii ubaati ŋáań u-biyaamuee, míǹ ní ti ŋá ni-kansikin ubɔ ubɔ.

english_verse: We begged, encouraged, and urged each of you to live in a way that would honor God. He is the one who chose you to share in his own kingdom and glory.
translation_verse: Ti sáŋkì-ni ki tīī-ni kunyannyaau ki páb́-ni yii ní nīn còom̄ min fáatiǹ Unimbɔtee, úǹ un yíiń-ni ní dāá kɔ́ u-Beel nì u-nyootinee.

english_verse: We always thank God that you believed the message we preached. It came from him, and it isn't something made up by humans. You accepted it as God's message, and now he is working in you.
translation_verse: Kun pu ti gíti pàkà Unimbɔti kaa gbèentée di sá ti nín cáań Unimbɔti bɔti ki sòon̄ nì nee, ni pílifì-tì ki fōō-tì kaa dūu yíiń binib bɔti, ama ki fōō-tì yii tì sá Unimbɔti bɔti tiŋman. Tibɔti gbantee di tūǹ nimbi bin fōō ki kííyee pɔbiliŋ poon atuun.

english_verse: My friends, you did just like God's churches in Judea and like the other followers of Christ Jesus there. And so, you were mistreated by your own people, in the same way they were mistreated by their people.
translation_verse: An puee, nnabiyaamu, ni dī Unimbɔti nikitil din bí Juudee ki sá Yeesu Kriisitoo yabee tabɔbiliŋ dee. Di sá yii falaabi bin ni jíń ni-jutiibi ceeyee, falaabee bibaantiibi ní bi mun jíń Juuda yab ŋaan.

english_verse: Those evil people killed the Lord Jesus and the prophets, and they even chased us away. God doesn't like what they do and neither does anyone else.
translation_verse: Bíǹ di kūū ti-Dindaan Yeesu nì Unimbɔti bɔnaatiliibi ki sāaǹ ti mun. Unimbɔti kaa gèetíǹ-bi ní bi sá binib kɔkɔ pulincɔntiibi.

english_verse: They keep us from speaking his message to the Gentiles and from leading them to be saved. They have always gone too far with their sins. Now God has finally become angry and will punish them. Paul Wants To Visit the Church Again
translation_verse: Bi pìintí-ti nsan tí taa sòoǹ nì bin kaa sá Juuda yabee Unimbɔti bɔti tin ŋūǹ kí cáań-bi difiilee. Bi mɔ̀tīi gbēentí bi-kpitii pu ŋyunti kamaa. Ama Unimbɔti fōō bi-pu diŋuul ki dóò. Pɔɔl nyàab̀ kí gíti ká Teesalooniiki yab

english_verse: My friends, we were kept from coming to you for a while, but we never stopped thinking about you. We were eager to see you and tried our best to visit you in person.
translation_verse: An yaa sá timbee, nnabiyaamu, doooo ŋyunti ŋun ti yāaǹ tɔbin nì tiwun yàantam, kaa sá nì ti-pɔbiliŋee, ti nyàab̄ nì dinimbinaamandi kí bàà fàtīí ká ni-nimbiin ti-pɔbiliŋ ń bàà sɔ̀ŋkì.

english_verse: We really wanted to come. I myself tried several times, but Satan always stopped us.
translation_verse: Ti mɔ̀n̄ yii tí gítiń ni-cee, cilinjee man Pɔɔl, m mākaǹ ŋfunyɔm kupaau kí bàà gítiń ni-cee. Ama Sitaan pīiǹ-ti nsan.

english_verse: After all, when the Lord Jesus appears, who else but you will give us hope and joy and be like a glorious crown for us?
translation_verse: Nimbi di sá bin pu timbi cɔ́tée, ki sá ti-pɔɔpindi nì ti-jajil daaŋku kun pu ti-Dindaan Yeesu yaa láa gítìńee, ti dāa gbàntī u-nimbiinee.

english_verse: You alone are our glory and joy!
translation_verse: Tiŋman nimbi di sá timbi nyooti nì ti-pɔɔpindi.

english_verse: Finally, we couldn't stand it any longer. We decided to stay in Athens by ourselves
translation_verse: Ti nín kaa nìn gíti ŋūǹ kí nīn kā míǹ kaa gbìl̄ ni-puee ní timbi lēē yii min ŋān̄ee di sá tí gbíntí kí kàl̄ Ateeni ti-baba.

english_verse: and send our friend Timothy to you. He works with us as God's servant and preaches the good news about Christ. We wanted him to make you strong in your faith and to encourage you.
translation_verse: Ní ti dū ti-nabiki Tiimootee ti nì un tūǹ Unimbɔti tundi ki sòoǹ Kriisitoo Bɔmɔntiitee ki túnní ni-cee ú tīī-ni kunyannyaau kí kūtì-ni mpɔn ni-fookiiu poon.

english_verse: We didn't want any of you to be discouraged by all these troubles. You knew we would have to suffer,
translation_verse: Ni-kansikin ubɔ ń taa yàntī falaa un poon ni bée ń ŋmā-u. Kun puee ni nyí yii an sá falaa di pée dɔ̄ ki cí-ti tí jī.

english_verse: because when we were with you, we told you this would happen. And we did suffer, as you well know.
translation_verse: Ti nín nìn dáá bí ni-ceeyee, ti nìn pée tùkū-ni ki yóoǹ yii falaa dɔ̄ ki cí-ti, an di bāań nee kii ni nín nìn gbìl̄ puee.

english_verse: At last, when I could not wait any longer, I sent Timothy to find out about your faith. I hoped Satan had not tempted you and made all our work useless.
translation_verse: M nín kaa ti ŋūǹ kí nīn gbíntìi kā ki cée puee ní m túnní Tiimootee ú dāá kpèè ni-fookiiu nín bí puee, kun puee m fàŋkí yii Sitaan ń taa láa cɔ̄ŋkì kí líí-ni ti-tundi din ti túńee ń ŋá fám.

english_verse: Timothy has now come back from his visit with you and has told us about your faith and love. He also said that you always have happy memories of us and that you want to see us as much as we want to see you.
translation_verse: Ama kɔŋkɔnnee Tiimootee nín nyánní ni-cee ki fātìi bāańee, u cáań-ti faawiimɔnti ni-fookiiu nì ni-neendi pu. U máafì-ti yii ni téetí ti-pu múlmul mmɔntiimin ki nyàab̀ kí bàà ká-ti kii ti mun nín nyàab̀ kí ká ni mun puee.

english_verse: My friends, even though we have a lot of trouble and suffering, your faith makes us feel better about you.
translation_verse: Míǹ puee nnabiyaamu, ni-puee ti kāntí kunyannyaau ti-falaabi nì ti-nimbinaamandi kɔkɔ poon. Ni-fookiiu di tīī-ti dipɔɔsɔŋkil.

english_verse: Your strong faith in the Lord is like a breath of new life.
translation_verse: Díǹ pu nee timbi ŋmátì ní, kun puee ni gbíntìi bí ti-Dindaanni ki ŋúb́ an píkí.

english_verse: How can we possibly thank God enough for all the happiness you have brought us?
translation_verse: Dipɔɔpiŋkpaandi din ti cáá ni-pu ki fàal̀ Unimbɔti nimbiinee, taa ti nyí gba ti nín làá pàkà-u kí gbèen̄ puee.

english_verse: Day and night we sincerely pray that we will see you again and help you to have an even stronger faith.
translation_verse: Ti mèé ki páb̀-u ŋwiimpu nì kunyeeu yii ú pée yàntī tí gíti ká-ni án nín làá ŋá pu ní kun naa cááyee tí tīī-ni ní dūú gbéeǹ ni-fookiiu puee.

english_verse: We pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus will let us visit you.
translation_verse: Ti-Baa Unimbɔti u-ba nì ti-Dindaan Yeesu ń ŋāŋkì ti-saŋŋu tí ŋmā kí dāá ká-ni.

english_verse: May the Lord make your love for each other and for everyone else grow by leaps and bounds. This is how our love for you has grown.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan ń yàntī dineendi din ni cáá tɔb pu nì binib kɔkɔ puee ń wíiǹ ní mɔ̀tīí nīn néeń tɔb míǹ tikpil kí nīn pée cáa cá, án nīn bí kii ti mun nín néeń-ni puee.

english_verse: And when our Lord comes with all his people, I pray he will make your hearts pure and innocent in the sight of God the Father.
translation_verse: Ú yàntī ni-pɔbiliŋ ń nīn tɔ́kɔ́ ibaamɔn pu ki pɔ̄ɔ̄, kí nīn bí circir bí taa ká ni-pu ikpiti iba ti-Baa Unimbɔti nimbiin ŋyunti ŋun ti-Dindaan Yeesu yaa láa gítìń nì bin kɔkɔ sá u-yabee. Ameeni.

english_verse: Finally, my dear friends, since you belong to the Lord Jesus, we beg and urge you to live as we taught you. Then you will please God. You are already living that way, but try even harder.
translation_verse: Kí kúntí tibɔtee, nnabiyaamu, ti dàkā-ni min ní ni máaǹ kí nīn còom̄ Unimbɔti ń nīn fáatì ni-bɔtee. Ibaamɔn, ni bíi còom̄ min fáatì Unimbɔtee, ama ti dū ti-Dindaan Yeesu ki gbāam̀-ni yii ní nīn gbíntìi ŋáań min jítiǹ mimmee ki cá.

english_verse: Remember the instructions we gave you as followers of the Lord Jesus.
translation_verse: Ni nyí ti nín nìn dàkā-ni tibɔti tin ti-Dindaan Yeesu yindi puee.

english_verse: God wants you to be holy, so don't be immoral in matters of sex.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti nín là kuŋyee di sá ní nīn bí circir kí nīn ŋúb́ ni-ba kí taa ŋá tilaakpaal.

english_verse: Don't be a slave of your desires or live like people who don't know God.
translation_verse: kí taa dū ni-ba kí tīī ajɔkɔntuun kii bin kaa nyí Unimbɔtee nín ŋáań puee.

english_verse: You must not cheat any of the Lord's followers in matters of sex. Remember, we warned you that he punishes everyone who does such things.
translation_verse: Tibɔti nee poonee, ni-kansikin ubɔ ń taa ŋá u-nabiki min kaa kítèeyaaa, kí taa mùul̀-u. Ti nìn tùkū-ni an bɔti dooooyee ki gíti kpáafì-ni-tì tiŋan yii ti-Dindaan làá dāá dáaĺ bin ŋáań an kpitiiyee tafal.

english_verse: God didn't choose you to be filthy, but to be pure.
translation_verse: Di sá yii Unimbɔti kaa yíiń-ti tí dāá nīn bí tijɔkɔndi poon, ama u yíiń-ti tí dāá nīn sá circirdambi ní.

english_verse: So if you don't obey these rules, you are not really disobeying us. Instead, you are disobeying God, who gives you his Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: An puee un di yaa dū ti-dàkatam nee ki fée, an kaa sá unil bɔti ní u fá, ama Unimbɔti un tīī-ni u-Circir Famee bɔti ní u fá.

english_verse: We don't have to write you about the need to love each other. God has taught you to do this,
translation_verse: An yaa kíǹ ni nì ni-nabiyaamu kansikin neendee, an kaa ti bàlifī yii tí ŋmà-ni an pu gba, kun puee Unimbɔti dàkā-ni ni nín máaǹ kí nīn néeń tɔb puee.

english_verse: and you already have shown your love for all his people in Macedonia. But, my dear friends, we ask you to do even more.
translation_verse: An neendee gba ní ni cáá nnabiyaamu mun kɔkɔ bí Maseeduwaan tiŋki kɔkɔnee pu. Ama ti bàlifī-ni yii ní gíti ŋá min jítiǹ min ni nìn ŋáań dooooyee.

english_verse: Try your best to live quietly, to mind your own business, and to work hard, just as we taught you to do.
translation_verse: Ní pɔ́ɔǹ ni-ba kí nīn bímaan ŋgbansɔŋfi poon kí nīn tūǹ atuun kí kpíiǹ ni-ba, kii ti nín nìn pée tùkū-ni dooooyee puee.

english_verse: Then you will be respected by people who are not followers of the Lord, and you won't have to depend on anyone. The Lord's Coming
translation_verse: Ni yaa ŋá mimmee, an di làá yàntī bin kaa nyí Unimbɔtee ń nīn tɔ́-ni, ní naa báká ubɔ pu. Ti-Dindaan Yeesu gítintam

english_verse: My friends, we want you to understand how it will be for those followers who have already died. Then you won't grieve over them and be like people who don't have any hope.
translation_verse: Nnabiyaamu, ti là yii ní nīn nyí bin kpíìyee bɔti nín làá dāá jītí puee mbaamɔmin. Taa là yii ní nīn bí kunimbaaun kii bin kaa cáá ti-Dindaan pu dimákalee nín bí puee.

english_verse: We believe Jesus died and was raised to life. We also believe that when God brings Jesus back again, he will bring with him all who had faith in Jesus before they died.
translation_verse: Kun puee ti nyí yii Yeesu kpíì ki fātìi fīkitì, míǹ ní ti nyí yii Unimbɔti làá fàtīí tí gíiǹní bin nóó Yeesu ki kpíìyee dimaŋfalin, kii u nín fīkitì Yeesu puee.

english_verse: Our Lord Jesus told us that when he comes, we won't go up to meet him ahead of his followers who have already died.
translation_verse: Ní pīlifì, ti-Dindaan bɔti tin u nìn sòoǹee tiba sɔ̀. Ti-Dindaan yaa láa bāańee, timbi bin dáá bí dimaŋfalinee kaa làá dāá péeǹ bin kpíìyee kí lìntī.

english_verse: With a loud command and with the shout of the chief angel and a blast of God's trumpet, the Lord will return from heaven. Then those who had faith in Christ before they died will be raised to life.
translation_verse: Di sá yii ti-Dindaan u-ba làá dāá pɔ̄ kinyɔkɔ ní ituun kpiliu ń téeń ní Unimbɔti kantándi ń búń. Niinee ní ti-Dindaan ń nyānní yilpu kí sìntīń, ní bin fōō-u ki kíí ki kpíìyee ń péé péé kí fìkitī.

english_verse: Next, all of us who are still alive will be taken up into the clouds together with them to meet the Lord in the sky. From that time on we will all be with the Lord forever.
translation_verse: Ní timbi bin dáá kíǹ kaa kpíìyee mun ń yīkì kí kūtì bi-pu ní án yòon̄-ti kutaa pu tí tūŋkì ti-Dindaan atagbanni, ní ti nì ti-Dindaan ń nīn kíǹ ki bí baabadal.

english_verse: Encourage each other with these words.
translation_verse: Ní nīn cáá tibɔti nee ki sɔ̀ŋkīmaan tɔb pɔbiliŋ.

english_verse: I don't need to write you about the time or date when all this will happen.
translation_verse: Nnabiyaamu, an kaa ti bàlifī yii tí ŋmà kí tùkù-ni iyunti in ní an bɔtee làá bàńee.

english_verse: You surely know that the Lord's return will be as a thief coming at night.
translation_verse: Di sá yii nimbi ni-ba ni nyí ti-Dindaan dāantam bɔti tiŋan yii u làá bàń kii unaayuu nín dòoń kunyeeu puee ní.

english_verse: People will think they are safe and secure. But destruction will suddenly strike them like the pains of a woman about to give birth. And they won't escape.
translation_verse: Ŋyunti ŋun binib yaa láa bí ki lì yii: «Ŋgbansɔŋfi, ti ŋmátì dee», dicilpu kpalaa niin ní nnaabu ń jēetí bi-pu kí nàan̄-bi. Báà ubɔ kaa dāa ŋmátí, an dāa bí kii imatiŋween nín bàń upɔdaan puee ní.

english_verse: My dear friends, you don't live in darkness, and so that day won't surprise you like a thief.
translation_verse: Ama nimbee, nnabiyaamu, naa ti bí dibɔmbɔndin ŋwiin gbanti ń dāá túuǹ-ni kii unaayuu nín tūuntí binib puee.

english_verse: You belong to the light and live in the day. We don't live in the night or belong to the dark.
translation_verse: Di sá yii nimbi kɔkɔ sá ŋwalifi biyaamu ní ki bí ŋwiimpu. Taa sá kunyeeu yabaaa, kaa sá dibɔmbɔndi yab.

english_verse: Others may sleep, but we should stay awake and be alert.
translation_verse: Míǹ puee, tí taa nín̄ gèeǹ kii bin kíǹee nín gèeǹ puee, ama timbi ń fìntī kí nīn ŋúb́ ti-ba.

english_verse: People sleep during the night, and some even get drunk.
translation_verse: Kunyeeu ní bin gèeǹee gèeǹ, ní bin nyù ki gbéèyee nyù kunyeeu.

english_verse: But we belong to the day. So we must stay sober and let our faith and love be like a suit of armor. Our firm hope that we will be saved is our helmet.
translation_verse: Ama timbi bin sá ŋwalifin yabee. Ti máaǹ kí nīn ŋúb́ ti-ba tiŋan. Ti máaǹ kí dū ti-fookiiu nì ti-neendi kí dūú pèen̄ kii dijanjabɔkutilee, ní kí dū ti-fiil din pu ti mákée kí cíkiń kii kifuuliiyee.

english_verse: God doesn't intend to punish us, but wants us to be saved by our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Di sá yii Unimbɔti kaa lēē-ti ki yóoǹ tí nīn sá bin pu u làá dāá fōō diŋuulee, ama tí nīn sá bin làá ká difiil ti-Dindaan Yeesu Kriisitoo puee.

english_verse: Christ died for us, so we could live with him, whether we are alive or dead when he comes.
translation_verse: Úǹ Kriisitoo di kpíì ti-pu, án nín làá ŋá pu báà ti yaa láa bí dimaŋfalinaaa, ti yaa láa kpíìyaaa, u yaa láa gítìńee ti nì u ń kpāfì kí nīn bí mbaantiiminee.

english_verse: This is why you must encourage and help each other, just as you are already doing. Final Instructions and Greetings
translation_verse: Míǹ puee ní nīn tììmaan tɔb kunyannyaau ki kútí tɔb mpɔn kii ni nín pée ŋáań puee. Tibɔkpaafikaal nì ijaam

english_verse: My friends, we ask you to be thoughtful of your leaders who work hard and tell you how to live for the Lord.
translation_verse: Nnabiyaamu, ti mèé-ni yii ní nīn tɔ́ bin bí ni-kansikin ki tūǹ ditundi, ki cáá ti-Dindaan bɔti ki dàkà-ni, ki kpòotī-nee.

english_verse: Show them great respect and love because of their work. Try to get along with each other.
translation_verse: Nín̄ cáámaan bi-pu dineeŋkpaandi atuun ŋin bi bí ni-kansikin ki tūǹee pu. Ŋgbansɔŋfi ń nīn bí ni-kansikin.

english_verse: My friends, we beg you to warn anyone who isn't living right. Encourage anyone who feels left out, help all who are weak, and be patient with everyone.
translation_verse: Ti mèé-ni, nnabiyaamu, yii ní kpāafì biwutijoodambee, kí tīī bifaantidambee kunyannyaau, kí tūtuǹ bin wunti yɔ̄tèe, kí nīn cáá kimɔtii báà ŋma pu.

english_verse: Don't be hateful to people, just because they are hateful to you. Rather, be good to each other and to everyone else.
translation_verse: Ní nīn nyíǹ ni-ba ni-jutiibi yaa ŋá-ni ikpitee, ní taa dū ikpiti kí téeǹ-bi, ama nín̄ nyàab̀maan tiŋan diŋál baabadal ki ŋáań ni-jutiibi nì binib kɔkɔ.

english_verse: Always be joyful
translation_verse: Ní nīn fàal̀maan baabadal,

english_verse: and never stop praying.
translation_verse: kí nīn mèé Unimbɔti kí taa gbèen̄.

english_verse: Whatever happens, keep thanking God because of Jesus Christ. This is what God wants you to do.
translation_verse: Báà tin kamaa di yaa pée bāańee, ní nīn jáaḿ Unimbɔti. Min Unimbɔti là bin sá Yeesu Kriisitoo yabee ń nīn bée dee.

english_verse: Don't turn away God's Spirit
translation_verse: Ní taa kpɔ̀ Unimbɔti Fam tuuŋŋi ni-ni,

english_verse: Put everything to the test. Accept what is good
translation_verse: Ama, ní kpèè tiwan kɔkɔ kí lēē tin ŋān̄ee,

english_verse: and don't have anything to do with evil.
translation_verse: kí nīn nyíǹ ni-ba nì tikpitil kɔkɔ nì ti-bulifi.

english_verse: I pray that God, who gives peace, will make you completely holy. And may your spirit, soul, and body be kept healthy and faultless until our Lord Jesus Christ returns.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti un tìì ŋgbansɔŋfee u-ba ń yàntī ní dū ni-ba kɔkɔ kí tīī-u. Ú ŋúb́ ni-Fam nì ni-nammu nì ni-wunti kɔkɔ, án nín làá ŋá pu ti-Dindaan Yeesu Kriisitoo bàńtamee, ní nīn bí circir bí taa láa ká ni-pu ikpiti ibee.

english_verse: The one who chose you can be trusted, and he will do this.
translation_verse: Un yíiń-nee làá ŋá míǹ kí tīī-ni kun puee u sá ibaamɔndaan ní.

english_verse: Friends, please pray for us.
translation_verse: Nnabiyaamu, ní nīn mèé ki tìì ti mun.

english_verse: Give the Lord's followers a warm greeting.
translation_verse: Ní jāam̀ ti-yab nì kunabitiiu jaamii kí tīī-mi.

english_verse: In the name of the Lord I beg you to read this letter to all his followers.
translation_verse: Nì ti-Dindaan yindi puee, m tùkù-ni yii ní dūmaan kugbɔŋu nee kí kàaǹ nnabiyaamu kɔkɔ nimbiin.

english_verse: I pray that our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you!
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan Yeesu Kriisitoo ŋanti ń nīn bí ni-pu.

english_verse: From Paul, Silas, and Timothy. To the church in Thessalonica, the people of God our Father and of the Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Man Pɔɔl nì Siilasi nì Tiimootee di ŋmàn̄ kugbɔŋu nee. Ti ŋmàn̄-ku kí tīī nimbi Kriisitoo nikitil din bí Teesalooniiki ki sá ti-Baa Unimbɔti nì ti-Dindaan Yeesu Kriisitoo yabee ní.

english_verse: I pray that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! When Christ Returns
translation_verse: Unimbɔti ti-Baa nì ti-Dindaan Yeesu Kriisitoo ń ŋá-ni tiŋan kí tīī-ni ŋgbansɔŋfi. Ibɔsoon in dāa bí Kriisitoo gítintam dalee

english_verse: My dear friends, we always have good reason to thank God for you, because your faith in God and your love for each other keep growing all the time.
translation_verse: Nnabiyaamu, ti ŋmāntì kí nīn jáaḿ Unimbɔti ni-pu múlmul. An lafun máaǹ míǹ, kun puee ni-fookiiu mɔ̀tīi wīintí ki cá, ní dineendi din ni cáá tɔb puee mun mɔ̀tīi wīintí.

english_verse: This is why we brag about you to all of God's churches. We tell them how patient you are and how you keep on having faith, even though you are going through a lot of trouble and suffering.
translation_verse: Nimbi pu ní timbi mɔ̀ɔǹ Unimbɔti nikitiŋ cee, ni nín gbíntìi pɔ̄ɔntí ki ŋúb́ ni-fookiiu falaabi kɔkɔ nì agìń ŋin poon ni bée.

english_verse: All this shows that God judges fairly and is making you fit to share in his kingdom for which you are suffering.
translation_verse: Míǹ di dàkà Unimbɔti bɔsooŋyi nín bí deedee miŋyee, kun puee an di làá yàntī ní ŋmā kí kɔ́ Unimbɔti Beel din pu ni bí ki jīǹ falaayee.

english_verse: It is only right for God to punish everyone who is causing you trouble,
translation_verse: Kun puee Unimbɔti sá deedeedaan ní, falaa ní u làá dāá gíiǹ kí téeǹ bin yàntī ni jīǹ falaayee.

english_verse: but he will give you relief from your troubles. God will do the same for us, when the Lord Jesus comes from heaven with his powerful angels
translation_verse: U làá dāá kàan̄ nimbi bin jíń falaayee nì timbi nsɔŋfin ŋyunti ŋun ti-Dindaan Yeesu yaa láa nyánní yilpu nì u-tuuŋyi ipɔndambee.

english_verse: and with a flaming fire. Our Lord Jesus will punish anyone who doesn't know God and won't obey his message.
translation_verse: U làá dāan̄ nì ŋŋmi kí dáaĺ bin kaa nyí Unimbɔti, kaa fōō ti-Dindaan Yeesu Bɔmɔntiitee ki kííyee tafal.

english_verse: Their punishment will be eternal destruction, and they will be kept far from the presence of our Lord and his glorious strength.
translation_verse: Bi-tafadaaldi di dāa sá bí nàan̄-bi kí nīn cá jaanjaan, bí taa nín̄ dàbiǹ ti-Dindaan nì u-nyooti nì u-pɔŋŋu.

english_verse: This will happen on the day when the Lord returns to be praised and honored by all who have faith in him and belong to him. This includes you, because you believed what we said.
translation_verse: Daliŋkin u yaa láa gítìń bin sá u-yabee nì bin kɔkɔ fōō-u ki kííyee cee bí tīī-u tinyoolee kí pàkà-uee, ni mun dāa bí niin, kun puee ni fōō ti-bɔti tin ti sòon̄ nì nee ki kíí.

english_verse: God chose you, and we keep praying that God will make you worthy of being his people. We pray for God's power to help you do all the good things you hope to do and your faith makes you want to do.
translation_verse: An puee ti mèé Unimbɔti ni-pu baabadal ki bàlifī yii ú yàntī ní nīn sá binib bin máaǹ dimaŋfal din pu u yíiń-nee. Ti gíti mèé-u yii u-pɔŋŋu ń yàntī ní ŋmā kí ŋá tiŋan tin ni dàkafī kí ŋée, kí yàntī ni-fookiiu tuuŋŋi ń còom̀ mmɔntiim.

english_verse: Then, because of the undeserved grace of God and our Lord Jesus Christ, you will bring honor to the name of our Lord Jesus, and he will bring honor to you.
translation_verse: Mimmee, ni-puee ti-Dindaan Yeesu Kriisitoo yindi làá ká tinyool, ní u mun puee ni mun ń ká tinyool nì ti-Nimbɔtiu nì ti-Dindaan Yeesu Kriisitoo ŋanti pu.

english_verse: When our Lord Jesus returns, we will be gathered up to meet him. So I ask you, my friends,
translation_verse: Nnabiyaamu, ti-Dindaan Yeesu Kriisitoo làá gítiń ní ti làá dāá kóoǹ kí kpāfì u-cee. Tibɔti gbanti puee, tin ti cáá kí kpāafì-nee sɔ̀.

english_verse: not to be easily upset or disturbed by people who claim the Lord has already come. They may say they heard this directly from the Holy Spirit, or from someone else, or even that they read it in one of our letters.
translation_verse: Ní taa yàntī ni-pɔbiliŋ ń bīil̀ binib nín lì yii ti-Dindaan gbanti pūtì kpáàa bāańee pu. Báà ubɔ di yaa bí yii u fōō Unimbɔti cee tibɔti ní ki nāatì-naaa, ubɔ di yaa tí bí yii tibɔti àá kugbɔŋu ní u fōō ti-cee kí dūú nàatī-nee, ní taa fōō kí kíí.

english_verse: But don't be fooled! People will rebel against God. Then before the Lord returns, the wicked one who is doomed to be destroyed will appear.
translation_verse: Ní taa pée yàntī ubɔ ń dī tiba pu kí ŋmàtiǹ-ni. See binib ń dāá fá Unimbɔti ní utɔŋfiti un ti-Dindaan làá dāá nàan̄ee ń nyā kí jī mpaan, kí wàatī ní ti-Dindaan wiiŋŋu ń nín bàń.

english_verse: He will brag and oppose everything holy or sacred. He will even sit in God's temple and claim to be God.
translation_verse: Utɔŋfitee kaa dāa kíikí binib ń nóó Unimbɔtaaa, kaa dāa kíikí bí jāam̀ tiba nì tiba. U làá dāá yíí kí mɔ̄tì míǹ ní kí tin kpáàa kɔ́ kí kàl̄ kunimbɔtidiin ní kí dū u-ba kí gíiǹ Unimbɔti.

english_verse: Don't you remember I told you this while I was still with you?
translation_verse: Naa téetí yii m nín nìn dáá bí ni-ceeyee, m nìn tùkū-ni an bɔtaaa?

english_verse: You already know what is holding this wicked one back until it is time for him to come.
translation_verse: Ama tiba di dáá ŋúb́-u ní an bɔtee kaa láá bíi ŋáań kɔŋkɔnnee. Ni mun nyí kudɔŋu kun dáá ŋúb́-uee. An puee, see utɔŋfitee yuntiŋu yaa láa bàn̄ee ní ú nín nyā kí jī mpaan.

english_verse: His mysterious power is already at work, but someone is holding him back. And the wicked one won't appear until this someone is out of the way.
translation_verse: U-pɔŋŋu bí dibalin ki bíi tūǹ ditundi dooooyee. Ama un ŋúb́-uee yaa láa búntèe,

english_verse: Then he will appear, but the Lord Jesus will kill him simply by breathing on him. He will be completely destroyed by the Lord's glorious return.
translation_verse: niinee ní utɔŋfitee ń nyā, ní ti-Dindaan ń dāá púfí-u ní ú kpú, ní u-dāantam nín dāa jìl̀ puee ń nàan̄-u.

english_verse: When the wicked one appears, Satan will pretend to work all kinds of miracles, wonders, and signs.
translation_verse: Utɔŋfitee làá dāá dāan̄ nì Sitaan pɔŋŋu ní ki ŋáań maamaacib kɔkɔ nì tidaandi nì tinyimɔŋkpaŋkpantiil.

english_verse: Lost people will be fooled by his evil deeds. They could be saved, but they will refuse to love the truth and accept it.
translation_verse: U dāa cáá tin pée sá ikpitee ki kíiĺ bin wáŋkèe, kun puee bi yíì kaa néeń ibaamɔn in bàà ŋūǹ kí fīī-bee.

english_verse: So God will make sure they are fooled into believing a lie.
translation_verse: An pu ní Unimbɔti dū mpɔn ŋun làá yàntī bí gáatée ki tīiń-bi án nín làá ŋá pu bí nīn nóó tinyimɔmbɔtee.

english_verse: All of them will be punished, because they would rather do evil than believe the truth. Be Faithful
translation_verse: Míǹ puee Unimbɔti làá dāá dáaĺ bin yíì kaa fōō ibaamɔn ki kíí ki néeń ikpitee tafal. Unimbɔti lēē-ni ki yóoǹ kí fīī-ni ní

english_verse: My friends, the Lord loves you, and it is only natural for us to thank God for you. God chose you to be the first ones to be saved. His Spirit made you holy, and you put your faith in the truth.
translation_verse: Nnabiyaamu, ti làá nīn pée jáaḿ Unimbɔti ni-pu ní baabadal, nimbi bin ti-Dindaan néeńee. Di sá yii Unimbɔti péé ki lútì-ni ki fīī-ni nì u-Fam min yāntì ni kpántì u-yabee nì ni nín fōō ibaamɔn ki kííyee pu.

english_verse: God used our preaching as his way of inviting you to share in the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Míǹ pu ní Unimbɔti dī Tibɔmɔntiil tin ti sòoǹ nì ni nee pu ki yíiń-ni ní nīn cáá ti-Dindaan Yeesu Kriisitoo nyooti.

english_verse: My friends, this is why you must remain faithful and follow closely what we taught you in person and by our letters.
translation_verse: Míǹ puee nnabiyaamu, tibɔti tin ti cáań ki dàkà-ni nee, ní nīn ŋúb́-tì an píkí. An yaa sá tin ti sòon̄ kinyɔkɔneeyaaa, an yaa tí sá tin ti ŋmàn̄-neeyaaa, ní kpāafìmaan-tì tiŋan.

english_verse: God our Father loves us. He treats us with undeserved grace and has given us eternal comfort and a wonderful hope. We pray that our Lord Jesus Christ and God our Father
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan Yeesu Kriisitoo u-ba nì ti-Baa Unimbɔti un néeń-ti ki ŋá-ti tiŋan ki tīī-ti dipɔɔsɔŋkil din kaa cáá dikúntilee nì dimákamɔntiilee,

english_verse: will encourage you and help you always to do and say the right thing.
translation_verse: ń gbéeǹ ni-pɔbiliŋ kunyannyaau kí tīī-ni mpɔn ní ŋmā kí nīn ŋáań tin ŋān̄ee ni-tuuŋŋi nì ni-bɔsoontam poon.

english_verse: Finally, our friends, please pray for us. This will help the message about the Lord to spread quickly, and others will respect it, just as you do.
translation_verse: Nnabiyaamu, m-bɔjoolkaati sèé: ní nīn mèé ti-pu, án nín làá ŋá pu Unimbɔti bɔti ń gbìtī kí bà ntimu poon malaa malaa, kí nīn cáá tinyool kii an nín ŋá ni-cee miŋyee.

english_verse: Pray that we may be kept safe from worthless and evil people. After all, not everyone has faith.
translation_verse: Ní mèè ti-pu, án nín làá ŋá pu Unimbɔti ń nyāntí-ti binikpitib nì bitɔŋfitiibi ŋaanee, kun puee an kaa sá binib kɔkɔ di fòol̄ Unimbɔti bɔti ki kíikí.

english_verse: But the Lord can be trusted to make you strong and protect you from harm.
translation_verse: Ama ti-Dindaan sá ibaamɔndaan ní. U làá yàntī ní nīn ŋúb́ an pɔ̄ɔ̄, kí mɔ̄tì ni-pu Sitaan ukpiti ń taa ŋmā-ni.

english_verse: He has made us sure that you are obeying what we taught you and that you will keep on obeying.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan puee, ti cáá ni-pu dimákal ki béè mbaamɔn yii tin ti dàkā-nee, ni bíi ŋáań míǹ, ki làá nīn gbíntì ki ŋáań míǹ ki cá.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will guide you to be as loving as God and as patient as Christ. Warnings against Laziness
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan ń yàntī ní béé ni-pɔbiliŋ poon Unimbɔti neendi nì Kriisitoo nín tìì kimɔtii kiŋyee. An máaǹ unil ń tɔ̄ ditundi

english_verse: My dear friends, in the name of the Lord Jesus, I beg you not to have anything to do with any of your people who loaf around and refuse to obey the instructions we gave you.
translation_verse: Nnabiyaamu, nì ti-Dindaan Yeesu Kriisitoo yindi puee, ní gàntīmaan nnabiyaamu mun di sá biwutijoodambi kaa là kí ŋá min ní ti dàkà-nee.

english_verse: You surely know that you should follow our example. We didn't waste our time loafing,
translation_verse: Nimbi ni-ba nyí ni nín máaǹ kí fōō min timbi ŋáańee, kun puee ti nín nìn bí ni-ceeyee, taa nìn sá biwutijoodambi.

english_verse: and we didn't accept food from anyone without paying for it. We didn't want to be a burden to any of you, so night and day we worked as hard as we could.
translation_verse: Taa dɔ́miń ki kā ubɔ pu u kpīintí-ti fám. Ama kí taa nín̄ kā ubɔ pu udaan ń nīn kpīintí-tee puee, ti nìn tūǹ ditundi ní ŋwiimpu nì kunyeeu ki gì.

english_verse: We had the right not to work, but we wanted to set an example for you.
translation_verse: Ti nín nìn bí ki ŋáań mimmee, an kaa sá yii taa nìn cáá nsan kí fōō ni-jikaati, ama ti ŋá míǹ ki dàkā-ni ní fōō min timbi ŋáańee ní.

english_verse: We also gave you this rule: If you don't work, you don't eat.
translation_verse: Di sá ti nín nìn bí ni-ceeyee, ti nìn tùkū-ni tibɔti tiba yii: «Un kaa là kí tɔ̄ ditundee kaa máaǹ kí jī mun.»

english_verse: Now we learn that some of you just loaf around and won't do any work, except the work of a busybody.
translation_verse: Kun puee ti gbìl̄ yii ni-kansikin biba sá biwutijoodambi ki kā kaa ŋáań diba ní ki cáǹ bi-ba ki kɔ̄ntí bi-jutiibi bɔtin.

english_verse: So, for the sake of our Lord Jesus Christ, we ask and beg these people to settle down and start working for a living.
translation_verse: Nì ti-Dindaan Yeesu Kriisitoo yindi puee, ti tùkù ki kpáafí an nibee yii bí tɔ̄ ditundi nì dipɔɔsɔŋkil poon kí kpíiǹ bi-ba.

english_verse: Dear friends, you must never become tired of doing right.
translation_verse: Ama nimbee, nnabiyaamu, ní taa yàntī tiŋan diŋál.

english_verse: Be on your guard against any followers who refuse to obey what we have written in this letter. Put them to shame by not having anything to do with them.
translation_verse: Un di yaa kaa tɔ́ tibɔti tin ti ŋmàn̄-ni kugbɔŋu nee poonee, ní dáań-u, ni nì u ń taa ti nín̄ nōotí, icoo ń kɔ́-u.

english_verse: Don't consider them your enemies. Instead, speak kindly to them as you would to any other follower. Final Prayer
translation_verse: Ní taa nín dū-u kí kpántí ni-nannanliu ní, ama ní sāŋkì-u kii unil nín sáŋkí u-nabiki tibɔti puee. Ijaam nì dibiindi

english_verse: I pray that the Lord, who gives peace, will always bless you with peace. May the Lord be with all of you.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan un tìì ŋgbansɔŋfee u-ba ń tīī-ni ŋgbansɔŋfi ŋyunti kamaa nì tikɔkɔ poon. Ti-Dindaan ń nīn bí ni-kɔkɔ cee.

english_verse: I always sign my letters as I am now doing: PAUL.
translation_verse: Ijaam nee, man Pɔɔl m-ba ŋal di ŋmàn̄. M-gbɔnti kɔkɔ poonee, m nín nyìitī m-ŋal puee dee. Kpèèmaan m-ŋmaŋmabiti dee.

english_verse: I pray that our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to all of you.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan Yeesu Kriisitoo ŋanti ń nīn bí ni-kɔkɔ pu.

english_verse: From Paul. God our Savior and Christ Jesus commanded me to be an apostle of Christ Jesus, who gives us hope.
translation_verse: Man Pɔɔl, un sá Yeesu Kriisitoo kpambal din Unimbɔti ti-Fiiliu nì Yeesu Kriisitoo un pu ti mákée túnnée di ŋmàn̄ kugbɔŋu nee.

english_verse: Timothy, because of our faith, you are like a son to me. I pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind and merciful to you. May they bless you with peace! Warning against False Teaching
translation_verse: M ŋmàn̄-ku kí tīī sii Tiimootee un sá m-ba bindi pu jipɔɔn a nín fōō Yeesu Kriisitoo ki kííyee puee ní. Ti-Baa Unimbɔti nì ti-Dindaan Yeesu Kriisitoo ń ŋá-si tiŋan, kí sɔ̄ a-saai, kí tīī-si ŋgbansɔŋfi. Á nīn nyí nì a-ba nì nnyimɔn dakaŋ

english_verse: When I was leaving for Macedonia, I asked you to stay on in Ephesus and warn certain people there to stop spreading their false teachings.
translation_verse: Ŋyunti ŋun m làá nìn yīkì kí nīn cá Maseeduwaanee, m nìn tùkū-si yii á nīn kā Eefeesi kí pìin̄ bin bí niin ki dàkà tinyimɔmbɔtee nsan bí taa ti dàkà. Á nīn ŋáań míǹ,

english_verse: You needed to warn them to stop wasting their time on senseless stories and endless lists of ancestors. Such things only cause arguments. They don't help anyone to do God's work that can only be done by faith.
translation_verse: ki dàkà-bi bí taa nín̄ kā ki máafí mmaam ki kàaǹ atiŋkpikiyin ŋin kaa dóotée. An cāabìń kunikpɔŋkpɔkɔu, kaa tútúǹ unil ń béé Unimbɔti nín yóoǹ puee: an dàkà yii tí fōō-u kí kíí.

english_verse: You must teach people to have genuine love, as well as a good conscience and true faith.
translation_verse: Kun pu ní a kpáafí-bi mimmee di sá a là bí nīn cáá dineendi din nyēeń dipɔɔnyaandinee ní, bi-landɔkɔjaatiŋu ń nīn sá mmɔnti bi-fookiiu ń nīn bá ki pɔ̄ɔ̄.

english_verse: There are some who have given up these for nothing but empty talk.
translation_verse: Biba dū an saŋŋuee ki fá, ní ki cūtìi kɔ́ tibɔfan tin kaa cáá taapuee ni.

english_verse: They want to be teachers of the Law of Moses. But they don't know what they are talking about, even though they think they do.
translation_verse: Bi bàà là kí nīn dàkà binib Unimbɔti marab, ama nì min kɔkɔ bi dàkà nì mpɔnee, bíǹ biba kaa gbìl̀aaa, kaa nyí tibɔti tin bi sòoǹee taapu.

english_verse: We know the Law is good, if it is used in the right way.
translation_verse: Ti nyí yii marab sá tiwammɔntiil ní, a yaa dū marab gbanti ki ŋá min sá á dūú ŋée.

english_verse: We also understand it wasn't given to control people who please God, but to control lawbreakers, criminals, godless people, and sinners. It is for wicked and evil people, and for murderers, who would even kill their own parents.
translation_verse: Ti nyí yii an kaa sá binimɔntiibi pu ní bi yóoǹ marab, an sá bin gáatèe, nì bin yiliŋ pɔ̄ɔ̄yee, nì bin kaa tɔ́ Unimbɔtee, nì bikpitiŋaliibi, nì binib bin kaa là Unimbɔtee, nì bin bíiĺ Unimbɔti wantee, nì bin kù bi-baabi nì bi-nabee, nì binikpɔliibi,

english_verse: The Law was written for people who are sexual perverts or who live as homosexuals or are kidnappers or liars or won't tell the truth in court. It is for anything else that opposes the correct teaching
translation_verse: nì bin ŋáań tilaakpaalee, nì bin dɔ̀ nì bi-ninjajutiibee, nì bin nyáfí binibee, nì binyimɔndambi, nì bin pùtī fám fámee, nì bin kɔkɔ ŋáań tin jáà nì ibaamɔn bɔti tin bi dàkà-tee pu ní bi yóoǹ marab.

english_verse: of the good news the glorious and wonderful God has given me. Being Thankful for God's Kindness
translation_verse: Tinyool Nimbɔtiu un bí mmɔnnee Bɔmɔntiiti tin u dūu ŋá m-ŋaanee poon ní tin m sòon̄ ki tīī-ni nee kā. Pɔɔl jáaḿ Unimbɔti u-ŋanti pu

english_verse: I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who has given me the strength for my work because he knew he could trust me.
translation_verse: M jáaḿ ti-Dindaan Yeesu Kriisitoo un di tīī-mi mpɔn ki cáá m-pu dimákal yii ḿ tɔ̄ u-tundee.

english_verse: I used to say terrible and insulting things about him, and I was cruel. But Christ had mercy on me because I didn't know what I was doing, and I had not yet put my faith in him.
translation_verse: Nì min kɔkɔ m nìn sòoǹ u-pu min kaa kítèe ki sàantí u-yab ki wɔ́b̀-bee, Unimbɔti súń m-saai, kun puee maa nìn fōō Yeesu ki kíí, kaa nìn nyí yii m bíi yìntī.

english_verse: Christ Jesus our Lord treated me with undeserved grace and has greatly blessed my life with faith and love just like his own.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan ŋá-mi tiŋan tikpil ki yāntì m fōō ki kíí, ní ki tīī-mi dineendi din nyēeń Yeesu Kriisitoo ceeyee.

english_verse: “Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners.” This saying is true, and it can be trusted. I was the worst sinner of all!
translation_verse: Tibɔti nee sá mbaamɔn ní ki máaǹ báà ŋma ń fōō-tì kí kíí mmɔntiimin. Di sá yii Yeesu Kriisitoo dɔ́miń duulinya nee ni kí fīī binikpitib, binikpitibee kansikinee man di sá unikpitikpaan.

english_verse: But since I was worse than anyone else, God had mercy on me and let me be an example of the endless patience of Christ Jesus. He did this so that others would put their faith in Christ and have eternal life.
translation_verse: Ama ní Unimbɔti súń m-saai ki yāntì Yeesu Kriisitoo dī man unikpitikpaan pu ki dàkā u-mɔtiiki nín wīikí min bulifee, án nīn sá kudaaŋŋu kí tīī bin làá dāá fōō-u kí kíí foolboon kí ká dimaŋfal din kaa kúntée.

english_verse: I pray that honor and glory will always be given to the only God, who lives forever and is the invisible and eternal King! Amen.
translation_verse: An puee, bí tīī Unimbɔti un bí talku, kaa kúù, baa wālifí-uee jilma nì tinyool. Úǹ baba di sá Unimbɔti, kí nīn cá abin abin! Ameeni.

english_verse: Timothy, my son, the instructions I am giving you are based on what some prophets once said about you. If you follow these instructions, you will fight like a good soldier.
translation_verse: Sii m-biki Tiimootee, m dū tibɔti nee ki ŋá a-ŋaan. Kii tibɔti tin bi nìn fōō Unimbɔti cee a-pu dooooyee ki dūu nāatèe, á tɔ́kɔń tibɔtee pu kí já kujamɔntiiu.

english_verse: You will be faithful and have a clear conscience. Some people have made a mess of their faith because they didn't listen to their consciences.
translation_verse: Á nīn gbíntìi ŋúb́ tin a nìn fōō ki kííyee kí nīn cáá nlandɔkɔmɔnti. Biba fá nlandɔkɔmɔnti ní bi-fookiiu ŋá fám.

english_verse: Two of them are Hymenaeus and Alexander. I have given these men over to the power of Satan, so they will learn not to oppose God.
translation_verse: Ti kāntí binib gbanti kansikinee Imeenee nì Aleekisandir, bin m dū ki líiǹ Sitaan, án nín làá ŋá pu án cíiǹ-bi bí béé kí taa nín̄ gíti sòoǹ ki bíiĺ Unimbɔtee.

english_verse: First of all, I ask you to pray for everyone. Ask God to help and bless them all, and tell God how thankful you are for each of them.
translation_verse: Tibɔpeepeekaal tin m kpáafí bí ŋée di sá bí nīn mèé ki gbàam̄ ki jáaḿ Unimbɔti binib kɔkɔ pu.

english_verse: Pray for kings and others in power, so we may live quiet and peaceful lives as we worship and honor God.
translation_verse: Bí nīn mèé bibɔtiibi nì biyidambi kɔkɔ pu, án nín làá ŋá pu tiba ń taa páb́-ti, tí nīn bí nsɔŋfin kí nīn nóó Unimbɔti mmɔntiimin kí lafun nín̄ sá binimɔntiibee.

english_verse: This kind of prayer is good, and it pleases God our Savior.
translation_verse: Á mèè kí tīī binibee ŋān̄ Unimbɔti ti-Fiiliu cee,

english_verse: God wants everyone to be saved and to know the whole truth, which is,
translation_verse: kun puee u là yii binib kɔkɔ ń ká difiil kí béé ibaamɔn.

english_verse: There is only one God, and Christ Jesus is the only one who can bring us to God. Jesus was truly human, and he gave himself to rescue all of us.
translation_verse: Di sá yii Unimbɔti sá ubaanti, ní ugbaamil un yú timbi binib nì Unimbɔti kansikinee mun sá ubaanti, úǹ di sá Yeesu Kriisitoo un kpántì unilee.

english_verse: This is why God chose me to be a preacher and an apostle of the good news. I am telling the truth. I am not lying. God sent me to teach the Gentiles about faith and truth.
translation_verse: Ní Unimbɔti dū-mi ki ŋá un sòoǹ u-bɔtee nì u-kpambal, ḿ nīn dàkà bin kaa sá Juuda yabee u-bɔti tin sá ibaamɔnee bí fōō kí kíí. Tin m lì nee sá ibaamɔn ní, maa mɔ́ntí.

english_verse: I want everyone everywhere to lift innocent hands toward heaven and pray, without being angry or arguing with each other.
translation_verse: An puee, m là yii, báà laakiŋyee, bininjab ń yòon̄ bi-ŋalii yilpu kí nīn mèé, bi-pɔbiliŋ poon ń nīn bí circir, bí taa nín̄ cáá diŋuul nì kunikpɔŋkpɔkɔu.

english_verse: I would like for women to wear modest and sensible clothes. They should not have fancy hairdos, or wear expensive clothes, or put on jewelry made of gold or pearls.
translation_verse: M là yii binimpoobi mun ń nīn pèentí tiwan min kítèe, kí taa nín̄ nyāantí bi-ba ki gíti lákatí, kí taa nín̄ dàkà bi-ba, bi-yikpibóobitam ń taa nín̄ nyēē mbamin. Bí taa nín̄ cáá sindaariya nì abeedimbil wanti ki nyāantí bi-ba, kí taa nín̄ pèentí tiwan tin pɔ̄ɔ̄ kudaauee.

english_verse: Women who claim to love God should do helpful things for others,
translation_verse: Ama bí nīn tūǹ atummɔnti ŋin máaǹ binimpoobi bin bí yii bi nóó Unimbɔtee tuuŋŋee.

english_verse: and they should learn by being quiet and paying attention.
translation_verse: Bi yaa bíi dàkà Unimbɔti bɔtee, binimpoobi ń sìntī bi-ba taapu kí nīn ŋmí.

english_verse: They should be silent and not be allowed to teach or to tell men what to do.
translation_verse: Maa pūǹ nsan yii binimpoobi ń nīn dàkà bininjab, kí taa nín̄ wɔ́b̀ bininjab, bi máaǹ kí nīn kā soooo ní.

english_verse: and the man Adam wasn't the one who was fooled. It was the woman Eve who was completely fooled and sinned.
translation_verse: An kaa tí sá Adam ní Sitaan ŋmātiǹ, u-nimpuu ní Sitaan ŋmātiǹ, ní u yīntì Unimbɔti marau.

english_verse: But women will be saved by having children, if they stay faithful, loving, holy, and modest.
translation_verse: Ama ní u-maaliŋu puee, u yaa gbíntì ki pɔ̄ɔntí u-fookiiu poon nì dineendi kí nīn bí circir kí taa nín̄ dàkà u-bee, u làá dāá ká difiil.

english_verse: It is true that anyone who desires to be a church official wants to be something worthwhile.
translation_verse: Tibɔti tin m làá sòoǹee sá ibaamɔn ní: di sá yii unil un là kí nīn kpòotī Kriisitoo nikitilee lēē ditummɔntiil.

english_verse: That's why officials must have a good reputation and be faithful in marriage. They must be self-controlled, sensible, well-behaved, friendly to strangers, and able to teach.
translation_verse: An máaǹ bí taa ká un kpòotī Kriisitoo nikitilee pu tikpitil tiba. Ú nīn cáá unimpubaanti, kí ŋúb́ u-ba, kí nīn cáá iciin, kí nīn sá unimɔnti, kí nīn fòol̄ binicambi, kí nīn ŋūǹ ki dàkà binib Unimbɔti bɔti.

english_verse: They must not be heavy drinkers or troublemakers. Instead, they must be kind and gentle and not love money.
translation_verse: Ú taa nín̄ sá udanyɔl nì kílkil niliu, ama ú nīn sá unil un mɔ̄ee, kí taa nín̄ cáá kunikpɔŋkpɔkɔu, kí taa nín̄ néeń animbil.

english_verse: Church officials must be in control of their own families, and they must see that their children are obedient and always respectful.
translation_verse: U máaǹ kí ŋmā kí kpòotī u-ba dicaŋku tiŋan, kí yàntī u-biyaamu ń nīn tɔ́-u nì tibulcin.

english_verse: If they don't know how to control their own families, how can they look after God's people?
translation_verse: Di sá yii unil yaa kaa ŋūǹ kí kpòotī u-ba dicaŋku tiŋanee, mana ní u làá ŋmā kí kpòotī Unimbɔti nikitil?

english_verse: They must not be new followers of the Lord. If they are, they might become proud and be doomed along with the devil.
translation_verse: Udaan ń taa nín̄ sá un fōō Yeesu ki kíí mpɔmee. An yaa sá fám, u dù kí ŋá dilambil, ní kí kɔ́ Unimbɔti bɔtin kii Sitaan nín kɔ́ puee.

english_verse: Finally, they must be well-respected by people who are not followers. Then they won't be trapped and disgraced by the devil. Church Officers
translation_verse: Bin kaa nóó Unimbɔtee mun máaǹ kí nīn nyí udaan pu yii u sá unimɔnti, án nín làá ŋá pu bí taa nín̄ kpèé-u fám, ú dāá jēetí Sitaan talintinee. Kriisitoo nikitil kpilib

english_verse: Church officers should be serious. They must not be liars, heavy drinkers, or greedy for money.
translation_verse: Míǹ mbaantiimin, Kriisitoo nikitil kpilib máaǹ kí nīn cáá mbimbimɔntiim, kí taa nín̄ bí mili mili, kí taa nín̄ gbéè ndaam, kí taa dī isaŋkpiti pu kí nyàab̀ animbil.

english_verse: And they must have a clear conscience and hold firmly to what God has shown us about our faith.
translation_verse: Bi máaǹ kí nīn ŋúb́ Unimbɔti saŋŋu ŋun nìn bí dibalin u nyántì ki dàkā-tee nì dipɔɔbaantiil.

english_verse: They must first prove themselves. Then if no one has anything against them, they can serve as officers.
translation_verse: Kí wàatī bí lēē-bee, bí cɔ̄ŋkì kí kpèè bi-bimbim nín bí puee. Bi yaa kaa ká bi-pu tibee, ní bí ŋmā kí nīn sá bin tūǹ Kriisitoo nikitil kansikin ditundee.

english_verse: Women must also be serious. They must not gossip or be heavy drinkers, and they must be faithful in everything they do.
translation_verse: Míǹ mbaantiim, binimpoobi mun máaǹ kí nīn cáá mbimbimɔntiim, kí taa nín̄ sòoǹ ki bíiĺ binib, kí nīn ŋúb́ bi-ba, kí nīn bí deedee tikɔkɔ nì tikɔkɔ poon.

english_verse: Church officers must be faithful in marriage. They must be in full control of their children and everyone else in their home.
translation_verse: Bin tūǹ Kriisitoo nikitil kansikin ditundee máaǹ kí nīn cáá unimpu ubɔ ubɔ, ní kí ŋmā kí kpòotī bi-biyaamu nì bi-dicaŋŋi mmɔntiimin.

english_verse: Those who serve well as officers will earn a good reputation and will be highly respected for their faith in Christ Jesus. The Mystery of Our Religion
translation_verse: Bi yaa tūǹ bi-tuuŋŋi mmɔntiiminee, binib tɔ́-bi ní, ní bi sòoǹ Yeesu Kriisitoo bɔti, kaa gùgufī kpataaa. Tiwan tin nìn bí dibalinee

english_verse: I hope to visit you soon. But I am writing these instructions,
translation_verse: M dá láá ŋmàn̄-si kugbɔŋu nee ki máká yii an kaa làá ti yúntí, m làá dāan̄ a-cee.

english_verse: so if I am delayed, you will know how everyone who belongs to God's family ought to behave. After all, the church of the living God is the strong foundation of truth.
translation_verse: M yaa kaa tí ŋúń ki dɔ́miń malaayaaa, kugbɔŋu nee ŋūǹ kí tūtuǹ-si á béé a nín máaǹ kí nīn bí min Unimbɔti dicaŋku poonee, an dàkà yii Unimbɔti un kaa kúùyee nikitil din sá kii jaantalkub ki tíkí ibaamɔnee.

english_verse: Here is the great mystery of our religion: Christ came as a human. The Spirit proved that he pleased God, and he was seen by angels. Christ was preached to the nations. People in this world put their faith in him, and he was taken up to glory.
translation_verse: Tiŋman, dinimbɔtinool bɔti tin nìn bí dibalin Unimbɔti nyántì ki dàkā-tee sá tiwaŋkpaandi ní! Yeesu kpántì unil ní ki dɔ́miń ti-cee, Circir Fam dàkā yii u sá deedeedaan, Unimbɔti tuuŋyi ká-u. Bi sòon̄ u-pu atimbun kɔkɔn, kitiŋ pu nib fōō-u ki kíí ní Unimbɔti yōoǹ-u ki jɔ́m̀ yilpu tinyool laŋki.

english_verse: God's Spirit clearly says that in the last days many people will turn from their faith. They will be fooled by evil spirits and by teachings that come from demons.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti Fam lī ki cántì yii, iyuntijoolkaa poonee, binib biba làá dāá fá nnimbɔtisan ní ki kíǹ ki tɔ́ arasiniibi bin kíiĺ binibee, ní ki nóó bi-dàkatam.

english_verse: They will also be fooled by the false claims of liars whose consciences have lost all feeling. These liars
translation_verse: Mpoonnyoondambi bin mɔ́ntí binib, bi-pɔbiliŋ tīlifèe di làá dāá yàntī bí gáatí.

english_verse: will forbid people to marry or to eat certain foods. But God created these foods to be eaten with thankful hearts by his followers who know the truth.
translation_verse: Bi dāa yíití yii an kaa ŋān̄ unil ń cáá unimpu, ní ki kòó tijin tiba, tijikaal tin Unimbɔti nyántì yii bin fōō Yeesu ki kíí ki nyí ibaamɔn kɔkɔee ń mèè kí jāam̀ Unimbɔti ní kí jēe.

english_verse: Everything God created is good. And if you give thanks, you may eat anything.
translation_verse: Tin kɔkɔ Unimbɔti náańee ŋān̄ ní, tiba kaa sá tí dūú fá. Tí fōō tin kɔkɔ bée kí jāam̀ Unimbɔti.

english_verse: What God has said and your prayer will make it fit to eat. Paul's Advice to Timothy
translation_verse: Unimbɔti bɔti nì ŋwimmeem yàntī tijin ń kpántí timɔntiil ní u-nimbiin. Yeesu Kriisitoo tɔntɔmmɔntiu

english_verse: If you teach these things to other followers, you will be a good servant of Christ Jesus. You will show you have grown up on the teachings about our faith and on the good instructions you have obeyed.
translation_verse: A yaa dū tibɔti nee ki dàkā ti-nabiyaamuee, a kpántí Yeesu Kriisitoo tɔntɔmmɔntiu, ní kí nīn cáá nnimbɔtisan bɔti nì didàkamɔntiil din a nóó tiŋanee ki kpīintí a-ba.

english_verse: Don't have anything to do with worthless, senseless stories. Work hard to be truly religious.
translation_verse: Á fá mmaam min nyáń mi-ba nì nnimbɔtisan bɔti ki sá tibɔfanee, kí pɔ́ɔǹ a-ba kí mɔ̀tīí nóó Unimbɔti mbaamɔmin.

english_verse: We have put our hope in the living God, who is the Savior of everyone, but especially of those who have faith. This is why we work and struggle so hard.
translation_verse: Kun pu ti tūǹ ditundi ki gì ki bí kujaau poonee di sá ti dū ti-mákal ki ŋá Unimbɔti un bí kaa kúùyee ni, Unimbɔti un fìil̄ binib kɔkɔee: kí cántée, bin fōō Yeesu ki kííyee ní an sá.

english_verse: Teach these things and tell everyone to do what you say.
translation_verse: Á dàkà binib tibɔti nee kɔkɔ kí yàntī bí ŋá míǹ.

english_verse: Don't let anyone make fun of you, just because you are young. Set an example for other followers by what you say and do, as well as by your love, faith, and purity.
translation_verse: Á taa yàntī bí kpèè kí sìŋkīǹ-si yii a nín sá kinaacimpɔmbikee pu. Ama á nīn sá un bin fōō Yeesu ki kííyee làá nīn kpèé ki ŋáań min a ŋáańee, kí fōō a-sòontam nì a-bimbim nì a-neendi nì a-fookiiu nì a-circir bítam.

english_verse: Until I arrive, be sure to keep on reading the Scriptures in worship, and don't stop preaching and teaching.
translation_verse: Kí wàatī ḿ nín dāan̄ee, á dū a-ba kí tīī Unimbɔti gbɔŋku dikàandi binib cee, kí nīn sòoǹ ki tìì-bi kunyannyaau, ki dàkà-bi Unimbɔti bɔti.

english_verse: Use the gift you were given when the prophets spoke and the group of church leaders blessed you by placing their hands on you.
translation_verse: Mpɔn ŋun Unimbɔti nìn pú-si ŋyunti ŋun bi nìn fōō a-pu Unimbɔti cee tibɔti ki nāatì, ní Kriisitoo nikitil kpilib dū bi-ŋalii ki páaǹ a-puee, ŋu bí a-ni. Á dū-ŋu kí tɔ̄ ditundi.

english_verse: Remember these things and think about them, so everyone can see how well you are doing.
translation_verse: Á taa gbīiliǹ ditundi gbanti. Á dū a-ba kɔkɔ kí kúntí di-poon, án nín làá ŋá pu báà ŋma ń ká a nín cá nyɔkɔpu miŋyee.

english_verse: Be careful about the way you live and about what you teach. Keep on doing this, and you will save not only yourself, but the people who hear you.
translation_verse: Á nīn nyí nì a-ba bítam nì tin a dàkèe, kí cúú an píkí. A yaa lafun ŋá míǹ, a làá fīī a-ba, kí kpáàa fīī bin pílifíǹ-see mun.

english_verse: Don't correct an older man. Encourage him, as you would your own father. Treat younger men as you would your own brother,
translation_verse: Á taa wòoǹ utikpil mpɔn. Á sòoǹ nì u soooo kii a-baayee, kí nīn sòoǹ nì binaacimpɔmbi kii a-naalibee.

english_verse: and treat older women as you would your own mother. Show the same respect to younger women that you would to your sister.
translation_verse: Á nīn sòoǹ nì binimpukpaambi kii a-nabee, nì binimpusapɔmbi kii a-niisalibee nì tibulcin poon.

english_verse: Take care of any widow who is really in need.
translation_verse: Á nīn ŋúb́ bikpiipoobi bin kaa cáá báà ubɔ nì ubɔee kí nīn tɔ́-bi.

english_verse: But if a widow has children or grandchildren, they should learn to serve God by taking care of her, as she once took care of them. This is what God wants them to do.
translation_verse: Ama ukpiipu ubɔ yaa cáá mbiyaamu, an yaa tí sá u-naantiibaaa, bíǹ di máaǹ kí béé nnimbɔtisan tundi bi-ba dicaŋku poon kí wàatī ní kí ŋúb́ bi-nab nì bi-naambi kí téeǹ, min fáatì Unimbɔtee dee.

english_verse: A widow who is really in need is one who doesn't have any relatives. She has faith in God, and she keeps praying to him night and day, asking for his help.
translation_verse: Unimpu un yaa lafun sá ukpiipu, kaa cáá ubɔ ń kpèè-uee dù u-mákal kí ŋá Unimbɔtin ní, ki mèé ki gbàam̄ Unimbɔti ŋwiimpu nì kunyeeu.

english_verse: A widow who thinks only about having a good time is already dead, even though she is still alive.
translation_verse: An yaa sá ukpiipu un ŋáań min kaa kítèe, u bí dimaŋfalin ama ní ki kpíì.

english_verse: Tell all this to everyone, so they will do the right thing.
translation_verse: Tin tin a máaǹ kí dūú dàkà-bee dee, án nín làá ŋá pu ubɔ ń taa ká ikpiti iba bi-puee.

english_verse: People who don't take care of their relatives, and especially their own families, have given up their faith. They are worse than someone who doesn't have faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Un kaa ŋúb́ u-dicaŋku tiŋanee, m lì ki bántí u-diiku poon nib kíŋŋŋ ní, mimmee udaan fá fookii, ní bin kaa fōō Yeesu ki kííyee sɔ́ǹ-u.

english_verse: For a widow to be put on the list of widows, she must be at least
translation_verse: Bí taa ŋmà ukpiipu ubɔ yindi kí kūtì bikpiipoobi gbɔŋku poon, asee ukpiipu un yaa cáá abin jítì abin imuŋku ita puee baba. Kí wàatēe, ú nīn sá un nìn mɔ́ǹ uninjabaantee.

english_verse: She must also be well-known for doing all sorts of good things, such as raising children, giving food to strangers, welcoming God's people into her home, helping people in need, and always making herself useful.
translation_verse: Ú nīn sá unimpu un bi pàkà yii u tūǹ atummɔnti ki ŋúń ki ŋúb́ u-biyaamu tiŋan, ki fòol̄ binicambi mmɔntiimin, ki fíntí Unimbɔti nib taaŋi, ki tútúǹ bifalaadambi, ki pée tūǹ atummɔnti ŋmaniŋmee.

english_verse: Don't put young widows on the list. They may later have a strong desire to get married. Then they will turn away from Christ
translation_verse: An yaa sá bikpiipusapɔmbee, bí taa ŋmà bi-yiŋŋi kugbɔŋu poon, kun puee nninjaneel ŋūǹ kí cúú-bi bí dū Kriisitoo kí fá, kí cùú mɔ̄ǹ.

english_verse: Besides, they will become lazy and get into the habit of going from house to house. Next, they will start gossiping and become busybodies, talking about things that are none of their business.
translation_verse: Kí kūtèe, bi nín kaa cáá tiba kí ŋée puee ní bi yìiǹ ki póotí acin. Tin gíti púntèe di sá bi kíǹ ki cáá kubɔcaau ní ki sòoǹ icoo bɔti, nì tin tin kaa bàà máaǹ bí sòoǹee.

english_verse: I would prefer that young widows get married, have children, and look after their families. Then the enemy won't have any reason to say insulting things about us.
translation_verse: An pu ní m là yii bikpiipoobi bin dáá pɔ̀ɔǹee ń mɔ̄ǹ kí màal̀ mbiyaamu kí nīn kpèé bi-ciŋŋi, án nín làá ŋá pu bí taa pɔ̄ unannanli nsan bí sòoǹ kí bīil̀-tee.

english_verse: Look what's already happened to some of the young widows! They have turned away to follow Satan.
translation_verse: Kun puee bikpiipoobi biba pūtì kpáàa dū nsammɔnti ki fá, ki kíǹ ki nóó Sitaan.

english_verse: If a woman who is a follower has any widows in her family, she should help them. This will keep the church from having that burden, and then the church can help widows who are really in need. Church Leaders
translation_verse: Unimpu un fōō ki kííyee yaa cáá bikpiipoobi u-dumpuee, u máaǹ kí tūtuǹ-bi, kí taa dū ditúndi gbanti kí túń Kriisitoo nikitil pu. Míǹ di làá yàntī Kriisitoo nikitil ń ŋmā kí nīn tútúǹ bikpiipoobi bin kaa pée cáá báà ubɔ nì ubɔee.

english_verse: Church leaders who do their job well deserve to be paid twice as much, especially if they work hard at preaching and teaching.
translation_verse: Bin kpòotī Kriisitoo nikitil mmɔntiiminee máaǹ tipaal mili pu. Cilinjee bin pu m sòoǹee di sá bin pɔ̄ɔntí ki sòoǹ Unimbɔti bɔti ki dàkà muee.

english_verse: It is just as the Scriptures say, “Don't muzzle an ox when you are using it to grind grain.” You also know the saying, “Workers are worth their pay.”
translation_verse: Di sá Unimbɔti gbɔŋku poon lī yii: «Á taa bóob́ unaa un tà ki gbátí adibilee nyɔkɔ», ní ki gíti lī yii: «Utɔntɔnli máaǹ u-paati.»

english_verse: Don't listen to any charge against a church leader, unless at least two or three people bring the same charges.
translation_verse: Ubɔ yaa dɔ́miń ki tùkū-si yii bin kpòotī Kriisitoo nikitilee ubɔ ŋá tibee, á taa fōō kí kíí, see binib bili kii bita di yaa ká ní ki tùkū-si.

english_verse: But if any of the leaders should keep on sinning, they must be corrected in front of the whole group, as a warning to everyone else.
translation_verse: Á nīn wòoǹ bin ŋáań ikpitee binib kɔkɔ nimbiin, án nín làá ŋá pu bin kíǹee ń fàŋkèe.

english_verse: In the presence of God and Christ Jesus and their chosen angels, I order you to follow my instructions! Be fair with everyone, and don't have any favorites.
translation_verse: M kpáafí-si Unimbɔti nì Yeesu Kriisitoo nì Unimbɔti tuuŋyi in u lútèe nimbiin, yii á ŋúb́ tibɔti tin m sòoǹ nì si nee kí taa nín̄ cáá dinigàntil, kí taa lēē biba ki ŋáań bíǹ tiŋan ki yàntī bin kíǹee.

english_verse: Don't be too quick to accept people into the service of the Lord by placing your hands on them. Don't sin because others do, but stay close to God.
translation_verse: Á taa ŋá kujinjikilaapaau kí dū a-ŋalii kí páań ubɔ pu kí mèè u-pu kí tīī-u ditundi diba Kriisitoo nikitil kansikin, kí taa kɔ́ biba kpitiin. Nín̄ nyí nì a-ba kí nīn bí circir.

english_verse: Stop drinking only water. Take a little wine to help your stomach trouble and the other illnesses you often have.
translation_verse: Á taa ti nín̄ nyù nnyim ŋmaniŋma. Nín̄ nyù ndamam fiii ipɔŋween nì a-wunti nín nyàŋfī múlmulee pu.

english_verse: Some people get caught in their sins almost at once, even before the time of judgment. But other people's sins don't show up until later.
translation_verse: Bi wālifí biba kpitii kí wàatī gba ní kí nín sòoǹ bidambi bɔti, ama bibee, ibɔsoon poon ní bi dāa nín bìitī bíǹ kpitii pu.

english_verse: It is the same with good deeds. Some are easily seen, but none of them can be hidden.
translation_verse: Míǹ ní bi tí kāntí atummɔnti mun. Ŋin ní baa kāntí malaayee gba mun kpá kí gbíntí dibalin.

english_verse: If you are a slave, you should respect and honor your owner. This will keep people from saying bad things about God and about our teaching.
translation_verse: Iyumbu máaǹ kí nīn tɔ́ i-dindambi nì i-pɔbiliŋ kɔkɔ. Mimmee binib kaa sòoǹ kí bīil̀ Unimbɔti yindi nì tibɔti tin ti dàkèe.

english_verse: If any of you slaves have owners who are followers, you should show them respect. After all, they are also followers of Christ, and he loves them. So you should serve and help them the best you can. False Teaching and True Wealth These are the things you must teach and tell the people to do.
translation_verse: Iyumbu in dindambi nóó Kriisitooyee, í taa kpèè-bi fám, yii bi nín sá i-nabiyaamuee pu. Míǹ gba ní i nín máaǹ kí nīn tūǹ ditundi mmɔntiimin, kun puee bin i tūǹ ditundi ki tììyee sá i-nabineeŋkaamu mun nóó Kriisitooyee ní. Ibaamɔn gaajati nì tinyimɔmbɔti dàkatam Min a máaǹ kí nīn dàkà binib ki kpáafí-bee sèé.

english_verse: Anyone who teaches something different disagrees with the correct and godly teaching of our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Ubɔ yaa bíi dàkà tinyimɔmbɔti tiba, ki yíì, kaa nóó ti-Dindaan Yeesu Kriisitoo baamɔmbɔti nì bi nín dàkā-ti unil nín máaǹ kí nīn bí min Unimbɔti nimbiinee,

english_verse: Those people who disagree are proud of themselves, but they don't really know a thing. Their minds are sick, and they like to argue over words. They cause jealousy, disagreements, unkind words, evil suspicions,
translation_verse: udaan lámintí, kaa nyí tiba. Udaan būǹ tibɔti weeŋyi ní ki kpákà anyɔɔbun pu. An di cāabìń nnimbidiki, kujaau, asiibil, nì ilandɔkɔkpiti bi-jutiibi pu.

english_verse: and nasty quarrels. They have wicked minds and have missed out on the truth. These people think religion is supposed to make you rich.
translation_verse: Baa ti dàkafī nnimɔntiyaamin, baa ti nyí ibaamɔn, ki kpākantí tɔb an kaa kúntí. Bi nyí kii nnimbɔtisan sá laakin bi làá dī kí ká tigaajatee ní.

english_verse: And religion does make your life rich, by making you content with what you have.
translation_verse: Tiŋman, nnimbɔtisan lafun sá tigaajakpaandi ní, ŋyunti ŋun ní an mɔ̄ǹ-si tin a cááyee puee.

english_verse: We didn't bring anything into this world, and we won't take anything with us when we leave.
translation_verse: Ti dɔ́miń duulinya nee ni nì iŋaŋkulim ní, míǹ ní ti làá dāá fàtīí tí gítí nì iŋaŋkulim.

english_verse: So we should be satisfied just to have food and clothes.
translation_verse: Míǹ puee, ti yaa cáá kun ti làá jēe nì kun ti làá pèen̄ee, án ŋmàntīǹ-tee.

english_verse: People who want to be rich fall into all sorts of temptations and traps. They are caught by foolish and harmful desires that drag them down and destroy them.
translation_verse: Ama bin nimbiliŋ máǹ tigaajati puee làá kɔ́ icɔŋkin kí lítí, ní nnimbitaataam tiwan tikpil pu min kaa cáá taapu ki cāabìń diwaŋkilee sàtī-bi kii kutaliŋŋuee. An di téekí binib ki cáǹ asaluun ki nàantí-bi.

english_verse: The love of money causes all kinds of trouble. Some people want money so much they have given up their faith and caused themselves a lot of pain. Fighting a Good Fight for the Faith
translation_verse: Di sá yii nnimbineel di cāabìń mbusub kɔkɔ. Biba nín néeń animbil puee, bi dū nnimbɔtisan ki fá ki dū bi-ba ki kɔ́ǹ dinimbinaamandin tikpil. Isaŋkiluŋkikaa

english_verse: Timothy, you belong to God, so keep away from all these evil things. Try your best to please God and to be like him. Be faithful, loving, dependable, and gentle.
translation_verse: Ama sii Unimbɔti niliu, nyā tíǹ kɔkɔn, kí nyàab̀ kí nīn bí deedee, kí ŋúb́ dinimbɔtinool, kí nīn cáá fookii, kí nīn cáá dineendi nì kimɔtii, kí nīn mɔ̄.

english_verse: Fight a good fight for the faith and claim eternal life. God offered it to you when you clearly told about your faith, while so many people listened.
translation_verse: Á já kujamɔntiiu kun sá fookii jaakuee, kí cúú dimaŋfal din kaa kúntée. Di sá yii tíǹ pu ní Unimbɔti yíiń-si á béé-ŋu ŋyunti ŋun a nìn sòon̄ a nín fōō ki kíí kunipaau nimbiin miŋyee.

english_verse: Now I ask you to make a promise. Make it in the presence of God, who gives life to all, and in the presence of Christ Jesus, who openly told Pontius Pilate about his faith.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti un tìì tiwan kɔkɔ dimaŋfalee nimbiin, nì Yeesu Kriisitoo un nìn sòon̄ ibaamɔn Pɔnsi Piilati cee mmɔntiimee mun nimbiin ní m kpáafí-si.

english_verse: Promise to obey completely and fully all that you have been told until our Lord Jesus Christ returns.
translation_verse: Á kpèè tibɔti tin m ŋúbiǹ-si nee tiŋan kí taa yìntī. Bí taa ká a-pu tikpitil tiba kí nīn cí ŋyunti ŋun ti-Dindaan Yeesu Kriisitoo làá dāá páannée.

english_verse: The glorious God is the only Ruler, the King of kings and Lord of lords. At the time that God has already decided, he will send Jesus Christ back again.
translation_verse: Ŋyunti ŋun Unimbɔti yóoǹee yaa láa bāańee, ní ú yàntī Yeesu ń páanní. Úǹ di sá nnaam nyeel ní ki sá tikɔkɔ Dindaan, bibɔtiibi kɔkɔ Bɔtiu nì bidindambi kɔkɔ Dindaan.

english_verse: Only God lives forever! And he lives in light that no one can come near. No human has ever seen God or ever can see him. God will be honored, and his power will last forever. Amen.
translation_verse: Úǹ baba di kaa kúù, ki kóò ŋwalifi ŋun ubɔ kaa ŋūǹ kí sútí kí pìl̄ee ni. Báà unil kaa láá ká-u, ní kaa tí ŋūǹ kí ká-u. Úǹ di máaǹ tinyool nì mpɔn kí nīn cá jaanjaan! Ameeni.

english_verse: Warn the rich people of this world not to be proud or to trust in wealth that is easily lost. Tell them to have faith in God, who is rich and blesses us with everything we need to enjoy life.
translation_verse: Á kpāafì bin cáá tigaajati duulinya nee nee yii bí taa nín̄ cáá dilambil, kí taa nín̄ máká bi-gaajati tin kaa làá nīn bí ki cá jaanjaanee pu. Ama bí dū bi-mákal kí ŋá Unimbɔti un di pūǹ-ti tikɔkɔ nì tikɔkɔ tikpil tikpil tí nīn bí mmɔnnee ni.

english_verse: Instruct them to do as many good deeds as they can and to help everyone. Remind the rich to be generous and share what they have.
translation_verse: Bí nīn ŋáań tiŋan. Bi-gaajawanti nín wīikí puee, bi-tummɔntiiŋi mun ń nīn wīikí míǹ, bí nīn cáá tiniti ki yàkatī tin bi cááyee nì bin kíǹee.

english_verse: This will lay a solid foundation for the future, so they will know what true life is like.
translation_verse: Bi yaa ŋá mimmee, bi kōontí tigaajamɔntiil tin kaa bíiĺee ki sīintí án nīn dɔ̄ ki cí-bi foolboon dee, ní bí ŋmā kí ká ibaamɔn maŋfal.

english_verse: Timothy, guard what God has placed in your care! Don't pay any attention to godless and stupid talk that sounds smart but really isn't.
translation_verse: Sii Tiimootee, kpāafì tin Unimbɔti tīī-see tiŋan, kí gɔ́ntí tibɔfan tin kaa nàaǹ nì nnimbɔtisanee, kí taa cèeǹ a-nyɔkɔ bin bí yii bi cáá iciin kin kaa cááyee nikpɔŋkpɔkɔku poon.

english_verse: Some people have even lost their faith by believing this talk. I pray that the Lord will be kind to all of you!
translation_verse: Di sá biba nìn bí yii bíǹ di nyí dinyil gbanti ní ki dāa dū nnimbɔtisan ki fá. Kriisitoo ŋanti ń nīn bí ni-pu.

english_verse: From Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus. God himself chose me to be an apostle, and he gave me the promised life that Jesus Christ makes possible.
translation_verse: Man Pɔɔl di ŋmàn̄ kugbɔŋu nee, man un Unimbɔti là ḿ nīn sá Yeesu Kriisitoo kpambal ki sòoǹ dimaŋfal din u pōoǹ Yeesu Kriisitoo tìì bin fōō-u ki kííyee bɔtee.

english_verse: Timothy, you are like a dear child to me. I pray that God our Father and our Lord Christ Jesus will be kind and merciful to you and will bless you with peace! Do Not Be Ashamed of the Lord
translation_verse: M ŋmàn̄ kugbɔŋu nee ki tīī sii Tiimootee m-bineeŋkaaki ní. Ti-Baa Unimbɔti nì ti-Dindaan Yeesu Kriisitoo ń ŋá-si tiŋan, kí sɔ̄ a-saai, kí tīī-si ŋgbansɔŋfi. Unil ń pɔ́ɔǹ u-ba kí nīn yú deedee

english_verse: Night and day I mention you in my prayers. I am always grateful for you, as I pray to the God my ancestors and I have served with a clear conscience.
translation_verse: M jáaḿ Unimbɔti un m nóó nì dipɔɔmɔntiil, kii m-naanjab mun nín nìn nóó-u puee. M jáaḿ-u tikpil ŋyunti ŋun m téetí a-pu ki mèé múlmul ŋwiimpu nì kunyeeuee.

english_verse: I remember how you cried, and I want to see you, because this would make me truly happy.
translation_verse: Di sá yii m téetí a-nyinnyim pu, ki mɔ̀ ki nyàab̀ kí ká-si, m-pɔbil ń pīil̀.

english_verse: I also remember the genuine faith of your mother Eunice. Your grandmother Lois had the same sort of faith, and I am sure you have it as well.
translation_verse: M dáá gbíntìi téetí fookiibaamɔn un a cáá Yeesu puee pu, fookii un a-naan Loowiisi nì a-na Eeniisi nìn pée cááyee. M nyí nì ibaamɔn yii a mun cáá fookii gbanti.

english_verse: So I ask you to make full use of the gift God gave you when I placed my hands on you. Use it well.
translation_verse: An pu ní m téetí-si yii á mɔ̀tīí nyàatī mpɔn ŋun Unimbɔti tīī-si ŋyunti ŋun m nìn dū m-ŋalii ki páaǹ a-pu a fōōyee.

english_verse: God's Spirit doesn't make cowards out of us. The Spirit gives us power, love, and self-control.
