translation_verse: Kun puee Unimbɔti nín tīī-ti Ŋfam miŋyee kaa sá Ŋfam min tìì tifaandee, ama an sá Ŋfam min tìì mpɔn, nì dineendi kí yàntī unil ń ŋmā kí ŋúb́ u-bee ní.

english_verse: Don't be ashamed to speak for our Lord. And don't be ashamed of me, just because I am in jail for serving him. Use the power that comes from God and join with me in suffering for telling the good news.
translation_verse: Míǹ puee á taa nín̄ cáá icoo kí sòoǹ ti-Dindaan pu, kí taa nín̄ cáá icoo ma mun pu, nì min kɔkɔ m sá usarkadaan ti-Dindaan puee. Ama Tibɔmɔntiil puee, á jī falaa un man bíi jīǹee nì Unimbɔti pɔŋŋu.

english_verse: God saved us and chose us to be his holy people. We did nothing to deserve this, but God planned it because he is so kind. Even before time began God planned for Christ Jesus to show kindness to us.
translation_verse: Úǹ di fīī-ti ní ki dū-ti ki kpántì u-yab. An kaa sá atuun aba ní ti túń ní u fīī-ti, an sá úǹ u-ba di lēē kí ŋá-ti tiŋan gbanti doooo jaanjaan Yeesu Kriisitoo pu.

english_verse: Now Christ Jesus has come to offer us God's gift of undeserved grace. Christ our Savior defeated death and brought us the good news. It shines like a light and offers life that never ends.
translation_verse: Kɔŋkɔnnee u nyántì u-ŋanti gbanti mpaampiin pu ŋyunti ŋun ti-Fiiliu Yeesu Kriisitoo dɔ́mińee. Úǹ di dɔ́miń ki kúntì ŋkúm pɔŋŋu, ní ki cáań dimaŋfal din kaa kúntée Tibɔmɔntiil tin u cáańee pu.

english_verse: My work is to be a preacher, an apostle, and a teacher.
translation_verse: An Bɔmɔntiiti gbanti ní Unimbɔti dūu ŋúbiǹ-mi ḿ nīn sá u-kpambal ki báakí tibɔtee ki dàkà-tì binib.

english_verse: This is why I am suffering now. But I am not ashamed! I know the one I have faith in, and I am sure he can guard until the last day what he has trusted me with.
translation_verse: An pu ní m bíi jīǹ falaa un m jīǹ nee. Ama an kaa cáá-mi icoo, kun puee m nyí un m fōō ki kííyee nín sá uŋyee. Míǹ ní m nyí yii u cáá mpɔn kí kpāafì tin u dūu ŋúbiǹ-mee kí dāá sāā u-gítintam dal.

english_verse: Now follow the example of the correct teaching I gave you, and let the faith and love of Christ Jesus be your model.
translation_verse: Á nīn ŋúb́ ibaamɔn bɔti tin m sòon̄ ki tùkū-see, kí nīn sòoǹ-tì kii a nín gbìl̄-tì m-cee puee. Nín̄ cáá fookii nì dineendi ti nín ŋá ubaanti nì Yeesu Kriisitooyee pu.

english_verse: You have been trusted with a wonderful treasure. Guard it with the help of the Holy Spirit, who lives within us.
translation_verse: Á kpāafì Tibɔmɔntiil tin Unimbɔti dūu ŋúbiǹ-see nì u-Fam min kóò ti-nee tūtuntam pu.

english_verse: You know that everyone in Asia has turned against me, especially Phygelus and Hermogenes.
translation_verse: Kii a nín nyí puee, bin kɔkɔ sá Asiiyee dū-mi ki fá ki kpáaǹ Fiijeel nì Eemɔgeeni.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will be kind to the family of Onesiphorus. He often cheered me up and wasn't ashamed of me when I was put in jail.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan ń ŋá Ɔneesiifɔɔr dicaŋku tiŋan. Di sá yii u nìn ŋmēentí-mi múlmul, kaa cáá man usarkadaan pu icoo.

english_verse: Then after he arrived in Rome, he searched everywhere until he found me.
translation_verse: Áli gba u nín dɔ́miń Roomee, u nyàab̄-mi nì dinimbinaamandi, ní ki dāa ká-mi.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord Jesus will ask God to show mercy to Onesiphorus on the day of judgment. You know how much he helped me in Ephesus.
translation_verse: Ibɔsoon dalee, ti-Dindaan ń dāá ŋá Ɔneesiifɔɔr tiŋan. Tin kɔkɔ u ŋá ki tīī-mi Eefeesi tiŋkinee, a nyí ki jítiǹ báà ŋma.

english_verse: Timothy, my child, you must let Christ Jesus make you strong by his gift of undeserved grace.
translation_verse: Míǹ puee sii man biki, pɔ́ɔǹ a-ba nì tiŋan tin ti ká ti nì Yeesu Kriisitoo nín ŋá ubaantee pu.

english_verse: You have often heard me teach. Now I want you to tell these same things to followers who can be trusted to tell others.
translation_verse: A nín gbìl̄ m sòon̄ tin diniwul nimbiinee, dū-tì kí ŋúbiǹ binib bin yú deedee ki ŋūǹ kí dàkèe, bi mun ń ŋmā kí dūú dàkà bin kíǹee.

english_verse: As a good soldier of Christ Jesus you must endure your share of suffering.
translation_verse: Si mun kūtì kí jī falaa kii Yeesu Kriisitoo janjamɔntiuee.

english_verse: Soldiers on duty don't work at outside jobs. They try only to please their commanding officer.
translation_verse: Ujanjal un là kí tɔ̄ ditundi kí fáatíǹ u-kpiliuee kaa ti yì u-ba kí ŋá kii binifantantiibi nín tɔ́ bi-ba ki ŋáań miŋyee.

english_verse: And farmers who work hard are the first to eat what grows in their field.
translation_verse: Ukpaal un di kùn̄ u-saaku nì digìńdee di dāa tí sá upeepeekaa kí lēeń tijin u-saakun.

english_verse: If you keep in mind what I have told you, the Lord will help you understand completely.
translation_verse: Á dàkafì tibɔti tin m sòoǹee pu, kun puee ti-Dindaan làá tūtuǹ-si á gbìl̄ ti-taapu kɔkɔ.

english_verse: Keep your mind on Jesus Christ! He was from the family of David and was raised from death, just as my good news says.
translation_verse: Á téetí Yeesu Kriisitoo un fīkitì ditaŋkpiilinee pu. U sá Daafiidi naantiiu kii Tibɔmɔntiil tin m sòoǹee nín tùkū-ti puee ní.

english_verse: And because of this message, I am locked up in jail and treated like a criminal. But God's good news isn't locked in jail,
translation_verse: Tibɔmɔntiil gbanti sòontam pu ní m bí ki jīǹ falaa bi bóob́-mi ikusaka kii m sá unikpitee, ama baa bóob́ Unimbɔti bɔti tíǹ.

english_verse: and so I am willing to put up with anything. Then God's special people will be saved and given eternal glory because they belong to Christ Jesus.
translation_verse: An pu ní m ŋmèé tikɔkɔ án nín làá ŋá pu bin Unimbɔti lútèe ń ŋmā kí ká difiil din bí Yeesu Kriisitoonee, nì tinyool tin làá nīn bí jaanjaanee.

english_verse: Here is a true message: “If we died with Christ, we will live with him.
translation_verse: Tibɔti tin m làá sòoǹee sá ibaamɔn ní: «Ti nì u yaa kpáfì ki kpíìyee, see ti nì u ń dāá nīn tí bí dimaŋfalin.

english_verse: If we don't give up, we will rule with him. If we deny that we know him, he will deny that he knows us.
translation_verse: Ti yaa pɔ́ɔǹ ki tin kátì-kuee, ti nì u di dāa tí jīǹ dibeel. Ti yaa néè yii taa nyí-u, u mun làá dāá néé yii waa nyí-ti.

english_verse: If we are not faithful, he will still be faithful. Christ cannot deny who he is.” An Approved Worker
translation_verse: Ti yaa kaa yúliǹ-u deedee, úǹ làá nīn yú deedee, kun puee waa ŋūǹ kí néé kí kpántí u-deedeebítam.» Utɔntɔnli un sá umɔntee

english_verse: Don't let anyone forget these things. And with God as your witness, you must warn them not to argue about words. These arguments don't help anyone. In fact, they ruin everyone who listens to them.
translation_verse: Á téetí bi-kɔkɔ kí tùkù-bi yii nì Unimbɔti puee, bí taa nín̄ kpākantí tɔb anyɔɔbun aba pu. An nikpɔŋkpɔkɔkuee kaa cāabìń tiŋan, ama an bíiĺ bin pílifée ní.

english_verse: Do your best to win God's approval as a worker who doesn't need to be ashamed and who teaches only the true message.
translation_verse: Pɔ́ɔǹ a-ba Unimbɔti ń ká-si kii utɔntɔnli un tuuŋŋi kaa cāabìń icooyee, kí sòoǹ ibaamɔn Bɔmɔntiitee nín sá puee deedee.

english_verse: Keep away from worthless and useless talk. It only leads people farther away from God.
translation_verse: Taa cèeǹ a-nyɔkɔ tibɔfan nikpɔŋkpɔkɔku kun nyáń tiba nì Yeesu Kriisitoo bɔti tin a fōōyee, di sá bin ŋúb́ an bɔtee mɔ̀tīi gáatí Unimbɔti nimbiin ní.

english_verse: That sort of talk is like a sore that won't heal. And Hymenaeus and Philetus have been talking this way
translation_verse: Binib gbanti dàkatam bí kii mbuunee ní ki ŋmóò ki lɔ̀tī tiwun. Imeenee nì Fiileeti mun bí binib gbanti kansikin.

english_verse: by teaching that the dead have already been raised to life. This is far from the truth, and it is destroying the faith of some people.
translation_verse: Bi nyáń ibaamɔn saŋŋu poon ki yāntì bi-jutiibi bin fōō Yeesu ki kííyee fá bi-fookiiu bi nín lì yii dooooyee ní bitaŋkpiibi fīkitèe pu.

english_verse: But the foundation God has laid is solid. On it is written, “The Lord knows who his people are. So everyone who worships the Lord must turn away from evil.”
translation_verse: Ama nì míǹ kɔkɔee, Unimbɔti bɔnyeel din u dūu tíĺ taapuee pée pɔ̄ɔ̄ ní ki yú di-laŋki. An bɔnyeelee di sá yii: «Ti-Dindaan nyí bin sá u-yabee», ní «Un kamaa nyí yii u sá ti-Dindaan yɔuee máaǹ kí fá ikpiti.»

english_verse: In a large house some dishes are made of gold or silver, while others are made of wood or clay. Some of these are special, and others are not.
translation_verse: Diciŋkpaandinee, an kaa sá sindaariya nì animbil kúti booŋŋi baba di bí, ama aboon ŋin bi máń nì kuyɔkɔuee nì itúun mun bí. Sindaariya nì animbil kúti booŋŋi yú ki cí iwiŋkpaan dal ní, ní itúun nì aboon ŋin bi máń nì kuyɔkɔuee sá báà ŋma ń nīn cáa ŋáań min u lèe.

english_verse: This is also how it is with people. The ones who stop doing evil and make themselves pure will become special. Their lives will be holy and pleasing to their Master, and they will be able to do all kinds of good deeds.
translation_verse: Un yaa fá ikpiti in bɔti m sòoǹee kpántì umɔnti dee ki sá kii sindaariya booŋŋi ŋin yú ki cí iwiŋkpaanee. Di sá yii u bí ki tīī u-kpiliu an kɔkɔ pu ú dū-u kí tɔ̄ atummɔnti.

english_verse: Run from temptations that capture young people. Always do the right thing. Be faithful, loving, and easy to get along with. Worship with people whose hearts are pure.
translation_verse: Á fá tinaacimpɔn landɔkɔkpitii kí nyàab̀ deedeebítam nì fookii nì dineendi nì ŋgbansɔŋfi, sii nì bin kɔkɔ jáaḿ ti-Dindaan nì dipɔɔmɔntiilee.

english_verse: Stay away from stupid and senseless arguments. These only lead to trouble,
translation_verse: Ama á fá fám fám nikpɔŋkpɔkɔku kun sá tibɔfanee, kun puee sii a-ba nyí yii an nikpɔŋkpɔkɔkuee pée kúntí nì kujaau ŋma ní.

english_verse: and God's servants must not be troublemakers. They must be kind to everyone, and they must be good teachers and very patient.
translation_verse: An mun kaa máaǹ yii ti-Dindaan tɔntɔnliu nì binib ń nīn jáà, ama u máaǹ kí nīn néeń báà ŋma, kí nīn ŋūǹ ki dàkà binib nì kimɔtii.

english_verse: Be humble when you correct people who oppose you. Maybe God will lead them to turn to him and learn the truth.
translation_verse: U máaǹ kí nīn sá unil un mɔ̄ee kí ŋmā kí dàkà bin kpākantí-uee. An yaa yíì Unimbɔti táá yàntī bí kpántí bi-bimbim kí ŋmā kí béé ibaamɔn,

english_verse: They have been trapped by the devil, and he makes them obey him, but God may help them escape.
translation_verse: kí gítiń nsammɔnti poon kí ŋmátí Sitaan taliŋku kun sàl̄-bi ki yāntì bi ŋáań min u lèe.

english_verse: You can be certain that in the last days there will be some very hard times.
translation_verse: Á nīn nyí yii iyuntijoolkaa poonee, án làá dāá nīn pɔ̄ɔ̄.

english_verse: People will love only themselves and money. They will be proud, stuck-up, rude, and disobedient to their parents. They will also be ungrateful, godless,
translation_verse: Di sá yii binib dāa kíǹ ki cáá ikummunti, ní ki néeń animbil, ní ki gà bi-biŋŋi, ki cáá alambil, ki sòoǹ ki bíiĺ Unimbɔti, kaa tɔ́ bi-baabi nì bi-nab, kaa dāa nyí tiŋan, kaa tɔ́ tin bí circiree.

english_verse: heartless, and hateful. Their words will be cruel, and they will have no self-control or pity. These people will hate everything good.
translation_verse: Baa dāa cáá dineendi, kaa dāa sūǹ binib saai, ki dāa kúŋfí binib boon, kaa dāa ŋūǹ kí cúú bi-ba, ki dāa sá bitɔŋfitiibi, ki dāa ná tin ŋān̄ee.

english_verse: They will be sneaky, reckless, and puffed up with pride. Instead of loving God, they will love pleasure.
translation_verse: Bi dāa sá bin nyēē binib boon ki nyáfí-bee. Bi dāa sá binib bin an yòontée, ki dāa néeń timɔn, ki dāa néeń tin fáatiǹ-bee ki jítiǹ Unimbɔti.

english_verse: Even though they will make a show of being religious, their religion won't be real. Don't have anything to do with such people.
translation_verse: Bi dāa ŋúb̀ nnimbɔtisan bɔti ní kí yíí kaa là mbaamɔn pɔŋŋu ŋun bí tibɔti gbanti poonee. Á fá an nibee.

english_verse: Some men fool whole families, just to get power over those women who are slaves of sin and are controlled by all sorts of desires.
translation_verse: Bi-kansikin biba kóò binimpoobi bin landɔkɔi pátì bi ŋáań ikpiti ki cáá kɔdeebi kupaauee dumpui ní ki yàntī bi fòol̄ tin bi sòoǹee ki kíikí.

english_verse: These women always want to learn something new, but they never can discover the truth.
translation_verse: An nimpoobee pílifí tibɔti ní baabadal, ama doooo kii nee, baa ŋūǹ kí béé ibaamɔn.

english_verse: Just as Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, these people are enemies of the truth. Their minds are sick, and their faith isn't real.
translation_verse: Kii Jaaneesi nì Jambiree nín kaa nìn là Mooyiisi bɔti puee, míǹ mbaantiim ní an nibee kaa là ibaamɔn. An sá binib bin landɔkɔi gábitèe, baa nóó Unimbɔti.

english_verse: But they won't get very far with their foolishness. Soon everyone will know the truth about them, just as Jannes and Jambres were found out. Paul's Last Instructions to Timothy
translation_verse: Ama baa làá nīn bí kí cù ndan, kun puee báà ŋma làá dāá béé bi-pu yii bi sá bigbaambi, a lì kii Jaaneesi nì Jambiree cee nín nìn jítì puee. Isaŋkijoolkaa

english_verse: trouble and suffering in the cities of Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra. Yet the Lord rescued me from all those terrible troubles.
translation_verse: nì bi nín páb́-mi puee, nì m-falaau. A nyí tin nìn jítì m-pu Antiyɔɔsi nì Ikooniyum nì Liistiree. Falaa ulɔu ní maa jíń niin? Ama ti-Dindaan nyántì-mi tikɔkɔ poon.

english_verse: In fact, anyone who belongs to Christ Jesus and wants to live right will have trouble from others.
translation_verse: Di sá yii bin di yaa fōō Yeesu Kriisitoo ki kíí ki là kí nīn yú deedee Unimbɔti nimbiinee, see bidambi ń ká digìńdi.

english_verse: But evil people who pretend to be what they are not will become worse than ever, as they fool others and are fooled themselves.
translation_verse: Ama bitɔŋfitiibi nì bikiililiibee làá nīn mɔ̀tīi múl̀ ki kóò tin kaa ŋān̄ee poon ní baabadal. Bi wáŋkì, ní ki bíi kíiĺ bi-jutiibi mun ń wāŋkì.

english_verse: Keep on being faithful to what you were taught and to what you believed. After all, you know who taught you these things.
translation_verse: Míǹ puee, sii ń ŋúb́ tibɔti tin a bífì ki fōō ki kíí tiŋanee, kun puee sii nyí bin di dàkā-si an bɔtee.

english_verse: Since childhood, you have known the Holy Scriptures that are able to make you wise enough to have faith in Christ Jesus and be saved.
translation_verse: Doooo a-biyatin ní a pée nyí Unimbɔti gbɔŋku poon bɔti. An di ŋūǹ kí tīī-si iciin in cáǹ unil difiilinee nì fookii un a cáá Yeesu Kriisitoo puee.

english_verse: Everything in the Scriptures is God's Word. All of it is useful for teaching and helping people and for correcting them and showing them how to live.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti di yāntì bi ŋmàn̄ tibɔti gbanti kɔkɔ, ki sá bí dūú dàkà binib ń béé ibaamɔn, kí dàkà unil yìntitam, kí kpòotī-u, kí dàkà unil ú nīn cáá deedee bimbim,

english_verse: The Scriptures train God's servants to do all kinds of good deeds.
translation_verse: án nín làá ŋá pu kí bɔ́ntí Unimbɔti niliu mmɔntiimin ú kítí kí tɔ̄ atummɔnti kɔkɔee.

english_verse: When Christ Jesus comes as king, he will be the judge of everyone, whether they are living or dead. So with God and Christ as witnesses, I command you
translation_verse: M bíi kpáafí-si tibɔti nee Unimbɔti nimbiin nì Yeesu Kriisitoo un làá dāá sòoǹ binifoobi nì bitaŋkpiibi bɔtee nimbiin, úǹ un làá dāá dāan̄ kii ubɔtee:

english_verse: to preach God's message. Do it willingly, even if it isn't the popular thing to do. You must correct people and point out their sins. But also cheer them up, and when you instruct them, always be patient.
translation_verse: Á sòoǹ Unimbɔti bɔti. Báà ŋyunti yaa pɔ̄ɔ̄yaaa, ŋu yaa pɔ̀fàaa, á nīn pée cɔ́ tibɔti gbanti pu, kí dàkà binib bi-yìntitam kí wòoǹ-bi bi-kpitii pu, kí tīī-bi kunyannyaau. Á nīn cáá kimɔtii tikpil a-dàkatam poon.

english_verse: The time is coming when people won't listen to good teaching. Instead, they will look for teachers who will please them by telling them only what they are itching to hear.
translation_verse: Kun puee iyunti iba dòoń binib kaa dāa gíti là kí pīlifì ibaamɔn dàkatam. Ama bi dāa nōotí bíǹ bi-ba nín fáatì miŋyee ní ki dāa kpáfí bidakaliibi kupaau bi-cee, ní bíǹ dàkà-bi tin bi là kí nīn pílifée.

english_verse: They will turn from the truth and eagerly listen to senseless stories.
translation_verse: Baa dāa gíti là kí pīlifì ibaamɔn, see bitiŋkpikib nín nìn ŋáań tiŋyee ní bi dāa néeń ki pílifí.

english_verse: But you must stay calm and be willing to suffer. You must work hard, telling the good news and to do your job well.
translation_verse: Ama sii ń ŋúb́ a-ba an kɔkɔ poon, ní kí ŋmèè falaa kí tɔ̄ a-tundi din sá Tibɔmɔntiil sòontamee. Tɔ̄ ditundi din sá Unimbɔti tɔntɔnliu tundee.

english_verse: Now the time has come for me to die. My life is like a drink offering being poured out on the altar.
translation_verse: Ama an yaa kíǹ mamee, ŋyunti bāań ḿ dū m-ba kí ŋá saraa, man kúm yuntiŋu bāań.

english_verse: I have fought well. I have finished the race, and I have been faithful.
translation_verse: M jáń kujamɔntiiu, m sáǹ ki bàn̄ ditaatandi kúntilaŋki ki gbíntìi ŋúb́ m-fookiiu.

english_verse: So a crown will be given to me for pleasing the Lord. He judges fairly, and on the day of judgment he will give a crown to me and to everyone else who wants him to appear with power. Personal Instructions
translation_verse: Kɔŋkɔnnee dijajil paati di dɔ̄ ki cí-mi. Tíǹ di sá difiil beefuuliiki kin Yeesu un sá ibaamɔn bɔsoonliuee làá dāá tīī-mi ŋwindalee. An kaa dāa sá man baba ní u làá tīī, ama bin bin kɔkɔ néeń ki cí u-gítintamee.

english_verse: Come to see me as soon as you can.
translation_verse: Á pɔ́ɔǹ kí dāan̄ m-cee malaa,

english_verse: Demas loves the things of this world so much that he left me and went to Thessalonica. Crescens has gone to Galatia, and Titus has gone to Dalmatia.
translation_verse: di sá yii Deemasi dū-mi ki fá ki búntì Teesalooniiki, kun puee u néeń duulinya un poon ti bí nee tikpil. Kriiseensi búntì Galaati, ní Tiiti mun búntì Dalmatii.

english_verse: Only Luke has stayed with me. Mark can be very helpful to me, so please find him and bring him with you.
translation_verse: Luuki baba di pée kíǹ m-cee. A yaa dòońee, á kpáaǹní-mi Maarki, kun puee u ŋūǹ kí dāá tūtuǹ-mi m-tundi poon.

english_verse: I sent Tychicus to Ephesus.
translation_verse: M dū Tiisiiki ki tú Eefeesi.

english_verse: When you come, bring the coat I left at Troas with Carpus. Don't forget to bring the scrolls, especially the ones made of leather.
translation_verse: A yaa dòońee, á taa súntí kí kpáaǹní-mi m-bɔkutifɔkɔl din m nìn yāntìń Troowaasi tiŋkin Kaarpusi ceeyee, kí kpáaǹní-mi m-gbɔnti, cilinjee tigbɔn tin sá igbanee.

english_verse: Alexander, the metalworker, has hurt me in many ways. But the Lord will pay him back for what he has done.
translation_verse: Ucaa Aleekisandir ŋá-mi inikpiti tikpil. Ti-Dindaan làá dāá pà-u atuun ŋin u túńee paati.

english_verse: Alexander opposes what we preach, so you had better watch out for him.
translation_verse: A mun ń nīn nyíǹ-u, kun puee u nìn yíì kpataaa kaa là tibɔti tin ti sòoǹee.

english_verse: When I was first put on trial, no one helped me. In fact, everyone deserted me. I hope it won't be held against them.
translation_verse: Bi nín péé péé ki cúú-mi ki cáá ibɔsoonee, báà ubɔ kaa yúl̀ m-boon. Bi-kɔkɔ dū-mi ki fá ní. Unimbɔti ń taa dūú ŋá-bi tibɔti.

english_verse: But the Lord stood beside me. He gave me the strength to tell his full message, so that all Gentiles would hear it. And I was kept safe from hungry lions.
translation_verse: Ama ti-Dindaan yúl̀ m-boon ki tīī-mi mpɔn m ŋúń ki sòon̄ Unimbɔti bɔti mmɔntiimin ki yāntì bin kaa sá Juuda yabee kɔkɔ gbìl̄ tibɔti gbanti, ní m nyáń gbikinti nyɔkɔn.

english_verse: The Lord will always keep me from being harmed by evil, and he will bring me safely into his heavenly kingdom. Praise him forever and ever! Amen. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan làá nīn pée nyāntí-mi tibɔkpitil kamaa poon míǹ ní kí dāá cáá-mi kí kɔ́ǹ yilpu Beelin nì alaafiya. Úǹ di sá tinyooldaan kí nīn pée cá jaanjaan! Ameeni. Ijaam iluŋkikaa

english_verse: Give my greetings to Priscilla and Aquila and to the family of Onesiphorus.
translation_verse: Á jāam̀ Priisiil nì Akiilasi, ní kí jāam̀ Ɔneesiifɔɔr dicaŋkun yab.

english_verse: Erastus stayed at Corinth. Trophimus was sick when I left him at Miletus.
translation_verse: Eeraasiti gbíntì Kɔranti ní Troofiim būǹ. M yāntì u gbíntì Miilee.

english_verse: Do your best to come before winter. Eubulus, Pudens, Linus, and Claudia send you their greetings, and so do the rest of the Lord's followers.
translation_verse: Á pɔ́ɔǹ a-ba kí bàń-mi kí wàatī tiwool yuntiŋu ń nín bàń. Eebulusi nì Pudansi nì Liinusi nì Kloodiya nì nnabiyaamu kɔkɔ jáaḿ-si.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will bless your life and will be kind to you.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan ń nīn bí a-cee. Unimbɔti ŋanti ń nīn bí ni-pu.

english_verse: From Paul, a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ. I encourage God's own people to have more faith and to understand the truth about religion.
translation_verse: Man Pɔɔl un sá Unimbɔti tɔntɔnliu ki sá Yeesu Kriisitoo kpambalee di ŋmàn̄ kugbɔŋu nee. Yeesu Kriisitoo di túnní-mi ḿ yàntī bin Unimbɔti lútì bí nīn sá u-yabee ń fōō-u kí kíí, kí béé nnimbɔtisan mmɔntiimin.

english_verse: Then they will have the hope of eternal life God promised long ago. And God never tells a lie!
translation_verse: Bí ŋmā kí nīn kíǹ ki máká dimaŋfal din kaa cáá dikúntilee pu. Doooo jaanjaan ní Unimbɔti un kaa mɔ́ntée pōoǹ yii u làá tīī-ti dimaŋfal gbanti.

english_verse: So, at the proper time, God our Savior gave this message and told me to announce what he had said.
translation_verse: Ŋyunti bāańee, ní ti-Fiiliu Unimbɔti dī u-nyɔɔbundi pu ki nyántì tin u nìn pōoǹee ki dàkā-ti. Dinyɔɔbundee di sá din u dūu ŋúbiǹ-mi ki bí yii ḿ nīn sòoǹee.

english_verse: Titus, because of our faith, you are like a son to me. I pray that God our Father and Christ Jesus our Savior will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! What Titus Was To Do in Crete
translation_verse: Sii Tiiti un kpántì m-ba bindi pu jipɔɔn ti-kɔkɔ nín fōō Yeesu ki kííyee puee ní m ŋmàn̄ kugbɔŋu nee kí tīī. Ti-Baa Unimbɔti nì Yeesu Kriisitoo ti-Fiiliu ń ŋá-si tiŋan, kí tīī-si ŋgbansɔŋfi. Ditundi din Tiiti làá tɔ̄ Kreeti tiŋkinee

english_verse: I left you in Crete to do what had been left undone and to appoint leaders for the churches in each town. As I told you,
translation_verse: M yāntì-si Kreeti tiŋkin yii á púntí kí bɔ́ntí ditundi din kíǹ niinee, kí kàan̄ bikpilib Kriisitoo nikitiŋ kansikin kitiŋ sá kamaa poon, kii m nín nìn pée tùkū-si puee.

english_verse: they must have a good reputation and be faithful in marriage. Their children must be followers of the Lord and not have a reputation for being wild and disobedient.
translation_verse: Kriisitoo nikitil kpiliu máaǹ bí taa ká u-pu ibɔkpiti iba, kí nīn cáá unimpubaanti, u-biyaamu ń nīn sá bin fōō Yeesu ki kíí ki sá mun pu binib kaa sòoǹ yii mu-bimbim kaa ŋān̄, muaa tɔ́ binibee.

english_verse: Church officials are in charge of God's work, and so they must also have a good reputation. They must not be bossy, quick-tempered, heavy drinkers, bullies, or dishonest in business.
translation_verse: Di sá yii un kpòotī Kriisitoo nikitilee tundi di sá ú nīn kpèé Unimbɔti tundi ń còom̀. An puee waa máaǹ bí ká u-pu ikpiti iba. Ú taa nín̄ sá ulambidaan nì uŋuudaan nì udanyɔgbil, kí taa nín̄ sá kílkil niliu nì un dì isaŋkpiti pu ki kāntí animbilee.

english_verse: Instead, they must be friendly to strangers and enjoy doing good things. They must also be sensible, fair, pure, and self-controlled.
translation_verse: Ama ú nīn fòol̄ binicambi tiŋan, kí nīn néeń tin ŋān̄ee, kí nīn cáá iciin, kí nīn bí deedee, ki bí circir, kí nīn ŋūǹ ki ŋúb̀ u-ba.

english_verse: They must stick to the true message they were taught, so their good teaching can help others and correct everyone who opposes it.
translation_verse: U máaǹ kí nīn kpáafí tibɔŋmanee án píkí kii bi nín dàkā-tì puee, án nín làá ŋá pu ú ŋmā kí nīn cáá tibɔŋman gbantee ki tìì binib kunyannyaauee, kí kpáàa dàkà bin mun kaa là tibɔti gbantee bi-yìntitamee.

english_verse: There are many who don't respect authority, and they fool others by talking nonsense. This is especially true of some Jewish followers.
translation_verse: Di sá yii binib tikpil bí ki gáatì ki cáá tibɔfan ki kíiĺ binib. Bin pée yì diyilee di sá Juuda yab kansikin biba.

english_verse: But you must make them be quiet. They are after money, and they upset whole families by teaching what they should not.
translation_verse: Á pìin̄-bi nsan bí taa ti sòoǹ, kun puee bi dàkà tin kaa máaǹ bí dàkèe, ki bíiĺ adicammɔn, ki dì icoo saŋyi pu míǹ kí ŋmā kí ká animbil.

english_verse: It is like one of their own prophets once said, “The people of Crete always tell lies. They are greedy and lazy like wild animals.”
translation_verse: Bi-bɔnaatiliu ubɔ, u sá ukreetija. Úǹ di nìn lī yii: «Kreeti tiŋki yab pée sá binyimɔndambi ní, ki cáá ntoom kii ipeecuncutee, ki sá biwutijoodambi, ki sá bipoofub.»

english_verse: This surely is a true saying. And you should be hard on such people, so you can help them grow stronger in their faith.
translation_verse: Kijapaayee nín lī puee, waa mɔ́ntì. An puee, á kpìin̄-bi tiŋan án nín làá ŋá pu bi-fookiiu ń nīn sá ibaamɔn yɔuee.

english_verse: Don't pay any attention to any of those senseless Jewish stories and human commands. These are made up by people who won't obey the truth.
translation_verse: Bí yàntī titiŋkpikibɔti tin Juuda yab cáá ki máafée, nì binib bin fá ibaamɔn saŋŋu ki yōoǹ bíǹ bi-ba marabee bɔti.

english_verse: Everything is pure for someone whose heart is pure. But nothing is pure for an unbeliever with a dirty mind. That person's mind and conscience are destroyed.
translation_verse: Binib bin bí circiree, tikɔkɔ sá circir ní ki tīī-bi. Ama bin kaa fōō Yeesu ki kíí ki kɔ́ tijɔkɔndee, tiba kpá ki bí bíǹ cee circir, kun puee bi-landɔkɔi nì bi-ciiŋyi kɔ́ tijɔkɔndi.

english_verse: Such people claim to know God, but their actions prove they really don't. They are disgusting. They won't obey God, and they are too worthless to do anything good.
translation_verse: Bi gà bi-biŋŋi yii bi nyí Unimbɔti, ní bi-tuuŋŋi ŋin bi tūǹee dàkà yii baa nyí-u. Bi sá bikpitib ní ki gáatì, kaa ŋūǹ kí tɔ̄ ditummɔntiil báà diba.

english_verse: Titus, you must teach only what is correct.
translation_verse: Ama sii ń dàkà tibɔŋman kii tì nín sá puee,

english_verse: Tell the older men to have self-control and to be serious and sensible. Their faith, love, and patience must never fail.
translation_verse: kí tùkù bijaŋkpilib bí ŋúb́ bi-ba binib ń nīn tɔ́-bi. Bí nīn cáá iciin, bi-neendi nì bi-mɔtiiki nì bi-fookiiu ń nīn pɔ̄ɔ̄.

english_verse: Tell the older women to behave as those who love the Lord should. They must not gossip about others or be slaves of wine. They must teach what is proper,
translation_verse: Míǹ ní kí tùkù binimpucikitikaabee yii bi-bimbim ń nīn sá binib bin bí circiree bimbim. Baa máaǹ kí nīn sòoǹ ki bíiĺ binib, kí taa nín̄ sá ndaam yumbui, ama bí nīn sá bin tìì isaŋkimɔntee.

english_verse: so the younger women will be loving wives and mothers.
translation_verse: Mimmee, bi ŋūǹ kí dàkà binimpupɔmbee bí béé bi nín máaǹ kí nīn néeń bi-calib nì bi-biyaamu miŋyee.

english_verse: Each of the younger women must be sensible and kind, as well as a good homemaker, who puts her own husband first. Then no one can say insulting things about God's message.
translation_verse: Bí nīn cáá iciin kí nīn ŋúb́ bi-ba, kí nīn nyí kudii poon tundi tiŋan, kí nīn sá bilaŋŋaŋfitiibi, kí nīn tɔ́ bi-calib, binib ń taa ká bi-pu ikpiti iba kí nīn cáa sòoǹ ki bíiĺ Unimbɔti bɔti.

english_verse: Tell the young men to have self-control in everything.
translation_verse: Míǹ mbaantiim, á sāŋkì binaacimpɔmbi yii bí nīn cáá mbimbimɔntiim.

english_verse: Always set a good example for others. Be sincere and serious when you teach.
translation_verse: Tikɔkɔ poonee, sii a-ba ń tɔ̄ atummɔnti kí dàkà báà ŋma bi mun ń nīn ŋáań míǹ. A-dàkatam ń nīn sá mbaamɔn ki kítì.

english_verse: Use clean language that no one can criticize. Do this, and your enemies will be too ashamed to say anything against you.
translation_verse: Á nīn sòoǹ anyɔɔbummɔnti ŋin pu baa ŋūǹ kí kpákáǹ-see, ní icoo ń cúú ti-nannanliibi, kun puee baa làá ká ti-pu ikpiti iba kí sòoǹ.

english_verse: Tell slaves always to please their owners by obeying them in everything. Slaves must not talk back to their owners
translation_verse: Á sāŋkì iyumbu í nīn tɔ́ i-dindambi tikɔkɔ poon, kí nīn ŋáań tin ŋān̄ i-dindambi ceeyee, kí taa nín̄ lì min kaa fáatì-bee.

english_verse: or steal from them. They must be completely honest and trustworthy. Then everyone will show great respect for what is taught about God our Savior. God's Kindness and the New Life
translation_verse: Í taa yɔ̀ i-dindambi wanti báà tiba, ama i máaǹ kí nīn dàkà i-deedeebítam mmɔntiimin iyunti kɔkɔ, kí ŋmā kí tīī Unimbɔti ti-Fiiliu bɔti tin bi dàkèe tinyool an kɔkɔ pu.

english_verse: God has shown us undeserved grace by coming to save all people.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti ŋanti tin cáań binib kɔkɔ difiilee nyáń mpaampiin pu.

english_verse: He taught us to give up our wicked ways and our worldly desires and to live decent and honest lives in this world.
translation_verse: U-ŋantee di dàkà-ti tí fá ti-bimbikpitim nì duulinya doo nimbitaataam. Ŋyunti ŋun poon ti bí nee, ti máaǹ kí nīn ŋúb́ ti-ba, kí nīn bí deedee ki nóó Unimbɔti mmɔntiimin,

english_verse: We are filled with hope, as we wait for the glorious return of our great God and Savior Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: kí nīn cí dipɔɔpindi wiiŋŋu ŋun pu ti cɔ́tée. Ŋwiin gbanti ní Yeesu Kriisitoo, ti-Nimbɔtiu un sá-ti ukpaan ki sá-ti ufiilee, làá dāá nyāntí u-nyootee.

english_verse: He gave himself to rescue us from everything evil and to make our hearts pure. He wanted us to be his own people and to be eager to do right.
translation_verse: Úǹ di dū u-ba ki tīī ki dá-ti ki nyántì ikpiti kɔkɔ poon, ní ki dū-ti ki kpántì dinikitil din sá úǹ baba yal, ki bí circir, ki cáá difaŋgiil ki tūǹ atummɔntee.

english_verse: Teach these things, as you use your full authority to encourage and correct people. Make sure you earn everyone's respect.
translation_verse: A nín máaǹ kí dàkà miŋyee dee, kí tīī-bi kunyannyaau, kí kpìin̄-bi nì mpɔn, kí taa yàntī ubɔ ń kpèè kí sìŋkīǹ-si.

english_verse: Remind your people to obey the rulers and authorities and not to be rebellious. They must always be ready to do something helpful
translation_verse: Á téetí-bi yii bi máaǹ kí sìntīǹ bi-ba kí tīī bikpilib bin sá gɔmina nì biyidambee. Bí nīn tɔ́-bi, ki yáb̀ atummɔnti kɔkɔ pu.

english_verse: and not say cruel things or argue. They should be gentle and kind to everyone.
translation_verse: Bí taa nín̄ sòoǹ ki bíiĺ binib, kí nīn sá ŋgbansɔŋfi nib, kí nīn ŋáań tiŋan, kí nīn mɔ̄ báà ŋma cee.

english_verse: We used to be stupid, disobedient, and foolish, as well as slaves of all sorts of desires and pleasures. We were evil and jealous. Everyone hated us, and we hated everyone.
translation_verse: Kun puee, dooooyee ti mun nìn sá bin kaa nyí tibee, ní kaa nìn tɔ́ Unimbɔti, ki yìntī, ní ti-nimbitaataam nì min ti fáatèe nìn cúú-ti kuyuŋu. Ti nìn cáá ntoom nì inimbidiki, ki ná ti-jutiibi ní bi mun ná-ti.

english_verse: God our Savior showed us how good and kind he is.
translation_verse: Ama Unimbɔti ti-Fiiliu dàkā-ti tiŋan nì dineendi din u cáá timbi binib puee,

english_verse: He saved us because of his mercy, and not because of any good things we have done. God washed us by the power of the Holy Spirit. He gave us new birth and a fresh beginning.
translation_verse: ki fīī-ti. An kaa sá yii ti túń atunnyaan aba, an sá isaa ní u súń ti-pu. Bi nín fùul̀-ti Unimbɔti nyim puee di dàkà min Circir Fam fātìi màl̄-ti mpɔm ki tīī-ti dimaŋfapɔndi diŋyee.

english_verse: God sent Jesus Christ our Savior to give us his Spirit.
translation_verse: Yeesu Kriisitoo ti-Fiiliu puee, Unimbɔti tīiń-ti u-Fam tikpil tikpil,

english_verse: Jesus treated us much better than we deserve. He made us acceptable to God and gave us the hope of eternal life.
translation_verse: tí ŋmā kí kpántí deedeedambi Unimbɔti nimbiin u-ŋanti pu, kí fōō dimaŋfal din pu ti máká, dàa cáá dikúntilee.

english_verse: This message is certainly true. These teachings are useful and helpful for everyone. I want you to insist that the people follow them, so that all who have faith in God will be sure to do good deeds.
translation_verse: Tibɔti tin m sòoǹ nee sá ibaamɔn ní. M là á nīn cɔ́ tibɔtee pu tikpil, án nín làá ŋá pu bin fōō Unimbɔti ki kííyee ń dū bi-ba kí tīī atummɔnti tɔ̄tamee. Tin ŋān̄ ki kèetī binibee dee.

english_verse: But don't have anything to do with stupid arguments about ancestors. And stay away from disagreements and quarrels about the Law of Moses. Such arguments are useless and senseless.
translation_verse: Ama bí taa nín̄ kpákà tibɔfan pu ki kàaǹ bi-naanjab yiŋŋi an kaa kúntí, kí taa nín̄ kpákà ki jáà Juuda yab marab pu. Tíǹ sá tibɔfan ní kaa kèetī.

english_verse: Warn troublemakers once or twice. Then don't have anything else to do with them.
translation_verse: Á kpāafì un cāabìń ni-kansikin diyakatilee mili pu, boonee, u yaa kaa gbìl̄ee, á nyāntí-u.

english_verse: You know their minds are twisted, and their own sins show how guilty they are. Personal Instructions and Greetings
translation_verse: Di sá yii a nyí yii an niliuee fá nsammɔnti ki ŋá unikpiti, ní u-kpitiiyee dàkà yii u gáatì. Tibɔkpaafikaal tijoolkaal

english_verse: I plan to send Artemas or Tychicus to you. After he arrives, please try your best to meet me at Nicopolis. I have decided to spend the winter there.
translation_verse: M yaa láa dū Ariteemasi àá Tiisiiki ki túnní a-cee u bāań-see, á pɔ́ɔǹ a-ba kí kíntiń-mi Niikoopoolii, kun puee niin ní m là kí dāá nīn bí kuseeun.

english_verse: When Zenas the lawyer and Apollos get ready to leave, help them as much as you can, so they won't have need of anything.
translation_verse: Á pɔ́ɔǹ a-ba kí tūtuǹ Seenaa un sá umaranyilee nì Apooloosi, án nín làá ŋá pu tiba ń taa lóó-bi bi-saŋkindi poonee.

english_verse: Greetings to you from everyone here. Greet all of our friends who share in our faith. I pray that the Lord will be kind to all of you!
translation_verse: Man nì bin kɔkɔ bí dooyee jáaḿ-si. Á jāam̀ bin fōō Yeesu ki kíí ki néeń-tee. Kriisitoo ŋanti ń nīn bí ni-kɔkɔ pu.

english_verse: From Paul, who is in jail for serving Christ Jesus, and from Timothy, who is like a brother because of our faith. Philemon, you work with us and are very dear to us. This letter is to you
translation_verse: Man Pɔɔl un sá usarkadaan Yeesu Kriisitoo puee nì ti-nabiki Tiimootee di ŋmàń kugbɔŋu nee. Ti ŋmàn̄-ku kí tīī sii Fiileemɔn ti-tɔntɔnjuti un ti néeńee,

english_verse: I pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! Philemon's Love and Faith
translation_verse: Ti-Baa Unimbɔti nì ti-Dindaan Yeesu Kriisitoo ń ŋá-ni tiŋan kí tīī-ni ŋgbansɔŋfi. Fiileemɔn fookiiu nì u-neendi

english_verse: Philemon, each time I mention you in my prayers, I thank God.
translation_verse: Baabadal, m yaa bí ki mèé m-Nimbɔtiuee, m téetí a-pu ki jáaḿ-u a-pu,

english_verse: I hear about your faith in our Lord Jesus and about your love for all God's people.
translation_verse: kun puee m gbìl̀ bi sòoǹ a-fookiiu un a cáá ti-Dindaan Yeesu puee nì dineendi din a cáá Unimbɔti yab kɔkɔ mun puee pu.

english_verse: As you share your faith with others, I pray they may come to know all the blessings Christ has given us.
translation_verse: M mèé-u yii fookii un yāntì ti nì si ŋá ubaantee ń mɔ̀tīí yàntī á béé tiŋan tin kɔkɔ Unimbɔti ŋáań-ti Kriisitoo puee.

english_verse: My friend, your love has made me happy and has greatly encouraged me. It has also cheered the hearts of God's people. Paul Speaks to Philemon about Onesimus
translation_verse: M-nabiki, a-neendi din a cáá nnabiyaamu puee mɔ́ɔkiǹ-mi ki tīī-mi kunyannyaau tikpil, kun puee a tīī Unimbɔti yab kunyannyaau. Pɔɔl gbàam̄ Fiileemɔn Ɔneesiim pu

english_verse: Christ gives me the courage to tell you what to do.
translation_verse: Míǹ puee, nì min kɔkɔ ti nì Kriisitoo ŋá ubaantee, m bàà ŋūǹ kí dàkà-si min sá á ŋée,

english_verse: But I would rather ask you to do it simply because of love. Yes, as someone in jail for Christ,
translation_verse: ama man kaa làá dī míǹ pu. Nì dineendi puee, man Pɔɔl un sá utikpil ki gíti tí sá usarkadaan Yeesu Kriisitoo puee làá gbàam̀-si ní.

english_verse: I beg you to help Onesimus! He is like a son to me because I led him to Christ here in jail.
translation_verse: M gbàam̄-si m-biki Ɔneesiim pu. Sarkan dooyee, man di kpántì u-baa nnimbɔtisan poon.

english_verse: Before this, he was useless to you, but now he is useful both to you and to me.
translation_verse: Dooooyee, waa nìn kèetī-si, ama kɔŋkɔnnee u kèetī man, ki làá kèetī si mun.

english_verse: I would like to keep him here with me, where he could take your place in helping me while I am here in prison for preaching the good news.
translation_verse: Kii Tibɔmɔntiil sòontam nín yāntì m bí sarkan puee, m bàà là yii ú fōō a-yil kí nīn bí m-cee kí tūtuǹ-mi kii sii nín bàà làá nīn tútúǹ-mi puee.

english_verse: But I won't do anything unless you agree to it first. I want your act of kindness to come from your heart, and not be something you feel forced to do.
translation_verse: Ama maa là kí ŋá míǹ kaa bālifì-si, kaa tí là kí páb́-si yii á ŋá tiŋan nee kí tīī-mi. M là yii á ŋá min a-pɔbil lèe ní.

english_verse: Perhaps Onesimus was taken from you for a little while so you could have him back for good,
translation_verse: An yaa yíì, Ɔneesiim yíkì a-cee ŋyunti ŋubɔ fiii, án nín làá ŋá pu, u yaa láa fātì ki gítìńee, si nì u ń ŋmā kí nīn kíǹ ki bí jaanjaanee.

english_verse: but not as a slave. Onesimus is much more than a slave. To me he is a dear friend, but to you he is even more, both as a person and as a follower of the Lord.
translation_verse: Kun puee waa ti sá uyumbufantanti. Kɔŋkɔnnee u jítì uyumbu pu, u kíǹ ki sá kinabineeŋkaai ní. Man néeń-u tiŋan, ama sii làá nīn gíti néeń-u tikpil, kun puee u sá sii yumbuu ní, ní ki sá a-nabiki mun ti-Dindaan pu.

english_verse: If you consider me a friend because of Christ, then welcome Onesimus as you would welcome me.
translation_verse: Míǹ puee, a yaa nyí yii m sá a-bɔɔyee, á fōō-u kii a nín bàà làá fōō man puee.

english_verse: If he has cheated you or owes you anything, charge it to my account.
translation_verse: U yaa bíil̀-si tibaaa, u yaa tí jíń-si dipɔndaaa, man fōō ki ŋá m-ba.

english_verse: With my own hand I write: I, PAUL, WILL PAY YOU BACK. But don't forget you owe me your life.
translation_verse: Man Pɔɔl m-ba di dū m-ŋal ki ŋmàn̄ní-si tibɔti nee yii, man di làá pà-si u-pɔndi din u yaa jíń-see. An taa nín̄ sá yii a nín sá m-pɔnliu, kun puee a ká difiil man puee pu ní m tɔ̀n̄-si.

english_verse: My dear friend and follower of Christ our Lord, please cheer me up by doing this for me.
translation_verse: Míǹ puee, m-nabiki, m cíkitì-si kifuulii. Ti-Dindaan puee á fōō m-gbaamii gbanti kí yàntī m-pɔbil ń sɔ̀ŋkì, ti nín ŋá ubaanti nì Kriisitooyee pu.

english_verse: I am sure you will do all I have asked, and even more.
translation_verse: M nyí m-pɔbilin yii tin m bíi ŋmà-si yii á ŋá kí tīī-mi nee, a làá ŋá án jītí míǹ pu gba.

english_verse: Please get a room ready for me. I hope your prayers will be answered, and I can visit you.
translation_verse: Á kpáàa bɔ́ntí-mi kudii kubɔ, kun puee m nyí yii Unimbɔti làá fōō ni-wimmeem ḿ ŋmā kí fàtīí gítiń ni-cee. Ijaam iluŋkikaa

english_verse: Epaphras is also here in jail for being a follower of Christ Jesus. He sends his greetings,
translation_verse: Eepafrasi man nì un bí sarkan Yeesu Kriisitoo puee jáaḿ-si.

english_verse: and so do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke, who work together with me.
translation_verse: M-tɔntɔnjutiibi Maarki nì Ariistaarki nì Deemasi nì Luuki mun jáamiń-si.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you!
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan Yeesu Kriisitoo ŋanti ń nīn bí ni-pu.

english_verse: Long ago in many ways and at many times God's prophets spoke his message to our ancestors.
translation_verse: Dooooyee, Unimbɔti nìn dī u-bɔnaatiliibi pu nì nsàmbiyaamu tikpil pu ki sòon̄ nì ti-naanjab ŋfunyɔm tikpil.

english_verse: But now at last, God sent his Son to bring his message to us. God created the universe by his Son, and everything will someday belong to the Son.
translation_verse: Ama iyunti in sá ijoolkaa nee poonee, u dī u-Jipɔɔn pu ní ki sòon̄ nì ti. Unimbɔti dī u-Jipɔɔn gbanti pu ní ki náań duulinya nì tin kɔkɔ bí duulinyanee. Úǹ ní Unimbɔti lēē ní ki dū tikɔkɔ ki ŋá u-ŋaan.

english_verse: God's Son has all the brightness of God's own glory and is like him in every way. By his own mighty word, he holds the universe together. After the Son had washed away our sins, he sat down at the right side of the glorious God in heaven.
translation_verse: U-pu ní ti kāntí Unimbɔti nyooti nín jìl̀ miŋyee. Úǹ di sá Unimbɔti naŋku, ní ki cáá u-nyɔɔbundi din sá mpɔnee ki ŋúb́ duulinya kɔkɔ. U fíntì ti-kpitii. Boonee ní u nín jɔ́ḿ yilpu ki cūtìi kāl̀ Unimbɔti Mpɔŋkpaandaan ŋaŋgiil pú. Unimbɔti Jipɔɔn jítiǹ ituun

english_verse: He had become much greater than the angels, and the name he was given is far greater than any of theirs. God's Son Is Greater than Angels
translation_verse: Kii Unimbɔti Jipɔɔn nín jítiǹ ituun puee, míǹ ní u-yindi mun tí jítiǹ ituun yaŋ.

english_verse: God has never said to any of the angels, “You are my Son, because today I have become your Father!” Neither has God said to any of them, “I will be his Father, and he will be my Son!”
translation_verse: Di sá yii Unimbɔti kaa lī ntuun ŋubɔ dalba yii: «A sá m-Jipɔɔn, kí yòon̄ díǹ kí nīn cée, man di sá a-Baa.» Waa láá sòon̄ ntuun ŋubɔ pu yii: «Man di làá nīn sá ŋu-Baa ní ŋú nīn sá man Jipɔɔn.»

english_verse: When God brings his first-born Son into the world, he commands all of his angels to worship him.
translation_verse: Ŋyunti ŋun u dū u-Jipɔŋkpiliu gbanti ki túnní duulinya poonee, ní u bí yii: «Unimbɔti tuuŋyi kɔkɔ ń gbàan̄ kí nyɔ̄ŋkì-u.»

english_verse: And when God speaks about the angels, he says, “I change my angels into wind and my servants into flaming fire.”
translation_verse: Kpèè Unimbɔti nín sòon̄ ituun pu yii i sá kuŋyee sèé, yii: «Ituun yáb̀ kii kubuŋuee, ní ki tūǹ úǹ tundi, ní ki tùm̀ kpaŋkpam kii ŋŋmee ki tūǹ u-tundi.»

english_verse: But God says about his Son, “You are God, and you will rule as King forever! Your royal power brings about justice.
translation_verse: Kpèè u nín sòon̄ u-Jipɔɔn pu miŋyee sèé, yii: «Unimbɔti, a-beejal pée bí ní kí nīn cá jaanjaan. A làá jī a-beel nì deedee ní.

english_verse: You loved justice and hated evil, and so I, your God, have chosen you. I appointed you and made you happier than any of your friends.”
translation_verse: A néeń tin bí deedeeyee ní ki ná tin kaa ŋān̄ee. An pu ní Unimbɔti, a-Nimbɔtiu, lútì-si, ki bātì dipɔɔpindi kpam ki sītì a-yil pu. U kāaǹ-si tinyool kakaaŋu, a jítiǹ a-jutiibi kɔkɔ.»

english_verse: The Scriptures also say, “In the beginning, Lord, you were the one who laid the foundation of the earth and created the heavens.
translation_verse: Ní Unimbɔti gíti bí yii: «Ŋkilkaaminee, sii ti-Dindaan di nìn náań kitiŋ, a-ŋalii ní a dūu náań kutagbɔŋu.

english_verse: They will all disappear and wear out like clothes, but you will last forever.
translation_verse: Tíǹ kɔkɔ làá dāá púĺ ní kí sátí kii dibɔkutilee ní kí kpú, ama sii làá nīn pée bí ní.

english_verse: You will roll them up like a robe and change them like a garment. But you are always the same, and you will live forever.”
translation_verse: A làá dāá kpáb́ yilpu nì taapu kii kukampeeuee, ní kí cáań tipɔn kí kpántí tikpikil kii bi nín kpántí dibɔkutil pu kí dū dipɔndi kí pèen̄ puee ní. Ama sii làá nīn pée gbíntì ki bí min a bée ní, aa làá púĺ jaanjaan.»

english_verse: God never said to any of the angels, “Sit at my right side until I make your enemies into a footstool for you!”
translation_verse: Unimbɔti kaa láá lī ntuun ŋubɔ dalba dalba yii: «Kàl̄ m-ŋaŋgiiliŋu pú yéè kí nīn cí ŋyunti ŋun m làá dū a-nannanliibi kí bíĺ a-taapu á tāā-bee.»

english_verse: Angels are merely spirits sent to serve people who are going to be saved.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti tuuŋyi di kaa sá bin kɔkɔ sá ŋfam ki bí ki tūǹ Unimbɔti tundeeee? U tūnní-bi ní bi dòoń ki tútúǹ bin làá ká difiilee.

english_verse: We must give our full attention to what we were told, so we won't drift away.
translation_verse: An puee, an máaǹ yii tí ŋúb́ ibaamɔn bɔti tin ti gbìl̄ee tiŋan án nín làá ŋá pu tí taa wāŋkèe.

english_verse: The message spoken by angels proved to be true, and all who disobeyed or rejected it were punished as they deserved.
translation_verse: Kun puee Unimbɔti nín nìn yāntì ituun sòon̄ tibɔti tiŋyee, bi ká ti-baamɔŋyi. Di sá yii bin nìn yīntì kaa tɔ́ ituunee nín lī puee nìn ká ditafadaaldi din máaǹ-bee.

english_verse: So if we refuse this great way of being saved, how can we hope to escape? The Lord himself was the first to tell about it, and people who heard the message proved to us that it was true.
translation_verse: Ti mun yaa yíì kaa fōō difiil dikpaandi din bí neeyee, mana ní ti làá ŋá kí ŋmátí kí nyā ditafadaaldin? Ti-Dindaan Yeesu di péé ki sòon̄ difiil gbanti bɔti ní bin gbìl̄-tèe tùkū-ti tì nín sá ibaamɔn miŋyee.

english_verse: God himself showed that his message was true by working all kinds of powerful miracles and wonders. He also gave his Holy Spirit to anyone he chose to. The One Who Leads Us To Be Saved
translation_verse: Ní Unimbɔti ŋáaǹ tidaandi nì maamaacib ki dū u-pɔŋŋu ki túń atuun kupaau kí dàkà yii tin bi sòon̄ee sá mbaamɔn, ní ki yākatì u-Fam pɔŋŋu min fáatì-uee ki tīī binib. Kriisitoo di fìil̄

english_verse: We know that God did not put the future world under the power of angels.
translation_verse: Di sá duulinya un bí ki dòoń ti bí ki sòoǹ u-pu nee, an kaa sá ituun di làá dāá nīn kpòotī-u.

english_verse: Somewhere in the Scriptures someone says to God, “What makes you care about us humans? Why are you concerned for weaklings such as we?
translation_verse: Ubɔ lī Unimbɔti gbɔŋku poon laaba yii: «Unil sá ba ní a téetí u-pu ní? Nisaal bí tilatin ní a kpèé-u ní?

english_verse: You made us lower than the angels for a while. Yet you have crowned us with glory and honor.
translation_verse: A sīntiǹ-u taapu ŋyunti ŋubɔ fiii ituun ń jītíǹ-u. Ama kɔŋkɔnnee a tīī-u tinyool nì kupampakau poon,

english_verse: And you have put everything under our power!” God has put everything under our power and has not left anything out of our power. But we still don't see it all under our control.
translation_verse: ní ki tīī-u mpɔn tiwan kɔkɔwoooo pu.» Unimbɔti nín tīī-u mpɔn tikɔkɔ puee dàkā yii tiba kaa kíǹ kaa bí u-taapu. Nì míǹ kɔkɔee, taa láá wāĺ tiwan kɔkɔ nín bí u-taapu kɔŋkɔnnee puee.

english_verse: What we do see is Jesus, who for a little while was made lower than the angels. Because of God's gift of undeserved grace, Jesus died for everyone. And now that Jesus has suffered and died, he is crowned with glory and honor!
translation_verse: Ama tin ti dáań ki kée di sá yii Yeesu un ní Unimbɔti sīntiǹ taapu ituun jítiǹ-u ŋyunti ŋubɔ poon fiiiyee, kɔŋkɔnnee ti wāĺ-u tinyool nì kupampakau poon ní. Ŋkúm min u jíń falaa ki kpíìyee pu ní Unimbɔti yōoǹ-u yilpu míǹ. Unimbɔti ŋanti pu ní Yeesu kpíì an kúm binib kɔkɔ pu.

english_verse: Everything belongs to God, and all things were created by his power. So God did the right thing when he made Jesus perfect by suffering, as Jesus led many of God's children to be saved and to share in his glory.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti di náań tikɔkɔ nì tikɔkɔ ní u-pu ní tikɔkɔ bí. U là inibool tikpil ń kpántí u-biyaamu kí kɔ́ u-nyootin. Di sá yii Yeesu di fìil̄-bi, míǹ puee an kítì yii Unimbɔti ń dī u-falaabi bin u jíńee pu kí yàntī ú kpántí mmɔm.

english_verse: Jesus and the people he makes holy all belong to the same family. This is why he isn't ashamed to call them his brothers and sisters.
translation_verse: Un kpántí binib circiree nì bin kpántì circiree kɔkɔ Baa sá ubaanti ní, an pu ní an kaa cáá Yeesu icoo ú yíiń-bi u-naalib.

english_verse: He even said to God, “I will tell them your name and sing your praises when they come together to worship.”
translation_verse: U lī yii: «Unimbɔti, m làá sòoǹ nì m-naalib a nín sá uŋyee, kí gāā ilan kí pàkà-si kunipaau kansikin.»

english_verse: He also said, “I will trust God.” Then he said, “Here I am with the children God has given me.”
translation_verse: Ní ki gíti lī yii: «Sii pu ní m làá nīn pée máká.» Ní ki gíti kūbitì ki lī yii: «Kpèè, man nì mbiyaamu mun Unimbɔti tīī-mee sèé.»

english_verse: We are people of flesh and blood. This is why Jesus became one of us. He died to destroy the devil, who had power over death.
translation_verse: Mbiyaamu gbantee nín sá binib tiwun nì fatiku puee ní Yeesu gíiǹ u-ba tiwun nì fatiku kii bíǹ nín bí puee. U ŋá míǹ kí ŋmā kí kpú, u-kúmee ń nàan̄ Sitaan un ŋúb́ ŋkúm pɔŋŋuee,

english_verse: But he also died to rescue all of us who live each day in fear of dying.
translation_verse: kí nyāntí bi nín pée màl̄ bin bi bí kuyuŋu poon kun puee bi fàŋkí ŋkúmee.

english_verse: Jesus clearly did not come to help angels, but he did come to help Abraham's descendants.
translation_verse: Di sá yii an kaa sá ituun ní u dɔ́miń ki tútúǹ, ama an sá Abraam biyaamu ní u dɔ́miń ki tútúǹ.

english_verse: He had to be one of us, so he could serve God as our merciful and faithful high priest and sacrifice himself for the forgiveness of our sins.
translation_verse: An pu ní an sá yii ú dū u-ba kí nántíǹ u-naalib tikɔkɔ poon kí ŋmā kí nīn sá bi-saraaŋakpiliu ki cáá disaasɔl ki tūǹ u-tundi deedee Unimbɔti nimbiin, án nín làá ŋá pu bí ká bi-kpitii pɔ̄tamee.

english_verse: And now that Jesus has suffered and was tempted, he can help anyone else who is tempted.
translation_verse: U nín jíń falaa icɔŋki poon ki kée di yì-tì ní u ŋūǹ kí jòò bin bí icɔŋkinee.

english_verse: My friends, God has chosen you to be his holy people. So think about Jesus, the one we call our apostle and high priest!
translation_verse: An puee m-nabiyaamu, nimbi bin Unimbɔti yíiń ni sá u-yabee, ní nīn kpèé Yeesu. Úǹ ní Unimbɔti túnní ú nīn sá ti-saraaŋakpiliu, ní u-pu ní ti fōō ki kíí.

english_verse: Jesus was faithful to God, who appointed him, just as Moses was faithful in serving all God's people.
translation_verse: Di sá yii u yúliǹ Unimbɔti un lēē-u ú tɔ̄ an tundee deedee, kii Mooyiisi nín nìn túń Unimbɔti dicaŋkun ditundi deedee puee.

english_verse: But Jesus deserves more honor than Moses, just as the builder of a house deserves more honor than the house.
translation_verse: Bi pàkà un máń kudiiyee ki jítiǹ kudii ku-ba. Míǹ mbaantiim ní Yeesu nyooti jítiǹ Mooyiisi yati.

english_verse: Of course, every house is built by someone, and God is really the one who built everything.
translation_verse: Kudii kamaa cáá un máń-kuee ní, ní un di māā tikɔkɔee di sá Unimbɔti.

english_verse: Moses was a faithful servant and told God's people what would be said in the future.
translation_verse: Mooyiisi úŋ̀wuee, u sá utɔntɔnli ní ki túń ditundi nì deedee Unimbɔti dicaŋkun. U-tundee nìn sá kí dàkà tin tin Unimbɔti làá dāá sòoǹ foolboonee ní.

english_verse: But Christ is the Son in charge of God's people. And we are those people, if we keep on being brave and don't lose hope. A Rest for God's People
translation_verse: Ama Kriisitoo úǹ sá Unimbɔti Jipɔɔn ní ki yì Unimbɔti dicaŋku. Timbi di sá Unimbɔti dicaŋkuee, ti yaa gbíntì ki máká u-pu, ki cɔ́tí u-pu ki tin kátì-kuee. Diŋuŋfil din dɔ̄ ki cí Unimbɔti yabee

english_verse: It is just as the Holy Spirit says, “If you hear God's voice today,
translation_verse: An puee, kii Circir Fam nín lī puee, yii: «Ni yaa gbìl̄ Unimbɔti bɔti díǹ,

english_verse: don't be stubborn! Don't rebel like those people who were tested in the desert. *
translation_verse: ní taa ŋá mpɔɔgbifin, a lì kii ni-naanjab nín nìn ŋá mpɔɔgbifin ki cɔ́ŋkì Unimbɔti kuteeun puee.

english_verse: For forty years your ancestors tested God and saw the things he did.
translation_verse: Kuteeun niin ní ni-naanjab nìn cɔ́ŋkì-mi kí kpèè m nín sá uŋyee, ní m dàkā-bi m nín sá uŋyee, áli abin imuŋku ili.

english_verse: “Then God got tired of them and said, ‘You people never show good sense, and you don't understand what I want you to do.’
translation_verse: An pu ní m gíí binib gbanti pu diŋuul, ki bí yii: <Binib nee mɔ̀tīi gáatí baabadal ní, baa dī m-sàmbiyaamu.>

english_verse: God became angry and told the people, ‘You will never enter my place of rest!’ ”
translation_verse: An di yì-tì ní m nìn gíí diŋuul ki pūtì yii baa làá ti kɔ́ mpaan ŋun m bɔ́ntì bí bàà kɔ́ kí kàl̄ kí ŋùŋfèe ni!»

english_verse: My friends, watch out! Don't let evil thoughts or doubts make any of you turn from the living God.
translation_verse: An puee m-nabiyaamu, ní nīn nyíǹ ni-ba, ubɔ ń taa nín̄ cáá dipɔɔkpitil din kaa cáá fookiiyee kí cúú u-ba kí nákatíǹ Unimbɔti un bí dimaŋfalinee.

english_verse: You must encourage one another each day. And you must keep on while there is still a time that can be called “today.” If you don't, then sin may fool some of you and make you stubborn.
translation_verse: Ama ní nīn tììmaan tɔb kunyannyaau baabadal ŋyunti nín dáá bí pu nee, án nín làá ŋá pu ikpiti ń taa kīil̀ ubɔ ni-kansikin udaan ń pɔ̄ɔkì u-pɔbilee.

english_verse: We were sure about Christ when we first became his people. So let's hold tightly to our faith until the end.
translation_verse: Ti nín kíĺ ki cáá dimákal din Kriisitoo puee, ti yaa gbíntì ki ŋúb́ míǹ ki tin kátì-kuee di dàkà yii ti sá Kriisitoo yab.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “If you hear his voice today, don't be stubborn like those who rebelled.”
translation_verse: A lì kii Unimbɔti gbɔŋku poon nín lī puee yii: «Ni yaa gbìl̄ Unimbɔti bɔti díǹ, ní taa ŋá mpɔɔgbifin a lì kii ni-naanjab nín nìn ŋá mpɔɔgbifin puee.»

english_verse: Who were those people that heard God's voice and rebelled? Weren't they the same ones that came out of Egypt with Moses?
translation_verse: Bilab di nìn gbìl̄ Unimbɔti bɔti ní ki pɔ́ɔkì bi-pɔbiliŋ ní? An sá bin kɔkɔ Mooyiisi nìn nyántìń Eejipiti tiŋkinee.

english_verse: And who did God say would never enter his place of rest? Weren't they the ones that disobeyed him?
translation_verse: Bilab pu ní Unimbɔti nìn pūtì yii: «Bi kpá kí kɔ́ mpaan ŋun m bɔ́ntì bí bàà kɔ́ kí kàl̄ kí ŋùŋfèe ni ní?» An sá bin nìn ŋá mpɔɔgbifinee ní u nìn lī míǹ.

english_verse: We see that those people did not enter the place of rest because they did not have faith.
translation_verse: Ti lafun ká yii baa nìn ŋúń ki kɔ́ diŋuŋfil laŋki, kun puee baa nìn fōō Unimbɔti ki kíí.

english_verse: The promise to enter the place of rest is still good, and we must take care that none of you miss out.
translation_verse: Kii dipoondi din sá tí kɔ́ Unimbɔti ŋuŋfilinee nín dáá bí pu nee, tí fàŋkìmaan, ni-kansikin ubɔ ń taa ŋá u-ba kí dāá gbíntí boon.

english_verse: We have heard the message, just as they did. But they failed to believe what they heard, and the message did not do them any good.
translation_verse: Kun puee bi sòon̄ Tibɔmɔntiil ti gbìl̄ kii bi nín nìn pée tí sòon̄ nì ti-naanjab bi mun gbìl̄ puee ní. Di sá bi nìn gbìl̄ tibɔtee kɔkɔ, ama ní kaa fōotìi yīkiǹ, kun puee bi nín nìn gbìl̄-tèe, baa nìn fōō-tì ki kíí.

english_verse: Only people who have faith will enter the place of rest. It is just as the Scriptures say, “God became angry and told the people, ‘You will never enter my place of rest!’ ” God said this, even though everything has been ready from the time of creation.
translation_verse: Timbi bin fōō ki kííyee, ti làá kɔ́ diŋuŋfil laŋki, laakin ní Unimbɔti lī yii: «M nìn gíí diŋuul ki pūtì yii mpaan ŋun m bɔ́ntì bí bàà kɔ́ kí kàl̄ kí ŋùŋfèe nee, bi kpá kí kɔ́!» U nìn lī míǹ, nì min kɔkɔ u nìn bɔ́ntì u-tundi ki síiǹ ki wāatì ní ki nín náań duulinyee.

english_verse: In fact, somewhere the Scriptures say that by the seventh day, God had finished his work, and so he rested.
translation_verse: Di sá Unimbɔti gbɔŋku poon sòon̄ ŋwinluluúti pu yii: «Unimbɔti ŋūŋfì u-tuuŋŋi kɔkɔ pu ŋwinluluúti dal.»

english_verse: We also read that he later said, “You people will never enter my place of rest!”
translation_verse: Ní an dāa nín sòon̄ doo yii: «Unimbɔti bí yii: <Bi kpá kí kɔ́ mpaan ŋun m bɔ́ntì binib ń kɔ́ kí ŋùŋfèe ni.>»

english_verse: This means that the promise to enter is still good, because those who first heard about it disobeyed and did not enter.
translation_verse: Bin bi nìn péé péé ki sòon̄ Tibɔmɔntiilee ki tīīyee nìn ŋá mpɔɔgbifin, an puee baa nìn ŋúń ki kɔ́ diŋuŋfil gbanti poon, ama dipoondee dáá gbíntìi bí, biba làá ŋmā kí kɔ́.

english_verse: Much later God told David to make the promise again, just as I have already said, “If you hear his voice today, don't be stubborn!”
translation_verse: Kun puee Unimbɔti gíti yóoǹ ŋwimpɔɔn ŋun binib làá kɔ́ u-ŋuŋfil laŋkee. Ŋúǹ di sá «díǹ». Di sá yii abin kupaau boonee, u nìn gíti yāntì ubɔti Daafiidi sòon̄ an pu, kii ti nín dáá kàan̄ní-tì pu nee yii: «Ni yaa gbìl̄ Unimbɔti bɔti díǹ, ní taa ŋá mpɔɔgbifin.»

english_verse: If Joshua had really given the people rest, there would not be any need for God to talk about another day of rest.
translation_verse: Di sá yii laakin Joosuwa nìn cáá Isirayeel yab ki cūnnèe di yaan nìn sá diŋuŋfil laŋki, laakin Unimbɔti bée, Unimbɔti kaa bàà nìn gíti sòoǹ diŋuŋfil diba mun pu.

english_verse: But God has promised us a Sabbath when we will rest, even though it has not yet come.
translation_verse: An puee, ŋwiŋŋuŋfikaa mmɔnti ŋubɔ gíti bí nyɔkɔpu ki cí bin sá Unimbɔti yabee.

english_verse: On that day God's people will rest from their work, just as God rested from his work.
translation_verse: Un yaa kɔ́ laakin Unimbɔti kā ki ŋùŋfēe mun ŋùŋfī ní. Kii Unimbɔti u-ba nín náań duulinya ki dóò ki kā ki ŋùŋfī puee, míǹ ní udaan mun yàntī u-tuuŋŋi kí ŋùŋfì.

english_verse: We should do our best to enter the place of rest, so none of us will disobey and miss going there, as they did.
translation_verse: An puee, timbi ń pɔ́ɔǹ ti-ba kí kɔ́ diŋuŋfil gbanti poon, kí taa fōō ti-naanjab yaŋyam kí lántí-dì.

english_verse: God's word is alive and powerful! It is sharper than any double-edged sword. His word can cut through our spirits and souls and through our joints and marrow, until it discovers the desires and thoughts of our hearts.
translation_verse: Di sá yii Unimbɔti bɔtee, tì cáá dimaŋfal ní, ní ki tūǹ ditundi ki jītí ki jítiǹ bɔlfi un jītí ajan liitil puee, ki gífí malaa, kí cúú kinaŋ nì ŋfam kí yàkatī tɔbin, ki kóò dikpabilin ki bà ncoom, ki béetí unil nín màkà kí ŋá puee nì u-pɔbil poon landɔkɔi.

english_verse: Nothing is hidden from God! He sees through everything, and we will have to tell him the truth. Jesus Is the Great High Priest
translation_verse: Tiwannáaŋkaal tiba kaa bí Unimbɔti kaa wāĺ-tì. Tin kɔkɔ pée bí duulinyanee dɔ̄ mpaampiin pu ní úǹ cee. U-nimbiin ní ti làá dāá sòoǹ ti-nyɔkɔpu yai. Yeesu, usaraaŋakpil un jítiǹ bin kɔ kíǹee

english_verse: We have a great high priest, who has gone into heaven, and he is Jesus the Son of God. This is why we must hold on to what we have said about him.
translation_verse: Yeesu, Unimbɔti Jipɔɔn di sá usaraaŋakpil un sá ukpaan ki jɔ́m̀ doooo yilpu fɔ́ŋŋŋ kí nīn tútúǹ-tee. An puee tí mɔ̀tīí nīn ŋúb́ fookii un ti cáá u-puee gbīŋgbim.

english_verse: Jesus understands every weakness of ours, because he was tempted in every way that we are. But he did not sin!
translation_verse: Kun puee timbi saraaŋakpiliuee sá un nyí ti-wɔfii ki sūǹ ti-saayee. Di sá yii u gíiǹ u-ba kii timbee ní, nniyaamin, ní ki béè iwɔsɔfi, ní Sitaan cɔ́ŋkì-u ama waa lítì ikpitin.

english_verse: So whenever we are in need, we should come bravely before the throne of our merciful God. There we will be treated with undeserved grace, and we will find help.
translation_verse: Míǹ puee, kámaan kunyannyaau kí sútiń kí pìl̄maan Unimbɔti beejal nì dimákal. Niin ní u-ŋanti bí. Niin ní u làá dàkà-ti u-ŋanti kí dū ti-kpitii kí pɔ̄-ti ní kí tūtuǹ-ti ŋyunti ŋun an máaǹee.

english_verse: Every high priest is appointed to help others by offering gifts and sacrifices to God because of their sins.
translation_verse: Binib kansikin ní bi lèekī ubɔ ú nīn sá usaraaŋakpil kí nīn ŋáań bin kɔkɔ kíǹee yil pu saraabi Unimbɔti nimbiin, ní u ŋáań saraabi binib kpitii pu.

english_verse: A high priest has weaknesses of his own, and he feels sorry for foolish and sinful people.
translation_verse: Usaraaŋakpil gbanti nyí kí jī bin kaa nyí tibee nì bin yīntèe pu kimɔtii, kun puee úǹ u-ba sá unil ní ki cáá u-wɔfii.

english_verse: This is why he must offer sacrifices for his own sins and for the sins of others.
translation_verse: Kii u mun nín cáá u-wɔfiiyee puee, an sá yii ú ŋá u-kpitii pu saraa ní kí nín ŋá bin kíǹee kpitii pu saraau.

english_verse: But no one can have the honor of being a high priest simply by wanting to be one. Only God can choose a priest, and God is the one who chose Aaron.
translation_verse: Ubɔ kaa ŋūǹ kí gāā u-bindi yii u làá ŋá disaraaŋatundi. Unimbɔti di lèekī kii u nín nìn lēē Aarɔn puee.

english_verse: This is how it was with Christ. He became a high priest, but not just because he wanted the honor of being one. It was God who told him, “You are my Son, because today I have become your Father!”
translation_verse: Míǹ mbaantiim an kaa sá Kriisitoo u-ba di gāā u-bindi ki là jilma ní ki kpántì usaraaŋakpil. Un tīī-uee di sá un bí-u yii: «Sii di sá man Jipɔɔn, báà ŋma ń béé díǹ yii man di sá a-Baa.»

english_verse: In another place, God says, “You are a priest forever just like Melchizedek.”
translation_verse: An gíti lī laaba mun yii: «Bi lēē-si á nīn sá usaraaŋakpil kii Meelkiiseedeeki nín nìn sá puee kí nīn cá jaanjaan.»

english_verse: God had the power to save Jesus from death. And while Jesus was on earth, he begged God with loud crying and tears to save him. He truly worshiped God, and God listened to his prayers.
translation_verse: Yeesu nín nìn dáá bí duulinyanee, u nìn mēē Unimbɔti un ŋūǹ kí fīī-u ŋkúminee ki gbāam̀-u nì ikuŋkuunti nì nnyinnyim. Unimbɔti nìn pílifiǹ-u, kun puee u nìn sīntiǹ u-ba taapu.

english_verse: Jesus is God's own Son, but still he had to suffer before he could learn what it really means to obey God.
translation_verse: Nì min kɔkɔ Yeesu sá Unimbɔti Jipɔɔnee, u bífì kí nīn tɔ́ Unimbɔti falaabi bin kɔkɔ u jíńee poon.

english_verse: Suffering made Jesus perfect, and now he can save forever all who obey him.
translation_verse: An pu ní u sá uniŋman umɔnti un pu baa kāntí tikpitil tibee, ki kpántì un tìì difiil din kaa cáá dikúntilee ki tīī bin kɔkɔ tɔ́-uee.

english_verse: This is because God chose him to be a high priest like Melchizedek. Warning against Turning Away
translation_verse: Unimbɔti di lēē-u ú nīn sá usaraaŋakpil kii Meelkiiseedeeki nín nìn sá puee. Nín̄ nyíǹ a-ba kí taa fá fookii

english_verse: Much more could be said about this subject. But it is hard to explain, and all of you are slow to understand.
translation_verse: Ti bàà cáá tibɔti tikpil kí sòoǹ nì ni an pu, ama ní an pɔ̄ɔ̄ tí bɔ́bití taapu kí tùkù-ni, kun puee ni sá binib bin sɔ̀m̀ kí gbìl̄ tibɔti taapu malaayee ní.

english_verse: By now you should have been teachers, but once again you need to be taught the simplest things about what God has said. You need milk instead of solid food.
translation_verse: Ni bàà máaǹ ki kpántì doooo nee bin dàkà bin kíǹee Unimbɔti bɔtee, ama nimbi di gíti bí ki nyàab̀ bí dàkà-ni Unimbɔti bɔti tin bi péetí kí dàkà bin fōō ki kíí mpɔmee. An nín bàà sá ní nīn jīǹ binicikitikaabi jintee, ní ni dū mbiim ki ŋá ni-jinti kii mbiyaamu mun ŋáaḿee.

english_verse: People who live on milk are like babies who don't really know what is right.
translation_verse: Un ní mbiim sá-u tijinee, udaan dáá sá kii kibiki kin ŋáaḿee dee, waa ŋūǹ kí béé min ŋān̄ Unimbɔti nimbiinee.

english_verse: Solid food is for mature people who have been trained to know right from wrong.
translation_verse: Ama tijin tin nyìm̀ee sá ki tīī binicikitikaabi bin cáá nlandɔkɔ ki dàkafī ki nyí ki gàntī tin sá tiŋanee nì tin sá tikpitilee ní.

english_verse: We must try to become mature and start thinking about more than just the basic things we were taught about Christ. We shouldn't need to keep talking about why we ought to turn from deeds that bring death and why we ought to have faith in God.
translation_verse: An puee tí jītímaan tibɔpeepeekaal tin unil yaa fōō Kriisitoo ki kíí mpɔm bi dàkà-uee pu, kí nyàab̀ kí kpántí binicikitikaabi. An kaa máaǹ tí gbíntíǹ tibɔpeepeekaal tin un fōō ki kíí mpɔmee nyée pu, tin sá unil ń fá atuun ŋin kaa cáá ipaatee nì unil ń fōō Unimbɔti kí kííyee,

english_verse: And we shouldn't need to keep teaching about baptisms or about the laying on of hands or about people being raised from death and the future judgment.
translation_verse: nì bi nín dàkà Unimbɔti nyiŋfàltam bɔti puee, nì bi nín pāantí iŋal binib pu ki mèé ki tìì-bee, nì bitaŋkpiibi fìkititam, nì ditafadaaldi din kaa cáá dikúntilee nín dɔ̄ ki cí binikpitib puee.

english_verse: Let's grow up, if God is willing.
translation_verse: An puee tí yàntīmaan tíǹ, Unimbɔti yaa lèe, tí póotí tipɔn.

english_verse: A field is useful to farmers, if there is enough rain to make good crops grow. In fact, God will bless such a field.
translation_verse: Kitiŋ yaa bí ní ki fòol̄ ntaanyim múlmul ní ki lòoǹ tijin tin bi kùn̄ ki-puee, Unimbɔti bìintí ki-pu ní.

english_verse: But land that produces only thornbushes is worthless. It is likely to fall under God's curse, and in the end it will be set on fire.
translation_verse: Ama kitiŋ gbanti yaa nyēē ikuŋkum nì abɔjanaakunee, mimmee bi ká-kì yii kàa bí tiban dee. Mbusu kaa pɔ̄ɔ̄ an tiŋkee dikɔl, kun puee ŋŋmi di dāa dòoń kí wà-kì.

english_verse: My friends, we are talking this way. But we are sure that you are doing those really good things people do when they are being saved.
translation_verse: Nnabineeŋkaamu, nì min kɔkɔ ti bí ki sòoǹ nì ni míǹ nee, ti cáá ni-pu dimákal yii naa bí míǹ, ni tɔ́kɔ́ difiil saŋŋu pu.

english_verse: God is always fair. He will remember how you helped his people in the past and how you are still helping them. You belong to God, and he won't forget the love you have shown his people.
translation_verse: Di sá yii Unimbɔti sá deedeedaan ní. Waa làá súntí dineendi din ni dàkà binib u-puee nì atummɔnti ŋin ni túń nì ŋin ni gbíntì ki nìkì ki tūǹ ki tìì bin sá u-yabee pu.

english_verse: We wish each of you would always be eager to show how strong and lasting your hope really is.
translation_verse: Tin ti nyàab̀ee di sá báà ŋma ń dàkà difaŋgiil míǹ kí tin kátí-ku, án nín làá ŋá pu ní dāá fōō kun pu ni máká ki tūǹ an tuuŋŋee.

english_verse: Then you would never be lazy. You would be following the example of those who had faith and were patient until God kept his promise to them. God's Promise Is Sure
translation_verse: An puee ní taa bàtī ni-faŋgiil pu, ama ní táá bin dū bi-fookiiu nì bi-mɔtiiki ki fōō tin Unimbɔti pōoǹee tabɔbiliŋ. Unimbɔti nín nìn pōoǹ Abraam puee bɔti

english_verse: No one is greater than God. So he made a promise in his own name when he said to Abraham,
translation_verse: Ŋyunti ŋun Unimbɔti làá nìn pòon̄ Abraam dipoondee, kí dàkà-u yii u làá lafun ŋá min u pōoǹ-uee, Unimbɔti nìn pūtì ní. Tiba kaa nìn bí ki jítiǹ-u ú yíiń kudɔŋu yindi kí pùtēe puee, ní Unimbɔti dūu pūtì u-ba.

english_verse: “I, the Lord, will bless you with many descendants!”
translation_verse: U bí Abraam yii: «M pūtì m-ba yii m làá bìin̄ a-boon kí bùtī a-maaliŋu.»

english_verse: Then after Abraham had been very patient, he was given what God had promised.
translation_verse: Abraam nín gbìl̄ mimmee, u jíń kimɔtii ní ki cíitì áli ŋyunti dāa bāań ní u fōō tin Unimbɔti pūtì ki pōoǹ yii u làá tīī-uee.

english_verse: When anyone wants to settle an argument, they make a vow by using the name of someone or something greater than themselves.
translation_verse: Binib bili yaa kpákèe, un jítiǹ-bi bi fàŋkée ní bi pùtī. Bi nín pūtì mimmee ní bi-nikpɔŋkpɔkɔkuee ń kúntí.

english_verse: So when God wanted to prove for certain his promise to his people could not be broken, he made a vow.
translation_verse: Míǹ mbaantiim ní Unimbɔti nín là kí dàkà u-yab yii u-poondee kaa bí kí kpántí jaanjaanee pu ní u pūtì.

english_verse: God cannot tell lies! And so his promises and vows are two things that can never be changed. We have run to God for safety. Now his promises should greatly encourage us to take hold of the hope that is right in front of us.
translation_verse: U tīī-ti tiwan tili tí ŋmā kí nīn máká ti-pu, dipoondi nì dipùtil. Tiwan tili gbanti puee, Unimbɔti kpá kí kpántí u-nyɔkɔ. U kpá kí mɔ̄ntì-ti, an puee timbi bin sáǹ ki dɔ́miń ki kɔ́-uee, tí kámaan kunyannyaau kí mɔ̀tīí dū ti-mákal kí báań tin u pōoǹ-tee pu tiŋan.

english_verse: This hope is like a firm and steady anchor for our souls. In fact, hope reaches behind the curtain and into the most holy place.
translation_verse: Dimákal din ti cáá yii ti làá dāá ká tin Unimbɔti pōoǹee di yì-tì ti bá ki yú ki ŋúb́ an pɔ̄ɔ̄. Dimákalee di jītí yilpu punyɔkɔki kí kɔ́ circir páaa laŋki.

english_verse: Jesus has gone there ahead of us, and he is our high priest forever, just like Melchizedek.
translation_verse: Niin ní Yeesu līntì ti-nyɔkɔpu ki dī ki kɔ́ ki kpántì usaraaŋakpil kii Meelkiiseedeekee, ki gbàam̄ ti-pu kí nīn cá jaanjaan.

english_verse: Melchizedek was both king of Salem and priest of God Most High. He was the one who went out and gave Abraham his blessing, when Abraham returned from killing the kings.
translation_verse: Ŋyunti ŋun ní Abraam nìn cūtì ki jáń ki pɔ́ɔkiǹ bibɔtiibi ki fàtīi kùnnée, Meelkiiseedeeki di nìn túŋkì-u nsanni ki mēē ki bīiǹ u-pu. Meelkiiseedeeki gbanti di sá Saleem yab bɔtiu, ní ki gíti sá Unimbɔti un bí kutaa fɔ́ŋŋŋee saraaŋaliu.

english_verse: Then Abraham gave him a tenth of everything he had. The meaning of the name Melchizedek is “King of Justice.” But since Salem means “peace,” he is also “King of Peace.”
translation_verse: Úǹ ní Abraam nìn lēē u-wanti tin u cááyee saalaa kamaa puee kubɔ kubɔ ki tīī. Meelkiiseedeeki taapu sá yii: Ubɔtikpaan un bí deedeeyee, ní boonee u gíti sá Saleem yab bɔtikpaaŋwu, an taapu sá yii ŋgbansɔŋfi bɔtikpaaŋwu.

english_verse: We are not told he had a father or mother or ancestors or beginning or end. He is like the Son of God and will be a priest forever.
translation_verse: Meelkiiseedeeki gbantee kaa cáá baa, kaa cáá na, kaa cáá nnyeen. An kaa cáá yii bi màl̄-u, kaa cáá yii u kúù. U bí kii Unimbɔti Jipɔɔnee ní, u làá nīn pée sá usaraaŋal ní kí nīn cá jaanjaan.

english_verse: Notice how great Melchizedek was! Our famous ancestor Abraham gave him a tenth of what he had taken from his enemies.
translation_verse: Ní kpèè u nín sá ukpaan miŋyee. Ti-naanja Abraam u-ba nìn tīī-u tiwan tin u nìn jáń ki fōō kujaaunee saalaa kamaa puee kubɔ kubɔ ní.

english_verse: The Law teaches that even Abraham's descendants must give a tenth of what they possess. And they are to give this to their own relatives, who are the descendants of Levi and are priests.
translation_verse: Mara poonee, Leefii naakookun yab bin sá bisaraaŋaliibee baba di nìn cáá nsan kí fōō bi-nabiyaamu mun sá Abraam maaliŋunee cee bi-wanti saalaa kamaa poonee kubɔ kubɔ.

english_verse: Although Melchizedek wasn't a descendant of Levi, Abraham gave him a tenth of what he had. Then Melchizedek blessed Abraham, who had been given God's promise.
translation_verse: Ama Meelkiiseedeeki gbanti kaa sá Leefii naakookun yab ubɔ ní ki fōō Abraam wanti saalaa kamaa puee kubɔ kubɔ, boonee ní ki mēē ki bīiǹ Abraam un Unimbɔti nìn líì dipoondee pu.

english_verse: Everyone agrees a person who gives a blessing is greater than the one who receives the blessing.
translation_verse: Ti-kɔkɔ pée nyí yii un jítiǹ-see di bìintí a-boon.

english_verse: Priests are given a tenth of what people earn. But all priests die, except Melchizedek, and the Scriptures teach that he is alive.
translation_verse: Juuda yab saraaŋaliibi bin fòol̄ bi-wanti saalaa kamaa pu kubɔ kubɔee sá binib ní, ki kúù, ama ti ká yii Meelkiiseedeeki úǹ pée bí ní kí nīn cá jaanjaan.

english_verse: Levi's descendants are now the ones who receive a tenth from people. We could even say that when Abraham gave Melchizedek a tenth, Levi also gave him a tenth.
translation_verse: Ti ŋūǹ kí lì yii Juuda yab saraaŋaliibi bin bi-jutiibi nìn tìì bi-wanti saalaa kamaa pu kubɔ kubɔee naanja Leefii u-ba dī Abraam pu ki tīī Meelkiiseedeeki u-wanti saalaa kamaa puee kubɔ kubɔ.

english_verse: This is because Levi was born later into the family of Abraham, who gave a tenth to Melchizedek.
translation_verse: Ŋyuntee, baa nìn dáá màl̄ Leefii, ama u nìn kā u-naanja Abraam poon ŋyunti ŋun Meelkiiseedeeki nìn túŋkìń-u nsannee.

english_verse: Even though the Law of Moses says the priests must be descendants of Levi, those priests cannot make anyone perfect. So there needs to be a priest like Melchizedek, rather than one from the priestly family of Aaron.
translation_verse: Isirayeel nibul marau poonee, Leefii naakookun yab kansikin ní bi nìn lèekī bisaraaŋaliibi. Bi sá bisaraaŋaliibi Aarɔn yamee ní. Ama bi nín sá bisaraaŋaliibi puee kaa sá páaa, yaa sá fám, ba pu ní an bàà gíti bàlifī yii usaraaŋal ubɔ mun ń nīn gíti bí ki náań nì Meelkiiseedeeki? An kaa bàà gíti páb́ deeyaa.

english_verse: And when the rules for selecting a priest are changed, the Law must also be changed.
translation_verse: Mimmee, bi yaa kpántì bisaraaŋaliibee, see bí kpántí marab mun.

english_verse: The person we are talking about is our Lord, who came from a tribe that had never had anyone to serve as a priest at the altar.
translation_verse: Ama ti-Dindaan un pu ní tibɔti nee sòon̄ ki dàkèe sá kunaakoou kun yab kaa pée ŋá disaraaŋatundi nsaraafan pu ki ká jaanjaanee ní.

english_verse: Everyone knows he came from the tribe of Judah, and Moses never said priests would come from that tribe.
translation_verse: Báà ŋma nyí u-pu yii u sá Juuda naakookun ní. Mooyiisi kaa nìn tīī kunaakoou gbanti disaraaŋatundi báà fiii. Usaraaŋal ubɔ, un nì Meelkiiseedeeki náańee

english_verse: All of this becomes clearer, when someone who is like Melchizedek is appointed to be a priest.
translation_verse: Tin bí nee gíti dàkà ki cántí tibɔti taapu, di sá usaraaŋal ubɔ gíti nyáń ki náań nì Meelkiiseedeeki.

english_verse: The Scriptures say about him, “You are a priest forever, just like Melchizedek.”
translation_verse: Di sá yii Unimbɔti gbɔŋku sòon̄ u-pu yii: «Sii di làá nīn pée sá usaraaŋal kí nīn cáa cá jaanjaan, Meelkiiseedeeki yam.»

english_verse: In this way a weak and useless command was put aside,
translation_verse: Mpeepeekaamee, bimarakpikib kpītì, kun puee baa pɔ̄ɔ̄ kaa tútúǹ binib.

english_verse: because the Law cannot make anything perfect. At the same time, we are given a much better hope, and it can bring us close to God.
translation_verse: Nliliitiimee, marabee kaa ŋúń ki kítì-ti tí kpántí biniŋmambi bimɔntiibi bin pu baa kāntí ikpiti ibee. Ama Kriisitoo sá-ti dimákabaamɔndi din pu ti ŋūǹ kí dī kí sútí kí pìl̄ Unimbɔtee.

english_verse: God himself made a promise when this priest was appointed. But he did not make a promise like this when the other priests were appointed. The promise he made is, “I, the Lord, promise that you will be a priest forever! And I will never change my mind!”
translation_verse: Ama Yeesu pu ní u pūtì ki lī yii: «Man ni-Dindaan di pūtì yii sii di làá nīn sá usaraaŋal kí nīn pée cáa cá jaanjaan, m kpá kí kɔ́ntí m-nyɔkɔ.»

english_verse: This means that Jesus guarantees us a better agreement with God.
translation_verse: An puee Yeesu di sá dipoommɔntiilee daaŋku kun dàkà yii án làá lafun ŋá mimmee.

english_verse: But Jesus will never die, and so he will be a priest forever!
translation_verse: Ama Yeesu úǹ pée bí ní jaanjaan, an puee ubɔ kaa fòol̄ u-saraaŋatundi.

english_verse: He is forever able to save the people he leads to God, because he always lives to speak to God for them.
translation_verse: An pu ní u ŋūǹ kí fīī bin dì u-pu ki nyàab̀ Unimbɔtee an kɔkɔ pu, kun puee u pée bí ní. Waa sá un kúùyee, ní ki mèé Unimbɔti bi-pu.

english_verse: Jesus is the high priest we need. He is holy and innocent and faultless, and not at all like us sinners. Jesus is honored above all beings in heaven,
translation_verse: Usaraaŋakpil un ti máaǹee dee. U bí circir, kaa ŋá ikpiti iba, ikpiti iba kaa bí u-pu. Unimbɔti cúú-u ki lēē bikpitib kansikin ki jɔ́m̀ yilpu fɔ́ŋŋŋ.

english_verse: and he is better than any other high priest. Jesus doesn't need to offer sacrifices each day for his own sins and then for the sins of the people. He offered a sacrifice once for all, when he gave himself.
translation_verse: Waa bí kii bisaraaŋakpilib bin kíǹee nín bí puee, ki ŋáań bi-yil pu kpitii saraau baabadal kí wàatī kí nín ŋá samaa yɔuee. Ŋyunti ŋun u dū u-ba ki ŋá saraayee ní u kúntì saraabi ŋátam kɔkɔ.

english_verse: The Law appoints priests who have weaknesses. But God's promise, which came later than the Law, appoints his Son. And he is the perfect high priest forever.
translation_verse: Mooyiisi marab nín yóoǹ bin bí nīn sá bisaraaŋakpilibee nìn sá binib ní. Baa cáá mpɔn bi-ba, ama ní boonee ní Unimbɔti sòon̄ ki pūtì ki lēē u-Jipɔɔn ki kāaǹ ú nīn sá usaraaŋakpil un sá uniŋman umɔnti un pu ikpiti iba kpée, kí nīn pée cáa cá jaanjaan.

english_verse: What I mean is we have a high priest who sits at the right side of God's great throne in heaven.
translation_verse: Tibɔti tin kɔkɔ ti sòon̄ nee, dibɔyil di sá yii, an saraaŋakpiliu juti ní ti cáá u kā yilpu Unimbɔti Mpɔŋkpaandaan ŋaŋgiiliŋu pú, dibeelin, tinyool laŋki.

english_verse: He also serves as the priest in the most holy place inside the real tent there in heaven. This tent of worship was set up by the Lord, not by humans.
translation_verse: Úǹ sá usaraaŋakpil un tūǹ ditundi laakin ti-Dindaan Unimbɔti u-ba máń an sá circiree ní, an kaa sá tanti un binib gāāyee poon kii bisaraaŋaliibi bin kíǹee nín ŋáań puee.

english_verse: Since all priests must offer gifts and sacrifices, Christ also needed to have something to offer.
translation_verse: Bi kāaǹ bisaraaŋakpilib bí nīn ŋáań saraabi ki jáaḿ Unimbɔti ní kí nīn ŋáań saraabi binib kpitii pu. An puee u máaǹ kí nīn cáá tin tin u làá dūú ŋá saraayee.

english_verse: If he were here on earth, he would not be a priest at all, because here the Law appoints other priests to offer sacrifices.
translation_verse: U yaa bàà bí duulinyan doo, waa bàà ŋūǹ kí nīn sá usaraaŋal kpaŋkpam. Di sá yii bisaraaŋaliibi bí ki ŋáań saraabi kii Juuda yab marab nín lī yii bí nīn ŋáań miŋyee.

english_verse: But the tent where they serve is just a copy and a shadow of the real one in heaven. Before Moses made the tent, he was told, “Be sure to make it exactly like the pattern you were shown on the mountain!”
translation_verse: Saraabi bin bisaraaŋaliibi ŋáańee sá tin bí yilpuee naŋku ní, a lì kii Unimbɔti nín nìn dū yilpu diiku bítam kɔkɔ ki dàkā Mooyiisi u gāā-u tanti taapu doo puee ní. Unimbɔti bí-u yii: «Á kpèè kí gāā-mi tanti ú nīn bí kii un m nìn dàkā-si dijool puee deedee.»

english_verse: Now Christ has been appointed to serve as a priest in a much better way, and he has given us much assurance of a better agreement.
translation_verse: Ama kɔŋkɔnnee ditundi din Kriisitoo bí yilpu ki tūǹee jítiǹ Juuda yab saraaŋaliibi nín tūǹ ŋiŋyee, di sá Kriisitoo kúm di yì-tì ní Unimbɔti pōoǹ-ti dipoondi din sá dimɔntiil ki jítiǹ dikpikilee.

english_verse: If the first agreement with God had been all right, there would not have been any need for another one.
