translation_verse: Dipoompeepeekaal din Unimbɔti nìn pōoǹ ti-naanjabee yaa nìn sá dimɔntiilee, an kaa bàà gíti bàlifī yii bí kpántí diba.

english_verse: But the Lord found fault with it and said, “I tell you the time will come, when I will make a new agreement with the people of Israel and the people of Judah.
translation_verse: An pu ní Unimbɔti nìn bíi wòoǹ-bi ki tùkù-bi yii: «Man ni-Dindaan di lī yii iwiin bí ki dòoń in poon m làá fàtīí pòon̄ Isirayeel yab nì Juuda yab dipoompɔndee.

english_verse: It won't be like the agreement that I made with their ancestors, when I took them by the hand and led them out of Egypt. They broke their agreement with me, and I stopped caring about them!
translation_verse: Dipoondi gbanti kaa dāa sá kii din m nìn pōoǹ bi-naanjab daliŋkin m nìn nyántìń-bi Eejipiti tiŋkinee. Boonee baa dū dipoondee ki túń ditundi, ní ma mun kaa ti fātìi tɔ́ bi-bɔti.

english_verse: “But now I tell the people of Israel this is my new agreement: ‘The time will come when I, the Lord, will write my laws on their minds and hearts. I will be their God, and they will be my people.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan bí yii: M nín làá dāá líí Isirayeel yab dipoondi diŋyee sèé: Ŋyunti gbantee, m làá dāá ŋmà m-marab kí ŋá bi-landɔkɔyin bí ŋmā kí nīn nyí min m lèe, ní kí dūú ŋmà bi-pɔbiliŋin bí ŋmā kí nīn ŋúb́-bi kí taa ti súntí. Míǹ ní m dāa sá bi-Nimbɔtiu ní bi mun dāa sá man samaau.

english_verse: Not one of them will have to teach another to know me, their Lord.’ “All of them will know me, no matter who they are.
translation_verse: Ubɔ kaa dāa gíti dàkà u-kɔŋkɔnnaatɔ àá u-nabiki yii ú nīn nyí ti-Dindaan. Kí yòon̄ bi-kansikin mbiyaawaamu kí tin cáá sāā bikpaambi, báà ŋma làá dāá béé-mi.

english_verse: I will treat them with kindness, even though they are wicked. I will forget their sins.”
translation_verse: Kun puee m làá dāá sɔ̄ bi-saai kí dū bi-kpitii kí pɔ̄-bi, kaa làá ti pée téetí bi-kpitii gbanti pu.»

english_verse: When the Lord talks about a new agreement, he means that the first one is out of date. And anything that is old and useless will soon disappear.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti nín sòon̄ dipoompɔndi bɔtee, mimmee din béeyee ŋá dikpikil dee. Tiwan yaa ŋá tikpikilee ti púĺ dee, ki làá kúntí mun.

english_verse: The first promise included rules for worship and a tent for worship here on earth.
translation_verse: Ŋyunti ŋun Unimbɔti nìn pōoǹ dipoompeepeekaalee, u nìn yóoǹ marab bin binib làá dī kí jāam̀-uee nì tanti un poon bi làá nīn jáaḿ-uee.

english_verse: The first part of the tent was called the holy place, and a lampstand, a table, and the sacred loaves of bread were kept there.
translation_verse: Bi nìn gāā tanti ní, ní ki dū sata ki pītì poon adiin ali, ní ki yíì kudipeepeekaauee circir laŋki. Niin ní fitilab tɔ́kɔŋkaati nìn bí, ní teebil yú ní bi cāabìń kpɔnɔb bin bi ŋáań Unimbɔti saraayee ki pāantí.

english_verse: Behind the curtain was the most holy place.
translation_verse: Sataliliiti boonee, kudii kubɔ mun dee, niin ní bi yíì circir páaa laŋki.

english_verse: The gold altar for burning incense was in this holy place. The gold-covered sacred chest was also there, and inside it were three things. First, there was a gold jar filled with manna. Then there was Aaron's walking stick that sprouted. Finally, there were the flat stones with the Ten Commandments written on them.
translation_verse: Niin ní sindaariya saraafaŋŋu nìn yú ní bi tùutī talaalub an pu, ní dipoondi dakaau yú bi dū sindaariya ki nyūntì u-kɔkɔ. Dakaayee poonee, kibaŋŋi kiba yú ki sá sindaariya ŋma. Ki-poon ní tijin tin bi yíì maanee nìn kā. Dakaa ubaantee poon ní Aarɔn kpandɔŋu ŋun nìn púkuḿ nsupumpukumee nì ataŋkpee ŋin pu Unimbɔti nìn ŋmàn̄ dipoondi marabee kā.

english_verse: On top of the chest were the glorious creatures with wings opened out above the place of mercy. Now isn't the time to go into detail about these things.
translation_verse: Ní bi dū sindaariya ki mɔ́ɔ́ keerubimbi bin sá Unimbɔti nyootee bili ki tɔ́kɔǹ dakaayee pu kí dàkà yii Unimbɔti u-ba bí niin. Keerubimbee nìn kpátì bi-feeŋyi ki bīiǹ laakin bi yaa ŋá ikpiti saraau bi cáá fatiku ki yàantée pu. Taa ŋūǹ kí sòoǹ dakaa gbanti bɔti nì u-tuuŋŋi nín sá puee kɔŋkɔnnee.

english_verse: But this is how everything was when the priests went each day into the first part of the tent to do their duties.
translation_verse: Bi nìn ŋá míǹ kɔkɔ ki dóòyee, kudipeepeekaauee poon ní bisaraaŋaliibi kóò baabadal ki ŋáań bi-saraatuuŋŋi.

english_verse: However, only the high priest could go into the second part of the tent, and he went in only once a year. Each time he carried blood to offer for his sins and for any sins that the people had committed without meaning to.
translation_verse: Ama poon diiku laakin bi yíì yii circir páaa laŋkee, usaraaŋakpil baba di kóò niin dibindi poonee diba ja kí cáá tiwaŋkuti tin u kūū úǹ u-ba kpitii puee fatikuu nì tin bi kūū samaa kɔkɔ nín ŋá ikpiti in kaa nyée fatikuu kí kɔ́ǹ kí ŋá Unimbɔti saraa.

english_verse: All of this is the Holy Spirit's way of saying no one could enter the most holy place while the tent was still the place of worship.
translation_verse: Circir Fam nìn dàkà yii, ŋyunti ŋun ní nsan pú diiku dáá bée, nsan nìn kpá unil ń jītí kí kɔ́ circir páaa laŋki.

english_verse: These rules are merely about such things as eating and drinking and ceremonies for washing ourselves. And rules about physical things will last only until the time comes to change them for something better.
translation_verse: An sá marab bin bi yóoǹ bi sá tijin nì tinyɔkaal nì tiwun difíntilee bɔti ní. An marabee kɔkɔ sá tiwun pu marab ní kí tin sāā ŋyunti ŋun Unimbɔti làá dāá cáań tipɔnee.

english_verse: Christ came as the high priest of the good things that are now here. He also went into a much better tent that wasn't made by humans and that doesn't belong to this world.
translation_verse: Kriisitoo dɔ́miń ki sá-ti usaraaŋakpil un cáań-ti tiŋan tin poon ti bí nee. Úǹ di kɔ́ kusaraadimɔntiiu kun sá kukpaaŋŋu kaa sá binib di máńee, an dàkà yii kuaa sá duulinya doo diiku.

english_verse: Then Christ went once for all into the most holy place and freed us from sin forever. He did this by offering his own blood instead of the blood of goats and bulls.
translation_verse: U kɔ́ diba ja Circir páaa laŋki Unimbɔti nimbiin. An kaa sá nì iŋɔjaa nì anabil fatikuu ní u cáa kɔ́ǹ, ama úǹ u-ba fatikuu. Míǹ ní u ŋá ní ki cáań-ti difiil din kaa cáá dikúntilee.

english_verse: According to the Law of Moses, those people who become unclean are not fit to worship God. Yet they will be considered clean, if they are sprinkled with the blood of goats and bulls and with the ashes of a sacrificed calf.
translation_verse: Dikoobil di nìn sá puee di sá bi nìn dū iŋɔjaa nì inajaa fatikuu nì unasal un bi nìn wù ŋŋmi kɔkɔee fantam kí yàaǹ bin ŋá ikpitee pu ní. Bi yaa nìn ŋá mimmee, an lēē ikpiti bi-wunti pu bi kpántì circirdambi dee.

english_verse: But Christ was sinless, and he offered himself as an eternal and spiritual sacrifice to God. This is why his blood is much more powerful and makes our consciences clear. Now we can serve the living God and no longer do things that lead to death.
translation_verse: An yaa nìn ŋūǹ kí ŋá míǹ, kin ataa aŋa pu ní Kriisitoo un Circir Fam tútúǹ u dū u-ba ki ŋá saraamɔnti ki tīī Unimbɔtee fatikuu kaa ŋūǹ kí fíntí atuŋkpiti ti-pɔbiliŋ poon tí ŋmā kí nóó Unimbɔti un bí dimaŋfalinee.

english_verse: Christ died to rescue those who had sinned and broken the old agreement. Now he brings his chosen ones a new agreement with its guarantee of God's eternal blessings!
translation_verse: Kriisitoo di cáań-ti dipoompɔndi, án nín làá ŋá pu ní bin Unimbɔti fīīyee ń ŋmā kí fōō tigaajawan tin Unimbɔti pōoǹ tàa cáá dikúntilee. Kun pu bi làá ŋmā kí fōō tigaajawan gbantee di sá Kriisitoo kpíì ki nyántì-bi bi nín nìn bí dipooŋkpikil poon ki ŋáań ikpiti iŋyee ni.

english_verse: In fact, making an agreement of this kind is like writing a will. This is because the one who makes the will must die before it is of any use.
translation_verse: Unil yaa bí yii a làá jī u-fakalee, u yaa kaa láá kpíì, saa yòontí tiba.

english_verse: In other words, a will doesn't go into effect as long as the one who made it is still alive.
translation_verse: Daliŋkin u sòon̄ ki tùkū-si yii sii di làá jī u-fakalee, tibɔtee kaa láá tūǹ ditundi, see u yaa láa kpíìyee ní á nín yīkì kí tɔ́kɔń difakalee pu kii u nín nìn pée tùkū-si puee.

english_verse: Blood was also used to put the first agreement into effect.
translation_verse: An pu ní tiwaŋkuti fatikuu nìn nyáń ki wāatì ní dipoompeepeekaal nín ŋúń ki túń ditundi.

english_verse: Moses told the people all the Law said they must do. Then he used red wool and a hyssop plant to sprinkle the people and the book of the Law with the blood of bulls and goats and with water.
translation_verse: Di sá Mooyiisi nín kàan̄ marab bin kɔkɔ Unimbɔti ŋmàn̄ee ki tùkū samaa kɔkɔ ki dóòyee, ní u yōoǹ anabil, nì iŋɔjaa fatikuu ki dū nnyim ki ŋmālim̀ ní ki dū tipikuti tin bi mántèe nì isɔpi faapibiti ki cáa sèetī fatiku poon ki yàantí kugbɔŋu kun poon bi ŋmàn̄ marabee nì samaa kɔkɔ pu.

english_verse: He told the people, “With this blood God makes his agreement with you.”
translation_verse: U nìn lī yii: «Fatiku nee di sá dipoondi din Unimbɔti líì-nee daaŋku.»

english_verse: Moses also sprinkled blood on the tent and on everything else used in worship.
translation_verse: U ŋá mimmee ní ki yāaǹ Unimbɔti tantiu un bi gāāyee nì tiwan tin bi cáa ŋáań saraabee kɔkɔ pu.

english_verse: The Law says that almost everything must be sprinkled with blood, and no sins can be forgiven unless blood is offered. Christ's Great Sacrifice
translation_verse: Kii mara nín lī puee, fatiku ní bi ŋman nìn pée cáa yàantí tiwan kɔkɔ pu ní tí kpántí circir. An puee fatiku yaa kaa nyáńee, unil kaa kāntí u-kpitii pɔ̄tam. Yeesu fatikuu di lèekī ikpiti

english_verse: These things are only copies of what is in heaven, and so they had to be made holy by these ceremonies. But the real things in heaven must be made holy by something better.
translation_verse: Bi yaa nìn máaǹ kí ŋá tiwan tin sá yilpu wanti naŋku circir mimmee, an bàlifī yii bí ŋá saraabi bin jítiǹ míǹ kpataaayee yilpu wanti pu.

english_verse: This is why Christ did not go into a tent made by humans and was only a copy of the real one. Instead, he went into heaven and is now there with God to help us.
translation_verse: Kun puee an kaa sá yii Kriisitoo kɔ́ kudii kun binib máń ki nántiǹ yilpu yɔkɔee poon ní ki ŋá saraa. Ama yilpu, Unimbɔti cee ní u kɔ́, ki bí Unimbɔti nimbiin kɔŋkɔnnee ki gbàam̄ ti-pu.

english_verse: Christ did not have to offer himself many times. He wasn't like a high priest who goes into the most holy place each year to offer the blood of an animal.
translation_verse: Kí kūtèe, dibindi sá kamaayee, usaraaŋakpil nìn kóò circir páaa laŋki nì tiwaŋkuti fatikuu ní kí ŋá saraabi. Ama Kriisitoo úǹ kaa kɔ́ ŋfunyɔm kupaau kí dū u-ba kí ŋá saraa.

english_verse: If he had offered himself every year, he would have suffered many times since the creation of the world. But instead, near the end of time he offered himself once and for all, so he could be a sacrifice that does away with sin.
translation_verse: An yaa sá mimmee, doooo duulinya nín kíĺ ki dāa sāā díǹee, u bàà làá jī falaabi ŋfunyɔm kupaau ní. Ama duulinya nín tóob́ dikúntil pu nee ní u dɔ́miń ki dū u-ba ki ŋá saraa diba pu kí kúntí ikpiti.

english_verse: So Christ died only once to take away the sins of many people. But when he comes again, it will not be to take away sin. He will come to save everyone who is waiting for him.
translation_verse: Míǹ mbaantiim ní Kriisitoo mun dū u-ba ki ŋá saraa diba ja ki nyántì binib tikpil ikpiti poon. U làá dāan̄ nliliitiim, kaa sá kí dāá nyāntí binib ikpiti poon, ama u dāa dòoń kí fīī bin kíǹ ki kā ki cí-uee ní.

english_verse: The Law of Moses is like a shadow of the good things to come. This shadow isn't the good things themselves, because it cannot free people from sin by the sacrifices offered year after year.
translation_verse: Mooyiisi marab kaa nìn baasii dàkà tiŋan tin Yeesu làá cáań-tee mbaamɔmin, an nìn pée sá kunaŋu ní. Di sá yii bi nìn pée ŋáań saraabi gbanti míǹ ní dibintil sá kamaa an kaa kúntí, ama ní an kaa ŋūǹ kí yàntī bí kpántí bimɔntiibi páaa kí sútí kí pìl̄ Unimbɔti.

english_verse: If there were worshipers who already have their sins washed away and their consciences made clear, there would not be any need to go on offering sacrifices.
translation_verse: Bin bin nìn ŋáań tiwaŋkuti saraabi ki tìì Unimbɔtee yaa nìn ŋá saraa míǹ diba pu bi-kpitii lēēyee, kɔnampu bi bàà nìn gbēeǹ disaraaŋal dooooyee, kun puee baa bàà gíti gbìl̀ bi-ban yii bi cáá ikpiti.

english_verse: But the blood of bulls and goats cannot take away sins. It only reminds people of their sins from one year to the next.
translation_verse: Kun puee inajaa nì iŋɔjaa fatikuu kaa ŋūǹ kí lēē ikpiti jaanjaan.

english_verse: When Christ came into the world, he said to God, “Sacrifices and offerings are not what you want, but you have given me my body.
translation_verse: An pu ní ŋyunti ŋun Kriisitoo làá nīn dòoń duulinyanee, u bí Unimbɔti yii: «Aa là kuwaŋkuluu saraabi àá tijimpin saraabi. Man ní a tīī tiwun ḿ dū-tì kí ŋá saraa kí tīī-si.

english_verse: No, you are not pleased with animal sacrifices and offerings for sin.”
translation_verse: Bisaraawɔkaabi nì ikpiti pɔ̄tam saraabi kaa fáatì-si.

english_verse: Then Christ said, “And so, my God, I have come to do what you want, as the Scriptures say.”
translation_verse: An pu ní m bí yii: Unimbɔti, m sèé, m làá cùú ŋá min làá fáatíǹ-see, kii an nín pée ŋmàn̄ m-pu min ki yóoǹ a-gbɔŋkunee.»

english_verse: The Law teaches that offerings and sacrifices must be made because of sin. But why did Christ mention these things and say that God did not want them?
translation_verse: Yeesu dá láá péé ki lī yii: «Aa fáatì tiwaŋkuti saraabi nì tijimpin saraabi nì bisaraawɔkaabi nì ikpiti pɔ̄tam saraabi.» U nìn lī míǹ, nì min kɔkɔ mara di pú nsan yii bí nīn ŋáań saraabi gbanti kɔkɔee.

english_verse: Well, it was to do away with offerings and sacrifices and to replace them. This is what he meant by saying to God, “I have come to do what you want.”
translation_verse: Boonee ní ki dāa lī yii: «An pu ní man bí yii: M sèé, Unimbɔti, m làá cù kí ŋá min fáatì-see.» Ní u lafun dɔ́miń ki kpītì nsaŋkpiki ŋun binib nìn dī ki nóó Unimbɔtee ní ki náań mpɔɔn.

english_verse: So we are made holy because Christ obeyed God and offered himself once for all.
translation_verse: Yeesu Kriisitoo dɔ́miń ki ŋá min fáatiǹ Unimbɔtee. U dū u-ba ki ŋá saraa diba pu ki kúntì saraabi, ní u-saraauee fíntì ti-kpitii.

english_verse: The priests do their work each day, and they keep on offering sacrifices that can never take away sins.
translation_verse: Baabadalee, usaraaŋal yú u-tundi laŋki ní, ní ki ŋáań bisaraabaantiibi múlmul, ama ní an saraabee kaa ŋūǹ kí lēē unil kpitii.

english_verse: But Christ offered himself as a sacrifice that is good forever. Now he is sitting at God's right side,
translation_verse: Ní Kriisitoo úǹ dū u-ba ki ŋá saraa un bí kí nīn cá jaanjaanee diba pu timbi kpitii pu. Boonee ní ki cūtìi kāl̀ Unimbɔti ŋaŋgiil pú.

english_verse: and he will stay there until his enemies are put under his power.
translation_verse: U kā niin ki cí ŋyunti ŋun Unimbɔti làá dāá dū u-nannanliibi kí ŋá u-taaŋi taapu ú tāāyee.

english_verse: By his one sacrifice he has forever set free from sin the people he brings to God.
translation_verse: Di sá yii saraabambaanti ní u ŋá ní an fíntì binib kpitii ní saraa gbantee cáá mpɔn kí nīn cá, kí gàntī-bi kí yóoń bí nīn ŋān̄ Unimbɔti nimbiin.

english_verse: The Holy Spirit also speaks of this by telling us that the Lord said,
translation_verse: Unimbɔti Fam lī yii míǹ ní an lafun sá. Mpeekaamee, mì bí yii:

english_verse: Then I will forget about their sins and no longer remember their evil deeds.”
translation_verse: Ní nliliitiimee mì gíti bí yii: «Maa làá dāá gíti téetí bi-kpitii nì bi-yìntitam pu dalba dalba.»

english_verse: When sins are forgiven, there is no more need to offer sacrifices. Encouragement and Warning
translation_verse: Di sá bi yaa dū unil kpitii ki pú-uee, an kaa ti cáá saraa ubɔ ú gíti ŋá ikpitee pu. Tí sútiń kí pìl̄ Unimbɔti

english_verse: My friends, the blood of Jesus gives us courage to enter the most holy place
translation_verse: An puee nnabiyaamu, Yeesu nín kpíì u-fatikuu nyáńee ní nsan dōoǹ tí jītí kí kɔ́ circir páaa laŋki laakin Unimbɔti bée.

english_verse: by a new way that leads to life! And this way takes us through the curtain that is Christ himself.
translation_verse: An sá nsampɔɔn ŋun tìì dimaŋfalee ní Yeesu pīitì-ti ki dī ŋŋaabu ŋun nìn pītì circir laŋki nì circir páaa laŋkee. Ŋŋaabuee di sá u-wunti.

english_verse: We have a great high priest who is in charge of God's house.
translation_verse: Ti nín cáá usaraaŋakpil un Unimbɔti kāaǹ u-dicaŋku puee,

english_verse: So let's come near God with pure hearts and a confidence that comes from having faith. Let's keep our hearts pure, our consciences free from evil, and our bodies washed with clean water.
translation_verse: tí sútí kí pìl̄ Unimbɔti nì dipɔbil diba nì dimákabaamɔndi, kí fíntí ti-pɔbiliŋ poon ilandɔkɔkpiti án nyā dándan, kí dū nnyim min ŋān̄ circiree kí fàl̀ ti-wunti ń nyā.

english_verse: We must hold tightly to the hope we say is ours. After all, we can trust the one who made the agreement with us.
translation_verse: Tí nīn gbíntì ki ŋúb́ ti-mákal din ti lì yii ti cááyee gbīŋgbim, kun puee u nín pōoǹ yii u làá ŋá miŋyee, u làá lafun ŋá míǹ ní.

english_verse: We should keep on encouraging each other to be thoughtful and to do helpful things.
translation_verse: Tí nīn ŋúb́maan tɔb tiŋan kí nīn nyàatī tɔb, ti-neendi ń mɔ̀tīí nīn wīintí, kí nīn tūǹ atummɔnti,

english_verse: Some people have given up the habit of meeting for worship, but we must not do that. We should keep on encouraging each other, especially since you know that the day of the Lord's coming is getting closer.
translation_verse: kí taa fàtī ti-boon kí tīī Kriisitoo nikitiŋ kooŋyi kii an nín kpántì biba bimbim baa ti dòoń puee. Ama nín̄ tììmaan tɔb kunyannyaau, kun puee nimbi ni-ba nyí yii ti-Dindaan wiiŋŋu tóobiń.

english_verse: No sacrifices can be made for people who decide to sin after they find out about the truth.
translation_verse: Ti yaa béè ibaamɔn ní ki fōō-i, ní boonee ti gbíntì ki nìkì ki ŋáań ikpiti ti nín là puee, tí béé yii saraa ubɔ gíti kpá bí ŋá án lēē ti-kpitii.

english_verse: They are God's enemies, and all they can look forward to is a terrible judgment and a furious fire.
translation_verse: Ama tin kíǹ tí nīn cée di sá ditafadaakpaandi din sá ŋŋmi ki gà lìblib ki làá wà Unimbɔti nannanliibee.

english_verse: If two or more witnesses accused someone of breaking the Law of Moses, that person could be put to death.
translation_verse: Un yaa nìn yīntiǹ Mooyiisi marab, ní binib bili kii bita yaa lēē seera yii bi ká u nín yīntì puee, bi nìn kù-u ní baa sūǹ u-saai.

english_verse: But it is much worse to dishonor God's Son and to disgrace the blood of the promise that made us holy. And it is just as bad to insult the Holy Spirit, who shows us mercy.
translation_verse: Ní kpèè ditafadaaldi dilal ní un kpēē Unimbɔti Jipɔɔn fám kaa dū fatiku un Unimbɔti dū ki líì-ti dipoondee ki yíiń tibee máaǹ? Ama fatikuee ní bi dūu fíntì u-kpitii, ní boonee u kíǹ ki kɔ̄ntí Unimbɔti Fam min min pú-u an yimɔɔlee diŋuul.

english_verse: We know that God has said he will punish and take revenge. We also know that the Scriptures say the Lord will judge his people.
translation_verse: Ti nyí Unimbɔti un di lī yii: «An sá man Unimbɔti di làá dāá tɔ̀ ipɔntoon, man di làá dāá pà tipaal,» ní ki gíti bí yii: «Man di làá dāá sòoǹ m-samaau bɔti.»

english_verse: It is a terrible thing to fall into the hands of the living God!
translation_verse: Sii un yaa kɔ́ Unimbɔti un bí nee bɔtinee, an dóò sii pu dee!

english_verse: Don't forget all the hard times you went through when you first received the light.
translation_verse: Téetímaan ŋkpikim ni nín nìn fōō Kriisitoo ki kíí ki ká ŋwalifi ŋuŋyee, nì falaabi bin ní ni nìn jíń tikpil kaa fātìi tɔ́ee.

english_verse: Sometimes you were abused and mistreated in public, and at other times you shared in the sufferings of others.
translation_verse: Iyunti ibee, bi sìí-ni, iyunti ibee, bi cáǹ-ni diniwul nimbiin ki sàantí, iyunti ibee, ni bí ki sūǹ bin bi sàantée saai.

english_verse: You were kind to people in jail. And you gladly let your possessions be taken away, because you knew you had something better, something that would last forever.
translation_verse: Míǹ ní ni nì bisarkadambi yākatì bi-falaau. Bi yaa nìn cúú ni-wanti ki fōōyee, an kaa nìn páb́-ni, ni-pɔbiliŋ nìn sɔ̀m̀, kun puee ni nyí yii ni cáá tigaajamɔntiil tin làá nīn bí jaanjaanee an dɔ̄ yilpu.

english_verse: Keep on being brave! It will bring you great rewards.
translation_verse: An puee ní taa páatí ni-mákal, ipaatikpaan dɔ̄ ki cí-ni.

english_verse: Learn to be patient, so you will please God and be given what he has promised.
translation_verse: An máaǹ ní nīn cáá dipɔ́ɔǹdi ní kí ŋmā kí ŋá min Unimbɔti lèe kí wàatī ní kí nín ká tin u pōoǹee.

english_verse: The people God accepts will live because of their faith. But he isn't pleased with anyone who turns back.”
translation_verse: Un bí deedee m-nimbiinee fookiiu pu ní u làá ŋmátí, ama u yaa gítì u-boonee, ubɔti kaa dāa gíti fáatiǹ-mi.»

english_verse: We are not like those people who turn back and get destroyed. We will keep on having faith until we are saved.
translation_verse: Timbee, taa sá bin gítí bi-boon ki wáŋkée, ama ti sá bin fōō ki kíí ki cáá dimaŋfalee ní.

english_verse: Faith makes us sure of what we hope for and gives us proof of what we cannot see.
translation_verse: Á nīn cáá fookiiyee taapu sá yii: á nīn cɔ́tí tiwan tin pu a mákée, ama aa wāĺ-tì ní ki nyí yii tì bí.

english_verse: It was their faith that made our ancestors pleasing to God.
translation_verse: Fookii un Unimbɔti nib dooooyee yab nìn cááyee pu ní bi ká disíndi Unimbɔti cee.

english_verse: Because of our faith, we know that the world was made at God's command. We also know that what can be seen was made out of what cannot be seen.
translation_verse: Fookii un ti cáá Unimbɔti puee di yì-tì ní ti nyí yii an sá nì u-nyɔɔbundi ní u dū ki náań duulinya, di sá duulinya wanti tin kɔkɔ ti wāĺ nee nyánní dinyɔɔbundi din taa wāĺee poon ní.

english_verse: Because Abel had faith, he offered God a better sacrifice than Cain did. God was pleased with him and his gift, and even though Abel is now dead, his faith still speaks for him.
translation_verse: An sá fookii un Abeel nìn cáá Unimbɔti puee di yì-tì saraa un u nìn ŋá ki tīī-uee nìn ŋān̄ ki jítiǹ Kayeen yɔu. U-fookiiu gbanti pu ní u kpántì deedeedaan Unimbɔti cee, kun puee Unimbɔti nìn fōō u-saraau. U-fookiiu puee, nì min kɔkɔ u kpíìyee, u-bɔti bí bi sòoǹ díǹ.

english_verse: Enoch had faith and did not die. He pleased God, and God took him up to heaven. This is why his body was never found.
translation_verse: Eenɔki fookiiu un u nìn cáá Unimbɔti puee di yì-tì ní waa kpíì. Unimbɔti nìn yōoǹ-u ki cáá-u ki jɔ́miǹ u-cee ubɔ kaa ti ká-u. Unimbɔti gbɔŋku poon lī yii Eenɔki nìn pée fáatì Unimbɔti dooooyee ní ki wāatì u dāa nín yōoǹ-u.

english_verse: But without faith no one can please God. We must believe that God is real and rewards everyone who searches for him.
translation_verse: Unil yaa kaa fōō Unimbɔti ki kííyee, udaan kpá kí fáatí-u. Di sá yii un là kí sútiń kí pìl̄ Unimbɔtee máaǹ kí nīn nyí yii Unimbɔti bí, ki tìì bin nyàab̀-u nì dipɔbil dibee tipaal.

english_verse: Because Noah had faith, he was warned about something that had not yet happened. He obeyed and built a boat that saved him and his family. In this way the people of the world were judged, and Noah was given the blessings that come to everyone who pleases God.
translation_verse: Fookii un Noowa nìn cáá Unimbɔti puee di yì-tì ní Unimbɔti nín nìn kpáafì-u yii nnyiŋgbeen dòońee, u nìn fōō ki kíí kaa láá ká-mì, ní ki nìn kíĺ ki bíi kpáà meela un poon u nì u-dicaŋku làá kɔ́ kí ŋmátée. U-fookiiu un u nìn cáá Unimbɔti puee di dàkā duulinya yab bɔkpil ní úǹ kpántì deedeedaan Unimbɔti nimbiin.

english_verse: Abraham had faith and obeyed God. He was told to go to the land that God had said would be his, and he left for a country he had never seen.
translation_verse: Fookii un Abraam nìn cáá Unimbɔti puee di yì-tì ní ŋyunti ŋun Unimbɔti nìn yíiń-u ki bí ú yīkì u-tiŋkin kí nīn cá kitiŋ kin u làá pòon̄ kí tīī-uee nee, u lafun nìn yíkì míǹ kaa nyí laakin pú ní u nìn túĺ ki cée.

english_verse: Because Abraham had faith, he lived as a stranger in the promised land. He lived there in a tent, and so did Isaac and Jacob, who were later given the same promise.
translation_verse: Nì fookii un u nìn cáá Unimbɔti puee ní u bàn̄ kitimpooŋkaayin ki gāā tanti ki kóò kii unicaanee. Míǹ ní Isaaki nì Jaakɔb bin mun nìn yíkì ki tɔ́kɔǹ dipoondi gbanti puee nìn gāā tantib ki kóò.

english_verse: Abraham did this, because he was waiting for the eternal city God had planned and built.
translation_verse: Di sá Abraam nìn kā ki cí kitiŋkpaaŋŋi kin diiŋŋi Unimbɔti u-ba kítì ki máń, ŋi yú ki pɔ̄ɔ̄yee ní.

english_verse: Even when Sarah was too old to have children, she had faith that God would do what he had promised, and she had a son.
translation_verse: Fookii un Saara nìn cáá Unimbɔti puee di yì-tì ní nì min kɔkɔ u nìn púĺ ki jítì mmaal puee, u ŋúń ki màl̄ ki kpántì ditimbundi na, kun puee u nìn fōō ki kíí yii Unimbɔti nín pōoǹ miŋyee, u làá ŋá míǹ.

english_verse: Her husband Abraham was almost dead, but he became the ancestor of many people. In fact, there are as many of them as there are stars in the sky or grains of sand along the seashore.
translation_verse: Míǹ ní Abraam unibaanti un púĺ ki jítì mmaal puee màl̄, u-naantiibi būtì ki wīikí kii iŋmalbijaayee, baa ŋūǹ kí kàaǹ-bi, a lì kii bi nín kaa ŋūǹ kí kàaǹ dibul din dɔ̄ tiŋku gbandee puee.

english_verse: Every one of those people died. But they still had faith, even though they had not received what they had been promised. They were glad just to see these things from far away, and they agreed that they were only strangers and foreigners on this earth.
translation_verse: Nì fookii poon ní an nibee kɔkɔ dūu kpíì kaa kpáàa fōō tin Unimbɔti nìn pōoǹee. Bi nìn ká tì nín páaǹní ndan ki dòońee, ní bi jáam̀-tì, ní ki bí yii bíǹ sá binicambi ní ki kóò duulinyan.

english_verse: When people talk this way, it is clear they are looking for a place to call their own.
translation_verse: Bi nín sòoǹ miŋyee dàkà ki cántí-ti yii bi bíi nyàab̀ kitiŋ ní kí nīn kóò.

english_verse: If they had been talking about the land where they had once lived, they could have gone back at any time.
translation_verse: An yaa nìn sá kitiŋ kin poon bi nìn yíkèe pu ní bi yaa nìn bíi yáliŋkée, bi bàà nìn ŋūǹ kí fàtīí nīn gítí niinaa!

english_verse: But they were looking forward to a better home in heaven. This is why God wasn't ashamed for them to call him their God. He even built a city for them.
translation_verse: Ama ibaamɔnee, bi nìn baasii nyàab̀ kitimmɔntii ní, an dàkà yii yilpu tiŋki. An pu ní bi nín yíì Unimbɔti yii bi-Nimbɔtiuee, an kaa cáá-u icoo, kun puee u bɔ́ntì-bi kitiŋ ki yóoǹ yilpu.

english_verse: Abraham had been promised that Isaac, his only son, would continue his family. But when Abraham was tested, he had faith and was willing to sacrifice Isaac,
translation_verse: Unimbɔti nìn pōoǹ-u yii: «Isaaki di làá bùtī a-maaliŋu ŋun làá dāá fōō a-yindee.»

english_verse: Later, when Jacob was about to die, he leaned on his walking stick and worshiped. Then because of his faith he blessed each of Joseph's sons.
translation_verse: Fookii un Jaakɔb nìn cáá Unimbɔti puee di yì-tì u nín púĺ ki cīkiǹ ŋkúmee, u nìn mēē Unimbɔti ki bīiǹ Jooseefi biyaamu liitil pu ki nyīī u-kpandɔŋu pu ki nyɔ́ŋkí Unimbɔti.

english_verse: And right before Joseph died, he had faith that God would lead the people of Israel out of Egypt. So he told them to take his bones with them.
translation_verse: Jooseefi nìn fōō Unimbɔti ki kíí. An di yì-tì ní ŋyunti ŋun u tóob́ ŋkúmee, u nìn sòon̄ Unimbɔti nín làá dāá nyāntí Isirayeel yab Eejipiti tiŋkinee. An puee ní u nìn tīī-bi mara ki dàkā-bi bi nín làá dāá ŋá u-kpabiŋ puee.

english_verse: Because Moses' parents had faith, they kept him hidden until he was three months old. They saw that he was a beautiful child, and they were not afraid to disobey the king's orders.
translation_verse: Fookii un Mooyiisi baa nì u-na nìn cáá Unimbɔti puee di yì-tì ní bi nín màl̄ Mooyiisee, bi dū-u ki bál̀ áli iŋmal ita. Bi nín ká kibiki nín ŋān̄ miŋyee, baa ti fāŋkì ubɔti marau un u yóoǹ yii bí kpɔ̀ mbiyaamuee.

english_verse: Then after Moses grew up, his faith made him refuse to be called the king's grandson.
translation_verse: Fookii un Mooyiisi nìn cáá Unimbɔti puee di yì-tì ní u nín wíiǹee, u nìn yíì yii waa là kí nīn sá ubɔti Faaroo bisal jipɔɔn,

english_verse: He chose to be mistreated with God's people instead of having the good time that sin could bring for a little while.
translation_verse: ki là kí nīn bí Unimbɔti nikitilin bí kpāfì bi-kɔkɔ kí sàaǹ. Míǹ nìn mɔ̄ǹ-u ki jítiǹ ú nīn bí ikpitin ki jīǹ mmɔn ŋun kaa làá yúntée.

english_verse: Moses knew that the treasures of Egypt were not as wonderful as what he would receive from suffering for the Messiah, and he looked forward to his reward.
translation_verse: U nìn ká yii, ú jī falaa kii Meesiya nín làá dāá jī uŋyee ŋān̄ ki jítiǹ Eejipiti gaajawanti kɔkɔ, kun puee u nìn wāĺ tipaal tin bí nyɔkɔpuee ní.

english_verse: Because of his faith, Moses left Egypt. Moses had seen the invisible God and wasn't afraid of the king's anger.
translation_verse: Fookii un Mooyiisi nìn cáá Unimbɔti puee di yì-tì ní u nìn yíkì Eejipiti tiŋkin, kaa fāŋkì diŋuul din ubɔti fōōyee pu, ní ki ŋúb́ Unimbɔti un baa wāĺee bɔti an píkí gbīŋgbim kii u wāĺ-uee.

english_verse: His faith also made him celebrate Passover. He sprinkled the blood of animals on the doorposts, so that the first-born sons of the people of Israel would not be killed by the destroying angel.
translation_verse: Fookii un u nìn cáá Unimbɔti puee di yì-tì u nìn fōō Unimbɔti nyɔkɔ ki jíń Dilákatil jiŋaaliu, ki nìn yāntì bi dū ipiiyee fatikuu ki ŋmītì mpunyɔmu pu, án nín làá ŋá pu ntuun ŋun làá kpɔ̀ Eejipiti yab jipɔŋkpilibee ń taa gbēē Isirayeel yab báà ubɔee.

english_verse: Because of their faith, the people walked through the Red Sea on dry land. But when the Egyptians tried to do it, they were drowned.
translation_verse: Fookii un Isirayeel yab nìn cáá Unimbɔti puee di yì-tì ní bi nìn dūtì Tikati mɔɔl kii kitiŋkuliŋŋee, ama Eejipiti yab mun nìn mākaǹ kí dùtī ní dimɔɔl dū-bi ki náĺ.

english_verse: God's people had faith, and when they had walked around the city of Jericho for seven days, its walls fell down.
translation_verse: Fookii un Isirayeel yab nìn cáá Unimbɔti puee di yì-tì bi nìn cūtì ki cōom̀ ki māntì Jeeriikoo tiŋki. Iwiin iluli dalee, agun nìn cúu kpīkitì ki lítì.

english_verse: Rahab had been a prostitute, but she had faith and welcomed the spies. So she wasn't killed with the people who disobeyed.
translation_verse: Fookii un Raab kinimpulaakpaayee nìn cáá Unimbɔti puee di yì-tì ní baa nìn kūū-u ki kpáaǹ binikpitib, kun puee u nìn ŋá tiniti ki fōō binib bin bi nìn tú bí cù kí cɔ̄ŋkì kitiŋee.

english_verse: What else can I say? There isn't enough time to tell about Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah, David, Samuel, and the prophets.
translation_verse: M làá gíti lì yii ba? Mpaan kaa bí-mi ḿ sòoǹ Geedeeyɔn nì Baraaki nì Samsɔn nì Jeefita nì Daafiidi nì Samiyeel nì Unimbɔti bɔnaatiliibi pu.

english_verse: and put out raging fires and escaped from the swords of their enemies. Although they were weak, they were given the strength and power to chase foreign armies away.
translation_verse: Ŋŋmi gà lìblib bi téé biba ki tɔ́ poon, an kaa ŋá-bi tiba bi-fookiiu pu. An bàà nìn sá bí kpɔ̀ biba nì ntàataajimu, ama fookii un bi nìn cáá Unimbɔti puee puee, bi nìn ŋmátì. Biba nìn būǹ ki pɔ́ɔkì. Biba nìn sá ŋwɔsɔfimu, bi-fookiiu puee, bi kpántì bibaatandambi. Biba fookiiu puee, bi nìn cúú bi-nannanliibi.

english_verse: Some women received their loved ones back from death. Many of these people were tortured, but they refused to be released. They were sure they would get a better reward when the dead are raised to life.
translation_verse: Binimpoobi fookiiu un bi nìn cáá Unimbɔti puee di yì-tì bi fīkitì bi-yab bin kpíìyee ki tīī-bi. Biba fookiiu puee, bi nìn sāaǹ-bi kí kpɔ̀-bi, ama bi nìn yíì yii bí taa fīī-bi, kun puee bi nyí yii bi làá dāá fìkitī kí nīn kíǹ ki bí dimaŋfal din kaa cáá dikúntilee ni.

english_verse: Others were made fun of and beaten with whips, and some were chained in jail.
translation_verse: Bi nìn bēel̀ biba ki gbáń-bi anaalab, ki nìn gúĺ biba nì ikusaka ki cáa tɔ́ sarka.

english_verse: The world did not deserve these good people, who had to wander in deserts and on mountains and had to live in caves and holes in the ground.
translation_verse: Binib gbanti circiriu puee, baa bàà nìn máaǹ kí kàl̄ duulinyan doo. Bi nìn yíkí ní ki cá kuteeun nì ajoon pu, ki kóò itaŋkpalɔkɔn nì afaginni.

english_verse: All of them pleased God because of their faith! But still they died without being given what had been promised.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti u-ba ká yii an nibee kɔkɔ nìn lafun fōō-u ki kíí, ama nì míǹ kɔkɔee, baa nìn fōō tin Unimbɔti nìn pōoǹee.

english_verse: This was because God had something better in store for us. And he did not want them to reach the goal of their faith without us.
translation_verse: Kun puee Unimbɔti bɔ́ntì tin sá timɔntiilee ki yóoǹ, kaa dá láá dūu tīī-bi ki cíitì ti-kɔkɔ yaa kpáfèe, ú dūú yàkatī-ti.

english_verse: Such a large crowd of witnesses is all around us! So we must get rid of everything that slows us down, especially the sin that just won't let go. And we must be determined to run the race that is ahead of us.
translation_verse: Kii kunipaau kun nìn cáá fookii Unimbɔti puee nín māntì ki tú-ti pu, ki kpèé-ti puee, ní yàntī tí fámaan atuŋkpiti ŋin cāabìń-ti digìńdee nì ikpiti in kaa pɔ̄ɔ̄-ti dicuulee, kí sāǹ nì dipɔ́ɔǹdi ditaatandi din Unimbɔti náká ki yóoǹ-ti tí sāǹee.

english_verse: We must keep our eyes on Jesus, who leads us and makes our faith complete. He endured the shame of being nailed to a cross, because he knew later on he would be glad he did. Now he is seated at the right side of God's throne!
translation_verse: Ti-nimbikpeeŋu ń nīn pée cɔ́ Yeesu pu. Úǹ di nāantí fookii ti-ni kí tin cáá kátí-ku. U kíí ki kpíì ndɔpuntikaa kúm min sá icoo nì kpeefamee, kun puee u nìn nyí dipɔɔpindi din dɔ̄ ki cí-uee. Kɔŋkɔnnee u cūtìi kāl̀ Unimbɔti ŋaŋgiiliŋu pú dibeelin.

english_verse: So keep your mind on Jesus, who put up with many insults from sinners. Then you won't get discouraged and give up.
translation_verse: Ní dàkafì u nín kaa mɔ́tì u-ba pu ki gīī digìńdi din binikpitib ŋaanee, an di ŋūǹ kí yàntī ní taa pɔ̄ nsan diwuŋyɔtil ń kɔ́-ni.

english_verse: None of you have yet been hurt in your battle against sin.
translation_verse: Doooo nee, naa láá jáń nì ikpiti áli fatiku nyáń.

english_verse: But you have forgotten that the Scriptures say to God's children, “When the Lord punishes you, don't make light of it, and when he corrects you, don't be discouraged.
translation_verse: Ni súntì isaŋki in Unimbɔti nìn sáŋkì-ni kii ubaati nín sáŋkí u-jipɔmbi pueeee? U nìn bí-ni yii: «M-jipɔɔn, ti-Dindaan yaa bíi dàkà-see, á taa dūú kpèè fám. U yaa dáaĺ a-tafalee, á taa yɔ̀tī a-wunti.

english_verse: The Lord corrects the people he loves and disciplines those he calls his own.”
translation_verse: Kun puee un ti-Dindaan néeńee ní u dàkà, ní ki dátí bin kɔkɔ u fōō ki ŋá u-jipɔmbee tafal.»

english_verse: Be patient when you are being corrected! This is how God treats his children. Don't all parents correct their children?
translation_verse: An puee, Unimbɔti yaa bíi sáŋkí-nee, ní pɔ́ɔǹ ni-ba. Ni nín sá u-biyaamuee pu ní u ŋáań-ni míǹ, kun puee kibiki kpá ki-baa kaa sáŋkí-kì.

english_verse: God corrects all his children, and if he doesn't correct you, then you don't really belong to him.
translation_verse: Ubaati yaa bíi dàkà u-biyaamu ní kaa bíi dàkà nimbee, mimmee waa yì nimbi dee, naa sá u-bimaalkaamu.

english_verse: Our earthly fathers correct us, and we still respect them. Isn't it even better to be given true life by letting our spiritual Father correct us?
translation_verse: Tí kpèè ti-baabi bin màl̄-tee nín dàkà-ti ti tɔ́-bi miŋyee, kin ataa aŋa pu ní taa máaǹ kí nīn tɔ́ Ubaati un yì ŋfamee kí ká dimaŋfal!

english_verse: Our human fathers correct us for a short time, and they do it as they think best. But God corrects us for our own good, because he wants us to be holy, as he is.
translation_verse: Ti-baabee, bíǹ dàkà-ti ŋyunti ŋubɔ ní kí tin sāā min bi lèe ní kí gbèen̄, ama Unimbɔti úǹ nín dàkà-tee, an sá ti-ŋanti ní, kun puee u là tí nīn bí circir kii úŋ̀wuee ní.

english_verse: It is never fun to be corrected. In fact, at the time it is always painful. But if we learn to obey by being corrected, we will do right and live at peace.
translation_verse: Ibaamɔn didàkal kaa mɔ̄, ŋyunti ŋun a bí di-poonee. An wù ní, ama boonee, bin bi dàkēe kpántí binimɔntiibi ní kí páatí dipɔɔsɔŋkil nì deedeebítam. Ní ká kunyannyaau

english_verse: Now stand up straight! Stop your knees from shaking
translation_verse: An puee, nimbi bin ŋalii nì ni-taaŋi yɔ̄tèe, pɔ́ɔm̀maan ni-ba kí ká kunyannyaau,

english_verse: and walk a straight path. Then lame people will be healed, instead of getting worse. Warning against Turning from God
translation_verse: kí nìkī ni-taatandi kí dī nsan ŋun tèen̄ee pu án nín làá ŋá pu ditaal din wùee ń taa gíí ama dí pɔ̄ɔkèe.

english_verse: Try to live at peace with everyone! Live a clean life. If you don't, you will never see the Lord.
translation_verse: Ní pɔ́ɔǹ ni-ba ŋgbansɔŋfi ń nīn bí ni nì báà ŋma kansikin, kí nīn bímaan circir. Kun puee un yaa kaa bí circiree kpá kí ká ti-Dindaan.

english_verse: Make sure no one misses out on God's wonderful kindness. Don't let anyone become bitter and cause trouble for the rest of you.
translation_verse: Ní nīn nyíǹ ni-ba ubɔ ń taa fá diyimɔɔl din Unimbɔti tīī-tee, kí nīn nyíǹ ni-ba ubɔ ń taa kpántí kii kisubiki kin cáá tiloolee kí dū u-lootee kí bīil̀ kunipaau.

english_verse: Watch out for immoral and ungodly people like Esau, who sold his future blessing for only one meal.
translation_verse: Ní nīn nyíǹ ni-ba ubɔ ń taa ŋá tilaakpaal, kí taa kpèè Unimbɔti fám, kii Eesayuu nín nìn ŋá pu, tijin puee u dū u-kpiti ki nyáfèe.

english_verse: You know how he later wanted it back. But there was nothing he could do to change things, even though he begged his father and cried.
translation_verse: Kéè, ni nyí yii boonee, u nín dāa nyàab̄ kí fōō difakal din ujipɔŋkpil fòol̄ee, waa ti káa! Nì min kɔkɔ u dū nnyinnyim ki nyàab̄ u nín làá dī pu kí kpántí min u nìn lēe, waa ká.

english_verse: You have not come to a place like Mount Sinai that can be seen and touched. There is no flaming fire or dark cloud or storm
translation_verse: An kaa sá dijool kii Siinaayi joolee ní ni sútìń ki pìl̄: laakin ŋŋmi wù, dibɔmbɔndi dɔ́miń, kubuŋkpaaŋŋu jítì,

english_verse: or trumpet sound. The people of Israel heard a voice speak. But they begged it to stop,
translation_verse: ní dikantándi búń ki pɔ̄ɔ̄ kpaŋkpam, ní nneen ŋubɔ sòon̄ee. Isirayeel yab nín gbìl̄ nneenee puee ní bi gbāam̀ yii ŋú taa ti sòoǹ.

english_verse: because they could not obey its commands. They were even told to kill any animal that touched the mountain.
translation_verse: Di sá yii bi nìn fāŋkì Unimbɔti nín sòon̄ yii: «Un yaa gbēē dijool neeyee, báà an yaa sá kuwaŋkuluuaaa, bí yāŋkì-ku ataŋkpee kí kpɔ̀ee.»

english_verse: The sight was so frightening that Moses said he shook with fear.
translation_verse: An nìn cáá dipɔɔbiildi kaa bí ŋkpèé, áli Mooyiisi u-ba bí yii: «M fāŋkì yɔ́kɔ́ yɔkɔ.»

english_verse: You have now come to Mount Zion and to the heavenly Jerusalem. This is the city of the living God, where thousands and thousands of angels have come to celebrate.
translation_verse: Ama nimbi dɔ́miń Siiyɔn jool taapu nì Unimbɔti un bí dimaŋfalinee dumpu Jeerusaleem un bí yilpuee, laakin ituun cutimaanyi kpátì ki bí mmɔnnee ní.

english_verse: Here you will find all of God's dearest children, whose names are written in heaven. And you will find God himself, who judges everyone. Here also are the spirits of those good people who have been made perfect.
translation_verse: Nimbi dɔ́miń laakin bin sá Unimbɔti biyaamu mun u péé péé ki màl̄ bi-yiŋŋi ŋmàn̄ yilpuee kpáfée ní. Ni dɔ́miń Unimbɔti u-ba cee ní, úǹ di sòoǹ binib kɔkɔ bɔti nì binib bin bí deedee Unimbɔti yāntì bi-nammu kpántì mmɔntiimu baa kāntí mu-pu tikpitil tibee.

english_verse: And Jesus is here! He is the one who makes God's new agreement with us, and his sprinkled blood says much better things than the blood of Abel.
translation_verse: Nimbi dɔ́miń Yeesu un cáań-ti dipoompɔndi ki dū u-ba ki tīī u-fatikuu fíntì-tee cee ní, u-fatikuuee sòoǹ tiŋan ki jítiǹ Abeel yɔu.

english_verse: Make sure you obey the one who speaks to you. The people did not escape, when they refused to obey the one who spoke to them at Mount Sinai. Do you think you can possibly escape, if you refuse to obey the one who speaks to you from heaven?
translation_verse: An puee ní nīn nyíǹ ni-ba kí taa yíí un bí ki sòoǹ nì ni nee nyɔkɔ. Bin nìn yíì kaa fōō un nìn bí bi-cee taapu doo ki sòoǹ nì bee nyɔkɔee, bi nìn dáaĺ bi-tafal ní, kin ataa aŋa ní ti yaa yíì kaa fōō un nyánní yilpu ki sòon̄ nì tee nyɔkɔee, taa kāntí ditafadaaldi!

english_verse: When God spoke the first time, his voice shook only the earth. This time he has promised to shake the earth once again, and heaven too.
translation_verse: U nín nìn sòon̄ dijool puee, kitiŋ nìn cīŋkì ní, ama kɔŋkɔnnee u pōoǹ yii u làá dāá gíti cìŋkì kitiŋ. Niinee an kaa dāa sá kitiŋ ŋmaniŋma, u làá dāá cìŋkì kí kpáaǹ yilpu mun.

english_verse: The words “once again” mean that these created things will someday be shaken and removed. Then what cannot be shaken will last.
translation_verse: Anyɔɔbun ŋin sá yii «u làá gíti cìŋkèe» dàkà yii tin kɔkɔ u náańee, ní tin kaa bá ki pɔ̄ɔ̄yee ń lítí kí wāŋkì kí kíń tin bá ki pɔ̄ɔ̄yee.

english_verse: We should be grateful we were given a kingdom that cannot be shaken. And in this kingdom we please God by worshiping him and by showing him great honor and respect.
translation_verse: Kii Unimbɔti nín kāaǹ-ti Dibeel din bá ki pɔ̄ɔ̄yee poon puee, tí jāam̀-u u-ŋanti gbanti pu kí nīn ŋáań min fáatì-uee kí nīn tɔ́-u nì tifaandi poon kí dàkà-u yii ti nyí tiŋan tin u ŋá ki tīī-tee.

english_verse: Our God is like a destructive fire!
translation_verse: Di sá yii ti-Nimbɔtiu sá ŋŋmi ŋun wù ki céetée ní.

english_verse: Keep being concerned about each other as the Lord's followers should.
translation_verse: Ní nīn néeḿmaan tɔb kii nnabiyaamu nín néeń tɔb puee án taa gbèen̄.

english_verse: Be sure to welcome strangers into your home. By doing this, some people have welcomed angels as guests, without even knowing it.
translation_verse: Ní téetí yii ni máaǹ kí nīn fòol̄ binicambi, kun puee biba nìn fōol̀ binicambi míǹ ní ki dāa kpáàa fōō Unimbɔti tuuŋyi kaa béè.

english_verse: Remember the Lord's people who are in jail and be concerned for them. Don't forget those who are suffering, but imagine you are there with them.
translation_verse: Ní nīn téetímaan bisarkadambi pu kí jī bi-falaau kii ni nì bi kɔkɔ di kpáfì ki bí sarkanee, kí nīn téetí bin bi sàantée pu kii ni nì bi kɔkɔ ní bi kpáfì ki sàantée.

english_verse: Have respect for marriage. Always be faithful to your partner, because God will punish anyone who is immoral or unfaithful in marriage.
translation_verse: Ní tīīmaan dinimpucaal àá dicamɔndi tinyool, ní unimpu nì u-cal ń yūlíǹ tɔb deedee, di sá yii Unimbɔti làá dāá dáaĺ bilaakpaadambi nì bijɔkɔndambi tafal.

english_verse: Don't fall in love with money. Be satisfied with what you have. The Lord has promised that he will not leave us or desert us.
translation_verse: Ní taa yàntī nnimbineel ń jī ni-pɔbiliŋ poon mpaan, ama ní yàntī án nīn mɔ̄ǹ-ni fiii un ni cááyee pu, kun puee Unimbɔti lī yii: «M kpá kí yàntī-si fám, maa làá dū-si kí fá míǹ jaanjaan.»

english_verse: This should make you feel like saying, “The Lord helps me! Why should I be afraid of what people can do to me?”
translation_verse: An pu ní ti cáá dimákal kí lì kí tɔ́kɔń dinyɔɔbundi nee pu yii: «Unimbɔti di jòoń-mi, an puee maa fàŋkí tiba, Ba ní unil làá ŋmā kí ŋá-mi?»

english_verse: Don't forget about your leaders who taught you God's message. Remember what kind of lives they lived and try to have faith like theirs.
translation_verse: Téetímaan ni-kpilib bin nìn dàkā-ni Unimbɔti bɔtee pu, kí dàkafì kí kpèè min ní bi nìn nóó Unimbɔti ki dāa kpíìyee, ki mun ń bīfì bi-fookiiu un bi cáá Unimbɔti puee.

english_verse: Don't be fooled by any kind of strange teachings. It is better to receive strength from God's gift of undeserved grace than to depend on certain foods. After all, these foods don't really help the people who eat them.
translation_verse: Binib nyántì tibɔpɔn tin nyáń ti-bee ki dàkà, ní taa yàntī bí dū an bɔtee kí dàkà-ni ní gáatí. An ŋān̄ yii diyimɔɔl din Unimbɔti pú-tee pu ní tí nīn kāntí mpɔn, án taa nín̄ sá marab bin binib ŋúb̀ ki kòó tijin tibee pu. Bin ŋúb̀ an marab gbantee kaa ká ipaati iba poon.

english_verse: But we have an altar where even the priests who serve in the place of worship have no right to eat.
translation_verse: Timbi saraafaŋŋu ŋun ti cááyee, Juuda yab saraaŋaliibi kaa ŋūǹ kí jī nsaraafan gbanti pu jinti.

english_verse: After the high priest offers the blood of animals as a sin offering, the bodies of those animals are burned outside the camp.
translation_verse: Di sá Juuda yab saraaŋakpiliu nìn kù tiwaŋkuti ní kí lēē fatiku kí kɔ́ǹ circir páaa laŋki kí ŋá saraa binib kpitii pu, ní kí yòon̄ tiwaŋkutee kí nyāntí kitiŋ kpaanceetiŋu kí dūú wà ŋŋmi.

english_verse: Jesus himself suffered outside the city gate, so his blood would make people holy.
translation_verse: Míǹ mbaantiim ní bi ŋá Yeesu, bi nyántì-u kitiŋ kpaanceetiŋu ní ki kūū-u. An ŋá míǹ u-fatikuu ń fíntí binib kpitii.

english_verse: This is why we should go outside the camp to Jesus and share in his disgrace.
translation_verse: An puee ti mun ń nyā kitiŋ kpaanceetiŋu kí cù u-cee bí bèel̀-ti kii bi nín bēel̀-u puee.

english_verse: On this earth we don't have a city that lasts forever, but we are waiting for such a city.
translation_verse: Kun puee duulinya kaa sá-ti kitiŋ kin làá nīn bí ki cá jaanjaanee, an pu ní ti bí ki nyàab̀ yilpu tiŋki kin làá nīn bí jaanjaanee.

english_verse: Our sacrifice is to keep offering praise to God in the name of Jesus.
translation_verse: Yeesu puee ti-nyɔŋkii ń nīn sá saraa ti tìì Unimbɔti múlmul, an dàkà yii tí nīn pàkà u-yindi kí taa gbèen̄.

english_verse: But don't forget to help others and to share your possessions with them. This too is like offering a sacrifice that pleases God.
translation_verse: Ní taa súntí tiŋan diŋál pu, kí nīn tútúǹ tɔb, míǹ di sá saraabi bin ŋān̄ Unimbɔti ceeyee.

english_verse: Obey your leaders and do what they say. They are watching over you, and they must answer to God. So don't make them sad as they do their work. Make them happy. Otherwise, they won't be able to help you at all.
translation_verse: Ní nīn tɔ́ bin kpòotī-nee kí sìntī ni-ba taapu kí tīī-bi. Bíǹ di mɔ́tí ni-nammu pu, kun puee bi dāa cáá kí sòoǹ bi-nyɔkɔpu yai Unimbɔti nimbiin. An puee, ni yaa tɔ́-bee, bi mun tūǹ bi-tundi nín sá puee nì dipɔɔpindi ní, ama bi yaa tūǹ ni-pu ditundi bi-pɔbiliŋ kaa sɔ̀m̀ee, nimbi ní an gīintí boon.

english_verse: I especially want you to pray that I can visit you again soon. Final Prayers and Greetings
translation_verse: M là ní baasii mèè m-pu, Unimbɔti ń pɔ̄-mi nsan ḿ ŋmā kí gítiń ni-cee malaa. Ŋwimmeem

english_verse: God gives peace, and he raised our Lord Jesus Christ from death. Now Jesus is like a Great Shepherd whose blood was used to make God's eternal agreement with his flock.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti di tìì-ti ŋgbansɔŋfi. U fīkitì ti-Dindaan Yeesu un di sá upikpaakpilee ditaŋkpiilin. U-saraau fatikuu di náań dipoompɔndi din kaa kúntée ki tīī-ti.

english_verse: I pray God will make you ready to obey him and that you will always be eager to do right. May Jesus help you do what pleases God. To Jesus Christ be glory forever and ever! Amen.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti gbanti ń tīī-ni ŋŋmam ní nīn pée ŋáań tin ŋān̄ee nì tin u lèe. Yeesu Kriisitoo puee, ú dī ti-pu kí ŋá min fáatiǹ-uee. Úǹ Yeesu Kriisitoo ní bí nīn pée tìì tinyool kí nīn cáa cá jaanjaan! Ameeni. Tibɔjoolkaal nì ijaam

english_verse: My friends, I have written only a short letter to encourage you, and I beg you to pay close attention to what I have said.
translation_verse: Nnabiyaamu, tibɔti tin m ŋmàn̄-ni nee kaa fɔ̀kɔ̀, m mèé-ni ní jī kimɔtii kí pīlifì m-saŋkii gbanti.

english_verse: By now you surely must know that our friend Timothy is out of jail. If he gets here in time, I will bring him with me when I come to visit you.
translation_verse: M là ní kpáàa béé yii bi líì ti-nabiki Tiimootee sarkan. U yaa bāań ti-cee malaayee, man nì u di làá táá kí dāá màntì ni-pu.

english_verse: Please give my greetings to your leaders and to the rest of the Lord's people. His followers from Italy send you their greetings.
translation_verse: Ní jāam̀ ni-kpootiliibi bin kpòotī-ni nnimbɔtisan poonee nì bin kɔkɔ nóó Unimbɔtee. Ti-nabiyaamu mun bí Italii tiŋkinee jáaḿ-ni.

english_verse: I pray that God will be kind to all of you!
translation_verse: Unimbɔti ŋanti ń nīn bí ni-kɔkɔ pu!

english_verse: From James, a servant of God and of our Lord Jesus Christ. Greetings to the twelve tribes scattered all over the world. Faith and Wisdom
translation_verse: Man Yakubu un sá Unimbɔti nì ti-Dindaan Yeesu Kriisitoo tɔntɔnliuee di ŋmàn̄ kugbɔŋu nee. M jáaḿ nimbi tinaakɔti saalaa nì tili tin yàl̄ ki kɔ́ duulinya jaŋŋi kɔkɔnee. Fookii nì iciin bɔti

english_verse: My friends, be glad, even if you have a lot of trouble.
translation_verse: M-nabiyaamu, dinimbinaamandi nín bí puee nì di-nyɔkɔm yaa bāań ni-puee, ní yàntī án nīn mɔ̄ǹ-ni tikpil.

english_verse: But you must learn to endure everything, so you will be completely mature and not lacking in anything.
translation_verse: Ama ní nīn cáá kimɔtii míǹ kí tin kátí-ku, án nín làá ŋá pu ní kpántí biniŋmambi bimɔntiibi ni-bimbim poon, tiba nì tiba ń taa lóó-nee.

english_verse: If any of you need wisdom, you should ask God, and it will be given to you. God is generous and won't correct you for asking.
translation_verse: Míǹ puee, ni-kansikin ubɔ yaa lóò iciinee, udaan ń mèè Unimbɔti un mɔ̄ ki pūǹ báà ŋma nì dipɔbil diba, kaa wòoǹee, u làá tīī-u.

english_verse: But when you ask for something, you must have faith and not doubt. Anyone who doubts is like an ocean wave tossed around in a storm.
translation_verse: Tin bée di sá yii udaan ń nīn máká yii u làá fōō kun u bíi mèéyee kí taa gùgufì, kun puee un mèé ki gùgufēe náań nì kii dimɔɔl nyim min kubuŋu téekí ki cáǹ ajan kɔkɔ púee ní.

english_verse: Any of God's people who are poor should be glad he thinks so highly of them.
translation_verse: Án nīn mɔ̄ǹ kinabiki kin di sá usoodaanee, kun puee Unimbɔti yōoǹ-u yilpu.

english_verse: But any who are rich should be glad when God makes them humble. Rich people will disappear like wild flowers
translation_verse: Míǹ ní án nīn mɔ̄ǹ kinabiki kin di sá ugaajee, kun puee Unimbɔti sīntiǹ-u taapu: di sá yii u làá dāá gbátí kí lítí kii mpumpukumee ní.

english_verse: scorched by the burning heat of the sun. The flowers lose their blossoms, and their beauty is destroyed. This is how the rich will disappear, as they go about their business. Trials and Temptations
translation_verse: Ŋwìiń yaa nyáń ki píĺ sínsiŋee, ní mpumpukum ń kpā ní kí gbátí kí lítí, ní mi-nyaaŋku ń wāŋkì. Míǹ mbaantiim ní ugaaja dāa bí u-tuuŋŋi poon ní kí kpáàa wāŋkì. Dinimbinaamandi nì icɔŋki

english_verse: God will bless you, if you don't give up when your faith is being tested. He will reward you with a glorious life, just as he rewards everyone who loves him.
translation_verse: Án nīn mɔ̄ǹ sii un di yaa bí dinimbinaamandin ní ki pɔ̄ɔntí ki ŋmèéyee. Di sá yii a yaa ŋmēē míǹ ki tin kátì-kuee, Unimbɔti làá pà-si tipaal tin sá dimaŋfal din kaa kúntí u pōoǹ ki yóoǹ bin néeń-uee.

english_verse: Don't blame God when you are tempted! God cannot be tempted by evil, and he doesn't use evil to tempt others.
translation_verse: Sii un yaa bí dinimbinaamandinee ń taa lì yii: «Unimbɔti di bíi cɔ́ŋkí-mi.» Kun puee tiba kaa ŋūǹ kí yàntī Unimbɔti ń ŋá tikpitil, ní úǹ u-ba mun kaa yàntī ubɔ ń ŋá tikpitil.

english_verse: We are tempted by our own desires that drag us off and trap us.
translation_verse: Ama an sá unil nimbitaataam di kíiĺ-u ki téekí-u ki cáǹ ikpitin.

english_verse: Our desires make us sin, and when sin is finished with us, it leaves us dead.
translation_verse: Nnimbitaataam yaa kɔ́ unilee, ní mí màal̀ ikpiti, ní ikpiti yaa wíiǹee ní í cáań ŋkúm.

english_verse: Don't be fooled, my dear friends.
translation_verse: M-nabineeŋkaamu, ní taa ŋmàtim̀maan ni-ba.

english_verse: Every good and perfect gift comes down from the Father who created all the lights in the heavens. He is always the same and never makes dark shadows by changing.
translation_verse: Tiwannyaandi nì tiwammɔntiil tin kɔkɔ ti fòol̄ faalaayee nyēeń yilpu ní. Ti-Baa Unimbɔti iwalfi in bí yilpuee náanliu cee ní an nyēeń. Úǹ kaa kpántáaa, kaa fàtī ki ŋmíntí dijandi diba, din kíǹee dɔ̄ dibɔmbɔndin.

english_verse: He wanted us to be his own special people, and so he sent the true message to give us new birth. Hearing and Obeying
translation_verse: Úǹ di là ní ki dī dinyɔɔbundi din sá ibaamɔnee pu ki tīī-ti dimaŋfal, án nín làá ŋá pu timbi ń nīn līī tiwan tin kɔkɔ u náańee nyɔkɔpuee. A nín gbìl̄ tiŋyee, á ŋá míǹ

english_verse: My dear friends, you should be quick to listen and slow to speak or to get angry.
translation_verse: M-nabineeŋkaamu, ní nīn nyímaan tin bí nee: báà ŋma ń kpòon̄ u-tafal malaa kí pīlifì u-juti, kí taa nín̄ jìkì disoondi pu, kí taa nín̄ fòol̄ diŋuul malaa malaa.

english_verse: If you are angry, you cannot do any of the good things God wants done.
translation_verse: Di sá yii sii un yaa fōō diŋuulee, tin a ŋáańee kaa kítì Unimbɔti cee.

english_verse: You must stop doing anything immoral or evil. Instead be humble and accept the message planted in you to save you.
translation_verse: Míǹ puee, ní fámaan tin kɔkɔ bíiĺ unilee nì atuŋkpiti kɔkɔ, kí sìntīǹ ni-ba kí fōō dinyɔɔbundi din Unimbɔti dū ki búĺ ni-pɔbiliŋinee, kun puee díǹ di ŋūǹ kí fīī-ni.

english_verse: If you hear the message and don't obey it, you are like people who stare at themselves in a mirror
translation_verse: Sii un pílifí dinyɔɔbundee fám, ní kaa ŋáań min dì lì yii á ŋée, náań nì un kpèé digitil ki wāĺ u-nimbiinee ní.

english_verse: and forget what they look like as soon as they leave.
translation_verse: U nín kpēē ki dóò ki búntèe, ní ú kpáàa súntí u nín bàà kpēē digitil poon ki bí miŋyee kɔkɔ.

english_verse: But you must never stop looking at the perfect law that sets you free. God will bless you in everything you do, if you listen and obey, and don't just hear and forget.
translation_verse: Ama sii un di yaa kpèé bimaramɔntiibi bin tìì dibatɔlee tiŋan ní ki yaa cáá a-ba ki tìì-bi, kaa pílifí fám boonee kí súntí, ama ki ŋáań min marabee bí yii á ŋée, Unimbɔti làá bìin̄ a-boon a-tuuŋŋi poon.

english_verse: If you think you are being religious, but can't control your tongue, you are fooling yourself, and your religion is useless.
translation_verse: Sii un yaa nyí yii a sá unimbɔtinool, ní kaa ŋúb́ a-nyɔkɔee, kíiĺ a-ba ní, a-nimbɔtinoolee sá fám ní.

english_verse: Religion that pleases God the Father must be pure and spotless. You must help needy orphans and widows and not let this world make you evil.
translation_verse: Dinimbɔtinool din ŋān̄ ki bí circir ti-Baa Unimbɔti ceeyee di sá: á kpèè ataŋkpiibil nì bikpiipoobi bin bí falaa poonee, kí nīn nyí nì a-ba kí taa jēetí duulinya kpitii poon.

english_verse: My friends, if you have faith in our glorious Lord Jesus Christ, you won't treat some people better than others.
translation_verse: M-nabiyaamu, kii ni nín bí ti-Dindaan Yeesu Kriisitoo tinyooldaan saŋŋun puee, an kaa máaǹ ní nīn cáá dinigàntil.

english_verse: Suppose a rich person wearing fancy clothes and a gold ring comes to one of your meetings. And suppose a poor person dressed in worn-out clothes also comes.
translation_verse: Tí lì yii ni-kpafil poon ní ugaaja ubɔ yaa kóoń ki fúuń sindaariya bɔmbiki ki pēē dibɔkutinyaandi, ní usoodaan ubɔ mun kóoń ki pēē ikpalcati,

english_verse: You must not give the best seat to the one in fancy clothes and tell the one who is poor to stand at the side or sit on the floor.
translation_verse: ní ni yaa tīī ugaaja un pēē tiwammɔntiilee jilma ki bí-u yii: «Sii dāá kàl̄ mpaammɔnti nee pu.» Ama ní ki bí usoodaanee yii: «Sii nín̄ yú, a yaa tí làaa, dāá kàl̄ kitiŋ m-taaŋi caŋin yéè.»

english_verse: This is the same as saying that some people are better than others, and you would be acting like a crooked judge.
translation_verse: Mimmee, naa gāntì-bi deeee? Ilandɔkɔkpiti ní ni dākafì ní ki ŋá míǹ.

english_verse: My dear friends, pay attention. God has given a lot of faith to the poor people in this world. God has also promised them a share in his kingdom that he will give to everyone who loves him.
translation_verse: M-nabineeŋkaamu, ní pīlifìmaan: Unimbɔti lútì duulinya nee poon bisoodambi bí fōō Yeesu Kriisitoo kí kíí, ní kí ká tigaajamɔntiil kí kɔ́ Unimbɔti Beel din u pōoǹ ki yóoǹ bin néeń-uee ni.

english_verse: You mistreat the poor. But isn't it the rich who boss you around and drag you off to court?
translation_verse: Ama ní nimbi kpèé bisoodambi fám. An kaa sá bigaajab di sàantí-ni ki cútí-ni ki cáǹ ibɔsoonaaa?

english_verse: Aren't they the ones who make fun of your Lord?
translation_verse: Bíǹ di kaa bíiĺ Yeesu Kriisitoo yinnyaandi din u pú-neeee?

english_verse: You will do all right, if you obey the most important law in the Scriptures. It is the law that commands us to love others as much as we love ourselves.
translation_verse: Tiŋman, ni yaa nóó Unimbɔti Beel marau kii an nín ŋmàn̄ puee, yii: «Á nīn néeń a-juti kii sii a-bee,» mimmee, ni ŋáań min ŋān̄ee dee.

english_verse: But if you treat some people better than others, you have done wrong, and the Scriptures teach that you have sinned.
translation_verse: Ama ni yaa kpèé ki gàntī binibee, an sá ikpiti ní ni ŋáań, maree cúú-ni, kun puee ni yīntiǹ-u.

english_verse: If you obey every law except one, you are still guilty of breaking them all.
translation_verse: Di sá yii, a yaa ŋúb́ marab kɔkɔ ní ki yaa yīntiǹ ubambaanti bi-kansikinee, a yīntì bi-kɔkɔ dee,

english_verse: The same God who told us to be faithful in marriage also told us not to murder. So even if you are faithful in marriage, but murder someone, you still have broken God's Law.
translation_verse: kun puee Unimbɔti un lī yii: «Á taa ŋá tilaakpaalee», úǹ ubaantee di tí lī yii: «Á taa kpɔ̀ unil.» Míǹ puee, a yaa kaa ŋá tilaakpaal, ama ní ki yaa kūū unilee, a yīntì mara dee.

english_verse: Speak and act like people who will be judged by the law that sets us free.
translation_verse: Míǹ puee, ni-bɔsooŋyi nì ni-ŋáaǹtam kɔkɔnee, ní nīn ŋáań ki nyí yii ni sá binib bin Unimbɔti làá dū mara un cāabìń dibatɔlee ní kí sòoǹ ni-bɔtee.

english_verse: Do this, because on the day of judgment there will be no pity for those who have not had pity on others. But even in judgment, God is merciful! Faith and Works
translation_verse: Sii un kaa súń a-jutiibi saayee, ibɔsoon dalee, Unimbɔti kaa làá dāá sɔ̄ si mun a-saai. A nín súń binib saayee di làá yàntī Unimbɔti ń dāá sɔ̄ si mun saai. Fookii nì atuun

english_verse: My friends, what good is it to say you have faith, when you don't do anything to show you really do have faith? Can this kind of faith save you?
translation_verse: M-nabiyaamu, an kaa ŋān̄ unil ń bí yii úǹ fōō Yeesu ki kíí, ama ní kaa bíi tūǹ atummɔnti, an fookiiuee ŋūǹ kí fīī-uaaa?

english_verse: If you know someone who doesn't have any clothes or food,
translation_verse: Kii ti-nabiki kiba, uninja àá unimpu, di yaa bí, kaa cáá tiwampeeŋkaalaaa, kaa cáá tijikaal baabadal kí jī,

english_verse: you shouldn't just say, “I hope all goes well for you. I hope you will be warm and have plenty to eat.” What good is it to say this, unless you do something to help?
translation_verse: ní ni-kansikin ubɔ yaa tùkū udaan yii: «Án ŋá kí kūtì, á nīn bí tiŋan! Taa yàntī tiwool ń cúú-si, á nīn jīǹ tijin ki díkì!», ama ní kaa tīī-u ú jī, kaa tīī-u ú pèen̄ kí ŋmátée, an ŋān̄ lapu?

english_verse: Faith that doesn't lead us to do good deeds is all alone and dead!
translation_verse: Míǹ mbaantiim ní un yaa fōō Yeesu ki kíí ŋmaniŋma, ní kaa ŋáań fookii tundi nín sá puee, mimmee udaan fookiiu kpíì dee.

english_verse: Suppose someone disagrees and says, “It is possible to have faith without doing kind deeds.” I would answer, “Prove that you have faith without doing kind deeds, and I will prove that I have faith by doing them.”
translation_verse: Ubɔ ŋūǹ kí lì yii: «Sii cáá fookii, ama ní man tūǹ atummɔnti. Too, dàkà-mi a nín fōō ki kíí min min, kaa tūǹ atummɔntee, ní ma mun ń dàkà-si m-tummɔntiŋ a béé yii m fōō ki kíí.

english_verse: You surely believe there is only one God. That's fine. Even demons believe this, and it makes them shake with fear.
translation_verse: A nín fōō ki kíí yii Unimbɔtibaanti di bée, an ŋān̄: ama míǹ ní arasiniibi mun fōō ki kíí, ní ki fàŋkí yɔ́kɔ́ yɔkɔ.

english_verse: Does some stupid person want proof that faith without deeds is useless?
translation_verse: Ugbaan, aa là kí béé yii a yaa fōō ki kíí ní kaa tūǹ atummɔntee, a-fookiiu sá fámaaa?

english_verse: Now you see how Abraham's faith and deeds worked together. He proved his faith was real by what he did.
translation_verse: A káa! U fōō ki kíí ní ki túń ditundi mun, u-fookiiu nì u-tuuŋŋi nín kpáfì mbaantiim ki táá tɔb puee ní u-fookiiu kpántì umɔnti.

english_verse: This is what the Scriptures mean by saying, “Abraham had faith in God, and God accepted him.” That's how Abraham became God's friend.
translation_verse: An ŋá kii Unimbɔti gbɔŋku poon nín lī puee dee, yii: «Abraam fōō Unimbɔti ki kíí, ní Unimbɔti ká u-fookiiu un u cáá u-puee ní ki yíiń-u deedeedaan,» ní ki kíǹ ki yíì-u u-bɔɔ mun.

english_verse: You can now see that we please God by what we do and not only by what we believe.
translation_verse: Ni káa! Unil tuuŋŋi pu ní u kpántí deedeedaan Unimbɔti cee, an kaa sá fookii un u cááyee ŋmaniŋma pu.

english_verse: For example, Rahab had been a prostitute. But she pleased God when she welcomed the spies and sent them home by another way.
translation_verse: Míǹ mbaantiim ní an nìn tí jítì Raab kinimpulaakpaayee cee. U mun nín nìn túń atuun ŋin ki kpántì deedeedaan Unimbɔti ceeyee di sá u nín fōō binib bin Juuda yab nìn túee ki dàkā-bi nsan ŋubɔ bi dī ki ŋmátèe.

english_verse: Anyone who doesn't breathe is dead, and faith that doesn't do anything is just as dead!
translation_verse: Kii ŋfam yaa nyáń tiwun nín kpántí utaŋkpiil puee, míǹ ní unil yaa fōō ki kíí ní kaa tūǹ atummɔntee, u-fookiiu kúù.

english_verse: My friends, we should not all try to become teachers. In fact, teachers will be judged more strictly than others.
translation_verse: M-nabiyaamu, ni-kɔkɔ ń taa yīkì bìliku yii ni là kí nīn dàkà Unimbɔti bɔti, kun puee ni nyí yii timbi bidakaliibee bɔsooŋyi dāa pɔ̄ɔ̄ ki jítiǹ bin kíǹee yai.

english_verse: All of us do many wrong things. But if you can control your tongue, you are mature and able to control your whole body.
translation_verse: Ti-kɔkɔ yìntī ajan tikpil poon, ama sii un yaa kaa yìntī a-bɔsooŋyi poonee di sá uniŋman ki ŋūǹ kí cúú a-ba kɔkɔ.

english_verse: By putting a bit into the mouth of a horse, we can turn the horse in different directions.
translation_verse: Ti kpàl̀ itaamu nyɔmmu tikúti í nīn tɔ́-ti ní ki kpáàa kpòotī i-wunti kɔkɔ.

english_verse: It takes strong winds to move a large sailing ship, but the captain uses only a small rudder to make it go in any direction.
translation_verse: Kpèèmaan, meelab mun nín sá bikpaambi miŋyee, ama báà kubuŋu yaa yāntì ki téekí-bi min kamaa, kipimbiwaŋwaai ní un ŋàal̀ee cáa kpòotī-bi ki cáǹ laakin u lèe.

english_verse: Our tongues are small too, and yet they brag about big things. It takes only a spark to start a forest fire!
translation_verse: Míǹ mbaantiim ní unil wunti puee, dilimbil sá kijaŋwaai ní, ní ki ŋáań tibɔkpaandi. Kéè, ni nyí yii kiŋmibilii fiii yéè di gbátí kí wà kupɔɔuaa!

english_verse: The tongue is like a spark. It is an evil power that dirties the rest of the body and sets a person's entire life on fire with flames that come from hell itself.
translation_verse: Dilimbil sá kii ŋŋmee ní. Duulinya bɔkpitii kɔkɔ bí dilimbilin ní dì kā ti-wunti pu ki bíiĺ tiwun kɔkɔ, ní kí cáań Sitaan ŋmiŋu kí tɔ̄ ti-pu.

english_verse: All kinds of animals, birds, reptiles, and sea creatures can be tamed and have been tamed.
translation_verse: Unil ŋūǹ kí kpàà ipeel nì inoon nì tin fù ti-pooŋi puee, nì ijɔm kɔkɔ, í ŋá u nín là puee, ní binib lafun ŋúb̀-i míǹ.

english_verse: But our tongues get out of control. They are restless and evil, and always spreading deadly poison.
translation_verse: Ama doooo nee, ubɔ kaa láá ŋúń ki ŋúb́ dilimbil: dì sá kuwaŋkpitiu kun baa ŋūǹ kí cúúyee, ki gbí tilool tin cáá ŋkúmee ŋmaniŋma.

english_verse: My dear friends, with our tongues we speak both praises and curses. We praise our Lord and Father, and we curse people who were created to be like God, and this isn't right.
translation_verse: Kinyɔkɔn ní ijaam nyēē, kíǹ kibaantii poon ní mbusu tí nyēē. M-nabiyaamu, an kaa máaǹ kí nīn bí míǹ.

english_verse: Can clean water and dirty water both flow from the same spring?
translation_verse: Nnyimbul ŋubɔ kaa bí ki nyēē inyiŋfi ili: min tūee nì min mɔ̄ee dicilpu.

english_verse: Can a fig tree produce olives or a grapevine produce figs? Does fresh water come from a well full of salt water? Wisdom from Above
translation_verse: M-nabiyaamu, kɔŋki subu kaa lòoǹ tikpasampiil, ní nunufi mun kaa lòoǹ kɔŋki. Míǹ mbaantiim, nnyimbul ŋun nyēē nnyim min tūee kaa nyēē min mɔ̄ee. Iciin in nyánní yilpuee

english_verse: Are any of you wise or sensible? Then show it by living right and by being humble and wise in everything you do.
translation_verse: Ni-kansikin ubɔ bí ki cáá iciin ki nyáaa? Ú nīn sìntīǹ u-ba taapu kí nīn tūǹ atummɔnti ŋin làá dàkà yii u lafun cáá iciinee.

english_verse: But if your heart is full of bitter jealousy and selfishness, don't brag or lie to cover up the truth.
translation_verse: Ama a yaa ná a-jutiibi, a-poon tū, ki sá unil un mɔ̀ kí nīn jítiǹ báà ŋmee, á taa nín̄ gà a-bindi yii a tɔ́kɔ́ ibaamɔn pu, kí taa mɔ̄ntì a-ba.

english_verse: This kind of wisdom doesn't come from above. It is earthly and selfish and comes from the devil himself.
translation_verse: An ciiŋyee kaa nyēeń yilpu, i sá taapu doo ní, nniyaamin, i nyēeń Sitaan cee ní.

english_verse: Whenever people are jealous or selfish, they cause trouble and do all sorts of cruel things.
translation_verse: Kun puee laakin ní binib ná tɔb ní ki mɔ̀ kí nīn jítiǹ tɔbee, niin ní ni kāntí tin kaa kítèe nì tibɔkpiil kɔkɔ nì ti-bulifi.

english_verse: But the wisdom that comes from above leads us to be pure, friendly, gentle, sensible, kind, helpful, genuine, and sincere.
translation_verse: Ama iciin in nyēeń yilpuee, mpeepeekaamee i bí circir, ní boonee i cāabìń ŋgbansɔŋfi binib kansikin, ní ki mɔ̄, ki bí soooo, ní ki cáá tiniti tikpil, ki tūǹ atummɔnti, ní kaa gàntī binib, kaa cáá mpoonnyoon.

english_verse: Why do you fight and argue with each other? Isn't it because you are full of selfish desires that fight to control your body?
translation_verse: Ba di cāabìń kunikpɔŋkpɔkɔu nì kujaau ni-kansikin ní? An sá ni-kpɔkɔsib bin bí ni-wuntin ki jáà baabadalee di cāabìń tíǹ kɔkɔ.

english_verse: You want something you don't have, and you will do anything to get it. You will even kill! But you still cannot get what you want, and you won't get it by fighting and arguing. You should pray for it.
translation_verse: Ni cáá nnimbitaataam tiba pu, ní kaa ŋūǹ kí ká kudɔŋu, míǹ puee ní ni yaa ká unilee, ní ní kpɔ̀. Ni-nimbiliŋ máǹ tiba pu ní naa ŋūǹ kí ká kudɔŋu, ní kujaau nì kunikpɔŋkpɔkɔu kóò. Kun di yì-tì ní naa kāntí kun ní ni nyàab̀ee di sá naa mèé Unimbɔti un tìì kudɔŋu gbantee.

english_verse: Yet even when you do pray, your prayers are not answered, because you pray just for selfish reasons.
translation_verse: Míǹ ní ni yaa tí mēē Unimbɔti, naa kāntí, kun puee ni dàkafī ilandɔkɔkpiti ní. Kun ni mèé ki nyàab̀ee, ni là kí dūú ŋá min fáatì-nee ní.

english_verse: You people aren't faithful to God! Don't you know if you love the world, you are God's enemies? And if you decide to be a friend of the world, you make yourself an enemy of God.
translation_verse: Nimbi bin fá Unimbɔti kii kinimpulaakpaai nín féeń u-cal puee, naa nyí yii un néeń duulinyee sá Unimbɔti pulincɔnti níii? Sii un píí duulinya kubɔɔtiiuee kpántì Unimbɔti pulincɔnti dee.

english_verse: Do you doubt the Scriptures that say, “God truly cares about the Spirit he has put in us”?
translation_verse: Ni nyí fám ní Unimbɔti gbɔŋku poon sòon̄ yii: «Unimbɔti kaa mɔ̄ ŋfam min u dūu ŋá ti-nee pu.»

english_verse: In fact, God treats us with even greater kindness, just as the Scriptures say, “God opposes everyone who is proud, but he blesses all who are humble with undeserved grace.”
translation_verse: Ama u ŋáań-ti tiŋan tin wīikí ki lákatèe, kii an nín ŋmàn̄ u-gbɔŋku poon puee, yii: «Unimbɔti kaa gèetíǹ bilambidambi, ama ní ki ŋáań bin sìntīǹ bi-ba taapuee tiŋan.»

english_verse: Surrender to God! Resist the devil, and he will run from you.
translation_verse: Míǹ puee, sìntīmaan ni-ba taapu kí tīī Unimbɔti, kí já nì Sitaan, see ú sāǹ kí wàatī-ni.

english_verse: Come near to God, and he will come near to you. Clean up your lives, you sinners. Purify your hearts, you people who can't make up your mind.
translation_verse: Sútímaan kí pìl̄ Unimbɔti, ní u mun ń sútiń kí pìl̄-ni. Ikpitidambi, fíntímaan ni-ŋalii ikpiti ń nyā, milimilidambi, fíntímaan ni-pɔbiliŋ poon ń nyā circir.

english_verse: Be sad and sorry and weep. Stop laughing and start crying. Be gloomy instead of glad.
translation_verse: Ni-kpitii puee, nín̄ bímaan kunimbaaun kí nīn sūǹ ki yáliŋkí, ni-laati ń kpántí nsiim, ni-pɔɔpindi ń kpántí-ni kunimbaau.

english_verse: Be humble in the Lord's presence, and he will honor you. Saying Cruel Things about Others
translation_verse: Sìntīmaan ni-ba kí tīī Unimbɔti, ní ú yòon̄-ni yilpu. Ní taa nín̄ sòom̀maan ki bíiĺ ni-nabiyaamu

english_verse: My friends, don't say cruel things about others! If you do, or if you condemn others, you are condemning God's Law. And if you condemn the Law, you put yourself above the Law and refuse to obey either it
translation_verse: Nnabiyaamu, ní taa nín̄ sòoǹ ki bíiĺmaan tɔb. Sii un di yaa sòon̄ ki bíil̀ a-nabikee, àá a sòon̄ ki kūū u-bɔtee, mara ní a sòon̄ ki bíil̀ ki kūū. A yaa sòon̄ ki bíil̀ maree, aa ti tɔ́-u dee, a sòon̄ ki kūū-u dee.

english_verse: or God who gave it. God is our judge, and he can save or destroy us. What right do you have to condemn anyone? Warning against Bragging
translation_verse: Unimbɔti baba di tìì marab ní ki sá ubɔsoonli. Úǹ baba di ŋūǹ kí fīī binib, úǹ di tí ŋūǹ kí kpɔ̀-bi. Sii yíì a-ba ŋma ní ki sòoǹ a-juti bɔti ní? Ní taa nín̄ cáá dilambil

english_verse: You should know better than to say, “Today or tomorrow we will go to the city. We will do business there for a year and make a lot of money!”
translation_verse: Ní pīlifìmaan kɔŋkɔnnee, nimbi bin lì yii: «Díǹ àá fool, ti làá yīkì kí cù kitiŋ kinee ni, kí tin ŋá niin dibindi diba, kí bàntì kí ká animbilee.»

english_verse: What do you know about tomorrow? How can you be so sure about your life? It is nothing more than mist that appears for only a little while before it disappears.
translation_verse: Ni nyí kun làá fu bàń ni-pu fooleeee? Ni pée bí kii dipɔ̀ńdi nín nyēē kí páań pu, án kūtì fiii, dí wāŋkèe ní.

english_verse: You should say, “If the Lord lets us live, we will do these things.”
translation_verse: An nín bàà máaǹ ní lì puee sèé: «Unimbɔti yaa là ní ti yaa bí ki pɔ̄ɔ̄yee, ti làá ŋá tinee nì tinee.»

english_verse: Yet you are stupid enough to brag, and it is wrong to be so proud.
translation_verse: Ama nimbee, ni sá bilambidambi ní ki dàkà ni-ba, an nì an lambiliŋee kaa ŋān̄.

english_verse: If you don't do what you know is right, you have sinned.
translation_verse: Sii un di nyí tiŋan tin bàà sá á ŋá ní kaa ŋée, ŋá ikpiti.

english_verse: You rich people should cry and weep! Terrible things are going to happen to you.
translation_verse: Nimbi bigaajabee, ní pīlifìmaan tibɔti nee: Ní sɔ̄ kí yāliŋkìmaan nnaabu ŋun làá bàń ni-puee.

english_verse: Your treasures have already rotted, and moths have eaten your clothes.
translation_verse: Ni-gaajawanti sūū, ní akɔtuu mɔ́ ni-wampeeŋkaati.

english_verse: Your money has rusted, and the rust will be evidence against you, as it burns your body like fire. Yet you keep on storing up wealth in these last days.
translation_verse: Ni-sindaariyab nì ni-nimbiliŋ dámintì, ní an nín dámintì puee di làá dāá lēē mmɔ́ɔn yii ni nín ŋá miŋyee kaa ŋān̄, ní kí dāá wà ni-wunti kii ŋŋmee. Di sá yii ni báá tigaajati ŋyuntijoolkaa nee poon ní.

english_verse: You refused to pay the people who worked in your fields, and now their unpaid wages are shouting out against you. The Lord All-Powerful has surely heard the cries of the workers who harvested your crops.
translation_verse: Bipaadambi bin kùn̄ ni-sati naa pàn̄-bee, pīlifìmaan, bíǹ di tíminsée. Bin cáń ni-jikaatee biilii bàn̄ Unimbɔti Mpɔŋkɔdaan cee.

english_verse: While here on earth, you have thought only of filling your own stomachs and having a good time. But now you are like fat cattle on their way to be butchered.
translation_verse: Ni kāl̀ duulinya poon ki jíń mmɔn ki ŋá min fáatì-nee, ní ki jíń ki ŋá ŋkpam ki cíitì ŋwiin ŋun bi làá cáá-ni kí kpɔ̀ee.

english_verse: You have condemned and murdered innocent people, who couldn't even fight back. Be Patient and Kind
translation_verse: Ni túǹ bin kaa ŋá tibee pu abɔgaan ki kūū-bi, baa kpákáǹ-ni. Kimɔtii nì ŋwimmeem

english_verse: My friends, be patient until the Lord returns. Think of farmers who wait patiently for the autumn and spring rains to make their valuable crops grow.
translation_verse: Míǹ puee, nnabiyaamu, nín̄ cáámaan kimɔtii kí nīn cí ti-Dindaan gítintam. Kpèèmaan ukpaal nín jīǹ kimɔtii pu ki cīití u-wambɔlkaati ń bī puee. U jīǹ kimɔtii ní ki cīití utaapeekaa ń nì, ní utaajoolkaa mun ń dāá nì, ní ú nín cā u-jimmɔntiiti.

english_verse: Be patient like those farmers and don't give up. The Lord will soon be here!
translation_verse: Ni mun ń nīn cáámaan an mɔtiiki juti, kí nīn pɔ̄ɔntí kun puee ti-Dindaan tóob́ kí bàń.

english_verse: Don't grumble about each other or you will be judged, and the judge is right outside the door.
translation_verse: Nnabiyaamu, taa nín̄ gbùkum̄maan tɔb pu, án nín làá ŋá pu Unimbɔti ń taa yíiń-ni ibɔsoonee. Úǹ ubɔsoonlee kaa dátiǹ-ti, u yú kipunyɔkɔpu ki làá kíĺ ibɔsoon.

english_verse: My friends, follow the example of the prophets who spoke for the Lord. They were patient, even when they had to suffer.
translation_verse: Nnabiyaamu, téetímaan Unimbɔti bɔnaatiliibi bin nìn sòon̄ u-puee falaabi nì bi-mɔtiiki pu, kí nīn bímaan míǹ.

english_verse: In fact, we praise the ones who endured the most. You remember how patient Job was and how the Lord finally helped him. The Lord did this because he is so merciful and kind.
translation_verse: Ti pàkà-bi kun puee bi yúl̀ deedee. Ni gbìl̄ bi sòon̄ Yoob mɔtiiki pu, ki nyí u nín jíń kimɔtii ki kátì, ti-Dindaan ŋá-u miŋyee, kun puee ti-Dindaan sá usaasɔl ní ki ŋān̄.

english_verse: My friends, above all else, don't take an oath. You must not swear by heaven or by earth or by anything else. “Yes” or “No” is all you need to say. If you say anything more, you will be condemned.
translation_verse: M-nabiyaamu, tin kaa pée máaǹ ní ŋée di sá ní taa pùtī. Ní taa pùtī yilpu kí taa pùtī taapu, kí taa pùtī báà tiba nì tiba poon. An yaa sá Iiiŋyee, kíímaan «Iiin,» an yaa tí sá Aayeeyaaa, kíímaan «Aayee,» án nín làá ŋá pu ní taa kɔ́ Unimbɔti bɔtinee.

english_verse: If you are having trouble, you should pray. And if you are feeling good, you should sing praises.
translation_verse: Ni-kansikin ubɔ yaa bí falaa poonee, ú nīn mèé Unimbɔti. Ubɔ yaa tí bí ni-kansikin dipɔɔpindi poonaaa, ú nīn gà ilan ki nyɔ́ŋkí Unimbɔti.

english_verse: If you are sick, ask the church leaders to come and pray for you. Ask them to put olive oil on you in the name of the Lord.
translation_verse: Ubɔ yaa tí bí ni-kansikin ki būǹee, ú tɔ̄ bí yíiń Kriisitoo nikitil kpilib ń dāan̄ kí dū ŋkpam kí jōō u-yil pu kí yíiń ti-Dindaan yindi kí mèè kí tīī-u.

english_verse: If you have faith when you pray for sick people, they will get well. The Lord will heal them, and if they have sinned, he will forgive them.
translation_verse: Bi yaa máká Unimbɔti pu ki mēē-u, see ubunlee ń ŋmátí. Ti-Dindaan làá tīī-u ŋgbampɔn. Báà u yaa ŋá ikpiti iba, Unimbɔti làá dūú pɔ̄-u.

english_verse: If you have sinned, you should tell each other what you have done. Then you can pray for one another and be healed. The prayer of an innocent person is powerful, and it can help a lot.
translation_verse: An puee, nín̄ bìitī ni-kpitii pu ki tùkùmaan tɔb, kí nīn mèé ki tììmaan tɔb, kí ŋmā kí nīn kāntí dicáaǹdi. Di sá yii unil un yú deedee Unimbɔti nimbiinee yaa dū u-pɔbil kɔkɔ ki mēē-uee, an tūǹ atuŋkpaan ní.

english_verse: Elijah was just as human as we are, and for three and a half years his prayers kept the rain from falling.
translation_verse: Eelii mun nìn pée tí sá unifutifoo kii ti nín bí pu nan ní, ní ki nìn mēē Unimbɔti nì u-pɔbil kɔkɔ, yii utaa ń taa ti nì, ní utaa kaa lafun gíti jōō kitiŋ pu áli abin ata nì dijandi.

english_verse: But when he did pray for rain, it fell from the skies and made the crops grow.
translation_verse: Boonee ní u fātìi tí mēē, ní utaa nìn̄, ní kitiŋ lòon̄ tijikaal.

english_verse: My friends, if any followers have wandered away from the truth, you should try to lead them back.
translation_verse: M-nabiyaamu, ni-kansikin ubɔ ŋūǹ kí dū Unimbɔti saŋŋu ki fá ní ubɔ mun ŋūǹ kí fàtīí gíiǹní-u.

english_verse: If you turn sinners from the wrong way, you will save them from death, and many of their sins will be forgiven.
translation_verse: Too, ni máaǹ kí béé yii un di yaa nyántìń unil nsaŋkpitin ki gíiǹní-u nsammɔnti poonee, udaan fīī u-nabiki gbanti naŋki ki nyántì ŋkúm ŋaan dee. Udaan nín ŋá mimmee puee, Unimbɔti làá dūú pɔ̄-u.

english_verse: From Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ. To God's people who are scattered like foreigners in Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia.
translation_verse: Man Peetroo un sá Yeesu Kriisitoo kpambalee di jáaḿ-ni. M ŋmàn̄ kugbɔŋu nee kí tīī nimbi bin Unimbɔti lútì ni yàl̄ ki bíń kunicaŋu Pɔnti nì Galaati nì Kapadoosi nì Asii nì Bitinii timmunee ní.

english_verse: God the Father decided to choose you as his people, and his Spirit has made you holy. You have obeyed Jesus Christ and are sprinkled with his blood. I pray that God will be kind to you and will keep on giving you peace! A Real Reason for Hope
translation_verse: Ti-Baa Unimbɔti lútì-ni ní nīn sá u-yab u-Fam pu. U nìn pée lī míǹ ki yóoǹ dooooyee ní. Kun puee u là ní nīn tɔ́ Yeesu Kriisitoo u-fatikuu ń fíntí-ni ní nyā. Unimbɔti ń ŋá-ni tiŋan kí tīī-ni ŋgbansɔŋfi tikpil. Dimákal tiŋman pu yal
