english_verse: Praise God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ. God is so good, and by raising Jesus from death, he has given us new life and a hope that lives on.
translation_verse: Tí nyɔ̄ŋkì Unimbɔti ti-Dindaan Yeesu Kriisitoo Baa, kun puee u súń ti-saai tikpil. U nín fīkitì Yeesu Kriisitoo ditaŋkpiilinee ní u pú-ti nsan tí kɔ́ dimaŋfapɔndin. Kɔŋkɔnnee ti cáá dimákal tiŋman pu yal.

english_verse: God has something stored up for you in heaven, where it will never decay or be ruined or disappear.
translation_verse: An pu ní ti cí ú tīī-ti difakal din u yóoǹ kí dāá tīī bin sá u-yabee. Difakal gbantee kaa bíiĺ, kaa jòontí, kaa dóotí. Unimbɔti dū-dì ki kpáafì yilpu ki yóoǹ nimbi ní.

english_verse: You have faith in God, whose power will protect you until the last day. Then he will save you, just as he has always planned to do.
translation_verse: Ni nín fōō Unimbɔti bɔti ki kííyee ní u ŋúb́-ni taapu doo nì u-pɔŋŋu, án nín làá ŋá pu ŋwindalee, ú dāá tīī-ni difiil din u bɔ́ntì ki yóoǹee, báà ŋma ń dāá wāl̀.

english_verse: On that day you will be glad, even if you have to go through many hard trials for a while.
translation_verse: Míǹ puee ní yàntī án nīn mɔ̄ǹ-ni báà ŋyunti fiii ŋun poon ti bí nee gba ní icɔŋki nín bí puee nì i-nyɔkɔm yaa cāabìń-ni kunimbaau.

english_verse: Your faith will be like gold that has been tested in a fire. And these trials will prove that your faith is worth much more than gold that can be destroyed. They will show that you will be given praise and honor and glory when Jesus Christ returns.
translation_verse: An falaabee sá kí cɔ̄ŋkì kí kpèè yii ni-fookiiu pɔ̄ɔ̄yaaa, waa pɔ̄ɔ̄ ní. Kpèèmaan, sindaariya un bí ki làá wāŋkì ŋwindalee. Bi ŋáań-u ŋŋmin ní kí kpèè yii u sá umɔntaaa, waa sá. Míǹ mbaantiimin ní falaa sá kí cɔ̄ŋkì ni-fookiiu un jítiǹ sindaariya pu kpataaayee kí kpèè yii u pɔ̄ɔ̄yaaa, waa pɔ̄ɔ̄. Ni-fookiiuee cáá kudapɔɔu ki jítiǹ sindaariya pu kpataaa. Ni yaa jáń ki nyáń icɔŋki poonee ní Yeesu Kriisitoo ń dāá pàkà-ni kí tīī-ni tinyool nì jilma u-gítintam dal.

english_verse: You have never seen Jesus, and you don't see him now. But still you love him and have faith in him, and no words can tell how glad and happy
translation_verse: Yeesu Kriisitoo gbantee, naa ká-u nì ni-nimbiliŋ, ama ni néeń-u. Ni fōō-u ki kíí kaa wāĺ-u, ki fàal̀ nì dipɔɔpiŋkpaandi din baa ŋūǹ kí māafèe.

english_verse: you are to be saved. This is why you have faith.
translation_verse: Kun puee ni làá dāá fōō ni-fookiiu paati tin sá ni-nammu fīitamee.

english_verse: Some prophets told how God would treat you with undeserved grace, and they searched hard to find out more about the way you would be saved.
translation_verse: Bibɔnaatiliibi nìn nyàab̄ mmɔntiim kí béé difiil bɔti tiŋan. Bi nìn sòon̄ dipɔl din ni làá fōō nee pu ki síiǹ.

english_verse: The Spirit of Christ was in them and was telling them how Christ would suffer and would then be given great honor. So they searched to find out exactly who Christ would be and when this would happen.
translation_verse: Kriisitoo Fam di nìn bí bi-ni ní ki dàkā-bi falaa un u làá dāá jēe nì tinyool tin làá dāá páanní falaayee boonee. Unimbɔti bɔnaatiliibi nìn nyàab̄ kí béé ŋyunti nì min ní tíǹ gbanti kɔkɔ làá bàńee.

english_verse: But they were told that they were serving you and not themselves. They preached to you by the power of the Holy Spirit, who was sent from heaven. And their message was only for you, even though angels would like to know more about it. Chosen To Live a Holy Life
translation_verse: Unimbɔti nìn lēē ki dàkā u-bɔnaatiliibi yii tibɔti tin bi bí ki sòoǹee, bíǹ kaa làá ká ti-poon tiba, ama nimbi di dāa yì. Kɔŋkɔnnee bin sòoǹ Kriisitoo Bɔmɔntiitee sòon̄ nì ni tibɔbaantiil gbanti ní, kun puee Unimbɔti Fam min nyánní yilpuee di dàkā-bi. Áli gba Unimbɔti tuuŋyi mun bàà là kí béé min ní an bɔtee làá jītée. Unimbɔti yíiń-ti tí nīn bí circir

english_verse: Be alert and think straight. Put all your hope in how God will treat you with undeserved grace when Jesus Christ appears.
translation_verse: Míǹ puee, ní bɔ́ntí ni-ba ni-nimbiliŋ ń nīn cɔ́ tiŋan tin pu ni máká yii Yeesu Kriisitoo yaa láa gítìń ni làá dāá fōōyee pu, kí nīn ŋúb́ ni-ba.

english_verse: Behave like obedient children. Don't let your lives be controlled by your desires, as they used to be.
translation_verse: Ní nīn tɔ́ Unimbɔti, kí taa nín̄ gíti nóó ni-bimbikpitim min naa nìn dáá nyí ki ŋáańee.

english_verse: Always live as God's holy people should, because God is the one who chose you, and he is holy.
translation_verse: Ní nīn bí circir ni-bimbim kɔkɔ poon kii Unimbɔti un yíiń-nee nín bí circir puee.

english_verse: That's why the Scriptures say, “I am the holy God, and you must be holy too.”
translation_verse: A lì kii Unimbɔti nín lī u-gbɔŋku poon puee yii: «Nín̄ bímaan circir kun puee man bí circir ní.»

english_verse: You say that God is your Father, but God doesn't have favorites! He judges all people by what they do. So you must honor God while you live as strangers here on earth.
translation_verse: Ni-wimmeem poonee ni yíì Unimbɔti yii ni-Baa. Ama ní téetí yii úǹ di sòoǹ báà ŋma bɔti ki nóó nì min udaan ŋée, kaa gàntī, an puee iyunti in kíǹ ní dū kí kàl̄ duulinyanee, dàkàmaan-u ni-bimbim poon ni nín tɔ́-u puee.

english_verse: You were rescued from the useless way of life you learned from your ancestors. But you know you were not rescued by such things as silver or gold that don't last forever.
translation_verse: Nimbi ni-ba nyí Unimbɔti nín dī min ki nyántìń-ni ni-naanjab saŋyi in ni nìn nóó fám tiba kpá poonee. An kaa sá tiwan tin bíiĺ kii animbilee àá kii sindaariyee ní u dū ki nyántì-ni.

english_verse: Christ was chosen even before the world was created, but because of you, he did not come until these last days.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti lēē Kriisitoo ki wāatì ní ki nín náań duulinya. Ni-puee ní u nyántì-u ŋyuntijoolkaa nee poon.

english_verse: And when he did come, it was to lead you to have faith in God, who raised him from death and honored him in a glorious way. This is why you have put your faith and hope in God.
translation_verse: U-pu ní ni fōō Unimbɔti un fīkitì-u ditaŋkpiilin ki tīī-u tinyoolee ki kíí, án nín làá ŋá pu ni-fookiiu nì ni-mákal ń nīn cɔ́ Unimbɔti puee.

english_verse: You obeyed the truth, and your souls were made pure. Now you sincerely love each other. But you must keep on loving with all your heart.
translation_verse: Ni nín nóó mbaamɔn saŋŋuee ní ni kpántì circirdambi, ní ki néeń ni-nabiyaamu bin mun fōō ki kííyee mbaamɔmin. Míǹ puee nín̄ gbíntì ki néeḿmaan tɔb tikpil nì dipɔbil diba.

english_verse: Do this because God has given you new birth by his message that lives on forever.
translation_verse: Di sá yii Unimbɔti di tīī-ni dimaŋfapɔndi. Dinyɔɔbundi gbantee kaa sá kii ŋwambool ŋun kúùyee cee. Dinyɔɔbundee kaa kúù, di bí ní ki cá jaanjaan.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “Humans wither like grass, and their glory fades like wild flowers. Grass dries up, and flowers fall to the ground.
translation_verse: Kii Unimbɔti gbɔŋku poon nín lī puee yii: «Binib kɔkɔ bí kii kumoouee ní, ní bi-nyooti bí kii mpumpukumee, kumoou kōō ní mpumpukum ń gbátí.

english_verse: But what the Lord has said will stand forever.” Our good news to you is what the Lord has said.
translation_verse: Ama ti-Dindaan bɔti tíǹ pée bí ní kí nīn cá jaanjaan.» Tibɔti gbanti di sá Kriisitoo Bɔmɔntiiti tin bi cáań ki sòon̄ nì ni nee.

english_verse: Stop being hateful! Quit trying to fool people, and start being sincere. Don't be jealous or say cruel things about others.
translation_verse: Míǹ puee, ní fá tibɔkpitil kɔkɔ nì inyimɔn kɔkɔ nì mpoonnyoon nì ipoompoon nì tibɔfan disoondi.

english_verse: Be like newborn babies who are thirsty for the pure spiritual milk that will help you grow and be saved.
translation_verse: Ní nīn néeń Unimbɔti bɔti kii mbipɔmu nín néeń mbiim puee kí ŋmā kí cù nyɔkɔpu Unimbɔti saŋŋu poon kí tin kátí-ku.

english_verse: You have already found out how good the Lord really is.
translation_verse: An bí kii Unimbɔti gbɔŋku poon nín lī puee yii: «Ni dáká ki ká ti-Dindaan nín mɔ̄ puee.»

english_verse: Come to Jesus Christ. He is the living stone people have rejected, but which God has chosen and highly honored.
translation_verse: Sútiń kí pìl̄maan ti-Dindaan Yeesu un tìì dimaŋfalee. U sá kii ditaŋkpal din bí dimaŋfalin ní binib dūu fée, ama Unimbɔti ká yii dì cáá kudapɔɔuee ní u lēē-dì.

english_verse: And now you are living stones being used to build a spiritual house. You are also a group of holy priests, and with the help of Jesus Christ you will offer sacrifices that please God.
translation_verse: Nimbi bin mun ká u-cee dimaŋfalee, sútiḿmaan kí nīn sá kii ataŋkpeeyee Unimbɔti ń dūú mā u-kɔŋkooŋŋu. Ní yàntī Unimbɔti Fam ń dū-ni kí kpántí bisaraaŋaliibi bin bí circiree, kí dū ni-ba kí tīī Unimbɔti. Yeesu Kriisitoo puee ní nīn sá saraa un fáatì-uee.

english_verse: It is just as God says in the Scriptures, “Look! I am placing in Zion a choice and precious cornerstone. No one who has faith in this one will be disappointed.”
translation_verse: Kpèèmaan Unimbɔti nín lī u-gbɔŋku poon puee yii: «M lēē ditaŋkpal din cáá kudapɔɔuee ki dū-dì ki tíĺ kii ditampinjalee m-diiku kun bí Siiyɔn jool puee. Un kamaa di yaa fōō-dì ki kííyee, icoo kpá kí jī udaan.»

english_verse: You are followers of the Lord, and this stone is precious to you. But it isn't precious to those who refuse to follow him. They are the builders who tossed aside the stone that turned out to be the most important one of all.
translation_verse: Dipoondi gbantee sá ki tīī nimbi bin fōō ki kííyee ní, nimbi bin nyí yii ditaŋkpalee sá-ni tiwaŋkpaandi ki jítiǹ tikɔkɔ nì tikɔkɔee. Ama bin kaa fōō ki kííyee pu ní Unimbɔti gbɔŋku sòon̄ ditaŋkpalee pu yii: «Ditaŋkpal din bidimaliibi nìn dūu fée di dāa kpántì ditaŋkpal din ŋúb́ kudii pɔŋŋuee.»

english_verse: But you are God's chosen and special people. You are a group of royal priests and a holy nation. God has brought you out of darkness into his marvelous light. Now you must tell all the wonderful things he has done. The Scriptures say,
translation_verse: Ama nimbee, ni sá dinibul din Unimbɔti lútì dí nīn sá u-yalee ní. Nimbi di sá u-Beelin saraaŋaliibi ní ki sá Unimbɔti bindi pu timbundi. U yíiń-ni ní nyānní dibɔmbɔndin kí kɔ́ u-walifimɔntiŋun, kí ŋmā kí lēē u-tunnyaaŋŋi pu seera.

english_verse: “Once you were nobody. Now you are God's people. At one time no one had mercy on you. Now God has treated you with kindness.” Live as God's Servants Should
translation_verse: Dooooyee, naa nìn sá Unimbɔti nibul, ama kɔŋkɔnnee ni kpántì u-nibul. Dooooyee, naa nìn nyí yii Unimbɔti sūǹ binib saai, ama kɔŋkɔnnee u súń ni-saai ni béè. Ní nīn cáá Unimbɔti tɔntɔnliibi bimbim

english_verse: Dear friends, you are foreigners and strangers on this earth. So I beg you not to surrender to those desires that fight against you.
translation_verse: M-nabineeŋkaamu, m mèé-ni kii ni nín sá binicambi duulinya nee poon puee, ní cúúmaan ni-ba nì bikɔdeekpitib, kun puee an di jáaǹ kinaŋ.

english_verse: Always let others see you behaving properly, even though they may still accuse you of doing wrong. Then on the day of judgment, they will honor God by telling the good things they saw you do.
translation_verse: Ní nīn cáá mbimbimɔntiim bin kaa nyí Unimbɔtee kansikin. Báà biba yaa bàà bíi kúŋfí ni-boon yii ni sá binikpitibaaa, bi yaa ká ni-tunnyaaŋŋee, Unimbɔti ń yàntī bí béé yii an tunnyaaŋŋi nyánní úǹ cee ní, ní bí pàkà-u ŋyunti ŋun u yaa láa dɔ́mińee.

english_verse: The Lord wants you to obey all human authorities, especially the Emperor, who rules over everyone.
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan puee, nín̄ tɔ́maan biyidambi, kí nīn tɔ́ gɔmina un cáá mpɔn ki kpèé kitiŋ kɔkɔee,

english_verse: You must also obey governors, because they are sent by the Emperor to punish criminals and to praise good citizens.
translation_verse: kí nīn tɔ́ bibɔtiibi bin bi kāaǹ bí nīn dátí digaŋgandambi tafal, kí nīn pàkà bin ŋáań tiŋanee.

english_verse: You are free, but still you are God's servants, and you must not use your freedom as an excuse for doing wrong.
translation_verse: Ní nīn bímaan kii binib bin Kriisitoo tīī dibatɔlee. Ní taa nín̄ sá binib bin dì dibatɔl pu ki kāntí inaakpal ki ŋáań ikpitee. Ama dūmaan ni-batɔlee kí nīn ŋáań kii Unimbɔti tɔntɔnliibee.

english_verse: Respect everyone and show special love for God's people. Honor God and respect the Emperor. The Example of Christ's Suffering
translation_verse: Nín̄ tɔ́maan binib kɔkɔ, kí nīn néeń Kriisitoo yab, kí fàŋkìmaan Unimbɔti, kí nīn tɔ́ gɔmina. Tí nóó Kriisitoo tabɔbiliŋ kí jī falaa

english_verse: Servants, you must obey your masters and always show respect to them. Do this, not only to those who are kind and thoughtful, but also to those who are cruel.
translation_verse: Nimbi bin kā binib ceeyee, ní sìntīǹ ni-ba taapu kɔkɔ kí tīī ni-kpilib kí nīn tɔ́-bi mmɔntiimin. An kaa sá bidambi yaa sá binib ki mɔ̄ee baba ní ní nīn tɔ́-bi, báà bidambi bɔti yaa pɔ̄ɔ̄yaaa, ní nīn tɔ́-bi.

english_verse: God will bless you, even if others treat you unfairly for being loyal to him.
translation_verse: Ni nín ŋáań Unimbɔti lammee puee ní bidambi yaa bíi sàantí-ni fámee, an ŋān̄. Unimbɔti làá bìin̄ ni-boon.

english_verse: You don't gain anything by being punished for some wrong you have done. But God will bless you, if you have to suffer for doing something good.
translation_verse: Bi yaa bíi gbáà-si digaŋgam pu ní a jīǹ kimɔtiiyee, ipaati ilai ní a làá ká poon? Ama a yaa ŋá tin ŋān̄ee ní bi yaa bíi sàantí-si ní a jīǹ kimɔtiiyee, míǹ di ŋān̄ Unimbɔti nimbiin.

english_verse: After all, God chose you to suffer as you follow in the footsteps of Christ, who set an example by suffering for you.
translation_verse: Kun pu Unimbɔti là ní nīn bí mimmee di sá Kriisitoo u-ba jíń falaa míǹ ni-pu, ní ki bí yii ni mun ń nóó u-tabɔbiliŋ kí jī falaa gbanti.

english_verse: Christ did not sin or ever tell a lie.
translation_verse: Waa ŋá ikpiti báà iba, baa gbìl̄ u-nyɔkɔn nnyimɔn ŋubɔ.

english_verse: Although he was abused, he never tried to get even. And when he suffered, he made no threats. Instead, he had faith in God, who judges fairly.
translation_verse: Bi nín bí ki sìí-uee, waa sīī ubɔ ki téeǹ. Bi nín sāaǹ-uee waa tɔ́-bi mbusu, ama u dū ki ŋá Unimbɔti un sòoǹ tibɔti nì deedeeyee ŋaan ní.

english_verse: Christ carried the burden of our sins. He was nailed to the cross, so we would stop sinning and start living right. By his cuts and bruises you are healed.
translation_verse: Úǹ Kriisitoo di fōō ti-kpitii ki ŋá u-ba pu ní ki fōō ti-kpitii tafadaaldi ndɔpuntikaa pu, án nín làá ŋá pu tí nyā ikpiti poon kí nīn kíǹ ki bí deedee maŋfal poonee. Bi nín gbáń-u u-wunti léetì puee di cāantí ni-weeŋyi.

english_verse: You had wandered away like sheep. Now you have returned to the one who is your shepherd and protector.
translation_verse: Kun puee dooooyee ni nìn wáŋkì kii ipii in kaa cáá ukpaalee ní. Ama ní kɔŋkɔnnee ni fātìi gítìń un sá upikpaal ki sá un cí ni-nammuee cee.

english_verse: If you are a wife, you must put your husband first. Even if he opposes our message, you will win him over by what you do. No one else will have to say anything to him,
translation_verse: Nimbi binimpoobi mun, ní sìntīmaan ni-ba taapu kí tīī ni-calib. Niinee ni-calib kansikin biba yaa kaa fōō Unimbɔti bɔti ki kííyee, bi yaa ká ni-bimbimɔntiimee, bí fōō kí kíí án taa nín̄ gíti sá nì kinyɔkɔ ní ní dū kí sòoǹ nì bi.

english_verse: because he will see how you honor God and live a pure life.
translation_verse: Di sá yii bi làá ká yii ni cáá mbimbimɔntiim ní ki tɔ́-bi.

english_verse: Don't depend on things like fancy hairdos or gold jewelry or expensive clothes to make you look beautiful.
translation_verse: Unimpu yaa là kí nīn ŋān̄ee, an kaa sá ú nīn dàkafī tiwun nyaaŋku ŋmaniŋma pu, an dàkà yii diyikpiboobil nì sindaariya falfatib nì an léeŋkaati, nì tiwammɔntiil dilòondi.

english_verse: Be beautiful in your heart by being gentle and quiet. This kind of beauty will last, and God considers it very special.
translation_verse: Ama u máaǹ kí dàkafì u-bimbim min u cááyee pu, an dàkà yii u-pɔbil poon ń nīn ŋān̄, ú nīn mɔ̄, ki bí soooo. An nyaaŋkuee di kaa jòontí. Míǹ di ŋān̄ ki jítiǹ tikɔkɔ Unimbɔti nimbiin.

english_verse: Long ago those women who worshiped God and put their hope in him made themselves beautiful by putting their husbands first.
translation_verse: Dooooyee nimpoobi bin nìn bí circir ki máká Unimbɔti puee nín nìn bɔ́ntí bi-ba puee dee, ní ki sìntīǹ bi-ba taapu ki tìì bi-calib.

english_verse: For example, Sarah obeyed Abraham and called him her master. You are her true children, if you do right and don't let anything frighten you.
translation_verse: Ti-naanja Abraam nimpuu Saara nín nìn bí puee dee. U nìn sīntiǹ u-ba ní ki tīī u-cal Abraam, ní ki yíì-u u-dindaan. Ni yaa ŋáań tiŋan, kaa yàntī tiba ń fàaǹ-nee, mimmee, ni kpántì Saara naantiibi dee.

english_verse: If you are a husband, you should be thoughtful of your wife. Treat her with honor, because she isn't as strong as you are, and she shares with you in the gift of life. Then nothing will stand in the way of your prayers. Suffering for Doing Right
translation_verse: Míǹ mbaantiim ní nimbi bininjabee, ni mun ń nīn ŋúb́ ni-nimpoobi tiŋan, kí nīn nyí yii bi-pɔŋŋu kaa bàn̄ ni-yɔŋu, kí nīn tɔ́-bi, kun puee dimaŋfal din kaa kúntée mbaanti ní Unimbɔti làá dāá tīī uninja nì unimpu. Ni yaa bí mimmee, tiba kaa lìkintí ni-wimmeem. Jī falaa a-deedeeu pu

english_verse: Finally, all of you should agree and have concern and love for each other. You should also be kind and humble.
translation_verse: Nimbi bin kíǹee, ni-kɔkɔ ń nīn cáámaan nlandɔkɔbaanti kí nīn sūǹ tɔb saai kí nīn néeń tɔb kii nnabiyaamuee, kí nīn ŋáaḿmaan tɔb tiŋan kí nīn sìntīǹ ni-ba taapu ki tìì tɔb.

english_verse: Don't be hateful and insult people just because they are hateful and insult you. Instead, treat everyone with kindness. You are God's chosen ones, and he will bless you. The Scriptures say,
translation_verse: A-juti yaa ŋá-si min kaa ŋān̄ee á taa téeǹ-u. U yaa tí sīī-saaa, á taa sìì-u kí téeǹ, ama mèè Unimbɔti ń bìin̄ udaan pu. Di sá Unimbɔti pōoǹ yii u làá bìin̄ ni-pu ní, an pu ní u yíiń-ni.

english_verse: “Do you really love life? Do you want to be happy? Then stop saying cruel things and quit telling lies.
translation_verse: Kii Unimbɔti gbɔŋku poon nín lī puee, yii: «Un yaa là kí kàl̄ kí jī mmɔn u-wiiŋyi poonee, ú cúú u-limbil kí taa nín̄ sòoǹ tibɔkpitil kí taa nín̄ mɔ́ntí.

english_verse: Give up your evil ways and do right, as you find and follow the road to peace.
translation_verse: Ú fá tikpitil kí nīn ŋáań tin ŋān̄ee, kí nīn nyàab̀ ŋgbansɔŋfi nì dipɔ́ɔǹdi baabadal.

english_verse: The Lord watches over everyone who obeys him, and he listens to their prayers. But he opposes everyone who does evil.”
translation_verse: Kun puee ti-Dindaan kpèé bin bí deedeeyee tiŋan ní ki fòol̄ bi-wimmeem, ní ki fàtī u-kpaŋkpamboon ki tìì bikpitiŋaliibi.»

english_verse: Can anyone really harm you for being eager to do good deeds?
translation_verse: Ni yaa cáá difaŋgiil ki ŋáań tiŋanee, ŋma di làá ŋá-ni tikpitil?

english_verse: Even if you have to suffer for doing good things, God will bless you. So stop being afraid and don't worry about what people might do.
translation_verse: Báà tiŋan tin ni ŋáańee pu ní ni yaa bíi jīǹ falaayee, ní taa yàntī án nīn wù-ni. Ní taa yàntī binib ń bīil̀ ni-pɔbiliŋ kí kɔ́ǹ-ni tifaandi.

english_verse: Honor Christ and let him be the Lord of your life. Always be ready to give an answer when someone asks you about your hope.
translation_verse: Ama, ní nīn tɔ́maan ti-Dindaan Kriisitoo ni-pɔbiliŋin, kí bɔ́ntí kí nīn cí baabadal un kamaa di yaa bālifì-ni ni-mákal din ni cáá Kriisitoonee taapuee, ní ŋmā kí kíí-u.

english_verse: Give a kind and respectful answer and keep your conscience clear. This way you will make people ashamed for saying bad things about your good conduct as a follower of Christ.
translation_verse: Ama ní kíí an nibee soooo kí nīn tɔ́maan-bi, kí taa yàntī bí ká ni-pu ibɔkpiti iba kí sòoǹ. Ní nīn gbíntì ki dàkà ni-bimbimɔntiim min ni ká Kriisitoonee, án nín làá ŋá pu ubɔ yaa bàà làá bīil̀-nee, icoo ń cúú udaanee.

english_verse: You are better off to obey God and suffer for doing right than to suffer for doing wrong.
translation_verse: An ŋān̄ á jī falaa tiŋan tin a ŋáańee pu, míǹ di yaa sá min Unimbɔti lèe, ki jítiǹ á jī falaa a-kpitii pu.

english_verse: Christ died once for our sins. An innocent person died for those who are guilty. Christ did this to bring you to God, when his body was put to death and his spirit was made alive.
translation_verse: Di sá yii míǹ ní Kriisitoo u-ba mun kpíì binib kpitii pu. U kpíì dibaba ja ní binib kpitii pu, úǹ un bí deedeeyee kpíì bin kaa bí deedeeyee pu. U ŋá míǹ kí ŋmā kí cáań-ti Unimbɔti cee ní. Bi kūū-u ama ní Unimbɔti Fam fātìi gíiǹní-u dimaŋfalin.

english_verse: Christ then preached to the spirits that were being kept in prison.
translation_verse: U kpíìyee ní ki cūtì ditaŋkpiilin ki sòon̄ Unimbɔti bɔti ki tīī bitaŋkpiibi bin bí sarkan niinee,

english_verse: They had disobeyed God while Noah was building the boat, but God had been patient with them. Eight people went into that boat and were brought safely through the flood.
translation_verse: an dàkà yii binib bin kɔkɔ nìn bí Noowa yuntiŋuee. Bi-kansikinee, binib binii jantanja di nìn kɔ́ meelan ki dēeǹ nnyim pu ki ŋmátì. Ama bin kíǹee kpíì, kun puee bi kpēē Unimbɔti mɔtiiki fám ŋyunti ŋun Noowa nìn bíi kpáà meelee.

english_verse: Those flood waters were like baptism that now saves you. But baptism is more than just washing your body. It means turning to God with a clear conscience, because Jesus Christ was raised from death.
translation_verse: Nnyim min nìn fīī binib biniiyee náań nì min ni fùul̀ ki kāntí difiil nan ní. Unimbɔti nyim difaldee kaa sá kí lēē tiwun pu jɔkɔnti, an sá kí mèè Unimbɔti ú fíntí ti-pɔbiliŋ ń nyā circir ní. Yeesu Kriisitoo fìkititam pu ní Unimbɔti nyim difaldi cáá mpɔn kí fīī-ti.

english_verse: Christ is now in heaven, where he sits at the right side of God. All angels, authorities, and powers are under his control.
translation_verse: U búntì yilpu ki kāl̀ Unimbɔti ŋaŋgiiliŋu pú, kí jī dibeel ituun nì bin kɔkɔ cáá ipɔn ki bí yilpuee pu.

english_verse: Christ suffered here on earth. Now you must be ready to suffer as he did, because suffering shows that you have stopped sinning.
translation_verse: Ni nyí yii Kriisitoo kpíì, míǹ puee ni mun ń nīn bímaan kii ni kpíìyee. Kun puee un kpíìyee, úǹ kaa ti ŋáań ikpiti.

english_verse: It means you have turned from your own desires and want to obey God for the rest of your life.
translation_verse: Kí yòon̄ kɔŋkɔnnee kí nīn cée, ní dū ni-yuntii in kíǹ ní dūú kàl̄ duulinyanee kí dūú ŋá min Unimbɔti lèe, kí taa ti ŋá min fáatì ni-wuntee.

english_verse: You have already lived long enough like people who don't know God. You were immoral and followed your evil desires. You went around drinking and partying and carrying on. In fact, you even worshiped disgusting idols.
translation_verse: Dooooyee, ni nìn dū ŋyunti tikpil ki ŋá kii bin kaa nyí Unimbɔtee nín ŋáań puee. Ni nìn ŋáań tin kɔkɔ cāabìń ntimbiilee, ní ki ŋáań tijɔkɔndi, ki bí jiŋaalib poon baabadal, ki nyù idafi ki gbéè, ki jīǹ ki lákatí ni-ba pu, ki tòotī awaa, kun mun kaa ŋān̄ kpataaa Unimbɔti nimbiinee dee. Kɔŋkɔnnee an ŋmāntì.

english_verse: Now your former friends wonder why you have stopped running around with them, and they curse you for it.
translation_verse: An ŋá bin kaa nyí Unimbɔtee maamaaci ni nì bi nín kaa ti kpáfí ki ŋáań tin cāabìń ntimbiilee, ní bi sìí-ni.

english_verse: But they will have to answer to God, who judges the living and the dead.
translation_verse: Ama bi làá dāá yūĺ kí sòoǹ bi-tuŋkpitiŋ gbanti pu Unimbɔti un bɔ́ntì ki cí kí sòoǹ binifoobi nì bitaŋkpiibi bɔtee nimbiin.

english_verse: The good news has even been preached to the dead, so that after they have been judged for what they have done in this life, their spirits will live with God.
translation_verse: An pu ní Tibɔmɔntiil bàn̄ bitaŋkpiibi, án nín làá ŋá pu bi yaa sòon̄ bi-bɔti kii binifoobee, bí nīn bí dimaŋfalin ŋfamin Unimbɔti nimbiinee. Dū dipɔl din Unimbɔti pú-see kí tūtuǹ a-juti

english_verse: Everything will soon come to an end. So be serious and be sensible enough to pray.
translation_verse: Duulinya kúntitam tóobiń, ní ŋúb́ ni-ba mmɔntiim kí fìntīmaan kí ŋmā kí nīn mèé.

english_verse: Most important of all, you must sincerely love each other, because love wipes away many sins.
translation_verse: Ama kí wàatēe, ní nīn néeḿmaan tɔb tikpil, kun puee un cáá dineendi tikpilee bìintí ikpiti tikpil pu ní.

english_verse: Welcome people into your home and don't grumble about it.
translation_verse: Ní nīn fòol̄ ni-jutiibi ni-dumpui kí taa nín̄ gbùkum̄.

english_verse: Each of you has been blessed with one of God's many wonderful gifts to be used in the service of others. So use your gift well.
translation_verse: Kii Unimbɔti nín pú-ni ŋŋmam mì bí tɔbin puee, nín̄ cáa tútúm̀maan tɔb. Ni yaa bíi ŋáań mimmee, binib làá ká Unimbɔti ŋanti kɔkɔ tin u là kí tīī-bee.

english_verse: If you have the gift of speaking, preach God's message. If you have the gift of helping others, do it with the strength that God supplies. Everything should be done in a way that will bring honor to God because of Jesus Christ, who is glorious and powerful forever. Amen. Suffering for Being a Christian
translation_verse: Un ní Unimbɔti pú ú nīn sòoǹ u-bɔtee, ń sòoǹ-tì. Un ní u yaa tí pú ŋŋmam ú nīn tútúǹ u-jutiibee máaǹ kí dū ŋŋmam min Unimbɔti tīī-uee ní kí dūú tūtuǹ binib, án nín làá ŋá pu tin kɔkɔ ni ŋáań nì Yeesu Kriisitoo tūtuntam puee, án nīn tìì Unimbɔti tinyoolee. Úǹ di pée yì tinyool nì mpɔn kí nīn cá jaanjaan! Ameeni. Jī falaa Yeesu pu

english_verse: Dear friends, don't be surprised or shocked that you are going through testing that is like walking through fire.
translation_verse: Nnabineeŋkaamu, án taa ŋá-ni maamaaci icɔŋkikpaan in poon ni bí nee kii an sá-ni tibɔcanee.

english_verse: Be glad for the chance to suffer as Christ suffered. It will prepare you for even greater happiness when he makes his glorious return.
translation_verse: An yaa sá yii ní jī falaa un Kriisitoo jíńee, ní nīn fàal̀maan, án nín làá ŋá pu daliŋkin u làá dāá dàkà u-nyootee, ní dāá ká dipɔɔpiŋkpaandi yaadalee.

english_verse: Count it a blessing when you suffer for being a Christian. This shows that God's glorious Spirit is with you.
translation_verse: Ni nín nóó Kriisitooyee pu ní bi yaa sìí-nee, án nīn mɔ̄ǹ-ni, kun puee Unimbɔti Fam min cáá tinyoolee bí ni-pu.

english_verse: But you deserve to suffer if you are a murderer, a thief, a crook, or a busybody.
translation_verse: Ni-kansikin ubɔ falaau ń taa nín̄ sá yii u kūū unil àá u yùn̄ tiba, àá u sá digaŋgandaan, àá u cáá u-ba ki tɔ́ biba bɔtin.

english_verse: God has already begun judging his own people. And if his judgment begins with us, imagine how terrible it will be for those who refuse to obey his message. The Scriptures say,
translation_verse: Ŋyunti ŋun Unimbɔti làá sòoǹ báà ŋma bɔtee bāań ní nee. U làá péé péé kí sòoǹ bin sá u-yabee bɔti ní. Mimmee, u yaa ká timbi bin sá u-yabee pu tiba ki sòon̄ee, mana ní bin yíì kaa fōō Unimbɔti Bɔmɔntiiti ki kííyee cee dāa nín bí dee?

english_verse: “If good people barely escape, what will happen to sinners and to others who don't respect God?”
translation_verse: Kii Unimbɔti gbɔŋku poon nín lī puee yii: «An yaa pɔ̄ɔ̄ ki tīī bin nóó Unimbɔtee ń tin ŋmátée, mimmee bin kaa nóó Unimbɔtee nì bikpitiŋaliibee, bíǹ cee dāa nín bí mana dee?»

english_verse: If you suffer for obeying God, you must have complete faith in your faithful Creator and keep on doing right.
translation_verse: Míǹ puee, bin bí ki ŋáań min Unimbɔti là ní ki bíi jīǹ falaayee ń pɔ́ɔǹ bi-ba kí mɔ̀tīí nīn ŋáań tiŋan, kí dū bi-mákal kɔkɔ kí ŋá bi-náanliu un ŋáań tin u pōoǹee ni.

english_verse: Church leaders, I am writing to encourage you. I too am a leader, as well as a witness to Christ's suffering, and I will share in his glory when it is shown to us.
translation_verse: Kɔŋkɔnnee m bíi sòoǹ nì Kriisitoo nikitil kpilib bin bí ni-kansikinee ní nee. Ma mun sá Kriisitoo nikitil kpiliu ní m-ba. M ká Kriisitoo falaabi nì m-nimbiliŋ, ní ki làá dāá fōō m-jandi tinyool tin làá dāá nyēe poon.

english_verse: Just as shepherds watch over their sheep, you must watch over everyone God has placed in your care. Do it willingly in order to please God, and not simply because you think you must. Let it be something you want to do, instead of something you do merely to make money.
translation_verse: M bàlifī yii ní kpàà Unimbɔti nikitil din u dūu ŋúbiǹ-nee. Ní dū nlammɔntiim min fáatì Unimbɔtee kí kpàà-dì, án taa nín̄ sá nì kugaau, kí taa nín̄ tí sá yii ni tūǹ ki nyàab̀ animbil. Ama nín̄ tūm̀maan nì ni-pɔbiliŋ kɔkɔ.

english_verse: Don't be bossy to those people who are in your care, but set an example for them.
translation_verse: Ní taa nín̄ wɔ́b́ binib bin bi dū ki ŋúbiǹ-ni ní kpààyee, ama nín̄ sámaan binib bin bimbim sá mmɔntiim bí nīn kpèé ki tááyee.

english_verse: Then when Christ the Chief Shepherd returns, you will be given a crown that will never lose its glory.
translation_verse: Ni yaa ŋúb́-bi míǹ, áli ki tin sāā daliŋkin ní Kriisitoo upikpaakpil làá bàńee, u làá dāá tīī-ni tinyool beefuuliiki kin làá nīn bí jaanjaanee.

english_verse: All of you young people should obey your elders. In fact, everyone should be humble toward everyone else. The Scriptures say, “God opposes proud people, but he helps everyone who is humble.”
translation_verse: Nimbi binaacimpɔmbi mun, ní sìntīǹ ni-ba taapu kí tīī bikpilib. Ni-kɔkɔ ń sìntīǹ ni-ba kí tīīmaan tɔb kí nīn tūǹ atuun ki tìì tɔb, kun puee Unimbɔti gbɔŋku poon lī yii: «Unimbɔti kaa gèetíǹ bilambidambi, ama ní ki ŋáań tiŋan ki tìì bin sìntīǹ bi-ba taapuee.»

english_verse: Be humble in the presence of God's mighty power, and he will honor you when the time comes.
translation_verse: Míǹ puee, sìntīm̀maan ni-ba Unimbɔti Mpɔŋkɔdaan taapu, án nín làá ŋá pu ŋyunti ŋun Unimbɔti yóoǹee yaa láa bāańee, ú dāá yòon̄-ni yilpuee.

english_verse: God cares for you, so turn all your worries over to him.
translation_verse: Túutímaan ni-gìŋ́ŋi kɔkɔ kí páań u-pu, di sá yii úǹ di pée kpèé-ni.

english_verse: Be on your guard and stay awake. Your enemy, the devil, is like a roaring lion, sneaking around to find someone to attack.
translation_verse: Ní nīn wálifì, kí nīn nyíǹ ni-ba, kun puee ni-nannanliu Sitaan bí ki yìiǹ kii gbikinti nimbiliŋ nín máǹ pu u nyàab̀ kun u yaa pée kée ú cúú kí ŋmɔ́ee ní.

english_verse: But you must resist the devil and stay strong in your faith. You know that all over the world the Lord's followers are suffering just as you are.
translation_verse: Míǹ puee, ní ŋúb́ ni-ba ni-fookiiu poon, kí yíí Sitaan. Kun puee ni nyí yii ni-nabiyaamu mun yàl̄ duulinya jaŋŋi kɔkɔnee bí ki jīǹ falaa gbanti ubaanti míǹ ní.

english_verse: But God shows undeserved kindness to everyone. That's why he appointed Christ Jesus to choose you to share in his eternal glory. You will suffer for a while, but God will make you complete, steady, strong, and firm.
translation_verse: Ni làá jī falaa ŋyunti ŋubɔ fiii ní. Ama Unimbɔti un néeń-ni tikpilee yíiń-ni ni mun ń dāan̄ kí ká u-nyooti tin bí kaa kúntée ni nì Kriisitoo nín ŋá ubaantee pu. U làá yàntī ní kpántí deedee nib kí nīn bá ki pɔ̄ɔ̄, ní ubɔ kaa dāa gíti bí ki ŋūǹ kí téé-ni kí lúkú.

english_verse: God will be in control forever! Amen. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Úǹ di yì mpɔn kí nīn pée cáa cá jaanjaan! Ameeni. Ijaam iluŋkikaa

english_verse: Silvanus helped me write this short letter, and I consider him a faithful follower of the Lord. I wanted to encourage you and tell you how kind God really is, so you will keep on having faith in him.
translation_verse: Siilasi ní m kàan̄ anyɔɔbuŋkaaŋkaa nee ki tùkū, ki yāntì u ŋmàn̄-ni kugbɔŋu nee, kun puee m nyí yii u sá kinabiki kin yú deedee nnimbɔtisan poonee. M là kí tīī-ni kunyannyaau kí mɔ̀tīí tùkù-ni nì ibaamɔn yii Unimbɔti ŋanti tin ni fōōyee, tì lafun sá míǹ ní, ní nīn ŋúb́-tì án nīn pɔ̄ɔ̄.

english_verse: Greetings from the Lord's followers in Babylon. They are God's chosen ones. Mark, who is like a son to me, sends his greetings too.
translation_verse: Babiloon nikitil din Unimbɔti lútì kii u nín lútì ni mun puee, jáaḿ-ni. Maarki un kpántì kii m-jipɔɔnee mun jáaḿ-ni.

english_verse: Give each other a warm greeting. I pray that God will give peace to everyone who belongs to Christ.
translation_verse: Ní jāam̀maan tɔb nnabiyaamin. Unimbɔti ń tīī nimbi bin kɔkɔ sá Kriisitoo yabee ŋgbansɔŋfi.

english_verse: From Simon Peter, a servant and an apostle of Jesus Christ. To everyone who shares with us in the privilege of believing that our God and Savior Jesus Christ will do what is just and fair.
translation_verse: Man Siimɔn Peetroo un sá Yeesu Kriisitoo kpambal ki sá u-tɔntɔnliu muee di ŋmàn̄ kugbɔŋu nee. M ŋmàn̄-ku kí tīī nimbi bin fōō Unimbɔti bɔti ki kíí mbaantiim kii timbee. Yeesu Kriisitoo un sá Unimbɔti ki sá ti-Fiiliuee di ŋá míǹ ki tīī-ti, kun puee u sá deedeedaan.

english_verse: I pray that God will be kind to you and will let you live in perfect peace! May you keep learning more and more about God and our Lord Jesus. Living as the Lord's Followers
translation_verse: Kii ni nín nyí Unimbɔti nì ti-Dindaan Yeesu Kriisitoo puee, ú ŋá-ni tiŋan kí tīī-ni ŋgbansɔŋfi tikpil. Bin Unimbɔti lútì ki yíińee bɔti

english_verse: We have everything we need to live a life that pleases God. It was all given to us by God's own power, when we learned he had invited us to share in his wonderful goodness.
translation_verse: Yeesu Kriisitoo pɔŋŋu tīī-ti ŋŋmam min ti ŋūǹ kí nīn bí ki nákáǹ Unimbɔtee, ki yāntì ti béè un yíiń-ti tí dāan̄ kí fōō u-nyooti nì u-ŋantee.

english_verse: God made great and marvelous promises, so his nature would become part of us. Then we could escape our evil desires and the corrupt influences of this world.
translation_verse: Míǹ mbaantiim ní u tí pōoǹ-ti apooŋkpaan ŋin jítiǹ tikɔkɔee, án nín làá ŋá pu ni yaa fōō ipoon gbantee, ní taa nín̄ cáá nnimbitaataam tikpitil pu kí wāŋkì, ama ní fōō mbimbim min náań nì Unimbɔti yamee.

english_verse: If you keep growing in this way, it will show that what you know about our Lord Jesus Christ has made your lives useful and meaningful.
translation_verse: Mbimbimɔntiim min ni máaǹ kí nīn cááyee dee. Ni yaa cáá-mì ní mì wīikí ni-ni tikpilee, án di làá yàntī ní nīn béetí ti-Dindaan Yeesu Kriisitoo mmɔntiim kí nīn cá, ní kí nīn bí kii isufi in lòoǹ asubimɔntee.

english_verse: But if you don't grow, you are like someone who is nearsighted or blind, and you have forgotten that your past sins are forgiven.
translation_verse: Ama un kaa cáá an bimbimɔntiimee kaa ŋūǹ kí wāl̀ kí bà ndan Unimbɔti saŋŋu poon, ní ki pūtì kpáàa súntì yii Unimbɔti nìn fíntì u-pɔbilin kpitii kɔkɔ.

english_verse: My friends, you must do all you can to show God has really chosen and selected you. If you keep on doing this, you won't stumble and fall.
translation_verse: Kɔŋkɔnnee nnabiyaamu, ni nyí yii Unimbɔti lútì-ni ki yíiń-ni ní nīn sá u-yab ní. Ni yaa pɔ̄ɔntí ki gbíntìi nóó nsan gbantee, ni kpá kí jēetí tikpitilin.

english_verse: Then our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ will give you a glorious welcome into his kingdom that will last forever.
translation_verse: Ní Unimbɔti ń dāá pɔ̄-ni nsan ní kɔ́ ti-Dindaan Yeesu Kriisitoo un sá ti-Fiiliuee Beel din kaa cáá dikúntilee ni sɔkɔmii.

english_verse: You are holding firmly to the truth you were given. But I am still going to remind you of these things.
translation_verse: M nín là yii ní ká tin m sòon̄ee pu ní m gbíntì ki téetí-ni múlmul, nì min kɔkɔ ni nìn pée nyí-tì ki yú ibaamɔn bɔti tin ni fōō ki kííyee poon ki ŋúb́ an píkée.

english_verse: In fact, I think I should keep on reminding you until I leave this body.
translation_verse: Ama m là yii m nín dáá bí nee, ḿ nīn pée cɔ́ an bɔti pu ki téetí-ni múlmul.

english_verse: And our Lord Jesus Christ has already told me that I will soon leave it behind.
translation_verse: Kun puee ti-Dindaan Yeesu Kriisitoo tùkū-mi yii an kaa làá ti yúntí m làá kpú.

english_verse: This is why I am doing my best to make sure that each of you remembers all of this after I am gone. The Message about the Glory of Christ
translation_verse: An puee m làá pɔ́ɔǹ nì m-pɔŋŋu kɔkɔ kí dàkà-ni nsàmbiyaamu mun ní ni làá dī kí nīn téetí an bɔti pu baabadal m-kúm boonee. Bin ká Kriisitoo nyootee

english_verse: When we told you about the power and the return of our Lord Jesus Christ, we were not telling clever stories someone had made up. But with our own eyes we saw his true greatness.
translation_verse: Di sá yii ti-Dindaan Yeesu Kriisitoo dāantam nì u-pɔŋŋu bɔti tin ti sòon̄ ki tùkū-nee kaa sá mmaam min binib nyí bi-landɔkɔyin ki sòon̄ee. Timbi ti-ba di baasii ká-u nì ti-nimbiliŋ u nín sá ukpaan miŋyee.

english_verse: God, our great and wonderful Father, truly honored him by saying, “This is my own dear Son, and I am pleased with him.”
translation_verse: Timbi nimbilin ní u-Baa Unimbɔti tīī-u jilma nì tinyool. Unimbɔti un sá ukpaan tinyooldaanee bí yii: «Un bí nee di sá m-Jipɔɔn un m néeńee, m-pɔbil sɔ̀m̀ u-pu.»

english_verse: We were there with Jesus on the holy mountain and heard this voice speak from heaven.
translation_verse: Timbi nì u di nìn bí circir jool pu ní Unimbɔti sòon̄ní míǹ yilpu.

english_verse: All of this makes us even more certain that what the prophets said is true. So you should pay close attention to their message, as you would to a lamp shining in some dark place. You must keep on paying attention until daylight comes and the morning star rises in your hearts.
translation_verse: An puee, ti baasii mɔ̄tìi fōō ki kíí Unimbɔti bɔnaatiliibi nín sòon̄ tiŋyee ní. Ní gíiǹ ni-landɔkɔi tibɔti gbanti pu, kun puee tì bí kii fitila nín yú dibɔmbɔndin ki wāĺ pu áli ŋwìiń ń dāá nyānní puee ní, ní Kriisitoo un sá kii utaafaaŋmalbijee ń dāá ŋmíntí ni-pɔbiliŋ.

english_verse: But you need to realize that no one alone can understand any of the prophecies in the Scriptures.
translation_verse: Kí wàatēe, tin m là ní bééyee sèé: Ubɔ kaa ŋūǹ kí dū úǹ u-ba ciiŋŋu kí béé tibɔti tin Unimbɔti bɔnaatiliibi ŋmàn̄ ki ŋá kugbɔŋunee.

english_verse: The prophets did not think these things up on their own, but they were guided by the Spirit of God.
translation_verse: Kun puee tin kɔkɔ Unimbɔti bɔnaatiliibi lēe, tiba nì tiba kaa nyánní bi-làtamin, ama an sá Unimbɔti Fam di kpōotì-bi, ní bi fōō Unimbɔti paaŋŋu ki sòon̄ u-bɔti.

english_verse: Sometimes false prophets spoke to the people of Israel. False teachers will also sneak in and speak harmful lies to you. But these teachers don't really belong to the Master who paid a great price for them, and they will quickly destroy themselves.
translation_verse: Iyunti in jítèe poonee, bin nìn mɔ́ntí yii bi sá Unimbɔti bɔnaatiliibee nìn kɔ́ Unimbɔti nikitil kansikin. Míǹ mbaantiim ní bin dàkà tinyimɔmbɔtee mun làá tí kɔ́ ni mun kansikin. Bíǹ làá cáań tinyimɔmbɔti tin làá nàan̄ binibee ní kí dàkà, ní kí dū bi-kpiliu un fīī-bee kí fá kí yàntī Unimbɔti tafadaaldi ń jēetí bi-pu bí kpú kí céetí dicilpu.

english_verse: Many people will follow their evil ways and cause others to tell lies about the true way.
translation_verse: Binib tikpil làá dāá nóó bi-bimbikpitim gbanti saŋŋu. Bi-yaŋyam puee, binib làá dāá nīn kpākantí mbaamɔn saŋŋu bɔti.

english_verse: They will be greedy and cheat you with smooth talk. But long ago God decided to punish them, and God doesn't sleep.
translation_verse: Bin dàkà tinyimɔmbɔtee là kí kīil̀-ni kí fōō ni-nimbiliŋ ní. Ama dooooyee ní un làá sòoǹ bi-bɔtee bɔ́ntì ki cí kí tɔ̄ u-tundi, un làá céetí-bee kaa dɔ̄ ki gèeǹ.

english_verse: God did not have pity on the angels that sinned. He had them tied up and thrown into the dark pits of hell until the time of judgment.
translation_verse: Di sá yii Unimbɔti kaa nìn tāaǹ ituun in nìn ŋá ikpitee ki cúú-i ki tɔ́ ditafadaaldi paaŋŋun. Bi bóob́-i nì ikusaka i kā dibɔmbɔndin ki cí daliŋkin Unimbɔti làá sòoǹ i-bɔtee.

english_verse: And during Noah's time, God did not have pity on the ungodly people of the world. He destroyed them with a flood, though he did save eight people, including Noah, who preached the truth.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti kaa nìn tāaǹ duulinyakpiki, ama u nìn cāntì nnyiŋgbeen dɔ́miń ki kúntì binikpitib kɔkɔ, ní ki fīī binib biluli ki kútì Noowa un nìn sòoǹ Unimbɔti bɔti tin bí deedeeyee ki tùkù binibee.

english_verse: God punished the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah by burning them to ashes, and this is a warning to anyone else who wants to sin.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti nìn dáaĺ ntimu mun bi yíì Soodoom nì Goomoorayee yab tafal ki yāntì ŋŋmi dɔ́miń ki wùn̄-bi búkú buku. U ŋá míǹ kí dàkà u nín làá dāá dáaĺ binikpitib tafal puee ní.

english_verse: Lot lived right and was greatly troubled by the terrible way those wicked people were living. He was a good man, and day after day he suffered because of the evil things he saw and heard. So the Lord rescued him.
translation_verse: Di sá yii Looti nìn kóò bi-kansikin, ki gbìl̀ ní ki kāntí baabadal ikpiti in bi ŋáańee. U nín nìn sá unimɔntee puee, an nìn kɔ̄ntí-u kunimbaau, ki páb́-u tikpil.

english_verse: This shows that the Lord knows how to rescue godly people from their sufferings and to punish evil people while they wait for the day of judgment.
translation_verse: Míǹ puee ti-Dindaan nyí u nín dì pu ki nyāntí bin yú nì u deedeeyee dinimbinaamandi poonee, ní ki nyí u nín làá yóoń binikpitib laakin kí dāá dáaĺ bi-tafal ibɔsoon dalee.

english_verse: The Lord is especially hard on people who disobey him and don't think of anything except their own filthy desires. They are reckless and proud and are not afraid of cursing the glorious beings in heaven.
translation_verse: Bin tafal Unimbɔti làá dāá dáaĺ tikpilee di sá bin dū bi-ba ki tīī bikɔdeekpitib ki kpèé Unimbɔti pɔŋŋu fámee. An dàkà yii bin bɔti m bàà sòon̄ nì ni yii bi dàkà tinyimɔmbɔtee. Baa tɔ́ báà ubɔ nì ubɔ ní bi-pɔbiliŋ nyìm̀. Baa ti tɔ́ Tinyooldambi bin bí yilpuee gba, ama bi sìí-bi ní.

english_verse: Although angels are more powerful than these evil beings, even the angels don't dare to accuse them to the Lord.
translation_verse: Ituun in cáá mpɔn ki jítiǹ bin dàkà tinyimɔmbɔti gbantee gba kaa bíi sòoǹ tibɔkpitil bi-pu ti-Dindaan nimbiin.

english_verse: These people are no better than senseless animals that live by their feelings and are born to be caught and killed. They speak evil of things they don't know anything about. But their own corrupt deeds will destroy them.
translation_verse: Binib gbanti ŋáań kii kumooun peelii in pée sá bí nīn cútí-i ki kùee ní. Bi sìí tin baa nyée. Bi làá dāá pée nàan̄ kí céetí-bi ní.

english_verse: They have done evil, and they will be rewarded with evil. They think it is fun to have wild parties during the day. They are immoral, and the meals they eat with you are spoiled by the shameful and selfish way they carry on.
translation_verse: Bi nín yāntì binib jīǹ falaa miŋyee, an falaau ní Unimbɔti làá dāá gíiǹ kí téeǹ-bi. Bíǹ pɔɔsɔŋkil di sá bí nīn ŋáań tin kɔkɔ sá ntimbiilee ŋwiimpu. Naa ká yii binib gbanti yaa dɔ́miń ni nì bi ń jī tijinee, bi kɔ̄ntí-ni tijɔkɔndi nì icoooo? Ní an mɔ̄ǹ-bi bi nín kíiĺ binib puee.

english_verse: All they think about is having sex with someone else's husband or wife. There is no end to their wicked deeds. They trick people who are easily fooled, and their minds are filled with greedy thoughts. But they are headed for trouble!
translation_verse: Ní bi-nimbiliŋ máǹ bí ŋá tijɔkɔndi. Baa gì nì ikpiti diŋál, ní ki pīil̀ ki sàtī binib bin pɔ̀fì nnimbɔtisan poonee. Bi-landɔkɔŋu di pée sá yii bí ká animbil. Bi sá mbusudambi ní.

english_verse: They have left the true road and have gone down the wrong path by following the example of the prophet Balaam. He was the son of Beor and loved what he got from being a crook.
translation_verse: Bi fá nsammɔnti ní ki gáatì ki nóó Boosɔɔr jipɔɔn Balaam nín nìn là animbil ki dī nsaŋkpiti ŋuŋyee.

english_verse: But a donkey corrected him for this evil deed. It spoke to him with a human voice and made him stop his foolishness.
translation_verse: Ama Unimbɔti nìn wòon̄-u u nín kaa tɔ́-uee pu, di sá u nìn yāntì kimaŋ sòon̄ kii unilee ní ki pīiǹ digbaantundi din Balaam bàà nìn là kí tɔ̄ee saŋŋu.

english_verse: These people are like dried up water holes and clouds blown by a windstorm. The darkest part of hell is waiting for them.
translation_verse: Binib gbanti bí kii ibun in kaa cáá nnyimee, ní ki bí kii atagban ŋin kaa cáá ntaanyim kubuŋu cáá-ŋi ki yìiǹee. Mpaan ŋun Unimbɔti bɔ́ntì ki yóoǹ-bee nyóò ní, ki sá dibɔmbɔndi.

english_verse: They brag out loud about their stupid nonsense. And by being vulgar and crude, they trap people who have barely escaped from living the wrong kind of life.
translation_verse: An nibee dàkà bi-ba ní ki sòoǹ anyɔɔbuŋkpaan ki ŋmàtíǹ binib ní ki sàtī bin pɔ́ɔǹ bi-ba ki nyáń ikpiti saŋŋu poonee ki yàntī bi fàtī ki gítí ikpiti saŋŋu poon.

english_verse: They promise freedom to everyone. But they are merely slaves of filthy living, because people are slaves of whatever controls them.
translation_verse: Bi pòontí binib yii bi yaa ŋáań min bíǹ sòoǹee ní bi kāntí dibatɔl, ama ní bíǹ bi-ba sá ikpiti yumbui. Bi súntì yii unil sá kun kpòotī-uee yumbuu ní.

english_verse: When they learned about our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, they escaped from the filthy things of this world. But they are again caught up and controlled by these filthy things, and now they are in worse shape than they were at first.
translation_verse: Bin di béè ti-Dindaan Yeesu Kriisitoo ti-Fiiliu, ki nyáń duulinya bimbikpitim poon, ní ki dāa fātìi gíti yāntì bi-bimbikpitimee cúú-bee, tin poon bi làá kɔ́ee dāa jítiǹ tin poon bi nìn bí dooooyee kpataaa.

english_verse: They would have been better off if they had never known about the right way. Even after they knew what was right, they turned their backs on the holy commandments they were given.
translation_verse: Bidambi yaa kaa bàà béèmaan mbaamɔn saŋŋu, an bàà sɔ́ nì bí béé-ŋu, ní boonee kí dū-ŋu kí fá kaa ti tɔ́ maramɔntiibi bin Unimbɔti nìn tīī-bi bi ŋúb́ee.

english_verse: What happened to them is just like the true saying, “A dog will come back to lick up its own vomit. A pig that has been washed will roll in the mud.”
translation_verse: Tin bāań-bi nee dàkà yii dilaŋkpandi nee sá mbaamɔn dee, yii: «Kibɔkɔ wūliŋkì ki fātìi gíiǹ ki ŋmɔ́», ní «Ugbeeti un bi fùl̄ee fātìi lítì tikpatin ki dɔ̄ ki bíntí.»

english_verse: what God's prophets said would happen. You must never forget what the holy prophets taught in the past. And you must remember what the apostles told you our Lord and Savior has commanded us to do.
translation_verse: M là ní béé tibɔti tin Unimbɔti circir bɔnaatiliibi nìn lī dooooyee, nì tin ti-Dindaan un sá ti-Fiiliuee dūu ŋúbiǹ u-kpambaliŋ dàkā-nee.

english_verse: But first you must realize that in the last days some people won't think about anything except their own selfish desires. They will make fun of you
translation_verse: Ama ní nīn nyí iwinjoolkaa poonee, binib biba làá nyā kí nīn ŋáań min fáatiǹ-bee, ki làá dāá nīn bèel̄-ni,

english_verse: and say, “Didn't your Lord promise to come back? Yet the first leaders have already died, and the world hasn't changed a bit.”
translation_verse: ní ki dāa lì-ni yii: «Kéè, Yeesu Kriisitoo pōoǹ-ni yii u gítińaaa? Kin, doooo nee, u bí la ní kaa bàń? Doooo bitiŋkpikib áli nì díǹ, waa gítìń. Doooo duulinya nín náańee, tin pée bée di gbíntìi bí nee.»

english_verse: They will say this because they want to forget that long ago the heavens and the earth were made at God's command. The earth came out of water and was made from water.
translation_verse: Binib bin sòoǹ mimmee, bi nyí, ama ní ki yíì kaa fōō min Unimbɔti lēe. Unimbɔti nìn sòon̄ u-nyɔkɔn ní kutagbɔŋu nì kitiŋ nyáń. Nì nnyim ní u dūu náań kitiŋ, ní ki gāntì kitiŋ nì nnyim.

english_verse: Later it was destroyed by the waters of a mighty flood.
translation_verse: Nì nnyim mbaantiimee ní u yāntì nnyiŋgbeen dɔ́miń ki kúntì dooooyee duulinyau.

english_verse: But God has commanded the present heavens and earth to remain until the day of judgment. Then they will be set on fire, and ungodly people will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti di tí lī yii yilpu nì taapu un bí nee dɔ̄ ki cí ŋŋmi ń dāá wà daliŋkin u làá dāá sòoǹ binikpitib bɔti kí kúntí-bee.

english_verse: The Lord isn't slow about keeping his promises, as some people think he is. In fact, God is patient, because he wants everyone to turn from sin and no one to be lost.
translation_verse: An kaa sá yii ti-Dindaan sɔ̀m̀ kaa là kí ŋá kii u nín nìn pōoǹ puee, kii biba nín dàkafī puee. Ama u bíi jīǹ ni-pu kimɔtii ki là yii báà ŋma ń kpántí u-bimbim, báà ubɔ ń taa wāŋkì ní.

english_verse: The day of the Lord's return will surprise us like a thief. The heavens will disappear with a loud noise, and the heat will melt the whole universe. Then the earth and everything on it will be seen for what they are.
translation_verse: Ama nì míǹ kɔkɔee, ti-Dindaan dāantam làá dāá túuǹ-ti ní kii unaayuu nín tūuntí binib puee. Kutagbɔŋu dāa gà kuwookpaaŋŋu kubɔ ní kí wāŋkì fílamm, ní tiwan tin bí yilpu kutagbɔŋu puee ń wà búkú buku, ní taapu doo wanti kɔkɔ ń wāŋkì.

english_verse: Everything will be destroyed. So you should serve and honor God by the way you live.
translation_verse: Kii tiwan kɔkɔ nín làá dāá kúntí miŋyee puee, ni máaǹ kí béé ni nín làá bɔ́ntí ni-ba pu kí nīn cáá mbimbimɔntiim kí mɔ̀tīí nīn tɔ́ Unimbɔti mmɔntiimee.

english_verse: You should look forward to the day when God judges everyone, and you should try to make it come soon. On that day the heavens will be destroyed by fire, and everything else will melt in the heat.
translation_verse: Kí nīn cí ŋwiin ŋun Unimbɔti làá dāá dāan̄ee, ŋwiin gbanti ní ŋŋmi làá dāá wà kutagbɔŋu lìblib ní tin kɔkɔ bí yilpuee ń dùntī. An puee pɔ́ɔm̀maan ni-ba án nín làá ŋá pu ŋwiinee ń bàń malaayee.

english_verse: But God has promised us a new heaven and a new earth, where justice will rule. We are really looking forward to this!
translation_verse: Kun puee Unimbɔti pōoǹ yii u làá fàtīí náań-ti kutagbɔmpɔŋu nì kitimpɔŋ. Duulinya gbantinee, bin baba ŋáań Unimbɔti lammee di dāa kíǹ ki bí. Duulinya un ti kā ki cée dee.

english_verse: My friends, while you are waiting, you should make certain the Lord finds you pure, spotless, and living at peace.
translation_verse: Míǹ puee m-nabineeŋkaamu, ŋyunti ŋun ni dáá kā ki cí duulinya gbanti ń bàńee, ní pɔ́ɔm̀maan nì ni-pɔŋŋu nyɔkɔm kí nīn bímaan circir, Unimbɔti ń taa ká ni-pu tiba. Nimbi nì u kansikinee, ŋgbansɔŋfi ń nīn bí.

english_verse: Don't forget that the Lord is patient because he wants people to be saved. This is also what our dear friend Paul said when he wrote you with the wisdom God had given him.
translation_verse: Ní nīn nyí yii ní ŋmā kí ká difiilee pu ní ti-Dindaan bíi jīǹ kimɔtii kaa láá bāań nìn díǹ. Míǹ ní Unimbɔti tīī ti-nabiki Pɔɔl iciin u mun ŋmàn̄-ni an bɔti gbanti.

english_verse: Paul talks about these same things in all his letters, but part of what he says is hard to understand. Some ignorant and unsteady people even destroy themselves by twisting what he said. They do the same thing with other Scriptures too.
translation_verse: U-gbɔnti tin kɔkɔ u ŋmàn̄ee, míǹ ní u sòon̄ an bɔti pu. U nín ŋmàn̄ tiŋyee, ajan aba pɔ̄ɔ̄ bí gbìl̄ taapu malaa, ní binib bin nyil kaa náaǹee nì bin kaa béè Unimbɔti bɔti ki kɔ́ poonee kpántí tibɔti gbanti taapu mbamin, kii bi nín pée tí kpántí Unimbɔti gbɔŋku poon ajan aba puee. An nibee bí ki nyàab̀ mbusu ní ki tòó bi-ba pu.

english_verse: My dear friends, you have been warned ahead of time! So don't let the errors of evil people lead you down the wrong path and make you lose your balance.
translation_verse: Ama nimbee, m-nabineeŋkaamu, kɔŋkɔnnee ti kpáafì-ni, ní nīn nyím̀maan ni-ba, án nín làá ŋá pu ní taa gáatí kí nóó binikpitib bin bí diyìntil poonee kí fá difiil paaŋŋu ŋun poon ni yúee.

english_verse: Let the gift of undeserved grace and the understanding that come from our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ help you keep on growing. Praise Jesus now and forever! Amen.
translation_verse: Ama ní nīn gbíntì ki nìkì ki béetí ti-Dindaan Yeesu Kriisitoo un sá ti-Fiiliuee ki cá, nì u-ŋanti tin u ŋáań-tee poon. Tí tīīmaan-u tinyool kɔŋkɔnnee kí nīn cáa cá jaanjaan! Ameeni.

english_verse: The Word that gives life was from the beginning, and this is the one our message is about. Our ears have heard, our eyes have seen, and our hands have touched this Word.
translation_verse: Ti ŋmàn̄ kugbɔŋu nee kí tùkù-ni dimaŋfal bɔti. Dimaŋfal gbantee nìn pée bí doooo ŋkilkaamin ní. Ti gbìl̄ dì nín nìn sòon̄ puee, ki wál̀-dì nì ti-nimbiliŋ, ki máań-dì nì ti-ŋalii mun.

english_verse: The one who gives life appeared! We saw it happen, and we are witnesses to what we have seen. Now we are telling you about this eternal life that was with the Father and appeared to us.
translation_verse: Dimaŋfal gbanti nyáń mpaampiin pu, ní ti ká-dì. An pu ní ti sòoǹ ki tùkù-ni dimaŋfal din kaa cáá dikúntilee bɔti. Dì nìn bí ti-Baa Unimbɔti cee ní u nyántì-dì ki dàkā-ti.

english_verse: We are telling you what we have seen and heard, so you may share in this life with us. And we share in it with the Father and with his Son Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Míǹ puee tin tin ti kée nì tin ti gbìl̄ee ní ti cáa bíi tùkù ni mun, án nín làá ŋá pu ti nì ni kɔkɔ ń kpántí ubaantee. Kun puee timbi nì ti-Baa Unimbɔti nì u-Jipɔɔn Yeesu Kriisitoo ŋá ubaanti.

english_verse: We are writing to tell you these things, because this makes us truly happy. God Is Light
translation_verse: Ti ŋmà kugbɔŋu nee án nín làá ŋá pu ti-pɔbiliŋ ń mɔ̀tīí pīil̀ee. Unimbɔti sá ŋwalifi ní

english_verse: Jesus told us God is light and doesn't have any darkness in him. Now we are telling you.
translation_verse: Dinyɔɔbundi din ti gbìl̄ Yeesu cee ki cáa tùkù-nee di sá yii Unimbɔti sá ŋwalifi, ní dibɔmbɔndi kpá u-ni báà fiii.

english_verse: If we say we share in life with God and keep on living in the dark, we are lying and are not living by the truth.
translation_verse: Míǹ puee, ti yaa bí yii ti nì u ŋá ubaanti ní ki gbíntìi còom̄ dibɔmbɔndinee, ti mɔ́ntí, taa dī ibaamɔn.

english_verse: But if we live in the light, as God does, we share in life with each other. And the blood of his Son Jesus washes all our sins away.
translation_verse: Ama ti yaa dī ŋwalifi saŋŋu kii Unimbɔti u-ba nín sá ŋwalifi puee, niinee ní ti nì ti-nabiyaamu ŋáań ubaanti, ní u-Jipɔɔn Yeesu fatikuu fíntí ti-pɔbiliŋ circir ki lèekī ti-kpitii kɔkɔ. Tí fá tikpitil

english_verse: If we say we have not sinned, we are fooling ourselves, and the truth isn't in our hearts.
translation_verse: Ti yaa bí yii taa cáá ikpitee, mimmee ti bíi kíiĺ ti-ba ní ibaamɔn kaa bí ti-ni.

english_verse: But if we confess our sins to God, he can always be trusted to forgive us and take our sins away.
translation_verse: Ti yaa bīitì ti-kpitii pu, Unimbɔti sá deedeedaan ki cáá ibaamɔn ki làá dū ti-kpitii kí pɔ̄-ti, kí fíntí tin kɔkɔwoooo bí ti-pɔbiliŋin kaa ŋān̄ee, tí nīn bí circir.

english_verse: If we say we have not sinned, we make God a liar, and his message isn't in our hearts.
translation_verse: Ama ti yaa bí yii taa ŋá ikpitee, mimmee ti yíì Unimbɔti unyimɔndaan dee. An dàkà yii u-nyɔɔbundi kaa bí ti-pɔbiliŋin.

english_verse: My children, I am writing this so you won't sin. But if you do sin, Jesus Christ always does the right thing, and he will speak to the Father for us.
translation_verse: M-biyaamu, m ŋmà-ni tin bí nee án nín làá ŋá pu ní taa ŋá ikpitee. Ama ubɔ yaa jéetì ikpitinee, ti cáá un mɔ́tí ti-puee ti-Baa Unimbɔti cee. Úǹ di sá Yeesu Kriisitoo ibaamɔndaan.

english_verse: Christ is the sacrifice that takes away our sins and the sins of all the world's people.
translation_verse: U dū u-ba ki ŋá saraa ti-kpitii pu. Ama an kaa sá timbi kpitii ŋmaniŋma pu, an sá ki kpáaǹ binib kɔkɔwoooo kpitii pu ní.

english_verse: When we obey God, we are sure we know him.
translation_verse: Ti yaa kpáafí Unimbɔti marabee, niinee ní ti béetí yii ti nyí-u.

english_verse: But if we claim to know him and don't obey him, we are lying and the truth isn't in our hearts.
translation_verse: Un yaa bí yii: «M nyí Unimbɔti,» ama ní kaa ŋúb́ u-marabee sá unyimɔndaan, ibaamɔn kaa bí udaanni.

english_verse: We truly love God only when we obey him as we should, and then we know we belong to him.
translation_verse: Ama sii un di yaa kpáafí Unimbɔti bɔtee, mimmee sii di néeń Unimbɔti tiŋman. An pu ní a béetí yii a bí Unimbɔtin.

english_verse: If we say we are his, we must follow the example of Christ. The New Commandment
translation_verse: Sii un di yaa lī yii a bí Unimbɔtinee, a máaǹ kí nīn còom̄ kii Yeesu u-ba nín nìn còom̄ puee.

english_verse: My dear friends, I am not writing to give you a new commandment. It is the same one you were first given, and it is the message you heard.
translation_verse: M-nabineeŋkaamu, an kaa sá marapɔɔn ubɔ ní m gíti bíi ŋmà-ni, an sá marakpiki un ni nìn pée nyí doooo ŋkilkaaminee ní. An marakpikiuee di sá Unimbɔti bɔti tin ni nìn pée gbìl̄ee.

english_verse: But it really is a new commandment, and you know its true meaning, just as Christ does. You can see the darkness fading away and the true light already shining.
translation_verse: Nì míǹ kɔkɔee, u sá marapɔɔn ní m bíi ŋmà-ni. Ibaamɔn in bí mara un nyánní Yeesunee bí ni mun ni, kun puee dibɔmbɔndi bíi jītí ní ŋwalifimɔnti dɔ́miń ki ŋmíntì ti-pu.

english_verse: If we claim to be in the light and hate someone, we are still in the dark.
translation_verse: Sii un di yaa bí yii a còom̄ ŋwalifin ní ki gbíntìi ná a-nabikee, a dáá gbíntìi bí dibɔmbɔndin.

english_verse: But if we love others, we are in the light, and we don't cause problems for them.
translation_verse: Ama sii un di yaa néeń a-nabikee còom̄ ŋwalifin dee, a kpá kí yàntī ubɔ ń lítí.

english_verse: If we hate others, we are living and walking in the dark. We don't know where we are going, because we can't see in the dark.
translation_verse: Sii un di yaa ná a-nabikee, mimmee a bí dibɔmbɔndin ki còom̄, kaa nyí laakin pú a cée, kun puee dibɔmbɔndi yāntì a jɔ̀b̄.

english_verse: Children, I am writing you, because your sins have been forgiven in the name of Christ.
translation_verse: M-biyaamu, m ŋmà-ni tin bí nee, kun puee Yeesu yindi pu ní ni ká ni-kpitii pɔ̄tam.

english_verse: Parents, I am writing you, because you have known the one who was there from the beginning. Young people, I am writing you, because you have defeated the evil one.
translation_verse: Bibaatiibi, m ŋmà-ni tin bí nee, kun puee ni nyí ti-Dindaan un nìn pée bí doooo ŋkilkaaminee. Binaacimpɔmbi, m ŋmà-ni tin bí nee, kun puee ni jáń ki pɔ́ɔkiǹ Sitaan.

english_verse: Children, I am writing you, because you have known the Father. Parents, I am writing you, because you have known the one who was there from the beginning. Young people, I am writing you, because you are strong. God's message is firm in your hearts, and you have defeated the evil one.
translation_verse: Mbiyaamu, m ŋmàn̄-ni tin bí nee, kun puee ni nyí ti-Baa Unimbɔti. Bibaatiibi, m ŋmàn̄-ni tin bí nee, kun puee ni nyí ti-Dindaan un nìn bí doooo ŋkilkaaminee. Binaacimpɔmbi, m ŋmàn̄-ni tin bí nee, kun puee Unimbɔti bɔti bí ni-ni, ni pɔ̄ɔ̄ ki ŋúń ki jáń ki pɔ́ɔkiǹ Sitaan.

english_verse: Don't love the world or anything that belongs to the world. If you love the world, you cannot love the Father.
translation_verse: Ní taa nín̄ néeń duulinya nì tin u cááyee. Sii un di yaa néeń duulinyee, aa ŋūǹ kí nīn néeń Unimbɔti.

english_verse: Our foolish pride comes from this world, and so do our selfish desires and our desire to have everything we see. None of this comes from the Father.
translation_verse: Kun puee tin kɔkɔ bí duulinyan, an dàkà yii mbimbikpitim kɔdeebi, nì nnimbitaataam, nì unil ń nīn néeń timɔn ki dàkà tigaajatee, tíǹ kɔkɔee kaa nyēeń ti-Baa Unimbɔti cee, an nyēeń duulinyan ní.

english_verse: The world and the desires it causes are disappearing. But if we obey God, we will live forever. The Enemy of Christ
translation_verse: Ní duulinya nì u-nimbitaataam kɔkɔ jītí, ama un di yaa ŋáań min ní Unimbɔti lèe, udaan làá dāá nīn bí ní jaanjaan. Kriisitoo nannanliu

english_verse: Children, this is the last hour. You heard that the enemy of Christ would appear at this time, and many of Christ's enemies have already appeared. So we know the last hour is here.
translation_verse: M-biyaamu, ŋyuntijoolkaa sèé. Kii ni nín gbìl̄ yii Kriisitoo nannanliu dòońee, kɔŋkɔnnee Kriisitoo nannanliibi tikpil pūtì kpáàa bāań. Míǹ pu ní ti béè yii ŋyuntijoolkaa sèé nee.

english_verse: These people came from our own group, yet they were not really part of us. If they had been part of us, they would have stayed with us. But they left, which proves they did not belong to our group.
translation_verse: Ti-kansikin ní binannanliibi gbanti nyáń. Ama baa nìn sá ti-yab, kun puee bi yaa bàà nìn sá ti-yabee, ti-kɔkɔ bàà bímaan mbaantiim ní. An nín ŋá pu nee di dàkà tiŋan yii ti nì bin nìn bée, bi-kɔkɔ kaa nìn sá ti-yab.

english_verse: Christ, the Holy One, has blessed you, and now all of you understand.
translation_verse: Ama nimbee, ti-Dindaan circirdaan sītì ni-pu Circir Fam, an di yì-tì ní ni-kɔkɔ nyí ibaamɔn.

english_verse: I did not need to write you about the truth, since you already know it. You also know that liars do not belong to the truth.
translation_verse: Míǹ puee, m yaa ŋmàn̄-ni tin bí neeyee, kaa sá yii naa nyí ibaamɔn, ni nyí-i, ki béè yii ibaamɔn poonee, baa kāntí nnyimɔn báà ŋubɔ.

english_verse: And a liar is anyone who says Jesus isn't truly Christ. Anyone who says this is an enemy of Christ and rejects both the Father and the Son.
translation_verse: Ŋma di sá unyimɔndaan an yaa kaa sá un néè yii Yeesu kaa sá Kriisitooyee? Udaan di sá Kriisitoo nannanliu kaa là Ubaati, kaa là u-Jipɔɔn mun.

english_verse: If we reject the Son, we reject the Father. But if we say we accept the Son, we have the Father.
translation_verse: Un di yaa kaa là Unimbɔti Jipɔɔn Yeesuee, kaa fōō u-Baa mun dee, ama un di yaa lì binib nimbiin yii Yeesu sá Ubaati Jipɔɔnee fōō Ubaati u-ba mun dee.

english_verse: Keep thinking about the message you first heard, and you will always be one in your heart with the Son and with the Father.
translation_verse: Míǹ puee, tin tin ní ni nìn pée gbìl̄ doooo ŋkilkaaminee, ní kpāafìmaan-tì ni-pɔbiliŋin. Sii un yaa kpáafì tin ní a pée gbìl̄ doooo ŋkilkaaminee, mimmee sii ŋá ubaanti nì ti-Baa Unimbɔti nì u-Jipɔɔn dee.

english_verse: The Son has promised us eternal life.
translation_verse: Dipoondi din Yeesu pōoǹ-tee di sá dimaŋfal din kaa cáá dikúntilee.

english_verse: I am writing to warn you about those people who are misleading you.
translation_verse: M ŋmàn̄ tin bí nee kí sòoǹ nì ni bin là kí ŋmàtiǹ-nee pu.

english_verse: But Christ has blessed you with the Holy Spirit. Now the Spirit stays in you, and you don't need any teachers. The Spirit is truthful and teaches you everything. So stay one in your heart with Christ, just as the Spirit has taught you to do. Children of God
translation_verse: Ama nimbee, Yeesu sītì ni-pu u-Fam. An puee, an kaa ti bàlifī ubɔ ń dàkà-ni. Kun puee u-Famee di dàkà-ni tikɔkɔ, ní tin ní u dàkèe sá ibaamɔn, nnyimɔn kpá poon. Míǹ puee, ní kpāafìmaan u-Fam nín dàkà-ni puee, ni nì Yeesu ń nīn sá ubaanti.

english_verse: Children, stay one in your hearts with Christ. Then when he returns, we will have confidence and won't have to hide in shame.
translation_verse: M-biyaamu, ní nīn bí Yeesu cee, án nín làá ŋá pu ŋyunti ŋun u yaa láa páaǹnée, tí dāá nīn cáá kunyannyaau kí yūĺ u-nimbiin kí taa nín̄ cáá icoo daliŋkin u làá bàńee.

english_verse: You know Christ always does right and everyone who does right is a child of God.
translation_verse: Míǹ puee, ni yaa nyí yii u sá deedeedaanee, béémaan yii un sá kamaa yaa nóó deedeeyee, Unimbɔti di fātìi màl̄ udaan mpɔm.

english_verse: Think how much the Father loves us. He loves us so much that he lets us be called his children, as we truly are. But since the people of this world did not know who Christ is, they don't know who we are.
translation_verse: Ní kpèèmaan ti-Baa Unimbɔti nín cáá ti-pu dineeŋkpaandi diŋyee! Di sá yii u yíì-ti u-biyaamu. Míǹ ní tiŋman ti lafun sá u-biyaamu. Kun pu duulinya kaa nyí-tee di sá waa béè Unimbɔti.

english_verse: My dear friends, we are already God's children, though what we will be hasn't yet been seen. But we do know when Christ returns, we will be like him, because we will see him as he truly is.
translation_verse: M-nabineeŋkaamu, kí yòon̄ díǹ kí nīn cée, ti kpántì Unimbɔti biyaamu. Ti nín làá dāá nīn bí miŋyee kaa láá nyáń mpaampiin pu. Ama ti nyí yii ŋyunti ŋun ti-Dindaan yaa láa páaǹnée, ti làá dāá nīn bí kii u nín bí puee ní, kun puee ti làá dāá ká-u kí béé un ní u baasii sée.

english_verse: This hope makes us keep ourselves holy, just as Christ is holy.
translation_verse: Sii un di yaa cáá dimákal gbanti Yeesunee bɔ́ntí a-pɔbil circir, kii a-Dindaan u-ba nín bí pu circiree ní.

english_verse: Everyone who sins breaks God's law, because sin is the same as breaking God's law.
translation_verse: Un yaa ŋá ikpitee yīntì marab dee, di sá yii marab yìntitam di sá ikpiti.

english_verse: You know Christ came to take away our sins. He isn't sinful,
translation_verse: Ni nyí yii Kriisitoo dɔ́miń kí lēē binib kpitii ní, ní úǹ u-ba kaa cáá ikpiti.

english_verse: and people who stay one in their hearts with him won't keep on sinning. If they do keep on sinning, they don't know Christ, and they have never seen him.
translation_verse: Sii un nì Kriisitoo yaa ŋá ubaantee kaa ti ŋáań ikpiti, ama sii un di yaa ŋáań ikpitee kaa ká-uaaa, kaa nyí-u mun.

english_verse: Children, don't be fooled. Anyone who does right is good, just like Christ himself.
translation_verse: M-biyaamu, ní taa yàntī ubɔ ń ŋmàtiǹ-ni. Un yaa ŋáań min bí deedeeyee sá deedeedaan, kii ti-Dindaan u-ba nín bí deedee puee.

english_verse: Anyone who keeps on sinning belongs to the devil. He has sinned from the beginning, but the Son of God came to destroy all that he has done.
translation_verse: Ama un yaa ŋáań ikpitee sá Sitaan yɔu, kun puee Sitaan pée sá ikpitidaan ní doooo ŋkilkaamin. An pu ní Unimbɔti Jipɔɔn dɔ́miń ki kpītì Sitaan tuuŋŋi.

english_verse: God's children cannot keep on being sinful. His life-giving power lives in them and makes them his children, so they cannot keep on sinning.
translation_verse: Sii un Unimbɔti yaa fātìi màl̄ mpɔmee kaa ti ŋáań ikpiti, kun puee a náań nì a-Baa un màl̄-see. Aa ti ŋūǹ kí nīn ŋáań ikpiti, kun puee Unimbɔti di fātìi màl̄-si mpɔm.

english_verse: You can tell God's children from the devil's children, because those who belong to the devil refuse to do right or to love each other. Love Each Other
translation_verse: Kun gàntī Unimbɔti biyaamu nì Sitaan yɔmuee di sá, sii un yaa kaa ŋáań tin bí deedeeyee nì sii un yaa kaa néeń a-nabikee kaa sá Unimbɔti yɔu. Tí nīn néeń tɔb

english_verse: From the beginning you were told we must love each other.
translation_verse: Dinyɔɔbundi din ni nìn gbìl̄ doooo ŋkilkaaminee tùkū-ti yii tí nīn néeń tɔb.

english_verse: Don't be like Cain, who belonged to the devil and murdered his own brother. Why did he murder him? He did it because his brother was good, and he was evil.
translation_verse: Tí taa nín̄ bí kii Kayeen nín nìn bí puee. Úǹ nìn sá Sitaan niliu ní, ní ki kūū u-naal. Ba pu ní u nìn kūū u-naal míǹ? Kun pu u nìn kūū-uee di sá Kayeen tuuŋŋi sá akpiti, ní u-naal tuuŋŋi sá deedee yaŋ.

english_verse: My friends, don't be surprised if the people of this world hate you.
translation_verse: Nnabiyaamu, duulinya yaa ná-nee, an taa bàkatīǹ-ni.

english_verse: Our love for each other proves we have gone from death to life. But if you don't love each other, you are still under the power of death.
translation_verse: Ti nyí yii ti nyáń ŋkúmin ki póotì dimaŋfalin, kun puee ti néeń ti-nabiyaamu. Un yaa kaa néeń u-nabikee dáá gbíntìi bí ŋkúmin.

english_verse: If you hate each other, you are murderers, and we know murderers do not have eternal life.
translation_verse: Un yaa kaa néeń u-nabikee sá unikpɔl ní, ní ni nyí yii unikpɔl báà ubɔ kaa cáá dimaŋfal din kaa cáá dikúntilee u-ni.

english_verse: We know what love is because Jesus gave his life for us. This is why we must give our lives for each other.
translation_verse: Kun di yì-tì ti béè dineendi nín sá kuŋyee di sá Yeesu nín dū u-maŋfal ki tīī ti-puee. Míǹ mun mbaantiim ní ti mun máaǹ kí dū ti-maŋfal kí tīī ti-nabiyaamu pu.

english_verse: If we have all we need and see one of our own people in need, we must have pity on that person, or else we cannot say we love God.
translation_verse: Ubɔ yaa cáá ŋŋmam duulinya nee poon, ní ki ká u-nabiki bí falaani, ní u ŋmí, kaa tīī-u tibee, mimmee ba di dàkà yii Unimbɔti neendi bí udaan ni?

english_verse: Children, you show love for others by truly helping them, and not merely by talking about it.
translation_verse: M-biyaamu, tí taa nín̄ lì nì ti-nyɔmmun fám yii ti néeń tɔb, ama tí yàntī ti-tuuŋŋi ń dàkà ibaamɔn yii ti lafun cáá dineendi. Min ní ti làá ká dimákalee

english_verse: When we love others, we know we belong to the truth, and we feel at ease in the presence of God.
translation_verse: Míǹ ní ti dùú béé yii ti sá ibaamɔn nib, ní ki kāntí dipɔɔsɔŋkil Unimbɔti nimbiin.

english_verse: But even if we don't feel at ease, God is greater than our feelings, and he knows everything.
translation_verse: Báà ti-pɔbiliŋ yaa máfí yii ti sá binikpitibee, Unimbɔti jítiǹ ti-pɔbiliŋ ki nyí tikɔkɔ mun.

english_verse: Dear friends, if we feel at ease in the presence of God, we will have the courage to come near him.
translation_verse: M-nabineeŋkaamu, sii un pɔbil yaa kaa tí máfí yii a ŋá tibee, mimmee a cáá dimákal Unimbɔti nimbiin dee.

english_verse: He will give us whatever we ask, because we obey him and do what pleases him.
translation_verse: Báà tin sá kamaa ní a yaa mēē-uee u làá tīī-si kudɔŋu, kun puee a kpáafí u-marab ki ŋáań min fáatì-uee.

english_verse: God wants us to have faith in his Son Jesus Christ and to love each other. This is also what Jesus taught us to do.
translation_verse: Mara un u tīī-tee di sá tí fōō u-Jipɔɔn Yeesu Kriisitoo kí kíí, kí nīn néeń tɔb, kii Yeesu u-ba nín bí yii tí nīn néeń tɔb puee.

english_verse: If we obey God's commandments, we will stay one in our hearts with him, and he will stay one with us. The Spirit he has given us is proof that we are one with him.
translation_verse: Un di yaa kpáafí u-marab gbantee, udaan ŋá ubaanti nì Unimbɔti, ní Unimbɔti bí udaanni. Kun pu ní ti nyí yii u bí ti-nee di sá u-Fam min u tīī-tee pu.

english_verse: Dear friends, don't believe everyone who claims to have the Spirit of God. Test them all to find out if they really do come from God. Many false prophets have already gone out into the world,
translation_verse: M-nabineeŋkaamu, ní taa nín̄ máká bin kɔkɔ lì yii bi cáá Ŋfamee, ama ní cɔ̄ŋkì kí dáań kí kpèè yii an sá Unimbɔti Famaaa, an kaa sá. Di sá yii nnyimɔn bɔnaatiliibi gbóotì duulinyan tikpil.

english_verse: and you can know which ones come from God. His Spirit says that Jesus Christ had a truly human body.
translation_verse: Kun di làá yàntī ní béé un Unimbɔti Fam kpòotēe di sá un di yaa lì nì ibaamɔn yii Yeesu Kriisitoo kpántì unil ki dɔ́miń duulinyanee, mimmee Unimbɔti Fam di yāntì udaan sòon̄.

english_verse: But when someone doesn't say this about Jesus, you know this person has a spirit that doesn't come from God and is the enemy of Christ. You knew this enemy was coming into the world and now is already here.
translation_verse: Un yaa yíì ki bí yii Yeesu kaa kpántì unil ki dɔ́miń duulinyanee, an kaa sá Unimbɔti Fam di yāntì udaan sòon̄, an sá Kriisitoo nannanliu fam. Ni nìn pée gbìl̄ yii unannanli gbanti làá dāan̄, ama u pūtì kpáàa bāań ki bí duulinyan.

english_verse: Children, you belong to God, and you have defeated these enemies. God's Spirit is in you and is more powerful than the one who is in the world.
translation_verse: M-biyaamu, nimbi sá Unimbɔti yab ní, an pu ní ni jáń ki pɔ́ɔkiǹ bin mɔ́ntí yii bi sá Unimbɔti bɔnaatiliibee. Kun puee Unimbɔti Fam min bí ni-nee pɔ̄ɔ̄ ki jítiǹ Sitaan un bí duulinyanee.

english_verse: These enemies belong to this world, and the world listens to them, because they speak its language.
translation_verse: Binyimɔndambi gbantee, bíǹ sá duulinya yab ní. Bi sòoǹ tin duulinya nyée ní, míǹ pu ní an mɔ̄ǹ duulinya yab pílifíǹ-bi.

english_verse: We belong to God, and everyone who knows God will listen to us. But the people who don't know God won't listen to us. This is how we can tell the Spirit that speaks the truth from the one that tells lies.
translation_verse: Ama timbi sá Unimbɔti yab ní. Un yaa nyí Unimbɔtee di pílifíǹ-ti. Un kaa là kí pīlifiǹ-tee kaa sá Unimbɔti yɔu. An di yì-tì ní ti ŋūǹ kí gàntī Unimbɔti Fam min sá ibaamɔnee nì Sitaan yam min mɔ́ntée. Unimbɔti di sá dineendi

english_verse: My dear friends, we must love each other. Love comes from God, and when we love each other, it shows we have been given new life. We are now God's children, and we know him.
translation_verse: M-nabineeŋkaamu, tí nīn néeń tɔb, kun puee dineendi nyēeń Unimbɔti cee ní. Mimmee, sii un yaa cáá dineendee di sá un Unimbɔti fātìi màl̄ mpɔmee, ki nyí Unimbɔti mun.

english_verse: God is love, and anyone who doesn't love others has never known him.
translation_verse: Sii un yaa kaa cáá dineendee kaa nyí Unimbɔti, kun puee Unimbɔti di sá dineendi.

english_verse: God showed his love for us when he sent his only Son into the world to give us life.
translation_verse: Kun yāntì ti ká dineendi din u cáá ti-puee di sá u dū u-Jipɔmbaabil ki túnní duulinyan, tí ŋmā kí ká dimaŋfal u-pu.

english_verse: Real love isn't our love for God, but his love for us. God sent his Son to be the sacrifice by which our sins are forgiven.
translation_verse: Kaa sá timbi di péé ki néeń Unimbɔti, an sá Unimbɔti di péé ki néeń timbi, ní ki dū u-Jipɔɔn ki túnní ú kpú tí ká ti-kpitii pɔ̄tam, míǹ di dàkà dineendi.

english_verse: Dear friends, since God loved us this much, we must love each other.
translation_verse: M-nabineeŋkaamu, Unimbɔti yaa néeń-ti míǹ bulifee, ti mun máaǹ kí nīn néeń tɔb.

english_verse: No one has ever seen God. But if we love each other, God lives in us, and his love is truly in our hearts.
translation_verse: Ubɔ kaa pée ká Unimbɔti dalba, ama ti yaa néeń tɔbee, Unimbɔti bí ti-ni, ní u-neendee bí ti-ni tiŋman.

english_verse: God has given us his Spirit. This is how we know we are one with him, just as he is one with us.
translation_verse: Kun di yì-tì ti béè yii ti ŋá ubaanti nì Unimbɔti, ní Unimbɔti bí ti-nee, di sá u-Fam min u tīī-tee pu,

english_verse: God sent his Son to be the Savior of the world. We saw his Son and are now telling others about him.
translation_verse: ní ti ká ki béè, ki kíǹ ki tùkù binib yii ti-Baa Unimbɔti dū u-Jipɔɔn ki túnní ú dāan̄ kí nīn sá duulinya Fiiliu.

english_verse: God stays one with everyone who openly says Jesus is the Son of God. This is how we stay one with God
translation_verse: Sii un di yaa lì nì ibaamɔn yii Yeesu sá Unimbɔti Jipɔɔnee, Unimbɔti bí a-ni ní si nì u ŋá ubaanti.

english_verse: and are sure God loves us. God is love. If we keep on loving others, we will stay one in our hearts with God, and he will stay one with us.
translation_verse: Timbi béè dineendi din Unimbɔti cáá ti-puee ní ki fōō-dì ki kíí. Di sá yii Unimbɔti di sá dineendi, un yaa cáá dineendee, udaan nì Unimbɔti ŋá ubaanti, ní Unimbɔti bí udaanni.

english_verse: If we truly love others and live as Christ did in this world, we won't be worried about the day of judgment.
translation_verse: Kun di dàkà yii a néeń-u tiŋmanee di sá, daliŋkin Yeesu làá dāá sòoǹ binib bɔtee, sii dāa cáá dimákal u-nimbiin ní, kun puee a-bimbim min a bí duulinya nee nee nì u-yam náań.

english_verse: A real love for others will chase those worries away. The thought of being punished is what makes us afraid. It shows we have not really learned to love.
translation_verse: Sii un cáá dineendee kaa fàŋkí, kun puee dineembaamɔndi jì tifaandi ní. Ditafadaaldi di cāabìń tifaandi, míǹ puee, sii un cáá tifaandi a-nee kaa cáá dineembaamɔndi dee.

english_verse: We love because God loved us first.
translation_verse: Kun pu timbi cáá dineendee di sá úǹ di péé ki néeń timbi.

english_verse: But if we say we love God and don't love each other, we are liars. We cannot see God. So how can we love God, if we don't love the people we can see?
translation_verse: Ubɔ yaa bí yii: «M néeń Unimbɔti», ní ki yaa ná u-nabikee, udaan sá unyimɔndaan. A yaa kaa néeń a-nabiki kin a wāĺee, a làá ŋá mana ní kí nīn néeń Unimbɔti un saa wāĺee?

english_verse: The commandment that God has given us is: “Love God and love each other!”
translation_verse: Mara un Yeesu tīī-tee sèé yii, sii un yaa néeń Unimbɔtee máaǹ kí nīn néeń a-nabiki mun.

english_verse: If we believe Jesus is truly Christ, we are God's children. Everyone who loves the Father will also love his children.
translation_verse: Un sá kamaa yaa fōō ki kíí yii Yeesu sá Kriisitooyee, Unimbɔti di fātìi màl̄ udaan mpɔm. Un di yaa tí néeń Ubaatee néeń u-biyaamu mun ní.

english_verse: If we love and obey God, we know we will love his children.
translation_verse: Min ní ti béetí yii ti néeń Unimbɔti biyaamuee di sá ti yaa néeń Unimbɔti ki kpáafí u-marabee.

english_verse: We show our love for God by obeying his commandments, and they are not hard to follow.
translation_verse: Tí nīn néeń Unimbɔtee taapu di sá yii tí nīn kpáafí u-marab. U-marab gbanti mun kaa pɔ̄ɔ̄,

english_verse: Every child of God can defeat the world, and our faith is what gives us this victory.
translation_verse: kun puee un sá kamaa ní Unimbɔti fātìi màl̄ mpɔmee ŋūǹ kí já kí pɔ̄ɔkiǹ duulinya. Kun pu ní a ŋūǹ kí já kí pɔ̄ɔkiǹ duulinyee di sá fookii un a cáá Yeesu puee.

english_verse: No one can defeat the world without having faith in Jesus as the Son of God. Who Jesus Is
translation_verse: Ŋma di ŋūǹ kí já kí pɔ̄ɔkiǹ duulinya an yaa kaa sá sii un yaa fōō ki kíí yii Yeesu sá Unimbɔti Jipɔɔnee? Seera un bi lēē Yeesu Kriisitoo puee

english_verse: Water and blood came out from the side of Jesus Christ. It wasn't just water, but water and blood. The Spirit tells about this, because the Spirit is truthful.
translation_verse: An sá úǹ Yeesu Kriisitoo di dɔ́miń duulinyan nì nnyim nì fatiku. An kaa sá nì nnyim ŋmaniŋma, ama an sá nì nnyim nì fatiku ní. Ní Unimbɔti Fam mun lèekī seera yii an sá míǹ, kun puee mì sá mbaamɔn ní.

english_verse: They are the Spirit, the water, and the blood, and they all agree.
translation_verse: Ŋfam nì nnyim nì fatiku, ní bi-taatilee kpáfì ki lèekī seerabaanti.

english_verse: We believe what people tell us. But we can trust what God says even more, and God is the one who has spoken about his Son.
translation_verse: Ti yaa fòol̄ binib seerau ki kíikée, an máaǹ tí fōō Unimbɔti seerau kí kíí, kun puee Unimbɔti seerau pɔ̄ɔ̄ ki jítiǹ unil yɔu.

english_verse: If we have faith in God's Son, we have believed what God has said. But if we don't believe what God has said about his Son, it is the same as calling God a liar.
translation_verse: Un yaa fōō Unimbɔti Jipɔɔn ki kííyee cáá seera gbanti u-pɔbilin. Un yaa kaa fōō seera un Unimbɔti lēē u-Jipɔɔn puee ki kííyee, udaan kaa fōō Unimbɔti ki kíí ki yíì-u unyimɔndaan.

english_verse: God has also said he gave us eternal life and this life comes to us from his Son.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti nín lī puee sèé yii, u tīī-ti dimaŋfal din kaa cáá dikúntilee. Dimaŋfal gbanti bí u-Jipɔɔn cee ní.

english_verse: And so, if we have God's Son, we have this life. But if we don't have the Son, we don't have this life. Knowing about Eternal Life
