translation_verse: Un yaa fōō u-Jipɔɔnee cáá dimaŋfal, un yaa kaa fōō u-Jipɔɔnee kaa cáá dimaŋfal. Dimaŋfal din kaa cáá dikúntilee bɔti

english_verse: All of you have faith in the Son of God, and I have written to let you know you have eternal life.
translation_verse: Nimbi bin fōō Unimbɔti Jipɔɔn ki kííyee, m ŋmàn̄-ni tin bí nee ní béé yii ni cáá dimaŋfal din kaa cáá dikúntilee.

english_verse: We are certain God will hear our prayers when we ask for what pleases him.
translation_verse: Ti cáá dipɔbil kí cù u-cee, di sá yii ti yaa mēē-u tiba ní an yaa sá min ní u lèe, u làá pīlifiǹ-ti.

english_verse: And if we know God listens when we pray, we are sure our prayers have already been answered.
translation_verse: Míǹ puee, ti yaa nyí yii u pílifíǹ-tee, tin kɔkɔwoooo ti yaa mēē-uee, tí béé yii ti fōō kudɔŋu.

english_verse: Suppose you see one of our people commit a sin that isn't a deadly sin. You can pray, and this person will be given eternal life. But the sin must not be one that is deadly.
translation_verse: Ubɔ yaa ká u-nabiki bíi ŋáań ikpiti in kaa cáǹ-u ŋkúminee, udaan ń mèè, Unimbɔti làá tīī u-nabiki gbanti dimaŋfal. Bin pu m sòoǹee di sá bin ŋáań ikpiti in kaa cáǹ-bi ŋkúminee, kun puee ikpiti iba cáǹ unil ŋkúmin. Kaa sá un ŋá ikpiti gbantee pu ní m bí yii ní mèè.

english_verse: Everything that is wrong is sin, but not all sins are deadly.
translation_verse: Tin kɔkɔ kaa bí deedeeyee sá ikpiti ní, ama ní ikpiti iba bí kaa cāabìń ŋkúm.

english_verse: We are sure God's children do not keep on sinning. God's own Son protects them, and the devil cannot harm them.
translation_verse: Ti nyí yii un sá kamaa Unimbɔti fātìi màl̄ mpɔmee kaa ŋáań ikpiti, kun puee Unimbɔti Jipɔɔn mɔ́tí u-pu, Sitaan Ukpiti kaa ŋūǹ kí ŋá-u tiba.

english_verse: We are certain we come from God and the rest of the world is under the power of the devil.
translation_verse: Ti nyí yii ti sá Unimbɔti yab, ní Ukpiti tɔ́kɔ́ duulinya kɔkɔ pu.

english_verse: We know that Jesus Christ the Son of God has come and has shown us the true God. And because of Jesus, we now belong to the true God who gives eternal life.
translation_verse: Ti tí nyí mun yii Unimbɔti Jipɔɔn dɔ́miń ki tīī-ti iciin tí ŋmā kí béé ibaamɔn Nimbɔtiu, ní timbi nì Unimbɔti ibaamɔndaanee nì Yeesu Kriisitoo u-Jipɔɔn mun ŋá ubaanti. Úǹ di sá Unimbɔti ibaamɔn, ki sá dimaŋfal din kaa cáá dikúntilee.

english_verse: Children, you must stay away from idols.
translation_verse: M-biyaamu, ní nīn nyí nì ni-ba kí taa nóó duulinya nimbɔtii.

english_verse: From the church leader. To a very special woman and her children. I truly love all of you, and so does everyone else who knows the truth.
translation_verse: An sá man Ukpil di jáaḿ sii ti-Na un Unimbɔti lútèe nì a-biyaamu. Ibaamɔn, m néeń ni-kɔkɔ. An kaa sá man baba di néeń-ni, an sá ki kpáaǹ bin kɔkɔ béè ibaamɔnee,

english_verse: We love you because the truth is now in our hearts, and it will be there forever.
translation_verse: kun puee ibaamɔn bí ti-ni ki làá nīn pée bí kí nīn cá jaanjaan.

english_verse: I pray that God the Father and Jesus Christ his Son will be kind and merciful to us! May they give us peace and truth and love. Truth and Love
translation_verse: Ti-Baa Unimbɔti nì Yeesu Kriisitoo, Ubaati Jipɔɔn ń ŋá-ti tiŋan, kí sɔ̄ ti-saai, kí tīī-ti ŋgbansɔŋfi, tí nīn cáá ibaamɔn kí nīn néeń tɔb. Ibaamɔn nì dineendi

english_verse: I was very glad to learn that some of your children are obeying the truth, as the Father told us to do.
translation_verse: An mɔ́ɔkiǹ-mi tikpil m nín ká a-biyaamu mubɔ nóó ibaamɔnee, kii ti-Baa Unimbɔti nín tīī-ti mara uŋyee.

english_verse: Dear friend, I am not writing to tell you and your children to do something you have not done before. I am writing to tell you to love each other, which is the first thing you were told to do.
translation_verse: Kɔŋkɔnnee, ti-Na, m gbàam̄-si, tí nīn néeḿmaan tɔb. Dinyɔɔbundi gbanti kaa sá marapɔɔn, an sá mara un ti nìn pée fōō doooo ŋkilkaaminee ní.

english_verse: Love means we do what God tells us. And from the beginning, he told you to love him.
translation_verse: Dineendi taapu di sá tí nóó Unimbɔti marab. Kii ni nín gbìl̄ doooo ŋkilkaamin puee, mara gbanti di sá tí nīn cáá dineendi.

english_verse: Many liars have gone out into the world. These deceitful liars are saying Jesus Christ did not have a truly human body. But they are liars and the enemies of Christ.
translation_verse: Kun puee biŋmatinliibi gbóotì duulinyan ki yíì, kaa fōō ki kíí yii Yeesu Kriisitoo kpántì unil ki dɔ́miń duulinyan. Un néè mimmee di sá uŋmatinli ki sá Kriisitoo nannanliu.

english_verse: So be sure not to lose what we have worked for. If you do, you won't be given your full reward.
translation_verse: Míǹ puee, ní nīn nyí nì ni-ba, ní taa fá ti-tundi nín cáań ipaati iŋyee, án nín làá ŋá pu ní dāá ŋmā kí fōō ni-paati kɔkɔee.

english_verse: Don't keep changing what you were taught about Christ, or else God will no longer be with you. But if you hold firmly to what you were taught, both the Father and the Son will be with you.
translation_verse: Un di yaa lákatì, kaa là kí nīn ŋúb́ Kriisitoo bɔtee, kaa nyí Unimbɔti, ama un yaa ŋúb́ tibɔti gbantee, úǹ di nyí ti-Baa Unimbɔti nì u-Jipɔɔn.

english_verse: If people won't agree to this teaching, don't welcome them into your home or even greet them.
translation_verse: Míǹ puee, un yaa dɔ́miń kaa cáań-ni tibɔti gbantee, ní taa fōō-u ni-dumpu kí taa jāam̀-u gba,

english_verse: Greeting them is the same as taking part in their evil deeds. Final Greetings
translation_verse: kun puee, un yaa jáam̀-uee mun ŋmàl̄ atuŋkpiti ŋin udaan tūǹee ni dee. Tibɔkuntikaal

english_verse: I have much more to tell you, but I don't want to write it with pen and ink. I want to come and talk to you in person, because this will make us really happy.
translation_verse: Tibɔti tikpil bàà bí ḿ sòoǹ nì ni, ama maa là kí dūú ŋmà kugbɔŋu poon, kun puee m là kí dāan̄ ni-cee niin kí sòoǹ nì ni ní, án mɔ̀tīí mɔ̄ɔkiǹ man nì ni.

english_verse: Greetings from the children of your very special sister.
translation_verse: A-Naal un Unimbɔti lútèe biyaamu mun jáaḿ-si.

english_verse: From the church leader. To my dear friend Gaius. I love you because we follow the truth,
translation_verse: An sá man Ukpil di ŋmàn̄ kugbɔŋu nee kí jāam̀ m-nabineeŋkaaki Gaayusi, un m néeń nì ibaamɔnee.

english_verse: dear friend, and I pray all goes well for you. I hope you are as strong in body, as I know you are in spirit.
translation_verse: M-nabineeŋkaaki, m mèé yii tikɔkɔ ń còom̀-si tiŋan á nīn cáá ŋgbampɔn kii a-naŋki nín cáá ŋgbampɔn puee.

english_verse: It makes me very happy when the Lord's followers come by and speak openly of how you obey the truth.
translation_verse: An mɔ́ɔkiǹ-mi tikpil nnabiyaamu nín bāań ki tùkū-mi a nín ŋúb́ ibaamɔn an píkí puee, kii a nín pée còom̄ ibaamɔn poon puee.

english_verse: Nothing brings me greater happiness than to hear that my children are obeying the truth. Working Together
translation_verse: Tiba kaa ti bí ki mɔ̄ǹ-mi ki bàn̄ ḿ gbìl̄ yii m-biyaamu bí ki còom̄ ibaamɔn saŋŋu poon, án mɔ́ɔkíǹ-mi tikpil ní. Yoowaneesi pàkà Gaayusi

english_verse: Dear friend, you have always been faithful in helping other followers of the Lord, even the ones you didn't know before.
translation_verse: Kinabineeŋkaai, a nín tūǹ atummɔnti ŋin ki tìì nnabiyaamu ki kpáaǹ bin sá-si binicambee gbee, a lafun dàkā yii a fōō ki kíí tiŋman pu.

english_verse: They have told the church about your love. They say you were good enough to welcome them and to send them on their mission in a way God's servants deserve.
translation_verse: Bi bāańee, bi máafì a-neendi gbanti pu Kriisitoo nikitil kɔkɔ nimbiin. Mimmee, m mèé-si, á tūtuǹ-bi bi-saŋŋu gbanti poon min làá fáatíǹ Unimbɔtee.

english_verse: When they left to tell others about the Lord, they decided not to accept help from anyone who wasn't a follower.
translation_verse: Di sá yii Yeesu tundi pu ní bi còom̄ nsan, kaa fōō tiba bin kaa nyí Unimbɔtee cee.

english_verse: We must support people like them, so we can take part in what they are doing to spread the truth.
translation_verse: An puee, bi yaa bāań ti-ceeyee, ti máaǹ kí tūtuǹ binib gbanti. Mimmee, ti mun kútì bi-pu ki cáá ibaamɔn tundi ki cáǹ nyɔkɔpu dee. Diyootreefi nì Deemeetriyusi

english_verse: I wrote to the church. But Diotrephes likes to be the number-one leader, and he won't pay any attention to us.
translation_verse: M nìn ŋmàn̄ kugbɔŋu ki tīī Kriisitoo nikitil ki sòon̄ nì bi kibɔgiŋ, ama Diyootreefi là kí nīn sá bi-kpiliu ní kaa là kí pīlifì tin man sòoǹee.

english_verse: So if I come, I will remind him of how he has been attacking us with gossip. Not only has he been doing this, but he refuses to welcome any of the Lord's followers who come by. And when other church members want to welcome them, he puts them out of the church.
translation_verse: U gífí inyimɔn nì tibɔkpitil ki tūntí ti-pu. Míǹ kɔkɔ kaa yá ki kɔ́-u, kun puee u yíití kaa fòol̄ nnabiyaamu mun jītí u-ceeyee mun, ní bin yaa bàà là kí fōō-bee, u pìintí-bi nsan ki là kí nyāntí-bi Kriisitoo nikitil kansikin. Míǹ puee, m yaa láa bāańee, m làá dāá kàaǹ tin kɔkɔwoooo u ŋáańee binib nimbiin.

english_verse: Dear friend, don't imitate the evil deeds of others, but follow the example of people who do kind deeds. They are God's children, but those who are always doing evil have never seen God.
translation_verse: M-nabineeŋkaaki, á taa nóó binib bin ŋáań tikpitilee tabɔbiliŋ, ama nín̄ nóó bin ŋáań tiŋanee tabɔbiliŋ. Un ŋáań tiŋanee di sá Unimbɔti niliu, un ŋáań tikpitilee kaa nyí Unimbɔti.

english_verse: Everyone speaks well of Demetrius, and so does the true message that he teaches. I also speak well of him, and you know what I say is true. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Ama Deemeetriyusi ní báà ŋma pàkà, ní ibaamɔn bɔti tin tin u bí ki sòoǹee mun pàkà-u, ní ti mun pàkà-u. Sii a-ba nyí yii tin ti yaa lēe sá ibaamɔn ní. Tibɔkuntikaal

english_verse: I have much more to say to you, but I don't want to write it with pen and ink.
translation_verse: M bàà cáá tibɔti tikpil kí sòoǹ nì si, ama maa là kí dū ŋgbaŋŋmamɔɔn kí ŋmà.

english_verse: I hope to see you soon, and then we can talk in person.
translation_verse: Kun puee m là kí dāan̄ a-cee iwiin ili nee poon, niin ní ti dāa ŋūǹ kí kàl̄ kí sòoǹ tikɔkɔ.

english_verse: I pray that God will bless you with peace! Your friends send their greetings. Please give a personal greeting to each of our friends.
translation_verse: Unimbɔti ń tīī-si ŋgbansɔŋfi. A-bɔɔbi jáaḿ-si. Á jāam̀ ti-bɔɔbi kɔkɔ kí tīī-mi.

english_verse: My dear friends, I really wanted to write you about God's saving power at work in our lives. But instead, I must write and ask you to defend the faith that God has once for all given to his people.
translation_verse: M-nabineeŋkaamu, m nìn baasii mɔ̀ kí ŋmàń-ni difiil din ti-kɔkɔ ká nee bɔti. M dāa lafun kpēēyee, an pée sá yii ḿ ŋmàń-ni kí tīiń-ni kunyannyaau ní ŋmā kí nīn jáà ibaamɔn in Unimbɔti dūu tīī u-yab iaa bí kí kpántée pu.

english_verse: Some godless people have sneaked in among us and are saying, “God treats us much better than we deserve, and so it is all right to be immoral.” They even deny we must obey Jesus Christ as our only Master and Lord. But long ago the Scriptures warned that these godless people were doomed.
translation_verse: Di sá yii binib biba bin kaa tɔ́ Unimbɔtee ŋá soooo ki kóoń ni-kansikin ki kpántì tiŋan tin Unimbɔti ŋá-tee bɔti, ki ŋáań min kaa kítèe, ki yíì, kaa là Yeesu Kriisitoo un baba sá ti-kpiliu ki sá ti-Dindaanee. Ama dooooyee ní ditafadaaldi din dɔ̄ ki cí bidambee pée ŋmàn̄ Unimbɔti gbɔŋkun.

english_verse: Don't forget what happened to those people the Lord rescued from Egypt. Some of them did not have faith, and he later destroyed them.
translation_verse: M nyí yii ni pée nyí tibɔti nee ki yóoǹ dooooyee, ama m là kí gíti téetí-ni ti-pu. Kéè ni nyí ti-Dindaan nín nìn fīī Isirayeel yab ki nyántì Eejipitee, boonee u dāa fātìi kúntì bin kaa nìn là kí fōō kí kííyeeyaa!

english_verse: You also know about the angels who didn't do their work and left their proper places. God chained them with everlasting chains and is now keeping them in dark pits until the great day of judgment.
translation_verse: Téetímaan tin nìn jítì ituun iba puee: iaa nìn là kí nīn bí mpaan ŋun pu Unimbɔti yóoǹ-iee, ama ní ki dūu fá ki póotì i-laŋki. Unimbɔti nìn bóob́-i nì ikusaka kí nīn cá jaanjaan, ní ki dū-i ki tɔ́ dibɔmbɔŋkpaandin í nīn kā niin ki cí ibɔsooŋkpaan dal.

english_verse: We should also be warned by what happened to the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah and the nearby towns. Their people became immoral and committed all sorts of sexual sins. Then God made an example of them and punished them with eternal fire.
translation_verse: Ní téetímaan ntimu mun bi yíì Soodoom nì Goomoora nì ntimbilimu mun nìn bí ki pìlīǹ-muee bɔti. Bi mun nìn tí ŋáaǹ kii ituunee nín nìn ŋá puee ní, ki mun nìn dū bi-ba ki tīī dijɔkɔntundi nì atuŋkpiti ŋin unil kaa máaǹ kí ŋée. An puee ní Unimbɔti nìn yāntì ŋŋmi ŋun kaa kúùyee dɔ́miń ki wùn̄-bi, ki dáaĺ bi-tafal, án nīn sá kudaaŋŋu kí dūú dàkà báà ŋma.

english_verse: The people I am talking about are behaving just like those dreamers who destroyed their own bodies. They reject all authority and insult angels.
translation_verse: Binib bin kóoń ni-kansikinee, míǹ ní bi mun tí ŋáań ki bí yii bi wāĺ, ní an càntī bi cáá bi-ba ki kɔ̄ntí tijɔkɔndin, ní ki kpèé Unimbɔti pɔŋŋu fám, ki sìí Tinyooldambi bin bí yilpuee.

english_verse: Even Michael, the chief angel, didn't dare to insult the devil, when the two of them were arguing about the body of Moses. All Michael said was, “The Lord will punish you!”
translation_verse: Ama, ŋyunti ŋun ituun kpiliu un bi yíì Mikayeelee nì Sitaan nìn bíi jáà ki kpákà Mooyiisi wunti puee, ntuunee kaa nìn kpáàa dākafì kí sìì Sitaan gba, see ŋu nín pée tùkū-u yii: «Ti-Dindaan di làá dáaĺ a-tafal.»

english_verse: But these people insult powers they don't know anything about. They are like senseless animals that end up getting destroyed, because they live only by their feelings.
translation_verse: Ama ní bíǹ sìí tin baa nyée, ní tin bi nyí kii kumooun peelii nyítamee di kúntí-bi.

english_verse: Now they are in for real trouble. They have followed Cain's example and have made the same mistake that Balaam did by caring only for money. They have also rebelled against God, just as Korah did. Because of all this, they will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Mbusu dɔ̄ ki cí-bi, kun puee bi táá Kayeen saŋŋu, ní ki dū bi-ba ki tīī isaŋkpiti ki kāntí animbil kii Balaam nín nìn ŋá puee, ki kúù kii Kooree yab nín nìn yíì kaa tɔ́ Unimbɔti ki kpíì puee.

english_verse: These people are filthy minded, and by their shameful and selfish actions they spoil the meals you eat together. They are like clouds blown along by the wind, but never bringing any rain. They are like leafless trees, uprooted and dead, and unable to produce fruit.
translation_verse: Ni nì bi yaa kpáfì ki jīǹ kunabitiiu jikaatee, bi-bimbim bíiĺ-ni ní. Bi jīǹ tikpil, an kaa cáá-bi icoo, ki sūǹ bi-ba pu ŋma. Bi bí kii atagban ŋin kubuŋu cáa yìiǹ, ntaanyim kpá poonee, ní ki bí kii isufi in kaa pée lòoǹ kpataaayee, ki kpíì an kɔkɔ pu, ki kpīkitì.

english_verse: Their shameful deeds show up like foam on wild ocean waves. They are like wandering stars forever doomed to the darkest pits of hell.
translation_verse: Bi bí kii tiŋku nín wòoǹ pu tinyiŋgban yíkí ki pùkufī puee ní, bi nyāntiń bi-tuuŋŋi ŋin cáá icooyee. Bi tí bí kii iŋmalbijaa in nyēē ki pùntēe ní. Unimbɔti yóoǹ-bi mpaan ŋun sá dibɔmbɔŋkpaŋkpaandee, niin ní bi làá nīn bí baabadal.

english_verse: Enoch was the seventh person after Adam, and he was talking about these people when he said: Look! The Lord is coming with thousands and thousands of holy angels
translation_verse: Bíǹ pu ní Eenɔki un sá Adam naantitɔntɔkɔl ululuútee nìn sòon̄ dooooyee ki yóoǹ yii: «Ní pīlifì, ti-Dindaan dòoń nì u-circir tuuŋyi kutukub kutukub.

english_verse: to judge everyone. He will punish all those ungodly people for all the evil things they have done. The Lord will surely punish those ungodly sinners for every evil thing they have ever said about him.
translation_verse: U làá sòoǹ báà ŋma bɔti, ní kí kpɔ̀ bin kɔkɔ kaa tɔ́-uee bɔti, bi-tuŋkpitiŋ ŋin bi ŋáańee kɔkɔ nì bi nín yíì Unimbɔti kaa fōō-uee, nì bi nín kaa tɔ́-u ki sòoǹ-u tibɔfan tiŋyee kɔkɔ pu.»

english_verse: These people grumble and complain and live by their own selfish desires. They brag about themselves and flatter others to get what they want. More Warnings
translation_verse: Binib gbantee, baabadalee, an kaa pée mɔ̄ǹ bíǹ ŋma ní, ní bi yáliŋkí ní ki ŋáań tikpitil tin fáatì-bee, ní ki sòoǹ tilambibɔti, ki cáá nyɔɔmálmal ki ŋmàtíǹ binib ki jīǹ bi-pu. Tibɔkpaafikaal

english_verse: My dear friends, remember the warning you were given by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Ama m-nabineeŋkaamu, nimbi ń téetí ti-Dindaan Yeesu Kriisitoo kpambaliŋ nín nìn sòon̄ nì ni tibɔti tin ki síiǹ dooooyee pu.

english_verse: They told you that near the end of time, selfish and godless people would start making fun of God.
translation_verse: Bi nìn tùkū-ni yii, iwinjoolkaa poonee, binib làá dāá nīn bèel̄-ni, ní ki ŋáań tikpitil tin fáatì-bee.

english_verse: And now these people are already making you turn against each other. They think only about this life, and they don't have God's Spirit.
translation_verse: Bíǹ di cāabìń digàntil binib kansikin. Bi nín là miŋyee di kpòotī-bi, an kaa sá Unimbɔti Fam.

english_verse: Dear friends, keep building on the foundation of your most holy faith, as the Holy Spirit helps you to pray.
translation_verse: Ama nimbee, m-nabineeŋkaamu, nín̄ mɔ̀tīi cámaan nyɔkɔpu ni-fookiiu un bí circiree poon, ni-wimmeem ń nīn cáá Unimbɔti Fam pɔŋŋu.

english_verse: And keep in step with God's love, as you wait for our Lord Jesus Christ to show how kind he is by giving you eternal life.
translation_verse: Ní nīn pée gbíntì ki bí Unimbɔti un néeń-nee ŋaan, kí nīn cí ti-Dindaan Yeesu Kriisitoo usaasɔlee ń dāá tīī-ti dimaŋfal din kaa cáá dikúntilee.

english_verse: Be helpful to all who may have doubts.
translation_verse: Sɔ̄maan bin dàkafī ki gùkufēe saai,

english_verse: Rescue any who need to be saved, as you would rescue someone from a fire. Then with fear in your own hearts, have mercy on everyone who needs it. But hate even the clothes of those who have been made dirty by their filthy deeds. Final Prayer
translation_verse: kí dáaliń-bi kí nyāntiń ŋŋmi poon kí fīī-bi. Ní sɔ̄ bin kíǹee mun saai, kí nīn nyíǹ ni-ba bí taa dū bi-kpitii kí tìntī-ni. An puee, ni-ŋalii ń taa gbēē bi-bɔkutiŋ ŋin bi pēē ki ŋáań bi-jɔkɔntuuŋŋee kpaŋkpam. Unimbɔti tinyooldaan

english_verse: Offer praise to God our Savior because of our Lord Jesus Christ! Only God can keep you from falling and make you pure and joyful in his glorious presence. Before time began and now and forever, God is worthy of glory, honor, power, and authority. Amen.
translation_verse: Tí nyɔ̄ŋkì Unimbɔtibaanti un dī ti-Dindaan Yeesu Kriisitoo pu ki fīī-tee. Úǹ di yì tinyool nì tikpaandi nì mpɔn, nì ŋŋmam doooo ŋkilkaamin nì kɔŋkɔnnee kí nīn pée cáa cá jaanjaan! Ameeni.

english_verse: This is what God showed to Jesus Christ, so that he could tell his servants what must happen soon. Christ then sent his angel with the message to his servant John.
translation_verse: Yeesu Kriisitoo nín lēē tibɔti tin ki dàkā Yoowaneesee sèé. Unimbɔti di bí yii ú lēē tin bí ki làá ŋá kɔŋkɔnneeyee kí dàkà u-tɔntɔnliibi, ní Kriisitoo túnní u-tuuŋŋu dɔ́miń ki tùkū u-tɔntɔnliu Yoowaneesi tibɔti tin u lēē ki dàkā-uee kɔkɔ taapu.

english_verse: And John told everything he had seen about God's message and about what Jesus Christ had said and done.
translation_verse: Yoowaneesi di ŋmàn̄ Unimbɔti nín sòon̄ puee nì ibaamɔn in Yeesu Kriisitoo lēē ki dàkā-uee, nì tin kɔkɔ u kée.

english_verse: From John to the seven churches in Asia. I pray that you will be blessed with kindness and peace from God, who is and was and is coming. May you receive kindness and peace from the seven spirits before the throne of God.
translation_verse: An sá man Yoowaneesi di ŋmàn̄ kugbɔŋu nee ki tīī Kriisitoo nikitiŋ aluli ŋin bí Asii tiŋkinee. Unimbɔti un bí, ki nìn pée bí dooooyee ki làá dāá dāan̄ee ń ŋá-ni tiŋan kí tīī-ni ŋgbansɔŋfi nì ŋfam miluli min bí u-beejal nimbiinee.

english_verse: May kindness and peace be yours from Jesus Christ, the faithful witness. Jesus was the first to conquer death, and he is the ruler of all earthly kings. Christ loves us, and by his blood he set us free from our sins.
translation_verse: Yeesu Kriisitoo un sòoǹ ibaamɔn, ki sá Ujipɔŋkpil, ki sá upeepeekaa un Unimbɔti fīkitì ditaŋkpiilinee, ki sá duulinya bɔtiibi kpiliuee ń tīī-ni tíǹ kɔkɔ. Úǹ di néeń-ti ní ki nyántì u-fatikuu ki kpíì ki fīī-ti ti-kpitii poon.

english_verse: He lets us rule as kings and serve God his Father as priests. To him be glory and power forever and ever! Amen.
translation_verse: Úǹ di kóoǹ-ti ki kpáfì u-Beelin ní ki dū-ti ki ŋá u-Baa Unimbɔti saraaŋaliibi. Úǹ Yeesu Kriisitoo di yì tinyool nì mpɔn kí nīn pée cáa cá jaanjaan! Ameeni.

english_verse: Look! He is coming with the clouds. Everyone will see him, even the ones who stuck a sword through him. All people on earth will weep because of him. Yes, it will happen! Amen.
translation_verse: Kpèèmaan, u làá dāá dāan̄ atagban māntì ki tú-u. Báà ŋma làá dāá ká-u, ki kpáaǹ bin nìn sāā ki cíl̀ u-takakalee. Míǹ ní duulinya timbuŋŋi kɔkɔ làá dāá sɔ̄ kí yāliŋkì u-dāantam gbanti pu. Tiŋman, án ŋá míǹ!

english_verse: The Lord God says, “I am Alpha and Omega, the one who is and was and is coming. I am God All-Powerful!” A Vision of the Risen Lord
translation_verse: Ti-Dindaan Unimbɔti Mpɔŋkɔdaan, un bí, ki nìn pée bí dooooyee ki làá dāá dāan̄ee bí yii: «Man di sá Alfa nì Oomeega, upeepeekaa nì ujoolkaa.» Kriisitoo lēē tibɔti ki dàkā Yoowaneesi

english_verse: I am John, a follower together with all of you. We suffer because Jesus is our king, but he gives us the strength to endure. I was sent to Patmos Island, because I had preached God's message and had told about Jesus.
translation_verse: An sá man Yoowaneesi ni-nabiki, ni nì un kpáfì ki jīǹ Yeesu pu falaa nì kimɔtii u-Beel puee. M nìn bí Patimoosi tiŋki kin dimɔɔl māntì ki túee ni ní. Kun pu bi nìn cáá-mi ki cūnnì niinee di sá m sòon̄ Unimbɔti bɔti ki lēekì Yeesu pu seera.

english_verse: On the Lord's day the Spirit took control of me, and behind me I heard a loud voice that sounded like a trumpet.
translation_verse: An nìn sá Kɔɔsil dal, ní Unimbɔti Fam dɔ́miń m-ni. Niinee ní m gbìl̄ m-boon nneen ŋubɔ sòoǹ ki pɔ̄ɔ̄ kpaŋkpam kii dikantándee,

english_verse: The voice said, “Write in a book what you see. Then send it to the seven churches in Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, and Laodicea.”
translation_verse: yii: «Á ŋmà tin a wāĺ nee kí ŋá kugbɔŋun kí tīī Kriisitoo nikitiŋ aluli ŋin yiŋŋi m làá yíiń nee: Eefeesi nikitil nì Simiirni nikitil nì Peergaam nikitil nì Tiyatiir nikitil nì Saardi nikitil nì Fiiladeelfii nikitil nì Lawoodiisee nikitil.»

english_verse: When I turned to see who was speaking to me, I saw seven gold lampstands.
translation_verse: M fātì kí kpèè yii ŋma di sòoǹ m-boonee, m kpēēyee ki ká fitilab tɔ́kɔŋkaati tiluli yú ki sá sindaariya.

english_verse: There with the lampstands was someone who seemed to be the Son of Man. He was wearing a robe that reached down to his feet, and a gold cloth was wrapped around his chest.
translation_verse: Ní m ká ubɔ náań nì unil ki yú fitilab tɔ́kɔŋkaati tin sá sindaariyee kansikin, ki pēē dibɔkutifɔkɔl diba ní ki cúú sindaariya dambalau u-bindi.

english_verse: His head and his hair were white as wool or snow, and his eyes looked like flames of fire.
translation_verse: Ní u-yikpiti pīiǹ káŋkaŋ kii gulfee, ní u-nimbiliŋ ŋmóò làka laka kii ŋŋmee.

english_verse: His feet were glowing like bronze being heated in a furnace, and his voice sounded like the roar of a waterfall.
translation_verse: Ní u-taaŋi jìl̀ pàlpal kii tasa ní bi fíntèe, ní u-neen bí kii mbuŋkpaan nín wòoǹ puee.

english_verse: He held seven stars in his right hand, and a sharp double-edged sword was coming from his mouth. His face was shining as bright as the sun at noon.
translation_verse: Ní u ŋúb́ u-ŋaŋgiilin iŋmalbijaa iluli, ní kitàataajiki kin jītí ajan liitilee nyēē u-nyɔkɔn, ní u-nimbiin jìl̀ kii ŋwìiń yaa bíitì ki píĺ ŋu nín jìliŋkī puee.

english_verse: When I saw him, I fell at his feet like a dead person. But he put his right hand on me and said: Don't be afraid! I am the first, the last,
translation_verse: M nín ká mimmee ní m lítì ki kíǹ ki dɔ̄ u-taaŋi taapu kii m kpíìyee, ní u dū u-ŋaŋgiil ki páaǹ m-pu ní ki bí-mi yii: «Taa fàŋkì! Man di sá upeepeekaa ní ki sá ujoolkaa.

english_verse: and the living one. I died, but now I am alive forever, and I have the keys to death and the world of the dead.
translation_verse: Man di sá un bí dimaŋfalinee. M nìn kpíì, ama kɔŋkɔnnee m kíǹ ki bí dimaŋfalin kí nīn cá jaanjaan. Man di ŋúb́ ŋkúm nì ditaŋkpiil pɔŋŋu.

english_verse: Write what you have seen and what is and what will happen after these things.
translation_verse: An puee á ŋmà tin a ká nee, nì tin bí ki jītí nee nì tin bí boon ki dòońee.

english_verse: I will explain the mystery of the seven stars you saw at my right side and the seven gold lampstands. The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches, and the lampstands are the seven churches.
translation_verse: Iŋmalbijaa iluli in a ká m ŋúb́ m-ŋaŋgiilinee, nì fitilab tɔ́kɔŋkaati tiluli tin sá sindaariya a ká kaa nyí an nín sá puee, taapu sèé: iŋmalbijaa ilulee di sá Kriisitoo nikitiŋ alulee tuuŋyi, ní fitilab tɔ́kɔŋkaati tilulee sá Kriisitoo nikitiŋ alulee.»

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Ephesus: I am the one who holds the seven stars in my right hand, and I walk among the seven gold lampstands. Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: «Á ŋmà kugbɔŋu kí tīī m-nikitil din bí Eefeesee tuuŋŋu yii: «Un ŋúb́ iŋmalbijaa iluli u-ŋaŋgiilin ki còom̄ fitilab tɔ́kɔŋkaati tiluli tin sá sindaariyee kansikinee di lī yii:

english_verse: I know everything you have done, including your hard work and how you have endured. I know you won't put up with anyone who is evil. When some people pretended to be apostles, you tested them and found out they were liars.
translation_verse: M nyí a-tuuŋŋi ŋin a túńee kɔkɔ pu, m nyí falaa un jíń-see, ki nyí a-pɔ́ɔǹtam. M nyí a-pu yii aa là binikpitib bɔti. A cɔ́ŋkì ki béè bin bí yii bi sá Yeesu kpambaliŋ, kin kaa sée, ní ki bīitì binyimɔndambi pu.

english_verse: You have endured and gone through hard times because of me, yet you have not given up.
translation_verse: A cáá dipɔ́ɔǹdi, ki jíń falaa m-pu kaa yɔ̄tì a-wunti.

english_verse: But I do have something against you! And it is this: You don't have as much love as you used to.
translation_verse: Ama tiba ní m cáá kí wòoǹ-si, di sá yii a nín nìn néeń-mi ŋkilkaamin puee, a dūu fá, aa ti néeń-mi míǹ.

english_verse: Think about where you have fallen from, and then turn back and do as you did at first. If you don't turn back, I will come and take away your lampstand.
translation_verse: An puee á téetí laakin ní a lítèe. Á kpántí a-bimbim, kí fàtīí nīn tūǹ atummɔnti ŋin a nìn tūǹee. A yaa yíìyee, m làá dāan̄ a-cee ní kí yòon̄ a-fitilau nì u-tɔkɔŋkaati ti-paaŋŋu.

english_verse: But there is one thing you are doing right. You hate what the Nicolaitans are doing, and so do I.
translation_verse: Ama nì míǹ kɔkɔee, a cáá tiba tì ŋān̄. Tíǹ di sá a nín ná atuun ŋin Niikoolaati yab tūǹee, kii ma mun nín ná-ŋi puee.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. I will let everyone who wins the victory eat from the life-giving tree in God's wonderful garden. The Letter to Smyrna
translation_verse: «Un yaa cáá ditafalee ń pīlifì Circir Fam nín bíi sòoǹ nì Kriisitoo nikitiŋ puee. «Un yaa jáń ki jíńee, m làá tīī-u dimaŋfal subu bun yú Unimbɔti kpaabunee bil ú ŋmɔ́.» Tibɔti tin Yeesu sòon̄ Simiirni nikitil puee

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Smyrna: I am the first and the last. I died, but now I am alive! Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: «Á ŋmà kugbɔŋu kí tīī m-nikitil din bí Simiirnee tuuŋŋu yii: «Un sá upeepeekaa ki sá uluŋkikaayee, man un nìn kpíì ki fīkitèe di lī yii:

english_verse: I know how much you suffer and how poor you are, but you are rich. I also know the cruel things being said about you by people who claim to be God's people. But they are not really God's people. They are a group that belongs to Satan.
translation_verse: M nyí a-falaau nì a-sool, ama nì míǹ kɔkɔee, a sá ugaaja ní. M nyí bin kúŋfí a-boon ki yíì bi-ba yii Juuda yab kin kaa sée. An nibee sá Sitaan nikitil ní.

english_verse: Don't worry about what you will suffer. The devil will throw some of you into jail, and you will be tested and made to suffer for ten days. But if you are faithful until you die, I will reward you with a glorious life.
translation_verse: Á taa fàŋkì falaa un dɔ̄ ki cí-si a làá jēe pu. Di sá yii Sitaan làá cɔ̄ŋkì-ni kí yàntī bí cūtì ni-kansikin biba kí tɔ̄ sarka, ní ní dāá jī falaa iwiin saalaa. Nín̄ yú deedee áli a-kúm dal, ní ḿ dāá tīī-si dijajil beefuuliiki, an dàkà yii dimaŋfal din kaa kúntée.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. Whoever wins the victory will not be hurt by the second death. The Letter to Pergamum
translation_verse: «Un yaa cáá ditafalee ń pīlifì Unimbɔti Fam nín sòoǹ nì Kriisitoo nikitiŋ puee. «Un yaa jáń ki jíńee, ŋkúnliliitiim kaa dāa gíti gbèetī udaan.» Tibɔti tin Yeesu sòon̄ Peergaam nikitil puee

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Pergamum: I am the one who has the sharp double-edged sword! Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: «Ŋmà kí tīī m-nikitil din bí Peergaamee tuuŋŋu yii: «Un ŋúb́ kitàataajiki kin jītí ajan liitilee bí yii:

english_verse: I know you live where Satan has his throne. But you have kept true to my name. Right there where Satan lives, my faithful witness Antipas was taken from you and put to death. Even then you did not give up your faith in me.
translation_verse: M nyí yii kitiŋ kin poon Sitaan jíń dibeelee ní a kóò. Ama ní a ŋúb́ m-bɔti deedee kaa páatì a-fookiiu m-pu. A gbíntì ki ŋúb́ an píkí ki kpáaǹ ŋyunti ŋun bi nìn kūū m-tɔntɔmmɔntiu Antiipa ni-tiŋki kin sá Sitaan kɔŋkooŋŋuee nee.

english_verse: I do have a few things against you. Some of you are following the teaching of Balaam. Long ago he told Balak to teach the people of Israel to eat food that had been offered to idols and to be immoral.
translation_verse: Ama nì míǹ kɔkɔee, m làá wòoǹ-si tiba pu. Di sá binib biba bí a-cee ki ŋáań kii Balaam nín nìn sáŋkì Balaaki ú ŋmàtiǹ Isirayeel biyaamu bí ŋmɔ́ tiwaatootinan kí ŋá tilaakpaal kí lítí ikpitinee.

english_verse: Now some of you are following the teaching of the Nicolaitans.
translation_verse: Míǹ ní si mun a-ba cáá binib bin tūǹ atuŋkpiti kii Niikoolaati yabee.

english_verse: Turn back! If you don't, I will come quickly and fight against these people. And my words will cut like a sword.
translation_verse: An puee á kpántí a-bimbim. A yaa yíì, m làá dāan̄ kí dū m-nyɔɔbundi din sá kitàataajikee kí já nì an nibee kɔŋkɔnnee.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. To everyone who wins the victory, I will give some of the hidden food. I will also give each one a white stone with a new name written on it. No one will know that name except the one who is given the stone. The Letter to Thyatira
translation_verse: «Un yaa cáá ditafalee ń pīlifì Unimbɔti Fam nín bíi sòoǹ nì Kriisitoo nikitiŋ puee. «Un yaa jáń ki jíńee, m làá tīī-u maana un bí dibalinee, nì ditaŋkpapindi din pu bi ŋmàn̄ diyimpɔndi diba din báà ubɔ kaa nyée, see un fōō ditaŋkpalee.» Tibɔti tin Yeesu sòon̄ Tiyatiir nikitil puee

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Thyatira: I am the Son of God! My eyes are like flames of fire, and my feet are like bronze. Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: «Ŋmà kugbɔŋu kí tīī m-nikitil din bí Tiyatiiree tuuŋŋu yii: «Unimbɔti Jipɔɔn un nimbiliŋ ŋmóò làka laka kii ŋŋmi, u-taaŋi jìl̀ pàlpal kii tasa ní bi fíntèe di lī yii:

english_verse: I know everything about you, including your love, your faith, your service, and how you have endured. I know you are doing more now than you have ever done before.
translation_verse: M nyí tin kɔkɔ a ŋáańee, m ká dineendi din a cááyee, nì a-fookiiu, nì a nín tūǹ atuun ŋin ki tútúǹ binibee nì dipɔ́ɔǹdi din a cááyee. M ká yii atummɔnti ŋin a bíi tūǹ kɔŋkɔnnee jítiǹ apeepeekaa.

english_verse: But I still have something against you because of that woman Jezebel. She calls herself a prophet, and you let her teach and mislead my servants to do immoral things and to eat food offered to idols.
translation_verse: Ama nì míǹ kɔkɔee, m làá wòoǹ-si tiba pu, di sá a yāntì unimpu Jeesabeel un yíì u-ba yii u sá Unimbɔti bɔnaatiliuee cáá u-dàkatam ki kíiĺ m-tɔntɔnliibi yii bi yaa ŋáań tilaakpaalee, an kaa cáá tiba, ki yàntī bi ŋmóò tiwaatootinan.

english_verse: I gave her a chance to turn from her sins, but she did not want to stop doing these immoral things.
translation_verse: M pú-u ŋyunti ú bàà kpántí u-ba kí fá u-bimbikpitim ní u yíì.

english_verse: I am going to strike down Jezebel. Everyone who does these immoral things with her will also be punished, if they don't stop.
translation_verse: An puee m làá yàntī ú lítí iween pu kí jī falaa ki kpáaǹ u nì bin pēē kinyɔkɔ ki ŋáań tilaakpaalee. Asee bi yaa kpántì bi-ba ki fá bi-bimbikpitim baba.

english_verse: I will even kill her followers. Then all the churches will see that I know everyone's thoughts and feelings. I will treat each of you as you deserve.
translation_verse: M làá fáá kí kpɔ̀ u-yab bin nóó-uee ní m-nikitiŋ kɔkɔ ń béé yii man di sá un nyí binib landɔkɔi nì bi-làtamee. M làá dāá pà báà ŋma tuuŋŋi paati ní.

english_verse: Some of you in Thyatira don't follow Jezebel's teaching. You don't know anything about what her followers call the “deep secrets of Satan.” So I won't burden you down with any other commands.
translation_verse: «Ama nimbi bin kíǹ Tiyatiir nikitil kansikin kaa bí bi-tuŋkpitiŋ gbanti poon, kaa bífì kun bíǹ yíì yii Sitaan bɔti tin bí dibalin ki nyóòyee, nimbee, maa pée cáá tiba kí lì ni-pu.

english_verse: But until I come, you must hold firmly to the teaching you have.
translation_verse: Ama tin baba m làá lèe di sá ní nīn ŋúb́ tin ni cááyee gbīŋgbim áli ḿ dāá gítiń.

english_verse: I will give power over the nations to everyone who wins the victory and keeps on obeying me until the end.
translation_verse: «Un di yaa jáń ki jíń ki gbíntì ki nìkì ki ŋáań min fáatì-mee ki tin kátì-kuee, m làá yàntī ú jī dibeel atimbun pu.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches.
translation_verse: «Un yaa cáá ditafalee ń pīlifì Unimbɔti Fam nín sòoǹ nì Kriisitoo nikitiŋ puee.»

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Sardis: I have the seven spirits of God and the seven stars. Listen to what I say. I know what you are doing. Everyone may think you are alive, but you are dead.
translation_verse: «Ŋmà kugbɔŋu kí tīī m-nikitil din bí Saardee tuuŋŋu yii: «Un cáá Unimbɔti Fam miluli nì iŋmalbijaa ilulee di bí-u yii: M nyí a-tuuŋŋi, ki nyí yii a-yindi yíkì yilpu. Bi nyí a-pu yii a sá dinikitil din cáá dimaŋfalee, ama ní a kpíì.

english_verse: Wake up! You have only a little strength left, and it is almost gone. So try to become stronger. I have found that you are not completely obeying God.
translation_verse: Fìntī kí tíkiń tin dáá bí a-ni kaa kpíì ama ki làá kpúee, kun puee maa ká a-tummɔntiŋ aba m-Nimbɔtiu cee.

english_verse: Remember the teaching you were given and heard. Hold firmly to it and turn from your sins. If you don't wake up, I will come when you least expect it, just as a thief does.
translation_verse: Á téetí bi nín nìn dàkā-si Unimbɔti bɔti a fōō-tì ki kíí puee. Á nīn gbíntì ki ŋúb́-tì kí kpántí a-ba. A yaa kaa fīntèe, m làá dāan̄ ŋyunti ŋun saa nyí yii m làá dāan̄ee ní kí túuǹ-si kii unaayuu nín tūuntí unil puee.

english_verse: A few of you in Sardis have not dirtied your clothes with sin. You will walk with me in white clothes, because you are worthy.
translation_verse: Ama nì míǹ kɔkɔee, biba bí Saardi nikitil kansikin kaa ŋá ikpiti bi-bɔkutiŋ pīiǹ. Binib gbanti dāa pēē abɔkutipiin káŋkaŋ ní man nì bi ń nīn táá ki còom̄, kun puee bi máaǹ míǹ.

english_verse: Everyone who wins the victory will wear white clothes. Their names will not be erased from the book of life, and I will tell my Father and his angels that they are my followers.
translation_verse: «Míǹ ní un yaa jáń ki jíńee dāa pèentí abɔkutipiin káŋkaŋ. Maa làá dāá kpìtī udaan yindi dimaŋfal gbɔŋku poon, ama m làá dāá lì m-Baa nì u-tuuŋyi kɔkɔ nimbiin yii man di yì-u.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. The Letter to Philadelphia
translation_verse: «Un yaa cáá ditafalee ń pīlifì Unimbɔti Fam nín bí ki sòoǹ nì Kriisitoo nikitiŋ puee.» Tibɔti tin Yeesu sòon̄ Fiiladeelfii nikitil puee

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Philadelphia: I am the one who is holy and true, and I have the keys that belonged to David. When I open a door, no one can close it. And when I close a door, no one can open it. Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: «Ŋmà kugbɔŋu kí tīī m-nikitil din bí Fiiladeelfiiyee tuuŋŋu yii: «Un sá circir ki sá ubaamɔnee, un di ŋúb́ Daafiidi saafiiu ki yaa pīitì, ubɔ kaa ŋūǹ kí dūú pìin̄, ki yaa tí dūu pīiǹ, ubɔ kaa ŋūǹ kí pìitēe,

english_verse: I know everything you have done. And I have placed before you an open door no one can close. You were not very strong, but you obeyed my message and did not deny you are my followers.
translation_verse: di bí-u yii: M nyí atuun ŋin kɔkɔ a túńee. M pīitì kipunyɔkɔ ki wāaǹ a-nimbiin, ní ubɔ kaa ŋūǹ kí dūú pìin̄. Kun puee m nyí a-pɔŋŋu kaa náaǹ, ama a ŋúń ki ŋúb́ m-bɔti, kaa dū-mi ki fá.

english_verse: Now you will see what I will do with those people who belong to Satan's group. They claim to be God's people, but they are liars. I will make them come and kneel down at your feet. Then they will know that I love you.
translation_verse: Á kpèè tin m làá ŋá kí tīī-see: Binib bin kpáfì ki sá Sitaan yab ki mɔ́ntí yii bi sá Juuda yab kin kaa sée, m làá dū-bi kí ŋá a-ŋaan. M làá yàntī bí dāá gbàan̄ a-taaŋi taapu ní kí béé yii m néeń-si.

english_verse: You obeyed my message and endured. So I will protect you from the time of testing everyone in all the world must go through.
translation_verse: Kun puee a nín pɔ́ɔǹ ki ŋúb́ m-bɔtee, ma mun làá ŋúb́-si ŋyunti ŋun dinimbinaamandi làá dāá jēetí duulinya nib kɔkɔ pu kí cɔ̄ŋkì-bee.

english_verse: I am coming soon. So hold firmly to what you have, and no one will take away the crown you will be given as your reward.
translation_verse: M dòoń kɔŋkɔnnee. Á ŋúb́ tin a cááyee gbīŋgbim ubɔ ń taa fōō a-cee kibeefuulii kin bi tìì bin jáń ki jíńee.

english_verse: Everyone who wins the victory will be made into a pillar in the temple of my God, and they will stay there forever. I will write on each of them the name of my God and the name of his city. It is the new Jerusalem my God will send down from heaven. I will also write on them my own new name.
translation_verse: «Un yaa jáń ki jíńee, m làá dū-u kí kpántí m-Nimbɔtiu diiku jaantalkuu ní ú báań kí nīn kíǹ ki bí niin kí taa ti nyā, ní ḿ dāá dū m-Nimbɔtiu yindi nì m-Nimbɔtiu tiŋki, Jeerusaleempɔɔn un nyánní yilpu m-Nimbɔtiu ceeyee yindi nì man yimpɔndi kí ŋmà udaan pu.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. The Letter to Laodicea
translation_verse: «Un yaa cáá ditafalee ń pīlifì Unimbɔti Fam nín bí ki sòoǹ nì Kriisitoo nikitiŋ puee.» Tibɔti tin Yeesu sòon̄ Lawoodiisee nikitil puee

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Laodicea: I am the one called Amen! I am the faithful and true witness and the source of God's creation. Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: «Ŋmà kugbɔŋu kí tīī m-nikitil din bí Lawoodiiseeyee tuuŋŋu yii: «Un bi yíì Ameeni u sá un lèekī seera deedee nì ibaamɔn, ki sá Unimbɔti wannaaŋkaati kɔkɔ nyeelee,

english_verse: I know everything you have done, and you are not cold or hot. I wish you were either one or the other.
translation_verse: di bí-u yii: M nyí atuun ŋin a túńee kɔkɔ. Aa sɔ̀m̀aaa, kaa tùm̀ mun. A yaa là kí nīn sɔ̀m̀aaa, á nīn sɔ̀m̀. A yaa là kí nīn tí tùm̀maaa, á nīn tùm̀.

english_verse: But since you are lukewarm and neither cold nor hot, I will spit you out of my mouth.
translation_verse: Kii a nín bí gbìmmm kaa sɔ̀m̀aaa, kaa tùm̀ muee, m làá wùliŋkì-si kí fá.

english_verse: You claim to be rich and successful and to have everything you need. But you don't know how bad off you really are. You are pitiful, poor, blind, and naked.
translation_verse: Di sá a lì yii sii sá ugaaja ní. A-gaajati tin a ká nee puee, aa ti là tiba nì tiba. Di sá kun pu a lì mimmee di sá yii aa nyí yii a sá ufalaadaan, ki sá unandaan, ki sá usoodaan, ki sá ujɔfu, ki sá ucancaŋgbeefu.

english_verse: Buy your gold from me. It has been refined in a fire, and it will make you rich. Buy white clothes from me. Wear them and you can cover up your shameful nakedness. Buy medicine for your eyes, so you will be able to see.
translation_verse: An puee m sáŋkí-si yii á dāan̄ m-cee kí dā sindaariya un bi dū ŋŋmi ki cɔ́ŋkì ki ká yii u sá umɔntee, ní kí nín ŋmā kí kpántí ugaaja, kí dā m-cee abɔkutipiin kí pèen̄ kí bìin̄ a-cooi pu, kí dā nnyɔkɔ m-cee kí jōō a-nimbiliŋ kí wāl̀.

english_verse: I correct and punish everyone I love. So make up your minds to turn away from your sins.
translation_verse: Man dátí bin m néeńee tafal ní ki sáŋkí-bi. An puee á ká kunyannyaau kí kpántí a-ba.

english_verse: Listen! I am standing and knocking at your door. If you hear my voice and open the door, I will come in and we will eat together.
translation_verse: Á pīlifì, m yú kipunyɔkɔ pu ki ŋáań gaafalaa. Un yaa gbìl̄ m-nyɔkɔ pu ní ki pīitì-mee, m làá kɔ́ udaan cee ní man nì u ń kpāfì kí jī.

english_verse: Everyone who wins the victory will sit with me on my throne, just as I won the victory and sat with my Father on his throne.
translation_verse: «Un yaa jáń ki jíńee, m làá yàntī ú dāan̄ kí kàl̄ kí kɔ́ĺ-mi m-beelin, kii ma mun nín jáń ki jíń pu ki dɔ́miń ki kāl̀ m-Baa beelin ki kɔ́ĺ-u puee.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches.
translation_verse: «Un yaa cáá ditafalee ń pīlifì Unimbɔti Fam nín bí ki sòoǹ nì Kriisitoo nikitiŋ puee.»

english_verse: After this, I looked and saw a door that opened into heaven. Then the voice that had spoken to me at first and that sounded like a trumpet said, “Come up here! I will show you what must happen next.”
translation_verse: U lī míǹ ki dóòyee, boonee m kpēē kutagbɔŋu puee, kipunyɔkɔ kiba cúu pīitì. Niinee nneen ŋun m bàà péé péé ki gbìl̄ ŋu pɔ̄ɔ̄ kpaŋkpam kii dikantándee bí-mi yii: «Jɔ̄mìń doo ḿ dàkà-si tin bí ki dòoń boonee.»

english_verse: Right then the Spirit took control of me, and there in heaven I saw a throne and someone sitting on it.
translation_verse: Kpalaa niinee ní Circir Fam yōoǹ-mi ki jɔ́m̀ yilpu ní m ká dibeejal ní ubɔ kā dibeejalee pu.

english_verse: The one who was sitting there sparkled like precious stones of jasper and carnelian. A rainbow that looked like an emerald surrounded the throne.
translation_verse: Udaan nimbiin jìl̀ ki ŋmóò làka laka kii ataŋkpamɔnti ŋin bi yíì jaspee nì ŋin bi yíì saarduwaanee, ní dikuntinyindi māntì ki tú dibeejalee ní ki jìl̀ pàlpal kii ditaŋkpal din bi yíì eemeeroodee.

english_verse: Twenty-four other thrones were in a circle around that throne. And on each of these thrones there was an elder dressed in white clothes and wearing a gold crown.
translation_verse: Ní abeejal mmuŋku nì anaa aba mun māntì ki tú dibeejalee, ní bikpilib bin kā an beejaliŋ gbanti puee pēē tiwampin ní ki cíkí sindaariya beefuulimmu.

english_verse: Flashes of lightning and roars of thunder came out from the throne in the center of the circle. Seven torches, which are the seven spirits of God, were burning in front of the throne.
translation_verse: Dibeejalee ni ní itaaŋmɔŋmɔ nì ataadun nì dibintiŋkpaandi nyēeń ní iŋminaapool iluli tūū ki yú dibeejalee nimbiin ki tùm̀ kpaŋkpam, an di sá Unimbɔti Fam milulee.

english_verse: Also in front of the throne was something that looked like a glass sea, clear as crystal. Around the throne in the center were four living creatures covered front and back with eyes.
translation_verse: Tiŋku ubɔ dɔ̄ dibeejalee nimbiin ki wāĺ kílkil kii digitil nín wāĺ puee, kii ataŋkpee ŋin bi yíì kriistaalee nín jìl̀ puee. Dibeejalee jannaatiliŋ puee, tiwan tinaa tin cáá kufoouee yú kansikin ki māntì ki tú, ní ti-boon nì ti-nimbiinee kɔkɔ sá animbil ŋma.

english_verse: The first creature was like a lion, the second one was like a bull, the third one had the face of a human, and the fourth was like a flying eagle.
translation_verse: Upeepeekaayee náań nì gbikinti, ní uliliitee náań nì unaja, ní utataatee nimbiin nì unil yɔŋu náań, ní unanaatee náań nì ukaalun yaa bíi ŋàaǹ u nín bí puee.

english_verse: Each of the four living creatures had six wings, and their bodies were covered with eyes. Day and night they never stopped singing, “Holy, holy, holy is the Lord, the all-powerful God, who was and is and is coming!”
translation_verse: Tiwan tinaa tin cáá kufoouee gbanti kɔkɔ cáá ifeen iluu iluu in pu animbil píńee poon nì boon. Ní bi lì ŋwiimpu nì kunyeeu kaa gbèentí yii: «Circir, circir, ti-Dindaan Unimbɔti di sá circir, úǹ di sá Mpɔŋkɔdaan, un nìn bí, ki gbíntì ki bí, ki làá dāan̄ee.»

english_verse: The living creatures kept praising, honoring, and thanking the one who sits on the throne and who lives forever and ever.
translation_verse: Ŋyunti ŋun ní tiwan tinaa tin cáá kufoouee yaa bí ki tìì jilma nì tinyool ki pàkà un kā dibeejal pu ki làá nīn bí kí nīn cá jaanjaanee,

english_verse: “Our Lord and God, you are worthy to receive glory, honor, and power. You created all things, and by your decision they are and were created.”
translation_verse: «Sii ti-Dindaan ti-Nimbɔtiu, a máaǹ jilma nì tinyool nì mpɔn. Di sá yii sii di náań tikɔkɔ nì tikɔkɔ, ní ki là ní ki tīī tikɔkɔ dimaŋfal tí nīn bí.»

english_verse: In the right hand of the one sitting on the throne I saw a scroll that had writing on the inside and on the outside. And it was sealed in seven places.
translation_verse: Ní m ká un kā dibeejal puee ŋúb́ kugbɔŋu kubɔ u-ŋaŋgiilin bi kpáb́-ku, ní an ŋmàn̄ poon nì boon ní bi dū tiwampiiŋkaal tiluli ki bóob́ kugbɔŋuee.

english_verse: I saw a mighty angel ask with a loud voice, “Who is worthy to open the scroll and break its seals?”
translation_verse: Ní ntuun ŋun cáá mpɔnee bíi báakí mpɔn yii: «Ŋma di cáá mpɔn kí bútí tiwampiiŋkaal nee kí kpátí kugbɔŋu nee dee?»

english_verse: No one in heaven or on earth or under the earth was able to open the scroll or look inside it.
translation_verse: Báà ubɔ nìn kpá yilpuɔɔɔ, ki kpá taapuɔɔɔ, ki kpá ditaŋkpiilin kí ŋmā kí kpátí kugbɔŋuee kí kàaǹ poon.

english_verse: I cried hard because no one was found worthy to open the scroll or look inside it.
translation_verse: Niinee ní m bíi sūǹ tikpil, kun puee ubɔ kaa nìn bí laaba ki ŋūǹ kí kpátí kugbɔŋuee kí kàaǹ tin bí poonee.

english_verse: Then one of the elders said to me, “Stop crying and look! The one who is called both the ‘Lion from the Tribe of Judah’ and ‘King David's Great Descendant’ has won the victory. He will open the scroll and its seven seals.”
translation_verse: Ní bikpilib mmuŋku nì binaayee kansikin ubɔ bí-mi yii: «Taa ti sɔ̄. Kpèè! Juuda naakookun gbikintiu un sá ubɔti Daafiidi naantiiuee jáń ki jíń. Úǹ di làá ŋmā kí bútí tiwampiiŋkaal tiluli tin bi dū ki bóob́ kugbɔŋuee kí kpátí-ku kí kàaǹ.»

english_verse: Then I looked and saw a Lamb standing in the center of the throne surrounded by the four living creatures and the elders. The Lamb looked as if it had once been killed. It had seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven spirits of God, sent out to all the earth.
translation_verse: Ní m kpēēyee, dipibil di yú bikpilibee nimbiin, dibeejal nì tiwan tinaa tin cáá kufoouee kansikinee, ki bí kii bi nìn kūū-dèe, ní dì cáá iyin iluli, animbil aluli. Animbil alulee di sá Unimbɔti Fam miluli min u tú duulinya kɔkɔnee.

english_verse: The Lamb went over and took the scroll from the right hand of the one who sat on the throne.
translation_verse: Dipibilee di dɔ́miń ki fōō un kā dibeejal puee ŋaŋgiiliŋun kugbɔŋu.

english_verse: Then they sang a new song, “You are worthy to receive the scroll and open its seals, because you were killed. And with your own blood you bought for God people from every tribe, language, nation, and race.
translation_verse: Ní bi bí ki gà nlampɔɔn ki nyɔ́ŋkí-u yii: «A máaǹ kí fōō kugbɔŋuee kí bútí tiwampiiŋkaal tin bi dūu bóob́ee. Kun puee bi kūū-si ní a-fatikuu dá anibul kɔkɔ nì isoon kɔkɔ nib, nì atimbun kɔkɔ nib nì ntimu kɔkɔ nib ki tīī Unimbɔti,

english_verse: You let them become kings and serve God as priests, and they will rule on earth.”
translation_verse: ki dū-bi ki ŋá dibeel poon nib, bí nīn sá ti-Nimbɔtiu saraaŋaliibi kí jī dibeel duulinya poon.»

english_verse: As I looked, I heard the voices of a large number of angels around the throne and the voices of the living creatures and of the elders. There were millions and millions of them,
translation_verse: M bí ki kpèéyee, ní ki gbìl̄ ituun kucikukpaaŋŋu kutukub kutukub wooku māntì ki tú dibeejalee nì tiwan tin cáá kufoouee nì bikpilibee.

english_verse: and they were saying in a loud voice, “The Lamb who was killed is worthy to receive power, riches, wisdom, strength, honor, glory, and praise.”
translation_verse: Ní bi gà ilan mpɔn yii: «Dipibil din bi kūūyee máaǹ bí tīī-dì mpɔn nì tigaajati nì iciin nì jilma nì tinyool nì ipaka.»

english_verse: Then I heard all beings in heaven and on the earth and under the earth and in the sea offer praise. Together, all of them were saying, “Praise, honor, glory, and strength forever and ever to the one who sits on the throne and to the Lamb!”
translation_verse: Niinee ní m gbìl̄ tiwannáaŋkaal tin kɔkɔ bí yilpuee nì tin kɔkɔ bí taapuee nì tin gíti bí kitiŋ taapu taapuee nì tin bí tiŋkunee, tiwannáaŋkaal kɔkɔ bí ki gà ilan yii: «Un kā dibeejal puee nì dipibilee di máaǹ inyɔŋki nì ipaka nì tinyool nì mpɔn kí nīn pée cáa cá jaanjaan.»

english_verse: The four living creatures said “Amen,” while the elders knelt down and worshiped.
translation_verse: Ní tiwan tinaa tin cáá kufoouee kíí yii: «Ameeni!» Ní bikpilibee tātìi gbāaǹ ki nyɔ́ŋkì.

english_verse: At the same time I saw the Lamb open the first of the seven seals, I heard one of the four living creatures shout with a voice like thunder. It said, “Come out!”
translation_verse: M yú ki kpèéyee, ní Dipibil cúú tiwampiiŋkaal tiluli tin bóob́ kugbɔŋuee kubɔ ki bútì, ní m gbìl̄ tiwan tinaa tin cáá kufoouee kansikin kubɔ téeń mpɔn mpɔn kii ntaateenteenee yii: «Dāan̄!»

english_verse: Then I saw a white horse. Its rider carried a bow and was given a crown. He had already won some victories, and he went out to win more.
translation_verse: M kpēēyee, ki ká utampiin, un kā-uee ŋúb́ butɔbu, ní bi cíkiǹ-u kibeefuulii, ní u búntì nì dijajil poon kí já kí jīń.

english_verse: When the Lamb opened the second seal, I heard the second living creature say, “Come out!”
translation_verse: Ní Dipibilee bútì tiwampiiŋkaal kuliliitiiu, ní m gbìl̄ kuwaŋu kun cáá kufoouee kuliliitiiu téeń yii: «Dāan̄!»

english_verse: Then another horse came out. It was fiery red. And its rider was given the power to take away all peace from the earth, so people would slaughter one another. He was also given a big sword.
translation_verse: Niinee ní utaamu ubɔ mun nyánní ki sá uman ní bi pú un kā u-puee mpɔn ú lēē ŋgbansɔŋfi kitiŋ pu binib ń nīn kù tɔb, ní bi dū kitaataajikpaaŋŋi ki tīī-u.

english_verse: When the Lamb opened the third seal, I heard the third living creature say, “Come out!” Then I saw a black horse, and its rider had a balance scale in one hand.
translation_verse: Ní Dipibilee bútì tiwampiiŋkaal kutataatiiu, ní m gbìl̄ kuwaŋu kun cáá kufoouee kutataatiiu téeń yii: «Dāan̄!» M kpēēyee, ki ká utambɔn, un kā-uee ŋúb́ saniya u-ŋaan.

english_verse: I heard what sounded like a voice from somewhere among the four living creatures. It said, “A liter of wheat will cost you a whole day's wages! Three liters of barley will cost you a day's wages too. But don't ruin the olive oil or the wine.”
translation_verse: Ní m gbìl̄ nneen ŋubɔ sòon̄ní tiwan tinaa tin cáá kufoouee kansikin ki lī yii: «Dū saniya kí ŋmàntī bilee kiiloo ubɔ ŋwiin ŋubɔ tundi paati, kí ŋmàntī ɔɔji kiiloo bita ŋwiin ŋubɔ tundi paati. Ama á taa gbēē ŋkpam nì ndaam pu.»

english_verse: When the Lamb opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth living creature say, “Come out!”
translation_verse: Ní Dipibilee tí bútì tiwampiiŋkaal kunanaatiiu ní m gbìl̄ kuwaŋu kun cáá kufoouee kunanaatiiu téeń yii: «Dāan̄!»

english_verse: Then I saw a pale green horse. Its rider was named Death, and Death's Kingdom followed close behind. They were given power over one fourth of the earth, and they could kill its people with swords, famines, diseases, and wild animals.
translation_verse: M kpēēyee, ki ká utaamu un pīiǹ fùuuyee, ní bi yíì un kā-uee yii Ŋkúm ní Ditaŋkpiil nóó-u. Bi nìn tīī-bi mpɔn yii bí dū ntàataajimu nì ŋkùm nì bìlbil kúm kí kpɔ̀ kitiŋ pu nib kɔkɔ yaa yākatì minaayee dijandi diba pu, ní tipeecuncuti tin bí kitiŋ puee ń cūtì binib.

english_verse: When the Lamb opened the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of everyone who had been killed for speaking God's message and telling about their faith.
translation_verse: Ní u cúú tiwampiiŋkaal kuŋmooŋmootiiu ki bútì. M kpēēyee, ki ká nsaraafan ceeyee bin bin nìn sòoǹ Unimbɔti bɔti ki lèekī seerab bi kūū-bee nammu,

english_verse: They shouted, “Master, you are holy and faithful! How long will it be before you judge and punish the people of this earth who killed us?”
translation_verse: ní bi bí ki tátí mpɔn yii: «Ti-Dindaan un sá circir ki sá mbaamɔndaanee, a làá cīití kí tin sāā ŋyunti ŋulɔŋu ní kí sòoǹ duulinya yab bin kūū-tee bɔti kí dáaĺ bi-tafal ní?»

english_verse: Then each of those who had been killed was given a white robe and told to rest for a little while. They had to wait until the complete number of the Lord's other servants and followers would be killed.
translation_verse: Niinee ní bi cáań abɔkutipiin ki pēeǹ bi-kɔkɔ ní ki bí-bi yii bí dá láá kàl̄ kí ŋùŋfì fiii, kí nīn cí ŋyunti ŋun ní bi yaa láa kūū bi-tɔntɔnjutiibi nì bi-nabiyaamu mun kíǹ duulinyan bi mun dɔ́miń ki kútì bi-puee.

english_verse: When I saw the Lamb open the sixth seal, I looked and saw a great earthquake. The sun turned as dark as sackcloth, and the moon became red as blood.
translation_verse: Ní Dipibilee tí cúú tiwampiiŋkaal kululuutiiu ki bútì, ní kitiŋ cīŋkì ŋkpitim pu, ní ŋwìiń fōō ki bɔ̄ntì kii satabɔnee, ní uŋmal mántì cínciŋ kii fatikuee,

english_verse: The stars in the sky fell to earth, just like figs shaken loose by a windstorm.
translation_verse: ní iŋmalbijaa tìfī yilpu ki lítí a lì kii kubuŋkpaaŋŋu nín tìfī asubigaan ki lúkufí puee.

english_verse: Then the sky was rolled up like a scroll, and all mountains and islands were moved from their places.
translation_verse: Ní kutagbɔŋu wáŋkì a lì kii kukampeeu ní bi kpáb́ ki yōoǹee, ní ajoon nì ntimu mun nnyim māntì ki túee kpīkitì.

english_verse: The kings of the earth, its famous people, and its military leaders hid in caves or behind rocks on the mountains. They hid there together with the rich and the powerful and with all the slaves and free people.
translation_verse: Ní duulinya bɔtiibi nì biyidambi nì bisoojakpilib nì bigaajab nì ipɔndambi nì iyumbu nì bin tɔ́ bi-bee, báà ŋma sáń ki bāal̀ afaginni nì titaŋkpanaakɔtin ajoon pu,

english_verse: Then they shouted to the mountains and the rocks, “Fall on us! Hide us from the one who sits on the throne and from the anger of the Lamb.
translation_verse: ní binibee lì ajoon nì ataŋkpee yii: «Lítímaan kí bìin̄ ti-pu, un kā dibeejal puee ń taa ká-ti, Dipibil mun ŋuul ń taa bàń-ti.

english_verse: That terrible day has come! God and the Lamb will show their anger, and who can face it?”
translation_verse: Kun puee ŋwiin ŋun sá diŋuukpaandi wiiŋŋuee bāań. Ŋma di sá-u kí yūĺ?»

english_verse: “Don't harm the earth or the sea or any tree! Wait until I have marked the foreheads of the servants of our God.”
translation_verse: «Ní taa láá ŋá kitiŋ nì tiŋku nì isufi tiba kí nīn cí ŋyunti ŋun ti yaa láa dū tidaandi ki nákáǹ ti-Nimbɔtiu tɔntɔnliibi yigbeeŋi pu ki dóòyee.»

english_verse: and said, “Amen! Praise, glory, wisdom, thanks, honor, power, and strength belong to our God forever and ever! Amen!”
translation_verse: ní ki lì yii: «Ameeni! Ti-Nimbɔtiu di yì inyɔŋki nì jilma nì iciin nì ijaam nì tinyool nì mpɔn kí nīn pée cáa cá jaanjaan! Ameeni.»

english_verse: After this, I saw a large crowd with more people than could be counted. They were from every race, tribe, nation, and language, and they stood before the throne and before the Lamb. They wore white robes and held palm branches in their hands,
translation_verse: Míǹ boonee, m kpēēyee, ní ki ká nnibiim tikpil tikpil, ubɔ kaa ŋūǹ kí kàaǹ-mì. An nìn sá anibul kɔkɔ nì atimbun kɔkɔ nib nì ntimu kɔkɔ nib nì isoon kɔkɔ nib. Bi nìn yú dibeejal nì Dipibil nimbiin ki pēē abɔkutipiin káŋkaŋ ki ŋúb́ tikpakpati bi-ŋaan.

english_verse: as they shouted, “Our God, who sits upon the throne, has the power to save his people, and so does the Lamb.”
translation_verse: Bi nìn tátí mpɔn yii: «Difiil nyēeń ti-Nimbɔtiu un kā dibeejal puee nì Dipibil cee ní.»

english_verse: The angels who stood around the throne knelt in front of it with their faces to the ground. The elders and the four living creatures knelt there with them. Then they all worshiped God
translation_verse: Ní ituun in māntì ki tú dibeejalee, nì bikpilibee nì tiwan tinaa tin cáá kufoouee, tātìi dōoǹ dicincibil dibeejal taapu ní ki bíi nyɔ́ŋkí Unimbɔti,

english_verse: One of the elders asked me, “Do you know who these people are that are dressed in white robes? Do you know where they come from?”
translation_verse: Ní bikpilibee kansikin ubɔ bālifì-mi yii: «Binib bin pēē abɔkutipiin nee sá bilab ní? Bi nyánní la ní?»

english_verse: “Sir,” I answered, “you must know.” Then he told me: “These are the ones who have gone through the great suffering. They have washed their robes in the blood of the Lamb and have made them white.
translation_verse: Ní m kíí-u yii: «M-Dindaan, sii di nyí-bi.» Ní u fātì ki bí-mi yii: «Bin nyánní falaakpaŋkpaan poonee dee. Bíǹ di fíntì bi-bɔkutiŋ ki dū-ŋi ki ŋá Dipibil fatikuun ŋi píil̀ káŋkaŋ.

english_verse: And so they stand before the throne of God and worship him in his temple day and night. The one who sits on the throne will spread his tent over them.
translation_verse: An pu ní bi yú kunimbɔtidiin Unimbɔti beejal nimbiin ki jáaḿ-u ŋwiimpu nì kunyeeu, ní un kā dibeejal puee làá nīn bí bi-cee kí mɔ̄tì bi-pu.

english_verse: They will never hunger or thirst again, and they won't be troubled by the sun or any scorching heat.
translation_verse: Ŋkùm kaa dāa gíti cútí-bi, nnyinnyoo kaa dāa gíti cútí-bi, diwiŋkaŋkambil kaa dāa wù-bi, ní kutuntuŋu kubɔ kaa dāa bí niin.

english_verse: “The Lamb in the center of the throne will be their shepherd. He will lead them to streams of life-giving water, and God will wipe all tears from their eyes.”
translation_verse: Kun puee Dipibil din yú dibeejal kansikinee di dāa sá bi-kpàaliu, ní kí cáá-bi kí cùnnì nnyim min tìì dimaŋfalee laŋki, ní Unimbɔti ń pítí bi-nyinnyim kɔkɔ.»

english_verse: When the Lamb opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about half an hour.
translation_verse: Dipibil bútì tiwampiiŋkaal kululuútiiuee, ní yilpu ŋmíl̀ fɔ́ŋfɔŋ díkí diki ki tin cáa sāā kukúluu dijandi pu.

english_verse: I noticed that the seven angels who stood before God were each given a trumpet.
translation_verse: Ní m ká ituun iluli in yú Unimbɔti nimbiinee, ní bi tīī-i akantán aluli.

english_verse: Another angel, who had a gold container for incense, came and stood at the altar. This one was given a lot of incense to offer with the prayers of God's people on the gold altar in front of the throne.
translation_verse: Ní ntuun ŋubɔ mun dɔ́miń ki yúl̀ nsaraafan cee ki ŋúb́ sindaariya sambiki kin poon bi ŋáań talaalu ki tùutēe. Ní bi tīī-ŋu talaalu tikpil yii ŋú tūū kí kpáaǹ Unimbɔti nib wimmeem kí ŋá saraa kí tīī Unimbɔti, sindaariya saraafaŋŋu ŋun yú dibeejal nimbiinee pu.

english_verse: Then the smoke of the incense, together with the prayers of God's people, went up to God from the hand of the angel.
translation_verse: Ní talaalu un ntuunee tūūyee nyiim yíkí ŋu-ŋaan ki jɔ́ḿ Unimbɔti cee ki kpáaǹ Unimbɔti nib wimmeem.

english_verse: After this, the angel filled the incense container with fire from the altar and threw it on the earth. Thunder roared, lightning flashed, and the earth shook. The Trumpets
translation_verse: Ní ntuunee yōoǹ kisambiki kin poon bi ŋáań talaalu ki tùutēe ní ki pātì ŋŋmi nsaraafan pu ki gbéeǹ ki-poon, ní ki dūu lúkuń duulinyan. Niinee ní m gbìl̄ dibintiŋkpaandi nì ataadun pu, ki ká an bíi ŋmóò kii utaayee ní kitiŋ cīŋkì. Akantán bɔti

english_verse: The seven angels now got ready to blow their trumpets.
translation_verse: Ní ituun iluli in ŋúb́ akantánee bɔ́ntì kí búń i-kantáŋŋi.

english_verse: When the first angel blew his trumpet, hail and fire mixed with blood were thrown down on the earth. A third of the earth, a third of the trees, and a third of all green plants were burned.
translation_verse: Ntuun mpeepeekaa búń ŋu-kantándi ní ataanyiŋkumbil nì ŋŋmi ŋmàl̄ fatiku ki nyánní yilpu ki lítí kitiŋ, ní kitiŋ nín dɔ̄ ki wīikí puee yaa yākatì mitee dijandi lēē ki wùn̄, ní isufi nì timool nín dɔ̄ ki wīikí puee yaa yākatì mitee, an lēē dijandi ki wùn̄.

english_verse: When the second angel blew his trumpet, something like a great fiery mountain was thrown into the sea. A third of the sea turned to blood,
translation_verse: Ní ntuun nliliiti búń ŋu-kantándi, ní an bí kii dijookpaandi di fōō ŋŋmee, ní bi dūu lúkuń tiŋkun, ní tiŋku nín dɔ̄ ki wīikí puee yaa yākatì mitee dijandi kpántì fatiku.

english_verse: a third of the living creatures in the sea died, and a third of the ships were destroyed.
translation_verse: Ní tiwan tin cáá kufoou ki bí tiŋkunee nì ti-nyɔkɔmee yaa yākatì mitee, dijandi lēē ki kpíì poon, ní meelab nì bi-nyɔkɔm bin bí tiŋkunee yaa yākatì mitee, dijandi lēē poon ki nāaǹ.

english_verse: When the third angel blew his trumpet, a great star fell from heaven. It was burning like a torch, and it fell on a third of the rivers and on a third of the springs of water.
translation_verse: Ní ntuun ntataatee búń ŋu-kantándi, ní uŋmalbija ubɔ nyánní yilpu ki wù kii ŋŋminaapoolee ki dɔ́miń ki lítì amɔɔ nì inyimbul yaa yākatì mitee dijandi diba pu.

english_verse: The name of the star was Bitter, and a third of the water turned bitter. Many people died because the water was so bitter.
translation_verse: Inyiŋfi jandi din pu uŋmalbijee lítèe túŋkì ní binib tikpil nyùn̄-mì ní ki kpíì, kun puee mì nìn tū.

english_verse: When the fourth angel blew his trumpet, a third of the sun, a third of the moon, and a third of the stars were struck. They each lost a third of their light. So during a third of the day there was no light, and a third of the night was also without light.
translation_verse: Ní ntuun nnanaatee búń ŋu-kantándi, ní ŋwìiń yaa yākatì mitee, dijandi fōō ki bɔ̄ntì, ní uŋmal yaa yākatì mitee, dijandi fōō ki bɔ̄ntì, ní iŋmalbijaa yaa yākatì mitee, dijandi fōō ki bɔ̄ntì, ní dibɔmbɔndi jéetì kitiŋ pu ŋwiin yaa yākatì mitee dijandi pu, ní uŋmal nì iŋmalbijaa kaa ti ŋmíntí kunyeeu yaa yākatì mitee, dijandi diba pu.

english_verse: Then I looked and saw a lone eagle flying across the sky. It was shouting, “Trouble, trouble, trouble to everyone who lives on earth! The other three angels are now going to blow their trumpets.”
translation_verse: M bí ki kpèéyee, ní ki gbìl̄ ukaalun ubɔ nín ŋàaǹ yilpu yilpu ki tátí mpɔn yii: «Mbusu, mbusu, mbusu gíti dɔ̄ ki cí kitiŋ pu nib ŋyunti ŋun ituun ita in kíǹee yaa láa búń i-kantáŋŋee.»

english_verse: When the fifth angel blew his trumpet, I saw a star fall from the sky to earth. It was given the key to the tunnel that leads down to the deep pit.
translation_verse: Ní ntuun ŋŋmooŋmootee búń ŋu-kantándi, ní m ká uŋmalbija ubɔ nyánní yilpu ki lítì kitiŋ ní bi dū mbookpaan saafiiu ki tīī-u.

english_verse: As it opened the tunnel, smoke poured out like the smoke of a great furnace. The sun and the air turned dark because of the smoke.
translation_verse: Ní u cúú mbookpaanee ki pīitì, ní ŋŋminyiim nyēeń poon tikpil tikpil a lì kii kipaai kikpaŋkpaaŋŋinee, ní ki dūu bīiǹ ŋwìiń pu ki kpáaǹ kubuŋu mun pu.

english_verse: Locusts came out of the smoke and covered the earth. They were given the same power that scorpions have.
translation_verse: Ní inaakitoon nyánní ŋŋminyiimee poon ki kpátìi gbí kitiŋ pu, ní Unimbɔti tīī-i mpɔn í nīn júntí binib án nīn wàlifī kii inoomee.

english_verse: The locusts were told not to harm the grass on the earth or any plant or any tree. They were to punish only those people who did not have God's mark on their foreheads.
translation_verse: U nìn tùkū-i yii í taa jú kumoou, kí taa jú nsuwaamu, kí taa jú isukpaan, ama í nīn pée júntí binib bin kaa cáá Unimbɔti daaŋku bi-yigbeeŋi puee,

english_verse: The locusts were allowed to make them suffer for five months, but not to kill them. The suffering they caused was like the sting of a scorpion.
translation_verse: ní ki bí-i yii í taa nín̄ júntí ki kù binib, ama í nīn júntí-bi bi yáliŋkí áli iŋmal iŋmoo. I-looti weeŋyi sá kii unoom yaa jú unil an nín wù u yáliŋkí puee ní.

english_verse: In those days people will want to die, but they will not be able to. They will hope for death, but it will escape from them.
translation_verse: Iwiin gbantee, binib dāa nyàab̀ ŋkúm ń dāá kpɔ̀-bi, ama baa làá dāá ká-mì. Ŋkúm ní bi dāa néeń, ama ní ŋkúm ń dāá sāǹ kí wàatī-bi.

english_verse: These locusts looked like horses ready for battle. On their heads they wore something like gold crowns, and they had human faces.
translation_verse: Inaakitoonee bimbim náań nì kii itaamu in bi bɔ́ntì i cá kujaauee ní, ní i cáá tiba i-yiliŋ pu an náań nì sindaariya beefuuliiki, ní i-nimbiin náań nì binib nimbiin,

english_verse: Their hair was like a woman's long hair, and their teeth were like those of a lion.
translation_verse: ní i-yikpiti fɔ̀kɔ̀ kii binimpoobi yikpitee ní i-nyiŋŋi náań nì gbikinti nyiŋŋi.

english_verse: On their chests they wore armor made of iron. Their wings roared like an army of horse-drawn chariots rushing into battle.
translation_verse: Ní i cáá ajanjabɔkuti i-biŋŋi pu an náań nì tikúti. I yaa ŋàaǹee, i-feeŋyi bintindi bí kii itaamu kupaau nín dátí tɔrɔkub ki sáń ki jáà kujaau puee bintindi ní.

english_verse: Their tails were like a scorpion's tail with a stinger that had the power to hurt someone for five months.
translation_verse: I-juuŋi nì i-looti bí kii inoomee ní i cáa júntí binib kí tin cáá sāā iŋmal iŋmoo.

english_verse: Their king was the angel in charge of the deep pit. In Hebrew his name was Abaddon, and in Greek it was Apollyon.
translation_verse: Inaakitoon gbanti bɔtiu di sá ntuun ŋun kā kubookpaaŋŋun bi yíì-ŋu eebru sooŋyin yii «Abadɔn», ní greeki sooŋyin yii «Apooliyɔn», an taapu sá yii «Un nàantée».

english_verse: The first horrible thing has now happened! But wait. Two more horrible things will happen soon.
translation_verse: Mbusupeepeekaa dɔ́miń ki ŋá ki jítì, an kíǹ mbusub bili mun ń dāan̄ dee.

english_verse: Then the sixth angel blew his trumpet. I heard a voice speak from the four corners of the gold altar that stands in the presence of God.
translation_verse: Ní ntuun nluluuti búń ŋu-kantándi, ní m gbìl̄ nneen ŋubɔ nyánní iyin inaa in nìn cɔ́ sindaariya saraafaŋŋu ŋun yú Unimbɔti nimbiinee ni.

english_verse: The voice spoke to this angel and said, “Release the four angels who are tied up beside the great Euphrates River.”
translation_verse: Ní nneenee lī ntuun nluluuti ŋun ŋúb́ dikantándee yii: «Cùú gbìntī ituun inaa in bi bóob́ i kā dimɔɔl din bi yíì Eefiraatee kí líí.»

english_verse: The four angels had been prepared for this very hour and day and month and year. Now they were set free to kill a third of all people.
translation_verse: Ní bi gíiǹ ituun inaa in bɔ́ntì ki cí i-kúluku nì i-wiiŋŋu nì i-ŋmaliu nì i-bindi din bi làá líí-i í lēē duulinya poon binib yaa yākatì mitee diba pu kí kpɔ̀ee ki líì ŋyunti ŋun bi yóoǹee deedee.

english_verse: By listening, I could tell there were more than
translation_verse: Ní m gbìl̄ bi lī yii i-soojab bin kā itaamu puee sá miiliyɔmbi kulaafaau ní.

english_verse: In my vision their riders wore fiery-red, dark-blue, and yellow armor on their chests. The heads of the horses looked like lions, with fire and smoke and sulfur coming out of their mouths.
translation_verse: M nín ká i-soojab bin kā itaamu puee nín bí puee sèé: bi-janjabɔkutiŋ máǹ kii ŋŋmee, ní iba yaŋ jìl̀ kii ataŋkpamɔnti ŋin bi yíì iyasintee, ní iba yaŋ bɔ̀ǹ kii kunaaluŋuee, ní iba yaŋ bí kii kpalkuee. Itaamu yiliŋ bí kii gbikinti yilee, ní ŋŋmi nì nnyiim nì farwata nyēē i-nyɔmmun.

english_verse: One third of all people were killed by the three terrible troubles caused by the fire, the smoke, and the sulfur.
translation_verse: Ŋŋmi nì nnyiim nì farwata un nyēē i-nyɔmmunee di sá ditafadaaldi din bi dūu kūū duulinya nib yaa yākatì mitee dijandi dibee.

english_verse: The horses had powerful mouths, and their tails were like poisonous snakes that bite and hurt.
translation_verse: Di sá itaamuee pɔŋŋu kā i-nyɔmmun nì i-juuŋin ní, ní i-juuŋi náań nì ikoobu, ní i cáá ayil. An ní i cáa ŋáań binib asaluu.

english_verse: The people who lived through these terrible troubles did not turn away from the idols they had made, and they did not stop worshiping demons. They kept on worshiping idols that were made of gold, silver, bronze, stone, and wood. Not one of these idols could see, hear, or walk.
translation_verse: Binib bin kíǹ, ditafadaaldee kaa kūūyee, baa dū bíǹ bi-ba nín ŋá tiŋyee ki fá, bi gbíntì ki jáaḿ arasiniibi nì awaa ŋin bi dū sindaariya nì animbil kúti nì tasa kúti ki mɔ́ɔ́yee, awaa ŋin sá ataŋkpee nì isufee. Tiwan gbanti kaa wāĺ, kaa gbìl̄, kaa ŋūǹ kí còom̀ mun.

english_verse: No one stopped murdering or practicing witchcraft or being immoral or stealing.
translation_verse: Baa dū bi-nikpaakooŋu, nì bi-nyɔɔjil, nì bi-laakpaati nì bi-naayufii ki fá.

english_verse: I saw another powerful angel come down from heaven. This one was covered with a cloud, and a rainbow was over his head. His face was like the sun, his legs were like columns of fire,
translation_verse: Boonee ní m ká ntuun ŋubɔ ŋun cáá mpɔnee nyánní yilpu ki kpákatiń, ní ditagbandi bīī ŋu-pu ní dikuntinyindi māntì ki tú ŋu-yil, ní ŋu-nimbiin jìliŋkī kii ŋwìińee, ní ŋu-taaŋi bí kii ŋŋmipiinee,

english_verse: and with his hand he held a little scroll that had been unrolled. He stood there with his right foot on the sea and his left foot on the land.
translation_verse: ní ŋu ŋúb́ kigbambiki kiba, kì kpátì ki kā ŋu-ŋaan. U nìn dū u-ŋaŋgiitaal ki tɔ́kɔ́ǹ tiŋku pu, ní ki dū u-ŋaŋgantaal ki tɔ́kɔ́ǹ kitiŋ pu.

english_verse: Then he shouted with a voice that sounded like a growling lion. Thunder roared seven times.
translation_verse: Ní ŋu téeń mpɔn a lì kii gbikinti di súń ní. Niinee ní itaatantati iluli bíi tátí.

english_verse: After the thunder stopped, I was about to write what it had said. But a voice from heaven shouted, “Keep it secret! Don't write these things.”
translation_verse: Ŋyunti ŋun m bàà là kí ŋmà itaatantatee nín sòon̄ puee ní m gbìl̄ nneen ŋubɔ sòon̄ní yilpu yii: «Á dū itaatantati ilulee bɔti kí dūú kpāafì, á taa dūú ŋmà.»

english_verse: The angel I had seen standing on the sea and the land then held his right hand up toward heaven.
translation_verse: Ní ntuun ŋun m bàà ká ŋu-taal diba tɔ́kɔ́ tiŋku pu, din kíǹee kitiŋ puee, yōoǹ ŋu-ŋaŋgiil ki túĺ kutaa,

english_verse: He made a promise in the name of God who lives forever and who created heaven, earth, the sea, and every living creature. The angel said, “You won't have to wait any longer.
translation_verse: ní ki pūtì un bí kí nīn cá jaanjaan ki náań yilpu nì tin kɔkɔ bí yilpuee, ki náań kitiŋ nì tin kɔkɔ bí kitiŋ puee, ki náań tiŋku nì tin kɔkɔ bí tiŋkunee yii: «Unimbɔti kaa làá ti yóoń ŋyunti ŋubɔ!

english_verse: God told his secret plans to his servants the prophets, and it will all happen by the time the seventh angel sounds his trumpet.”
translation_verse: Ŋyunti ŋun ní ntuun nluluútee làá dāá búń dikantándee, ŋyunti gbantee ní tin nìn bí dibalin Unimbɔti yāntì u-tɔntɔnliibi bin sá u-bɔnaatiliibee sòon̄ee làá ŋá.»

english_verse: Once again the voice from heaven spoke to me. It said, “Go and take the open scroll from the hand of the angel standing on the sea and the land.”
translation_verse: Ní nneen ŋun bàà nyánní yilpu ki sòon̄ nì mee gíti bí-mi yii: «Cù ntuun ŋun yú ŋu-taal diba tɔ́kɔ́ tiŋku pu, din kíǹee tɔ́kɔ́ kitiŋ puee cee kí fōō kigbambiki kin kpátì ki kā ŋu-ŋaanee.»

english_verse: When I went over to ask the angel for the little scroll, the angel said, “Take the scroll and eat it! Your stomach will turn sour, but the taste in your mouth will be sweet as honey.”
translation_verse: Ní m cūtì ntuunee cee ki mēē-ŋu ŋú dū kigbambikee kí tīī-mi. Ní ŋu bí-mi yii: «Fōō kí dūú ŋmɔ́, kì làá nīn mɔ̄ a-nyɔkɔn kii tisiilee ní, ama ní kí tin nín̄ tū a-poon.»

english_verse: I took the little scroll from the hand of the angel and ate it. The taste was sweet as honey, but my stomach turned sour.
translation_verse: Ní m fōō kigbambikee ntuun cee ki dūu ŋmɔ́. M nín bíi ŋmóòyee, an mɔ̄ m-nyɔkɔn kii tisiilee ní, ama m nín dūu náĺee ní an túŋkì m-poon.

english_verse: Then some voices said, “Keep on telling what will happen to the people of many nations, races, and languages, and also to kings.”
translation_verse: Ní ŋu bí-mi yii: «An sá á gíti sòoǹ tin bí ki dòońee kí tùkù binib tikpil, nì atimbun nì isoon kɔkɔ nib nì bibɔtiibi ní.»

english_verse: But don't measure the courtyard outside the temple building. Leave it out. It has been given to those people who don't know God, and they will trample all over the holy city for
translation_verse: Ní bi gíti bí-mi yii: «Yàntī, taa ŋmàntī kunimbɔtidii cindi din bí mmɔŋki púee, kun puee bi dū niin ki tīī atimbun ŋin kaa nyí Unimbɔtee ní. Bíǹ di làá tāā circir tiŋki pùb kí tin sāā abin ata nì dijandi.

english_verse: My two witnesses will wear sackcloth, while I let them preach for
translation_verse: M-seeradambi bin m làá dāá tɔ̄ńee dāa pēē kutukub ní ki sòoǹ m-bɔti kí tin sāā abin ata nì dijandi.»

english_verse: These two witnesses are the two olive trees and the two lampstands that stand in the presence of the Lord who rules the earth.
translation_verse: M-seeraleeliibi gbantee di sá ɔliifi sufii ili nì fitilab bili bin yú ti-Dindaan un yì kitiŋee nimbiinee.

english_verse: Any enemy who tries to harm them will be destroyed by the fire that comes out of their mouths.
translation_verse: Ubɔ yaa là kí bīil̀-bee, ŋŋmi ŋubɔ làá nyānní bi-nyɔmmun ní kí wà bi-nannanliibi. Un nyàab̀ kí bīil̀-bee nín làá dāá kpú miŋyee dee.

english_verse: They have the power to lock up the sky and to keep rain from falling while they are prophesying. And whenever they want to, they can turn water to blood and cause all kinds of terrible troubles on earth.
translation_verse: Bi cáá mpɔn kí pìin̄ kutagbɔŋu iwiin in bi làá dūú sòoǹ Unimbɔti bɔtee utaa ń taa jōō kitiŋ pu, ki cáá mpɔn kí yàntī nnyim ń kpántí fatiku, ki tí cáá mpɔn kí yàntī animbinaaman nín bí tɔbin puee ń jēetí kitiŋ pu ŋyunti ŋun kamaa bi yaa lèe.

english_verse: After the two witnesses have finished preaching God's message, the beast that lives in the deep pit will come up and fight against them. It will win the battle and kill them.
translation_verse: Bi yaa láa sòon̄ Unimbɔti bɔti ki dóòyee, upeel un bí mbookpaannee làá dāá nyānní kí jáǹ-bi ní kí pɔ̄ɔkiǹ-bi ní kí kpɔ̀-bi.

english_verse: Their bodies will be left lying in the streets of the same great city where their Lord was nailed to a cross. And this city is spiritually like the city of Sodom or the country of Egypt.
translation_verse: U yaa kūū-bee, anikpilee làá gbíntí ki dɔ̄ kitiŋkpaaŋŋi gbanti daŋŋi pu. Kitiŋkpaaŋŋee ní bi dū ki nántiǹ Soodoom nì Eejipiti. Kitiŋ gbanti kibaantii poon ní bi kpáá bi-Dindaan ndɔpuntikaa pu.

english_verse: For three and a half days the people of every nation, tribe, language, and race will stare at the bodies of these two witnesses and refuse to let them be buried.
translation_verse: Anibul kɔkɔ nì atimbun kɔkɔ nì isoon kɔkɔ nib làá dāá dāan̄ kí kpèè anikpil gbanti kí tin sāā iwiin ita nì dijandi. Baa làá dāá pɔ̄ nsan bí síb́-bi.

english_verse: Everyone on earth will celebrate and be happy. They will give gifts to each other, because of what happened to the two prophets who caused them so much trouble.
translation_verse: Bi-kúm gbanti puee, an dāa sá duulinya yab kɔkɔ jiŋaal ní, ní bi fàal̀ ki pūǹ tɔb tiwan. Kun pu an dāa mɔ̄ǹ-bi mimmee di sá Unimbɔti bɔnaatiliibi bili gbantee nìn kɔ́ǹ-bi dinimbinaamandin.

english_verse: But three and a half days later, God will breathe life into their bodies. They will stand up, and everyone who sees them will be terrified.
translation_verse: Ama iwiin ita nì dijandee boonee, Unimbɔti yāntì kufoou kubɔ dɔ́miń ki kɔ́ bi-ni, ní bi fīkitì, ní tifaandi cúú bin yú ki kpèé-bee.

english_verse: The witnesses then heard a loud voice from heaven, saying, “Come up here.” And while their enemies were watching, they were taken up to heaven in a cloud.
translation_verse: Bi yáatìi yúl̀ee ní ki gbìl̄ nneen ŋubɔ sòon̄ní yilpu mpɔn yii: «Jɔ̄mìḿmaan doo!» Bi-nannanliibi yú ki kpèé-bi míǹ ní bi yíkìi nín jɔ́ḿ yilpu ki tin kɔ́ atagbanni.

english_verse: At that same moment there was a terrible earthquake that destroyed a tenth of the city. Seven thousand people were killed, and the rest were frightened and praised the God who rules in heaven.
translation_verse: Dicilpu niinee, kitiŋ cīŋkì ŋkpitim pu. Bi yaa yākatì kitiŋ gbanti diiŋŋi saalaa puee, diba pu lēē ki lítì ní binib kutukub biluli kpíì. Ní tifaandi kɔ́ bin kíǹ kaa kpíìyee, ní bi bí ki nyɔ́ŋkí Unimbɔti un yì yilpuee.

english_verse: At the sound of the seventh trumpet, loud voices were heard in heaven. They said, “Now the kingdom of this world belongs to our Lord and to his Chosen One! And he will rule forever and ever!”
translation_verse: Ntuun nluluútee búń ŋu-kantándee, ní ineen kupaau sòon̄ní yilpu mpɔn yii: «Duulinya beel kpántì ti-Dindaan nì u-Meesiyau Beel ní kɔŋkɔnnee. Úǹ di làá nīn pée kā di-pu kí nīn cá jaanjaan.»

english_verse: They said, “Lord God All-Powerful, you are and you were, and we thank you. You used your great power and started ruling.
translation_verse: ki lì yii: «Ti-Dindaan Unimbɔti Mpɔŋkɔdaan, sii un nìn bí ki gbíntì ki bée, ti jáam̀-si a nín dàkā a-pɔŋkpaaŋŋu ki jíń dibeelee pu.

english_verse: When the nations got angry, you became angry too! Now the time has come for the dead to be judged. It is time for you to reward your servants the prophets and all your people who honor your name, no matter who they are. It is time to destroy everyone who has destroyed the earth.”
